bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: 1910 Genetics
providers.description: 1910 Genetics (now branded 1910) is an AI-native biotechnology company advancing small and large molecule drug discovery with a multimodal AI platform powered by high-throughput laboratory automation. Its ITO platform integrates computational data, wet-lab proxy biological data, and wet-lab ground-truth biological data to pursue "modality agnostic" drug discovery, alongside named AI models including PEGASUS (macrocyclic peptide discovery) and CANDID-CNS (CNS-penetration prediction). The company partners with pharma and technology organizations and offers co-engineering collaborations at the data, AI-model, compute, and interactive-tool levels. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Playground Global. As of this profile the company publishes no public API, SDK, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: 5B Australia
providers.description: 5B is an Australian cleantech manufacturer that builds prefabricated, pre-wired ground-mount solar technology for utility-scale, mining, industrial and remote-community power projects. Founded in Sydney in 2013 by solar engineers Chris McGrath and Eden Tehan, the company designs and manufactures the 5B Maverick, an accordion-folded east-west solar array that is assembled in a factory and unfolded on site in under an hour rather than built panel by panel, cutting on-site labour by roughly 80% and roughly doubling energy yield per hectare compared with single-axis trackers. 5B manufactures in Adelaide, South Australia, with a global assembly model, and has deployed projects across Australia, the United States, Panama, Puerto Rico, El Salvador and Chile. 5B is a hardware and deployment-services company: as of this profile it publishes no developer portal, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract on any host it controls.

providers.name: Aerem
providers.description: Aerem is a Mumbai-based "FinTech for CleanTech" group that finances, supplies and monitors rooftop solar in India. The group comprises Aerem Solutions Private Limited, NetZero Finance Private Limited — an RBI-licensed, solar-focused NBFC — and Sunstore Solar Private Limited. Aerem underwrites collateral-free rooftop solar loans for MSMEs and homeowners, provides supply chain finance to solar EPC installers, runs the SunStore B2B solar equipment marketplace, and operates AeROC, an inverter-agnostic remote monitoring portal for installed plants. It also ships two mobile products — the Aerem App for borrowers and the Aerem Partner App for installers — and an AAA (Aerem Asset Assurance) quality-certification programme for EPCs. Aerem publishes a machine-readable llms.txt and five first-party npm packages, but no public API, developer portal or machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Agile Medical
providers.description: Agile Medical — 敏捷医疗科技（苏州）有限公司, trading under the AGIBOT brand — is a Chinese surgical robotics manufacturer founded in September 2020 and headquartered in Suzhou, Jiangsu, with R&D offices in the Suzhou Industrial Park Dushu Lake innovation district and Shanghai Zhangjiang. Its flagship AGIBOT endoscopic (laparoscopic) surgical robot system pairs a surgeon console, an eight-degree-of-freedom patient-side platform and an imaging processing platform that ingests third-party ultrasound, CT and endoscopic sources. The system received NMPA Class III medical device approval in March 2025 and is in clinical use for minimally invasive urology, gynecology, general, hepatobiliary and thoracic procedures. The company closed a several-hundred-million-RMB Series B in October 2025. It sells regulated capital equipment to hospitals and publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Aitomatic
providers.description: Aitomatic, Inc. (Palo Alto, CA) builds DanaOS, an operating system for industrial AI. DanaOS is a governed, neurosymbolic, self-improving platform that runs autonomous AI agents inside a customer's own boundary — for semiconductor fabs, building and process operations, energy grids, and heavy industry. It combines neural flexibility with symbolic precision: a Sector Ontology encodes domain expertise as executable knowledge, Small Specialist Agents (SSAs) reason over it in a See-Think-Act-Reflect loop, and a governance substrate (the Dana Ontologist) verifies every action against ontology and policy before it commits — all deployable on-prem and air-gapped. Aitomatic is a founding member of the AI Alliance and publishes the open-source Dana agent-native language, the OpenSSA framework, and SemiKong, the first open-source semiconductor-industry LLM. Founded by Christopher Nguyen (CEO).

providers.name: Alembic
providers.description: Alembic offers an enterprise causal AI platform that models cause‑and‑effect across marketing, sales, pricing, supply and operations. It provides decision‑grade intelligence for CEOs, CFOs, COOs, CMOs and other senior leaders, enabling real‑time simulation of strategic choices and proof of what drives growth.

providers.name: Arthanfinance
providers.description: Arthanfinance is an Indian fintech platform focused on providing small business loans and financial services. It aims to empower entrepreneurs by offering quick loan disbursement, with over 600 crore rupees disbursed and more than 150,000 lives impacted. The company emphasizes digital solutions, partnerships with government bodies, and a growing ecosystem of products and services for SMEs.

providers.name: ARX Robotics
providers.description: ARX Robotics is a European defense technology company building autonomous unmanned ground systems and the software that runs them. Its flagship Mithra OS is an AI-driven autonomy platform that turns legacy and modern military vehicles into software-defined, autonomous units, while its Gereon RCS line delivers scalable robotic ground vehicles for reconnaissance, firepower, clearance, surveillance, cargo, and casualty evacuation across defense and commercial missions. Headquartered in Munich with offices in Berlin, the UK, and Ukraine, ARX operates one of Europe's largest autonomous defense systems production facilities and has delivered unmanned ground systems to Ukraine. The company is venture-backed (a €31M Series A extended by €11M, with HV Capital among its investors) and partners with RENK, DEUTZ, Helsing, and Quantum Systems to strengthen Europe's technological resilience and defense sovereignty. ARX publishes no public developer API; this profile captures the company's public web presence and an llms.txt it publishes for AI agents.

providers.name: Asiayo
providers.description: AsiaYo is a global travel platform offering bookings for hotels, tours, sports activities, and transportation. It provides a marketplace for travelers to discover and reserve accommodations, group tours, cruises, and day trips worldwide, with multilingual support and member discounts.

providers.name: Asilla
providers.description: We are a global company that independently develops world‑class behavior recognition AI. AJIRA’s “Behavior Recognition AI” builds a friendly environment for all people and realizes a safe and secure world.

providers.name: BabyCenter
providers.description: BabyCenter is an online pregnancy and parenting media company founded in 1997 and operated today by Everyday Health Group, a division of Ziff Davis. It provides medically reviewed information and interactive tools covering conception, pregnancy, birth, and early childhood development, and publishes the widely used "My Pregnancy & Baby Today" mobile app for iOS and Android used by hundreds of millions of expecting and new parents worldwide. BabyCenter operates as a content and community destination rather than an API platform: it does not publish a public developer program, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or hosted API, and its verified GitHub organization contains only forked iOS libraries. This API Evangelist profile captures the company's public operational surface — domain security posture, a live RFC 9116 security.txt with a Ziff Davis Bugcrowd vulnerability disclosure program, and its editorial/legal properties.

providers.name: Betidigitalservices
providers.description: Beta Digital Services is a technology and digital marketing firm based in India, offering a wide range of services including marketplace management, e‑commerce marketing, social media advertising, web development, and AI‑powered digital solutions. Founded in 2018, the company serves brands across major Indian marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, and Myntra, helping them grow through product onboarding, catalog management, advertising, and analytics. The team combines strategy, creativity, and technology to deliver scalable solutions for businesses seeking to expand their online presence.

providers.name: Biobotsurgicalpteltd
providers.description: Biobot Surgical Pte Ltd is a Singapore‑based medical technology company focused on robotic‑assisted prostate biopsy and treatment solutions. Their flagship Mona Lisa system provides sub‑millimetre accuracy for transperineal procedures, aiming to improve cancer detection and patient outcomes. With regulatory clearances across the US, EU, China and Australia, the company reports over 23,000 procedures performed worldwide and a growing pipeline of new indications and digital health services.

providers.name: Boldr
providers.description: Boldr is a Techstars-backed consumer hardware company building energy-saving smart home climate control devices. Its two products are Kelvin, a smart infrared heater, and Klima, a smart thermostat controller for mini-split air conditioners that also monitors appliance health so units last longer with fewer issues. Both devices are managed through the Boldr mobile app, which lets homeowners control climate settings remotely and track energy usage to lower utility bills. Boldr also runs Boldr Pro, a program for HVAC contractors. The company sells direct to consumers through a Shopify-hosted online store at shopboldr.com and does not currently publish a first-party developer API; its only public machine-readable surface is the Shopify Customer Account OIDC discovery served at the storefront host.

providers.name: Bowery Valuation
providers.description: Bowery Valuation is a New York-headquartered, technology-enabled commercial real estate appraisal firm that pairs state-certified appraisers with a proprietary cloud platform for comparable-sales research, rent-roll and income analysis, mobile property inspection capture, adjustment grids, narrative report components and XML report generation. The firm appraises multifamily, mixed-use, office, retail, industrial, self-storage, condo/co-op, affordable housing, land and ground-up construction assets across all 50 U.S. states for banks, agency (Fannie Mae / Freddie Mac) lenders, funds and private lenders. The appraisal platform is used internally by Bowery's own appraisers rather than sold or exposed as a developer product; the company publishes no public API, SDK or developer portal, and directs external technology interest to enterprise partnership conversations.

providers.name: Boxhub
providers.description: Boxhub provides new and used shipping containers for individuals and businesses, offering a wide range of container types including standard, refrigerated, and specialty containers. With a focus on fast delivery, transparent pricing, and a 30‑day money‑back guarantee, Boxhub serves industries such as agriculture, construction, logistics, and hospitality, helping customers store, move, and ship goods efficiently.

providers.name: Branch International
providers.description: Branch International offers a smartphone‑based finance app that provides digital banking products such as instant loans, money transfers, bill payment, high‑yield investments, savings accounts, and a debit card for payments and ATM withdrawals. The service is aimed at consumers in emerging markets, primarily across Africa and India, and is delivered through a mobile‑only platform.

providers.name: Brite
providers.description: Brite is a white-label learning management system (LMS) platform for STEM education, giving educators, academies, and learning centers a single operational tool to run computer-science programs in game and web development. It bundles a ready-made curriculum, classroom and roster management, student progress reporting, and teacher accounts, replacing spreadsheets and disparate software with one branded platform. Brite is offered on free, per-student Professional, and custom school/district tiers. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Bunch
providers.description: Bunch is a Berlin-based financial technology company building AI-native infrastructure for private markets. Its all-in-one platform combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows, and expert fund services so venture capital and private equity funds and investors can seamlessly transact, close, and securely operate — spanning fund administration, SPV and vehicle setup, investor onboarding and KYC, capital calls, and reporting. Bunch was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Northzone and profiled into the API Evangelist network. Bunch operates a private, customer-facing product at app.bunch.capital and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Califia Farms
providers.description: Califia Farms, LLC is a Los Angeles, California based plant-based beverage company founded in 2010 by Greg Steltenpohl and named for the mythical Queen Califia. It manufactures and distributes non-dairy oatmilks, almondmilks and organic soymilks, coffee creamers, barista blends, cold brew coffees and teas, and ready-to-drink creamy refreshers, sold through grocery retail, foodservice distribution and direct-to-consumer channels across North America and Europe. Its public web presence is a marketing, recipe and where-to-buy site built on Gatsby and hosted on Netlify; the company publishes no developer program, no API documentation, and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: CargoWise
providers.description: CargoWise is WiseTech Global's logistics execution platform - a single-database ERP for international freight forwarding, customs, warehousing, transport, and landside logistics. Its integration surface is delivered primarily through eAdaptor, which pairs a RESTful XML inbound service (push, query, add, and update records) with a SOAP-based outbound service (a webhook equivalent that emits messages on milestones). Payloads use CargoWise's Universal XML schemas - Universal Shipment (XUS), Universal Event (XUE), and Universal Transaction - or the legacy Native XML format. Newer REST integration (eAdaptor Next / xHub) adds OAuth 2.0 authorization-code access. The integration API is real but heavily gated - the eAdaptor Developers Guide and endpoint details are released only after a customer purchases the eAdaptor modules, and partner access runs through WiseTech accreditation and certification. Endpoints below are modeled from public developer references; the authoritative specification is not publicly published.

providers.name: Chimney Trail Health
providers.description: Chimney Trail Health provides evidence‑based mental health and cognitive‑defense training for high‑pressure environments. Their programs serve U.S. military, corporate teams, and elite performers, offering in‑person training, self‑led tools, and scalable solutions backed by scientific research. The company focuses on building resilience, improving psychological literacy, and delivering measurable performance benefits for organizations facing critical challenges.

providers.name: Choose Energy
providers.description: Choose Energy is a free online energy marketplace, founded in 2008 and operated by Red Ventures, that helps consumers and businesses in deregulated U.S. energy markets compare electricity and natural gas plans, view transparent all-inclusive pricing, and switch providers online in minutes. The platform serves customers across Texas, Pennsylvania, Ohio, Illinois, New Jersey, New York, Maryland, Massachusetts, Connecticut, and other deregulated states, and also offers solar cost estimation, business energy procurement, and educational energy resources. Choose Energy is a consumer-facing web marketplace and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Clair
providers.description: Clair Inc is a New York-based financial technology company that provides free, compliant On-Demand Pay (earned wage access) as an embedded service inside the payroll, time-and-attendance and workforce-management platforms employees already use. Rather than selling a consumer app, Clair partners with platforms — Gusto Embedded Payroll, Check, 7shifts and others — and connects to them over a partner REST API that transmits employee, employment and attendance data, which Clair's underwriting engine uses to originate 0% APR earned wage advances through its FDIC-insured partner bank, Pathward N.A. Partners embed a Clair-hosted user experience (a WebView component, distributed for iOS as Swift packages) so employees can take an advance, review history and handle loan servicing without a separate login. Clair has raised roughly $218M in total capital, including a $23.2M Series B in May 2025.

providers.name: Clearcover
providers.description: Clearcover is a digital-first auto insurance company that offers customizable, affordable car insurance backed by AI-assisted claims that can resolve eligible claims in minutes rather than days. Customers buy and manage policies through a mobile app, file claims by photographing damage, and track claim status in real time, with coverage spanning liability, comprehensive and collision, medical payments, uninsured/underinsured motorist protection, roadside assistance, and alternate transportation. Clearcover operates across multiple US states through several underwriting entities, distributes through both direct and independent-agent channels, and runs a developer portal for partner and embedded insurance integrations. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched from its public web surface.

providers.name: Cloverpop
providers.description: Cloverpop provides an Enterprise Decision Intelligence Platform that combines AI, human expertise, and business processes to accelerate and improve decision-making across organizations. Their solutions include Decision Intelligence Platform, CloverPlan Forecasting, D‑Sight™, and Decision‑Back™ Transformation, helping enterprises achieve faster decisions, higher ROI, and resilient operations.

providers.name: Cobalt AI
providers.description: Cobalt AI (formerly Cobalt Robotics) is a San Francisco based physical security automation company whose Cobalt Monitoring Intelligence platform uses AI handlers to investigate security events across access control systems and video feeds, determine root cause, and trigger automated responses so security teams focus on genuine threats instead of alarm triage. Its offerings include the Cobalt Command Center remote monitoring service and an indoor autonomous security robot, with integrations spanning LenelS2, Genetec, Avigilon, Brivo, Eagle Eye Networks, Milestone, Okta, ServiceNow, Salesforce, and Slack. The company was founded in 2016, backed early by Bloomberg Beta and Sequoia, and acquired in 2024 by Dean Drako, who rebranded it to Cobalt AI.

providers.name: Contentguru
providers.description: Content Guru is a global provider of cloud‑based Customer Experience (CX) solutions, founded in 2005 and serving enterprises in over 60 countries. The company offers the Storm CX platform, AI‑driven conversational tools, and integration services that help organisations improve customer satisfaction, automate processes, and leverage generative AI. Content Guru’s portfolio includes the brain® AI suite and the Storm® CX cloud, supporting industries such as finance, healthcare, utilities, and public sector. The firm emphasizes compliance, data security, and scalable cloud communications.

providers.name: Creditas
providers.description: Creditas is a Brazilian digital lending fintech founded in 2012 and headquartered in Sao Paulo, operating in Brazil and Mexico. It provides secured consumer credit - loans backed by real estate (home equity) and vehicles, plus private payroll (consignado privado) loans - alongside auto insurance, multi-bank real estate and vehicle financing, and a corporate benefits platform (salary advance, flexible-benefits cards, and financial education). Regulated by the Banco Central do Brasil, Creditas has originated over R$12 billion in credit. It is backed by QED Investors and the SoftBank Vision Fund. No public developer API program or OpenAPI has been identified; this profile captures the company public identity, its published llms.txt, and its domain security posture.

providers.name: Descartes Underwriting
providers.description: Descartes Underwriting is a Paris-headquartered insurtech, founded in 2019, specializing in parametric insurance for climate, natural-catastrophe, cyber, and emerging corporate risks. It operates two complementary entities — Descartes Underwriting, a global parametric managing general agent (MGA), and Descartes Insurance, an ACPR-licensed European full-stack carrier — using AI, satellite imagery, IoT sensor data, and scientific risk models to structure index-based covers that pay out automatically within days when a predefined trigger is met, without a traditional claims-adjustment process. Backed by Battery Ventures and other investors, the company serves 600+ large corporations and public entities through corporate brokers across 20+ offices worldwide. No public developer API or documentation is published; the company distributes coverage through brokers rather than a self-serve API surface.

providers.name: Digital Diagnostics
providers.description: Digital Diagnostics is a healthcare AI company based in Coralville, Iowa, founded by Dr. Michael Abramoff. It builds autonomous artificial-intelligence diagnostic systems that make a medical diagnosis at the point of care without requiring a physician to interpret the result. Its flagship product, LumineticsCore (formerly IDx-DR), was the first FDA-cleared autonomous AI diagnostic system and detects diabetic retinopathy from fundus images in about 30 seconds, reimbursed under CPT code 92229 and integrated with EHR systems such as Epic. A companion product, SphereDx, provides securely hosted diagnostic result management. The company is a portfolio company of 8vc and is researching additional indications including glaucoma, age-related macular degeneration, cardiovascular, and neurodegenerative disease detection via retinal imaging. Digital Diagnostics emphasizes ethical, equitable AI ("AI the right way") and holds ISO 13485:2016 quality-management certification. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Dreambound
providers.description: Dreambound is a career and technical education marketplace that helps job seekers discover, compare, and enroll in vocational training programs across healthcare, technology, business, and the skilled trades. The platform aggregates thousands of schools and hundreds of programs, letting students filter by location, schedule, format (online, hybrid, or in person), and price, with enrollment coaches guiding them into certifications such as certified nursing assistant, medical billing, phlebotomy, and sterile processing. The service is free for students and monetizes through schools and workforce partners who list and advertise their programs. Backed by Union Square Ventures, Collaborative Fund, and 8VC, Dreambound is added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it does not currently publish a public developer program, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Earnix
providers.description: Earnix provides an AI orchestration system (Earnix AIOS) purpose-built for insurance and banking decisioning. The platform unifies pricing, an enterprise rating engine, automated underwriting, and real-time customer engagement so insurers and financial institutions can price smarter, underwrite faster, and engage customers better. Earnix serves 100+ leading insurers worldwide, processing billions of transactions annually and compressing rate creation from months to days. Earnix is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Earnix is an enterprise B2B vendor with no public self-serve developer portal or API documentation.

providers.name: Elephant Healthcare
providers.description: Elephant Healthcare is a global health-technology company, headquartered in the UK, that partners with governments to digitise and strengthen public health systems across Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia. Its flagship product, ElephantOS, is a mobile- and offline-first electronic health record (EHR) that streamlines clinical workflows for primary and secondary care facilities, serving over 19 million contracted patients across Nigeria, Kenya and Pakistan. The company also builds Elephant Nudge, a clinical co-pilot that guides and rewards quality of care, and Elephant Platform, an emerging AI-driven marketplace that connects clinicians to third-party healthcare software, medical devices and supply-chain partners. Elephant is backed by General Catalyst and Seedcamp. As of July 2026 the company publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission
providers.description: The U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) is responsible for enforcing federal laws that make it illegal to discriminate against a job applicant or an employee because of the person's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related conditions, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age (40 or older), disability or genetic information. EEOC publishes EEO-1, EEO-3, EEO-4, and EEO-5 workforce demographic data through the EEOC Explore Tableau dashboards and downloadable bulk data files, and serves the federally required Project Open Data / DCAT-US public data listing at https://www.eeoc.gov/data.json — a 140-record dcat:Catalog in which every distribution is a file download rather than an API endpoint. It publishes no OpenAPI, GraphQL, MCP or event surface of any kind.

providers.name: Equity Residential
providers.description: Equity Residential (NYSE: EQR) is an S&P 500 company and one of the largest publicly traded apartment real estate investment trusts (REITs) in the United States. The company owns and operates high-quality apartment communities in affluent, dynamic urban and high-density suburban markets where today's renters want to live, work, and play.

providers.name: Exporo
providers.description: Exporo is a Hamburg, Germany-based digital investment platform for real estate and renewable-energy infrastructure, operating as a regulated European Crowdfunding Service Provider (ECSP). The platform lets private investors participate in residential and commercial property development as well as clean-energy projects such as solar, with typical terms of 12-36 months. Exporo has mediated over EUR 1.17 billion of capital across more than 600 financed projects, and also offers Club Deals for larger qualified investors. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API or developer portal is currently published; this profile is maintained as a company lead and will be enriched if a developer surface appears.

providers.name: Family Dollar Stores
providers.description: Family Dollar is a chain of discount variety stores in the United States offering a broad assortment of merchandise in the $1 to $10 range, including consumables, household and home products, apparel, seasonal goods and electronics. Stores are concentrated in neighborhood locations and in food deserts where other retailers do not operate. Dollar Tree, Inc. divested the Family Dollar business on 7 July 2025 to Brigade Capital Management and Macellum Capital Management; Family Dollar now operates as a standalone private retailer headquartered in Chesapeake, Virginia, and also runs the Chesapeake Media Group retail media network. Family Dollar publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, webhook catalog or agent surface: contract discovery on 2026-09-07 probed every well-known and specification path across www.familydollar.com, corporate.familydollar.com and careers.familydollar.com and returned no machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Fundbox
providers.description: Fundbox is an API-first embedded working capital platform that enables B2B sellers and platforms to offer net payment terms, credit underwriting, and working capital financing. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Plano, TX, Fundbox has unlocked over $6 billion in capital for more than 170,000 small businesses. The platform provides a fully white-labeled, embedded lending API stack that allows B2B platforms to integrate credit decisioning, compliance, and servicing in two weeks or less.

providers.name: Healthcare.com
providers.description: Healthcare.com (HealthCare, Inc.) is a privately held, non-government health insurance marketplace and distribution platform founded in 2014. Consumers use healthcare.com to find, compare and enroll in ACA/under-65 individual health plans, Medicare Advantage and Medicare Supplement plans, and specialty coverage; distributors, FMOs, MGAs and agents use its Autopilot machine-learning enrollment acquisition platform, which matches high-intent shoppers to distributor partners with predictive scoring and value-based lead pricing. Its Pivot Health subsidiary develops and markets proprietary short-term medical, fixed indemnity and supplemental gap products with A-rated carriers. Insurance is sold through Healthcare.com Insurance Services, LLC. As of this profiling pass the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI definition or SDKs.

providers.name: HumanQ
providers.description: HumanQ is an execution-capability and intelligence platform that helps organizations move critical work forward through structured, live execution sprints called QPods. Each QPod is a 60-minute facilitated session, led by trained "Catalysts," for small groups of up to six participants working through decision drag, unclear ownership, and cross-team stalls. HumanQ is offered as HumanQ Scale (an enterprise-wide program with weekly and monthly tracks, on-demand drop-ins, and deep customization) and HumanQ Teams (a manager-led tool for up to four groups, live in two weeks with no contract). Progress is tracked through the QStart, QImpact, and QSignal measurement framework, with delivery across 74 countries. HumanQ is a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures. It is a managed-services platform and does not currently publish a public API, SDK, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: HYPERZ AI
providers.description: HYPERZ AI is a generative-AI company focused on professional photography and headshot generation, offering both consumer (B2C) and enterprise (B2B) products. Its consumer tool, Business Photo AI (businessphoto.ai), turns selfies into professional headshots with customizable poses, outfits, and backgrounds. Its enterprise product, HYPERTURE (hyperture.ai), delivers consistent, studio-grade headshots for teams with brand-consistency controls, member approval workflows, and C2PA provenance verification. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm qiming and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass it publishes no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or /.well-known discovery surface — the products are end-user applications rather than a developer platform.

providers.name: Immunitas Therapeutics
providers.description: Immunitas Therapeutics is a Boston, Massachusetts clinical-stage biotechnology company that discovers and develops novel antibody therapeutics for patients with cancer and autoimmune disease. It was founded by cancer-research and therapeutic-antibody scientists from Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, Mass General Cancer Center, the Broad Institute and MIT, whose single-cell analysis drug-discovery platform identified CD161 as a T-cell target. The lead program, IMT-009, is an anti-CD161 antibody in a Phase 1/2a study in solid tumors and hematological malignancies; a second, preclinical anti-CD161 program (IMT-380) for chronic inflammatory disease was licensed to Boehringer Ingelheim in May 2026. Immunitas publishes no public API, developer portal or machine-readable API contract. Its only public software is open source research tooling from the immunitastx GitHub organization, notably the MIT-licensed Python package monkeybread for analyzing cellular niches in single-cell spatial transcriptomics data.

providers.name: Iontra
providers.description: Iontra Inc. is a Denver, Colorado battery technology company that develops proprietary Charge-Control technology for rechargeable lithium batteries. Founded in 2013 and publicly launched in 2022, Iontra applies electrodynamic sensing and signal processing during charging to suppress lithium plating, dendrite growth and SEI-layer expansion, claiming up to 4x cycle life, 2x faster charging, improved cold-weather charging and better safety without changing cell chemistry. The technology is chemistry agnostic across Li-ion, Li-metal, Li-S, solid-state and Na-ion cells, and is delivered to OEMs as custom charging algorithm "recipes" flashed onto an application-specific microcontroller, or as a software-only library. Iontra closed a $45M Series C led by Volta Energy Technologies to launch an integrated RISC-V charge-control and fuel-gauge MCU. Iontra is an embedded/silicon company: it publishes no public web API, no OpenAPI, and no public SDK packages — its SDK is firmware delivered to OEM customers through a login-gated Document Portal under commercial engagement.

providers.name: Jitjatjo
providers.description: Jitjatjo is a New York City based on-demand staffing and workforce management platform operated by JJJ International, matching hospitality, healthcare, education, facilities, retail and logistics businesses with W2 temporary talent in real time. The company runs two consumer-facing products — "Ondemand by Jitjatjo" for businesses booking shifts and "Flex by Jitjatjo" for talent picking up gigs — alongside "Network", a frontline vendor management system (VMS) for contingent labor that is integrated with SAP Fieldglass. JJJ International was acquired by Dayforce in September 2025 and the platform is being rebranded as Dayforce Flex Work; the Jitjatjo web apps now call API hosts on dayforceflexwork.com. Jitjatjo publishes no public developer program: no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI/GraphQL contract, SDK or webhook catalog was found on any host the company controls.

providers.name: Klippa
providers.description: Klippa is a document AI platform whose flagship product, DocHorizon (rebranded as Doxis AI.dp following the SER acquisition), provides OCR, document classification, conversion, verification, fraud detection and anonymization for 50+ document types. Klippa also publishes dedicated APIs for receipts, invoices, IDs/passports and expense management. EU-hosted, GDPR / ISO 27001 certified.

providers.name: KoBold Metals
providers.description: KoBold Metals is a critical-minerals exploration and development company that applies artificial intelligence and machine learning to the search for the copper, lithium, nickel and cobalt deposits needed for electrification. The company combines three capabilities: novel sensor hardware and software that collect higher-quality subsurface data faster, centralized data systems that organize disparate geological information about the Earth's crust, and predictive models that rank and target exploration prospects. Its stated aim is to "turn exploration into a repeatable science." Its flagship project is Mingomba in Zambia, described by the company as one of the best copper deposits ever found and positioned to become one of the world's largest copper mines. KoBold is venture-backed (investors include a16z and Bond Capital) and operates as a private exploration company. As of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; the public surface is a corporate marketing, science, careers and news site.

providers.name: LabGenius Therapeutics
providers.description: LabGenius Therapeutics is a London-based drug discovery company that combines machine learning, high-throughput robotic experimentation and synthetic biology to discover and co-optimise next-generation therapeutic antibodies for solid tumours. Its EVA (Experimental Vector Automation) platform is a closed-loop, modality-agnostic discovery engine that runs a design-build-test-learn cycle in under six weeks — computationally designing multispecific antibodies in the dry lab, then cloning, expressing, purifying and functionally screening up to 2,300 multispecifics per cycle in an automated wet lab, and feeding the resulting proprietary data back into multi-objective ML models. The company operates a wholly-owned pipeline of selectivity-enhanced T-cell engagers alongside partnered antibody-optimisation programmes with Sanofi. LabGenius is a pre-clinical therapeutics company and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile captures its public web and machine-readable surface only.

providers.name: LedgiFi
providers.description: LedgiFi (formerly Krypto Ledgers) is a Latin American cryptocurrency tax and portfolio-tracking platform founded in 2020 and headquartered in Antofagasta, Chile. The product syncs a user's transaction history from exchanges and wallets — Binance, Coinbase, Kraken and MetaMask among them — normalizes it across more than 25,000 assets, and computes realized capital gains using the valuation methods and monetary-correction adjustments each jurisdiction requires, so investors can file a compliant return. Its Chilean profile applies the SII's specific rules (IPC indexation and dollar-variation adjustments, Impuesto de Primera Categoría and Impuesto Global Complementario), and the platform has since expanded to Mexico, Spain, Colombia and Argentina. Alongside tax reporting it offers a portfolio view spanning crypto, stocks and ETFs, with per-asset performance and allocation. LedgiFi is a 500 Global (500 LatAm B18) portfolio company. It runs a monitored production API at api.ledgifi.com that backs its own web and mobile apps, but publishes no developer portal, no API specification and no self-service API program.

providers.name: LeoVegas
providers.description: LeoVegas is a leading online casino and sports betting operator, offering a wide range of casino games, live dealer experiences, and sports wagering options. Founded in 2011, the company focuses on mobile-first experiences, providing users with a seamless, high-quality gaming platform across devices. LeoVegas operates under licenses in multiple jurisdictions and emphasizes responsible gambling, secure payments, and a rich promotional offering for new and existing customers.

providers.name: Linux Foundation
providers.description: The Linux Foundation is a nonprofit technology consortium that supports open source projects and ecosystems. It provides a neutral home for collaboration on open source software, hardware, standards, and data, and hosts hundreds of projects including the Linux kernel, Kubernetes, Node.js, PyTorch, OpenSSF, CNCF, RISC-V, and FINOS. The LFX platform offers tooling and insights for open source contributors and member organizations.

providers.name: LinuxBoot
providers.description: LinuxBoot is a Linux Foundation firmware project that uses a Linux kernel and initramfs as a bootloader, replacing specific firmware functionality such as UEFI DXE. It provides faster, more reliable, and more secure boot processes by leveraging the well-tested Linux kernel for hardware initialization. Core components include u-root (the ramfs builder), the LinuxBoot build system, and the NERF (Non-Extensible Reduced Firmware) heritage from Google.

providers.name: Machinations
providers.description: Machinations is a visual platform for designing, simulating, and balancing game economies, tokenomics, and other complex systems. Studios and designers model resource flows as interactive node-and-connection diagrams, run Monte-Carlo simulations to predict outcomes, and balance economies before a single line of production code is written. The product spans Design, Predict, and Balance modules plus an AI Builder that generates runnable diagrams from natural-language descriptions and a spreadsheet integration. It is used by studios such as Amazon Games, Hasbro, and Zynga and taught at MIT, NYU, and Berkeley. Machinations is a Seedcamp portfolio company; at the time of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface.

providers.name: Mate Security
providers.description: Mate Security operates an AI-powered Security Operations Center (SOC) platform built on a "Security Context Graph." It learns an organization's unique security environment, tools, and procedures within 24 hours of integration, then runs a continuous detection and response (CD/CR) framework: AI agents automatically investigate, triage, and respond to alerts using organizational context, generate new detections from closed investigations, and support human-in-the-loop threat hunting across disparate security tools and data sources. Mate Security is backed by Insight Partners. No public API, SDK, or developer documentation is published at this time; this profile captures the company's identity and security posture.

providers.name: Meadow
providers.description: Meadow is a financial technology company delivering modern student financial services to colleges and universities. Its platform spans the full student financial lifecycle — Meadow Price (a mobile, SAI-compliant net price calculator), Meadow Pay (student billing and payments with automated workflows), Meadow Pre (pre-collections for recovering unpaid tuition), and Meadow Checkout (campus-wide collection of non-tuition fees). Meadow helps institutions improve enrollment, retention, and payment outcomes from application through graduation. Backed by Matrix Partners and Y Combinator. No public API or developer platform is published as of this profile.

providers.name: MiRus
providers.description: MiRus is a Marietta, Georgia life sciences company founded in 2015 that develops and commercializes implants and procedural solutions built on MoRe, its proprietary molybdenum-rhenium superalloy, for spine, orthopaedic and structural heart disease. Its FDA-cleared portfolio spans the Europa pedicle screw system, CYGNUS MoRe anterior cervical plating, 3DR printed interbody and corpectomy systems, the Atlas foot-and-ankle plating line, and the Siegel transcatheter aortic valve, alongside GALILEO — a spine-focused surgical planning, intra-operative alignment measurement and remote physiologic monitoring platform delivered to clinicians as the "Mirus Analytics" web application at rpm.mirusmed.com. MiRus publishes no public developer program: the GALILEO backend, which includes a FHIR route, is bearer/Cognito authenticated and answers 401 on every path, and no OpenAPI, SDK, reference or developer portal is published anywhere on its public surface.

providers.name: Monitaur
providers.description: Monitaur is an enterprise AI governance platform that helps regulated organizations manage machine learning and AI responsibly across the full model lifecycle. Its software lets teams define enterprise-wide AI governance policies, manage and monitor model performance for drift and bias, and automate model validation, risk assessment, stress testing, and vendor governance at scale. Monitaur is built for regulated industries such as insurance and financial services, delivering audit-ready documentation and compliance reporting. A Techstars-backed company, Monitaur has been recognized as a Gartner Magic Quadrant Visionary and is SOC 2 Type II certified. The company does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal; this profile captures its identity and security posture.

providers.name: Nabu
providers.description: Nabu is an AI-powered customs clearance platform that automates international trade compliance end to end. It collects shipment data from emails, PDFs, Excel files, databases, and TMS records via API, EDI, SFTP, or email, prepares complete compliant customs files, and generates pre-filled import/export declarations ready for submission in standard customs software. Nabu targets customs brokers and declaration teams, offering autonomous processing, workload flexibility to absorb staffing gaps, and full auditability across multiple regions and local regulatory regimes. Backed by Techstars. No public developer API, documentation, or SDKs are published at this time.

providers.name: New Lantern
providers.description: New Lantern is a cloud-native, AI-native radiology platform that unifies the worklist, PACS/DICOM viewer, and AI-powered reporting into a single browser-based workspace, replacing the fragmented multi-system software stack most radiology practices run today. Its cloud-native DICOM viewer offers 3D/MPR/MIP reconstruction, mammography and PET/CT modes, and AI hanging protocols; its Curie AI reporting assistant drafts reports that a licensed radiologist reviews, edits, and signs; and NL-Vox provides radiology-tuned speech recognition, alongside intelligent worklist and case distribution, analytics, and native Epic/Oracle Health EHR integration. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, New Lantern is backed by a $19M Series A led by Benchmark and is FDA registered as a Class I medical image communications device (21 CFR 892.2020). New Lantern does not currently expose a public developer API; this profile captures its company identity and public web/security posture.

providers.name: Nym
providers.description: Nym is a healthcare technology company providing autonomous medical coding for health systems, hospitals, and physician groups. Its proprietary Clinical Language Understanding (CLU) engine reads clinical documentation and assigns accurate medical codes (ICD-10, CPT, and E/M) without human intervention, combining machine reading with transparent, rules-based coding logic rather than generic natural language processing. Nym automates revenue cycle management to reduce coding costs, accelerate billing, and improve charge capture across 400+ US healthcare facilities, and is used by health systems including OSF, Ochsner Health, Inova, and Henry Ford. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Nym does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: OneWeb
providers.description: OneWeb, now part of Eutelsat, is a global communications company operating a low Earth orbit satellite constellation to provide broadband internet services worldwide. Founded in 2012, it aims to deliver high‑speed connectivity to underserved regions, enterprises, and maritime and aviation sectors.

providers.name: Perfectly
providers.description: Perfectly is an AI-native recruiting platform (Y Combinator W2026) that automates the hiring process end to end, from candidate sourcing and outreach through screening and qualification. Its employer-facing AI recruiting agent, Paul, sources, engages, and qualifies candidates to help startups fill roles in days rather than weeks, delivered as an AI-native recruiting agency paired with a forward-deployed recruiter for onboarding and configuration. Its job-seeker agent, Parker, is an AI career super-connector on iMessage and WhatsApp that helps candidates find relevant industry contacts and craft personalized outreach before roles are publicly posted. Founded by former ML scientists and engineers from Meta and TikTok, Perfectly operates as a chat- and agent-delivered hiring service rather than a public developer API; no public API, developer portal, SDK, or specification surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Plush
providers.description: Plush is an AI-powered fashion discovery and shopping platform at plush.shop that lets shoppers describe what they want in natural language and returns curated results from trusted and emerging brands. Rather than rigid keyword search, Plush matches on mood, aesthetic, and intent, layering image search, smart real-time filters, influencer edit collections, and wishlists on top of its proprietary AI curation. Founded by Chang Liu (CEO) and Ying Zhu (CTO) — who met through Y Combinator's co-founder matching — Plush is backed by the Anthemis Female Innovators Lab Fund and the Oxford Seed Fund. It is a consumer-facing web application; no public developer API is published at this time.

providers.name: Prenav
providers.description: PRENAV, Inc. is a Belmont, California company that automates the visual inspection of large civil and industrial structures using commercially available drones, photogrammetry and deep learning. Its PRENAV.XYZ web platform stitches thousands of drone photographs into a high-resolution 3D point-cloud digital twin, then runs machine-learning models over that twin to detect cracking in concrete, spalling, exposed rebar, cracks in steel and rust, resolving features under 0.2mm and tracking change over time. A second line, Synthetic Imagery as a Service, procedurally renders thousands of annotated photoreal defect images each month to augment a customer's own AI training sets. PRENAV publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API description; the product is sold as an enterprise service through a contact form.

providers.name: Reco
providers.description: Reco is a SaaS security platform using identity-centric analysis to detect threats, prevent data exposure, and manage access across SaaS applications.

providers.name: Reynolds and Reynolds
providers.description: Reynolds and Reynolds is one of the automotive industry's largest Dealership Management System (DMS) providers, running the ERA-IGNITE and POWER platforms that operate the core of thousands of franchised car dealerships - sales and desking, F&I, service and repair orders, parts inventory, CRM, and dealership accounting. Reynolds does NOT publish an open, self-serve developer API. All programmatic access to DMS data flows through the Reynolds Certified Interface (RCI) program, a certification-gated, contract-and-NDA partner program run by Reynolds Data Management. RCI provides secured, real-time, bi-directional interfaces so certified third parties can read from and write back to a dealer's Reynolds DMS. There is no public developer portal, no public API reference, and no published OpenAPI. The APIs below are logical groupings of the DMS data domains exposed through RCI; endpoints are modeled, not sourced from public documentation.

providers.name: Sanlo
providers.description: Sanlo is a multi-platform payments and monetization platform built specifically for game developers and studios. Its products let studios run live ops and accept payments outside the walled gardens of the major app stores to reduce platform commission fees: Webshop Builder (a full-stack direct-to-consumer web shop), Web Checkout (accept payments on any website, web shop, or web game), and Unity Checkout (native iOS/Android in-game checkout for Unity titles via a first-party SDK and API, with one-click checkout, fully customizable UI, and creator-code support). Card and payment collection is powered by Adyen underneath. Sanlo also offers game funding to help studios finance user acquisition and growth. The company is backed by Index Ventures and other gaming-focused investors.

providers.name: SNMP
providers.description: Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) is the foundational IETF standard for monitoring and managing network devices. SNMP defines a request/response protocol over UDP (ports 161 and 162) for retrieving and altering management variables exposed by agents on routers, switches, servers, UPSs, and other equipment, plus an asynchronous trap/notification channel for event delivery. The protocol family spans three major generations — SNMPv1 (RFC 1157), SNMPv2c (RFC 1901-1908), and the modular SNMPv3 architecture (RFC 3411-3418, extended by RFC 7860 for HMAC-SHA-2 authentication) — and is paired with the Structure of Management Information (SMI) and a vast catalog of MIB modules, most notably the IF-MIB (RFC 2863) for network interfaces. SNMP remains the lingua franca of network monitoring, consumed primarily by NMS platforms such as Nagios, Zabbix, PRTG, SolarWinds, LibreNMS, and Observium, and implemented in open source primarily by the Net-SNMP suite.

providers.name: Solaren
providers.description: Solaren is a combination energy and aerospace company headquartered in Manhattan Beach, California, founded in 2001 by a team of satellite engineers and space scientists. Solaren designs, develops, integrates, deploys and operates space solar power (SSP) plants: solar arrays on a patented lightweight solar power satellite in geosynchronous orbit convert sunlight to electricity, convert that electricity to radio-frequency power, and beam it to an earth receiving station that returns it to the grid as baseload power. The company's business model is to own and operate its SSP plants and sell continuous, zero-emission electricity to utility and government customers; it signed the world's first power purchase agreement for space solar electricity, with Pacific Gas & Electric. Solaren is a hardware and energy-generation company and publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Stitch Fix
providers.description: Stitch Fix is an online personal styling service that pairs data science and machine learning with expert human stylists to send customers curated shipments ("Fixes") of apparel, footwear, and accessories selected to their size, budget, and style preferences. Founded in 2011 and publicly traded (NASDAQ: SFIX), the company operates a direct-to-consumer retail model across womens, mens, and kids categories. Stitch Fix does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; its engineering team shares its data-science and platform work through the Multithreaded technology blog and open-source projects on GitHub. This profile captures the company's public web, security, and engineering surfaces.

providers.name: StoreDot
providers.description: StoreDot is an Israeli battery technology company founded in 2012 by Doron Myersdorf, Simon Litsyn and Gil Rosenman, headquartered in Herzliya with an advanced technology campus in Irvine, California. It develops extreme fast charging (XFC) lithium-ion cells built on proprietary silicon-dominant anode chemistry and synthesized organic and inorganic compounds optimized with machine-learning models, targeting the range and charging anxiety that gate mainstream electric-vehicle adoption. Its "100inX" product roadmap sets 100 miles of range charged in 5 minutes (100in5, 2024), 3 minutes (100in3, 2028) and 2 minutes (100in2, 2032); the company has demonstrated pouch and prismatic XFC cells sustaining more than 1,000 and later 2,000 extreme fast charging cycles while retaining over 80 percent of original capacity, and designs its chemistry to drop into existing Li-ion production lines. Strategic investors and partners include Daimler/Mercedes-Benz, BP, VinFast, Volvo, Polestar, Ola Electric, Samsung Ventures, TDK and manufacturing partner EVE Energy. In 2026 a planned SPAC merger with Andretti Acquisition Corp. II was terminated and the company returned to private fundraising. StoreDot is a hardware, materials and cell-manufacturing business: it publishes no public developer API, SDK, MCP server or machine-readable API contract, and no /.well-known/ discovery surface, llms.txt or developer subdomain resolves on store-dot.com.

providers.name: SureCheck
providers.description: SureCheck provides a simple API for validating phone numbers and email addresses. It offers international phone formatting, carrier detection, and email syntax plus DNS checks, including disposable domain detection. The service runs on a free Render.com host, offering a free beta and paid plans for higher volume. It is designed for developers needing quick validation before storing user data.

providers.name: Sync API
providers.description: Sync API is an enterprise API platform for the in-app mobile advertising ecosystem, delivering performance, transparency, and control for marketers. The platform provides a bidder platform and suite of APIs for user acquisition, mobile user growth, and user re-engagement. It enables data-driven, ROI-focused mobile advertising across 1.2 billion global audiences in 50+ countries, with 500+ robust API integrations and advanced algorithms for LTV forecasting and in-app event conversion tracking.

providers.name: Tenex AI
providers.description: TENEX.AI is an AI-native, human-led Managed Detection and Response (MDR) provider that fuses agentic AI, automation, and elite human security analysts to run security operations at scale. Its platform triages every alert and investigates every threat, orchestrating workflows across 300+ security tools to deliver faster detection, high-fidelity triage, and autonomous response with human guardrails for Fortune 500 and Global 2000 enterprises. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Crosspoint Capital, and Shield Capital, TENEX.AI operates as a managed cybersecurity service rather than a public developer API platform; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Tooth Fairy
providers.description: Toothfairy is a UK dental telehealth platform billing itself as the world's first dentist on-demand, pairing registered dentists with a consumer mobile app to deliver teeth straightening with clear aligners, prescription teeth whitening, and same-day emergency video dental consultations 24/7, plus employer dental plans for businesses. The company is health-regulated in the UK, backed by Seedcamp, and ships its product as iOS and Android apps with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Travelstop
providers.description: Travelstop (rebranded WegoPro) is a modern corporate travel and expense management platform founded in Singapore and backed by Accel. Companies use it to book flights and hotels from multiple supply partners, enforce travel policy and approval workflows, and automate expense reporting with receipt scanning (OCR), duplicate detection, and fraud prevention. Expense and accounting data syncs to Xero and QuickBooks, and native iOS and Android apps support travelers on the move. The product exposes prebuilt in-app accounting integrations rather than a public, self-serve developer API; this profile enriches its public web, security, and identity surface.

providers.name: Tripo3D
providers.description: Tripo3D (by VAST) is an AI 3D generation platform with text-to-3D, image-to-3D, mesh refinement, and texturing APIs producing game-ready 3D assets. The Tripo API uses an async task-based REST pattern at https://api.tripo3d.ai/v2/openapi/task. Authenticate with API key.

providers.name: Upwing Energy
providers.description: Upwing Energy is an energy technology company founded in 2016 and headquartered in Cerritos, California, with service operations near Houston, Texas, operating as an affiliate of Calnetix Technologies. It designs, manufactures and deploys the Subsurface Compressor System (SCS) — a downhole gas compressor installed up to two miles inside a natural gas well — along with Magnetic Drive Systems and the supporting high-speed permanent magnet motors, passive magnetic radial bearings, active magnetic thrust bearings, magnetic couplings and sensorless long-step-out variable speed drives that make it work. The company sells hardware and an end-to-end field service (planning and completions, deployment and startup, operations and monitoring, analysis and predictions) to natural gas operators worldwide, including deployments with Equinor, ENAP and operators across MENA and Central Asia. It publishes no developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Volocopter
providers.description: Volocopter is a German urban air mobility company developing electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft for passenger and cargo use. Its product portfolio includes VoloCity, a two-seat multicopter air taxi pursued under EASA SC-VTOL certification; VoloRegion, a longer-range fixed-wing transition design for inter-city flights; VoloDrone, a heavy-lift cargo drone; and VoloIQ, a digital operations platform built on Microsoft Azure for fleet, route, and vertiport management. Volocopter has demonstrated flights in numerous cities including Paris, Singapore, Seoul, and Dubai, and worked toward operations around the Paris 2024 Olympics. The company experienced significant financial restructuring in 2024-2025 and ownership changes affecting commercial timelines; current status should be verified against the latest newsroom updates.

providers.name: Wabi
providers.description: Wabi is a consumer AI mini-app platform — billed as "the first personal software platform" and a "YouTube of apps" — where anyone can create, discover, share, and remix AI-generated mini-apps from a single natural-language prompt while Wabi handles the underlying infrastructure, UI, hosting, and data. Founded by Eugenia Kuyda (founder of the AI companion app Replika) and backed by a roughly $20M pre-seed round (investors include Naval Ravikant, Garry Tan, Justin Kan, and Forerunner Ventures), Wabi is an invite/beta consumer product. As of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, OpenAPI, or developer documentation — only the consumer web app and its Terms/Privacy pages.

providers.name: WiTricity
providers.description: WiTricity AI Tech, LLC is a wireless power transfer company founded on the highly resonant magnetic-resonance research published by an MIT team led by Marin Soljacic in 2007. The company holds the foundational patent portfolio for wireless power transfer over distance and commercializes it by licensing intellectual property, reference designs and engineering services to automakers, Tier 1 suppliers and charging hardware manufacturers rather than by selling software. Its product surface is hardware and IP: the MR/1 charging system, light-, medium- and heavy-duty EV wireless charging, smart-city and transit infrastructure, autonomous-vehicle and ground-support-equipment fleets, and bidirectional V2G energy arbitrage. WiTricity chairs several SAE J2954 working groups, the interoperability standard for wireless EV and PHEV charging. As of a probe on 2026-09-04 the company publishes no developer program, no API documentation, no machine-readable contract and no public code repositories; its integration story is delivered through licensee engineering support, not a public API.

providers.name: ZeroAvia
providers.description: ZeroAvia is a UK/US hydrogen-electric aviation company founded in 2017 by Valery Miftakhov, developing hydrogen fuel cell and electric propulsion systems for commercial aircraft. Its powertrain line runs from the ZA600 (600kW, 10-20 seat regional turboprops) through the ZA2000 (2-5MW, 40-80 seat turboprops) to the ZA2000 RJ (5MW+, up to 90 seat regional jets), alongside a component business selling electric propulsion systems, inverters, electric motors and HTPEM/SuperStack fuel cell stacks to other clean-aviation manufacturers, plus a hydrogen airport refuelling ecosystem of electrolyzers, mobile refuelers and LH2 development. It operates from Cotswold Airport in Kemble, UK and from Everett, Washington, and holds FAA and CAA experimental certificates for its flight-test aircraft. ZeroAvia sells certified aerospace hardware to airframers, airlines, lessors and defense customers; it publishes no public developer API, SDK or developer portal.

providers.name: 3T Biosciences
providers.description: 3T Biosciences is a clinical-stage immunotherapy company based in South San Francisco, developing next-generation T-cell receptor (TCR) therapeutics for solid tumors and other immune-mediated diseases. Founded in 2017 on research from K. Christopher Garcia's lab at Stanford University, the company operates its proprietary 3T-TRACE (T-Cell Receptor Antigen and Cross-reactivity Evaluation) platform, which combines high-diversity yeast-display target libraries with active machine-learning to screen billions of protein fragments and identify novel shared TCR targets and specificities. 3T has raised a $40M Series A from Westlake Village BioPartners and Lightspeed Venture Partners and has struck cancer-immunotherapy collaborations with Boehringer Ingelheim worth up to $268M in milestones. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of CRV and enriched into the API Evangelist network; 3T publishes no public developer API, SDK, or specification surface.

providers.name: Adventum Student Living
providers.description: Adventum Student Living Private Limited (ASL) is a Mumbai-headquartered study-abroad and student accommodation group founded in 2019 by Amit Singh, Anupam Gupta and Sayantan Biswas. It operates a family of consumer brands for internationally mobile students: UniAcco (a global purpose-built student accommodation marketplace covering the UK, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia and continental Europe), UniCreds (an education-loan marketplace), UniScholars (study-abroad counselling and admissions guidance), UniFlx (short-stay 1-12 week student housing) and UniEssential (arrival services such as airport transfers, guarantors, insurance and student bank accounts). ASL publishes consumer web properties and an invite-only partner dashboard for property owners, but as of this profile it publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Ai Fabrik
providers.description: AI Fabrik is an infrastructure company building an edge inference delivery network for high-performance AI tokens. Incubated within Gruve and led by founder Tarun Raisoni alongside Swati Deshpande and Tanuj Mohan, the company has deconstructed the traditional data center model and rebuilt every layer for real-time AI, delivering distributed inference close to users and cloud providers with sub-20ms latency, cost efficiency, and built-in compliance. AI Fabrik is deploying five initial production sites with 6,000+ B300 GPUs launching in 2026, backed by Mayfield, Xora (Temasek), Acclimate Ventures, and Cisco Investments.

providers.name: AI Palette
providers.description: AI Palette is an AI-first consumer-insights and product-innovation platform for the Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry. Founded in Singapore in 2018 and later acquired by GlobalData, it aggregates more than 61 billion data points across 24 countries and 18 languages to help food, beverage, and personal-care brands discover emerging trends, generate and screen new product concepts, and bring winning products to market faster. Its platform spans the Foresight Engine for real-time trend discovery, Concept Genie for generative-AI concept creation, Screen Winner for concept validation, and the FoodGPT / Arya agentic co-pilot. Customers include Nestle, Mondelez, Kellogg, Diageo, Cargill, ADM, and Symrise. This is an enterprise SaaS platform accessed by license; no public developer API, SDK, or specification is published.

providers.name: Airblack
providers.description: Airblack (Airblack Technologies Private Limited) is a Gurugram, India-based edtech company that runs an outcome-focused skilling academy for creators and micro-entrepreneurs, delivering live online makeup, beauty and culinary courses with professional certification through its website and Android/iOS app, plus a sister app, Zudo. Founded by Videt Jaiswal and backed by Info Edge Ventures and Elevation Capital (USD 5.2M Series A, 2021), it reports a community of 45,000+ students. Airblack is a consumer learning product, not a platform: it publishes no developer program, no public API documentation and no machine-readable API contract, and the backend its web app calls (service.ablck.com) is a private application service that answers every probed path with a JSON 404.

providers.name: Airspace Intelligence
providers.description: Air Space Intelligence (ASI) builds AI software for mission-critical, geospatial operations across aviation, defense, logistics, and energy. Its Prescience platform fuses data, models operational domains, runs predictive simulations, and optimizes complex operations in real time — spanning airline operations, air traffic management, global logistics, defense (space, air, land, sea), and energy grids. ASI holds an $875M FAA contract to help modernize the U.S. National Airspace System and works with partners including Alaska Airlines, National Grid, and the U.S. Air Force. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal.

providers.name: AiSensum
providers.description: AiSensum (AISensum) builds agentic AI "teammates" that work alongside front-line staff to drive revenue, improve quality, and reduce labour while keeping the human in the lead. Operating since 2017 with a presence across Southeast Asia, it deploys purpose-built AI teammates for enterprise front-line operations in retail, F&B, hospitality and entertainment, each specialising in one measurable outcome: Daniel (revenue teammate, personalised counter offers/upsell), Sasha (time and cost teammate, bulk product-photo editing and approval), and Nicole (progress teammate, conversation scoring and cashier coaching against brand SOPs). Deployments are scoped through a half-day IFA (Intelligent Front-line Automation) Workshop. AiSensum publishes no public API, SDK, or developer portal; it is a portfolio company of 500 Global tracked in the API Evangelist network. This profile was enriched from the company's public web presence and an on-site llms.txt.

providers.name: Animaj
providers.description: Animaj is a technology company focused on providing innovative solutions in the animal health and welfare sector. The company aims to leverage data-driven platforms to improve animal care, monitoring, and management for farms, veterinary practices, and pet owners. Through its API offerings, Animaj enables integration of real-time health metrics, environmental data, and analytics to support better decision-making and enhance overall animal well-being across various industries.

providers.name: Arizona Public Service
providers.description: Arizona Public Service (APS) is Arizona's largest electric utility, a subsidiary of Pinnacle West Capital, serving residential and business customers across the state.

providers.name: Assemble
providers.description: Assemble builds autonomous AI agents that help enterprise IT and business-systems teams automate development work inside core platforms such as Salesforce, SAP, Workday, and NetSuite. The agents scope changes across integrated ERP, CRM, and HRIS systems, understand cross-system dependencies, implement and validate modifications, and keep a complete audit trail so teams can review agent work, approve modifications, and revert individual changes or restore a system to a prior state. Assemble is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) company targeting IT and business-systems teams managing complex enterprise transformations. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, documentation, or OpenAPI, so only its verified public identity and website properties are captured.

providers.name: Atalanta
providers.description: Atalanta is a mathematical AI company building provably correct decision-making for the world's most important missions. Its flagship platform, Argo, is described as the first software understanding platform - it uses mathematical proof and formal verification to establish safety, security, and performance guarantees for software-defined and autonomous systems at operational speed, moving beyond the limits of traditional testing. Argo identifies failure modes before deployment and verifies compliance with critical constraints across energy (nuclear and grid control systems), space (satellite and communications networks), and defense (complex military systems and data isolation). Atalanta was founded by Anjana Rajan and Jonathan Ring, is headquartered in Washington, D.C., and is backed by Felicis and In-Q-Tel.

providers.name: Axiom Global
providers.description: Axiom Global Technologies provides consulting, talent acquisition, cost containment, and electronic document management solutions. Their services include IT consulting, diversity hiring programs, bill review for cost savings, and EDM solutions for document scanning and secure hosting. Based in Walnut Creek, CA, they serve enterprises seeking expertise, integrity, and results across human capital and operational efficiency.

providers.name: Axiom Space
providers.description: Axiom Space, Inc. is a privately funded American space infrastructure developer headquartered in Houston, Texas, founded in 2016 by Kam Ghaffarian and former NASA International Space Station Program Manager Michael Suffredini. The company is building Axiom Station, the world's first commercial space station and planned successor to the ISS, and has flown private astronaut missions to the ISS (Ax-1 through Ax-4). Axiom Space also develops the Axiom Extravehicular Mobility Unit (AxEMU) spacesuit for NASA's return to the lunar surface, and sells human spaceflight, microgravity research, in-space manufacturing, and Orbital Data Center services (in-orbit cloud compute, with the ODC T1 node built alongside Kepler Communications and Skyloom Global). As of this enrichment pass Axiom Space publishes no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or machine-readable API contract — every offering is transacted through direct enterprise, agency, and government engagement, and its only public code presence is a two-repository GitHub organization holding forks of NASA simulation software (Trick and GUNNS).

providers.name: aXiomatic
providers.description: Axiomatic Technologies designs and manufactures electronic control and power conversion products, including battery chargers, motor and actuator controllers, DC‑DC converters, AC‑DC supplies, I/O automation, and protocol converters. The company supplies these rugged components to manufacturers of construction, mining, off‑highway and on‑highway machines that operate in harsh environments. It also offers OEM control design services and custom development for clients worldwide.

providers.name: BeyondHQ
providers.description: BeyondHQ is a distributed workforce planning platform that combines talent, cost, and location data to enable cross-functional decision making for hybrid and distributed teams. It equips HR, Real Estate, and Finance teams with a single, integrated experience that centralizes hiring and location-planning processes, providing real-time interactive comparisons across 500+ markets, 70,000+ searchable job skills, 750+ searchable occupations, and 50,000+ market-data combinations. The platform helps companies determine where to hire and physically locate their workforce using trusted, real-time data. BeyondHQ is a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta. BeyondHQ does not currently publish a public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Biosplice Therapeutics
providers.description: Biosplice Therapeutics, Inc. is a privately held, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, founded in 2008 by Osman Kibar and known until its 2020 rename as Samumed, LLC (samumed.com still redirects to biosplice.com). The company develops first-in-class small-molecule therapeutics that act on novel components of the Wnt signaling pathway and on the regulation of alternative pre-mRNA splicing. Its lead program is lorecivivint, an investigational intra-articular knee injection for osteoarthritis, positioned against a stated unmet need of "over 50 million US patients suffer from osteoarthritis, with no drugs available to arrest the disease"; the candidate has completed Phase 3 study and a New Drug Application has been submitted to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration. Programs outside lorecivivint — neurology, diabetes and oncology — are developed by the company's affiliate TenaRx, Inc. The company is led by Erich Horsley (Chief Executive Officer) with Osman Kibar as Founder and Executive Chairman, Yusuf Yazici as Chief Medical Officer, Phil Wilson as Chief Financial Officer and Scott W. Bulcao as Chief Legal Officer. Biosplice is a drug-discovery and clinical-development organization, not a software vendor: biosplice.com is a small ASP.NET corporate site covering mission, board, management, advisors, programs, publications, news and careers, and the company publishes no developer program of any kind — no API, no SDK, no developer portal, no GitHub organization and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: BizteX
providers.description: BizteX株式会社はAIオートメーションカンパニーとして、RPA・AI-OCR・業務自動化プラットフォームを提供しています。企業の業務効率化を支援するため、インテリジェントフロー、BizteX robop、BizteX Connectなどのサービスを展開し、製造業から医療・不動産まで幅広い業界で導入実績があります。

providers.name: Blueworldtechnologies
providers.description: Blue World Technologies develops and manufactures high‑temperature PEM methanol fuel cell components and systems for maritime, stationary and heavy‑duty transportation sectors. The company aims to provide green, efficient alternatives to combustion engines and diesel generators, focusing on renewable methanol solutions and advanced fuel cell platforms.

providers.name: Botrista
providers.description: Botrista, Inc. is a San Francisco based beverage-automation company founded in 2017 that builds the DrinkBot robotic beverage dispenser and the CloudBar cloud platform behind it. The DrinkBot automates craft beverages — infused teas, flavored lemonades, iced coffees and mocktails — dispensing a drink in roughly twenty seconds from a touchscreen order, and every unit is internet connected so it pulls recipes, reports consumption, tracks ingredient levels and pushes maintenance alerts back to Botrista. CloudBar is the operator-facing web application used by restaurant, campus dining, convenience and theme-park operators to manage recipes, inventory replenishment and sales/menu performance analytics across a fleet of machines, alongside a separate Botrista Data Portal. Botrista sells beverage automation as a service rather than as a developer platform: as of this profiling pass it publishes no public developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable API contract, and POS integrations are handled case-by-case through its commercial team.

providers.name: Brilliant
