This API Evangelist profile currently tracks the company's public web presence; no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer documentation surface has been identified at this time.

providers.name: Novus
providers.description: Novus (operating as SEI Novus) is a portfolio intelligence and investment analytics platform for institutional investors — endowments, foundations, sovereign wealth funds, family offices, pension funds, and asset managers. The platform provides manager monitoring, performance analysis, risk assessment, attribution, and reporting across public and private markets at the position, fund, and portfolio level, along with data integration and maintenance services. Originally venture-backed (Index Ventures among its investors), Novus was acquired by SEI and now operates as SEI Novus. It has been recognized as Best Portfolio Management Vendor (Family Wealth Report Awards) and Best Multi-Asset Class Portfolio Management System (PAM Awards). No public developer API is currently published on its website.

providers.name: Onefinestay
providers.description: Onefinestay is a British luxury hospitality company founded in 2009 that curates and manages a portfolio of upmarket private homes, villas, apartments and chalets for short-term and extended vacation rentals, pairing hand-picked properties with hotel-grade concierge service. AccorHotels acquired Onefinestay in 2016 for around $168 million; in 2025 Exclusive Resorts took a controlling operational stake while Accor retained a majority interest. Onefinestay operates as a consumer travel brand with a booking website and a technical/engineering organization on GitHub, but it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK program, or developer portal. This profile is maintained as a network company record.

providers.name: Onze
providers.description: Onze is a Brazilian fintech (São Paulo) focused on corporate private pension (previdência privada) and financial health for companies and their employees. It offers digital management of employer-sponsored pension plans, access to more than 300 investment funds, one-on-one financial consultations with specialists, and financial-education seminars, all delivered as a B2B employee benefits platform. Onze positions itself as the first fintech centered on pension and financial wellness for a company's collaborators, and is backed by Ribbit Capital. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; as of this enrichment pass Onze publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Operon
providers.description: Operon is an AI-powered manufacturing intelligence platform (Y Combinator S2026) that turns P&IDs (Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams), schematics, datasheets, and scanned engineering documents into one structured, queryable model of a plant. Its P&ID Recognition detects equipment, instruments, valves, and piping symbols across ISA, ISO, and proprietary symbology; its P&ID Agent generates standards-compliant diagrams from text, simulation data, or sketches; and Knowledge Chat lets engineers query plant documentation in natural language and build agentic workflows for safety, compliance, HAZOP/PHA, EHS, material take-offs, brownfield digitization, and management-of-change. Operon exports structured DEXPI data and offers cloud and on-premise deployment with encryption, role-based access control, and audit trails. As of July 2026 the product is in private beta (pid.operonsolutions.com) and publishes no public API.

providers.name: Paraglide
providers.description: Paraglide is a British-Swedish AI company building autonomous agents that automate accounts receivable for high-volume B2B finance teams. Its agents handle two-way billing communication across the order-to-cash lifecycle: answering customer billing questions, chasing overdue invoices, resolving disputes and deductions, running collections, operating a supplier portal, and applying cash — integrating with ERPs, CRMs, and billing software to cut Days Sales Outstanding and improve cash flow. Founded in 2025 by Rasmus Areskoug and Andreas Astrom with offices in London and Malmo, Paraglide raised a $5M seed round led by Bessemer Venture Partners and DN Capital in January 2026. As of this profile the company is a product/agent platform with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Pediatrix Medical Group (formerly MEDNAX)
providers.description: Pediatrix Medical Group, Inc. (NYSE: MD) — known as MEDNAX until its 2022 rebrand, and still reachable at mednax.com, which now redirects to www.pediatrix.com — is a US physician services organization delivering neonatal, maternal-fetal, pediatric cardiology, pediatric surgery and other pediatric subspecialty care through affiliated practices at hospitals and clinics across the country. Its one software product, BabySteps Cloud, is a cloud clinical documentation tool for NICUs that feeds the Pediatrix Clinical Data Warehouse and is sold to hospital partners as an end-user product. As of a 2026-09-04 probe pass Pediatrix publishes no public API, developer portal, machine-readable specification, or /.well-known/ discovery document. The MEDNAX Radiology Solutions / vRad business covered by this repository's older press and blog archive was sold to Radiology Partners in December 2020 and is no longer part of this company.

providers.name: PharmaCann
providers.description: PharmaCann is one of the largest vertically integrated cannabis companies in the United States, founded in 2014 and operating cultivation centers, processing facilities and retail dispensaries across eight states — Colorado, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, New York, Ohio and Pennsylvania. The company runs nine cultivation and processing facilities (Denver CO, Dwight IL, Lothian and Stevensville MD, Holliston MA, Warren MI, Hamptonburgh NY, Buckeye Lake OH and Olyphant PA) and sells through two retail banners, LivWell (Colorado and Michigan) and Verilife (Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, New York, Ohio and Pennsylvania), alongside a house of product brands including Matter, Magnitude, Full Melt, CAM, P3, LivWell Flower, Hash and PC Nursery. PharmaCann is a physical-goods operator in a federally restricted, state-regulated industry; it publishes no developer program, no public API and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Plural Finance
providers.description: Plural Finance is a financial operating system for infrastructure — a programmable execution layer that automates ownership, payments, compliance, and reporting across the lifecycle of infrastructure and energy assets. Its AssetOS platform tokenizes infrastructure assets such as distributed renewables, data centers, public-private partnerships, and electricity sales contracts, so institutional and individual investors can underwrite, monitor, and trade projects, with smart-contract execution of capital contributions and distributions and embedded regulatory controls. The company holds broker-dealer licensing and is backed by Paradigm. Plural currently exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; access is through its institutional web application.

providers.name: PNC
providers.description: PNC Financial Services Group is a Pittsburgh-based money-center bank and Fortune 500 diversified financial services company offering retail banking, corporate and institutional banking, treasury management, asset management, and residential mortgage banking across the United States. PNC operates a real first-party developer portal at developer.pnc.com ("PNC Developer Tools: Open APIs for Banking & Payments") that publishes a catalog of treasury and payments API products — including Account Verification Services, ePayments, Real-Time Payments (RTP), Direct-to-Debit-Card (push-to-card) disbursement, and information reporting — surfaced through its PINACLE commercial banking platform and PINACLE Connect embedded-banking integrations. Full API reference documentation, sandbox/testing environments, and call codes are gated behind credentialed onboarding arranged through a PNC Relationship Manager or Treasury Management Officer; no OpenAPI/Swagger specifications are publicly downloadable. On the consumer open-finance side, PNC exposes account data through an Akoya-provided tokenized data-access API and signed a bilateral data-access agreement with Plaid in September 2024, positioning PNC ahead of CFPB Section 1033 personal-financial-data-rights requirements.

providers.name: PrecisionLender
providers.description: PrecisionLender is a relationship pricing and profitability platform for commercial banks, now part of Q2 Holdings (acquired 2019). It equips relationship managers, treasury officers, and credit teams to price and structure optimal commercial deals with total relationship visibility, in-deal collaboration, and "Andi", an AI coaching engine that surfaces in-the-moment pricing guidance. The product draws market-competitive intelligence from 150+ financial institutions and integrates into a bank's technology stack to reduce manual data entry. The standalone precisionlender.com site now redirects to the Q2 "Relationship Pricing and Profitability" product; there is no independent public PrecisionLender API, and Q2's developer surface (Q2 Innovation Studio) requires authentication.

providers.name: Puzzle Medical Devices
providers.description: Puzzle Medical Devices Inc. is a Montreal, Quebec based clinical-stage medical device company founded in 2018 by Jade Doucet-Martineau, Gabriel Georges and Francois Trudeau. It develops ModulHeart, a modular percutaneous mechanical circulatory support pump for patients with advanced heart failure, anchored in the descending aorta to reduce cardiac afterload and improve renal perfusion. ModulHeart holds FDA Breakthrough Device Designation and has completed a first-in-human study. The company is a hardware manufacturer, not a software vendor - it publishes no developer program, API reference, SDK or machine-readable contract. Its only agent-reachable surface is a Model Context Protocol endpoint provisioned automatically by Wix, its website host, which serves public site content rather than any product capability.

providers.name: rebtel
providers.description: Rebtel is a Swedish international communications company (Rebtel Networks AB, registered 556680-3622, headquartered in Stockholm) serving the world's roughly two billion international migrants with low-cost international calling, mobile top-up / airtime recharge, and calling cards delivered through its iOS and Android apps. It routes calls over optimized local phone lines to keep prices low. Backed by Balderton Capital and Index Ventures. Rebtel exposes no public developer API or SDK program; this profile captures the company's public web, legal, support, and security.txt surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Rentomojo
providers.description: Rentomojo is India's largest tech-driven, full-stack direct-to-consumer furniture and appliance rental platform, converting ownership into flexible monthly subscriptions. Customers rent beds, sofas, wardrobes, refrigerators, washing machines, air conditioners, water purifiers and other home essentials on plans from roughly three to thirty-six months, with delivery, installation, maintenance, relocation and upgrades handled in-house. Per its March 2026 draft red herring prospectus the company operates across 22 Indian cities with 227,511 live subscribers and 1,688 in-house technicians, carpenters and painters. Backed by Accel and Bain Capital Ventures. Added to the API Evangelist network from VC portfolio data; this pass found no public developer API, SDK or documentation surface.

providers.name: Repertoire Immune Medicines
providers.description: Repertoire Immune Medicines is a Cambridge, Massachusetts biotechnology company (with a site in Schlieren, Switzerland) building immune medicines grounded in the human T cell repertoire. Its proprietary DECODE platform characterizes the immune synapse by identifying T cell receptor (TCR) and antigen (peptide-MHC) pairs together with T cell function and HLA presentation, and uses that map to rationally design treatments across oncology, autoimmune disease, and infectious disease. Backed by Flagship Pioneering and SoftBank Vision Fund, the company was surfaced as a portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. It publishes no public developer API; its only public technical surface is a small research GitHub organization.

providers.name: Ring Therapeutics
providers.description: Ring Therapeutics is a Cambridge, Massachusetts biotechnology company founded by Flagship Pioneering that develops targeted vector conjugate medicines built on the human commensal virome. Its Anellogy platform harnesses anelloviruses — commensal viruses that co-exist with the human immune system — to generate gene delivery vectors with tissue-specific tropism and the potential to be redosed. Ring has sequenced thousands of anelloviruses into what it describes as the largest anellovirus database assembled to date, and has raised more than $250 million across Series A, B and C financings. The company is a therapeutics developer rather than a software provider: it publishes a corporate site, a press release stream and a scientific publications list, and operates no public API, developer portal or SDK.

providers.name: Robert Half International
providers.description: Robert Half International is the world's first and largest specialized staffing and talent solutions firm. Founded in 1948, it provides contract, temporary, and permanent placement solutions across finance and accounting, technology, marketing, legal, and administrative fields. The company is the parent of Protiviti, a global consulting firm. Robert Half does not publicly expose a developer API; integration is available through partner programs and ATS ecosystem connectors. Listed in the Fortune 500.

providers.name: Rovi Health
providers.description: Rovi Health is a clinical navigation platform for employer health plans that puts "a clinician in every member's pocket." Members get text-based access to registered nurse care advisors who help them find high-quality, in-network doctors and specialists, navigate their insurance benefits and coverage, and coordinate care across every stage of treatment. The company also uses AI agents to search millions of pricing and quality data points to surface the best in-network providers for complex care and to handle appointment scheduling, aiming to help employers cut 10-20% of healthcare spend while improving employee outcomes. Rovi Health was a Y Combinator (Fall 2025) company operating in the digital health, health insurance navigation, and consumer health services space. As of this enrichment pass Rovi Health publishes no public API, SDK, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Semperis
providers.description: Semperis provides identity-first cybersecurity and disaster recovery for hybrid Active Directory, Entra ID, and Okta environments. Its platform prevents, detects, and responds to identity-based attacks and enables rapid recovery to a trusted state. Products include Directory Services Protector (AD/Entra ID threat prevention, detection, and response), Active Directory Forest Recovery, Disaster Recovery for Entra Tenant, Recovery for Okta, Lightning Intelligence security posture assessment, Delegation Manager, Migrator for AD, and the Ready1 crisis-response platform, alongside the free community tools Purple Knight and Forest Druid. Backed by Insight Partners, Semperis serves enterprises defending the identity attack surface. This profile was enriched from public sources; Semperis publishes no public developer/REST API surface as of this pass.

providers.name: ShiftSouth
providers.description: ShiftSouth (Pty) Ltd operates SweepSouth, South Africa's first on-demand home services marketplace, launched in 2014. The platform connects roughly 250,000 customers with about 6,500 vetted home-services professionals ("SweepStars") across Cape Town, Johannesburg, Sandton, Centurion, Pretoria, Durban, Umhlanga, Stellenbosch, Paarl and other South African cities. Services span on-demand and express indoor cleaning, office and Airbnb turnover cleaning, laundry and ironing, elder care, Mom's Helper and childcare, dog walking, gardening and pool maintenance, plus full-time placements of housekeepers, nannies and carers and a MyHome Hub subscription for managing private domestic workers. Professionals are background-checked, reference-verified and insured. SweepSouth is a 500 Global portfolio company and has won the Forbes Africa Women Innovation Award (2020) and the World Economic Forum Breakthrough Female Innovators Award (2017). It is a consumer marketplace with mobile apps for iOS and Android and does not publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Sioma
providers.description: SIOMA is a Colombian precision-agriculture (agtech) software platform for tropical crops such as oil palm, banana, and cacao. It helps plantations monitor field labor, track harvest and weighing (pesaje) operations with GPS, and make data-driven decisions to raise productivity. The product combines a mobile field-management app, GPS-based labor tracking, smart weighing hardware (Nukak, Sigma, Jaco, and Bascula-G scales), and Siomi, an AI assistant for agriculture. SIOMA is delivered as a customer web and mobile application and is backed by 500 Global. No public API or developer program is currently published.

providers.name: Squint
providers.description: Squint is a Manufacturing Intelligence platform that uses AI and augmented reality to help industrial and frontline operations teams lower downtime and improve quality at scale. Its mobile app captures and digitizes tribal knowledge from video and real work, orchestrates workflows and work assignments across employees and locations, provides AI-powered troubleshooting and expert guidance, and delivers analytics on performance across teams and sites. Founded by Devin Bhushan, Squint began in manufacturing and serves automotive, food and beverage, oil and gas, heavy industrials, equipment, consumer packaged goods, and energy customers, expanding into healthcare and hospitality. Backed by Menlo Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Squint exposes no public developer API; its documentation and application are gated behind a Squint workspace login.

providers.name: StatMuse
providers.description: StatMuse is a natural-language search engine that answers sports and financial questions in plain English, returning instant stats, tables, and visual answers. It covers MLB, NBA, NFL, NHL, WNBA, PGA, college football, and soccer, along with StatMuse Money for stock-market and finance data. Users ask questions conversationally ("How many points did LeBron score last night?") and get sourced answers with charts and shareable cards. Backed by Techstars, the company is consumer-facing and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or programmatic access surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company lead.

providers.name: SuccessionMatching
providers.description: SuccessionMatching is an online community platform that connects business buyers, sellers, and succession planning professionals to facilitate ownership transitions of businesses and farms. The platform uses a compatibility matching algorithm to pair buyers and sellers, offers customizable privacy settings, commission-free sales for owners, educational resources on succession planning and business valuation, and a formal succession planning program that guides owners through selling their business. A Techstars-backed company operating a members-only web application, it currently exposes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: T-Mobile
providers.description: A major American wireless network operator and the second-largest carrier in the United States. Known for its Un-carrier strategy disrupting the wireless industry with simplified plans, no-contract offerings, and aggressive 5G network expansion.

providers.name: Teamshares
providers.description: Teamshares is a tech-enabled acquirer of small businesses that offers a permanent home for companies whose owners are retiring. It programmatically buys profitable companies with $0.5-5 million of EBITDA from retiring owners, integrates them onto the Teamshares operating platform of financial products, software, and education, and helps employees earn company stock through employee ownership. Backed by QED Investors and other fintech investors, Teamshares runs a login-gated operating platform (os.teamshares.com) for its portfolio companies plus an investor portal. As of this profile Teamshares publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Udaan
providers.description: Udaan is India's largest eB2B trade platform, connecting small businesses - kirana stores, chemists, hotels, restaurants, and offices - with manufacturers, brands, and wholesalers across categories including FMCG, staples, fruits and vegetables, pharma, and general merchandise. The platform combines supply chain and logistics operations with financial services for small businesses through udaanCapital, its working-capital fintech arm. Udaan is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and GGV Capital. It publishes no public developer API; buyer and seller experiences are delivered through its web and mobile apps, with api.udaan.com serving as the private app backend.

providers.name: Vertex Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Vertex Pharmaceuticals is a global biotechnology company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, focused on scientific innovation to create transformative medicines for people with serious diseases. The company specializes in cystic fibrosis, sickle cell disease, beta thalassemia, APOL1-mediated kidney disease, pain, and other serious conditions. Vertex is committed to responsible sharing of clinical trial data with qualified researchers through formal data request processes.

providers.name: Vico
providers.description: Vico (getvico.com) is a Colombian marketplace for finding and renting furnished rooms, aparta-estudios, and apartments for shared, medium- to long-term stays across cities such as Bogotá and Medellín. Guests browse and book verified co-living spaces while hosts list and manage rooms, under the tagline "Ama donde vives" (Love where you live). It is a consumer-facing accommodation platform backed by 500 Global; it exposes no public developer API program, OpenAPI, GraphQL, or /.well-known discovery surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Virtuo
providers.description: Virtuo (govirtuo.com) is a Paris-based, next-generation car rental company founded in 2015 and backed by Balderton Capital. It replaces the traditional rental counter with a mobile app: customers book, unlock, and return premium connected vehicles (Mercedes, BMW, Audi, Peugeot, Renault, Toyota, Volkswagen and others) entirely from their phone, with delivery options, free cancellation, and 24/7 support across 100+ locations in Europe. Virtuo also runs a "Virtuo for Business" corporate program and has committed to offsetting 100% of trips and electrifying its fleet by 2030. Virtuo does not publish a public developer API or documentation surface; this profile captures the company's public web properties and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Vise
providers.description: Vise is an SEC-registered investment adviser that provides an AI-powered wealth management platform for financial advisors, RIAs, enterprise wealth firms, and asset managers. The platform helps advisors build personalized, tax-aware portfolios and supports direct indexing, fixed income management, long/short strategies, tax-loss harvesting, portfolio rebalancing, and client reporting, managing over $100B in platform assets across 135K+ accounts. Vise publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK; this profile captures its public company, legal, and domain-security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Waymark
providers.description: Waymark is a healthcare technology and services company that scales value-based, community-based care for people enrolled in Medicaid. In partnership with health plans and primary care providers, Waymark trains and employs local care teams — community health workers, care coordinators, licensed therapists, and pharmacists — and equips them with predictive technology that identifies high-risk patients and coordinates interventions addressing the social determinants of health such as housing, food security, transportation, medication management, and behavioral health. The model is designed to reduce avoidable hospitalizations and emergency room visits, and Waymark operates community-based care across Ohio, Virginia, and Washington. The company is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), NEA, Lux Capital, and CVS Health Ventures. Waymark publishes no public developer API or documentation surface; this profile captures the company identity and its public web presence.

providers.name: Westlake Chemical
providers.description: Westlake Chemical (now Westlake Corporation) is a global manufacturer and supplier of petrochemicals, polymers, building products, and specialty chemicals. The company produces ethylene, polyethylene, PVC, chlor-alkali, epoxy resins, and fabricated building products serving packaging, healthcare, automotive, consumer goods, and construction markets worldwide.

providers.name: Zeta
providers.description: Zeta is a next-generation banking and payment card processing platform for banks and financial institutions, offering a cloud-native omnistack to launch and manage credit, debit, prepaid, BNPL, and fleet card programs alongside loans and deposits. Its product suite spans Tachyon (core processing and real-time APIs and events), Neutrino (digital app experiences), Elena (conversational AI), Saturn (servicing and back-office operations), Luminos (engagement and rewards), and Zeus (data and analytics). Founded by Bhavin Turakhia and Ramki Gaddipati and backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Zeta processes 25+ million cards across seven countries for institutions including HDFC Bank, Pluxee, and Sparrow. Zeta's platform is delivered to enterprise banking partners; its APIs are partner-gated rather than published on a public developer portal.

providers.name: Zum
providers.description: Zum is a student transportation technology company that runs school bus operations for K-12 school districts through its Connected Mobility Experience (CMX) platform. Founded by Ritu Narayan and headquartered in Redwood City, California, Zum unifies parents, students, drivers, and district administrators with real-time ride tracking, route optimization, parent notification apps, driver tooling, fleet management dashboards, and an electrified bus program. The company serves roughly 6,500 schools and districts, has completed more than 159 million rides, and is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund. Zum operates consumer-facing parent and driver mobile apps and district dashboards, but publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or API surface at this time.

providers.name: 4D Bios
providers.description: 4D Bios Co., Ltd. (四维生态, Hangzhou, China) is an ag-tech manufacturer of smart vertical-farming systems, founded in 2018 by Dr. Gary Hua. It designs and builds fully enclosed, digitally controlled plant factories — 3D, nursery, strawberry, leafy-greens and specialty lines — alongside containerized grow systems, indoor grow boxes, full-control planting equipment and LED horticultural lighting. The hardware is operated from the company's own software layer: the 4D Cloud Platform, the 4D CUBE MS management console and 4D BOX, which combine IoT telemetry, environmental and HVAC control, nutrient-solution circulation and big-data analytics for year-round continuous production. 4D Bios markets a "4D Bios Open Platform API" for customers who have already purchased its products and want to build their own software or hardware against the platform, and invites third-party platform service providers to develop applications on the Open Platform. That API has no public developer portal, reference, or machine-readable contract; the Open Platform and IoT consoles are login-gated single-page applications.

providers.name: Acclinate
providers.description: Acclinate is a health-equity technology company that improves clinical trial diversity by building trust with historically underrepresented communities. Its NOWINCLUDED community platform engages 250,000+ members with culturally relevant content and in-person events, while its proprietary e-DICT AI/ML engine transforms community trust signals into predictive enrollment intelligence — participation-probability scoring, demographic forecasting, and real-time dashboards for pharmaceutical sponsors and CROs. Acclinate operates as a managed service across a three-stage trust model (Access, Engage, Mobilize) rather than a self-service developer platform; no public API, developer portal, or API documentation is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Adicet Bio
providers.description: Adicet Bio, Inc. (Nasdaq: ACET) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company with offices in Redwood City, California and Boston, Massachusetts, discovering and developing allogeneic "off-the-shelf" gamma delta T cell therapies engineered with chimeric antigen receptors (CARs) for autoimmune disease and cancer. Its lead candidate, prulacabtagene leucel (prula-cel), is an anti-CD20 gamma delta CAR T cell therapy in development for B cell-mediated autoimmune diseases, alongside ADI-212 for metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. Adicet publishes a corporate website covering its science platform, clinical pipeline, leadership and careers, plus a vendor-hosted investor relations portal. It operates no public developer program, API, SDK, or machine-readable interface of any kind; this profile records that absence rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Alude
providers.description: Alude is a Brazilian proptech (real estate technology) SaaS platform that digitizes the day-to-day operations of imobiliárias (real estate agencies), brokers, and property managers. Serving more than 20,000 agencies, the platform bundles rental management with automated payment collection and reporting, instant CPF/CNPJ tenant background screening (análise de ficha), legally valid electronic signatures without digital certificates, fast fire-insurance (seguro incêndio) issuance, automated property capture and lead generation, and capitalization bonds as an alternative to traditional rental deposits. Alude is LGPD-compliant, free to try without a credit card, and backed by Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, Global Founders Capital, and MAYA Capital. It operates as an end-to-end web application rather than a public API-first product; no developer portal, OpenAPI, or public API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Ambient Clinical Analytics
providers.description: Ambient Clinical Analytics is a Rochester, Minnesota clinical decision support company spun out of Mayo Clinic in 2013 and operating from the Mayo Clinic Business Accelerator. Its AWARE Patient Surveillance and AWARE Sepsis DART products are FDA Class II cleared, EMR-agnostic "bolt-on" dashboards that apply more than 1,200 licensed Mayo Clinic rules and algorithms to live patient data, delivering point-of-care data visualization, situational awareness of a patient's total condition, and smart notifications for conditions such as sepsis across ICU, tele-ICU and remote patient monitoring settings. Deployment is carried out by third-party EMR data-integration partners rather than by hospital IT; the company publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: American National Insurance
providers.description: American National Insurance Company is a multi-line insurance holding company founded in 1905 and headquartered in Galveston, Texas. The company offers life insurance, annuities, pension risk transfer, health insurance, and property and casualty insurance through multiple subsidiary companies operating in all 50 states. American National holds A-level ratings from A.M. Best, Fitch, and S&P.

providers.name: Andercore
providers.description: Andercore is a Europe‑based AI‑native supplier of industrial materials, operating a platform that unifies supply, demand, and capital for global industrial trade. The company offers real‑time inventory access, dynamic pricing, managed logistics, and embedded financing, aiming to replace fragmented manual processes with speed, transparency, and reliability across multiple languages and regions.

providers.name: ANYbotics
providers.description: ANYbotics is a Swiss deep-tech robotics company that builds ANYmal, an autonomous four-legged inspection robot used to automate routine and hazardous industrial inspections across power and utilities, oil and gas, mining, chemicals, and metals. Its platform pairs the legged robot with inspection-management software and analytics to increase plant uptime, cut costs, and remove workers from dangerous areas. ANYbotics is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. No public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface is exposed; this API Evangelist profile currently captures the company's published security and trust posture.

providers.name: Apnimed
providers.description: Apnimed is a late-stage clinical-stage pharmaceutical company headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, developing novel oral drug therapies for sleep-related breathing disorders. Its lead candidate AD109 (Oxnimbi) is a fixed-dose combination of an anti-muscarinic and a selective norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor, designed to improve upper-airway muscle activity and treat an underlying neuromuscular cause of obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) rather than manage it mechanically. The company was founded in 2017, partners with Shionogi through the Shionogi-Apnimed Sleep Science (SASS) joint venture, and had a New Drug Application for AD109 accepted by the FDA in 2026. Apnimed is a drug developer, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: ARCON
providers.description: ARCON provides runtime privilege security solutions that enforce just‑in‑time and just‑enough access for users, machines, and AI agents. Their platform evaluates identity, context, policy, and risk in real time to grant minimum necessary privileges, monitor usage, and automatically revoke access. ARCON serves enterprises across banking, telecom, utilities, government, healthcare, and education, helping reduce identity risk, accelerate compliance, and simplify governance through dynamic privilege lifecycle management.

providers.name: Arconic
providers.description: Arconic Corporation is an aluminum solutions company producing rolled aluminum sheet and plate, extrusions, and architectural building products for the aerospace, automotive, commercial transportation, building & construction, industrial, and packaging markets. Spun off from Alcoa in 2016, separated from Howmet Aerospace in 2020, and acquired by Apollo Global Management in August 2023 for approximately $5.2 billion, Arconic now operates as a private company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Key brands include Kawneer architectural systems and Reynobond aluminum composite panels.

providers.name: AstraZeneca
providers.description: AstraZeneca is a British-Swedish multinational pharmaceutical and biotechnology company focused on oncology, cardiovascular, renal, metabolism, and respiratory therapies. AstraZeneca does not publish a general developer portal or commercial public APIs; technology integration is delivered through enterprise partner programs, clinical trial data portals such as clinicaltrials.gov and the Vivli platform, and EDI/x12 channels used by distributors and pharmacy benefit managers.

providers.name: Atticus
providers.description: Atticus is a consumer legal-technology law firm, launched in 2019 and backed by Forerunner Ventures, True Ventures, and GV, that helps Americans in crisis get the benefits and aid they deserve. It began with Social Security Disability and has expanded to workers' compensation, VA benefits, and other government-aid programs. Atticus combines a free online qualification quiz, on-staff lawyers and client advocates reachable by phone, text, or chat, and a matching engine that connects each client with vetted attorneys from a network of 100+ top firms who work on contingency. It has helped tens of thousands of people access billions of dollars in life-changing aid. Atticus is a consumer-facing service company and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Attovia Therapeutics
providers.description: Attovia Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company in San Carlos, California, founded in 2022 and developing next-generation precision biologics for immune-mediated diseases. Its proprietary ATTOBODY platform is a modular protein design technology built on biparatopic nanobody scaffolds, used to engineer multispecific biologics that inhibit two, three, or four disease-driving pathways from a single molecule while targeting improved selectivity, stability, and less frequent dosing than existing therapies. The lead program ATTO-1310 is an anti-IL-31 candidate in Phase 1 for chronic pruritus and high-itch atopic dermatitis; ATTO-2306 (IL-31 x IL-13) and ATTO-1091 (TL1A x IL-23p19 x integrin alpha-4-beta-7, for inflammatory bowel disease) are in IND-enabling studies, alongside discovery-stage programs in rheumatology, IBD, and respiratory disease. The company raised a $105M Series B led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives and listed on Nasdaq as ATTO in August 2026, raising $289M. Attovia publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification — its product is therapeutics, not software.

providers.name: Aviva
providers.description: Aviva (Aviva Financial, S.A. de C.V., SOFOM E.N.R.) is a Mexican fintech lender operating under the tagline "Tu historia importa." It offers quick, secured personal and business loans originated in person through a network of 100+ physical kiosks across central Mexico (Puebla, Hidalgo, Estado de Mexico, Morelos, Queretaro, Tlaxcala and Veracruz), using a video-call onboarding flow (the Aviva Onboarding System, AOS) with same-day or 24-hour direct-deposit disbursement. Products include Aviva Contigo (everyday expenses, up to $15,000), Aviva tu Negocio (business owners, up to $20,000), Aviva tu Compra (appliances at Bodega Aurrera), and Aviva tu Casa (construction materials via Construrama). Borrowers manage payments through the Aviva mobile app. Aviva was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Aviva publishes no public developer portal, API, SDKs, or OpenAPI - it exposes a consumer web/app and kiosk surface only.

providers.name: axiTrust
providers.description: axiTrust is a technology and consulting platform for the Indian surety-bond market, connecting IRDAI-licensed insurers, MSMEs, and government procurement bodies. Its platform unifies application processing, underwriting checks, and insurance surety bond issuance, with dashboards for tracking bonds, partners, and claims, plus integrations to financial, legal, banking, and ROC data sources. axiTrust also offers consulting services including discovery workshops, economic analysis comparing sureties to bank guarantees, and adoption support for enterprises and government departments. It is not an insurer or broker; all insurance surety bonds are issued by IRDAI-licensed insurance companies. axiTrust is a fintech backed by General Catalyst.

providers.name: Ayenda
providers.description: Ayenda is a hotel-technology platform operating across Colombia, Mexico, and Peru. It combines a property management system (PMS), a channel manager for distributing hotel inventory, and a booking engine; ayenda.com is its consumer reservations channel where travelers search, compare, and book budget hotels, hostels, and aparthotels by city, neighborhood, or landmark, with both traveler and corporate (Empresas) rates. Ayenda began as a budget hotel chain and since 2023 has focused on software, management, and distribution for independent hoteliers across Latin America. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: AZmed
providers.description: AZmed is a Paris-based medical-imaging AI company whose Rayvolve AI Suite assists radiologists by automatically analyzing X-rays and other studies. Its applications include AZtrauma (fracture detection), AZchest (chest imaging), AZmeasure (anatomical measurements), AZboneage (bone-age assessment) and AZnod (CT nodule detection). The software integrates into existing radiology workflows rather than being exposed as a public developer API, and is deployed across 2,500+ healthcare centers in 55+ countries, analyzing over 15 million X-rays annually, backed by 10+ peer-reviewed publications. As of this profile AZmed does not publish a public REST API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI.

providers.name: B612
providers.description: B612 is a consumer selfie and beauty camera application for iOS and Android, published globally by SNOW Corporation and operated in mainland China as B612咔叽 (B612 Kaji) by Yiruike Information Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd. The app combines a real-time beauty camera, AR stickers and scene effects, user-created and creator-published filters, and photo and video editing tools, and has been distributed through the Apple App Store and Google Play since 2014. B612 is a mobile end-user product rather than an API provider: as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no developer portal, no public API documentation, no SDKs, and no machine-readable API artifacts on any of its web properties.

providers.name: Baubap
providers.description: Baubap is a Mexican fintech offering instant personal microloans through an Android mobile app. Founded in 2018 in Mexico City by Roberto Salcedo and Luis Villarreal, it grants loans from $500 to roughly $9,000 MXN in minutes with no credit-bureau check and no income verification, using its own AI/ML-based alternative-scoring model to serve underbanked and no-credit-history borrowers. On-time repayment unlocks progressively larger amounts and helps users build a positive credit history. Baubap operates as a regulated SOFOM registered with CONDUSEF and supervised by CNBV, complying with Mexican data-protection and financial-security regulations. It has no public developer API; this profile captures the company's identity, its published /llms.txt, and its domain-security posture.

providers.name: Big Lots
providers.description: Big Lots is a discount retailer offering a wide assortment of brand-name closeout merchandise including furniture, food, consumables, seasonal products, soft home, hard home, and electronics. Big Lots operated hundreds of stores across the United States. Big Lots filed for Chapter 11 in September 2024; a planned sale to Nexus Capital Management fell through, and in January 2025 Gordon Brothers Retail Partners acquired the company's assets and sold the Big Lots brand, up to 400 stores and distribution centers to Variety Wholesalers, which relaunched biglots.com in 2026. Big Lots publishes no developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Book My Show
providers.description: BookMyShow (Bigtree Entertainment Pvt. Ltd.) is India's premier online entertainment ticketing platform, serving as a centralized hub for discovering and booking movies, live music festivals, comedy, theatre, sports, activities, and Video-on-Demand (VOD) streaming. For enterprise partners and event organizers it also provides venue management software, box-office point-of-sale solutions, corporate vouchers, gift cards, and end-to-end event production capabilities. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Accel; enriched by the enrichment pipeline. No public developer API or portal was found, but BookMyShow publishes an agent-facing llms.txt describing its consumer inventory hubs and B2B services.

providers.name: Booster Fuels
providers.description: Booster (Booster Fuels, Inc.) is a mobile energy delivery company that brings gasoline, diesel, diesel exhaust fluid (DEF), and renewable fuel alternatives directly to vehicles, fleets, and on-site fuel tanks using a fleet of Smart Tankers, removing the need for drivers to visit gas stations. The company serves enterprise fleets and local businesses across the United States, pairing on-demand fueling with a proprietary technology platform (BoosterOS / the Fleet dashboard at fleet.trybooster.com) for real-time fleet management, fuel-usage reporting, invoicing automation, fraud prevention, and emissions reduction. Booster offers custom enterprise integrations (ERP, CRM, and telematics such as Geotab and Samsara) but does not publish a public developer API portal, OpenAPI definition, or SDKs. This profile is a company/lead entry in the API Evangelist network; no public API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Bridgewater Bank
providers.description: Bridgewater Bank is a Canadian Schedule I chartered bank, a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Alberta Motor Association (AMA), headquartered in Calgary, Alberta and established in 1997. It is a member of the Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation (CDIC) and operates a broker-distributed, deposit-and-lending model rather than a direct-to-consumer retail branch network — residential mortgages, Guaranteed Investment Certificates (GICs), and high-interest savings accounts sold through a select network of trusted mortgage and deposit brokers, with roughly $3.3 billion in mortgages and deposits across approximately 53,000 customer accounts nationwide. Bridgewater Bank exposes NO public first-party developer API or developer portal. Its only dedicated digital surface beyond the corporate site is a partner-gated broker information portal (bwbbrokerinfo.ca). Canada's Consumer-Driven Banking (open-banking) framework is legislated but not yet operational, so any consumer data access from a bank of this size is voluntary and today would be aggregator/screen-scraping based rather than through a documented first-party API. No Interac, Real-Time Rail (RTR), FDX, or consumer-driven-banking API participation is publicly documented by the institution.

providers.name: Canopy Aerospace & Defense
providers.description: Canopy Aerospace & Defense (Canopy A&D) is a vertically integrated advanced materials platform serving the aerospace, defense, space, maritime, and power-electronics industries. The company manufactures and delivers highly specialized materials with exceptional insulative, absorptive, and signal-reducing characteristics, including thermal protection systems (TPS), ultra-high-temperature ceramics, additive-manufactured ceramic components, multi-layer insulation and soft goods, and composite structures. Formed by Trive Capital through the combination of Canopy Aerospace, Hera Technologies, and MSM Industries, Canopy partners with OEMs from initial design and R&D through turnkey manufacturing and refurbishment of reusable platforms, operating facilities across the US, UK, and Netherlands. This is a physical materials manufacturer and publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its web and identity surface.

providers.name: Carreira Beauty
providers.description: Carreira Beauty (carreirabeauty.com) is a Brazilian online job marketplace connecting beauty, aesthetics, and wellness professionals with employment and freelance opportunities. The platform operates as a two-sided network that lets professionals — manicurists, hairdressers, estheticians, makeup artists, barbers, masotherapists, eyebrow designers, and salon receptionists — create a free professional profile and discover nearby openings, while salons, aesthetic clinics, spas, and studios post jobs and freelance ("freelas") shifts. It offers geographic filtering to match professionals with local roles, direct employer-to-professional communication over WhatsApp, and one free job posting per business with no credit card required. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global. Carreira Beauty is a consumer web application and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Civica Digital
providers.description: Cívica Digital is a Mexican civic-technology company, founded in 2015 and backed by 500 Global, that helps governments, public institutions, and organizations design, build, and launch digital services for citizens. Its product portfolio includes Urbem, a platform for digitizing government procedures and citizen-facing services; Signum, a digital document and official-records management system with electronic signatures; and a suite of conversational AI agents that support citizens over WhatsApp, phone, and web. The company focuses on digital government transformation across Latin America. No public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface has been located; this profile captures the company's public web presence, legal pages, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: ClevelandDx
providers.description: ClevelandDx, operating as Cleveland Diagnostics, provides innovative cancer diagnostic testing, including the IsoPSA test and the IsoClear platform. The company focuses on early detection of cancer through advanced protein biomarker analysis, offering services to clinicians and patients worldwide. Their mission is to improve cancer decision-making with more accurate and rapid diagnostic tools, supported by a leadership team and extensive research collaborations.

providers.name: Cooleaf
providers.description: Cooleaf is an employee engagement, recognition, and rewards platform built by ITA Group that helps HR and people leaders create lasting engagement across their organizations. The platform lets teams recognize peers, reward performance and KPIs, celebrate milestones and anniversaries, run pulse surveys and challenges, deliver training and programming, and surface engagement analytics through manager dashboards. Cooleaf meets employees where they already work by embedding recognition into Slack and Microsoft Teams and syncing people data through connectors like Zapier and Workday. Cooleaf is delivered as a closed SaaS product with a hosted web application and login; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API reference, so this API Evangelist profile captures its identity, domain-security posture, and the integration surface it exposes to customers rather than a developer program.

providers.name: Cowboy Space Corporation (formerly Aetherflux)
providers.description: Cowboy Space Corporation is an American orbital-infrastructure company founded in 2024 by Baiju Bhatt, co-founder and former co-CEO of Robinhood, headquartered in San Carlos, California with a second site in Seattle, Washington. It operated as Aetherflux Inc. from founding until May 2026, when it renamed to Cowboy Space Corporation and broadened its mission from space-based solar power alone to vertically integrated orbital infrastructure for the AI era, spanning launch vehicles, space-based power generation and in-orbit compute. Its flagship program is Stampede, a Low Earth Orbit constellation of satellites that harvest solar power to run on-orbit GPU data centers, with the first Galactic Brain data-center node targeted for early 2027 using NVIDIA Space-1 Vera Rubin modules and a small infrared power-beaming demonstrator satellite planned for 2026. The company concluded that launch supply was the binding constraint on orbital compute and is therefore also developing its own rocket, sized between Falcon 9 and Starship at roughly 20,000-25,000 kg of payload, whose upper stage is itself the payload - each one intended to become a one-megawatt orbital data center - with a first launch targeted for the end of 2028. It has raised roughly USD 365 million to date, including a USD 50 million Series A in April 2025 and a USD 275 million Series B in May 2026 at a USD 2 billion valuation, led by Index Ventures with IVP, Blossom Capital, SAIC, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Construct Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, NEA and Interlagos participating. Cowboy Space is a space hardware and energy infrastructure company, not a software vendor: as of August 2026 it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation, no SDK, no public GitHub organization and no machine-readable API contract of any kind. Its entire public web presence is a four-page Framer-hosted marketing site (home, terms, privacy, media terms of use) plus an Ashby-hosted careers board.

providers.name: Day One Biopharmaceuticals
providers.description: Day One Biopharmaceuticals is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company developing and commercializing targeted therapies for people of all ages living with life-threatening diseases, with an initial focus on pediatric and rare cancers. Its lead product OJEMDA (tovorafenib) is an FDA-approved treatment for relapsed or refractory pediatric low-grade glioma, and its pipeline includes DAY301 and the antibody-drug conjugate Emi-Le. Headquartered in Brisbane, California, the company was acquired by and is now part of the Servier Group as of March 2026. Day One was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; it maintains a corporate and investor-relations web presence but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or programmatic surface.

providers.name: Descomplica
providers.description: Descomplica is a Brazilian online education (edtech) company founded in 2011 and headquartered in Rio de Janeiro, offering a digital learning platform for ENEM and vestibular exam prep, K-12 (Escolar), undergraduate and graduate (Pós-graduação) degrees, public-exam (Concursos) preparation, and corporate training. The platform delivers live and recorded classes, study plans, tutoring, exercises, and support materials to millions of Brazilian students, and is MEC-authorized. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global; the company operates consumer and corporate learning products but does not publish a public developer API program.

providers.name: DLT Payments
providers.description: DLT Payments (DLTPAY) is a Web3 payments company offering a stablecoin wallet that enables businesses to send and receive instant payments in stablecoins across multiple blockchain networks — Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, and BNB Chain — with zero exposure to cryptocurrency price volatility. The product targets merchants and businesses that want the settlement speed and low cost of blockchain rails without the FX risk of holding volatile tokens. DLT Payments is a Techstars portfolio company. Added to the API Evangelist network and enriched from its public web surface; no public API, OpenAPI specification, or developer documentation was discovered at enrichment time.

providers.name: DouxMatok
providers.description: DouxMatok is an Israeli food-technology company, rebranded as Incredo Ltd in May 2023, that develops Incredo Sugar — a sugar-based sugar-reduction ingredient built on a patented silica-carrier delivery technology that improves how efficiently real cane or beet sugar reaches sweet taste receptors, enabling manufacturers to cut sugar in bakery, confectionery, chocolate, spreads and nut butters by 30-50% (the company markets up to 70%) without artificial sweeteners, sugar alcohols or the aftertaste and cooling effects of alternative sweeteners. The technology is protected by more than 20 patents, was named a TIME Best Invention of 2020, and was featured in Netflix's "Explained". The company sells as a B2B ingredient to food manufacturers through distributors and partner enquiries, and is backed by Sienna Venture Capital, Pitango, DSM-Firmenich Venturing and BlueRed Partners. It is an ingredient manufacturer, not a software vendor: as of this profile it operates a twelve-page marketing website and publishes no API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Draxon
providers.description: Draxon is a Berlin-based company (founded 2025, backed by HV Capital and Point Nine) that provides IATA-certified virtual reality training for airport ground handling operations. The platform ships pre-configured Meta Quest VR headsets and an immersive training library covering ramp equipment such as belt loaders, tractors, pushback tugs, GPUs and towable stairs, plus safety procedures and hand signals for frontline ramp personnel. Its Trainer Hub delivers automated, IATA-compliant certification tracking with self-paced or instructor-led modules. Draxon operates as a B2B SaaS training provider and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: EarnBetter
providers.description: EarnBetter is a consumer job-search platform that gives workers free AI-powered tools to land better work, including an AI resume builder, cover letter generator, personalized job matching across more than five million listings, and a job-search tracker. The service is positioned as 100% free to job seekers and was acquired by EarnIn, the earned-wage / payroll-access company. EarnBetter surfaces as a portfolio company of a16z and was added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. As of this pass EarnBetter publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface; this profile therefore captures company identity and public link properties only, with no API artifacts to enrich.

providers.name: Edge Case Research
providers.description: Edge Case Research (operating as "Edge Case", ecr.ai) is a Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania company founded in 2013 that provides functional safety engineering, risk management and safety-assurance software for autonomous and other "frontier technology" systems. Its DevSafeOps methodology carries safety through the whole product lifecycle — hazard identification in design, verified safety evidence in build, and continuous safety monitoring in operations — and its nLoop live-safety-case platform assembles evidence from design, simulation, test and field operations into an auditable, continuously updated safety case. The company works across aerospace and defense, automotive and autonomous trucking, space, oil and gas, and supply chain and logistics, and publishes the Open Autonomy Safety Case framework as SACM XML on GitHub. Edge Case publishes no public product API or OpenAPI; the only machine-readable surface reachable on its own host is the Wix-provided site MCP endpoint advertised in its llms.txt.

providers.name: Essex Open Data
providers.description: Essex Open Data is a local council open-data portal for United Kingdom running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately an open datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: Foundation Medicine
providers.description: Foundation Medicine is a molecular information and precision cancer diagnostics company that develops comprehensive genomic profiling (CGP) tests for solid tumors, blood cancers, and sarcomas, including its FoundationOne family of assays. Its testing analyzes patient tumor and liquid-biopsy samples to identify genomic alterations that can inform targeted therapy, immunotherapy, and clinical-trial matching, and it partners with biopharma on companion diagnostics and clinical-trial enrollment. A Roche company, it has delivered more than 1.5 million patient CGP reports and supports 950+ clinical trials. This profile was surfaced as a venture-portfolio lead (gv, kleiner-perkins) and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the company publishes no public developer API or portal, so this record captures its public web, legal, and security-disclosure surface.

providers.name: Geltor
providers.description: Geltor is a biodesign company founded in 2015 by Alex Lorestani and Nick Ouzounov that engineers animal-free designer proteins, peptides and polypeptides and manufactures them through precision fermentation. Its Biodesigner AI computational biology platform is used to imagine, screen and optimize novel protein sequences, which are then scaled commercially as ingredients for beauty and personal care, specialty nutrition and medical/life-science applications. The portfolio includes HumaColl 21 (biomimetic human collagen), HumaColl 21 Select (a matrikine peptide complex), Elastapure (biomimetic human elastin), Collume and Caviance (vegan collagens) and PrimaColl, a Type XXI signaling collagen and the first biotech-derived collagen to receive an FDA GRAS "no questions" letter for ingestible use. Geltor sells business-to-business to brand formulators and manufacturers; it publishes no public developer API, SDK or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Getsafe
providers.description: Getsafe (Getsafe Digital GmbH) is a Heidelberg, Germany-based digital insurance company (insurtech) that lets consumers buy, manage, and file claims for insurance entirely through a mobile app. Getsafe operates as a licensed insurance carrier and offers 15+ products across liability and legal protection, health (public, private, dental, and travel), living (contents and drone), pet (pet health and dog liability), and protection and finance (income protection, term life, private pension, and children's savings). It serves 500k+ customers in Germany and Austria with English-language, app-based support. In 2018 Getsafe launched an early-access P&C and health insurance API and embeddable widget for partner distribution; that partner API is no longer offered as a public self-service developer program, so this profile is maintained as a company record. Backed by earlybird and partech.

providers.name: Gustav
providers.description: Gustav is a vendor management platform (VMS) and sub-vendor marketplace for the staffing industry, enabling staffing firms to source talent from their trusted vendor network, share open jobs, collect and screen candidate submissions, run standardized hiring pipelines, schedule interviews, message vendors, and track performance in one place. Vendors organize into "Gustav Circles" with tiered job-release controls, and candidate submissions sync to applicant tracking systems including Bullhorn and JobDiva. Originally a Speedinvest-backed startup, Gustav is now operated by the member-owned Fuse Cooperative (a Colorado Limited Cooperative Association) and bills itself as the staffing industry's largest sub-vendor marketplace. Gustav is a SaaS web application; it does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs — integrations are delivered through the Bullhorn and JobDiva marketplaces.

providers.name: Harris Ambulatory Care Enterprise
providers.description: Harris Ambulatory Care Enterprise (part of Harris Healthcare, a Harris Computer company) provides ambulatory healthcare software solutions including the Pulse electronic health record system. The platform supports a §170.315(g)(10) ONC certified FHIR API for third-party application developers to access patient data, provider information, and clinical resources. Pulse is deployed on-premises, so each provider hosts a separate API instance with its own base URL. Third-party developers must obtain an ONC 2015 Edition Certified API License and register with each provider organization.

providers.name: Herb
providers.description: Herb (herb.co) is a leading digital media and e-commerce platform dedicated to cannabis culture, education, and lifestyle. It publishes cannabis news, strain databases, product reviews, dispensary and brand guides, deals, recipes, and city-level legalization guides, and operates the "Herb Agency" offering branding and marketing services to cannabis companies. The consumer site is built on Gatsby (React) with a GraphQL data layer, Algolia search, and a Firebase/serverless backend hosted on Netlify. Herb is backed by Bullpen Capital and was added to the API Evangelist network from that portfolio; the company exposes no public developer API program at this time, so this profile captures its published web, content, and discovery surface (llms.txt, domain security posture, and identity/link properties) rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Hippo Insurance
providers.description: Hippo, the US homeowners insurance company at hippo.com. This is a duplicate slug: Hippo is profiled in the hippo-com repository (slug follows the hippo.com domain), which is canonical. Consolidated 2026-10-13, approved by Kin Lane.

providers.name: iBasis
providers.description: iBasis is a global communications solutions provider serving mobile operators, MVNOs, over-the-top players, and IoT device companies worldwide. Its portfolio spans international and managed voice, 5G data roaming and roaming hub/breakout, A2P and RCS messaging monetization, and IoT connectivity built on eSIM technology, the Simfony connectivity-management platform, MVNO-as-a-Service, and fixed wireless access. iBasis also offers signaling and fraud security (FraudLock iQ360, Security iQ360, Signaling Vulnerability Scanner) and business intelligence for carriers. Customer and partner operations run through the eCare portal behind single sign-on; iBasis does not currently publish a public developer program, OpenAPI specifications, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of CRV and enriched from the public iBasis web presence and live domain probes.

providers.name: Impactyn B.V
providers.description: Impactyn B.V is an AI-powered crowd-marketing platform that turns authentic user-generated video reviews into brand marketing assets. Based in Cairo, Egypt, Impactyn connects brands with real customers who record genuine video testimonials, letting businesses leverage user-generated video content to increase visibility, credibility, and engagement. The platform is delivered primarily through consumer iOS and Android mobile apps plus a partner/brand web console, and was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. Founded by Mohamed Wahid and registered in Egypt under Commercial Register No. 18682, the company reports 51,000 consumer signups in its first year and sells brands a campaign-based service with a live views/engagement/ROI dashboard. No public API, developer portal, SDK, machine-readable specification or /.well-known/ document is published — verified by probe on 2026-08-12 — and the partner console host advertised on the website no longer resolves. This profile captures company identity, the domain-security posture, a verified well-known probe, and the absence of published pricing.

providers.name: Infervision
providers.description: Infervision is a medical artificial intelligence company that builds AI-powered medical imaging and clinical decision-support software for hospitals and healthcare providers. Its InferRead diagnostic suite assists radiologists with CT and DR reading across lung nodule detection, chest abnormality detection, coronary artery stenosis, stroke and hemorrhage triage, rib fracture identification, and pneumonia triage, while the InferOperate suite provides 3D reconstruction for thoracic, liver, and urological surgical planning. Additional platforms include InferCare for patient management and image follow-up, InferScholar for AI-enabled medical research, and the InferMatrix medical application platform. The company holds FDA 510(k) clearance for InferRead CT Lung, has filed 380+ patents and published 330+ peer-reviewed papers, and operates across 30+ countries. Infervision was surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: Instruct
providers.description: Instruct ("AI that works for you") is an AI automation platform that lets non-technical users delegate repetitive work across their connected applications. Users describe a task in natural language and Instruct's AI pulls context from one integrated app, acts on it in another, and can turn any successful one-off task into a recurring scheduled workflow, spanning use cases across education, recruiting, sales, and operations. It is a hosted end-user application with a free plan and Google/email sign-up. As of this profile Instruct does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation. Instruct is backed by Creandum.

providers.name: Justos
providers.description: Justos is a Brazilian digital auto insurance insurtech founded in 2020 and headquartered in Barueri, São Paulo. Operating as a managing general agent (MGA), Justos uses smartphone-collected driving data (telematics) to reward safe drivers with lower, usage-based pricing — advertised as up to 30% cheaper than traditional plans — plus weekly bonuses and perks like gas vouchers, maintenance, and ride credits. Its products are distributed digitally through a consumer mobile app and a broker (corretor) portal, with claims tracked in-app and 24/7 support. Backed by Ribbit Capital, Kaszek, SoftBank Latin America and GGV; its auto insurance is underwritten by Companhia Excelsior de Seguros (SUSEP code 05690). No public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal is published at this time.

providers.name: Kaavio
providers.description: Kaavio is an AI-powered product content platform for B2B distributors and manufacturers. It sources product data from supplier submissions, PDFs, spec sheets, internal systems (PIM, DAM, ERP) and the web, validates it with conflict detection and confidence scoring, generates market-ready content (structured attributes, SEO descriptions, FAQs, comparisons, substitutes), and deploys it to destination systems such as PIMs, e-commerce platforms, and channels. The platform handles catalogs ranging from 20,000 to more than a million SKUs and claims a 90% reduction in the time and effort to get market-ready SKU content online. Founded by Derek Gregg and Sam Bobb, based in San Francisco, and backed by Baukunst, Techstars, and Looking Glass Capital ($2.9M pre-seed).

providers.name: Kirilys Therapeutics
providers.description: Kirilys Therapeutics is a multi-asset precision oncology company developing targeted therapeutic treatments for cancer patients. Led by co-founder and CEO BT Slingsby, MD, PhD, MPH, the company is building a pipeline of precision medicines and is backed by Catalys Pacific, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and UBE. Kirilys was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a clinical-stage biotech, Kirilys publishes a corporate marketing website (company, news, and contact pages) but exposes no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or machine discovery surface at this time.

providers.name: Komodor
providers.description: Komodor is an autonomous AI SRE platform for Kubernetes observability, troubleshooting, and operations across multiple clusters. The platform surfaces cluster events, deployment timelines, dependency maps, and remediation runbooks to help platform and SRE teams diagnose incidents faster. Komodor exposes a REST API plus a Terraform provider for managing clusters, services, monitors, and policies, authenticated with API keys generated from the User Settings page.

providers.name: Koobz
providers.description: Koobz is a Ventura, California additive-manufacturing company rebuilding the footwear supply chain around on-demand 3D printing. Its "gigafactory" prints circular-ready, mono-material foamed-TPU shoes to order, so brands carry zero inventory and face no minimum order quantities: a consumer buys on the brand's own storefront, the order and personalization specs sync to the Koobz factory, the shoe is printed in Ventura and dropshipped direct to the customer in days. The company markets 10x faster concept-to-market cycles (4-6 weeks, no tooling), custom cushioning and foot-scanning personalization, and a KoobzWeave toolpath-as-textile upper pattern engine. Its mono-material architecture is positioned for Extended Producer Responsibility regimes such as California SB 707, since a single-polymer shoe yields premium TPU on take-back rather than mixed waste. Koobz has raised $7.2M and is backed by Uncork Capital. It describes its factory as API-driven and its order intake as an API sync from brand storefronts, but as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API definition; integration appears to run through its partner ("Partner With Us") channel.

providers.name: Kotcha
providers.description: Kotcha is a consumer running-coaching mobile application operated by PACEUP SAS, a French company based in Paris, and co-founded with marathon world-record holder Eliud Kipchoge and the NN Running Team. The app generates personalized, adaptive training plans for 5K, 10K, half-marathon and marathon distances, delivered through a conversational AI coach that adapts to completed workouts, and it imports activity and health data from Strava, Garmin Connect, Apple, Coros and Huawei wearables. Kotcha raised EUR 3.5M in October 2025 in a round led by Racine2, operated by Serena and makesense. Kotcha is a consumer subscription product distributed through the Apple App Store and Google Play; it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract, and its terms of service explicitly prohibit automated access to the service. This profile records that absence rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Leapmotor
providers.description: Leapmotor (Zhejiang Leapmotor Technology Co., Ltd., HKEX: 9863) is a Chinese intelligent electric vehicle manufacturer founded in 2015 and headquartered in Hangzhou, China, which sold its first vehicles in 2019. Leapmotor designs and builds battery-electric and range-extended (REEV) passenger vehicles — including the T03 city car and the B03X, B05, B10 and C10 SUVs — on its own vertically integrated LEAP platform, developing its electric drive, battery, and intelligent cockpit and driving systems in house. Stellantis took a stake in the company in 2023 and, through the Leapmotor International joint venture, distributes Leapmotor vehicles across Europe and other export markets via leapmotor.net. Leapmotor operates connected-vehicle services — the Leapmotor mobile app, OTA software updates, and the Leapmotor Connected Experience — but publishes no public developer API program, developer portal, or API documentation; the vehicle cloud interfaces used by its mobile app are private and only reached through unofficial, reverse-engineered community clients.

providers.name: Livspace
providers.description: Livspace is India's largest home interior design and renovation company, founded in 2014 and headquartered in Bangalore. It runs an end-to-end, technology-driven interiors platform: free design consultation, in-browser 3D visualisation, factory-made modular products (kitchens, wardrobes, storage), and managed on-site installation, backed by a lifetime warranty on modular products. Livspace serves 125+ cities across India through 100+ Experience Centres and a network of interior designers, covering full-home interiors, modular kitchens, false ceilings, flooring, painting and related fit-out services. It is a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio company. This profile currently exposes no public developer API or SDK surface; enrichment captured its public security, well-known, and llms.txt surfaces.

providers.name: MagnusMetal
providers.description: Magnus Metal (MagnusMetal Ltd.) is an Israeli advanced-manufacturing company bringing metal casting into the Industry 4.0 era with its patent-pending Digital Casting System. Founded in 2017 and headquartered at the Revadim Industrial Park in Kibbutz Revadim, Israel, the company builds machines that combine additive-manufacturing and casting principles: a slicer designs a ceramic mold layer by layer and solid alloy is deposited into each layer, so parts are produced from widely available solid metals rather than powders and with no hard tooling. The company markets the process for powertrains, engines, industrial machinery and structural components, claiming removal of 6-18 weeks of tooling lead time, up to 70% raw-material savings and roughly 50% lower energy use. Magnus Metal is a hardware and materials manufacturer - it sells castings and casting systems, not software - and publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Motorola
providers.description: Motorola (motorola.com) is the consumer mobile-device brand operated by Motorola Mobility, a Lenovo company, producing Android smartphones (moto g, moto edge, and razr foldable lines), tablets, and accessories sold worldwide. It was originally added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio stub. On review, the consumer brand publishes no open public REST/HTTP API developer portal: the historical developer.motorola.com Moto Mods hardware SDK (for the modular Moto Z) is no longer reachable, and no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, or well-known discovery surface was found. Enterprise and public-safety APIs are offered separately by Motorola Solutions, Inc. (docs.motorolasolutions.com), a distinct company, under a gated partner Application Developer Program.

providers.name: Murphy USA
providers.description: Murphy USA (NYSE: MUSA) is a Fortune 500 retailer of gasoline and convenience merchandise, headquartered in El Dorado, Arkansas. The company operates roughly 1,700 Murphy USA and Murphy Express stores across a 27-state footprint in the southern and midwestern United States, most of them sited in or adjacent to Walmart Supercenter parking lots, and it also owns the QuickChek chain of fresh convenience stores in New Jersey and New York. Its fuel slate spans E-10, E-15, FlexFuel (E85), ethanol-free E0, ULSD diesel, biodiesel and winterized diesel, marketed alongside a FuelAssure fuel-quality monitoring program. Consumer digital engagement runs through the Murphy Drive Rewards loyalty app and a Business Fuel Card program. Murphy USA publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: OneShield
providers.description: OneShield Software provides core insurance platform solutions for property and casualty (P&C) insurers, managing general agents (MGAs), program administrators, and insurance startups. Its two platforms — OneShield Enterprise, a comprehensive cloud/SaaS core suite, and OneShield Market Solutions (OMS), a preconfigured SaaS offering — cover policy administration, billing, claims, rating, product configuration, relationship management, business intelligence, and analytics across more than 90 lines of business. OneShield exposes RESTful and SOAP integration services (XML/JSON) through its Services Designer and OMS API integration suite, but publishes no public developer portal or OpenAPI; API access is provisioned to customers and implementation partners.
