Headquartered in Marlborough, Massachusetts with offices in India, OneShield is backed by investors including Bain Capital and Earlybird Venture Capital.

providers.name: Open Data Schleswig-Holstein
providers.description: Open Data Schleswig-Holstein is a state government open-data portal for Germany running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 32,414 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: Oportun
providers.description: Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company and U.S. Treasury-certified Community Development Financial Institution (CDFI) that provides responsible, affordable personal loans, savings, and budgeting tools to people with limited or no credit history. Founded in 2006, Oportun has disbursed more than $20.8 billion across 7.7 million loans and established credit history for over 1.3 million people. Beyond its consumer app, Oportun runs an Enterprise Platform offering Lending-as-a-Service (LaaS) and embedded-finance partnerships, but publishes no public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or self-serve API; the LaaS integration API is available only through contact-gated enterprise partnerships.

providers.name: PictorLabs.ai
providers.description: Pictor Labs develops AI-powered virtual staining technology for histopathology and digital pathology laboratories. Its platform generates diagnostic-quality tissue stains computationally in minutes rather than the hours or days required by traditional chemical staining, preserving precious tissue samples for additional downstream testing. Products include ClearStain for direct virtual H&E sequencing and DeepStain and ReStain for flexible, repeatable multi-stain tissue analysis. The technology integrates with existing whole-slide scanner platforms (partners include Hamamatsu and Proscia) and offers cloud or on-premise deployment. Virtual stains are currently labeled For Research Use Only. Pictor Labs is a venture-backed company in the Insight Partners portfolio. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: Plus One Robotics
providers.description: Plus One Robotics is a San Antonio, Texas warehouse-automation company founded in 2016 by Erik Nieves and Shaun Edwards that builds AI-powered computer-vision software and robotic work cells for parcel handling, depalletizing, palletizing and induction. Its PickOne perception system tells a robot arm how to grasp each item and verifies placement, while Yonder provides supervised autonomy — remote human "Crew Chiefs" who take over when the robot hits an exception. Packaged work cells DepalOne and InductOne wrap that stack in deployable hardware. The company reports more than 1.5 billion lifetime picks across robots fielded in 15 countries, with additional offices in Eindhoven (Netherlands) and Boulder, Colorado. Plus One Robotics publishes no public developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract; product integration is handled through its partner channel and a login-gated partner portal.

providers.name: Polisen
providers.description: Polisen is Sweden’s national police authority, responsible for law enforcement, public safety, and crime prevention across the country. The agency provides public information, services, and resources through its website, including crime statistics, reporting tools, and guidance for citizens. While primarily a governmental organization, its digital platforms expose various APIs for data access, service integration, and public engagement, making it a relevant entity for API profiling and integration efforts.

providers.name: Precision Neuroscience
providers.description: Precision Neuroscience is a New York City brain-computer interface company founded in 2021 by Benjamin Rapoport, Michael Mager, Demetrios Papageorgiou and Mark Hettick, with additional sites in Santa Clara, California and Addison, Texas. Its product is the Layer 7 Cortical Interface, a thin-film microelectrode array that lies on the surface of the cortex rather than penetrating brain tissue, and is designed to be removable and upgradable. The array received FDA 510(k) clearance for recording, monitoring and stimulating on the brain surface for implantation durations of up to 30 days, and the company reports 95+ clinical study participants across 15+ hospital partnerships — Mount Sinai, Penn Medicine, Johns Hopkins, Mass General Brigham, Northwestern, Emory, Barrow Neurological Institute and others — plus a strategic partnership with Medtronic. Precision sells a regulated medical device, not software services. It runs no developer program: no public API, SDK, webhooks, developer portal or machine-readable specification is published anywhere on its domain. Its only public engineering surface is a verified GitHub organization whose single public repository is an Apache-2.0 research notebook accompanying a 2025 neural-decoding result.

providers.name: Rapport Therapeutics
providers.description: Rapport Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: RAPP) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts with research operations in San Diego, California, founded in 2022 and taken public in a $174 million IPO in June 2024. Rapport develops precision small-molecule medicines for central nervous system disorders using its proprietary RAP technology platform, which pairs human genetics with functional proteomics to identify receptor-associated proteins that confer neuroanatomical specificity — the goal being drugs that act only where the disease circuit lives rather than across the whole brain. Its lead clinical candidate, RAP-219, is a selective negative allosteric modulator of TARP-gamma-8-associated AMPA receptors in development for focal onset seizures, peripheral neuropathic pain and bipolar disorder, behind two discovery-stage nicotinic acetylcholine receptor programs targeting alpha-6 (chronic pain) and alpha-9-alpha-10 (hearing disorders). Rapport is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor: the RAP platform is an internal discovery capability and the company publishes no developer program, no public API and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Redwood Materials
providers.description: Redwood Materials is a Carson City, Nevada battery materials company founded in 2017 by former Tesla CTO JB Straubel. It operates a domestic circular supply chain for lithium-ion batteries: collecting and recycling end-of-life EV, consumer, micromobility and stationary-storage batteries, refining the recovered lithium, nickel, cobalt and copper, and remanufacturing anode copper foil and cathode active material for North American cell producers. Through Redwood Energy it also deploys second-life battery energy storage systems for data centers and the grid. Redwood runs the Tahoe Campus in Northern Nevada, the Carolina Campus outside Charleston, South Carolina, and an R&D center in San Francisco, and works with Panasonic, Toyota, GM, BMW, VW/Audi, Rivian, Caterpillar, Isuzu and Lime. Redwood publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK or MCP server; its only machine-facing surface is a gated AWS Cognito partner portal used by automotive dismantlers to price and sell end-of-life battery packs.

providers.name: Reibus
providers.description: Reibus is a technology-enabled B2B platform for the industrial metals industry, originally a digital marketplace for buying and selling steel and other metals and now focused on open-deck freight logistics for shipping steel and industrial metals. Operating as Reibus Logistics, the company connects shippers with a vast network of international and domestic carriers across flatbed, dry van, and drayage modes, offering instant quoting, shipment visibility, and cross-border logistics in the US, Canada, and Mexico. Founded by CEO John Blount, Reibus operates in 7 countries, does business in 25+ countries, and is backed by Canaan Partners, Initialized Capital, and the SoftBank Vision Fund. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Sally Beauty Holdings
providers.description: Sally Beauty Holdings, Inc. is a leading international specialty retailer and distributor of professional beauty supplies. Operates through two segments: Sally Beauty Supply (consumer-facing beauty retail) and Beauty Systems Group (BSG, professional-only distribution). The company serves salon professionals, colorists, and beauty enthusiasts with over 4,800 stores globally.

providers.name: Sankun
providers.description: Sankun (산군) is a South Korean construction-industry big data platform based in Seoul that aggregates and sells access to eight integrated construction databases covering roughly 280,000 construction companies, some 820,000 project sites, government e-procurement bids, contract awards, professional reputation reviews, and construction news. Alongside its web application and a construction sales CRM (Sankun Sales), the company markets a Sankun API (data.sankun.com) for programmatic access to its construction data, though public developer documentation is gated behind sales and login. Sankun is a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: SarisAI
providers.description: SarisAI (Saris) builds agentic AI workflow automation for banks and credit unions, automating multi-step back-office operations across lending, compliance, and operations while keeping human oversight and audit trails. Its platform runs six specialized AI agents (Document, System, Inbox, Audit & Monitoring, External, and Income & Financial Analysis) that handle document intake, income verification, data validation, borrower communication, and post-close regulatory checks across mortgage, consumer, and commercial lending. Saris integrates directly with core banking, loan origination, and document systems (Fiserv, Encompass, OnBase/Hyland, Meridian) and LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini). The company is a Homebrew-backed fintech and is SOC 2, GDPR, GLBA, and CUSO certified. It is a private B2B platform with no public developer API, OpenAPI, or self-service surface; this profile captures its identity and security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Scrapy
providers.description: Scrapy is an open-source Python web crawling framework for extracting structured data from websites using spiders and built-in data pipelines.

providers.name: Second Home
providers.description: Second Home is a flexible workspace and cultural venue provider committed to supporting entrepreneurship, innovation, and community, with locations in London (Spitalfields and Holland Park) and Lisbon (Mercado da Ribeira). It offers coworking (resident and roaming desks), private offices, day passes, meeting-room and venue hire, and a program of cultural events. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable developer surface — this is a consumer/business workspace brand rather than an API producer.

providers.name: Segway-Ninebot
providers.description: Segway-Ninebot is a global personal-transportation and robotics company, formed when Ninebot acquired Segway in 2015. It designs and manufactures electric kickscooters (the world's top-selling e-kickscooter brand, 13M+ units sold across 100+ countries), self-balancing personal transporters, e-bikes, and — through its Robotics division — RMP mobile-robot chassis and delivery/service robots (Nova Carter, NVIDIA Isaac-powered developer kits). Backed by HongShan. Its public developer surface is limited to Segway Robotics' open-source ROS / NVIDIA Isaac integration packages on GitHub; no first-party REST or OpenAPI product API is currently published.

providers.name: Selency
providers.description: Selency is the leading European online marketplace for vintage furniture and second-hand home decor. Founded in Paris in 2014 (formerly Brocante Lab), it connects individual sellers and professional antique dealers with buyers around a curated catalog of more than 300,000 unique pieces: Scandinavian, art deco, mid-century, 20th-century and contemporary design, lighting, mirrors, rugs and decorative objects. Selency acts as a trusted third party, editorially validating each listing and arranging specialized furniture delivery across Europe. It is a B Corp certified consumer marketplace with French, UK and Netherlands storefronts. No public developer API is offered.

providers.name: Sempra Energy
providers.description: Sempra Energy is a San Diego-headquartered North American energy infrastructure holding company and a Fortune 500 constituent, operating regulated utilities and energy infrastructure across California, Texas and Mexico. Its businesses include San Diego Gas & Electric and Southern California Gas Company in California, Oncor Electric Delivery in Texas, and Sempra Infrastructure, which develops LNG export terminals, natural gas pipelines and renewable generation in North America. Sempra operates a Google Apigee API program — an API gateway at api.sempra.com and a developer portal at developer.sempra.com inviting developers to "sign up today and start using Sempra APIs" — but publishes no API product, contract or reference to unauthenticated visitors, so the entire integration surface sits behind portal registration.

providers.name: Sensi (fka Clanz)
providers.description: Sensi.ai (formerly Clanz) is a home-care technology company whose 24/7 Care Copilot is an AI platform for senior home-care agencies. Using ambient audio sensing and a set of AI agents (Care, Growth, and Ops), Sensi gives care providers a holistic view of seniors' physical, emotional, and cognitive needs to support aging in place and proactive intervention when no caregiver is present. The company markets reduced hospitalizations, revenue growth, and operational efficiency for agencies. Sensi is backed by Insight Partners. No public developer API, documentation, or well-known discovery surface was found during enrichment; the customer application lives at app.sensi.ai.

providers.name: sherpa
providers.description: sherpa is an AI operating system for External Workforce Management (EWM) that runs an enterprise's contingent-labor program end to end with autonomous agents, replacing the work traditionally done by a VMS (Vendor Management System) and MSP (Managed Service Provider). Its agents cover every phase of an external engagement: autonomous intake and classification from Slack, email, Teams or voice; collaborative scope, role and budget drafting; autonomous sourcing with market-benchmarked rates and ranked candidates and suppliers; coordinated screening interviews scored against a weighted rubric; autonomous hiring and onboarding (documents, background and compliance checks, contracts, provisioning, hardware and badges); and active management and payment with a dedicated PM agent, live spend visibility and flexible payouts once outcomes are verified. One platform spans every worker type — contingent labor, freelancers / independent contractors (with a built-in Agent of Record), SOW / services engagements, and, coming soon, AI agents as a managed worker type — with rate intelligence, compliance management and analytics built in. sherpa launched out of stealth with a $2.2M pre-seed round and is backed by Seedcamp and Y Combinator.

providers.name: Simplii Financial
providers.description: Simplii Financial is the no-fee direct banking brand of the Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (CIBC), one of Canada's Big Six Schedule I domestic banks. Launched November 1, 2017, Simplii succeeded CIBC's two-decade President's Choice Financial (PC Financial) co-venture with Loblaws, migrating roughly two million accounts to the new brand. Simplii is not a separately chartered bank; it operates as a division and trade name of CIBC under CIBC's Schedule I federal charter, offering no-fee daily chequing and savings, mortgages, personal loans, lines of credit, GICs, mutual funds, and USD accounts through online, mobile, and telephone channels only (no branches), with CDIC deposit insurance provided through CIBC. On open finance, Simplii exposes no first-party public developer API or developer portal; consumer financial-data access today is aggregator- and screen-scraping-based via Plaid, Finicity, and MX (CIBC signed a data-access agreement with MX), consistent with Canada's voluntary, pre-mandate posture while the federal Consumer-Driven Banking framework (Budget 2024 / FES 2024, overseen by the FCAC) is legislated but not yet operational.

providers.name: SmarterDx
providers.description: SmarterDx builds clinical AI software that hospitals and health systems use to analyze the complete record of every patient and fully capture the value of care delivered. Its products span the revenue cycle — SmarterPrebill, SmarterCharges, SmarterDenials, SmarterNotes, and SmarterUtilization — surfacing missing diagnoses, validating charges, defending against payer denials, improving clinical documentation, and supporting utilization management decisions. The company serves 85+ health systems and operates as an enterprise B2B vendor: it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or self-serve sign-up, and maintains HIPAA compliance to protect the privacy of its health-system partners.

providers.name: Sonatus
providers.description: Sonatus, Inc. is a Sunnyvale, California automotive software company, founded in 2018, that builds cloud-to-edge vehicle AI software for software-defined vehicles (SDVs). Its Fastlane platform pairs in-vehicle Fastlane Edge software with Fastlane Collector for dynamic, policy-driven vehicle data collection, Fastlane Insight for cloud-side analysis, and Fastlane Copilot for quick-start integration, alongside the Sonatus Automator vehicle-automation product. Sonatus states its technology is deployed in more than eight million vehicles worldwide, and it is backed by Hyundai Motor Group, Kia, LG, Marvell, NEC, Foxconn and Translink Capital. Sonatus sells to vehicle OEMs and tier-one suppliers rather than to individual developers: it markets an SDK comprising Sonatus Automator, APIs and documentation, but that developer surface is delivered to contracted OEM customers and is not published on any public developer portal.

providers.name: SPARK Neuro
providers.description: SPARK Neuro is a New York City neuroscience company that quantifies brain data with EEG and machine learning, for both clinical care and commercial audience measurement. Its clinical arm, SPARK Medical, pairs FDA-cleared EEG hardware with deep-learning models to produce objective biomarkers for Alzheimer's disease, traumatic brain injury and concussion, Parkinson's disease, ALS, and mental-health conditions, and ships a push-button test-and-report software platform aimed at clinicians, researchers and pharmaceutical trial operations. Its commercial arm, Spark MEDIA, applies the same biometric measurement to advertising and entertainment, reading emotional and attentional response to content. A third product, Spark Predict, is a conversational analytics interface over the company's healthcare claims intelligence engine, marketed to payers and providers. The company was founded by CEO Spencer Gerrol and has raised more than $35M. SPARK Neuro publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable contract; its software reaches customers as a delivered product rather than as an API.

providers.name: Stability Audio
providers.description: Stable Audio (by Stability AI) is a generative audio model for music and sound-effect generation. The Stability Developer Platform exposes Stable Audio 2.5 endpoints alongside image, video, and 3D generation. Pricing is credit-based at 1 credit = $0.01; Stable Audio 2.5 generations are reported at $0.20 per generation regardless of duration.

providers.name: Statespace
providers.description: Statespace is the company behind Aimlabs (aimlabs.com, formerly statespace.gg), the leading AI-powered aim-training platform for FPS gamers. Aimlabs delivers personalized training tasks, real-time performance analytics, and game-specific tools, serving over 40 million players and operating as an official partner of Valorant and Rainbow Six Siege. Statespace is venture-backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Lux Capital. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a consumer web/desktop product but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Surefire Cyber
providers.description: Surefire Cyber is a cyber incident response firm serving the cyber insurance ecosystem — carriers, brokers, breach-counsel law firms, and the organizations they cover. It delivers end-to-end, insurance-driven incident response: 24/7 intake and immediate containment, digital forensics and investigation, in-house threat-actor communication and ransom negotiation, data mining and restoration, cyber intelligence, and claims-ready reporting. Alongside response it sells incident response retainers with pre-negotiated rates and terms, IR plans and tabletop exercises, and a resiliency support program. The company launched in 2022 with $10M in funding led by Forgepoint Capital and is headquartered in Maryland. In February 2026 it announced a next-generation, AI-enabled response platform intended to unify the response lifecycle from intake through invoice across every stakeholder. That platform is an internal and customer-facing delivery system; Surefire Cyber publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Targetspot
providers.description: Targetspot is a global digital-audio advertising (AdTech) company founded in 2007 and headquartered in New York, connecting brands with audiences across podcasts, online radio, streaming, in-video audio, mobile gaming, and in-home/out-of-home audio. Its Passport product is a self-serve ad-serving platform for publishers and advertisers, with granular reporting data made available via a partner API, and Targetplay extends audio advertising into gaming and in-app inventory. Targetspot is now part of the Azerion platform. This profile originated as a Union Square Ventures portfolio lead and has been enriched from public web probes.

providers.name: Terra CO2
providers.description: Terra CO2 Technology is a Golden, Colorado climate-technology and building-materials manufacturer that produces low-carbon replacements for Portland cement. Its commercial product, OPUS SCM, is a supplementary cementitious material that replaces up to 50% of the Portland cement in a concrete mix as a drop-in substitute for legacy SCMs such as fly ash, cutting CO2 by roughly 70% and NOx by roughly 90% per ton replaced, and it is produced from abundant silicate feedstocks rather than coal-plant by-products. A second product, OPUS ZERO, targets a full zero-carbon cement replacement and is in concrete trials. The company runs a pilot and materials R&D facility in Golden and is building a 240,000-ton-per-year commercial plant in Cleburne, Texas, backed by more than $250M raised from climate and construction investors including Cemex Ventures. Terra CO2 sells physical material into the construction supply chain; it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Time is Ltd
providers.description: Time is Ltd. is a collaboration analytics company that turns workplace communication and productivity data into actionable insights for HR, sales, and operations teams. Its platform connects to tools such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, Salesforce, Webex, and Tableau to measure meetings, focus time, and collaboration patterns, then reports on team performance, employee engagement, and revenue outcomes. Backed by Accel and profiled in the API Evangelist network, Time is Ltd. exposes no public developer API; integrations are configured through its hosted analytics application rather than a documented REST or GraphQL surface.

providers.name: TJX Companies
providers.description: The TJX Companies, Inc. is an American multinational off-price department store corporation headquartered in Framingham, Massachusetts, ranked No. 80 on the 2024 Fortune 500 list. Operating over 4,800 stores across nine countries and three continents under brands including T.J. Maxx, Marshalls, HomeGoods, Sierra, HomeSense (US), and Winners, HomeSense, Marshalls (Canada), TJX provides supplier and vendor integration through EDI and web-based portal platforms. Supplier connectivity is handled via Oracle iSupplier, SupplierOne, and the DiCentral ASN Vendor Portal, supporting purchase orders, advanced shipping notices, invoicing, and payment tracking.

providers.name: Transport for NSW Open Data Hub
providers.description: Transport for NSW Open Data Hub is a open data portal open-data portal for Australia running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 230 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: truBrain
providers.description: truBrain is a Santa Monica, California nootropics and functional-beverage brand that makes "natural superfuels for performance" — drinkable nootropic shots (2,000mg of natural nootropics per 1oz bottle for focus and motivation), drinkable ketones (Ketone XL, 11g of pure ketones per shot for athletic energy and recovery), plus gummies, functional-mushroom blends, capsules, NAD+, hydration, and sleep supplements, packaged in recycled paper bottles. Founded by a team of neuroscientists and backed by 500 Global, the company sells direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront and has run a Regulation A+ public equity offering. This profile was surfaced from the 500 Global portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network. truBrain is a consumer packaged-goods company: it publishes no first-party developer API, documentation, or SDKs. The only machine-readable surface at its domain is Shopify's Customer Accounts OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 discovery metadata.

providers.name: US Health Partners
providers.description: US Health Partners (USHP) is a physician-led national cardiovascular care network headquartered in Rockville, Maryland. USHP partners with independent cardiology practices across the country, providing management support, clinical governance, and technology while practices remain independent — reporting roughly 800 team members, 525K patients, and 30 locations. The company is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Summit Partners, and Silversmith Capital Partners. USHP publishes no public developer portal or API surface as of July 2026.

providers.name: Vekia
providers.description: Vekia is a French supply-chain software vendor founded in 2008 in Lille by Manuel Davy (Vekia SAS, 143 rue d'Athènes, 59800 Lille, RCS Lille Métropole 503 225 716). Its platform, Vekia Engine, applies probabilistic artificial intelligence and machine learning to demand and stock forecasting, then generates optimised purchase-order proposals that are pushed back into the customer's existing ERP rather than replacing it, alongside shortage-risk alerting and a logistics control tower. Vekia Disrupt covers disruption and shortage management. The platform is hosted on Microsoft Azure in Europe and marketed to retail and specialised distribution, e-commerce, industry, energy and telecom, with published case studies at ENGIE, Mr Bricolage and Okaïdi. Vekia publishes no public API, no developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable contract; ERP, WMS and TMS integration is delivered as a project by Vekia rather than through a self-serve developer surface.

providers.name: VoltServer
providers.description: VoltServer, Inc. (East Greenwich, Rhode Island, with VoltServer Ltd in Tadley, UK) is the inventor and manufacturer of Digital Electricity, a Class 4 fault-managed power distribution technology. Digital Electricity breaks conventional power into short, digitally analyzed energy packets that are transmitted over Class 2/Class 4 cabling and reconstituted to AC or DC at a receiver, delivering kilowatt-scale power over long distances at the installation cost and safety profile of low-voltage wiring. Products are hardware: Digital Electricity transmitters (TXAC family) and receivers (RXDC, RXAC, TETRA families), sold into service-provider networks, data centers, smart buildings and campuses, industrial and manufacturing sites, building electrification and transportation networks. VoltServer's published software surface consists of two downloadable end-user utilities — the VoltServer Site Tech App (Windows) and the VoltServer Discovery Tool (macOS) — for commissioning and discovering deployed devices. As of the 2026-09-04 probe VoltServer publishes no public API, developer portal, machine-readable specification, SDK or webhook surface.

providers.name: X mart
providers.description: X mart is a 500 Global portfolio company whose website, dentacarts.com, operates DentaCarts, an online dental supplies marketplace positioned as a "Dentist Smart Partner." The storefront sells dental and medical products across categories including restorative materials, endodontics, orthodontics, implants, prosthetics, perio and surgery, instruments, equipment, consumables, dermatology, and dental lab supplies, with support offered over WhatsApp. No public developer API surface has been found.

providers.name: Xaira
providers.description: Xaira Therapeutics is a South San Francisco-based biotechnology company building the transformative artificial intelligence that discovers and develops the next generation of medicines. Founded in 2023 and launched publicly in 2024 out of ARCH Venture Partners and Foresight Labs, Xaira couples large-scale generative and predictive AI models with in-house wet-lab data generation to design novel therapeutics, shorten development timelines, and lower the cost of bringing medicines to patients. The company's research spans protein design, molecular machine learning, and genome-scale perturbation modeling (its open X-Cell diffusion language model). Xaira does not currently operate a public developer platform, API, or SDK; this API Evangelist profile tracks its public web, security, and open-source research surface.

providers.name: Yana
providers.description: Yana is an AI-powered emotional companion app (published by Yana App, S.A.P.I. de C.V., a 500 Global portfolio company) that gives millions of Spanish and English speakers a private space to talk through their feelings, reflect, and build daily emotional wellbeing. The product ships as consumer iOS and Android apps rather than a public API, and the company is currently rebuilding toward a new version of the companion.

providers.name: Yonsei University
providers.description: Yonsei University (연세대학교) is a private research university in Seoul, South Korea, founded in 1885 and one of the "SKY" institutions. Its programmable footprint is small, and most of what previously appeared under its name was not its own engineering: the Yonsei Research Information portal at yonsei.elsevierpure.com is an Elsevier Pure (CRIS) tenancy whose OpenAPI is authored by Elsevier — info.title "Pure API", contact pure-support@elsevier.com — and whose data endpoints and OAI-PMH feed both return HTTP 401 to the public. That relationship is recorded here as a tenant surface; the contract itself belongs to Elsevier and has been removed from this repo. What Yonsei genuinely operates is narrower and more interesting: a SAML 2.0 Identity Provider on its own domain (kafe.yonsei.ac.kr) registered in the Korean Access FEderation and exported to eduGAIN with the scope yonsei.ac.kr and a Sirtfi declaration; a DSpace 5.5 medical-library repository (YUHSpace) at ir.ymlib.yonsei.ac.kr serving public RSS 2.0 and Atom 1.0 feeds from behind a JavaScript bot challenge, with no OAI-PMH deployed; and a members-only Yonsei Data Portal at data.yonsei.ac.kr that ships no public API. There is no central developer portal, no institution-operated REST API, and no official institutional GitHub organization — the only GitHub presence is GDGoC Yonsei, a student Google Developer Group. The institutional AI posture is a governance document, not an API, and it exists only on the Korean surface.

providers.name: Yukon Open Data
providers.description: Yukon Open Data is a territorial government open-data portal for Canada running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 3,773 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: Zeroqode
providers.description: Zeroqode is a leading no-code development platform and Bubble agency that provides app templates, plugins, courses, and automation tools for building scalable applications without coding. It offers 800+ plugins for Bubble.io, the Air Native mobile app conversion service, and Framer plugins. Zeroqode helps founders and developers build apps 10x faster using no-code and AI tooling.

providers.name: Zopper
providers.description: Zopper is an Indian insurtech platform that combines insurance and technology to deliver end-to-end, embedded insurance distribution for its partners. It builds APIs that let banks, consumer-electronics brands, retailers, e-commerce, travel and fintech platforms embed insurance into their customer journeys, and it manages policy issuance, servicing, claims and compliance across consumer-durables protection, life, health, bancassurance and embedded insurance. Zopper serves 2,500+ brands including Bank of Baroda, Axis Bank, IDFC First Bank, Apple, Samsung, Croma and Vijay Sales, and is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners.

providers.name: Zorus
providers.description: Zorus is a cybersecurity company that provides DNS web protection and filtering built for managed service providers (MSPs), managed security service providers (MSSPs), and IT teams. Its Archon agent delivers DNS filtering without requiring per-router DNS changes, layered with CyberSight behavioral user analytics, geo-IP and network filtering, zero-trust device isolation, and SaaS inventory and usage visibility. Zorus is delivered as a multi-tenant SaaS platform administered through a partner portal (portal.zorustech.com), positioned as an alternative to Cisco Umbrella, WebRoot DNS, and WebTitan. Zorus does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer documentation; its API surface (api.zorustech.com) sits behind the authenticated product portal. This profile captures the company's public web properties and probed security posture.

providers.name: 1QBit
providers.description: 1QB Information Technologies Inc. (1QBit) is a quantum computing software company founded in 2012 and headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. It builds hardware-agnostic algorithms and software for optimization, simulation, and machine learning that run across quantum, quantum-inspired, and classical high-performance computing hardware, with work spanning computational finance, life sciences and quantum chemistry, materials, and telecommunications. 1QBit has hardware and platform partnerships with D-Wave, Fujitsu, IBM, and Microsoft Azure Quantum, and participates in DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative (QBI) on automated design tools for utility-scale quantum computation. The company markets a 1Qloud optimization platform whose own marketing page cites Python SDK, gRPC, and REST API interfaces, but as of August 2026 1QBit publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API contract — the former portal.1qbit.com host no longer resolves and access is arranged through industry partnerships. Its only public developer surface is a small GitHub organization of research code plus two first-party Python libraries on PyPI.

providers.name: 51haohuo.com
providers.description: 51haohuo.com is the corporate site of 好活（苏州）数字科技有限公司 (Haohuo (Suzhou) Digital Technology Co., Ltd.), a Suzhou, Jiangsu based Chinese software vendor trading under the 苏爱才 ("Su Ai Cai") brand as a 人才服务供应商 — a talent-services supplier. It markets six enterprise SaaS lines to Chinese employers: a 零工平台 (gig-work platform), a 产业园平台 (industrial-park platform), 鹦鹉课堂 (a courseware/training product), a 智能体平台 (AI agent platform), a 做课平台 (course-authoring platform), and custom AIBPO engagements, sold on three published monthly tiers. As of the 2026-09-05 probe the company runs a single-page marketing site with a request-a-demo contact form and publishes no developer program, API reference, or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: 64x Bio
providers.description: 64x Bio is a bioengineering company in Brisbane, California, founded in 2018 by scientists out of Harvard Medical School and the Wyss Institute to rebuild the manufacturing foundation for cell and gene therapies. Its VectorSelect platform pairs massively parallelized, barcoded genome-scale pooled screens with computational mining of CellMap, a proprietary atlas linking genetic and metabolic pathway data to production phenotypes, to engineer high-yield producer cell lines. Commercial products are the AAV APEX Suite for adeno-associated virus production across serotypes and scales, the LV APEX Suite for lentiviral vectors used in CAR-T programs, and a Biologics Suite for antibodies and protein therapeutics still in development. The business is delivered through licensing and partnership agreements with therapeutics developers and manufacturers rather than as software: CellMap and the screening stack are internal research infrastructure, and 64x Bio publishes no developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Aaru
providers.description: Aaru is an AI synthetic-research and prediction company based in New York City, founded in 2024 by Cam Fink, Ned Koh, and John Kessler. Aaru builds multi-agent simulation software that generates thousands of AI agents from public and proprietary behavioral data to model how individuals, groups, and entire populations will respond to future events, products, policies, and messaging. Its platform (marketed as Lumen) replaces traditional survey-based market research and polling with measurable-outcome simulation, covering price-sensitivity analysis, voter-behavior prediction, and disaster-communication testing. Customers include Accenture, EY, Interpublic Group, and political campaigns; the company raised a Series A at a roughly $1B headline valuation in December 2025, with backing from General Catalyst, Redpoint Ventures, Felicis, Abstract Ventures, and others. Aaru currently exposes no public developer API; this profile tracks its identity and web surface in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: AbbVie
providers.description: AbbVie is a research-based biopharmaceutical company that discovers, develops, manufactures, and markets advanced therapies in immunology, oncology, neuroscience, and other specialty areas. AbbVie's portfolio includes treatments for autoimmune diseases, various cancers, neurological disorders, and aesthetics through the Allergan Aesthetics portfolio.

providers.name: Affinity Credit Union
providers.description: Affinity Credit Union is a member-owned financial cooperative headquartered in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, Canada. Formed in 2005 through the amalgamation of several Saskatchewan credit unions, it is the largest credit union in Saskatchewan and among the ten largest in Canada, with roughly CAD 9.6 billion in managed assets and a province-wide branch and advice-centre network serving personal and business members. As a provincially regulated cooperative under its "Banking on Values" mandate, members democratically own and govern the institution. Affinity exposes NO first-party public developer API or developer portal; digital and core banking are delivered through banking-technology providers (the credit-union system's Central 1 rails), and third-party consumer data access today is aggregator/screen-scraping based. Affinity is a stated supporter of the credit-union-system "Open Banking Solution" delivered by Caspian One under the Large Credit Union Coalition, positioning it for Canada's legislated-but-not-yet-operational Consumer-Driven Banking framework (FCAC).

providers.name: Agile Robots
providers.description: Agile Robots SE is a Munich-based robotics and artificial intelligence company founded in 2018 as a spin-off from the German Aerospace Center (DLR) Institute of Robotics and Mechatronics. The company develops force-sensitive industrial and service robots, robotic arms (Diana series), grippers and hands (Agile Hand), mobile robotics, and the AgileCore / AgileAI software platform that lets system integrators and operators build and deploy AI-driven automation for the automotive, consumer electronics, healthcare, and service industries. Headquartered in Munich's Sendling district with manufacturing across Europe, China, and India, Agile Robots reached unicorn valuation in a 2021 Series C and is backed by investors including Hongshan (Sequoia Capital China). This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Agile Robots does not currently publish a public developer portal, REST API, or first-party SDKs.

providers.name: Andela
providers.description: Andela is a global talent platform and AI services provider founded in 2014 by Jeremy Johnson, connecting enterprises with vetted, remote technologists and AI engineers across 135+ countries. It grew into a unicorn (valued at $1.5B in 2021) serving 650+ clients, with a network of 200,000+ trained technologists. Its services span hiring AI engineers for application building, systems integration, and platform engineering; building enterprise AI solutions from data readiness to production deployment; and upskilling teams through AI curricula developed with partners such as NVIDIA and Google. Andela operates a fully remote model and is backed by GV, SoftBank Vision Fund, and Susa Ventures. It publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Antech Diagnostics
providers.description: Antech Diagnostics operates North America's largest veterinary reference laboratory network, plus in-house diagnostic instruments, imaging, and the HealthTracks diagnostics platform. Antech is part of Mars Petcare (Mars Veterinary Health), acquired via Mars' 2017 purchase of VCA. Antech's programmatic surface is a partner-gated laboratory integration API - commonly configured in practice information management systems (PIMS) as "Antech V3" - that lets veterinary software submit lab requisitions to Antech and receive results back into the patient's medical record. There is no public, self-serve developer portal or published API reference; access requires an Antech account and a business / integration partner relationship, authenticated with an Account Number, Username, Password, and Clinic ID. The logical APIs below are modeled from documented PIMS integration behavior (Vetspire, Cornerstone, DaySmart Vet, NaVetor, ezyVet, NectarVet), not from an Antech-published specification.

providers.name: Applied EV
providers.description: Applied EV (formerly AEV Robotics, legal entity Applied Electric Vehicles Ltd) is an Australian software-defined vehicle company founded in Melbourne in 2015 by Julian Broadbent and Shane Ambry. It builds the Blanc Robot, a cabinless autonomous-ready electric platform for logistics, industrial, mining and agricultural transport; the Digital Backbone, a safety-rated ASIL-D programmable vehicle control system; and an Internet-of-Vehicles (IoV) Cloud Platform the company markets as API-first. The IoV platform is advertised as a set of vehicle APIs — Access Manager for identity and access management, a Vehicle Task API, a Vehicle Mission API, a Drive API for autonomous driving and motion control, a Pod and Accessory API, and Virtual Vehicles for simulation — together with a Vehicle Management System for fleet telemetry, diagnostics, mapping, mission creation and over-the-air software updates. No public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable contract is served: the developer host resolves but refuses public connections, and the marketing pages route every developer path to an enquiry form.

providers.name: Argámedtech
providers.description: Argámedtech is a medical technology company developing next‑generation non‑thermal cardiac ablation systems using Pulsed Field Ablation (PFA) technology. The firm focuses on improving safety and efficacy of atrial fibrillation treatments, offering a versatile catheter‑based solution. Their platform integrates advanced energy delivery and proprietary software to enhance procedural outcomes for physicians and patients worldwide.

providers.name: Athletesperformance
providers.description: Athletesperformance, now part of EXOS, provides human performance coaching, training, and consulting services for athletes and organizations. Their offerings include strength, speed, nutrition, and movement programs, as well as corporate wellness solutions, facility design, and virtual coaching platforms. The company focuses on optimizing performance across sports, education, military, and corporate sectors, leveraging data-driven methods and expert coaching to reduce injury risk and enhance results.

providers.name: Attralus
providers.description: Attralus is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in San Francisco, California, developing transformative medicines for patients with systemic amyloidosis. Its proprietary pan-amyloid removal (PAR) platform pairs a pan-amyloid binding peptide with a humanized IgG1 monoclonal antibody so the resulting fusion protein binds amyloid deposits across every amyloidosis type and stage and recruits the immune system to clear them. The lead candidate, zamubafusp alfa (AT-02), is a pan-amyloid depleter in a Phase 1/2 open-label extension study and has received U.S. FDA Orphan Drug Designation for the treatment of AL amyloidosis; a next-generation PAR program (IV and subcutaneous) and a research-stage neurodegeneration program targeting Abeta, tau and alpha-synuclein aggregates follow behind it. Attralus' molecular imaging agents AT-01 (124-iodine evuzamitide) and AT-05 (99mTc-p5+14) were acquired by Bayer in January 2026. The company was launched in 2020 with a Series A from venBio Partners and has since raised additional rounds including a $56 million financing led by Alpha Wave Ventures with participation from Bristol Myers Squibb. Attralus is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, no public API, no SDKs and no machine-readable API contract of any kind (every OpenAPI, GraphQL, MCP, A2A and /.well-known/ path probed on its hosts returns 404, and no api/developer/docs subdomain resolves).

providers.name: Auris Health
providers.description: Auris Health, now part of Johnson & Johnson MedTech, develops the MONARCH robotic-assisted bronchoscopy platform for lung diagnostics. The company focuses on innovative medical devices that enable physicians to navigate and biopsy hard-to-reach lung nodules, improving early detection and treatment of lung cancer. Through its integration with J&J MedTech, Auris Health leverages extensive resources to advance robotic bronchoscopy technology and expand its clinical impact worldwide.

providers.name: Autocore
providers.description: AutoCore, founded in 2018, is a global leader in high‑performance mobile computing platforms, offering software‑defined vehicle solutions, AI‑driven robotics, and cloud‑based services for automotive and industrial automation. The company provides a suite of products including AutoCore.COMM, AutoCore.OS, central computing units, and tools for intelligent mobility devices.

providers.name: Autoxing
providers.description: AutoXing is a leading provider of intelligent robot services based on autonomous driving technology. The company focuses on AGV and AMR robots for factories, logistics, restaurants, and hotels, aiming to empower smart retail and improve efficiency through AI-driven navigation and big data integration. AutoXing’s mission is to use smart technology to enable a better life, offering a range of autonomous delivery vehicles, robot chassis, and customized solutions for various industries.

providers.name: Bank OZK
providers.description: Bank OZK is a regional bank headquartered in Little Rock, Arkansas, tracing its charter to 1903 and today operating roughly 265 offices across Arkansas, Georgia, Florida, North Carolina, Texas, and New York. It is a state-chartered commercial bank and the wholly owned subsidiary of Bank OZK holding company, publicly traded on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol OZK, with about $40.8 billion in total assets as of year-end 2025 and a national reputation in commercial real estate lending. Bank OZK runs no first-party public developer portal and publishes no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger specifications; it is not a documented Financial Data Exchange (FDX) participant and has not published a specific CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture. Consumer-permissioned account data is reached only indirectly through third-party aggregators, with Plaid documented as the supporting aggregator. This is an honest identity-only profile with no public API surface.

providers.name: BECU
providers.description: BECU (Boeing Employees' Credit Union) is a member-owned, not-for-profit state-chartered credit union founded in 1935 and headquartered in Tukwila, Washington (NMLS ID 490518). Originally serving Boeing employees, it is today one of the largest credit unions in the United States, offering consumer and business deposit accounts, lending, mortgages, and investment services across the Pacific Northwest and nationally through digital channels. Like the vast majority of US credit unions, BECU exposes no public first-party developer API or developer portal; its digital banking runs on established core and fintech vendors (FIS, LPL/Client Point, ICE/Ellie Mae for mortgage), and consumer-permissioned data access for third-party fintech apps is intermediated through data aggregators rather than a documented, self-serve BECU API. US open finance is voluntary and fragmented, and no mandated open-banking API contract applies here; the CFPB Section 1033 Personal Financial Data Rights rule is the emerging framework that will shape BECU's future data-access posture.

providers.name: Big Run Studios
providers.description: Big Run Studios is a mobile game developer focused on creating cutting edge, casual competitive games for traditionally underserved audiences. Their portfolio includes titles such as Blackout Bingo, Big Cooking, Big Run Solitaire, and more, offering real‑cash rewards and social competition across iOS and Android platforms.

providers.name: Binx Health
providers.description: binx health, inc. is a Boston, Massachusetts point-of-care diagnostics company whose binx io platform is the first FDA-cleared, CLIA-waived molecular point-of-care test for chlamydia (Chlamydia trachomatis) and gonorrhea (Neisseria gonorrhoeae), returning central-lab-equivalent results in roughly thirty minutes from female vaginal swabs or male urine so a patient can be tested, diagnosed and treated in a single visit. The instrument pairs ultra-rapid PCR amplification with the company's proprietary electrochemical detection and needs no calibration, preventative maintenance or result interpretation, so it can be run by staff with no laboratory training. binx sells into urgent care, OB/GYN, pediatrics, student health, government health and other specialty settings through distributors including Cardinal Health, McKesson, Medline and Fisher Healthcare. The company divested its at-home consumer testing business to imaware in December 2023 and retained the point-of-care molecular diagnostics business. binx health publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Biomason
providers.description: Biomason is a biotechnology company that engineers living concrete using microbes to replace traditional Portland cement, aiming to reduce carbon emissions and create sustainable building materials. Founded in Research Triangle Park, NC, Biomason offers biocement products and services for construction, partnering with industry leaders to scale eco‑friendly concrete solutions.

providers.name: Bitcoin
providers.description: Bitcoin is the original decentralized peer-to-peer digital currency and open-source protocol, first described in the 2008 whitepaper by Satoshi Nakamoto. It is not a company or a hosted commercial API; the reference implementation, Bitcoin Core, exposes a local JSON-RPC interface for node operators and application developers to query the blockchain, manage wallets, build and broadcast transactions, and interact with the peer-to-peer network. bitcoin.org and the developer documentation site at developer.bitcoin.org publish developer guides, an extensive RPC API command reference, worked examples, and reference material for building Bitcoin applications. This profile was seeded as a Ribbit Capital portfolio-sector lead and enriched from Bitcoin's public developer surface.

providers.name: Buzz360
providers.description: Buzz360 is an all‑in‑one political campaign software platform based in Minneapolis, United States. Founded in 2011, it provides tools for voter contact, relational organizing, SMS, email, fundraising, event management, and ballot chase, targeting conservative campaigns and small organizations. The platform unifies data, door‑knocking, messaging, and analytics into a single system for fast, high‑stakes election work.

providers.name: Camfer
providers.description: Camfer is a Y Combinator-backed startup (S24) building an AI mechanical engineer — an AI-powered CAD tool that plugs into SolidWorks and lets engineers generate parametric designs from natural language prompts and images. Its camfy text-to-CAD model produces editable feature-tree geometry, automates repetitive modeling tasks, answers questions about a model without manual feature-tree navigation, and gives real-time design feedback. The product is a downloadable desktop application (currently in invite-only beta), not a public API; the company is backed by Y Combinator, Next47, Bloomberg Beta, Octave Fund, and the founders of Dropbox, Airtable, and Clari.

providers.name: Carallel
providers.description: Carallel provides personalized guidance and digital health tools to identify and support caregivers, helping health plans, providers, and employers improve outcomes and reduce costs. Founded in 2017, the Lake Forest‑based company offers a platform that connects caregivers with resources, advocacy, and on‑demand assistance, aiming to alleviate caregiver burden and enhance patient care quality.

providers.name: Carallelllc
providers.description: Carallelllc, operating as Carallel, provides digital health tools and personalized caregiver support for health plans, providers, and employers. Their platform combines technology with human guidance to identify caregivers, offer resources, and improve outcomes while reducing costs. The company focuses on empowering caregivers through a secure app, expert advice, and data-driven insights, aiming to enhance patient care and workforce wellbeing across the United States.

providers.name: Carenation
providers.description: Carenation is a scalable telehealth platform that enables complete remote care delivery. It provides virtual consultations, COVID‑19 home care programs, and a suite of digital health services across multiple countries including India, Spain, Greece, Peru, Bangladesh, Mexico, and Nepal. The platform is built to world‑class standards, offering patients and providers a comprehensive, secure, and user‑friendly experience for pediatric, adolescent, and adult care.

providers.name: Carepoynt
providers.description: Carepoynt is a healthcare and wellness focused rewards platform that incentivizes healthy behaviors by awarding Poynts for activities such as doctor visits, exercise, and healthy purchases. Users can redeem points for spa treatments, charitable donations, or gifts, while businesses, providers, employers, and payers can engage customers and improve health outcomes through the Carepoynt network.

providers.name: Cashkaro
providers.description: CashKaro is India’s largest cashback and coupons platform, helping shoppers save money by offering cash back, discount codes, and deals across thousands of online stores. Users earn cash back on purchases, track earnings, and redeem rewards, while the site provides a comprehensive catalog of offers, a referral program, and a mobile app for convenient shopping.

providers.name: Chief Acquisition Officers Council
providers.description: The Chief Acquisition Officers Council (CAOC) is a senior interagency forum established pursuant to Section 16 of the Office of Federal Procurement Policy Act (41 USC 1311). The Council brings together the Chief Acquisition Officers (CAOs), the Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition and Sustainment, and the Senior Procurement Executives of Executive Branch agencies to monitor and improve the federal acquisition system, promote effective business practices, deliver best-value products and services, and further integrity, fairness, competition, and openness in federal procurement. The CAOC publishes resources, charters, working group output, and guidance through Acquisition.gov, and operates alongside the Federal Acquisition Regulatory Council and the Office of Management and Budget's Office of Federal Procurement Policy (OFPP).

providers.name: Cibus
providers.description: Cibus is an agricultural biotechnology company focused on precision breeding to develop more resilient, sustainable, and vigorous crops. By leveraging nature‑identical traits and advanced gene‑editing technologies, Cibus accelerates the creation of seeds with improved yield, stress tolerance, and reduced chemical inputs, helping farmers meet the challenges of a changing climate and growing global food demand.

providers.name: Compredict
providers.description: Compredict is a German deep‑tech company pioneering AI‑powered virtual sensor technology for the automotive industry. Founded as a spin‑off from TU Darmstadt, it transforms raw vehicle sensor data into trusted physical signals using software‑defined virtual sensors, enabling hardware‑free insights across automotive, manufacturing, defense, robotics, and agriculture sectors.

providers.name: COMSPOC
providers.description: COMSPOC provides commercial off‑the‑shelf software for Space Situational Awareness (SSA). Their platform includes SSASuite, a comprehensive space object catalog, and desktop products such as Spacebook for visualization, SEG for event simulation, and tools for threat assessment. COMSPOC also runs a research center advancing SSA standards and offers data downloads via APIs. The company focuses on delivering actionable space data to support operators, researchers, and policymakers.

providers.name: Concentricinc
providers.description: Concentric Inc provides critical infrastructure power and cooling solutions for data centers, industrial facilities, and commercial enterprises. With over 25 years of experience, they deliver power systems, forklift power, environmental safety products, and maintenance services across the United States, supporting mission‑critical operations and sustainability initiatives.

providers.name: Cradle
providers.description: Cradle is a Dutch–Swiss biotechnology software company founded in 2021 with headquarters in Amsterdam and an office in Zurich, building an AI-powered protein engineering platform for industrial biotech and biopharma R&D teams. The platform combines proprietary generative AI models — trained on billions of natural protein sequences and on data produced in Cradle's own Amsterdam wet lab — with a web application and REST API/Python SDK so that scientists can design, simulate, and co-optimize amino-acid sequence variants across multiple measurable properties such as activity, binding affinity, stability, expression, and developability. Core platform capabilities include AI candidate generation, multi-property co-optimization, virtual plate design, experimental data management with full versioning and audit trails, task orchestration (analyze data, diversify, engineer, select, search, train) across modalities including antibodies/mAbs, enzymes, vaccines, therapeutic peptides, and food ingredients, plus a Custom Predictors framework letting customers plug in their own ML models. Cradle is sold as enterprise SaaS to R&D organizations — disclosed customers and partners include Johnson & Johnson Janssen, Bayer, Novozymes/Novonesis, and Twist Bioscience, with the platform serving six of the top 25 global pharma companies and over 50 active R&D programs. The company has raised approximately $115M to date across a seed round (Index Ventures, 2022), a $24M Series A (Index Ventures, 2023), and a $73M Series B (IVP, 2024). Co-founders are Stef van Grieken (CEO), Jelle Prins, Elise de Reus, Eli Bixby, and Harmen van Rossum.

providers.name: Culture
providers.description: Culture Partners provides organizational culture consulting, helping companies achieve better results through clarity, alignment, and accountability. Their services include strategic alignment, executive leadership consulting, change activation, and industry‑specific solutions such as healthcare and manufacturing. The firm leverages 37 years of research and proprietary IP to drive measurable outcomes like increased EBITDA and employee NPS.

providers.name: Customer Analytics
providers.description: Customer Analytics (CA) is a data, analytics and AI consultancy headquartered in Middleton, Wisconsin with a delivery centre in Guindy, Chennai, India. The firm delivers AI/ML and data analytics, data engineering, business intelligence and reporting, business solutions design and software development, platform implementation and software management (Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Fabric, Salesforce), and quality assurance. Alongside these services it packages six productised offerings — DataWorks 360, BI Xpert 360, AI Assist 360, Retail AI Insights 360, PBILens 360 and Smart IoT Data Track 360 — and publishes case studies across healthcare, manufacturing, retail/B2B, education, agriculture, clinical research, warehouse operations, the art industry and government. Customer Analytics is a professional services company: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs or machine-readable API specifications.

providers.name: Darwin
providers.description: Darwin AI is an AI governance platform built exclusively for state, local, and education (SLED) government agencies, providing a centralized, secure hub for the public sector to safely adopt, manage, and govern AI tools while ensuring compliance, accountability, and public records requirements are met. The platform serves IT departments, innovation and digital services teams, city and county management, and data governance professionals across municipal and state government. Its core product surface includes the Control Center, which delivers cross-departmental visibility into AI usage along with records management and FOIA compliance tracking; the Policy Wizard, which helps agencies establish and refine AI policies aligned to regulatory requirements using 30+ policy frameworks and 15+ city and county regulation packs; Risk Management, which detects unauthorized or unvetted AI applications; the AI Navigator, which monitors departmental adoption patterns and surfaces actionable insights; and the Marketplace, an organization-wide hub of approved AI applications. Darwin AI was named to Government Technology's 2026 GovTech 100. The company also publishes a free public Policy Wizard tool. Darwin is backed by Insight Partners and was added to the API Evangelist network as a government-sector company profile. As of this enrichment pass Darwin publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI, so this profile captures identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Dyndrite
providers.description: Dyndrite develops GPU-accelerated software for digital and additive manufacturing, focused on laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) and other metal 3D-printing processes. Its platform streamlines build preparation, materials development, process qualification, and production automation for industrial manufacturers, machine builders (OEMs), and software vendors. Products include Dyndrite LPBF Pro for end users and the Application Development Kit (ADK) for machine makers, exposing low-level toolpathing control (Vector and Raster Toolpathing APIs) plus a scriptable Python geometry engine. Dyndrite is backed by Amplify Partners and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as an AI/ML and manufacturing automation company. It does not currently publish a public web/REST API, OpenAPI definition, or self-service developer portal; its APIs are embedded scripting and integration interfaces delivered inside its desktop software and ADK.

providers.name: EverySim
providers.description: EverySim Inc. (everysim.io) is a 500 Global-backed company that operates a private, authentication-gated web application. Every public path on everysim.io redirects unauthenticated visitors into a Keycloak-based OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 single-sign-on flow (realm "everysim", client "everysim-web", authorization-code with PKCE). As of this profile no public developer API, documentation, SDK, CLI, or developer portal surface was found; the only publicly reachable machine-readable endpoint is the realm's OpenID Connect discovery document on auth.everysim.io. This entry captures the provider's verifiable identity, authentication model, and domain-security posture pending a public API surface.

providers.name: Field AI
providers.description: FieldAI builds general-purpose robot intelligence through its Field Foundation Models (FFMs) and EDGE brain — a new class of physics-first, risk-aware foundation models for embodied AI. FieldAI's embodiment-agnostic autonomy lets robots navigate dynamic, unstructured environments without maps, GPS, or predefined trajectories, and has been proven across quadrupeds, humanoids, wheeled robots, and passenger-scale vehicles. Founded in 2023 (formerly AI for Humanity) and based in Mission Viejo, California, the company is led by veterans from DeepMind, Google Brain, Tesla Autopilot, NASA JPL, and SpaceX, and serves construction, energy, mining, logistics, manufacturing, power and utility, agriculture, and federal applications. FieldAI has raised over $405M from investors including Bezos Expeditions, Canaan Partners, Khosla Ventures, Temasek, Intel Capital, Hyundai Motor Company, and Prysm Capital.

providers.name: Focal Systems
providers.description: Focal Systems is a San Francisco-based deep-learning company building the operating system for brick-and-mortar retail. Its platform combines proprietary shelf-mounted computer-vision cameras, real-time AI, and streaming data to digitize physical stores hourly — tracking on-shelf availability, out-of-stocks, planogram and price-tag compliance, shrink, and inventory. Products include Computer Vision cameras, Shelf AI, the Action Tool associate mobile app, and the Impact analytics dashboard, used by leading grocery and retail chains such as Walmart Canada to reduce waste, redeploy labor, and recover lost sales. Focal Systems is a Y Combinator and Uncork Capital-backed company and operates as an enterprise SaaS vendor; it does not publish a public self-serve developer API or SDK.

providers.name: Foot Locker
providers.description: Foot Locker, Inc. is a global retailer of athletic footwear and apparel, operating the Foot Locker, Kids Foot Locker, Champs Sports, WSS and atmos banners across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia. DICK'S Sporting Goods completed its acquisition of Foot Locker, Inc. on September 8, 2025 and continues to operate the Foot Locker brand suite. Foot Locker publishes no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable contract. Trading-partner integration runs through third-party host platforms rather than a first-party developer site: supplier inventory and dropship through CommerceHub Dsco, and the Storefronts creator/affiliate program through impact.com, each requiring a commercial agreement. The former api.footlocker.com Apigee gateway no longer resolves.

providers.name: Fundamental Technologies
providers.description: Fundamental Technologies Inc. (Fundamental) is an AI company building foundation models for predictive decision-making across enterprises and governments. Its flagship product, NEXUS, is a large tabular model pre-trained on billions of real-world enterprise tables and designed to capture the complex, non-linear feature interactions in structured data that large language models handle poorly. NEXUS is positioned to be deployed "with just one line of code" with a deep AWS integration and confidential-computing privacy controls. Founded by DeepMind alumni and led by serial entrepreneurs, the company raised a $255M Series A in February 2026 and is surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Battery Ventures portfolio company. As of this profile it publishes a marketing and research presence at fundamental.tech but no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Greater Than
providers.description: Greater Than provides risk intelligence solutions aimed at improving road safety and reducing climate impact. Their platform leverages AI-driven analytics to assess driver behavior, predict crash probability, and offer actionable insights for insurers, fleet operators, and regulators. Products include Crash Probability Hub, AI Coach, Analytics Reports, and ESG Compliance packages, helping clients meet CSRD requirements while optimizing telematics data and insurance pricing.

providers.name: Happypal
providers.description: Happypal (HappyPal) is a Paris-based HR-tech and fintech company, founded in 2019, that operates the most widely used digital platform for French works councils (Comite Social et Economique, or CSE). The SaaS and payment platform lets CSE administrators distribute employee benefits and perks, manage budgets and accounting, run ticketing and gift-voucher (cheques-cadeaux) programs, and engage more than 500,000 beneficiaries through a mobile app. Happypal replaces paper gift vouchers with a dematerialized SaaS-plus-fintech model targeting France's employee-benefits market. It is a portfolio company of Anthemis. Happypal does not currently publish a public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs; this profile captures its public web and identity surface.

providers.name: Hopstack
providers.description: Hopstack is an AI-native, cloud-based warehouse management system (WMS) and fulfillment operations platform that helps warehouses, 3PLs, and e-commerce operators optimize inbound logistics, inventory, order processing, picking, packing, shipping, and returns across channels. Hopstack exposes a documented RESTful API (referenced at apidocs.hopstack.io) for programmatic access to core resources such as orders and consignments, secured with a per-user X-API-Key generated from the Hopstack Dashboard. API access is gated - a customer must contact Hopstack Support to enable API-key generation in the UI - and the full endpoint surface, base URL, and machine-readable specification are published behind that account/partner reference rather than as a fully open catalog.

providers.name: Infinant Health
providers.description: Infinant Health (formerly Evolve Biosystems) is a privately held life-sciences company in Sacramento, California, spun out of the Foods for Health Institute at the University of California, Davis after more than a decade of research into the infant gut microbiome. Its foundational discovery is B. infantis EVC001, a strain of Bifidobacterium longum subsp. infantis that metabolizes human milk oligosaccharides and has largely disappeared from infants in industrialized countries. The company commercializes that strain as Evivo, a consumer infant probiotic sold direct-to-consumer and through retail, and is developing INF108 as a drug candidate intended to reduce necrotizing enterocolitis in premature infants. Infinant Health is a biotechnology and consumer-health manufacturer rather than a software company: it publishes clinical trials, peer-reviewed publications and investor material, but no developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable API contract could be found on any of its hosts.

providers.name: Insito Health
providers.description: Insito Health provides a comprehensive platform for onsite and virtual mental health services, education, and training for schools, healthcare providers, and families. Their solutions include mental health referral management, suicide screening, bullying prevention, and comprehensive care navigation, supporting both students and adults through integrated digital tools and professional support.

providers.name: Jaxsta
providers.description: Jaxsta is a music industry data platform that aggregates official metadata from record labels, distributors, and rights owners. The service provides verified artist, release, and credit information to creators, partners, and industry members. As of 2024, Jaxsta entered hibernation under Vinyl Group, pausing commercial operations while preserving its underlying database and technology for future use. The platform remains a valuable source of authoritative music data for integration via APIs and data services.

providers.name: Konn Technologies
providers.description: Konn Technologies is an Amman, Jordan based design and construction technology company, founded in 2020, that builds three integrated systems for a new model of homeownership - a composable architectural design language, an industrialized construction methodology using reinforced concrete and insulated sealed envelopes, and a software platform connecting the entire homeowner journey from first idea to keys in hand. Its consumer brand, Konn (konnhomes.com), sells that system directly to homeowners through a productized ladder - DesignFit, a 300 JOD ten-day land assessment producing 2D layouts, a site plan, and a budget and timeline; ArchDesign, a 4,000 JOD 3D design with a locked-in construction price; and Konnify, which adapts a design a homeowner already commissioned from an outside architect onto the Konn engineering system. Customer-facing software includes a Design Studio for browsing floor types, sizes, and styles with plans and pricing, and a Design Match tool that recommends a home design from stated requirements. The company reports 100+ homes designed and 35+ homes built, with typical permit-to-move-in timelines of three to six months. It publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Lilith Games
providers.description: Lilith Games (上海莉莉丝网络科技有限公司) is a Shanghai-headquartered video game developer and publisher founded in 2013, known for globally distributed mobile and PC titles including Rise of Kingdoms (万国觉醒), AFK Arena (剑与远征), AFK Journey (剑与远征：启程), Farlight 84 (远光84), Warpath (战火勋章), Art of Conquest (剑与家园) and a portfolio of indie games. The company operates as a consumer game publisher rather than an API platform: it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or partner API program. Its public engineering surface is the LilithGames GitHub organization, which open-sources backend and build infrastructure (Go networking and reverse-proxy tooling, build caching, Perforce virtual file system work) rather than client SDKs for a Lilith API. Surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital.

providers.name: Loctax
providers.description: Loctax is a collaborative tax compliance, risk, and governance platform built for global in-house tax teams. Founded in 2020 and based in Gent, Belgium, its Global Tax Intelligence Platform lets teams ask any tax question grounded in their own company data and IBFD's authoritative tax content spanning 220+ jurisdictions, then act on the answer with workflow, compliance-monitoring, risk, and controversy-management tooling. Loctax is backed by Index Ventures, Cavalry Ventures, and Seedcamp, and in 2026 was acquired by Tax Systems to build a combined EMEA tax-technology platform. Loctax is a closed enterprise SaaS product with no public developer API, portal, or specification at the time of this profile.

providers.name: Luminai
providers.description: Luminai is an AI-powered automation platform for health system operations, marketed as "The AI Platform for Health System Operations." It automates complex, high-volume healthcare back-office workflows including referral intake and processing, provider inbox automation, patient registration, orders and referrals, pharmacy renewals, payor contract management, denial appeals, and underpayment recovery. The company reports over 12 million automations driven, an average 5.3x ROI, and a 48-day average time to value, with enterprise-grade security and flexible deployment options (on-premises, VPC, or fully managed). Luminai is SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR compliant. It is a venture-backed company in the General Catalyst portfolio. Luminai does not publish a public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal at this time; this profile captures its public identity and security posture.

providers.name: Materna Medical
providers.description: Materna Medical is a Mountain View, California women's health medical device company building an OBGYN platform around pelvic floor health. Its first product, Milli, is an expanding vaginal dilator that widens one millimeter at a time with optional vibration, sold direct-to-consumer and through OBGYN and pelvic floor physical therapy practices for vaginismus, dyspareunia, postpartum recovery and menopause-related painful sex; it launched as a wellness trainer in 2019 and received FDA over-the-counter clearance in 2023. Its second product, Ellora, is an investigational device used during labor to reduce pelvic floor muscle injury in vaginal delivery, studied in the randomized EASE trial across US hospitals and assigned a new ICD-10-PCS technology code effective April 2026. Materna Medical sells regulated physical devices and clinical evidence, not software: it operates a WordPress marketing site (maternamedical.com) and a WooCommerce consumer storefront (hellomilli.com), publishes no developer program, no public API, no SDK and no machine-readable API contract, and runs no api., developer., docs. or app. subdomain.

providers.name: Metalshub
providers.description: Metalshub (Metals Hub GmbH) is a Berlin-based digital platform for the metals, mining, and recycling industries, enabling over 2,800 industry participants to buy, sell, and trade raw materials online.
