Its procurement, sales, and tolling solutions help companies source ferroalloys, minor metals, noble alloys, and recycled materials, discover new suppliers and customers, run digital tenders and auctions, and manage the full transaction lifecycle from negotiation to contract. Backed by Point Nine and other investors, Metalshub operates a login-gated trading application at trade.metals-hub.com. No public API or developer program was found during enrichment.

providers.name: MindMeld *
providers.description: MindMeld is an open-source conversational-AI platform for building deep-domain voice interfaces and chatbots, originally developed by the GV-backed startup MindMeld (formerly Expect Labs), acquired by Cisco in 2017 and open-sourced in 2019. Distributed as the `mindmeld` Python framework (Apache-2.0), it provides tooling for every step of a modern conversational workflow — domain and intent classification, entity recognition and resolution, and dialogue management — along with reusable application Blueprints for use cases such as food ordering, video discovery, and home-assistant experiences. MindMeld powers the Webex Assistant and other Cisco conversational products.

providers.name: mPower Social
providers.description: mPower Social Enterprises Ltd. is a Dhaka, Bangladesh technology-for-development company founded in 2008 by Harvard and MIT graduate students as ClickDiagnostics — winner of the MIT $100K competition — and renamed after moving its center of gravity to Bangladesh in 2010. mPower designs, builds and operates information systems for governments, UN agencies, donor organizations and international NGOs across health and nutrition, water and sanitation, agriculture and livestock, education, governance and rights, livelihood and poverty alleviation, climate and environment, and humanitarian response, and states it has deployed more than 300 ICT solutions across 17 countries in the Global South. Its engineering practice is built on open-source digital public goods — DHIS2, OpenMRS, OpenSRP / FHIR Core, Bahmni and Moodle — which it customizes, integrates and supports for national health management information systems, electronic medical records and shared health records, rather than shipping a hosted product of its own. The company is ISO 9001:2015 certified. mPower publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable contract; its public software surface is a GitHub organization made up largely of downstream forks of the open-source health platforms it implements, plus a set of first-party Android apps on Google Play.

providers.name: Nordnet
providers.description: Nordnet is a leading digital brokerage and wealth management platform based in Sweden, offering a wide range of financial services including stock trading, mutual funds, ETFs, bonds, and private market investments. The platform provides intuitive tools for both private investors and professional traders, with features such as real‑time market data, portfolio analytics, and automated savings plans. Nordnet emphasizes low fees, transparent pricing, and a user‑friendly experience across web and mobile applications, serving millions of customers across the Nordics.

providers.name: Numan
providers.description: Numan (trading as Vir Health Limited) is a UK-based digital healthcare and telemedicine company offering convenient, clinician-led care direct to consumers. Its services span weight-loss programmes (including GLP-1 medications such as Mounjaro and Wegovy), men's health (erectile dysfunction, hair loss, testosterone), women's health (menopause support), at-home blood tests and diagnostics, supplements, and one-off doctor consultations, delivered through its website and iOS/Android app. Numan is regulated by the Care Quality Commission and operates a GPhC-licensed pharmacy. It is a portfolio company of Anthemis. As of this enrichment pass Numan publishes no public developer API, SDKs, MCP server, or partner integration surface.

providers.name: OneBill Utilities
providers.description: A La Carte SaaS provides a secure, AI‑powered financial comparison platform for utilities, mortgage, insurance and other financial products in Ireland. It offers real‑time data, consumer apps and broker tools to help advisors sell and retain customers, with a focus on transparency and streamlined decision‑making.

providers.name: Panora
providers.description: Panora is an open-source unified API platform that allows developers to integrate with hundreds of third-party tools through a single API. It provides a unified interface for CRM, HR, accounting, and other integrations.

providers.name: Partender
providers.description: Partender is a bar and beverage inventory management platform that lets hospitality operators complete a full physical liquor, wine, beer, and keg inventory in roughly fifteen minutes by tap-and-swipe estimating how full each bottle is, at up to 99.2% accuracy. The subscription SaaS spans iOS, Android, and web apps and adds online ordering, purchase orders auto-sorted by distributor, pour-cost and variance reporting, and lightweight accounting so venues can cut time, labor, and inventory loss. Founded in 2012 and backed by 500 Global, Partender serves bars, restaurants, hotels, and stadiums. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Partender exposes a consumer mobile/web product rather than a publicly documented developer API.

providers.name: Peregrine
providers.description: Peregrine Technologies is a public-safety operational-intelligence platform that unifies fragmented data sources into actionable context for law enforcement, corrections, fire-rescue, EMS, emergency management, and 911 agencies. Its full-stack platform pairs Peregrine Foundation for data integration with Peregrine AI for analysis, surfacing connections across otherwise disconnected datasets to speed decision-making and situational awareness. FedRAMP High authorized and operating within AWS GovCloud, it is used by agencies including the Atlanta, Miami, and Edmonton police departments and Ada County Paramedics. The product is delivered as a login-gated enterprise/government SaaS with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Photonic
providers.description: Photonic Inc. is a Vancouver, British Columbia deep-tech company founded in 2016 by Dr. Stephanie Simmons and led by CEO Dr. Paul Terry, building distributed, fault-tolerant quantum computing and quantum networking on silicon T centre spin-photon qubits. Its "Entanglement First" architecture couples qubits that compute, store and emit telecom-band photons natively, so individual modules can be entangled over ordinary telecom fibre rather than scaled inside a single dilution refrigerator, and its SHYPS QLDPC error-correction codes cut the physical-qubit overhead of fault tolerance. Backed by Microsoft, British Columbia Investment Management Corp, RBC and TELUS, selected for Stage B of DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, and intending to deliver quantum computing through Azure and private systems. As of this profile Photonic is pre-commercial from an integration standpoint: it publishes no API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Rabbit
providers.description: Rabbit Inc. is a consumer technology company building AI-powered devices, best known for the Rabbit R1, a $199 handheld AI companion with industrial design by Teenage Engineering. The R1 runs rabbitOS and centers on a Large Action Model (LAM) that automates tasks across operating systems and applications (DLAM), alongside features like the Magic Camera, voice recording with transcription, and vibe-coded "creations." Rabbit is a portfolio company of a16z. As of this profile, Rabbit is a consumer hardware and device company with no publicly documented developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its public surface is a marketing site, support center, blog, and newsroom.

providers.name: Rad AI
providers.description: Rad AI is a San Francisco based healthcare technology company that builds generative and machine-learning software for radiology. Its products help radiologists work faster and reduce burnout: Rad AI Reporting is a generative AI reporting platform, Rad AI Impressions automatically generates customized report impressions (reported to save radiologists 60+ minutes per shift), and Rad AI Continuity manages follow-up of incidental findings. The company is SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA certified and is backed by Khosla Ventures. Rad AI markets its clinical products directly to health systems and imaging groups and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and compliance program for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: RadixArk
providers.description: RadixArk is a deep-tech AI-infrastructure company on a mission to make frontier-level AI infrastructure open and accessible to everyone ("Build AI for all"). Backed by a $100M seed round announced in May 2026, RadixArk builds open-source infrastructure and managed tooling for training and serving modern AI models at scale. Its flagship open-source projects are SGLang, a fast and flexible inference/serving engine for large language and vision-language models, and Miles, an enterprise-facing reinforcement-learning framework for LLM and VLM post-training (with a companion Miles Diffusion framework for large-scale diffusion training). RadixArk also operates a managed platform at platform.radixark.com serving developers, enterprises, and research labs. The company does not yet expose a public REST/HTTP API; this profile captures its open-source packages, identity, and security posture pending an API surface.

providers.name: Replika
providers.description: Replika is a consumer AI companion chatbot created by Luka, Inc., launched November 2017 and now serving 40+ million users. The product personalizes a neural network through user conversations and offers free "friend" plus paid "partner / spouse / sibling / mentor" relationship modes via iOS, Android, Oculus Rift, and a legacy web app at my.replika.com. There is no public developer API or partner program.

providers.name: RockFi
providers.description: RockFi is a French private wealth management firm positioning itself as a modern family office, pairing experienced private-banking advisors with technology to serve high-net-worth entrepreneurs, executives, athletes, and independent professionals. Its fixed-fee model offers life insurance (France and Luxembourg), structured funds, private equity, SCPI real estate, PEA and securities accounts, customized investment mandates, and consolidated real-time portfolio monitoring, tax optimization, and wealth-transmission planning. Registered with ORIAS (23004556) under ACPR and AMF oversight. Backed by Partech. No public developer API is currently published; this profile has been enriched from the public site.

providers.name: Second Spectrum (Genius Sports)
providers.description: Second Spectrum is a Los Angeles–based computer vision and AI sports tracking company, acquired by Genius Sports in 2021 for roughly $200M. It supplies skeletal and optical tracking, machine-learning analytics, and augmented broadcast products to major leagues, clubs, and broadcasters — most notably the NBA (official tracking partner from 2017 to 2023), the Premier League (official tracking partner via Football DataCo), and MLS. The customer-facing offering is the Performance Studio platform, used by club analysts and coaching staff to access tracking data, visualizations, and tagged clips. There is no public developer portal, no published OpenAPI, and no self-serve API keys; data and integration access are delivered exclusively under enterprise agreement with Genius Sports. The product surface is effectively a sales-led, league/club-tier offering rather than a developer API.

providers.name: Security Service Federal Credit Union
providers.description: Security Service Federal Credit Union (SSFCU), headquartered in San Antonio, Texas, is a member-owned, not-for-profit financial cooperative federally chartered and insured by the National Credit Union Administration (NCUA). It is one of the largest credit unions in the United States, serving members across Texas, Colorado, and Utah with consumer and business banking, deposit accounts, credit cards, auto and mortgage lending, and investment services through branches, online banking, and mobile apps. Its open-finance posture is the norm for a US credit union: there is no first-party public developer portal or downloadable API specification, and no public FDX or CFPB Section 1033 data-access API is documented. Consumer-permissioned account data is reachable only indirectly through third-party aggregators, and any API capability is delivered through its core banking provider rather than a self-serve developer program.

providers.name: Servus Credit Union
providers.description: Servus Credit Union Ltd. is a member-owned cooperative financial institution headquartered in Edmonton, Alberta, founded in 1938. It is Alberta's largest credit union and, following its 2023 member-approved merger with connectFirst Credit Union, became Canada's largest credit union by total assets (roughly $30 billion CAD), serving more than 500,000 members through about 100 branches and distributing profits back to members via its Profit Share program rather than to outside shareholders. As a provincially regulated Alberta credit union, Servus operates within a cooperative charter and offers retail and business banking, mortgages, loans, investments, and digital/mobile banking. On the open-finance front its posture is aggregator-only and honest: Servus runs no public first-party developer portal or documented public API. External data access to member accounts today is provided through third-party financial-data aggregators (Mastercard Open Banking / Finicity and Plaid) via consumer-permissioned connections, consistent with Canada's voluntary, not-yet-operational Consumer-Driven Banking framework overseen by the Financial Consumer Agency of Canada (FCAC).

providers.name: Seurat Technologies
providers.description: Seurat Technologies is a Wilmington, Massachusetts contract manufacturer that produces high-volume metal parts using its proprietary Area Printing technology, a Laser Powderbed Fusion (LPBF) additive process that decouples print speed from resolution and is positioned as roughly 10x more productive than conventional LPBF. Seurat does not sell 3D printers; it sells parts, qualifying customer designs through its Area Printing Production (APP) qualification program and then mass-producing them at localized factories for consumer electronics, automotive, energy, aerospace and defense OEMs. The company markets its process on reshoring, supply-chain resilience, tariff resistance and decarbonization, and engages customers through a quote / upload-your-part motion rather than any developer-facing product.

providers.name: Shippingbo
providers.description: Shippingbo is a Toulouse, France-based e-commerce logistics SaaS founded in 2016 by Marc Hericher and Romain Parent. The platform unifies an Order Management System (OMS), Warehouse Management System (WMS), and Transport Management System (TMS) behind a single REST API so that merchants, DNVBs, 3PLs, wholesalers, manufacturers, and marketplaces can centralize multi-channel orders, pilot warehouse picking and packing, and execute multi-carrier shipments from one back office. Shippingbo claims 5,000+ active users, 80 million orders, and EUR 5 billion in merchandise handled in 2024, with 2,500+ warehouses equipped across France and Europe. The Shippingbo Developer Portal (powered by Stoplight) exposes a public REST/JSON API covering orders, products, stocks, shipments, customers, pickings, and source connectors, secured by OAuth 2.0 through the oauth.shippingbo.com authorization server. Shippingbo additionally offers a dedicated TMS API for multi-carrier label generation and a webhook channel for order state changes, stock changes, and shipment events. Reported developer-facing scale includes 500+ developers, 10+ million orders processed through the APIs, 500+ million webhook deliveries, and 40+ pre-integrated carriers. Shippingbo is a French Tech company backed by IRDI Capital Investissement and GSO Innovation.

providers.name: Snapdocs
providers.description: Snapdocs is a digital mortgage closing platform that connects lenders, title and settlement companies, notaries, and signing services on a single system to automate the loan closing process. The platform provides eClosing and hybrid closing workflows, Notary Connect for scheduling and coordinating signing agents, automated document quality control, and an eVault for secure eNote registration and management. Snapdocs is used across roughly one in four U.S. residential mortgage transactions and connects to the major loan origination, point-of-sale, title production, and RON systems through pre-built partner integrations rather than a public self-serve developer API. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of SV Angel and Y Combinator and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Standab
providers.description: Standab provides parking and charging infrastructure solutions for shared micromobility fleets, enabling cities and operators to manage scooters and e‑bikes efficiently. Their platform offers structured parking spaces, charging stations, and operational tools to integrate with public spaces, addressing the physical infrastructure gap in micromobility deployments. Standab works with municipalities and mobility operators to create safe, organized, and scalable micromobility ecosystems.

providers.name: StoreCash
providers.description: StoreCash, operated by G Cards, Inc., is a Los Angeles-based cashback and payments company whose mobile app (iOS and Android) lets shoppers earn instant, unlimited cashback on everyday purchases at hundreds of online and in-store retailers. Users buy a store card for a purchase amount, receive cashback immediately, then redeem the digital card at checkout like a gift card. The product works with debit and credit cards, stacks with existing store promos, and offers sign-up, referral, and birthday bonuses under a free-trial-then- subscription model. StoreCash also markets a plug-and-play cashback API to businesses and banks to power their own loyalty and engagement, though that B2B API is contact-sales only and not publicly documented. The public website is Wix-hosted and exposes a Wix Site MCP endpoint for agentic AI access.

providers.name: Talkiatry
providers.description: Talkiatry is an online psychiatry (telepsychiatry) platform that connects patients with in-network, employed psychiatrists and therapists for virtual mental health care. Patients begin with a free online assessment that matches them to a psychiatrist, then attend video visits for evaluation, medication management, and talk therapy. Talkiatry treats conditions including ADHD, depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, PTSD, and OCD, works with major insurance plans, and operates as a HIPAA-compliant, LegitScript-certified telehealth provider. The company is backed by a16z. As of this enrichment pass Talkiatry publishes a consumer telehealth website but no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Tenstorrent
providers.description: Tenstorrent is an AI hardware company designing Tensix and Tensix++ based AI accelerators on the open RISC-V architecture, including the Wormhole and Blackhole generations of cards, the TT-QuietBox workstation, and the Galaxy Blackhole 6U server housing 32 Blackhole chips. The company is unusual in the AI silicon space for shipping a fully open-source software stack including TT-Metal (the low-level kernel and operator library), TT-Forge (an MLIR-based compiler for PyTorch, JAX, and ONNX), TT-MLIR, TT-XLA, the TT-Inference-Server, and RISC-V cores and toolchains. Pricing is published from 999 dollars for an entry card up to 440,000 dollars for a base Galaxy supercluster. Tenstorrent does not currently offer a public hosted-inference API, so this profile catalogs hardware, SDKs, compilers, and open-source repositories rather than an HTTP API surface.

providers.name: TRexBio
providers.description: TRexBio, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered at 681 Gateway Blvd in South San Francisco, California, founded in 2018 and seed funded by SV Health Investors, that discovers and develops immunoregulatory biologics based on tissue regulatory T cell (Treg) biology. Its Deep Biology Platform combines human tissue samples, computational biology and immunobiology expertise to map how tissue Tregs behave in disease and to identify and characterize novel targets for inflammatory, autoimmune and other immune-mediated conditions. Disclosed programs include TRB-061, the CD30 agonist TRB-071, TRB-081, and the Lilly-partnered TRB-051, with Phase 1 trials expected to initiate in 2027. The company announced an $84 million Series B in November 2024 and closed a further $50 million financing in January 2026; investors include Eli Lilly and Company, Pfizer Ventures, Johnson & Johnson, SV Health Investors and Polaris Partners. TRexBio publishes no developer program, API documentation, SDK or machine-readable API contract. trex.bio is a WordPress marketing site whose only machine-readable surfaces are the WordPress core REST API, a Yoast-generated llms.txt, and an OAuth-protected WordPress MCP adapter endpoint — CMS infrastructure rather than a product API.

providers.name: TurbineOne
providers.description: TurbineOne builds a frontline AI/ML platform that turns raw sensor data into real-time detection, classification, and targeting at the edge for defense and national-security missions. Its product suite spans Frontline Perception (edge computer vision on live sensor feeds), Frontline Command, Frontline Autonomy, a Model Hub for managing and deploying ML models, and EdgeWorks, a program that brings warfighters, mission teams, and engineers together to develop and validate mission capabilities for contested, disconnected environments. The company was founded on expertise in artificial intelligence, mesh networking, and sensing technology, and positions its work as "Responsible AI for our nation's heroes." It is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. TurbineOne publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public identity, GitHub organization, and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Valence Discovery
providers.description: Valence Discovery is an AI-first drug discovery company, now operating as Valence Labs, the AI research engine of Recursion. Formed from the merger of Datamol and InVivo AI, the team builds machine-learning methods and foundation models for molecular design, cellular perturbation prediction, and biological discovery, trained on petabyte-scale phenomics and transcriptomics data. Rather than a public REST API, Valence's developer surface is a suite of first-party open-source Python libraries - datamol, molfeat, graphium, SAFE and OpenQDC - published under the datamol-io and valence-labs GitHub organizations for cheminformatics, molecular featurization, graph neural networks and ML-ready quantum datasets.

providers.name: Verdant Robotics
providers.description: Verdant Robotics is an agricultural robotics company building precision farming systems for specialty crop growers. Its flagship SharpShooter uses "Aim & Apply" technology - machine learning and computer vision that identify crops and weeds in real time, build a three-dimensional map of the field, and deliver microliter-precise applications directly onto weeds without contacting the crop, doing over 240 targeted applications per second. The Robotics-as-a- Service platform reduces herbicide use by up to 99% and manual labor costs by up to 85% across carrots, leafy greens, cabbage, onions, and grass seed and sod production. Founded by leaders from the self-driving vehicle industry and commercial agriculture, Verdant is backed by DCVC. This profile was surfaced as a DCVC portfolio company; Verdant publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation - its GitHub organization hosts robotics tooling and forks (cbuf message serialization, Jetson build scripts, YOLO/ultralytics forks) rather than a product API.

providers.name: Winden
providers.description: Winden (Winden Technologies, Inc.) is a US fintech offering an AI-powered business credit card built to maximize cash back on every purchase. Its Visa commercial card advertises 2% unlimited cash back, and its Scout AI automatically hunts for discounts and promo codes at checkout. Alongside the card, Winden bundles business banking-style services: virtual cards with custom spend limits and merchant locks, free domestic ACH and wire transfers, invoicing and payment management, an AI CFO for accounting and cash-flow projections, 24/7 concierge support, and integrations with common accounting and payroll software. Winden is a consumer/SMB financial product; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: Wintrust Financial
providers.description: Wintrust Financial Corporation is a Rosemont, Illinois-based financial holding company operating a network of chartered community banks (Wintrust Bank, N.A. and its affiliates) primarily across Illinois, Wisconsin, Indiana and Florida, plus specialty lending, wealth management and mortgage businesses. Wintrust does not publish a first-party public developer portal or downloadable API specifications; its programmatic surface is delivered through commercial treasury management. Wintrust describes "API banking" that connects businesses directly to its secure file transfer protocol (SFTP) for account balance and activity reporting, payment files (Positive Pay, ACH, wires, EDI, lockbox) and data-format translation (NACHA, EDI 820, BAI2). Consumer and small-business account data is reachable to third parties through open-banking aggregators — Plaid is the confirmed aggregator supporting Wintrust / iBusinessBanking access.

providers.name: XP Health
providers.description: XP Health is an AI-powered vision benefits platform that modernizes employer vision programs with full-replacement and dual-option plans designed to reduce employee out-of-pocket eyewear costs. The platform serves more than 6,300 organizations, offering in-app prescription renewals, virtual try-on across 5,000+ eyewear styles, and a provider network reaching 90% of the U.S. population, with members saving an average of 69% on eyewear claims. Backed by QED Investors. XP Health does not currently publish a public developer portal or API.

providers.name: Xperi
providers.description: Xperi Inc. (NYSE: XPER) is an entertainment technology company whose licensed technologies power audio, video, and media discovery experiences across connected cars, consumer electronics, pay-TV, and streaming media platforms. Its brands include DTS immersive audio, HD Radio digital broadcast radio, IMAX Enhanced certification, and the TiVo video platform. Xperi ships its technologies to automakers, device makers, and video providers through commercial licensing and integration programs rather than a public developer API; no public developer portal or API documentation was found, though its TiVo engineering organization maintains an open-source presence on GitHub.

providers.name: 1047 Games
providers.description: 1047 Games is an independent video game studio best known for the arena shooter Splitgate and its follow-up title EMPULSE, a free-to-play movement shooter. Backed by Insight Partners and Lightspeed Venture Partners, the studio ships games across PC (Steam), PlayStation, and Xbox. As a consumer game publisher it exposes no public developer API; this profile tracks its public web, legal, and community surfaces for the API Evangelist network. Added originally as a VC-portfolio lead and enriched with live domain-security and identity probes.

providers.name: AbelZeta Pharma
providers.description: AbelZeta Pharma is a global clinical-stage cell therapy company discovering, developing, and manufacturing T-cell-based immunotherapeutics for cancer and immunological diseases. Its pipeline centers on Chimeric Antigen Receptor (CAR)-T cell technology across hematologic malignancies, solid tumors, and inflammatory and immunological conditions. Backed by Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China), AbelZeta develops personalized immune cell therapies that empower patients' own immune systems to address unmet medical needs, with operations in the United States (Maryland) and China. AbelZeta does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures the company's corporate web presence and identity within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Ablacare
providers.description: AblaCare rebranded as May Health in September 2022 and now operates at mayhealth.com; ablacare.com 301-redirects there. It is a clinical-stage medical device company headquartered in Paris, France, founded in 2017 out of Sofinnova Partners' MD Start medtech acceleration program. The company develops Ovarian Rebalancing, a one-time minimally invasive in-office procedure using ultrasound-guided radiofrequency ablation of ovarian tissue to restore spontaneous ovulation in women with infertility related to polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS). It raised a EUR 10M Series A in 2019, a USD 25M Series B co-led by Bpifrance and Trill Impact Ventures in 2024, and is running the randomized REBALANCE pivotal study intended to support an FDA submission. It publishes no developer program, API or SDK.

providers.name: ABM Respiratory Care
providers.description: ABM Respiratory Care (ABMRC, LLC — operating with Advanced Biomechanics Private Limited in Bangalore, India and Advanced Bio Machines PTE LTD in Singapore, with US headquarters in Eagan, Minnesota) is a privately held respiratory medical device manufacturer founded by CTO Vinay Joshi and led by CEO Greg Miller. It designs, manufactures and sells airway clearance and lung ventilation hardware under the BiWaze brand — BiWaze Clear (oscillation and lung expansion therapy) and BiWaze Cough (mechanical insufflation-exsufflation) — in both hospital and home-care configurations, sold through direct sales, demo requests and reimbursement channels rather than self-service signup. ABM Respiratory Care is a physical device company: it publishes no developer portal, no public API, no SDK and no machine-readable specification, and its entire public web surface is a WordPress marketing site at abmrc.com plus a separate WordPress electronic instructions-for-use portal at eifu.abmrc.com.

providers.name: Advantive
providers.description: Advantive is an AI-enabled software company for specialty manufacturing and distribution operations, unifying ERP, MES, quality (SPC/SQC), PLM, WMS, and B2B commerce workflows into industry-specific systems. Built from a portfolio of brands including Advantzware, DDI System, Distribution One, InfinityQS (Enact and ProFicient), Kiwiplan, WinSPC, and VIA, Advantive serves more than 2,500 customers across eight countries in verticals such as food and beverage, packaging (corrugated, folding carton, plastics), automotive, aerospace and defense, electronics, and distribution of fasteners, bearings, HVAC, and janitorial supplies. The company is a private-equity-backed operations software provider; this API Evangelist profile tracks its public digital surface. No public developer API or OpenAPI has been found — integration is delivered through the products' own connectors and the Advantive support portal.

providers.name: Affinia Therapeutics
providers.description: Affinia Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company in Waltham, Massachusetts pioneering next-generation adeno-associated virus (AAV) gene therapies. Using AI and structural modeling to rationally design novel capsids that better target tissues for improved safety and effectiveness, Affinia develops therapeutic cargoes for devastating rare and prevalent diseases of the heart and the nervous system. Its lead program, AFTX-201, targets BAG3-associated dilated cardiomyopathy and is being evaluated in the UPBEAT trial. Affinia Therapeutics is a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). This company profile carries no public API surface; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network for identity and demand signal.

providers.name: AgFunder
providers.description: AgFunder is a global agrifood-tech venture capital firm investing in deeptech and foundational technologies across AI, biology, robotics, and climate to advance food, agriculture, and human and planetary health. Founded roughly a decade ago by Michael Dean and Rob Leclerc and headquartered in Silicon Valley with offices in London and Singapore, the firm manages over $300M in assets and has backed more than 100 portfolio companies across four continents. AgFunder also operates AgFunderNews (AFN), the leading agtech and foodtech news and research publication, and publishes market research for the agrifoodtech ecosystem. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead and enriched with the firm's public identity and site properties; AgFunder publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: AgNovos Bioscience
providers.description: AgNovos Bioscience is a privately held medical technology company developing novel treatments for bone disease, founded in 2012 with offices in New York, Rockville (Maryland), Frankfurt and Dallas. Its lead technology is AGN1, a proprietary triphasic, calcium-based, osteoconductive implant material delivered through the OSSURE Local Osteo-Enhancement Procedure (LOEP) — a minimally invasive procedure intended to immediately, substantially and durably increase the density and strength of osteoporotic bone at sites of highest fracture risk. The company runs an active clinical program (CONFIRM, RECONFIRM, RESTORE and GRACE trials) and sponsors the ESCEO-AgNovos Young Investigator Award. AgNovos ships a physical implant and surgical kit, not software: its public web presence is a corporate and clinical-communications site with no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable interface of any kind.

providers.name: Agtonomy
providers.description: Agtonomy is a physical-AI and automation software company, founded in 2021 by growers and technologists, that embeds machine vision, connectivity, and AI directly into agricultural and off-road equipment from manufacturers such as Bobcat, Kubota, and Clemens. Its platform combines GPS guidance, computer vision, and fleet intelligence so a single operator can plan, remotely monitor, and review autonomous tasks like mowing, hauling, spraying, and cultivation across 10+ tractors at once. The TeleFarmer product controls these field missions through an intuitive app, helping growers address labor shortages and rising operational costs. Backed by investors including GV and Allison Transmission, Agtonomy operates primarily across the western United States with expansion into the Southeast US and Australia. This profile was surfaced as a GV portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Agtonomy publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Alcresta Therapeutics
providers.description: Alcresta Therapeutics is a specialty pharmaceutical company developing enzyme-based products that improve fat absorption and digestive health for people with rare and chronic conditions. Its lead product, the RELiZORB (immobilized lipase) cartridge, uses the company's patented iLipase microbead technology to mimic pancreatic lipase and hydrolyze fats in enteral (tube) feeding formulas, helping patients with exocrine pancreatic insufficiency, cystic fibrosis, short bowel syndrome, and critical-care nutrition needs absorb fatty acids they otherwise could not. Alcresta is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. The company operates a corporate and product marketing website but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications at this time.

providers.name: Alignable
providers.description: Alignable is a business networking platform that connects small business owners and entrepreneurs across North America. Its members build local referral relationships, join discussion groups and networking events, request and give business introductions, and use intelligent matching tools to find nearby partners, suppliers, and customers. The platform reports more than 10 million members and focuses on peer support and word-of-mouth growth for small businesses. Alignable does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web presence, policies, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: All City Network
providers.description: ALLCITY Network (All City Network) is a sports media and podcasting company built on the tagline "Sports Over Everything." It operates a set of city-based sports networks — DNVR (Denver), PHNX (Phoenix), CHGO (Chicago), PHLY (Philadelphia), and DLLS (Dallas) — that produce team-focused podcasts, video shows, and written coverage of local professional and collegiate sports, alongside network-wide shows and NBA/NFL programming. The company reaches fans through audio and video podcasts, memberships, and a merchandise store. It is a Bullpen Capital portfolio company and is not an API provider; it publishes no developer portal, documentation, or API, so the API-specific artifacts of the enrichment pipeline are not applicable.

providers.name: Alodokter
providers.description: Alodokter is Indonesia's leading digital health and telemedicine platform, founded in 2014 and operated by PT Alodokter Teknologi Solusi. It connects tens of millions of monthly active users with tens of thousands of licensed doctors through chat-based consultations (Tanya Dokter), online and in-person doctor appointment booking, a large library of medically reviewed health articles and a symptom and disease encyclopedia, health protection and insurance products, and a health commerce surface for medicines and health products. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched from the provider's own public web surface; Alodokter does not publish a public developer API portal or OpenAPI at this time, so this profile focuses on company identity, legal and support surfaces, and domain security posture.

providers.name: Alpha-9 Oncology
providers.description: Alpha-9 Oncology is a clinical-stage radiopharmaceutical company that spun out of the University of British Columbia and BC Cancer in 2019 to develop a portfolio of targeted cancer therapies. Alpha-9 engineers bespoke radiopharmaceutical molecules — optimizing the binder, linker, chelator, and radioisotope — to deliver radiation directly to tumor cells while limiting exposure to healthy tissue. The company operates purpose-built research facilities in Vancouver, BC and Boston, MA, and in October 2024 raised an oversubscribed $175M Series C led by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Ascenta Capital to advance its clinical pipeline. Alpha-9 is a drug developer and does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its company identity and public-web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Alta Resource Technologies
providers.description: Alta Resource Technologies is a Colorado-based deep-tech company reinventing how critical minerals are sourced. It uses advanced biochemistry — customizable, engineered proteins licensed from Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory and co-developed with researchers at Pennsylvania State University — to selectively separate high-purity rare earth elements and other strategic metals from low-grade ores, mining tailings, and electronic-waste streams such as end-of-life hard disk drives. The protein-based platform binds target elements out of complex, low-concentration solutions with high selectivity while dramatically reducing the environmental footprint of conventional mining and refining, strengthening U.S. and allied critical-mineral supply chains. Alta emerged from stealth in January 2025 and expanded its Series Seed to $10M, backed by DCVC, Voyager Ventures, In-Q-Tel, and Orion Industrial Ventures. As a materials-science and biochemistry company, Alta does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal; this API Evangelist profile carries its identity and website properties only.

providers.name: Andromeda
providers.description: Andromeda is a robotics company building personalised humanoid robot companions for aged care and assisted living. Its flagship robot, Abi, adapts to each resident's personality, ability, and language to provide social connection, conversation, and engagement that improves resident mood and wellbeing while extending care-team capacity. Founded by Grace Brown and backed by Forerunner Ventures and Paradigm, Andromeda has deployed Abi across aged-care providers in Australia and the United States (partners include mecwacare and Medical & Aged Care Group) and has been featured by the BBC, CNN, Forbes, and ABC Australia. The company currently publishes a public marketing and news site but no developer platform, API, or public technical documentation.

providers.name: Ansible Health
providers.description: AnsibleHealth is a virtual-first, doctor-led telemedicine practice specializing in the management of COPD, congestive heart failure, and other chronic pulmonary and cardiac conditions from home. Serving patients across 50+ states, it combines virtual diagnosis and personalized treatment plans, remote patient monitoring of vitals like heart rate and blood oxygen, virtual physical therapy, smoking-cessation coaching, and medication and durable-medical-equipment ordering to reduce hospitalizations and emergency-room use. The practice accepts Medicare, Medicaid, and most major commercial insurance plans. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes a patient-facing website but no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Antimatter Systems
providers.description: Antimatter Systems is an education technology company building a peer-to-peer learning network where students demonstrate mastery by making memes, puzzles, and games rather than by writing essays or sitting tests. Founded by Jonathan Libov, the company raised a $2M seed round led by Version One Ventures in 2023, joined by Spacecadet, Ordinary Holdings, Haystack and Compound. Its classroom product lets teachers create meme-based activities with deadlines and instructions, invite students by shareable link, moderate submissions, restrict learners to view-only, work from a library of pre-approved templates, catch unedited-image uploads with plagiarism detection, and grade every submission in one place; the company states it should be free for schools. Antimatter also ships a Sorcerer AI instructional coach plus the consumer Antimatter: Creator and Antimatter: Universe iOS apps. The platform runs on the web at playantimatter.com. As of July 2026 the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications.

providers.name: Anunta
providers.description: Anunta is an enterprise managed-services company specializing in Desktop-as-a-Service (DaaS), Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI), managed endpoints, and cloud services across private, public, and hybrid cloud environments. It delivers secure digital workspaces for large enterprises, with proprietary platforms including DesktopReady (off-the-shelf DaaS), CloudOptimal (cloud cost management and optimization), EuVantage (VDI environment visibility and management), and an AI Fabric operations-automation layer. Anunta reports over one million migrated users, 400,000+ active users, and 99.98% user uptime. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners, Anunta operates primarily as a services provider and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Anyfin
providers.description: Anyfin is a Swedish consumer-fintech company that helps people lower the cost of their existing debt. Through its mobile app, customers photograph or import a current loan, credit card, or installment plan and Anyfin offers to refinance and consolidate it at a lower interest rate into a single monthly payment. Products span personal loans, credit-card and installment refinancing, car loans, debt consolidation, credit-score checking (via UC) and optional payment-protection insurance (via AXA). Founded in 2018 and backed by Accel, EQT Ventures and Northzone, Anyfin operates primarily in the Swedish market. It exposes no public developer API or developer portal; its api.anyf.in backend serves the consumer app only.

providers.name: Apartment List
providers.description: Apartment List is a virtual-first online rental marketplace that helps renters find apartments across all 50 U.S. states. Founded in September 2011 by John Kobs and Chris Erickson, the platform uses an AI-driven "Perfect Match" recommendation engine to pair renters with listings based on budget, location, amenities, and lifestyle preferences, and offers a Partner Portal for property managers and landlords to list and manage units. The company runs a consumer-facing search experience alongside a B2B property-management side. Apartment List does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web, brand, and security surface.

providers.name: ApniBus
providers.description: ApniBus is an India-based online bus ticket booking platform that lets travelers search routes, compare operators, select seats, and pay for tickets across government and private bus services. It positions itself as a leading Indian bus-booking marketplace and an official RSRTC (Rajasthan State Road Transport Corporation) booking partner, aggregating over one lakh bus services across thousands of routes. The consumer experience spans a website and Android/iOS apps, with UPI, cards, net banking, and wallet payments, instant e-ticket / m-ticket confirmation, live bus tracking, and easy cancellation. ApniBus was surfaced as a portfolio company of Version One Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; it publishes no public developer or API program at this time.

providers.name: Arc
providers.description: Arc is an intelligent cash management platform for technology companies that consolidates business banking, treasury, debt capital, and AI-powered financial services into a single dashboard. Customers can sweep idle cash into yield-bearing accounts, manage liquidity across multiple accounts, raise debt capital, and access AI tooling for financial operations. Arc also offers a Global Treasury product that lets qualifying startups invest in US Treasury Bills as non-US entities while safeguarding funds in US brokerage accounts. The platform is primarily delivered through a hosted web application rather than a public REST API, and integrations are coordinated through Arc's solutions and customer success teams. Arc is positioned as a unified financial operating system for venture-backed and growth-stage technology businesses.

providers.name: Arc (The Browser Company)
providers.description: Arc is a Chromium-based alternative web browser from The Browser Company, organized around Spaces, Profiles, Split View, Boosts (user-authored CSS/JS overlays), Easels, Notes, and Arc Search on mobile. Arc is primarily a consumer product without a broad public developer REST API. Developer surface area is limited to Developer Mode in the desktop browser, the underlying Chromium extension model, and user-created Boosts. The company has signalled that Arc's active product investment is winding down in favor of the successor product, Dia.

providers.name: Artofsport
providers.description: Art of Sport is a consumer personal-care brand offering a complete line of daily body and skin care products made for athletes, including aluminum-free deodorant, antiperspirant, charcoal shampoo and body wash, bar soap, sunscreen, and hair care. Products are formulated with high-performance skincare science, fresh scents, clean formulas, and natural botanical ingredients. The company sells direct-to-consumer through a Shopify-powered e-commerce storefront at artofsport.com as well as retail distribution. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners. Art of Sport does not publish a first-party developer API; its only machine surface is the Shopify Customer Accounts OpenID Connect / OAuth authorization server exposed at the storefront host.

providers.name: Ashland
providers.description: Ashland is a global specialty chemicals company headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, that provides high-performance ingredients and additives for the pharmaceutical, personal care, food and beverage, coatings, adhesives, and industrial markets. The company's product portfolio includes cellulose ethers, vinyl pyrrolidone polymers, acrylates, and specialty polymers sold under brands such as Benecel, Klucel, Natrosol, Plasdone, and Povidone. Ashland serves over 10,000 customers in more than 100 countries. Ashland does not offer a public developer API but provides digital product selection tools, safety data sheets, and technical documentation through its website.

providers.name: asieris
providers.description: Asieris Pharmaceuticals is a China-based biopharmaceutical company developing innovative therapies in genitourinary tumors and women's health. Its focus areas span urologic oncology (bladder cancer diagnosis and treatment), women's health, and breast and gynecologic oncology, with marquee assets Vesique (APL-1202) for bladder cancer and Cevira (APL-1702), a non-invasive photodynamic therapy for cervical precancerous lesions. The company runs three proprietary R&D platforms (TIMN, TAIDD, DDC). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network; as a biopharma company it publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Astatechinc
providers.description: Astatechinc, operating as AstaTech Inc., is a long‑standing U.S. contract research organization (CRO) based in Bristol, Pennsylvania. Founded in 1996, it provides extensive chemistry catalog products, custom synthesis, bulk manufacturing, and analytical services to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies worldwide. The company emphasizes high‑quality, cost‑effective solutions and is certified as a Woman‑Owned Small Business.

providers.name: Astrobotic
providers.description: Astrobotic Technology is a Pittsburgh-based space robotics company building lunar landers, rovers, and lunar surface infrastructure for NASA and commercial customers. Its product lines include the Peregrine and Griffin lunar landers, the CubeRover and Polaris rover families, LunaGrid lunar surface power, the Xodiac reusable suborbital rocket lander test platform, and spacecraft navigation, machine vision and computing systems. The company sells payload delivery to the Moon under NASA's Commercial Lunar Payload Services (CLPS) program, alongside the consumer MoonBox service. Voyager Technologies completed its acquisition of Astrobotic on 13 July 2026 and the business now operates as Voyager Lunar Systems from its Pittsburgh headquarters. Astrobotic sells missions and hardware, not software: it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: At-Home-Doc
providers.description: At-Home-Doc (now branded MetaDoc) is a Qatar-based healthcare SuperApp operated by Medihealth Solutions (MOPH Licence No. 2066) offering round-the-clock virtual and in-person medical care. Patients book on-demand video consultations, in-network clinic appointments, or home doctor visits through the app, alongside pharmacy delivery, lab-at-home services, family insurance packages, and a Med Coins loyalty rewards program. The platform bundles Meta Doc (virtual clinics for practitioners), Meta Patient (a patient community), and Medi Shop into a single consumer healthcare experience delivered over iOS and Android. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or documentation surface is currently published.

providers.name: Atmosfy
providers.description: Atmosfy is a live-video mapping platform that bills itself as the world's largest live video map, aggregating 500M+ geo-tagged short-form videos across 100M+ places in 20,000+ cities and 150+ countries. The consumer app lets people see what restaurants, bars, hotels, and events actually look like in real time, while its business side offers brand targeting, embedded local-video integrations for other platforms, and video corpora for AI training. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Redpoint Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; as of this enrichment pass Atmosfy publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal, so this profile captures company identity, legal/link surface, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Audible
providers.description: Audible is an Amazon-owned online audiobook, podcast, and spoken-word entertainment service. It sells and streams audiobooks, Audible Originals, and podcasts through membership plans and a la carte purchases, delivered via web, iOS, Android, Alexa, and Kindle apps. Audible does not operate a public developer program or documented API — its catalog, library, and playback endpoints are a private internal API consumed by its own first-party apps. Community projects (the mkb79/Audible Python library, audible-cli, and omarroth/audible.cr) reverse-engineer that internal API; none are first-party or officially supported. This profile catalogs Audible's public web, help, and legal surface plus the unofficial client ecosystem.

providers.name: Aumio
providers.description: Aumio (Aumio GmbH) is a Berlin-based children's digital-health company behind a freemium sleep, meditation, and mindfulness mobile app for kids aged roughly 0-10 and their families. The app offers 200+ audio experiences - bedtime stories, soundscapes, white noise, sleep music, and guided meditations - added to weekly, with parts of the subscription reimbursed by German statutory health-insurance providers as a certified prevention course. Founded in 2020 and backed by Partech, Aumio operates as a consumer B2C product (iOS, Android, and web) and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this API Evangelist profile captures its public web and domain footprint.

providers.name: Awa Studios
providers.description: AWA Studios (Artists, Writers & Artisans, Inc.) is a New York-based independent multimedia entertainment company founded in 2018 by comics-industry veterans, including former Marvel editor-in-chief Axel Alonso and former Marvel president Bill Jemas, with media executive Jon Miller as board chairman. AWA publishes original comic books and graphic novels across action, crime, horror, science fiction, and fantasy genres, built around a creator-owned business model that offers favorable terms to writers and artists. The company operates the "Upshot" imprint and a shared "Resistance Universe," runs a direct-to-consumer shop for print and digital titles, and develops film and television adaptations of its properties. AWA received seed-stage funding from Lightspeed Venture Partners in 2018. It is a media and entertainment company and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Battery Smart
providers.description: Battery Smart is India's largest battery-swapping network for electric two- and three-wheelers, founded in 2019 by Pulkit Khurana and Siddharth Sikka and operated from New Delhi by Upgrid Solutions Private Limited and Upgrid Electrilease Private Limited. It runs an asset-light, partner-led model: local businesses — kirana stores, petrol pumps and neighbourhood shops — host swap points where a driver exchanges a depleted lithium-ion pack for a charged one in roughly two minutes and pays per swap instead of buying the battery with the vehicle, which removes the single largest cost from an electric two- or three-wheeler. The network is concentrated in Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Jaipur and Lucknow, and the company has raised across eleven rounds including a USD 65 million Series B led by LeapFrog Investments with MUFG Bank, Panasonic, Ecosystem Integrity Fund, Blume Ventures and British International Investment participating, plus a USD 15 million debt round with Mirova in April 2026. Battery Smart's software ships only as end-user Android applications — Battery Smart Driver and Battery Smart Partner — backed by a production API host at api.upgrid.in that self-identifies as the "Battery Smart API". As of this profile the company publishes no developer portal, API reference, SDK, webhook catalog or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: BeReal
providers.description: BeReal is a French social media application that encourages authentic, unfiltered daily sharing through a two-minute random notification window in which users capture a moment using both the front and rear cameras simultaneously. Positioned as an alternative to curated, algorithmic social media, it emphasizes genuine connection over performance and explicitly excludes AI-generated content from the platform. Founded in France and acquired by mobile publisher Voodoo, BeReal operates a consumer mobile product with a help center and an advertising business, but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced via a16z and Accel portfolio data and enriched with the provider's real public web properties and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Blind
providers.description: Blind (teamblind.com) is an anonymous professional community platform where verified employees discuss compensation, interview experiences, layoffs, company culture, and career decisions while preserving their anonymity through work-email verification. The platform organizes conversation into company channels, industry topics, and location-based feeds, and runs on a freemium model with a For Business offering. It operates primarily as a consumer mobile and web app; no public developer API, developer portal, or well-known discovery surface was found during enrichment (all /.well-known/* probes returned 404). Sector: consumer / professional social network. Surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures.

providers.name: Bloom Energy
providers.description: Bloom Energy Corporation (NYSE: BE) is a San Jose, California hardtech company that designs and manufactures solid-oxide fuel cell "Energy Server" platforms which generate electricity on-site from natural gas, biogas, or hydrogen through an electrochemical process rather than combustion. Its modular systems deliver resilient, always-on power for data centers, manufacturing, healthcare, utilities, and critical infrastructure, can be deployed in roughly 90 days, and scale from single units to hundreds of megawatts. Bloom also builds high-temperature solid-oxide electrolyzers for low-cost hydrogen production. The company is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a hardtech portfolio company; it publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Blue Apron
providers.description: Blue Apron is a direct-to-consumer meal-kit and prepared-food delivery company that ships chef-designed recipes with pre-portioned fresh ingredients on a weekly, no-commitment basis. Its consumer-facing surface spans meal kits, assembly-and-bake meals, ready-to-eat prepared dishes, and family-style options ordered and managed through blueapron.com and its mobile apps. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners, Blue Apron operates a consumer e-commerce and subscription platform with no public developer program, API portal, or documented API surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Blue Nile
providers.description: Blue Nile is an online retailer of diamonds and fine jewelry, founded in 1999 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington. It pioneered the direct-to-consumer model for engagement rings and loose diamonds, letting shoppers search and compare certified diamonds by cut, color, clarity, and carat and build custom rings, wedding bands, and gifts online. The company is now part of Signet Jewelers. Blue Nile is included in the API Evangelist network as a consumer / e-commerce company profile; it was originally surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Trinity Ventures. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Blue Water Autonomy
providers.description: Blue Water Autonomy is a Boston-based defense technology company building autonomous warships for open-ocean operations, with the goal of revitalizing U.S. shipbuilding through scalable, reliable, uncrewed naval vessels. Founded in 2025 by Rylan Hamilton (ex-U.S. Navy officer and founder of 6 River Systems), Scott N. Miller (ocean engineer and early iRobot engineer), and Austin Gray (former Navy intelligence officer), the company unveiled its 190-foot Liberty Class autonomous ship platform for the U.S. Navy in February 2026. Backed by a $50M Series A led by GV, Blue Water Autonomy operates from offices in Boston MA, Washington DC, Morgan City LA, and San Diego CA. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Blue Wire
providers.description: Blue Wire is a podcast network and monetization platform built for independent sports content creators, positioning itself as "The Monetization Engine for Sports Creators." The company provides sales, marketing, distribution, and operational support so creators can focus on producing content while Blue Wire handles ad sales and sponsorship coordination across a network of 200+ shows and 500+ creators reaching hundreds of millions of listeners. Backed by 500 Global. Blue Wire operates as a media and advertising business and does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its company identity and domain-security posture within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Bolo.ai
providers.description: Bolo.ai provides a context layer that enables agentic AI to work effectively in heavy industry. By embedding directly into existing industrial software and workflows, Bolo captures operational data and institutional knowledge, ensuring AI models have reliable, domain‑specific context. This platform helps preserve expertise, improve safety, and accelerate decision‑making across sectors such as energy, manufacturing, and infrastructure.

providers.name: Boom Supersonic
providers.description: Boom Supersonic is a Denver-based aerospace company building supersonic commercial aircraft to make the world dramatically more accessible. Its flagship airliner, Overture, is designed to carry passengers at twice the speed of today's jets and has orders and pre-orders from United Airlines, American Airlines, and Japan Airlines. The company develops the Symphony medium-bypass turbofan engine purpose-built for supersonic flight, flew the XB-1 demonstrator past Mach 1, and is applying its propulsion technology to Superpower gas turbines for data-center energy. Boom is a deep-tech, hardware-first manufacturer and does not currently publish a public developer API surface; this profile tracks its identity and security posture in the API Evangelist network. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Electric Capital, and Homebrew.

providers.name: Breathwrk
providers.description: Breathwrk is a consumer health and performance app offering guided breathing exercises to reduce stress, improve sleep, boost energy, and enhance athletic and social performance. It packages more than 50 science-backed breathing techniques with music, haptics, coach-led classes, and progress tracking across calming, sleep, energizing, performance, and social categories. Breathwrk is available on iOS and Android with free and Pro subscription tiers plus a Breathwrk for Business program for organizations, and the company is now part of Peloton. Breathwrk publishes no public API, SDK, or developer program; this profile is maintained by API Evangelist and reflects the company's live web presence and security posture.

providers.name: Brelyon
providers.description: Brelyon is an MIT Media Lab spin-off building headset-free virtual displays — desktop monitors that use electro-optics and computational rendering to produce monocular image depth rather than autostereoscopic 3D. Its Ultra Reality line delivers a 122-inch virtual screen filling roughly 110 degrees of field of view, alongside Ultra Reality Extend (a multi-focal monitor that renders AI-generated overlays at different depths), Ultra Reality Mini, and experimental Hyper Displays. The company is headquartered in San Mateo, California with an international office in Taichung, Taiwan, and sells into enterprise simulation, training, teleoperation and medical visualization; prosumer flight simulation, gaming, trading and content production; and automotive in-vehicle HMI integration. Brelyon ships desktop software (Brelyon Suite, Focal Studio, Visual Engine, Stream Weaver) for distortion correction, monitor merging and multi-focal content creation, but publishes no public developer program, API, or SDK.

providers.name: Brick&Bolt
providers.description: Brick&Bolt (bricknbolt.com) is a Bangalore-based, tech-enabled home and commercial construction marketplace that delivers end-to-end design-to-build services across major Indian cities including Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Delhi NCR, and Mysuru. The company connects homeowners with vetted contractors and manages projects through its QASCON quality system (470+ quality checks), an ESCROW-secured payment model that releases funds only as milestones complete, transparent quotations, and consumer and professional mobile apps for real-time project tracking. Backed by Accel, Brick&Bolt has delivered thousands of homes and was named to Forbes Asia's "100 to Watch" list. This profile was surfaced as an Accel portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Brick&Bolt operates a consumer construction platform and mobile apps but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Bright View Technologies
providers.description: BrightView Technologies, Inc. is a Durham, North Carolina optical film company specializing in computational optics and the design and manufacture of Micro Lens Array (MLA) solutions that shape, diffuse, and manage light. Founded in 2002 on intellectual property licensed from Duke University, the company engineers precision optical films and micro-optical structures used in automotive displays, head-up displays, and LiDAR; consumer and mini/micro-LED displays (gain enhancement and LED-hiding films); LED and architectural lighting (beam shaping and diffusion); and augmented- and virtual-reality beam-shaping optics. BrightView is a hardware and materials manufacturer serving OEMs and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead of Battery Ventures and enriched from the company's public website.

providers.name: Bumame
providers.description: Bumame is an Indonesian healthcare provider ("Elevating Indonesian Healthcare") delivering global-standard health screening and preventive-care services to Indonesian families. It operates a network of clinics and offers medical check-up packages, laboratory testing, vaccination and boosters, maternal and child health services, early cancer screening and genetic DNA testing, vitamin infusions, home care, doctor consultations, and corporate health programs, with online appointment booking. Backed by 500 Global. Surfaced as a portfolio-company lead in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API surface has been found to date.

providers.name: Bustle
providers.description: Bustle is the flagship lifestyle and culture publication of Bustle Digital Group (BDG), a New York-based digital media company that moves culture forward through premium editorial content, social storytelling, and live experiences. BDG operates a portfolio of eight brands - Bustle, NYLON, Scary Mommy, W Magazine, Inverse, The Zoe Report, Romper, and Elite Daily - spanning lifestyle, fashion, parenting, entertainment, and luxury. The company produces award-winning branded content and campaigns through its BDG Studios and BDGx experiential arm. Bustle is a consumer media publisher rather than an API provider; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company/portfolio lead, and no public developer API or specification has been identified on its properties.

providers.name: Cake
providers.description: Cake (stylized CAKE) is a Stockholm, Sweden based maker of premium, lightweight, high-performance electric motorcycles and mopeds, built around a mission to accelerate the shift to a zero-emission society by combining excitement with responsibility. Its clean-mobility lineup spans commuter models (Makka, Osa), off-road bikes (Kalk, Bukk) and work-focused utility variants. Founded by Stefan Ytterborn and backed by Creandum, CAKE filed for bankruptcy in early 2024 and its brand and IP were acquired by Norway's Brages Holding AS, which relaunched the company. Cake sells direct to consumers and through dealers at ridecake.com. Its bikes ship with the CAKE Connect module, and CAKE markets a "CAKE API" on its own :work and delivery pages that lets fleet owners pull vehicle data, telemetry and controls into their own fleet software — but that API has no public developer portal, no reference and no machine-readable specification; access runs through the contact and partner forms.

providers.name: California Forever
providers.description: California Forever is a real estate and urban development company founded by Jan Sramek in 2017, backed by prominent Silicon Valley investors including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Laurene Powell Jobs, Reid Hoffman, Marc Andreessen, and Stripe co-founders Patrick and John Collison. Through its subsidiary Flannery Associates the company assembled roughly 60,000-70,000 acres of land in southeastern Solano County, California, and is planning a new walkable city for up to 400,000 residents alongside the Solano Foundry advanced manufacturing park and the Solano Shipyard. The company describes the effort as a $215 billion private investment intended to create hundreds of thousands of jobs, 170,000+ new homes, and billions in annual tax revenue over 40 years. California Forever is a physical-development and land-use company; it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable interfaces at this time.

providers.name: Carbon Health
providers.description: Carbon Health is a technology-enabled healthcare provider offering primary, urgent, virtual, and pediatric care through in-person clinics and telemedicine across the United States. It operates on its own clinical technology platform (CarbyOS) and offers services including same-day appointments, cold/flu/COVID testing, STI/STD testing, sports physicals, occupational and workplace health, and clinical research for sponsors. Carbon Health was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and DCVC and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or FHIR patient-access surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity, public web properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Cargolux
providers.description: Cargolux Airlines International S.A. is Europe's largest all-cargo airline, headquartered at Luxembourg Findel Airport in Luxembourg and operating a global Boeing 747 freighter network under IATA designator CV and air waybill prefix 172 (with Cargolux Italia on prefix 356). In the logistics chain Cargolux is the main-leg air carrier: it sells capacity to freight forwarders and general sales agents rather than to shippers, hands cargo to terminal and ground handling operators such as its Luxcargo Handling subsidiary, and files customs and security data on behalf of the contracted forwarder. Its API posture is honestly a customer-contract one. Cargolux publishes no developer portal and no machine-readable contract of any kind — developer.cargolux.com, developers.cargolux.com and docs.cargolux.com do not resolve, and /developers, /api, /openapi.json, /swagger.json, /api-docs and /.well-known/ all return 404 on www.cargolux.com. The only public self-service surfaces are HTML: a track-and-trace widget and a flight scheduler on the marketing site, plus a login-walled Customer Portal at my.cargolux.com. A real quote-and- booking API exists, but it is a bilateral, commercially negotiated forwarder interface — piloted with Kuehne+Nagel in 2021 and extended to DB Schenker — with no published reference, and it is complemented by indirect distribution through the cargo.one, CargoAi and WebCargo by Freightos marketplaces. Underneath, Cargolux runs IBS Software's iCargo SaaS cargo management system and holds a large minority stake in Luxembourg's CHAMP Cargosystems, whose developer.champ.aero portal is the developer surface Cargolux's ecosystem actually reads — CHAMP's, not Cargolux's. IATA e-AWB "Single Process" is documented; no IATA ONE Record or Cargo-XML publication was found.

providers.name: Carmoola
providers.description: Carmoola is a UK-based, mobile-first car finance platform that lets consumers get a pre-approved budget in minutes through its app, then pay dealers or private sellers directly with a virtual card. It offers Hire Purchase (HP) and Personal Contract Purchase (PCP) financing, soft credit checks that do not affect the applicant's score, flexible repayment terms, and the ability to refinance an existing car loan. Carmoola is authorised and regulated by the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and is backed by investors including QED Investors. This profile was surfaced as a QED Investors portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Carmoola operates a consumer app rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: CarOnSale
providers.description: CarOnSale is an AI-supported B2B marketplace for used-car trading across Europe, operated by Castle Tech GmbH. Licensed dealers, OEMs, fleet operators, and leasing companies buy and sell used vehicles through digital auctions built on standardized 110-point condition assessments, AI-based pricing and valuation, and integrated transport and financing services. The platform connects sellers (dealer groups, OEMs, leasing and rental companies) with a European network of professional buyers, handling procurement, price discovery, settlement, and logistics end to end. Added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio company; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Cashify
providers.description: Cashify is an Indian re-commerce platform for buying, selling, and repairing used and refurbished consumer electronics — smartphones, laptops, tablets, and other gadgets. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Gurugram, the company provides instant online price quotes, free doorstep pickup with on-the-spot payment for devices sold to it, and sells certified refurbished devices backed by warranty. Alongside its consumer website and mobile apps, Cashify operates a network of physical retail stores across India, runs device repair services, and offers a partner program for retailers. It is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners among other investors. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a company lead and has been enriched with identity and domain-security artifacts.

providers.name: Castbox
providers.description: Castbox is a free cross-platform podcast and audio content platform that lets listeners discover, stream, download, and manage millions of podcasts, audiobooks, and radio shows across Apple iOS, Android, Amazon Alexa, Google Home, CarPlay, Android Auto, and the web. Alongside its consumer listening apps, Castbox offers a "For Podcasters" suite for creators to host, distribute, and monetize their shows. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network, Castbox is a consumer audio company that publishes no public developer API portal; this profile captures its public identity, legal, and support surface.

providers.name: Cerevance
providers.description: Cerevance is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel therapeutics for central nervous system (CNS) disorders. Its proprietary NETSseq platform profiles gene expression across specific human brain cell types from post-mortem tissue to identify previously undiscovered, cell-type-specific drug targets, powering a pipeline of small-molecule candidates for Parkinson's disease, Alzheimer's disease, epilepsy, and other neurodegenerative and psychiatric conditions. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV; profiled in the API Evangelist network. Cerevance publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK.

providers.name: Charm Industrial
providers.description: Charm Industrial is a carbon removal technology company that permanently sequesters atmospheric CO2 by converting waste biomass (agricultural residues and other plant matter) into a stable, carbon-rich liquid called bio-oil through fast pyrolysis, then injecting that bio-oil into EPA-regulated underground wells where it solidifies and remains stored for millennia. Charm sells verified carbon dioxide removal (CDR) credits to enterprise buyers and publishes a public ledger of delivered tonnage. The company received a $53M advance market commitment from Frontier and is backed by investors including General Catalyst and Lowercarbon Capital. This API Evangelist profile tracks Charm Industrial as a company; the provider publishes a marketing and carbon-purchasing website but no public developer API surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Chefsteps
providers.description: Chefsteps is a culinary technology company offering digital cooking tools, recipes, and classes. Founded by chefs, it provides a platform with step‑by‑step guides, precision cooking equipment integration, and a community of food enthusiasts. The company focuses on innovative cooking experiences, combining hardware like the Joule sous‑vide device with software to help users achieve professional results at home.

providers.name: Cintas
providers.description: Cintas Corporation is a Fortune 500 provider of uniform rental, facility services, first aid and safety products, and fire protection services. Cintas does not currently publish a public developer portal; B2B integrations (ordering, EDI, route management, billing) are delivered to enterprise customers through the myCintas portal, the Cintas Partner Connect program, and account-managed EDI relationships.

providers.name: Cirsium Biosciences
providers.description: Cirsium Biosciences is a biotechnology company democratizing gene therapy through transformative manufacturing methods.
