It develops viral vector production systems that use whole plants as bioreactors, offering a highly scalable, linear scale-out platform for producing recombinant AAV (adeno-associated virus) vectors. The plant-based, controlled-environment agriculture approach targets the industry's core production bottlenecks - inadequate global capacity, poor scalability, high clinical-grade manufacturing costs, and standardization challenges - claiming up to a 70% reduction in manufacturing lead times. Cirsium is a private, venture-backed therapeutics-manufacturing firm and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Citizen
providers.description: Citizen is a consumer public-safety mobile application that delivers real-time, location-based safety alerts and incident notifications to users about events happening in their communities. The app surfaces verified alerts, live video streamed by witnesses at the scene, incident search, and community broadcast features to help people connect and stay safe. Backed by 8vc, Citizen positions itself as the leading public-safety app in the United States. It is a consumer product with no public developer program, API documentation, SDK, or developer portal exposed on its website as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Claim
providers.description: Claim — legally Claim Digital Assets, Inc. — is a New York consumer rewards app that pays people cash back for showing up in person at restaurants and retailers. Every Thursday its "Drop" matches a user with three nearby merchants; the user picks one, pays with a card linked through Plaid, and Claim reimburses them automatically over Venmo. Users can also trade Claims with friends, the social mechanic behind its "Benefits with Friends" positioning. Merchants buy performance-based customer acquisition instead of impressions, and Claim markets the program as turnkey — "no integrations, no setup, no training, no fees" — paying only when a guest transacts. Claim raised a $12M Series A led by VMG Technology in October 2024 ($20M raised in total, with Sequoia Capital and Susa Ventures) and was acquired by Wonder Group, Inc. in January 2026, where it now scales inside Grubhub and Seamless. Claim publishes no developer program, no API reference, and no machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Claim Genius
providers.description: Claim Genius is an AI vehicle-inspection and automated damage-assessment company serving auto insurance claims, underwriting, dealerships, salvage, lease and rental, fleet and collision repair. Its GeniusINSPECT engine converts vehicle photos and video into structured, decision-ready data — per-part damage classification (scratch, dent, tear, glass, wheel), repair-versus-replace decisions, labor and paint hours, OEM part pricing, repairability status and total-loss probability. The capabilities are packaged as products (GeniusINSPECT for Claims, GeniusINSPECT for Underwriting, GeniusPrepost, GeniusOPS) and exposed to integrators through the GeniusAPI Suite, a JWT-authenticated REST API with asynchronous pipeline processing. The company has operated across the US, EU and Asia since 2018.

providers.name: Clark
providers.description: Clark ("Dein Versicherungsmanager") is a Germany-based digital insurance manager that lets consumers view, compare, optimize, and manage all of their insurance policies in one mobile app and web platform. Founded in Frankfurt in 2015, Clark pairs a licensed insurance brokerage with automated tariff comparison across more than 180 insurance providers and free expert consultation, covering health, liability, property, life, mobility, and retirement products. The company operates across Germany, Switzerland, France, and the UK, serves over 700,000 customers, and is backed by venture investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners. Clark exposes no public developer API or developer portal; it is a consumer-facing insurtech rather than an API producer.

providers.name: Clikalia
providers.description: Clikalia is a Spanish proptech founded in 2018 by Alister Moreno and Pablo Fernandez that operates an iBuyer model for residential real estate: it makes homeowners an instant purchase offer, can close a sale within days, then renovates and returns properties to the market in turnkey condition. The company pairs proprietary technology with a large operations team to digitize a historically slow home buying and selling process, and also offers mortgage brokerage (hipotecas) and renovation services (Studio by Clikalia). Backed by Fifth Wall and SoftBank Vision Fund, Clikalia operates across Spain, Portugal, France and Mexico. Clikalia does not publish a public developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures its public web, legal, and domain-security surface.

providers.name: CMR Surgical
providers.description: CMR Surgical is a British medical-device company headquartered in Cambridge, UK, founded in 2014 (as Cambridge Medical Robotics). It develops Versius, a small, modular and portable robot-assisted surgical system used across urology, general, gynaecological and thoracic surgery, and Versius Plus, its next-generation platform cleared by the US FDA in December 2025. More than 45,000 patients have been treated globally, making Versius one of the most widely used soft-tissue robotic surgery platforms. CMR reached unicorn status in 2019 and raised a $600M Series D at a $3B valuation in 2021, backed by SoftBank Vision Fund 2, GE Healthcare, ABB Technology Ventures and others. Its digital ecosystem (Versius Connect, Versius Team, Versius Clinical Insights) is a login-gated clinical surface; CMR publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs or developer portal.

providers.name: Coach
providers.description: Coach is a luxury leather goods and lifestyle brand offering handbags, accessories, footwear, ready-to-wear apparel, and fragrances. Coach is owned by Tapestry, Inc. (NYSE: TPR), the New York-based house of accessible luxury brands that also operates Kate Spade New York and Stuart Weitzman. Coach operates direct-to-consumer e-commerce at coach.com and a global network of retail and outlet stores. Coach does not publish a public-facing developer portal or API; integrations with retail partners, marketplaces, and ad tech platforms run through Tapestry's enterprise systems and approved partner channels rather than a self-service developer program.

providers.name: CoConstruct
providers.description: CoConstruct is a residential construction management software platform originally founded in 2005 in Charlottesville, Virginia by Donny Wyatt to help custom home builders and remodelers manage projects, budgets, selections, client communications, scheduling, and financial workflows in a single web and mobile application. The product served thousands of custom builders across the United States and was paired with CBUSA, a homebuilder group purchasing organization CoConstruct previously acquired. On February 24, 2021, CoConstruct was acquired by Buildertrend of Omaha, Nebraska, with growth funding from Bain Capital Tech Opportunities, HGGC, and Serent Capital, creating a combined company serving 23,000+ clients, 1.1M+ users, and $200B+ in annual construction project value. By 2022 Buildertrend had merged the two products into a single unified Buildertrend platform and migrated CoConstruct customers off the legacy product. CoConstruct historically operated a developer portal at developer.coconstruct.com exposing APIs for project, financial, and scheduling data, but as of the merger CoConstruct has paused new API development — "we are not establishing new API endpoints or connecting additional users to existing endpoints" — and the developer portal now redirects to a static notice page. Existing API connections are reportedly maintained but no public OpenAPI specification, SDK, or open-source release is published. Net-new integration work is directed to Buildertrend's own platform and partner program.

providers.name: CodeMentor
providers.description: CodeMentor (codementor.io) is an on-demand marketplace that connects software developers with vetted expert mentors for live 1:1 coding help, code review, debugging, pair programming, and longer-term freelance engagements across dozens of programming languages and frameworks. Part of the Arc / CodeMentor group, it serves individual learners seeking real-time mentorship as well as companies hiring vetted remote developers. As of this profile CodeMentor exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface; this record was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched with verified identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Coffee Meets Bagel
providers.description: Coffee Meets Bagel (CMB) is a consumer dating application built for people seeking serious, committed relationships rather than casual swiping. Founded by three sisters, the app uses a curated daily-match model and reports over 150 million matches, with the large majority of its daters looking for a long-term partner. The company operates a mobile-first product for iOS and Android across the US, Canada, and worldwide markets, supported by a premium subscription tier. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of DCM Ventures. Coffee Meets Bagel publishes no public developer or partner API, no OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specifications, and no /.well-known discovery surface; this profile therefore carries company identity, verified public web properties, and a domain-security probe only.

providers.name: Conceivable Life Sciences
providers.description: Conceivable Life Sciences is a fertility technology company founded in 2021 that builds AURA, an AI-powered, end-to-end automated in vitro fertilization (IVF) laboratory. AURA combines six integrated robotic workstations, advanced optics, machine vision and AI inference to automate more than 200 manual embryology steps — sperm preparation, oocyte retrieval and denudation, ICSI, dish preparation, embryo culture and vitrification — so that embryologists supervise rather than perform each micromanipulation. The company raised a $50M Series A in September 2025 (bringing total funding to $70M), opened the first automated IVF lab in Mexico City, and has partnered with IVI RMA Global to deploy AURA in a US clinic. Its public surface is a corporate and scientific one — research papers, patents, press and clinical trial registrations — with no developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Concentric AI
providers.description: Concentric AI provides an AI-driven data security governance platform built on its proprietary Semantic Intelligence technology to autonomously discover, classify, monitor, and protect sensitive data across cloud and on-premises environments. The agentless platform spans Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), data loss prevention, data access governance, insider risk detection, and generative-AI data security (covering Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, and Perplexity), connecting to 40+ data platforms and business applications including Snowflake, Amazon S3, Microsoft 365, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and Google Workspace. Backed by Homebrew, Concentric AI was recognized as a 2026 Gartner Peer Insights Customers' Choice for DSPM.

providers.name: Connect Biopharma
providers.description: Connect Biopharma is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, dedicated to transforming care for patients with inflammatory diseases such as asthma and COPD. Its lead drug candidate, rademikibart (CBP-201), is an antibody targeting IL-4Ra in Phase 2 clinical development for acute asthma and COPD exacerbations. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network, the company operates in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sector and publishes no public developer portal, API, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Corvus Robotics
providers.description: Corvus Robotics provides autonomous warehouse inventory management solutions using AI‑powered drones and robotics. Their platform, including Corvus One, Cold Chain, and Trident, enables real‑time inventory tracking, cold‑chain monitoring, and automated material handling for Fortune 500 enterprises across North America. The company focuses on reducing labor costs, increasing accuracy, and improving supply‑chain efficiency through advanced perception and navigation technologies.

providers.name: Couchsurfing
providers.description: Couchsurfing is a community-driven travel and hospitality-exchange platform that connects travelers with local hosts offering free accommodation, local meetups, and cultural exchange across more than 200,000 cities worldwide. Members build trust through verified profiles, references, and community events, and use the service to find places to stay, meet locals, and discover events while traveling. Couchsurfing publishes no official public developer API or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public web, trust, and policy surface for discovery and monitoring, and was originally surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and Point Nine.

providers.name: Coveti
providers.description: Coveti is a curated luxury fashion marketplace that connects consumers with independent designers and exclusive heritage boutiques across Milan and Paris through what it calls "Agentic Commerce" - AI-powered personal styling. Its Fashion Agent builds looks for specific occasions, while The Blind Network sources from 500+ boutiques, offering global shipping to 190+ countries, duty handling, custom 3D shoe design, and private client concierge services. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and tracked in the API Evangelist network; no public developer/API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: crownbio
providers.description: Crown Bioscience (CrownBio) is a global contract research organization (CRO) specializing in translational oncology and immuno-oncology drug discovery. It provides preclinical and translational services to biotech and pharmaceutical companies, including in vitro drug screening (cell lines, organoids, panels), in vivo studies (PDX, CDX, syngeneic and humanized models), DMPK/toxicology, preclinical imaging, and biomarker analysis spanning genomics (NGS, single-cell sequencing), proteomics, spatial biology, and flow cytometry. CrownBio also operates public web-browsable cancer-model databases — a PDX Model Database (2,500+ models), an Organoid Models Database (600+ models), an IO Murine Models Database, and a Cell Line / CDX Database — searchable through a Multi-Model Search interface. There is no public developer API or programmatic data access; the databases are web interfaces. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Crystal Dynamics
providers.description: Crystal Dynamics is a AAA video game development studio, best known as the home of the Tomb Raider franchise and its Lara Croft character, and part of the Embracer Group. The studio publishes a consumer-facing marketing website, careers portal, player support center, and news/community hub, but exposes no public developer API program, API documentation, developer portal, or SDKs. This profile entered the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio stub lead; enrichment confirms there is no public API surface to catalog at this time.

providers.name: Curefoods
providers.description: Curefoods is a Bengaluru-based multi-brand cloud kitchen and quick-service restaurant company founded in 2020 that builds and operates iconic Indian food brands. As of March 2025 it runs roughly 502 outlets across India (about 281 cloud kitchens, 99 kiosks, and 122 restaurants) under a house-of-brands model including Kitchens of EatFit, Sharief Bhai, Olio Pizza, Nomad Pizza, Arambam, CakeZone, Frozen Bottle, and Krispy Kreme. Backed by Accel, Chiratae Ventures, and Iron Pillar, the company crossed roughly Rs 746 crore in FY25 revenue and has received SEBI approval for an IPO. Curefoods is a consumer food operator with no public developer API or documentation surface; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and carries only identity, domain-security, and public-property signals.

providers.name: Curology
providers.description: Curology is a direct-to-consumer skincare and telehealth company founded in 2014 and based in San Francisco, California. It pairs online dermatology providers (dermatologists, nurse practitioners, and physician assistants) with custom-compounded prescription topical treatments for acne, anti-aging, and other skin concerns, delivered as a subscription. Care is delivered through a secure telemedicine platform where patients complete a skin assessment, upload photos, and receive a personalized formula plus ongoing provider messaging. Curology is a portfolio company of Forerunner Ventures and IVP. It operates as a consumer web and mobile product and does not publish a public developer API; this profile tracks the company as part of the API Evangelist health/telehealth network.

providers.name: Curve Health
providers.description: Curve Health is a New York City-based digital health technology company, founded in 2020, that delivers a virtual care and telemedicine platform purpose-built for skilled nursing facilities (SNFs) and senior care. The platform unifies telemedicine, a health information exchange, predictive analytics, and smart billing into a single system so nurses, physicians, behavioral health providers, and facility operators can deliver care in place and reduce avoidable hospital transfers. Curve Health reports enabling 150,000+ remote care visits and an 80% reduction in hospitalizations for partner facilities, and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Morningside. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public web and product-documentation surface; Curve Health does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI definition.

providers.name: Datacor
providers.description: Datacor is an enterprise software company founded in 1981 and headquartered in Florham Park, New Jersey, that builds industry-specific business management and engineering software for process manufacturers, chemical distributors, and animal-nutrition producers. Its business-automation suite spans ERP, CRM, MES, WMS, formulation management, BLISS LIMS, regulatory and nutrition labeling, and TrackAbout asset tracking, while its engineering line delivers chemical process simulation and flow-modeling tools including CHEMCAD, Fathom, Arrow, Impulse, and xStream. Datacor serves the petrochemical, refinery, energy, feed, and specialty-chemical sectors, and has begun layering AI-driven capabilities across its products. The company is backed by Norwest Venture Partners. Datacor does not currently publish a public developer portal, API reference, or API specifications; this profile captures its verified public identity while the API surface (if any) remains behind its customer support portal.

providers.name: Daybreak
providers.description: Daybreak Health is a B2B mental health company that delivers teletherapy and mental health programs for K-12 students (ages 5-19) in partnership with school districts and health plans. Its services include one-on-one teletherapy, in-person and hybrid onsite programs, universal mental health screeners, and mental health classes, with programs tailored for BIPOC, LGBTQIA+, and low-income student populations. Daybreak is a care-delivery organization sold to schools and payers rather than a developer platform; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer or API surface. This APIs.json profile captures the company's public web properties and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Dedrone
providers.description: Dedrone is a counter-drone (counter-UAS) airspace security company that detects, tracks, identifies, and helps mitigate unauthorized drones and unmanned aerial systems. Its AI-powered sensor platform combines RF detection, radar, cameras, and mitigation technologies to protect airports, critical infrastructure, correctional facilities, stadiums, and government and military sites. Dedrone was acquired by Axon and operates as its counter-drone / airspace-security line. Surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Felicis and Menlo Ventures; no public developer API, portal, or specification was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Deduce
providers.description: Deduce is a New York City-based identity intelligence and fraud-prevention company focused on detecting stolen and synthetic identities, including the rapidly growing class of AI-generated identities used to bypass traditional Know Your Customer and onboarding controls. The company operates the Deduce Identity Graph, an activity-backed U.S. identity network the firm describes as covering 185 million weekly active users and 1.5 billion daily events, used to deliver real-time multi-contextual risk and fraud signals during new account opening, login, and checkout. Deduce sells a real-time API-based fraud-risk scoring product, a Multicontextual Identity Insights service, and a browser-based dashboard for traffic segmentation, anomaly detection, and forensic review, with pre-built integrations into common identity platforms (Auth0, Microsoft Entra External ID / Azure AD B2C, ForgeRock / Ping, Gluu) alongside a native REST API. The company sells to banks, fintechs, lenders, BNPL providers, retail, travel, and payments platforms; its commercial model is enterprise contracts, and its developer documentation, OpenAPI definitions, and integration guides sit behind an authenticated portal, with no public GitHub repositories, no public SDKs, and no published machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Delfi Diagnostics
providers.description: DELFI Diagnostics is a precision oncology company, founded in 2019 and built on research from the Johns Hopkins Kimmel Cancer Center, that combines machine learning with genome-wide analysis of cell-free DNA fragmentation patterns (an approach it calls DNA fragmentomics, or "fragmentomes") to develop accessible, blood-based cancer screening and treatment-monitoring tests. Its first commercial product, FirstLook Lung, is a laboratory-developed liquid biopsy screening test for lung cancer that runs from a simple blood draw and reports a high negative predictive value; the company also offers DELFI-TF for treatment monitoring and partners with health systems and pharmaceutical researchers. DELFI operates a CLIA laboratory and is headquartered in Palo Alto, California. This profile tracks the company in the API Evangelist network; DELFI publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Dia
providers.description: Dia & Co is a plus-size fashion and personal styling subscription service for women, operated by FullBeauty Brands. Customers complete an online style quiz, and stylists curate a monthly box of up to seven clothing items in sizes 10 to 32 from hundreds of brands to try on at home, with free shipping and free returns both ways. Dia & Co also runs an online shop and has been featured in Vogue, Forbes, and Glamour, and was an early portfolio company of Union Square Ventures. It operates as a consumer e-commerce brand and publishes no public developer API; this profile tracks its web and security surface within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Diana Health
providers.description: Diana Health (heydianahealth.com) is a women's healthcare provider offering personalized in-person and virtual care across the reproductive and primary health lifespan: maternity and prenatal care, labor and delivery, postpartum, gynecology, well-woman visits, menopause management, family planning and contraception, mental health, and wellness coaching, plus treatment for conditions such as endometriosis, PCOS, UTIs, and STIs. The company operates collaborative care-team clinics across Tennessee, Florida, and Texas, accepts most major insurance plans including Medicaid, and emphasizes longer appointments and whole-person (mental, physical, social) care. Diana Health is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. It publishes a consumer marketing and appointment-booking website but no public developer API; this profile is enriched with identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Diem
providers.description: Diem is a consumer social search engine, delivered as an iOS and Android app, that surfaces community-driven answers to questions people are often reluctant to ask elsewhere - positioning itself as "a search engine that feels like you're asking questions in a girl's bathroom at 1am." The Diem experience centers on a women-focused community, a Gems rewards program redeemable for products and features, a weekly newsletter, a merch shop, and companion products such as the Twin Flame astrology-compatibility app. Diem is backed by a16z, Ribbit Capital, and Techstars. It is a consumer application with no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: digitaleseiten
providers.description: Digitale Seiten is a German online marketing company that operates a network of 28+ industry-specific business directories for craftspeople and local service providers (for example Elektriker.org, Klempner.org, Maler.org and Dachdecker.org). The platform lets tradespeople create free business listings, distributes regional customer inquiries and job requests to registered companies as leads, improves their search-engine visibility, and provides review-collection tools. According to the company it lists 869,000+ registered businesses and has matched 765,000+ job assignments. It is a B2B directory and lead-generation service and does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or developer portal. Backed by Point Nine.

providers.name: Dimensional
providers.description: Dimensional is a Toronto-based personality-science company whose consumer mobile app assesses more than 200 traits across 15 dimensions — including cognition, values, communication styles, interests, love styles, attachment style, conflict resolution, strengths, and political ideology — to build detailed personality profiles. Users compare results with friends and explore relationship compatibility, positioning the product against social-media highlight reels in favor of authentic connection. The app is available on iOS with an Android beta, and the company is backed by Bloomberg Beta. No public API, SDK, or developer platform is published at this time; this profile captures the company's public web and security surface.

providers.name: Divvy Homes
providers.description: Divvy Homes is a San Francisco-based proptech company operating a rent-to-own home ownership program. A customer chooses a home on the open market, Divvy purchases it, and the customer moves in as a renter while a portion of each monthly payment builds toward a future down payment, giving aspiring buyers who are not yet mortgage-ready a path toward eventual ownership. The consumer web experience integrates third-party services such as Plaid for bank connectivity and Stripe for payments, but Divvy exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation surface of its own. This profile was surfaced from venture-portfolio data (a16z, Threshold Ventures) and enriched from Divvy's public consumer website only.

providers.name: Donut Media
providers.description: Donut Media is an American automotive entertainment brand and one of the largest automotive channels on YouTube, founded in 2015 by Matt Levin, Ben Conrad, and Nick Moceri. It is best known for original series such as Up to Speed, Money Pit, and HiLow, along with the Past Gas podcast, reaching millions of car enthusiasts through video, social, and audio. Donut monetizes through advertising, brand sponsorships, content licensing, and an extensive Shopify-powered online store selling apparel, hats, and collectibles. The company was acquired by Recurrent Ventures in November 2021. This profile documents Donut Media's public web and commerce surface; the company does not publish a developer API program.

providers.name: Dren Bio
providers.description: Dren Bio is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in Foster City, California, focused on the discovery and development of novel antibody therapeutics that selectively deplete pathogenic cells and other disease-causing agents. Its proprietary Targeted Myeloid Engager and Phagocytosis Platform is a multispecific, antibody-based technology designed to induce potent depletion of disease-causing agents by engaging a novel phagocytic receptor selectively expressed on myeloid cells. The pipeline spans two first-in-class clinical-stage programs (including DR-01 and DR-0202) plus multiple preclinical and discovery-stage programs across oncology, autoimmune disease, immunology, and neurology. Dren Bio has established strategic collaborations with Pfizer and Sanofi, the latter of which acquired its DR-0201 (SAR448501) bispecific myeloid cell engager program. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes no public API or developer surface; this profile captures its identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Dsw
providers.description: DSW (Designer Shoe Warehouse) is the footwear and accessories retail banner of Designer Brands Inc. (NYSE: DBI), selling athletic shoes, sneakers, boots, sandals and accessories through roughly 500 US stores, the dsw.com storefront, a mobile app, and the DSW VIP Rewards loyalty program. DSW publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract: dsw.com is a client-side Angular application served by a private first-party backend at api.dsw.com, and supplier-side integration runs over EDI through the Designer Brands vendor portal rather than a partner API.

providers.name: Dualbird
providers.description: Dualbird is a data and AI infrastructure company building accelerated data processing systems that speed up Apache Spark and Amazon EMR workloads by 10x-30x at 50%-90% lower cost, without code changes or migration. Founded by Gilad Tal (CEO), Ohad Gamliel (Chief Engineer), and Ehud Eliaz (Chief Hardware Architect) - a team with deep ASIC, FPGA, and high-performance computing expertise - Dualbird optimizes enterprise data pipelines at the hardware and software level to remove processing bottlenecks and let organizations maximize data utilization beyond current GPU capabilities. The company raised a $25M round backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Uncork Capital. As of this enrichment pass Dualbird publishes a marketing and company site only - no public API, developer documentation, SDKs, or GitHub organization were found.

providers.name: eGenesis
providers.description: eGenesis is a biotechnology company working at the intersection of genome engineering and transplantation to make organ transplants accessible to all. Using a multiplex CRISPR gene-editing and genome-engineering platform, eGenesis engineers porcine (pig) donor organs that are immunologically and molecularly compatible with human recipients and free of porcine endogenous retroviruses, aiming to end waitlist mortality by removing donor-organ scarcity as a barrier to transplantation. Its pipeline spans kidney, liver, and heart xenotransplantation programs; the U.S. FDA has cleared its IND for EGEN-2784, a genetically engineered porcine kidney, to begin a Phase 1/2/3 trial in patients with end-stage kidney disease. eGenesis is a private, venture-backed company (investors include Lux Capital). This API Evangelist profile tracks the company for network discovery; eGenesis publishes a corporate and scientific web presence but does not currently expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Elevarm
providers.description: Elevarm is an upstream-focused agritech company founded in 2022 and headquartered in Bandung, Indonesia, that elevates smallholder horticulture farmers across West Java, Central Java, and Yogyakarta. It aggregates and supports more than 15,000 farmers with high-quality inputs (premium greenhouse seedlings, bio-based fertilizers, and environmentally friendly pest control via its NextBio line), lab-based soil testing through Klinik Tani, an AI-powered farming productivity app for land monitoring and data-driven agronomy recommendations, pro-farmer financing, and the PasarAgri commodity trading platform that links supply to business buyers. Elevarm is backed by Intudo, Insignia Ventures Partners, and 500 Global.

providers.name: Elo Life
providers.description: Elo Life Systems is a next-generation food and agriculture company based in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, using molecular farming and gene-editing to turn high-yield crops into biofactories for natural food ingredients. Its lead product is a low-calorie, high-potency natural sweetener inspired by monk fruit that is designed to taste like sugar while replacing both sugar and artificial sweeteners at a lower cost. Elo also partners with Dole to develop a fungus-resistant (TR4/Fusarium wilt) Cavendish banana. Backed by DCVC Bio and Novo Holdings, the company raised an oversubscribed $20.5M Series A2 to scale its molecular-farming platform. Elo Life is a food-tech / agricultural-biotech company and does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Endeavor Catalyst I
providers.description: Endeavor Catalyst is the rules-based, co-investment fund of Endeavor Global, the nonprofit that supports high-impact entrepreneurs worldwide. The fund invests exclusively in companies led by Endeavor Entrepreneurs across Series A through D+ rounds, recycling proceeds back into Endeavor's mission of building entrepreneurial ecosystems in emerging and underserved markets. Endeavor Catalyst I is the first vintage in this fund family; across all vintages the program manages $540M+ in assets with 405+ active investments spanning 35+ markets, including 71 companies valued at $1B+ and 37 realized exits. This profile tracks the firm as a venture-capital entity in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public API.

providers.name: Enough
providers.description: ENOUGH (brand name ABUNDA) is a food-technology company that produces mycoprotein through a zero-waste fermentation process, growing fungi on grain-derived sugars. Operating as a B2B ingredient supplier to retailers and food brands, ENOUGH makes nutrient-dense, sustainable meat and seafood alternatives — including burgers, chicken-style products, noodles, and snacks — that use dramatically less water and produce far less CO2 than conventional animal protein. The company operates one of the world's largest mycoprotein fermentation facilities and is backed by DCVC. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; ENOUGH is a food-ingredient business and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Entyre Care
providers.description: Entyre Care is a US home health care provider that helps people who care for a friend or family member at home get paid for the care they already provide. Through state Medicaid structured / self-directed family caregiving programs, Entyre Care guides caregivers through eligibility and enrollment, handles the paperwork, and delivers financial compensation alongside professional caregiving guidance and emotional support. The company operates in Maine, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Hampshire, Ohio, Virginia, and Wisconsin, offering tools such as a compensation calculator, a step-by-step guide to getting paid, and localized care teams. Entyre Care is a consumer-facing healthcare services business and does not currently publish a public developer program or API; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of HV Capital and enriched with the company's real identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Epic CleanTec
providers.description: Epic Cleantec is a San Francisco based water technology company that designs, builds and operates onsite water reuse systems for buildings. Its OneWater and OneWater Rain systems collect, treat and recycle a building's greywater, blackwater, rainwater and condensate onsite — recovering up to 95% of wastewater for non-potable uses such as toilet flushing, irrigation, cooling towers and laundry — alongside wastewater heat recovery and a soil amendment product line. The technology grew out of work on the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation Reinvent the Toilet Challenge and is deployed in multifamily, commercial office, hospitality, stadium, data center, higher education and community-scale developments across North America. Systems ship with PLC/SCADA control and a cloud-connected Eco-Insights reporting dashboard for remote monitoring, alarms and utility savings reporting, but Epic Cleantec publishes no public developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract; the data surface is delivered to building owners and operators as a hosted dashboard rather than as a public API.

providers.name: Escient Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Escient Pharmaceuticals is a San Diego, California clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing first-in-class, oral small-molecule therapeutics targeting Mas-related G protein-coupled receptors (MRGPRs) along the neurosensory-inflammatory axis. Its lead programs are EP262, an MRGPRX2 antagonist for mast-cell-mediated diseases such as chronic spontaneous and inducible urticaria and atopic dermatitis, and EP547, an MRGPRX4 antagonist for cholestatic and uremic pruritus. The company was backed by New Enterprise Associates (NEA) and was acquired by Incyte Corporation on May 30, 2024. Escient operates a corporate marketing website only and publishes no public API, developer program, or machine-readable API specification; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Everdrop
providers.description: Everdrop is a Munich-based direct-to-consumer sustainability brand, founded in 2019, that sells more sustainable everyday household products — cleaning tabs, laundry detergent, dishwasher tablets, washing-up liquid and natural body care — designed around a refill model of concentrated tabs/powders dissolved in reusable bottles to cut single-use plastic, unnecessary chemicals and CO2. The company operates an e-commerce storefront (Shopify/Next.js/Storyblok stack) with a subscription-based refill program, and reports certifications including B Corp, EU Ecolabel and Ecocert. It has no public developer or API program; this profile was surfaced as an HV Capital portfolio company and enriched from Everdrop's public web surface.

providers.name: EVERY Company
providers.description: The EVERY Company (formerly Clara Foods; site now at every.com, redirected from theeverycompany.com) is a foodtech ingredients company that produces animal-free, antibiotic-free egg proteins using precision fermentation. Its flagship OvoPro product replicates the functional properties of conventional eggs — binding, gelling, foaming, and whipping — for food manufacturers making baked goods, frozen foods, pasta, and protein bars, offering kosher, halal, and sustainable ingredients with more consistent pricing and availability than animal-derived eggs. Backed by Prosus Ventures. As a B2B ingredient supplier it publishes no public API or developer surface; this profile captures its identity and domain security posture in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Evigence Sensors
providers.description: Evigence Sensors is a freshness-management technology company for the food industry, combining low-cost physical sensors with data analytics to monitor food quality in real time from production to consumption at the individual item level. Its time-temperature indicator technology powers both digital (QR-scan) and visual freshness indicators applied to retail units, serving food brands, retailers, foodservice operators, cold-chain logistics providers, and consumers across the supply chain. Evigence holds 27 granted patents and its indicators meet WHO time/temperature monitoring standards. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Evigence publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDK, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures its verified public company properties only.

providers.name: Fabric
providers.description: Fabric is a healthcare care-enablement platform (formerly Zipnosis, rebranded to Fabric in 2024) that streamlines access to virtual and in-person care. Its AI-powered system automates patient intake, symptom gathering, triage, and routing while integrating with existing EMR systems, serving health systems, hospitals, health plans, employers, and brokers. The platform spans synchronous and asynchronous virtual care delivery, an AI navigation and symptom-checking assistant, an intelligent provider directory and scheduling layer, a 50-state virtual clinical network (Evo), and patient engagement and care-management pathways. Fabric was assembled through the acquisitions of Zipnosis, GYANT, MeMD, TeamHealth Virtual Care, and UCM Digital Health. As of this profile Fabric does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal; integration is EMR-based and arranged via sales.

providers.name: Fairlyne
providers.description: Fairlyne is a French travel-technology company offering a white-label Resale-as-a-Service platform that lets travel brands turn no-shows and low-yield bookings into new revenue by allowing passengers and guests to resell non-refundable tickets and reservations. Founded in 2021 by former Accor executives Gilles de Richemond and Michael d'Eboli, the platform serves airlines, railway and road-transport operators, and hospitality chains, and powers programs such as SNCF Ouigo's resale experience. Fairlyne raised a 3M EUR seed round from Speedinvest, Kima Ventures, Evolem, and FJ Labs. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Fairlyne. No public developer API or documentation portal has been identified at this time.

providers.name: Fay
providers.description: Fay (Fay Health, Inc.) is a digital-health marketplace that connects members with registered dietitians and nutritionists and handles the insurance billing so nutrition counseling is covered — often at little or no out-of-pocket cost. The platform offers telehealth consultations, personalized meal planning, and support for chronic condition management, backed by iOS and Android apps and a member help center. Fay reports 4,000+ registered dietitians, 700+ accepted insurance plans, and 100,000+ members. It is backed by Forerunner Ventures and General Catalyst and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead company profile; Fay publishes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: FiberSense
providers.description: FiberSense is a distributed fiber optic sensing (DFOS / distributed acoustic sensing) company that turns existing and purpose-built fiber optic cables into dense arrays of vibration and acoustic sensors for real-time detection, localization and classification of objects and events across critical infrastructure. Its AI/ML algorithms filter noise and false alarms in dense urban, marine and underground environments, delivered as a subscription-based sensing platform rather than a public developer API. Product lines include DigitalAsset (critical infrastructure asset protection), DigitalCity (urban infrastructure and utility monitoring), DigitalMarine (subsea and marine cable route monitoring) and DigitalLeak (pipeline leak detection). Backed by Prosus Ventures; customer support runs through an Atlassian service desk portal.

providers.name: Fitetv
providers.description: FITE (fite.tv) is a live sports and entertainment streaming platform that now operates as TrillerTV, run by Flipps Media Inc., a Triller Group Inc company. The service specializes in combat sports and alternative entertainment, streaming boxing, bare-knuckle fighting (BKFC), MMA, kickboxing, professional wrestling, cricket (via the Willow by Cricbuzz channel), soccer, cycling, and motorsports. It advertises thousands of hours of free video, more than a thousand live events per year, and a multi-million-strong fan community, with content delivered through free tiers, the TrillerTV+ subscription, and pay-per-view events across web, mobile, and connected-TV apps. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public web surface; no public developer API or documentation program has been located.

providers.name: Flashfood
providers.description: Flashfood is a Toronto-based mobile marketplace that connects shoppers with heavily discounted groceries nearing their best-by date at partner grocery stores across the United States and Canada. Through its iOS and Android apps, shoppers browse deals of up to 50% off on fresh produce, meat, dairy, and packaged goods, pay in-app, and pick the items up at a dedicated Flashfood Zone in-store. By routing surplus food away from landfills and onto dinner tables, the company reduces grocery-retail food waste while helping families save on their grocery bills. Flashfood is a consumer-facing app and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web, legal, and security surface.

providers.name: Flow48
providers.description: Flow48 is an SME financing platform founded in March 2022 and backed by Speedinvest that provides non-dilutive, collateral-free capital to small and medium businesses across the GCC and wider MENA region, with a focus on the e-commerce and food & beverage sectors. Its two core products are revenue-based financing, which converts a business's future revenues into upfront capital repaid as a share of sales, and invoice financing, which accelerates cash locked in unpaid invoices. Flow48 markets funding decisions and disbursement within 24 to 48 hours with flexible repayment and no equity surrender. The company operates a self-service borrower onboarding portal but does not currently publish a public developer program, API reference, or SDKs.

providers.name: Focused Space
providers.description: Focused Space, Inc. operates focused.space, a consumer productivity platform built around "body doubling" — a neuroscience-backed technique where people work silently alongside others to more easily enter and sustain a flow state. The service combines 100+ weekly live sessions hosted by real humans (available 24/7) with a custom focus-video platform, a goal-setting and task-tracking app, and a community aimed at creatives, builders, remote workers, and people with ADHD. Focused Space is a 500 Global (and E14 Fund) portfolio company. It ships web, iOS, and Android apps but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures its public web and security posture.

providers.name: Folx Health
providers.description: FOLX Health is a virtual healthcare platform built for and by the LGBTQIA+ community, delivering clinician-led care through a predominantly queer and trans network of providers. Its consumer services span gender-affirming hormone therapy (HRT), PrEP and sexual & reproductive health, primary care, mental health and therapy, and fertility and family building, plus care navigation, a peer community platform, and secure provider messaging. Members access care through the web and iOS/Android apps with same or next-day appointments and insurance acceptance. FOLX is a direct-to-consumer digital health company and, as of this profile, does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification. This entry was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and enriched from its public web presence.

providers.name: Forterra
providers.description: Forterra is a defense autonomy company headquartered in Clarksburg, Maryland, that builds combat-proven autonomous mission systems for ground operations in contested, GPS-denied, off-road environments. Founded in 2002 as Robotic Research and rebranded as Forterra, it retrofits existing military and commercial vehicles with self-driving capability through its AutoDrive autonomous driving system, the TerraLink modular vehicle-management and command-and-control platform, and the OASIS open architecture that lets the government and third-party developers add sensors, effectors, and payloads without vendor lock-in. Additional offerings span resilient communications, sensing, and ruggedized edge-compute hardware. The company is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund 2 and Enlightenment Capital and supplies autonomy to multiple active U.S. Department of Defense programs. Forterra does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or self-service developer portal; its systems are delivered as government and defense-integration programs.

providers.name: Forward Earth
providers.description: Forward Earth is a Berlin-based climate technology company building AI-automated carbon management software that helps businesses measure, track, and reduce their carbon footprint in line with environmental regulation. Its platform covers Corporate Carbon Footprint (CCF) accounting certified to the GHG Protocol, Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) calculation, and Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) compliance reporting, with an emphasis on automating data collection and emissions calculation to save time and cost. Forward Earth also offers a white-label / partner offering that embeds its carbon management capabilities into GRC, ESG, supply-chain, and consultancy software, exposing environmental and partner-specific APIs plus single sign-on through a sandbox that partners access on request. The company is backed by Speedinvest and is moving toward agent-native product carbon footprinting.

providers.name: Four Pillars
providers.description: Four Pillars is a research-driven blockchain enterprise headquartered in Asia, operating through three divisions: FP Research publishes primary analysis of crypto protocols, markets, and policy with deep regional expertise across Korea and the broader Asian market; FP Validated runs validator and node infrastructure across proof-of-stake networks, pairing research with live operations; and FP Institution advises banks, financial institutions, and corporates on blockchain strategy. The firm serves founders, funds, and regulators, and is a portfolio company of Pantera Capital. It is a research and advisory business rather than a developer-facing API platform, and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Freight Farms
providers.description: Freight Farms is a Boston-based vertical farming company that builds the Greenery container farm, a commercial-scale, modular, hydroponic farm assembled inside a shipping container so growers can produce hyper-local produce 365 days a year in any climate. Its Farmhand software platform provides remote farm control, farm data analytics and insights, crop planning, and pre-set growing recipes, backed by certified training, onboarding, logistics, and technical support. The company reports 800+ farms across 50 U.S. states and 3 territories and 2,100+ farmers in 42 countries. Freight Farms currently publishes no public developer API, portal, or OpenAPI surface; this API Evangelist profile captures its public web, brand, and legal properties plus a domain-security probe while a programmatic surface is monitored for.

providers.name: Frontage Laboratories
providers.description: Frontage Laboratories is a global contract research organization (CRO) providing integrated, science-driven drug discovery and development services across the pharmaceutical and biotechnology lifecycle. Its services span drug discovery (chemistry, biology, ADME/toxicology screening, pharmacology), drug development (DMPK, preclinical safety and toxicology, clinical trial support), laboratory testing (bioanalysis, genomics, central lab, biomarkers), CMC (product development, formulation, analytical services, manufacturing), and agrochemical support. Frontage operates roughly 28 sites across North America, Asia-Pacific, and Europe with about 2,200 employees. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Frontage publishes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or programmatic integration surface, so this profile captures company identity and web properties only.

providers.name: Fuchsia
providers.description: Fuchsia is an AI-native hardware certification and compliance platform ("Vanta for hardware") that helps hardware teams get products to market faster by streamlining regulatory testing and certification. The platform maps the applicable standards for a product (FCC, CE, UL, FDA 510(k), ISO, RF & EMC, environmental, and functional-safety categories), auto-generates the lab-ready technical documentation and test plans required for certification, connects teams with qualified testing labs specialized in their product category, and tracks compliance progress to surface blockers early. Fuchsia uses AI agents to manage the compliance workflow end to end — from design through testing and certification — including direct communication with testing labs, aiming to democratize regulatory compliance that has traditionally favored larger companies with dedicated compliance teams. Founded in 2025 and part of the Y Combinator Spring 2026 batch, Fuchsia is based in the San Francisco Bay Area and targets robotics, medical-device, IoT, and consumer-hardware builders. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company; as of this enrichment pass Fuchsia publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Future
providers.description: Future (Future Research, Inc., future.co) is a consumer fitness technology company that delivers custom, one-on-one personal training through a mobile app. Members are paired with a dedicated certified coach who builds an individualized workout program, provides real-time messaging and accountability check-ins, and adapts the plan over time. The product includes an exercise library with form-guidance videos, flexible scheduling, and Apple Watch integration for workout tracking. Future is a direct-to-consumer subscription service (first month $50, then $199/month with a 30-day money-back guarantee) and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a Kleiner Perkins portfolio company.

providers.name: GEANT
providers.description: GEANT is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: tag-qc) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Geek+
providers.description: Geek+ (Geekplus, HKEX: 2590) is a global leader in AI-driven autonomous mobile robot (AMR) solutions for warehouse and logistics automation. Founded in 2015, it delivers end-to-end smart-warehouse systems spanning shelf-to-person (PopPick), tote-to-person (RoboShuttle), pallet-to-person (Skycube) storage and retrieval, robot-arm picking, sorting, and intralogistics transport. Its All-in-One Software Suite (Robot Management System, Warehouse Execution System, Intelligent Warehouse Management System, data and simulation platforms) exposes open REST APIs and SDKs so customers and partners can integrate robot fleets with major WMS, ERP, and MES platforms including SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Manhattan Associates, and Blue Yonder. Geek+ serves 3PL, retail, e-commerce, apparel, grocery, healthcare and pharma, manufacturing, automotive, electronics, and cold-chain logistics across 40+ countries, with 950+ deployed warehouses. In 2025 it became the world's first publicly listed AMR warehouse robotics company on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

providers.name: Glimpse
providers.description: Glimpse (legally Dime Campus, Inc.) is an AI-native retail finance platform that automates deductions management, revenue recovery, and cash application for consumer brands and CPG companies. Its AI agents are trained on billions of dollars in retail transactions to track, validate, and dispute invalid deductions, recover trapped cashflow, and match payments faster across retailer accounts. Glimpse reports a 91% dispute win rate, $200M+ in transactions processed, and 100+ hours saved monthly per finance team, and works alongside major retailers including Walmart, Target, Kroger, Walgreens, and Amazon. The San Francisco company serves 200+ consumer brands, raised a $35M Series A, and is backed by 8vc. It is currently an enterprise, contact- sales SaaS with no public self-service API or developer portal.

providers.name: Glydways
providers.description: Glydways is an autonomous urban-transit company building on-demand, high-capacity mobility networks that combine small self-driving electric vehicles (Glydcars), an AI fleet-orchestration layer, and dedicated narrow guideways separated from regular road traffic. The system is designed to move up to 10,000 people per hour while cutting construction cost by roughly 90% and operating cost to about 30% of conventional transit, with launch projects underway in Atlanta, Contra Costa County, California, and at San Jose Airport. Backed by Khosla Ventures, Glydways was surfaced through the venture portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network. As an autonomous-transit infrastructure company it publishes a corporate and news presence but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: GoOpti
providers.description: GoOpti is a European ground-transportation marketplace for affordable airport transfers and intercity rides, connecting travelers with a network of vetted, contractual transport partners. Founded in Slovenia, GoOpti offers both shared (door-to-door pooled) and private transfers across Central and Southern Europe, using dynamic pricing where earlier, more flexible bookings earn lower fares. The company operates as a platform intermediary rather than a fleet owner, and has served more than two million passengers. Alongside its consumer booking site it runs B2B partner programs for agencies and resellers, corporate business accounts, franchising, and affiliates. GoOpti is a portfolio company of Point Nine and is tracked in the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, SDK, or agent-facing surface has been identified at this time.

providers.name: Gourmey
providers.description: Gourmey is a Paris-based cultivated meat company producing sustainable, cell-cultured meat delights — starting with cultivated foie gras — for an uncompromising and conscious generation. Founded in France and backed by Partech and Point Nine, Gourmey grows real meat directly from animal cells without raising or slaughtering animals, aiming for a lower environmental footprint across the food and agritech sectors. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio company profile; Gourmey operates a consumer and corporate website but does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Greentoe
providers.description: Greentoe is a name-your-price e-commerce marketplace where shoppers make an offer on brand-new electronics, cameras, TVs and home theater, appliances, baby gear, watches, and optics, and manufacturer-authorized retailers compete to fulfill the order at the buyer's price. Built to bring the negotiation model of big-ticket purchases online, Greentoe reports more than $100M saved by its customers, backs every order with manufacturer warranties and a 30-day return policy, and is backed by 500 Global and Y Combinator. Greentoe operates as a consumer-facing web application and does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Guazi
providers.description: Guazi is a China-based used-car export, auction, and trading platform founded in 2015 and headquartered in Beijing. It connects international dealers and buyers with used vehicles sourced across China, offering sealed-bid online auctions, Buy It Now direct sales, a 200-plus-point vehicle inspection process, direct sourcing on request, and global logistics shipping to more than 50 countries via container and Ro-Ro. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, HongShan (Sequoia China), and Tencent, Guazi handles over 200,000 vehicles annually. This API Evangelist profile currently tracks the company's public web presence; no public developer program, API, or SDK has been found.

providers.name: Gym Class VR
providers.description: Gym Class VR (operating as "Gym Class" by IRL Studios) is a social virtual reality sports gaming platform for Meta Quest headsets and mobile devices, offering multiplayer basketball, baseball, football, boxing, paintball, and soccer experiences where players compete, socialize, and create and share their own games. The top-rated sports title on the Meta Quest Store with a 4.8-star average across 53,000+ ratings, the company holds licensing agreements with the NBA and Major League Baseball, expanded to mobile in 2026, and has raised over $8M from Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Y Combinator, and NBA players. It is a consumer VR entertainment product with no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Haber
providers.description: Haber (Elixa Technologies Private Limited), headquartered in Pune, India with a US presence in Chicago, is an industrial AI company delivering AI-led automation for smart manufacturing across heavy industries including pulp, paper, packaging and tissue, metals and mining, food and beverages, oil and gas, and water/utility institutions. Its product suite spans eLIXA, an IIoT-powered process intelligence platform; Mt. Fuji for historical data storage, visualizations, digital twins and predictive interventions; Kaiznn, an optimization engine for trim-loss reduction, inventory and production scheduling; plus Kensei and FiMorph. The platform emphasizes real-time monitoring, predictive analytics, and enterprise-grade security (SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001:2022). Surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Habi
providers.description: Habi is a Colombian real estate technology company (proptech) that operates as a direct home buyer and seller — an iBuyer model where Habi itself purchases apartments in cash, typically within 10 days, rather than acting as a traditional agency. It operates across Bogota, Medellin, Cali, Barranquilla and 20+ Colombian cities and is expanding into Mexico. Products include Habimetro (an online property valuation simulator), property listings and search, Habi Credit (mortgage financing), Habi Inmobiliaria (assisted longer-term sales), and an allied-agent partner network. The company reports 40,000+ families served, 4,000+ allied real estate agents, and 550+ real estate experts. Backed by Homebrew. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network and enriched from Habi's public surface; the company publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Halo Health
providers.description: Halo Mental Health (Halo Health) operates same-day mental health urgent care clinics, offering immediate psychiatric assessments, medication management, crisis intervention, individual and group therapy, and teletherapy for adults and children ages eight and older. Founded by Paul Manley with medical director Dr. Vahid Osman, the Joint Commission-accredited provider runs clinics in Central Las Vegas and Summerlin, accepts commercial insurance and Medicaid, and is building the largest network of urgent cares dedicated to same-day mental health services. Backed by 8vc. Halo Health publishes no public API or developer platform; this profile captures its identity, web presence, and domain security posture.

providers.name: Hello Pediatrics
providers.description: Hello Pediatrics is a virtual pediatric medical practice that partners with primary care pediatric offices to cover their patients after hours. Board-certified pediatricians deliver telehealth visits — triage, video appointments and real-time messaging — on nights, weekends and holidays, and send a visit summary back to the child's regular pediatrician so the medical home keeps the record. The practice works with 30+ partner pediatric practices, participates with major insurers (Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, Aetna, Anthem, CareFirst), and prices partner coverage at $16 per call with a monthly minimum. It is a clinical service organization, not a software vendor: patient scheduling and video are delivered on a white-labeled third-party telehealth platform (Mend) at book.hellopediatrics.com, and Hello Pediatrics publishes no developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: HelperGo
providers.description: HelperGo is a Hong Kong-based on-demand home services marketplace that connects households with more than 5,000 vetted local helpers for domestic cleaning, air-conditioning and window cleaning, cooking, childcare and babysitting, postnatal doula and confinement care, elderly and nursing care, and medical escort services. Customers book through the HelperGo iOS and Android apps or the website, with instant helper matching, ratings and reviews, and a satisfaction guarantee. HelperGo is a portfolio company of 500 Global and operates across Hong Kong and Singapore. The company is a consumer-facing service marketplace and publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Heltia
providers.description: Heltia is a Turkish digital mental-health and employee-wellbeing platform (an Employee Assistance Platform, EAP) that connects individuals and corporate employees with licensed psychologists and dietitians for online therapy, counseling and nutrition support. Its consumer app offers video sessions with experts, self-assessment tests (anxiety, depression, OCD, motivation) and an expert-reviewed blog, while its corporate products — Esenlik (wellbeing), Sağlık Yönetimi (health management) and brokerage — give employers measurable workforce mental-health programs. Backed by Northzone. Heltia does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK or documentation surface.

providers.name: Hemab Therapeutics
providers.description: Hemab Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with a US presence in Cambridge, Massachusetts, developing prophylactic antibody-based therapeutics for serious, underserved bleeding and thrombotic disorders. Its modality-agnostic approach uses monoclonal and bispecific antibodies to stabilize coagulation proteins, prevent their premature breakdown, and direct them to sites of injury. The clinical pipeline targets Glanzmann Thrombasthenia (sutacimig, HMB-001), von Willebrand Disease (HMB-002), Factor VII deficiency and heavy menstrual bleeding. Hemab publishes a corporate marketing site, an investor relations site, and audience-specific sections for patients, caregivers and healthcare providers. It operates no public developer program: there is no developer portal, API reference, machine-readable specification, SDK, or webhook surface on any host it controls.

providers.name: Hertz
providers.description: The Hertz Corporation is a global vehicle rental company operating the Hertz, Dollar and Thrifty brands from airport and neighbourhood locations in roughly 160 countries, renting cars, vans and trucks to leisure, corporate, government and rideshare customers and running the Hertz Gold Plus Rewards loyalty programme. Hertz publishes no public developer programme: probing on 2026-09-13 found no developer portal, no OpenAPI or other machine-readable contract, no SDKs, no first-party MCP server and no /.well-known/ discovery documents on any Hertz host. Third-party integrators reach Hertz rates and availability through the global distribution systems — Amadeus, Sabre and Travelport — which Hertz's own Travel Agent GDS Tools page directs them to, rather than through a first-party API.

providers.name: HomeFirst
providers.description: HomeFirst (Home First Finance Company India Limited) is an affordable-housing finance company headquartered in Mumbai, India, that provides home loans, self-construction and resale loans, loans against property, shop loans, and renovation/top-up loans to first-time and lower- to middle-income home buyers across India, marketing itself as "India's Home Loan Expert" with approval within 48 hours. It is a technology-led lender operating consumer-facing customer and connector portals and mobile apps, and is a publicly listed company backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. It was surfaced as a Bessemer portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts at this time, so this profile captures its public web/identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Hometree
providers.description: Hometree is a UK home services and residential energy company offering homeowners and landlords subscription-based boiler and home emergency cover with unlimited repairs and annual maintenance from around £12.95 per month. Its nationwide network of Gas Safe registered engineers handles breakdowns across heating, plumbing, electrics, drainage and gas fires, and the company also arranges boiler installations and green home upgrades such as heat pumps and solar panels. Operating as an insurance distributor and installer across mainland England, Scotland and Wales, Hometree is backed by Anthemis, DN Capital, Barclays, BlackRock, 2150 and Puma Growth Partners.

providers.name: Honeylove
providers.description: Honeylove Sculptwear Inc. is a Los Angeles-based, venture-backed direct-to-consumer apparel brand founded in 2018 that designs and sells shapewear, bras, bodysuits, leggings, and intimates engineered with targeted "smart compression" panels that support the body without over-squeezing. Sold primarily through its Shopify-powered online store at honeylove.com, the company has grown to millions of customers, was named to the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing private companies, and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Y Combinator. Honeylove operates as a consumer e-commerce retailer and does not currently publish a public developer API program; this profile captures its public web, policy, and support surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Hooked
providers.description: Hooked is a mobile entertainment company founded in 2015 by Prerna Gupta and Parag Chordia (Telepathic, Inc.) that pioneered the chat-fiction format: bite-sized, suspenseful stories read as simulated text-message conversations. Its flagship Hooked app reached #1 on the App Store and Google Play in more than 25 countries and over 100 million viewers, and the company later launched Hooked TV, a short-form mobile video streaming service. Hooked uses data and AI to predict and produce hit short-form content distributed across its own apps and social platforms including TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat, and YouTube. It is backed by 500 Global, Cowboy Ventures, Sound Ventures, The Chernin Group, Founders Fund, and Greylock. Hooked does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDK.

providers.name: HouseEazy
providers.description: HouseEazy is an Indian proptech startup, founded in 2021 by Tarun Sainani and Deepak Bhatia, that runs a full-stack platform for buying and selling ready-to-move, pre-owned residential homes across the Delhi NCR region (Noida, Ghaziabad, and Gurugram). It uses an AI/ML-based pricing algorithm built on over two million on-ground data points — registry records, market trends, and recent transactions — to price properties instantly, then pairs that with 3D walkthroughs, drone imagery, and virtual staging to make resale transactions fast, transparent, and secure. HouseEazy also offers LoanEazy home financing and a channel-partner program, and is backed by Accel, Antler, and DTU-IIF. It is a consumer-facing web application and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal.

providers.name: Hutch Games
providers.description: Hutch Games (Hutch) is a mobile game development studio founded in London with additional studios in Dundee, Scotland and Nova Scotia, Canada. Hutch specializes in free-to-play mobile driving and car games, developing and publishing titles including F1 Clash, Top Drives, and Matchcreek Motors. The studio was surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer mobile game publisher, Hutch does not currently expose a public developer API or developer program; this profile captures the company identity, public web properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Ideaya Biosciences
providers.description: IDEAYA Biosciences is a clinical-stage precision medicine oncology company headquartered in South San Francisco, California (NASDAQ IDYA), focused on discovering, developing, and commercializing targeted therapeutics for genetically defined cancer patient populations. Its research spans PKC inhibition in uveal melanoma, antibody-drug conjugate and DNA-damage-response combinations, synthetic-lethal MTAP-pathway programs, and KAT6/7 epigenetic inhibition, led by the investigational candidate darovasertib in registrational uveal melanoma trials. The company maintains a corporate and investor-relations web presence and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: ilik
providers.description: Ilik (ilikhealth.com) is a direct-to-consumer telehealth company offering personalised prescription skincare designed and approved by dermatologists. Customers complete an online dermatology consultation, receive a custom AM/PM routine built from medical-grade, clinically proven ingredients, and have their prescription medication shipped free to their door — consulting with a dermatologist on their own time without the wait of an in-clinic appointment. The service is organised around skin concerns such as acne, anti-ageing, hyperpigmentation, and rosacea. Ilik is a consumer health / e-commerce brand and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment and monitoring.

providers.name: iMile
providers.description: iMile is a technology-driven last-mile delivery and e-commerce logistics company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Led by founder and CEO Rita Huang, iMile provides express parcel delivery, cash-on-delivery (COD), domestic and international express, dropshipping, order fulfillment, warehousing, storage, and reverse logistics / return management across more than 30 countries spanning the Middle East, China, Latin America, Africa, Europe, and Australia. The company operates its own routing, tracking, and delivery technology and employs over 20,000 people. iMile assigns each shipment a 13-digit tracking number; parcel tracking is available on imile.com and through major third-party tracking aggregators. iMile does not currently publish a first-party public developer API or open platform, so this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Immersive Gamebox
providers.description: Immersive Gamebox is a London-founded (2018) location-based entertainment company operating indoor gaming venues across the UK, US, Germany, and the UAE. Each Gamebox combines projection mapping, touch screens, motion tracking, and surround sound to deliver fully immersive, interactive games for teams of two to six players in 30-60 minute sessions. Its catalog spans licensed titles built with partners such as Netflix (Squid Game), Aardman (Shaun the Sheep), Rovio (Angry Birds), and Tetris, alongside originals, and the business runs on bookings, party and corporate packages, Game Pass subscriptions, and a multi-unit franchise model. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of index-ventures. It exposes no public web/REST API today; developer collaboration is limited to a Unity-based SDK offered to game studios building titles for the Gamebox hardware platform.

providers.name: Impelpharma
providers.description: Impel Pharmaceuticals is a commercial-stage pharmaceutical company developing first-in-class intranasal drug treatments for central nervous system (CNS) disorders with high unmet medical needs. Its proprietary Precision Olfactory Delivery (POD) technology targets the vascular-rich upper nasal cavity to achieve more rapid and consistent bioavailability than conventional delivery. Its lead product, Trudhesa (dihydroergotamine mesylate) nasal spray, is approved for the acute treatment of migraine with or without aura in adults. Impel was backed by Norwest Venture Partners (co-led its 2018 Series D) and later filed for bankruptcy in December 2023. This is a patient- and science-facing pharma company with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Imperative Care
providers.description: Imperative Care is a U.S. medical technology company founded in 2015 by Fred Khosravi, neurosurgeon L. Nelson Hopkins, M.D., and Amar Sawhney, Ph.D., that develops connected interventional devices to elevate care for people affected by devastating vascular diseases such as ischemic stroke, venous thromboembolism, and acute limb ischemia. Its portfolio spans the Zoom Stroke System (including Zoom intracranial access and aspiration catheters and Continuous Dual Aspiration / CDAT technology) for fast, effective clot removal, the Symphony Thrombectomy System for venous thromboembolism, and the Prodigy Thrombectomy System for acute limb ischemia, with the Telos robotic-assisted platform in development in partnership with Proximie. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of D1 Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Imperative Care publishes no public developer API, SDK, or technical developer portal; this profile captures its public web, security, and corporate surface.

providers.name: Improovy
providers.description: Improovy is a Chicago-based prop-tech startup and digitally-native managed marketplace that connects homeowners with vetted, professional painters and controls the end-to-end residential and commercial painting experience. Founded in 2019 by CEO Andre Kazimierski, a third-generation tradesman, the platform offers instant online quotes and covers interior and exterior house painting, cabinet painting, drywall and plaster repair, staining, power washing, and specialty finishes across markets in Illinois, Michigan, Colorado, Florida, and Wisconsin. Improovy is a consumer service brand with no public developer program or API; this profile captures its web presence and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Insitu
