providers.description: Insitu Inc. is a wholly owned subsidiary of The Boeing Company that designs, builds, and operates uncrewed aerial systems (UAS) and related intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance technologies for defense and government customers. Its product line includes the Integrator, ScanEagle, and RQ-21A air vehicles alongside imaging payloads, ground control stations, and mission software such as TacitView, the Media Management Suite, and the Tungsten SDK. Insitu delivers end-to-end capabilities for collecting, processing, and distributing information, with more than 1.6 million operational flight hours across 30-plus international customers. Insitu operates as a defense contractor and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Intuition Robotics
providers.description: Intuition Robotics is a Tel Aviv-based AI company (with offices in the United States, Japan, and Greece) building social companion technology for older adults. Its flagship product, ElliQ, is an AI care companion robot that proactively engages users through natural conversation, body language, lights, and sound, powered by a proprietary "Relationship Orchestrator" cognitive-AI platform and multiple large language models to support health, wellness, cognitive engagement, and reducing loneliness. Intuition Robotics publishes no first-party developer API, SDK, or developer portal; the ElliQ product store (elliq.com, on Shopify) does expose an agent-commerce surface via the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP), including a published llms.txt and a UCP shopping MCP endpoint for agent-driven catalog search and checkout. Backed by Bloomberg Beta among other investors.

providers.name: Iodine Software (Waystar)
providers.description: Iodine Software is a healthcare AI company whose AwareCDI suite applies clinical machine learning to the mid-revenue cycle, surfacing clinical documentation integrity (CDI) gaps, prioritizing high-impact cases, and automating physician queries so hospitals and health systems capture the complete patient story for more accurate coding, quality metrics, and revenue capture. Its Concurrent, Retrospective, and Interact modules integrate directly into existing EHR and coding workflows rather than exposing a public developer API. Founded in Austin, Texas, Iodine was acquired by revenue-cycle technology company Waystar in October 2025, and its products, blog, newsroom, and legal pages now live under waystar.com and its AltitudeAI platform. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Bain Capital Ventures portfolio company in the healthcare sector.

providers.name: IONITY
providers.description: IONITY operates a high-power electric vehicle (EV) charging network across Europe, offering fast, reliable charging stations in 24 countries. The company focuses on seamless mobility, providing drivers with subscription plans, fleet solutions, and a mobile app to locate and pay for charging. IONITY aims to accelerate the transition to electric transportation by expanding its infrastructure and delivering transparent pricing.

providers.name: Jago Coffee
providers.description: Jago Coffee is an Indonesian mobile coffee company operating a fleet of electric-vehicle coffee carts ("Jagoans") that bring freshly brewed specialty coffee, tea, and seasonal drinks directly to neighborhoods across Indonesia. Billing itself as the "#1 Cafe on Wheels," Jago lets customers order through its mobile app with no delivery fees or order minimums, paying with GoPay or OVO digital wallets, using Arabica beans sourced directly from local Indonesian farmers. Backed by 500 Global, the company is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a consumer coffee-delivery business; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK.

providers.name: Jam City
providers.description: Jam City is a Culver City, California mobile entertainment company founded in 2010 by MySpace co-founders Chris DeWolfe and Aber Whitcomb (with Josh Yguado), now led by CEO Simon Sim. It develops and publishes free-to-play mobile games across puzzle, casual and narrative RPG genres — including the Cookie Jam and Panda Pop franchises and licensed titles such as Harry Potter: Hogwarts Mystery, Disney Emoji Blitz and Family Guy: The Quest for Stuff — built with partners including Disney and Warner Bros. Games. The company reports over $4 billion in aggregate lifetime bookings and nearly 1.5 billion downloads across studios in Los Angeles, Burbank, San Diego, San Francisco, Buenos Aires, Montevideo and Toronto. Jam City is a consumer games publisher: it distributes through the Apple App Store and Google Play and, as of this profile, publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Jellysmack
providers.description: Jellysmack is a content amplification and creator-growth platform that helps digital creators expand their audiences and earnings across multiple social platforms (YouTube, Facebook, Snapchat, TikTok, Instagram) using AI-driven optimization, first-party data, and multi-platform distribution expertise. Its offerings span the Creator Program (audience growth and monetization for 500+ creator partners), Jellysmack Originals (owned beauty, sports, gaming, and entertainment channels), media licensing, and brand partnerships. The company reports 10B+ monthly video views and 125M+ monthly U.S. unique viewers. It is a consumer/creator-facing media technology company and does not publish a public developer API; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company/portfolio intelligence.

providers.name: Jiobit
providers.description: Jiobit is a real-time GPS tracking device company owned by Life360, based in San Mateo, California. Its lightweight (18g) wearable tracker is designed for kids, pets, seniors, and adults, combining LPWA CatM1 cellular, GPS, WiFi, and BLE for location accuracy of 1-50 feet, up to 30 days of battery life, geofence and SOS/911 emergency alerts, and tamper-proof, government-level encryption. Jiobit is a consumer hardware and mobile-app product sold direct-to-consumer with a monthly connectivity subscription; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company discovery and monitoring.

providers.name: Joko
providers.description: Joko is a French fintech company operating a consumer cashback, rewards, and savings application that connects shoppers with more than 3,500 partner brands online and in physical stores. Users earn cashback and automatically apply promo codes through the Joko iOS and Android apps and browser extensions (Chrome, Firefox, Safari), while also managing budgets, loyalty cards, gift cards, and split (3x installment) payments. Joko also runs a business solution offering brand partnerships and consumer market research. Backed by Partech, Joko is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation at this time.

providers.name: Journey Medidtation
providers.description: Journey (Journey Meditation) is a workplace mental health platform that delivers preventive Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services to enterprise organizations. Rather than the reactive model of traditional EAPs, Journey uses AI-powered risk detection (Journey Signal) to identify emerging mental health issues before they escalate and connects employees to clinicians across 190+ countries in 100+ languages. Its offerings include Journey Proactive EAP, the Journey LIVE guided-meditation and wellbeing experience, and a Mental Health Certification training program. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer or API surface has been found; this profile is maintained as a company lead and refreshed by the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Junglee Games
providers.description: Junglee Games is a skill-based online gaming company founded in 2012 by Ankush Gera, operating as an independent subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, which acquired a majority stake in 2021 in a deal valuing the company at more than $440 million. Headquartered in Gurugram with a studio in Bengaluru, the company builds and operates consumer real-money and casual gaming apps for a base of over 150 million users, with flagship titles including Junglee Rummy, the Howzat fantasy cricket and football platform, Carrom Stars, and Junglee Poker. The company positions trust, safety, and fairness as engineering priorities. Junglee Games is a consumer gaming provider and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documented API program; this profile captures its identity, web properties, and probed security posture for the API Evangelist network. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: K4Connect
providers.description: K4Connect is a Morrisville, North Carolina technology company serving the senior living industry, backed by Sierra Ventures. Its patented FusionOS integration and data platform provides two-way ("One-to-Many") interoperability that shares the who, what and when of a community between every integrated system, connecting 50+ leading applications, devices and services. On top of FusionOS sits K4Community, an enterprise engagement suite of interconnected modules: Team Hub for staff, the Plus App for residents, Voice (Amazon Alexa), K4TV infotainment, Digital Signage, and smart-home Resident Check-In. K4Connect operates a partner-led integration model rather than a public self-serve developer API; integrations are built and coordinated through FusionOS.

providers.name: Kabam
providers.description: Kabam is a mobile game developer and publisher founded in 2006 and headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, operating as a wholly owned subsidiary of Netmarble. The studio builds free-to-play multiplayer titles for iOS and Android, best known for Marvel Contest of Champions, alongside Shop Titans, Transformers Forged to Fight, King Arthur Legends, and past titles such as Disney Mirrorverse and Fast & Furious games. Kabam operates studios and offices across Vancouver, Montreal, Charlottetown, Los Angeles, San Francisco, Austin, and Seoul. Kabam publishes no public developer program, API reference, or SDK surface; this profile captures its public web, legal, and support properties plus a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Kale
providers.description: Kale (operated by Palette Technologies, Inc., dba Kale) is a creator-rewards and user-generated-content marketplace that connects social-media content creators with brands. Creators join brand challenges and tournaments, post authentic sponsored content about products they use, and earn cash, merchandise, and perks; brands source authentic UGC and micro-influencer marketing at scale. The platform is delivered through the getkale.com and kalecard.com web apps and native iOS/Android apps, with a merchant network spanning consumer brands such as Chili's, Planet Fitness, Urban Outfitters, DoorDash, Southwest, and Starbucks. Kale is backed by Forerunner Ventures. No public developer/API surface is published; this profile captures the company's public identity and security posture.

providers.name: Kandou
providers.description: Kandou (Kandou AI) is a fabless semiconductor company founded in 2011 by Amin Shokrollahi and headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland. It designs high-speed, energy-efficient chip-to-chip interconnect technology built on its proprietary Copper MIMO / Chord Signaling architecture, which turns noise in copper channels into usable bandwidth for massively scalable AI systems. Products include the Glasswing chiplet interconnect IP, the Regli PCIe retimer, the Matterhorn USB4 retimer, the Zetti PCIe switch, and AI Fabric memory/networking platforms. Chord signaling has been adopted into JEDEC and OIF industry specifications. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners across multiple rounds, Kandou raised a $225M round in March 2026 led by Maverick Silicon with strategic participation from SoftBank, Synopsys, Cadence, and Alchip. This is a hardware/semiconductor IP company with no public REST/GraphQL API, SDK, or developer platform surface.

providers.name: Kango
providers.description: Kango is an on-demand rides and childcare platform for families, connecting parents and schools with background-checked, fingerprinted drivers and sitters who transport and care for children from preschool through high school. Operated by Dolightful, Inc. and backed by 500 Global, Kango offers prescheduled and same-day rides, real-time ride tracking, in-app communication with drivers, provided car and booster seats, in-home sitter sessions, and a free carpool feature promoted by schools and camps. It runs on iOS and Android apps using a subscription plus per-ride and per-session fee model. Kango is a consumer mobile product and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Karma Science
providers.description: Karma (Karma Science, karmanow.com) is a consumer shopping-assistant platform delivered as a browser extension and mobile app that helps people shop smarter. Founded in 2015, it serves roughly 6.5 million users with automatic coupon finding at checkout, price-drop and back-in-stock tracking, cross-retailer wishlists, and cash-back rewards across major merchants including Amazon, Apple, Nike, Target, and Nordstrom. The company also offers an Embedded Loyalty and partnerships program for retailers. Karma is a Kleiner Perkins-backed consumer company; as surfaced through the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline it publishes consumer product surfaces (apps, help center, blog) but no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Kennek
providers.description: Kennek (Kennek Solutions Ltd) is a UK-based fintech providing all-in-one loan management software built for specialist bridge and development lenders. The platform lets lenders originate, manage, and service loans while monitoring funding lines in one place, automating manual workflows, covenant and eligibility calculations, portfolio risk visibility, and investor reporting so lending teams can scale without adding headcount. Founded by former lenders and backed by HV Capital, Kennek is surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a fintech portfolio-company profile; it publishes a marketing site and legal pages but no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: KlariVis
providers.description: KlariVis is an enterprise data analytics platform built for community banks and credit unions by former community bankers. It ingests data nightly from a financial institution's core and ancillary systems into a secure Microsoft Azure data warehouse, then aggregates and visualizes it through role-based interactive dashboards covering deposits, loans, transactional intelligence, profitability and funds transfer pricing, plus a Report Builder for bespoke charts and reports. The company was founded in 2019 in Roanoke, Virginia by Kim Snyder, raised an $11M Series B led by Blueprint Equity in January 2024, and serves 100+ financial institutions. KlariVis is a consumer of core banking APIs rather than a publisher of one: it operates no public developer program, publishes no API documentation or machine-readable contract, and integration work is handled through its implementation team.

providers.name: La Vie
providers.description: La Vie Foods is a Paris-based plant-based food company that makes vegan alternatives to pork products, including bacon, smoked lardons, ham, salami sticks, croquettes and meatballs, sold across French and UK retail and foodservice. Its stated mission is to move people from animal to vegetable fat without compromising on taste, citing 88% less CO2, 82% less water and 74% less land use than conventional pork. Its products are stocked by retailers including Tesco, Sainsbury's, Waitrose, Whole Foods Market and Planet Organic, and used by restaurant partners such as Burger King. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of partech. La Vie Foods operates as a consumer packaged-goods brand rather than an API provider: it publishes no public developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, CLI, packages or programmatic API surface, and exposes no /.well-known/ discovery documents. This profile therefore captures the company's real public web, legal, press and domain-security surface rather than developer artifacts.

providers.name: Launching Next
providers.description: Launching Next is a startup discovery and submission platform that publishes daily listings of new and trending tech startups and side projects worldwide. Founded as a long-running startup directory, the platform has featured over 45,000 startups and side projects, making it a go-to resource for founders, investors, and early adopters looking to discover what is being built next. Entrepreneurs can submit their startups for free, with an optional paid fast-track review.

providers.name: LawnStarter
providers.description: LawnStarter is an on-demand lawn care and outdoor-services marketplace founded in 2013 and headquartered in Austin, Texas, that connects homeowners with vetted local lawn care professionals ("LawnTrepreneurs"). Beyond recurring lawn mowing, the platform books more than 30 services including landscaping, lawn treatments and fertilization, tree care, gutter cleaning, pressure washing, and leaf removal, with transparent online quoting, consistent crews, and a re-mow-or-refund quality guarantee. LawnStarter operates across 500+ cities, has served more than 500,000 customers through roughly 7,500 professionals, and reached profitability in 2021. LawnStarter runs a consumer web/mobile marketplace and a separate provider app (pros.lawnstarter.com); it does not publish a public developer platform, API, or SDKs.

providers.name: Levita Magnetics
providers.description: Levita Magnetics is a Mountain View, California medical device company, founded by minimally invasive surgeon Dr. Alberto Rodriguez-Navarro and co-founded by Nicolas Luksic, with an additional office in Santiago, Chile. It develops Magnetic Surgery — the Levita Magnetic Surgical System, in which an external magnet placed on the patient's skin controls a shaftless detachable retractor to enable reduced-port laparoscopic procedures — and the MARS (Magnetic-Assisted Robotic Surgery) platform launched in 2023, an FDA-cleared surgical robotic system used in abdominal and, more recently, pediatric procedures. The MARS platform is built on RTI Connext (the DDS real-time connectivity standard) internally, and Levita has demonstrated AI-guided autonomous camera control during surgery. Levita ships regulated surgical hardware and its embedded control software to hospitals; it operates no public developer program, publishes no API documentation, and exposes no machine-readable API contract on any host it controls.

providers.name: Little Freddie
providers.description: Little Freddie (Sunny Fields Enterprise Ltd) is a UK-based organic baby and toddler food brand producing nutritious weaning products for infants from six months, developed with a paediatric dietitian to meet UK and EU baby-food guidelines. Its ranges include Greek-style yoghurts, Simply Fruit purees, Full of Veg meals, dairy-free alternatives, home-style meals and omega-3 "Good for Brains" options, sold through major UK retailers including Tesco, Sainsbury's, Asda, Morrisons, Co-op, Ocado, Booths and Spar. The company also runs a Parenting Hub with weaning, nutrition and parenting content. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Hillhouse; this profile currently exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Lollipuff
providers.description: Lollipuff is a luxury goods authentication service that has been authenticating high-end designer apparel and accessories professionally since 2010. Led by CEO Fei Deyle, the company uses a patent-pending process combining human expert authenticators with software to determine the authenticity of pre-owned designer items from submitted photographs, issuing an online certificate with a unique, shareable URL that owners can post alongside listings on sites like eBay. Lollipuff (YC W13) originally operated as a peer-to-peer online auction marketplace that pre-screened every listing for authenticity; the marketplace closed in 2020 as payment-processor fee structures changed, and the company now focuses on its photo-based authentication and certificate-lookup service, which many consignment and resale businesses rely on for their most challenging authentications. It is a consumer-facing web service with no publicly documented developer API.

providers.name: ltztherapeutics
providers.description: LTZ Therapeutics is a clinical-stage immunotherapy biotechnology company developing novel myeloid engager therapeutics for cancer treatment. Its platform focuses on the direct engagement of myeloid cells with target cells to boost anti-tumor immunity, with lead candidate LTZ-232 receiving FDA IND clearance in July 2026 for advanced metastatic colorectal cancer and other solid tumors. The company operates from Redwood City, USA and Shenzhen, China. It is a portfolio company of Qiming and was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment; it publishes no developer API surface.

providers.name: Luna
providers.description: Luna is an in-home physical therapy company that dispatches licensed physical therapists to patients' homes for 1:1 treatment sessions covered by insurance, including Medicare and major commercial plans. The company supports orthopedic, sports medicine, neurologic, post-surgical, and geriatric rehabilitation across a nationwide network of thousands of therapists, reaching roughly 85K patients and more than 1.2M in-home PT visits in 2024. Luna was surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a consumer healthcare service with no public developer or API program at this time.

providers.name: Manatee
providers.description: Manatee is a digital mental health company delivering family-centered virtual therapy for children, teens, and their parents. It pairs licensed therapists with dedicated care navigators to provide evidence-based treatment (CBT, DBT, and family-systems therapy) for kids ages 5-18 and counseling for caregivers, coordinated through a family app and covered by most major insurance plans across multiple U.S. states. Backed by Techstars, Manatee operates as a consumer telehealth service and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Marathon Health
providers.description: Marathon Health is a healthcare services company delivering advanced primary care and occupational health to employers, labor unions, health plans, and brokers/consultants. It operates onsite, nearsite, and network health centers plus virtual primary care, spanning preventive care, mental health, musculoskeletal treatment, lifestyle and medication management, value-driven referrals, and population health management to improve employee health outcomes while lowering total healthcare cost. Backed by NEA. As of this enrichment pass Marathon Health publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or event/webhook surface.

providers.name: Marlin Equity Partners
providers.description: Marlin Equity Partners (marlinequity.com) is a global investment firm founded in 2005 and headquartered in Hermosa Beach, California, with an additional office in London. The firm acquires and builds software and technology businesses, partnering with management teams to create strategic value through operational support, organic growth, and add-on acquisitions, with particular focus on financial technology and e-commerce segments. Its portfolio has included companies such as Bazaarvoice, Medius, StarCompliance, Exegy, and Learning Pool. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-network lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; as a private equity investor rather than a technology service provider, Marlin publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Marshall
providers.description: Marshall is a Swedish-British consumer audio brand, part of Marshall Group AB, known for its iconic guitar amplifiers and a modern line of Bluetooth speakers, wireless headphones, and earbuds. Built on more than 60 years of live-music heritage, Marshall sells direct-to-consumer through marshall.com across amps, home and portable speakers, and personal audio. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a consumer portfolio company of HongShan. Marshall publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation at this time; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Martie
providers.description: Martie is a woman-owned, San Francisco-based online discount grocery marketplace founded in 2021 to fight food waste and make quality goods accessible and affordable. Martie works directly with brands on their overstock, surplus, seasonal, and old-packaging inventory — pantry staples, beauty, and household goods — and resells it to consumers at up to 80% off retail with no membership or subscription required. Shoppers browse daily deals through the martie.com website or the Martie iOS and Android apps. The company reports having diverted over five million pounds of food from landfill since launch. Martie is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand (a Shopify-hosted storefront) and does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, or documentation surface; this profile was surfaced as a Seedcamp portfolio company and enriched with company identity plus a domain-security probe.

providers.name: MayStreet
providers.description: MayStreet is a low-latency market data infrastructure vendor founded in 2012 and acquired by London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) in May 2022, with maystreet.com now redirecting into LSEG's data feeds pages. The company captures full-depth exchange feeds in raw PCAP form across 300+ venues and sells them through the Bellport feed handler (C++ library, on-premises or managed), a 20+ petabyte Market Data Lake of historical tick data (PCAP/Parquet queried via Athena SQL and the Medusa Python client), the cloud Analytics Workbench (JupyterLab), and the High Performance Query (HPQ) streaming WebSocket API for near-time data. Access is sales-gated and entitlement-managed with no self-serve signup or public developer portal; the public API surface that exists is documented through example "springboard" repositories on the MayStreet GitHub organization rather than a docs site.

providers.name: MedeAnalytics (JLL Partners)
providers.description: MedeAnalytics is a healthcare data and analytics company serving health insurance payers and risk-bearing provider organizations, positioning itself as a healthcare performance improvement company that turns claims, clinical, and operational data into actionable insight and measurable financial and quality results. Its platform spans Health Fabric, an AI-powered healthcare data fabric; AI Studio for ready-to-use and custom predictive models; Managed Action for workflow automation; and Integrated Analytics modules with embedded ROI tracking. Solution areas include MLR optimization, HEDIS/Stars quality performance, utilization and network management, value-based care, revenue cycle, population health, and social determinants of health (SDOH). The company was surfaced from a VC portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network; it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Medefer
providers.description: Medefer is a UK digital-first managed clinical services company that connects patients directly with consultant specialists remotely and safely, working in partnership with the NHS. Its virtual, consultant-led model triages and manages patient referrals through remote review, coordinating in-person tests and treatment through a trusted local and national partner network only when they are needed. Backed by Seedcamp, Medefer brings hospital-level specialist expertise into patients' homes and communities, reducing waiting times for NHS and self-pay patients across a range of specialties. Medefer operates a patient/clinician application and a private internal application backend (api.medefer.com) rather than a public developer API program.

providers.name: Medical Informatics
providers.description: Medical Informatics Corp. (MIC) is a Houston, Texas healthcare technology company behind the FDA-cleared Sickbay platform for virtual and remote patient monitoring. Founded in 2010 by Emma Fauss and Craig Rusin, Sickbay archives, aggregates, and transforms otherwise unrecorded high-resolution physiological waveform data across disparate, vendor-neutral biomedical devices to enable anytime, anywhere remote monitoring, TeleICUs, alarm management, workflow automation, and patient-centered predictive analytics and AI across the continuum of care. The company is backed by DCVC, Intel Capital, Catalio Capital, and the Texas Medical Center. Sickbay is a clinical SaaS platform with no public developer API surface; integration is delivered through the vendor as HL7/device connectivity.

providers.name: MeetMe
providers.description: MeetMe is a consumer social-discovery and chat platform that helps people find and connect with new people nearby who share their interests, through profiles, feeds, live streaming, and real-time messaging on web and mobile. Operated by The Meet Group as part of the ParshipMeet Group, MeetMe grew out of the myYearbook social network and today runs as a location-aware social networking and dating-adjacent app. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass MeetMe publishes no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, or SDKs — this profile captures its identity, legal surface, and live domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Mejuri
providers.description: Mejuri is a direct-to-consumer fine jewelry brand founded in Toronto that designs and sells everyday fine jewelry — rings, earrings, necklaces and bracelets — direct to consumers through its e-commerce site, mobile app, and a growing network of retail stores across North America, Australia, and the United Kingdom. The company also runs the Mejuri+ membership program, offers in-store ear piercing services, and hosts community events. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network, this profile has been through the enrichment pipeline: Mejuri operates a consumer-facing commerce experience and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Meragi
providers.description: Meragi is an Indian wedding planning and execution platform for city and destination weddings, offering a plug-and-play alternative to bare-shell venues. It coordinates venue discovery, decor design (10,000+ options), catering, photography, vendor management, and multi-event logistics across Bangalore, Hyderabad, Goa, Delhi NCR, Jaipur, and Udaipur. Backed by Accel, the company runs a consumer-facing web presence with no public developer, API, or integration surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Mercanis
providers.description: Mercanis is an AI-powered procurement platform that automates the end-to-end source-to-contract lifecycle for enterprise procurement teams. It combines structured intake, connected sourcing (RFx and supplier comparison), supplier relationship management, contract lifecycle management, and risk, compliance and spend analytics, coordinated by a large fleet of autonomous AI agents. Mercanis serves sectors including energy and utilities, pharma and chemicals, automotive, consumer goods, manufacturing, and construction, and integrates with ERP systems such as SAP and NetSuite alongside procurement networks like Unite. The company is headquartered in Germany with SOC-certified, GDPR-compliant infrastructure. No public developer API, documentation, or /.well-known discovery surface has been identified as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Metro Africa Xpress
providers.description: Metro Africa Xpress (MAX), operating as maxdrive.ai, is a Nigerian technology-driven mobility company on a mission to make transportation safe, affordable, accessible and sustainable across Africa. MAX finances and deploys vehicles — including electric two- and three-wheelers — to a vetted network of driver-partners ("champions"), and runs a drivers services platform, electric-vehicle assembly and charging infrastructure, enterprise last-mile logistics, and mobility gov-tech solutions. Emerging from the MIT and Techstars ecosystem, MAX is backed by Novastar Ventures, Goodwell, Shell Foundation, Breakthrough Energy, Capria and Yamaha, and operates across Nigeria, Cameroon and other West African markets. The company publishes a marketing and corporate website only; no public developer program, API, or developer portal was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Microhealth
providers.description: Microhealth is a Y Combinator (S15) digital-health company building digital therapeutics and connected patient-provider networks for people living with rare bleeding disorders such as hemophilia and for sickle cell disease. Its products let patients track, manage, and share their treatment journey while giving clinicians real-time monitoring between visits, and it aggregates anonymized real-world evidence for life-science and pharmaceutical research. Products include Microhealth Bleeding Disorders (patient) and Rare Bleeding Disorders HCP (clinician dashboard), Microhealth SCD and SCD HCP for sickle cell disease, and life-science research tooling. The company validates interventions through clinical studies toward regulatory clearance as Software as a Medical Device (SaMD). Its hemophilia network is reported to cover roughly a third of US patients and providers in the specialty, with pharmaceutical clients including Sanofi, Bayer, Novo Nordisk, Biogen, and Roche. Microhealth is a patient- and clinician-facing application platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Mission Barns
providers.description: Mission Barns is a Berkeley, California cultivated-meat company founded in 2018 that grows real animal fat from cells to make animal-friendly pork products — including meatballs, bacon, pepperoni, chorizo, and sausage — built on Mission Fat, its proprietary cultivated pork fat. It is the first company to receive both FDA and USDA clearance for cultivated fat and operates a dual B2C consumer-brand and B2B ingredient / co-development model across foodservice and CPG partners. This API Evangelist profile is a portfolio-company lead (backed by Point Nine); the company runs a consumer marketing site and publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Mobile Premier League
providers.description: Mobile Premier League (MPL) is a mobile skill-gaming and esports platform founded in 2018 and headquartered in Bengaluru, India, operated by Galactus Funware Technology. It distributes a catalog of casual, card, board and fantasy-sports titles inside a single app and runs tournaments and contests around them, reporting more than 100 million registered users across Asia, Europe and North America. MPL historically ran a game-developer program — a Developer Dashboard and a publish-and-monetize SDK at developer.mpl.live, documented at docs.developer.mpl.live — that let third-party studios ship a single build to the MPL app under a revenue-share agreement. That program's hosts no longer resolve, and MPL publishes no public REST, GraphQL, MCP or event API today. Following India's Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025, MPL discontinued real-money gaming in India; www.mplgames.com is the live consumer surface, principally serving the United States.

providers.name: Modern Age
providers.description: Modern Age is a longevity-focused health and wellness clinic based on New York City's Upper East Side. It provides proactive aging interventions including comprehensive Aging Wellness Assessments (blood work, bone-density scans, cognitive testing, and clinician consultation), IV drip therapies, vitamin injections, hormone therapy, medically supervised weight loss, and aesthetic skin and hair treatments. Backed by GV (Google Ventures), the company blends clinical diagnostics with wellness services to help members understand and proactively slow the aging process. Modern Age is a consumer health clinic and does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation surface.

providers.name: Moj.io
providers.description: Mojio (moj.io) is a connected-car and connected-mobility platform that collects, processes, and monetizes vehicle telematics data at scale for mobile network operators, automotive OEMs, insurers, and fleet/field-service businesses. Its "Mobility Studio" platform exposes REST endpoints for vehicle data, a PUSH API for real-time insights, mobile SDKs, and a vehicle simulator, alongside a white-label consumer app (Motion) and a services ecosystem (Alexa, Google Maps, Bosch, and others). Mojio has processed 15+ billion miles of driving data. As of this pass the API and SDK surface is partner-gated — there is no public developer portal, published OpenAPI specification, or self-serve API documentation. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Momox
providers.description: momox SE (formerly Momox AG / Momox GmbH) is a Berlin-based re-commerce company founded by Christian Wegner in 2004 — the name stands for "Moderner Medien Online Express-Ankauf" (Modern Media Online Express Purchase). Through momox.de it buys used books, CDs, DVDs/Blu-rays and games from private sellers at fixed prices in Germany, Austria, France, Belgium and the UK, reselling them via its Medimops shop and third-party marketplaces. Its momox fashion arm (formerly ubup.com, momoxfashion.com) does the same for second-hand clothing, shoes and accessories. momox runs large logistics centres in Berlin, Leipzig and Neuenhagen bei Berlin and has handled more than 350 million articles since founding. momox is a consumer-facing re-commerce operation; it publishes no official public developer program, API portal, or SDKs. The only machine surface is an internal, undocumented mobile-app pricing endpoint (api.momox.de / api.momox.fr) that is not offered as a first-party API.

providers.name: Movandi
providers.description: Movandi is an RF semiconductor company founded by former Broadcom executives (CEO Maryam Rofougaran and CTO Reza Rofougaran) that designs 5G mmWave chipsets, RF front ends, phased-array antenna modules, 5G smart repeaters, and beamforming software for terrestrial and non-terrestrial networks. Based in Irvine, California and backed by Sierra Ventures, the company holds 130+ patents covering millimeter wave semiconductor, system, and software technologies spanning 5G, fixed wireless, and satellite connectivity. Movandi is a hardware/semiconductor vendor and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal surface.

providers.name: Mural Health
providers.description: Mural Health is a clinical research technology company whose Mural Link platform manages the clinical trial participant experience end to end. Founded by the team that created ClinCard, Mural Health provides integrated participant payments across 10+ global methods (Venmo, PayPal, Zelle, Revolut, bank transfer, virtual and physical prepaid debit cards, and check via mail), in-app travel and rideshare coordination (Uber, Lyft), participant messaging and calendar syncing, and real-time satisfaction analytics for research sites and sponsors. The company works with leading pharmaceutical sponsors, CROs, and site networks to reduce trial dropout and administrative burden across studies in 75+ countries, and is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. Mural Health does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs; system integrations are delivered through partnerships (e.g., ClinOne, Clinical Ink).

providers.name: MycoTechnology
providers.description: MycoTechnology, Inc. is a Colorado-based food ingredient technology company that uses mushroom mycelial fermentation to create naturally derived ingredients for the food and beverage industry. Operating publicly as Myco (mycoiq.com), the company develops and manufactures flavor-modulation and sweetening ingredients — ClearIQ natural flavor, ClearHT natural flavor, and Zukora honey truffle sweet protein — used for bitterness masking, off-note mitigation, sugar reduction, and clean-label formulation in plant proteins, meat analogues, dairy alternatives, and health and wellness products. It also offers Fermentation as a Service (FaaS) and a MyCulinary culinary science program for food brands. This is an ingredient manufacturing and food science business, not a software or API company: it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation, and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: nabfly
providers.description: nabfly, Inc., doing business as Bespoke Post, is a New York City-based direct-to-consumer e-commerce and subscription retailer founded in 2011 and backed by 500 Global. It sells rugged-meets-refined menswear and lifestyle gear, designing its own brands (including Line of Trade, Fieldworth, Halfday, Wren, Ash and Fir, and Marcellin) and curating products from small independent makers. Alongside a standard online store, it runs an optional membership offering member pricing, early access, and curated monthly boxes. The company operates as a consumer retail brand at bespokepost.com and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its identity, public web properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Nawy
providers.description: Nawy is an Egyptian proptech real estate marketplace that lets users buy, sell, rent, and invest in premium property across Egypt, listing 15,000+ properties and 800+ compounds with search, virtual tours, mortgage financing, and its "Nawy Now" instant-purchase and part-exchange offerings. It operates a consumer-facing web and mobile marketplace connecting buyers, sellers, and developers; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer program, API documentation, or partner integration surface is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: NCX
providers.description: NCX (Natural Capital Exchange), originally founded as SilviaTerra, is a forestry technology company that maps and measures every acre of U.S. forestland using satellite imagery and machine learning. NCX built the Natural Capital Exchange, a marketplace that paid landowners to defer timber harvests and generate forest carbon credits, and it now offers LandBook, a tool that helps landowners capture the story, plans, and practical knowledge behind their property so it can be passed on to the next steward. The company is backed by Union Square Ventures and Version One Ventures.

providers.name: Neuron Mobility
providers.description: Neuron Mobility is a rental e-scooter and e-bike operator and micromobility technology developer running shared micromobility fleets in cities across Australia, the United Kingdom, and Canada. The company designs its own vehicles (including the N3 e-scooter), safety systems such as its patented Helmet Lock and ScootSafe rider training program, and the backend fleet-management, IoT, and geofencing technology that powers its rider apps and city operations. Backed by 500 Global, Neuron was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and profiled in the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no first-party developer API, GBFS data feed, or well-known discovery surface on its own domain; this profile captures its public web, legal, and support properties plus a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Nexii
providers.description: Nexii is a green construction technology company that designs and manufactures prefabricated wall and roof panel systems for commercial and industrial buildings. Its panels are made from Nexiite, a proprietary low-carbon building material the company says is up to 80% lighter than conventional concrete, and bolt together on site to cut build times by as much as five times while producing near-zero construction waste. Nexii serves retail, residential, warehouse, data center, cold storage, healthcare, office and education verticals, with projects for Starbucks, McDonald's, Pizza Hut, Popeyes, Dutch Bros, Walmart and Marriott. The original Vancouver-based Nexii Building Solutions entered creditor protection in January 2024; Dallas-based 3 Gates acquired its assets in a court-approved sale completed 28 June 2024 and relaunched the business as NEXII, Inc., headquartered in Dallas, Texas with manufacturing in Squamish, British Columbia. Nucor Corporation subsequently made a strategic equity investment. Nexii is a manufacturer, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: NNG
providers.description: NNG (NNG Software Developing and Commercial LLC), formerly Nav N Go, is a Budapest-based automotive navigation and location-based software company founded in 2004. Its flagship iGO platform delivers modular guidance, positioning, routing, map content management, and driver-assistance features such as Intelligent Speed Assistance, embedded in more than 60 million devices across 30+ vehicle brands and supplied to over 150 automotive and mobility partners in nearly 200 countries. NNG is backed by growth investment from Insight Partners. NNG sells embedded and OEM location-based software rather than a public developer API; no public developer portal, OpenAPI, SDK, or API documentation was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Noah Medical
providers.description: Noah Medical is a surgical robotics company building the Galaxy System, a robotic-assisted bronchoscopy platform for interventional pulmonology. The system combines advanced imaging, precision targeting, single-use scope technology, and an adaptive workflow to deliver "tool-in-lesion" confidence for diagnosing lung nodules, improving diagnostic yield and workflow efficiency for physicians. Noah Medical is a medical-device manufacturer focused on clinical hardware and does not currently expose a public developer platform, API, or documentation surface; it was added to the API Evangelist network as a healthcare portfolio company backed by Hongshan (HongShan Capital / formerly Sequoia China).

providers.name: Notti
providers.description: Notti (Notti Pet Food) is a Malaysian pet-nutrition startup selling premium slow-baked kibble, treats, and supplements for dogs (Wou Wou) and cats (Mau Mau) direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront. Formulations emphasise ">=80% fresh meat", low-temperature slow-baking to preserve nutrients, no meat meal or by-products, and AAFCO-compliant nutrition with no chemical preservatives. The company is seed-funded, has been covered by Malaysian business press (The Edge, The Star, Business Today, Free Malaysia Today), and is tracked here as a 500 Global portfolio company. Notti operates as a consumer e-commerce and retail brand and publishes no developer API, documentation, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: Nuevo Método
providers.description: Nuevo Método (NUME) is an international digital-health and corporate-wellness platform, headquartered in Mexico City and operating across 17 countries in Latin America and Europe. It helps insurers and enterprises deliver personalized wellbeing benefits to employees, customers, and their families across three pillars: mental health (psychology sessions, mindfulness, meditation, sleep tracking), physical health (24/7 virtual medical consultations, fertility guidance, menstrual-cycle tracking, health workshops), and lifestyle (personal-finance courses, financial advisory, and inspirational talks). The company runs a fully remote workforce and reports measurable client outcomes such as improved sleep, productivity, and employee retention. Founded and led by Dr. Ingrid Briggiler (CEO). No public API or developer portal is currently published; this profile captures the company's identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Nvidia
providers.description: Nvidia is a Fortune 500 company that provides developer APIs and integration capabilities through its developer platform. NVIDIA provides developer APIs for GPU computing, AI/ML model training and inference, and graphics. The platform includes APIs for CUDA, TensorRT, Omniverse, and cloud GPU services.

providers.name: Oboe
providers.description: Oboe is an AI-powered learning platform whose mission is to teach one billion people one trillion things. Positioned as "AI that won't make you stupid," it lets anyone learn virtually any subject through a conversational interface that generates personalized, on-demand courses and lessons ("magical courses made just for you"). Founded in New York and backed by Homebrew, Oboe is building what it calls the world's first completely generalized AI-powered learning platform, focused on making humans smarter rather than only making machines smarter. As a consumer web application, Oboe does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; api.oboe.com serves only an XML sitemap index for public course pages.

providers.name: Odyssey Interactive
providers.description: Odyssey Interactive is an independent game development studio focused on building free-to-play, cross-platform, competitive titles set in bright, hopeful, anime-inspired IP. The studio is best known for Omega Strikers, a free-to-play competitive arena game, and its mission is to "ignite the spark of competitiveness that lives within everyone" by creating community-driven games with longevity. Odyssey Interactive was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the studio publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal — its public surface is its marketing site, a Verified Creators program, downloadable game asset kits, and a Zendesk-hosted player support center. This profile captures the studio's identity and verified public links.

providers.name: OfferUp
providers.description: OfferUp is a mobile-first local marketplace where people buy and sell items in their community across categories including electronics, vehicles, furniture, clothing, and collectibles. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, OfferUp reports more than 40 million active users and around 30 million transactions annually, and merged with letgo in 2020 to become one of the largest recommerce platforms in the United States. The company operates consumer iOS and Android apps and a website but does not publish a public developer program, partner API, or API documentation. This profile was surfaced as a venture-capital portfolio company (a16z, GGV Capital) and enriched with an identity and domain-security pass; no public API surface was found.

providers.name: Olaris
providers.description: Olaris, Inc. is a precision-medicine diagnostics company in Framingham, Massachusetts, founded in 2014 by Elizabeth O'Day, that combines mass-spectrometry and NMR metabolomics with machine learning to turn metabolite signatures into clinical biomarkers of response. Its lead product, myOLARIS-KTdx, is a non-invasive urine test for surveillance of kidney graft injury in transplant recipients — including borderline, subclinical and clinical rejection and polyomavirus-associated nephropathy — run in the company's own CLIA-certified laboratory and distributed through a commercial collaboration with Labcorp. Olaris also sells biomarker discovery services to biopharma and is advancing a diagnostics pipeline across oncology, solid-organ transplant and neurodegeneration. Olaris publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable API contract; its only machine-readable surfaces are the platform-generated llms.txt and Wix Site MCP endpoint served from its own marketing host.

providers.name: Omnitron Sensors
providers.description: Omnitron Sensors designs advanced MEMS (micro electro mechanical systems) sensors using innovative 3D manufacturing techniques, aiming to deliver high-performance, low-cost sensing with major gains in precision and reliability. Its technology targets AI data centers, autonomous systems and vehicles, environmental and climate monitoring, and extended reality (XR) devices. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network, the company is a hardware/semiconductor business with no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: On the Beach
providers.description: On the Beach Group plc (LSE: OTB) is a Manchester-headquartered online travel agent and the United Kingdom's largest online short-haul beach package holiday specialist, founded in 2004 by Simon Cooper and registered at Aeroworks, 5 Adair Street, Manchester M1 2NQ. It sits on the demand side of the travel distribution chain: an asset-light dynamic packager that buys real-time seats from 42 airlines and hotel inventory from bedbanks and direct hotel contracts, combines them into ATOL-protected packages, and sells them direct to UK and Republic of Ireland consumers through onthebeach.co.uk, sunshine.co.uk and its mobile app. FY25 total transaction value was GBP 1.25bn across 1.7 million customers. It is a consumer of other operators' distribution APIs rather than a publisher of its own - it was the first UK OTA to take a direct NDC connection to Emirates' Online B2B API in 2019 and signed a direct Ryanair "Approved OTA" partnership in 2024 - and it explicitly bypasses the GDS layer entirely. Its API posture as a producer is almost non-existent. The FY25 results describe an "API-first microservices architecture" and a proprietary Hotel Discovery Cache managing more than 5 billion hotel prices, but none of that surface is published: there is no developer portal, no API documentation, no OpenAPI or other machine-readable contract, no partner or trade API, and no self-serve access of any kind. Its only remaining B2B channel, Classic Collection, was put into orderly wind-down on 23 September 2025. The single exception, and the first externally addressable machine surface the company has ever shipped, is a ChatGPT App launched on 1 April 2026 - claimed as the first by a UK OTA - which serves live, bookable package combinations to ChatGPT users over MCP. That surface is distribution-gated rather than developer-facing: no endpoint, tool list, schema, auth flow or terms are documented, and a deliberate mcp.onthebeach.co.uk host exists but is Cloudflare WAF-blocked to every probe.

providers.name: One Medical *
providers.description: One Medical (1Life Healthcare, Inc.) is a membership-based primary care organization delivering in-person and virtual healthcare across 25+ US cities. Members pay an annual fee for same/next-day appointments, 24/7 on-demand video visits, secure provider messaging, integrated lab services, and digital health records, with most major insurance plans accepted. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) and is now owned by Amazon, which offers One Medical membership to Amazon Prime members. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment; One Medical operates a consumer healthcare site and member app and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or /.well-known/ discovery surface.

providers.name: Onibi
providers.description: Onibi (Onibi inc.) is a video game studio founded in 2023 by Benjamin Devienne, with a distributed team in San Francisco, London and Bordeaux drawn from Blizzard, Riot, Ubisoft, EA and Rockstar. Its first title is Tomo: Endless Blue, a procedurally generated monster-taming voxel sandbox open world announced for Steam and funded through a Kickstarter campaign plus roughly $6.5M in seed capital from SeaX Ventures, Serena, Octopus Ventures and Pix Capital. Onibi is a consumer game studio, not an API provider: as of August 2026 the game is unreleased and the studio publishes no developer portal, API reference, SDK or machine-readable specification. The Steam page states an intent to keep the game moddable, but no modding API, tooling or documentation has been published yet, so there is nothing machine-readable to catalog.

providers.name: Ooda Health
providers.description: OODA Health is a healthcare technology company modernizing the business of healthcare by automating administration and payments between payers, providers, and patients. Its flagship platform, OODAPay, coordinates billing across all parties to give patients a single consolidated bill while reducing provider administrative burden and bad debt; OODA Optic extends its analytics and administrative tooling. OODA Health worked with payers and health systems including Anthem, CommonSpirit Health, Blue Cross Blue Shield of Massachusetts and Arizona, Blue Shield of California, and Hill Physicians Medical Group, and was acquired by Cedar. The company was backed by Threshold Ventures. No public API, developer portal, or SDK surface has been identified.

providers.name: Oolka
providers.description: Oolka is a Bangalore-based consumer fintech that helps people in India check, monitor, and improve their credit scores. Its mobile app provides free bureau-integrated credit-score checks (Experian), a Credit Builder for users with no prior credit history, EMI and bill payments with cashback via Bharat Bill Pay (the RBI-NPCI initiative), AI-guided insights on credit utilization and payment timing, and assistance disputing incorrect credit-report entries. Oolka operates as a co-branded financial-product partner working with banks and financial institutions. It is a consumer-facing mobile application and does not currently publish a public developer API or SDK surface.

providers.name: OpenLoop Health
providers.description: OpenLoop Health is a Des Moines, Iowa-based white-label telehealth infrastructure company that powers virtual care for digital health companies, health plans, diagnostic labs, retailers and pharmacies, and hospitals and health systems. Its platform bundles a nationwide clinician network (covering all 50 states and more than 500,000 patient visits per month), provider staffing, licensing and credentialing, payer coverage and revenue cycle management, diagnostic imaging, regulatory and legal support, and practice management, with AI-powered clinical operations across synchronous and asynchronous care. OpenLoop delivers its capabilities through EHR integrations and protocol-specific API integrations offered to partners via sales; as of this profile there is no publicly published API specification, SDK, developer portal, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Orasis Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Orasis Pharmaceuticals is an ophthalmic pharmaceutical company with offices in the United States and Israel, focused on treatments for presbyopia — the age-related loss of near vision that affects roughly two billion people worldwide. Its lead product, QLOSI (pilocarpine hydrochloride ophthalmic solution) 0.4%, is a preservative-free, single-use-vial prescription eye drop approved by the FDA in October 2023 and commercially available in the United States, with a follow-on candidate (BESKA) submitted for approval in Australia. The company is backed by life-sciences investors including Sequoia Capital, Johnson & Johnson Innovation and Arboretum Ventures. Orasis sells a regulated pharmaceutical product, not software: it operates a corporate marketing site plus product sites for patients (qlosi.com) and eye care professionals (qlosiecp.com), and publishes no developer program, public API, SDK, webhook surface or machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Orchard Labs
providers.description: Orchard Labs Inc. is a Toronto-based e-commerce company, founded in 2013, that buys, refurbishes, and resells pre-owned and certified-refurbished smartphones, tablets, and accessories across North America. Through its consumer website and mobile app, Orchard lets people test, price, and sell their used iPhones and Android devices, and buy thoroughly tested refurbished devices backed by a 90-day no-questions-asked warranty and carbon-neutral shipping. It is a consumer retail brand with no public API, developer portal, or SDKs. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: OriGene Technologies
providers.description: OriGene Technologies, Inc. is a life sciences company that develops and supplies validated research reagents and laboratory services for genomics and proteomics research. Its catalog spans cDNA clones, expression vectors, lentivirus and viral gene-delivery systems, RNAi and CRISPR tools, primary antibodies, recombinant proteins, ELISA and assay kits, and human tissue samples, alongside custom cloning, antibody and protein development, and lentivirus production services. The company operates in the United States and, through OriGene Technologies GmbH, in Europe. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and profiled in the API Evangelist network; as of this enrichment pass OriGene publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Ossium Health
providers.description: Ossium Health is a bioengineering company developing off-the-shelf cell therapies manufactured from stem cells recovered from deceased organ and tissue donors. The company operates a proprietary bone marrow and tissue recovery, banking, and manufacturing platform, and is advancing a clinical pipeline of allogeneic cellular therapies targeting hematologic diseases, organ transplant tolerance, and orthopedic conditions. Ossium Health is a private, venture-backed life sciences company; it does not currently publish a public developer program, API, or SDKs. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company/provider record and was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst.

providers.name: Ostro
providers.description: Ostro (Veeva Ostro) is an AI-powered brand engagement platform for life sciences. Founded in 2019 as RxDefine and legally incorporated as Rise Healthcare Tech, Inc., the Miami-based, remote-first company turns a pharmaceutical brand's existing PRC/MLR-approved content into compliant, two-way conversational AI across web, email and SMS. Its products are Navigate (web engagement), Airmark (conversational email for HCPs), Prompt (SMS) and Tailor (brand-website intelligence), unified in September 2025 into a single digital experience. The platform is grounded exclusively in approved content and is designed not to generate novel responses, which is how it clears promotional-review requirements. Veeva Systems (NYSE: VEEV) acquired Ostro on 2026-03-10 for approximately $100M and runs it as an independent unit whose capabilities are being folded into Veeva Commercial Cloud. Ostro publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract; its only machine-readable surface is an llms.txt served at its own website root.

providers.name: Oula Health
providers.description: Oula Health (Oula) is a modern maternity and women's health provider operating collaborative-care clinics in New York and Connecticut. Oula pairs OBGYNs with certified nurse midwives to deliver comprehensive support before, during, and after pregnancy — including preconception planning, prenatal and postpartum care, gynecology, and miscarriage care — and partners with health systems, employers, and payers to extend that model. It is a patient-facing healthcare provider and does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: Outcomes4Me
providers.description: Outcomes4Me is a digital health company providing a personalized cancer care navigation platform for patients. The consumer app delivers personalized treatment plans, symptom and medication management, and community support grounded in NCCN Guidelines, serving over 300,000 patients across 100+ cancer communities. Alongside the patient app, Outcomes4Me runs a For Life Sciences business that offers real-world outcomes data, precision content and marketing, and clinical-trial recruitment and patient-reported-outcomes support to pharmaceutical and diagnostics partners. Backed by Sierra Ventures. No public developer/API surface is published at this time; this profile has been enriched with the company identity and domain-security posture that are publicly available.

providers.name: Own Up
providers.description: Own Up is an AI-driven mortgage marketplace that helps borrowers shop for home loans by comparing personalized rate offers from a network of top-rated lenders without hard credit checks or sales pressure. It provides real-time rate comparisons, personalized recommendations, pre-approval letters, and educational resources for both home purchases and refinancing. Own Up is not a lender or bank; it arranges loans and is compensated by third-party lenders whose offers appear on the platform. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Oxford Science Enterprises
providers.description: Oxford Science Enterprises (OSE) is an independent investment company and venture builder that transforms cutting-edge research from the University of Oxford into commercial companies tackling global challenges across deep tech, life sciences, and health tech. Operating on a "find, fund, build" model, OSE provides patient capital and hands-on company-building to Oxford science founders, backing 50+ flagship companies with a net asset value of around £1.3bn alongside 300+ co-investors. Notable outcomes include Oxford Ionics (acquired by IonQ) and Dark Blue Therapeutics. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; OSE is an investor and venture builder and does not publish a public API or developer program.

providers.name: Paperstack
providers.description: Paperstack is a Canadian fintech operating a private-credit / working-capital financing platform for direct-to-consumer (DTC), e-commerce, and retail consumer brands. It provides non-dilutive, revenue-based funding of up to $5,000,000 that brands can use without restrictions to purchase inventory, invest in advertising, and finance payroll, with transparent flat fees (typically 4-10%) and no origination or late fees. Paperstack couples a network of lending partners with proprietary AI/ML underwriting software that integrates directly into a brand's financial and e-commerce data to assess creditworthiness and project future performance in real time. Founded by Assel Beglinova (CEO) and Vadim Lidich (CTO) and backed by Techstars, the company has processed over 1,500 funding applications. As of this enrichment pass Paperstack publishes a customer-facing product and marketing site only; it exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Partiful
providers.description: Partiful is a free consumer event-invitation and party-planning platform for creating customized digital invites, managing RSVPs, coordinating guests with polls and custom questions, sending text-blast updates, selling tickets or collecting payments via a Stripe integration, and sharing event photos across web, iOS, and Android. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bond Capital, Canaan Partners, GV, and Initialized Capital. Partiful publishes no official public developer API or developer portal; a community-maintained reverse-engineered client library exists on GitHub but is not first-party. This profile captures the provider identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Pattern Bioscience
providers.description: Pattern Bioscience is a privately held in vitro diagnostics company founded in 2016 and headquartered in Austin, Texas, developing a culture-free Single-Cell Microbiology system for rapid bacterial identification and antibiotic susceptibility testing (ID/AST). The platform isolates individual bacterial cells in picoliter-scale droplets and reads the metabolic patterns those cells produce over time, using machine learning to identify the pathogen and determine phenotypic susceptibility in hours instead of the days a culture workflow requires. The company holds FDA Breakthrough Device Designation for its Pneumonia Action Panel, raised $43M in Series D financing in November 2025 to pursue FDA clearance, and is backed by Illumina Ventures, Omnimed Capital, CARB-X, the AMR Action Fund and a $22.5M BARDA contract. Pattern is pre-commercial: it publishes a marketing and news site at pattern.bio and no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Pokelabo
providers.description: Pokelabo (ポケラボ) is a Japanese mobile game development studio founded in 2007 and headquartered in Tokyo. Originally an independent social-game maker, it became a subsidiary of GREE and, as of January 1, 2025, was integrated into WFS (Wright Flyer Studios) under the GREE group. The studio develops and operates smartphone games built on licensed and original intellectual properties, including titles such as SINoALICE and Magia Exedra (Puella Magi Madoka Magica). Pokelabo is a consumer entertainment company and does not expose a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Poker Skill
providers.description: Poker Skill is a mobile-first poker-training app for iOS and Android that turns learning poker into a daily habit. It teaches through interactive puzzles, bite-sized guided lessons, and daily practice reps that adapt to the player's skill level, from complete beginner to serious improver. At its core is "Showdown AI", a versioned game-theory engine that deals practice hands, plays the opponents, and grades every decision by its expected value — an approach the company says replicates the methods behind Pluribus, the first AI to beat top professionals at six-max no-limit hold'em. The product is subscription-funded with a free-to-start funnel, and is backed by Initialized Capital. Poker Skill is a consumer application and does not publish a public developer API program.

providers.name: POMS
providers.description: POMS Corporation develops POMSnet Aquila, a Manufacturing Execution System (MES) purpose-built for pharmaceutical, biotech, cell and gene therapy, and medical device manufacturers. The platform delivers FDA-compliant electronic batch records (EBR), production execution, review-by-exception, and plant-floor integration with ERP and equipment systems, deployed on-premise or in the cloud. POMS also offers the POMSnet Falcon EBR analytics dashboards. Founded around its first MES implementation in 1988 and headquartered in Redmond, Washington, POMS sells enterprise software to regulated life-sciences manufacturers rather than publishing a public developer API. Surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio lead, this profile is enriched from the company's public web presence; no public API, OpenAPI, or developer portal was found.

providers.name: PortalOne
providers.description: PortalOne is a hybrid gaming platform that blends mobile games with live, interactive television-style entertainment, letting players compete inside shows and classic titles such as Atari's Breakout. Operated by PortalOne AS (Norway) and PortalOne, Inc. (United States), the company delivers its experience through native iOS and Android apps rather than a public developer platform. It is a consumer-facing entertainment product backed by Seedcamp and other venture investors; as of this profile PortalOne publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Pretzel Therapeutics
providers.description: Pretzel Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company developing first-in-class medicines that target mitochondrial biology and cellular energy regulation. Its pipeline spans neurological, muscular atrophy, metabolic, and rare disease indications, applying novel mitochondrial modulation approaches to conditions driven by dysfunctional cellular energy production. Backed by GV, the company operates as a therapeutics developer and publishes no public API or developer platform; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company record and life-sciences lead.

providers.name: Probably Genetic
providers.description: Probably Genetic is a healthcare company focused on rare disease diagnosis through genetic testing. It offers free targeted genetic testing programs for specific rare conditions (including alpha-mannosidosis, cerebrotendinous xanthomatosis, GRN-FTD, and SYNGAP1-related disorder), insurance-billed testing paired with genetic counselors, at-home saliva/cheek-swab collection kits, and physician-ordered genetic counseling. The platform has served more than 200,000 patients and partners with 50+ patient advocacy groups to advance rare disease research. This is a consumer-facing healthcare provider with no public API or developer program surface.

providers.name: ProGrad
providers.description: ProGrad (prograd.uk) is a UK-based consumer mobile app that lets users earn money by playing games and completing online tasks such as surveys and offers, positioning itself as a leading "make money" app in the United Kingdom. Users choose from a large catalogue of games and micro-tasks, accumulate rewards, and withdraw earnings to PayPal or Visa once they pass a minimum threshold. The company also publishes Gen Z insights and research alongside a consumer blog. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network, ProGrad is a consumer-facing product with no public developer program, API portal, or programmatic surface at this time.

providers.name: Prypco
providers.description: PRYPCO is a Dubai-based PropTech platform building an integrated real estate ecosystem for the United Arab Emirates. Its products include Blocks (fractional property investment starting from AED 500), Mint (blockchain-based tokenized real estate buying, selling, and trading, run in partnership with the Dubai Land Department), Mortgage (instant pre-approval and mortgage comparison), Golden Visa application assistance, a general property buy/sell/rent management service, and One (an agent platform with listing and commission tooling). PRYPCO Real Estate LLC is registered in Dubai, UAE. The company operates a consumer web and mobile product surface and publishes no public developer API; this profile is a company identity record in the API Evangelist network, surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and awaiting any future developer/API surface.

providers.name: Qraved
providers.description: Qraved is Indonesia's leading food discovery platform, self-described as the "No. 1 Food App for Indonesia," helping diners across Jakarta, Bali, Bandung, Surabaya, Medan and other cities explore restaurants, read reviews and dining guides, watch food videos, and connect with a community of food enthusiasts. Backed by 500 Global, Qraved operates a consumer web experience and iOS/Android mobile apps. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification surface.

providers.name: Qualifi
providers.description: Qualifi is a recruiting and hiring platform that streamlines candidate screening through asynchronous, voice-based phone interviews, automated scheduling, and live video interviews. Recruiters send candidates a pre-recorded phone screen, review responses on their own schedule, and move qualified applicants forward faster, reducing time-to-hire while keeping the candidate experience high. Qualifi offers 50+ applicant tracking system (ATS) integrations, a "Qualifi Copilot" that surfaces the tool directly inside your ATS, and Google/Microsoft calendar sync. The company is a Techstars portfolio company and is SOC 2 Type II certified.

providers.name: QueroQuitar
providers.description: QueroQuitar is a Brazilian fintech platform that helps consumers and businesses renegotiate and settle overdue debts online. Through its web and mobile apps it connects users with 50+ creditors (including Santander, Claro, Sky, BV, Inter and Carrefour) to arrange discounted, installment-based payoffs, and participates in Brazil's Desenrola Brasil program. It also offers QueroCredito credit products and QueroSaude health services. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass QueroQuitar exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: QuSecure
providers.description: QuSecure is a post-quantum cybersecurity company whose QuProtect R3 platform helps enterprises and government agencies discover, remediate, and report on cryptographic risk ahead of the quantum-computing threat. The platform pairs Recon (automated inventory of cryptographic assets), Resilience (crypto-agile remediation of encryption without code changes or downtime), and Reporting (Cryptographic Bill of Materials / CBOM for NIST, FIPS, CNSA 2.0, and GDPR compliance). QuSecure serves telecom, defense, finance, and critical-infrastructure customers including Fortune 500 companies and U.S. federal agencies. This profile currently exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Rally
providers.description: Rally (Rally Rd.) is an alternative-asset investing platform that lets everyday investors buy and sell equity shares in individual collectible assets — classic cars, watches, fine art, wine, sports memorabilia, trading cards, and other rare items. Rally sources and authenticates each item, files it with the SEC as a regulated offering, splits it into shares in an Initial Offering, and then opens a Bid/Ask secondary market roughly 90 days later so shareholders can trade. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in New York, Rally runs iOS, Android, and web apps and raised a $30M Series B led by Accel in 2021. Rally publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface; this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Rapido
providers.description: Rapido is an Indian on-demand urban mobility platform that connects riders with independent driver-partners (called "Captains") for bike taxis, auto rickshaws, and cabs through its consumer and Captain mobile apps. Founded in Bengaluru and backed by Accel, Rapido operates across hundreds of Indian cities and has expanded into parcel delivery and corporate mobility. As of this enrichment pass Rapido exposes only a consumer-facing web and app surface — no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification was found. This profile captures the company identity, its published policy and content pages, and a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Raus
