providers.description: Raus (operated by StayRaus GmbH, Berlin) is a consumer platform for booking sustainable, design-forward tiny cabins in nature across Germany and Austria, giving city dwellers a quick escape "close to home." Guests browse and book fully-equipped smart cabins in forests, by lakes, and on farms, add culinary experiences and extras, buy gift cards, and can list their own land as a host. Raus was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a B2C hospitality/booking brand with a public consumer website but no publicly documented API, developer portal, SDKs, or developer documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Rebel Foods
providers.description: Rebel Foods is an Indian cloud-kitchen operator, headquartered in Mumbai, that describes itself as the world's largest chain of internet restaurants. It runs a portfolio of delivery-first food brands — Faasos, Behrouz Biryani, Oven Story, Firangi Bake, The Good Bowl, Sweet Truth, Mandarin Oak, The Biryani Life and Lunch Box — out of a shared network of cloud kitchens, and consolidates them for consumers in the EatSure ordering app. Its internal technology platform, the Rebel Operating System, handles kitchen workflow, inventory, demand forecasting, order routing and logistics, and is offered to third-party restaurant chains through the Rebel Launcher partner programme. That platform is a commercial partnership, not a self-serve developer product: as of this profile Rebel Foods publishes no developer portal, no public API documentation, and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Remedee Labs
providers.description: Remedee Labs is a French medical device company founded in 2016 in Grenoble that develops millimeter-wave neuromodulation solutions for chronic pain management. Its flagship product is the Remedee wrist bracelet, which stimulates nerve endings to trigger endorphin release, paired with the myRemedee companion app and human coaching. The company markets two subscription solutions, FibroRem for fibromyalgia and NoviRem for osteoarthritis pain. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network; the product is consumer-facing and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or technical integration surface at this time.

providers.name: ResortPass
providers.description: ResortPass is a consumer travel and hospitality marketplace that lets people book hotel and resort day passes — pool access, spa treatments, cabanas, fitness centers, and day rooms — at over 2,000 hotels without an overnight stay, starting around $25. Guests search by city and date, book a pass, and enjoy resort amenities for the day, while partner hotels monetize otherwise-idle amenity capacity. Surfaced as a portfolio company of CRV and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal was found during enrichment; the company operates a consumer web/mobile booking product and a hotel partner program.

providers.name: ResourceWise
providers.description: ResourceWise is a market intelligence company for sustainable commodities, delivering data, analytics, pricing benchmarks, forecasts, and consulting across the forest products, pulp and paper, biofuels, and chemicals markets. It was formed by unifying established industry brands including Tecnon OrbiChem, Wood Resources International, Fisher International, Forest2Market, Prima Markets, and Chemical Intelligence under the ResourceWise name. Its subscription platforms include ChemEdge360, FisherSolve, Forestat Global, OrbiChem360, Prima CarbonZero, Recycled Fiber 360, SilvaStat360, and WoodMarket Prices. The company is backed by Battery Ventures. No public API or developer portal is currently published; access is delivered through its SaaS platform logins.

providers.name: Rho
providers.description: Rho is an all-in-one finance platform for businesses that combines business banking, treasury, corporate cards, expense management, bill pay, invoicing, and automated month-end close. Customers get a business checking account with high FDIC sweep insurance, a yield-bearing treasury product, corporate cards with cash back, and zero-fee bill pay, all reconciled against connected accounting systems. Rho serves startups, small businesses, enterprises, accountants, banks, and consumer brands, with no per-seat fees. The platform exposes APIs for use cases such as vendor onboarding and virtual card issuance so partners can embed Rho capabilities into their own portals. Native integrations exist for QuickBooks Online, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.

providers.name: RightHand Robotics
providers.description: RightHand Robotics builds autonomous piece-picking robotic systems for order fulfillment. Its RightPick platform combines computer vision, machine learning, and adaptive grasping hardware to pick and place millions of SKUs at cycle times as fast as three seconds across e-commerce, pharmaceutical, apparel, health & beauty, and grocery operations. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV, Menlo Ventures, and SoftBank Vision Fund. RightHand Robotics does not publish a public web API; integration, deployment, and operator documentation is provided to authorized customers and partners through a login-gated partner portal (rhrdocs.com). The public GitHub organization hosts open-source ROS packages and C control libraries for the earlier ReFlex robotic hand hardware rather than web-API client SDKs.

providers.name: Rippl Care *
providers.description: Rippl (Rippl Care) is a specialty healthcare company delivering value-based, virtual-first behavioral health and dementia care for older adults and their caregivers. Its clinical model spans medication assessments, personalized care plans, counseling, community-resource navigation, and safety guidance, partnering with health systems, providers, and payors. Rippl runs its patient portal on athenahealth and is backed by GV (Google Ventures); it has no public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Ripple Foods
providers.description: Ripple Foods is a plant-based beverage company that manufactures dairy-free milk alternatives made from pea protein, along with protein shakes, kids' milk, barista and coffee creamers, and organic plant-based milk. It sells through retail grocery and a direct-to-consumer Shopify storefront. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) in the frontier-tech sector and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer packaged goods company, Ripple Foods publishes no public developer program, API, or technical documentation; this profile captures its public web and domain-security surface only.

providers.name: Robocurve
providers.description: Robocurve is a San Francisco Public Benefit Corporation (Y Combinator Summer 2026) building open-source tools and independent benchmarks to help society understand what AI and robots can actually do in the physical world. Its flagship framework, Inspect Robots ("the Inspect AI for robotics"), runs any vision-language-action policy on any embodiment against any benchmark with full trace logs and live Rerun visualization, and integrates with ROS, Isaac Lab, and LeRobot. World Evals is its curated catalog of physical-world benchmarks (KitchenBench, DataCenterBench). Everything ships MIT-licensed as Python packages with a command-line interface rather than a hosted REST API.

providers.name: Roomi
providers.description: Roomi is a consumer roommate- and room-rental matching platform that connects verified renters looking for roommates with people posting available rooms, sublets, spare rooms, and monthly rentals across more than 200 cities. The service offers a searchable listing experience with filters for amenities, duration, and property type, roommate verification and ID/background checks, an in-app booking and messaging system, and a safety-check service. Roomi is delivered primarily through free iOS and Android mobile apps and a web experience built on Bubble.io, monetized through premium features such as background checks and listing boosts. It exposes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead of DCM Ventures.

providers.name: Rossignol
providers.description: Rossignol is a French outdoor sports equipment and apparel manufacturer (Rossignol Group), one of the world's best-known makers of alpine skis, cross-country skis, snowboards, bindings, boots, poles, helmets and goggles, alongside a growing range of apparel, footwear, mountain bikes and accessories. Founded in Voiron, France, the company sells direct-to-consumer through localized e-commerce storefronts across 40+ countries and regions. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and added to the API Evangelist network; this pass enriched it as a consumer brand with a public e-commerce presence but no public developer, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Route 92 Medical
providers.description: Route 92 Medical (r92m) is a neurovascular medical device company committed to improving outcomes for stroke and neurovascular patients through revolutionary procedural change. Its portfolio includes the FreeClimb System of access and aspiration catheters (models 54, 70, and 88), the HiPoint Reperfusion System built on the Monopoint Approach (under investigation in the SUMMIT MAX clinical trial), and the Ascent product line. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Route 92 Medical publishes a corporate marketing and clinical-evidence website but exposes no public developer, API, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Rupifi
providers.description: Rupifi is an India-based B2B payments and embedded-credit fintech that lets marketplaces, distributors, and brands offer their SME and retailer buyers a line of credit and Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) at checkout, with flexible 15/30/45/60/90-day repayment terms. Its platform connects three parties — anchors (brands/platforms), merchants (borrowers/retailers), and lenders — through digital onboarding, real-time credit assessment, and embedded B2B checkout. Products include B2B Credit (line of credit) and B2B Checkout, integrated by partners via the Rupifi developer portal and BNPL API.

providers.name: Rwazi
providers.description: Rwazi is a hyper-local market intelligence and Decision AI platform whose product, Sena, combines a company's internal business data with real-world consumer signals from 190+ countries — who is buying what, for how much, from where, when, and why — using consumer activity data, computer vision, zero-party data collection, and 250+ third-party integrations to inform marketing, sales, product, strategy, and growth decisions. Rwazi is a Techstars-backed company added to the API Evangelist network. This profile has been enriched from public web sources; at the time of enrichment Rwazi published no self-service developer API, OpenAPI, or public API reference — onboarding is enterprise, demo-driven, and account-based.

providers.name: Rénibus Therapeutics
providers.description: Rénibus Therapeutics is a privately held clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Southlake, Texas, developing treatments for cardio, renal and metabolic disease. Its pipeline is led by veverimer, a non-absorbed polymer in Phase 3 for metabolic acidosis in chronic kidney disease, and RBT-1 (stannic protoporfin / iron sucrose), a first-in-class intravenous pharmacologic preconditioning agent given 24-48 hours before non-emergent cardiac surgery to reduce post-operative complications, which holds FDA Breakthrough Therapy and Fast Track designations and completed the pivotal Phase 3 PROTECT trial. The company publishes a corporate marketing site, a news and events feed, an expanded access policy and patient information, but operates no developer program, public API, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Salvo Health
providers.description: Salvo Health is a virtual care company delivering continuous gastrointestinal and metabolic care through integrated, tech-enabled clinical teams. Its platform pairs registered dietitians, licensed nurses, and behavioral health specialists with a patient mobile app and remote patient monitoring to manage conditions including IBS, obesity, GLP-1/anti-obesity therapy, and fatty liver disease (MASH/MASLD). Adherence data and monthly patient reports are integrated directly into provider EHR systems. Salvo Health is a portfolio company of Threshold Ventures. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this record captures its public identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Sandbox VR
providers.description: Sandbox VR is a location-based virtual reality entertainment company operating full-body, free-roam VR experiences for groups of friends, families, and corporate teams across 60+ venues in North America, Europe, and Asia. Guests play social, multiplayer VR adventures — horror, action, sports, and family-friendly titles including licensed properties — using motion-tracked suits and headsets. The business spans company-owned and franchised locations, online booking, gift cards, parties/events, and an unlimited-pass subscription. Backed by a16z and Craft Ventures. Sandbox VR is a consumer entertainment operator and, as of this profile, publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this record captures the company identity and its public web/security posture.

providers.name: Sano
providers.description: Sano Genetics is a UK-based precision-medicine company operating a 360-degree platform that connects the workflows behind decentralized clinical trials and research studies. Its services span patient recruitment and outreach, protocol and study design, digital prescreening and consent, electronic medical record retrieval, at-home DNA testing with genetic counseling, participant engagement portals, and biomarker testing programs. The platform helps pharmaceutical sponsors and research teams find, engage, and retain the right participants for genetically-informed studies. Surfaced as a Seedcamp portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API is published at this time.

providers.name: Sarla Aviation
providers.description: Sarla Aviation is an Indian advanced air mobility company building electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft for urban transportation. Its flagship flying taxi, Shunya, uses a hybrid-electric propulsion system (seven electric units, dual battery packs, and a sustainable aviation fuel tank) to reach up to 250 km/h with a range up to 800 km and 150 km fully electric, in cabin configurations spanning 6-seat, 4-seat, cargo, and ambulance variants. Founded by former Lilium engineers Rakesh Gaonkar and Adrian Schmidt, the company is a portfolio company of Accel. The public website exposes no developer, API, or technical integration surface as of this enrichment pass; this profile captures corporate identity, legal, and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Saucey
providers.description: Saucey is an on-demand alcohol delivery service that brings beer, wine, and spirits from local retailers to customers' doors, often in under an hour, across a growing list of US markets. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Los Angeles, the company operates consumer iOS, Android, and web ordering experiences, a Saucey Club membership offering free delivery and perks, and a retailer/brand partnership program. Saucey is backed by 500 Global and Bullpen Capital. This profile tracks Saucey in the API Evangelist network; as of this enrichment pass Saucey publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Science 37 *
providers.description: Science 37 operates a decentralized, direct-to-patient clinical research platform — the first and only FDA-inspected direct-to-patient site — that delivers clinical trials to participants wherever they are. Its Metasite and Agile Clinical Trial operating model combine patient recruitment, research-grade nursing, telemedicine, eConsent, ePRO, wearable/device integration, and EHR data capture into a single end-to-end SaaS platform used by sponsors and CROs. Backed by GV and Lux Capital, the company has supported 200+ trials across many therapeutic areas. No public developer portal or API surface was found during enrichment (developer./api.science37.com do not resolve); this profile captures identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Senken
providers.description: Senken (Senken GmbH, Berlin) is a carbon credit procurement marketplace and advisory for European enterprises. It curates high-integrity carbon credits by scoring climate projects across 600+ data points with its Sustainability Integrity Index (SII), aligned to the Oxford Offsetting Principles and ICVCM Core Carbon Principles, rejecting roughly 95% of available credits. Products span advisory (CSRD, SBTi, CDP compliance), vetted procurement, audit-ready documentation (Champion's Kit), the SBTi 2035 Reserve carbon-removal supply, an OER portfolio, and free self-serve tools at tools.senken.io (checkout, portfolio calculator, OER calculator, EU greenwashing auditor). Clients include Vodafone, Deutsche Telekom, DZ Bank, and Union Investment. No public developer API is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Service Corp International
providers.description: Service Corporation International (NYSE: SCI), headquartered in Houston, Texas, is North America's leading provider of deathcare products and services, owning and operating funeral homes and cemeteries across the United States and Canada. SCI markets its network under the Dignity Memorial brand, alongside Neptune Society and National Cremation, and sells funeral and cemetery services on both an at-need and a preneed basis. It publishes no developer program, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Set Scouter
providers.description: Set Scouter is a location-scouting marketplace, built by former producers, that connects film, television, commercial, and branded-content productions with residential and commercial filming locations across North America. Producers browse film-ready spaces — kitchens, lofts, warehouses, mansions and more — arrange in-person scouts, and book online with payments, deposits and overtime handled by the platform, while property owners list their spaces to earn income from productions. The company operates from offices in Toronto and Los Angeles, serving markets including Toronto, New York, Los Angeles, Miami, Chicago, Vancouver, Montreal and Atlanta.

providers.name: Shohoz
providers.description: Shohoz (Shohoj Limited) is a Bangladeshi consumer technology platform and digital super-app, billed as Bangladesh's largest online ticket destination. Founded in 2014 as an online ticketing service, it lets users book bus, train, air, launch (ferry), event, and movie tickets from its website and mobile apps, and expanded into ride-hailing (car and motorbike), on-demand delivery, and other everyday services. The company reports 10M+ users, 250M+ tickets sold, and 1,000+ transport and merchant partners across 3,000+ routes. Shohoz is a technology-first business but does not publish a public developer program, API reference, SDKs, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Shopeando
providers.description: Shopeando is a Mexican technology and logistics startup that manages the full international shipping process, enabling businesses and individuals to import and export merchandise between China, Europe, the United States and Mexico. Through its platform it coordinates cross-border logistics, customs handling and last-mile delivery, and provides dedicated import, export and e-commerce fulfillment services for online stores. Shopeando is backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: ShopLook
providers.description: ShopLook is a consumer fashion discovery and outfit-creation platform where a community of over two million creators design and share outfit ideas on a drag-and-drop styling canvas. Everyday shoppers browse the feed, follow designers, and shop expertly designed looks for any occasion, body type, and budget across the web (shoplook.io) and native iOS and Android apps, with an AI personal stylist and a rewards model that pays creators for outfits that inspire purchases. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Siren
providers.description: Siren is a digital health company that makes temperature-monitoring smart socks to prevent diabetic foot ulcers. The seamless, machine-washable socks require no charging or smartphone; embedded sensors continuously track foot temperature to detect the early inflammation that precedes an ulcer, and licensed nurses review the data and alert the patient's healthcare provider. Siren pairs the hardware with a remote patient monitoring service billed through providers and payers, and operates as a HIPAA-regulated healthcare business rather than a developer platform. It is backed by 500 Global and DCM Ventures. As surveyed for the API Evangelist network, Siren publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Skiptown
providers.description: Skiptown is a modern pet-care company operating premium dog daycare, boarding, grooming, and walking services alongside its signature Dog Bar & Park — an indoor/outdoor social club where owners enjoy craft cocktails and coffee while dogs play off-leash. Backed by Techstars, Skiptown runs company-owned locations in Charlotte, Atlanta, and Denver and offers franchise expansion opportunities. Its consumer experience is delivered through a mobile app for booking, curbside dropoff, and daily photo updates. Skiptown does not currently publish a public API or developer platform; this profile captures its public web and security posture.

providers.name: Sleep Number
providers.description: Sleep Number Corporation (NASDAQ: SNBR) designs, manufactures, and retails smart adjustable-firmness beds and sleep-wellness products, sold through an omnichannel US retail model. Its Sleep Number 360 smart beds run the proprietary SleepIQ operating system, which captures biometric sleep data each night and returns actionable insights to improve sleep health. Sleep Number does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; the SleepIQ platform is a closed, undocumented backend consumed only by the first-party mobile and web apps. The community has reverse-engineered unofficial SleepIQ client libraries (Python, Go, PHP), but these are not first-party and are not endorsed by Sleep Number. This profile was surfaced as a legacy portfolio lead of Norwest Venture Partners and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: SmartAsset
providers.description: SmartAsset is a financial technology company that runs the largest online marketplace connecting consumers with fiduciary financial advisors. Its SmartAdvisor matching service pairs more than 50,000 retail investors each month with up to three vetted advisors based on geography, investable assets, and preferences, while the SmartAsset Advisor Marketing Platform (AMP) delivers advisors a subscription stream of qualified referrals plus lead automation that syncs into their CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot, Wealthbox, Redtail, Zoho, Pipedrive, SmartOffice). SmartAsset also publishes a large library of consumer personal-finance calculators and editorial content across taxes, retirement, mortgages, investing, and banking. Backed by a16z and Y Combinator, SmartAsset is a lead-generation and media business and does not currently expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Snout
providers.description: Snout provides affordable veterinary wellness subscription plans that help pet owners access preventive and routine care without financial stress, while enabling veterinary clinics to increase visit frequency and revenue. Clinics offer monthly membership plans covering unlimited exams and preventative care tailored to each pet's life stage (puppy, adult, senior), and receive upfront payment at the time of service. Snout supports partner practices with dedicated Clinic Success Managers, custom marketing, and staff training, serving 2,500+ providers nationwide. Backed by 500 Global. No public API, developer portal, or developer documentation was found during enrichment.

providers.name: SPR Therapeutics
providers.description: SPR Therapeutics, Inc. is a Cleveland, Ohio medical device company that develops and commercializes the SPRINT Peripheral Nerve Stimulation (PNS) System, a non-opioid, minimally invasive percutaneous therapy for chronic and acute pain. SPRINT is the only percutaneous PNS device FDA-cleared for both chronic and acute pain that does not require permanent implantation: leads are placed in an outpatient procedure without surgery, incisions or anesthesia and deliver up to 60 days of therapy. The company was acquired by Medtronic plc on 2026-07-16 for $650 million and now operates within the Medtronic Neuromodulation Operating Unit. SPR is a device manufacturer rather than a software vendor: it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract. Its only software surfaces are the consumer SPRINT PNS Patient App and the credentialed SPRcare provider reimbursement portal, neither of which exposes a public integration.

providers.name: SPT Labtech
providers.description: SPT Labtech is a life-sciences laboratory-automation company headquartered near Cambridge, UK, that designs and manufactures instruments and consumables to accelerate drug discovery and life-science research. Its portfolio spans liquid handling (firefly, mosquito, dragonfly, apricot), sample preparation (chameleon for cryo-EM and Quantifoil supports), and sample management and storage (comPOUND, comPACT, arktic, lab2lab, and BioMicroLab). With 400+ employees across seven global locations and 30+ products, SPT Labtech serves pharmaceutical, biotech, and academic laboratories. It is a portfolio company of Battery Ventures. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a company lead; SPT Labtech is a hardware and instrumentation vendor and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Stel
providers.description: Stel Life provides cellular-connected remote patient monitoring (RPM) infrastructure for healthcare. Its cellular-enabled vitals hubs and connected medical devices — blood pressure monitors, pulse oximeters, glucometers, thermometers, and scales — let patients transmit vital-sign readings to electronic health record (EHR) systems without WiFi, broadband, a smartphone, or app setup, targeting elderly, low-income, rural, and low-tech-literacy populations. Health systems and digital health organizations use Stel across the care continuum, from wellness and chronic-care management to hospital-at-home. Stel is backed by Bloomberg Beta.

providers.name: Stockeld Dreamery
providers.description: Stockeld Dreamery is a Swedish food-tech company founded in Stockholm in early 2019 by Sorosh Tavakoli (previously founder of the video-advertising company Videoplaza) to reinvent animal-based staples as plant-based alternatives, starting with cheese. The company develops and manufactures fermented, legume-based cultured cheese products — including a cream cheese and a melting cheese aimed at foodservice — as a sustainable substitute for dairy. Backed by venture investors including Creandum and Northzone, Stockeld Dreamery operates as a consumer packaged-goods brand and does not currently publish a public API or developer program.

providers.name: Sukino
providers.description: Sukino Healthcare is a Bangalore, India-based continuum-of-care provider specializing in post-hospitalization recovery, rehabilitation, and transitional care for seniors and patients with chronic and neurological conditions. Founded by Rajinish Menon, it operates in-patient continuum care centers alongside home healthcare services, covering neuro, stroke, and knee-replacement rehabilitation, transitional care, and palliative care. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network, Sukino is a healthcare services operator and publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification at this time; this profile captures its identity and web presence for network discovery.

providers.name: SunPower
providers.description: SunPower is a residential solar energy company (Nasdaq: SPWR) that designs, installs, and finances solar systems and battery storage for homeowners. The original SunPower Corporation filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in August 2024; its assets were acquired by Complete Solaria in September 2024, which rebranded as SunPower Inc. in April 2025. SunPower maintains the GitHub org github.com/SunPower, hosting open-source solar modeling tools including pvfactors (view-factor model for bifacial PV modeling), PVMismatch (mismatch loss calculations), and SolarUtils. These Python libraries are used by solar energy professionals and researchers for photovoltaic system modeling and simulation.

providers.name: Super Evil Megacorp
providers.description: Super Evil Megacorp is an award-winning independent video game studio building shared, cross-platform gaming experiences that push creative and technical boundaries. Founded in 2012, the studio is best known for the mobile MOBA Vainglory and has since shipped titles including Catalyst Black, TMNT Splintered Fate, and Blood Line - Rebel Moon, developed on its own in-house game engine. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and Index Ventures; it is a consumer games studio and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Sweatcoin
providers.description: Sweatcoin is a health-and-fitness app that converts a user's physical steps and movement into a digital currency ("sweatcoins") that can be redeemed for gadgets, subscriptions, travel vouchers, charity donations, and cryptocurrency. Its proprietary movement-validation algorithms count outdoor steps while, the company states, not selling location data. Sweatcoin reports being a top-3 health & fitness app worldwide with tens of millions of users across 180+ countries, and partners with brands and organizations (NHS, Apple, Amazon and 600+ others) through sponsored challenges, clubs, boosts and an affiliate marketplace. The team also launched the Sweat Economy ($SWEAT), a NEAR-Protocol "movement economy" token, and the Sweat Wallet app, turning tracked movement into on-chain digital value. Sweatcoin exposes no public REST/OpenAPI developer surface; integration is via partner and marketplace programs and the SWEAT on-chain token.

providers.name: SwipeRx
providers.description: SwipeRx (operated by mClinica Pte. Ltd., formerly mClinica Pharmacy Solutions) is the leading community and B2B commerce platform for pharmacies across Southeast Asia. Delivered as a mobile application, it connects a network of more than 300,000 pharmacy professionals and 50,000 retail pharmacies in Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam, Thailand and Cambodia. The platform combines professional networking, accredited continuing professional development (CPD) education, industry news, a drug directory, adverse-event reporting, and B2B medicine purchasing (the Belanja marketplace) into a single app that digitizes a historically fragmented pharmacy supply chain. SwipeRx publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal; its api.swiperxapp.com host is an undocumented private backend serving the mobile app.

providers.name: Symbiotic
providers.description: Symbiotic is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of paradigm and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: crypto-defi. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Synapticure
providers.description: Synapticure is a virtual-first telehealth company delivering comprehensive, specialist neurology care for people living with neurodegenerative and complex neurological conditions, including ALS/PLS, Parkinson's, Alzheimer's, dementia, Huntington's, and multiple sclerosis. Founded in 2021 by ALS patient Brian Wallach and caregiver Sandra Abrevaya, the company integrates 24/7 access to neurologists, behavioral health (psychiatry and therapy), care coordination, genetic testing, clinical-trial navigation, and insurance support into a single virtual care experience available in all 50 states and covered by most insurance. It is accredited by The Joint Commission and maintains AICPA SOC 2 compliance. Synapticure operates as a healthcare provider and does not publish a public developer program or API; this profile was surfaced as a GV portfolio company and enriched with real, published identity and security signals.

providers.name: Tactile Games
providers.description: Tactile Games is a Danish mobile game studio headquartered in Copenhagen, founded in 2014, that builds and publishes casual free-to-play puzzle titles for iOS and Android. Its portfolio includes Lily's Garden, Penny & Flo, Makeover Match, the Cookie Cats series (Cookie Cats, Cookie Cats Pop, Cookie Cats Blast), and the Simon's Cat games. Tactile is a portfolio company of Index Ventures. It is a consumer game publisher rather than an API producer: it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal, so this profile captures the company identity, public web properties, and domain-security posture surfaced by the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Talkspace
providers.description: Talkspace is a New York City-based online behavioral healthcare company founded in 2012 by Oren Frank and Roni Frank that delivers virtual therapy, psychiatry, and medication management through video, voice, messaging, and live chat. The platform connects users with licensed therapists and psychiatric providers across all 50 U.S. states, covering more than 150 mental health conditions including anxiety, depression, ADHD, bipolar disorder, OCD, PTSD, insomnia, postpartum depression, and substance use. Service lines include individual therapy for adults, teen therapy (ages 13-17), couples therapy, psychiatry with prescription management, and specialized programs for LGBTQIA+, military/veteran, and senior populations, plus the women's mental health program Chapters. Talkspace is in-network with major payers such as Aetna, Anthem, Cigna, Optum, Blue Cross Blue Shield, TRICARE, and Medicare, and sells B2B solutions (Talkspace for Business) to employers, payers, benefit consultants, educational institutions, and government agencies. The company markets Precision Therapy, an internal machine-learning and NLP system used to match members to providers and surface clinical signal. Talkspace went public on NASDAQ under ticker TALK on June 23, 2021 via a SPAC merger with Hudson Executive Investment Corp, and was acquired by Universal Health Services on March 9, 2026. Talkspace does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or open-source repository; integrations with payers, EAPs, and benefits platforms are delivered through private partnership channels, and the platform is HIPAA, HITECH, and GDPR compliant.

providers.name: Taylor & Hart
providers.description: Taylor & Hart is a luxury bespoke jewellery company specialising in custom engagement rings and wedding bands, crafted made-to-order in London with showrooms in London and New York. The company pairs an in-house design team with in-person and virtual consultations, ethical gemstone and diamond sourcing, and a customer-led custom design experience. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As a direct-to-consumer luxury retail business, Taylor & Hart publishes a public website, blog, and standard legal pages, but exposes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or webhook/event surface at this time; this profile captures its public web and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Terray Therapeutics
providers.description: Terray Therapeutics is an AI-native, chemistry-first biotechnology company building an integrated full-stack platform for small molecule drug discovery. Its EMMI platform (Experimentation Meets Machine Intelligence) pairs a proprietary ultra-miniaturized microarray assay system and fully automated lab with a family of machine learning models: COATI, a chemistry foundation model trained on roughly a billion molecules that encodes molecules into a latent space; reinforcement-learning generative models for synthesizable de novo design; TerraBind for potency prediction; and EMMI Select for uncertainty-aware molecule selection. Terray reports a proprietary target-molecule interaction dataset of more than 17 billion measurements growing by about a billion per quarter, and runs multi-target discovery collaborations with Bristol Myers Squibb, Gilead, Calico and Odyssey Therapeutics, with investment from NVIDIA. Terray publishes several of its research code libraries as open source on GitHub (COATI, COATI-LDM, TerraMax) but operates no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Tessera Labs
providers.description: Tessera Labs is an AI-native enterprise software company building a governed, multi-agent AI platform that automates complex ERP and business-system transformations, compressing SAP ECC-to-S/4HANA migrations and broader modernization work from years to weeks. The platform orchestrates data, process, and code changes across ERP, CRM, HCM, and finance systems (SAP, Salesforce, Workday, Oracle) with enterprise governance, full audit trails, and traceability, letting business teams describe requirements in natural language. Founded by AI researchers and enterprise-software veterans and backed by a $60M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz. Tessera Labs currently exposes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs; it is a sales-led enterprise platform.

providers.name: Textsidekick
providers.description: Textsidekick (Sidekick) is a Y Combinator-backed (S26) workforce communication and knowledge-management platform built for frontline workers who do not have a desk. Workers text a question or report an issue over plain SMS with no app to install and no login; Sidekick triages the message, answers from company knowledge, converts issues into work orders, routes them to the right person, and captures every fix as searchable organizational knowledge. It also AI-generates safety procedures, handbooks, and FAQs, schedules preventive maintenance, and delivers text-based onboarding and training. Founded to serve the roughly 80% of American workers without a desk, it is live across 20+ plants serving 600+ frontline workers. No public developer API, SDK, or API reference is published at this time.

providers.name: TheSkimm
providers.description: TheSkimm is a digital media company founded in 2012 that curates news, lifestyle, money, career, and wellness content for a primarily female audience, delivered through email newsletters (the flagship Daily Skimm, plus Well Played, Skimm Well + Good, and Skimm Shopping), a mobile app, podcasts, and shopping guides. It is now part of Everyday Health, Inc., a Ziff Davis company. TheSkimm operates as a consumer media and audience business rather than an API provider: it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications. This API Evangelist profile was seeded as a portfolio lead of GV (Google Ventures) and enriched with the company's public identity, link properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Thrive Causemetics
providers.description: Thrive Causemetics is a direct-to-consumer, cause-driven beauty brand selling cosmetics (makeup) under the Thrive Causemetics label and skincare under its Bigger Than Beauty Skincare line. The company operates a Shopify-based e-commerce storefront with a loyalty/rewards program, subscriptions, and referral offers, and donates products and funds to charitable partners with every purchase. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Trinity Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Thrive Causemetics publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine discovery surface; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Tigermed
providers.description: Tigermed (Hangzhou Tigermed Consulting Co., Ltd.) is a leading global contract research organization (CRO) providing integrated drug and medical device development services across the full clinical lifecycle. Its capabilities span preclinical development (medicinal chemistry, compound screening, toxicology, and bioanalytical services), clinical development (medical writing, clinical monitoring, regulatory affairs, and data management), and integrated services including central laboratories, pharmacovigilance, medical imaging, quality assurance, and real-world and post-marketing studies. The company reports 11,000+ global employees, 180+ offices and locations, and 4,000+ customers, supporting the development of 170+ innovative drugs. Tigermed was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer, API, or technical platform surface.

providers.name: Travelio
providers.description: Travelio is one of Indonesia's largest online property rental and management platforms, operated by PT Horizon Internusa Persada. It lists furnished and unfurnished apartments, houses, villas, guest houses, and hotel residences for daily, monthly, and yearly rental across 15+ Indonesian cities including Jakarta, Bandung, Surabaya, Bali, and Yogyakarta, and offers hospitality-grade property management for owners. Backed by 500 Global, Travelio runs consumer web and mobile apps but publishes no public developer API, SDK, partner integration surface, or developer portal as of this profile.

providers.name: Truly Experiences
providers.description: Truly Experiences is a UK-based experiential gifting company that curates and sells memorable experiences as gifts rather than physical products. Its catalog spans dining, spa treatments, drinks tastings, activities, masterclasses, travel getaways, and premium "dreams come true" experiences, organized by recipient, occasion, price point, and UK location (London, Edinburgh, Birmingham, Manchester and beyond). After checkout customers receive an e-certificate with a unique code, and a concierge team arranges the booking date and time. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass it operates a consumer e-commerce storefront with no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: TuneCore
providers.description: TuneCore is a Brooklyn, New York based independent music distribution and publishing administration company founded in 2006 (as YourTunes, Inc., rebranded TuneCore in 2008) and acquired by French music company Believe in 2015. TuneCore lets self-releasing artists and labels deliver recorded music to 150+ digital stores and streaming services — Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music, YouTube Music, TikTok, Tidal, Deezer, Beatport, and others — while retaining 100% of their rights and master ownership, in exchange for a flat annual distribution fee starting at $24.99/year for unlimited releases. TuneCore Publishing Administration registers compositions with performance rights organizations, mechanical rights societies, and digital service providers worldwide to collect songwriter royalties, sync, and neighboring rights income. Additional services include the TuneCore Accelerator artist development program, TuneCore Social (monetization on TikTok, Reels, and Shorts), TuneCore Direct Advance (royalty-backed capital, powered by RoyFi), mastering, and Splits for collaborator revenue sharing. TuneCore operates across 5 continents with local teams in 15+ countries through Believe's global network. There is no current public TuneCore developer API, SDK, or partner portal — an earlier white-label REST/XML "TuneCore Direct" partner API existed circa 2008-2012 (with a community Ruby gem `tunecore_direct`) but is no longer actively documented or promoted. TuneCore's public-facing surface is the artist web app at web.tunecore.com and the support/help center; any current B2B integrations run through Believe's enterprise partnerships.

providers.name: UrbanMetry
providers.description: UrbanMetry is a Malaysia-based big data analytics firm specialising in geospatial and urban intelligence for the property and real estate sector. It supports developers, financial institutions, government bodies, retailers, and public transport operators with property market intelligence, geo-behavioural analytics, and branch location analysis, alongside consumer products UrbanVault (multi-bank mortgage applications, in beta) and UrbanWave (home co-ownership and renovation funding). A World Economic Forum Technology Pioneer, UrbanMetry publishes no public developer API, but its website exposes a live Wix Site MCP endpoint and llms.txt for agentic access to public site content.

providers.name: Viewlocity
providers.description: Viewlocity Technologies Pty Ltd is a supply chain management software company that provides supply chain visibility, control tower, and execution solutions for global manufacturers, distributors, and logistics providers. Its solution set spans supply chain design, inventory and asset management, supply chain management, logistics and transportation, planning and production, order lifecycle management, and supplier management, delivered as SaaS and managed services to industries including aerospace and defense, automotive and industrial, consumer goods, high tech and electronics, manufacturing, retail, and third-party logistics. Viewlocity publishes a corporate marketing and resource website but does not expose a public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specifications.

providers.name: Vita Inclinata
providers.description: Vita Inclinata Technologies is a Colorado-based hardware company that builds physics-based load stabilization systems for helicopter hoists and construction cranes, eliminating the dangerous spin and sway of suspended loads. Its ecosystem spans Vita Aerospace (helicopter and rescue hoist stabilization), Vita Industrial (crane and construction load control), Air Rescue Systems (hoist training and products), and the Vita Rescue System used in military MEDEVAC operations. The company is Techstars-backed. It was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and added to the API Evangelist network; as a physical-hardware manufacturer it currently publishes no public developer API, SDK, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: Vividion Therapeutics
providers.description: Vividion Therapeutics is a San Diego-based clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company that discovers and develops precision small-molecule medicines for previously undruggable disease targets. Its proprietary chemoproteomics platform pairs covalent chemistry with proteome-wide screening to map druggable pockets across the human proteome, driving a pipeline in oncology and immunology (including VVD-214, a WRN helicase inhibitor for MSI-high cancers). Vividion was acquired by Bayer in 2021 and operates as an independent subsidiary. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund; this profile has been enriched and carries no public developer or API surface (a corporate/scientific website only).

providers.name: VivorCare
providers.description: OncoveryCare (VivorCare) is the first virtual survivorship clinic for people living with and beyond cancer. Backed by Techstars, the company pairs survivorship-trained care teams with a virtual-first platform delivering physical and mental health support, personalized survivorship care planning, patient navigation to community resources and referrals, and survivor education. It partners with oncology providers such as New York Cancer & Blood Specialists (NYCBS) to extend post-treatment care. OncoveryCare operates a public website and blog but currently publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Vongi Health (芝兰健康)
providers.description: Vongi Health (芝兰健康, Hangzhou Zhilan Health Co., Ltd., also branded Slan Health) is a Qiming Venture Partners-backed Chinese digital therapeutics company founded in Hangzhou in 2015. Its hepatitis B mother-to-child transmission prevention digital therapeutic (小贝壳) was the first digital therapeutic certified by China's NMPA, and it also operates a sleep specialty (CBT-I) digital therapeutics platform and a DTx CDMO business covering product R&D, clinical research, regulatory registration, and commercial operations. The company publishes no public API or developer surface.

providers.name: Well
providers.description: Well is a personalized health engagement platform for employers and their workforce, marketed as "your personalized daily health partner." It pairs an AI-driven health engine that delivers tailored interventions and behavior-change nudges with human "Well Guides," across a mobile and web experience, and ties outcomes to a performance-based ROI guarantee for the sponsoring employer. Well powers wellness programs, health challenges, biometric screenings, premium reductions, and rewards for large employer and benefits clients including Bank of America, USAA, Sam's Club, UNC Health, MGM, Regions, Amentum, and Octapharma. The company is backed by General Catalyst and was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead; enrichment found a public WordPress marketing/campaign presence at well.co but no public developer API, SDKs, documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: WINT
providers.description: WINT (also styled Wint) is an AI-powered water management and leak-detection platform for commercial and industrial facilities. Its IoT flow sensors, automated shut-off valves, and 24/7 staffed monitoring center use signal processing and anomaly detection to catch leaks in real time across main feeds, domestic cold and hot water, HVAC loops, cooling towers, and irrigation systems, reporting 20-25% average water-consumption reduction and up to 90% less water damage and insurance loss. WINT is backed by Insight Partners and carries NSF International, ISO, and USGBC affiliations. During enrichment no public developer API, documentation, well-known discovery surface, OpenAPI, or SDK was found; this profile captures the company's public web properties and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Withco
providers.description: Withco, now operating as With at with.us (the original with.co domain 301-redirects there), is rebuilding main street one share at a time. The company helps small business owners buy the commercial buildings they operate in, stacking the owner's investment, seller financing, and community investor capital to meet the deal price, grounding offers in comparable sales, and giving each business a public investor page to tell its story to potential backers. Withco is a consumer/community real-estate platform and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Zai Lab
providers.description: Zai Lab is an innovative, research-based, commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company based in China and the United States, founded in 2014 with headquarters in Cambridge, Massachusetts and Shanghai. The company discovers, develops, and commercializes transformative medicines for conditions with significant unmet patient needs across oncology, immunology, neuroscience, and infectious disease. As a fully integrated biopharma, Zai Lab spans early-stage discovery through development, regulatory approval, manufacturing, and commercialization. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of HongShan and Qiming Venture Partners. Zai Lab publishes a corporate and investor web presence but exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Zenyum
providers.description: Zenyum is a Singapore-founded, direct-to-consumer oral-care and dental company operating across Asia. Its flagship product is ZenyumClear invisible braces (clear aligners) delivered through a network of partner clinics, alongside a broader oral-care line that includes ZenyumSonic electric toothbrushes, ZenyumBright whitening strips, serums and pens, toothpastes, water flossers and floss. Zenyum sells online and through retail across Singapore, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam and Japan, and is backed by venture investors including Partech. As of this profile the company operates consumer e-commerce and clinic-partner surfaces but publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or GitHub organization; this record captures its verifiable public web and domain security footprint.

providers.name: 01health
providers.description: 01Health is a UK-based health technology company building clinical infrastructure that lets specialist healthcare be delivered safely inside community and dental clinics rather than only in hospitals. Founded in 2022 by Dr Sonia Szamocki, its platform centralizes patient acquisition, clinical protocols, remote specialist oversight, treatment workflows, procurement, and financial management into a single system, currently spanning orthodontics (32Co) and sleep medicine (Aerox). 01Health is backed by Balderton Capital, Gresham House Ventures, Eka Ventures, and Wavemaker360. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal has been published to date; this profile captures the company identity and the security posture of its public web surface.

providers.name: Aalo Atomics
providers.description: Aalo Atomics is an Austin, Texas-based advanced nuclear engineering company, founded in 2021, working to make reactor deployment fast, repeatable, and economical through factory manufacturing. It is developing the Aalo-1, a factory-fabricated sodium-cooled microreactor (~10 MWe class), and Aalo Pod power plants that combine five Aalo-1 reactors to deliver roughly 50 megawatts of electricity for data centers, industrial facilities, and communities. The company describes a new XMR ("extra modular reactor") category, has raised a $100M Series B, and is advancing through U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission pre-application activities and a U.S. Department of Energy experimental microreactor site in Idaho. This API Evangelist profile tracks Aalo Atomics as a company in the network; the company does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Advano
providers.description: Advano is a New Orleans, Louisiana battery-materials company that develops silicon-based anode materials for lithium-ion batteries. Spun out of Tulane University in 2016 and backed by 25+ patents, its flagship REALSi silicon-carbon composite is engineered as a drop-in replacement for graphite anodes, delivering up to 9x the energy density of graphite for electric vehicles, consumer electronics, defense, and grid energy storage. Advano's process avoids hazardous silane gas, uses abundant metallurgical-grade silicon, and runs on existing manufacturing equipment. The company operates a pilot plant in New Orleans East and is scaling toward 3,000 tons of REALSi in 2026 and 20,000 tons by 2030. This is a physical deep-tech manufacturer with no public API or developer platform; it is catalogued in the API Evangelist network as a VC portfolio company profile.

providers.name: Aiko Solar
providers.description: Aiko Solar (Zhejiang Aiko Solar Energy Co.) is a solar photovoltaic manufacturer specializing in high-efficiency solar cells and modules, best known for its ABC (All Back Contact) module technology for residential, commercial, industrial, and utility-scale applications. A BloombergNEF Tier 1 manufacturer, the company reports 200 GW+ accumulative cell and module shipments and mass-production cell efficiency around 25%. This is a hardware manufacturer with no public developer or API surface; the profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Airhelp
providers.description: AirHelp is a passenger-rights platform that helps air travelers claim compensation for delayed, cancelled, and overbooked flights under regulations such as EU 261, UK 261, and similar laws worldwide. It handles the full claims process on a "no win, no fee" basis, managing paperwork, airline negotiations, and legal escalation on the passenger's behalf, and offers an AirHelp+ membership adding fast-track claims, flight-disruption assistance, and airport lounge access. AirHelp operates a consumer web funnel and mobile apps plus a network of travel-brand, corporate, and affiliate partnerships, but does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or client SDKs; its GitHub organization hosts internal engineering tooling rather than API client libraries. This profile was seeded as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from AirHelp's public web surface.

providers.name: Alleviant Medical
providers.description: Alleviant Medical, Inc. is a clinical-stage medical device company headquartered in Austin, Texas, founded in 2017 to develop minimally invasive, transcatheter therapies for heart failure. The Alleviant System is an investigational, no-implant approach that creates a small interatrial passageway to relieve elevated left atrial pressure without leaving a permanent device behind; it holds U.S. FDA Breakthrough Device designation for both preserved and reduced ejection fraction heart failure and is under study in the FDA-approved ALLAY-HF and ALLAY-HFrEF pivotal trials. The company has raised roughly $164M across a $75M round led by S3 Ventures and RiverVest Venture Partners and a $90M round led by Gilde Healthcare with Omega Funds, Vensana Capital, Longview Ventures, Gilmartin Capital and the TMC Venture Fund. Alleviant is a device and clinical-trial business, not a software business: it publishes no developer portal, no public API, no SDK and no machine-readable specification, and its public web surface is limited to clinician, patient-education, investor and press material.

providers.name: Alloy Therapeutics
providers.description: Alloy Therapeutics is a biotechnology ecosystem company operating as a Product Development Organization that partners across discovery, preclinical, and clinical development. It combines proprietary AI/ML, real-world data, and tech-enabled scientific services across multiple therapeutic modalities, including monoclonal and bispecific antibodies, TCR mimics, genetic medicines (cyclic RNA and oligonucleotide design), and cell-therapy pharmacology. Alloy is known for its transgenic antibody-discovery platforms (the ATX-Gx mouse series) and licenses reagents, platforms, and services to pharmaceutical and biotech partners rather than exposing a public developer API. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Amogy
providers.description: Amogy is an energy-technology company decarbonizing hard-to-electrify sectors by converting energy-dense ammonia into dispatchable, zero-carbon electricity. Its AMMDrive power systems crack ammonia into hydrogen and nitrogen and convert the hydrogen to power for data centers, industrial facilities, microgrids, and maritime vessels, and it develops proprietary low-temperature ammonia-cracking catalysts. Backed by DCVC and other investors, Amogy has demonstrated the world's first carbon-free ammonia-powered maritime vessel and partners with firms such as Samsung Heavy Industries and Mitsubishi. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Amogy publishes no public developer API surface at this time, so this record captures its corporate identity and public web properties rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: AMSC
providers.description: American Superconductor Corporation (AMSC) is a power control systems company headquartered in Ayer, Massachusetts, and traded publicly on NASDAQ under the ticker AMSC. The company designs and delivers grid and power-electronics solutions across three specialties - power supply, power protection, and power innovation - serving the energy, renewables, utility, industrial, materials, and military sectors. Its offerings span grid capacity and resiliency systems, renewable generation integration, industrial process power control, and shipboard power protection for naval defense. AMSC is an early Battery Ventures portfolio investment. AMSC does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures the company's corporate identity and domain security posture within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Anthro Energy
providers.description: Anthro Energy is a battery materials company based in Alameda, California, developing next-generation electrolyte technology for lithium-ion and next-gen battery cells. Its flagship Proteus platform is a drop-in electrolyte that increases energy density, improves safety, and adds mechanical integrity without requiring changes to existing gigafactory manufacturing infrastructure, and is compatible with a wide range of anodes, separators, and cathodes. Spun out of research at Stanford, Anthro Energy is a portfolio company of Union Square Ventures and Ultratech Capital. It is a physical-materials company with no public API surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company and market discovery.

providers.name: apusapps
providers.description: APUS (apusapps.com) is a global mobile internet company founded in July 2014, operating the APUS User System — an Android-based ecosystem of consumer utility apps including APUS Launcher, Browser, Booster+, Message Center, Camera, Security Elite, Flashlight, and Theme Store. APUS reaches over two billion users across more than 200 countries and regions and supports 25+ languages, and was named the "world's youngest unicorn" by the Wall Street Journal in 2015. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. APUS is a consumer mobile app developer and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Aurascape
providers.description: Aurascape is an AI-native security company (Santa Clara, CA) that gives enterprises real-time visibility, intent-based controls, and data protection for every AI interaction. Its AI-native cloud proxy sits inline to discover and monitor thousands of generative, embedded, and agentic AI applications across browsers, SaaS, copilots, and IDEs; classify and protect multimodal data (text, code, voice, video) in real time; and secure AI agents from development through production, including testing for prompt injection and data leakage and enforcing runtime guardrails through its Zero-Bypass MCP Gateway. Aurascape is a Menlo Ventures portfolio company profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Auto Finance
providers.description: Auto Finance is a decentralized finance (DeFi) liquidity-management protocol built by Tokemak. Its core product, Autopools, are automated onchain vaults that autonomously optimize, rebalance, and auto-compound liquidity-provider yield across major DeFi venues (Curve, Fluid, Inverse, Morpho, AAVE) and networks (Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base), abstracting away the complexity of manual LP management. The protocol is governed and secured through AUTO token staking, and its onchain surface is a public set of audited Solidity smart contracts rather than a REST API. Documentation is published via GitBook with an agent-readable llms.txt index.

providers.name: Bailey44
providers.description: Bailey 44 (stylized Bailey/44) is a contemporary womenswear brand selling direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront at bailey44.com. The label offers women's apparel — dresses, tops, knits, and separates — around a brand voice of optimism and self-expression ("The Future is Female"). Bailey44 was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. It does not publish a public developer API; its only machine-readable surfaces are the Shopify Customer Account API discovery documents (OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 authorization-server metadata, issuer shopify.com/authentication/8596750398) served at bailey44.com/.well-known/, a standard Shopify sitemap, and an RSS-backed news blog. This profile is a lead enriched by the pipeline; no first-party API artifacts were found.

providers.name: BitAccess
providers.description: Bitaccess is a Canadian blockchain company (Ottawa, founded 2013, Y Combinator) that builds the enterprise software and hardware powering Bitcoin ATM (BTM) operations and fintech businesses in more than 15 countries. Its stack includes the Bitaccess BTM operating software, the Cash API for cash-in and cash-out crypto transaction flows, and the Catena blockchain suite for publishing complex datasets to public or private blockchains via smart contracts. Bitaccess maintains an in-house HD/multisig enterprise wallet built for high-velocity applications and publishes first-party open-source client libraries under the npm @bitaccess scope and the github.com/bitaccess organization, led by the coinlib unified Node.js/TypeScript crypto-payments library. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Pantera Capital.

providers.name: Black Sheep Foods
providers.description: Black Sheep Foods is a San Francisco food-technology company making plant-based meat that targets the flavors and textures of premium and heritage animal proteins — starting with its signature meat-free lamb, plus steak bites, built on a proprietary pea-protein DualTexture blend. Originally launched as a restaurant and retail brand (served at Bay Area restaurants and sold as vegan ground lamb), the company has increasingly positioned itself as a B2B ingredient supplier, licensing its DualTexture protein platform for hybrid and fully plant-based meat products. It is venture-backed (investors include Bessemer Venture Partners and AgFunder) and pitches a sustainability story of far lower land, water, and greenhouse-gas footprint than conventionally raised lamb. This is a consumer/ ingredient food-tech business with no first-party public developer API; its web presence runs on Shopify.

providers.name: BlackSwan Technologies
providers.description: BlackSwan Technologies is an enterprise AI software company founded in 2014 by Michael and Elinoar Ouliel, headquartered in London with engineering across Israel, Poland and India. Its flagship product, ELEMENT, is marketed as an Enterprise AI Operating System: a low/no-code platform-as-a-service combining a data fabric, knowledge graphs, machine learning and composite AI so banks and other regulated enterprises can assemble applications for KYC on demand, enhanced due diligence, financial crime, transaction intelligence, market intelligence and underwriting without first consolidating their data. Its software engineering unit, BST LABS, built and open-sourced CAIOS (Cloud AI Operating System) and a family of Python developer tools (DynaCLI, CLVM, PyJdict, PyComposite, AuthK). BlackSwan Technologies was acquired by HUB Cyber Security Ltd. (NASDAQ: HUBC) in a stock-for-stock transaction that closed on 27 January 2025, and its corporate domain blackswantechnologies.ai no longer resolves in DNS; the secured data fabric technology is now marketed under HUB Technologies. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API contract (OpenAPI, GraphQL, AsyncAPI, MCP, A2A) was found for BlackSwan Technologies during enrichment.

providers.name: Bloxtel
providers.description: Bloxtel, Inc. builds a decentralized private 5G platform that lets enterprises deploy standalone 5G networks in hours. Its all-in-one 5G Access Point runs Open6GC, Bloxtel's decentralized network core, and pairs with tokenized dSIM electronic-SIM technology and a Web3 Operator dApp for configuring networks, managing dSIM subscriptions, and AI-powered predictive maintenance. Solutions span indoor coverage, SIM-swap protection, neutral hosting, peer nodes, and network analytics, targeting lower latency, reduced threat surface, and lower cost versus traditional carrier deployments. Backed by 500 Global. As of this profile Bloxtel publishes a marketing and lead-generation site only, with no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, or SDK yet available.

providers.name: Blue Fever
providers.description: Blue Fever is a social and mental-health app for young people that pairs a judgment-free peer community with "Blue," an AI emotional-support companion, under the tagline "A place to feel seen, not be seen." Users share thoughts, moods, and creative expression and receive support from both community members and the AI companion, alongside curated wellness resources and crisis support. The app is available on iOS and Android, has been featured as an Apple App of the Day, and carries a 4.6 App Store rating. The company was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; it is a consumer application with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Bolt.Earth
providers.description: Bolt.Earth operates what it describes as India's largest EV charging network, with more than 100,000 charging points deployed across 2,100+ cities. The company sells EV charging hardware (3.3kW smart sockets for 2/3/4-wheelers, AC chargers from 7.4kW to 22kW, and DC fast chargers from 30kW to 240kW) alongside a Charging Management System (CMS) for operators and a consumer mobile app for locating, booking, and paying for charging sessions. Services span site assessment, installation, KYC onboarding, charger activation, remote firmware updates, and 24/7 support for individuals, RWAs, enterprises, fleet operators, hospitality venues, highways, and government agencies. Bolt.Earth is backed by Version One Ventures and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as an energy-sector company profile. No public developer API portal or OpenAPI definition was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Bot Hub
providers.description: Bot Hub is an anonymous, read-only A2A agent for Kalshi prediction markets served from baconhollow.com and listed on a2aregistry.org. Its agent card (protocolVersion 0.3.0, JSON-RPC transport, no authentication) declares four skills — portfolio status for a set of trading bots, weather-forecast edge on Kalshi temperature markets computed from GFS forecasts with a calibrated normal CDF model, a market scan, and "Weather Oracle" trading picks with tier-based access and a buyer sign-up — and a live anonymous message/send returned a six-strategy catalog, every strategy marked "testing" with no live track record and one "deprecated". The agent is the entire published surface: the apex answers 405 to GET, there is no www host, no web page, documentation, OpenAPI, MCP server, llms.txt, pricing, terms, privacy policy or operator identity anywhere, and the registry lists the author as Unknown. The domain was registered 2026-02-20.

providers.name: California Regional MLS
providers.description: California Regional MLS (CRMLS) is the largest multiple listing service in the United States, serving REALTORS across California with MLS systems (Flexmls, Matrix, Paragon), compliance and education. Listing data reaches developers as IDX and RESO certified data feeds licensed through a CRMLS data licensing request and approved IDX vendors; CRMLS publishes no public API documentation or machine-readable contract of its own.

providers.name: Calumet Specialty Products Partners
providers.description: Calumet, Inc. (NASDAQ: CLMT) is a publicly traded U.S. manufacturing company established in 1919, headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. The firm specializes in the manufacture of lubricating oils, solvents, waxes, packaged and synthetic specialty products, fuels, renewable diesel, and fuel-related products. It operates 12 production facilities across North America and serves approximately 2,700 global customers in over 90 countries through brands including Royal Purple, Bel-Ray, Penreco, Orchex, and TruFuel. Calumet does not publish a public developer API program; commercial integrations are handled via B2B portals and EDI.

providers.name: Calyxo
providers.description: Calyxo is a medical device company focused on revolutionizing kidney stone care with the world’s first all‑in‑one kidney stone treatment system. Their CVAC System combines ureteroscopy, laser lithotripsy, micro‑jet irrigation, dynamic aspiration and stone collection, delivering minimally invasive, high‑efficacy stone clearance. Founded in 2016, Calyxo operates as a standalone nephrology hospital and has raised significant Series F funding to advance its innovative technologies.

providers.name: Capi Money
providers.description: Capi Money is a cross-border payments fintech that lets businesses pay their suppliers in more than 30 currencies, targeting importers in Africa and other emerging markets who have historically faced high fees and multi-week settlement times on international invoices. Founded in 2023 by Mitch Riley and Scott Liddle and headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, the company offers instant FX rate quotes, settlement within 24 hours, real-time payment tracking, and holds customer funds with licensed financial institutions. Capi is a Y Combinator company backed by Creandum, Firstminute Capital, and Raba, having raised roughly EUR 17.2 million in Series A funding. The product is delivered through a web application (app.capimoney.com) and an FX Partner Program; there is no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal published at this time.

providers.name: Capstone Turbine
providers.description: Capstone Turbine Corporation, now operating as Capstone Green Energy (and its operating entity Capstone Energy+), is a California-based manufacturer of low-emission microturbine energy systems founded in 1988. The company designs and builds oil-free, air-bearing microturbines ranging from 65 kW to multi-megawatt configurations for on-site and on-demand power, combined heat and power (CHP), and combined cooling, heat and power (CCHP). Its systems power data centers, microgrids, ports, EV charging, oil and gas operations, critical power, and renewable energy applications. Capstone was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. It is an industrial energy manufacturer with no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures company identity and public web properties only.

providers.name: Ceibo
providers.description: Ceibo is a Chilean copper technology company accelerating access to copper supply through a proprietary leaching process that recovers copper from primary sulfide ores. Backed by Khosla Ventures and BHP Ventures, the company positions its on-site technology as faster than bioleaching, using less water than concentration and a fraction of the capital expenditure of concentrators, aiming to close the global copper supply-demand gap needed for the energy transition. Headquartered in Santiago, Chile, Ceibo was named a 2026 Fast Company World Changing Ideas winner. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Ceibo publishes no public developer/API surface at this time.

providers.name: Central Garden and Pet
providers.description: Central Garden & Pet Company (Nasdaq: CENT, CENTA) is a Walnut Creek, California manufacturer and distributor of branded pet supplies and lawn & garden products — Nylabone, Kaytee, Aqueon, Four Paws, Farnam, Pennington, Amdro, Sevin and Ferry-Morse among roughly seventy brands — with its own nationwide pet and garden distribution network. It is a consumer-products company, not a software company: it publishes no developer portal, public API, SDK, package, OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, MCP server, A2A agent card or llms.txt, and retailer and distributor connectivity is EDI through E2open under private contract. The host developer.central.com once recorded here does not resolve, and api.central.com, on Central's own network block, serves only a 2015-era IIS placeholder page, so no API entry is carried. On the horizontal regulatory layer its privacy notice states the Global Privacy Control signal is honored and links a OneTrust portal for CCPA and GDPR data subject requests.

providers.name: Chelsio Communications
providers.description: Chelsio Communications designs and sells high-performance Ethernet network adapters and ASICs — the Terminator (T4/T5/T6/T7) Unified Wire family — for virtualized enterprise datacenters, hyperscale public and private clouds, cluster computing, GPU-accelerated computing and high-frequency trading. Its 1/10/25/40/50/100GbE adapters fully offload TCP, iSCSI, FCoE, iWARP RDMA and NVMe-oF onto a single chip with single firmware, and the sixth-generation T6 ASIC adds integrated cryptography offload for IPsec/TLS/SSL/DTLS. Chelsio distributes Unified Wire driver packages for Linux, Windows, FreeBSD and VMware ESXi plus the Unified Wire Manager management software as downloads from its service portal; it publishes no public developer program, REST API or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: City Therapeutics
providers.description: City Therapeutics, Inc. is a privately held, clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered at 399 Binney Street in Kendall Square, Cambridge, Massachusetts, founded in 2024 by pioneers of RNA interference including John Maraganore, Phillip Zamore, Kotaro Nakanishi, Yukihide Tomari and Mark Keating. The company engineers next-generation RNAi trigger molecules — including its proprietary cleavage-inducing tiny (city) RNAs — and pairs them with precision targeting ligands designed to deliver siRNAs beyond the liver into ocular, CNS and other extrahepatic tissues. Its pipeline includes CITY-FXI, a Factor XI-targeting candidate for thromboembolic disease, and CITY-RBP4 for Stargardt disease and geographic atrophy, alongside undisclosed hepatic, ocular and CNS programs. City Therapeutics raised a $135M Series A in October 2024 and a $99.5M Series B in June 2026, and holds research collaborations with Biogen and Bausch + Lomb. City Therapeutics publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable interface; it is catalogued here as a company profile only.

providers.name: Condorsoftware
providers.description: Condor Software builds AI-powered financial intelligence software for life sciences R&D organizations, unifying clinical, operational, and financial data to manage complex clinical trial finances. The platform connects data from existing systems (CROs, ERP, CTMS, EDC, procurement), automates AI-powered accruals, invoice reconciliation, and financial close, and delivers board-ready forecasts, scenario planning, and portfolio dashboards for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device companies.
