Product lines are branded AIRMADE and span sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), ethanol, methanol, diesel and rocket fuel, with earlier consumer validation products including AIR Vodka and AIR Eau de Parfum. Partners and customers include the U.S. Department of Defense, U.S. Air Force, Department of Energy and NASA, alongside aviation partners such as Virgin, Air France-KLM, JetBlue and Air Canada; strategic investors include Alaska Airlines, Carbon Direct, In-Q-Tel and Toyota Ventures. Air Company publishes no public API, developer portal or machine-readable API contract as of the 2026-07-31 enrichment pass.

providers.name: Alector
providers.description: Alector is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing immuno-neurology therapies for neurodegenerative diseases, including frontotemporal dementia (FTD), Alzheimer's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Combining human genetics, neuroscience, and immunology, the company designs potential first- and best-in-class medicines that remove toxic proteins, replace deficient proteins, and restore immune and nerve cell function. Alector was added to the API Evangelist network as a GV portfolio company; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface, so this profile captures corporate and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Alethea
providers.description: Alethea is an AI-powered risk intelligence company that operates a proactive narrative and disinformation risk management platform. Its flagship product, Artemis, is a threat intelligence and narrative-risk mitigation platform that detects coordinated inauthentic behavior, influence operations, and emerging online narratives before they escalate into reputational or operational crises. Complementary offerings include Risk Radar (a threat-visibility dashboard), an agentic AI takedown agent for automated mitigation, and Alethea Insights macro threat analysis. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and Multicoin Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Alethea is an enterprise, engagement-led platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a self-service developer portal.

providers.name: All City Communications
providers.description: All City Communications is a Wisconsin-based telephone answering and call center service provider offering 24/7 live answering for businesses across many industries. Founded in 1979 (originally as a paging service), the company operates from Green Bay and Milwaukee and delivers custom call scripting, message delivery by text, email or live call patching, call recording with secure storage, a customer web portal for real-time call data, and detailed call reporting. It serves property management, home restoration, electrical / plumbing / HVAC trades, municipalities, home health and hospice, healthcare, legal, landscaping, and travel and hospitality clients. All City Communications is a service business and does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal.

providers.name: Alvee Health
providers.description: Alvee Health is an AI-powered care navigation platform for social determinants of health (SDOH) and whole-person care coordination. It surfaces unmet social and clinical needs from documentation, auto-codes Z-codes, automates patient outreach and benefits enrollment through an autonomous care navigator, generates compliant billing documentation, and tracks outcomes so providers can capture reimbursement for CHI, PIN, CCM, PCM, and G0136 care-coordination codes. The platform is HIPAA compliant and SMART on FHIR certified, integrating with EHRs to embed social drivers of health into clinical workflows. Alvee is a Techstars Iowa (2022) portfolio company.

providers.name: Angi
providers.description: Angi (formerly Angie's List, founded 1995) is a digital home services marketplace connecting homeowners with home service professionals for repair, maintenance, and improvement projects. Angie's List merged with IAC's HomeAdvisor in 2017 under parent ANGI Homeservices Inc.; in March 2021 the consumer brand and parent company were both renamed Angi, with HomeAdvisor continuing as the pro-facing "Angi Leads" lead-generation business. IAC fully spun off its stake in April 2025, making Angi Inc. (NASDAQ: ANGI) an independent public company. Angi does not operate a self-serve public developer portal or publish an API reference. It does offer a gated, partner-only lead-delivery mechanism: Angi Ads/Angi Leads pushes new homeowner leads as JSON to a webhook URL a pro's CRM provides (authenticated with an X-API-KEY header), and an OAuth-style "Sign in with Angi" account-linking flow used by a short list of approved CRM/field-service partners (ServiceTitan, Jobber) to receive lead and booking data. Both require a direct arrangement with an Angi Ads Client Success Manager rather than self-serve API keys.

providers.name: Approxima
providers.description: Approxima is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) startup building AI agents that test every pull request. Approxima plugs into your CI/CD pipeline and runs autonomous agents on each PR: the agents build your application in an isolated sandbox, exercise it in a real browser, and report exactly what is broken, with screenshots. The company positions itself as a trust layer for AI-assisted software development, letting engineering teams catch regressions and validate fixes end to end before code merges to production. As of this profile Approxima operates a marketing site and private login at approxima.ai and does not yet publish a public API, developer documentation, or an OpenAPI definition; this repo captures its identity and domain-security posture pending a public API surface.

providers.name: Aravo
providers.description: Aravo Solutions is a San Francisco based enterprise software company providing third-party risk management (TPRM), supplier and procurement risk management, and governance, risk and compliance software. Its Intelligence First platform covers vendor nomination and intake, onboarding, due diligence, continuous monitoring, contracts, performance management, issue remediation and offboarding, with risk-domain applications for anti-bribery and corruption, data privacy and GDPR, information security, ESG, DORA and the German Supply Chain Due Diligence Act (LkSG). Aravo markets an integration framework that exchanges data with ERP, procure-to-pay, accounts payable and GRC systems, and with risk-intelligence providers including Refinitiv World-Check One, LexisNexis, Dow Jones, BitSight, SecurityScorecard, RapidRatings and Dun & Bradstreet, over SOAP and REST web-services APIs in XML and JSON. That API surface is described only on marketing pages; the reference documentation sits behind the login-gated Aravo customer portal.

providers.name: Astroscale
providers.description: Astroscale provides on‑orbit servicing and space sustainability solutions, offering end‑to‑end services such as mission licensing, spectrum acquisition, insurance, and operations for debris removal and satellite life‑extension. The company aims to accelerate space development while ensuring long‑term orbital sustainability for future generations.

providers.name: autone
providers.description: autone is an AI-powered inventory management platform for retail brands, blending machine-driven recommendations with merchandising expertise and a brand's own data to optimize stock decisions across buying, reordering, replenishment, and rebalancing. Its modules — Buy, Reorder, Replenish, Rebalance, Assortment & Initial Allocation, and Insights — help fashion, beauty, furniture, and sports retailers reduce stockouts and overstock, redistribute inventory across locations, and improve margins. Founded by supply-chain operators from luxury fashion houses (Alexander McQueen, Victoria Beckham, Givenchy), autone is backed by General Catalyst, Seedcamp, and Speedinvest. No public developer API or documentation is published at this time; the platform is delivered as an enterprise SaaS. This profile originated as a VC-portfolio lead and has been enriched with verifiable company identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Auxilium Health
providers.description: Auxilium Health provides a comprehensive suite of patient support programs and services to streamline access to medical treatments for physicians and patients. Based in Toronto, Canada, the company offers dedicated portal programs, product provision, data insight, and optiCare services, ensuring high-quality, safe, and efficient patient care across the healthcare ecosystem.

providers.name: Auxmoney
providers.description: Auxmoney (auxmoney GmbH) is a Düsseldorf-based German fintech operating one of Europe's largest online lending marketplaces, connecting consumer and small-business borrowers with private and institutional investors. Its fully digital platform handles personal-loan applications end to end — identity and credit checks, risk scoring, approval within seconds, and disbursement typically within 24 hours — funded by retail investors and institutional capital via its investment arm. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures. auxmoney publishes no public developer API or portal; its integration surface is a partner/affiliate program plus internal open-source tooling on GitHub. This profile is maintained by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Avathon
providers.description: Avathon — formerly SparkCognition, rebranded in November 2024 — is an industrial AI company whose Industrial AI Platform combines a data platform, industrial digital twin, AI modeling and application development layers to bring predictive maintenance, asset performance management, visual intelligence and autonomy to physical operations. Its solutions span renewables, oil and gas, power and utilities, manufacturing, mining, aerospace and defense, maritime, rail, aviation, logistics, warehousing and retail, with named offerings including Asset Performance Management, Visual AI / Visual Intelligence, Autonomy for Health, Safety and Environment, the Digital Maintenance Advisor and the Multidomain Awareness Advisor. The platform is sold and delivered as an enterprise engagement — marketing material references an application development SDK and APIs, but no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification is published; the only documentation surface, support.avathon.com/help, redirects to a HubSpot member login. Avathon is backed by investors including Temasek, Verizon Ventures and Boeing, and is headquartered in Silicon Valley after relocating from Austin, Texas.

providers.name: Baseframe
providers.description: BaseFrame (baseframe.co) is a Y Combinator (W26) startup building an AI workflow discovery platform for teams and small businesses. Its privacy-first desktop application analyzes historical work patterns across email, documents, Slack, calendar, browser activity, and files using on-device local models to identify high-value, repetitive tasks and recommend concrete AI automations, then helps users set them up in the tools they already use. BaseFrame publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI at this time; it is a consumer/desktop product with SaaS integrations (Gmail, Slack, HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Sheets, Office 365, Jira). Founded in 2025 by Anshul Paul and Vaibhav Agrawal.

providers.name: Bedrock Robotics
providers.description: Bedrock Robotics develops advanced autonomy for the built world, retrofitting existing heavy construction machinery with an autonomous kit the company calls the Bedrock Operator. The system adds machine intelligence to equipment such as excavators and dozers so jobsites can run around the clock with reduced human intervention, compressing project timelines, improving safety by removing operators from hazardous work, and enabling remote progress tracking. Backed by 8vc and Emergence Capital, the company raised a $270M Series B. Bedrock is a robotics and physical-autonomy company; it publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface at this time. This profile tracks the company in the API Evangelist network and captures its public web and security posture.

providers.name: Beepsaúde
providers.description: Beepsaúde (Beep Saúde) is a Brazilian digital health platform offering at‑home medical services such as laboratory exams, vaccinations, and immunobiologics. Operating in Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo and the Federal District, the company provides a web portal and mobile app for scheduling, payment, and results delivery. It serves both private customers and health‑plan members, partnering with over 40 insurers. The service emphasizes convenience, rapid home visits, and transparent pricing, with a focus on preventive care and chronic‑disease monitoring.

providers.name: Better Place Forests
providers.description: Better Place Forests is a nonprofit organization that provides nature‑based memorials and forest conservation. Families can plan cremation, funerals, and memorial services in protected forests across the United States, creating lasting memorials while supporting forest stewardship and grief support. The organization operates a network of nine forests, offering a range of memorial options, grief resources, and environmental stewardship programs.

providers.name: Boeing
providers.description: Boeing is an American multinational corporation that designs, manufactures, and sells airplanes, rotorcraft, rockets, satellites, and telecommunications equipment. Boeing Developer Tools provides aviation data APIs powered by Jeppesen aeronautical databases, covering aircraft models, airport data, airspace information, NOTAMs, flight events, and runway operations.

providers.name: Bonfire Analytics
providers.description: Bonfire Analytics provides sales intelligence solutions for the healthcare sector, helping commercial leaders and business development teams identify target markets, optimize referral pathways, and evaluate market share. Their platform offers deep provider and organization insights, market segmentation, and referral intelligence to drive growth and improve outreach strategies across the health ecosystem.

providers.name: Bootc
providers.description: Bootc is an open source tool that enables transactional, in-place operating system updates using OCI/Docker container images as the source for OS updates. It applies the container layering model to bootable host systems, using standard OCI containers as a transport and delivery format for base operating system updates. The container image includes a Linux kernel, and when deployed the base userspace runs normally with systemd as PID 1. Bootc is a CNCF Sandbox project with a stable CLI and API.

providers.name: BorderX Lab
providers.description: BorderX Lab, founded in 2014 by three former Google PhDs, is a Silicon Valley‑based leader in AI‑driven cross‑border e‑commerce. It offers a suite of products—including CloudStore AI, BeyondStyle, and the Bieyang app—to empower brands and merchants worldwide to deliver autonomous shopping experiences. With over 200 employees across the US and China, BorderX Lab combines advanced personalization, logistics, and agentic commerce technology to create a seamless global trade platform.

providers.name: Breezy
providers.description: Breezy is a Los Angeles-based proptech startup building what it calls the first independent AI operating system for residential real estate. Founded in 2024 by top-producing agent James Harris alongside Afterpay co-founders Nick Molnar and Anthony Eisen, the mobile-first app consolidates an agent's workflow — comparable market analysis (comps), AI meeting notes, deal-pipeline management, client insights and an AI assistant — into a single workspace, and adds an "UnderBuilt Radar" that uses zoning, geospatial and setback data to flag properties with unrealized development potential across 1,200+ cities. Breezy raised a $10M pre-seed led by Ribbit Capital with participation from Fifth Wall, DST Global Partners, Liquid 2 Ventures, O.G. Venture Partners, Fidji Simo and David Marcus. The company exposes no public developer API today; this profile tracks it as a Fifth Wall portfolio lead.

providers.name: Bukalapak
providers.description: Bukalapak is one of Indonesia's largest online marketplaces and all-commerce platforms, connecting millions of individual sellers, small warungs (kiosks), and buyers across the archipelago, alongside virtual products, financial services, and online-to-offline retail. Originally added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub (backed by 500 Global), this profile has been enriched from Bukalapak's real public developer surface: a public REST API at api.bukalapak.com secured with OAuth2 via accounts.bukalapak.com, a first-party JavaScript SDK (bukalapak.js), and a large public GitHub organization. No OpenAPI/Swagger specification is currently published by the provider, so the captured artifacts (authentication, packages, domain security) are sourced from first-party repositories and live domain probes rather than derived from a spec.

providers.name: Burbank
providers.description: Burbank is a Cardiff and London based payments technology company that builds card-present authentication for online and remote payments. Its flagship Card Present Over Internet (CPoI) technology lets consumers authenticate anywhere using the globally familiar "tap and PIN" gesture, alongside a SoftPOS product and an Issuer Toolkit for identity verification. Burbank ships a white-label SDK (mobile library plus containerized backend services) to issuers, acquirers, and payment service providers to reduce online fraud and improve conversion. Backed by Anthemis, Mouro Capital, and Portfolio Ventures.

providers.name: Cadre
providers.description: Cadre is a New York-based, technology-driven investment platform that gives individual and institutional investors access to private-market alternatives, historically centered on institutional-quality commercial real estate. Founded in 2014 and backed by investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Thrive Capital, and Slow Ventures, Cadre now operates in partnership with Willow Wealth (Willow Wealth Markets LLC, a FINRA/SIPC broker-dealer formerly known as RealCadre LLC, and Willow Asset Management LLC, an SEC-registered investment adviser) to offer diversified private-market funds alongside traditional stocks and bonds. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Cadre does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Casma Therapeutics
providers.description: Casma Therapeutics is a privately held clinical-stage biotechnology company founded in 2018 and headquartered at 201 Brookline Ave, Suite 1401, Boston, MA. Casma develops novel cellular degradation medicines built on the autophagy pathway — the conserved process cells use to clear damaged components. Its PHLYT (Phagosome-Lysosome Targeting) platform initiates target-specific autophagic degradation of disease targets independent of size or complexity, reaching beyond single proteins to organelles, protein aggregates and large signaling complexes, with programs spanning oncology, inflammation, neurodegeneration and metabolic disease. Casma was named to the Fierce 15 list in 2019. The company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs or machine-readable API contract; it is catalogued here as a company profile only.

providers.name: Catchfashion
providers.description: Catchfashion is an online fashion retailer based in the Netherlands, offering women’s clothing from brands such as VERO MODA, VILA, Object, Pieces, and Noisy May. The store provides a wide range of sizes and includes a Curve line for plus-size fashion, serving customers with a curated selection of apparel and accessories.

providers.name: Ceremonia
providers.description: Ceremonia is a clean hair care brand rooted in Latinx heritage, offering sustainable, silicone‑free, sulfate‑free hair products. Founded by Babba Rivera, the company focuses on natural ingredients and clinically‑backed formulas, aiming to empower confident, healthy hair while celebrating cultural rituals.

providers.name: Chemify
providers.description: Chemify is a Glasgow-based programmable-chemistry company, spun out of the University of Glasgow in 2022 by chemist Lee Cronin, that digitizes the creation of molecules through what it calls "Chemputation." The platform fuses AI/ML-driven molecular design, a universal chemical programming language, and robotic synthesis so pharmaceutical, biotech, and industrial partners can move from a novel concept to a makeable compound end to end. In 2025 Chemify opened its first Chemifarm, a fully automated chemistry facility in Glasgow's Maryhill district that pairs its molecular-design engine with industrial-scale robotic synthesis, and closed a $50M Series B co-led by Wing Venture Capital and Insight Partners, with backing from DCVC. Chemify does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs; engagement runs through its partner program.

providers.name: Chief Information Officers Council
providers.description: The Chief Information Officers Council (CIOC) is the principal interagency forum for improving agency practices related to the design, acquisition, development, modernization, use, sharing, and performance of federal information resources. Established by Executive Order 13011 in 1996 and codified in the E-Government Act of 2002 (44 U.S.C. 3603), the Council is comprised of the Chief Information Officers and Deputy CIOs of executive branch agencies, the Federal CIO at OMB (who serves as Chair), the Federal Chief Information Security Officer, and the Administrator for Electronic Government. The CIOC develops recommendations for OMB IT policy, identifies opportunities to improve federal IT performance, coordinates multi-agency IT initiatives such as cybersecurity and cloud adoption, supports federal IT workforce development, and disseminates effective IT management practices across the federal government. The Council publishes guidance, playbooks, committee output and its charter through councils.gov, the consolidated federal executive councils hub GSA launched in March 2026; its long-standing home at cio.gov now redirects there. The Council operates no developer program and publishes no API.

providers.name: Chipotle Mexican Grill
providers.description: Chipotle Mexican Grill is a Fortune 500 fast-casual restaurant chain serving burritos, bowls, tacos, salads, and quesadillas made with responsibly sourced, classically-cooked, real ingredients. Founded in 1993 in Denver, Colorado and headquartered in Newport Beach, California, Chipotle operates more than 3,500 restaurants across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Kuwait, and the United Arab Emirates. The company is widely recognized as a digital ordering and loyalty leader in the restaurant industry through its Chipotle Rewards program, native iOS and Android apps, and digital ordering platforms (web ordering, group ordering, and catering). Chipotle does not currently publish a public consumer-facing developer API catalog; partner integrations such as third-party delivery (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub) are managed through bilateral agreements, and supplier and franchise integrations occur through internal portals.

providers.name: Chipstack
providers.description: Chipstack is an AI-driven semiconductor verification company that uses agentic AI to automate chip design verification, one of the most time-consuming stages of building a complex chip (often 60% or more of total development effort). Its product suite is a set of specialized AI agents — a Mental Model AI Agent, a Formal AI Agent, a Unit Simulation AI Agent, and a UVM AI Agent — that read design intent and generate, run, and reason about verification tasks to shift that work earlier in the design cycle and cut the time and resources it takes to tape out. Founded and based across Seattle, WA and San Jose, CA, and backed by Khosla Ventures, Chipstack is an enterprise, demo-request product rather than a public developer platform: as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer documentation, SDK, or developer portal. In 2026 the company announced it is joining Cadence. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for discovery and monitoring.

providers.name: Chooch AI
providers.description: Chooch AI provides computer vision AI solutions focused on hospital inventory management, safety monitoring, remote patient monitoring, and manufacturing. Their platform automates inventory tracking, predicts shortages, and enhances safety through vision AI, helping healthcare facilities reduce costs and improve operational efficiency.

providers.name: Choochintelligencetechnologiesco
providers.description: Choochintelligencetechnologiesco provides AI-powered computer vision solutions for hospitals and enterprises, focusing on inventory management, safety monitoring, and remote patient care. Their platform uses deep learning to automate counting, predict shortages, and improve operational efficiency across healthcare facilities.

providers.name: Circulate
providers.description: Circulate is a sustainable packaging data platform founded in Sweden. It aggregates, structures, and enriches packaging supplier information, turning PDFs, spreadsheets, and certificates into a searchable database. The platform enables businesses to source compliant packaging quickly, reduces greenwashing, and supports sustainability reporting with AI‑driven insights.

providers.name: Clinikk
providers.description: Clinikk (Clinikk Health Hub) is a Bangalore, India-based primary healthcare provider offering membership-based access to unlimited doctor consultations, free prescribed medicines and lab tests, 24/7 teleconsultation, and optional group health insurance in partnership with IndusInd General Insurance. Clinikk operates in-person Health Hubs across Bangalore alongside a consumer mobile app, and was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. No public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Commons Clinic
providers.description: Commons Clinic is a Santa Monica, California physician-led specialty care group founded in 2021 that operates multi-specialty musculoskeletal clinics across Southern California — Santa Monica, Marina del Rey, Beverly Hills, Torrance, Westlake Village, Lakewood and two Long Beach sites — plus its own ambulatory surgery center, the Marina Orthopedic & Spine Institute. The group treats orthopedic, spine, sports medicine, joint replacement and chronic pain conditions with on-site imaging, physical and occupational therapy, injections and surgery under one roof, and has extended into a bundled preventive diagnostics program marketed as Wholebody. It is venture-backed and its stock trades on private secondary markets. Commons Clinic is a care delivery organization, not an API provider: it publishes no developer program, no API documentation, and no machine-readable API contract. The only machine-readable artifacts on its host are a Rank Math generated llms.txt and the stock WordPress core REST API behind its marketing site.

providers.name: Convey
providers.description: Convey is an enterprise AI platform for building and running autonomous "digital teammates" — AI workers that non-technical operators train by describing a workflow or sharing their screen, after which the teammate runs business processes end to end across existing enterprise systems (Salesforce, NetSuite, ad operations, reporting) with role-based access, isolated agent identities, dedicated credentials, audit logs, and escalation to a human on high-stakes decisions. Founded by former DoorDash and project44 engineers, Convey raised a $38M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz in June 2026 (with Khosla Ventures and Pear VC) and reports 1.1M+ hours of work completed for customers including NBCUniversal, TelevisaUnivision, Unity, and Samsara. The platform is SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliant. Convey is an enterprise, contact-sales product with no public developer API or documentation surface as of this profile.

providers.name: CorneaGen
providers.description: CorneaGen provides a comprehensive surgeon portal offering corneal tissue services, products, and educational resources. The platform enables eye surgeons to request tissue, access product information, view reimbursement details, and engage with training materials. It also includes regulatory information, adverse reaction reporting, and a range of corneal surgical solutions such as DSAEK, DMEK, and pre‑loaded grafts, supporting ophthalmic professionals worldwide.

providers.name: Crew
providers.description: Crew is a digital workplace platform for frontline and deskless teams, connecting frontline staff to corporate leadership across distributed workforces. The product bundles real-time team communication and employee engagement, labor optimization and shift scheduling, task execution, culture and recognition, knowledge management, a Command Center for administration and analytics, a compliance and safety suite, and third-party integrations. Crew reports serving more than one million frontline workers across companies including Taco Bell, Wendy's, Planet Fitness, and Harps Foods. It is backed by Greylock and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Curavit
providers.description: Curavit Clinical Research is a remote clinical site and contract research organization (CRO) that designs, develops, and executes decentralized clinical trials. Founded in 2019 and based in Boston, Curavit offers feasibility, protocol development, virtual site technology, and end‑to‑end trial management services for sponsors across therapeutics, diagnostics, medical devices, and digital health. Their platform integrates regulatory guidance, participant‑centric tools, and scalable recruitment to accelerate study timelines and improve data quality.

providers.name: Cyclone Robotics
providers.description: Cyclone Robotics is an enterprise Robotic Process Automation (RPA) and hyperautomation platform provider serving large organizations across Asia. Its product suite spans RPA Studio, RPA Robot and RPA Controller for building and orchestrating software robots; AI capabilities including AI Skill Studio, Task Intelligence, Process Intelligence, Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) and chatbots; and delivery options such as Robot-as-a-Service and RPA Mobile. The platform lets business and technical users automate finance, government, manufacturing, banking, insurance, logistics, healthcare and customer-service processes, and can expose robot business functions as callable services (RaaS) for third-party integration. Surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Dialogue AI
providers.description: Dialogue AI is an AI-native customer and market research platform, founded in 2025 and backed by a Lightspeed Venture Partners seed round, that helps product, design, and research teams uncover customer needs, test ideas, and capture authentic feedback through adaptive AI-moderated interviews. The platform automates the research workflow end to end — study design, participant recruitment (including a Prolific partnership), AI-led interviewing across multiple research formats, and real-time reporting and insight synthesis — so organizations can make agile, data-driven decisions aligned with real-world market changes. Dialogue AI is a web application (app.dialogueai.com) rather than a public developer API provider; this profile captures its company identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Discz
providers.description: Discz is a consumer mobile application that blends music discovery with social chat, styled as a modern, MySpace-inspired music community. Users discover songs, build music profiles, and chat with others around shared taste in music. The iOS app is developed by Discz, a Y Combinator-backed startup and a portfolio company of DCM Ventures. Discz publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its surface is the consumer iOS app distributed through the Apple App Store.

providers.name: Divergent
providers.description: Divergent Technologies, Inc. is a Torrance and Long Beach, California manufacturer that built the Divergent Adaptive Production System (DAPS), an end-to-end software-hardware production system for industrial digital manufacturing. DAPS pairs AI-driven generative design software with in-house metal additive manufacturing — the Monolith One printer, compatible with aluminum, nickel, steel and titanium alloys — and automated fixtureless robotic assembly, so complex multi-part structures can be engineered, printed and assembled without fixed tooling. Founded in 2013 by Kevin and Lukas Czinger, the company is a Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and has expanded into aerospace and defense, including selection under the US Air Force Eglin Wide Agile Acquisition Contract. Divergent sells manufactured structures and production capacity, not software: it publishes no developer portal, no public API, and no machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Domino's Pizza
providers.description: Domino's Pizza is a major US quick-service restaurant corporation and Fortune 1000 company. Domino's does NOT publish an official public developer API or a developer portal. Its digital ordering surface is delivered through consumer channels - the dominos.com website, the Domino's mobile apps, and the "AnyWare" ordering platform (text, voice, smart TV, Amazon Echo, Google Home, and more), including the "Dom" virtual voice ordering assistant. The undocumented HTTP endpoints behind these first-party apps have been reverse-engineered by the developer community into well-known UNOFFICIAL wrapper libraries (the npm "dominos" / node-dominos-pizza-api package and the Python "pizzapi" / "dominos" packages). These community libraries are not endorsed, supported, or warranted by Domino's. Domino's does expose APIs to select delivery-marketplace partners (e.g. Uber Eats, Just Eat) through direct partnership and a private Postman workspace, but these are not publicly available. No official API specification, pricing, or rate-limit policy is published.

providers.name: Dropzone AI
providers.description: Dropzone AI delivers an Agentic SOC platform built around an autonomous AI SOC Analyst that handles tier-1 alert triage and threat hunting 24/7. The platform ships pre-trained, is coachable in natural language, and connects via secure APIs to 90+ existing security tools (SIEM, EDR/XDR, identity, cloud, threat intel). Dropzone does not publish a customer-facing REST API; integration is delivered through its outbound connectors and partner program.

providers.name: Drover AI
providers.description: Drover AI is a Los Angeles-based micromobility technology company that pioneers the use of computer vision, machine learning, and proprietary sensor fusion in shared light electric vehicles (LEVs) such as e-scooters and e-bikes. Its flagship PathPilot module is a plug-and-play IoT unit retrofit onto existing fleet vehicles that delivers granular infrastructure distinction (sidewalk, bike lane, crosswalk, street), real-time parking validation, and the ability to control vehicle behavior (speed reduction, throttle disable) based on rider location. The Drover Corral dashboard surfaces real-time compliance insights and validation to operators and cities in line with the MDS 2.0 standard, delivered via API and automated Slack alerts. Partners and customers include Spin, Voi, Bolt, Beam, Dott, and Felyx. Drover AI is a portfolio company of 500 Global. No public developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDK surface is published; integration is handled directly with operators.

providers.name: Editas Medicine
providers.description: Editas Medicine is a clinical-stage genome editing company headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, developing durable, precision CRISPR-based gene editing medicines for people with serious diseases. The company works across in vivo and ex vivo approaches and holds foundational CRISPR/Cas9 and Cas12a intellectual property, advancing a pipeline that has included programs in sickle cell disease, beta-thalassemia and inherited retinal disorders. Editas Medicine trades on Nasdaq under the ticker EDIT and was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). As a life-sciences research and therapeutics organization it publishes a corporate and investor-relations web presence rather than a public developer API, so this profile captures its identity, web properties, and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: EdSights
providers.description: EdSights is a student voice and engagement platform for higher education. It pairs an AI-powered SMS chatbot with real-time analytics to collect continuous feedback from students, surface persistence and well-being risk, and flag individuals who need staff intervention. Its Student Voice Score (SVS) benchmarks student satisfaction the way NPS benchmarks customers, and institutional dashboards help retention, advising, and student-success teams act on that feedback throughout the academic journey. EdSights serves 290+ colleges and universities and connects to campus systems — Banner SIS, Slate, Salesforce, Starfish, EAB Navigate360, and Pharos — via SFTP data feeds. The company is Techstars-backed. As of this profile EdSights exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or webhooks; integration is data-file (SFTP) based, so most API-artifact enrichment is not applicable.

providers.name: Educ-up
providers.description: Educ-up is a French social-impact education group founded in 2016 by Mohamed El Mazzouji, headquartered in Saint-Denis, La Réunion with establishments in metropolitan France including Montreuil (Seine-Saint-Denis). It operates two consumer- and professional-facing brands rather than a software product: Domissori, launched in 2019, which places Montessori-trained educators in family homes for childcare, educational workshops and academic tutoring across Vannes, Chambéry, Lyon, Grenoble, Perpignan, Montpellier, Marseille and Saint-Denis; and Edacademy, a Qualiopi-certified training and apprenticeship centre for early-childhood and personal-care professions (CAP AEPE, Titre Pro ADVF, Bac Pro ASSP, parenting and Montessori support). The group also runs Ed'solidaire, a subsidy scheme that opens paid childcare to low-income families. Investors include Serena, M Capital, Inco Ventures, MakeSense and Racine2. Edacademy delivers its programmes through a self-hosted Moodle learning platform at formation.edacademy.fr, but that is an end-user LMS: as of August 2026 Educ-up publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract, and its corporate domain educ-up.fr now redirects to a parked IONOS default site.

providers.name: Efreshli
providers.description: Efreshli is a Cairo, Egypt based online home-furnishing and interior-design commerce platform founded in 2018 by Heba El Gabaly. The company lets consumers design and shop their space online, pairing an e-commerce catalog of furniture, decor, lighting, rugs, bedding, and kitchen and dining goods with AI-assisted room design tools, curated collections, a gift registry, an Efreshli Pro membership, and a B2B / trade program that connects a network of vendors and brands. Efreshli is backed by 500 Global, Algebra Ventures, Marakez, and angel investor Tarek Sakr. This profile is a company record in the API Evangelist network; Efreshli operates a consumer e-commerce web storefront and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Felix
providers.description: Félix (Félix Pago) is a US-based fintech building financial services for the Latino community in the United States. Its core product lets users send remittances to Latin America in seconds through a WhatsApp message, with no app download or physical-location visit required, covering 9+ countries including Mexico, Guatemala, Honduras, El Salvador, Nicaragua, Colombia, Dominican Republic, Ecuador and Peru with real-time exchange rates, no hidden fees, over 40,000 cash pickup and deposit locations, and Spanish-language support. Félix is expanding beyond remittances into accounts, credit building, savings and investing for immigrants. Backed by General Catalyst and QED Investors. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Félix is a consumer-facing service and does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation.

providers.name: FlagshipRTL
providers.description: FlagshipRTL (Flagship) is a SaaS company providing AI-powered inventory forecasting and merchandise planning software for retail brands, with a focus on apparel and direct-to-consumer (DTC) businesses. Its platform pairs demand forecasting at size-level granularity with multi-scenario planning, a purchase-order (PO) builder, and real-time inventory alerts to help retailers reduce stockouts and maximize full-price sell-through. Flagship reports optimizing over $2B in GMV for customers such as Bala, Mack Weldon, and Fresh Clean Threads, and integrates with systems including Shopify, NetSuite, Cin7, Snowflake, and Google Sheets. Backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: FlyFin
providers.description: FlyFin is an AI-powered tax preparation and filing platform for freelancers, self-employed individuals, 1099 contractors, sole proprietorships, LLCs, S-Corps, C-Corps, partnerships, and W-2 employees. It pairs an A.I. deduction scanner that connects to 2,000+ financial institutions through Plaid with a team of certified CPAs who prepare and file federal and state returns. The product suite includes a quarterly tax calculator, a CPA-certified AI tax assistant for unlimited questions, audit insurance with IRS representation, and Excel tax-summary exports. FlyFin operates as a consumer mobile and web application (iOS and Android) and does not publish a public developer API. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Foresight Mental Health
providers.description: Foresight Mental Health is a Berkeley, California technology-enabled outpatient behavioral health organization founded in 2018 by UC Berkeley computer science students Doug Hapeman and Matt Milford to widen access to insurance-covered therapy and psychiatry. It delivers virtual and in-person care through its own clinics in California and Georgia plus partner locations in Arizona, Florida and Texas, covering psychiatry and medication management, individual and couples therapy (CBT, DBT-informed care, EMDR, ACT, Gottman Method, play therapy), child and adolescent services, a maternal mental health program, ADHD/IVA-2 CPT testing, intensive outpatient services in California and transcranial magnetic stimulation in Georgia. The company acquired Psychiatric Addictive Curative Therapies (PACT) Atlanta and has raised roughly $17.7M across pre-seed through Series C with investors including Polaris Partners. Its clinical technology stack is bought rather than built and patient-facing: scheduling runs through Zocdoc and the patient portals are operated by third parties — AdvancedMD for California patients and athenahealth elsewhere. Foresight publishes no developer program, no API documentation, and no machine-readable API contract; the only machine-readable documents on its host are a Yoast-generated llms.txt, a sitemap index and the marketing site's stock WordPress core REST API at /wp-json/.

providers.name: ForeVR
providers.description: ForeVR Games is a consumer virtual-reality game studio that brings classic social bar and backyard games into VR. Its catalog includes ForeVR Bowl, ForeVR Darts, ForeVR Pool, and ForeVR Cornhole, built for multiplayer play across Meta Quest, Steam VR, and PlayStation VR2. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network. ForeVR is a consumer game publisher with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation program; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Forged Sports
providers.description: Forged Sports, Inc. is a Palo Alto, California software company (founded May 2024) building a Venue Management System (VMS) for commercial indoor golf and golf-simulator venues. The platform consolidates bay operations, bookings, player profiles, waivers, leagues, business intelligence, and third-party integrations into a single command center — offering live bay monitoring, reservation and booking management, player-retention analytics, game-popularity insight, and bay-utilization reporting. Forged Sports also develops gamified indoor-golf experiences on top of launch-monitor technologies. Backed by 500 Global. No public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface is currently published.

providers.name: FundMiner
providers.description: FundMiner is a fund management and donor stewardship platform for mission-driven organizations, giving universities, healthcare systems, and community foundations one place to manage the full fund lifecycle. It combines fund management with compliance monitoring, impact and donor reporting, and a branded donor portal that gives donors real-time visibility into how their gifts are used. The platform integrates with existing financial systems and offers role-based dashboards and access controls. FundMiner is a Techstars-backed company; it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or API reference at this time, so this profile captures its public identity and web presence.

providers.name: Gojo & Company
providers.description: Gojo & Company, Inc. is a Tokyo-headquartered financial inclusion holding company founded on 4 July 2014 by Taejun Shin and Sanjay Gandhi, with the stated ambition of becoming a "private-sector World Bank". Gojo raises capital from mission-aligned investors and deploys it into microfinance institutions and inclusive financial service providers across South Asia, Southeast Asia, Central Asia, the Caucasus and Africa, supplying not only equity and debt but also management, governance, risk and technology support to its group companies. It runs a Financial Diaries research programme on low-income household cashflows, the Pasio digital financial inclusion initiative, and a non-profit arm, the Gojo Foundation. Gojo is a certified B Corporation and reports under J-GAAP. It is a private company; its equity trades on secondary marketplaces such as Hiive. Gojo publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract — its digital financial infrastructure and cloud core banking work is internal to the group and its partner institutions.

providers.name: Golden Child
providers.description: Golden Child is a direct-to-consumer pet wellness brand offering fresh, human-grade, vet-formulated dog food delivered on a subscription basis. Founded in 2025 by former Hims & Hers leaders Quentin Lacornerie and Jack Abraham, the company pairs science-backed "main" meals with taste-driven "drizzle" toppers, guided by a two-minute intake quiz that builds a personalized meal plan for each dog. It operates a Shopify Hydrogen storefront at mygoldenchild.com and has raised $37M from Redpoint Ventures, Atomic, and A*. Golden Child publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs; this profile tracks it as a company in the API Evangelist network, surfaced from the Redpoint Ventures portfolio.

providers.name: Greg
providers.description: Greg is a consumer mobile application for plant identification and care, available on iOS and Android. Users photograph a plant to identify it in seconds and receive smart, personalized care guidance — watering schedules, light and soil recommendations, and reminders — alongside a community of plant enthusiasts, care articles, and a plant directory. Greg is an Index Ventures portfolio company in the AI/ML space, applying computer-vision plant recognition. It is a consumer app and does not currently publish a developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Guild
providers.description: Guild (formerly Guild Education) is an education benefits and career opportunity platform that partners with large employers to fund and administer workforce education, upskilling, and career-mobility programs for their frontline and hourly employees. Employers offer Guild as a benefit; employees access a curated marketplace of degrees, certificates, bootcamps, English-language, and professional-skilling programs from vetted learning providers, plus coaching and career navigation to move into higher-demand roles. Guild is a B2B/B2B2C SaaS platform sold to enterprise HR and talent-development teams to fill critical roles, improve retention, increase internal mobility, and prove measurable ROI. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Denver, Colorado, Guild is a venture-backed company. This profile was surfaced from investor portfolios and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Guild publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation at this time.

providers.name: Happy5
providers.description: Happy5 is a Jakarta-based employee performance management platform, operated by Happy5 For The World Pte. Ltd. and founded in 2013, that unifies goal and OKR management, project tracking, and 360-degree performance reviews in one tool for HR teams. It automatically surfaces the goals hit, projects delivered, and milestones completed inside every performance review, and integrates with tools teams already use such as Jira, Asana, Slack, and Google Sheets. Its customers span major Indonesian banks, startups, and SMEs. Happy5 is a closed SaaS product and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or client SDKs; this profile captures its verified public identity and web properties as a lead.

providers.name: Hazelight
providers.description: Hazelight is a Swedish video game development studio founded in 2014, known for creating cooperative multiplayer games that emphasize narrative and emotional storytelling. Their flagship titles include "A Way Out" and "It Takes Two," both of which have received critical acclaim for innovative gameplay mechanics and award-winning design. Hazelight focuses on delivering high-quality, story-driven experiences that bring players together, fostering collaboration and shared adventure across platforms.

providers.name: HijUp
providers.description: HijUp is an Indonesia-based modest-fashion e-commerce marketplace selling Muslim women's clothing online — abayas, blouses, dresses, tunics, printed scarves, hijabs, mukena, khimar, and related accessories — aggregating a large catalog of local Indonesian modest-wear brands (over a hundred labels listed under its brands directory) into a single storefront with international shipping. The company operates a consumer-facing shopping site (product catalog, categories, cart, checkout, and customer accounts) rather than a public developer platform; it publishes no API, SDK, or developer portal at this time. HijUp is backed by 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile. Public contact is customer@hijup.com and +6221-78-24-001.

providers.name: HireRight
providers.description: HireRight is a leading global provider of employment background screening, drug and health screening, and workforce verification services, helping more than 28,000 organizations across 200+ countries and territories run and manage their screening programs. Founded in 1990 and headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, HireRight offers 250+ products and services spanning criminal, financial, identity, education and employment verification, compliance, driving records, and Form I-9 checks, and screened roughly 85 million people in 2025. HireRight does not publish a public developer REST API or developer portal; its integration surface is partner- and contract-based, delivered through 70+ prebuilt connectors with 45+ HCM and ATS partners (including Workday, ADP, Oracle, and UKG) and the Applicant Center candidate experience. This API Evangelist profile captures the company's public, machine-readable, and security/compliance surface (llms.txt, trust center, disclosure, domain security) rather than an open API.

providers.name: Homeward Health
providers.description: Homeward Health is a value-based healthcare provider founded in 2022 by former Livongo executives (CEO Dr. Jennifer Schneider) and incubated as the first investment in General Catalyst's Creation fund. Homeward is rearchitecting rural healthcare for the roughly 60 million Americans living in rural communities, taking on full financial risk for the total cost of care of Medicare Advantage members. Its hybrid care model combines telehealth visits over cellular networks, in-home remote patient monitoring, and in-person care delivered through mobile care units, in partnership with regional health plans (e.g. Priority Health), local providers, and community organizations. Homeward is a care-delivery and health-plan-partnership company rather than a developer platform; it publishes no public developer program, API, or SDK.

providers.name: ID Planet
providers.description: ID Planet is a Web3 GameFi company building an EVM-compatible blockchain ecosystem for blockchain gaming. Its published ecosystem spans ID Planet Chain, the ID Explorer block explorer, the ID Wallet multi-chain wallet, ID SWAP (a decentralized exchange), ID PLANETXC (a centralized exchange) and an NFT marketplace, alongside first-party game titles Infinitar (5v5 MOBA), Runesoul (ARPG) and CoolGods (MOBA). The $ID governance token is issued as a BEP20 asset on BNB Chain with a total supply of 7,800,000,000 and a mining/burn distribution model. Company material is published as a GitBook whitepaper in eight languages. As of 2026-08-22 ID Planet publishes no developer portal, API reference, RPC endpoint, chain ID or machine-readable specification on any host it controls, so this profile is identity and documentation only.

providers.name: IDEXX
providers.description: IDEXX Laboratories is a global leader in veterinary diagnostics, offering reference laboratory testing, in-house analyzers (IDEXX VetLab Station), diagnostic imaging (IDEXX Web PACS), and practice management software (Cornerstone, Neo, and ezyVet, which IDEXX acquired in 2021). IDEXX connects the practice to its diagnostic ecosystem through VetConnect PLUS - a diagnostic results and ordering platform - and through partner integration APIs for Web PACS imaging and reference/in-house lab results. These developer integrations are partner-gated - the developer portal at developer.vetconnectplus.com requires an authenticated login, and partner access is granted only after an approved IDEXX integration request. Web PACS API Partner integrations authenticate with OAuth 2.0-style credentials (Client ID, Client Secret, and Grant Type) issued by IDEXX customer support. IDEXX does not publish an open, unauthenticated API reference, OpenAPI description, or pricing; the logical APIs below are modeled from IDEXX's public product and integration pages, not from a public endpoint reference.

providers.name: Kailera Therapeutics
providers.description: Kailera Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the next generation of obesity and cardiometabolic care through a diversified pipeline of GLP-1 based therapies. Founded in 2024 and headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, its lead candidate ribupatide (KAI-9531) is a once-weekly injectable GLP-1/GIP receptor dual agonist in a global Phase 3 program, alongside oral small-molecule GLP-1 candidates and tri-agonist programs licensed in part from Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals. Kailera has raised a $400M Series A and a $600M Series B led by Bain Capital, and priced its IPO in April 2026 (NASDAQ: KLRA). This is a corporate/portfolio company profile in the API Evangelist network; Kailera publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Keychain
providers.description: Keychain is an AI-powered operating system and network for the consumer packaged goods (CPG) industry, connecting brands and retailers with the contract manufacturers, co-packers, and suppliers that make their products. The platform lets CPG brands discover and match with vetted manufacturing partners, manage sourcing and production relationships, and streamline the supplier-discovery workflow that has traditionally been manual and relationship-driven. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Keychain was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile surfaced from the a16z venture portfolio. As of this enrichment pass Keychain publishes a marketing and product web presence at keychain.com but does not expose a public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API discovery surface (no developer/API subdomain, no /.well-known catalog, no llms.txt).

providers.name: Kingsware
providers.description: Kingsware (Zhuhai Kingsware Artificial Intelligence Co., Ltd. / 珠海金智维人工智能股份有限公司) is a leading Chinese enterprise AI and RPA solutions provider that builds "AI digital employees" and enterprise-grade agent platforms by fusing large language models, AI algorithms, and robotic process automation with vertical industry workflows. Its core products are the K-APA intelligent process automation (RPA) platform and the Ki-Agent enterprise agent platform (built around a "Supervised Agent" model with task planning, tool calling, multi-agent collaboration, and result verification), exposed through the Kingsware AI Open Platform (ai.kingsware.cn). The company serves finance, government, manufacturing, energy, telecom, education, HR, and finance/operations use cases; it has been recognized by IDC as the number-one China RPA+AI solution vendor by market share, counts all six major state-owned banks and 1,300+ enterprise/government customers, has deployed over 1.8 million AI digital employees, and is a national-level "little giant" (专精特新) enterprise. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and enriched by the pipeline.

providers.name: Koordinator
providers.description: Koordinator is a QoS-based scheduling system for hybrid workloads orchestration on Kubernetes, providing colocation, interference detection, and resource optimization capabilities to improve cluster utilization.

providers.name: Kudos
providers.description: Kudos is a consumer credit-card rewards and smart-shopping assistant operated by Kudos Technologies, Inc., founded in 2021 by Tikue Anazodo and Ahmad Ismail. Its browser extension and iOS/Android apps sit at online checkout and recommend which of a shopper's connected cards to use to maximize points, cash back, and card benefits. Kudos Boost pays cashback at 15,000+ stores, redeemable as Amazon gift cards or PayPal cash, and the product bundles free credit-score access, a wallet and credit-management hub, a best-card cheatsheet, weekly insights scores, a Dream Wallet planner, and an Explore card-comparison and Test Drive tool. Kudos is backed by QED Investors. As of July 2026 Kudos publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs; its only machine-readable public surface is mobile app-association metadata at app.joinkudos.com.

providers.name: LastPass
providers.description: LastPass is a password and identity-management platform offering personal and enterprise vaults, single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, and directory provisioning. The LastPass Enterprise API and Provisioning API let admins programmatically manage users, groups, shared folders, policies, and events. SCIM and SAML endpoints integrate with identity providers; an MFA SDK supports adaptive authentication for custom apps.

providers.name: Levee Medical
providers.description: Levee Medical, Inc. is a privately held, clinical-stage medical device company headquartered in Durham, North Carolina, developing the Voro Urologic Scaffold — a bioabsorbable implant designed to support and stabilize the bladder neck and urethra following radical prostatectomy, in order to accelerate the return of continence and reduce the risk of chronic post-prostatectomy urinary incontinence. The device is investigational, is not approved for commercial sale, and is being evaluated in the FDA-approved ARID II IDE multicenter randomized pivotal trial. The company was founded in 2018 and has raised Series A and Series B financing. Levee Medical is a physical medical device manufacturer: it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification, and its only web surface is a WordPress marketing and clinical-trial site.

providers.name: Lycia Therapeutics
providers.description: Lycia Therapeutics is a South San Francisco, California biotechnology company developing a new class of targeted protein degradation medicines built on its proprietary lysosomal targeting chimera (LYTAC) platform, which originated in the Stanford University laboratory of Nobel laureate Carolyn Bertozzi, Ph.D. LYTAC molecules bind a disease-driving extracellular protein and shuttle it into the cell for destruction by the lysosome, allowing Lycia to pursue circulating and membrane-bound proteins that conventional small molecules and antibodies have been unable to drug. The company is led by President and Chief Executive Officer Aetna Wun Trombley, Ph.D., is backed by Versant Ventures, Redmile Group, Venrock, RTW and Blue Owl among others, and has partnered with Eli Lilly and Company to discover and develop LYTAC degraders. Lycia is a privately held, research-stage therapeutics company; it publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: Mahmee
providers.description: Mahmee is a wraparound maternal and infant healthcare platform that connects expectant and new parents with integrated, coordinated teams of nurses, doulas, lactation consultants (IBCLCs), mental health coaches, and nutritionists through virtual and in-person appointments. Founded by Melissa Hanna (CEO) and Linda Hanna (Director of Care), the platform delivers evidence-based pregnancy and postpartum care — including remote blood pressure monitoring, in-home newborn jaundice phototherapy, and lactation support — across all 50 U.S. states, with in-person clinics in California. Mahmee works with major insurers such as Aetna, Cigna, Kaiser Permanente, and United Healthcare, and focuses on reducing maternal health disparities. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Mars Reel
providers.description: Mars Reel (Mars Reel Media Corp) is a Los Angeles-based youth sports media and streaming company producing original basketball and soccer documentary series, athlete training content, and original episodic shows (The Vault, Like Mike, Game City). Its Mars Club membership provides premium on-demand video, and its TFIOM (The Future Is On Mars) label runs a Shopify fashion storefront. Mars Reel is a 500 Global portfolio company operating consumer web and streaming products. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or technical documentation; this profile captures its public identity and consumer link surface only.

providers.name: mokSa AI
providers.description: mokSa AI (moksa.ai) is an AI-powered surveillance and video-analytics platform that delivers real-time threat detection, automated alerts, and smarter operational decision-making from a single intelligent system. The platform integrates with existing camera and monitoring infrastructure and applies real-time training and analysis to detect security and safety threats across retail spaces, hospitality and lodging, educational institutions, fuel and service stations, and food-handling environments. mokSa AI states SOC 2 Type 2 certification and GDPR compliance for its data handling. The company was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public API, developer documentation, or SDK surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Motorway
providers.description: Motorway is the UK's fastest-growing used car marketplace, connecting private sellers with a network of more than 8,000 verified car dealers through a daily online auction. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in London and Brighton, the platform provides instant AI-assisted vehicle valuations, a mobile app that builds a sale-ready car profile, nationwide home collection, same-day payment (Motorway Pay), transport (Motorway Move), and outstanding-finance handling. Over one million people have used Motorway to sell a car. It is a consumer and dealer (B2C/B2B) marketplace rather than a public API provider: no developer portal, OpenAPI, or public API surface is published as of this enrichment pass. Backed by Index Ventures, ICONIQ Growth, BMW i Ventures and LocalGlobe.

providers.name: MyWear
providers.description: MyWear (operating as vPersonalize Inc.) is a Houston, Texas based, Accel-backed software company founded in 2014 that provides a cloud platform for on-demand apparel manufacturing and mass customization. Its integrated toolset spans the full production lifecycle: a 3D product customizer and 3D uniform builder for real-time design, an online pattern-making CAD with automated size grading, web-to-print and print-layout automation with color management (PANTONE, CMYK, custom SPOT), an automated catalog builder, e-commerce storefront integration, and order and factory management across multiple suppliers. The company holds six US patents covering its automation and pattern-generation technology and targets apparel brands, sportswear makers, and print-on-demand operators. The public surface is a marketing and product site (vpersonalize.com); no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI definition is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Nanit
providers.description: Nanit is a consumer smart baby-monitoring company whose camera-based system tracks infant sleep patterns, monitors breathing motion through wearable Breathing Wear, and sends real-time safety notifications to parents. Its products pair 1080p HD video with computer-vision analytics, alongside a companion mobile app, sound machines, and sleep-guidance content, sold direct-to-consumer as hardware plus app subscriptions. As of this enrichment pass Nanit publishes no public developer API, SDK, CLI, or webhook surface for third-party integration.

providers.name: Nanotronics
providers.description: Nanotronics (rebranded to CubeFabs in 2025) builds AI-driven inspection, process-control, and automation systems for advanced industrial manufacturing, with a focus on semiconductors, data centers, EV/automotive, and aerospace/defense. Its "AI factory" platform combines optical imaging, machine learning, and robotics to improve manufacturing precision, yields, and cost efficiency for customers including Hologic, Broadcom, Coherent, and Standard BioTools. Surfaced as a founders-fund portfolio company; no public developer/API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: National Labor Relations Board
providers.description: The National Labor Relations Board (NLRB) is an independent federal agency responsible for protecting the rights of employees and employers in the United States. The NLRB administers the National Labor Relations Act, which guarantees the rights of employees to form unions and engage in collective bargaining with their employers.

providers.name: National Technical Information Service
providers.description: The National Technical Information Service (NTIS) is a government agency that serves as the largest central resource for government-funded scientific, technical, engineering, and business-related information, collecting, archiving, and disseminating data and reports on energy, aerospace, health, and environmental topics.

providers.name: Netreo
providers.description: Netreo is an IT infrastructure monitoring platform (now part of BMC as BMC Helix Operations Management with Netreo) that provides full-stack observability across networks, servers, applications, cloud services and databases. The platform exposes a documented REST API for programmatic access to monitoring data, configuration, and automation workflows.

providers.name: Neurala
providers.description: Neurala is a Boston-based edge AI company whose Lifelong Deep Neural Network (L-DNN) technology is delivered as an embeddable, customized software library for on-device computer vision and visual inspection. Its stack trains on minimal data and runs entirely at the edge without cloud dependency, keeping data private on the device. Neurala partners directly with hardware and software makers rather than publishing a public self-service API; no public developer API, SDK registry package, OpenAPI, or /.well-known discovery surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Niron Magnetics
providers.description: Niron Magnetics is a U.S. advanced-manufacturing company commercializing high-performance permanent magnets made from Iron Nitride rather than rare-earth elements. Spun out of University of Minnesota and U.S. Department of Energy ARPA-E research and founded in 2013, the company holds 150+ patents around its Clean Earth Magnet technology and is building the first full-scale Iron Nitride magnet plant in Sartell, Minnesota, alongside its Minneapolis headquarters and a Washington, D.C. policy office. Its magnets target electric-motor, automotive, consumer-audio, industrial and defense applications, with announced collaborations including Stellantis, Moog, Aspina, FaitalPRO, MATTER and Bimotal. Niron Magnetics is a materials and hardware manufacturer: it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Nourish
providers.description: Nourish is a virtual nutrition-counseling telehealth platform that connects patients with Registered Dietitian Nutritionists (RDNs) through insurance-covered video appointments in all 50 states. Its network of more than 10,000 dietitians supports conditions including diabetes, eating disorders, heart health, and gut health, and a companion mobile app handles meal and goal tracking, secure messaging, lab-work review, and between-session support. Nourish verifies insurance and submits claims on the patient's behalf, with the company reporting that 94% of patients pay $0 out of pocket. Backed by Index Ventures, Menlo Ventures, and Susa Ventures, the company raised a $100M Series C. Nourish exposes a consumer marketing and patient-app surface only; no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation are published at this time.

providers.name: One Five
providers.description: One Five (styled one.five) is a sustainable packaging technology company based in Holm, Germany that pairs an AI-driven decision platform, Quartermaster, with ready-to-use recyclable and compostable packaging products. The Quartermaster platform embeds product-market-fit and material analysis into packaging development to accelerate material scouting and packing trials, helping consumer brands cut R&D spend, improve customer acquisition efficiency, and meet emerging packaging regulations while reducing environmental impact. One Five ships flexible sustainable packaging for categories such as dishwasher tablets and gummies through partners including Bluemorph and Glassleaf, and is backed by Speedinvest. The company offers no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Onefootball
providers.description: Onefootball is a Berlin-based digital football (soccer) media platform that aggregates news, live scores, match coverage, video highlights, and streaming (OneFootball TV) for a global audience across iOS, Android, and the web. Backed by Earlybird and Union Square Ventures, the company partners with clubs, leagues, and publishers to distribute content and operates an official merchandise store and a Web3/club ecosystem. Onefootball does not publish a public developer API or partner developer portal; content ingestion for partners is handled via WordPress REST and private editorial integrations rather than an open, documented API surface.

providers.name: OnMyGrad
providers.description: OnMyGrad is a Hong Kong-based campus-recruitment and career-learning SaaS platform that helps employers connect with university talent across Southeast Asia through virtual job-tasting and work-experience programs. Founded in 2021 by Jesse Chow and Chun Hin Anthony So, its B2B2C "OnMyGrad Space" lets employers build branded profiles, run virtual talent pipelines, and evaluate candidates, while students access immersive career and industry learning content from leading employers. The company launched its MVP in February 2021, raised pre-seed funding from 500 Global, and is expanding into Singapore and Taiwan. It operates a public marketing site and a web application but does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Outpace Bio
providers.description: Outpace Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company applying AI-powered protein design to cell therapy, with the mission of curing solid tumors. The company engineers novel proteins that reprogram immune cells to overcome the limitations of current cancer immunotherapies, built on a set of proprietary platform technologies (OUTSPACER, OUTSMART, OUTLAST, OUTSAFE) and logic-gated cell targeting. Outpace Bio is a private, research-driven organization backed by Playground Global; it operates no public developer API, SDK, or third-party technical platform, so this API Evangelist profile captures company identity, web properties, and domain-security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: PDI Technologies (fka PDI Software)
providers.description: PDI Technologies (formerly PDI Software) is a global provider of software and data solutions for the convenience retail and wholesale petroleum industries, serving 200,000+ customers across 60+ countries. Its portfolio spans PDIQ (an AI foundation for convenience and fuel operations), PDI Enterprise wholesale petroleum software, ERP and back-office systems, POS and store systems, logistics, loyalty marketing, fuel and mobility payments, an offer network, insights and analytics, cybersecurity (PDI Security and Network Solutions, formerly Echosat), and the consumer app GasBuddy. PDI is backed by Insight Partners and has grown through acquisitions including P97 Networks. The company exposes no public self-serve developer/API portal; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead.

providers.name: PLOS
providers.description: These examples use the search API to search the PLOS corpus of scientific articles. These examples are not intended to be a full explanation on the use of Solr. A full Solr query language explanation can be found here and a tutorial here. The construction of PLOS search queries deviates from the standard Solr query URL by using search instead of select when making request to the end point. The primary endpoint is http://api.plos.org/search and supports parameters such as q, fl, wt, start, and rows for querying the PLOS Solr index.

providers.name: Preteckt
providers.description: Preteckt provides AI-powered predictive maintenance for transit buses, coach buses, and trucking fleets. Its platform ingests vehicle sensor telemetry and applies machine-learning algorithms to detect maintenance issues before they cause breakdowns, reducing diagnostic time by nearly 50 percent and preventing roughly 20 percent of failures. Preteckt processes more than one million sensor data points per day per vehicle across 20+ maintenance-focused algorithms. The company is part of Diesel Laptops. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Preteckt publishes no public developer, API, documentation, or sign-up surface.

providers.name: Prisms VR
providers.description: Prisms VR (Prisms) is an educational technology company building what it calls the world's first spatial learning platform, where students learn core math, science, and other subjects by abstracting up from immersive, first-person physical experiences delivered in virtual reality. Founded by MIT engineer-turned-educator Anurupa Ganguly, the teacher-facing platform uses kinesthetic, embodied learning to help students grasp abstract concepts and aims to develop curious, resilient thinkers. Prisms is an a16z portfolio company; it was added to the API Evangelist network as a lead and profiled through the enrichment pipeline. As of this pass the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal surface.

providers.name: ProbablyMonsters
providers.description: ProbablyMonsters Inc. is an independent video game company headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with a second location in Fort Worth, Texas. Founded in 2016 by former Bungie CEO Harold Ryan, it operates as a parent company that founds, funds and incubates development teams building AAA and AA interactive entertainment — publishing titles including Crimson Moon, Storm Lancers, IRE: A Prologue and Nekome. ProbablyMonsters sells finished games to players through console and PC storefronts; it is not a platform or developer-tools business. It publishes no developer program, no public API, no SDK and no machine-readable API description, and its GitHub organization carries zero public repositories. This profile records that absence with the probes behind it.

providers.name: Quero Educação
providers.description: Quero Educação is a Brazilian education-technology company that operates a marketplace connecting students with higher-education institutions across Brazil. Its flagship product Quero Bolsa lets students compare colleges, courses and schools with price transparency and enroll online at discounted tuition, while a suite of institution-facing products — Nota Quero (online entrance exams), Matrícula Digital (digital enrollment), Quero Pago (tuition payments) and Quero Analytics (data intelligence) — helps partner schools fill seats and manage admissions. The company is a 500 Global portfolio company. It maintains a private GitHub organization and a public engineering blog on Medium, but exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or published API documentation at this time; this profile captures its public identity, domain-security posture, and commercial/legal surfaces.

providers.name: Recycleye
providers.description: Recycleye is a London-based company building AI-powered sorting equipment and analytics for waste management and material recovery businesses worldwide. Its products include Recycleye QualiBot robotic sorting cells, Recycleye QuantiSort optical sorting technology, and Recycleye Insights, a data analytics platform that uses computer vision (WasteNet) to identify and categorize waste streams. The company sells hardware and software into recycling operations to improve purity, recovery rates, and profitability. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC.
