As of this enrichment pass Recycleye publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK; this profile captures its identity and public web properties only.

providers.name: Remitbee
providers.description: Remitbee is a Canadian licensed money-services business (FINTRAC-regulated, founded 2014, Mississauga, Ontario) offering low-cost international money transfers from Canada to 100+ countries across 89 published corridors, along with CAD/USD currency exchange, mobile top-ups / recharge, international bill payments, gift cards, travel eSIMs, and business money-transfer accounts. Customers fund transfers via Interac e-Transfer, EFT bank transfer, bill payment, or debit card, with zero fees on transfers above $500 CAD and live, transparent exchange rates. Remitbee operates consumer web and iOS/Android apps; it exposes partner/embedded integration APIs but publishes no public self-serve developer portal, OpenAPI, or OAuth surface. It does publish a /llms.txt agent-ingestion index of its corridor pages. Added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company.

providers.name: Ripcord
providers.description: Ripcord is a document digitization and data-extraction company that uses proprietary robotics and AI to turn paper and digital records into structured, actionable business data. Its pipeline runs in three stages — robotic digitization (scanning paper to high-quality digital files), intelligence (AI classification, extraction, validation and enrichment), and action (accessing the resulting data through existing enterprise systems or Ripcord's Canopy cloud content-management platform). Ripcord serves manufacturing, financial services, insurance, real estate, energy, public sector, HR, food & beverage, and accounts-receivable management, with customers including Coca-Cola Bottlers, BP, UCLA, MUFG Bank, Agilent, and the IRS. Integration with enterprise systems (ERP, ECM, RPA, BI) is offered through direct engagement rather than a public developer API. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of GV and Lux Capital.

providers.name: Robust.AI
providers.description: Robust.AI is a robotics company building Carter, an AI-powered collaborative mobile robot for warehouse fulfillment and manufacturing environments. Founded by Rodney Brooks (co-founder of iRobot and Rethink Robotics) and colleagues, the company designs human-centered autonomous material-handling robots that work alongside people with minimal infrastructure change, no capital expenditure, and rapid ROI. Robust.AI is backed by Playground Global and was recognized among Fast Company's World's Most Innovative Companies of 2026. This is a physical-robotics company; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or GitHub surface.

providers.name: RPM International
providers.description: RPM International Inc. is a multinational specialty coatings and sealants company headquartered in Medina, Ohio, with annual revenues of approximately $7.4 billion. RPM operates a portfolio of over 100 leading brands across three segments: Consumer (Rust-Oleum, DAP, Zinsser), Construction (Tremco, Dryvit, Flowcrete), and Performance Coatings (Carboline, Stonhard, Plasite). RPM International does not currently offer a public developer API, but its subsidiaries and brands serve the construction, maintenance, and protective coatings markets globally.

providers.name: Ruzuku
providers.description: Ruzuku is a hosted online course platform for coaches, authors, and subject matter experts to create, teach, and sell online courses and learning communities. Ruzuku does not publish a documented public REST API or developer program. Its programmatic surface is exposed exclusively through a Zapier integration - authenticated with an API Key, API Secret, and Site URL generated under Account then Integrations then Configure Zapier - that offers event triggers (enrollments, lesson and course completions, quiz and assignment submissions, comments, cancellations) and a small set of student enroll, unenroll, and lookup actions. The APIs modeled below are honest logical groupings of that Zapier-mediated surface, not endpoints from a public Ruzuku API reference.

providers.name: SES
providers.description: SES (Société Européenne des Satellites) is a leading satellite operator providing global communications services, including broadband internet, broadcast, and secure government connectivity. The company designs, builds, and operates a fleet of geostationary and medium Earth orbit satellites, delivering resilient, high‑throughput connectivity to enterprises, governments, and consumers worldwide. SES focuses on innovative solutions for aviation, maritime, energy, and digital infrastructure, emphasizing sustainability and advanced technology integration across its network.

providers.name: SHINE Technologies
providers.description: SHINE Technologies is a privately held fusion technology company founded in 2010 and headquartered in Janesville, Wisconsin, that operates fusion neutron generators at industrial scale. High-current particle beams strike a tritium gas target to produce an intense neutron flux, which SHINE applies across four staged business phases: neutron imaging and radiation-effects testing (the Phoenix Imaging Center, the FLARE 14 MeV radiation-effects service, and a nuclear fuel scanner), medical isotope production (Cassiopeia, which makes the non-carrier-added lutetium-177 product Ilumira, and Chrysalis, a molybdenum-99 facility backed by a conditional $263M U.S. Department of Energy loan), used nuclear fuel recycling (the REDUCE process, with partners including Orano and Deep Isolation), and ultimately fusion energy. SHINE designs and manufactures its own particle accelerators, fusion targets and radiochemical processing systems, and merged with Phoenix LLC in 2022. It is a manufacturer of hardware and radiopharmaceuticals rather than a software company, and publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Sym
providers.description: Sym was a developer-first authorization and access-management platform for platform, security, and infrastructure engineering teams. Rather than a REST API, Sym exposes its control plane as infrastructure-as-code: teams declare access flows, environments, targets, and user-facing fields with the Sym Terraform provider, customize runtime behavior with the Python SDK (hooks and reducers in impl.py), and operate the platform with the symflow CLI. It automated context-based, time-bound access requests and approvals across AWS (IAM, SSO), Okta, GCP, Jira, Slack, and other targets with centralized governance embedded in an organization's existing SDLC. The Sym product is now largely wound down — the docs root is sunset and most source repositories under github.com/symopsio are archived — but its published packages, Terraform provider, and changelog remain available.

providers.name: Syntis Bio
providers.description: Syntis Bio is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company in Boston, Massachusetts developing oral therapies that use the small intestine as a delivery site. Its SYNT platform (Synthetic Tissue-lining) applies a mussel-inspired polydopamine polymer coating transiently to specific tissues in the GI tract, sustaining therapeutic activity for up to 24 hours before being naturally cleared. The platform is being applied to nutrient exclusion for obesity, gut-restricted enzyme replacement for rare metabolic disorders such as homocystinuria and maple syrup urine disease, and oral bioavailability enhancement for peptides and biologics. Lead candidate SYNT-101 is a once-daily oral pill intended to mimic aspects of gastric bypass by transiently blocking nutrient absorption in the duodenum. The company was co-founded in 2022 by MIT's Robert Langer and Giovanni Traverso with CEO Rahul Dhanda. Syntis Bio is a therapeutics developer and publishes no public API, developer program, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: TechProcess Payment Services
providers.description: TechProcess Payment Services is an Indian digital-payments pioneer that has been building and operating cloud-based electronic-payment platforms since 2000, when it launched BillJunction.com, India's first electronic bill presentment and payment service. Its payment gateway supports card payments, Net-banking, NACH, NEFT/RTGS, IMPS, UPI and e-wallets for merchants across India. The business is now part of Worldline India (ePayments India), whose merchant checkout product is Paynimo, offering hosted and embeddable checkout, native mobile SDKs, and 20+ e-commerce platform plugins so developers can accept digital payments with a few lines of code. Originally a Battery Ventures portfolio company, it was acquired by Ingenico Group and folded into Worldline.

providers.name: Tenaya Therapeutics *
providers.description: Tenaya Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in South San Francisco, California, focused on discovering, designing, developing, and delivering potentially curative gene therapies and precision medicines that address the underlying drivers of heart disease. Its clinical pipeline includes TN-201, an AAV-based gene therapy for MYBPC3-associated hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM), and TN-401 for PKP2-associated arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy (ARVC), both in early clinical development. Publicly traded on Nasdaq as TNYA and backed by investors including GV, the company operates as a therapeutics developer and publishes no public developer platform or API surface.

providers.name: Tennibot
providers.description: Tennibot builds AI-powered ball machines and autonomous ball collectors for tennis, pickleball, and padel. Its flagship Partner ball machine and Rover ball collector use computer vision and robotics to deliver realistic drills and eliminate manual ball pickup, controlled through the Tennibot mobile app for iOS and Android. The company, based in Auburn, Alabama and backed by Techstars, sells direct-to-consumer hardware; it ships a companion mobile app but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record; no external API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: The Atlas Marketplace
providers.description: The Atlas Marketplace (branded "The Atlas") is a free online community and knowledge marketplace for local government leaders. Officials and staff use it to learn from their peers about the smart, safe, and sustainable solutions working in their communities, browsing a searchable library of case studies, vendors, and civic-technology projects. The platform connects public-sector practitioners with the companies and partners behind proven municipal solutions across mobility, infrastructure, sustainability, and public safety. Backed by 500 Global, it operates as a content and community website rather than a developer/API product; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched from its public web presence.

providers.name: TigerBeetle
providers.description: TigerBeetle is an open-source (Apache 2.0) distributed financial accounting and transactions database, purpose-built for high-throughput, mission-critical double-entry bookkeeping and online transaction processing (OLTP). It is NOT an HTTP/REST API and ships no OpenAPI - the database is accessed over a custom binary wire protocol on TCP (default port 3000) via official client libraries for .NET, Go, Java, Node.js, Python, Ruby, and Rust. The "API" is the set of client operations - create_accounts, create_transfers, lookup_accounts, lookup_transfers, get_account_transfers, get_account_balances, query_accounts, and query_transfers - that use fixed-size, cache-line-aligned structs for zero-deserialization performance. TigerBeetle is self-hostable; a fully managed service is also offered to select enterprise partners via sales@tigerbeetle.com.

providers.name: Touchlight
providers.description: Touchlight is a UK-based cell-free DNA manufacturer, founded in 2007 and headquartered in Hampton, London, that produces synthetic DNA enzymatically rather than by bacterial fermentation. Its doggybone DNA (dbDNA) platform — along with mbDNA and z-dbDNA — is a cell-free, plasmid-free DNA vector used as starting material for mRNA, viral vector (AAV, lentivirus), non-viral gene therapy, gene editing and DNA vaccine programs, manufactured at what the company describes as the first GMP-licensed facility for fully cell-free enzymatic DNA. Touchlight sells physical DNA material — off-the-shelf catalogue constructs and custom RUO-to-GMP manufacturing — and operates no developer program, public API, or machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: TrustIQ
providers.description: TrustIQ (operating as Trusting Social) is a Singapore-headquartered AI fintech that provides alternative-data credit scoring, fraud detection, and digital identity verification for lenders and consumer platforms across emerging Asian markets including India, Indonesia, Vietnam, and the Philippines. Its products — Trust Scores (AI credit and fraud scoring built from telco and alternative data), Trust Vision (facial-recognition digital onboarding and KYC), and Smart Customer Acquisition — help financial institutions extend credit to underbanked, new-to-credit consumers. Engagement is sales-led; the company publishes no public self-service API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Valo Health
providers.description: Valo Health is a Boston-based drug discovery and development company that combines real-world human data, artificial intelligence, advanced causal inference and predictive chemistry to identify and validate therapeutic targets. Its work is organized around two stated capabilities: Human Causal Biology, which applies AI/ML and statistical genetics to large-scale human datasets and validates findings in human tissue, and Closed-Loop Chemistry, which pairs integrated computational modeling with laboratory work to engineer novel small molecules. The company, launched out of Flagship Pioneering and historically associated with its Opal Computational Platform, operates a shared risk-and-reward partnership model with pharmaceutical companies including Novo Nordisk, Merck KGaA, Pfizer and Lundbeck, advancing early-stage R&D while partners lead clinical development. Valo Health is a private biotechnology company that publishes no developer program, no public API and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Volley
providers.description: Volley is a San Francisco voice-AI entertainment company, backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, that builds voice-controlled and connected-TV games. Its catalog includes hits such as Song Quiz, Yes Sire, and officially licensed titles like Jeopardy!, Wheel of Fortune, and Family Feud, playable on Amazon Alexa, Google Assistant, Roku, Fire TV, LG, and Samsung TVs. The company is rebranding its consumer surface as "Weekend." Volley operates as a consumer entertainment product studio and does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Wanderu
providers.description: Wanderu is a ground-travel metasearch and booking platform - a Kayak-style aggregator that lets travelers search, compare, and book intercity bus and train tickets (plus flights and ferries) across hundreds of carriers in North America and Europe, including Amtrak, Greyhound, FlixBus, Megabus, Peter Pan, VIA Rail, and Deutsche Bahn. Its routing technology stitches together multi-operator bus-and-train itineraries, and bookings are completed in-platform with carriers paying a percentage of each fare. Wanderu operates a private booking/search API and publishes no public developer program, SDKs, or OpenAPI; its public open-source presence is internal engineering tooling on GitHub (the redis-backed "bamboo" queuing system). Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Xayn (now Noxtua)
providers.description: Xayn is a Berlin-based AI company founded in 2017 as XAIN out of research by Dr. Leif-Nissen Lundbaek and Prof. Michael Huth at Oxford and Imperial College London. Rebranded to Xayn in 2020, it built the Xaynet privacy-preserving federated learning framework and a privacy-protecting search and discovery engine. In February 2024 the company pivoted to legal AI and rebranded as Noxtua AG (noxtua.com), Europe's sovereign Legal AI for research, document analysis, and drafting, backed by a Series A of EUR 10M (2021, Global Brain/KDDI, with Earlybird) and a Series B of roughly EUR 81M led by legal publisher C.H. Beck. xayn.com is offline and the company publishes no public API or developer portal today; its former open-source SDKs and packages are archived.

providers.name: Zeitview
providers.description: Zeitview (formerly DroneBase) is an AI-powered aerial inspection and asset intelligence platform. It combines a managed network of drone and aircraft pilots with computer-vision analytics and lifecycle asset-management software to deliver inspection imagery, condition assessments, and actionable intelligence for wind energy, solar, utilities, oil & gas, construction, commercial real estate, and property management. As of this profile the company operates a customer web platform, support center, and blog but does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDK; data access is arranged through direct customer engagement.

providers.name: Adoc (Viva Innovation)
providers.description: Adoc is the corporate web presence of Viva Innovation Inc. (주식회사 비바이노베이션), a Seoul, South Korea health-technology company founded in January 2018 and based in Gangnam-gu, which operates the health-checkup and medical-records platform 착한의사 (Chakan Uisa / Kindoc). Consumers use the Kindoc mobile and web apps to pull scattered personal medical records into one place, run an AI symptom check against personal and Health Insurance Review and Assessment Service data, compare hospital examination packages and their costs, and book discounted health screenings; employers buy the same screenings as corporate checkup programs, and partner hospitals join through a hospital-affiliation program. For providers the company sells a medical cloud — Kindoc Care CMS and Kindoc Care PMS for checkup centres — alongside a medical AI line it splits into Preventive AI (test-item recommendation, plain-language result explanation, biomarker and biological-age analysis), Clinical AI (comprehensive findings generation, abnormal-finding triage, follow-up test recommendation) and Decision Support AI (disease-risk analysis from repeated checkup results, endoscopy anaesthesia-risk prediction, real-time endoscopic polyp detection), plus a generative "주치의 AI" assistant published as Dr.Patch at chat.kindoc.ai and a research arm, Kindoc Labs. Everything the company ships is a consumer app, a partner landing page or hospital-side software: as of this profile it publishes no developer portal, no API reference, no SDK and no machine-readable API contract on any host it operates.

providers.name: AGL Resources
providers.description: AGL Resources was an energy services holding company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, whose principal business was the distribution of natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial customers. In 2016, AGL Resources was acquired by Southern Company and renamed Southern Company Gas, becoming the nation's largest natural gas-only distribution company. The company distributes natural gas through subsidiaries including Atlanta Gas Light, Chattanooga Gas, Nicor Gas, and Virginia Natural Gas. AGL Resources / Southern Company Gas does not offer a public developer API; utility data access is available through third-party data aggregators and community-built integrations.

providers.name: AI Unlimited Group
providers.description: AI Unlimited Group, Inc. (OTC: AIUG) is a West Hollywood, California fintech holding company founded in 2022 as Lever Global Corporation and renamed in July 2024. It markets four consumer-facing, AI-branded platforms — Lever App (student-loan and consumer-debt management), Nest Egg (self-directed investing, via the Nest Egg Securities broker-dealer), Travl.App (travel planning and savings) and Resolve Debt (accounts receivable). All four are end-user mobile and web products; the company operates no developer program, publishes no API reference, and ships no machine-readable contract. As of September 2026 its corporate domain aiug.ai serves a GoDaddy parking lander and the Lever App backend host api.lever.app returns HTTP 503 with x-render-routing: suspend, leaving travl.app as the only live company property.

providers.name: AirPOS
providers.description: AirPOS Ltd is a Belfast, Northern Ireland software company that sells AirPOS Pay, a subscription-free cloud point-of-sale, integrated card payments, stock control, reporting and e-commerce platform for independent retailers in the UK and Ireland. The POS software is free and the company charges a single fee per card transaction (advertised at 1.4% + 14p for new businesses, from 0.8% for existing businesses), with the platform hosted on Amazon EC2 in Dublin. AirPOS ships an Android POS app and a web backoffice and integrates with Shopify, Xero, SumUp and Zettle, but it publishes no public API, SDK, webhook surface or developer program of any kind; its GitHub organization holds only forked infrastructure libraries. Surfaced via the API Evangelist secondary-market harvest (EquityZen listing), and profiled here as a company with no public API surface.

providers.name: Akkari
providers.description: Akkari is an autonomous customer operations platform that runs the operational work across the entire customer lifecycle — from the first sales call through onboarding, success, and expansion. It captures every commitment, issue, request, and opportunity surfaced across customer channels like Slack, Discord, email, calls, and meetings, then executes the actual work to close each loop: drafting follow-ups, converting bug reports into tickets, scheduling meetings, and flagging expansion signals. Built for AI-native startups by 2x Y Combinator founders (OrderAhead, acquired by Square; and BLADE), Akkari integrates with tools including Slack, Linear, GitHub, Gmail, and PostHog.

providers.name: Albemarle
providers.description: Albemarle Corporation is a global specialty chemicals company and leading provider of lithium, bromine, and other essential elements. Operating from its global headquarters in Charlotte, NC, Albemarle serves customers in approximately 70 countries with world-class hard-rock and brine lithium resources, state-of-the-art lithium conversion facilities, advanced lithium material and process development, bromine production facilities, and the US's only producing lithium resource in Silver Peak, NV. The company serves critical markets including electric vehicle batteries, energy storage, flame retardants, pharmaceutical ingredients, catalysts, and specialty chemicals, employing approximately 7,800 people and holding over 1,500 active patents worldwide.

providers.name: All3D
providers.description: ALL3D, Inc. is a San Francisco AI-powered visual content platform that replaces traditional product photography for ecommerce brands and agencies. Users upload a product photo and its real-world dimensions, build a scene from inspiration images and props, and generate 4K studio and lifestyle images, influencer/UGC-style video, editable 3D models, 360-degree spins, product configurators, and AR "view in room" experiences accurate to real-world scale. Additional tools cover magic erase, item replacement, scale adjustment, bulk generation across hundreds of SKUs, team review/approval workflows, and direct publishing to Shopify and Amazon. Enterprise plans add API access and managed services. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bullpen Capital and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Alta
providers.description: Alta (Alta Daily) is a New York City-based consumer AI styling and agentic-shopping app built by Flagship AI, Inc. It digitizes a user's wardrobe into a searchable digital closet, generates daily outfit recommendations from natural-language prompts, weather, and occasion, lets users virtually try outfits on a personalized avatar, and surfaces shoppable recommendations across 4,000+ partner brands. Powered by more than a dozen proprietary in-house multimodal generative AI models, Alta was named a TIME Best Invention of 2025 and raised an $11M seed round led by Menlo Ventures. It is offered as a free iOS and Android mobile app; as of this profile there is no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Animoca Brands
providers.description: Animoca Brands is a Web3 company focused on advancing digital property rights and building the open metaverse through blockchain technology, gaming, and digital assets. Founded in Hong Kong, the company operates a portfolio of consumer products including The Sandbox, Moca Network (digital identity), Open Campus (education), and Anichess, alongside institutional offerings such as Anchorpoint Financial (stablecoins and real-world assets) and NUVA (treasury management). Animoca Brands is also one of the most active investors in Web3, backing 600+ builders across gaming, infrastructure, real-world assets, and digital-ownership platforms. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of the SoftBank Vision Fund and added to the API Evangelist network; Animoca operates primarily as a holding and investment company and does not publish a first-party public developer API.

providers.name: Another
providers.description: Another is an AI-native software platform that modernizes off-channel and off-price inventory operations for fashion, beauty, and retail brands. Founded in 2024 by Corina Marshall, the platform connects to a retailer's existing systems - including returns management - to create a single source of truth for excess, returned, and pre-loved goods, then automates how brands identify, manage, and monetize that inventory across downstream channels. Teams can invite and connect with secondary merchandise recipients, send inventory proposals to buyers, request payment from partners, and let partners request inventory, replacing fragmented manual workflows spread across teams, buyers, channels, and partners. Another closed a $2.5M seed round in January 2026 co-led by Anthemis and Westbound. As of this profile the company operates a private, invite-based web application and publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Aporia
providers.description: Aporia was an AI guardrails and observability platform for production LLM and ML applications, known for low-latency guardrails covering hallucination, prompt injection, PII, toxicity, off-topic responses, and custom policies, alongside full ML monitoring for drift and data quality. Coralogix acquired Aporia in late 2024 and the Aporia guardrails technology is now offered as part of the Coralogix AI Observability and AI Guardrails product line, with the standalone Aporia.com experience consolidated into Coralogix's portfolio.

providers.name: Arctic Health
providers.description: Arctic Health provides AI-native provider credentialing and payer enrollment for healthcare organizations, handling the workflow end to end — from CAQH management and primary source verification to payer applications, contracting, and ongoing follow-up. The company collects and validates organization and provider data to each state and payer's requirements, submits on the organization's behalf across hundreds of payer portals, and monitors status and compliance on an ongoing basis. It serves medical practices, telehealth groups, RCM companies, and CVOs across all 50 states plus DC, offering both standard and white-label ("For Scale") solutions with AI-powered document extraction and error detection. Arctic Health is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) company based in New York City, also backed by Menlo Ventures and Fortitude Ventures.

providers.name: Arzana
providers.description: Arzana is an AI-powered Office Execution System for US manufacturers and distributors, founded in 2025 in San Francisco and backed by Y Combinator (Spring 2026). Arzana trains custom models on a factory's historical data and deploys agents that automate back-office work — quoting, estimating, order entry, purchasing, prospecting, outreach, CRM, AP 3-way match, AR tracking, and customer service — alongside a customizable ERP/CRM/MES with every agent pre-installed. Forward-deployed engineers configure each agent per operation; Arzana reports going live in 120 days with 99%+ accuracy. Arzana currently exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; it does publish a /llms.txt for agent discovery.

providers.name: Atlas Air Worldwide Holdings
providers.description: Atlas Air Worldwide Holdings is a global airfreight, charter, and aircraft leasing group headquartered in Purchase, New York and operating across more than 80 countries and 330+ airports. The holding company positions itself as the "Leader in Aviation Outsourcing" and runs three operating businesses: Atlas Air (ACMI, CMI, charter, and military/government cargo and passenger operations on Boeing 747-400F, 747-8F, 777F, 767, and 737-800BCF freighters), Polar Air Cargo (scheduled airport-to-airport cargo network, historically a joint venture with DHL), and Titan Aviation Leasing (commercial aircraft acquisition, leasing, and sale-leaseback services). Atlas is the largest operator of the Boeing 747 freighter, the Dreamlifter operator for Boeing, and one of the principal lift providers for Amazon Air's middle-mile network. In August 2022 a consortium led by Apollo Global Management with J.F. Lehman & Company and Hill City Capital agreed to take the company private in an all-cash transaction valued at approximately US$5.2 billion; the deal closed in March 2023, delisting the company (formerly Nasdaq: AAWW). As a freight carrier the group does not publish a public developer portal or open APIs — integrations with shippers, forwarders, and customers are delivered through private B2B channels (EDI, Cargo-IMP/XML messaging, airwaybill tracking on polaraircargo.com, and account-managed connectivity). A "Track Shipment" tool and a Special Loads request form (specialloads.atlasair.com) are the principal self-service surfaces; an internal-facing GitHub organization (Atlas-Air-Data-Platform) exists but publishes no public repos.

providers.name: Atlas Card
providers.description: Atlas is a technology company (not a bank) that offers an invite-only luxury lifestyle membership built around a premium metal charge card, issued by Lead Bank. Membership pairs a CNC-milled steel Atlas Card with no preset spending limit and a concierge-driven mobile app that delivers curated restaurant reservations, luxury hotel bookings, access to sold-out concerts and sporting events, points-based travel rewards, and thousands of dollars in annual travel and lifestyle credits. Atlas Card is a consumer fintech product with a full monthly-payment charge structure and an annual membership fee; it does not publish a public developer API. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures and enriched with the identity, well-known discovery, and domain-security surface it exposes publicly.

providers.name: Bayapay Sdn Bhd
providers.description: BayaPay Sdn Bhd is a Malaysian fintech (incorporated 2021, registration 202101021154 / 1421454-H, based in Subang Jaya, Selangor) building programmable, permission-based business and vehicle expense management on an open-loop prepaid Mastercard. Its flagship BayaFuel FuelFleet programme gives fleet operators, SMBs, corporate teams and gig workers real-time spend controls, customizable limits, fraud deterrence and digitized expense tracking across fuel, travel and operational spend. The reloadable prepaid card is issued under license from Instapay Technologies Sdn Bhd (a Bank Negara Malaysia e-money issuer and Mastercard Asia/Pacific licensee), and BayaPay is one of the first Full Functional Open-Loop payment solutions in the APAC region. A 500 Global portfolio company. The public site is Wix-powered and exposes an agent-accessible llms.txt and a hosted Wix Site MCP endpoint; no bespoke BayaPay developer/payments API is publicly documented at this time.

providers.name: BETA Technologies
providers.description: BETA Technologies is a Vermont-based aerospace company that designs and manufactures all-electric aircraft and the supporting electric aviation charging network. BETA produces two variants of its ALIA platform: ALIA CTOL (conventional take-off and landing) and ALIA VTOL (vertical take-off and landing), each carrying a pilot plus five passengers or equivalent cargo, with demonstrated range of 336 nautical miles and sub-hour recharge. BETA's Charge Cube is an interoperable multimodal charger now deployed at sites across the U.S. covering more than 50 million people within 50 miles, and the company operates a 188,000-square-foot net-zero manufacturing facility in South Burlington, Vermont. Customers include UPS, United Therapeutics, the U.S. Air Force and U.S. Army (via AFWERX Agility Prime), Air New Zealand, Bristow, Surf Air Mobility, and other early operators; BETA was selected for seven of the eight FAA eVTOL Integration Pilot Program initiatives.

providers.name: Binu
providers.description: Datafree Technologies (originally biNu, founded 2008 and headquartered in Sydney, Australia) operates a #datafree reverse-billing connectivity platform that lets enterprises sponsor the mobile data cost of their websites, apps and portals so end users can reach those digital services without spending their own airtime or data - much like a toll-free number, but for the mobile internet. Widely deployed across South African mobile networks, the platform works on any device with no new SIM, top-up or contract, and layers on security controls, allowlist management, time windows, usage caps and audit logging. Products include the Datafree Platform and Datafree Connect. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Blank Beauty
providers.description: Blank Beauty is a direct-to-consumer nail polish brand offering cruelty‑free, vegan, and customizable nail products. Founded to provide high‑quality, affordable polish with a focus on sustainability, the company operates an online storefront, a custom‑color creation tool, and a subscription service. It serves a global customer base through its e‑commerce site and social media channels, emphasizing community engagement and innovative product launches.

providers.name: Calderdale Data Works
providers.description: Calderdale Data Works is a local council open-data portal for United Kingdom running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately an open datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 481 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: Capitainer
providers.description: Capitainer provides microsampling solutions for laboratory and biotechnology applications. Their product portfolio includes the Capitainer®B10, B50, B10Vanadate, SEP10, DIP70 instruments, accessories, and lab services such as sampling kit instructions and kitting support. The company focuses on enabling precise low-volume sampling for research and clinical use, offering request pricing and sample services through their website.

providers.name: Caribou
providers.description: Caribou is a Denver-based fintech that helps drivers lower their monthly car payments by refinancing existing auto loans through a network of banks, credit unions, and community lenders. Customers check personalized rates with a soft credit pull (no score impact), compare offers, add co-borrowers, and complete refinancing online, and can bundle optional vehicle protection plans. Caribou reports 150,000+ customers and average savings of about $162/month. The company exposes a consumer web application and a contact-gated partner integration program (click-out and API options for affiliates); it does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI, or self-serve API at this time.

providers.name: ClassDojo
providers.description: ClassDojo is a San Francisco-based education technology company that builds a classroom communication and behavior management platform connecting teachers, students, and families. The core ClassDojo product enables teachers to share photos, videos, and messages with parents; track social-emotional learning through Points and Big Ideas; manage attendance, timers, and classroom utilities via the Teacher Toolkit; and translate parent-teacher messages into 190+ languages. The platform serves more than 50 million teachers, students, and families globally and remains free for teachers. ClassDojo also offers Dojo Islands (adventure-based learning), Dojo Tutor (math, reading, dyslexia, and ESL tutoring), Dojo Sparks, and ClassDojo Plus as premium experiences for families. The company's revenue model is consumer subscriptions and tutoring; there is no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or webhook surface, and the GitHub organization at github.com/classdojo publishes only internal utilities, forks, and policy documents rather than developer-facing artifacts.

providers.name: Cocos Capital
providers.description: Cocos Capital is an Argentine investech and online broker (ALyC, founded 2021 in Buenos Aires) offering a 100% digital investment platform for retail investors. Through its mobile app and website, users open an account and trade Argentine stocks, CEDEARs, sovereign and corporate bonds, mutual funds, the MEP dollar, US stocks via an international account, and crypto, with a fast onboarding experience aimed at making investing accessible to everyone ("Invertir es para todos"). Cocos is registered as an ALyC and regulated by Argentina's Comision Nacional de Valores (CNV), settles through the BYMA group, and has surpassed 300,000 accounts. Cocos publishes no official public API for developers; the client libraries that exist (e.g. pyCocos) are unofficial, community-built and reverse-engineered from the app, so they are recorded here as third-party and unsupported.

providers.name: Collabra
providers.description: Collabra (Collabra Pty Ltd, ABN 35 672 933 818) is an Australian enterprise AI automation company whose platform combines robotic process automation with large language models to run back-office operations — contract review, revenue assurance, financial operations, vendor management, data processing, and compliance monitoring. Its product suite is CollabraCore (isolated, segmented data-protection workspaces), CollabraGuard (an AI-safety layer that constrains LLM output to prevent hallucinations and errors while logging every action), and CollabraFlow (a rapid build-test-deploy environment for automation workflows). The public tagline is "AI you can trust to run your operations". As of this profile Collabra is a demo-led SaaS with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: CoPlane
providers.description: CoPlane is a San Francisco-based enterprise software company building an AI-native intelligent operations layer for the back office of essential enterprises. The platform combines AI agents with deterministic business rules on a durable workflow engine to automate high-friction, exception-heavy processes across finance, procurement, and operations — including invoice intake, PO matching, vendor onboarding, cash application, billing, collections, bank and account reconciliation, close processes, and variance analysis. CoPlane runs inside the customer's own cloud environment and interoperates with existing enterprise systems (SAP, Workday, Coupa) across Source-to-Pay, Quote-to-Cash, and Record-to-Report workflows without a rip-and-replace migration. Founded in 2024, the company raised a $14M seed round in November 2025 led by Ribbit Capital with participation from Stripe, Optum Ventures, and Terrain. This profile was surfaced as a Ribbit Capital portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; CoPlane does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: CurbStand
providers.description: CurbStand provides valet, monthly parking, and mobile car wash services in Los Angeles. Founded in 2013, it offers a mobile app for locating, paying, and tipping for valet services, as well as subscription-based monthly parking and on-demand car wash. The company emphasizes convenience, safety, and flexible pricing, targeting both individual drivers and event organizers.

providers.name: DanAds
providers.description: DanAds is a global advertising technology company offering a self‑serve ad platform that streamlines ad sales, operations and creative management. It enables advertisers and publishers to automate workflows, maximize revenue, and expand globally through a unified solution. The platform provides tools for campaign creation, inventory management, reporting, and integration with major ad exchanges.

providers.name: data.overheid.nl
providers.description: data.overheid.nl is a national government open-data portal for Netherlands running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 20,386 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: Datenregister Berlin
providers.description: Datenregister Berlin is a municipal government open-data portal for Germany running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 2,609 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: DatologyAI
providers.description: DatologyAI is a data curation and optimization platform that automatically identifies, prioritizes, and curates training data at petabyte scale so teams can train machine learning and foundation models that are better, faster, and smaller. Founded on the principle that "models are what they eat," its research-driven pipeline improves model quality while cutting compute cost and training time, and is used by AI labs and enterprises building frontier open models. The company is venture-backed by Amplify Partners and Felicis. DatologyAI operates as an enterprise, contact-sales service and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or documentation portal.

providers.name: David Energy
providers.description: David Energy is a clean-energy technology company and licensed electricity retailer that installs free plug-in smart batteries for homes and businesses. Its software charges batteries when grid power is cheap and discharges them during peak-price periods to lower customers' monthly utility bills, alongside bill-monitoring and thermostat-management advisory tools. Backed by Union Square Ventures, David Energy operates in the New York City market with a stated mission of powering the grid on 100% clean energy and shifting the balance of energy control from institutions toward consumers.

providers.name: Eclipse GlassFish
providers.description: Eclipse GlassFish is the open-source reference implementation of the Jakarta EE platform, formerly owned by Sun/Oracle and now stewarded by the Eclipse Foundation. GlassFish is a lightweight Java application server that ships a full Jakarta EE runtime (Servlet, JAX-RS, CDI, JPA, EJB, WebSocket, JMS, Concurrency, etc.) and exposes a built-in REST management API on the DAS (Domain Administration Server) for administering domains, applications, resources, monitoring data, and configuration. The management API is part of the server itself rather than a public hosted service.

providers.name: Electric Hydrogen
providers.description: Electric Hydrogen (EH2) is a Massachusetts-based clean-energy company that designs, manufactures, and commissions the world's most powerful PEM electrolyzers, packaged into a fully-integrated 100MW HYPRPlant that turns water and renewable electricity into the lowest-cost green hydrogen. The complete plant solution bundles power conversion, gas processing, water treatment, and thermal management so heavy industry can decarbonize ammonia, e-fuels, steel, and refining at gigawatt scale. Founded in 2020 and led by CEO Raffi Garabedian, EH2 operates a 1.2GW gigafactory in Devens, Massachusetts, became green hydrogen's first unicorn with a $380M Series C, and is backed by Fifth Wall, Fortescue, Energy Impact Partners, bp Ventures, Temasek, and Microsoft's Climate Innovation Fund. This profile enriches the API Evangelist network stub with the company's real public web surface.

providers.name: Evommune
providers.description: Evommune, Inc. (Nasdaq: EVMN) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Palo Alto, California, discovering and developing therapies that target the key drivers of chronic inflammatory disease. Founded in 2020 by the team behind Dermira, the company applies a human tissue-based translational approach to immunology and is advancing a clinical pipeline that includes EVO756, an oral small-molecule MRGPRX2 antagonist in Phase 2b development for chronic spontaneous urticaria and migraine prophylaxis, and an IL-18 binding protein fusion program licensed from AprilBio. Evommune publishes no developer program, no public API and no machine-readable API contract; its public web presence is a WordPress marketing site plus a hosted investor-relations portal.

providers.name: Fabrix
providers.description: Fabrix (Fabrix Security) is an AI-native identity and access management company building AI agents for identity security. Its platform centers on the Identity Knowledge Graph, which unifies fragmented human, machine, and AI-agent identities across providers, and a set of AI agents that automate identity visibility and intelligence, user access reviews, just-in-time privileged access, identity lifecycle management, identity security posture management (ISPM), and non-human / AI-agent governance. Deployed as an agentless solution, Fabrix uses cross-provider identity resolution (deterministic matching, heuristics, and AI) plus natural-language analysis to speed access reviews, risk scoring, and compliance. Founded as a venture-backed startup (Norwest Venture Partners, Merlin, Jibe) and ISO 27001 aligned, Fabrix announced it is joining Silverfort in 2026 to build a runtime identity security platform. This profile currently tracks the company and its public web surface; Fabrix does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or API reference.

providers.name: Fleetline
providers.description: Fleetline is an all-in-one AI dispatch and fleet-optimization platform for trucking fleets. Its AI-based dispatch engine ingests load, driver, and ELD data, simulates billions of scenarios, and recommends the best assignment plan so operators maximize revenue, productivity, and fleet utilization. The platform aggregates major load boards into a unified workspace, identifies schedule gaps and fills them with spot loads, composes complex trips with tradeoff analysis, forecasts delays, breakdowns, and HOS violations, and includes an AI assistant trained on fleet history and TMS data. Fleetline is a Bloomberg Beta portfolio company; it exposes a marketing site, a customer login/auth portal, and an internal API host, but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Forge Nano
providers.description: Forge Nano is a materials-technology manufacturer headquartered in Thornton, Colorado that commercializes particle and wafer Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) under its Atomic Armor platform and patented ALDx architecture. The company applies atomic-scale nanocoatings to powders, electrodes and semiconductor wafers to improve energy density, cycle life, thermal stability and yield, and sells three lines of business: US-sourced lithium-ion cells from its Morrisville, North Carolina gigafactory, commercial semiconductor wafer-fabrication equipment including the TEPHRA cluster tool for 200mm wafers, and Powder ALD coating systems for batteries, catalysts and composites. Its markets are semiconductors, energy storage, defense and aerospace, AI hardware and quantum devices. Forge Nano is a hardware and advanced-materials company: as of this profiling pass it publishes no public developer portal, API, SDK or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Foundation Building Materials
providers.description: Foundation Building Materials (FBM) is a leading North American distributor of interior building products — drywall, steel framing, acoustic ceilings, insulation, and complementary construction supplies — serving commercial and residential contractors across the United States and Canada. Headquartered in Santa Ana, California, FBM operates a national branch network and a unified customer ordering platform at myfbm.com (consolidating the legacy fbmsales.com, MyRIS, and MyFBM portals) along with iOS/Android mobile apps for contractors. In April 2025, FBM acquired KCG/Rew Materials, adding 800 employees and 45 distribution branches across 23 states. In August 2025, Lowe's announced an agreement to acquire FBM. Brand families operating under FBM include FBM, RIS, Pacific Source, and Unified Door. FBM does not currently expose any public developer APIs, OpenAPI documentation, partner integration program, SDK, or GitHub organization — its digital surface is limited to buyer-facing e-commerce (search, ordering, order tracking, quick-order PDF/photo ingestion via "Quick Order Entry") rather than a developer/integration product.

providers.name: Freeport Markets
providers.description: Freeport Markets is a Y Combinator-backed fintech and crypto trading platform offering 24/7 self-custody access to stocks, crypto, commodities, forex, rates, perpetual futures and pre-IPO shares, with leverage and AI analysts that turn social and financial media into a real-time feed of market-moving news and actionable trade ideas. The consumer product is delivered primarily through iOS and Android apps and emphasizes self-custody, "smart money" signal tracking (insiders, politicians, hedge funds and social media), and unified DeFi opportunities in a single interface. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Freeport Markets does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer documentation at this time.

providers.name: Genmo
providers.description: Genmo is a San Francisco research lab building open-source video generation models. Its flagship release, Mochi 1, is an Apache-2.0 licensed 10B-parameter text-to-video diffusion model (AsymmDiT architecture) with strong prompt adherence and high-fidelity motion. Genmo does NOT publish a first-party hosted developer REST API. Programmatic access to Mochi comes in three honest forms: (1) the open-source model itself, self-hosted via the repo's Python pipeline ("simple composable API"), CLI, Gradio UI, or ComfyUI; (2) third-party hosted inference APIs from partners such as Replicate and fal.ai; and (3) a credit-based consumer web app and Playground at genmo.ai/play. The endpoints documented here for hosted access are modeled from partner documentation and are not operated by Genmo.

providers.name: Goat Group
providers.description: Goat Group is the parent company behind a family of global marketplaces for sneakers, apparel, and luxury goods, operating the GOAT marketplace and app (goat.com), the Flight Club consignment stores and site, the Grailed peer-to-peer menswear and streetwear community, and the alias B2B platform. Founded in 2015 by Eddy Lu and Daishin Sugano and headquartered in Los Angeles (Culver City), California, the company began as a sneaker marketplace that pioneered ship-to-verify authentication and grew into one of the largest platforms for buying and selling new and pre-owned style. Goat Group went through Y Combinator (Winter 2015) and has raised capital from investors including D1 Capital Partners, Park West Asset Management, Foot Locker, Index Ventures, and others. The company does not currently publish a public developer API program; this profile is a network identity record.

providers.name: GoodFirms
providers.description: GoodFirms is a B2B research, ratings, and reviews platform that helps service seekers find the best IT services providers, software, and freelancers across various business categories.

providers.name: Grpcurl
providers.description: grpcurl is an open source command-line tool for interacting with gRPC servers, like curl for gRPC with support for service reflection and JSON encoding.

providers.name: Hexagon Manufacturing Intelligence
providers.description: Hexagon Manufacturing Intelligence is a division of Hexagon AB providing metrology, quality management, and manufacturing intelligence software and hardware. Products include PC-DMIS (CMM measurement software), WORKXPLORE (CAD viewer), SFx (smart factory platform), and HxGN Smart Quality. The division offers APIs and SDKs for automating CMM measurement programs, integrating quality data into MES and ERP systems, and building custom metrology applications.

providers.name: i2x
providers.description: i2x is a German real-time AI platform for contact centers, built by i2x GmbH in Mönchengladbach. It provides live agent assistance that surfaces contextual recommendations during calls in under 0.4 seconds, including automatic detection of purchase signals and faster agent onboarding; full-coverage call analysis with automatic transcription plus quality, compliance, and sales-opportunity scoring across 100% of conversations; and voicebots for automated inbound/outbound telephony and virtual agent-training scenarios. The platform emphasizes DSGVO/GDPR compliance with EU-only hosting in German data centers, prepared works-council documentation, and EU AI Act alignment, positioning itself as an alternative to US-cloud-dependent conversation-intelligence tools. i2x publishes no developer program: no API reference, no OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL specification, no SDK on any package registry, no public GitHub organization, no MCP server, no agent card, no status page and no pricing — the only commercial entry point is a demo-request form. A private, login-gated API host does exist at api.eu.i2x.ai serving the customer web application at app.i2x.ai, but it is undocumented and is not offered as an integration surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of hv-capital.

providers.name: Jain Irrigation Systems
providers.description: Jain Irrigation Systems Ltd (JISL) is a global agri-industrial conglomerate headquartered in Jalgaon, Maharashtra, India, and is widely cited as the world's largest micro-irrigation company. Founded in 1963 by Padma Shri recipient Bhavarlal Jain under the slogan "More Crop Per Drop," the company manufactures drip and sprinkler irrigation systems, PVC/HDPE/PP and plumbing piping, rigid and foam plastic sheets, solar pumping and photovoltaic systems, tissue-culture planting material, greenhouses and protected cultivation, and processed foods. JISL operates 33 manufacturing bases across four continents, serves 126+ countries through 11,000+ dealers, is listed on the BSE and NSE, and reports turnover exceeding USD 1.2 billion. The company publishes a structured llms.txt for AI crawlers but exposes no public developer API.

providers.name: JMEM
providers.description: JMEM (Jmem Tek) is an upstream semiconductor company specializing in Application-Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC) solutions for quantum-resilient cybersecurity. The company designs hardware security intellectual property and provides IC design services, offering products such as JRoot, JPUF, JCrypt, and JShield, along with Zanker, described as the world's first PUF-based post-quantum cryptography (PQC) chip. Its NIST-aligned, quantum-safe encryption and hardware-anchored identity authentication protect chips against counterfeiting and unauthorized modification across UAV, automotive, surveillance, and fintech applications. JMEM is a portfolio company of 500 Global, added to the API Evangelist network and enriched from its public web presence; it publishes no public API or developer surface at this time.

providers.name: Keystatic
providers.description: Keystatic is an open source, Git-based content management system that stores content as Markdown, JSON, and YAML directly in a project's Git repository. The Keystatic Reader API is a Node.js library that lets applications read Keystatic content from any local directory or GitHub repository server-side, supporting frameworks like Next.js, Astro, Remix, and React Server Components.

providers.name: Kitura
providers.description: Kitura was an open source web framework for server-side Swift, originally developed by IBM, that allowed developers to use Swift for building web applications and REST APIs with support for databases, WebSockets, and OpenAPI. The project is now archived and no longer actively maintained, but remains a useful historical reference for server-side Swift API development.

providers.name: Kreya
providers.description: Kreya is a GUI client for gRPC, REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, and Server-Sent Events APIs. All data is stored in git-diffable files for easy reviews and versioning. Kreya provides automated snapshot and scripted tests, flexible environments, and support for all gRPC streaming modes.

providers.name: KUKA
providers.description: KUKA AG is a German industrial automation company headquartered in Augsburg, Bavaria, founded in 1898 and majority-owned by China's Midea Group since 2016. KUKA designs and manufactures industrial robots, autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), production cells, controllers, and the software stack that drives them. Its product portfolio spans six-axis articulated robots (KR series), sensitive collaborative robots (LBR iiwa, LBR iisy), mobile platforms (KMR iiwa, KMP), and palletizing/welding/CNC cells, controlled by the KR C4 and KR C5 / KR C5 micro controller generations. The robot software stack centers on KUKA System Software (KSS/VSS) for KR C4-class hardware, the newer iiQKA.OS / iiQKA.OS2 operating system for KR C5, and the KUKA Robot Language (KRL) for motion programming, with extension surfaces including KUKA.RobotSensorInterface (RSI), KUKA.EthernetKRL, KUKA.PLC mxAutomation for external PLC control, KUKA.OPC UA, and KUKA.AppTech / iiQKA App Builder for option packages. Engineering and simulation are delivered through iiQWorks (iiQWorks.Sim, iiQWorks.App Builder, iiQWorks.Copilot) and KUKA.Sim, while operational software includes KUKA Xpert (documentation/cloud), KUKA iiQoT (condition monitoring), and KUKA Connect / my.KUKA customer portals. KUKA does not publish a first-party public REST/OpenAPI developer API or an official GitHub organization for its robot control stack; integration is performed through proprietary protocols (RSI, EthernetKRL, mxAutomation, OPC UA, PROFINET, EtherCAT) and SDKs distributed via the iiQKA Creator portal and KUKA Xpert. A meaningful body of open-source KUKA integration code lives in the community-maintained kroshu GitHub organization (ROS 2 drivers, external-control SDK, URDF robot descriptions) and the roboticsapi / openkuka projects. KUKA serves automotive, electronics, battery, metal, consumer goods, healthcare, aerospace, and e-commerce logistics customers, and through its Swisslog subsidiary extends into warehouse and intralogistics automation.

providers.name: LF Research
providers.description: LF Research is the Linux Foundation's research arm that publishes reports and studies on open source trends, OSPO practices, technology adoption, and industry analysis. It provides data-driven insights to help organizations understand and participate in open source ecosystems.

providers.name: Loftia
providers.description: Loftia is a cozy, solarpunk massively-multiplayer online (MMO) game developed by Qloud Games Pty Ltd, a remote-first indie studio founded in 2022 and headquartered in Sydney, Australia. Set across floating islands in a warm, sustainable world, players farm, craft, decorate, socialize, and build a life in the sky alongside friends in a shared world that grows over time. The studio (founded by Eric Mallon, Martina Qin, and Michael Su) raised a $5M seed round led by BITKRAFT Ventures and GFR Fund with participation from Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), and took part in a16z's SPEEDRUN gaming accelerator. Loftia is a consumer game company with no public developer API surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Manus Bio
providers.description: Manus Bio Inc. (trading as "Manus", the BioAlternatives Company) is a Cambridge, Massachusetts industrial biotechnology company founded in 2011 out of MIT by Dr. Aji Parayil and Dr. Greg Stephanopoulos. Manus engineers microbial cell factories and precision-fermentation processes so that complex molecules normally obtained through petrochemical synthesis, agricultural extraction, or animal husbandry can be produced by fermentation instead - what the company calls bioalternatives. Its commercialized products include the first U.S. commercial-scale monk fruit sweetener (produced at its Augusta, Georgia BioFacility), the Yume M stevia Reb M sweetener co-developed with Tate & Lyle, citrus-derived aroma ingredients (Nootkatone 70, Valencene 80, BioNootkatone) for Givaudan, and an artemisinin antimalarial program funded by HHS/ASPR. It sells scale-up services through its BioAccelerator and BioManufacturing programs (protein engineering, strain development, bioprocess development from 250 ml to 3,000 L, pilot-scale and biomanufacturing). In April 2025 Manus merged with genome-engineering company Inscripta, adding whole-genome editing technology and the MAD7 CRISPR nuclease licensing program; inscripta.com is now a redirect notice. Manus is a manufacturer of physical ingredients and a contract development and manufacturing organization - it sells molecules and services, not software. It publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, webhook surface, or machine-readable specification of any kind, and its computational and AI-driven enzyme-engineering tools are internal capabilities that support its services rather than a customer-facing platform.

providers.name: Motorq
providers.description: Motorq is a connected vehicle intelligence platform that taps native OEM connectivity to deliver AI-powered insights across the automotive ecosystem. It aggregates and normalizes vehicle telematics data from 25+ automotive brands and third-party sources without plug-in hardware or dongles, so fleets, fleet management companies, dealerships, lenders, insuretechs, and mobility companies can drive maintenance, safety, utilization, and EV use cases. Motorq offers access through a cloud fleet management portal, bi-directional APIs and data streams (Get Location, Create Geofence, and more), and a Snowflake data lake integration. Its Motorq Fuse AI layer surfaces prioritized recommendations ranked by severity and cost impact. API access is gated to enterprise and OEM partners; there is no public self-serve developer portal or OpenAPI definition. Backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Mytos
providers.description: Mytos is a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) for regenerative medicine and cell therapy. Its iDEM automation platform automates every unit operation of cell culture — coating, seeding, feeding, imaging, passaging and harvesting — in standard 2D T-flask formats, letting clinical-stage biotech companies transfer their manual protocols to automated GMP production at up to 50% lower batch cost, with 10x less labor and cleanroom footprint per batch. Mytos operates a CDMO facility within the Cell and Gene Therapy Catapult site and is backed by Wing Venture Capital. No public developer/API surface was found during enrichment; the profile captures the company's verified security posture (trust center, SOC 2/SOC 3/21 CFR Part 11, domain security, vulnerability disclosure).

providers.name: NSW Government Open Data
providers.description: NSW Government Open Data is a state government open-data portal for Australia running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 16,907 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: O-RAN
providers.description: O-RAN supports the Open Radio Access Network architecture under the Linux Foundation for more interoperable and virtualized mobile network infrastructure. It defines open interfaces between RAN components enabling multi-vendor deployments and network intelligence through AI and machine learning.

providers.name: Ohalo
providers.description: Ohalo is a data governance company whose Data X-Ray platform discovers, classifies, redacts, and governs unstructured data across enterprise file systems, databases, and cloud stores at petabyte scale. Using generative AI for content categorization and extraction, it helps organizations inventory sensitive data, audit access entitlements, automate redaction, and prepare their data estates for AI adoption while meeting regulatory frameworks such as GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI DSS. Ohalo is backed by 500 Global, Anthemis, and Craft Ventures.

providers.name: Olli Health
providers.description: Olli Health is an AI-powered managed service for home health agencies that automates medical coding and OASIS (clinical assessment) and Plan of Care quality review. It pairs clinical artificial intelligence with certified human coders to ingest patient documentation (faxes, handwritten notes, and digital records), produce ICD-10 coding and OASIS review, and push approvals back into existing EHR workflows. The company reports 98%+ accuracy, roughly 4x faster turnaround, and about half the cost of traditional coding vendors, serving 100+ agencies and 200,000+ patients. Olli Health is HIPAA compliant, SOC 2 certified, and its OASIS/Plan of Care quality review service is CHAP Verified. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company; as of this enrichment pass Olli Health publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Omnicom Group
providers.description: Omnicom Group Inc. (NYSE: OMC) is the world's largest marketing and sales communications holding company, formed in its current shape when Omnicom completed its acquisition of Interpublic Group on 26 November 2025, combining pro forma revenue in excess of $25 billion. The company operates across advertising, media, precision marketing, commerce, public relations, healthcare, branding, experiential and production, serving clients in more than 100 countries through agency networks including BBDO, DDB, TBWA, OMD, PHD, Hearts & Science, McCann, FCB, Mediabrands, Flywheel and Acxiom. Its Omni platform — built and operated by Annalect, Omnicom's data, technology and AI division — is marketed as an AI-driven marketing intelligence operating system spanning orchestration, production, predictive intelligence and outcome-driven activation, and is grounded in Acxiom Real ID identity data. As of the 2026-08-12 probe, Omnicom publishes no public developer program: no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL document, SDK, MCP server or A2A agent card is served from any Omnicom host. The corporate site moved from omnicomgroup.com to omc.com, which 301-redirects the legacy domain.

providers.name: ONEAIX (1data / Yida Technology)
providers.description: ONEAIX (壹沓科技（上海）有限公司, formerly branded 1data / Yida Technology) is a Shanghai-headquartered enterprise AI company founded in 2016 that builds "digital employees" for global supply chains. Its 小沓AI platform ships two product lines — Cuber for supply-chain logistics (AI sales, route, operations, documentation and customs specialists covering quoting, booking, bills of lading, manifests and customs declaration) and Linker for supply-chain brands (brand, PR, GEO, content, e-commerce and data-analysis specialists) — on three in-house layers: Dax LLM, a supply-chain vertical LLM; Dax OS, an enterprise agent runtime and governance platform; and Dax KE, an agent-native knowledge engine, all delivered from the login-gated www.yxd.info tenant platform. Customers include COSCO Shipping, Sinotrans, Qingdao Port, DSV, Xtep and Colgate. ONEAIX publishes no developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract; the only agent-facing artifact it serves is a first-party llms.txt.

providers.name: OnsiteIQ
providers.description: OnsiteIQ is a construction intelligence platform for real estate owners and developers that combines regular on-site 360-degree reality capture with AI-powered computer vision to monitor construction progress across trades and asset classes. The platform documents projects visually week over week, turns the imagery into searchable, measurable records, and surfaces analytics and actionable insights that teams use to verify progress, support payment applications, and make business-critical decisions on projects anywhere in the world. OnsiteIQ is a private company headquartered in New York City and backed by Anthemis and Bullpen Capital. As surfaced through the API Evangelist network, OnsiteIQ publishes a marketing and product website but does not expose a public developer API, documentation portal, or machine-readable API surface at this time; this profile records that honest state alongside the company's identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Open 3D Foundation
providers.description: The Open 3D Foundation is a Linux Foundation project supporting the Open 3D Engine (O3DE), an open source, real-time 3D engine for building games, simulations, and other 3D applications. With Microsoft as a premier member, it provides a modular, cross-platform engine with advanced rendering capabilities.

providers.name: open NRW
providers.description: open NRW is a open data portal open-data portal for Germany running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 10,579 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: opendata.swiss
providers.description: opendata.swiss is a national government open-data portal for Switzerland running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 14,544 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: Oriient
providers.description: Oriient provides software-only, hardware-free indoor positioning ("indoor GPS") and navigation delivered as a SaaS SDK. Its geomagnetic technology reaches roughly 1-meter (3-foot) accuracy indoors without Wi-Fi, beacons, or installed infrastructure, powering product finding, order picking, visitor navigation, asset tracking, and in-store analytics for retail, grocery, and smart-building customers across thousands of locations. Oriient New Media Ltd is based in Tel Aviv and is a Techstars portfolio company. Oriient ships first-party mobile SDKs (including a React-Native Product Location AI package on npm) rather than a public REST API; integration is gated behind a customer dashboard and sales.

providers.name: Personetics
providers.description: Personetics is a Cognitive Banking platform that helps banks and financial institutions deliver AI-driven, financial-data-personalized customer engagement and money management. Its products analyze customer transaction data in real time to surface personalized insights, proactive financial guidance, automated savings and cash-flow programs, and self-driving finance experiences embedded inside a bank's own mobile and web channels. Personetics serves hundreds of banks and financial institutions across roughly 30 global markets, reaching an estimated 150 million banking customers, and positions itself as a way for banks to deepen and monetize customer relationships. The platform is delivered as enterprise software integrated into a bank's digital banking stack rather than as a public self-serve developer API; developer and integration material lives in a gated Personetics Documentation Hub.

providers.name: Pine
providers.description: Pine is a Canadian digital-first mortgage lender and real estate brokerage (Pine Canada Financial Corporation / Pine Real Estate Brokerage) that makes home buying more accessible for Canadians through an online platform offering low interest rates, fast pre-approvals, and zero hidden fees. Backed by Greylock, Pine pairs mortgage origination with a REALTOR-affiliated brokerage licensed across multiple provinces (ON, AB, SK, NS, NB, NL), and reports more than $2B in mortgages funded and 100,000+ clients served. Pine is a consumer fintech product with no public developer API; its backend at api.pine.ca is a private, authenticated service.

providers.name: Poly
providers.description: Poly is an AI-powered intelligent cloud file browser that syncs a user's local files to the cloud and layers an AI agent over them, letting people search by image, concept, phrase, color or face and ask natural-language questions about their documents, images, video and audio to get summaries, transcriptions, tags and generated content such as podcasts and presentations. Founded by CEO Abhay Agarwal, Poly (formerly reached at withpoly.com, now poly.app) emerged from stealth in November 2025 with $8M in seed funding led by Felicis with participation from Bloomberg Beta, NextView, Figma Ventures, AI Grant, Wing Ventures and MVP Ventures. It is currently in waitlist/beta on web and Mac, with a Windows version planned, and as of this enrichment pass publishes no public developer API, SDKs, CLI, or MCP server.

providers.name: Polycam
providers.description: Polycam is a cross-platform 3D scanning and capture company building consumer and professional tools for turning the physical world into high-fidelity 3D content. Its iOS, Android, and web apps support LiDAR-based space capture, photogrammetry, photosphere capture, AI-generated 3D models, and Gaussian Splat reconstructions, with export formats including glTF/GLB, OBJ, FBX, DAE, STL, USDZ, point clouds, and CAD-friendly files. Polycam serves freelancers, AEC and real-estate teams, VFX and game studios, e-commerce sellers, and enterprise operators with 2D/3D floor plans, measurement tools, shared team libraries, virtual walkthroughs, AI reports, custom branding, SSO, and TransformEngine for custom 3D file creation. Revenue is subscription based across Free, Basic ($30/mo or $150/yr), Business ($400/yr per user), and Enterprise tiers, with sales-led pricing for organizations at scale. Polycam exposes a developer mode in the iOS app that unlocks a raw-data export bundle (raw.glb mesh, keyframes, images, cameras, depth maps, confidence data, mesh_info.json) used by partners such as Vuforia, Immersal, and Unity/Unreal workflows, and ships an open-source Python toolkit (polyform) for converting raw captures to NeRF and other research formats. As of this profile there is no public REST API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal — integrations happen through raw exports, partner pipelines, and the Polycam app surface itself.

providers.name: Pronto
providers.description: Pronto is an on-demand and subscription-based house-help marketplace operating across 11 Indian cities (including Mumbai, Bangalore, Delhi, Hyderabad, and Pune). It connects urban homes with trained, background-verified Pronto Professionals for everyday household chores such as cleaning, laundry, kitchen prep, bathroom care, ironing, dusting, and window cleaning. Customers book in the Pronto mobile app (iOS and Android) for instant (a Pro in ~15 minutes), scheduled, or recurring service, and pay in-app; the withpronto.com website is the marketing surface while the booking flow runs in the app. Pronto is backed by Bain Capital Ventures and General Catalyst. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is currently published; the only machine-readable surface is a provider-published llms.txt.

providers.name: Rakuten Mobile
providers.description: Rakuten Mobile is the Japanese mobile network operator (MNO) of Rakuten Group, headquartered in Setagaya, Tokyo, and Japan's fourth nationwide carrier alongside NTT Docomo, KDDI, and SoftBank. Commercially launched in April 2020 and surpassing 10 million subscribers in December 2025, Rakuten Mobile built and operates the world's first fully cloud-native, end-to-end virtualized mobile network on Open RAN, with 4G population coverage of 99.9% and expanding 5G plus 700 MHz Platinum Band rollout. The same engineering effort spun out into Rakuten Symphony, a B2B business that productizes the Rakuten Mobile playbook as the Symworld platform — a cloud-native operating platform for telcos covering Open RAN (CU/DU/RIC, Symware distributed unit appliance), Symworld Cloud (Kubernetes-based hyperconverged telco cloud / CNP), OSS/BSS, site management, and a marketplace of pre-integrated cloud-native network functions from 50+ vendor partners. Symphony also offers Rakuten CPaaS (carrier-grade SMS, Confirm/OTP, and Short URL APIs running on the Rakuten Mobile network with JWT-authenticated REST endpoints at api.cpaas.symphony.rakuten.net) and Rakuten Communications Platform (RCP) for enterprise private 5G. Public, developer-accessible APIs are concentrated in the CPaaS suite; the Symworld platform APIs themselves are TM Forum-aligned but exposed under commercial engagement rather than a public developer signup.

providers.name: React Native
providers.description: A framework for building native apps using React, enabling cross-platform mobile development for iOS and Android.

providers.name: Reliable Robotics
providers.description: Reliable Robotics is a California-based aerospace company developing continuous autopilot and remote piloting systems that retrofit existing fixed-wing aircraft for automated and remotely supervised flight across all phases (taxi, take-off, cruise, landing).
