As an agricultural commodity trading business, Alliance One International did not maintain a public developer API program, and probes on 2026-09-01 found none at its successor either: pyxusinternational.com is now a parked domain and the live corporate site at www.pyxus.com publishes no API, SDK, webhook surface, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Alpheus Medical
providers.description: Alpheus Medical is a private, clinical-stage biotechnology company developing Porphyrin Metabolite Activation (PoMA™), a drug-led, tumor-selective oncology approach using low‑intensity ultrasound to activate a tumor‑accumulating drug, currently in Phase 2b trials for glioblastoma. The therapy aims to improve outcomes while reducing treatment burden for patients and families.

providers.name: American Operator
providers.description: American Operator acquires small businesses from retiring owners and pairs them with vetted operators through an operate-to-own model, where operators begin with a 10% stake on day one and follow a defined path to majority ownership. The company runs an "Exit Confidently" program that gives retiring owners all-cash closes, and supports its operators with hands-on guidance, industry advisors, and a governance structure. Backed by 8vc, American Operator publishes a marketing and applicant website but exposes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface as of this profile.

providers.name: API Insights
providers.description: API Insights is a free online tool powered by Treblle that provides advanced API analysis and monitoring by evaluating OpenAPI specifications across multiple dimensions including AI readiness, design quality, performance, and security. It scores APIs against industry benchmarks and provides actionable recommendations for improvement.

providers.name: Applied Compute
providers.description: Applied Compute is a San Francisco AI company founded in 2025 by former OpenAI researchers, building "Specific Intelligence" for the enterprise. It operates a cloud platform for training, inference, and continuous improvement of custom, open AI models and long-horizon, tool-using agents grounded in a company's own proprietary data. Rather than selling a generic model, Applied Compute embeds engineers with customer teams to fine-tune models, mine production data, run online/reinforcement learning, and deploy autonomous agents that operate inside the customer's environment with observability over rollouts. The company emerged from stealth in October 2025 and is backed by Kleiner Perkins, Benchmark, Sequoia Capital, Lux Capital, Greenoaks, Neo, Elad Gil, and others at a reported ~$1.3B valuation. Named customers include DoorDash, Cognition, Harvey, and Mercor.

providers.name: ArriVent
providers.description: ArriVent BioPharma is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the identification, development, and commercialization of differentiated medicines to address the unmet medical needs of patients with difficult-to-treat diseases, beginning with cancers. The company operates through three strategic pillars — Discover (identifying oncology programs with strong scientific rationale), Partner & Collaborate (licensing promising candidates and building partnerships), and Develop (designing development strategies leveraging regulatory expertise). Its lead candidate is firmonertinib, an EGFR inhibitor, alongside ARR-002, a tetravalent antibody-drug conjugate. ArriVent was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes a corporate website and an investor relations site but exposes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Asbury Automotive Group
providers.description: Asbury Automotive Group is one of the largest automotive retailers in the United States, operating new and used vehicle dealerships across multiple states and brands. Headquartered in Duluth, Georgia, Asbury operates approximately 200 dealerships representing 30+ automotive brands including luxury and non-luxury vehicles. The company operates under multiple brand names including Coggin Automotive Group, Crown Automotive Group, Park Place Dealerships, Nalley Automotive Group, and others. Asbury does not expose a public developer API but operates digital retail platforms including Clicklane, their proprietary online vehicle purchase platform.

providers.name: Atmobiosciences
providers.description: Atmobiosciences (Atmo Biosciences) develops ingestible gas‑sensing capsules that measure gastrointestinal gases in real time. The Atmo Gas Capsule System provides clinicians with direct, localized data on gas production throughout the GI tract, enabling improved diagnosis and monitoring of motility disorders. The company’s platform integrates hardware, software, and data analytics to deliver actionable insights for research and clinical care.

providers.name: Auquan
providers.description: Auquan builds production-grade, autonomous AI agents for institutional finance — agentic systems that convert messy, global, unstructured data (earnings calls, ESG disclosures, filings, news across 2M+ sources in 76 languages) into auditable, decision-ready intelligence and fully-formed deliverables such as credit memos, IC memos, portfolio-monitoring alerts, sustainability reports and LP reporting. Its RAG-powered agents cover 550,000+ companies and entities and complete end-to-end workflows autonomously for banks, asset managers, private credit, insurers and other institutional clients. Founded by Chandini Jain (CEO) and Shub Jain (CTO) with offices in New York and London, Auquan is used by 40% of the top 50 financial institutions (MetLife, T. Rowe Price, BC Partners) and was named a Gartner 2025 Cool Vendor in Agentic AI. The platform is demo/sales-gated and publishes no public self-service API or developer portal.

providers.name: Aurie
providers.description: Aurie is a medical device company developing the world’s first automatically reusable no‑touch catheter system. Founded in 2018 in Syracuse, New York, Aurie aims to improve independence for individuals requiring intermittent urinary catheterization by reducing infections and eliminating the need for disposable catheters. The company has received FDA De Novo clearance and is expanding internationally, targeting over 600,000 potential users in the United States.

providers.name: Avalynpharma
providers.description: Avalyn Pharma is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing inhaled therapies for rare and serious respiratory diseases, with a focus on idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) and other interstitial lung diseases. Its inhaled-delivery pipeline includes AP01 (inhaled pirfenidone), AP02 (inhaled nintedanib), and AP03 (a fixed-dose combination), aiming to deliver antifibrotic medication directly to lung tissue to improve efficacy while reducing systemic side effects. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners, the company is a therapeutics developer and publishes no public API or developer surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Azos
providers.description: Azos is a Brazilian insurtech (founded 2021) that sells fully digital life insurance directly to consumers and through a broker (corretor) channel. Its products include life insurance, serious-illness coverage, accidental-disability coverage, and funeral assistance, all contracted online in minutes with no medical exam, transparent pricing from around R$5/month, and coverage up to R$1 million. The company positions itself as "seguro de vida sem burocracia" (life insurance without bureaucracy) and is backed by Prosus Ventures. Azos runs a consumer app and a broker portal but publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Bachatt
providers.description: Bachatt is a daily savings and investments mobile app operated by Trusave Fintech Private Limited, designed for India's underserved and self-employed population. As an AMFI-registered mutual fund distributor, Bachatt lets users save from as little as INR 100/day and invest in liquid mutual funds (Insta Fund) with instant withdrawal, curated mutual fund baskets (Bachatt Wealth), gold and silver mutual funds, fixed deposits, and access instant personal and business loans (Insta Loans) up to INR 5 lakhs. The company partners with major AMCs including SBI, ICICI Prudential, Axis, and HDFC and delivers everything through a single UPI-powered mobile application on Android and iOS. Bachatt is backed by Accel. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Bachatt is a consumer fintech app and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Bag Borrow or Steal
providers.description: Bag Borrow or Steal is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: secondary-market) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Bardy Diagnostics
providers.description: Bardy Diagnostics provides ambulatory ECG monitoring solutions, including the CAM Patch and BDxCONNECT platforms, enabling continuous cardiac rhythm tracking for patients and clinicians. The company focuses on remote cardiac diagnostics, offering detailed reports, arrhythmia detection, and integration with healthcare professional workflows. As part of Baxter’s portfolio, Bardy Diagnostics delivers innovative, FDA‑cleared technologies for real‑time cardiac monitoring and data analytics.

providers.name: Beam Therapeutics *
providers.description: Beam Therapeutics is a biotechnology company pioneering precision genetic medicines through base editing, a technology that makes precise, predictable, and efficient single-base changes to the genome without cutting the DNA double helix. The company is developing a portfolio of investigational base editing programs across hematology, hepatology, and other therapeutic areas, using multiple delivery modalities including electroporation, nonviral lipid nanoparticles, and viral vectors. Publicly traded on Nasdaq as BEAM, Beam was named a TIME100 Most Influential Company in 2026. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of gv and hongshan; it is a life-sciences company with no public developer/API surface at this time.

providers.name: Behance
providers.description: Behance is Adobe's online creative networking and portfolio platform where designers, illustrators, photographers, and other creatives showcase, discover, and follow creative work through project-based portfolios. Founded in 2005 by Matias Corea and Scott Belsky, it was acquired by Adobe in 2012 for roughly $150 million and is now tightly integrated with Adobe Creative Cloud and Adobe Portfolio. Behance passed 24 million members by 2020. Adobe has since retired the former public Behance REST API, so the platform no longer exposes a documented public developer program; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company/provider record.

providers.name: Bend
providers.description: Bend is a mobile application company offering a daily stretching and movement platform. The Bend app provides guided routines, video demonstrations, and progress tracking to help users improve flexibility, reduce pain, and maintain an active lifestyle. With millions of downloads, Bend targets a broad audience from beginners to athletes, emphasizing simplicity, affordability, and personalized workout plans.

providers.name: BenefitBay
providers.description: BenefitBay provides an ICHRA administration platform that connects brokers, employers, employees, and carriers in a unified ecosystem. It offers real-time plan modeling, compliance tools, and direct premium payments, aiming to simplify individual health reimbursement arrangements and improve employee satisfaction across the United States.

providers.name: Benson Hill *
providers.description: Benson Hill (now operating as Confluence Genetics at confluence.ag) is a seed-innovation company that develops high-protein, energy-dense soybean varieties using AI-driven plant science and advanced crop genetics. Its soy solutions serve three markets — animal feed, human food, and renewable fuel — pairing proven genetics with technology and environmental responsibility. Originally added to the API Evangelist network as a GV portfolio lead; the company has since rebranded from Benson Hill to Confluence Genetics and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Biosapieninc
providers.description: BioSapien Inc. develops localized cancer therapy technologies, including the biodegradable MediChip™ implant that delivers sustained cytotoxic treatment directly at tumor sites. Based in San Diego with operations in Abu Dhabi, the company focuses on precision oncology, in‑house manufacturing, and partnerships to advance targeted cancer treatments.

providers.name: Blank Street
providers.description: Blank Street is a consumer coffee and beverage retailer that began in 2020 as a single 5x10 coffee cart in Brooklyn and has grown into a global brand operating roughly 90+ locations across the United States and the United Kingdom, serving seasonal specialty drinks such as matcha and espresso beverages. The company emphasizes convenience through mobile ordering and a loyalty rewards program via its consumer app, alongside merchandise and gifting. It is backed by General Catalyst and Tiger Global and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company. Blank Street publishes a consumer web and mobile experience (rewards, ordering, shop, locations, help center) but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or specification surface at this time; this profile captures its public web properties and domain-security posture.

providers.name: BMI
providers.description: Broadcast Music, Inc. (BMI) is the largest performing rights organization in the United States, representing songwriters, composers and music publishers. It collects and distributes royalties for public performances of music, offers licensing services to businesses, and provides resources, advocacy, and career development for music creators. BMI also runs programs like Health Connect, Spark, and AI & Copyright initiatives to support its members.

providers.name: Boltsolutions
providers.description: Bolt Solutions is a digital agency founded in 2025 that builds fast websites and drives growth for brands. It offers packages, client case studies, and a focus on SEO, conversion gains, and rapid development, positioning itself as a small‑agency with big‑agency results for founders seeking fast, scalable digital experiences.

providers.name: Brondell
providers.description: Brondell designs and manufactures innovative bathroom and home wellness products, including bidets, water filtration systems, air purifiers, and shower accessories. The company focuses on health‑focused solutions that improve hygiene, water quality, and indoor air, offering both consumer and commercial lines. Brondell’s products are sold online and through retailers, and the brand maintains a robust support and resource hub for customers.

providers.name: Burnbot
providers.description: Burnbot is a wildfire mitigation and fuels management company that builds autonomous, remotely-operated machines and delivers field services to reduce hazardous vegetation and conduct controlled, precision fuel-reduction burns. Its equipment operates in steep, remote, and hazardous terrain around the clock in most weather conditions, cutting fuel loads without disturbing healthy vegetation or compacting soil, and is used across fire hazard mitigation, systematic fuels management, and timber operations. Burnbot works with utilities, transportation agencies, land managers, and tribal governments including PG&E, Caltrans, the U.S. Forest Service, and CAL FIRE. Burnbot was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a hardware and field-services company with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Camp
providers.description: CAMP is a family experience company operating immersive, rotating themed retail-and-play venues ("The Family Experience Store") across eleven U.S. markets — Atlanta, Boston, Charlotte, Chicago, Houston, Los Angeles, Miami, Minneapolis, New York City, Philadelphia, and Washington D.C. It blends hands-on crafts, counselor-led immersive activities, character meet-and-greets, birthday parties, and a curated toy retail store both in-store and through its online shop. CAMP is a venture-backed consumer brand (investors include Bullpen Capital) and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, or SDK surface.

providers.name: CarbonQuest
providers.description: CarbonQuest provides distributed carbon capture solutions that turn industrial CO₂ emissions into revenue-generating resources. Their modular DCCS™ system captures CO₂ at source across biogas, low‑carbon power, and food & beverage sectors, offering financing with no upfront capital and enabling carbon credit generation, tax credits, and sustainable CO₂ supply.

providers.name: Cardurion Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Cardurion Pharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on transforming the treatment of cardiovascular disease and heart failure. Its research and development pipeline centers on novel small-molecule programs including PDE9 inhibition for chronic heart failure (HFrEF and HFpEF) and CaMKII inhibition for cardiac diseases such as catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia (CPVT). Cardurion combines target discovery, adaptive clinical trial design, and precision-medicine approaches, and was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). The company publishes a corporate and R&D website but does not expose a public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Cartrawler
providers.description: CarTrawler is a leading B2B technology provider of car rental, ground transport and insurtech solutions to the global travel industry. Through its Connect Platform it links airlines, online travel agencies and travel companies to a worldwide marketplace of car rental suppliers, private transfers and ride-hailing partners, displaying millions of cars daily and processing billions of queries. CarTrawler serves 70+ airlines and 250+ travel companies worldwide (including American Airlines, Ryanair, easyJet, Qantas, Southwest, eDreamsODIGEO and Uber), differentiating through proprietary technology, real-time machine-learning pricing and personalized retailing. Integration is delivered through partner and supplier programs rather than a public self-service developer portal; this profile was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Carziqo
providers.description: Carziqo develops intelligent driving technologies and autonomous mobility platforms, offering end‑to‑end solutions from advanced driver assistance to fully autonomous vehicle services. The company powers real‑world mobility with AI‑driven perception, planning, and fleet management, serving millions of rides and targeting global deployment across diverse regions and regulations.

providers.name: Chatime
providers.description: Chatime is a global bubble tea franchise founded in 2005, operating in over 30 countries with thousands of stores. It offers a wide variety of handcrafted tea drinks, seasonal flavors, and a franchise model for entrepreneurs. The company focuses on quality ingredients, innovative beverage concepts, and expanding its presence worldwide through franchising and corporate-owned locations.

providers.name: ChowNow
providers.description: ChowNow is a Playa Vista, Los Angeles-based restaurant technology company providing commission-free online ordering, branded mobile apps, marketing tools, and operational software purpose-built for independent restaurants. Founded in 2011, ChowNow powers ordering websites, native iOS/Android apps, QR-code dine-in ordering, catering, email and SMS marketing, a rewards program, Flex Delivery, order aggregation, and centralized menu management for 20,000+ restaurants. The platform integrates with 20+ point-of-sale systems including Toast, Square, Revel, Clover, Lightspeed, Heartland Genius, Skytab, and PosiTouch, and syndicates restaurant menus through a Discovery Network spanning Google, Apple Maps, Yelp, and other channels, with optional hand-off to DoorDash, UberEats, and Grubhub for last-mile delivery. ChowNow's business model is flat-fee software-as-a-service for restaurants rather than per-order commissions, and the company does not publish a public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, webhooks reference, or open developer portal. Third-party integration is handled through pre-built connectors managed inside the restaurant dashboard and a private partnerships program; prospective POS, delivery, and technology partners apply through a partnerships form rather than self-serve API documentation. The company's public GitHub presence consists primarily of forks of open-source Python/JavaScript tooling and archived internal libraries, with no SDK, client library, or specification repositories.

providers.name: Claritypediatrics
providers.description: Clarity Pediatrics is a virtual pediatric telehealth clinic that diagnoses and treats ADHD, anxiety, and childhood obesity in children ages 5-17, currently serving families in California and Texas. It combines clinical evaluations, medication management, and evidence-based behavioral programs — Behavioral Parent Training (BPT) and RUBI for ADHD, the SPACE program and a Teen Anxiety Program for anxiety, and lifestyle medicine for obesity — delivered by licensed multispecialty clinicians through video visits and weekly group sessions. It is a direct-to-consumer healthcare platform (parent app + provider referral) with no public developer or API surface at this time. Backed by Homebrew; added to the API Evangelist network from VC-portfolio discovery and enriched from its public web presence.

providers.name: Clubhouse
providers.description: Clubhouse (Alpha Exploration Co.) is a social audio application founded in 2020 by Paul Davison and Rohan Seth, backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Kindred Ventures. It popularized live "drop-in" audio chat rooms where people gather to talk, listen, and learn in real time across clubs, channels, and scheduled events. Clubhouse ships consumer iOS and Android apps and operates its service on the clubhouse.com / clubhouseapi.com domains. The company does not publish an official, documented public developer API or SDK; the only machine-readable interfaces are third-party, reverse-engineered clients maintained by the community and not endorsed by Alpha Exploration Co. This API Evangelist profile captures the provider's real public surface — website, legal, and support properties plus a live domain-security probe — with no fabricated API artifacts.

providers.name: Collectiv Food
providers.description: Collectiv Food is a next-generation B2B food wholesaler serving professional kitchens across the UK and France. Launched in London in 2022, it combines collective buying power, consolidated deliveries, and direct sourcing through a shortened, patented supply-chain model to supply restaurants, hotels, and caterers with meat, fish, plant-based proteins, dairy, produce, dry and frozen goods, and prepared items. The company emphasizes traceability, responsible sourcing, and sustainability, and is B-Corp certified with an EcoVadis Gold rating. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; no public API or developer portal is currently published.

providers.name: Compass Therapeutics
providers.description: Compass Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing proprietary antibody-based therapeutics for the treatment of cancer. Its research is grounded in understanding the tumor microenvironment, designing candidates that optimize the components required for an effective anti-tumor immune response and bridge innate and adaptive immunity. Lead clinical programs include tovecimig and CTX-8371. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV, this is a life-sciences company profile in the API Evangelist network; it publishes a corporate and investor web presence but no public developer, API, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: Corner Health
providers.description: Corner Health is a primary care provider network operating in Arizona and Washington that connects patients with independent nurse practitioners and advanced practice registered nurses (APRNs). The company offers everyday and preventative care, chronic condition management, women's health, weight management and metabolic health, and hormone management, with longer appointment times, acceptance of major insurance plans, same-day/evening/Saturday availability, and continuity with the same provider across visits. It is a patient-facing healthcare service that publishes no public developer program, API, or technical documentation; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of homebrew and enriched with verified identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Coverfox
providers.description: Coverfox is one of India's largest online insurance distribution platforms, offering retail insurance products including car, bike, health, and life insurance alongside embedded insurance solutions for lenders, NBFCs, and fintechs. The company partners with 37+ IRDAI-approved insurers to compare, purchase, and manage policies online, and has reached roughly 10 million households across India. Coverfox was backed by Accel and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes no public developer program or API at this time.

providers.name: CoverHound
providers.description: CoverHound is an InsurTech marketplace, now part of Brown & Brown, Inc. (NYSE: BRO), that lets consumers and small businesses compare and buy insurance online from A-rated carriers across all 50 states. Its platform covers personal lines — auto, homeowners, and renters — alongside business insurance including general liability, workers' compensation, professional liability, commercial auto, cyber, and directors & officers coverage. Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Carpinteria, California, CoverHound provides digital quote comparison, agent-assisted purchasing, and an insurance learning center. It operates as a consumer/SMB web marketplace and publishes no public developer program, API, or technical documentation surface.

providers.name: CRISPR Therapeutics
providers.description: CRISPR Therapeutics (NASDAQ: CRSP) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company founded in 2013 and headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, with US operations in Boston, Massachusetts. Co-founded by CRISPR/Cas9 pioneer Emmanuelle Charpentier, the company develops transformative gene-based medicines for serious human diseases. Its programs span hemoglobinopathies, immuno-oncology, regenerative medicine, and in-vivo editing; its lead therapy CASGEVY (exagamglogene autotemcel), developed with Vertex Pharmaceuticals, is the first approved CRISPR/Cas9 gene-editing treatment for sickle cell disease and transfusion-dependent beta thalassemia. This is a corporate/investor web presence with no public developer program or API surface.

providers.name: Curi Bio
providers.description: Curi Bio develops human-relevant platforms integrating human cells, systems, and data to accelerate the discovery of new medicines. Their iPSC-based products enable scientists to build mature predictive tissue models for cardiac, skeletal muscle, and neuromuscular applications, supporting drug safety, efficacy, and potency testing.

providers.name: Curie.Bio
providers.description: Curie.Bio is a seed-stage biotech venture firm and drug-discovery co-pilot co-founded by Zach Weinberg (founder of Flatiron Health), Alexis Borisy, and Christoph Lengauer. It pairs seed investment — typically $5M-$7M initial checks, backed by a $380M pro-rata Series A follow-on fund — with hands-on scientific and operational support from a team of experienced drug hunters, helping therapeutics founders design their science and move programs into the clinic and toward a strong next round of financing. Curie.Bio has raised close to $1B and is backed by GV, a16z, and ARCH Venture Partners. It operates as a company/investor profile in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer API or platform, so most technical API artifacts are not applicable to this provider.

providers.name: Custodian
providers.description: Custodian (getcustodian.com) is a Mexico City-based consumer mobile application and insurtech service that centralizes vehicle documentation and automotive administrative tasks. The app helps drivers organize and store important paperwork, track expiration dates for registration, insurance policies, and health certificates, receive renewal notifications, and get assistance with auto-insurance renewals and claims management. A premium annual subscription (450 MXN) adds full document-handling and verification services (including Mexico City vehicle verification). Custodian is a consumer app distributed via the Apple App Store and Google Play; it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI at this time. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Data Sciences International
providers.description: Data Sciences International (DSI) is a preclinical research instrumentation and services company for in vivo physiology and translational research, operating as part of Harvard Bioscience. DSI builds implantable and external telemetry systems, respiratory measurement (plethysmography, airway mechanics, pulmonary function), inhalation and smoke-exposure systems, iPRECIO infusion pumps, and behavioral monitoring (VivaMARS), paired with analysis software (Ponemah, FinePointe, NeuroScore) and surgical, data-analysis, GLP-validation and training services. It is a laboratory-instrument and life-sciences vendor rather than an API provider; no public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface is published. Surfaced as a portfolio company of canaan-partners and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency
providers.description: Since 1958, DARPA has held to an enduring mission: to create technological surprise for U.S. national security. Working with innovators inside and outside government, DARPA invests in transformational breakthroughs across biological technologies, defense sciences, information innovation, microsystems, strategic technology, and tactical technology. DARPA does not expose public developer APIs but does publish an RSS news feed and program information through its website.

providers.name: Demander Justice
providers.description: Demander Justice (demanderjustice.com) is a French legal-technology company that lets everyday people (justiciables) resolve disputes and take a matter to court without hiring a lawyer. Through simplified, guided online procedures it helps users send formal notices (mise en demeure), file injonctions de payer, and bring cases before the relevant French courts across consumer, housing, telecom, travel, banking, neighbor, and small-claims disputes. The service combines legal information fiches with a step-by-step document-generation and court-filing workflow. Backed by Partech; profiled in the API Evangelist network under the Consumer sector. No public developer/API surface was found at enrichment time.

providers.name: Dia (The Browser Company)
providers.description: Dia is The Browser Company's successor browser to Arc, positioned as an AI-native browser that integrates a chat assistant, contextual search across open tabs and connected apps (GSuite, Slack, Notion, GitHub), Morning Brief summaries, automatic Reports, Better Meetings, and Live Work integrations directly into the browsing surface. Currently available on macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon. No public developer REST API or SDK has been published; the product is consumer-facing and integrates with third parties as a user-side agent rather than via developer APIs.

providers.name: Digital Currency Group
providers.description: Digital Currency Group (DCG) is a cryptocurrency and blockchain holding and venture company founded in 2015 by Barry Silbert and headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut. DCG builds, incubates, and invests in companies across the digital asset ecosystem, including subsidiaries such as Grayscale Investments and Foundry. It operates as an investor and parent company rather than a direct API provider; this network profile tracks DCG's public web presence and corporate surface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures. Sector: fintech / digital assets.

providers.name: DigitalAPI
providers.description: DigitalAPI is an API catalog, marketplace, and management platform that unifies APIs across multiple gateways into a single searchable catalog with governance, discovery, access control, and analytics.

providers.name: Diligent Robotics
providers.description: Diligent Robotics is an Austin, Texas-based healthcare robotics company founded in 2017 by Andrea Thomaz (CEO) and Vivian Chu (CIO), both trained as roboticists at MIT, Georgia Tech, and the University of Texas at Austin. The company builds Moxi, a socially intelligent mobile manipulator that operates autonomously inside hospitals to handle non-clinical material transport — delivering medications, lab samples, supplies, PPE, and patient items so nurses and clinical staff can focus on patient care. Moxi combines mobile manipulation (grasping, opening doors, riding elevators), social navigation, and human-guided learning, and is deployed 24/7 with minimal facility infrastructure (existing Wi-Fi). Operationally, Moxi has logged 500,000+ deliveries and 100,000+ autonomous elevator rides across customer hospitals including UTMB, Shannon Health, ThedaCare, Carilion Giles Community Hospital, and Medical City Denton. The platform is HIPAA compliant, SOC 2 Type II audited, and TX-RAMP Level 2 certified. Diligent has raised roughly $100M across rounds led by Canaan, True Ventures, Tiger Global, DNX Ventures, Next Coast Ventures, and Northwestern Medicine Innovation. Diligent's revenue model is robot deployment/leasing and enterprise services; there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release for Moxi or its underlying robotics stack.

providers.name: Easyhealth
providers.description: EasyHealth is a Los Angeles-based value-based care company that partners with health plans, provider groups, and risk-bearing entities to deliver proactive, in-home and virtual clinical care to Medicare, Medicaid, and Health Exchange members across 40+ states. Its Preventative Care Platform combines a hybrid visit model (in-home medical assistants paired with virtual nurse practitioners), Health Information Exchange integration, and real-time data dashboards for health plans to close HEDIS/care gaps, complete annual wellness visits, run preventive screenings, and manage chronic conditions such as cardiovascular, respiratory, diabetes, kidney, and behavioral health. EasyHealth emphasizes reaching underserved and hard-to-reach populations, claiming roughly 40% member engagement versus traditional sub-10% rates. The company is backed by Anthemis and QED Investors and is profiled here as an API Evangelist network company. EasyHealth publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time; this profile captures its public identity and web properties.

providers.name: Edme Insurance Brokers
providers.description: Edme Insurance Brokers Ltd (formerly Aditya Birla Insurance Brokers, ABIBL) is an India-based composite insurance broker offering corporate, retail, and reinsurance solutions across 30+ industries including aviation, marine, energy, manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, technology, and the BFSI and FMCG sectors. The company provides tailored risk management, employee benefits, and claims advisory services, backed by digital customer portals for policy and claims management and employee benefits. Edme is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Edme publishes no public developer program or API surface at this time.

providers.name: EDUFI
providers.description: EduFi (EDUFI PTE. LTD) is a Singapore-incorporated education-financing fintech operating Pakistan's first Study Now, Pay Later (SNPL) digital platform, with expansion into Saudi Arabia and Oman. The Shariah-approved platform lets parents and students finance private schooling, higher education, and international student loans through quick, collateral-free approvals with direct disbursement to educational institutes and convenient monthly installments. EduFi also provides partner educational institutes a free ERP system and subsidized SNPL for their students, and works with financial institutions to fund receivables. Backed by 500 Global. This profile is maintained by API Evangelist; EduFi publishes a consumer marketing and application surface but no public developer/API program.

providers.name: EnerGaia
providers.description: EnerGaia is a spirulina producer, incorporated in Thailand in April 2009 and now headquartered in Singapore, that grows nutrient-dense microalgae in proprietary closed bioreactors rather than open ponds to deliver clean, consistent spirulina for food and beverage manufacturers. The company originated from research into using microalgae to capture industrial CO2 from power-plant flue gas and has since focused on making spirulina a mainstream, sustainable food ingredient. Its product line includes Fresh Spirulina Paste, Fresh-Frozen Spirulina, and Freeze-Dried Spirulina Powder, used in beverages, egg substitutes, noodles, meat replacements, pastas, and snacks. EnerGaia is a portfolio company of 500 Global. It publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Epocrates
providers.description: Epocrates is a mobile clinical reference application, part of athenahealth, relied on by healthcare professionals for more than 25 years to support point-of-care decisions. It provides a drug reference database, a drug-drug interaction checker, a pill identifier, clinical practice guidelines, medical calculators, and a herbs and supplements reference, with the premium epocrates+ subscription adding expanded content. Epocrates does not publish a public developer API or SDK; this profile captures the company's public web identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network. Sector: healthcare.

providers.name: Equitable
providers.description: Equitable Holdings, Inc. is a financial services holding company offering individual retirement, group retirement, life insurance, and employee benefits solutions. In 2025, Equitable launched API capabilities for benefits plan setup integration, partnering with platforms such as Employee Navigator to streamline broker workflows.

providers.name: ethealthcare
providers.description: ET Healthcare (ethealthcare.com.cn) is an in-vitro diagnostics (IVD) company founded in 2008 and headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with operations in China. It develops immunodiagnostic systems built on its proprietary "lab-on-a-tip" technology, delivering central-lab-grade immunoassay performance in a near-patient setting. Its flagship Pylon platform (Pylon 3D automated immunoassay analyzers plus single-use Pylon Test Strips) runs cardiac, inflammation, fertility, infectious-disease, and tumor assays on whole blood, plasma, and serum. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners and other investors, ET Healthcare is a medical-device / clinical-laboratory instrument maker and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Eucalyptus
providers.description: Eucalyptus (eucalyptus.health) is a global digital healthcare company founded in 2019 and headquartered in Sydney, Australia, that builds and operates patient-first telehealth clinics. It runs four consumer digital-health brands — Juniper (women's weight management and menopause), Pilot (men's health, hair loss, sexual health and weight), Software (clinical-grade skincare and dermatology) and Kin (reproductive, fertility and postpartum care) — across Australia, the United Kingdom, Germany, Japan and Canada, pairing licensed practitioners with technology and connected-care tooling. Eucalyptus was acquired by Hims & Hers Health in June 2026. This profile is a consumer-facing healthtech company: it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI at this time, so enrichment is limited to verified corporate identity, published website properties, a responsible-disclosure program, and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: favorited
providers.description: Favorited is a mobile-first live streaming platform that helps content creators run interactive, real-time shows with their audiences. The app centers on participatory formats — games, giveaways, and community interactions — so that viewers feel like they are playing together with a creator rather than passively watching a broadcast, alongside monetization tools for creators. Favorited ships as consumer iOS and Android apps and, as of this profile, publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment and monitoring.

providers.name: FinancesOnline
providers.description: Read detailed online reviews of B2B & SaaS solutions prepared by industry experts. Compare popular tools and easily find a perfect software that will let your business grow. Write your own reviews and share your experience with a constantly growing community of SaaS users.

providers.name: Finda
providers.description: Finda (핀다) is a South Korean fintech company founded in 2015 and headquartered in Seoul that operates a licensed online loan-comparison and financial-product marketplace. Through its mobile app and website, Finda lets consumers compare loan products from 76+ financial institutions and 400+ products in about a minute, refinance existing loans ("갈아타기"), aggregate accounts and cards for asset management, run financial calculators (interest, DSR, year-end tax, mortgage eligibility), and monitor and manage their credit. Registered as a loan-brokerage/loan-collection corporation under Korea's Financial Services Act, Finda earns commissions from partner financial institutions rather than charging consumers. It reports 3.47M+ cumulative members and 256T+ won in managed loan assets, and is backed by 500 Global. Finda is a consumer B2C platform and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Finku
providers.description: Finku is an AI-based personal finance management (PFM) mobile app from Indonesia, recognized as the number-one Indonesia PFM app and a Google Play "Best of 2025" selection with more than one million users. It helps people track expenses, set budgets, and build better money habits through manual entry, receipt and bank e-statement scanning, and FinGPT, a chat-based AI financial assistant. The app connects multiple banks and e-wallets, generates real-time interactive dashboards and reports, and runs a freemium model with a Premium tier. Finku is registered with Indonesian regulators OJK, Kominfo, AFTECH, and AFPI, and secures user data with 256-bit AES encryption. Finku is a consumer application and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile originated as a VC-portfolio lead for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Flex Pharma
providers.description: Flex Pharma, Inc. entered the API Evangelist network as a healthcare portfolio lead of bessemer-venture-partners. Enrichment on 2026-07-20 found no API, developer program, SDK, or machine-readable surface of any kind. The flex-pharma.com domain now resolves (via Cloudflare) to a consumer online-pharmacy storefront retailing generic and brand erectile-dysfunction medication (tadalafil, sildenafil), whose About page invokes Rockefeller University professor Dr. Rod MacKinnon — a founder associated with the original Flex Pharma biotech — while publishing no corporate entity name, address, or registration details. Treat the present site as unverified and distinct from the original venture-backed company. Only Terms, Privacy, and a Contact page were verified as live; every /.well-known/ path soft-404s to the homepage.

providers.name: Flyzipline
providers.description: Flyzipline (Zipline International Inc., flyzipline.com / zipline.com) designs, manufactures, and operates autonomous delivery drones for food, groceries, and medicine. Its instant logistics platform flies vital shipments — blood products, vaccines, pharmaceuticals, prepared meals, and retail goods — on direct aerial routes at up to 70 mph, with temperature-controlled pods and real-time tracking. Zipline operates distribution centers across the United States, Rwanda, Ghana, Nigeria, Kenya, Côte d'Ivoire, and Japan, partnering with health systems, retailers (Walmart, Chipotle), and restaurant technology providers (Olo) that submit delivery requests through Zipline's ordering system or software integrations. As of early 2026 the fleet has completed more than two million commercial deliveries across 120+ million autonomous miles. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars-adjacent portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Zipline publishes no public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI at this time — partner integrations are bespoke.

providers.name: Fractyl Health
providers.description: Fractyl Health, Inc. (Nasdaq: GUTS) is a clinical-stage metabolic therapeutics company developing treatments that target the root causes of type 2 diabetes and obesity rather than managing symptoms. Its lead product, Revita, is an outpatient endoscopic procedure that resurfaces the duodenal lining to address a driver of metabolic disease, and Rejuva is an early-stage pancreatic islet-cell gene therapy platform designed for durable, one-time metabolic remission. The company is headquartered in Massachusetts and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and General Catalyst. Fractyl publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile tracks its corporate, product, and investor web presence.

providers.name: Frontlinewildfire
providers.description: Frontline Wildfire Defense is a wildfire protection company that designs, manufactures, and installs exterior sprinkler defense systems for homes, businesses, wineries, summer camps, and new-home communities. The system combines roof- and ground-mounted sprinklers, a pump, and water/foam concentrate with a mobile app (iOS and Android) that lets property owners remotely activate the system, monitor nearby wildfires on a live fire map, and receive evacuation alerts. The company also publishes wildfire risk maps, home-hardening and defensible-space guidance, and works through a network of partner installers. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners. This is a consumer/hardware company profile; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Funcom
providers.description: Funcom is a Norwegian video-game developer and publisher founded in 1993, headquartered in Oslo with additional studios in Raleigh (North Carolina), Lisbon, and Bucharest. It is best known for online, open-world, and survival titles including Dune: Awakening, Conan Exiles, Age of Conan, and The Secret World / Secret World Legends, alongside published titles such as Metal: Hellsinger, Aloft, Dune: Spice Wars, and Mutant Year Zero. Funcom is majority-owned by Tencent. It was surfaced as a Northzone portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it does not currently publish a public developer API surface, so this profile captures company identity, legal/support links, and domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Futuredontics
providers.description: Futuredontics is the parent company of 1-800-DENTIST, a dental marketing and patient-acquisition business with more than 38 years serving dental practices across the United States. Its core offerings are PatientLeads, a pay-per-call program that routes live new-patient calls (with AI-powered call screening) to practices on month-to-month terms, and PatientActivator, patient-engagement software that automates appointment reminders, review requests, and reputation management. The company reports serving 5,000+ practices, handling roughly 70,000 calls per month, and scheduling over two million appointments through its platform. Futuredontics is a portfolio company of Bain Capital Ventures. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Fuze Health
providers.description: Fuze Health is a technology-powered healthcare company delivering comprehensive, patient-focused care at scale across three business units: FuzeRx (digital pharmacy and prescription fulfillment with patient engagement tools), Fuze Services (diagnostics, screening, clinical and genomics programs), and Fuze Technologies (proprietary healthcare software and consulting for partners). The company operates a unified digital platform that simplifies access, strengthens engagement, and supports patients throughout their care journeys, and reports serving 22 million patients, delivering 31 million prescriptions, and reaching 90% payer coverage. Fuze Health is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund. No public API or developer surface is published at this time.

providers.name: Gan & Lee Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Gan & Lee Pharmaceuticals (Shanghai Stock Exchange: 603087) is a Chinese biopharmaceutical company founded in 1998, specializing in the research, development, production, and commercialization of recombinant insulin analogs and injection devices for diabetes care, alongside a growing oncology pipeline and medical devices. Its products, including insulin glargine injections and prefilled pen injectors, are marketed across 23 countries with 19 products launched globally and clinical trials running in 10 countries. Gan & Lee does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public web presence and domain security posture.

providers.name: General Medicine
providers.description: General Medicine is a consumer digital-health company building a healthcare storefront for the age of AI, making it delightfully simple to access the best care in the world. Founded by PillPack alumni Elliot Cohen and TJ Parker with CEO Ashwin Muralidharan, the company operates as part telehealth provider, part medical concierge, and part marketplace for browsing and booking medical care, prescriptions, and diagnostic lab testing across more than 35 specialties with board-certified clinicians, transparent pricing, and no waitlists. It is backed by roughly $32M led by Matrix Partners, with BoxGroup, Founder Collective, VXI Capital, and JSL Health Capital participating. General Medicine runs a consumer web storefront (generalmedicine.co) and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Glassdoor
providers.description: Glassdoor is an online platform for company reviews, salary reports, and job listings, now part of Recruit Holdings (alongside Indeed) and tightly integrated with the broader Workday talent ecosystem. Historically Glassdoor offered a public Partner Job Search / Employer Reviews API (api.glassdoor.com/api/api.htm), but the program was closed to new applications in 2021 and active integrations require an existing partner relationship. Current API access is enterprise sales-led for ATS, programmatic recruitment, and employer-brand partners. No self-serve developer portal is active today.

providers.name: Gloset
providers.description: Gloset is a Mexican peer-to-peer marketplace for buying and selling pre-owned and new fashion — formal dresses, casual wear, handbags, accessories, footwear, jewelry, watches, sportswear, menswear, and swimwear. The platform offers a seller authentication program, curated collections and trending edits, buyer protection with returns and refunds, and integrated payments and shipping, operating primarily in Mexico. Gloset is backed by 500 Global. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, API reference, or technical documentation surface — it is a consumer marketplace web/app product.

providers.name: Glyphic Biotechnologies
providers.description: Glyphic Biotechnologies is a Berkeley, California proteomics company founded in 2021 that is developing ProSE (Protein Sequencing by Expansion) — a de novo, high-throughput, single-molecule protein sequencing technology designed to discriminate all 20 amino acids and their post-translational modifications. The company aims to make massively parallel proteome sequencing broadly accessible for drug discovery and biological research, and is backed by Wing Venture Capital. Glyphic currently publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Goop
providers.description: Goop is a modern lifestyle and wellness brand founded in 2008 by Gwyneth Paltrow, launched from her kitchen as a weekly email newsletter and grown into a content-and-commerce company spanning editorial journalism, e-commerce, and its own product lines across beauty, skincare, supplements, food, fashion, home, and travel. Goop operates goop.com as a curated online shop and digital magazine, publishes wellness and beauty guidance, and sells goop-branded product lines (including goopglow and goop Beauty) alongside a curated marketplace of third-party brands. It is a privately held company backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners (Series C, 2017) and other investors. Goop does not currently operate a public developer program or API; this profile captures its company identity and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: GoStudent
providers.description: GoStudent is an online tutoring platform headquartered in Vienna, Austria, offering personalized one-on-one lessons across 30+ subjects for K-12 and university students. Founded in 2016, it matches learners with vetted tutors and delivers lessons through its own video-classroom apps for iOS, Android, and web, sold as a monthly subscription. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund and Speedinvest, GoStudent grew into one of Europe's largest edtech companies and has acquired peers including Tus Media, Seneca Learning, and Studienkreis. GoStudent does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web properties and domain-security posture as a network lead.

providers.name: Greenplaces
providers.description: Greenplaces is a sustainability and ESG reporting platform that pairs software with expert consulting to help companies — especially suppliers responding to enterprise requirements — measure their carbon footprint under the GHG Protocol and complete sustainability framework submissions including CDP, EcoVadis, SBTi, GRI, SASB/ISSB and GRESB. The managed-service platform also supports B Corp certification, CSRD readiness, SOC 2 and AI-governance compliance, and tracking of regulations such as California SB 253 and SB 261. Greenplaces is venture-backed by Felicis and Redpoint Ventures. Added to the API Evangelist network from VC portfolio data; the company publishes a managed product (app.greenplaces.com) but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: GrowXCD
providers.description: GrowXCD (GrowXCD Finance Private Limited) is an RBI-registered Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) headquartered in Chennai, India, focused on accelerating business growth for the small businesses and self-employed customers that form the backbone of India's economy. Its lending products include Grow Shubam small-ticket mortgage loans, Loan Against Property (LAP) secured lending, and unsecured loans up to Rs 25 lakh with tenures of 12 to 60 months, delivered through a minimal-documentation digital process with swift approvals and repayment via eMandate or NACH auto-debit. GrowXCD is a portfolio company of Prosus Ventures. It publishes a consumer website and statutory policy documents but does not currently expose a public developer portal, API, or SDKs.

providers.name: Hakimo
providers.description: Hakimo is a Menlo Park, California physical-security software company founded by Stanford AI researchers Sam Joseph and Sagar Honnungar. Its AI platform sits on top of a customer's existing camera, NVR/VMS and access-control estate and turns it into an autonomous security operations capability: the AI Operator triages alarms and assigns a true-alarm probability, remote guarding and SOC-as-a-Service provide 24/7 monitored response, and forensic search, weapon detection, facial recognition, an insights dashboard and a mobile app round out the product line. Hakimo integrates with roughly forty third-party systems (Genetec, Milestone, Avigilon, LenelS2, Eagle Eye Networks, Axis, ServiceNow, Slack, Microsoft Teams, ONVIF devices) by consuming those vendors' APIs. As of August 2026 Hakimo publishes no public developer program of its own: there is no developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI or other machine-readable contract, and no SDK. Its tenant application API is served same-origin from the customer portal and answers unauthenticated requests with HTTP 401.

providers.name: Happy World
providers.description: Happy World operates SPICE (getspice.com), a premium lifestyle dining and rewards mobile application based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. SPICE lets diners discover curated partner restaurants across the Kingdom, reserve or walk in, pay their bill in-app by entering the bill number, and earn instant cashback rewards (advertised as up to 20% cashback with no caps) on every visit. The product emphasizes intelligent personalization and a hand-picked selection of the best restaurants, food, and dining experiences. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. The company is a consumer mobile-app business with no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or documented developer surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Hi Marley
providers.description: Hi Marley is an intelligent conversational platform built for the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry, delivering carrier-to-policyholder communication over SMS. The platform connects carriers, policyholders, and service providers through a single messaging fabric to streamline claims — including Conversational FNOL (First Notice of Loss) intake, Total Loss Assist for auto claims, and Workflow Assist for property claims — layered with AI coaching, sentiment analysis, and data insights. Trusted by 130+ carriers, including four of the top ten U.S. insurers across auto, property, and workers compensation lines. Hi Marley is backed by Emergence Capital and True Ventures. No public developer platform, API documentation, or self-service onboarding was found; the product is delivered as a closed SaaS to insurance carriers.

providers.name: HugeMed
providers.description: HugeMed (Shenzhen HugeMed Medical Technical Development Co., Ltd.) is a high-tech medical-device manufacturer founded in 2014 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China, specializing in airway management and endoscopic visualization equipment. Its product portfolio spans video laryngoscopes (blade, flexible, and stylet types for emergency, anesthesia, ICU, and educational use), single-use endoscopes for gynecology, ENT, gastroenterology, pulmonology, and urology, reusable ENT and urology endoscopes, and medical image processors. The company operates production facilities exceeding 60,000 square meters, employs roughly 600 people, and serves more than 10,000 medical institutions across 100+ countries. HugeMed is a hardware-first medical-device maker and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, SDK, or technical integration surface; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and enriched with company identity and infrastructure probes.

providers.name: HumanCo
providers.description: HumanCo is a mission-driven consumer packaged goods and wellness holding company that builds and acquires better-for-you food, beverage, and lifestyle brands made with real, clean ingredients and free of seed oils and highly processed inputs. Its portfolio spans brands and concepts such as Against the Grain (gluten-free foods), True Food Kitchen (health-focused restaurants), and Grove Collaborative (sustainable home and personal care). Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. HumanCo operates a marketing and e-commerce web presence but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or technical developer platform at this time.

providers.name: Inofab
providers.description: Inofab Health (a Clario company) is a digital respiratory health company headquartered in Ankara, Turkey, building connected spirometry and inhaler devices with cloud software for the home-based and clinical management of chronic respiratory conditions including asthma, COPD, and cystic fibrosis. Its product line spans the SpiroHome Personal portable ultrasonic spirometer, the SpiroClinic Pro and SpiroClinic Compact clinical-grade spirometers with EHR integration, the SpiroCloud web dashboard that collects and analyzes data from all connected SpiroHome and SpiroClinic devices, and the SpiroHaler smart inhaler attachments for medication adherence. Inofab was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; it does not currently publish a public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Insmed
providers.description: Insmed Incorporated is a NASDAQ-listed (INSM) global biopharmaceutical company developing and commercializing therapies for people with serious and rare diseases. Its approved medicines include ARIKAYCE (amikacin liposome inhalation suspension) for refractory Mycobacterium avium complex lung disease and BRINSUPRI (brensocatib) for bronchiectasis. The company advances a pipeline across pulmonary, inflammatory, and rare-disease indications and runs early-innovation science platforms in gene therapy with targeted delivery, protein deimmunization, RNA end-joining, and synthetic rescue. Insmed operates patient-facing surfaces such as a clinical-trials portal and an investigator-initiated-research program, but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal at this time. This profile was surfaced as a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio lead and enriched with identity and domain-security data only.

providers.name: Jackpocket
providers.description: Jackpocket is a third-party lottery courier and mobile app that lets users in supported US states order official state lottery tickets — Powerball, Mega Millions, and regional draw games — from their phone, with the physical tickets stored securely on their behalf and winnings paid out through the app. Founded in 2013 in New York City by Peter Sullivan, the company was acquired by DraftKings in 2024. Jackpocket is a consumer-facing gaming/lottery brand; it does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or webhook surface. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a network entity with its public web properties and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Jenkins Pipeline
providers.description: Jenkins Pipeline is a suite of plugins for the Jenkins automation server that supports implementing and integrating continuous delivery pipelines as code. It provides an extensible domain-specific language (DSL) with two syntax styles - Declarative and Scripted - and core building blocks (agents, stages, steps) for modeling simple-to-complex CI/CD workflows that are versioned with application source code via a Jenkinsfile.

providers.name: Jetti Resources
providers.description: Jetti Resources is a Boulder, Colorado based metallurgical technology company whose catalytic leaching process unlocks copper from low-grade primary sulfide ores such as chalcopyrite — roughly 70% of the world's copper resources — that conventional pyrometallurgy cannot treat economically and that bioleaching cannot treat at all because of the passivation layer that halts extraction. Jetti's catalyst prevents that layer from forming, allowing uninterrupted heap and stockpile leaching through existing bioleach and SX-EW circuits using modular, standardized micro plants that require no additional permits. The technology has been deployed commercially since 2019, including at Capstone's Pinto Valley mine in Arizona and Freeport-McMoRan's El Abra operation in Chile, and the company is backed by BHP, Freeport-McMoRan, Mitsubishi Corporation, BMW Group, BlackRock, T. Rowe Price, Orion Resource Partners, DNS Capital and Zoma Capital. Jetti sells a chemical and process technology licence to mine operators rather than software: it runs no developer program, publishes no public API, SDK or machine-readable specification, and its only authenticated surface is an Intralinks-hosted customer portal for existing licensees.

providers.name: Jetty
providers.description: Jetty is a financial-services company built for the real estate industry, making renting more accessible and affordable for renters while helping property managers reduce risk and bad debt. Following its merger with Rhino, Jetty operates across more than 6 million rental units in the United States and offers three core products: Jetty Deposit, a security-deposit replacement that swaps large cash deposits for a low monthly or one-time payment; Jetty Protect, integrated renters insurance and liability coverage; and Jetty Credit, a rent-reporting and credit-building service that helps renters establish credit history while lowering delinquencies for property managers. Jetty is backed by Ribbit Capital. No public developer/API surface is currently published; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Joopiter
providers.description: Joopiter (stylized JOOPITER) is a digital-first auction house and marketplace founded by Pharrell Williams for rare objects and culturally significant collectibles. The platform hosts timed online auctions, a curated marketplace, and private sales spanning watches, sneakers, streetwear, art, jewelry, and memorabilia, pairing commerce with editorial storytelling about each object and its provenance. Joopiter offers consignment and "sell with Joopiter" services connecting collectors and creators globally. It is a consumer-facing luxury commerce brand; as of this writing it publishes no public developer program, API, or documentation surface, so this API Evangelist profile is an identity record rather than a technical/API catalog entry.

providers.name: Juno
providers.description: Juno (juno.co), operated by Juno Technology, Inc., is a San Francisco-based owner's representation, development-consulting and construction-management firm for prefabricated, modular and mass-timber multifamily development, working with developers from site feasibility and entitlement through delivery across North America. Juno owns the rights to the Juno Mass Timber System, a field-tested kit-of-parts building system of roughly 33 components configurable into 25+ unit types, proven on the 24-unit Juno East Austin project at 400 Comal St, Austin TX. The current company is the 2024 relaunch ("Juno 2.0") of the venture-funded Juno / Juno Residential founded in 2019 by Jonathan Scherr, BJ Siegel and Chester Chipperfield, which raised roughly $32M from Comcast Ventures, Khosla Ventures and RET Ventures before running out of money; the relaunched firm is led by co-founders Emily Mills Marineau and Jen Canchola. Juno sells professional services and a physical building system, not software: as of this enrichment pass it publishes a marketing site, a mass-timber system page, a contact form, a newsletter signup, terms of service and a privacy policy, and no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Kendra Scott
providers.description: Kendra Scott is an American jewelry and accessories retailer founded in 2002 in Austin, Texas, offering personalized jewelry, watches, home goods, and gifts through customization options such as initials, birthstones, and engraving. The brand operates a direct-to-consumer ecommerce storefront alongside a network of retail stores, and pairs its Color Bar customization experience with a philanthropic giving model tied to purchases. Surfaced as a portfolio company of norwest-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes a consumer ecommerce site but no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time. This profile captures its public identity and web-property surface pending any future developer program.

providers.name: KeyMe
providers.description: KeyMe is a nationwide locksmith and key-duplication company that pairs mobile locksmith technicians with a network of self-service key-copying kiosks located inside thousands of retail stores across the United States. Customers can copy residential, commercial, and automotive keys, RFID fobs and access cards at a kiosk, order duplicates online, or request 24/7 mobile locksmith help for home, auto, and business lockouts, transponder and ignition key programming, lock installation, re-keying, and access-control and master-key systems. KeyMe is backed by Battery Ventures. As of this profile the company operates as a consumer-facing locksmith and kiosk service and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this record captures its public web identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: KiddoWear
providers.description: KiddoWear (now operating as Kiddo Health) is a pediatric healthcare technology company that offers a connected care platform for capturing and sharing health data for children with physical and behavioral health challenges. The platform combines biometric tracking of 12+ biomarkers (respiration, heart rate, stress scores, and sleep), family journaling of behavior and health status between visits, educational family resources, care navigation that integrates with medical records and clinical workflows, and a provider dashboard that surfaces insights and real-time health trends. Kiddo Health serves behavioral health conditions such as ADHD and autism spectrum disorder and metabolic conditions such as childhood obesity and diabetes, bridging gaps between families, providers, and care teams across health plans, health systems, and employers. A Techstars-backed portfolio company added to the API Evangelist network. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Kiki
providers.description: Kiki (Kikihub) is a location-based social networking and chat mobile app that connects people nearby for local friendships, dating, networking, and community conversations. Users join local chat rooms to discover people around them and start real conversations, meeting new friends and matches in their area. The app is available for iOS and Android. Kiki publishes no public API, developer portal, or documentation; this profile tracks the company within the API Evangelist network as a venture-backed (500 Global, a16z) consumer social lead awaiting any future developer surface.

providers.name: Kindor
providers.description: Kindor is a performance-intelligence platform for technology teams that turns engineering, project-management, finance, and HR activity into automated metrics, reports, and smart notifications. It integrates with tools like GitHub, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Notion, Google Calendar, and Google Meet to track DORA delivery metrics, resource allocation across initiatives, AI-tool adoption and ROI, and productivity anomalies, giving technology leaders real-time visibility and AI-generated summaries so they can align tech investments with business goals without manual reporting. Kindor claims outcomes such as lower tech operating costs, faster delivery, and less time spent on reporting. It is a 500 Global portfolio company; the public website is a Wix site that exposes a live Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint for agentic access, but Kindor publishes no first-party product API or developer portal.

providers.name: Kinlo
providers.description: KINLO is a consumer skincare and suncare brand formulating sun protection and skincare products specifically for melanin-rich skin. Co-founded with tennis champion Naomi Osaka, the line addresses a market gap in SPF for melanated skin tones, offering dermatologist-tested, tinted, reef-safe formulations with ingredients like niacinamide that blend without a white cast. Products are sold direct and exclusively through Amazon with Buy with Prime. KINLO is a direct-to-consumer commerce brand with no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or programmatic surface; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of initialized-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a consumer-brand profile.

providers.name: Leapfin
providers.description: Leapfin is an AI-powered financial data platform for record-to-report and automated revenue recognition. It ingests transactional data from billing systems, payment processors, and data warehouses, standardizes it into a unified Financial Records schema, applies templated GAAP, SOX, IFRS, and ASC 606 revenue rules, and produces audit-ready journal entries and revenue reports that post to ERPs such as NetSuite. Programmatic data ingestion is available through the Leap Connect API (released March 2024); the platform also offers Luca, a native AI agent for exploring and reporting on revenue data. Leapfin is enterprise SaaS - the developer reference is on a partner/login-gated documentation portal, so the API surface below is modeled from Leapfin's public product and help-center material rather than fully reproduced endpoint-by-endpoint.

providers.name: Lovevery
providers.description: Lovevery is a direct-to-consumer children's brand that designs stage-based Play Kits, books, and learning products for infants and toddlers, grounded in child-development research. It operates a Shopify-backed e-commerce and subscription storefront at lovevery.com with a customer help center, blog, and careers site. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) and added to the API Evangelist network, Lovevery publishes no public developer/API surface at this time; this profile captures its public web and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Lucid Lane
providers.description: Lucid Lane (now operating as Skyler Health) is a telehealth mental health platform delivering virtual talk therapy and counseling for mental health conditions, an AI-powered coaching companion, and guided meditation and mindfulness content through its Listen Therapy service. Originally founded to help patients taper off opioids and manage medication dependence during and after surgery, the company has since broadened into remote behavioral and mental health care delivered to members, employers, clinics, and providers. It is a consumer- and employer-facing care service with no public developer or API surface; member access is via the Skyler Health member portal. Backed by Accel and Battery Ventures.

providers.name: Lumos Helmet
providers.description: Lumos (Lumos Helmet) is a consumer hardware company that designs and manufactures smart bike helmets and connected bike lights with integrated safety features such as turn signals, brake lights, and high-visibility LED lighting. Its product line spans commuter, e-bike, and kids' helmets plus standalone smart bike lights, controlled through companion iOS and Android mobile apps. Backed by Techstars, Lumos sells direct-to-consumer through an online store; it does not currently publish a public API, developer platform, or SDK. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline, which confirmed no programmatic API surface and captured the company's identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: lunchlab
providers.description: lunchlab Corp. (런치랩) is a Seoul-based corporate lunch subscription and delivery service that brings daily meals to office teams across South Korea. It offers two rotating meal lines — a traditional home-style Korean lunch box and a "Fresh Meal" line of poke bowls and sandwiches — with delivery and pickup included for a flat per-meal price, employees choosing their meals through a mobile app while administrators manage orders and billing from a web dashboard. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network, lunchlab operates in the food-service / corporate-catering space and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Magic Spoon
providers.description: Magic Spoon is a direct-to-consumer breakfast brand selling high-protein, low-sugar cereal, oatmeal, granola, treats, and toaster pastries through its Shopify-powered online store and major retailers including Whole Foods, Target, Costco, Walmart, Kroger, and Sprouts. The company reformulates childhood-classic cereals to be keto-friendly and gluten-free, offering a subscribe-and-save model. Magic Spoon is a consumer packaged goods (CPG) ecommerce company backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners; it operates a retail storefront rather than a public developer platform, and this profile was surfaced as a VC portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Marriage Pact
providers.description: Marriage Pact is a matchmaking platform that pairs people using a research-backed compatibility questionnaire, originally built for college campuses and run as periodic matching events across universities. Participants answer a values-and-preferences survey and the service uses the responses to compute and deliver each person their most compatible match. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures, the company operates as a consumer web product; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, documentation portal, or programmatic integration surface.

providers.name: Mentimeter
providers.description: Mentimeter is a Swedish audience-engagement and interactive-presentation platform used to run live polls, quizzes, word clouds, ranking, open-ended questions and Q&A during meetings, classrooms and events, with results updating in real time as participants respond from their phones. Founded in Stockholm in 2014, it is used across education and enterprise for interactive presentations and workshops. Mentimeter does not publish a public developer REST API; its extensibility surface is delivered through LMS integrations (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, Brightspace via LTI), presentation add-ins (PowerPoint, Microsoft Teams, Zoom) and SSO, rather than a documented HTTP API.
