This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline against its public developer, security and trust surface.

providers.name: Metro Residences
providers.description: MetroResidences is a serviced apartments and furnished-rentals platform offering flexible temporary housing for business travelers, expatriates, and relocating professionals. Its portfolio spans thousands of listings across Singapore, Tokyo, and Australia, ranging from studios to six-plus bedroom units in both furnished and unfurnished configurations, alongside select hotel accommodations. The company also runs a property-management offering that lets owners list and monetize their units. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; the public site exposes no developer program, API, or developer documentation at this time.

providers.name: Mi Dulce Hogar
providers.description: Mi Dulce Hogar is a professional home and commercial cleaning services company operating in Mexico City (CDMX), connecting customers with vetted, background-screened cleaning professionals. Services include residential and office cleaning, upholstery and carpet washing, floor polishing, and pest control/fumigation. The company states it has delivered more than 100,000 services and screens candidates through a rigorous criminological vetting process. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; the public web presence is a consumer marketing and booking site with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Mirvie
providers.description: Mirvie is a clinical-stage women's health company founded in 2018 and based in South San Francisco, California, pioneering the early prediction of pregnancy complications. Its proprietary RNA platform uses a simple maternal blood test and machine learning to read tens of thousands of molecular messages from mother, baby, and placenta, revealing the underlying biology of each pregnancy months before symptoms appear. Mirvie's first product, the Encompass preeclampsia test, pairs a novel blood test that predicts personalized preeclampsia risk with a preventive care plan and received FDA Breakthrough Device designation. The company is backed by General Catalyst, GV, Mayfield, Khosla Ventures, Foresite Capital, and Decheng Capital. Mirvie operates consumer and clinical web properties (mirvie.com and encompasstest.com) but publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Mixhalo
providers.description: Mixhalo is an AI-enabled digital audio platform for live events that streams broadcast-quality speaker audio, real-time language interpretation, transcription, and summaries directly to attendees' smartphones, eliminating the need for silent-session headsets or dedicated receiver hardware. Its flagship product, Mixhalo Live, delivers low-latency multilingual audio into event apps, and it has partnered with Eventbase to offer an SDK for embedding the experience in client event applications. Mixhalo is now part of DeepL, extending DeepL's multilingual communication capabilities to in-person events. The company is backed by Cowboy Ventures. This profile currently exposes no public developer portal or API surface.

providers.name: Mundi
providers.description: Mundi is a digital cross-border trade finance platform for exporters, primarily connecting Mexican exporters with US importers. It provides non-recourse international factoring (invoice advances up to $10M USD / $200M MXN with rates from 0.9% per month), foreign-exchange spot and hedging across 100+ currencies, purchase-order and revolving-line financing, multi-currency virtual US accounts and international payments/collections, and digital cargo insurance. Backed by Speedinvest and Union Square Ventures, Mundi operates a customer web application but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Network Solutions
providers.description: Network Solutions is one of the original ICANN-accredited domain registrars, founded in 1979 and operator of the .com, .net and .org registries under the InterNIC/NSF cooperative agreement through the 1990s. Today it is a consumer and small-business web-services brand of Newfold Digital, selling domain registration and transfers, WHOIS lookup, shared and WordPress web hosting, SSL/TLS certificates, professional email, a website builder, and online marketing services. It operates a domain reseller program (via ResellerClub) and an affiliate program, but does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI documentation for third-party integration; the reseller and affiliate channels are the only programmatic-adjacent surfaces.

providers.name: Novidea
providers.description: Novidea is a cloud-native insurance management platform built on Salesforce that helps insurance brokers, MGAs (managing general agents), coverholders, and carriers digitize the full insurance distribution lifecycle across front, middle, and back office operations. The platform unifies quoting, underwriting, binding, policy administration, claims, and accounting with real-time data and analytics, workflow automation, document generation, and customer portals. It markets a "truly open API framework" and an "API a la carte" offering for extending and integrating the platform, but does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI definition, or SDKs; its API surface is delivered to customers on top of the Salesforce platform. Novidea is backed by Battery Ventures and serves insurance distribution businesses globally.

providers.name: Ocean Aero
providers.description: Ocean Aero is a Gulfport, Mississippi maritime robotics manufacturer that designs, builds and operates the Triton, an environmentally powered Autonomous Underwater and Surface Vehicle (AUSV) that can both sail on the surface and submerge to collect data above and below the waterline and relay it back to shore. The 14-foot platform harvests wind and solar energy, carries pre-packaged or custom payloads for defense, ocean research and offshore energy missions, and is managed through Ocean Aero's own proprietary mission-control GUI with fleet-wide waypoint and payload management. As of this profile Ocean Aero sells vehicles, payloads and mission services — it publishes no public developer program, no API reference and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Omnitracs
providers.description: Omnitracs is a commercial fleet management, telematics, and transportation-management provider, now part of Solera Inc. (acquired 2021, operating under Solera Fleet Solutions). Its Omnitracs One platform and the Omnitracs Roadnet routing platform serve roughly 15,000 fleet customers with ELD / Hours-of-Service compliance, telematics and GPS positioning, driver workflow and messaging, routing and dispatch, and video safety. Omnitracs exposes real integration APIs and web services (Roadnet Web Services, the Services Portal Entity Management web services, and the SOAP/XML Event Subscription Service that streams positions, messages, HOS, and critical events), but access is partner- and customer-account gated - there is no open, self-service public developer portal. API credentials (a username/password with API access) and the integration developer wiki are provisioned to contracted customers and integration partners. Endpoints documented here for gated surfaces are honestly modeled from public integration notes, not from an open reference.

providers.name: Open Bionics
providers.description: Open Bionics is a Bristol, UK-based medical technology company that designs and manufactures advanced multi-grip bionic arms for children and adults with upper-limb differences. Its Hero product family (Hero ARM, Hero PRO, Hero RGD, Hero FLEX and Hero GAUNTLET) pairs 3D-printed, lightweight myoelectric prosthetic hands with an ecosystem of MyoPods wireless electrodes and the Sidekick companion app, delivered through a network of specialist prosthetists and clinics in the US and UK. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company; enrichment probing found no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or event surface.

providers.name: OpenDurian
providers.description: OpenDurian is a Bangkok, Thailand based educational technology company delivering hybrid (online plus offline) learning and test preparation. Its platform offers exam-prep courses for TOEIC, IELTS, TOEFL, TCAS and Thai civil-service exams, language instruction in English, Chinese and Japanese, secondary-school mathematics and science courses, an online bookstore, free English-proficiency assessment tools, and extensive practice-test question banks. The company reports reach in the millions of annual users across its learning ecosystem. It is a consumer-facing edtech product; as of this enrichment pass no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation was found.

providers.name: Outdoor Voices
providers.description: Outdoor Voices is an Austin-founded direct-to-consumer activewear and athletic apparel brand designing clothing for everyday recreation — running, hiking, studio workouts, and rest days — for women and men. The company sells exclusively through its own Shopify-hosted e-commerce storefront and retail presence rather than a public developer platform. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and added to the API Evangelist network. An enrichment pass found no first-party public API, SDK, webhook, or developer surface: the site runs on Shopify commerce infrastructure with only consumer-facing help, privacy, and terms pages.

providers.name: Overtime
providers.description: Overtime is a sports media and entertainment company building disruptive, digital-first sports leagues and intellectual property aimed at the next generation of fans and athletes. It operates branded leagues including Overtime Elite (OTE) basketball, OT7 seven-on-seven football, and OT Select women's basketball, and reaches nearly 100 million followers across social platforms. Backed by a16z, Overtime generates revenue through sponsorships, merchandise, media rights, and brand partnerships, reimagining how Gen Z engages with sports through content-first entertainment.

providers.name: P.F. Chang's
providers.description: P.F. Chang's is an American casual-dining restaurant chain specializing in Asian-inspired cuisine, operating restaurants and a Home Menu retail line. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of trinity-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. The enrichment pipeline found no public developer API surface: no developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, or well-known discovery endpoints are published. The only live host, api.pfchangs.com, returns a default Azure Function App page (an internal app backend, not a public API). This profile captures the company's public web and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: PC Financial
providers.description: PC Financial (President's Choice Financial) is the financial-services brand of Canadian grocery giant Loblaw Companies Limited. Its personal banking and Mastercard credit-card products are issued by President's Choice Bank, a federally chartered Schedule I bank and CDIC member, while insurance is offered through PC Financial Insurance. The digital-first, branchless brand centers on the no-fee PC Money Account (a Mastercard-network everyday spending account launched September 2020), a line of PC Financial and PC World Elite Mastercard credit cards, and deep integration with the PC Optimum loyalty program across Loblaw's grocery, pharmacy, and retail banners. Consumer banking (chequing, savings, mortgages) was transferred to CIBC's Simplii Financial in 2017, so PC Financial today is a rewards-linked digital banking arm rather than a full-service bank. In December 2025 Equitable Bank (EQB) agreed to acquire PC Financial from Loblaw for roughly $800 million. On open finance, PC Financial runs NO public first-party developer portal or API; Canada's Consumer-Driven Banking framework is legislated but not yet operational, so consumer account access today is aggregator/screen-scraping-based via providers such as Plaid and Finicity (Mastercard). The bank supports Interac e-Transfer on the PC Money Account as shared payments-rail participation.

providers.name: Peak
providers.description: Peak is a consumer brain-training mobile application operated by Synaptic Labs (formerly Peak Labs) that offers cognitive exercise games and personalized workouts spanning memory, attention, problem-solving, mental agility, language, and emotion. Its games and Advanced Training Programmes are developed with researchers from institutions including Cambridge, Yale, UCL, and King's College London. Peak Pro is a subscription that unlocks 40+ games, personalized workouts, performance analytics, and an AI Coach. Peak is a mobile-only consumer product distributed via the App Store and Google Play and does not currently publish a public API or developer platform.

providers.name: PerfectStay
providers.description: PerfectStay is a French online travel company that sells curated flight-plus-hotel packages, all-inclusive stays, guided tours, city breaks and standalone flights, hotels, activities and transfers, marketed around a best-price guarantee (refunding twice any price difference), trip protection and 24/7 customer support, with installment payment options (2x/4x). Founded in Paris and backed by Partech, it also powers private, brand-operated travel-club sale sites. The company exposes no public developer platform, API, SDK or documentation surface; this profile captures its public web and security posture within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Phoenix Labs
providers.description: Phoenix Labs is an independent video game developer with studios in Vancouver and Montreal, building immersive online worlds and community-driven games. Its titles include the free-to-play action RPG Dauntless and the cozy life-sim Fae Farm. The studio operates player-facing support and account services for its games but does not publish a public developer platform, API program, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Sapphire Ventures and enriched into the API Evangelist network; its API surface is currently none.

providers.name: PitPro Automation
providers.description: PitPro Automation is a fleet-maintenance technology company building automated tire-service systems that perform full tire changes and rotations on commercial fleet vehicles in under fifteen minutes. Targeting Class 2 and smaller vehicles, the company serves last-mile delivery, rideshare, utility, telecom, moving, and government fleets with in-bay automation, 24/7 monitoring, and field support. Backed by Bloomberg Beta, PitPro is a hardware-and-software provider focused on reducing fleet downtime; it currently publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK.

providers.name: Player's Health
providers.description: Player's Health is an insurance and athlete-safety technology company founded in 2016 and based in Minneapolis, Minnesota, serving youth sports organizations, fitness facilities, schools, and collegiate athletic programs. The platform combines specialty insurance products (general liability, sexual abuse and molestation liability, accident medical, directors and officers, equipment and property, cyber, and employee benefits) with athlete-safety and risk-management tooling including coach credentialing and background checks, injury and incident reporting, investigations, mental-health support, and training. Player's Health operates login-gated web portals for claims, certificates of insurance, and safety/compliance (SafetyHub) rather than a public developer API. It is a Techstars-backed company surfaced through the API Evangelist network and profiled here for discovery.

providers.name: PlayQ
providers.description: PlayQ is a Los Angeles-based mobile game developer and publisher creating free-to-play games for a global audience, including titles such as Charm King and Treasure Party. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Techstars and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass PlayQ operates a consumer-facing marketing and game-support website with no public developer portal, API documentation, or API surface; player support is routed through per-game Zendesk help centers.

providers.name: Poppy
providers.description: Poppy (poppyflowers.com) is an online, full-service wedding florist that designs, delivers, and sets up personalized floral arrangements for weddings across multiple US locations. Couples receive a custom floral proposal based on their style preferences, with bridal and bridesmaid bouquets, boutonnieres, ceremony installations, arches, reception centerpieces, and table arrangements, all delivered and installed on-site by Poppy's team. The company publishes pricing guidance (a $1,750 order minimum, ~$3,400 average spend, a $249 deposit to secure dates) and offers interest-free monthly payment plans and flexible modifications up to 60 days before the event. Poppy was surfaced as a portfolio company of Anthemis and Techstars and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Poppy operates a consumer-facing website only and publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Prolaera
providers.description: Prolaera is a learning and compliance platform built for modern CPAs and accounting firms, combining automated CPE (Continuing Professional Education) tracking, a learning management system (LMS), and a built-in course library so firms can administer training, monitor license and compliance requirements, and manage professional development in one place. Prolaera merged with LCvista and now operates as "Prolaera by LCvista"; the product is delivered as a hosted SaaS application at app.prolaera.com with SSO/SAML 2.0 identity support and SCORM/AICC/xAPI content compatibility. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global. Prolaera does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specifications.

providers.name: Public Goods
providers.description: Public Goods is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce retailer selling household essentials, personal care, and home products under its own private label, with an emphasis on natural formulations, simplified ingredient lists, minimalist packaging, and sustainable sourcing. The company operates a membership model (an annual fee unlocking member pricing, free shipping, and store credit) and a wholesale channel. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer retail brand it publishes no developer API, SDK, or technical documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Puppeteer
providers.description: Puppeteer is a Node.js library providing a high-level API to control headless Chrome or Chromium browsers for web scraping, testing, and automation.

providers.name: Push Doctor
providers.description: Push Doctor is a UK telehealth company offering video consultations with licensed UK GPs via smartphone, describing itself as the UK's first platform to provide video doctor consultations on mobile. It serves both NHS patients and private paying customers, covering online GP appointments, digital prescriptions, referrals and follow-up care. Headquartered in Manchester and backed by Partech, Push Doctor operates as a consumer-facing telemedicine service; no public developer API, developer portal, or SDK surface was found during enrichment probes.

providers.name: Realty Mogul
providers.description: RealtyMogul is a real estate crowdfunding and investment platform that gives individual and institutional investors online access to commercial real estate opportunities, including private placements, 1031 Exchange properties, and Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs). The company performs due diligence on sponsors, business plans, and properties, and provides members with a secure website and online tools to evaluate and invest in professionally managed real estate. RealtyMogul publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: Reliance Health
providers.description: Reliance Health (formerly RelianceHMO) is a healthtech company making quality healthcare accessible and affordable across emerging markets, with operations centered in Nigeria and expanding across Africa and the Middle East. It offers employer-sponsored and individual health plans covering preventative, emergency, and chronic care, telemedicine and doctor consultations through its mobile app, and a network of 3,800+ healthcare partners (hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, and diagnostic centers). Reliance Health combines insurance, its own clinics, and technology to deliver an end-to-end care experience for businesses and their employees. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface; the reliancehmo.com application backend (api.reliancehmo.com) is an internal web-app origin, not a documented public API.

providers.name: Remedyskin
providers.description: Remedyskin (Remedy Science, operated by Doctorly Skin Inc.) is a dermatologist-developed skincare and beauty brand founded by Dr. Muneeb Shah. It sells a direct-to-consumer line of advanced skincare treatments organized by concern (dark spots, aging, pore size, body texture) and skin type, spanning cleansers, treatment serums, moisturizers, targeted solutions, and bundles, built around a "Do No Harm" formulation principle that excludes fragrances and common irritants. The storefront runs on Shopify with a Gorgias-powered help center and mobile apps on iOS and Android. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of norwest-venture-partners. Enrichment found no public API, developer portal, or SDK surface — this is a consumer e-commerce brand with no developer program.

providers.name: Reposit
providers.description: Reposit is a UK-based PropTech and fintech company offering a deposit alternative for the residential rental market. Instead of paying a traditional cash deposit, tenants pay a one-time, non-refundable fee (typically one week's rent) for insurance-backed cover, while landlords and letting agents receive protection worth up to eight weeks' rent. The FCA-authorised product is underwritten by a leading insurer and serves letting agents, build-to-rent (BTR) operators, landlords and tenants, with integrations into common property management tools. This profile was surfaced as a Seedcamp portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Reposit publishes no public developer API surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Ritual
providers.description: Ritual is a direct-to-consumer health and wellness brand that sells traceable, scientifically-formulated vitamins and nutritional supplements, best known for its Essential for Women multivitamin, prenatal and postnatal formulas, and protein products. The company emphasizes a "clean label" approach with a visible, traceable supply chain and university-backed clinical studies, sold primarily through a subscription model on ritual.com. As of this enrichment pass Ritual operates as a consumer e-commerce business and publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or API surface; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Roost
providers.description: Roost is a Sunnyvale, California home-telematics company that helps property and casualty insurance carriers modernize homeowners and commercial insurance with smart, in-home sensors and monitoring. Its Protection360 commercial loss-prevention service and Security360 white-label home-security bundle detect water leaks, extreme temperatures, and smoke-alarm events, delivering real-time alerts and risk data to insurers, property owners, and third parties. Roost partners with dozens of top P&C carriers, but does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; integrations are arranged directly with its engineering team.

providers.name: Royal
providers.description: Royal is a music-and-crypto company backed by a16z and Paradigm that originally let fans buy tokenized shares of songs (Limited Digital Assets, or LDAs) so they could earn streaming royalties alongside the artists they support. As of mid-2026 the public site at royal.io states the company is "reinventing itself" and is between products, keeping only its legal pages and LDA support live; it publishes no developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, SDKs, or public API surface at this time. This profile tracks Royal as an API Evangelist network company and will be enriched further if and when a public API or developer program appears.

providers.name: Rupeek
providers.description: Rupeek is an asset-backed online gold loan company operating across India, enabling customers to borrow money by pledging gold jewelry as collateral. Its products include gold loans (from around 30,000 up to 1.5 crore rupees), gold loan balance transfers, the Rupeek Gold Card, part/full gold release, and an online repayment portal. The company partners with banks such as Federal Bank, Indian Bank, and South Indian Bank, offers 100% insurance coverage via New India Assurance, and delivers its consumer experience primarily through its website and highly-rated mobile app. It is ISO 27001 certified. Rupeek is a consumer fintech surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and GGV Capital; it publishes no public developer API surface, so this profile is an identity-only company record.

providers.name: Saffron Finance
providers.description: Saffron Finance is a decentralized peer-to-peer interest-rate risk adjustment protocol built on Ethereum. Underlying DeFi yield is transformed by a smart-contract vault system according to each user's indicated risk preference, splitting deposits into senior (fixed-income, risk-averse) and junior (variable, risk-seeking) tranches across Uniswap V3 fixed-income vaults. The protocol is governed by the Saffron DAO and its SFI token, and was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Multicoin Capital in the crypto-web3 sector. Saffron is an on-chain protocol rather than a hosted web-API provider: its developer surface is Solidity smart contracts, published documentation, audits, and whitepapers rather than a REST/HTTP API.

providers.name: Sana Biotechnology *
providers.description: Sana Biotechnology is a clinical-stage biotechnology company (NASDAQ: SANA) focused on engineering cells as medicines. Its platforms repair or control genes inside cells and replace missing or damaged cells to address the underlying causes of disease, with drug candidates spanning type 1 diabetes, B-cell cancers, and B-cell-mediated autoimmune disorders. Surfaced as a portfolio company of gv and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass Sana publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation; this profile captures company identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Saturn
providers.description: Saturn is a mobile calendar and scheduling app built for high school students, designed around the complexities of the school day, built around your friends, and kept truly real-time. Students import their class schedule, see what their friends are doing, coordinate activities, and share their calendar socially. The company positions itself as "the next generation calendar, enabling time together for all." Saturn is a consumer iOS and Android application distributed through the App Store and Google Play; it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. Backed by General Catalyst and Insight Partners, with notable individual investors including Jeff Bezos, Marc Benioff, and Dara Khosrowshahi.

providers.name: Savage X Fenty
providers.description: Savage X Fenty is a direct-to-consumer lingerie, intimates, sleepwear and loungewear brand co-founded by Rihanna in 2018 and operated as part of TechStyle Fashion Group. It sells through savagex.com and its own iOS and Android shopping apps on a membership model — Savage X Rewards — where members unlock member pricing and store credits, or "skip the month" between the 1st and 5th to avoid the charge. The commerce stack is a custom TechStyle backend fronted by Next.js and Builder.io, behind a Cloudflare edge, with an AWS API Gateway at gateway.savagex.com. Savage X Fenty publishes no public developer program, no API reference, and no machine-readable contract; its first-party API gateway and its engineering docs site are both closed to the public.

providers.name: Scondoo
providers.description: Scondoo is a German consumer cashback and coupon platform, operated by acardo group AG, that lets shoppers earn money back on everyday grocery and drugstore purchases. Users browse exclusive cashback deals in the scondoo iOS and Android apps, buy the qualifying products at any supermarket or drugstore (Kaufland, REWE, EDEKA, Netto, Aldi, Lidl, dm, Rossmann and many more), then snap a photo of the receipt to have the cashback credited to their balance and paid out via bank transfer or PayPal. The service is consumer-facing and mobile-only; it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or partner integration surface.

providers.name: ScoreBig (TicketNetwork)
providers.description: ScoreBig is an online event-ticket resale marketplace owned by TicketNetwork, selling tickets to live sports, concert, and theater events with an emphasis on transparent, all-in pricing (no extra fees or hidden costs) and a money-back guarantee. Its parent, TicketNetwork, operates the Mercury Web Services API and Mercury Retail integration platform, an API-driven, real-time ticket-inventory feed offered to partners under contract. ScoreBig itself is a consumer storefront and does not publish a public developer API; Mercury is partner-gated behind a sales/onboarding contact form with a sandbox provided to approved integrators. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bain Capital Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Seekho
providers.description: Seekho (operated by Keyaro Edutech Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru, India) is a consumer edutainment mobile application delivering short-form learning videos across 50+ categories including stock market investing, spoken English, YouTube monetization, business, cooking, and government-procedure (sarkari) guidance. The platform reports 10 crore+ downloads, 40+ lakh learners, 10,000+ videos, and 250+ verified mentors, and is distributed via the Apple App Store and Google Play. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners. As of this enrichment pass, Seekho publishes a consumer marketing site, a blog, and a creator program but exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, or partner API surface.

providers.name: Senra Systems
providers.description: Senra Systems is an aerospace wire harness manufacturer based in Redondo Beach, California, that unites design, data, and production under one roof. The company builds complex electrical wire harnesses for aerospace and defense programs, spanning wire harness design and engineering support, prototype through full-rate production, component selection and supply chain optimization, and precision automation in a 15,000 square foot smart-manufacturing facility. Senra positions itself as delivering harnesses at roughly four times the speed of traditional vendors while maintaining aerospace-grade quality and certifications. Senra Systems is backed by Sequoia Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 8VC, and General Catalyst. The company does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Shriram Finance
providers.description: Shriram Finance Limited is one of India's largest retail non-banking financial companies (NBFC), with roughly Rs 3.02 lakh crore in assets under management and 3,225 branches nationwide. It offers commercial-vehicle, two-wheeler, used-car, personal, business and gold loans, fixed deposits and fixed investment plans, general and life insurance distribution, Bharat BillPay (BBPS) bill payments, and UPI through its Shriram One app. The company runs consumer web and mobile products but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification; a partner portal and a lending-service-provider program serve authorized business partners only.

providers.name: Sound.xyz
providers.description: Sound.xyz was a web3 music platform and suite of on-chain tools that let artists release music as digital collectibles and host listening parties for new releases, building direct economic relationships with their communities. The consumer platform went offline on 2026-01-16 (with a successor project, Vault.fm), but Sound.xyz's first-party developer surface remains publicly published: the open-source Sound protocol (a permissionless Solidity smart-contract framework for music collectibles) and the official @soundxyz npm SDK ecosystem (@soundxyz/sdk, sdk-viem, legacy-sdk) for on-chain development, alongside GraphQL and caching infrastructure libraries. Added to the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio company; this profile now reflects the enrichment pipeline's findings.

providers.name: Sovryn
providers.description: Sovryn is a Bitcoin-native, non-custodial decentralized finance (DeFi) protocol built on Rootstock (RSK). It offers spot and margin trading, perpetual swaps, 0% interest Bitcoin-backed loans (Zero), the Sovryn Dollar (DLLR) Bitcoin-backed stablecoin, yield and liquidity pools, and SOV governance staking, operating as a DAO. Sovryn also incubated BitcoinOS, a zk-powered rollup and multi-VM execution stack for Bitcoin. Developers integrate through open-source smart contracts, a GraphQL subgraph, an indexer HTTP data API, and first-party JavaScript SDKs published under the @sovryn and @sovryn-zero npm scopes.

providers.name: Spacebase
providers.description: Spacebase is an online marketplace for booking meeting rooms, event venues, and flexible workspaces, connecting businesses and event planners with more than 18,000 unique spaces across 4,000+ venues in 12 countries and 550+ destinations. The platform offers self-service online booking with transparent pricing, instant confirmation, add-on extras such as WiFi and catering, and a Spacebase booking guarantee, alongside consultant support for complex bookings and business accounts with negotiated rates and monthly invoicing. Spacebase is a portfolio company of Point Nine. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the company operates a consumer/business booking marketplace and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Spire Global
providers.description: Spire Global operates a constellation of more than 100 LEMUR nanosatellites collecting maritime AIS, aviation ADS-B, GNSS-RO weather profiles, and RF geolocation data, and offers Space Services for hosted payloads and managed satellite missions. Its data products are exposed as developer-friendly APIs: Spire Maritime 2.0 (now operated by Kpler) delivers vessel-tracking AIS through a GraphQL endpoint; Spire Aviation publishes REST APIs and real-time streams for flight metadata, live ADS-B tracking, historic positions, and event feeds; Spire Weather and Climate provides RESTful weather and ocean data APIs including 30 years of maritime weather history; and Spire Space Services exposes a developer portal for managed satellite operations. Spire's APIs are documented at product-specific subdomains and authenticated with API keys.

providers.name: STAND+
providers.description: STAND+ is a Techstars-backed footwear company making biomechanically engineered "energy-recovery" shoes for people who spend long hours standing or walking - healthcare workers, frontline and workforce professionals, athletes, and everyday movers. Its proprietary midsole is designed to dissipate and disperse impact energy outward rather than returning it into the joints, which the company markets for fatigue and pain reduction. The product lineup includes the AntiGrav1, AntiGrav2, and AG3 recovery shoes, the Gales Pro and Gales Frontline workforce and healthcare lines, and standalone recovery insoles. STAND+ is APMA (American Podiatric Medical Association) certified and HSA/FSA eligible through a Truemed partnership. This is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand (standshoes.com) with no public developer API, SDK, or integration surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Stride Health
providers.description: Stride Health is a benefits platform that helps independent, gig, and part-time workers access portable benefits that stay with the individual regardless of where or how they work. Stride connects people to affordable health, dental, vision, and life insurance, and provides tax tools, mileage/expense tracking, and savings features for the self-employed. The company reports 4.6 million independent workers served, $8+ billion saved on insurance and taxes, and 130+ partner companies. Stride operates a private B2B partner integration (embedded in partner apps such as gig-work platforms) but publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Sulekha
providers.description: Sulekha is an online local-services marketplace and classifieds platform serving Indian communities in the United States and Canada (us.sulekha.com) as well as its origin market in India (sulekha.com). It connects consumers with local service providers across housing and rentals, events and concert tickets, jobs, care services (nannies, eldercare, housekeeping), real estate, beauty, photography, immigration, astrology, travel and IT training. Sulekha operates as a consumer-facing web and mobile marketplace rather than an API producer; no public developer portal, API reference, or programmatic integration surface is published. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners.

providers.name: Superscript
providers.description: Superscript is a UK- and Netherlands-based business insurance provider offering flexible, subscription-based cover for small and growing businesses, sole traders, landlords, and larger enterprises. Its product range spans public and employers' liability, professional indemnity, cyber insurance, landlord insurance, and industry-specific policies, sold direct and through a broker channel. Superscript was surfaced as a portfolio company of Seedcamp and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, or programmatic integration surface; this profile captures its public web identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Supersolid
providers.description: Supersolid is a London, UK based mobile game developer and publisher, backed by Index Ventures, that designs and operates free-to-play mobile titles across merge, cooking, simulation, and multiplayer arena genres. Its portfolio includes Cook & Merge, Snake Rivals, Home Street, Food Street, Adventure Town, Super Penguins, and RoPets. Supersolid is a consumer-facing games studio and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile captures its public web properties (support, careers, terms, privacy) and domain-security posture. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures.

providers.name: SVT Robotics
providers.description: SVT Robotics builds the SOFTBOT Platform, a software integration and orchestration foundation for warehouse automation and the supply chain. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Norfolk, Virginia, the company lets enterprises connect industrial systems, robotics, AMRs, and warehouse management software through standardized, prebuilt SOFTBOT Connectors — reducing integration complexity and enabling real-time visibility, faster automation deployments, and a resilient data backbone for automation and AI. Customers include DHL Supply Chain, Barrett Distribution Centers, and the Hagen Group. The provider operates a developer documentation hub for the SOFTBOT integration API (docs.svtrobotics.com, currently password-protected) and a public status page; no public OpenAPI, SDK, or open API surface was discoverable at enrichment time.

providers.name: Swish
providers.description: Swish (operated by Munchmart Technologies Private Limited) is a Bengaluru-based quick-commerce food delivery startup founded in 2024 that promises meals at your door in ten minutes. It runs a full-stack, vertically integrated model — owning its neighbourhood cloud kitchens ("delight centres"), sourcing and supply chain, proprietary ordering/routing technology, and its own last-mile delivery fleet — operating dense hyperlocal clusters of roughly 1.5–2 km. The company focuses on frequent, lower-ticket occasions such as breakfast, snacks, and late-night meals, and reports around 20,000 orders a day across Bengaluru micro-markets. Swish raised a $38M Series B led by Hara Global and Bain Capital Ventures with participation from Accel, valuing it at $139M post-money and bringing total funding to about $54M. Swish is a consumer mobile-app business and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Tamara Mellon
providers.description: Tamara Mellon Brand, Inc. is a Los Angeles based direct-to-consumer luxury footwear company founded in 2016 by designer Tamara Mellon, co-founder of Jimmy Choo, together with chief executive Jill Layfield. The brand sells Italian-made women's shoes and accessories straight to customers online rather than through wholesale, releasing product in monthly drops instead of following the traditional fashion calendar, and it is reported to have raised roughly $87 million in venture funding after the earlier Tamara Mellon LLC filed for Chapter 11 in 2015. In August 2025 the company announced a licensing and operating partnership with footwear licensing firm Titan Industries. It is a consumer goods retailer rather than a software company: it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification of any kind. As probed on 2026-08-29 its canonical domain returns HTTP 404 on every path from an unprovisioned CDN origin, and its Shopify storefront at shop.tamaramellon.com redirects to a store password gate.

providers.name: Taxa
providers.description: Taxa Technologies is a San Francisco and Tokyo synthetic-biology startup engineering the human skin microbiome. Its debut consumer product is a shelf-stable probiotic deodorant cream: a single application of Taxa Probiotics (25.4 billion CFUs in a base of water, mango butter, and sunflower extract) lasts one week by swapping out the skin microbes responsible for body odor, with a line focused on Wakiga (severe underarm odor). The company frames the skin microbiome as a platform whose microbes drive body odor, UV absorption, and mosquito attraction. Backed by Matrix Partners, Taxa currently runs a product waitlist and publishes a consumer marketing site with People, Science, Terms, and Privacy pages, but no public API, developer documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: TerraFirma
providers.description: TerraFirma, Inc. is a construction technology and physical-AI company building the robotic infrastructure stack for modern heavy-civil construction. Founded in 2024 by former SpaceX engineers and based in Austin, Texas, it combines AI-enabled pre-construction software (Mission Planner), a remote command-and-control center (Mission Control), and retrofitted semi-autonomous heavy machinery — excavators, bulldozers, loaders, graders and rollers operated autonomously, remotely, or traditionally. The company raised roughly $115M including a $100M Series A led by Kleiner Perkins with Bain Capital Ventures. TerraFirma publishes no public developer/API surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: The Mind Company
providers.description: The Mind Company is a consumer mental-fitness company that builds a multi-app platform for cognitive and emotional wellbeing. Its apps include Elevate (cognitive training across memory, vocabulary, math, and more), Balance (personalized meditation for sleep, stress, and focus), and Spark (puzzle-based learning). The company is a portfolio company of Felicis and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile. As a direct-to-consumer mobile app business, The Mind Company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its identity, public web properties, and probed security posture.

providers.name: The Scotts Miracle-Gro Company
providers.description: The Scotts Miracle-Gro Company is the world's largest marketer of branded consumer lawn and garden products, with brands including Scotts, Miracle-Gro, Ortho, Roundup and Tomcat. It is a physical consumer-goods manufacturer and retailer: its digital surface is a Salesforce Commerce Cloud storefront and corporate site at scottsmiraclegro.com, plus end-user mobile apps. It publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable contract. The one developer-facing surface it ever marketed — the open API for the GRO connected smart-watering platform (Gro 7 Zone Controller, Gro Water Sensors) — had its cloud service discontinued on 2021-12-30 and its hosts no longer resolve. The Hawthorne Gardening Company subsidiary was divested to Vireo Growth in April 2026 and is no longer part of this company's surface.

providers.name: Theretailequation
providers.description: The Retail Equation (TRE) is an Irvine, California software and analytics company that helps retailers detect and prevent fraudulent transactions and reduce return/exchange policy abuse. Its core Transaction Authorization service analyzes a shopper's linked purchase, return, and exchange history in real time and returns an approve, warn, or deny recommendation at the point of return — scoring transaction frequency, value, and receipt status while explicitly excluding demographic factors. TRE is part of Appriss Retail. The public web presence is a marketing and consumer-inquiry site plus an authenticated retailer Return Activity Report (RAR) portal; no public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface is published.

providers.name: Thndr
providers.description: Thndr is an Egyptian investment and brokerage mobile app that lets retail users open a regulated brokerage account and invest in Egyptian Exchange (EGX) stocks, US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, and IPOs from their phone. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Cairo, Thndr is licensed by Egypt's Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) and registered with the Egyptian Exchange as a brokerage, positioning itself as a low-cost, mobile-first gateway to the capital markets across Egypt and the wider MENA region. The company raised a $20M Series A in 2022 led by Tiger Global with participation from Prosus Ventures and others, and has been recognized among Forbes Middle East's top fintech companies. Thndr's product surface is a consumer investing app (iOS, Android, and a web account-access portal) with an educational Learn hub and a customer support center; as of this profile it publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: Tugboat Logic
providers.description: Tugboat Logic is a security assurance and compliance automation platform acquired by OneTrust in 2021. It supports SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, and NIST. As of 2024, the product has been rebranded under OneTrust's Certification Automation offering; legacy Tugboat Logic APIs are not publicly documented and integrations now flow through OneTrust's developer platform.

providers.name: Tyra Biosciences
providers.description: Tyra Biosciences is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company (NASDAQ: TYRA) based in Carlsbad, California, focused on developing next-generation precision medicines that address the emergence of tumor resistance and other challenges in existing treatment options. Tyra's proprietary in-house SNAP discovery platform combines advanced protein crystallography with structure-based drug design, producing full structural "SNAPshots" of the real-world interaction between a drug and its target in as little as seven days rather than weeks to months. This rapid, sequential structural iteration lets the team refine molecular designs to angstrom-level precision and design selective inhibitors intended to deliver deeper, more durable responses for patients, including in cancers where resistance mutations block first-generation drugs. Tyra was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners. It is a therapeutics company and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: VillageMD
providers.description: VillageMD is a Chicago-based, value-based primary care organization that operates and supports physician practices across the United States through its Village Medical, Village Medical at Home, Summit Health, CityMD and Starling Physicians operating companies, serving millions of patients across primary care, multispecialty and urgent care. It runs clinics — free-standing practices, in-Walgreens practices, home-based care and virtual visits — rather than selling software, and its clinical record and patient-facing digital surface run on athenahealth: patient portals are hosted at practice-specific athenahealth portal subdomains and the Village Medical mobile app is the athenaPatient experience. VillageMD publishes no developer portal, no API documentation, no machine-readable specification and no SDK; the only public machine-readable interfaces touching its patients are athenahealth's certified FHIR R4 APIs, which are operated and documented by athenahealth, not by VillageMD. Since Sycamore Partners took Walgreens Boots Alliance private in August 2025, VillageMD has operated as a standalone company in that portfolio.

providers.name: Villoid
providers.description: Villoid is a Norwegian online fashion retailer (villoid.no, redirected from villoid.com) operating a Shopify-hosted boutique that curates over 250 designer and contemporary womenswear brands such as Ganni, Isabel Marant, Stella McCartney and ROTATE Birger Christensen. The store sells dresses, shoes, bags, accessories, sportswear and home goods, offering same-day delivery in Norway, easy returns, gift cards and payment via Klarna, Vipps, Visa and Mastercard. Originally surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global, Villoid exposes a consumer storefront and publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Vioo
providers.description: Vioo is a Mexican professional visual-content platform that connects businesses with a national network of 1,500+ certified photographers and creators across Mexico, delivering photography, videography, drone footage, 3D renders, and Matterport virtual tours. It serves real estate, gastronomy, e-commerce, hospitality, events, and portrait use cases with AI-assisted editing and 48-hour delivery, and offers scheduling either through a personalized form or automatically via an integration API. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Vir
providers.description: Vir Biotechnology, Inc. (NASDAQ: VIR) is a clinical-stage immunology company headquartered in San Francisco that combines immunologic insights with modern technology platforms to treat and prevent serious infectious diseases and, increasingly, cancer. Its pipeline spans chronic hepatitis B and D, respiratory infections, and dual-masked T-cell engagers for solid tumors, built on antibody, T-cell, innate-immunity, and small interfering RNA (siRNA) platforms. Vir is a research and corporate organization surfaced as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDK, MCP server, or developer portal — only its corporate and investor websites.

providers.name: WebComics
providers.description: WebComics (webcomicsapp.com) is a digital comics reading platform for Asian serialized comics, offering a large free library of manhua, manhwa, and manga across genres such as fantasy, romance, action, drama, horror, and slice-of-life. Readers browse trending titles, daily picks, new arrivals, and recent updates on the web and through native iOS and Android apps, while creators publish work through a separate Contribution Studio. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass WebComics exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or webhook surface; it operates as a consumer content application, so this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture rather than an API integration surface.

providers.name: Wellframe
providers.description: Wellframe is a digital health management and member engagement company, now part of HealthEdge, serving health plans and payers. Its platform combines care management, member engagement, and advocacy tooling to help health plans build trusted relationships with members through a mobile app and a clinician-facing dashboard. Wellframe does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; its integrations are delivered as part of enterprise health-plan implementations rather than a self-serve API program.

providers.name: Wellxai
providers.description: Wellx (Wellxai) is a Dubai-based health insurtech company that transforms health insurance from reactive to proactive through AI-driven behavior change. Its consumer mobile app pairs behavioral science and gamification with wearable integrations (Fitbit, Apple Watch, Whoop) so members earn xCoins rewards by hitting health goals, step and sleep challenges, and wellness programs, then redeem them with marketplace partners. Wellx also sells to corporates and SMEs and partners with brokers and insurers, positioning healthier behavior as the driver of better-value health insurance. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network; the company exposes consumer iOS/Android apps backed by a private API but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Welly
providers.description: Welly is a health and wellness brand and Certified B Corporation that designs first aid and personal care products, best known for its patterned Flex Fabric adhesive bandages, first aid kits, hydrocolloid blemish and bug-bite patches, and antiseptic wipes. Founded to make caring for everyday cuts, scrapes, and playtime injuries more joyful, Welly sells direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront at getwelly.com and via national retail partners. As a consumer packaged-goods company it publishes no public developer API or documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record enriched from its public web presence.

providers.name: Wollit
providers.description: Wollit is a UK-based credit-health subscription service (£9.99/month) that helps consumers build and strengthen their credit profile. Authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority for credit-broking activities, Wollit reports rent and subscription payments to Experian, Equifax and TransUnion, and bundles a suite of consumer tools: Rent Reporting, Payment Reporting, an AI credit assistant (Olli), Affordability Boost, Credit Smart lessons, and Credit Wins. It is a consumer-facing fintech app and was surfaced as a portfolio company of Anthemis; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: XOCEAN
providers.description: XOCEAN is an Irish ocean-data company, founded in 2017 and headquartered at the Rathcor Technical Centre in Co. Louth, Ireland, with offices in the UK, US, Canada, Norway and Australia and over 240 staff. It collects turnkey marine data using a fleet of low-carbon Uncrewed Surface Vessels (USVs) piloted over satellite from onshore operations centres, carrying multibeam echosounder, sub-bottom profiler, side-scan sonar, magnetometer and USBL payloads for seabed mapping, geophysical survey and environmental monitoring. Its customers are offshore wind developers, subsea cable operators, national hydrographic offices, oil and gas operators and carbon capture and storage projects, and its proprietary CyberDeck cloud environment monitors and controls the fleet in real time. XOCEAN sells survey data as a service — project deliverables, not a programmable product — and publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Ab Initio
providers.description: Ab Initio provides an enterprise data platform that enables large-scale data processing, integration, and analytics across diverse industries. Its software automates data ingestion, transformation, and delivery, supporting batch and real‑time workloads on cloud and on‑premises environments. The platform emphasizes scalability, self‑service, and governance, helping organizations turn massive data streams into actionable insights.

providers.name: Acme Markets
providers.description: Acme Markets is a regional supermarket chain founded in 1891 and headquartered in the U.S. Northeast, operating approximately 164 stores across Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, New York, Connecticut, and Maryland. Acme is a banner of Albertsons Companies, Inc., one of the largest food and drug retailers in the United States. The brand has no publicly documented developer program or public API: digital surfaces (store locator, loyalty program "ACME for U", FreshPass subscription, DriveUp & Go, delivery, pharmacy) are delivered through Albertsons-shared web and mobile platforms. The Android package ID (`com.safeway.client.android.acme`) confirms that the Acme app is built on the shared Safeway/Albertsons banner application, suggesting a shared backend API surface across Albertsons banners that is not externally published.

providers.name: AdvanCell
providers.description: AdvanCell is a vertically integrated, clinical-stage radiopharmaceutical company developing targeted alpha therapies (TAT) for cancer, built around lead-212 (Pb-212) alpha-emitting isotopes and a proprietary, scalable isotope production and supply chain. Its lead candidate, 212Pb-ADVC001, is in clinical development for metastatic prostate cancer, and the company operates GMP radiochemistry and sterile manufacturing capability across Sydney, Brisbane (Translational Research Institute and Richlands) and Adelaide in Australia, with a global headquarters established in the Greater Boston area. AdvanCell is a private, venture-backed biotechnology company; it publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Agentic Data Intelligence
providers.description: Agentic Data Intelligence SA (ADI) is a Swiss-headquartered startup building the control plane for AI data analytics: a thin semantics-and-control layer that sits between AI agents and data. ADI automatically generates machine-readable semantics and an enforceable contract (rules) that governs how copilots and agents conduct data analysis, improving governance, accuracy, and consistency while lowering inference cost. It never sees the underlying data, generating the contract from schema and context and running analysis locally. The Starter Edition targets coding agents and IDEs (Claude Code, Cursor, Manus) delivered via SKILL.md files, plugins, and MCP Servers; the Enterprise Edition extends cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, Databricks, dbt). Backed by Electric Capital and supporting the Open Semantic Interchange (OSI) initiative. Currently in limited alpha, accepting first partners via a waitlist.

providers.name: Aistech
providers.description: Aistech Space is a European leader providing proprietary high‑resolution thermal imagery and geospatial intelligence from its own satellite constellation. The company captures the human activity layer of Earth, delivering on‑demand thermal data for security, defense, infrastructure monitoring, maritime, natural hazards, and agriculture, enabling decisive action across industries.

providers.name: Aivar
providers.description: Aivar Innovations is an enterprise AI consulting and development firm that helps regulated and large organizations move agentic AI systems from pilot to scaled production. Alongside strategic AI consulting, custom AI development, managed AI/ML operations, data services, and cloud transformation, Aivar ships three accelerators: Convogent AI (autonomous voice and conversational agents in 16+ languages with sub-500ms latency), Velogent AI (governed agentic process automation for regulated industries), and Kubogent AI (enterprise AI infrastructure on Kubernetes). The company operates a professional-services model and does not currently publish a public, self-service API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Akur8
providers.description: Akur8 is a cloud-based actuarial AI platform for P&C and life insurers, covering pricing (Data, Risk, Demand, Rate, Rate Repo, Optim, Discover), reserving, and production deployment of rating models. There is no self-serve public developer API or public API reference published on akur8.com; the platform is sold and onboarded as enterprise SaaS through a sales-led, typically two-week free pilot. The one confirmed API capability is Akur8 Deploy - once a pricing model built in Akur8 Rate is finalized, Deploy auto-generates a private, tenant-specific real-time REST rating/scoring endpoint that a customer's own policy admin or quoting system calls at quote time to return a price in milliseconds. Access to that generated endpoint is provisioned per customer within a paid contract, not published for anonymous developer signup; rating tables can also be exported in CSV, JSON, PMML, and POJO formats for offline integration.

providers.name: Amera
providers.description: Amera (Amera Health Solutions) is a Seattle-based, Y Combinator (Fall 2025) healthcare technology company that automates claims processing workflows for health insurance payers, third-party administrators (TPAs), and self-insured employers. Its normalization engine ingests messy claim inputs from any source — EDI, PDFs, paper, fax, and proprietary/non-standard formats — and turns them into adjudication-ready, structured data that plugs into existing claims cores via API, EDI, or SFTP. The platform automates validation, reconciliation, stop-loss reporting, and real-time visibility and analytics, reducing plan administration costs and cutting carrier submission times from weeks to minutes while keeping full audit trails and HIPAA compliance. Founded in 2025 by Louise Tanski and Deep Kapur (both formerly of Rupa Health), Amera already works with payers and plan administrators representing roughly 100,000 members. This profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network; Amera does not yet publish a public developer portal or API specification.

providers.name: Anchor Protocol
providers.description: Anchor Protocol is a Terra-based decentralized finance (DeFi) savings protocol that offered a low-volatility yield on Terra stablecoin (UST) deposits, borrowing against bonded-asset (bAsset) collateral such as bLUNA and bETH, and cross-chain access through EthAnchor and xAnchor. Its developer surface is a set of first-party JavaScript/TypeScript SDKs (Anchor.js and Anchor Earn) plus on-chain CosmWasm smart contracts rather than a REST or OpenAPI web API. The project is part of the Terra ecosystem and is backed by Pantera Capital; its main web application deployment is currently disabled, though its developer documentation and npm SDK packages remain published.

providers.name: Apreciapharmaceuticals
providers.description: Apreciapharmaceuticals, operating as Aprecia Pharmaceuticals, is a pioneering specialty CDMO focused on 3D‑printed drug manufacturing. Founded in 2003 and based in Langhorne, PA, the company offers end‑to‑end development, clinical‑trial supply, and commercial‑scale production using FDA‑registered cGMP facilities. It is the world’s first to secure regulatory approval for a 3D‑printed medication (SPRITAM®) and continues to innovate in precision formulation, rapid prototyping, and flexible manufacturing to accelerate patient‑centered drug development.

providers.name: ARRIS Group
providers.description: ARRIS Group was a global telecommunications equipment company providing entertainment and communications solutions including broadband, video, and wireless products for service providers and consumers. ARRIS was acquired by CommScope in 2019, combining their broadband technology expertise with CommScope's infrastructure solutions. The combined company offers cable modem equipment, set-top boxes, network infrastructure, DOCSIS technology, and related telecommunications hardware and software platforms for cable operators, telcos, and internet service providers worldwide.

providers.name: Aspora
providers.description: Aspora is a cross-border fintech serving the Non-Resident Indian (NRI) diaspora, offering money transfers from the USA, UK, and UAE to India at near-mid-market ("Google") rates, NRE/NRO bank account opening, and digital gold investing, with multi-currency savings, bill payments, and EMI/SIP automation on its roadmap. The company reports over 1 million users moving more than $2 billion, with proactive fraud detection, 256-bit encryption, and funds held at regulated institutions. Formerly known as Vance, Aspora is a consumer mobile application (iOS and Android) and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation. This profile was surfaced as a Greylock portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from Aspora's public web surface (identity, links, and probed domain security).

providers.name: Assort Health
providers.description: Assort Health builds an AI voice-agent platform purpose-built for healthcare practices, automating the full patient-access journey across the phone line and back office — 24/7 appointment scheduling and management, intelligent triage and call routing, patient intake and insurance verification, proactive outbound reminders and outreach, referral and fax automation, medication refill management, after-hours medical answering, and payment resolution. The agents are trained on 190M+ patient interactions spanning 23+ medical specialties and integrate with 15+ EHR/PMS platforms (with deep athenahealth support), personalizing each conversation with patient context, language preference, and care history. The company is venture-backed (Series C), with Lightspeed Venture Partners and Menlo Ventures among its investors. This API Evangelist profile was enriched from Assort Health's public web surface; the company publishes no public developer/API program at this time.

providers.name: ATC (Alquila tu cancha)
providers.description: ATC (Alquila Tu Cancha) is an Argentine sports-technology company, founded in 2020, that operates LATAM's leading platform for booking amateur sports venues — courts for football, padel, tennis and more — alongside cloud management software for the clubs and complexes that run them. Consumers search real-time availability by location, sport and time and reserve in a few steps through the ATC Sports mobile apps and web app, with online payments guaranteed via Mercado Pago. Clubs use the ATC management software to handle online reservations, cash control, reporting and service sales. ATC operates across eight-plus countries including Argentina, Peru, Chile, Uruguay, Panama, Mexico, Colombia, Costa Rica and the United States, spanning 500-plus venues and more than 200,000 active players. The company is a 500 Global (500 Latam) portfolio company. It exposes no public developer API, SDK or developer portal at this time; this profile tracks its public web presence.

providers.name: Auto-Owners Insurance
providers.description: Auto-Owners Insurance is a mutual insurance company headquartered in Lansing, Michigan, offering auto, home, life, business, and farm insurance products through a network of independent agents. Founded in 1916, the company is consistently rated among the top mutual insurance companies in the United States. Auto-Owners provides online account management, claims filing, and agent portal services but does not currently offer a public developer API.

providers.name: Betdex
providers.description: Betdex Labs is the team behind BetDEX, a decentralized sports betting exchange, and the Monaco Protocol — an open-source, permissionless liquidity and betting-exchange protocol built on the Solana blockchain. Rather than a traditional REST API, Betdex exposes an on-chain integration surface: Solana programs plus first-party TypeScript client libraries (@monaco-protocol/client and @monaco-protocol/admin-client on npm) that let developers create markets, place and match orders, and settle outcomes directly against the protocol. Developer resources are published at betdex.com/developers with source under the MonacoProtocol GitHub organization.

providers.name: BioCytics
providers.description: BioCytics, Inc. is a privately held biotechnology company in Huntersville, North Carolina, founded in 2005 by John Powderly, MD, CPI, and clinically incubated by the co-located Carolina BioOncology Institute cancer research clinic. Its name means "applications of living cells": the company runs a Human Applications Laboratory (HAL), a patient-driven and industry-driven BioBank, and a BioInformatics group, and sells cGMP cell-therapy manufacturing (CDMO), early-phase CRO services, clinical lab diagnostics and translational analytical services alongside its own autologous adaptive immune cell therapy (AAICT) pipeline for solid tumors. Its BioDICE platform — BioCytics Digitally Integrated Clinical Enterprise — is an internal EMR / EDC-CDM / lab-documentation / CTMS suite whose product page names openEHR, HL7, FHIR, OMOP and SMART-on-FHIR as the data standards it works with, and openEHR International lists BioCytics as a Bronze industry partner. None of that is exposed: BioCytics publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind, and biocytics.com is a 26-page WordPress site whose only machine-readable surface is the CMS's own unadvertised /wp-json/ index.

providers.name: Biryanibykilo
providers.description: Biryanibykilo is an Indian online food ordering platform specializing in biryani and related dishes. It offers customers the ability to browse menus, place orders for delivery or pickup, and track order status through its website and mobile apps. The service focuses on a wide variety of regional biryani styles, catering to diverse taste preferences across India.

providers.name: Bloom & Wild
providers.description: Bloom & Wild is a British direct-to-consumer online florist and gifting brand founded in 2013 by Aron Gelbard and Ben Stanway, best known for pioneering letterbox flowers — bouquets packed flat so they fit through a UK letterbox — alongside hand-tied bouquets, plants, gift sets, gift cards and recurring flower subscriptions. Bloom & Wild Group trades as Bloom & Wild in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Germany and Austria, and operates the sister brands bloomon (Netherlands, Belgium, Denmark) and Bergamotte (France) on separate storefronts. The group is a certified B Corp and runs its own commerce platform — a Ruby on Rails backend fronted by Kong, an Angular multi-brand web app and native iOS and Android clients, on AWS and GCP. Bloom & Wild publishes NO public developer portal, no API documentation, no OpenAPI or other machine-readable API description, and no partner or corporate-gifting API: business and bulk gifting is transacted through a contact form, an account manager and invoicing, not through a programmatic surface. The application backends at api.bloomandwild.com and capi.bloomandwild.com are live but private to the brand's own clients and undocumented. What the group does publish for machines is narrow but real: an llms.txt on the UK and German storefronts that routes assistants to the correct market by delivery destination and even ships an optional agent widget specification, and an RFC 9116 security.txt served across every group storefront.

providers.name: Brain
providers.description: Brain Co. builds agent-native operating systems for institutions across the public and private sectors. Its Atlas platform powers GovOS — permitting, licensing, claims, and casework for government agencies at national scale — and InsuranceOS for underwriting, claims, authorization, and insurance operations, with an emphasis on sovereign-grade security and vendor neutrality. Founded in 2025 and based in San Francisco, the company was cofounded by Elad Gil, Jared Kushner, and Luis Videgaray, with a team drawn from Google, DeepMind, NVIDIA, Palantir, and Tesla. Brain Co. does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI definitions; this profile tracks its public web surface (news, trust center, privacy and terms) pending any future developer program.

providers.name: Bridg Payment Solutions
providers.description: Bridg Payment Solutions Ltd. is a Dubai-based fintech founded in 2013 by Moussa Beidas and Nadim Jarudi. Its patent-pending OneConnect technology turns any smartphone into a point-of-sale terminal and mobile wallet, using Bluetooth to let two phones exchange card payments even when only one (or neither) has an internet connection by treating the devices as a network of offline ledgers. Bridg targets delivery drivers, in-flight retail on low-cost carriers, and merchants who need to accept debit and credit card payments without dedicated hardware, and offers the product white-labeled to merchants and payment partners. The company advertises PCI DSS and Visa compliance and is backed by 500 Global, TURN8, MetLife Foundation, Village Capital, and the European Commission. This profile was enriched from the public marketing site; Bridg publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK at this time.

providers.name: Bugcrowd
providers.description: Bugcrowd API for interacting and tracking the reported issues programmatically

providers.name: Cardekho
providers.description: Cardekho is an Indian automotive technology platform offering comprehensive car buying, selling, and ownership services. It provides detailed car specifications, price comparisons, dealer listings, and tools for used‑car valuation, helping consumers make informed decisions across new and pre‑owned vehicle markets. The site also features extensive car reviews, EV information, and a dealer network across major Indian cities, enhancing the overall car ownership experience.

providers.name: Careem
providers.description: Careem is the everything app for the greater Middle East, a super-app operating across the MENAP region (Middle East, North Africa, and Pakistan) and headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Founded in 2012 and now owned by Uber, Careem combines mobility (rides, taxi, bike, car rental), food and grocery delivery (Careem Eat, Quik), courier and B2B logistics (Box, Express), and financial services (Careem Pay, remittance, donations) alongside the Careem Plus subscription. Careem does not currently operate a public developer API program or partner API portal; this profile captures its public identity, engineering surface, and domain-security posture within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Caregility
providers.description: Caregility provides a connected care platform that enables hospitals and health systems to deliver bedside virtual care, telehealth, and remote patient monitoring. Their solutions integrate with Epic and other EHRs, offering virtual nursing, AI‑enhanced clinical insights, and a suite of smart room devices to improve patient outcomes across inpatient, outpatient, home, and rural settings.

providers.name: CareGuide
providers.description: CareGuide is a Canadian company operating a network of online marketplaces that connect families with caregivers across child care, home care, pet care, and elder care, alongside HeartPayroll household payroll services. Its consumer brands include CanadianNanny.ca, Sitter.com, PetSitter.com, ElderCare.com, HouseKeeper.com and a family of "Meet A" professional directories. Backed by 500 Global, CareGuide is added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile. The company does not publish a public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Cashsembly
providers.description: Cashsembly provides free financial calculators for both Canada and the United States, covering a wide range of personal finance topics such as income tax, capital gains, GST/HST, mortgage calculations, retirement planning, and more. Users can access tools for budgeting, net worth tracking, loan payments, and investment projections, all without needing to register. The platform aims to simplify complex financial calculations for individuals and professionals alike.

providers.name: Century
providers.description: Century Aluminum produces and sells alumina and primary aluminum. It supplies these metals to the automotive, aerospace, defense, and consumer‑goods sectors. The company operates vertically integrated facilities, including a bauxite mine, alumina refinery, anode plant, and smelters in the United States, Jamaica, Iceland, and the Netherlands. Its products are positioned as critical metals for modern life and national security.

providers.name: CesiumAstro
providers.description: CesiumAstro designs, manufactures, and tests full-stack communication systems and satellites for space, air, and ground missions. The Austin, Texas company, founded in 2017, builds active phased array payloads (Vireo), software-defined radios (SDR-1001/2051/2104/3104), reconfigurable processing units, SATCOM terminals (Skylark), tactical ISR/PNT payloads (Nightingale), and the integrated Element LEO satellite platform. Its hardware enables inter-satellite links, high-speed downlinks, lunar communications, and 5G non-terrestrial networks. CesiumAstro publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal; this profile tracks the company as an aerospace hardware provider in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Cimulate
providers.description: Cimulate is an AI-native commerce experience platform for intelligent product discovery, delivering context-aware search, adaptive browse, real-time recommendations, a conversational AI shopping assistant, and Commerce AEO (answer/agent engine optimization for visibility inside LLM surfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude). The platform is architected API-first and headless-ready and advertises a proprietary Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for agentic commerce workflows. Cimulate became part of Salesforce in February 2026. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Sierra Ventures.

providers.name: Cochlear
providers.description: Cochlear is a global leader in implantable hearing solutions, helping over 700,000 people hear through advanced cochlear implant technology.
