The platform surfaces workflows, task and agent orchestration, workers, queue groups, prompts, assets, artifacts, secrets, webhooks, and audit logging, with integrations for tools such as GitHub, Slack, Postgres, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, OpenAI, and Claude. Hessian does not yet publish a public API, developer documentation, SDKs, or an OpenAPI definition; this profile captures its verifiable public identity and web properties while the developer surface is awaiting release.

providers.name: Humans Anonymous
providers.description: Humans Anonymous is a consumer mobile application offering anonymous audio spaces for mental health and peer support, built on the premise that "being a human is hard" and no one should face it alone. Distributed as an iOS app, it lets people join anonymous, real-time audio rooms to talk and listen around mental wellbeing. Surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes a consumer product website (humansanon.com) with privacy and terms pages but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Iambic Therapeutics
providers.description: Iambic Therapeutics is a clinical-stage AI drug discovery company headquartered in San Diego. Its proprietary AI platform pairs the NeuralPLexer 3D generative model for protein-ligand structure prediction with the Enchant multimodal transformer for clinical and preclinical endpoint prediction, integrated with automated wet-lab capabilities. Iambic's clinical pipeline includes IAM1363 (HER2), IAM-K1 (KIF18A), and IAM-C1 (CDK2/4) in oncology. Iambic is a therapeutics developer rather than an API provider and does not publish a public developer API or open-source platform.

providers.name: Instalily
providers.description: InstaLILY builds Lily, an AI "Forward Deployed Engineer" for the physical and regulated economy. Lily learns how an enterprise operates, builds custom software agents for high-friction operational work such as quoting, routing, field service, and approvals, and runs them inside the systems companies already use including SAP, NetSuite, Epicor, Salesforce, HubSpot, and Snowflake. InstaLILY serves industrial distribution and MRO, manufacturing and OEM, field service, healthcare and pharma, and private equity. The company is headquartered at 455 Broadway, New York, and is backed by Insight Partners. No public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: kWh Analytics
providers.description: kWh Analytics is a Beaverton, Oregon based managing general agent and data-analytics firm that underwrites property and performance insurance for renewable energy assets — solar, wind, and battery storage. Founded in 2012 and acquired by specialist insurer Beazley in 2023, the company operates what it describes as the industry's largest solar performance database, covering roughly 30% of U.S. solar assets across 300,000+ renewable energy assets and $100B+ in loss data. Its HelioStats platform ingests unstructured asset production documents (via AWS S3, Box, Dropbox, email attachment, or API) and applies OCR and machine learning to extract, validate, standardize, benchmark, and enrich operating data for investors, lenders, and asset owners. Commercial products include data-driven Property Insurance, the Solar Revenue Put credit enhancement, the Wind Proxy Hedge, and the SolarScape market intelligence offering. kWh Analytics also publishes the annual Solar Risk Assessment industry report. There is no public developer portal, published API reference, or machine-readable API specification — data delivery and the HelioStats ingest API are arranged through enterprise engagement.

providers.name: Latent Labs
providers.description: Latent Labs is a London- and San Francisco-based frontier AI lab founded in 2023 by Dr. Simon Kohl, a former senior research scientist on DeepMind's Nobel Prize-winning AlphaFold 2 and co-lead of DeepMind's protein design team. The company builds generative AI foundation models to make biology programmable, with the goal of enabling biotech and pharmaceutical partners to computationally generate and optimize therapeutic molecules. Latent Labs emerged from stealth in February 2025 with $50M in total funding ($40M Series A co-led by Radical Ventures and Sofinnova Partners, plus 8VC, Kindred Capital, Pillar VC, Flying Fish, Isomer, and angel investors including Jeff Dean, Aidan Gomez, and Mati Staniszewski). The company's proprietary model family includes Latent-X (atom-level de novo protein binder design for macrocycles and mini-binders), Latent-X2 (drug-like antibodies with low ex vivo immunogenicity), and Latent-Y (described as the first lab-validated agent for drug design). Models are accessed through the Latent Labs Platform (platform.latentlabs.com) — a no-code web application with a free tier and daily credits — and, for Latent-X2, via API for commercial partners. There is no public OpenAPI spec, SDK, or open-source release at this time; programmatic access is gated through partnerships@latentlabs.com and wet-lab validation is performed in-house at the company's San Francisco facility.

providers.name: Likeable Local
providers.description: Likeable Local is a social media marketing company that now operates publicly as Storytellit — likeablelocal.com and www.likeablelocal.com both redirect to storytellit.com, while the product application at app.likeablelocal.com and app.storytellit.com still identifies itself as "Likeable Local" in its web app manifest. Storytellit sells social media management as a white-label service to digital agencies — strategy, custom content creation and publishing, paid social advertising, lead capture, and monthly performance reporting for the agency's clients, across verticals including dental, medical, legal, real estate, insurance, finance, eCommerce, and local business. The company is based in Portland, Maine, and was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass Likeable Local / Storytellit publishes no public API, no developer portal, no API documentation, and no machine-readable specification; the public web surface is a four-page marketing site plus a private, login-gated React application. A production API does exist but is an internal application backend rather than a developer product — api.storytellit.com and api.likeablelocal.com both resolve to the same Amazon load balancer and run Express over FeathersJS, and every service path, including a GraphQL endpoint, rejects anonymous callers with HTTP 401 while serving no specification and no documentation of any kind.

providers.name: Mend
providers.description: Mend is a HIPAA-compliant telehealth and patient engagement platform for mental and behavioral healthcare organizations, powering appointment scheduling, automated reminders, secure video visits, digital intake forms and consents, patient messaging, payments, and AI no-show prediction. Mend integrates with EHR and practice-management systems through a combination of HL7, SFTP, and an API served from api.mendfamily.com. That API exists and is used by Mend's own portal for session initialization and signaling, but its reference documentation is delivered through a login-gated customer knowledge base rather than a public developer portal, so Mend's programmatic surface is best characterized as partner- and customer-gated rather than openly self-serve.

providers.name: NextSilicon
providers.description: NextSilicon is a deep-tech compute company building intelligent, software-defined acceleration hardware for high-performance computing, AI, and vector-database workloads. Its flagship Maverick-2 is a dataflow accelerator built on the Intelligent Compute Architecture (ICA) that reconfigures itself at runtime, and its Arbel product is a server-class RISC-V CPU core on TSMC process. A developer toolchain supports C/C++, FORTRAN, OpenMP, and Kokkos, with planned CUDA and HIP/ROCm paths, letting teams run existing code faster without rewrites or vendor lock-in. NextSilicon publishes no public web API, SDK registry package, or open developer portal; its documentation site is gated, so this profile captures company identity, its GitHub organization (largely upstream compiler/Kokkos forks), and domain-security posture.

providers.name: nEye Systems
providers.description: nEye (nEye.ai, formerly nEye Systems) is a silicon photonics company in Santa Clara and Emeryville, California building an optical circuit switch on a chip — a programmable photonic integrated circuit that combines silicon photonics, MEMS and CMOS to switch light directly between GPUs, CPUs and memory inside AI and high-performance computing data centers, marketed as the SuperSwitch. The company was spun out of University of California, Berkeley research by co-founder and chief scientist Ming C. Wu and is led by CEO Ashish Vengsarkar. It raised an $80M Series C led by Sutter Hill Ventures in April 2026, bringing total funding to $152M with participation from CapitalG, M12 and Socratic Partners, and it participates in the Open Compute Project Open OCS effort alongside Google, NVIDIA and Microsoft. nEye is a semiconductor and optical hardware company: as of this profile it publishes no developer program, API, SDK, webhook surface or machine-readable contract of any kind, and its entire public surface is a seven-page marketing site.

providers.name: Ontora
providers.description: Ontora is an AI operational-intelligence platform that runs parallel, voice-based AI-agent interviews with every employee to map how work actually gets done across operations, sales, finance, and change management. It synthesizes the roughly 80% of undocumented, tacit process knowledge that lives only in employees' heads into prioritized automation and cost-reduction roadmaps, compressing a discovery effort that traditionally takes a consulting firm months into a matter of hours. Founded in 2026 and backed by Y Combinator, Ontora targets mid-market companies of roughly 200-2,000 employees undergoing AI transformation. As of this profile the company publishes a product and app but no public API, SDK, or developer platform.

providers.name: Owner.com
providers.description: Owner.com is an all-in-one, done-for-you digital platform for independent restaurants - an AI-built website with SEO, commission-free online and direct ordering, a branded mobile app, email/SMS and push marketing, automated campaigns, a loyalty and rewards program, plus delivery and catering management and reporting - sold as a per-location monthly subscription. Owner.com is a closed SaaS product operated as a managed service for small and independent restaurant operators. It does NOT publish a public or partner developer API, SDK, or developer portal, and exposes no documented, self-serve, programmatic endpoints. It advertises "POS integrations" (Toast, Clover, Square) and payment integrations (Stripe, Apple Pay, Google Pay), but these are configured by Owner.com's own team as part of onboarding rather than offered as documented API surfaces to third-party developers. As of this writing there is no programmatic API to model - this entry is documented honestly as a no-public-API provider.

providers.name: R1 RCM
providers.description: R1 RCM is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The R1 RCM API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: React
providers.description: A JavaScript library for building user interfaces, maintained by Meta and the open source community.

providers.name: Resynergi
providers.description: Resynergi is an advanced plastic recycling technology company that builds modular Continuous Microwave Assisted Pyrolysis (CMAP) systems, marketed as AMP Modules, which convert hard-to-recycle waste plastics (HDPE, LDPE, polypropylene and polystyrene) into circular pyrolysis oil (PyOil) and other petrochemical feedstocks. Each 440 sq ft module is designed to process roughly 5 tons of plastic waste per day and produce about 1,000 gallons of PyOil per day, and the company claims a conversion roughly twenty times faster than conventional pyrolysis with a large reduction in CO2-equivalent emissions. Founded in 2015 by Jason Tanne and Brian Bauer around microwave pyrolysis research from the University of Minnesota, Resynergi commercializes its modules in partnership with Lummus Technology, which sells the AMP Modules, and also operates plants near the source of waste under a partner model. This is an industrial process-equipment business; it is not a software vendor and publishes no developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Ryerson Holding
providers.description: Ryerson Holding Corporation is a leading value-added processor and distributor of industrial metals, with operations across the United States, Canada, Mexico, China, and Brazil. The company offers a broad range of stainless steel, aluminum, carbon steel, and alloy steels in various shapes and forms. Ryerson operates an e-commerce platform at Ryerson.com enabling online metal ordering, order status tracking, and shipment management. The company has integrated its CRM (Salesforce) with ERP (SAP) for streamlined order management and uses EDI and API-based integration for wholesale distribution operations.

providers.name: Science Applications International Corporation (SAIC)
providers.description: Science Applications International Corporation (SAIC) is a leading American technology integrator providing full life cycle services and solutions in the technical, engineering, and enterprise information technology markets. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, SAIC serves the U.S. federal government with approximately $7.4 billion in annual revenues. The company delivers IT modernization, cloud computing, digital transformation, cybersecurity, AI/ML, and data analytics solutions primarily for defense, intelligence, and civilian government customers. SAIC's open source presence is at github.com/saic-oss with DevSecOps tools including Anvil (CI/CD container) and terraform modules for Kubernetes sandboxes.

providers.name: Sealed Air
providers.description: Sealed Air Corporation (SEE) is a global packaging company headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, now privately held following its acquisition by Clayton, Dubilier & Rice. It designs and manufactures food packaging, protective packaging and automated packaging equipment under the Bubble Wrap, Cryovac, AutoBag, Liquibox and NexCel brands, and pairs them with digital services including SEE Smart Service Link for connected-equipment monitoring and prismiq for digital printing and smart packaging. Its developer surface is an Azure API Management program at developer.sealedair.com whose API catalog requires a portal account, so no public OpenAPI, reference or SDK is available to an unauthenticated integrator.

providers.name: SolarCycle
providers.description: SolarCycle is a technology-driven solar recycling company founded in 2022 that provides certified end-of-life management for solar energy systems. It recovers up to 97% of panel materials (silver, copper, gold, aluminum, glass), recycles power electronics such as inverters and transformers, and handles logistics and field operations for large-scale solar projects, achieving 100% landfill diversion. SolarCycle operates seven facilities across Georgia, Illinois, Texas, Nevada, and Arizona and is building a domestic recycled-solar-glass manufacturing plant, serving major solar companies including Q Cells, AES, Orsted, and Sunrun. It is a portfolio company of Fifth Wall. This is a physical circular-economy operations business with no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Stellapps
providers.description: Stellapps is an end-to-end dairy technology company from Bangalore, India (IIT Madras incubated, founded 2011) that digitizes milk production, milk procurement, and cold-chain management through its SmartMoo full-stack IoT platform. Sensors in milking systems, animal wearables, chilling equipment, and procurement peripherals stream data to the SmartMoo Big Data Cloud for analytics and machine learning serving dairy farmers, cooperatives, and processors, with applications including mooON herd management, smartAMCU and smartCC milk procurement, ConTrak cold-chain monitoring, mooFlow ERP, and mooPay financial services. Stellapps publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs; the SmartMoo platform is accessed through hosted applications behind CAS single sign-on.

providers.name: Stroma Medical
providers.description: Strōma Medical Corporation is a clinical-stage medical device company headquartered in Irvine, California, developing the Strōma Laser System — a patented laser technology that permanently changes eye color by removing the thin layer of brown pigment on the anterior surface of the iris, revealing the underlying amber, hazel, grey, blue or green color beneath. The in-office procedure uses only topical anesthetic, takes under a minute per eye per treatment, and reveals its result over three to four weeks. Strōma licenses the system to refractive surgeons and LASIK-certified ophthalmologists rather than selling to consumers directly. The device is investigational and is not available for sale or use in the United States, and the company filed a voluntary Chapter 11, Subchapter V case in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware. Strōma publishes no developer program, no public API, no SDKs and no machine-readable API contract of any kind; its public web presence is a six-page WordPress marketing site.

providers.name: Ubiquitous Influence
providers.description: Ubiquitous Influence is a full‑service influencer marketing agency that partners brands with creators across platforms like TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and X. They provide end‑to‑end campaign management, including strategy, logistics, performance tracking, and paid amplification, delivering transparent and profitable results for clients ranging from startups to large enterprises.

providers.name: Visibl Semiconductors
providers.description: Visibl Semiconductors builds an AI-enabled coordination layer for custom chip design teams, positioning itself as "the first coordination layer for chip design." Its platform continuously monitors specifications against implementation to detect drift early, investigates issues by assembling evidence bundles, and proposes fixes through AI agents that require human approval before any change is deployed. The company frames this as a faster path to custom silicon and is backed by Y Combinator. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing website only and exposes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Vulcan Materials Company
providers.description: Vulcan Materials Company is the nation's largest producer of construction aggregates, primarily crushed stone, sand, and gravel, and a major producer of asphalt mix and ready-mixed concrete. Headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama, Vulcan serves all 50 states and operates over 400 quarries and plants. As a Fortune 500 company, Vulcan serves the construction industry with materials critical for roads, bridges, buildings, and infrastructure. Vulcan does not publish a public developer API ecosystem; their digital operations focus on internal ERP systems, supplier portals, and customer order management platforms.

providers.name: WSFS Financial
providers.description: WSFS Financial Corporation is a multibillion-dollar financial services company headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware. Its primary subsidiary WSFS Bank has operated since 1832, making it one of the oldest banks in the United States. As of March 31, 2026 the company reported $22.1 billion in assets and $97.6 billion in assets under management and administration across 114 offices in six states. Business lines include personal banking, small business and commercial banking, treasury management, WSFS Mortgage, WSFS Wealth Management, Bryn Mawr Trust (acquired 2022), WSFS Institutional Services, and the Cash Connect ATM-as-a-service business that provides cash logistics and vault cash to independent ATM operators. WSFS does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, or SDKs; all APIs are bilateral treasury / cash management integrations delivered through Enhanced Business Online Banking, ACH/wire file feeds, and the Cash Connect partner portal.

providers.name: Zaver
providers.description: Zaver provides a modern payments platform that enables businesses to accept, process, and manage payments across multiple channels, including online, in‑store, and mobile. The company focuses on delivering secure, fast, and developer‑friendly APIs that integrate with existing e‑commerce and ERP systems. Zaver’s solutions include payment processing, fraud detection, recurring billing, and comprehensive reporting tools, helping merchants streamline financial operations and improve customer experience.

providers.name: Zhangmen
providers.description: Zhangmen (掌门1对1 / 掌门教育) is a Shanghai-based online education company offering premium one-on-one and small-group tutoring to K-12 students across China. Its platform pairs students with elite instructors and layers on data-driven, intelligent learning analysis: diagnostic assessment, personalized study plans, real-time classroom monitoring, automated learning reports, and parent progress tracking. Beyond core academic tutoring the company runs quality-education modules spanning public speaking, creative art, programming, and comprehensive/mathematical thinking, along with a piano accompaniment-practice product (zmpeilian.com). The business is a direct-to-consumer web and mobile app play delivered in Simplified Chinese; it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: zincfive
providers.description: ZincFive is a power solutions company that manufactures nickel-zinc (NiZn) battery technology for mission-critical and backup power applications, including data center UPS systems, AI dynamic power, and grid storage. Its product line covers BC Series UPS battery cabinets, NiZn retrofit kits, monobloc batteries, and cylindrical cells, positioned as non-flammable, high-power-density, and highly recyclable alternatives to lead-acid batteries. ZincFive publishes technical documents, papers, and industry insights reports, but does not expose a public developer API or SDK surface.

providers.name: 1001 AI
providers.description: 1001 (also known as 1001 AI) is a deeptech artificial intelligence company founded in 2025 by Bilal Abu-Ghazaleh, a former director of generative AI operations at Scale AI, and headquartered between London and Dubai. The company builds sovereign AI operating systems for critical infrastructure — live operational models that help operators across aviation and airports, ports and logistics, energy and grids, construction, and manufacturing predict issues, automate and optimize decisions, and improve operational efficiency, while retaining full local ownership and governance of their AI systems. Focused primarily on the GCC and wider MENA region, 1001 raised a $9 million seed round in October 2025 led by CIV, General Catalyst, and Lux Capital, followed by a $30 million Series A in June 2026 led by Lux Capital with Sanabil Investments, 9Yards, and Hanabi joining and existing backers General Catalyst, CIV, and Stanford AI researcher Chris Ré increasing their commitments. As of this profile, 1001 publishes no public API, developer documentation, or SDK; this entry captures the company's public identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Acadia
providers.description: Acadia, founded in 2009 as AcadiaSoft, provides risk, margin and collateral management services to the global uncleared OTC derivatives market and now operates as part of LSEG Post Trade following LSEG's December 2022 acquisition. Its AcadiaPlus platform — Agreement Manager, Margin Manager, Collateral Manager, IM Exposure Manager, Payments Manager, Settlement Manager and Relay, alongside the Risk Suite analytics services — connects more than 2,000 market participants for initial-margin calculation, margin-call messaging, reconciliation, dispute resolution and settlement. Acadia's own factsheets state its applications are reachable by web user interface, direct API and SFTP, but that interface is delivered under customer contract: the product documentation portal is authenticated and no public specification is published. The company's one public machine-readable artifact is simm-lib, an MIT-licensed Java implementation of the ISDA SIMM initial-margin model.

providers.name: Access Vascular
providers.description: Access Vascular, Inc. is a Billerica, Massachusetts medical device manufacturer that designs and builds vascular access catheters from a proprietary hydrophilic biomaterial engineered to retain water and mimic the chemistry of the body, with the goal of reducing thrombosis, infection and phlebitis in intravenous therapy. Its FDA-cleared products include HydroPICC, a peripherally inserted central catheter cleared in 2018 and later extended to a dual-lumen configuration, and HydroMID, a midline catheter cleared in 2021, both carrying an anti-thrombogenic indication. The company is a device manufacturer rather than a software or platform business, and publishes no developer program, public API, or machine-readable API contract on any host it operates.

providers.name: Aclima
providers.description: Aclima is a San Francisco-based environmental intelligence company that maps and analyzes air pollution and greenhouse gas emissions at hyperlocal, block-by-block resolution. Using a network of roving (vehicle-mounted) and stationary sensors, Aclima measures multiple pollutants and climate gases simultaneously at up to 100,000x greater resolution than traditional monitoring, then translates billions of scientific measurements into environmental intelligence for governments, companies, and communities. Its professional analytics software, Aclima Pro, delivers visualization and automated analytics for emissions reduction and public-health programs, while its free air.health app maps address-level air and climate insights for the communities Aclima serves. Co-founded by CEO Davida Herzl, Aclima is backed by DCVC and is added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Aerospacelab
providers.description: Aerospacelab is a vertically integrated satellite manufacturer headquartered in Mont-Saint-Guibert, Belgium, founded in 2018 by Benoit Deper. The company designs, builds, tests and operates small-to-medium satellites — its Versatile Satellite Platform (VSP-50, VSP-150, VSP-300) family plus mission-specific payloads spanning very-high-resolution and multispectral/hyperspectral Earth observation, synthetic aperture radar, radio-frequency sensing, and narrowband/broadband telecommunications — for commercial, institutional and government customers, with an explicitly ITAR-free European supply chain. It is roughly 90% vertically integrated across platforms, payloads, avionics and subsystems, has flown eight satellites in under three years, acquired Belgian space-optics firm AMOS, and is building a European satellite megafactory targeting 500 satellites per year. Aerospacelab publishes no public developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract; its programmatic surfaces (mission control, tasking, image-processing pipeline and data platform built under the ESA InCubed MultiSpectral Companion Mission) are delivered to contracted mission customers rather than to self-serve developers.

providers.name: Agile Loop
providers.description: Agile Loop L.L.C. is a London-founded enterprise AI company (founded 2023, backed by 500 Global) building Large Action Models — action-first foundation models trained on thousands of software interfaces so AI agents can operate any user interface and execute multi-step workflows end-to-end from natural-language instructions. Its product suite spans Sector Fusion (telecom network analytics), an Intelligent Evaluation Platform (AI scoring and fraud detection), LLM Ops (governance for LLM applications), an Aviation Ops Suite, and SAM-X (natural-language Excel automation), alongside the open-source Synapse Copilot toolkit for connecting LLMs to APIs and an embeddable Copilot widget for SaaS products. Agile Loop publishes no public OpenAPI, developer portal, or versioned client SDKs at the time of this profile.

providers.name: Akulaku
providers.description: Akulaku is a Southeast Asian fintech and e-commerce platform serving Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam, and Malaysia, combining an online shopping marketplace with buy-now-pay-later (PayLater / Akucicil) installment credit and digital banking services. For merchants and partners it runs the Akulaku Open Platform (developer.akulaku.com), a vendor/seller integration surface exposing e-commerce and fulfillment APIs such as Add Item, Get Order Detail, and Init, alongside a Competence Center API set, a developer Console, and testing accounts to accelerate integration.

providers.name: Amartha
providers.description: Amartha (PT Amartha Mikro Fintek, operating as Amartha Financial Group) is an Indonesian technology company founded in 2010 that builds digital financial infrastructure for the grassroots economy, connecting micro-entrepreneurs — predominantly women running micro and small businesses in rural villages — with affordable working capital from retail and institutional funders. Its consumer and agent brands include Amartha Prosper (investment), Celengan (savings), Modal (group loans), AmarthaLink (agent network) and the AmarthaFin mobile app for payments and bill purchase, alongside two business lines — Institutional Investments and Embedded Lending — that let banks, non-bank financial institutions, insurers and technology partners channel loans to Amartha borrowers. The company is headquartered at Amartha Village in South Jakarta, and runs its social impact programs through Amartha.org.

providers.name: American Axle and Manufacturing
providers.description: American Axle & Manufacturing (AAM), now operating as Dauch Corporation following the February 2026 acquisition of Dowlais Group (GKN Automotive and GKN Powder Metallurgy), is a global Tier 1 automotive supplier designing, engineering, and manufacturing driveline and metal forming technologies for electric, hybrid, and internal combustion vehicles. AAM operates an iSupplier Portal for supplier communication, EDI integration for forecasts and releases, and the Demand AAM aftermarket parts portal.

providers.name: Animocabrandscorporation
providers.description: Animocabrandscorporation, also known as Animoca Brands, is a Hong Kong‑based digital assets leader building, investing, and accelerating impactful technologies and ecosystems across gaming, NFTs, blockchain, AI, and venture capital. The company operates a portfolio of over 600 projects, offers stablecoin and real‑world asset solutions, and provides digital‑asset services for institutions and consumers. It drives future economies through tokenization, metaverse experiences, and innovative web3 infrastructure.

providers.name: Antora Energy
providers.description: Antora Energy is a San Jose, California clean-energy hardware company founded by Justin Briggs, Andrew Ponec and David Bierman that designs, manufactures and deploys factory-built thermal batteries for heavy industry, data centers and the grid. Antora's system resistively heats blocks of solid carbon to temperatures up to 2,400C when electricity is cheapest, stores that energy for multiple days in a compact modular unit, and discharges it around the clock as radiant heat delivered directly to industrial processes or paired with off-the-shelf steam turbine equipment for firm power; the company also develops thermophotovoltaic (TPV) heat-to-power cells at what it describes as the world's largest TPV manufacturing line. Its HeatCore product delivers heat up to 375C at 300 kW-thermal per module, and its power block is rated at 50 MW-electric. Antora's first giga-scale deployment, Project Big Stone, is a 5 GWh system of more than 200 thermal batteries at POET's bioprocessing plant in Big Stone City, South Dakota, built from empty lot to energy delivery in under twelve months. The company closed a $550 million Series C in 2026. Antora sells energy hardware and long-term energy offtake rather than software: it publishes no developer program, no public API, no SDK and no machine-readable API contract, and its only public software surface is Insight, an authenticated steam and power optimization dashboard for named project stakeholders.

providers.name: Arocell2a9d
providers.description: Arocell2a9d, operating under the brand AROCELLUS, is a Korean‑origin beauty and lifestyle e‑commerce company offering premium skincare, cosmetics, jewelry and fashion items. The Shopify‑powered site showcases a range of products such as serums, cleansers, masks, and accessories, emphasizing advanced bio‑formulations and natural ingredients. It provides free shipping in the U.S. over $75 and maintains policies for refunds, privacy, and terms of service.

providers.name: Arq
providers.description: Arq (formerly DolarApp) is a Latin American cross-border fintech app that gives travelers, investors, and professionals digital dollar and digital euro accounts at real market rates without hidden fees. Founded in 2021, the mobile-first platform offers currency conversion, a borderless payment card, global accounts to send and receive international payments, bill payment, PIX transfers, stock and ETF investing, and high-yield Trade and Save accounts, plus ARQ Premium and Prestige tiers. Arq raised $70M from Sequoia Capital and Founders Fund and serves over 2 million users across the Americas. Arq is a consumer mobile product and does not publish a public API or developer portal; this profile captures its verified public identity and web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Asimily
providers.description: Asimily provides a proactive cyber asset defense platform that offers IoT device visibility, risk modeling, segmentation, and automated remediation. It serves industries such as healthcare, energy, financial services, and manufacturing, helping organizations continuously monitor, prioritize, and mitigate cyber risks across IT, OT, and IoT environments.

providers.name: Asleep
providers.description: Asleep is a company identified in the API Evangelist harvest backlog. It appears to be a consumer sleep‑related brand offering products such as eyemasks and pillows via an e‑commerce site. No public API documentation or developer portal could be located despite searching the company’s website and related domains. The profile therefore reflects a lack of discoverable API resources.

providers.name: Atlantic Money
providers.description: Atlantic Money is a London-based fintech, founded in 2020 by Robinhood alumni and backed by Index Ventures, offering international money transfers at a flat GBP 3 fee with the live mid-market exchange rate and no FX markup. The service supports transfers across ten currencies with direct bank deposits and standard or express delivery, for both consumers and businesses, and is authorized and regulated by the UK FCA as a payment institution. Atlantic Money is a consumer- and business-facing mobile and web application; it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface, so this network profile is limited to company identity, website property links, and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Atomic-6
providers.description: Atomic-6 designs and manufactures advanced composite aerospace components, offering products such as Light Wing solar arrays, Space Armor protective tiles, and Light Sheet panels. The company provides high‑performance, ITAR‑registered solutions for satellite, spacecraft, and defense applications, emphasizing CMMC 2.0 compliance and AS9100 certification. Customers can request custom quotes, view detailed datasheets, and purchase through the online store. Atomic-6 aims to enable reliable, lightweight structures for space and terrestrial missions.

providers.name: Authy
providers.description: Authy is a two-factor authentication (2FA) product originally built by Authy Inc. and acquired by Twilio in 2015. It provided a consumer authenticator app (TOTP soft tokens, encrypted cloud backup, and multi-device sync) alongside a developer-facing Authy API for one-time passwords over SMS and voice, soft tokens, and push authentication. Twilio has since folded the Authy developer API into the Twilio Verify API, deprecated and archived the first-party Authy client SDKs, and discontinued the Authy desktop applications in 2024. The consumer Authy mobile app remains available. New integrations are directed to Twilio Verify. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and is enriched here from Authy's remaining public surface (marketing site, archived GitHub organization, and deprecated SDK registries).

providers.name: Beatport
providers.description: Beatport is the leading online music store and streaming platform for electronic dance music DJs and producers, founded in 2004 and headquartered in Denver, Colorado. Beatport sells high-quality downloads (lossless WAV, AIFF, and FLAC, plus AAC) of tracks, releases, and DJ tools across more than 150 electronic genres, and operates a subscription streaming tier — Beatport Streaming — that delivers catalog tracks directly into supported DJ applications and hardware including Pioneer DJ rekordbox, Serato DJ Pro, Denon DJ Engine DJ, Algoriddim djay, Virtual DJ, Traktor, and others through integration partners. The Beatport Group also operates Beatsource (open- format DJ streaming and download store), DJCity (open-format record pool), Beatport LINK and Beatsource LINK (in-app streaming for DJ software), BeatportAmp (distribution and rights management for labels, formerly Ampsuite), Plugin Boutique (audio software and plugin marketplace), Loopcloud (sample subscription for producers), Label Radar (demo submission), Beatport Live (live events and streaming), Beatportal (editorial and media), and the International Music Summit (IMS) industry conference. The company reports ten million registered users, eighty thousand labels, four hundred thousand artists, and four hundred million USD paid out to rights holders since launch. Beatport operates a v4 REST API at api.beatport.com governed by OAuth 2.0 (authorization-code grant) with an interactive Swagger-UI developer portal at /v4/docs/; access is gated to approved partners through the Beatport Partner Portal, and there is no public client-credentials tier for general developers. The API exposes the Beatport catalog (tracks, releases, artists, labels, genres, sub-genres, charts, playlists, my-beatport collections, holds, and DJ-oriented search filters such as BPM, key, and released-date) and is the same surface that powers the public beatport.com applications and third-party DJ-software integrations. Beatport does not publish a downloadable OpenAPI document, an official SDK, or a CLI; partner integration is brokered case-by-case through the Partner Portal and the business-development team.

providers.name: Belong.Life
providers.description: Belong.Life leverages AI and data to enhance patient engagement and healthcare outcomes, offering solutions for clinics, enterprises, pharma, hospitals, payers, and advertisers. Their platform includes AI-driven cancer mentoring, weight management, and health assistants, alongside clinical trial support and research tools, aiming to personalize care and improve decision-making across the health ecosystem.

providers.name: Bonus Homes
providers.description: Bonus Homes offers a Home Appreciation Partnership (HAP) that lets homeowners unlock cash equity quickly, often within two weeks, while retaining a share of future home appreciation. By converting homes into rental properties and handling mortgage payments, insurance, and maintenance, Bonus Homes provides a faster, less stressful alternative to traditional home sales, targeting homeowners seeking liquidity and long‑term wealth building.

providers.name: Bosie
providers.description: Bosie Knitwear is a Scottish apparel brand offering handcrafted wool garments, including sweaters, cardigans, and accessories. The company operates an e‑commerce site at bosie.co, shipping internationally and showcasing collections such as Shetland, Chunky Fishermen, and Cashmere. It emphasizes heritage, quality materials, and sustainable production.

providers.name: Boxpower
providers.description: BoxPower designs, deploys, and operates utility‑grade distributed energy infrastructure at the grid edge. It provides turnkey microgrid solutions, including solar‑plus‑storage containers, software platforms, and services for utilities, developers, and communities, enabling rapid, reliable, and clean power delivery where traditional grid expansion is slow or costly.

providers.name: Brainever
providers.description: BrainEver is a biopharmaceutical company developing novel homeoprotein‑based therapies for neurodegenerative diseases such as ALS, Parkinson’s disease, age‑related macular degeneration and glaucoma. The company focuses on translating the homeoprotein concept into clinical pipelines, with multiple candidates in pre‑clinical and early clinical stages, and collaborates with academic and industry partners to advance treatments for patients suffering from these conditions.

providers.name: Brincdrones
providers.description: Brincdrones is a startup that focuses on providing drone-based solutions for various industries, including aerial surveying, inspection, and delivery services. The company aims to leverage advanced drone technology and data analytics to offer efficient, cost-effective, and scalable solutions for clients ranging from construction firms to logistics providers. While detailed public information is limited, Brincdrones appears to be positioned within the emerging market of commercial drone applications, seeking to address industry-specific challenges through innovative aerial platforms and services.

providers.name: ClaimSorted
providers.description: ClaimSorted is a tech-enabled third-party administrator (TPA) for insurance claims, combining human claims-handling expertise with proprietary technology to process claims faster while lowering operating costs and fraud leakage for MGAs and insurance carriers. It offers a white-label electronic Notice of Loss (eNOL) intake system, a policyholder Claims Portal for status tracking and document upload, automated assessment workflows, and fraud-detection algorithms, with reporting delivered daily, weekly, or monthly and as live data feeds over SFTP/API. ClaimSorted supports commercial and personal property, auto, small commercial, general liability, accident & health, travel, and warranty lines of business, serving 30+ clients including Axis and Lloyd's.

providers.name: Cloudimperiumgames
providers.description: Cloud Imperium Games (CIG) is a game development studio founded in 2012 by Chris Roberts, creating ambitious space simulation titles such as Star Citizen and Squadron 42. Based in Austin, Texas with additional studios worldwide, CIG engages a large community of backers and fans, operating with a focus on immersive storytelling, cutting‑edge technology, and ongoing development updates. The company also runs a robust online presence, including a blog, privacy policy, legal information, and support channels for its players and partners.

providers.name: ConcertoCare
providers.description: ConcertoCare is a value-based healthcare provider delivering coordinated, in-home and virtual medical care to Medicare-eligible seniors and adults with complex, chronic, and behavioral health needs. Its interdisciplinary care teams of physicians, nurse practitioners, pharmacists, and social workers deliver house calls, medication management, behavioral and social health support, transportation and nutritional assistance, caregiver support, and advanced care and palliative planning, coordinating with a member's existing doctors and benefit plans. The company operates as a SOC 2 Type II and HITRUST CSF certified organization and is a portfolio company of Obvious Ventures. It has no public API or developer program at this time; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Cube3.ai
providers.description: Cube3.ai provides an agentic AI platform for financial crime prevention, offering real‑time detection and mitigation of fraud, scams, and cyber threats for large institutions such as banks, fintechs, crypto exchanges, and public sector agencies. Leveraging autonomous AI agents, the service monitors transactions, identifies malicious patterns, and blocks threats before loss occurs, delivering a proactive defense against AI‑powered criminal operations.

providers.name: Curated
providers.description: Curated is a consumer and lifestyle company tracked on Forge Global. It has raised $265.3M across Series A to C rounds, with notable investors like CapitalG, Forerunner, and Greylock Partners. The platform provides stock price history, funding details, and valuation data, though current price data is no longer available.

providers.name: Curebase
providers.description: Curebase is a San Francisco-based clinical trials technology company (founded 2017) that provides a modern, AI-native eClinical platform for sponsors, CROs, biotechs, MedTech companies, and research sites. The platform unifies the full trial lifecycle in one system: ePRO/eCOA (electronic patient-reported and clinical outcome assessments), eConsent (digital informed consent), EDC (electronic data capture), patient recruitment and screening, participant engagement and retention tooling, and site management. Curebase also ships Sitebase, a free eClinical suite for research sites, and Hope, a conversational AI voice agent. It supports decentralized and hybrid trial models natively. Curebase is a private, venture-backed company (Series B led by Industry Ventures; investors include GGV Capital, Acrew, Gilead, and others). It is SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant. Curebase does not publish a public developer API or API documentation; integration is handled through enterprise engagements.

providers.name: Cylib
providers.description: Cylib is a German battery recycling company founded in 2022 as a spinoff from RWTH Aachen University, headquartered in Aachen, Germany. It transforms end-of-life lithium-ion batteries, production scrap, and black mass back into critical raw materials, recovering lithium, graphite, nickel, cobalt, and manganese through a proprietary, largely water-based hydrometallurgical process that the company reports achieves over 90% recycling efficiency with an ~80% reduced carbon footprint versus primary extraction, powered by 100% renewable electricity. The company is backed by Speedinvest and other investors. Cylib operates as an industrial cleantech / circular-economy materials business and does not currently publish a developer program, public API, developer portal, SDKs, or other software integration surface; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and carries only identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Dexory
providers.description: Dexory is a UK-based warehouse intelligence and robotics company whose DexoryView platform pairs fleets of autonomous mobile scanning robots with physical AI to deliver real-time "ground truth" visibility across warehouses and distribution centers. The robots autonomously scan more than 10,000 pallet locations per hour and up to 18 meters of racking height, building a live digital twin that feeds AI-driven analytics for inventory accuracy, space and slotting optimization, damage/compliance detection, and operational performance. DexoryView is organized into modules (Integrity for stock accuracy and automated cycle counts, Optimise for space and productivity analytics, and Adapt for real-time operational response) and connects into existing warehouse and ERP systems such as SAP EWM, Manhattan, Blue Yonder, and Körber through pre-built connectors. Dexory serves 3PL logistics, manufacturing, food & beverage, retail, pharma, and air cargo operators. Added to the API Evangelist network from Atomico's portfolio and enriched via the pipeline; Dexory does not currently publish a public developer portal or OpenAPI.

providers.name: Dinii
providers.description: Dinii (株式会社ダイニー) is a Tokyo-based restaurant-technology SaaS company, founded in June 2018, offering an "All in One Restaurant Cloud" for food-service businesses. Its integrated modules span POS register, customer mobile ordering, mobile self-checkout payment, customer management/CRM (with LINE integration), staff attendance and scheduling, reservation ledger, and management analytics dashboards (daily P&L, labor-cost optimization, QSC monitoring). Dinii reports 3,000+ installed locations and 20 million+ end users, with offices in Tokyo, Osaka, Sapporo, and Nagoya. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Dinii publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs at this time; this profile captures its identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Direct Line Group
providers.description: Direct Line Group is a United Kingdom personal-lines and small-commercial general insurance carrier, founded in 1985 as the UK's first telephone-only motor insurer and listed on the London Stock Exchange from its 2012 IPO until Aviva plc completed its GBP 3.7 billion acquisition of the group on 1 July 2025. The group underwrites motor, home, pet, travel, landlord, breakdown and small-business insurance through the Direct Line, Churchill, Privilege, Darwin, By Miles, Direct Line for Business and Green Flag brands, and is regulated in its home market by the Financial Conduct Authority and the Prudential Regulation Authority. Its distribution is direct-to-consumer via telephone and web plus price-comparison-website placement (notably through the Darwin brand), rather than through broker or agency channels; it sold its brokered commercial business (NIG and FarmWeb) to RSA in September 2023, closing the one channel that would have carried standards-based broker integration. Its API posture is accordingly closed and partner-gated: as of 25 July 2026 the corporate domain directlinegroup.co.uk returns HTTP 301 to aviva.com, there is no developer.*, developers.* or docs.* host in DNS, every consumer brand site returns 404 on /developers, /api and /partners, and the only API host that exists — api.directlinegroup.co.uk, resolving to a MuleSoft Anypoint production load balancer — serves HTTP 403 behind an expired TLS certificate and requests a client certificate during the TLS handshake. There is no public self-serve developer portal, no downloadable OpenAPI, no GraphQL, no published webhook or event catalog, no public Postman workspace, and no ACORD reference anywhere in the group's public material. Quote, bind, issue and FNOL are all consumer web and telephone journeys only.

providers.name: DiscGenics
providers.description: DiscGenics is a privately held, late-stage clinical biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, developing allogeneic, cell-based regenerative biologic therapies for degenerative diseases of the spine. Its lead candidate, IDCT (rebonuputemcel), is a single-injection allogeneic discogenic progenitor cell therapy for symptomatic mild-to-moderate lumbar degenerative disc disease, manufactured under cGMP from donated adult human intervertebral disc tissue and granted FDA Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) and Fast Track designations. The company is running a US Phase III program (the PIVOT and CONFIRM studies) alongside a clinical study in Japan. DiscGenics is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, API, SDK or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: East Meet East
providers.description: East Meet East (now branded EME Hive) is a dating platform built specifically for Asian and Asian American singles across North America, founded by serial entrepreneur Mariko Tokioka. The service matches members using culture-aware criteria and is offered as consumer web and mobile apps. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer dating product it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface; this profile captures its identity and public web properties (about, mission, blog, help center, terms, and privacy pages).

providers.name: EndoQuest Robotics
providers.description: EndoQuest Robotics is a Houston, Texas medical device company — founded in 2017 and operating as ColubrisMX until its June 2022 rebrand — developing what it calls the world's first flexible endoluminal robotic surgical system. Its Endoluminal Surgical (ELS) System pairs an ergonomic physician console (high-definition monitor, hand controllers, foot pedals) with a mobile patient cart and positioning arm, driving two 6mm flexible robotic instruments and a 3.7mm high-definition robotic camera through the EndoDrive, with up to seven degrees of freedom and additional channels for insufflation, suction, irrigation and third-party accessories. The design targets scar-free minimally invasive procedures inside the gastrointestinal tract — including appendectomy and cholecystectomy — performed through natural orifices or a single transumbilical incision. The company was accepted into the FDA's Safer Technologies Program in December 2023, received an investigational device exemption in December 2024, and began first colorectal cases in its PARADIGM pivotal multicenter study in May 2025. The system is not FDA-cleared and is not for commercial sale. EndoQuest sells surgical robotics hardware, not software: it publishes no API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable contract of any kind, and its nine-page marketing site carries no developer surface.

providers.name: Fibmold
providers.description: Fibmold is an eco-friendly molded-fiber packaging manufacturer building sustainable, plastic-free alternatives to rigid single-use plastic packaging. Its products are thermoformed from natural fibres such as bagasse, bamboo, and hard/soft wood pulp collected from farms, forests, and agro-processing units, then upcycled into compostable and recyclable packaging. Applications span food-service packaging, customised industrial solutions, fibre-based dosing scoops, aviation casseroles, cosmetic inserts, pharma injectable trays, chocolate trays, and noodle cups. Fibmold also runs the Primo by Fibmold retail storefront and builds manufacturing eco-systems and material-science innovation to scale sustainable packaging on the supply side. Backed by Accel.

providers.name: Finova Capital
providers.description: Finova Capital is a non-banking financial company (NBFC) licensed by the Reserve Bank of India, founded in 2015 by Mohit Sahney and Sunita Sahney and headquartered in Jaipur, Rajasthan. It provides secured lending to micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) and self-employed customers across India, including MSME business loans, home loans, working capital and machinery loans, and personal loans, all secured against immovable property. Operating across 17 states through 450+ branches, Finova Capital is backed by investors including Peak XV Partners, Norwest Venture Partners, Faering Capital, Maj Invest, Sofina Ventures, Avataar Ventures and Madison India Capital. The company holds a Certificate of Registration issued by the RBI under Section 45-IA of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934. This is a financial-services provider with a public marketing and investor-relations website; it does not currently expose a public developer API surface.

providers.name: First Circle
providers.description: First Circle is a Philippine fintech offering digital business banking and non-collateral financing to small and medium enterprises. Its products include free online business bank accounts, business credit lines up to PHP 20M, same/next-day express business loans, longer-term Business Credit Plus, future salary access for employees, and solar financing. The company is 100% online with five-minute account opening and no branch visits, serves over 5,000 Filipino businesses, and has disbursed roughly PHP 16 billion in loans. It is licensed by the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), with banking delivered through partner rural banks regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP). It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. No public developer API surface is currently published.

providers.name: Flick
providers.description: Flick is an AI filmmaking studio that lets creators direct short films with AI on an infinite, node-based canvas. Rather than a linear prompt-to-clip generator, Flick gives directors a nonlinear workspace to plan, iterate and assemble complete narratives of any length — generating scenes, keeping character faces and styles consistent across shots, controlling shot composition, and editing images by reference. The product is a web app with a free tier (300 credits) and paid plans from $5/month, plus a Creative Partner Program and a Filmmaker Residency for AI filmmakers. Flick was founded by Ray Wang (previously a founding engineer on the Instagram AI team) and award-winning filmmaker Zoey Zhang, and is Y Combinator- and GV-backed. Flick publishes product documentation, a blog and a verbatim llms.txt, but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDKs, webhooks or an MCP server — the /api/ surface is an internal application API that robots.txt explicitly disallows.

providers.name: Forwardlane
providers.description: ForwardLane Technologies builds Signal Studio, a decision intelligence platform that transforms enterprise data into auditable actions rather than dashboards. Users ask questions in natural language and receive Next Best Actions with complete audit trails in seconds, powered by a semantic data layer, multi-agent AI orchestration, a no-code signal builder, and in-database processing so data never leaves the customer environment. Validated across eight years of Fortune 500 production, Signal Studio serves financial services, private credit and private equity, real estate, energy and oil and gas, and government, with BYOK support for any LLM, cloud, or inference provider. Led by CEO Nathan Stevenson. ForwardLane exposes no public developer API surface; this profile captures the company's public identity and security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: GEICO
providers.description: The second-largest private passenger auto insurance company in the United States and a subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway. Known for its direct-to-consumer model, competitive rates, and iconic advertising campaigns. GEICO serves customers through its website, GEICO Mobile app, and call centers rather than through a public API.

providers.name: Go Rise
providers.description: Rise (gorise.co) is a Dubai-based fintech platform that gives migrant workers control over their finances across both their home and host countries. Through a mobile app for iOS and Android, Rise offers bank accounts, insurance, savings and investment options, "Pay Later" installment services, and remittance and money-transfer capabilities. The company partners with regulated financial institutions including United Arab Bank and insurance providers such as AXA Gulf, and is headquartered in DMCC, Jumeirah Lakes Towers, Dubai, UAE. Rise is a portfolio company of 500 Global and has raised funding led by MEVP. This is a consumer financial-services product with no public developer/API surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: HealthEquity
providers.description: HealthEquity is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The HealthEquity API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Hourglass
providers.description: Hourglass is a DeFi protocol and time-bound token (TBT) infrastructure that invented a primitive for tokenizing staked, locked, or time-committed on-chain assets, letting holders trade their place in a lock-up queue for early liquidity. Its products include an RFQ marketplace built on OpenSea's Seaport for trading time-bound tokens, non-custodial on-chain vaults (including the Pre-iUSDT stable vault and the sunset Hourglass Boost product), and institutional-grade yield infrastructure that bridges on-chain DeFi capital with traditional capital markets. TBTs are semi-fungible ERC-1155 tokens issued by Hourglass custodian smart contracts on Ethereum. Launch partners included Lido, Frax, and Convex. Founded in 2022 and backed by a $4.2M seed round led by Electric Capital, with Coinbase Ventures, Circle Ventures, and others participating.

providers.name: Hugo
providers.description: Hugo is a mobile-first, usage-based car insurance company that lets drivers turn coverage on and off from their phone and pay in short intervals rather than a large upfront down payment. Through the Hugo app and web portal, customers can activate liability or comprehensive coverage in minutes, get instant proof of insurance, auto-reload their balance, and extend protection as needed. Hugo positions itself as a modern, micropayment alternative to traditional insurers for budget-conscious and gig-economy drivers, and is a seed-stage InsurTech company backed by Canaan Partners. Hugo operates in select U.S. states with expansion underway. Hugo is a consumer insurance application and does not currently publish a public API or developer program.

providers.name: Iconbuild
providers.description: ICON Technology, Inc. (iconbuild.com) is an Austin, Texas construction technologies company using large-scale robotics, advanced materials, and software to build homes and structures. ICON develops the Vulcan and Phoenix 3D-printing robots, proprietary Lavacrete and CarbonX building materials, and design/build tooling (including its CODEX architectural catalog and ICON Prime), and has printed communities across the US as well as researched off-world construction with NASA (Project Olympus). Backed by Norwest Venture Partners. This is a physical construction / building-technology company; as of this pass it publishes no public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI, or /.well-known discovery surface, so no API artifacts were harvested.

providers.name: Jingle Pay
providers.description: Jingle Pay is a DFSA-regulated (Dubai Financial Services Authority) digital financial services fintech headquartered in the UAE, offering an all-in-one mobile money account for cross-border remittances, peer-to-peer payments, real-time multi-currency exchange, and Mastercard-powered card payments. Founded and led by CEO Amir Fardghassemi, the company serves the UAE, Pakistan, Bahrain, and Canada, and reports having processed over $3.5 billion across 8M+ transactions to 150 countries for 1.5M+ unique senders. It is backed by strategic partners and investors including Bank Alfalah, MoneyGram, Mastercard, and 500 Global. Jingle Pay operates as a consumer mobile app (iOS and Android) and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Leadstate
providers.description: Leadstate Incorporated is a New York City based real estate and design technology company, founded in 2021 and backed by 500 Global, that builds AI and AR tooling for how spaces are planned, developed, designed, and marketed. Its consumer-facing products are ReelProp, which turns static property photography and interior design sketches into marketing video reels, and RealMe In, which generates and manipulates 3D assets. The published product surface covers Photo-to-Video and Sketch-to-Video generation, CADgpt text-to-3D model generation, Image-to-3D asset conversion, and FloorPlan-to-3D visualization. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI definition, SDK, or machine-readable developer surface of any kind, so this profile records verified company identity and web properties only.

providers.name: LegalZoom
providers.description: LegalZoom.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: LZ) is a Glendale, California online legal technology and services company that helps individuals and small businesses create legal documents and form, run, and grow their businesses without necessarily hiring an attorney. Founded in 1999, LegalZoom offers business formation services (LLC, S-Corp, C-Corp, nonprofit, DBA), registered agent service, EIN/tax ID filing, annual report and compliance filings, business licenses, virtual mail, business banking partnerships, trademark registration, and ongoing bookkeeping and tax services through LZ Books and LZ Tax. On the personal side it provides wills, living trusts, power of attorney, prenuptial agreements, and a partner-driven divorce flow via Divorce.com. Customers access an attorney-network legal advice subscription (LZ Legal Services / business advisory plans) connecting them to independent attorneys for consultations and document review. LegalZoom went public on Nasdaq in 2021 (ticker LZ) and serves customers primarily in the United States. The company's revenue model is transactional document and formation fees plus recurring subscription services (registered agent, compliance, attorney advice, bookkeeping). LegalZoom does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal; partner integrations (e.g. divorce.com, banking partners, accounting partners) appear to be private commercial arrangements rather than self-service developer APIs. The legalzoom.com web app calls a set of internal hosts under apigw.legalzoom.com (checkout-graphql-public-api, customer, experimentation, revv, attorney-state-service, site-search) but these are first-party and not documented for third-party use.

providers.name: Local
providers.description: Local (uselocal.co) is a Gulf Cooperation Council fintech and hospitality-technology company that replaces traditional card terminals with a single QR code guests scan to pay, order, and earn loyalty points instantly. Its pay-at-table, checkout, and remote payment-link flows serve 200+ restaurants, hotels, and hospitals across Bahrain, the UAE, and Saudi Arabia, capturing customer profiles from each transaction and feeding real-time revenue, table-turn, and staff-performance analytics back to venues. Local integrates with regional payment methods (BenefitPay, Apple Pay, Google Pay, all major cards) and POS platforms including Odoo, Oracle, Lightspeed, Square, and Invo. Local Holdings Limited was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Los Angeles Department of Water and Power
providers.description: The Los Angeles Department of Water and Power (LADWP) is the largest municipal utility in the United States, a department of the City of Los Angeles providing water and electric service. It publishes no public developer API; operational datasets attributed to LADWP are published on the City of Los Angeles open data portal (Socrata).

providers.name: MarketAxess
providers.description: MarketAxess provides a leading electronic trading platform for corporate bond markets, offering deep liquidity, pre‑trade data, AI‑powered insights, and real‑time market depth analysis. Clients can access pricing, trade execution, and post‑trade services across investment‑grade, high‑yield, and emerging‑market bonds, supported by advanced analytics and a modern X‑Pro workflow.

providers.name: Mast Reforestation
providers.description: Mast Reforestation (formerly DroneSeed) is North America's leading post-fire reforestation and carbon-removal company, restoring wildfire-damaged forests across the American West. It operates two nurseries, Cal Forest Nurseries and Silvaseed, manages the largest seed bank in the western United States, grows more than 30 million seedlings annually, and develops carbon-removal credits by burying post-wildfire biomass to finance reforestation for landowners and consulting foresters. Mast publishes no public developer program or API surface.

providers.name: Mercantile
providers.description: Mercantile is a branded business credit card platform operated by Onboard Partners LLC (Boston, MA) that helps fintechs, consumer brands, and trade associations launch and run custom affinity credit card programs. It delivers a turnkey card-as-a-service stack — card issuing (cards issued by Hatch Bank on the Mastercard network), tailored underwriting and flexible funding, a ready-made regulatory/compliance/banking framework, real-time fraud monitoring, rewards, cardholder support, and full-service marketing — plus a partner API that lets brands integrate card features into their own systems to automate and scale their program.

providers.name: Moneyfellows
providers.description: Money Fellows is an Egyptian fintech, founded in 2018 and regulated by the Central Bank of Egypt, that digitizes the traditional rotating savings and credit association (ROSCA / "gam'eya") model as a mobile app. Members join Money Circles to save together and access interest-free funds on flexible 6, 10, or 12-month plans of up to 1.2M EGP, and can spend and save through a prepaid Money Fellows Mastercard. The service is Sharia-compliant (Official Fatwa No. 46205 from the Egyptian Dar Al Iftaa) and has served millions of users while raising roughly $60M across its funding rounds, including a 2025 Series B first close backed by investors such as Partech. Money Fellows is a consumer mobile application and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or programmatic integration surface.

providers.name: Monolith Materials
providers.description: Monolith (legally Monolith Inc., formerly Monolith Materials) is an American chemicals and advanced-materials manufacturer headquartered in Lincoln, Nebraska and founded in 2012. It is the first company to run methane pyrolysis at commercial scale, using an electrified thermal-plasma process to split natural gas or renewable biogas into solid carbon and clean hydrogen with no direct CO2 combustion. The solid carbon is finished into carbon black for tire, rubber, plastics, battery and electronics manufacturing, and the co-produced hydrogen is used on-site or converted into anhydrous ammonia. Monolith operates a demonstration plant in Redwood City, California and its commercial Olive Creek facility in Hallam, Nebraska, which since 2023 has supplied made-in-Nebraska carbon black to Goodyear. Monolith is a physical materials producer and sells industrial product, not software: it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Neo Financial
providers.description: Neo Financial is a Calgary- and Winnipeg-based Canadian fintech (neobank) founded in 2019 by the founders of SkipTheDishes, offering credit cards, savings, money, investing, and mortgage products to consumers. Neo is not a chartered bank and holds no Canadian banking licence; it delivers CDIC-eligible deposits and card issuance through regulated partner institutions — Peoples Bank of Canada for everyday accounts, ATB Financial as Mastercard credit-card issuer, and formerly Concentra Bank (now part of Equitable Bank) for savings. Neo operates a consumer mobile and web platform only and publishes no first-party public developer API or developer portal; third-party access to Neo accounts today is available solely through data aggregators such as Flinks (a National Bank-owned Canadian aggregator) and Plaid via credential/screen-scraping access, not a documented first-party API. Canada's federal Consumer-Driven Banking (open banking) framework, legislated in Budget 2024 and overseen by the Financial Consumer Agency of Canada, is not yet operational, so no first-party FDX or CDB data API exists. Neo maintains a public GitHub organization of internal engineering tooling and an engineering blog, but ships no public API products.

providers.name: NICKL
providers.description: NICKL (Nicklpass) is a subscription management platform that bills itself as "the operating system for subscriptions." It helps organizations govern the digital tools, SaaS subscriptions, and data services their teams use by connecting identity, usage, and procurement data in one place. Capabilities include role-based governance and provisioning, usage intelligence to surface adoption and redundant spend, and coordinated procurement that aggregates demand to negotiate from real usage data. The platform integrates with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and Plaid, and applies AI models for insights and pricing optimization. NICKL participated in the Comcast NBCUniversal LIFT Labs Accelerator powered by Techstars. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing site and hosted control panel but no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDK, or other machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Normative
providers.description: Normative is a Stockholm, Sweden-based carbon accounting and ESG reporting software company helping enterprises measure, report, and reduce their greenhouse gas emissions across scopes 1, 2, and 3. Its platform combines a library of more than 349,000 region- and sector-specific emission factors with workflows for product carbon footprint (PCF), supply chain engagement, Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) target setting, Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD) disclosure, and Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) reporting. Calculations are built to the GHG Protocol and independently verified by TÜV SÜD against ISO/IEC 25051. Customers include Vodafone, Hertz, Hitachi Rail, and Flying Tiger Copenhagen, and every account is paired with a named, GHG Protocol-certified Climate Strategy Advisor rather than a traditional support helpdesk. The company's revenue model is enterprise SaaS subscriptions plus advisory services; Normative does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or open-source release, and its GitHub organization (normative-io) currently exposes no public repositories.

providers.name: Numerade
providers.description: Numerade is an education technology company that helps students learn STEM subjects through short, expert-created video solutions, step-by-step textbook explanations, and an AI study tutor branded as Ace. Ace responds to typed questions, uploaded notes, quizzes, and worksheets, and can summarize material to help students prepare for exams. The platform spans math, science, and other STEM courses with a large library of instructor-led problem walkthroughs and practice questions. Numerade is a venture-backed consumer learning product and does not currently expose a public developer API, developer portal, or SDK. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of General Catalyst and enriched by probing the public site (2026-07-20).

providers.name: Obsidian Therapeutics
providers.description: Obsidian Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing engineered cell and gene therapies built on its proprietary cytoDRiVE platform, which uses drug-responsive domains to regulate therapeutic protein function with an FDA-approved small molecule. Its lead program, OBX-115, is in Phase 2 trials for advanced melanoma. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a life-sciences company with no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Old National Bank
providers.description: Old National Bank is a nationally chartered, FDIC-insured regional commercial bank and the primary subsidiary of Old National Bancorp (NASDAQ: ONB), headquartered in Evansville, Indiana and Chicago, Illinois. With roughly $73 billion in assets and nearly 200 retail branches across Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Michigan, Minnesota, Tennessee, and Wisconsin, it is one of the largest commercial banks headquartered in the U.S. Midwest, offering consumer, small business, commercial, treasury management, and wealth banking. Old National does not operate a first-party public developer portal or publish any downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger specifications; probes of developer., api., and apis.oldnational.com do not resolve and /developers returns HTTP 404. Consumer-permissioned account and transaction data is instead reached through third-party financial data aggregators (Finicity by Mastercard is documented), which is the honest, aggregator-only open-finance posture typical of U.S. regional banks. No documented first-party FDX-conformant data-access API or published CFPB Section 1033 developer surface was found at review time.

providers.name: Omnifold
providers.description: Omnifold is an AI supply chain planning platform for physical product companies — CPGs, manufacturers, distributors, and retailers. The company trains a custom AI model for each supply chain to forecast demand, optimize inventory, and surface revenue, margin, and cash that traditional planning systems miss, positioning itself in the Forbes "Purpose-Built AI" tier and competing with Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, and o9. Omnifold was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Omnifold publishes marketing and product content but exposes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or authentication surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Onecard
providers.description: OneCard is a mobile-first metal credit card from India's FPL Technologies, a fintech unicorn that reimagines credit and payments with full-stack, in-house technology. OneCard is issued in partnership with banks including Bank of Baroda, CSB Bank, Federal Bank, SBM Bank, South Indian Bank and Indian Bank, and emphasizes simplicity, transparency and giving control back to the user. FPL Technologies also operates OneScore (credit-score monitoring) and Wizely (savings). Backed by QED Investors, OneCard is a consumer-facing product; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: OwnBackup
providers.description: OwnBackup (Own Company) is a SaaS data protection platform providing backup, recovery, and sandbox seeding for Salesforce and other cloud applications.

providers.name: Payall
providers.description: Payall Payment Systems provides purpose-built banking infrastructure that automates cross-border payments for regulated financial institutions. The platform orchestrates the full international money-movement lifecycle across originating banks, correspondent and clearing institutions, central banks, and payment channels, automating sanctions screening, KYC/AML compliance, fraud and risk management, FX, and settlement.
