providers.description: Conbini is a Japanese online retailer offering a wide range of snack foods, confectionery, beverages, and other convenience items. The website conbini.com provides product listings, shopping cart functionality, and account management for customers in Japan. It showcases categories such as candy, chocolates, drinks, and ready‑to‑eat meals, reflecting a typical convenience‑store catalog in an e‑commerce format.

providers.name: Consure Medical
providers.description: Consure Medical is a nurse-centric medical device company with Silicon Valley roots that develops incontinence and critical-care management solutions for hospitals. Its product line includes the QiVi family of truly external male and female urine management catheters, the Qora SMK manual stool management kit, and the Qoramatic automated stool management system, all designed to reduce catheter-associated urinary tract infections (CAUTI), incontinence-associated dermatitis (IAD), and hospital-acquired conditions while improving patient dignity. The company operates from San Diego, California and New Delhi, India, and markets its devices through partners such as Medline. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Consure Medical publishes no public developer API, documentation, or specification surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Corning
providers.description: Corning Incorporated is a Fortune 500 American technology company that specializes in glass science, ceramic science, and optical physics. Founded in 1851, Corning manufactures specialty glass, ceramics, and related materials and technologies for industrial and scientific applications. Corning's businesses include Optical Communications (fiber optic cable and hardware), Display Technologies (LCD and OLED glass substrates), Specialty Materials (Gorilla Glass for mobile devices), Environmental Technologies (ceramic substrates and filters for emissions control), and Life Sciences (laboratory glassware, cell culture, and bioprocess products). Corning does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Cour Pharmaceuticals Development
providers.description: COUR Pharmaceuticals Development Co., Inc. (COUR Pharma) is a privately held, clinical-stage biotechnology company founded in 2012 and headquartered in the Chicago area (Northbrook/Skokie, Illinois), spun out of research at Northwestern University. COUR develops antigen-specific immune tolerance therapies built on its proprietary COUR Nanoparticle (CNP) platform: biodegradable polymer nanoparticles of roughly 500 nm carrying about 1% disease-specific antigen, which mimic apoptotic bodies so that antigen-presenting cells in the liver and spleen re-recognize the antigen as self, deleting pathogenic T cells and expanding regulatory T cells. Active clinical programs include CNP-103 for Type 1 Diabetes and CNP-106 for Myasthenia Gravis, with earlier work in Primary Biliary Cholangitis and Celiac Disease. COUR is a therapeutics developer, not a software or platform company: it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Covera Health
providers.description: Covera Health is a clinical intelligence company that delivers AI-powered quality insights across the healthcare ecosystem, beginning with diagnostic radiology. Its Connected Platform helps providers, health plans, and employers improve diagnostic accuracy and care coordination across high-cost conditions including musculoskeletal disorders, cancer, neurological disease, heart disease, chronic pain, and metabolic disease. Certified as a Patient Safety Organization by AHRQ, Covera focuses on reducing misdiagnosis, unnecessary cost, and patient harm from the point of diagnosis through care delivery, prior authorization, and claims administration. Backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Cowbellcyberinc
providers.description: Cowbell Cyber, Inc. provides AI‑native adaptive cyber and specialty insurance for small and medium‑size enterprises. Leveraging data and artificial intelligence, it offers real‑time risk assessment, automated underwriting, and API‑based quoting to simplify cyber coverage and improve resilience for businesses.

providers.name: Creyon Bio
providers.description: Creyon Bio (branded Creyon) is a San Diego drug-development company operating an AI-powered nucleic acid engineering platform, NucleIQ, that designs oligonucleotide and RNA therapies with tissue- and cell-specific delivery. Creyon uses aptamer-based delivery, lipid nanoparticles, and transferrin-receptor aptamers to cross the blood-brain barrier, targeting immunology, central nervous system (CNS), and neuromuscular indications including late-onset Pompe disease. The company is a venture-backed portfolio company of DCVC and currently advances three wholly-owned programs. This profile is a company/identity record in the API Evangelist network; Creyon publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Crystalys
providers.description: Crystalys Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing novel treatments for gout. Based in San Diego, CA, the company aims to address significant unmet medical needs through innovative drug development, advancing clinical trials, and securing substantial financing to bring therapies to patients worldwide. Their mission emphasizes improving lives of those suffering from gout and related inflammatory conditions.

providers.name: Datasembly
providers.description: Datasembly is a real-time retail intelligence platform that collects hyperlocal pricing, promotion, and assortment data from physical and online retail locations. The company reports gathering 12+ billion weekly prices across 150K+ stores from 230+ retailers, building a dataset of more than 2 trillion observations that consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands and retailers use to optimize pricing strategy, measure trade-spend effectiveness, monitor competitors, evaluate key value items, and plan seasonal launches. Datasembly delivers this competitive intelligence as fully shareable data and analytics rather than a public developer API. The company was acquired by SPINS. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public API, developer portal, or API documentation was found on the provider's surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: DayDayCook
providers.description: DayDayCook is a home-cooking content-to-commerce platform founded in Hong Kong that publishes recipes, cooking videos, and food storytelling (its "Taste & Tales" blog) alongside a direct-to-consumer shop selling its own branded sauces, ingredients, and prepared foods under the tagline "Easy Cooking, Festive Flavours." The business pairs a culinary media audience with a consumer-packaged-goods and e-commerce operation. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass DayDayCook publishes a consumer web presence and online shop but exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Dialup
providers.description: Dialup is a voice-chat app that revives the magic of talking on the phone by pairing people for one-on-one calls based on shared interests. It automates recurring, scheduled calls so users connect serendipitously with friends, communities, or complete strangers around the world without any manual coordination. Callers opt in with custom caller IDs rather than random numbers, and the free service is available on iOS and Android. Dialup is a Bloomberg Beta portfolio company; it operates as a consumer social/communication application and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: DNS Coffee
providers.description: DNS Coffee collects, analyzes, and archives changes to root zone files provided by various top-level domains (TLDs), offering one of the most comprehensive views of the current state of the Domain Name System (DNS). By continuously tracking these changes, DNS Coffee uncovers valuable trends over time, making it a powerful resource for analysis and research. What began in 2011 with just 4 zones has grown into a robust platform that now processes data from over 1,200 zones daily.

providers.name: Doomersion
providers.description: Doomersion (doomlingo.ai) is a consumer mobile language-learning app that teaches languages by "doomscrolling" — a vertical, TikTok-style feed of short-form videos in the learner's target language, matched to their level, with clickable explainer subtitles that let you tap any word for an instant translation and grammar note. Founded by Mostafa Afr and backed by Y Combinator, the app ships on iOS and Android. Doomersion exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this record is an API Evangelist network company profile capturing its public web and identity footprint.

providers.name: EditorConfig
providers.description: EditorConfig helps maintain consistent coding styles for multiple developers working on the same project across various editors and IDEs. The EditorConfig project consists of a file format for defining coding styles and a collection of text editor plugins that enable editors to read the file format and adhere to defined styles. EditorConfig files are easily readable and work well with version control systems. The format uses an INI-style syntax compatible with the Python configparser library, with filepath glob patterns similar to gitignore.

providers.name: Enigmalabs
providers.description: Enigma Labs operates a crowdsourced platform for reporting, tracking, and analyzing unidentified aerial phenomena (UAP) and UFO sightings, positioning itself as a destination for UFO sighting alerts and aerial intelligence. Through a mobile app (iOS and Google Play) and a web platform with a map interface and sighting-submission flow, a global community of sky watchers contributes reports that the company enriches with data science, machine-learning analysis, real-time alerts, and historical context. Enigma Labs reports over 57,000 sightings, more than 570,000 sky watchers, and around 2,000 high-signal UAP events, and has been featured by NBC News, PBS Nova, Scientific American, The Guardian, and The New Yorker. It is a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures. No public API, developer portal, or developer documentation was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's public web presence as a consumer-facing product rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Ensoma
providers.description: Ensoma is a privately held, clinical-stage genomic medicines company developing in vivo hematopoietic stem cell (HSC) engineering. Its platform pairs an off-the-shelf in vivo delivery system built on high-capacity virus-like particles that preferentially bind HSCs with a gene engineering toolkit spanning base editing and high-efficiency gene integration, carrying payloads of roughly 35 kilobases so that changes from single-base edits through multi-gene insertions can be made without ex vivo cell collection, manipulation, or transplant conditioning. The company is pursuing programs across genetic disease, immune disorders, and oncology, including EN-374 for X-linked chronic granulomatous disease, and is backed by 5AM Ventures, F-Prime Capital, RTW Investments, Alexandria Venture Investments, Cormorant Asset Management, and the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. Enrichment found no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, OpenAPI/GraphQL/AsyncAPI contract, MCP server, or agent card — this is a therapeutics R&D company, not an API provider. Its only public machine-readable output is open-source computational genomics and sequencing-pipeline code published under its GitHub organization.

providers.name: Erasca
providers.description: Erasca is a clinical-stage precision oncology company (NASDAQ: ERAS) headquartered in San Diego, California, whose name is its mission: to erase cancer. The company is singularly focused on discovering, developing, and commercializing therapies for RAS- and MAPK pathway-driven cancers. RAS is the most frequently mutated oncogene and the MAPK pathway one of the most frequently altered signaling pathways in cancer, together accounting for roughly five million newly diagnosed patients globally each year. Erasca pursues three complementary therapeutic strategies intended to comprehensively shut down the RAS/MAPK pathway by targeting multiple nodes and cooperative mechanisms in parallel. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as an a16z portfolio-linked lead; as a therapeutics company Erasca publishes a corporate and investor web presence rather than a developer API surface, so this record captures verified company identity, legal, and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Ethic
providers.description: Ethic is an SEC-registered technology-driven asset manager that helps financial advisors and institutions build and manage highly customized, values-aligned, and tax-smart investment portfolios at scale. Its platform centralizes client portfolio management across direct indexing, model portfolios, and unified managed accounts (UMAs), letting advisors personalize holdings to individual values and tax situations. Ethic is a private, advisor- and institution-facing platform and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or webhooks as of this profiling.

providers.name: Evergreen Theragnostics
providers.description: Evergreen Theragnostics is a Springfield, New Jersey radiopharmaceutical company founded in 2019 that operates a cGMP contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) for therapeutic and diagnostic radiopharmaceuticals, alongside its own clinical pipeline of theragnostic pairs including the OCTEVY PET diagnostic imaging agent for neuroendocrine tumors. Its 14,000 square foot Springfield facility carries seven commercial-scale production suites, sterility lines, quality control and packaging space serving radioligand therapy developers. Lantheus Holdings completed its acquisition of the company on April 1, 2025, and Evergreen now operates as part of Lantheus. The company sells manufacturing services and drug products, not software: it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable specifications.

providers.name: Exowatt
providers.description: Exowatt is a clean-energy technology company redefining power generation for the AI era. Its flagship Exowatt P3 is a modular, dispatchable solar-thermal energy platform that captures solar energy with proprietary Fresnel lenses and heat exchangers, stores it in a high-efficiency heat battery, and dispatches electricity on demand via a proprietary heat engine, delivering up to 24 hours of dispatchable baseload power. The systems are factory-built in the USA from abundant, low-cost materials without rare-earth minerals, and are aimed at energy-intensive customers such as AI data centers and utilities. Backed by a16z and Felicis, Exowatt is added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it currently publishes no public developer API or documentation surface.

providers.name: FanCraze
providers.description: FanCraze is an International Cricket Council (ICC) officially licensed platform for cricket collectibles, trading, and fantasy gaming, serving more than 500,000 cricket fans worldwide. Its flagship products are Grails, a digital collectibles experience where fans pull officially licensed ICC player cards (Common through Legendary), trade them with other fans, and complete themed sets; and Matchday, a free-to-play fantasy cricket game where fans build squads from their collectibles and compete on live challenges tied to real ICC tournaments including Men's and Women's Cricket World Cups, T20 World Cups, and U-19 World Cups. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and is backed by investors including Tiger Global, Sequoia, Coatue, Dapper Labs, and Coinbase Ventures. FanCraze operates as a consumer (B2C) mobile and web app and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Findem
providers.description: Findem is an AI Talent Intelligence platform that blends assistive AI for sourcing, marketing, executive search, and analytics with agentic AI workers for intelligent job posting, application boost, screening, and scheduling. The company also exposes Embedded AI building blocks (AI Job Board, Sourcing Copilot, Labeling Engine, Agents, and MCP) for partners to ship branded AI hiring experiences. Findem is sold enterprise-direct; ATS, HRIS, and partner integrations are gated rather than offered through a public self-serve developer portal.

providers.name: First Club
providers.description: FirstClub is a member-exclusive quick-commerce grocery platform operating in Bengaluru and Hyderabad, India, delivering curated, quality-inspected groceries in as little as 30 minutes from physical "ClubHouses" rather than traditional dark stores. The company targets India's top-tier consumers with only trusted, tasted, and tested products, screening out a published list of banned ingredients across categories including fruits and vegetables, dairy and eggs, bakery, staples, kids nutrition, packaged foods, snacks and beverages, health supplements, and cleaning essentials. FirstClub also offers a subscription model, "FirstClub Mornings." Founded by ex-Flipkart executive Ayyappan R, the company is backed by Accel and RTP Global. It surfaces here as an API Evangelist network profile; FirstClub is a consumer mobile-app business and currently publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation.

providers.name: Frankford Candy
providers.description: Frankford Candy & Chocolate Company is a privately held, family-owned confectionery manufacturer headquartered in the Frankford neighborhood of Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Founded in 1947 by Russian immigrant Sam Himmelstein, the company describes itself as the "#1 Marketer of Licensed Confectionary in the United States," producing licensed novelty candy, holiday plush, hot chocolate bombs, gummies, Valentine heart boxes, and seasonal collectibles under partnerships with M&M's, Hershey, Pez, Oreo, Sour Patch Kids, Peeps, Welch's, Jif, Kraft, Disney, Marvel, Netflix, Nickelodeon, Minecraft, Super Mario, SpongeBob, Stitch, Care Bears, Elf on the Shelf, Baskin-Robbins, Dunkin', KFC, and Smucker's. Frankford acquired the Cap Candy and Wonder Ball lines from Hasbro and Nestlé in the 2000s and is one of the largest producers of chocolate Easter rabbits in the United States. This repository captures the publicly observable web surface for Frankford Candy; the company exposes no public developer API, portal, SDK, status page, or machine-readable artifacts.

providers.name: Fundable
providers.description: Fundable is a software-as-a-service fundraising platform for startups, operated as part of the Startups.com family and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of 500 Global. Fundable helps founders start and manage a professional raise to attract accredited investors, providing a secure investor data room, investor browsing and discovery tools, and email outreach templates across Self-Managed and Funding Accelerator Premium tiers. The platform reports more than $700 million in funding commitments across 20,000+ accredited investors. Fundable is not a registered broker-dealer and does not execute securities transactions or offer investment advice. As of this enrichment pass Fundable publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable specification, so this profile captures company identity, published policy/support surfaces, and a probed domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Gatherhealth
providers.description: Gather Health is a Boston-area primary care organization delivering team-based, community-centered medical care for seniors aged 65+ on Medicare. Operating neighborhood locations across Quincy, Lynn, Dorchester, and Brockton, each patient is supported by a care team of a primary care provider, a "Gather Guide," and a medical technician, with both in-office and home-based visits, care coordination with specialists and hospitals, and 24/7 urgent care support. Gather Health is a portfolio company of Khosla Ventures. As a care-delivery organization it does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; it uses athenahealth for its patient portal. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company identity record.

providers.name: General Matter
providers.description: General Matter is a domestic nuclear-fuel company founded in 2024 and based in California, building United States uranium enrichment capacity to produce low-enriched uranium (LEU) and high-assay low-enriched uranium (HALEU) for advanced commercial and government nuclear reactors. Co-founded by Scott Nolan and Lee Robinson and backed by Founders Fund, the company was awarded a $900M Department of Energy IDIQ contract and plans a $1.5B commercial enrichment facility at the former Paducah Gaseous Diffusion Plant in Kentucky, plus a lease on the Hanford Fuels and Materials Examination Facility in Washington. Its mission is to reduce American reliance on foreign nuclear fuel and strengthen energy independence. General Matter is an industrial energy manufacturer with no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, website properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: getriff
providers.description: Riff (getriff.co) is a voice and video workspace for remote and hybrid teams, backed by Balderton Capital. Its Mac and Windows desktop apps aim to reduce Slack overload and Zoom fatigue with a minimal video header, one-click availability-based chat, multi-screen sharing with drawing tools, advanced echo cancellation, and focus-time scheduling that updates status automatically, plus Google Calendar and Slack integrations. Riff ships as a consumer/team desktop product and publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI; this API Evangelist profile captures its identity, legal, and domain-security surface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of balderton-capital.

providers.name: Givers
providers.description: Givers is a healthcare technology platform that enrolls, supports, and pays family caregivers through state programs. Qualified family caregivers can earn up to $2,000 per month tax-free while caring for a loved one such as a parent, spouse, or child. Givers handles Medicaid and state program eligibility screening and enrollment, provides caregiver coaching and training, and manages ongoing payment processing on behalf of the caregiver. The company operates a consumer web platform rather than a public developer API. It is backed by CRV and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Groups
providers.description: Groups (Groups Recover Together, joingroups.com) is a healthcare provider delivering outpatient opioid use disorder treatment that combines Suboxone (buprenorphine) medication-assisted treatment with weekly group therapy and individual care coordination. Founded in 2014 and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Groups operates in-person locations nationwide alongside a virtual/telehealth care option and a member mobile app, accepting most commercial insurance and Medicaid. It is CARF-accredited and focuses on accessible, non-judgmental, long-term recovery. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Groups is a direct-to-consumer clinical service and publishes no public developer API surface at the time of profiling.

providers.name: Guestline
providers.description: Guestline provides hospitality management software solutions as part of The Access Group. Their platform helps hotels, resorts, and other accommodation providers manage bookings, front‑desk operations, housekeeping, revenue, and guest experiences. Integrated with a suite of finance, HR, and property maintenance tools, Guestline enables property owners to streamline operations, improve efficiency, and deliver better service across multiple locations.

providers.name: GymNadz
providers.description: GymNadz is a women-focused fitness application offering personalized workout programs, nutrition and meal plans, and community features. The platform provides a library of 300+ exercises with customizable workout and meal plans tailored to individual fitness goals, plus progress tracking and coach interaction. It is delivered as consumer iOS and Android mobile apps rather than as a developer platform. GymNadz is a portfolio company of 500 Global, tracked in the API Evangelist network. No public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's public identity and domain security posture.

providers.name: H.B. Fuller Company
providers.description: H.B. Fuller Company is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The H.B. Fuller Company API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Habito
providers.description: Habito is a UK-based digital mortgage broker that lets people research, compare, and apply for mortgages online across the whole of the market, pairing self-serve digital tools with human mortgage experts, alongside related home-buying services. Founded as a fintech in the consumer lending and real-estate space and backed by Ribbit Capital, Habito has since joined Monzo. The company operates a consumer web product (Webflow-hosted marketing site) and does not publish a public developer API program, developer portal, or OpenAPI at the time of this profile; this record is maintained by the API Evangelist network and reflects only publicly verifiable surfaces.

providers.name: Harmonix
providers.description: Harmonix Music Systems is one of the world's leading independent game development studios, best known for creating blockbuster music and rhythm franchises including Rock Band and Dance Central, alongside titles such as Amplitude, Fuser, DropMix, Audica, Super Beat Sports, and Harmonix Music VR. Founded in 1995 and based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, the studio was acquired by Epic Games in 2021 and continues to invent the future of music and motion gaming. Harmonix operates a consumer-facing web presence (games, music, community, blog, and press) and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Heron Power
providers.description: Heron Power is an industrial power-electronics company modernizing the electrical grid with solid-state transformers and integrated power conversion systems. Founded by former Tesla executive Drew Baglino, the company builds Heron Link products that combine a solid-state transformer with a power supply or inverter for two markets: data centers (AI and hyperscale power delivery, including 800 VDC datacenter architectures) and solar-and-storage renewable energy systems. Heron Power targets the grid infrastructure bottlenecks of the clean-energy transition, replacing century-old passive transformer technology with dense, controllable, software-defined power hardware. The company is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Breakthrough Energy. Heron Power is a hardware and infrastructure company and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company intelligence.

providers.name: Hitachi Construction Machinery
providers.description: Hitachi Construction Machinery provides operational data about machines and equipment on construction sites through the Telematics API, which complies with the ISO 15143-3 (AEMP 2.0) standard. The API enables higher efficiency, productivity, and safety while reducing life cycle costs.

providers.name: Hoptroff
providers.description: Hoptroff is a London-based precision timing company that delivers Traceable Time as a Service (TTaaS), providing enterprise-grade, traceable UTC time with guaranteed SLA accuracy to any data center or cloud environment. Founded in 2015 by Richard Hoptroff, the company operates a global network of atomic timing hubs in London, New York, and Tokyo, delivering microsecond-level precision over IEEE 1588 Precision Time Protocol (PTP) and NTP. Its Certified Time and Terrestrial Time Feed products let organizations timestamp and audit automated events without a satellite dependency, using resilient multi-source feeds (three satellite feeds plus a terrestrial feed from the RISE Institute of Sweden) that are hardened against GPS spoofing and network failure. Hoptroff is certified to ISO 27001 and ISO 9001, and its time synchronization is licensed as an API so a consistent, compliant timescale can be applied across an enterprise for use cases in financial services (MiFID II timestamping and high-frequency trading), content streaming, gaming, IoT, and distributed ledger technology.

providers.name: huspy
providers.description: huspy is a UAE-based proptech and digital mortgage brokerage platform headquartered in Dubai that helps home buyers search residential property, compare mortgage rates across 20+ partner banks (including ADCB, ADIB, Emirates NBD, Dubai Islamic Bank, FAB, HSBC, Mashreq and RAK Bank), get pre-approved online, and close financing in as little as two weeks versus the usual two months. It also operates a broker portal and seller listing services (professional photography, videography and portal placement). No public developer API, documentation, or /.well-known discovery surface was found during enrichment; this profile remains a company stub with a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Hustle Fund
providers.description: Hustle Fund is a pre-seed and seed-stage venture capital firm that invests in "hilariously early" software and technology startups, backing founders often within one or two meetings. Beyond writing early checks through its funds and angel investor network, Hustle Fund publishes tactical, BS-free educational content and newsletters for founders (The Founder Playbook) and investors (Small Bets), and runs programs that help operators learn to angel invest. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of foundry-group. Sector: venture-capital.

providers.name: HyperStrong
providers.description: HyperStrong (Beijing HyperStrong Technology Co., Ltd. / 北京海博思创科技股份有限公司, SSE: 688411) is a leading Chinese provider of battery energy storage systems (BESS) and integrated energy solutions. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in Beijing, the company designs and manufactures modular liquid-cooled storage systems (HyperBlock and HyperCube series), integrated solar-plus-storage and charging-storage units, and the core control stack of battery management systems (BMS), energy management systems (EMS), and power conversion systems (PCS), alongside its HyperCloud AI cloud platform for fleet monitoring and optimization. HyperStrong serves generation-side, grid-side, and user-side (commercial, industrial, and residential) storage markets, ranking among the top domestic and global players by cumulative installed capacity with 60+ GWh deployed across 400+ projects. It is backed by IDG Capital and Qiming Venture Partners. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; HyperStrong is a hardware and energy-platform company and does not publish a public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Iantrek
providers.description: Iantrek, Inc. is a venture-backed ophthalmic medical technology company headquartered in White Plains, New York, pioneering the field it calls bio-interventional ophthalmic surgery (BIOS) for the treatment of glaucoma. Founded in 2019 by ophthalmic innovator Sean Ianchulev, MD, MPH, the company develops micro-interventional surgical devices that reinforce and restore the eye's natural aqueous outflow pathways with biologic allograft tissue rather than bypassing or removing tissue. Its commercial and pipeline portfolio includes AlloFlo Uveo, AlloSert Uveo, C-Rex and AlloSpan Canal. Iantrek has raised approximately $103M across its rounds, including a $42M Series C used to launch AlloFlo Uveo in the United States in October 2025. Iantrek publishes a corporate and surgeon-facing marketing website at iantrekmed.com; it operates no public developer portal, documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Included Health
providers.description: Included Health is a healthcare company that delivers personalized virtual care and healthcare navigation to members through their employers and health plans. The platform combines virtual primary, urgent, behavioral, and specialty care with a 24/7 Care Team that handles benefits navigation, provider matching, billing and claims advocacy, and expert medical opinions. Sold B2B to employers, health plans, labor and trust organizations, and the public sector, Included Health surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Greylock portfolio company; it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or well-known discovery surface, so this profile captures company identity and live domain-security posture rather than an API contract.

providers.name: Indian Energy Exchange
providers.description: Indian Energy Exchange (IEX) is India's largest electricity trading platform, operating a nationwide automated exchange for the physical delivery of electricity, renewable energy, and certificates. IEX runs Day-Ahead, Real-Time, Term-Ahead, Renewable Energy Certificate and Energy Saving Certificate market segments, matching buy and sell bids across a member network of distribution utilities, industrial and commercial consumers, and power generators. For members with sophisticated trading needs IEX offers a members-only trading API (currently for the iDAM and RTM segments) supporting order placement, trade-data retrieval and real-time monitoring for automated and high-frequency trading; access is provisioned to registered members rather than published as a public developer portal. Surfaced as a portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Inertia
providers.description: Inertia is a commercial fusion energy company pursuing laser-driven inertial confinement fusion to deliver safe, affordable, grid-scale clean power. Building on the December 2022 ignition milestone at the National Ignition Facility (NIF) in Livermore, Inertia is developing a modular laser system composed of roughly a thousand smaller, more efficient lasers, mass-manufacturing 4.5mm fusion fuel targets for under a dollar each, and firing them ten times per second to power a 1.5 gigawatt baseload, dispatchable power plant. The company is a deep-tech venture tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; it operates a corporate/marketing web presence and publishes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Inspiren
providers.description: Inspiren is a healthcare technology company providing an AI-powered ecosystem for senior living communities that combines hardware and software to improve resident safety, care planning, and staff efficiency. Its platform pairs devices such as the AUGi sensor, Sense, Help Button, Resident Pendant, and Staff Beacon with the Inspiren HQ software platform and mobile app to deliver emergency call, real-time fall prevention and safety monitoring, data-driven care insights, and staff workflow coordination. Inspiren reports outcomes including reductions in falls, faster alert response times, and improved occupancy for the communities it serves. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and Scale Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; Inspiren does not publish a public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API specifications at this time.

providers.name: Jingle
providers.description: Jingle is a consumer marketplace mobile app for fast, direct local deliveries from mobile stores and services — "shops-on-wheels" — operating in the San Francisco Bay Area. Users sign up with a phone number (no password) and enable push notifications to be alerted when their favorite mobile vendors are nearby — artisanal food trucks, farmers'-market sellers, and one-click services such as bike repair, car wash, manicures, pedicures, and knife sharpening — then request a "jingle" to summon them. Deliveries are handled directly by the businesses themselves, cutting out delivery middlemen. Merchants use the app at their discretion to broadcast their presence to nearby neighborhoods, and residential complexes can partner to bring vendors on-site. Jingle is a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners. The company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK; this profile captures its public consumer and merchant surface.

providers.name: jokr
providers.description: JOKR is an instant grocery and convenience delivery company headquartered in Luxembourg (JOKR S.a.r.L) that operates an online supermarket delivering fresh products and local brands to consumers within minutes or on a scheduled window through its mobile app. The service offers more than 10,000 products with AI-powered personalized recommendations and competitive supermarket pricing, and reports roughly 3 million app downloads and 5 million users. In Brazil it operates under the DAKI brand (soudaki.com), the leading online supermarket in cities including Sao Paulo and Belo Horizonte. JOKR is a consumer-facing quick-commerce business with no public developer API surface; this profile captures its identity and domain posture in the API Evangelist network. Backed by Balderton Capital, GGV Capital, and HV Capital.

providers.name: Karius
providers.description: Karius is an infectious disease diagnostics company that applies clinical metagenomics and machine learning to microbial cell-free DNA (mcfDNA) circulating in the bloodstream, detecting pathogens that conventional culture-based testing misses. Its CLIA-certified and CAP-accredited laboratory runs the Karius Spectrum blood test, which screens a single blood draw for more than 1,000 bacteria, fungi, DNA viruses, and parasites, and the Karius Focus BAL test, which detects more than 500 pathogens in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid for lung infections. Results are returned to clinicians managing complex, immunocompromised, and difficult-to-diagnose patients.

providers.name: KeyRunner
providers.description: KeyRunner is a local-first API platform combining a desktop API client, request monitor, mock server, and secret manager. It is delivered as desktop applications (Windows, macOS Intel, macOS Apple Silicon), a VS Code extension, and a CLI, with all requests and secrets kept inside the developer environment.

providers.name: Kimberly-Clark
providers.description: Kimberly-Clark is a global personal care and consumer tissue company with brands including Huggies, Kleenex, Scott, Kotex, Cottonelle, Poise, Depend, and Pull-Ups. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified for Kimberly-Clark; this repository tracks corporate, supplier, and integration surfaces for ongoing API discovery.

providers.name: KreditBee
providers.description: KreditBee is a Bengaluru, India digital lending platform founded in 2017 by Madhusudan Ekambaram, Vivek Veda and Karthikeyan Krishnaswamy, operated by Finnovation Tech Solutions Private Limited (CIN U74900KA2016PTC086953) and lending through its in-house RBI-registered NBFC KrazyBee Services Limited alongside partner banks and NBFCs. Its consumer products are instant personal loans from Rs 6,000 to Rs 10 lakh, business loans up to Rs 1 crore, two-wheeler loans up to Rs 5 lakh, loan against property, a flexi personal loan line, 24K digital gold, and free credit score reports, delivered through an Android and iOS app and a single-page web application that the company says serves over 7 crore registered Indian users. KreditBee publishes no public developer portal, no API documentation, no API reference, no SDKs and no machine-readable API description of any kind. Its only API host, api.kreditbee.in, is an AWS API Gateway behind Cloudflare that answers HTTP 403 ForbiddenException to every anonymous request and exists to serve the company's own mobile and web clients. Partner and lending-partner integrations are transacted through the /partner-with-us and /digital-lending-partners business pages rather than through any self-serve technical surface.

providers.name: Kula Bio
providers.description: Kula Bio is an agricultural biotechnology company headquartered in Natick, Massachusetts that manufactures Kula-N, a nitrogen-fixing microbial biofertilizer built on the bacterium Xanthobacter autotrophicus. The company's process, originating in Dr. Dan Nocera's research, "supercharges" the microbe with renewable energy so it fixes atmospheric nitrogen at the root zone, letting growers replace a portion of synthetic nitrogen while cutting the greenhouse-gas footprint of the applied product. Kula Bio sells a liquid formulation and, since February 2026, a Soluble Powder (SP) line, serving produce and row-crop growers through agronomic distribution rather than through software. It raised a $50M Series A led by Lowercarbon Capital and was named to TIME's list of America's Top GreenTech Companies of 2026. Kula Bio publishes no developer program, API, SDK, or machine-readable contract of any kind; this profile records that measured absence alongside its verified public corporate surface.

providers.name: LENZ Therapeutics
providers.description: LENZ Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: LENZ) is a commercial-stage ophthalmic pharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, focused on the commercialization of VIZZ (aceclidine ophthalmic solution) 1.44% — the first and only FDA-approved aceclidine-based eye drop for the treatment of presbyopia. LENZ commercializes VIZZ in the United States and establishes international licensing partnerships to provide access globally. The company publishes no developer program, public API, SDK, or machine-readable API description of any kind; its public surface is a ten-page WordPress marketing site, a VIZZ product site, and an investor-relations portal carrying SEC filings and a press-release RSS feed.

providers.name: LF Energy
providers.description: LF Energy is a Linux Foundation project building open source technology solutions for the power grid and energy sector. Launched in 2018, it accelerates the energy transition through open source collaboration and hosts projects for grid modernization, flexibility, and decarbonization.

providers.name: Mad Realities
providers.description: Mad Realities is a creator-powered entertainment network that produces original episodic shows for internet-native audiences, bridging the gap between culture born online and television-level production by partnering with creators. Its Mad Labs arm is an R&D effort leveraging AI and technology to superpower creatives. Backed by Paradigm, the company operates as a consumer media brand and publishes no public API, SDK, or developer platform at this time.

providers.name: Mariana Oncology
providers.description: Mariana Oncology, a Novartis company, is a Watertown, Massachusetts biotechnology company developing precision radioligand therapies (RLTs) — targeted radiopharmaceuticals that deliver alpha- and beta-emitting radioisotopes selectively to tumor cells while sparing healthy tissue. Its pipeline pursues solid-tumor targets including DLL3-expressing small cell lung cancer (MC-339), alongside breast and prostate programs, and it operates a Radioligand Therapy Innovation Center of Excellence for radiochemistry, isotope handling and clinical supply. Founded in 2020 and acquired by Novartis in May 2024, Mariana Oncology is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable interface of any kind.

providers.name: Marvel Fusion
providers.description: Marvel Fusion is a Munich-based deep-tech company founded in 2019 that is developing laser-based inertial confinement fusion energy. It combines a proprietary fast-ignition approach with innovations across lasers, fuel targets, and power-plant design to make commercial fusion power viable, building on the National Ignition Facility 2022 ignition breakthrough. The company operates in Germany and the United States, with a demonstration facility in Fort Collins, Colorado, and has raised over $400M from venture capital, industrial partners, and public funding. As a physics and energy-infrastructure company it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or MCP surface; this profile captures its corporate identity and web/domain security posture.

providers.name: Matcherino
providers.description: Matcherino is an esports crowdfunding and tournament-management platform that provides monetization infrastructure for competitive gaming events of every scale, from college clubs to stadium finals. Its stack covers prize-pool crowdfunding, brackets, player signups, ticketing and entry fees, streaming overlays, sponsor activation, and a publisher dashboard for distributing cash and in-game prizes. Matcherino handles global payouts to organizers and winners across 120+ countries with tax-form collection, and surfaces real-time analytics for organizers, sponsors, and publishers. The company reports having paid out more than $5.2M across 14,000+ tournaments. Matcherino is a Techstars-backed company; it does not currently publish a public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Medivis
providers.description: Medivis is a medical technology company building AI-powered augmented reality solutions for surgery and medical education. Its flagship product, SurgicalAR, is an FDA 510(k)-cleared platform that runs on Microsoft HoloLens 2 and transforms 2D medical imaging (CT and MRI) into interactive 3D holographic visualizations for surgical planning and navigation, including FDA-cleared systems for spine and cranial procedures. Medivis also offers AnatomyX, an AR platform for anatomy and medical education. The company reports deployment across 40+ institutions and use in 2,000+ surgeries. Medivis is a Microsoft technology partner and a portfolio company of Initialized Capital. Medivis publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK; its software surface is delivered as HoloLens and iOS applications for clinical and educational users.

providers.name: Mendaera
providers.description: Mendaera is a healthcare robotics company building the Focalist handheld robotic system, which combines robotics, real-time ultrasound imaging, and software to guide needle-based medical procedures with greater precision and consistency. The FDA-cleared platform is preparing for broad commercial launch in 2026. Mendaera is backed by Lux Capital, Threshold Ventures, Founders Fund, PFM Health Sciences, and Puma Venture Capital. The company is focused on medical devices rather than a developer-facing platform; as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or technical documentation surface.

providers.name: Mother Games
providers.description: Mother Games is a Brooklyn, New York consumer gaming studio backed by GV (Google Ventures). As of mid-2026 the company is pre-launch: it operates a public waitlist for its debut social title "Le Zoo" and runs a campus ambassador program from its Williamsburg mailbox address (223 Bedford Ave #200, Brooklyn, NY 11211). Mother Games does not currently expose any public developer API, SDK, documentation, or developer platform surface — probes of the domain returned 404 for every /.well-known/, /llms.txt, /openapi.json, /api, /docs, and /developers path. This profile tracks the company identity and public web properties in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead pending any future developer platform.

providers.name: Mukuru
providers.description: Mukuru is a Cape Town-headquartered, pan-African fintech and one of the continent's largest formal remittance providers, serving over 16 million customers across Southern, Eastern and Western Africa, the United Kingdom, and the European Union. Founded in 2004 to make sending money home faster and more affordable for the African diaspora, Mukuru now operates a broader financial services platform spanning international and domestic money transfers, the Mukuru Card (a prepaid card product), Mukuru Wallet (a mobile money wallet available in markets such as Botswana for airtime, electricity, and bill payments), Mukuru Pay (cash-based online checkout at retail partners), and Mukuru Funeral Cover (life insurance with cross-border repatriation benefits underwritten by Guardrisk Life). The company is licensed as a South African Financial Services Provider (FSP 45517) and registered Credit Provider (NCRCP9244), and reaches customers through a hybrid network of branches, retail booths, USSD, WhatsApp, web, and native Android, iOS, and Huawei AppGallery apps, supported by more than 320,000 pay-in and pay-out locations. An enterprise arm — branded under the Mukuru Enterprise / MukuruPay umbrella — offers collections and disbursements rails to businesses sending funds into or paying out across Africa. Mukuru does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or open-source client; its Mukuru GitHub organization contains only archived forks of upstream infrastructure tooling (Drone, Helm, Puppet, PHP Docker images) and no Mukuru-authored libraries. Integrations with the Mukuru Enterprise platform are arranged through direct commercial engagement rather than a self-service developer program.

providers.name: NewDays
providers.description: NewDays is a cognitive health company backed by General Catalyst that delivers a clinically proven, Medicare-covered program for people living with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) or dementia. The service pairs a dedicated licensed cognitive clinician with AI-guided brain-training exercises delivered remotely from home: a free consultation, ongoing telehealth sessions, and clinician-supervised AI exercises between visits. NewDays reports that 75% of participants showed improved cognitive function on ACE-III assessments and that dementia participants delayed symptom progression by more than a year versus an untreated baseline. NewDays is a direct-to-patient telehealth offering with no public developer program, API, SDKs, or documentation surface; this profile captures the company's identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Nikahsatu
providers.description: Nikahsatu is a Malaysian wedding-planning marketplace that helps couples plan and budget their weddings more easily and affordably. The consumer-facing platform curates venue packages across Kuala Lumpur, Selangor, Johor, Melaka, Penang and other Malaysian states, along with wedding vendor services such as digital and printed invitations, photography and videography, traditional songket attire, and custom gift boxes, bundled into coordinated all-in-one wedding packages with promotional rebates. It is built on WordPress/WooCommerce and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Nikahsatu publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Nu (Nubank)
providers.description: Nu Holdings (Nubank) is Latin America's largest digital bank, with tens of millions of customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Its core product surface - credit card, account, lending, investments, and insurance - is consumer-facing through the Nu mobile app, and Nubank does not publish a general-purpose public developer portal. Nubank participates in Brazil's Open Finance (Open Banking Brasil) regime, which standardises consent-driven access to account, transaction, and payment-initiation APIs for authorised third parties; Nubank's Open Finance endpoints are registered with the Brazilian Central Bank's directory. For merchant acceptance, Nubank operates NuPay for Business, a REST API for checkout payments, refunds, OAuth2/CIBA-based authorization, beneficiary management, and webhook event notifications, hosted at api.spinpay.com.br.

providers.name: Oceans
providers.description: Oceans Healthcare is a behavioral health system operating a network of psychiatric hospitals and outpatient programs across the southern United States. Founded in 2010 and backed by General Catalyst, the company delivers inpatient and outpatient mental health treatment for adolescents, adults, older adults, and veterans and first responders, spanning acute inpatient psychiatry, partial hospitalization, intensive outpatient, and virtual telehealth care. Oceans Healthcare is a care-delivery operator focused on safety, stability, and lasting healing; it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI definition at this time.

providers.name: OCSiAl
providers.description: OCSiAl is a Luxembourg-headquartered advanced-materials manufacturer and the world's largest industrial producer of single wall carbon nanotubes (graphene nanotubes), sold under the TUBALL brand. Founded in 2010, the company industrialised nanotube synthesis with its Graphetron reactors and now supplies TUBALL nanotubes, TUBALL MATRIX concentrates and TUBALL BATT dispersions as conductive and reinforcing additives to lithium-ion battery electrode, elastomer, thermoplastic, coating, composite and ESD-flooring producers. TUBALL was the first single wall carbon nanotube registered under EU REACH and covered by a US EPA consent order. OCSiAl operates production and dispersion facilities in Luxembourg and Serbia plus laboratories and TUBALL CENTERs in Europe and Asia, with commercial representation in more than 20 countries. It is a materials producer, not a software vendor, and publishes no public API, developer portal or SDK.

providers.name: Octave
providers.description: Octave (Octave Online Therapy) is a modern behavioral and mental health company providing personalized, evidence-based therapy — individual, couples, and family therapy, plus Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT) and specialized Centers of Excellence for perinatal/postpartum mental health, LGBTQIA+ (queer resiliency), trauma, and women's emotional health. Care is delivered virtually and in-person across 20+ U.S. states, with in-network insurance coverage, a therapy cost calculator, therapist matching, and a secure client portal. Octave is a portfolio company of Obvious Ventures. Octave publishes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures the company's public web surface, a provider-published llms.txt, and its domain-security posture.

providers.name: Oligo
providers.description: Oligo Security is a runtime security platform built for the AI era, giving security teams real-time visibility and protection across applications, cloud infrastructure, and AI systems. Oligo combines Cloud Application Detection and Response (CADR), runtime software composition analysis (SCA) and SBOM generation, container scanning, and AI security posture management to detect and stop attacks at the application layer before they spread. By observing which vulnerable code actually executes at runtime, Oligo proves exploitability and reduces vulnerability noise by up to 90-99%, letting teams prioritize the small fraction of findings that are truly reachable. The platform covers apps, workloads, hosts, and cloud infrastructure, and adds runtime protection for AI agents and models. Oligo is a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and counts organizations such as Databricks, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Instacart, and Cresta among its customers. Its customer platform and API documentation are gated behind authentication; no public REST API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, CLI, or MCP server is published on the open web at the time of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: One Identity
providers.description: One Identity is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: gartner-mq) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Open Port Technology
providers.description: Open Port Technology (OpenPort) is a pan-Asian logistics and supply chain technology company that digitizes trucking, freight, and supply chain operations across emerging markets through an open, neutral, AI-based platform. Headquartered in Karachi, Pakistan, its product suite spans transport management (OpenTM), a digital trucking marketplace (OpenMarket), customs clearance (OpenClear), warehouse picking operations (OpenPick), and FBR digital invoicing (Open Invoice). The company reports millions of completed shipments, 1,600+ transport partners, and integrations across 100+ ERP systems, offering ERP integration and custom API development to clients, though it publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine readable API specification at this time.

providers.name: Openhouse
providers.description: Openhouse is a network of neighborhood children's learning centres in Bangalore and Kolkata, India, describing itself as a "Third Space" for children — neither home nor school, but a sanctuary for curiosity. It runs preschool programs for ages 1-6, a Parent-Toddler Club for ages 1-3, and Excel extracurriculars (robotics, public speaking, music, art and design) for ages 3-5+, built around a learning-by-doing philosophy. The consumer-facing website (openhouse.school, formerly openhouse.study) is a marketing and enrollment surface; the only network-visible technical surface is a private app backend health endpoint at api.openhouse.study. Openhouse was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. It publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: ORAS
providers.description: ORAS (OCI Registry As Storage) is a CNCF project that provides a CLI and a set of client libraries for pushing and pulling arbitrary OCI artifacts to and from OCI-compliant registries, allowing container registries to be used as a generic artifact distribution mechanism.

providers.name: Osmind
providers.description: Osmind is an interventional psychiatry platform that powers what it describes as the largest network of interventional psychiatry practices in the United States. The company provides a purpose-built electronic health record (EHR), billing and revenue-cycle management (RCM), measurement-based care and outcomes tracking, and a patient mobile app for practices delivering treatments such as ketamine, Spravato (esketamine), TMS, and other novel and interventional mental-health therapies. Osmind reports serving 1,000+ practices and supporting more than one million treatments delivered. It is a private B2B healthcare SaaS company backed by General Catalyst and other investors. As of this profile, Osmind publishes no public developer API, developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or webhook surface on its public site.

providers.name: Osmo
providers.description: Osmo (Tangible Play) makes hands-on, screen-interactive learning games for iPad and Fire tablet that pair a physical reflector base placed over the device camera with digital games spanning math, coding, spelling, drawing, and problem-solving for children. Backed by Accel and GV, Osmo is a consumer educational-technology brand that sells hardware kits and companion apps direct to families and schools. As of this enrichment pass it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Oto Capital
providers.description: OTO (Oto Capital) is India's leading platform to discover, research, and buy two-wheelers online with embedded financing. It offers digital bike loans with eligibility checks in five minutes and loan approvals within thirty minutes, an EMI calculator, home delivery, and test rides across 22+ Indian cities, working with 10+ lending partners including Northern Arc, Western Capital, Ujjivan Small Finance Bank, and Suryoday Small Finance Bank. Backed by 500 Global. No public developer API, portal, or documentation surface is currently published by the company.

providers.name: Otrium
providers.description: Otrium is an online designer fashion outlet, headquartered in Amsterdam, that connects shoppers across Europe with end-of-season and overstock apparel, footwear, and accessories from designer and premium brands at reduced prices. A Certified B Corporation, Otrium operates a curated marketplace model with dedicated brand storefronts, native iOS and Android apps, and multi-market localization across the Netherlands, Germany, Belgium, France, Italy, the United Kingdom, Spain, Poland, and the rest of Europe. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bond Capital and Index Ventures. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface is currently published; this profile captures the company identity and its verified public web properties.

providers.name: Pacaso
providers.description: Pacaso is a proptech company that operates a luxury vacation-home co-ownership platform, letting individuals buy a fractional share of a professionally managed second home. It handles the LLC ownership structure, financing, scheduling, cleaning, maintenance, and full property management for co-owners across premium destinations in the US, Europe, Mexico, and other resort markets. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Fifth Wall and the SoftBank Vision Fund and added to the API Evangelist network. Pacaso publishes no public API or developer program at this time; this profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Papa
providers.description: Papa is a companion care company that pairs older adults and families with vetted, trained companions called Papa Pals for social support, errands, transportation, technology help, check-ins, and everyday assistance. Papa sells to Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Special Needs, and commercial health plans and to employers as a tech-enabled social care benefit, serving millions of members across roughly 70-100 health plan and employer partners. Members are enrolled by phone or, for employer members, online, and use the Papa Care app to request and schedule visits; Papa Pals use the Papa Pal app to accept and complete visits. Papa does not publish a public or self-serve developer API. Health plan integration is handled through business agreements - eligibility file exchange to identify and onboard eligible members, and recurring reporting dashboards covering utilization, gaps, referrals, satisfaction, and outcomes - rather than through a documented public REST API, developer portal, or API keys.

providers.name: PAQ Therapeutics
providers.description: PAQ Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered at 100 Summit Drive, Burlington, Massachusetts, developing targeted protein degradation (TPD) medicines for KRAS-driven cancers. Rather than inhibiting the KRAS oncoprotein, PAQ's autophagy-based degrader chemistry recruits the cell's own natural degradation machinery to remove the protein outright, an approach the company applies to the KRAS mutations found in roughly a quarter of human tumors, most notably lung, colorectal and pancreatic cancer. Its lead program, PT0511, is a pan-KRAS degrader that dosed its first patient in a Phase 1 trial in January 2026. The company was co-founded by Nan Ji (Chief Executive Officer) and Huaixiang Hao (Head of Research), with Andrew Krivoshik as Chief Medical Officer. PAQ Therapeutics is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor: it operates a four-page corporate WordPress site and publishes no API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Parabilis Medicines
providers.description: Parabilis Medicines (formerly FogPharma) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, developing a new class of ultra-tunable alpha-helical peptide therapeutics called Helicons to reach intracellular protein targets long considered undruggable. Its AI- and physics-based discovery platform underpins a pipeline led by zolucatetide, a candidate targeting the beta-catenin / TCF interaction in the Wnt signaling pathway across multiple cancers. Backed by more than $500M from leading life sciences investors and public since its June 2026 IPO (Nasdaq: PBLS), the company was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and GV. It publishes a public marketing and investor web presence and a science/data tech blog, but exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Pearl Health
providers.description: Pearl Health is a healthcare technology company that provides value-based care intelligence for physicians, primary care practices, physician networks, and health systems. Its platform acts as an operating system for value-based care, ingesting Medicare claims data, ADT feeds, and EHR information to identify high-risk patients, prioritize care activities with actionable next steps and automated administrative workflows, and optimize financial performance under Traditional Medicare and Medicare Advantage risk arrangements. Pearl reports serving 5,000+ providers across 40+ states, managing roughly 250,000 beneficiaries. The company connects to existing EHR systems but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. This profile was surfaced as an a16z and SV Angel portfolio company and enriched from the provider's public web surface.

providers.name: Pelikan Mobility
providers.description: Pelikan Mobility is a Paris-based smart-leasing and fleet-management company for electric commercial vehicles, founded in late 2022 by David Salfati and Vincent Schachter. It operates two products: Pelikan Lease, a very-long-term leasing offer (up to 10 years / 300,000 km) for electric utility vans that targets a 20% lower total cost of ownership, and Pelikan FleetPilot, a SaaS platform using digital twins, optimization algorithms and generative AI to plan fleet renewal, electrification and vehicle redeployment across large B2B fleets in utilities, maintenance, construction and logistics. The company is backed by Seedcamp, Frst and PaleBlueDot Ventures. It publishes a marketing and resources website but exposes no public API or developer surface at this time; this profile records its identity and web-domain security posture.

providers.name: Plantible Foods
providers.description: Plantible Foods is a business-to-business food-ingredient company founded in 2018 by Dutch entrepreneurs Tony and Maurits, with its first commercial production facility in Schleicher County, Texas. The company cultivates lemna (duckweed) in controlled, automated aquafarms and uses a proprietary water-based extraction process to isolate RuBisCO, sold as Rubi Protein — roughly 85% protein by weight with a PDCAAS of 1.0 — alongside Lemna Leaf Greens and application-specific systems such as RubiWhisk and RubiPrime. It sells to food manufacturers and ingredient companies rather than consumers, and in February 2026 became the first company to receive an FDA "no questions" GRAS letter for isolated RuBisCO protein in food. Investors include RA Capital, Nourish Ventures, Chipotle, Kellogg's and CJ Group. Plantible is an agricultural manufacturing business: it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable contract of any kind, and plantiblefoods.com is a Webflow marketing site with no developer surface.

providers.name: Port of Mokha
providers.description: Port of Mokha is a specialty coffee company founded by Mokhtar Alkhanshali that sources rare, high-scoring single-origin coffee from Yemen and brings it to the international specialty market. Known for record-setting Coffee Review scores and curated offerings such as the Timeless Mokha Blend and The Yemen Trilogy, it also runs a wholesale program and publishes brewing guides. The business operates as a direct-to-consumer Shopify storefront; it exposes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched as a retail (non-API) company record.

providers.name: Portea
providers.description: Portea Medical is India's leading home healthcare provider, delivering clinical care to patients at home across 40+ cities. Services include physiotherapy, nursing care, doctor consultations, medical equipment rental, trained attendants, diagnostic and lab tests, counselling, and specialized programs for eldercare, mother and baby care, diabetes, critical care, and vaccination. Portea was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer home-healthcare operator it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal at this time; this profile captures its identity and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Proportunity
providers.description: Proportunity is a London-based proptech/fintech mortgage lender, founded in 2016 by Vadim Toader and Stefan Boronea, that helps first-time buyers get onto the property ladder with a shared-equity loan. The Proportunity Loan supplements a buyer's deposit and can boost purchasing power by up to GBP 150,000, letting buyers secure a home with as little as a 5% deposit on any property on the market (not just new-builds). The company uses machine-learning models to forecast house prices and identify fair-valued homes in high-growth areas to reduce financing risk. Proportunity is authorised and regulated by the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FRN 716565). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Anthemis and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public developer/API surface (consumer-facing product only).

providers.name: Prosperity Bank
providers.description: Prosperity Bank is a Texas-chartered commercial bank (member FDIC, NMLS ID 466414) and the banking subsidiary of Prosperity Bancshares, Inc. (NYSE: PB), a Houston, Texas based regional financial holding company with roughly $37-43 billion in total assets and 300-plus full-service branches across Texas and central Oklahoma. It offers consumer and commercial banking, treasury management, mortgage, and wealth services, and has grown largely through acquisitions (LegacyTexas, Lone Star State Bancshares, American Bank Holding, Southwest Bancshares, Stellar Bancorp). On open finance, Prosperity Bank operates no first-party public developer portal or documented API: developer. and api. subdomains do not resolve, and no /developers or /api pages exist. Consumer-permissioned account and transaction data is reachable only through third-party aggregators (Finicity/Mastercard Open Banking, Plaid, and similar), not a directly published bank API. No FDX-conformant data-access API or CFPB Section 1033 posture is publicly documented by the bank as of this review.

providers.name: Protagonist Therapeutics
providers.description: Protagonist Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Newark, California and founded in 2006. It discovers and develops peptide-based new chemical entities using a proprietary peptide discovery and engineering platform, targeting rare and prevalent diseases with significant unmet medical need. Lead programs include rusfertide, a hepcidin mimetic in Phase 3 for polycythemia vera, and icotrokinra (PN-235), an oral IL-23 receptor antagonist partnered with Johnson & Johnson. The company is publicly traded (Nasdaq: PTGX) following its 2016 IPO. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or agent surface.

providers.name: Proxima Fusion
providers.description: Proxima Fusion is a Munich-based fusion energy company building the first generation of commercial fusion power plants using quasi-isodynamic (QI) stellarators. Spun out of the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics, the company is developing Stellaris, a stellarator power plant concept, with milestones that include a Stellarator Model Coil and an Alpha demonstration stellarator on the path to grid-scale fusion energy. Proxima Fusion is a privately held deep-tech startup and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Pvx Partners
providers.description: PvX Partners (PvX Partners Pte Ltd) is a Singapore-based fintech platform that provides non-dilutive, performance-based user-acquisition (UA) financing for mobile gaming and consumer app studios. Its PvX Capital product offers a flexible credit line covering up to 80% of monthly marketing spend with no equity dilution, term sheets within 24 hours, and funds within 30 days, secured by and repaid from funded user cohorts. PvX Lambda is a cohort intelligence engine offering cohort-based ROAS projections, benchmarking, and funding-eligibility analysis across 650+ apps and 14,500+ cohorts, and PvX Delta rounds out the analytics suite. The firm reports $1B+ in capital committed across 100+ client companies. Surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and profiled in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Qlaris Bio
providers.description: Qlaris Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing first-in-class therapies for ophthalmic diseases, with a mission to preserve vision and prevent blindness. Its lead candidate, QLS-111, uses a novel mechanism of action to lower intraocular pressure by targeting the distal outflow pathway, and is being evaluated for primary open-angle glaucoma, ocular hypertension, and elevated IOP associated with conditions such as Sturge-Weber Syndrome. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a clinical-stage drug developer, Qlaris Bio publishes a corporate website but no public developer, API, or product integration surface.

providers.name: rabot.energy
providers.description: rabot.energy (RABOT Energy DE GmbH) is a Hamburg-based German electricity supplier offering dynamic and fixed-rate power tariffs where consumers pay hourly rates that track the wholesale electricity market. The company provides 100% renewable energy certified by TÜV NORD, smart meter installation and management, EV charging optimization (Autostrom), and home battery storage (Rabot Flow), all managed through a consumer mobile app for consumption monitoring. It is a consumer-facing energy retailer; no public developer portal or API is currently published. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of HV Capital.

providers.name: Rainmarket
providers.description: Rainmarket is the flagship intelligence platform of Digital Media Nusantara (DMN), built to map and illuminate cross-border trade flows between ASEAN and Hong Kong's Greater Bay Area. It combines three integrated engines — Supply Chain Intelligence, a Tariff Tracker, and a Trade Flows Mapping engine — to turn roughly USD100 billion in previously unmapped or mispriced regional trade activity into investible, financeable, and transparently governed flows. The platform is architected for sovereign-grade deployment, targeting the security, compliance, and resiliency thresholds required by central banks, financial regulators, and national-level intelligence environments, and serves institutional investors, financial institutions, market regulators, and enterprise treasury and supply-chain teams. Rainmarket was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and profiled in the API Evangelist network. As of this pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable service surface.

providers.name: Rapyd
providers.description: Rapyd is a global Fintech-as-a-Service network offering collect, disburse, hold, and issue capabilities across 100+ countries with local payment methods, cards, and bank transfers.

providers.name: Ray Therapeutics
providers.description: Ray Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing optogenetic, gene-based medicines to restore vision in people with blinding degenerative retinal diseases. Its approach reprograms surviving retinal neurons to detect light and transmit visual signals to the brain, independent of the underlying gene mutation. Lead programs include RTX-015 (retinitis pigmentosa and other inherited retinal diseases, Phase 1/2) and RTX-021 (Stargardt disease and geographic atrophy, IND-enabling). The company is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. Ray Therapeutics operates as a therapeutics developer and does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: RealNetworks
providers.description: RealNetworks is a Seattle-based technology company that pairs AI-powered computer-vision and secure-communication products with its long-running consumer media brands. Its portfolio includes SAFR (facial recognition for security and retail loss prevention), Kontxt (AI messaging and voice security for CPaaS platforms, Telcos, and MNOs), GameHouse (cross-device casual gaming), and RealPlayer (media playback). Product APIs for SAFR and Kontxt are delivered through authenticated partner portals rather than an open developer portal; the historical Real Developer Program (developer.real.com) is no longer live, and no public OpenAPI specification was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Remedial Health
providers.description: Remedial Health is a Nigeria-based healthtech company digitizing pharmaceutical procurement and pharmacy operations across Africa. Its platform connects retail pharmacies, hospitals, clinics, health insurers/HMOs, and pharmaceutical manufacturers through a set of products: Remedial Store (a digital marketplace for pharmacies to procure inventory), Remedial RX (daily pharmacy operations and inventory tooling), Remedial Buy Now-Pay Later (inventory financing), the Remedial Benefits Manager (clinical pharmacy services and medication delivery for insurers), Remedial Market Access (distribution reach for manufacturers), and Remedial Intelligence (supply-chain data insights). The company is backed by QED Investors and reaches its customers primarily through Android and iOS mobile apps. As of this enrichment pass Remedial Health publishes no public API, developer portal, or documentation host; this profile captures its identity, legal, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Revalia Bio
providers.description: Revalia Bio transforms donated, non-transplantable human organs and tissues into high-fidelity biological datasets, using AI to accelerate drug and device development. The company has built "The Human Data Stack" — infrastructure spanning data generation, ingestion, integration, interpretation, and delivery of decision-ready clinical insights for pharma, biotech, healthcare, and regulatory customers. Applications include safety signal detection, dose and target selection, patient selection, and mechanism-of-action studies. Founded by Greg Tietjen (CEO) and Jenna DiRito (COO), it generated first revenue in 2023 and raised seed funding in 2024. Backed by Sierra Ventures.
