As of this enrichment pass Revalia Bio publishes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or technical surface — it is a B2B research-services company, not a developer platform.

providers.name: Rexby
providers.description: Rexby is a consumer travel discovery and trip-planning platform where local creators publish interactive travel guides and maps of curated "spots," and travelers browse those guides, build personal itineraries, and follow creator recommendations. The product is delivered as iOS and Android mobile apps plus the rexby.com web experience, with a creator program that lets travel enthusiasts monetize their guides. Backed by Techstars. As of this profile Rexby publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this apis.yml captures its identity and a domain-security probe for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Rezo Therapeutics
providers.description: Rezo Therapeutics is a San Francisco (Mission Bay) biopharmaceutical company spun out of the Quantitative Biosciences Institute (QBI) at UCSF, co-founded by Nevan Krogan, that is building a disease-agnostic network-biology drug discovery platform. Its "sequence to systems to drugs" approach integrates proteomics, human genetics, structural biology, medicinal chemistry, bioinformatics and machine learning to construct comprehensive maps of molecular disease networks and identify novel, druggable targets for precision therapeutics, with an initial focus on oncology. The company launched in November 2022 with a $78M Series A led by SR One, a16z Bio + Health and Norwest Venture Partners, and appointed Derek Hicks as chief executive officer in August 2025. Rezo is a therapeutics developer rather than a software vendor: its computational platform is internal R&D tooling, and the company publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Rightway Healthcare
providers.description: Rightway Healthcare is a healthcare navigation and pharmacy benefits management (PBM) company that pairs a transparent, 100% pass-through PBM built by pharmacists with clinical care navigation that helps members understand their benefits, resolve billing questions, and connect with the right care. Rightway serves employers and their members through web and mobile apps rather than a public developer program. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of khosla-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; as of this enrichment pass Rightway publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs, so the captured artifacts are limited to a domain-security probe and verified public web properties.

providers.name: Robeaute
providers.description: Robeauté is a Paris-based medical technology company, founded in 2017 by Bertrand Duplat and Joana Cartocci, developing what it calls the world's first microrobotic platform for the brain. Its rice-grain-sized robots are designed to navigate brain tissue to diagnose, treat, and monitor neurological disease, aiming to make neurosurgery safer and less invasive. The device is pre-market — it has not received FDA clearance or CE marking and is not approved for clinical use or commercial sale. Robeauté has raised over €40M, including a $28M Series A led by Plural, Cherry Ventures, Kindred Ventures, and Brainlab, and operates from Paris with a San Francisco office opened in 2026. The company publishes no public API, developer platform, or SDK.

providers.name: Rovio Entertainment
providers.description: Rovio Entertainment is a Finnish mobile game company founded in 2003 and headquartered in Espoo, best known for the Angry Birds franchise and a portfolio of casual and puzzle titles played by hundreds of millions of players worldwide. It operates game studios across Finland, Sweden, Denmark, Canada, Spain, and Turkey, and became part of Sega Sammy Holdings in 2023. Rovio was surfaced as a portfolio company of Atomico and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Rovio publishes a corporate/marketing website but no public developer portal, API, SDK, or well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Scorpion
providers.description: Scorpion is an American marketing technology company that provides revenue-focused advertising, marketing, and software services to local and multi-location businesses in home services, legal, franchise, and healthcare verticals. Founded in 2001 by Rustin Kretz and headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah (with major operations in Valencia, California), Scorpion pairs done-for-you digital advertising and SEO with its own AI-driven platform. In 2024 it launched RevenueMAX, an AI marketing platform built on Scorpion AI that aligns marketing spend, intake, and long-term revenue, and in 2025 it introduced Scorpion Convert, an AI intake-and-conversion product that automates response, scheduling, and voice/messaging engagement for missed leads. Scorpion is a services-and-platform provider; it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Scout
providers.description: Scout (Scout Space) is a Techstars- and venture-backed space technology company founded in 2019 that builds next-generation orbital sensing and autonomy for Space Domain Awareness (SDA). Its in-space products, first launched in 2021, let spacecraft see and understand objects around them through electro-optical and infrared sensors (the Owl long-range SDA sensor line), edge processing hardware, mission autonomy software developed with the U.S. Space Force, and mission-design analysis. Scout supplies cross-orbit intelligence and dynamic space operations to government and commercial operators and has been awarded multiple AFWERX SBIR and USSF TACFI contracts. Scout does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Season Share
providers.description: Season Share (SeasonShare) is a ticketing technology platform for sports and entertainment venues. Its subscription-pass, last-minute, student, and credit-based products — Pass, Flow, Flex, and LivePass — help teams and venues reach younger fans, capture first-party data, and build recurring ticket revenue. It reports $100M+ in ticket inventory delivered and 1.5M tickets purchased, and is used by 30+ franchises including the Sacramento Kings, New Jersey Devils, Arizona Diamondbacks, and Nashville Predators. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company; no public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Second Measure
providers.description: Bloomberg Second Measure provides alternative data analytics for investors, turning billions of anonymized U.S. consumer card-transaction purchases into daily insights on the performance of thousands of public and private companies and brands. It is a Bloomberg product delivered primarily through the Bloomberg Terminal (ALTD and ECAN commands) and via aggregated and transaction-level data feeds, with 2-, 3-, and 7-day delivery lags that support intra-quarter earnings forecasting and investment monitoring. Second Measure was founded as a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio company and acquired by Bloomberg in 2020. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification; access is gated through Bloomberg data products rather than a self-serve web API.

providers.name: Sharechat
providers.description: ShareChat (Mohalla Tech Pvt. Ltd.) is an Indian social media company that operates the regional-language social network ShareChat and the short-video entertainment app Moj. The platform lets users across 15+ Indian languages share posts, images, videos, shayari, quotes, and trending content through personalized feeds. ShareChat monetizes through a self-serve advertising platform (ShareChat Ads) offering campaign management, audience targeting, and brand partnerships across its social and short-video surfaces. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and other investors, the company is one of the largest homegrown social platforms in India. As of this profile, ShareChat exposes consumer apps and a self-serve ad manager but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or programmatic API surface.

providers.name: Shibuya
providers.description: Shibuya is a platform for curated short films and the independent creators behind them, describing itself as a home where fans help greenlight the future of film and audiences discover original storytelling. Operated by NotShibuya, Inc. and backed by a16z, Shibuya began as a web3 storytelling experiment and has grown into a community-driven curation platform for short-form film, winning a 2025 Primetime Emmy for Outstanding Innovation in Emerging Media Programming. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Shibuya publishes no public developer program, API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its real public web properties.

providers.name: Shiplyst
providers.description: Shiplyst is an India-based ocean freight procurement marketplace and supply-chain technology platform that lets exporters and importers search and compare container shipping rates from 50+ ocean carriers in real time, generate instant quotes, book containers with transparent pricing, and track cargo from pickup to delivery. The platform automates Bill of Lading and invoice generation and offers real-time tracking with exception alerts across its web and mobile apps. Shiplyst is backed by 500 Global. No public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Shoobs
providers.description: Shoobs is a UK-based online events discovery and ticketing platform focused on urban culture — Afrobeats, R&B, hip-hop, dancehall, comedy, theatre, festivals, brunches and club nights across London and other British cities. Founded as a Y Combinator-backed startup, Shoobs helps fans find and book tickets to events that match their taste, and lets promoters list and sell tickets for urban and Black-British cultural events. The platform pairs an events listing and discovery site with an integrated editorial blog covering artists, concerts and nightlife. Shoobs is a consumer web product; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Side
providers.description: Side is a technology-powered residential real estate brokerage platform that partners with top-producing agents, teams, and independent brokers to help them launch and grow their own branded brokerage companies without the time, cost, or risk of operating a traditional brokerage. Side provides back-office operations, compliance, transaction management, marketing, and a proprietary Side App that streamlines and automates real estate transactions. Founded in San Francisco, Side is backed by ICONIQ Capital, Matrix Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Trinity Ventures. Side runs a private, authenticated internal API (api.side.com/v1) that powers its app but publishes no public developer program, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Sketchpro
providers.description: SketchPro is an AI copilot for Autodesk Revit that helps architects and engineers automate construction documentation directly inside their live project models. Delivered as a native Revit plugin (not a public developer API), it executes natural-language instructions to handle dimensioning, tagging, view creation, sheet setup, and scheduling, while adapting to each firm's standards, naming conventions, and documentation logic through an admin-configured AI Knowledge Base. Founded in 2023 and used by architecture practices including SOM, 10 Design, and Little, SketchPro is backed by Khosla Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or event/webhook surface; API access is described as "contact vendor / not publicly documented."

providers.name: SkyDrive
providers.description: SkyDrive Inc. is a Japanese advanced air mobility manufacturer, founded in July 2018 by members of the CARTIVATOR volunteer project, that develops, manufactures, sells and operates eVTOL (electric vertical take-off and landing) aircraft. Its flagship aircraft, SKYDRIVE (model SD-05), is a compact three-seat electric aircraft in type certification with the Japan Civil Aviation Bureau and in concurrent validation with the US Federal Aviation Administration, and is produced with official manufacturing partner Suzuki Motor Corporation at Suzuki's plant in Iwata, Shizuoka. The company is headquartered in Toyota City, Aichi, with offices in Tokyo, Nagoya, Osaka and Yamaguchi and a US subsidiary, SkyDrive America. SkyDrive is a hardware and aircraft-operations company; it publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable interface contract of any kind.

providers.name: Skyworks Solutions
providers.description: Skyworks Solutions, Inc. is an American semiconductor company headquartered in Irvine, California that designs, develops, and markets proprietary semiconductor products for wireless communications, automotive, broadband, connected home, industrial, defense, and consumer electronics applications. Skyworks is a leading provider of analog and mixed-signal semiconductors, with dominant market share in 5G RF front-end modules (35% market share). Products span amplifiers, filters, front-end modules, isolators, switches, and power management ICs serving mobile, automotive, IoT, and infrastructure markets. The company does not publish a public developer API but provides datasheets, evaluation tools, and design resources for hardware engineers.

providers.name: Spero Therapeutics
providers.description: Spero Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company advancing innovative medicines for immune-mediated and infectious diseases. Its pipeline includes SP001, a third-generation anti-CD40L antibody targeting IgG4-related disease, alongside earlier programs in antibacterial and rare-disease therapeutics. Spero was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and added to the API Evangelist network. As a life-sciences drug developer, Spero publishes a corporate and investor-relations web presence but no public developer API, developer portal, or technical integration surface; this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Sundae
providers.description: Sundae is a residential real estate marketplace that buys homes directly from homeowners for cash and resells them to a vetted network of property investors. Sellers get a competitive as-is cash offer with no repairs, showings, or fees, flexible closings in as little as 10 days, and an optional cash advance before closing; investors access off-market and distressed properties through the Sundae Marketplace. Backed by QED Investors, Sundae operates a consumer-facing website, an investor marketplace, and an agent referral program. It is a proptech/fintech company and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Suplari
providers.description: Suplari is an enterprise procurement intelligence platform that goes beyond spend analytics, using AI to clean, classify, and unify fragmented spend data across ERP, P2P, and spreadsheet sources. It delivers spend analytics, value orchestration, savings tracking, contract intelligence, and ESG intelligence, alongside procurement-specific AI agents (Suplari Worker, Assistant, and AI Studio) that integrate with SAP, Oracle, Workday, Coupa, Databricks, Snowflake, and Microsoft. Suplari was acquired by Microsoft in 2021. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: Switch Therapeutics
providers.description: Switch Therapeutics is a precision neuroscience biotechnology company founded in 2020 and based in San Francisco, California, developing biomarker-gated genetic medicines for central nervous system (CNS) diseases with high unmet need. Its Conditionally Activated siRNA (CASi) platform combines properties of single- and double-stranded RNAs in one molecule to enable efficient self-delivery, potent and durable gene knockdown, and cell-type/cell-state selectivity. Its lead development candidate is CASi-APOE, a liver-sparing APOE RNAi therapy. The company is backed by CRV and Insight Partners and is a therapeutics developer with no public developer API, SDK, or technical documentation surface.

providers.name: Synchron
providers.description: Synchron is a clinical-stage neurotechnology company developing an implantable brain-computer interface (BCI). Its flagship device, the Stentrode, is placed in a blood vessel near the motor cortex through a minimally invasive endovascular procedure (via the jugular vein) rather than open brain surgery, letting people with paralysis control digital devices with their thoughts. Synchron has co-developed a Bluetooth-based interface aligned with Apple's BCI-HID protocol, connecting brain signals to iPhone, iPad, and Vision Pro through Switch Control, and runs a Cognitive AI division decoding neural data in real time. The Stentrode is an investigational device under FDA and TGA clinical trials and is not yet commercially approved. Synchron publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its corporate identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Take2.ai
providers.description: Take2.ai builds autonomous AI agents purpose-built for healthcare recruiting, automating the end-to-end hiring workflow from candidate sourcing through screening, interviewing, credential verification, and scheduling. Its product suite includes an AI Interviewer that conducts 24/7 phone interviews and syncs scoring and transcripts back into the recruiter's system, an AI Sourcer that re-engages past applicants to build pipelines for hard-to-fill clinical roles, an AI Verifier for real-time credential and certification checks, and an AI Scheduler for interview coordination. The platform integrates with most ATS and HRIS systems, is hosted on AWS in the United States, and is SOC 2 Type II compliant. Take2.ai is a Techstars-backed company serving enterprise healthcare organizations. As of this profile the company exposes a customer-facing SaaS product and ATS/HRIS integrations but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Tangelo
providers.description: Tangelo is a Latin American fintech company, surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of QED Investors (a fintech-focused venture firm). Tangelo runs an API-first developer program: it publishes API documentation through a Stoplight-hosted developer portal at docs.tangelolatam.com (workspace "Tangelo Latam Docs") and operates a branded Atlassian status page at status.tangelolatam.com. Its marketing site runs on Webflow. This profile was enriched by live probing of Tangelo's public surfaces; the underlying OpenAPI definition is served behind the Stoplight single-page app and was not machine-extractable in this pass, so spec-derived artifacts (packages, scopes, errors, authentication) remain open for a follow-up once the specification URL is captured.

providers.name: Taxscouts
providers.description: TaxScouts is a UK online tax-return and Self Assessment service that pairs individuals, sole traders, landlords and investors with accredited accountants to prepare, review and file their taxes with HMRC for a flat fee. Founded in London, TaxScouts was acquired by Taxfix and its taxscouts.com domain now redirects to taxfix.com/en-uk. The service is a consumer-facing web and mobile product with pricing tiers for one-off filing, optimisation with HMRC audit protection, and year-round accountant support. As of this profile it exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API documentation; this record captures its public identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Team8
providers.description: Team8 is an Israel-based venture group that both creates and invests in companies, operating as a company-building foundry alongside a traditional venture-capital fund. Founded in 2014 by veterans of Israel's elite military technology units, the firm builds and backs startups across four domains — Cybersecurity, Software Infrastructure, Fintech, and Digital Health — and believes the greatest successes emerge at their intersections. Team8 pairs founders with capital, deep operating expertise, a community of enterprise CISOs and executives, and a hands-on venture-creation methodology it calls "success by design." It does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures Team8's corporate, portfolio, and insights web presence, surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio lead.

providers.name: TEDI
providers.description: TEDI (Tecnologia y Educacion Innovadora) is a Latin American EdTech platform delivering professional training for the construction and engineering industries under the motto "Mejores profesionales, mejores paises." It runs 150+ live and recorded courses each month covering BIM, VDC, Lean management, and project management, plus Autodesk/PMI-aligned certifications, an exclusive construction job board, a professional community, the EDI AI learning assistant, and a TEDICOINS rewards system. TEDI reports 50,000+ certified students across 18+ countries with 150+ expert instructors, and is backed by 500 Global. The company operates a consumer-facing web platform (tedivirtual.com / tedicomunidad.com) and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Tele2
providers.description: Tele2 is a leading European telecommunications operator offering mobile, broadband, and digital services across multiple countries. It focuses on innovative, affordable connectivity solutions for consumers and businesses, emphasizing sustainability and smart network technologies. The company operates in Sweden, the Baltics, and other markets, providing 5G, IoT, and wholesale services, and maintains a corporate website with extensive information about its vision, governance, and offerings.

providers.name: Texas Capital Bank
providers.description: Texas Capital Bank, National Association is the banking subsidiary of Texas Capital Bancshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: TCBI), a Dallas-headquartered full-service financial services firm founded in 1998 with roughly $31.5 billion in assets (FYE 2025). As a nationally chartered commercial bank it serves businesses, entrepreneurs, and institutions across Texas and the United States with commercial and business banking, treasury management, mortgage/warehouse finance, and investment banking. On the open-finance dimension the bank is relationship-first rather than developer-first: it markets treasury and ERP API integrations (including its ConnectNow embedded banking for Sage and NetSuite, direct platform integrations, and SFTP/XChange file transfer) but exposes them through partner onboarding with dedicated bankers, not a public self-serve developer portal. There is no public first-party developer portal, no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger, and no self-serve API signup. Consumer account and transaction data is made available to permissioned third parties through the Finicity (Mastercard) aggregator rather than a first-party API, which is the honest posture for most US regional banks under the voluntary, fragmented US open-banking landscape (CFPB Section 1033 and the industry FDX standard).

providers.name: TherapyNotes
providers.description: TherapyNotes is a HIPAA-compliant practice management and electronic health record (EHR) platform built specifically for behavioral health - therapists, psychologists, psychiatrists, social workers, and group practices. It provides interactive note templates and clinical documentation, scheduling with appointment reminders, a client portal, telehealth, electronic insurance claims and ERA, credit card processing, and TherapyFuel AI tooling. As of this writing TherapyNotes does NOT expose a public or partner developer API, webhooks, or documented programmatic interface; access to client, appointment, clinical-note, and billing data is through the browser application and manual exports only. This entry documents TherapyNotes as an API-relevant provider and honestly models the capability areas a behavioral-health EHR API would cover; the API surfaces below are modeled, not published, and no endpoints are fabricated.

providers.name: Tibles
providers.description: Tibles is a digital collectibles company building authentic, engaging collecting experiences on the Flow blockchain. Its Tibles Clubhouse platform hosts multiple consumer iOS and web apps built around licensed intellectual properties — including FuggClub (Fugglers), Sk8tibles (Skateboarding Hall of Fame), OneShots (Valiant Comics), Tibles Fraggle Rock and Seussibles (Jim Henson / Dr. Seuss), and Aggretsuko (Sanrio) — offering interactive digital trading cards and NFT collections with barter-style trading, chat, and community events. Tibles is a Certified Flow Developer and publishes open-source Cadence smart contracts and an IPFS desktop client, but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal. Backed by Multicoin Capital.

providers.name: Togal.AI
providers.description: Togal.AI is a Miami, Florida construction-technology company building AI-powered takeoff and estimating software for the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) industry. Founded by former U.S. Congressman Patrick Murphy out of his family's multi-generational construction business, the cloud-based platform applies computer-vision and deep-learning models to architectural drawings and blueprints to automatically detect, measure, count, label, and compare project spaces and features — reporting up to 98% accuracy against AIA measurement standards and reducing manual estimating effort by roughly 80%. Signature capabilities include the Togal Button (one-click automated takeoff), AI-powered image, text, and pattern search across plan sets, drawing-set comparison for change quantification, real- time multi-user cloud collaboration, and Togal.CHAT, a natural-language assistant that lets estimators query plans, verify quantities, identify errors, and draft RFPs. The product serves drywall, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, glazing, landscaping, painting, FF&E, and general-contracting trades, with documented case studies (e.g., Coastal Construction) showing multi-hour-per-plan-set savings and seven-figure annual ROI. Togal.AI's revenue model is SaaS subscriptions sold to estimators, subcontractors, and general contractors; there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release, and the only known third-party integration is Service Titan plus data export to Excel and downstream estimating tools.

providers.name: Triveni Bio
providers.description: Triveni Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing first-in-class antibody therapeutics for immunological and inflammatory (I&I) disorders, built on a genetics-informed approach to target discovery combined with advanced antibody engineering. Its lead program TRIV-509 is a dual-specific monoclonal antibody against kallikreins 5 and 7 (KLK5/7) for moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, addressing barrier dysfunction, inflammation and itch; TRIV-573 is a half-life-extended, second-generation bispecific that pairs the KLK5/7 mechanism with anti-interleukin-13 (IL-13) and entered Phase 1 in 2026. The pipeline also includes an antibody inhibitor of trypsin 1 and 2 for hereditary pancreatitis driven by PRSS1 mutations. The company launched with a $92M Series A, raised a $115M Series B, and closed a $65M Series C in June 2026, and was named a Fierce 15 biotech of 2025. Triveni Bio is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor: it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Vartega
providers.description: Vartega is a Denver, Colorado-based advanced materials company that produces recycled carbon fiber (rCF) from post-industrial scrap as a sustainable, lower-cost drop-in alternative to virgin carbon fiber. Its product line includes EasyFeed Bundles for thermoplastic compounding, chopped carbon fiber in multiple lengths and sizings, and carbon fiber reinforced polypropylene and nylon pellets. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company; enrichment probing found no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or event surface.

providers.name: Vattenfall
providers.description: Vattenfall is a leading European energy company focused on delivering sustainable, carbon‑free electricity and heat. Operating in multiple countries, it invests in renewable generation, energy storage, and digital solutions to accelerate the transition to fossil‑free energy. The company emphasizes innovation, customer‑centric services, and a commitment to climate goals, positioning itself as a major player in the European utilities sector.

providers.name: Vetic
providers.description: Vetic is a pet healthcare company in India operating a chain of full-service veterinary clinics and hospitals across 11 cities, paired with a consumer mobile app. Founded by Gaurav Ajmera (ex-COO OYO), Vetic offers in-clinic vet consultations, vaccinations, in-house diagnostics (blood work, X-ray, imaging, endoscopy), surgery, physiotherapy, 24/7 emergency and intensive care, grooming, an in-house pharmacy, pet supplies, pet insurance, video vet consultations, digital medical records, and 2-hour pet food delivery. It is a consumer (B2C) business with no public developer API surface at this time; this profile captures its public web and app footprint.

providers.name: Virtusa
providers.description: Virtusa Corporation is a global provider of digital engineering, IT consulting, and outsourcing services headquartered in Southborough, Massachusetts. Founded in 1996, the company helps enterprises across banking and financial services, insurance, healthcare, communications, media, and manufacturing modernize their technology through cloud, data, AI, and application engineering. Formerly publicly traded on NASDAQ (VRTU), Virtusa was acquired by Baring Private Equity Asia in 2021 and employs tens of thousands of engineers worldwide. Virtusa operates as a professional-services and delivery organization; it does not publish a public developer portal or external API program, so this API Evangelist profile captures its corporate and domain-security footprint rather than a consumable API surface.

providers.name: W. R. Berkley
providers.description: W. R. Berkley Corporation is one of the largest commercial lines property and casualty insurance holding companies in the United States, operating through more than 60 operating units in approximately 60 countries. The company operates across two business segments: Insurance and Reinsurance and Monoline. Subsidiaries include BerkleyNet (workers' compensation), Berkley Risk Administrators, and others. W. R. Berkley does not offer a public developer API, though subsidiary portals and agent portals provide limited policy, billing, and claims access.

providers.name: Wellster
providers.description: Wellster Healthtech Group is a German digital healthcare company founded in Munich in 2018 by Dr. Manuel Nothelfer and Nico Hribernik. It operates a digital health ecosystem that integrates a diverse range of direct-to-patient medical brands across Europe, combining synchronous and asynchronous telemedicine with value-based, evidence-driven care. Wellster emphasizes German-based medical supervision, data stored on German servers, and treatments aligned with established clinical standards, acting as a structured filter and patient-routing layer for the healthcare system. It is backed by HV Capital and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. Wellster does not publish a public API, developer portal, or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: WeRide
providers.description: WeRide (NASDAQ: WRD) is an autonomous driving technology company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Guangzhou, China. It develops Level 4 self-driving technology across a portfolio of five core products — Robotaxi, Robobus, Robovan, Robosweeper (autonomous sanitation) and advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS) — and operates its fleets in more than 40 cities across 12 countries. WeRide does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures the company's public web presence and domain-security posture as surfaced by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Whisper Aero
providers.description: Whisper Aero is a Crossville, Tennessee based aerospace company developing ultra-quiet electric ducted-fan propulsion that converts electricity into thrust with roughly 20 percent more efficiency and 20 dB less noise than conventional systems, scaling from 5 to 500 pounds of thrust and 40 to 400 knots for aviation, defense, and commercial applications. Backed by Kindred Ventures, Lux Capital, and Menlo Ventures. The company is a hardware manufacturer and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public developer API, portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Wildlife Studios
providers.description: Wildlife Studios is one of the world's largest mobile game developers and publishers, founded in Brazil in 2011. It builds and operates free-to-play games played globally, with more than 4.7 billion downloads across a portfolio of over 60 titles including Zooba, Sniper 3D, Tennis Clash, War Machines, and Sky Warriors, and runs a publishing division for third-party studios. Wildlife is a consumer gaming company: its public surface is player-facing games and corporate/careers content, not a developer platform. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, or MCP server. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and tracked in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Within3
providers.description: Within3 is a life sciences engagement and insights-management platform used by pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device companies to run virtual advisory boards, engage key opinion leaders and healthcare professionals, and collect, structure, and analyze scientific and medical insights across the product lifecycle. The company emphasizes AI-assisted insights management and secure, compliant stakeholder engagement. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio company; an enrichment pass found no public developer/API surface (no API, docs, or developer subdomains resolve and no /.well-known discovery documents are served).

providers.name: XDemics
providers.description: XDemics Corporation is a Caltech and City of Hope spin-out in San Rafael, California that develops High Density Cell Respiration (HDCR) cell-culture hardware for biomedical research and biomanufacturing. Its gas-permeable, tissue-mimicking Expansify cultureware — a 24-well plate and a single-well plate — and its Profusion bioreactor line under development let mammalian cells reach 10-100X higher densities than conventional flasks and plates, targeting CAR-T and cell therapy, viral vector production, stem cell and regenerative medicine, drug screening, and biologics workflows. The company sells physical laboratory consumables and instrumentation, distributed through VWR, and its biological testing laboratories sit at the Buck Institute in Novato. It is a hardware and life-science company, not a software company: it publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Zencore Biologics
providers.description: Zencore Biologics (zgbiotech.com) is a one-stop biologics CDMO (contract development and manufacturing organization) technology service platform serving pharmaceutical clients globally. Its services span large-molecule biologics development and production, antibody-drug conjugates (ADC), cell culture media, analytical and quality testing, and regulatory registration support. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm qiming; this profile is a corporate/biotech entity with no public developer API surface (no OpenAPI, well-known, or event/webhook interfaces were found).

providers.name: Zolvers
providers.description: Zolvers is a home-services marketplace that connects households with vetted, background-checked domestic and home-maintenance workers across Latin America, operating in Argentina, Mexico, Colombia, and Chile with a focus on Buenos Aires, Mexico City, Santiago, Bogotá, and Monterrey. The platform handles service requests, worker vetting, scheduling, and integrated payment processing for housekeeping and cleaning (one-time and live-in) plus home maintenance such as plumbing, electrical, gas, painting, air conditioning, general repairs, upholstery cleaning, and elder care. Backed by 500 Global, Zolvers is a consumer-facing platform with no public API or developer program at this time.

providers.name: 51job
providers.description: 51job (前程无忧) is one of China's largest online recruitment and human resource services platforms, operated by 51job, Inc. Founded in 1998 and headquartered in Shanghai, the company connects job seekers and employers through its flagship 51job.com website and mobile apps, alongside enterprise hiring services (ehire.51job.com), campus recruitment, HR outsourcing, training, and assessment offerings. Formerly listed on NASDAQ under the ticker JOBS, 51job was taken private in 2022 by an investor consortium that included DCM, Ocean Link, and company management. 51job does not publish a public developer API or open platform; partner and applicant-tracking integrations (for example via SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Posting) are arranged through its sales and support teams under contract. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and enriched from 51job's public web properties.

providers.name: Ablative Solutions
providers.description: Ablative Solutions, Inc. is a privately held, clinical-stage medical device company founded in 2011 and headquartered in Kalamazoo, Michigan, with offices in San Jose, California. It develops the Peregrine System, a percutaneous catheter platform that performs chemical renal denervation by infusing dehydrated alcohol into the perivascular space around the renal arteries to deactivate surrounding sympathetic nerves, as a treatment for systemic and uncontrolled hypertension. The Peregrine System Infusion Catheter holds FDA 510(k) clearance for infusion of diagnostic and therapeutic agents into the perivascular area of the peripheral vasculature; the Peregrine System Kit remains an investigational product under clinical study in the United States and has received FDA Breakthrough Device Designation for drug-resistant hypertension. The company is certified to ISO 13485. Ablative Solutions publishes a small corporate and clinical-information website only; it operates no developer program, public API, documentation portal, or machine-readable specifications.

providers.name: Agvend
providers.description: AgVend is an agricultural technology company founded in 2017 (Austin, TX) that provides digital engagement and commerce software to agricultural retailers, cooperatives, manufacturers, and distributors. Its white-labeled Grower Portal (web and mobile) gives ag retailers a branded storefront, CRM, sales enablement, digital billing, and integrated payments, while its Nexus product extends the platform to manufacturers and distributors across the ag supply chain. The platform integrates with major ag and energy ERPs, agronomy planning tools, and grain and financing systems, and exposes an API Access Driver that lets customers pull structured platform data into external reporting and BI tools such as Power BI. Backed by 8vc and Tidemark.

providers.name: Apiday
providers.description: Apiday is an ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) software platform built for private markets. It combines AI-powered automation with expert guidance so investors, fund managers, and portfolio companies can streamline sustainability reporting, comply with regulatory frameworks (SFDR, EU Taxonomy, EDCI, PRI, ILPA), automate ESG questionnaires and due-diligence requests, calculate GHG emissions against 3,000+ benchmarks, and turn ESG obligations into measurable value creation. The company reports that over 500 investors and 5,000 companies use the platform across private equity, venture capital, private credit, institutional LP, and infrastructure asset classes. Backed by Speedinvest. Apiday does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures the company's identity and public web surface.

providers.name: Arena AI
providers.description: Arena AI (now operating as Arena Physica) is a New York-headquartered applied-research company building what it calls "electromagnetic superintelligence." Its flagship product, Atlas, is an AI-powered hardware-engineering platform that pairs general intelligence with deterministic physics models to accelerate the design, verification, and debugging of electronic and RF hardware. Atlas ingests telemetry, schematics, CAD files, and firmware, then connects via API or MCP (Model Context Protocol) to engineering toolchains such as Jira, GitHub, Altium, Cadence, and SPICE simulators, and to test equipment from vendors like Keysight and Tektronix. Atlas RF Studio, the company's RF design tool, is currently in beta. The company operates from New York City (HQ), San Francisco, and Los Angeles.

providers.name: ARKO
providers.description: ARKO Corp (Nasdaq: ARKO) is a Fortune 500 company and one of the largest operators of convenience stores and wholesalers of fuel in the United States. Through its subsidiary GPM Investments, ARKO operates approximately 1,400 company-operated stores under 25+ regional brands across 30+ states, as well as proprietary cardlock locations and a fleet fueling network. In 2026, ARKO completed the IPO of ARKO Petroleum Corp., which operates its wholesale, fleet fueling, and petroleum distribution segments.

providers.name: Armadin
providers.description: Armadin is an AI-native cybersecurity company building the "Ultimate Attacker" — an autonomous, agentic offensive security platform that continuously identifies, proves, and prioritizes exploitable risk across enterprise attack surfaces. Founded in 2025 and launched publicly in March 2026, Armadin is headquartered in San Francisco and was co-founded by Kevin Mandia (founder of Mandiant, former FireEye CEO) alongside former Mandiant and Google Cloud Security leaders. The company pairs agentic AI "attacker swarms" with elite human red teamers to deliver continuous, 24/7 red teaming and prioritized remediation, framed as a response to AI-driven machine-speed "Hyperattacks." Armadin raised $189.9M in combined Seed and Series A funding led by Accel, with Google Ventures, Kleiner Perkins, Menlo Ventures, 8VC, Ballistic Ventures, and In-Q-Tel participating. It is currently a security services and platform company with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Astrus
providers.description: Astrus is an AI-powered microchip design company automating the physical layout of analog circuits. Founded in 2022 by Brad Moon (CEO) and Zeyi Wang (CTO) and based in Toronto and Waterloo, Canada, Astrus applies deep reinforcement learning — inspired by AlphaGo-style self-play — to generate thousands of manufacturable analog chip layouts in seconds, targeting high-speed SERDES interconnects used in data-center GPUs. The platform lets circuit designers submit a schematic and receive optimized layouts in minutes rather than the weeks of manual transistor-by-transistor placement that analog EDA traditionally requires. Astrus raised $8M in seed funding led by Khosla Ventures with participation from Pradeep Sindhu, 1517 Fund, Drive Capital and Alumni Ventures. This profile was surfaced as a Khosla Ventures portfolio company; Astrus publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: ATLAS Space Operations
providers.description: ATLAS Space Operations provides a federated ground network and software-as-a-service solutions for satellite operations, including launch and early orbit phase (LEOP) support, commercial, civil, and federal space missions. The company offers Freedom Ground Software as a Service™ and a collaborative platform to manage ground station resources, enabling customers to streamline mission control, data downlink, and operational workflows across a global network.

providers.name: Atlas5D
providers.description: Atlas5D is a healthcare technology company that develops an Ambient Measurement System (AMS) for assessing health and wellness through motion in any environment. Its passive, privacy-preserving sensor platform recognizes specific individuals, characterizes and quantifies their movement, and interprets daily routines to predict trends and assess risk of adverse events such as falls, without wearables, without transmitting video, and without storing images. Atlas5D serves individuals monitoring aging loved ones, assisted-living and other institutional care settings, and healthcare and clinical-trial teams that need clinical-grade, real-world evidence of patient movement wherever people live. Backed by Techstars.

providers.name: AVATOUR, Imeve
providers.description: AVATOUR (Imeve Inc.) is a 360-degree video collaboration platform that lets distributed teams conduct remote site visits, inspections, virtual tours, and location-based training without travel. It supports live real-time 360 streaming, synchronous shared sessions, and asynchronous on-demand recordings with annotations and reporting, serving manufacturing, construction, real estate, logistics, and retail. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; no public API, SDK, or developer documentation surface was found during the enrichment pass.

providers.name: Bicara Therapeutics
providers.description: Bicara Therapeutics is a biotechnology company focused on developing gene‑editing therapies for serious diseases. The firm advances innovative approaches to treat patients with rare genetic disorders and oncology indications, leveraging its proprietary platform to create precise, durable therapeutic solutions. Through collaborations with academic institutions and industry partners, Bicara aims to translate scientific breakthroughs into clinical candidates that address unmet medical needs.

providers.name: Bitbrand
providers.description: Bitbrand is a digital marketplace specializing in watch faces and collectible digital art. The platform showcases a variety of themed collections, ranging from kawaii characters to collaborations with artists and brands. Users can browse, purchase, and download watch face designs for smart devices, with detailed artist profiles and licensing information provided for each collection.

providers.name: Bleacher Report
providers.description: Bleacher Report is a digital sports media company headquartered in San Francisco and owned by Warner Bros. Discovery (Turner Sports). Founded in 2007, it delivers sports news, live scores, highlights, video, and community-driven commentary across the web and its iOS and Android applications, spanning the NFL, NBA, MLB, soccer, and other leagues. Bleacher Report maintains a public GitHub organization with open source engineering projects but does not publish a public developer API program; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Booktrack
providers.description: Booktrack provides immersive audiobook production services, creating original soundtracks, sound design, and synchronized audio for publishers, authors, and studios. Since 2011, they have delivered over 300 immersive titles, leveraging patented technology to enhance the listening experience with multi‑layered soundscapes and Dolby Atmos. Their services include full‑production, post‑production, narration, quality control, and studio facilities, partnering with global publishers such as Penguin Random House and Simon & Schuster.

providers.name: Canadian National Railway
providers.description: Canadian National Railway (CN) is the largest railway network in Canada and one of the largest in North America spanning over 20,000 route miles. CN transports goods across an integrated network linking the Atlantic and Pacific coasts with the Gulf of Mexico. CN offers shipper APIs, EDI integration, the eBusiness portal, and the CN ONE mobile app for shipment tracking, ordering, billing, and rate management.

providers.name: Carahsoft
providers.description: Carahsoft Technology Corp. is a master government IT solutions aggregator and distributor that resells software, cloud, and cybersecurity products from hundreds of technology vendors to U.S. federal, state, local, defense, intelligence, healthcare, and education customers across 220+ government contract vehicles. Carahsoft operates a partner-facing Developer Center that exposes partner integrations for accounts, quotes, orders, invoices, price lists, purchase orders, and resources; the underlying API is gated behind a partner account and is not a public REST API.

providers.name: Carnot Fleet
providers.description: Carnot Fleet (Carnotfleet) is a Seoul-based cold-chain technology company that converts non-refrigerated vehicles into temperature-controlled units in under 30 minutes using modular insulation panels and proprietary solid-state thermoelectric heat pumps, spanning frozen, chilled, and ambient ranges with humidity control. Its Adaptive Thermal Control System (ATCS) is an AI-based autonomous control platform delivering cloud-connected temperature monitoring at 10-second intervals. Carnot Fleet surfaces its capabilities through the CF Mobile Application, the CF Portal, and CF APIs that let customers integrate the ATCS into existing logistics solutions to detect, analyze, prevent, and discover cold-chain data points and reduce post-harvest to pre-retail loss across the supply chain.

providers.name: Catena-X
providers.description: Catena-X is the automotive industry's data space standard, published by Catena-X Automotive Network e.V. — a non-commercial German registered association founded on 15 May 2021 by BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, Bosch, SAP, Siemens, Schaeffler, ZF, BASF, Henkel, Deutsche Telekom and Fraunhofer, with backing from the German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Climate Action. It publishes a numbered CX-xxxx library of 77 standards covering how a supply chain exchanges part data, carbon footprints, quality records, demand and capacity signals and digital product passports without any participant surrendering its data to a central platform. Standards move forward together in named releases — Jupiter, Io, Saturn, Titan — gated by a Technical Committee for Standardization, and conformance is certified by nominated third-party assessment bodies including TÜV Rheinland and TÜV SÜD. The reference implementation is open source as Eclipse Tractus-X, and the network is operated commercially by Cofinity-X. It is the most institutionally complete industry API standard in Europe, and the one whose endpoints an outside developer can never call: in a data space every participant runs its own connector and registry, so there is nothing to call until you are onboarded, credentialed and certified.

providers.name: Century 21 Canada
providers.description: CENTURY 21 Canada Limited Partnership is the Canadian master franchisor of the CENTURY 21® real estate brand, headquartered at 1285 West Pender Street in Vancouver, British Columbia. The master licence for Canada was secured in Vancouver in 1976 — the first international franchise of the CENTURY 21 System — and the network today spans roughly 400 independently owned and operated offices from coast to coast. Century 21 Canada sits in the brokerage/franchisor layer of the Canadian real estate value chain: it does not originate listing data, it consumes it. Canadian residential listings are consolidated nationally by the Canadian Real Estate Association (CREA), which runs REALTOR.ca and the Data Distribution Facility (DDF®); franchisors and brokerages redistribute that member-owned MLS® content under CREA rules rather than publishing it themselves. Century 21 Canada's API posture is accordingly empty. As of a 2026-07-26 probe there is no developer portal, no API documentation, no published base URL, no SDK, no webhooks, no Postman collection and no machine-readable contract of any kind on century21.ca or c21.ca — both century21.ca and c21.ca resolve to the same WordPress consumer site whose terms of use name MoxiWorks LLC as the site operator, and whose property search is a hosted MoxiWorks Web Marketing System surface rather than a first-party API. Wildcard DNS on *.century21.ca and *.c21.ca returns HTTP 200 for every subdomain probed (developer., developers., api., docs.) by parking them all on eboat.moxiworks.com, so those 200s are a DNS artifact and not a developer portal. RESO is absent: no RESO Web API or Data Dictionary certification, no OData or $metadata endpoint, and no Universal Property Identifier reference appears anywhere in the public surface — consistent with Canada, where RESO certification is not the operative seam and CREA's DDF® is. The only genuinely public, anonymously callable machine-readable surface found is the incidental WordPress REST API route index at https://www.c21.ca/wp-json/, which is a CMS artifact, is undocumented by Century 21 Canada, and is deliberately not listed here as a product API. Agent- and franchisee-facing tools live behind the hub21.ca member login. This profile is therefore identity-only and honestly records a brokerage franchisor with no published developer surface.

providers.name: Cfgi
providers.description: CFGI (Corporate Finance Group International) is a global advisory firm providing finance, accounting, tax, risk, and technology services to corporations, private equity firms, and investors. With over 25 years of experience, CFGI offers private capital solutions, technical accounting, cybersecurity, ESG advisory, and strategic transaction support across multiple industries worldwide.

providers.name: Chakrinnovation
providers.description: Chakr Innovation manufactures retrofit emission control devices (RECD) and related clean‑air technologies for diesel generators, including the Chakr Shield, Dual Fuel Kit 2.0, DeNOx, DeSmog dust suppression, and real‑time emission monitoring systems. It also offers aluminium‑air battery energy storage solutions. Its customers are large corporates, industrial facilities, real‑estate developers, institutions and public‑sector organisations across India that need to meet air‑quality regulations.

providers.name: Citryll
providers.description: Citryll is a biotech company developing CIT-013, a first‑in‑class monoclonal antibody targeting Neutrophil Extracellular Traps (NETs) to treat immune‑mediated inflammatory diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and hidradenitis suppurativa. The company focuses on innovative therapies addressing the underlying biology of inflammation.

providers.name: CloudConvert
providers.description: Online file converter for audio, video, document, ebook, archive, image, spreadsheet, presentation

providers.name: ContractPodAi
providers.description: ContractPodAi, now operating as Leah, is an agentic AI platform that unifies contract lifecycle management, legal transformation, and source‑to‑pay automation. It delivers end‑to‑end solutions for legal, procurement, and finance teams, leveraging AI to streamline contract creation, analysis, compliance, and execution across enterprises.

providers.name: Copperlane
providers.description: Copperlane is an AI-native mortgage loan origination platform founded in 2025 by Brianna Lin and Athan Zhang and backed by Y Combinator (W26 batch). Its AI agent, Penny, behaves like a real loan officer: it guides borrowers through intake, pulls and reads borrower documents, verifies loan eligibility in real time, answers borrower questions live, and generates Letters of Explanation, delivering cleaner files to human loan officers so they can focus on closing loans instead of chasing paperwork. The San Francisco company raised a $4.1M seed round to modernize a mortgage origination process that remains largely manual. Copperlane is currently a demo-request business application and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: DATEV
providers.description: DATEV provides software and IT services for tax consultants, auditors, and small businesses in Germany. It offers a comprehensive suite of solutions for accounting, payroll, and tax filing, enabling secure data exchange between tax advisors and authorities. The platform supports integration via APIs for automated data transfer, compliance reporting, and financial analytics, helping clients streamline their workflows and maintain regulatory compliance.

providers.name: Dazzle AI
providers.description: Dazzle AI is an early-stage, pre-launch artificial intelligence company backed by Forerunner Ventures, with the stated mission of closing the gap between what people want and what they can do with AI. As of mid-2026 the product is invite-only: the public site collects waitlist sign-ups and publishes About, Jobs, Press, Support, Terms of Service, and Privacy Policy pages, but exposes no developer portal, API, documentation, or SDKs. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a lead awaiting a public API surface.

providers.name: Doma
providers.description: Doma is a technology company transforming the mortgage closing process with an AI-first platform for title insurance, title and closing services, and title alternatives. Doma's technology aims to dramatically reduce the cost, time, and complexity of one of life's most confusing and expensive experiences—the mortgage process—serving lenders, mortgage brokers, real estate technology platforms, and homeowners. Doma is backed by Bloomberg Beta, Fifth Wall, and Uncork Capital. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Edgefolio
providers.description: Edgefolio is a London-based financial technology company providing a digital capital-raising and fund-marketing platform for the hedge fund industry. Its SaaS products connect hedge funds, prime brokers, and institutional investors: Edgefolio for Managers offers a secure data-room and CRM for fund managers to control their data, manage investor relationships, and collaborate; Edgefolio for Prime Brokers delivers capital introduction and consulting tooling for cap intro teams; and Edgefolio for Investors is a fund screening and research platform with integrated market data. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Seedcamp. As of this enrichment pass Edgefolio publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs — the platform is delivered as a private B2B application accessed via demo and client login.

providers.name: EMERGENCES AI
providers.description: EMERGENCES AI, INC. (Emergences Labs) builds human competency models, assessment, and training solutions for the AI era, focused on defining the transformative skills whose value compounds rather than erodes as AI advances. Its products include NeoWork, real-world task assessments for recruiting and identifying top performers in AI-native roles and for reskilling; NeoHuman, deliberate-practice training that teaches professionals and students effective human-AI collaboration through real enterprise work; and an expert-curated Data offering of annotated professional workflow trajectories for agent reinforcement learning and domain-specific benchmarks. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes a public website with research, blog, careers, and legal pages, but does not currently expose a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Erudifi
providers.description: ErudiFi (ErudiFi Pte. Ltd., formerly Dana Cita Pte. Ltd., a Singapore-registered company) is an education-financing technology company on a mission to expand access to affordable financial services for students across Southeast Asia. It operates two consumer lending platforms: Bukas in the Philippines, which provides secure, integrated tuition installment plans in partnership with top colleges and universities, and Danacita in Indonesia, a peer-to-peer education-financing platform registered with the OJK that funds diploma, bachelor's, master's, and short-course programs. ErudiFi is backed by investors including 500 Global and Helicap. The company maintains a small public GitHub presence (internal tooling, a data-quality checker, and a Danacita UI kit) but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or MCP server.

providers.name: Freedom Robotics
providers.description: Freedom Robotics is a San Francisco-based robotics infrastructure company founded in 2017 that builds mission-critical software to help robotics companies build, operate, support, and scale heterogeneous robot fleets. Its cloud platform — sometimes referred to as Mission Control — provides device and fleet management, remote teleoperation (Pilot), live data streaming, smart alerts and notifications, fleet maps and heatmaps, deployment and service management, remote development, and analytics across cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, drones, and custom hardware. The platform is robot- and OS-agnostic, installs on a device in seconds via a single-line Freedom Agent installer, and integrates with ROS, ROS 2, Python, microcontrollers, Protobuf, Docker, and the cloud offerings of AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure. Freedom exposes a public REST API at api.freedomrobotics.ai covering accounts, devices, alerts, statistics, uploads, tokens, users, user groups, and zones, plus a Python SDK (freedomrobotics.link) with Link, MicroLink, message, log, image, and command-callback primitives for programmatic control and telemetry of large numbers of robots. The company has raised approximately $17M in venture funding and operates on a per-robot subscription model (publicly cited at roughly $300 per robot per month) with custom enterprise plans negotiated through sales.

providers.name: Gandeeva
providers.description: Gandeeva Therapeutics is a Vancouver, Canada-based precision-medicine and drug-discovery company that combines cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) with artificial intelligence and machine learning to visualize druggable transient protein-protein interactions at atomic resolution and design first-in-class molecular glues and engineered antibodies. Its structure-guided platform spans target prediction and validation (SPOTLIGHT), hit identification across virtual and fragment libraries (HYPERFOCUS), and cryo-EM-driven lead optimization (CRYO-CADD), with an oncology-focused pipeline of proximity-inducing small molecules. The company raised a $40M Series A and has run cryo-EM research collaborations with partners including Moderna and Zymeworks. Gandeeva is a private biotechnology company and does not publish a public developer API; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company/portfolio record.

providers.name: Gather AI
providers.description: Gather AI is a Physical AI platform for logistics that gives warehouses dock-to-dock inventory visibility. Cameras mounted on autonomous drones and forklifts capture inventory, and computer vision extracts structured data (LPNs, UPCs, lot codes, and free text) from the imagery. Its Sage AI engine analyzes operations and surfaces prioritized actions before each shift, while automated Workflows route tasks to the right personnel across integrated systems. The plug-and-play solution deploys in hours alongside existing warehouse management systems, serving manufacturing, healthcare, food & beverage, retail, and 3PL operations. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and bloomberg-beta.

providers.name: GetCraft
providers.description: GetCraft is a Southeast Asian creative and content-marketing marketplace, headquartered in Indonesia and backed by 500 Global, that brands itself as "The Creative Industry's Premium Directory." It connects brands and agencies with a vetted network of freelance creators and production partners ("Crafters") for content, video, design, advertising, and marketing work, spanning a talent Directory, a Jobs board, Managed project services, and a Community. Its companion publication, MarketingCraft, is a bilingual (English/Indonesian) content hub of articles, events, tutorials, jobs, and research for marketers and creators. GetCraft exposes no public developer or API surface; this record is an identity/enrichment profile.

providers.name: Glass Imaging
providers.description: Glass Imaging is a Los Altos, California AI company that enhances image and video quality on smartphones and imaging devices. Its GlassAI technology uses machine learning to reverse lens aberrations and sensor imperfections, extracting the full image-quality potential of camera hardware by removing noise, blur, and artifacts. The company ships a Custom Neural ISP that boosts camera performance up to 10x on edge AI-enabled devices, and a Co-Designed AI + Optics approach for space-constrained (SWaP) cameras. Glass Imaging sells to smartphone and device manufacturers and is venture-backed by Google Ventures, LDV Capital, Future Ventures, Abstract Ventures, Ground Up, and Insight Partners. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Glass Imaging does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Good Eggs
providers.description: Good Eggs is an online grocery marketplace founded in 2011 that delivers "absurdly fresh" groceries, meal kits, and locally sourced food to homes across the West Coast of the United States, primarily the San Francisco Bay Area and Southern California. The company curates a marketplace of over 6,000 items from local farms, ranches, fisheries, and independent food makers, and operates its own fulfillment and same-day/next-day delivery logistics. Good Eggs is a consumer-facing e-commerce and delivery business; it maintains a verified public GitHub organization for its engineering open-source and internal tooling but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or partner integration program. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead (GV, Index Ventures, Obvious Ventures) and enriched with the company's real public web properties.

providers.name: Gousto
providers.description: Gousto is a British meal-kit retailer founded in 2012 by Timo Boldt and James Carter and headquartered in Shepherd's Bush, London. It delivers recipe boxes with pre-portioned fresh ingredients and step-by-step recipes to homes across the UK, using proprietary data science, ERP, courier-integration and warehouse-automation systems to run its subscription operation. A SoftBank Vision Fund portfolio company, Gousto does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public digital surface (website, engineering blog, GitHub organization, and coordinated vulnerability-disclosure program) for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Green Eye Technology
providers.description: Greeneye Technology is an agricultural technology company that builds AI-powered precision spraying systems for weed management. Its retrofit hardware and computer-vision software integrate into existing farm sprayers to identify weeds in real time and apply herbicide only where it is needed, enabling Green-on-Green (weed-versus-crop) and Green-on-Brown (bare-soil) selective application that can reduce herbicide use by up to 90 percent while performing species-level analysis to help combat herbicide resistance. The company positions its dual-line system as a way for growers to cut chemical costs, reduce soil contamination, and address the roughly $100 billion in annual crop losses attributed to weeds. Greeneye is a Techstars-backed company and was added to the API Evangelist network from that portfolio; it currently publishes a marketing and product site but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Groundspeed
providers.description: Groundspeed is an insurance data and analytics company that pioneered AI-powered extraction and standardization of unstructured commercial property and casualty (P&C) insurance documents — loss runs, schedules of values, ACORD forms, and broker submissions — turning them into structured, analytics-ready data for underwriters, brokers, and carriers. Founded in Ann Arbor, Michigan and backed by Insight Partners, Groundspeed was acquired by Insurance Quantified, where its technology now powers the Intake, Workflow, and Intelligence products of an AI-driven underwriting platform serving commercial P&C carriers and MGAs. Groundspeed does not currently publish a public developer program, API reference, or self-service onboarding surface; this profile tracks its identity and public web properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Handl Health
providers.description: Handl Health is a healthcare price-transparency AI platform that turns the negotiated rates, gross charges, and cash prices unlocked by the Hospital Price Transparency and Transparency in Coverage rules into clean, usable pricing intelligence. Using proprietary AI models, Handl cleans and organizes publicly available machine-readable pricing files at scale and supplements them with claims, Medicare rates, and provider-directory data to build a holistic, validated dataset. Its products — Iris, AI-driven network analytics for benefits consultants to evaluate and compare carrier networks, and Arke, real-time cost tools that help plan members find high-value care — serve benefits consultants, carriers, third-party administrators, and employers designing alternative health plans. Handl is a Techstars- and StartUp Health-backed company. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public developer API or portal was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Happytal
providers.description: Happytal is a French healthtech and services company founded in 2013 and acquired by La Poste Group's health division (La Poste Santé) in 2022. It operates a hospital concierge service (conciergerie hospitalière) that combines a digital platform with on-site human concierges to simplify the administrative, medical and hotel journey of each patient. Services include in-room delivery, a comfort-products marketplace, private-room and admission paperwork assistance, and support for patients, their families and hospital staff across French healthcare establishments, alongside elder-care/EHPAD offerings and the careside.care business-to-business product for care facilities. Happytal exposes no public developer API; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record enriched from public sources.

providers.name: HavocAI
providers.description: HavocAI (Havoc) is a Providence, Rhode Island-based defense technology company building all-domain collaborative autonomy software and autonomous surface vessels for the U.S. Navy, U.S. Army and allied militaries. Its software suite pairs Havoc OS, an edge autonomy operating system for heterogeneous platforms, with Havoc C2 for one-to-many operator control, Havoc Insights for real-time sensor and telemetry analytics, and Havoc Connect, a resilient peer-to-peer overlay network for degraded or GPS-denied environments. The company builds the Rampage, Seahound, Kiakoa and Atlas autonomous surface vessels and is partnered with Hanwha on 200-foot ASVs. Enrichment probing in July 2026 found no public developer API, OpenAPI or other machine-readable contract, no developer portal or documentation, no published SDKs or packages, no MCP server, and no A2A agent card - the platform is delivered under defense contract rather than as a self-serve developer product.

providers.name: HERP
providers.description: HERP Inc. (株式会社HERP) is a Japanese HR Tech company whose mission is "採用を変え、日本を強く。" (change recruiting, strengthen Japan). It builds HERP Hire, an AI-era applicant tracking and recruitment management system (ATS) known for "scrum recruiting", alongside ジョブミル (Jobmill) for recruiting agents and HERP Career, a startup-focused job-change service. HERP Hire integrates with job boards and tools such as Zoom, Google Calendar and Slack, and exposes the "HERP Hire API" (generally available from 2026-02-03 to paying customers) for member assignment and application management. HERP was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Human Archive
providers.description: Human Archive is a Stanford- and Berkeley-founded, Y Combinator-funded data lab building foundational multimodal datasets for training AI and robotics systems to understand human movement and interaction. It collects and labels first-person video, RGB-D, audio, tactile, and motion-capture data from a network of 100,000+ contributors and 500+ industry partners, and provides dataset access to researchers and enterprise partners through a customer dashboard on request. The company is a B2B data infrastructure provider rather than a self-serve platform, and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation at this time.

providers.name: Humatics
providers.description: Humatics Corporation is a Waltham, Massachusetts microlocation company founded in 2015 by MIT professor David Mindell and led by CEO James Kinsey. It builds radio-frequency positioning systems — ultra-wideband beacons, RF-pulse ranging, radar and inertial sensors fused in software — that locate people, vehicles and robots at centimeter- to millimeter-scale precision. Two product lines are on sale today: MILO, a sub-millimeter positioning system for industrial automation and in-motion robotics, advertised as compatible with Yaskawa, Mitsubishi Electric, FANUC, Universal Robots and KUKA; and Mobility, a rail and transit portfolio covering the FOCUS track-geometry monitoring kit and the Humatics Rail Navigation System (HRNS), used on New York City MTA subway signalling projects. Humatics publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable description of any product API. Two rounds of probing humatics.com returned HTTP 404 for every /.well-known/ path, /llms.txt, /openapi.json, /openapi.yaml, /swagger.json, /api-docs and /graphql; *.humatics.com is a DNS wildcard onto one retired address, so api., docs., developer., portal. and status. resolve but time out on connect. The only machine-readable HTTP interface on any Humatics host is the WordPress REST API of the marketing site itself at humatics.com/wp-json/ — 375 routes across 19 stock core and commercial-plugin namespaces, exposing pages and posts rather than positioning, and so recorded as evidence rather than catalogued as a Humatics API. The GitHub organization github.com/Humatics is real and public, but 31 of its 33 repositories are forks of third-party embedded and robotics open source (Fast-RTPS, Fast-CDR, FreeRTOS, Orange Pi BSP, Yocto meta-layers, EIPScanner, donkeycar); the two non-forks are internal tools. There is no first-party SDK, client library or specification, and no package named humatics exists on npm or PyPI. Marketing material for the earlier KinetIQ OS / Spatial Intelligence Platform referenced an "extensible API", but no public interface for it was ever documented, and the news host that carried those announcements (now.humatics.com) no longer answers.

providers.name: Ineffable
providers.description: Ineffable Intelligence is an AI research lab founded by David Silver aiming to make "first contact with superintelligence." The company is building a "superlearner" that discovers knowledge from its own experience using reinforcement learning, without relying on human data, with the goal of rediscovering and transcending human inventions such as language, science, mathematics and technology. Backed by Bond Capital and Index Ventures, Ineffable is an early-stage research lab: at this time it publishes a mission/beliefs site, a founder blog note, and open roles, but no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable specifications. This profile captures the company's public identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Inscripta
providers.description: Inscripta, Inc. was a Boulder, Colorado digital genome engineering company founded in 2015 that built the Onyx benchtop platform — an automated CRISPR instrument, consumables, assays and a cloud-based Inscripta Engineering Portal that let scientists design and track millions of precise single-cell genome edits in one experiment. It licensed the MAD7 nuclease, acquired Infinome Biosciences and Sestina Bio in 2023 to pivot toward sustainable biomanufacturing, and merged with Manus (Manus Bio) in April 2025 to form an end-to-end bioalternatives company. Inscripta publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification; its only public developer artifact is BioCantor, an MIT-licensed Python genome-annotation library on PyPI and GitHub. inscripta.com now serves a single merger landing page pointing at manusbio.com.

providers.name: Intellitech
providers.description: Intellitech Corporation is a semiconductor test and design-for-test company based in Rochester, New Hampshire, specializing in IEEE 1149.1 (JTAG) boundary-scan technology. Its products include the Eclipse boundary-scan test development environment, the Scan Executive production test platform, and concurrent JTAG hardware testers such as the PT100 and JAF Pro, used for printed circuit board (PCB) testing, in-system FLASH programming, and FPGA configuration. Intellitech is an early Battery Ventures ("Battery Ventures I") portfolio company in the semiconductor sector. The company publishes product, legal, and customer-account pages on its website but does not expose a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or MCP surface.

providers.name: JPA
providers.description: Jakarta Persistence (formerly Java Persistence API / JPA) defines a Java specification and binding layer for the management of persistence and object-relational mapping in Java environments. It provides a standardized ORM framework that enables developers to map Java objects to database tables and interact with relational data using Java rather than SQL. Jakarta Persistence 3.2 is the current stable release with Jakarta EE 11, while version 4.0 is under development for Jakarta EE 12.

providers.name: JSF
providers.description: Jakarta Faces (formerly JavaServer Faces / JSF) is an MVC framework for building component-based user interfaces for Java web applications.
