The product combines three surfaces: a private, invite-only community of 3,000+ Chief People Officers (one member per company) who exchange confidential playbooks and benchmarks; an AI "Chief of Staff" that delivers personalized morning briefings and monitors market and talent trends; and a suite of workflow-specific AI agents for people analytics, performance insight, and peer benchmarking across the people function. The company was founded as Knoetic around a people-analytics product and has since consolidated its public brand on CPOHQ — knoetic.com now redirects to cpohq.com, while the customer application remains at app.knoetic.com. Knoetic has raised $50M+ from Accel, EQT Ventures, Menlo Ventures and angel investors. As of this enrichment pass Knoetic publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or API documentation; the platform is a closed B2B SaaS offering sold to enterprise people teams. It does publish a Vanta-hosted trust center and displays a SOC 2 Type II attestation.

providers.name: Levocred AI
providers.description: Levocred AI builds an AI operating system for structured credit operations, serving both credit funds (lenders) and loan originators from a single platform. Its product, Levo, ingests loan tapes, credit agreements, servicer reports and bank feeds, then automates analytical work a credit team would otherwise do by hand: generating lender-ready borrowing base reports, monitoring covenants for breaches in real time rather than at month-end, drafting credit analyses and investment committee memos, assembling lender packages, consolidating treasury and cash visibility across facilities, and maintaining a centralized facility workspace as a single source of truth. The company is a Y Combinator Summer 2026 company based in San Francisco and reports monitoring $500M in capital across 10+ facilities. As of this profile Levocred publishes no public API, developer portal, or API documentation; the product is delivered as a hosted web application.

providers.name: Lynk Global
providers.description: Lynk Global, now operating as Elveo, provides direct‑to‑device satellite connectivity, enabling mobile phones, IoT devices and machines to stay connected worldwide without terrestrial infrastructure. The company leverages S‑band spectrum and a network of satellites to deliver reliable, low‑latency service across 60+ countries, supporting enterprises, automotive, consumer and government use cases.

providers.name: Mitchell & Ness
providers.description: Vintage and throwback sports apparel brand founded in Philadelphia in 1904. Holds league-licensed agreements with the NBA, NFL, MLB, NHL, and MLS to produce authentic reproduction jerseys, snapback hats, varsity jackets, hoodies, and shorts. Acquired in February 2022 by Fanatics, Inc. alongside investors Jay-Z (Marcy Venture Partners), LeBron James / Maverick Carter (SpringHill Co), and Kevin Hart.

providers.name: Nanotech Energy
providers.description: Nanotech Energy is an advanced materials manufacturer that develops and produces graphene-based super materials and the energy-storage products built from them. Its catalog spans graphene powders, graphene oxide pastes, dispersions, conductive inks and conductive adhesives, silver nanowires, and non-flammable lithium-ion battery cells and packs aimed at home and grid energy storage, marine, household and electric-vehicle applications. The company also offers customer-facing testing, analysis and product development services to help customers scale a graphene formulation from concept to full production. It is a physical-goods manufacturer: it publishes a marketing and product website but no developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Nelo
providers.description: Nelo is a Mexican fintech offering consumer credit that lets shoppers buy now and pay later in bi-weekly installments (quincenas). Its mobile app (iOS and Android) provides instant credit approval, an in-app marketplace (Tienda Nelo), bill payment for utilities such as CFE, water, gas and internet, phone recharges, cash withdrawals, and a premium Nelo VIP tier with a physical credit card. Backed by Homebrew, Nelo operates primarily as a consumer mobile product and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation. Sector: fintech / buy-now-pay-later (BNPL).

providers.name: Neurona Therapeutics
providers.description: Neurona Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotherapeutics company in South San Francisco, California, developing allogeneic regenerative neural cell therapies that permanently integrate into neural circuits to treat chronic disorders of the nervous system. Founded on nearly two decades of stem cell research from the University of California, San Francisco, its lead candidate NRTX-1001 (rezanecel) is an inhibitory interneuron cell therapy delivered as a single, minimally invasive dose for drug-resistant mesial temporal lobe epilepsy, and is advancing through the NTE001 and NTE002 studies toward the Phase 3 EPIC trial. UCB completed its acquisition of Neurona on June 2, 2026. The company publishes no public API, developer program, SDK, or machine-readable specification; its public surface is corporate and clinical, not developer-facing.

providers.name: NG.Cash
providers.description: NG.CASH is a Brazilian digital banking platform built for the new generation (roughly ages 12 to 30), founded in 2021 and headquartered in Rio de Janeiro. Authorized by Brazil's Central Bank as a payment institution and electronic currency issuer, it offers a digital account with Pix instant payments, a personalized Mastercard prepaid and virtual card, bill payment, mobile top-ups, a savings feature ("Cofrinho"), allowance management, and a discount marketplace, plus credit products offered as a banking correspondent through partners such as BTG Pactual and QI SCD. NG.CASH is a consumer-facing mobile application (iOS and Android) with over three million active accounts; it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and enriched by the API Evangelist network from public sources.

providers.name: Noteworthy AI
providers.description: Noteworthy AI is a Techstars-backed company delivering AI-powered grid inspection for electric utilities. Its Noteworthy Inspect product mounts smart cameras on utility fleet vehicles and applies computer-vision and machine-learning analytics to automatically identify pole defects, inventory grid components, and assess distribution-infrastructure conditions during routine operations, without dedicated inspection crews. Use cases span asset inventory and inspection, lighting audits, storm-damage assessment, vegetation management, and joint-use equipment tracking, helping utilities cut inspection operating costs while improving grid reliability and safety. Customers include FirstEnergy, NextEra Energy, Exelon, Xcel Energy, Alabama Power, and Georgia Power; technology partners include NVIDIA, Dell Technologies, Esri, and EPRI. Noteworthy AI is SOC 2 Type II compliant. The company publishes no public API, SDK, or developer surface at this time.

providers.name: Opterrix
providers.description: Opterrix delivers real-time and historical weather and natural hazard intelligence to inform and automate key decision-making throughout the insurance value chain. Their high-performance APIs provide property-level data on perils such as wind, hail, precipitation, wildfire, and convective storms, supporting underwriting, claims, portfolio risk management, and moratorium verification workflows.

providers.name: Parcel Monitor
providers.description: Global parcel tracking REST API aggregating real-time tracking data from 1,000+ carriers worldwide, enabling e-commerce shipment visibility, delivery analytics, and webhook-driven notifications across 170+ countries.

providers.name: PharmaCCX
providers.description: PharmaCCX, operating as CCX (Contingent Commitment Exchange), is a digital market-access and pricing software company for the pharmaceutical industry, serving pharma manufacturers, payers, and health systems. Its enterprise platform provides a single source of truth for global pricing strategy and contract management through three products: CCX Planning (contract scenario planning, modeling, and analysis), Deal Admin (contract administration and pharma-payer coordination), and CCX Digital Negotiation (an invite-only deal negotiation tool). The platform is delivered as an invite-only enterprise SaaS terminal (marketaccess.ccxterminal.com) with Terminal and Sandbox environments; no public developer API, documentation, or portal is published as of this profiling.

providers.name: Playroll
providers.description: Playroll is a global HR platform providing Employer of Record (EOR), contractor management, and global payroll across 180+ countries. It runs local payroll, statutory benefits, and compliance for distributed teams, and offers a partner/enterprise integration surface - native HRIS connectors (HiBob, BambooHR), an "Open API" for bi-directional HR data sync, and custom/embedded integration builds. The developer API is partner- and enterprise-gated; sandbox access and documentation are provided to integration partners rather than published on a public developer portal.

providers.name: PlotAPI
providers.description: Automotive and property data API. The published surface covers US VIN histories and vehicle specifications, UK MOT records, auto parts fitment catalogues, vehicle valuations, and property listings for the UK and US markets, served as typed JSON over a single REST endpoint. Positioned for AI agents and for developers who would otherwise integrate several gated data sources separately. The product is real and live; what is not public is the interface — documentation, the API reference and key issuance all sit behind an account sign-in, and the machine-readable artifacts the site advertises are not currently served.

providers.name: PortF
providers.description: PortF is an AI-powered portfolio monitoring platform for private equity, venture capital, and institutional investors. It automates investment data collection and reporting by extracting qualitative and quantitative data from emails, documents, and 25+ connected systems (Excel, OneDrive, SharePoint, SSO, Salesforce, FIS Global, Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, and NetSuite), then consolidates financial, ESG, and impact data into a single source of truth with real-time analytics, IRR benchmarking, and agentic reporting workflows. Founded by Alex Lu and headquartered in London, PortF is backed by Techstars.

providers.name: Prizeo
providers.description: Prizeo is a charity fundraising platform that runs celebrity-driven online sweepstakes: supporters donate as little as $10 to a participating cause to be entered for a chance to win once-in-a-lifetime experiences and prizes with well-known names in music, sports, and entertainment. Campaigns run on behalf of charities and celebrity partners, donations are processed online (Stripe and PayPal), and winners are selected by raffle under published official rules. Prizeo operates as part of the Charity Network family of fundraising brands (alongside Charitybuzz) and was backed by Battery Ventures. It is a consumer-facing web application; the /api/v1 and /api/v2 endpoints observed on the site are private backends for its own React frontend rather than a documented, public developer API — there is no developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or public API program.

providers.name: Procyrion
providers.description: Procyrion, Inc. is a privately held, clinical-stage medical device company headquartered in Houston, Texas, developing Aortix, a catheter-deployed percutaneous mechanical circulatory support (pMCS) pump. Aortix is placed in the descending thoracic aorta and uses fluid entrainment to unload the heart and increase perfusion to the kidneys, targeting acute decompensated heart failure with diuretic resistance, prevention of acute kidney injury during cardiac surgery, cardiac unloading to limit myocardial infarct size, and longer-term chronic heart failure therapy. The device is under investigation in the DRAIN-HF pivotal IDE trial and is limited by federal law to investigational use; it is not approved for sale in any geography. Procyrion is a medical hardware and clinical company - it publishes no developer program, public API, SDK, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Schnitzer Steel Industries
providers.description: Schnitzer Steel Industries, now rebranded as Radius Recycling (acquired by Toyota Tsusho in 2025), is one of the largest manufacturers and exporters of recycled metal products in North America. The company processes scrap metal from automotive and industrial sources for use in steelmaking, operating 103 recycling facilities including the Pick-n-Pull auto parts chain and Cascade Steel Rolling Mills in McMinnville, Oregon. Schnitzer/Radius Recycling does not expose a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Script Health
providers.description: Script Health (operating as "Scripted", scripted.co) is a healthcare technology company that lets community pharmacies deliver clinical services and prescribe for common conditions, so patients can skip the trip to the doctor and get same-day care at their local pharmacy. Its platform covers appointment booking and walk-in intake, clinical service administration, medical claims and pharmacy billing (CLIA waivers, collaborative practice agreements), and patient-record management across services including chronic conditions, general and urgent care, vaccines, testing, sexual and reproductive health, and skin and hair health. Scripted also builds native integrations into pharmacy management systems (its first with Liberty RXQ) so pharmacies can run clinical services inside their existing PMS. A Techstars-backed portfolio company; the original scripthealth.co domain now redirects to scripted.co. No public developer API, SDK, or API documentation is published at this time.

providers.name: Secretome Therapeutics
providers.description: Secretome Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company (formerly NeoProgen, founded 2018) developing allogeneic, off-the-shelf regenerative therapies derived from neonatal cardiac progenitor cells (nCPCs). Its lead candidate STM-01, and the cell-free secretome STM-2, target heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF), dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) and Duchenne muscular dystrophy associated cardiomyopathy, and are in Phase 1 clinical study. The company publishes a corporate and investor-relations website covering its science, pipeline, team, patient/expanded-access policy and press releases; it publishes no developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Skout
providers.description: Skout is a location-based social discovery and dating mobile app that lets people meet, chat, and make connections with others nearby or worldwide. Operated by the ParshipMeet Group, Skout is distributed as consumer iOS and Android applications and an in-browser experience, and was an early a16z portfolio company. It is a consumer product with no public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or API surface; this profile captures its public identity and published legal/support pages. Added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment.

providers.name: Sunoco LP
providers.description: Sunoco LP (NYSE: SUN) is a master limited partnership and the premier independent fuel distributor in the United States, distributing over 15 billion gallons of fuel annually to approximately 11,000 Sunoco and partner-branded retail locations and operating more than 160 terminals. Sunoco LP is affiliated with Energy Transfer (parent of Sunoco GP, the general partner). On November 3, 2025 Sunoco closed its $9.1 billion acquisition of Parkland Corporation (announced May 5, 2025), creating SunocoCorp LLC, which began trading on the NYSE under ticker "SUNC". The Parkland acquisition substantially expands Sunoco's footprint into Canada and additional international markets, adding Parkland's refining, retail, and commercial fuels businesses to Sunoco's North American distribution network.

providers.name: Synovus Financial
providers.description: Synovus Financial Corp. was a Columbus, Georgia based regional bank holding company whose bank subsidiary, Synovus Bank, provides commercial and consumer banking, treasury and payment solutions (Synovus Gateway and the Accelerate AR, FX, Pay and Trade suite), wealth services and capital markets across Georgia, Alabama, Florida, South Carolina and Tennessee. Synovus combined with Pinnacle Financial Partners in 2026 — synovus.com states "Synovus and Pinnacle Financial Partners are now one firm" and investors.synovus.com redirects to investors.pnfp.com — so the surviving company is Pinnacle. Synovus publishes no public API contract: developer.synovus.com is a provisioned Akamai host that answers HTTP 403 Access Denied on every path from two networks, api.synovus.com does not resolve, and www.synovus.com serves no discovery documents. Treasury integration runs through partners — Gateway ERP (October 2025) is powered by Koxa — and the Maast subsidiary has been wound down.

providers.name: Theker
providers.description: Theker (THEKER Robotics) is a Barcelona-based robotics and artificial intelligence company whose stated mission is "solving 100% of physical work" — building humanoid and physical-AI systems it frames as "a power beyond human" and "the next frontier of robotics and intelligence." The company is at a stealth stage: its public site is a landing page and careers portal with product details deliberately withheld ("Details remain secured"). Its public GitHub organization (THEKER Robotics, Spain) works in the physical-AI/ROS 2 stack — forks of the ZED ROS 2 wrapper, NVIDIA cuRobo CUDA motion planning, and Meta SAM 3 perception. Backed by CRV. No public developer API, documentation, or SDK is published yet; this profile captures its identity and public surface pending a developer platform.

providers.name: Theorem
providers.description: Theorem builds machine-learning-powered credit underwriting infrastructure for consumer debt markets. Since 2014 the company has priced and purchased billions of dollars in loan volume, powering one of the longest-running investment programs in the market. Its products deliver instant, API-driven credit assessments to lending originators (Custom Loan Integration Programs, or CLIP), score default risk down to individual loan cashflows (Theorem Loan Score, or TLS), and package loans into credit products for capital-market investors (Securitization as a Service). The API is a private, partner-onboarded B2B integration arranged through the partnerships team; there is no public developer portal, published OpenAPI specification, or self-service sign-up. Theorem is backed by Initialized Capital and operates from Silicon Valley, New York City, and Dallas.

providers.name: United Refining Company
providers.description: United Refining Company is an independent, integrated petroleum company headquartered in Warren, Pennsylvania. The company owns and operates a petroleum refinery and a network of retail gasoline stations and convenience stores under the Kwik Fill and Country Fair brands in the northeastern United States. United Refining does not offer publicly documented APIs or developer resources.

providers.name: Vespucci
providers.description: Vespucci (Vespucci Analytics) is a product-analytics platform that helps teams understand why their users engage with a product. Rather than replacing existing analytics, it connects to the event data companies already collect in Amplitude or Segment (via Reverse ETL) and applies statistical and AI models to automatically surface the drivers of activation, retention, churn, and engagement. It provides 24/7 monitoring with automated alerts when behavioral patterns shift, user segmentation, and story-style dashboards, and can push identified segments to activation tools such as OneSignal, MailChimp, and Brevo. Founded in 2021 and based in Brussels, Belgium, Vespucci is backed by Seedcamp.

providers.name: WESCO International
providers.description: WESCO International is a Fortune 500 leading provider of business-to-business distribution, logistics services, and supply chain solutions for electrical, industrial, communications, and utility customers worldwide. WESCO serves over 150,000 customers through a network of branches and distribution centers and provides comprehensive digital integration capabilities including EDI, punchout, cXML, and API connectivity for procurement automation.

providers.name: Zipline
providers.description: Zipline is a South San Francisco–headquartered autonomous logistics company operating the world's largest commercial drone delivery network, with more than two million customer deliveries flown across the United States, Rwanda, Ghana, Nigeria, Kenya, Côte d'Ivoire, and Japan. Zipline designs, builds, and operates two end-to-end aircraft platforms: Platform 1 (P1, "Sparrow"), a long-range fixed-wing aircraft that launches from a catapult, parachutes payloads from altitude, and is used primarily for national-scale healthcare logistics — delivering blood products, vaccines, medicines, and lab samples to hospitals and clinics — and Platform 2 (P2), a short-range hybrid VTOL aircraft with an autonomous tethered "droid" delivery vehicle that lowers packages from a hovering aircraft directly to a designated point on the ground, enabling precision quick-commerce delivery from restaurants, retailers, pharmacies, and hospitals. Zipline's customer roster includes Walmart, OhioHealth, Michigan Medicine, Cleveland Clinic, Mayo Clinic Florida, MultiCare, Sweetgreen, GNC, Jet's Pizza, the governments of Rwanda, Ghana, Nigeria, and Kenya, and Japan's Toyota Tsusho, with the P2 platform actively scaling across the Dallas–Fort Worth Metroplex, Pea Ridge (AR), and expanding into Houston and Phoenix in 2026. The company also operates one of the largest civil autonomous aviation stacks in the world — proprietary detect-and-avoid, route planning, weather, fleet operations, and flight-control software — and in 2025 received the first-ever FAA Part 135 BVLOS (beyond-visual-line-of-sight) operational approval permitting drone package delivery without visual observers. Zipline is a privately held company; its revenue model is drone-as-a-service contracts with healthcare systems, retailers, restaurant brands, and governments. There is no public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, GitHub organization, status page, changelog, or self-service developer portal — integrations with customer systems (order management, EHR, WMS, dispatch) are delivered as managed enterprise integrations rather than as a public programmable API.

providers.name: Zymbly
providers.description: Zymbly is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) startup building a voice-first AI copilot for aircraft maintenance. Its AI agents automate the administrative half of a maintenance technician's day at airlines and MROs (maintenance, repair, and overhaul organizations): troubleshooting issues, looking up parts, retrieving technical documentation, and generating compliant paperwork so technicians can focus on the aircraft. Zymbly is a demo-led B2B product with no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable specifications at this time; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and enriched from the company's public marketing site.

providers.name: 45-8 ENERGY
providers.description: 45-8 ENERGY is a French exploration and production company, founded in 2017 and headquartered in Metz with offices in Lyon, dedicated to helium and natural (native) hydrogen in Europe. It is the first company in France and Western Europe specialised in the exploration and production of these two low-carbon subsurface gases, covering the full value chain from geoscientific exploration through production, distribution and recycling. In 2024 it delivered the first helium produced on Western European soil, and it operates RECYCL'He, Europe's first mobile helium recovery and recycling unit. Its exploration and production portfolio spans France (Fonts-Bouillants, Avant-Monts, Marensin, Beauvoir), Germany (Guhlen, Brimir), the Balkans and the United States (Humboldt, Fayette). In April 2026 Ad Terra took a majority stake in the company. 45-8 ENERGY is a physical-resources operator and publishes no developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable data surface.

providers.name: Adagio Therapeutics
providers.description: Adagio Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2020 to discover, develop, and commercialize antibody-based therapies for serious infectious diseases, with an initial focus on SARS-CoV-2 and other respiratory viruses. Its lead programs centered on monoclonal antibody candidates engineered for high potency and broad, evolution-resistant neutralization. The company was renamed Invivyd, Inc. in 2023 (Nasdaq: IVVD) and now advances antibody medicines such as PEMGARDA and the VYD2311 candidate. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) and added to the API Evangelist network. As a life-sciences therapeutics company it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures corporate identity and policy links only.

providers.name: ADC Therapeutics
providers.description: ADC Therapeutics SA (NYSE: ADCT) is a commercial-stage biotechnology company headquartered at the Biopôle in Lausanne, Switzerland, with US operations in New Jersey, that discovers and develops antibody drug conjugates (ADCs) for hematologic malignancies and solid tumors. Its approved product ZYNLONTA (loncastuximab tesirine-lpyl) is a CD19-directed ADC for relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, and the company is expanding it into earlier lines through the LOTIS-5 Phase 3 and LOTIS-7 Phase 1b trials alongside a preclinical and clinical ADC pipeline. It is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor: a 2026-09-07 probe of every host it operates found no developer portal, no public API, no SDK and no machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Admission Table
providers.description: Admission Table (admissiontable.com) was a study-abroad and overseas-education counseling platform founded in 2013 by Manish Katyan and Duleep Deosthale, offering real-time student counseling, university admissions guidance, scholarships, financing, and online test preparation for the SAT, GRE, GMAT, TOEFL, and IELTS. It was backed by 500 Global, NYU, and Aarin Capital, and was subsequently acquired by Azent Overseas Education. The admissiontable.com domain now permanently redirects (HTTP 301) to azent.com. This entry was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub; enrichment found no public API, developer program, or API documentation on either host, so no API artifacts were produced.

providers.name: Aera Therapeutics
providers.description: Aera Therapeutics is a genetic-medicines biotechnology company founded by a team of scientists, investors, and company builders to unlock the potential of genetic medicines through next-generation delivery technologies and precision payloads. Aera develops multiple proprietary delivery platforms — including Targeted Lipid Nanoparticles (tLNPs) and protein-nanoparticle systems — to broaden the application of genetic medicines across many disease areas, advancing a broad preclinical pipeline toward the clinic. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) and added to the API Evangelist network. Aera is a therapeutics company and publishes no public developer API, portal, or documentation surface; this profile captures its corporate identity and domain-security posture. Sector: life-sciences.

providers.name: Agworld
providers.description: Agworld is a collaborative farm-management platform - now part of the Semios Group and majority-owned by Telus Agriculture & Consumer Goods - used by growers, agronomists, and ag retailers to plan, schedule, record, and report on field activities. The product surface covers planning, scheduling, precision spray records, agronomic and financial insights, and compliance reporting. Agworld integrates with John Deere, Climate-style monitor data via Agworld DBX, plus Figured, PowerBI, Shed, CalAg, Frames, CART by FarmReady, and Mobble. The companion DBX product is a label, manufacturer, ingredient, and pest database (Greenbook). Agworld does not publish an open public developer portal; partner integrations are arranged through their team.

providers.name: Alem Health
providers.description: AlemHealth is an AI-powered teleradiology and medical imaging platform that unifies image acquisition, diagnostic reading, reporting, and analytics into a single cloud system used by 500+ radiologists across 20+ countries. Its product suite includes Connect PACS (cloud image archiving with an FDA-approved diagnostic viewer), FrontDesk RIS scheduling, a referring-physician Referral Portal, a patient QR-access app, and the AlemBox gateway and AlemHub reporting-server hardware. AI features cover automated report drafting, quality-assurance scoring, laterality-mismatch detection, and ICD-10 tagging, metered via an AI-tokens model. For providers, AlemHealth supports bi-directional HL7, FHIR, and API integrations plus standard DICOM connectivity to sync orders, patient demographics, and finalized reports with existing EMR/EHR and PACS systems.

providers.name: Applied StemCell
providers.description: Applied StemCell provides genome engineering platforms and services, including the TARGATT™ large knock‑in technology, CRISPR/Cas9, Mad7 gene editing, and iPSC‑based drug discovery. The company offers kits, cell lines, and cGMP manufacturing to accelerate research and therapeutic development.

providers.name: Aptos Orbital
providers.description: Aptos Orbital (legal entity Cryptosat, Inc.) is a space technology company, founded in 2021 and backed by the Techstars Space Accelerator, that builds integrated hardware for satellites and spacecraft. Its flagship Aptos Terminal combines space-hardened, radiation-tolerant edge compute (with proprietary SEU/SEL protection), persistent global satellite communications, and cloud connectivity to platforms such as AWS and Azure into a single device. The company advertises 5.5+ years of proven orbital operation, 99% global data coverage, and TRL9 readiness for LEO applications, with development licenses, engineering models, and flight models offered to spacecraft builders. Aptos Orbital was added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio lead; as of this pass the company publishes hardware brochures and a "start developing" onboarding form but no public API, SDK, developer portal, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Aquaexchange
providers.description: Aquaexchange is an IT solution company focused on transforming aquaculture through innovative IoT technology and data‑driven insights. Their platform offers farmers comprehensive, affordable tools to enhance productivity, sustainability, and resource efficiency in fish and shrimp farming. Founded in 2020, Aquaexchange provides services ranging from farm monitoring to data analytics, aiming to promote smarter, sustainable farm management worldwide.

providers.name: Arqit
providers.description: Arqit provides enterprise‑grade quantum security solutions that safeguard data against future quantum threats. Their platform enables secure communications at scale, offering quantum‑resistant encryption, key management, and cryptographic services for enterprises seeking to protect information from emerging quantum attacks. Arqit’s technology is built on quantum‑ready protocols and integrates with existing security infrastructures to future‑proof data protection.

providers.name: Artiospharma
providers.description: Artios Pharma is a clinical‑stage oncology company focused on DNA Damage Response (DDR) medicines. It develops novel cancer therapies targeting DDR pathways, aiming to deliver meaningful survival benefits to patients with limited treatment options. The company’s pipeline includes ATR inhibitor alnodesertib, Pol Theta inhibitor ART6043, and DDR‑i‑ADC ART21934, supported by a strong scientific team and investors.

providers.name: Arunabiomedical
providers.description: Arunabiomedical, operating as Aruna Bio, is a privately held biotechnology company based in Athens, Georgia. It focuses on developing neural exosome therapeutics for neurological diseases, leveraging a proprietary platform to cross the blood‑brain barrier. The company offers research products and services derived from human stem cells, supporting drug discovery and basic research.

providers.name: Arvinas
providers.description: Arvinas is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company (NASDAQ: ARVN) headquartered in New Haven, Connecticut, developing targeted protein degradation therapeutics using its proprietary PROTAC (proteolysis targeting chimera) Discovery Engine. PROTAC molecules are heterobifunctional protein degraders that harness the body's natural protein-disposal system to eliminate disease-causing proteins rather than merely inhibiting them, with a therapeutic focus on oncology and neurology. Arvinas developed the first FDA-approved PROTAC protein degrader, VEPPANU (vepdegestrant). The company was founded on research from Yale University and maintains research partnerships across the industry. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; Arvinas is a life-sciences company and does not publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Asgardian Village · Canadian house
providers.description: Asgardian Village · Canadian house is a merit-based community of makers ("a Canadian house of makers" — hydroponics, 3D-printed modular nodes, veteran outreach, direct-diplomacy doctrine) that publishes an A2A agent card for humans and AI agents. The site is a Grok App hosted by xAI on the asgardian-village.grok.me subdomain (the registrable domain grok.me belongs to xAI and redirects to grok.com). The only machine-readable surface is the A2A agent card at /.well-known/agent-card.json (protocolVersion 0.3.0, three informational skills: Moral Code briefing, Barracks path, Forge kit pointer). No OpenAPI, MCP server, llms.txt, OAuth metadata or developer program is published, and the card's declared JSON-RPC url is the website itself, which answers non-HTML requests with HTTP 500 — the card is a discovery document, not a served A2A transport.

providers.name: Aspoptoelectronics
providers.description: Aspoptoelectronics is a technology company specializing in the design and manufacturing of advanced optoelectronic components and systems. The firm focuses on developing high-performance photonic devices for applications in telecommunications, industrial automation, and scientific instrumentation. While detailed public information is limited, the company appears in secondary-market listings and industry databases, indicating a presence in the optoelectronics sector. Further research may uncover specific product lines, partnerships, and market activities.

providers.name: Beautylish
providers.description: Beautylish is a San Francisco based online beauty retailer and community, founded in 2010 by Nils Johnson, Vu Nguyen and Sameer Iyengar. It began as a community where beauty enthusiasts shared tutorials, reviews and product knowledge, and launched its own e-commerce storefront in 2012. Beautylish curates makeup, skincare, hair, fragrance, nails, bath and body, wellness and tool brands from around the world, pairs them with editorial content and makeup-artist guidance, and operates its own fulfillment, rewards (Beautylish Rewards), flexible payments and Zero Day Delivery programs. The company runs a first-party storefront rather than a developer platform: as of this profile it publishes no developer portal, no public API reference, no OpenAPI or other machine-readable contract, and no SDKs. Its public partner surface is a ShareASale/Awin affiliate program rather than an API.

providers.name: Bedrock
providers.description: Bedrock (Bedrock Ocean Exploration) builds advanced autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) and Mosaic, a cloud-native data platform that transforms how the world maps, monitors, and understands the seafloor. Its AUV fleet carries multibeam echosounder, side-scan sonar, magnetometer, and sub-bottom profiler payloads to deliver high-resolution geophysical survey data for offshore energy (wind, oil and gas, renewables), ports and harbors, submarine telecom infrastructure, defense, and scientific research. A Northzone portfolio company, Bedrock is an enterprise ocean-data provider; it publishes no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Biosplice
providers.description: Biosplice Therapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing disease-modifying therapies for osteoarthritis. Their lead investigational drug candidate, lorecivivint, aims to halt disease progression and improve joint function. The company provides extensive information about its programs, leadership, and scientific publications through its corporate website, offering resources for patients, researchers, and potential partners.

providers.name: Boss Digital Technology
providers.description: Boss Digital Technology is a digital transformation agency offering web design, mobile app development, performance marketing, and strategic consulting services. It helps brands scale through comprehensive digital solutions, emphasizing user experience, technology integration, and growth-focused strategies.

providers.name: BreezoMeter
providers.description: Environmental intelligence REST API providing real-time and forecast air quality, pollen counts, wildfire data, and weather information with street-level accuracy. BreezoMeter was acquired by Google in September 2022 and its technology is now integrated into Google Maps Platform.

providers.name: Bright Peak Therapeutics
providers.description: Bright Peak Therapeutics AG is a clinical-stage biotechnology company founded in 2018 and co-located in Allschwil, Switzerland (Switzerland Innovation Park Basel Area) and San Diego / Del Mar, California. The company engineers next-generation multi-functional immunotherapies for cancer and autoimmune disease, using a protein-engineering and site-specific chemical-conjugation platform to build multi-functional PD-1 inhibitors and cytokine immunoconjugates that combine novel and clinically validated mechanisms in a single molecule. Its lead program, BPT567, is a first-in-class PD1-IL18 immunoconjugate that entered a Phase 1/2a clinical trial. The company has raised a USD 90 million Series C led by Johnson & Johnson Innovation (JJDC) alongside Versant Ventures, RA Capital Management, Fidelity, Qatar Investment Authority, Invus, Venrock, KB Investment, Alexandria Venture Investments and Northleaf Capital Partners. Bright Peak is a therapeutics developer, not a software company: it publishes a corporate marketing site and no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Buddy
providers.description: The fastest continuous integration and continuous delivery platform

providers.name: Carezone
providers.description: CareZone is a consumer digital-health company (Care Zone Inc., backed by Obvious Ventures) offering a medication-management and family health-organization platform. Its mobile app lets people scan pill bottles to track medications, set reminders, log health readings such as blood glucose and blood pressure, and organize care information for themselves and loved ones, with a free medication delivery service and Medicare savings consultations. CareFlow, CareZone's pharmacy platform, automates traditional pharmacy workflows behind an ecommerce experience. The app reports over 5 million installs. CareZone operates as a consumer product and does not publish a public developer program, API documentation, or SDKs; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: CEEZER
providers.description: CEEZER (CEEZER Software GmbH) is a Berlin-based climate-tech enterprise platform for the procurement and portfolio management of carbon credits, Energy Attribute Certificates (EACs), and Sustainable Aviation Fuel Certificates (SAFc). The platform gives corporate sustainability teams access to a marketplace of more than 10,000 global carbon projects with transparent pricing and volume data, a proprietary risk-assessment engine ("Prism") that evaluates hundreds of validated data points per project, and audit-ready reporting for net-zero and decarbonization commitments. CEEZER combines expert climate advisory with enterprise-grade technology to help buyers plan, procure, and manage climate performance assets. Surfaced as a portfolio company of HV Capital and added to the API Evangelist network; the company operates a customer-facing web application but does not publish a public developer API or documentation at this time.

providers.name: CF Industries Holdings
providers.description: CF Industries Holdings is a Fortune 500 American manufacturer and distributor of nitrogen-based fertilizers (ammonia, urea, ammonium nitrate, UAN) and clean-energy products serving agricultural and industrial customers worldwide. CF operates one of the largest global ammonia production networks and is scaling clean (blue and green) ammonia for low-carbon energy. CF does not publish a public developer API program; programmatic data access is limited to investor-relations SEC filings feeds, press/news RSS, and partner EDI/B2B integrations with agricultural distributors, rail, terminal, and industrial customers.

providers.name: Chapter
providers.description: Chapter is a technology-driven Medicare advisory service (parent company Memoir, Inc.; insurance services via Chapter Advisory, LLC) that helps older Americans navigate retirement healthcare. Licensed advisors and self-service tools compare and enroll consumers across all major Medicare carriers nationwide, representing 50 organizations offering more than 15,000 products, and serving 500,000+ enrollees with a 4.9/5 rating across 6,700+ reviews. Chapter is HIPAA compliant, BBB accredited, and also ships a consumer OTC benefits app. Founded 2020 in New York City; backed by Addition. This is a consumer healthtech company with no public developer/API surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Cloudlexinc
providers.description: CloudLex provides an end‑to‑end personal injury management platform for plaintiff personal injury law firms. The software unifies intake, case management, client communication, litigation, and settlement workflows, and includes built‑in AI tools and optional paralegal services. It is purpose‑built for personal injury practices of all sizes.

providers.name: Configo Health
providers.description: Configo Health is a health technology company focused on integrating social determinants of health data into clinical workflows. It provides a platform that aggregates community health resources, enables data-driven decision making for providers, and supports compliance reporting. The company aims to improve health outcomes by bridging gaps between healthcare services and social care through advanced analytics and interoperable APIs.

providers.name: Corebridge Financial
providers.description: Corebridge Financial (formerly AIG Life and Retirement) is one of the largest and most established retirement and insurance solutions providers in the United States. Spun off from AIG in September 2022 in the largest IPO of that year, Corebridge provides retirement solutions, life insurance, fixed and variable annuities, and institutional products. The company is a leading retirement plan provider for K-12 schools, healthcare, government, higher education, and other not-for-profit institutions. Corebridge Financial does not currently publish a public developer API; participant and plan sponsor access is provided through dedicated portals.

providers.name: Custom Ink
providers.description: Custom Ink is a direct-to-consumer custom apparel and promotional products company that lets groups design and order custom t-shirts, hoodies, hats, drinkware, bags, and other branded merchandise through an online Design Lab, instant price quotes, and full-service order fulfillment. As of the review date Custom Ink does not publish a public or partner developer API - there is no documented, self-serve programmatic surface for products, designs, quotes, or orders. An internal API host (api.customink.com) backs Custom Ink's own web and mobile storefront but is private and undocumented, secured behind AWS API Gateway and Cognito. Partnerships are handled as commercial/business relationships rather than technical developer integrations. This entry is a gated stub - the logical APIs below are honestly MODELED from Custom Ink's public product surface, not sourced from published API documentation, and no endpoints are fabricated as if real.

providers.name: Daash
providers.description: DAASH is an AI-powered predictive commerce intelligence platform built specifically for the beauty and cosmetics industry. It combines consumer shopping panels covering 6M+ people with social and advertising trend data and enriched product attributes to estimate sales performance, market share, and emerging trends at the SKU level. DAASH delivers weekly competitive intelligence to beauty brands, manufacturers, and financial services firms so they can uncover category shifts, benchmark competitor performance, and spot growth opportunities. The company was founded at the intersection of predictive intelligence and consumer products by retail and data experts (Philip Smolin, CEO; Justin Stewart, CTO; Melissa Munnerlyn, CMO), and is a portfolio company of Bullpen Capital. DAASH is delivered as a hosted SaaS application (my.daash.co); it currently exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Docsify
providers.description: Docsify is a lightweight, no-build documentation site generator that turns Markdown files into a website on the fly using client-side JavaScript rendering.

providers.name: Ebbo
providers.description: Ebbo is an enterprise loyalty and promotional marketing technology company that helps brands build lasting customer relationships and grow revenue through engagement. Its platform powers paid, tiered, and engagement-based loyalty programs alongside promotional overlays such as sweepstakes, instant wins, contests, and user-generated-content campaigns, supported by real-time performance dashboards, purchase validation, and advanced privacy and security controls. Ebbo pairs this technology with full-service program design, creative, program management, data analytics, rewards sourcing, and customer service for brands including T-Mobile, Lowe's, and FULLBEAUTY Brands. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners.

providers.name: ecoplanet
providers.description: ecoplanet provides cloud-based, integrated energy management software for German mid-market companies. The platform combines three core functions: real-time consumption monitoring through meter integration with AI-powered anomaly detection and automated load-shifting on price signals; strategic energy procurement using algorithmic purchasing across spot markets, tranches, and power purchase agreements (PPAs); and automated ISO 50001 compliance documentation. The company reports customers achieve up to 15% consumption savings and ~13.9% average price advantages on energy purchases. Backed by EQT Ventures and HV Capital. No public developer/API surface was found at the time of profiling.

providers.name: Electra
providers.description: Electra (legal name Electrasteel, Inc.) is a Boulder, Colorado clean-industrial company founded in 2020 that is reinventing ironmaking. Instead of smelting iron ore with fossil fuels in a blast furnace, Electra uses an electrochemical process — an acidic leach plus electrowinning driven by renewable electricity — to dissolve a broad range of iron ores, including low-grade and previously uncommercialized ores, and plate out 99% pure iron at roughly 60°C while recovering high-value co-minerals and emitting oxygen. The modular design lets units be added as building blocks for rapid scaling and lets the process follow intermittent renewable power. Electra has raised over $200M from Rio Tinto, BHP Ventures, POSCO, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Amazon's Climate Pledge Fund, Capricorn and Lowercarbon Capital, runs a pilot plant in Boulder, and is building a demonstration plant in Colorado. It is an industrial manufacturer with no public developer program: as of this profile it publishes no API, developer portal, documentation, machine-readable specification, or /.well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Embark Studios
providers.description: Embark Studios is a Swedish game development studio creating innovative multiplayer experiences. Their flagship titles include The Finals, a free‑to‑play dynamic shooter, and ARC Raiders, a multiplayer extraction adventure. The company focuses on cutting‑edge technology, community‑driven design, and immersive worlds, aiming to push the boundaries of interactive entertainment.

providers.name: Endless West
providers.description: Endless West is a Detroit-based molecular spirits manufacturer that applies food and molecular science to create alcoholic beverages without traditional distilling or aging. The company operates a TTB-approved production facility offering bulk base spirits and ready-to-bottle liquids, turnkey and private-label packaged brands, pre-made concentrates, and contract co-packing and bottling services for other brands and entrepreneurs. Its proprietary Glyph Molecular Spirit showcases a sustainability approach that reduces water usage and CO2 footprint versus conventional distillation. Endless West is a consumer-products and manufacturing company with no public developer API surface; this profile was surfaced as a Partech portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Endovascularengineering
providers.description: Endovascular Engineering is a medical-device company developing minimally invasive thrombectomy technology for the removal of blood clots. Its lead product, the Helo PE Thrombectomy System, targets pulmonary embolism, pairing a small catheter profile with large-bore clot engagement via a self-expanding funnel and dual-action high-speed agitation plus physician-controlled aspiration for single-pass navigation of complex vasculature. The Helo system is investigational only and not commercially available. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners. The company publishes a marketing and clinical-overview website but no public developer, API, SDK, or technical-documentation surface.

providers.name: Enertiv
providers.description: Enertiv is a commercial real estate sustainability and decarbonization technology company serving owners and operators of large CRE portfolios. Its platform combines portfolio-scale utility data collection and ESG reporting (Report), asset-specific carbon planning that pairs AI recommendations with on-site equipment surveys (Decarbonize), and real-time monitoring with fault detection and operational optimization (Optimize). Additional workflow tools cover automated tenant utility billing and maintenance/work-order management, with integrations into property management systems such as Yardi and MRI. The company guarantees 100% utility data coverage — including tenant-controlled utilities — and has worked with 100+ large portfolios over more than fifteen years.

providers.name: Enlaza Therapeutics
providers.description: Enlaza Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company in La Jolla, California developing first-in-class covalent protein biologics for cancer and other serious diseases. Its proprietary War-Lock technology uses engineered unnatural amino acids to enable protein drugs — including antibody-drug conjugates and T-cell engagers — to bind their disease targets irreversibly, aiming for sustained target occupancy and a prolonged biologic effect with minimal systemic exposure across oncology and immuno-oncology applications. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes a corporate website but no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Enpal
providers.description: Enpal is a Berlin-based residential clean-energy company and one of Germany's market leaders in home solar. It sells and finances complete home energy systems — rooftop solar PV, battery storage, air-to-water heat pumps, EV wallbox chargers, and a dynamic electricity tariff — orchestrated by its Enpal.One+ smart energy-management platform, with flexible purchase and zero-down financing options. Enpal serves over 130,000 German households and operates business (business.enpal.de) and installer partner (enpal.pro) channels alongside its consumer offering. Backed by HV Capital and the SoftBank Vision Fund. This API Evangelist profile was created from a VC-portfolio lead; Enpal publishes a consumer website and customer portal but no public developer API surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Essence Ventures
providers.description: Essence Ventures is an independent, African American-owned media, technology, and commerce company focused on content, community, and commerce for Black women and their communities. Founded by Richelieu Dennis, it acquired Essence Communications (Essence magazine and the Essence Festival of Culture) in 2018, and its portfolio of lifestyle brands has included Afropunk, BeautyCon, and Essence Studios, reaching audiences across print, digital, video, social, and live events. Essence Ventures does not operate a public developer program or API; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company/portfolio lead awaiting further enrichment.

providers.name: Exotic Markets
providers.description: Exotic Markets is a decentralized options and structured-products protocol on the Solana blockchain, describing itself as the #1 options protocol on Solana and backed by Multicoin Capital. The platform lets users earn yield or buy call/put options through flexible structured products, including baskets of tokens, accumulators, and capital-preservation strategies with customizable payoffs and maturities. Access is on-chain via a Solana wallet (Phantom, Solflare) and the $EXO token powers staking, points, and protocol utility. Exotic Markets is a smart-contract DeFi protocol rather than a REST/HTTP API provider: there is no public OpenAPI, gateway, or hosted developer API surface; developer materials are limited to GitBook documentation, a GitHub organization, and community channels.

providers.name: Focal Point Procurement Solutions
providers.description: Focal Point is an AI-powered procurement orchestration platform for enterprise procurement teams. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, the SaaS platform sits on top of a company's existing S2P and ERP systems to centralize procurement data, intake, and workflows across six core modules: Request Intake Management, Procurement Activity Management, Sourcing Event Management, Supplier Relationship Management, Third-Party Risk Management, and Contract Lifecycle Management. It connects existing systems and data via API integrations, automates tactical no-code workflows, and provides total spend visibility, intelligent intake, and smart routing so procurement teams can focus on strategic work. Focal Point does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal; integrations are delivered through the platform. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Futureplay
providers.description: Futureplay is a Helsinki, Finland-based mobile game studio founded in 2015 that develops free-to-play games for a global audience, having released six titles for more than 120 million players including Merge Gardens, Battlelands Royale, and Idle Farming Empire. Backed by Creandum and now part of Plarium, the studio operates in the consumer gaming sector. Futureplay publishes no public developer API, SDK, MCP server, or developer portal; player-facing support runs through a Zendesk help center, and legal terms are hosted on the Plarium company site.

providers.name: Green Fusion
providers.description: Green Fusion GmbH is a Berlin-based climate-energy software company that provides an intelligent 360-degree energy management platform for the residential real estate sector (Wohnungswirtschaft). Its software digitizes and optimizes building heating systems: "Der Energiespar-Pilot" delivers digital boiler-room management and optimized operation of conventional heat sources (gas, oil, district heating, CHP/BHKW), while its AI platform for sector coupling (Sektorkopplung) integrates heat pumps, PV systems, storage, and grid connectivity for intelligent monitoring and control. The platform is TUV-certified under GEG section 71a. Green Fusion is backed by HV Capital and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a climate-energy provider; it operates a customer control platform (control.green-fusion.de) but publishes no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Haus Laboratories
providers.description: Haus Labs by Lady Gaga (formerly Haus Laboratories) is an American clean-beauty cosmetics brand founded by Lady Gaga. It first launched in September 2019 and relaunched in June 2022 with Sephora as its exclusive retail partner. The brand makes skincare-infused, high-performance color cosmetics and makeup — including its Triclone Skin Tech Foundation plus lip, eye, and complexion products — that are always vegan and cruelty-free. It sells direct-to-consumer through hauslabs.com and through Sephora. Haus Labs is a consumer packaged goods / beauty company with no public developer API; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record surfaced from the Lightspeed Venture Partners portfolio.

providers.name: High Mark Credit Information Services
providers.description: High Mark Credit Information Services (now operating as CRIF High Mark) is one of India's four RBI-licensed credit bureaus, headquartered in Mumbai. It maintains credit information on retail, microfinance, and commercial borrowers, and delivers credit reports, bureau scores, analytics, portfolio monitoring, fraud-detection, and origination-decisioning solutions to banks, NBFCs, microfinance institutions, insurers, and telecom providers. The bureau is best known for its microfinance credit information services and pan-India retail and commercial credit databases. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer portal or API specification, so this profile captures company identity and domain security posture only.

providers.name: Honda
providers.description: Honda Motor Co., Ltd. is a Japanese multinational manufacturer known for automobiles, motorcycles, and power equipment. Honda provides APIs for customer satisfaction programs, roadside assistance, vehicle services, and dealer integration.

providers.name: Hopscotch
providers.description: Hopscotch Primary Care is a value-based healthcare provider bringing relationship-based primary care to rural communities, with a focus on seniors on Medicare and Medicare/Medicaid plans. Operating clinics across Western North Carolina and beyond, Hopscotch pairs longer appointments and multidisciplinary care teams with same-day access and help navigating insurance. Backed by 8VC, CVS Health Ventures, K2 HealthVentures, Town Hall Ventures and others, it is a patient-facing care company with no public developer API surface; patient records are handled through an athenahealth portal.

providers.name: Inovia Bio
providers.description: Inovia Bio is a TechBio company delivering drug development strategy and evidence generation for biotech and pharmaceutical organizations, aiming to combine big-pharma impact with biotech speed. It pairs purpose-built platforms with advisory services to produce regulatory-grade evidence, covering clinical development planning and trial design, therapeutic product profiles (TPP), development, regulatory and commercial strategy, Integrated Evidence Plans (IEP/IEGP), Real World Evidence (RWE) for regulatory submissions, and clinical program rescue. Its Study Designer platform (diagity.inovia.bio) supports study design workflows. Inovia Bio is a Seedcamp portfolio company; no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation are published at this time.

providers.name: Jamba Juice
providers.description: Jamba (formerly Jamba Juice) is an American quick-service restaurant chain that blends fruit-and-vegetable smoothies, fresh juices, bowls, and boosts. Founded in 1990 in San Luis Obispo, California, it operates hundreds of locations and is owned by GoTo Foods (formerly Focus Brands). The brand runs a consumer website, mobile ordering apps, and a rewards program; it publishes no public developer API. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a trinity-ventures portfolio company.

providers.name: Kontoor Brands
providers.description: Kontoor Brands, Inc. is a global lifestyle apparel company with a portfolio of iconic denim and casual apparel brands including Wrangler, Lee, and Rock & Republic. Headquartered in Greensboro, North Carolina, the company designs, manufactures, sources, markets, and distributes its apparel products worldwide through wholesale, retail, and direct-to-consumer channels. Kontoor Brands does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation portal.

providers.name: Kovzy Co.
providers.description: Kovzy is a restaurant technology company with offices in Tbilisi, Georgia and Yerevan, Armenia, selling an all-in-one SaaS platform for restaurants and cafes. The product is built from three modules that share one back office - a website builder that gives a restaurant its own online ordering site with no commission on direct sales, a QR digital menu customers browse and order from by scanning a code at the table, and a point-of-sale system that consolidates orders arriving from delivery aggregators (Wolt, Glovo), the QR menu, and the restaurant's own website into a single queue, with kitchen management and recipe and cost tracking on top. Pricing is per module and quoted monthly in Georgian lari, and onboarding is self-service through a hosted signup that provisions a restaurant subdomain. Kovzy was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. It publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or API documentation as of this profile, so this entry describes the company and its partner surface rather than an API.

providers.name: KSAT
providers.description: KSAT (Kongsberg Satellite Services) provides high‑reliability satellite ground station services, data acquisition, TT&C solutions, and hosted infrastructure for a wide range of customers including small‑sat constellations, lunar missions, and launch vehicle telemetry. Operating a global network of ground stations, KSAT enables secure, low‑latency communications between space assets and ground operators, supporting both commercial and governmental space initiatives.

providers.name: Lane
providers.description: Lane is a workplace experience platform for commercial real estate, now operated as VTS Activate after VTS acquired the company. The product gives building tenants a single mobile and web app for keyless building, suite and room access, booking amenities and shared spaces such as meeting rooms, fitness studios and desks, inviting and checking in visitors, receiving building information, maintenance updates and alerts, and RSVPing to events or ordering and paying for retail and food service. Landlords and property managers use it as the tenant-facing layer over the VTS commercial real estate platform. The legal entity behind the apps is VTS LANE INC. and the joinlane.com application traffic is served by the VTS Activate platform at activate.vts.com. Lane publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI definition or SDKs; the product is delivered as a first-party mobile and web application backed by an internal GraphQL API.

providers.name: Lightberry
providers.description: Lightberry is a San Francisco robotics software company (Y Combinator Fall 2025) that builds conversational AI "personality" software for humanoid and quadruped robots. Its platform lets a robot listen, speak, see its surroundings, and act on natural-language instruction without the owner writing any code, emphasizing emotional intelligence, contextual awareness, and autonomy rather than a simple speech-to-text voice pipeline. Lightberry ships pre-installed on robots sold through its partnership with Unitree, and the company runs a manufacturer-compatibility program with robot makers including Fourier, Booster Robotics, and High Torque. Its published documentation today covers device setup (power-on, WiFi provisioning, starting a conversation) plus an MCP architecture note describing a Model Context Protocol server that routes tool calls to individual Lightberry devices, which each expose a REST endpoint. There is no public developer portal, API reference, SDK, or OpenAPI definition at this time.

providers.name: Loop Health
providers.description: Loop Health is an India-based health assurance and group insurance company, founded in 2018 by Mayank Kale and Amrit Singh and headquartered in Pune. It combines traditional group hospitalization insurance with unlimited primary care, telemedicine, wellness programs, mental-health counseling, and an Employee Assistance Program, delivered to employers and their teams through asset-light clinics and a member app. Backed by General Catalyst, Elevation Capital and Y Combinator, Loop serves 1,250+ companies and 950,000+ members across India. This profile was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company; as of this enrichment pass Loop Health publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Lottie
providers.description: Lottie is a UK-based later-life care marketplace that helps families and retirees find and fund the country's best care homes, home care providers, and retirement living communities. The free consumer service matches people with regulated care providers, publishes availability and pricing, and offers guidance from care experts alongside a large library of funding and care guides. Backed by Accel and General Catalyst, Lottie serves tens of thousands of families monthly across England, Scotland, and Wales. As of this enrichment pass the company operates a consumer-facing web platform only and publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal.

providers.name: MagicBus
providers.description: MagicBus is a vanpool management platform that helps employers, HR teams, fleet managers, and transit agencies rebuild and operate employee commuting programs. Through its MagicRide app, riders, drivers, and coordinators book seats, form dynamic on-demand vanpools, and crowdsource new routes, while reporting dashboards supply the data needed for program evaluation and transit-subsidy applications. Surfaced as a mobility portfolio lead of Version One Ventures and Y Combinator, MagicBus publishes no public API or developer program at this time; this profile captures its verified public web surface.

providers.name: MedAll
providers.description: MedAll is a UK-founded healthcare education platform on a mission to make medical education radically accessible. It hosts live and on-demand courses, conferences, workshops, webinars and training sessions for healthcare professionals, students and organisations, and provides event management tooling for registrations, feedback forms, certificates, abstracts, schedules and digital poster halls, alongside CME (continuing medical education), question banks and mobile apps for iOS and Android. The platform is used by clinicians and institutions worldwide. As of this enrichment pass MedAll publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs or webhooks; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture. Backed by Seedcamp.

providers.name: MEQ Solutions
providers.description: MEQ Solutions is an Australian agrifood technology company delivering what it calls the world's only end-to-end measurement of red meat quality and yield. Its integrated hardware-and-software suite — MEQ Probe, MEQ Camera, MEQ Live, and MEQ Insights — gives producers, feedlots, processors, brands, retailers, and food-service operators objective, real-time carcass and eating-quality data. Deployed across Australia, New Zealand, the United States, and Brazil, MEQ has completed over 10 million scans across 60+ deployments and reports a demonstrated 10x ROI. The company is backed by Insight Partners. No public developer API surface is currently published; the meqinsights.com portal is a customer login.

providers.name: Mettler-Toledo International
providers.description: Mettler-Toledo International is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Mettler-Toledo International API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Minerals Technologies
providers.description: Minerals Technologies Inc. (NYSE: MTX) is a New York-headquartered, Fortune 1000 resource- and technology-based company that develops, produces and markets specialty minerals, mineral-based and synthetic mineral products and related systems and services across two segments, Consumer & Specialties (household and personal care, specialty additives) and Engineered Solutions (high-temperature technologies, environmental and infrastructure), through brands including Specialty Minerals, Minteq, CETCO and AMCOL, with more than 110 locations worldwide. It sells physical products through direct sales and distributors and publishes no developer portal, public API, SDK or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Mochacare
providers.description: MochaCare is an AI-powered operations platform for home care agencies and care facilities, combining human virtual assistants with AI agents to run hiring, scheduling, and client-intake operations end-to-end. The company offers two products: Mocha Managed, a 24/7 managed service where its team handles hiring and scheduling, and Mocha Tools, an AI software platform featuring an applicant tracking system, automated shift scheduling, shift-coverage management, document collection, and growth analytics. MochaCare builds custom integrations with existing care-agency systems (WellSky, AxisCare, AlayaCare), plus hiring and communication tools (Indeed, RingCentral), but does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation. A Y Combinator portfolio company founded by Nick Walker and Pranav Uppiliappan.

providers.name: Model N
providers.description: Model N is a revenue management software company that has served the pharmaceutical and medtech industries for more than 25 years. Its cloud commercial platform helps life sciences innovators grow market access, optimize revenue, and maintain regulatory compliance across provider and payer management, US Government Pricing and Medicaid, global pricing and tender management, 340B vigilance, state price transparency, deal management, and its Intelligence Cloud and Data nSights analytics. Model N is enterprise SaaS with a customer support portal and knowledge center but no public developer API surface; this profile captures the company identity plus its published security, trust, and compliance posture.

providers.name: Morgan Lewis
providers.description: Morgan, Lewis & Bockius LLP is a global Am Law 10 firm with approximately 2,200 lawyers and 39 offices across North America, Europe, Asia, and the Middle East. The firm provides corporate, transactional, litigation, and regulatory services across energy, financial services, healthcare, life sciences, retail and ecommerce, sports, technology, and transportation, with widely recognized depth in employee benefits and executive compensation, fintech and financial services regulation, intellectual property, and M&A. Morgan Lewis does not publish a public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI spec, or machine-readable data product; its public technology surface is limited to its corporate website, an email-alert subscription managed through a Real Magnet (REACTION) marketing platform, and a portfolio of LexBlog-style practice blogs covering specific subject areas.

providers.name: Naviday Health
providers.description: Naviday Health is a Boston-based women's health technology company and Techstars portfolio company building clinical decision support that connects the continuous health data women generate every day from consumer wearables and patient-generated sources to the practitioners who need it most. Its LUCI Care platform surfaces actionable insights for clinicians between appointments, and the company partners with device manufacturers on wearable integration services. Naviday Health is HIPAA compliant and has been recognized by the Mayo Clinic Platform, StartUp Health, and MassChallenge. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, documentation, SDK, or well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Novi Connect
providers.description: Novi Connect (Novi) is an AI shopping optimization platform and data infrastructure for CPG and retail brands. It connects brands, certification bodies, and major retailers to verify, standardize, and distribute product data so products are accurately understood, ranked, and recommended by AI shopping systems and agentic search. Products include the AI Shopping Optimizer for SKU-level product-feed optimization and the Product Authority Builder for verified direct data distribution across retailers and marketplaces. Backed by Felicis. No public developer API surface is currently published; product docs are hosted on Notion and customer access is via login apps.

providers.name: Nurture
providers.description: Nurture is an EdTech company that turns children's screen time into skill-building experiences through an interactive storytelling app for kids aged 5-7. Built on the thesis that AI is mastering information while human skills — critical thinking, curiosity, empathy, creativity, and resilience — still need to be nurtured, the app delivers character-driven story adventures with practice-based learning, no in-app purchases, no ads, and no endless autoplay. It is COPPA-compliant and features licensed brands such as Care Bears, Crayola, and Pocoyo. Nurture is a consumer mobile product distributed on the iOS App Store, Google Play, and Amazon Appstore, sold as a $36/year subscription with a 7-day free trial. It is a Seedcamp portfolio company. As a consumer application, Nurture publishes no public developer API, SDK, or integration surface; api.nurture.is serves only an internal app backend.

providers.name: Ollin Bio
providers.description: Ollin Bio is a privately held biotechnology company developing novel therapeutics, organizing its work around defined therapeutic areas and a product pipeline of drug candidates in development. Backed by a16z, the company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead. As a research-stage therapeutics company, Ollin Bio publishes a marketing and corporate website but does not expose a public developer program, API, documentation, or SDKs at this time. This profile records the company's public identity and web properties; it will be re-enriched if a public API surface ever appears.

providers.name: OMG Network
providers.description: OMG Network (formerly OmiseGO) is a Layer-2 plasma scaling solution for Ethereum, providing faster, cheaper value transfer and settlement on top of the Ethereum root chain via a Watcher / child-chain architecture. Surfaced as a portfolio company of pantera-capital and added to the API Evangelist network. The project has largely wound down: the omg.network site currently resolves to a redirect loop and the first-party @omisego/omg-js SDK last published in 2022. Sector: crypto.

providers.name: Onsitedental
providers.description: Onsite Dental is a mobile and on-site dental care provider that brings full-scope oral healthcare directly to employers and their employees at the workplace. It operates three delivery models: fixed-site practices built inside client buildings, mobile dental clinics deployed to larger corporate campuses, and pop-up practices set up temporarily in conference rooms or amenity centers. Services span cleanings, preventive and diagnostic care, and full treatment delivered by dentists, hygienists, and specialists, positioned as an employee benefit for large employers and their benefits consultants. Onsite Dental is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no developer API, developer portal, documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Ovia Health
providers.description: Ovia Health (by Labcorp) is a digital women's and family health platform delivering evidence-based programs, personalized data insights, and Care Team support across reproductive health, fertility, pregnancy, postpartum, parenting, and menopause. It is offered to individuals through consumer mobile apps (Ovia, Ovia Pregnancy, Ovia Fertility) and to employers and health plans as a benefit, and its apps sync with consumer health platforms including Apple Health and Google Fit. Ovia Health does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API specification; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and reflects the honest result of an enrichment pass that found no public API surface, only a consumer/enterprise product.

providers.name: Pebble
providers.description: Pebble is a Silicon Valley electric-vehicle and consumer-hardware company that designs and manufactures the Pebble Flow, an all-electric travel trailer (RV) with an integrated battery, solar, and motor-assist drivetrain. The product line pairs the trailer with the Pebble mobile app for remote control and monitoring, offering features such as autonomous "Magic Hitch" coupling, remote-control positioning, automatic leveling and setup, and up to seven days of off-grid capability. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, Pebble sells direct-to-consumer under the tagline "Where Home Meets the Road." As of this enrichment pass Pebble publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or documented API surface; its only software touchpoint is the consumer-facing Pebble Control Center app.

providers.name: Pelage Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Pelage Pharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing regenerative medicines for hair loss based on hair follicle stem cell biology discovered by UCLA researchers.
