Its lead candidate, PP405, is a topically-applied small molecule that reactivates dormant hair follicle stem cells via a metabolic switch to stimulate regrowth, targeting androgenetic alopecia, drug-induced alopecia, and telogen effluvium; it is non-hormonal, non-invasive, and in Phase 2 clinical trials. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). It publishes a corporate site and a clinical-trials site but no public developer, API, or technical surface.

providers.name: Pilotly
providers.description: Pilotly is a media and content audience-testing research platform used by studios, streamers, and brands to test films, trailers, series, and advertising with targeted audiences before release. Its managed service pairs clients with expert research managers who handle survey design, audience targeting, and insights synthesis, while a Study Tracker guides each project through five stages (Requested, Setting up, Fielding, Analysis, Complete). Content is fielded through a secure, DRM-protected and watermarked video player across desktop, mobile, and smart TV. Pilotly is a managed-service SaaS with no public developer API surface; clients named on the site include Netflix, Amazon, Sony, Paramount, Warner Bros. Discovery, and Audible. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Prime Medicine
providers.description: Prime Medicine is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing a new class of differentiated one-time curative genetic therapies built on Prime Editing, a versatile, precise, and efficient gene editing technology that can search and replace disease-causing genetic sequences at their precise location in the genome without causing double-strand DNA breaks. The company is advancing a pipeline of programs across a broad range of diseases and, per its public materials, believes Prime Editing could theoretically correct approximately 90% of known disease-causing genetic mutations. It is publicly traded and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). This is a corporate/life-sciences profile: the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: RadiantGraph
providers.description: RadiantGraph is a healthcare engagement platform that turns fragmented health data into personalized member connections to improve clinical outcomes and reduce wasted spend. Its "Intelligent Personalization" product suite includes a Health Data Engine that ingests and enriches member records with 80+ social determinants of health, Smart Cohorts for identifying high-risk member groups, and Smart Spend for scoring members on clinical risk. The platform integrates with CRMs, contact centers, campaign engines, portals, and care-management systems, connecting claims data warehouses, clinical data repositories, and member-demographics sources. Backed by True Ventures. No public developer platform, API documentation, or SDKs were found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Rally Network
providers.description: Rally Network (RLY Protocol, stewarded by the RLY Network Association) is a permissionless, open-source, multi-chain web3 mobile toolkit for developers. It provides natively embedded, self-custodial wallets and gasless (gas station / ERC-2771 relayer) transactions so mobile apps can let users create wallets, transfer tokens, claim NFTs, and deploy or call smart contracts without handling gas or seed phrases. The toolkit ships as first-party SDKs for React Native/Expo, Flutter, and Unity plus TypeScript libraries and a hosted dashboard for API keys and configuration. Rally Network is the successor to the original rally.io social-token platform (creator coins), which decentralized in 2021 and wound down its consumer sidechain in early 2023; the RLY Network Association now maintains the open protocol and developer tooling.

providers.name: RayzeBio
providers.description: RayzeBio is a clinical-stage radiopharmaceutical therapeutics company headquartered at 5505 Morehouse Drive, Suite 300, San Diego, California, and since 2024 a wholly owned Bristol Myers Squibb company. It develops targeted radiopharmaceutical therapies (RPTs) built on the alpha-emitting isotope actinium-225, led by RYZ101 (225Ac-DOTATATE) against somatostatin receptor 2 (SSTR2)-expressing tumors including gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, extensive-stage small cell lung cancer and hormone-receptor-positive breast cancer, alongside earlier programs targeting glypican-3 (GPC3) in hepatocellular carcinoma and ACP3, plus paired diagnostic imaging agents such as [68Ga]Ga-RAYZ-8009. Its public web presence is a WordPress corporate marketing site covering discovery capabilities, radioisotope manufacturing, the pipeline, posters and presentations, leadership and careers; the company operates no developer program and publishes no API, SDK, or machine-readable specification, and is profiled here for network completeness rather than for an API surface.

providers.name: Recyda
providers.description: Recyda is a German software company offering an all-in-one platform for packaging sustainability and regulatory compliance. The platform centralizes packaging data, automates Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) fee calculation and declaration across 20+ countries, and assesses packaging recyclability against standards such as the ZSVR Minimum Standard and EN 18120. It supports EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) compliance, portfolio-wide assessments, and submission-ready reporting, turning weeks of manual compliance work into minutes. Recyda is trusted by global brands and is backed by venture firm Speedinvest.

providers.name: Rita's Italian Ice
providers.description: Rita's Italian Ice is a Philadelphia-area founded franchise chain of frozen treat shops known for Italian Ice, Frozen Custard, Gelati, and Misto, operating approximately 550-590 locations across the United States under the tagline "Ice Custard Happiness." The brand is privately held under MTY Food Group (acquired 2021). Rita's maintains a consumer-facing loyalty mobile app and a franchise development site, but exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, webhooks, status page, or developer portal at this time. The loyalty program runs on the third-party Punchh customer engagement platform, and the mobile app was developed with Relevant Mobile; the only network-facing endpoint (api.ritasice.com) is a private backend for the consumer app and returns HTTP 403 to unauthenticated requests.

providers.name: Rosebud AI
providers.description: Rosebud AI is an AI-powered game creation platform that lets anyone build and deploy playable 3D games and interactive worlds from natural-language prompts, a workflow the company calls "Vibe Coding" — you describe scenes, rules, and behaviors and an AI assistant named "Rosie" writes and applies the underlying JavaScript. The platform runs on a custom engine designed for AI-era game development, featuring deterministic WASM-based physics, native real-time multiplayer, instant link-based sharing, and a built-in "Juice API" for camera effects, particle systems, and spatial audio. Founded in 2019 in San Francisco by CEO Lisha Li (Ph.D. in machine learning, UC Berkeley), Rosebud AI is backed by a16z. As of this enrichment pass the company ships a hosted consumer product and publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK packages, MCP server, or developer portal.

providers.name: Seaport Therapeutics
providers.description: Seaport Therapeutics is a Boston-based clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing new medicines for patients with depression, anxiety and other neuropsychiatric disorders. Its proprietary Glyph platform — licensed from the Porter Research Group at Monash University — applies lymphatic-targeting oral prodrug chemistry so that more medicine reaches the bloodstream and brain while bypassing first-pass liver metabolism and reducing side effects. The clinical pipeline includes GlyphAllo (SPT-300), an oral allopregnanolone prodrug in Phase 2 for major depressive disorder; GlyphAgo (SPT-320), an oral agomelatine prodrug in Phase 2 for generalized anxiety disorder; and Glyph2BLSD (SPT-348), a pre-clinical non-hallucinogenic 2-bromo-LSD neuroplastogen. Seaport publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification; its public web surface is a corporate WordPress site plus a hosted investor-relations subdomain.

providers.name: Simplifyber
providers.description: Simplifyber is a sustainable footwear and materials technology company that manufactures shoe uppers and other components using a proprietary fiber-molding process. By casting products directly from a liquid, cellulose-based material it eliminates the spinning, weaving, and knitting steps and much of the cutting and sewing of traditional shoemaking, which it says lowers the CO2 emissions of a shoe upper by roughly 33x versus conventional methods. Its flagship Moon Shoe was developed with the fashion brand Ganni. Simplifyber is a Techstars-backed startup. It operates as a consumer and industrial manufacturer and does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Sionna Therapeutics
providers.description: Sionna Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: SION) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered at 21 Hickory Drive, Waltham, Massachusetts, working to revolutionize the treatment paradigm for cystic fibrosis (CF) by developing novel small molecules that normalize the function of the cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator (CFTR) protein. Building on more than a decade of its co-founders' research, the company advances a pipeline of first-in-class stabilizers of CFTR's nucleotide-binding domain 1 (NBD1) — the domain that carries F508del, the most common CF-causing mutation — including SION-719 and SION-451, alongside a portfolio of complementary CFTR modulators such as SION-2222 (galicaftor) and SION-109 designed to work synergistically with the NBD1 stabilizers. Sionna operates purely as a drug-development organization: its public web presence is a nine-page WordPress marketing site covering science, pipeline, careers, contact and legal material, plus a hosted investor-relations portal. It publishes no developer program, public API, SDK, webhook surface, or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Snowman
providers.description: Snowman Logistics is an Indian integrated cold-chain and temperature-controlled logistics company headquartered in Bengaluru, providing refrigerated (frozen and chilled) warehousing, cold storage, and distribution services across India. It serves frozen and chilled foods, dairy, seafood, quick-service restaurants, pharmaceuticals, and other perishables through a national network of temperature-controlled warehouses and a refrigerated transportation fleet. The company is publicly listed on Indian exchanges and was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the enrichment pass confirmed the company publishes a marketing/corporate website (snowman.in) but exposes no public developer, API, or well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Soccer API
providers.description: Soccer API (soccer-api.com) is a Spain-contacted vendor marketing live football data — fixtures, live scores, match events, standings, teams, players, line-ups, statistics, head-to-head, odds, predictions, historical seasons and a real-time WebSocket feed — to developers building sports, fantasy, media and betting applications. The site went live in August 2026 and publishes documentation, coverage and pricing pages plus a small tutorial blog. Re-probed on 2026-08-27, the product is announced but not shipped: every one of those three pages carries the vendor's own notice declaring its contents placeholders pending a production specification, the documented base URL is the literal example host https://api.example.com/v1, the coverage matrix names no real competition, all paid prices read "$XX", and there is no sign-up, console, key issuance or machine-readable contract of any kind. Access is requested by WhatsApp or email.

providers.name: Solu Therapeutics
providers.description: Solu Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, pioneering a novel class of antibody therapeutics that unlock cell-surface targets by combining small molecules with effector antibodies through proprietary linker technology. Its two platform technologies are CyTAC (Cytotoxicity Targeting Chimera), which links cell-surface targets to antibodies that kill pathogenic cells, and TicTAC (Therapeutic Index Control Targeting Chimera), which gives long-acting small-molecule agonists and antagonists antibody-like pharmacokinetics. Its lead program, STX-0712, is a CyTAC targeting the GPCR CCR2 in Phase 1 trials for chronic myelomonocytic leukemia, with additional oncology and immunology programs advancing. Solu is a portfolio company of the venture firm DCVC. The company operates as a drug-discovery and clinical-development organization and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or programmatic surface.

providers.name: Structure Therapeutics
providers.description: Structure Therapeutics (NASDAQ: GPCR) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in South San Francisco, California, developing novel oral small-molecule medicines for chronic diseases with significant unmet medical need. The company applies a structure-based drug discovery platform focused on G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) to design once-daily oral therapies, with lead programs centered on oral small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonists for obesity and metabolic disease. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Structure Therapeutics maintains a corporate and investor web presence, but no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Swell Energy
providers.description: Swell Energy is a residential clean-energy company that designs, finances, installs, and operates home solar, battery storage, and virtual power plant (VPP) systems for homeowners, businesses, and utilities. Its Swell Compass platform connects to home energy devices to monitor, report, and optimize energy use, and coordinates aggregated distributed batteries into grid services (GridRevenue programs) in partnership with utilities. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, the company operates a consumer web and mobile experience (Compass) rather than a public developer API; no developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or documented public API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: TaleMonster Games
providers.description: TaleMonster Games is a fully remote mobile game studio whose mission is to create games that surprise, challenge, and evolve with players. The team is united by a shared obsession for product craft and a deep love for games, and ships casual mobile titles to iOS and Android. Its debut title, Match Valley, is a casual match puzzle game published on the Apple App Store and Google Play. TaleMonster Games publishes no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or technical documentation; this profile captures its public company and product identity.

providers.name: Tallyman
providers.description: Tallyman is Experian's collections and recoveries management software platform, acquired from Talgentra. It provides an end-to-end collections management system for financial services, utilities, telecommunications, and public sector organizations. The platform manages customer segmentation, contact strategies, decision automation, and analytics for debt collection operations. Tallyman integrates with Experian Decision Analytics, CRM systems, billing platforms, and external data sources via web services. It is available as a hosted service managed through Experian's data centres.

providers.name: Tepali
providers.description: Tepali is an AI-native operating system for medical spas and aesthetic and wellness practices. It replaces fragmented point solutions with a single system of record, combining marketing intelligence, online scheduling, team management, patient CRM, clinical charting, and inventory. AI agents handle front-desk phone calls around the clock, generate real-time patient documentation such as SOAP notes, treatment summaries, and consent forms, and convert inbound leads into booked appointments. Founded in 2026 and backed by Y Combinator (W26), the company is headquartered in New York City. Tepali currently ships a hosted web application at app.tepali.com and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or documentation.

providers.name: Timehop
providers.description: Timehop is a consumer mobile application that resurfaces a person's past photos, videos, and social media posts as daily "memories," letting people celebrate what they were doing on this day one, five, or more years ago. It aggregates content from a user's camera roll and connected social accounts and presents it back on a nostalgic timeline. Timehop is made by Sincere Corporation, a family of consumer brands that also includes Punchbowl, Lovebird, and Memento. Timehop ships as iOS and Android apps and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile captures the company's public web presence for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: USA Rare Earth
providers.description: USA Rare Earth, Inc. (Nasdaq: USAR) is an American critical-minerals and advanced-materials company building a domestic mine-to-magnet rare earth supply chain. It operates a 310,000 sq. ft. sintered neodymium-iron-boron (NdFeB) permanent magnet manufacturing facility in Stillwater, Oklahoma, and holds the Round Top heavy rare earth and critical minerals deposit in Hudspeth County, West Texas. The company produces rare earth elements, oxides, metals and sintered permanent magnets for defense, automotive, robotics, industrial and clean-energy customers, with the stated aim of reducing U.S. dependence on offshore rare earth processing and magnet production. It is a materials producer and manufacturer, not a software or data company, and publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Vera Therapeutics
providers.description: Vera Therapeutics is a clinical- and commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company based in Brisbane, California, developing treatments for serious immunological and inflammatory diseases of the kidney. Its lead program, atacicept (marketed as TRUTAKNA), is a dual BAFF/APRIL inhibitor for IgA nephropathy (IgAN). Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment, Vera Therapeutics publishes a corporate and patient-facing website (veratx.com) but exposes no public developer portal, API, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface. Sector: life-sciences.

providers.name: Verana Health
providers.description: Verana Health is a healthcare real-world data (RWD) and analytics company that transforms de-identified electronic health records from more than 90 million patients across 50+ EHR systems into curated, disease-specific datasets for life sciences and clinical research. Its VeraQ population health data engine harmonizes, tokenizes, and links structured and unstructured EHR data, claims, and medical images using clinician-directed curation, natural language processing, and machine learning, delivering Qdata modules across ophthalmology, urology, and neurology. Verana partners with medical specialty societies (including the AAO IRIS Registry) to power trial design, site and patient identification, real-world evidence studies, and quality-measure reporting. The company is HIPAA-compliant and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of GV. No public developer API or developer portal is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Vivere
providers.description: Vivere Partners is a technology-enabled Managing General Agent (MGA) that provides specialty property and management liability insurance solutions for complex risks. Founded and led by CEO Christopher McKechnie, who brings more than 25 years of insurance industry experience, Vivere combines deep underwriting expertise with advanced analytics and alternative data to deliver faster quotes, tailored coverage, and competitive terms for niche insurance lines, while giving carriers and capacity providers greater portfolio performance visibility. The company raised $7.5 million in seed funding led by General Catalyst, with participation from Pathlight Ventures and Greenlight Re.

providers.name: VOO (now SideUp)
providers.description: VOO was an Egyptian logistics marketplace that rebranded as SideUp in December 2022, relocating its headquarters to Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. SideUp is a fully integrated courier marketplace that lets e-commerce businesses ship locally and globally from one dashboard, connecting merchants with multiple courier services alongside payment gateways, shipping API integration, warehousing, and fulfillment, with plugins for Shopify, Salla, and OpenCart. Backed by 500 Global, Launch Africa VC, Riyadh Angels, and Alex Angels ($1.2M seed). No public developer portal or API documentation is published as of July 2026.

providers.name: Weibo
providers.description: Weibo is a Chinese microblogging platform, often described as the Chinese equivalent of Twitter. It provides a social networking service where users can post, share, and interact with short messages, images, and videos. Weibo offers a range of data APIs for developers to access public posts, user profiles, trends, and analytics, supporting commercial and research use cases. The platform is operated by Sina Corporation and serves hundreds of millions of active users worldwide, making it a significant source of social media data.

providers.name: WhatsCookin'
providers.description: WhatsCookin' is a community cooperation platform — a "Cooperation Engine for Communities" — that helps people organize local and virtual gatherings and build healthy social connections. Members join or create Circles (community spaces for conversation and events), post Offers to gauge interest in potential events, and make Wishes that others can fulfill by hosting. Communities span wellness, community-building, language exchange, and food, with active circles in Tucson, Queens, San Francisco, and Oakland. It is available on the web and as native iOS and Android apps. Backed by Bloomberg Beta. There is no public developer/API surface at this time.

providers.name: 6 Waves
providers.description: 6waves is a global mobile game publisher founded in 2008 and headquartered in Hong Kong, with offices in China, Japan, and the United States. The company partners with independent game developers around the world to publish, localize, and operate social and mobile games, offering culturalization, product guidance, live operations, marketing, platform relationships, customer service and community management, technical support, quality assurance, and VIP management. 6waves is recognized as a pioneer of top-grossing mobile game publishing, particularly in the Japanese market, and is a portfolio company of Insight Partners.

providers.name: Abbycare
providers.description: Abby Care (Wellspring Care Inc.) is a family caregiving platform that helps families deliver professional care at home and get paid for it. It provides no-cost caregiver certification and CNA training, employment, payroll and Medicaid enrollment support, and an AI-assisted care-management platform (AbbyOS / AbbyAid) for real-time care documentation and insights. Backed by Khosla Ventures. The company operates a public marketing website but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile captures the identity and domain-security posture that could be verified from public sources.

providers.name: Acelerate
providers.description: Acelerate (acelerate.io) is a Santa Monica, California restaurant technology company founded in 2019 by former DoorDash operator George Jacobs. It launched as a virtual-brand and host-kitchen platform that let existing restaurants run additional delivery-only brands out of their idle kitchen capacity, and raised a USD 14.44M Series A led by Sequoia Capital in July 2021. The product has since moved up the restaurant supply chain -- the production application at app.acelerate.io covers purchasing from distributors, invoices and rebates, supplier offers, a menu manager, an order manager, sales storefronts, payments and bank accounts. Acelerate publishes no public developer program - no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI or other machine-readable contract, SDK, webhook catalog or MCP server - and the marketing site that once carried its brand and customer pages has been retired, with acelerate.io now redirecting straight into the authenticated application.

providers.name: Adasky
providers.description: ADASKY (Adasky Ltd.) is an Israeli automotive sensor company founded in January 2016 and headquartered in Yokneam, Israel, that develops and manufactures automotive-grade long-wave infrared (LWIR) thermal imaging cameras and the perception software that runs on them. Its flagship product, Viper, is a compact solid-state shutterless thermal camera with 50mK sensitivity, object detection to about 300 metres and living-being classification beyond 200 metres, sold into ADAS and autonomous-vehicle programs for pedestrian, cyclist and wildlife detection, free-space detection and automatic emergency braking in darkness, glare and fog. A second line, SharpVision, serves intelligent transportation, V2X and smart-city infrastructure. ADASKY publishes no developer program, API reference, SDK or machine-readable specification; its software ships embedded in the camera under commercial OEM engagement.

providers.name: Adore Me
providers.description: Adore Me is a New York City based direct-to-consumer intimate apparel brand founded in 2011 by Morgan Hermand-Waiche, selling bras, panties, lingerie sets, sleepwear, swimwear, activewear and loungewear across an inclusive size range (bands 30-46, cups A-I, apparel XS-4X) through adoreme.com, native iOS and Android apps, and a small physical retail footprint. The company built a proprietary e-commerce and merchandising platform rather than buying a hosted storefront, and is known for the Elite Box home try-on program, an annual Premier membership, and published environmental, social and governance impact reporting. Victoria's Secret & Co. acquired Adore Me for $400 million in cash, signing on 1 November 2022 and closing on 3 January 2023; Adore Me continues to operate as its own brand and its technology is being used to modernize the VS&Co digital platform. Adore Me operates no public developer program: it publishes no developer portal, no API reference, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind. Its storefront JSON backend under /api/ is an undocumented internal surface that rejects every unauthenticated request with a validation error. The public technical surface enrichment could verify is a well-formed provider-authored llms.txt covering the whole catalog, mobile app-association documents at /.well-known/, an Atlassian Statuspage, and a Bugcrowd vulnerability disclosure program.

providers.name: Agrim Wholesale
providers.description: Agrim Wholesale Private Limited (branded AGRIM) is a Gurugram, India based business-to-business e-commerce marketplace for agricultural inputs, connecting agri-input manufacturers and wholesale suppliers with small rural retailers. Founded in 2020 by Avi Jain and Mukul Garg, the company lists more than 30,000 seed, crop-protection, fertiliser and farm-equipment products from over 1,200 manufacturers and fulfils orders across a pan-India network. The platform is delivered to retailers and sellers as Android applications and a marketing website at agrim.app; as of this profile the company publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Agro Club
providers.description: Agro.Club is a US-based agtech company operating a digital grain trading and crop marketing marketplace that connects farmers with grain buyers. The platform offers competitive bids for corn, wheat, soybeans and other grains, along with logistics (truck and rail transportation), quality control, financing, and market insights. Farmers can transact through cash, FOB or delivered, and basis contracts, plus a Firm Offer price-target monitoring service. Agro.Club serves tens of thousands of farmers and grain companies across the largest agricultural hubs. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest and added to the API Evangelist network. Agro.Club does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or documentation; its api.agro.club host is a private backend that serves the company's own applications.

providers.name: Alinia Ai
providers.description: Alinia is an AI compliance and control platform that helps enterprises deploy large language models and AI agents safely and in compliance with regulations, making AI systems "compliant by design" through regulation-informed control layers. The platform is built around three products: an Evaluation Engine that tests AI systems against company policies and regulatory standards (compliance red teaming), Guardrails that enforce compliance in real time — including a proprietary multilingual RAG Guard model that blocks hallucinations and irrelevance — and Monitoring that provides automated auditing, full traceability, and compliance reporting of AI activity. Alinia is model-agnostic and multilingual, targeting financial services, healthcare, and other heavily regulated industries, with named customers including Banco Santander and Origin Financial. The company was co-founded by Ariadna (CEO, previously Head of ML Platform at Twitter and Director of Development at IBM Watson) and Carlos (COO, previously AI Counsel at Hugging Face), operates offices in Barcelona, Valencia, New York, and Pittsburgh, and is backed by Speedinvest. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; no public API, OpenAPI, or developer portal is currently published.

providers.name: Alterest
providers.description: Alterest is the operating platform for asset-based finance (ABF), giving credit funds, banks, specialty lenders, and loan originators verification-first workflows, a unified data model, and AI-assisted controls over capital deployment, SPV operations, and asset origination. The platform digitizes facility management, borrowing-base calculations, trigger and covenant monitoring, multi-party workflows, and automated investor reporting, while running daily verification, tape-to-collections matching, integrity checks, and double-pledge detection to prevent fraud. It replaces fragmented spreadsheets and email with a system of record, portfolio analytics, immutable audit trails, and SFTP plus API data feeds to lender systems. Founded in 2016 and based in London, Alterest oversees $15B+ in capital across 250+ transactions, 9+ asset classes, and 4+ regions (US, UK, EU, APAC), and is backed by Seedcamp.

providers.name: Apollotherapeutics
providers.description: Apollotherapeutics is a portfolio biopharmaceutical company focused on translating breakthroughs in biology and basic medical research into innovative medicines. With over 20 active therapeutic programs across multiple disease areas, it operates in Cambridge, Oxford, Boston, and Chicago, backed by specialist investors. The company offers a scalable R&D platform and in-licenses clinical-stage programs to accelerate growth.

providers.name: Arya
providers.description: Arya.ai provides enterprise‑grade AI solutions for banking, insurance and lending, offering an API platform (Apex), AI models, and tools for cash‑flow forecasting, document processing, and more. The company aims to democratize AI innovation, delivering scalable, secure APIs and an AI operating system to help businesses integrate advanced intelligence into their workflows.

providers.name: Asap Work
providers.description: Asap.work is a next-generation temporary staffing, permanent placement, and freelance recruitment platform for the French construction and skilled-trades sector (BTP - Batiment et Travaux Publics). It connects tradespeople with short-term missions, permanent roles, and freelance projects through a mobile app and a network of consultants, and layers on worker benefits such as housing assistance, medical consultations, training via asap.academy, and wage advances. The company is backed by speedinvest and is expanding toward the United States. Asap.work publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and, on enrichment, was confirmed to have no machine-readable API surface (searched 2026-07-18).

providers.name: B2X
providers.description: B2X is a Munich-founded hardware lifecycle orchestration company that manages the complete service journey of electronic devices for global brands and operators — from warehousing, staging and onsite deployment through customer support, maintenance and repair, returns management, refurbishment and recycling. Its proprietary B2XONE platform combines ONE Connect (self-service customer portals with track & trace and appointment booking), ONE Service (operations management for repair, warehouse, inventory and logistics) and ONE Analytics (real-time KPIs and predictive insights), delivered through a network of 155+ certified service partners across 25+ countries. B2X serves mobile and consumer electronics, retail automation, B2B/enterprise and mission-critical segments. As of this profile, B2X does not publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Baller League
providers.description: Baller League is a small-sided (six-a-side) football entertainment league and media format founded in Germany that bills itself as "a new era of football, created for the streets by the streets." Teams are captained by professional footballers, influencers, and streamers, with matches played under a fast-paced ruleset and distributed primarily through live streaming and social video (Twitch, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram) rather than traditional broadcast. The organization has expanded from Germany into the United Kingdom and United States and is running its fourth season. It is a consumer sports-media and entertainment brand; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer program. Backed by EQT Ventures and tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company.

providers.name: Beaubble
providers.description: Beaubble is a community-driven beauty commerce platform that lets creators launch their own customized, premium beauty brands and products by engaging their audiences. The company runs a direct-to-consumer storefront at beaubble.com featuring creator-led lines from talent such as Teni Panosian, Elsa Hosk, Shanina Shaik, Abbie Herbert, Rudi Berry, and Avrey Ovard, selling items like lip stains, freckle pens, and curated bundles. Backed by 500 Global, Beaubble is a consumer e-commerce brand with no public developer API surface; this profile was created by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline and captures the company's public web presence and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Beyond Aero
providers.description: Beyond Aero is a French aerospace company building the world's first electric business aircraft powered by hydrogen propulsion. Its flagship aircraft, "One", is designed to fly more than 800 nautical miles with zero in-flight carbon emissions, targeting the light business-jet market. The company pairs rapid prototyping and iterative aircraft design with in-house engineering tools such as HADES (Hydrogen Aircraft Data Exploration Software). Backed by Initialized Capital, Beyond Aero is a frontier-tech hardware startup rather than an API provider; it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface at this time. This profile was surfaced from a VC portfolio and enriched with company identity and web/domain-security signals.

providers.name: Biofourmispteltd
providers.description: Biofourmis is a digital health company that leverages AI and advanced analytics to deliver personalized, real‑time care solutions. It provides a platform for remote patient monitoring, predictive health insights, and in‑home care services, helping healthcare providers improve outcomes and reduce costs. The company focuses on integrating wearable data, clinical data, and AI models to enable proactive health management across chronic disease, post‑acute care, and wellness programs.

providers.name: BIT ODD
providers.description: BIT ODD is a Helsinki-based mobile game studio founded in 2019 by former Supercell creative leads Lasse Louhento, Taneli Oksama, and Jani Lintunen. The studio hand-crafts casual mobile games driven by feeling and a sense of wonder rather than aggressive monetization, explicitly rejecting ad-spam and dark-pattern design. Backed by Index Ventures, Griffin Gaming Partners, and Makers Fund across a EUR 5M seed and a EUR 17M round, BIT ODD is a consumer entertainment company with no public developer platform, API, or SDK surface; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a portfolio lead and carries only the artifacts that can be honestly probed from its public web presence (domain security, legal pages).

providers.name: Blau
providers.description: Blau (Blau Corp) is a waste-management operating system for haulers (gestores), final-destination facilities, and government regulators across Mexico, Colombia, and Spain. The SaaS platform delivers AI-assisted route optimization, route-level profitability analysis, automated RP and RPBI hazardous- and biological-infectious-waste manifests, online collection booking, and end-to-end traceability, plus the Blau Driver mobile app for field crews. Founded in Guadalajara, Mexico in 2021 and backed by 500 Global (LatAm B17 batch), Blau integrates with SAT/CFDI, SEMARNAT, SAP/ERP, QuickBooks, WhatsApp, fleet GPS, and Power BI. Blau does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation.

providers.name: Bliq
providers.description: Bliq is a Berlin-based premium driverless-car subscription service rolling out across Europe. Instead of owning a car or paying per ride, members subscribe monthly to a private autonomous vehicle that Bliq charges, cleans, insures, maintains, and parks on their behalf. Cars are booked for time windows (hours or days) rather than single trips, every journey is remotely supervised by licensed local operators, and there is no surge pricing. Backed by Speedinvest, Bliq positions itself as "ownership without ownership." The company currently operates a consumer marketing site with early-access and waitlist flows and does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Braavos
providers.description: Braavos is a self-custody smart-contract wallet for Bitcoin and Starknet, available as a browser extension and mobile app. Built on Starknet account abstraction, it adds hardware-backed two-factor signing (mobile secure element and passkeys), session keys for dApps, gas abstraction, in-wallet swaps, staking, and fiat on-ramp. Its developer surface is the injected Starknet wallet API (get-starknet), the Braavos Cairo account contracts, and first-party JavaScript libraries (session keys, deeplinks, StarkNet URLs, dApp metadata) published under the myBraavos GitHub organization. Braavos does not publish a hosted REST API or OpenAPI. Sector: crypto. Backed by Pantera Capital.

providers.name: Bricklanecom
providers.description: Bricklane is a UK‑based proptech platform that enables professional investors to buy, improve and rent out single‑family homes responsibly. By leveraging technology and data‑driven acquisition, Bricklane offers a transparent, diversified real‑estate investment product, handling property management, tenant services and compliance. The company aims to modernise the rental market, delivering stable returns while promoting energy‑efficient, high‑quality housing for residents across the United Kingdom.

providers.name: Brilliant Light Power
providers.description: Brilliant Light Power is a privately held energy technology company founded by Dr. Randell L. Mills. It claims to develop a novel method of extracting usable energy from hydrogen atoms, termed the SunCell® technology, which it says can produce clean, non‑polluting power. The company provides detailed information about its theory, validation reports, and commercial applications on its website, including business, technology, and research sections. It positions itself as a potential source of primary energy beyond conventional fossil fuels.

providers.name: C2M
providers.description: C2M A.S. is the company behind Connected2.me, a consumer mobile messaging and social application that lets people create a profile, receive messages, and chat in real time with new contacts around the world. The app supports anonymous and identified conversations, following friends, and online-status notifications, and is distributed on both iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play). Connected2.me is a consumer-facing product with no public developer program, API, or SDK surface at this time; its published surface is limited to the marketing site, the mobile apps, and its legal documents (Terms of Service and Privacy Policy). C2M was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Cabot
providers.description: Cabot Corporation is a global specialty chemicals and performance materials company serving the transportation, infrastructure, environment, and consumer industries. The company's products include reinforcing carbons, specialty carbons, fumed silica, inkjet colorants, and engineered elastomer composites.

providers.name: Calyxia
providers.description: Calyxia designs, manufactures, and sells high‑performing, eco‑engineered microcapsule and microparticle solutions that enable global manufacturers to improve product performance and achieve sustainability goals.

providers.name: Carbontrack
providers.description: Carbontrack (carbonTRACK) is an Australian technology company specializing in smart energy management systems and IoT solutions. Headquartered in Melbourne, it provides a patented intelligent energy management platform that enables users and providers to monitor, control and automate energy consumption, generation and storage, supporting a decentralized energy future.

providers.name: Career Karma
providers.description: Career Karma is a consumer edtech platform that helps people find and compare career training programs and get matched to the right one based on their goals, learning style, schedule, and budget. Its catalog spans technology paths (coding bootcamps, software engineering, data science, cybersecurity, AI, UX design), skilled trades (CDL truck driving, HVAC, electrical), healthcare, beauty, and sales, alongside rankings, school comparisons, financing guidance (scholarships, deferred tuition, GI Bill), and a resource center of career guides. Backed by GV, Career Karma runs a guided quiz-and-advisor matching experience rather than a public developer API; this profile captures the company identity and the security and link surface probed from its public web properties.

providers.name: chatous
providers.description: Chatous is a consumer messaging application for random, anonymous chat with real people from around the world over text and video. It connects strangers by shared interests using topic hashtags, letting users make friends and start conversations across iOS and Android. Chatous is a mobile-first social product backed by Slow Ventures; it publishes a consumer website, privacy policy, and terms of service but does not expose a public developer API, SDK, or documented API program at this time.

providers.name: Chegg.com
providers.description: Chegg, Inc. is a US-based education technology company that provides direct-to-student learning services on a subscription basis, including homework and expert Q&A help, step-by-step textbook and problem solutions, textbook rental and purchase, online tutoring, writing and citation tools, math and science solvers, and AI-assisted study support. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass Chegg publishes a consumer web and mobile product but no public developer portal, documented API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or MCP server; this profile therefore captures its public web identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Circle Asia
providers.description: Circle Asia Technologies is a Singapore-headquartered consumer fintech (offices at 68 Circular Road, Singapore, and Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam) behind the Circle app and the VPBank Circle PayLater credit card, a digital buy-now-pay-later card issued in partnership with Vietnam Prosperity Joint Stock Commercial Bank (VPBank). The product lets consumers onboard with only an ID and phone number, waives the lifetime annual fee, and pairs a physical and virtual card with AI-assisted expense management, spending limits, one-tap card lock, biometric (face/fingerprint) authentication, and real-time SMS/app transaction alerts. The company is PCI DSS v4.0.1 certified and Visa-compliant, ships native iOS and Android apps, and is backed by 500 Global. Circle Asia is a consumer application company with no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and compliance claims for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Closing Theory Studios
providers.description: Closing Theory Studios, Inc. is an independent mobile game studio founded in 2023 and based in Austin, Texas, on a mission to bring the real world into games. Its debut title, Househunt (the officially licensed ZillowGoneWild game), lets the 70 million-plus people who browse Zillow for fun buy, guess prices on, renovate, flip, and manage real houses in a casual mobile experience aimed at "non-gamers." The studio was co-founded by Ankith Harathi and Nitin Rajinikanth and raised a $2.3M round led by a16z GAMES SPEEDRUN, with participation from Powerhouse Capital and angel Seth Sivak (founder of Proletariat, acquired by Blizzard). Closing Theory Studios ships consumer mobile games on iOS and Android and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: Clrfacilityservicespvtltd
providers.description: CLR Facility Services Private Limited provides integrated facility management solutions across multiple industries including healthcare, aviation, manufacturing, and retail. Their services span IFM, technical services, business support, aviation services, production support, and sustainable impact initiatives such as circular economy and renewable energy. The company emphasizes ESG pledges, corporate governance, and smart building technologies, offering comprehensive facility management and consulting.

providers.name: Cmbluenergyag
providers.description: Cmblu Energy AG (CMBLU) is a global deep‑tech company developing SolidFlow batteries – a non‑lithium, water‑based, long‑duration energy storage solution. Their modular, scalable systems target utilities, grid operators, data centers and industrial customers, enabling reliable, cost‑effective power storage for renewable integration and backup. The company is headquartered in Germany and focuses on sustainable, safe battery technology for a decarbonized energy future.

providers.name: Codeship
providers.description: Codeship is a Continuous Integration Platform in the cloud

providers.name: Condor Energy
providers.description: Condor Energy is an AI-powered energy management operating system for enterprise energy procurement, built for industrial companies, retailers, and data center operators who buy electricity at scale. The platform aggregates consumption data, PPAs, solar, batteries, and live market data into real-time dashboards; models load against market dynamics to execute hedging strategies and produce board-ready price-risk reporting; and analyzes granular load data to find flexibility opportunities and evaluate ROI on solar, battery, EV-charging, and hybrid investments. Founded in 2026 by former electricity traders and energy physicists, the Paris-based company is a Y Combinator Winter 2026 company. No public API, developer portal, or SDK is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Conduiit
providers.description: Conduiit provides modern finance infrastructure for film and TV productions, offering tools for tax credit incentives, expense management, and real‑time financial reporting. The platform streamlines approvals, payments, and documentation, enabling production teams to maintain control, compliance, and efficiency throughout the lifecycle of a project.

providers.name: Coolfire Solutions
providers.description: Coolfire Solutions provides flexible work management software designed to defeat operational chaos across industries such as logistics, telecommunications, energy, and government. Their flagship Coolfire Core platform enables teams to coordinate tasks, workflows, and communications, offering features for field service management, enterprise collaboration, and real-time situational awareness.

providers.name: Corvusenergy
providers.description: Corvus Energy, founded in 2009, provides zero‑emission energy storage solutions for the maritime industry. The company designs, manufactures and deploys battery systems that power hybrid and fully electric vessels, aiming to reduce diesel consumption and CO₂ emissions worldwide. With over 1,300 installations and more than 50% market share in maritime zero‑emission solutions, Corvus Energy serves a global customer base across shipping, offshore, and ferry sectors, delivering innovative, reliable and sustainable power.

providers.name: Craftt
providers.description: Craftt builds tokenized asset‑backed finance infrastructure for lenders and fintechs, enabling liquidity, efficiency and transparency in consumer credit markets. The platform connects institutional investors with high‑quality tokenized real‑world assets, offering financing solutions for BNPL, earned‑wage access and other consumer lending products. By modernizing the traditional asset‑backed finance ecosystem, Craftt aims to broaden access and reduce costs for both lenders and borrowers.

providers.name: CREATE Medicines
providers.description: CREATE Medicines is a Cambridge, Massachusetts biopharmaceutical company developing in vivo CAR (chimeric antigen receptor) cell therapies using mRNA lipid-nanoparticle (mRNA-LNP) delivery. Its platform reprograms immune cells, including T cells, NK cells, and myeloid cells, directly inside the body rather than extracting and engineering them ex vivo, with clinical and preclinical programs spanning oncology, autoimmune disease, and fibrosis. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. The enrichment pipeline found no developer or API surface; this is a clinical-stage therapeutics company, not a software or platform provider, so no API artifacts were produced (none is the correct, non-fabricated result).

providers.name: DCG
providers.description: Digital Currency Group (DCG) is a crypto-industry venture and holding company that describes itself as the enduring investor and operator of the crypto industry. Investing in digital currencies and blockchain since 2012, DCG has built a portfolio of 200+ equity investments, 50+ fund investments, and 30+ token and digital-asset positions across 25+ countries. It owns and operates category-leading subsidiaries including Grayscale (crypto asset management), Foundry (mining and staking infrastructure), CoinDesk (media, data and events), Genesis (institutional financial services), Luno (consumer wallet), HQ, and TradeBlock. DCG is a corporate holding and investment company and does not publish a public developer API; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead.

providers.name: De-Ice
providers.description: De-Ice Technologies is a Somerville, Massachusetts deep-tech aviation startup building a chemical-free aircraft de-icing system that replaces conventional glycol spray with electrically heated strips applied to aircraft surfaces, removing snow and ice prior to takeoff. The technology eliminates weather-related departure delays, cuts glycol spraying costs, and reduces CO₂ emissions from idling fuel burn and chemical production. Named to Time's Best Inventions of 2024, De-Ice counts Air Canada as its launch customer and is backed by Techstars. This is a physical-hardware aviation company and does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Detoure
providers.description: Detoure Inc (DETOURE) is a sustainable fashion resale marketplace, backed by 500 Global, that sources highly curated clothing from influencers and tastemakers and offers it to shoppers at thrift prices. The platform lets customers buy current trends from the creators they follow while cutting down on excess fashion waste, and lets influencers and partners apply to consign and sell items from their own closets. Detoure operates as a consumer e-commerce brand on a hosted Shopify storefront and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Dishpatch
providers.description: Dishpatch is a UK-based meal delivery service that partners with renowned chefs and restaurants to deliver restaurant-quality, finish-at-home meals nationwide. Operated by Dishpatch Ltd (part of the Waitrose family), the service curates seasonal menus from chefs such as Michel Roux, Rick Stein, Sabrina Ghayour, Jose Pizarro and Paul Ainsworth. Orders are placed a la carte rather than by subscription, delivered on Fridays in insulated, recyclable packaging via DPD, and arrive pre-prepared for simple finishing steps at home. A paid "Supper Club" membership adds free shipping, exclusive menus, early sale access and spending credits. Dishpatch operates a consumer e-commerce storefront and does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation surface.

providers.name: Dreamspace
providers.description: Dreamspace.art is a creative platform that enables users to experiment with AI models on an infinite digital canvas. It offers tools for generating art, visualizing data, and building interactive AI‑driven experiences, all accessible via a web interface. The service showcases cutting‑edge generative AI capabilities, providing both hobbyists and developers a space to explore, prototype, and share AI‑generated creations in real time.

providers.name: Edukita
providers.description: Edukita (PT Edukita Budaya Cinta Belajar) is an Indonesian education company founded during the COVID-19 pandemic by Peter Gumulia and Sean Widjaja on the belief that high-quality education should be accessible to all. It teaches skills that matter through playful but powerful learning, delivering programs online, through six physical learning centers across Greater Jakarta (Bintaro, Bogor, BSD, Depok, Gading Serpong), and blended (Rumah Belajar Edukita). Programs span English with native speakers, early childhood development, Japanese mathematics, and professional upskilling for young students, families, adult learners, and corporate training. Edukita is a portfolio company of 500 Global. It exposes no public developer API surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Elementus
providers.description: Elementus is a New York blockchain intelligence company founded in 2017 that attributes on-chain addresses to real-world entities across multiple chains, and sells that attribution graph to compliance, investigations and market-intelligence teams. Its public API surface is the Attribution API, a key-authenticated REST service at attribution-api.elementus.io that resolves batches of blockchain addresses to a beneficial owner, custodian, entity name and OFAC/SDN sanction status. As of the 2026-08-12 probe every Elementus web host — the marketing site, the app and the API — is unresolvable in DNS, so the developer surface documented here is reconstructed from the company's own public GitHub organization rather than from a live site.

providers.name: Emerson Electric
providers.description: Emerson Electric is a Fortune 500 global automation leader with more than 135 years of innovation history. Its portfolio spans automation systems, discrete automation, final control, measurement instrumentation, and test and measurement, marketed through brands such as Fisher, Rosemount, DeltaV, Micro Motion, ASCO, Bettis, PACSystems, Flexim, and NI. Emerson serves industries including power, oil and gas, chemical, life sciences, food and beverage, automotive, data centers, mining, and marine. This repository captures the public APIs, developer resources, and machine-readable artifacts associated with Emerson Electric.

providers.name: EPAM Systems
providers.description: EPAM Systems is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The EPAM Systems API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Everyrealm
providers.description: Everyrealm Inc. is a Web3 and metaverse company building virtual communities inside in-game worlds, positioned at the intersection of gaming, entertainment, and blockchain technology. Under the banner "Connecting what matters," Everyrealm develops immersive, gamified virtual worlds and experiences, partners with gaming platforms, and invests across the broader metaverse and digital-real-estate ecosystem. The company has raised venture funding from Lightspeed Venture Partners, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Coinbase Ventures, Brevan Howard, Hashed, and other prominent investors. Everyrealm is a consumer- and community-facing operator rather than an API-first developer platform; as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, OpenAPI definitions, SDKs, or programmatic API surface. This entry was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile and has been enriched with public identity, legal, and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Fabletics
providers.description: Fabletics is an American athleisure and activewear brand co-founded in 2013 by actress Kate Hudson with Adam Goldenberg and Don Ressler under the TechStyle Fashion Group in El Segundo, California. It sells women's and men's (FL2) activewear, leggings, sports bras, accessories, the Yitty shapewear line, and Fabletics Scrubs through a VIP membership subscription model that gives members monthly credits and member pricing, operating omnichannel across its e-commerce site and a growing footprint of brick-and-mortar retail stores. As a direct-to-consumer retailer, Fabletics does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Faire
providers.description: Faire is a wholesale marketplace connecting independent retailers with brands. The Faire External API v2 supports both sides of the marketplace: brand-side endpoints for products, orders, inventory, and shipments, and retailer-side endpoints for browsing and ordering.

providers.name: Flavrs
providers.description: Flavrs is a consumer food and cooking platform "made for people who live to eat" that pairs short-form cooking videos from notable chefs and food creators (including Eric Ripert and Binging with Babish) with structured recipe data and integrated ingredient shopping, so viewers can watch a dish being made and buy everything they need to cook it in a single app. Backed by a16z and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead company profile, Flavrs has since merged with the meal-delivery service CookUnity and now redirects its audience there. Flavrs operates as a mobile consumer application and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures its real identity, legal, and social properties for network completeness.

providers.name: Flickplay
providers.description: Flickplay, Inc. is a Web3 social and gaming company that turns character intellectual property into portable, interactive, and monetizable experiences across user-generated content, social platforms, and real-world retail activations. Its consumer iOS app combines character-based gameplay (blind boxes, spin games, leveling), AR video and GIF creation tools, AI character chat, iOS home-screen widgets, a quest system tying gameplay to e-commerce, and a Fandom Intelligence dashboard tracking fan identity, behavior, and spend. Flickplay is a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners. As of mid-2026 the company published a suspension notice, and it exposes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal — this profile is identity-only.

providers.name: Flovision (formerly FloWaste)
providers.description: Flovision Solutions (formerly FloWaste) builds AI-powered computer-vision systems for food production, using cameras and machine learning to measure product on the line for yield improvement, quality control, and staff-performance tracking. Its FloVision Nano (conveyor measurement, KPI reporting, and benchmarking) and FloVision Pro (real-time operator guidance at processing stations) products feed a hosted FloVision Analytics dashboard, and the company reports processing over 23 million kg of food and recovering up to 1.5% of production yield. Insight Partners portfolio company in the manufacturing / food-tech sector; no public developer API or documentation surface has been published to date.

providers.name: FreshPlanet
providers.description: FreshPlanet Inc. is a New York City based mobile game developer, headquartered at 200 Hudson St, New York, NY 10013, best known for the music trivia franchise SongPop. The studio builds free-to-play mobile entertainment titles for iOS and Android, combining licensed music catalogs, social multiplayer play, and live events. FreshPlanet is a portfolio company of Uncork Capital. As a consumer game studio it does not operate a public developer program or API: it exposes only a marketing site, player support via a Zendesk help center, and standard legal surfaces (Terms of Use and Privacy Policy). This profile captures the studio's real public web and legal footprint for the API Evangelist network; there is no OpenAPI, SDK, or agent surface to enrich because the company publishes none.

providers.name: Good Job Games
providers.description: Good Job Games is a global mobile gaming company founded in 2017 that designs, develops, and operates puzzle and match-3 titles for iOS and Android, including Wonder Blast and Match Villains. The studio publishes its games through the Apple App Store and Google Play rather than a developer API program, and its public web surface is limited to its marketing site, games catalog, careers ("Life at Good Job Games") pages, and legal policies. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Menlo Ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, SDK, documentation, or API reference was found during enrichment; the artifacts captured here reflect its domain security posture and public web properties.

providers.name: HAKEEM
providers.description: Hakeem X Technologies (HAKEEM HOLDING LTD) is a UAE-based healthcare technology company delivering AI-powered clinical decision support and medical education to hospitals, universities, and healthcare professionals across the UAE and KSA. Its flagship HakeemDx assistant turns medical research into instant, evidence-based answers at the point of care for physicians and pharmacists, alongside licensed clinical reference suites (Micromedex, EBSCO DynaMed, Isabel, GIDEON), medication-adherence and virtual pharmacy tooling, and medical/nursing education platforms (Lecturio, Healer case simulations, Simtics). Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API, SDK, or portal is published at this time.

providers.name: Harper
providers.description: Harper is an AI-native commercial insurance brokerage founded in 2024 and headquartered in San Francisco. Harper pairs licensed insurance experts with a proprietary AI tech stack that automates core brokerage workflows — reading applications, routing submissions, following up with underwriters, and managing client communications — to place excess & surplus (E&S) and specialty commercial coverage across industries from trucking and construction to technology, CPG, and professional services. Businesses can get bound coverage in 24-48 hours rather than weeks. The company is backed by Emergence Capital and Y Combinator and raised a $47M Series A and seed round in early 2026. Harper does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile tracks the company's identity and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Hexafarms
providers.description: Hexafarms GmbH is a Berlin-based agricultural technology company that builds AI-powered greenhouse optimization software for commercial growers. Its platform combines computer vision, environmental sensors, and machine learning to help greenhouse and foil-tunnel operations forecast yield, register crops, and detect pests and disease early. Products include AI yield forecasting (claimed up to 20% more accurate than traditional methods), automated crop registration via fruit and flower counting, pest and disease monitoring, and environmental sensing across crops such as strawberries, tomatoes, bell peppers, blueberries, cucumbers, raspberries, and aubergine. The product is delivered as a login-gated web application at hexafarms.app; no public developer API or documentation surface has been identified. Hexafarms was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Higharc
providers.description: Higharc is an AI-powered homebuilding software platform founded in 2018 by Marc Minor and headquartered in Durham, North Carolina, with team members across San Francisco and Atlanta. Its design-to-construction cloud platform lets residential builders design homes from scratch, configure market-proven plans, and turn every home into shoppable 3D visuals, plan-based estimating data, and permit-ready construction documents. The product surface spans Studio (design), Config (plan configuration), Showroom (3D visualization), Estimate (material takeoffs), Build (construction documents), Photoreal (renderings), and enterprise AI Estimating, unifying architecture, sales, and construction operations. Higharc is a portfolio company of Fifth Wall and was added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as of this profiling it publishes no public developer API, reference, or documentation surface.

providers.name: IAD
providers.description: IAD Group (I@D International) is a European real-estate network company that combines real estate, digital tools, and network marketing to digitalize the traditional agency model through a network of independent agents rather than brick-and-mortar offices. Founded in France, IAD operates across France, Portugal, Spain, Italy, Germany, Mexico, the United Kingdom, and the United States (Florida), with roughly 20,000 independent agents, around 500 employees, more than 96,000 online property listings, and 521 million euros in 2025 turnover. It is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. IAD publishes a consumer/agent web presence but no public developer platform or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Indigo Agriculture
providers.description: Indigo Agriculture is a Boston-based agriculture-technology company combining microbial seed and foliar treatments (biotrinsic) and on-farm seed treatment hardware (CLIPS) with two large supply-chain programs: Carbon by Indigo, a soil-carbon program that pays growers for verified carbon credits using Indigo's proprietary measurement, reporting, and verification (MRV) stack; and Source by Indigo, a Scope-3 program that connects consumer-goods buyers to sustainably grown crops with greenhouse-gas, water, and low-carbon-biofuel outcome reporting. Indigo does not publish a public developer portal; partner and supply-chain integrations are negotiated directly through their team.

providers.name: Inquis Medical
providers.description: Inquis Medical is a privately funded medical device company founded in 2020 and headquartered at 1530 O'Brien Drive in Menlo Park, California, dedicated to advancing the treatment of venous thromboembolic disease (VTE). Its flagship product, the AVENTUS Precision Thrombectomy System, is a single-catheter mechanical thrombectomy platform that combines a directional intelligent tip with an integrated 5F navigation catheter and dilator, TrueClot proprietary tissue-sensing that gives the operator real-time feedback on what the catheter tip is engaging (wall latch, lollipops, clogs), and in-line filtration with autologous blood reinfusion that reduces blood loss without capital equipment. The AVENTUS Thrombectomy System received FDA 510(k) clearance for peripheral indications and, in June 2025, for the treatment of pulmonary embolism; the company also ships the AVENTUS Introducer Sheath and the AVENTUS Clot Management System. Inquis raised a $40 million Series B in 2024 and a $75 million Series C to scale commercial adoption. Inquis Medical is a clinical hardware company: it publishes no public developer program, API documentation, SDK, or machine-readable API contract, and its public GitHub organization holds a single empty embedded-firmware repository.

providers.name: Instrumental
providers.description: Instrumental is a platform for manufacturing intelligence that helps companies detect and prevent product failures during the manufacturing process. The Instrumental API enables programmatic access to retrieve unit and inspection test data and metadata from Instrumental projects.

providers.name: Jupiter Money
providers.description: Jupiter Money is a Bengaluru-based Indian digital banking app (neobank) operated by Amica Financial Technologies Private Limited. Founded in 2019 by Jitendra Gupta, Jupiter delivers a consumer "money app" experience that bundles savings and salary accounts, UPI payments, co-branded credit cards, personal loans, mutual funds, digital gold, fixed and recurring deposits, insurance, and a Jewels rewards program into a single mobile application. Jupiter is itself not a bank — it operates as a fintech marketplace and Loan Service Provider on top of regulated partners. Federal Bank is the primary banking partner for savings, salary, and deposit products, with CSB Bank powering the Edge+ and Edge RuPay credit cards and Federal Bank the Edge Federal VISA card. Lending is provided through partners including Amica Finance Private Limited and Kisetsu Saison Finance, with mutual funds through AIAPL and digital gold through MMTC-PAMP. The product is consumer facing and distributed via the Android and iOS apps; Jupiter does not publish a public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal. All integrations with banks, NBFCs, NPCI/UPI rails, card networks, and depositories are private business-to-business arrangements rather than an open API program.

providers.name: Kinetic
providers.description: Kinetic (Kinetic Automation) builds robotics-based automated collision repair for modern vehicles equipped with advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS). The company operates robotic repair facilities (Kinetic Hubs), automated imaging for collision damage assessment and repair estimates (Kinetic Vision), and AI-powered calibration identification software (Kinetic ID) that determines which ADAS sensors need recalibration after a repair. Backed by Menlo Ventures and Techstars, Kinetic was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing and corporate site plus a login-only identity portal (id.kinetic.auto); it exposes no public developer program, API documentation, OpenAPI, SDKs, or webhooks surface.

providers.name: Kopperfield
providers.description: Kopperfield is a software company building design and permitting tools for electrical contractors, electricians, inspectors and instructors. Founded in 2022, the company started as an EV charger installation booking service and has since become a broader contractor platform whose stated mission is to "accelerate home electrification by giving contractors the tools they need to work faster, smarter, and with total confidence." The web and mobile product covers NEC-compliant residential and commercial load calculations, drag-and-drop single line diagrams, panel schedules with circuit directories, AI panel-photo analysis, and a National Electrical Code chatbot trained on the 2017, 2020 and 2023 code editions. Kopperfield publishes a public llms.txt and a public status page but does not currently operate a public developer program: there is no published API reference, OpenAPI definition, SDK, or developer portal, and robots.txt disallows crawling of /api/. The company is backed by General Catalyst, MCJ Collective, Lachy Groom and Designer Fund.

providers.name: Kpt
providers.description: kpt is a package-centric toolchain that enables a configuration authoring, automation, and delivery experience, which simplifies managing Kubernetes platforms and KRM-driven infrastructure at scale by utilizing resource configuration as the artifact of record.

providers.name: Lantum
providers.description: Lantum (formerly Network Locum, founded 2012 in Shoreditch, London) is a United Kingdom healthcare workforce-management company whose Connected Scheduling platform helps NHS primary- and secondary-care organisations build digital staff banks, manage rotas and e-rostering, run automated timesheets and payments, and fill clinical shifts from a verified network of 30,000+ locum clinicians. It serves over 2,000 primary-care organisations, GP practices, PCNs, GP federations, and integrated care systems across the UK. Lantum is a practice-management and workforce platform rather than a clinical-data interoperability vendor, and it does NOT publish a public developer portal, a documented REST API, or an HL7 FHIR CapabilityStatement. Its product is delivered through a gated web and mobile application (lantum.com), onboarded via sales and demo request, with any system integrations (for example to GP clinical systems) handled through private partner arrangements rather than a self-serve public API.

providers.name: Lumeris
providers.description: Lumeris is a physician-founded healthcare technology company delivering AI-powered primary care transformation through Tom, its Primary Care as a Service platform. Founded more than fifteen years ago, Lumeris helps physicians, health systems, and payers operate value-based care by reducing physician administrative burden, coordinating proactive patient experiences, and scaling care efficiently. The company serves over 1.4M lives across commercial, Medicare Advantage, multi-payer ACO, and Medicaid arrangements, and reports more than $90B in claims ingested. Lumeris is headquartered in the United States with its Tomorrow Labs innovation group in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Lumeris was surfaced as a portfolio company of Kleiner Perkins. No public developer portal, API documentation, or SDK surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Manicule
providers.description: Manicule is an AI-native technical documentation studio, backed by Y Combinator (Spring 2026), that specializes in developer relations and technical content for developer-tool and AI-native companies. It builds documentation from scratch, revamps existing docs, and provides ongoing maintenance as products evolve, pairing AI agents for auditing, code verification, and scaling with human expertise in information architecture, writing, and creative direction. Its work spans documentation, blogs, cookbooks, videos, and SEO, optimized for discovery by both AI agents and human developers. Clients include Supermemory, Greptile, Reducto, Rootly, Promptlayer, and Skyvern. Manicule is a professional-services company, not an API provider — it publishes no public API, SDK, or MCP surface.

providers.name: Marble Health
providers.description: Marble Health is a virtual mental-health company providing personalized therapy for K-12 students, delivered through partnerships with schools and school districts and directly to families. Licensed therapists meet with students over video, typically within a few days and with no waitlists, and the service accepts most insurance plans including Medicaid. The platform at app.marblehealth.com handles referrals and intake for school counselors and parents, and Marble Health also runs parent workshops and professional-development training for educators. The company is backed by Costanoa Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Marble Health exposes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable discovery surface (no .well-known documents and no llms.txt); it is a consumer/patient-facing healthtech service rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Massdriver
providers.description: Massdriver is an internal developer platform providing self-service infrastructure, ephemeral environments, and cloud operations for engineering teams.

providers.name: Memora Health
providers.description: Memora Health is a healthcare technology company (now part of Commure) that provides an AI-powered platform for digitizing and automating complex care programs. Its intelligent care enablement platform combines clinical workflow automation, remote patient monitoring, symptom management, medication adherence, and patient education to reduce clinician inbox burden and keep enrolled patients engaged between visits. Memora serves health systems and provider organizations across maternal care, surgical care, gastrointestinal care, oncology, chronic care management, population health, and transitions of care. The company operates as an enterprise B2B solution and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; integrations are delivered through direct enterprise engagements. Backed by General Catalyst, Memora is migrating onto the Commure platform at commure.com/engage.

providers.name: Modicus Prime
providers.description: Modicus Prime builds an AI Management System (AIMS) — enterprise software that gives pharmaceutical companies and CDMOs AI audit readiness through data, model, and control management. Just as a QMS manages quality and a LIMS manages laboratories, AIMS manages the AI lifecycle: AI inventory, validation evidence, datasets and model versions, risk guardrails, technical change history, decision records, traceability, and lifecycle performance monitoring. It integrates with existing QMS and data-science tooling to keep GxP AI systems compliant with FDA, EMA, and other health-authority expectations. Modicus Prime is Techstars-backed and is trusted by top-50 pharma companies.

providers.name: Mytra
