providers.description: Mytra, Inc. is a Brisbane, California robotics company founded in 2022 by former Tesla robotics lead Chris Walti, building what it calls software-defined warehousing: a three-part system of low-profile MytraBots that travel in X, Y and Z through a modular steel "cell" matrix up to 80 feet tall, and an AI-driven operating system that plans routes, resolves conflicts and dynamically reconfigures the matrix to store and retrieve anything from cases to full 3,000 lb pallets. The company raised a $120M Series C led by Avenir Growth in January 2026 (roughly $200M total) and sells the system as installed industrial infrastructure to enterprise distribution and food-and-beverage operators. Mytra publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Napkin Math
providers.description: Napkin Math is a personalized AI food journal from Paper Star (a Y Combinator company, founded 2026 in San Francisco by Manuel Castro, Claire Nord, and Jynnie Tang). Marketed as "an AI nutrition coach in your pocket," it is a simple, beautiful food diary that helps people log meals and understand their eating habits over time. The product is a consumer mobile application rather than a developer platform: as of this profile Napkin Math publishes no public API, developer documentation, SDKs, OpenAPI, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface. This entry is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company profile and enrichment lead; it will be upgraded to carry API artifacts if and when Napkin Math or Paper Star exposes a public API surface.

providers.name: Nature's Fynd
providers.description: Nature's Fynd is the consumer food brand of The Fynder Group, a fermentation biotechnology company that grows a complete protein (Fy Protein) from an extremophile fungus originally discovered in the geothermal springs of Yellowstone National Park. The Fynder Group operates as the central R&D, fermentation, and scaled-manufacturing hub behind Fynder Ingredients (specialty food and beverage ingredients), FynderBio (oral biopharmaceuticals), and Hydefy (bio-based performance materials). Nature's Fynd sells meat- and dairy-alternative consumer foods made from Fy Protein. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Newme
providers.description: Newme (newme.asia) is an Accel-backed fast-fashion women's apparel and accessories e-commerce brand operating under the tagline "Freshest Fashion Fastest." It sells trend-driven contemporary womenswear — denim, bottoms, tops, t-shirts, dresses, co-ords, jumpsuits, bodysuits and winterwear — through its website and iOS/Android shopping apps, backed by a growing footprint of physical retail stores across India and Asia. Newme is a consumer direct-to-consumer retailer and, as of this profile, publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: NEXT Academy
providers.description: NEXT Academy is a software engineering bootcamp operating across Malaysia and Singapore that trains junior developers through full-time, hands-on coding programs. Its flagship Quantum Degrees cover full-stack web development, frontend, and backend engineering, pairing project-based challenges with personalized mentorship. Founded to help close the region's tech-talent gap, NEXT Academy has produced 2,800+ graduates from 50+ countries, with alumni placed at companies including Google, Uber, AirAsia, Fave, and Mindvalley. It is backed by 500 Global. NEXT Academy publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface as of this profile; its primary digital surfaces are a marketing website and a student learning-management portal at lms.nextacademy.com.

providers.name: Nextdata
providers.description: Nextdata OS is a unified, automated data management platform for unstructured and structured data, designed for AI and analytics workloads. Founded by Zhamak Dehghani (creator of the data mesh paradigm), Nextdata enables organizations to build autonomous data products with embedded governance and discovery.

providers.name: NGINX Service Mesh
providers.description: NGINX Service Mesh (NSM) is a service mesh from F5 NGINX powered by NGINX Plus, designed to manage container-to-container traffic in Kubernetes environments. It provides mTLS, traffic policies via the Service Mesh Interface (SMI), traffic splitting, rate limiting, observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger), and integration with NGINX Plus Ingress Controller. NGINX Service Mesh exposes a control-plane REST API and a `nginx-meshctl` CLI for installation, sidecar injection, certificate management, and policy configuration. The upstream GitHub repository is archived; F5 announced End of Sale (EoS) for the NGINX Microservices Bundle as of July 1, 2023, and the project's successor for ingress and L7 routing is NGINX Gateway Fabric.

providers.name: Nike
providers.description: Nike is the world's largest supplier of athletic shoes and apparel and a major manufacturer of sports equipment, designing, developing, and marketing products under the Nike, Jordan, and Converse brands.

providers.name: OCUDU Ecosystem Foundation
providers.description: The OCUDU Ecosystem Foundation is a Linux Foundation project announced at MWC Barcelona in March 2026. It is an open collaboration hub dedicated to building a foundational reference platform for Radio Access Networks including AI-based algorithms, with founding members AMD, AT&T, Ericsson, Nokia, NVIDIA, and Verizon.

providers.name: Opalcamera
providers.description: Opal Electronics is an original hardware company based in California specializing in the design and engineering of premium webcams and creator-focused camera devices. Its products include the Opal C1, a professional-grade webcam built around a large image sensor and DSLR-style optics, and the Opal Tadpole, an ultra-compact clip-on webcam for laptops, paired with the Opal Composer desktop software that adds virtual-camera, scene, and streaming controls. The company is backed by Kindred Ventures. Opal runs a consumer hardware business and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or partner platform; this profile captures its public web presence and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: openIDL
providers.description: openIDL (Open Insurance Data Link) is a Linux Foundation project developing standardized, interoperable data frameworks for the insurance industry. It uses blockchain technology to enable secure, privacy-preserving data sharing between insurance carriers and regulators.

providers.name: Optoscale
providers.description: Optoscale (OptoScale AS) is a Norwegian aquaculture technology company founded in 2015 in Trondheim that builds AI-powered, camera-based edge-computing monitoring for fish farming. Its Bioscope units capture real-time measurements of fish weight, biomass, sea-lice counts, welfare, behaviour and feeding, producing tens of thousands of validated measurements each day directly on the unit rather than on remote servers. Customers view trends, graphs and high-resolution imagery through the OptoScale web portal, export to Excel/CSV, and integrate the underlying data into their own analytics and farm-management systems via OptoScale's data API. OptoScale was acquired by Insight Partners in 2025.

providers.name: Ordermark
providers.description: Ordermark is a restaurant technology company that consolidates online food delivery and takeout orders from third-party channels such as DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, and Postmates into a single dashboard and printer, with menu synchronization, order management, and analytics across delivery partners and 250+ POS systems. Ordermark was acquired by and now operates under UrbanPiper; the ordermark.com property is maintained by UrbanPiper. As of this enrichment pass Ordermark publishes no public developer API, developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs on its own surface. It was surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company lead.

providers.name: P&G
providers.description: Procter & Gamble provides an API Marketplace - the central API hub for Developers, Consumers, Application Managers, and Architects to discover and use P&G APIs.

providers.name: ParkPow
providers.description: ParkPow is software to manage and enforce parking lots. It lets you track vehicles, get custom alerts, and enforce your parking rules. The ParkPow API documentation requires application access and is not publicly available.

providers.name: Pashouses
providers.description: Pashouses (PT Pionir Alfa Sejahtera) is an Indonesian proptech company operating an end-to-end transactional marketplace for buying and selling ready-to-occupy residential homes across the Greater Jakarta (Jabodetabek) region — Jakarta, Tangerang, Tangerang Selatan, Bekasi, Bogor, and Depok. Founded in 2020 by Junghans Tasani and Bin Anindita, the platform combines an iBuyer model, brokerage, staging, and renovation with mortgage (KPR) origination through partnerships with major Indonesian banks (BCA, Mandiri, BSI, BRI). It offers consumer tools including a Smart Agent property assistant, a KPR mortgage calculator, and an affordability calculator. QED Investors led a $5M pre-Series B in November 2022 (its first Indonesian / Southeast Asian investment). The company exposes a consumer web marketplace only; no public developer, API, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Paw
providers.description: Paw (now RapidAPI for Mac) is a full-featured HTTP client that lets you test and describe the APIs you build or consume. It provides a native macOS API testing experience with collaboration features.

providers.name: PayScale
providers.description: PayScale is a compensation intelligence and salary data company that helps organizations and individuals price jobs, benchmark pay, and manage compensation. Its platform combines a Peer Data Ecosystem of daily-refreshed, HRIS-sourced salary data across thousands of organizations and millions of employee records with survey-based and crowdsourced pay data spanning tens of thousands of jobs across many countries. Products include the Payscale Ascent compensation management platform, market pricing and benchmarking datasets (Peer Global, Peer Enhanced, Peer Industry, Peer Markets), pay equity analytics, and consumer-facing salary research tools. This profile was surfaced as a VC-portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; PayScale publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time, so this entry captures company identity, links, and domain-security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Photobox
providers.description: Photobox is Europe's leading e-commerce retailer of personalised photo products and gifts, serving tens of millions of customers across the UK and continental Europe. Its consumer web and mobile apps let people upload photos and create photo books, wall art, canvas prints, calendars, cards, mugs and other personalised gifts for home delivery. Backed by Insight Partners. As of this enrichment pass Photobox publishes no public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or partner API surface; its verified GitHub organization contains only two forked operations utilities. This profile therefore captures company identity and public web properties rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: PLAYSTUDIOS
providers.description: PLAYSTUDIOS, Inc. (Nasdaq: MYPS) is a developer and publisher of free-to-play casual and casino-style mobile and social games, including myVEGAS Slots, POP! Slots, MGM Slots Live, myKONAMI, Tetris Block Puzzle, Solitaire, Bingo, and Mahjong titles. Its differentiating platform, playAWARDS, is a loyalty rewards engine that lets players earn real-world rewards from brand partners across gaming, hospitality, dining, and entertainment. The company is headquartered in Las Vegas and went public in 2021 via a business combination with Acies Acquisition Corp. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a dcm-ventures portfolio company; PLAYSTUDIOS publishes consumer-facing games and corporate/investor properties but no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Plotlogic
providers.description: Plotlogic is a mining technology company that builds AI-driven sensing systems for real-time ore and material characterisation. Its flagship product, OreSense, scans rock in open-pit, stockpile, and underground mining operations and delivers decision-ready quantitative mineralogy in under 15 minutes, compared with more than an hour for traditional laboratory assay methods. The hardware is engineered for harsh mining environments and integrates into existing operational workflows so mines can reduce waste, improve grade control, and make faster material-routing decisions. Plotlogic is headquartered in Zillmere, Queensland, Australia, and is backed by the deep-tech venture firm DCVC. Customer access is delivered through an enterprise client platform rather than a public developer API; there is no published developer program, SDK, or API documentation at this time.

providers.name: Porte Tech
providers.description: Porte Tech Ltd. is a hotel technology company based in Astana, Kazakhstan that offers a digital concierge platform to streamline guest experiences and reduce front-desk workload for hotels. Its product covers digital check-in and check-out, mobile room keys delivered via app, access codes or QR codes, Bluetooth lock upgrades that reuse existing hardware, an in-app guest experience for bookings and amenity ordering, integrations with spa, restaurant and laundry services, and a centralized management dashboard for property staff. Porte is a 500 Global portfolio company. No public API, SDK, or developer surface is currently published.

providers.name: Post-Quantum
providers.description: Post-Quantum is a quantum-safe cybersecurity company founded in 2009 that protects critical infrastructure against both present-day threats and future quantum-computing attacks. Its platform spans Identity Protection, a hybrid post-quantum VPN standardized by the IETF as RFC 9370, and quantum-safe messaging, built on a crypto-agile modular architecture and NIST-round cryptography such as Classic McEliece. The company authored RFC 9370, delivered first-in-world quantum-safe drone communications, and its technology is deployed in NATO and active defense environments. The public web presence is a marketing and platform-overview site; no public developer API, SDK, documentation portal, or sign-up surface is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: PostStack
providers.description: EU-hosted email API for transactional and marketing email, with contacts, broadcasts, and analytics

providers.name: Prudentia Sciences
providers.description: Prudentia Sciences provides a scientific intelligence layer powering life-sciences dealmaking. The platform unifies fragmented pharmaceutical and biotech data sources, applies expert-developed evaluation frameworks, and applies AI trained on drug development so that pharma companies, biotech firms, investors, and deal teams can assess pharmaceutical assets faster and with more confidence during M&A and licensing transactions. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). No public API or developer surface was found during enrichment; the company operates as a single-tenant, SOC 2-aligned SaaS platform.

providers.name: Pusher Beams
providers.description: Push notifications for Android & iOS

providers.name: PuTTY
providers.description: PuTTY is a free and open-source terminal emulator, serial console and network file transfer application. It supports several network protocols, including SCP, SSH, Telnet, rlogin, and raw socket connection.

providers.name: Quantifind
providers.description: Quantifind is a financial crimes automation company founded in 2009 by physicists Ari Tuchman and John Stockton to extract meaningful risk signals from large, unstructured datasets. Its flagship SaaS platform, Graphyte, applies machine learning, natural language processing, and entity resolution to anti-money laundering (AML) and know-your-customer (KYC) compliance. Graphyte spans watchlist and sanctions screening, adverse media screening, enhanced due diligence, credit risk, and investigations, and is delivered through GraphyteSearch (an investigation application), GraphyteQueue (an AI-native case manager), GraphyteAPI (a synchronous REST risk-assessment API), and GraphyteBatch (batch screening). Quantifind serves Tier 1 and regional banks, digital banks, Fortune 50 companies, and federal and defense agencies, and integrates with case-management systems such as Oracle FCCM. Backed by a16z.

providers.name: RADNET
providers.description: RadNet, Inc. (NASDAQ: RDNT) is the largest provider of freestanding, fixed-site outpatient diagnostic imaging services in the United States, operating roughly 440 imaging centers offering MRI, CT, PET/CT, ultrasound, mammography, and other modalities. Beyond its clinical network, RadNet runs a health-technology business spanning eRAD (web-based, cloud imaging workflow, PACS and RIS solutions) and DeepHealth, its AI and digital-health division whose cloud-native "DeepHealth OS" unifies enterprise imaging (Diagnostic Suite, Operations Suite, TechLive) with AI-powered population-health screening for breast, lung, prostate, neuro, and thyroid imaging. RadNet was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network. RadNet does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; its technology is delivered as enterprise imaging platforms and AI products through eRAD and DeepHealth.

providers.name: Rigi
providers.description: Rigi (Rigi TV) is an instant-entertainment mobile app that streams quick, captivating, and scroll-worthy short-form video and micro-drama series across genres such as romance, drama, thriller, and suspense. Operated out of HSR Layout in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India and backed by Accel, it delivers on-demand vertical entertainment through its Android app. It is a consumer-facing streaming product; no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal surface is currently published.

providers.name: Roboto Games
providers.description: Roboto Games is an independent video game development studio building Stormforge, an open-world survival crafting game where players craft, build, fight, and harness epic storms to survive in a magical fantasy world. The studio was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As a consumer game studio, Roboto Games publishes a marketing website, a careers page, and a studio blog, but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or programmatic surface — its player-facing experience is delivered through native game clients (Steam) and community channels (Discord, YouTube, Twitch) rather than an HTTP API. This profile captures the studio's public identity and web properties; no API artifacts are produced because none are published.

providers.name: Santa Ana Bio
providers.description: Santa Ana Bio is a precision immunology company developing targeted therapies to stop autoimmune and inflammatory disease at the source. The company pairs a multi-omics discovery platform (integrating genomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic data) with a pipeline of bispecific and multi-specific antibody and antibody-drug-conjugate programs (SAB01, SAB05, SAB06) advancing toward IND submissions across 2026-2027. Backed by a16z and GV, it was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company. It publishes a corporate and careers website but no public developer, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Satellite
providers.description: Satellite IM builds privacy-focused, decentralized peer-to-peer communication software for crypto and web3 communities. Its core is Warp, a Rust interface-driven distributed data service providing end-to-end-encrypted chat, voice, video, and file sharing with data stored on IPFS. Uplink is a customizable decentralized chat application built on top of Warp. Satellite publishes no hosted REST or GraphQL API; the developer surface is the open-source Warp Rust crates and the first-party warp-wasm WebAssembly and TypeScript library. Satellite is backed by Multicoin Capital and its code is MIT licensed.

providers.name: Seeqc
providers.description: Seeqc is developing the first digital quantum computing platform for businesses, integrating all core functions of a quantum computer - qubits together with classical control logic - onto a single superconducting chip operating at millikelvin temperatures. Founded in 2019 and holding over 115 patents, the company combines classical and quantum technologies to address the efficiency, stability, and cost challenges endemic to scalable quantum computing, and also offers superconducting chip foundry services. As a quantum-hardware and foundry company, Seeqc currently publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Showroomprive.com
providers.description: Showroomprive.com is a French online private-sales (flash-sales) e-commerce platform operated by Showroomprive.com SAS, a subsidiary of SRP Groupe SA, based in La Plaine Saint-Denis. It sells discounted apparel, beauty, home, sports, and travel products from major brands, and also runs a third-party seller marketplace. The company exposes a private marketplace / seller API reached through partner onboarding and surfaced by third-party integration platforms such as ChannelEngine and Commercium, but it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or OpenAPI. Added to the API Evangelist network as an Accel portfolio lead.

providers.name: Songlink / Odesli
providers.description: Get all the services on which a song is available

providers.name: Sounding Board
providers.description: Sounding Board is a leadership development company offering tech-powered coaching and mentoring solutions that help organizations develop dynamic leaders at every level. Its platform pairs software products (Expand, Guide, and Transform) with a global network of ICF/EMCC/IAC/CCE-certified coaches to deliver 1:1 coaching, group coaching, mentoring, and on-demand leadership development. Sounding Board serves technology, professional services, government, education, healthcare, financial services, and retail organizations, and was acquired by BTS in March 2025 to extend end-to-end executive-to-frontline coaching. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and Canaan Partners; no public developer or API surface has been found to date.

providers.name: SpryPoint
providers.description: SpryPoint is a cloud-based customer service and operations software provider for utilities, founded in 2012 and headquartered in Charlottetown, Prince Edward Island, Canada. Its platform modernizes the meter-to-cash lifecycle for water & sewer, electric, and gas utilities across North America through an integrated suite of modules: SpryCIS (customer information system), SpryEngage (omnichannel customer portal), SpryWallet (payment processing), SpryMobile MFS (field service orders), SpryMobile WOAM (work order and asset management), SpryBackflow (backflow compliance), and SpryIDM (interval data management). The company serves 100+ utility clients, employs 285+ people, is SOC 2 audited, and is backed by Norwest Venture Partners and Insight Partners. SpryPoint publishes no public developer portal or API documentation; integrations are delivered through partnership engagements rather than a self-service API.

providers.name: StepStone Group
providers.description: StepStone Group is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The StepStone Group API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Super.com
providers.description: Super.com (formerly SnapTravel and Snapcommerce) is a consumer savings company founded in 2016 by Hussein Fazal and Henry Shi, headquartered in San Francisco with engineering roots in Toronto. Its app bundles SuperTravel hotel booking, flights, SuperShop savings, SuperCash cash back and credit building, SuperPay, and SuperRx prescription discounts, and the company reports more than $2 billion in sales processed since launch on roughly $150 million raised across seed through Series C. Its only developer-facing surface is the SnapTravel Partner Search API at api.snaptravel.com — a hotel search-and-book integration offered to business partners. No public API reference, developer portal, or machine-readable specification is published: every documentation path on the API host returns 404, no developer/docs subdomain resolves, and the www.super.com HTML surface is served behind a Cloudflare bot challenge. The company does publish an RFC 9116 security.txt naming a security contact and an invite-only Bugcrowd program.

providers.name: SuperGaming
providers.description: SuperGaming is a Series B-funded game development studio building multiplayer games "for the next billion players" in emerging markets. Headquartered in Singapore with a studio in Pune, India, the company develops and operates titles including Indus (battle royale), Prime Rush, Prime Rush MENA, SHOWDOWN, MaskGun (110M+ installs), Tower Conquest, and Silly Royale. SuperGaming also runs SuperPlatform, a proprietary real-time multiplayer and live-ops engine that powers its own games and 15+ other titles, and offers publisher services such as co-development, LiveOps-as-a-service, localization, and user acquisition. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal for external developers; SuperPlatform is an internal engine offered through partnerships rather than a self-serve API. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z.

providers.name: SuperQuickQuestion
providers.description: SuperQuickQuestion (SQQ) is a fan-engagement platform that hosts brief, 60-second one-on-one live video interactions between fans and celebrities, athletes, and musicians. It is web-based with no app download required, uses industry-standard encryption, and removes traditional event logistics (travel, hotels, agent back-and-forth) so talent only needs WiFi and a camera device while fans receive brand- or team-sponsored free access. Early clients include professional sports organizations such as the Washington Wizards, Cleveland Browns, Washington Mystics, Wrexham AFC, and talent like Ric Flair. No public API, developer portal, or SDK surface is currently published; this remains a consumer product profile.

providers.name: SweetLabs
providers.description: SweetLabs is a San Diego-based software company that builds consumer applications and app-distribution, discovery, and personalization software for device manufacturers (OEMs), helping them differentiate their PCs and devices through preloaded and recommended app experiences. The company is backed by Google Ventures (GV). It operates as a corporate and consumer-software business: its public web presence is a marketing and careers site, and as of this enrichment pass SweetLabs does not publish a public developer API, SDK, MCP server, or developer portal, so no API artifacts were harvested. This profile captures the identity and domain-security posture that could be verified from its public surface.

providers.name: Syncbak
providers.description: Syncbak is a Marion, Iowa media-technology company founded in 2009 by Jack Perry that built the streaming infrastructure local U.S. television broadcasters use to put their over-the-air signals online. Its SimpleSync / MediaMogul platform handles live-stream transcoding, cloud-based rights resolution and geo-location authentication, cloud DVR, device filtering, content management, stream monitoring, clipping, and dynamic ad insertion through its AdSync product, delivering station feeds to OTT destinations including Paramount+, Hulu, fuboTV, Amazon, Roku, Apple TV and the NFL across 200+ U.S. markets. The company rebranded to Zeam Media in May 2024 to match its Zeam consumer hyperlocal streaming app, and syncbak.com now redirects to zeammedia.com. Syncbak publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable contract; its platform is delivered to broadcasters and station groups under commercial agreement.

providers.name: Telgani
providers.description: Telgani is an app-based car rental aggregator founded in 2018 and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Its consumer iOS and Android apps let users compare prices and book cars from more than 50 partner rental companies with over 500 branches across the Kingdom, offering doorstep delivery, airport pickup, and daily, monthly, or yearly rentals. Backed by 500 Global, Impact46, and Elm, Telgani has raised roughly $8.5M across a seed round, a 2021 pre-Series A, and a 2023 Series A. Telgani operates as a consumer mobile marketplace and does not publish a public developer API program; this profile captures its public web properties (homepage, privacy policy, terms of service) and its domain security posture.

providers.name: Tesoro
providers.description: Tesoro Corporation (later rebranded as Andeavor) was a Fortune 100 independent petroleum refiner and marketer headquartered in San Antonio, Texas. Founded in 1968, the company operated ten refineries in the Western United States with combined crude oil capacity of approximately 1.2 million barrels per day and approximately 3,000 branded retail gas stations. Tesoro rebranded as Andeavor in 2017 following its acquisition of Western Refining, and was acquired by Marathon Petroleum on October 1, 2018. No public developer API was offered.

providers.name: The Fit Body Co
providers.description: The Fit Body Co (Fitbody) is a Mexican direct-to-consumer sports nutrition and dietary supplements brand selling isolated and hydrolyzed protein powders, creatine, vitamins, and wellness products, along with digital recipe guides, through a Shopify-based online storefront at fitbody.mx. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As an e-commerce retail brand it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or API documentation; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity and domain-security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Trayd
providers.description: Trayd is a construction payroll, HR, and compliance platform built for commercial trade contractors and subcontractors. It automates certified and prevailing-wage payroll, union and multi-state compliance reporting, field and labor tracking, crew scheduling and dispatch, HR onboarding and benefits, and offers same-day pay, moving tens of millions of payroll dollars each week. Founded in 2022 (Y Combinator S23) and backed by Bloomberg Beta, Trayd operates a private SaaS and mobile application with no public developer API, documentation, or integration surface published at this time.

providers.name: Vake
providers.description: VAKE is a Norwegian maritime domain awareness company that detects, identifies, and tracks "dark vessels" from space. The VAKE platform fuses satellite imagery, AIS signals, and machine learning to reveal hidden vessel activity at sea for governments and industry. Its three products are Pathfinder, which reconstructs a vessel's past, present, and predicted movements and searches satellite imagery for vessels that go AIS-dark; Overwatch, which monitors an Area of Interest around ports, critical infrastructure, and economic zones to surface unreported activity such as illegal fishing, transshipments, and spoofing; and Clearview, a machine-learning service that identifies dark-vessel observations in multispectral satellite imagery against a global vessel-signature database spanning 2016 to today. The platform is delivered as a web application (studio.vake.ai) backed by a private API (api.nemme.io); onboarding is sales-led rather than self-serve.

providers.name: Vatn Systems
providers.description: Vatn Systems is a Bristol, Rhode Island defense technology company founded in 2023 that designs and manufactures low-cost, modular autonomous underwater vehicles (UUVs/AUVs) and the autonomy, navigation and acoustic-processing software that runs on them. Its product line spans the Skelmir S6 (6-inch, man-portable, swarm-capable) and Skelmir S12 (12.75-inch medium-class) vehicles, Eyra 5.1 and Eyra 8.0 passive hydrophone arrays, and four software systems - INStinct (maritime inertial navigation for GPS-denied operation), PARse (embedded acoustic signal processing on ARM), FUSE (multi-sensor tracking, distributed as a Docker image) and AEsir (TAK-native sensor fusion and mission planning). Mission planning is delivered through an ATAK/CivTAK/MilTAK/WinTAK plugin and Fathom, a browser-based mission planner and vehicle configurator. Vatn raised a $60M Series A in December 2025 (total funding $76.5M) and acquired Crewless Marine. It publishes no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable contract; every integration surface is reached through a demo request or supplier form.

providers.name: Veluga
providers.description: Veluga (Veluga Brewery Inc.) is a South Korean B2B alcohol wholesale distribution platform that connects hospitality business owners with liquor suppliers. Operating from Mapo, Seoul, the company runs a wholesale marketplace offering real-time wholesale pricing quotes for spirits and craft beverages, product recommendations for business owners, wholesale order facilitation, and partnership programs for distributors and catering services. Veluga positions itself as a transaction and information intermediary rather than a direct seller. The company began as a craft-beer and snack subscription service and is backed by 500 Global, Kakao Ventures, SparkLabs, HL Holdings, and Sema Investment. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is currently published; this profile captures the company identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Verdagy
providers.description: Verdagy is a Moss Landing, California clean-energy hardware company that designs and manufactures dynamic alkaline water electrolysis systems for large-scale green hydrogen production. Its eDynamic platform runs very large-area membrane-based electrochemical cells at high current density with dynamic turndown, so electrolyzers can follow intermittent renewable power, targeting fossil-fuel cost parity for clean hydrogen by 2028 without subsidies. The company operates a 2 MW eDynamic demonstration plant at Moss Landing with more than 21,000 commercial cell hours, plus 500 kW and 100 kW test plants, and opened a DOE-supported gigawatt-scale manufacturing facility of more than 100,000 square feet in Newark, California. Verdagy sells electrolyzer hardware and project capacity to industrial hydrogen buyers — refining, ammonia, methanol, e-fuels and SAF — rather than software; it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Verint Systems
providers.description: Verint Systems is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Verint Systems API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Watsco
providers.description: Watsco, Inc. is the world's largest distributor of air conditioning, heating, and refrigeration (HVAC/R) equipment and related products. Operating through subsidiaries including Carrier Enterprise, Baker Distributing, Gemaire Distributors, and East Coast Metal Distributors, Watsco serves contractors and dealers across more than 670 locations in the US, Canada, Mexico, and the Caribbean. The company has undergone significant digital transformation, running a unified B2B e-commerce platform powered by Magento Commerce and a centralized PIM system covering approximately 900,000 SKUs.

providers.name: Wheelocity
providers.description: Wheelocity (Wheelocity Fresh Private Limited) is a Bangalore, India based logistics and supply-chain company building daily fresh-produce and grocery delivery networks for underserved rural markets across India, which it frames as "the access rails for Bharat commerce." Its phygital (online plus offline) model combines location intelligence, IoT hardware, cold-chain and predictive demand forecasting with an electric-vehicle first-mile and last-mile fleet and a consumer app branded WoW. The company reports serving more than one million households, running over 100,000 km of EV movement daily and avoiding tens of thousands of kilograms of produce waste each day. Wheelocity is a venture-backed operating company (Lightspeed Venture Partners portfolio) and, as of this profile, publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Wrightspeed
providers.description: Wrightspeed is an electric-powertrain manufacturer in Alameda, California, founded in 2005 by Tesla co-founder Ian Wright and rebranded as REVO Powertrains in May 2022. Its product is the RePower Platform, a "Powertrain-in-a-Crate" retrofit kit that converts existing diesel Class 6 and 7 trucks and buses into battery-electric vehicles by replacing the legacy motor, transmission, rear axle, cooling, HVAC and fuel systems with an integrated e-axle, high-voltage battery, electrical harness, instrument cluster and a Vehicle Dynamics Module carrying traction control, diagnostics, telematics and over-the-air updates. Wrightspeed is a hardware company: the software it ships is embedded in the vehicle and sold with the kit. It publishes an eight-page Webflow marketing site (platform, about, careers, contact, reserve, terms, privacy) and no developer portal, API, SDK, webhook surface or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Xsight Labs
providers.description: Xsight Labs is a fabless semiconductor company redefining AI and cloud connectivity with end-to-end, software-defined silicon for hyperscale data centers. Its X-Series programmable Ethernet switch silicon (X1, X2) delivers 3.2-12.8 Tbps with sub-700ns latency and is programmable through XISA, the first fully open, documented switch instruction set architecture, published under MPLv2. Its E-Series is billed as the industry's first fully software-defined 800G DPU family, placing 64 Arm Neoverse N2 cores directly in the data path and programmable with standard Linux tooling (XDP, DPDK, SPDK) with no proprietary SDK. Xsight Labs contributes SONiC platform code and a SAI implementation through its public GitHub organization. Backed by Battery Ventures among other investors. The company publishes technical documentation, XISA specifications, and programming examples rather than a hosted web API; no public OpenAPI, REST endpoints, or hosted API surface were found during enrichment.

providers.name: Yuga Labs
providers.description: Yuga Labs is a Web3 company and the creator of the Bored Ape Yacht Club (BAYC), Mutant Ape Yacht Club (MAYC), and the Otherside metaverse, along with related NFT collections and intellectual property. Backed by a16z, Bond Capital, GV, Lightspeed Venture Partners and SV Angel, the company operates in the crypto / NFT sector on the Ethereum blockchain. It does not publish a formal, documented public developer API program; its on-chain assets are accessed via Ethereum smart contracts and third-party marketplaces (OpenSea, Blur), and Otherside exposes the forthcoming Otherside Development Kit (ODK) for building within the metaverse. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched with the available public identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Zhihu
providers.description: Zhihu (知乎) is a Chinese online question-and-answer and knowledge-sharing community, often described as China's answer to Quora, where users post questions and answers, follow topics and creators, and consume long-form content, columns, live sessions, e-books and short video. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in Beijing, Zhihu operates one of China's largest online content communities and is dual-listed (NYSE: ZH; HKEX: 2390). It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. As of this enrichment pass Zhihu publishes no public developer platform, open API, SDKs, or machine-readable API artifacts on its primary domain; this profile therefore captures company identity plus a probed domain-security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Agrud Technologies
providers.description: Agrud Technologies provides a governed data and content orchestration platform enabling enterprises to ingest, govern, and distribute structured and unstructured data at scale. The solution supports visualisation, agentic AI, and integrates with major data providers such as Bloomberg, FactSet, and Morningstar, offering compliance certifications like ISO 27001 and SOC 2.

providers.name: Aidora
providers.description: Aidora was an AI-native leave-of-absence management platform for HR teams, founded in 2023 in San Francisco by Rhiana Gademsky and Anant Agarwal. The product automated the highly regulated leave lifecycle — eligibility determination across federal FMLA plus state paid-family-and-medical-leave programs, compliance forms, documentation, return-to-work planning and payroll coordination — through a natural-language interaction model employees could use by voice or text. Aidora raised roughly $2.7M in seed funding from Team Ignite Ventures and Fractal Software. On 9 July 2026 Paylocity acquired Aidora and folded its absence-management capabilities into the Paylocity HR platform; getaidora.com is now a single acquisition notice and the company no longer operates an independent product surface. Aidora never published a public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Alere
providers.description: Alere Inc. was a global manufacturer of rapid point-of-care diagnostic tests, founded in 1991 and headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts. The company operated three business units focused on cardiometabolic, infectious disease, and toxicology testing. Alere's product portfolio included the Alere i platform for rapid molecular diagnostics, the Alere CD4 analyser for HIV management, and the RALS point-of-care data management system for laboratory connectivity. Alere Informatics offered web-based solutions including RALS-Freedom, AegisPOC, and RALS-Web3 for point-of-care device management and data integration with laboratory information systems. Abbott Laboratories acquired Alere on October 3, 2017 for $5.3 billion, and the company now operates as Abbott Rapid Diagnostics.

providers.name: Alterego
providers.description: Alterego is a Boston-based startup, spun out of the MIT Media Lab in 2025, building a near-telepathic silent-speech interface: a minimal, non-invasive wearable that detects the faint neuromuscular signals produced when a person internally verbalizes words, letting them interact with AI and computers without typing, tapping, or speaking aloud. Its "Silent Sense" technology responds only to intentional internal speech, keeping private thoughts private while enabling hands-free, screen-free messaging, queries, and information access. The company is pre-launch, backed by investors including Canaan, Granite Ventures, Mayfield, Rembrandt Venture Partners, and Cisco Investments. As of this profile Alterego publishes no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Alterome Therapeutics
providers.description: Alterome Therapeutics is a clinical-stage precision oncology company founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Diego, California, backed by Canaan Partners. The company designs alteration-specific cancer therapies using deep biology and chemistry expertise paired with an in-house computational chemistry platform ("The Kraken"), a custom CPU/GPU compute array for physics-based molecular simulation and drug design. Its clinical pipeline includes ALTA2618, a mutation-selective inhibitor for AKT1 E17K-driven cancers, and ALTA3263, an oral pan-KRAS ON-state inhibitor targeting more than 90% of KRAS mutations in cancer. Alterome was surfaced through the Canaan Partners portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Alveus Therapeutics
providers.description: Alveus Therapeutics is a clinical‑stage biotechnology company focused on developing next‑generation obesity and metabolic disease therapies. Based in Philadelphia, the firm aims to create sustainable weight‑loss treatments with improved efficacy and tolerability, leveraging extensive leadership experience in metabolic medicine.

providers.name: Angiex
providers.description: Angiex is developing first‑in‑class Nuclear‑Delivered Antibody‑Drug Conjugates™ (ND‑ADCs) to address cancer lethality. The company aims to make cancer a non‑lethal disease, leveraging novel biology to deliver safe and effective therapies. Over one‑third of people in developed countries develop cancer, with 10 million deaths annually; Angiex’s vision is that no one should die of cancer.

providers.name: Apheabio
providers.description: Apheabio (Aphea.Bio) develops innovative biocontrol and biostimulant products for sustainable agriculture. Leveraging its APEXbio™ R&D platform, the company creates microbial‑based solutions that integrate with conventional and organic crop protection, aiming to improve yields, resilience, and environmental outcomes across the agricultural sector.

providers.name: Aquishair
providers.description: Aquishair is a UK‑based brand that designs and sells premium hair towels, turbans and related hair‑care accessories. Their products focus on quick drying, softness and style, marketed toward women seeking convenient, high‑quality hair solutions. The company emphasizes natural materials and scientific formulation, offering a range that includes the popular Lisse Dair hair turban and other innovative hair‑care items. Aquishair operates an online store and provides detailed product information, brand story, and support through its website.

providers.name: Armstrong Robotics
providers.description: Armstrong Robotics is building general-purpose robots for commercial kitchens, beginning with autonomous dishwashing systems that load, run, and unload dishware without human intervention. Backed by Bloomberg Beta, the company is an early-stage robotics startup focused on kitchen labor automation. It currently exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation; it was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-sourced lead awaiting a public API surface, and this profile carries only the identity and domain-security signals that could be verified from its public website.

providers.name: Autolink
providers.description: Autolink, also known as Wuxi Autolink Intelligence Tech Co., Ltd, provides vehicle computing solutions integrating software and hardware for intelligent cockpits, ADAS, and zone controllers. The company offers a full-stack in‑house R&D platform, advanced manufacturing, and a collaborative ecosystem to support software‑defined vehicle architectures and smart mobility.

providers.name: Avantifinancialgroup
providers.description: Avantifinancialgroup, operating as AVANTI FINANCIAL GROUP, provides a broad range of insurance and risk management solutions including commercial property, construction, homeowners, life, and business owners policies. Based in the United States, the company serves individuals and businesses seeking tailored coverage and risk mitigation services across multiple industries. The firm emphasizes personalized service, comprehensive policy options, and expertise in navigating complex insurance needs for both residential and commercial clients, ensuring reliable protection and peace of mind.

providers.name: Avidbots Corp.
providers.description: Avidbots Corp. designs and manufactures autonomous floor cleaning robots for commercial and industrial environments. Their solutions include the Neo, Neo 2W, and Kas robots, which provide autonomous navigation, mapping, and cleaning capabilities, reducing labor costs and improving cleanliness across warehouses, retail, healthcare, and other facilities. The company offers a cloud‑based command center for fleet management and analytics, supporting scalable deployment and integration with existing facility operations.

providers.name: Believe
providers.description: Believe is a global artist development company that provides recording, publishing, and distribution services. It works with independent artists, songwriters, record labels, and music publishers to develop careers, protect rights, and collect royalties worldwide. The company operates in more than 50 countries and supports its partners with technology, expertise, and operational support.

providers.name: Bioworkshops
providers.description: Bioworkshops is a global biologics CDMO specializing in antibody‑based therapeutics, offering end‑to‑end development and manufacturing services including biosimilar development, cell line creation, purification, formulation, analytical development, and aseptic fill‑finish. The company operates state‑of‑the‑art facilities covering drug substance and product manufacturing, adhering to cGMP standards, and serves clients worldwide with expertise in complex antibody formats such as bispecifics and trispecifics.

providers.name: BrightGo
providers.description: BrightGo is an all-in-one janitorial and commercial-cleaning ERP platform for building service contractors. It unifies field operations, workforce management, and back-office finance in one system: scheduling, GPS-verified time and attendance, inspections and quality assurance, real-time job costing, payroll, and accounting, plus operations business-intelligence dashboards and an in-app employee communication portal. Backed by Index Ventures and Costanoa Ventures, BrightGo serves janitorial companies across the U.S. and Canada. No public developer API or documentation surface has been identified; the product is delivered via web (app.brightgo.com) and iOS/Android mobile apps.

providers.name: Brii BioSciences
providers.description: Brii BioSciences Limited (stock code: 2137.HK) is a biotechnology company founded in 2018, developing therapies for high unmet medical needs, notably hepatitis B virus infection. Operating in China and the United States, the firm focuses on innovative therapeutic candidates and has a pipeline of unique programs. It employs a visionary leadership team and aims to improve patient health through advanced biotech research.

providers.name: BT Group
providers.description: BT Group plc (British Telecommunications) is the United Kingdom's largest fixed-line, broadband, and mobile communications provider, headquartered in London with operations spanning consumer, business, wholesale, and global enterprise markets. The group is organised around three customer-facing brands — BT, EE, and Plusnet — and a wholesale division that sells capacity and access to other communications providers. BT Group operates the UK's largest mobile network (EE), runs fibre and copper access through Openreach (a legally separate group company), and provides networked IT and security services to multinational enterprises and the UK public sector. The group publishes a public developer programme at developer.bt.com that exposes a growing catalogue of REST APIs across two main domains: charging and crediting (Direct Carrier Billing, Crediting, Premium SMS) and digital identity / fraud prevention (SIM Swap, Network Identity, Call Divert Protection), alongside wholesale and operational APIs (Broadband One, Quote Management, Address Management, Appointment Management, Product and Network Availability, HubCo Voice, Global Voice Services, IMEI Lookup, Home Network, Rail Insights, Location Insights for London, and a Travel Journey API Platform). The portal supports sandbox onboarding with Client ID / Client Secret OAuth 2.0 credentials and progression to production under a commercial agreement with an account team. In April 2025 BT announced a federated API management partnership with Kong (Kong Konnect) to consolidate its previously fragmented API estate, strengthen governance, and offer a self-service developer experience across the group.

providers.name: Capgridsolutions
providers.description: Capgridsolutions (CapGrid) is a tech‑enabled design‑to‑deliver company offering precision parts and components through cloud manufacturing, dynamic fulfilment and quality assurance. It provides end‑to‑end supply‑chain visibility, traceability and sourcing services across automotive, EV, agri‑equipment and more, serving over 25 customers and 400 suppliers worldwide.

providers.name: Capitalfloat
providers.description: Capitalfloat, now operating as Axio, is an Indian consumer finance platform offering pay‑later, credit, and personal finance management solutions. Founded to provide flexible financing for online shoppers and small businesses, Axio has expanded into a unified financial services ecosystem, serving millions of customers across India with digital loans, budgeting tools, and merchant partnerships. The company focuses on transparent, technology‑driven credit products and aims to make credit worthy for all.

providers.name: CareTaker Medical
providers.description: Caretaker Medical provides the VitalStream platform, a device that delivers continuous, beat‑to‑beat hemodynamic monitoring both invasively and non‑invasively. The system is sold to hospitals and other care settings for use in pre‑operative, operating‑room, ICU, step‑down and ambulatory surgery environments, integrating with existing GE Carescape and Philips Intellivue monitors.

providers.name: Celebal Technologies
providers.description: Celebal Technologies is an enterprise data and AI consulting and engineering firm founded in 2016 and headquartered in Jaipur, India, with delivery across 13 countries and more than 3,000 certified professionals. It partners with organizations on digital transformation across Data Engineering, Generative AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, cloud and database migration, SAP Extend & Innovate, app modernization, and enterprise cloud integration, building on Microsoft Azure, Databricks, AWS, and SAP. Proprietary products include Konverto AI, CT VMS, CT Passport, CT Vision, Eagle Eye IQ, PuFF, and Chronify, serving manufacturing, retail & CPG, oil & gas, energy, BFSI, healthcare, media & entertainment, public sector, ITES, and education. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners; no public API or developer surface was found.

providers.name: Cerecin
providers.description: Cerecin is a neuroscience-focused healthcare company headquartered in Broomfield, Colorado, with additional offices in Singapore and Australia. It leverages the physiological ketone system to develop metabolic therapies for brain disorders, including rare pediatric epilepsy and Alzheimer’s disease. The firm has a diversified pipeline of products, strategic partnerships, and a scientific advisory board, aiming to address unmet medical needs in neurology through innovative drug delivery and formulation technologies.

providers.name: ChemTech AI
providers.description: ChemTech AI is an industrial software company, founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York, that builds autonomous AI control systems for chemical production plants. Its software continuously optimizes manufacturing by autonomously adjusting DCS setpoints to push plants to their maximum safe capacity, sustaining peak production while reducing emissions and losses. The platform is applied across chemical processes including ammonia, nitric acid, phosphoric acid, sulfuric acid, methanol, ethanol, and polyethylene, serving the chemicals, food, cosmetics, and oil and gas sectors. ChemTech AI is a portfolio company of 500 Global. No public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal are currently published.

providers.name: Chimebiologics
providers.description: Chime Biologics is a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) specializing in cell line development, process development, protein science, technology transfer, and drug substance and product manufacturing. The company offers comprehensive services including quality systems, regulatory support, project management, data integrity, and client confidential information protection, serving biotech and pharmaceutical clients worldwide.

providers.name: Codel Doors
providers.description: Codel Doors manufactures and sells fiberglass and steel entry doors, patio doors, and interior doors. The company provides its products through a network of dealers and wholesale distributors. It offers collections such as Smooth Fiberglass, Oak Grain Textured Fiberglass, Contemporary Classics, Rustic, Steel, and Primed Shaker interior doors.

providers.name: Confluence Unity
providers.description: Confluence Unity is the unified fund administration and reporting platform from Confluence Technologies, a software provider focused on the global investment management industry. The Unity suite (including Unity Financial Reporting, Unity Performance, and Unity Rex for AI-driven reconciliation) consolidates data, regulatory and shareholder reporting, and performance analytics for asset managers, fund administrators, and asset servicers. Confluence operates Unity as a hosted SaaS platform with integrations into client data warehouses; the public site does not publish open developer API documentation, so developer access is typically arranged through Confluence account teams.

providers.name: Cormintdatasystems
providers.description: Cormint Data Systems designs, manufactures, and operates high‑performance power infrastructure for large‑scale data centers and Bitcoin mining operations. The company builds modular power systems in‑house, operates multiple sites in Texas, and provides turnkey solutions for AI‑intensive workloads, emphasizing cost‑efficiency and reliability.

providers.name: Cortica
providers.description: Cortica is a Tel Aviv, Israel based Autonomous AI company founded in 2007 that builds and spins out category-leading AI companies. Its self-learning, unsupervised "Autonomous AI" is modelled on the mammalian cortex — signatures instead of labels, adaptive architecture, and self-learning neural networks that index high volumes of visual, audio, radar and time-series signal on low-compute platforms. Cortica states it has invested more than $250M over 15 years and holds 300+ patents, and it operates as a venture builder rather than a product vendor: its technology reaches the market through partner joint ventures and spin-outs including Autobrains (autonomous driving), Corsight AI (facial recognition), Corsound AI (voice), SeeTrue (airport security screening), CordiGuide (medical imaging) and Lean AI / Qualisense (industrial quality inspection, with Johnson Electric). Cortica itself publishes no developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable specification on its own domain.

providers.name: Coru
providers.description: Coru is an enterprise-grade AI company transforming financial services across Latin America with conversational AI agents. Its "Adi" platform lets banks, fintechs, and insurers build and customize agentic workflows for digital loan origination, 24/7 customer service, collections management, insurance quoting, claims handling, and commission reconciliation across web, app, and WhatsApp channels in Spanish, Portuguese, and English, with multimodal input (text, voice, audio, documents) and OCR-based document capture. Coru serves financial institutions including Bradesco, Banorte, and Neon, and is backed by QED Investors. Coru markets a hosted, enterprise agent product and does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: couple
providers.description: couple (couple.me) is an AI companion chat platform operated by Fab AI LTD and backed by Slow Ventures. The consumer-facing product lets users create and customize an AI girlfriend, boyfriend, or anime character, then hold personalized text conversations and request AI-generated images from that companion. It offers a free tier with an optional premium subscription. It is a consumer app with no public developer portal, API, SDKs, or documentation surface as of this enrichment pass; this profile captures the company identity and the domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Credence MedSystems
providers.description: Credence MedSystems is a healthcare technology company focused on providing advanced medical device integration platforms for hospitals and clinics. The firm offers middleware solutions that connect diagnostic equipment, electronic health records, and patient monitoring systems, enabling seamless data exchange and workflow automation. Their services aim to improve clinical efficiency, data accuracy, and patient outcomes through secure, scalable integration services.

providers.name: CRISPR QC
providers.description: CRISPR QC provides a CRISPR Analytics Platform delivering real‑time kinetic insights into gene‑editing workflows. Their services enable researchers to quantify RNP formation, DNA target binding, and cleavage efficiency, helping optimize guide design, enzyme selection, and process parameters across discovery to manufacturing. By offering detailed kinetic data, CRISPR QC accelerates decision‑making, reduces costly trial‑and‑error, and improves reproducibility for biotech and synthetic biology applications.

providers.name: Crunched
providers.description: Crunched is an AI Excel analyst for power users in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, and corporate finance. Working as a native Microsoft Excel add-in (Mac and PC) and a companion PowerPoint deck reviewer, it builds fully linked financial models (DCFs, LBOs, cohort and scenario analyses) from plain-English instructions, error-checks entire workbooks, extracts and structures data from PDFs and web sources, formats spreadsheets, and generates client-ready slides with full workbook context. Every edit is tracked with a full audit trail and cited sources. Founded by Philip Borge and Michael Sakowski (ex-McKinsey private equity), Crunched is ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant, and is backed by Y Combinator, First Round Capital, and 20VC. It is distributed through the Microsoft AppSource marketplace and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: DNOW
providers.description: DNOW Inc. (NYSE: DNOW), formerly NOW Inc. and operating as DistributionNOW, is a Houston-headquartered Fortune 1000 distributor of pipe, valves, fittings (PVF), pumps and packaged, engineered process and production equipment serving the upstream, midstream, downstream energy, and industrial sectors. Spun off from National Oilwell Varco in 2014 and built on a heritage that spans more than 160 years, DNOW combines a global network of distribution branches and engineering facilities with the DigitalNOW platform — shop.dnow.com B2B eCommerce, cXML/OCI ERP punchout integrations, the eSpec product configurator, the AccessNOW automated inventory control system, and a library of customer-facing mobile applications. DNOW does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, or a self-serve API program; customer integrations are delivered through configured cXML/OCI punchout sessions tied to enterprise ERP systems. In June 2025 DNOW announced a definitive merger agreement to acquire MRC Global in an all-stock transaction valued at approximately $1.5 billion.

providers.name: Earth AI
providers.description: Earth AI is a vertically integrated, AI-powered mineral exploration company that discovers, develops, and owns critical mineral mines for the emerging hardware economy — data centers, humanoid robots, eVTOL aircraft, fusion energy, space, and defense. Its proprietary predictive model, MTP, is trained on roughly 400 million geological sites to identify the source rocks of new mineral deposits and dramatically compress traditional exploration timelines. The company vertically integrates the search for critical minerals: it predicts targets with AI, acquires mineral rights, and drills to prove and own the resource. Earth AI is backed by DCVC and has been profiled by TechCrunch, Business Insider, and The Generalist's Future 50. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Earth AI does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Empirico
providers.description: Empirico is a biotechnology company that powers therapeutic discovery with human genetics and small interfering RNA (siRNA) medicines. Combining internal capabilities in human genetics and siRNA chemistry with partner expertise, the company identifies naturally occurring genetic variations associated with health benefits and develops precision oligonucleotide therapeutics for common diseases with significant unmet medical need. In October 2024 Empirico entered a licensing agreement with GSK worth up to $745 million for a clinical-stage oligonucleotide targeting respiratory disease (COPD). Empirico is backed by DCVC. It is a pharmaceutical R&D company and does not operate a public technology or API platform.

providers.name: Encompass Health
providers.description: Encompass Health is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Encompass Health API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Endogastric Solutions
providers.description: EndoGastric Solutions is a medical device company focused on treating gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD). Its flagship offering is the TIF (Transoral Incisionless Fundoplication) 2.0 procedure, performed with the EsophyX Z+ device and SerosaFuse non-resorbable polypropylene fasteners to endoscopically reconstruct the natural antireflux barrier at the esophagogastric junction, plus the combined cTIF procedure that pairs hiatal hernia repair with TIF. The company sells devices and clinician training rather than software, and it has since been acquired by Merit Medical — the endogastricsolutions.com domain now redirects to merit.com/solutions/tif-2-0/. It surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and carries no public API, developer portal, SDK, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: Ensign Group
providers.description: Ensign Group is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Ensign Group API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Federal Labor Relations Authority
providers.description: The Federal Labor Relations Authority oversees the Federal service labor-management relations program. It administers the law that protects the right of employees of the Federal Government to organize, bargain collectively, and participate through labor organizations of their own choosing in decisions affecting them.

providers.name: Finverse
providers.description: Finverse is a unified open finance API platform providing aggregated access to banking data, payments, and financial services across Asia-Pacific. Often described as the Plaid for Asia, it connects to over 40 banks across Hong Kong, Singapore, Philippines, Vietnam, and other Southeast Asian markets.

providers.name: Flowserve
providers.description: Flowserve moves, controls and protects the flow of materials in the world's most critical industries through pumps, seals, valves, and flow control systems. No public developer APIs have been identified; the company offers digital services such as RedRaven IIoT monitoring through customer engagements rather than an open developer portal.

providers.name: FT Cash
providers.description: FTCash (ftcash) is a Mumbai, India based financial services / fintech company focused on financial inclusion for micro-merchants and small and medium enterprises (SMEs). It provides digital payment acceptance and working-capital business loans to small offline retailers and merchants who are typically underserved by traditional banking, enabling them to accept digital payments and access short-term credit. FTCash was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global (500 Startups) and added to the API Evangelist network. At this time FTCash operates a public marketing website but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts, so this profile is limited to verified company identity plus a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Gravy
providers.description: Gravy is a local-first, AI-powered personal finance workspace that runs on the Mac. It connects every bank, credit card, and investment account, automatically categorizes every transaction, and lets people ask plain-language questions about their money while keeping the data on their own device for privacy. Gravy focuses on optimizing spending, surfacing savings, tracking investments and recurring subscriptions, and automating tedious money tasks for both individuals and small businesses. It is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) company. Gravy is a consumer application and, as of this profile, publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: H2O Hospitality
providers.description: H2O Hospitality is a South Korea-based hospitality digital-transformation company that connects existing hotel and leisure systems rather than replacing them, streamlining operations from booking to checkout. Its products span three areas: Connect (cloud property-management tooling including Smart CRS, Smart RMS, and Smart FMS), Maximize (revenue and guest-engagement tools such as Smart D2C and AI-based CRM), and Transform (managed operations). It offers smart mobile check-in and automated inventory management, operates across nine countries in Korea, Japan, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East, and is ISO 27001 and ISO 27701 certified. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: Huron Consulting Group
providers.description: Huron Consulting Group is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Huron Consulting Group API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: InkSoft
providers.description: InkSoft is a custom apparel e-commerce, online store, and design platform for screen printers, embroiderers, and print shops - part of the Inktavo family alongside Printful and GraphicsFlow. It provides hosted online stores, a browser-based Design Studio, product catalogs, art/clip-art libraries, and order management. InkSoft exposes a documented but license-gated developer surface, the InkSoft API 2, a per-store RPC-style HTTP API returning XML or JSON with CORS support. It lets partners and store owners build custom storefronts, product catalog pages, design galleries, cart and checkout flows, and single sign-on against a specific web store. API access requires an InkSoft Unlimited license and an additional monthly fee, so the reference is public but production use is account-gated.

providers.name: KWI
providers.description: KWI is a retail technology company founded in 1985 and headquartered in Melville, New York, that delivers a cloud-based, unified commerce platform for specialty and department retailers. The platform combines an iOS mobile point-of-sale, merchandising and inventory optimization, order management with buy-anywhere / fulfill-from-anywhere fulfillment, CRM, clienteling and loyalty, the Snapshot real-time sales analytics application, and AI product image search, all operated as a SaaS managed service with helpdesk, hardware, and payments support. KWI describes an API layer in its platform architecture used to export data to third-party systems and channels --- CRMs, ERPs, SRPs, and supply chains --- alongside packaged connectors such as Shopify Connect and a Klaviyo connector. As of this profile KWI publishes no public developer portal, API reference, machine-readable specification, or SDKs; integration is delivered through its professional-services organization under customer contract.

providers.name: Leucine
providers.description: Leucine is an AI-powered software platform for pharmaceutical manufacturing, quality, and laboratory operations, helping drug manufacturers plan, execute, and optimize every batch. The platform spans a Manufacturing Execution System (batch execution, batch intelligence, production logbooks, batch release, shop floor monitor, material management), a Quality Management System (AI Investigator, FDA Tracker, cleaning validation, market complaints, change control, CAPA, supplier quality, audit and deviation management), and a Laboratory Execution System (environmental monitoring, instrument logbooks, QC planning). Leucine also publishes FDA compliance research including 483 analysis and investigator profiles. As of 2026 the company is migrating its web presence from leucinetech.com and leucine.io to leucine.ai. Leucine is an enterprise SaaS vendor and does not publish a public developer API program, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Locofy
providers.description: Locofy.ai is an AI-assisted design-to-code platform that converts Figma and Adobe XD designs into production-ready front-end code. The flagship product Locofy Lightning is a Figma/Adobe XD plugin that tags designs and exports responsive code; Locofy Builder is a web-based workspace for refining the generated app, wiring data, and shipping to repositories. Output targets include React, Next.js, React Native, HTML/CSS, and Gatsby. The platform is primarily delivered as plugins and a web app rather than a public REST API.

providers.name: Luzia
providers.description: Luzia is a consumer-facing artificial intelligence assistant serving 85M+ users across web, iOS, Android, desktop, and WhatsApp, with a strong presence in Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking markets where it ranks as the #1 app in several countries. The free assistant offers AI chat, image generation, PDF understanding, web search, and an agentic "LuziClaw" task mode, with a Luzia+ premium subscription adding advanced reasoning, custom AI characters, and higher generation limits. Luzia is a portfolio company of Prosus Ventures. As of this enrichment pass, Luzia publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Mangomint
providers.description: Mangomint is salon and spa business management software covering scheduling, point of sale, payroll, marketing, memberships, and forms. Mangomint has no public, self-service developer portal, no published REST/GraphQL API reference, and no OpenAPI specification. Its only documented programmatic surface is outbound webhooks (appointment booked/updated/canceled, sale completed, form submitted) that Mangomint staff configure by hand over chat support once a customer supplies a receiving endpoint URL; payload schemas and authentication are not published. A small set of one-off, vendor-built integrations (Shopify, Mailchimp, Docovia, Doxy.me, WaiverForever, Gift Up!) are toggled on from the Mangomint dashboard, and there is no listed Zapier app. This entry is documented as a stub because there is no public API to catalog.

providers.name: Merida Biosciences
providers.description: Merida Biosciences is a Cambridge, Massachusetts biopharmaceutical company developing precision immunology therapies for autoimmune and allergic disorders. The company targets the pathogenic drivers of antibody-driven diseases with the goal of durable clinical responses while minimizing the side effects of current non-specific autoimmune treatments. Launched in 2025 with $121 million in funding and backed by GV, Merida operates as a preclinical therapeutics company with a science-and-pipeline website and no public developer, API, or technical product surface.

providers.name: MKS Instruments
providers.description: MKS Instruments is a global provider of foundational technology solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, electronics and packaging, and specialty industrial markets. Its product portfolio spans vacuum and gas delivery systems, photonics, lasers, optics, motion control, and process control. No public developer API or developer portal has been identified at the corporate level; technical integration is typically handled through product-level documentation, sales engineering, and partner channels.

providers.name: Montenegro Open Data
providers.description: Montenegro Open Data is a national government open-data portal for Montenegro running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 894 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: NACCO Industries
providers.description: NACCO Industries is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The NACCO Industries API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: National Transportation Safety Board
providers.description: The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) is an independent federal agency responsible for investigating transportation accidents, including those involving airplanes, trains, ships, and pipelines. The NTSB promotes safety and prevents future accidents by conducting thorough investigations and making recommendations to improve safety standards.

providers.name: Noon Academy
providers.description: Noon Academy (Noon) is a social learning platform where students study alongside their friends in live, teacher-led group classes. Operated by Noon Tech Limited and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, the company serves more than 12 million students and over 100,000 teachers across five countries, primarily in the Middle East and South Asia. Noon is a consumer education product delivered through student and teacher apps and a web experience; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal. This API Evangelist profile was created from a 500 Global portfolio lead and enriched with the company's public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Office of Community Oriented Policing Services
providers.description: The Office of Community Oriented Policing Services (COPS Office) is a component of the U.S. Department of Justice that works to advance the practice of community policing in law enforcement agencies across the country. The COPS Office provides grants, resources, and technical assistance to help law enforcement agencies develop and implement community policing strategies that build trust and collaboration with the communities they serve.

providers.name: Office of Congressional Workplace Rights
providers.description: The Office of Congressional Workplace Rights is responsible for enforcing workplace rights for employees of the United States Congress.
