This includes overseeing the administration of laws such as the Congressional Accountability Act, which guarantees certain rights and protections for congressional staff members.

providers.name: Office of Fossil Energy and Carbon Management
providers.description: The Office of Fossil Energy and Carbon Management is a division of the U.S. Department of Energy that is focused on addressing the challenges of reducing greenhouse gas emissions and advancing clean energy technologies. The office works to develop and deploy technologies that can capture, store, and utilize carbon dioxide emissions from fossil fuel sources, such as coal and natural gas.

providers.name: Parsons
providers.description: Parsons Corporation is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Parsons Corporation API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Pathos
providers.description: Pathos (Pathos AI, Inc.) is an AI-enabled, clinical-stage biotechnology company founded in 2022 by Eric Lefkofsky and Ryan Fukushima that applies artificial intelligence and large-scale multimodal patient data to oncology drug development. Its PathOS platform is organized around three engines — Scout (AI asset selection that matches an investigational therapy to the patient subgroup most likely to respond), Sprint (small autonomous clinical-execution pods that design and run biomarker-driven trials), and Foundry (the oncology foundation model built in partnership with Tempus and AstraZeneca) — trained against a stated corpus of more than 200 petabytes of multimodal clinical, molecular and imaging data linked to patient outcomes. The company raised a $365M Series D in May 2025 at roughly a $1.6B valuation, completed the acquisition of Rain Oncology, and is advancing a precision-oncology pipeline that includes a CBP/p300 inhibitor and a brain-penetrant PRMT5 inhibitor. Pathos sells partnership and co-development to pharma and biotech; it publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: PearPop
providers.description: Pearpop, Inc. is a Los Angeles-based creator marketing company founded in October 2020 by Cole Mason and Guy Oseary. It began as a two-sided social collaboration marketplace where brands could book social-media creators on demand under a performance-based, pay-per-placement model, and has since grown into a full-service creator marketing partner running campaigns for brands including Netflix, Microsoft, Chipotle, Klarna and Activision. Its current product line is marketed at pearpop.com (brand campaigns, creator representation and events) plus Pearpop.AI at pearpop.ai — described in Pearpop's own terms of service as an AI-powered email platform for content creators and influencers that handles brand-deal inboxes, contract review, rate recommendations and payments. Pearpop publishes no public developer program, API documentation, SDKs or machine-readable API specification; the only live API namespace, pearpop.ai/api/*, redirects unauthenticated callers to the application sign-in page.

providers.name: Platformable
providers.description: Platformable provides API governance, open ecosystem intelligence, and consultancy services. Their training resources, dashboards, and tools help organizations build comprehensive, automated, high quality API governance systems and participate in open digital ecosystems including open banking, digital health, and traceability.

providers.name: Plus
providers.description: Plus (PlusAI) develops AI-based autonomous driving technology for commercial trucks. Its flagship SuperDrive is an AI-powered Level 4 autonomous driving system, and HyperFoundry is an integrated development platform for Physical AI. Plus works through partnerships with truck OEMs including TRATON GROUP, Hyundai, and IVECO rather than shipping a public developer API. Backed by GGV Capital, the company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; this enrichment pass confirmed it exposes no public API, SDK, or developer portal surface, and captured its domain-security posture.

providers.name: Poetic
providers.description: Poetic is an enterprise AI automation company whose platform learns an organization's rules and procedures and then executes end-to-end business processes with high precision and compliance. Marketed as "turn your business into software," Poetic ingests procedures, training materials, and expert feedback to build self-healing automations that adapt when underlying systems change, targeting long, multi-step workflows such as fraud detection, KYC, and dispute resolution. The company emphasizes enterprise-grade security with zero data retention (processing data in-transit only) and states SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS, HIPAA, and GDPR compliance, and cites customers including AIG, SoFi, and Chime. Poetic is an early-stage, Kleiner Perkins-backed AI company; as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Povio
providers.description: Povio is a Y Combinator-backed product design and engineering agency headquartered in San Francisco that helps startups and established companies design, build, and launch scalable digital products. The team delivers end-to-end UI/UX and product design, frontend, backend, and mobile engineering, DevOps, QA, and AI, IT, and legal consulting across 38+ technology stacks including React, Node.js, Python, Swift, and the major cloud platforms. Povio positions itself around AI-accelerated delivery ("build in days what once took months") and engages through fixed-price projects, dedicated teams, staff augmentation, and startup MVP / CTO-as-a-Service models. Povio does not operate a public API or developer portal; it does maintain open-source GitHub organizations that publish first-party developer tooling such as deployment CLIs and the PovioKit Swift toolkit.

providers.name: Prellis Biologics
providers.description: Prellis Biologics is a Berkeley, California biotechnology company that discovers fully human antibody therapeutics by combining wet-lab human immunology with machine learning. Its EXIS (Externalized Immune System) platform uses LNO lymph node organoids — 3D tissue printed with holographic two-photon photolithography — to recreate human lymph node biology in vitro, raise true human antibody responses across genetically diverse donors, and feed the resulting sequence and characterization data into generative AI models that predict and optimize candidates in an iterative lab loop. The company sells antibody discovery collaborations and licensed therapeutic programs to pharmaceutical partners rather than software, and publishes no public developer program, API, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Proper
providers.description: Proper (proper.ai) is an AI-powered, full-service property-management accounting and bookkeeping provider serving property managers, asset managers, and real estate developers. Rather than shipping software, Proper delivers a trained accounting team supported by automation to handle accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, month-end close, and financial reporting, integrating with existing property-management systems such as AppFolio, Buildium, and RentManager. Founded in the property-management space in 2017, the company is backed by QED Investors, Redpoint Ventures, MetaProp, Expa, and Bling Capital. As of this enrichment pass Proper exposes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable developer surface; this profile is maintained as a company record.

providers.name: Prototyping.io
providers.description: Prototyping.io is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) startup building AI-driven autonomous manufacturing for mechanical parts. The platform converts CAD designs into finished physical parts by automating design-for-manufacturability analysis, manufacturability evaluation, production planning, machine execution, and quality control across CNC machining, sheet metal, 3D printing, injection molding, extrusion, and die casting. Founded by Revanth Bodepudi (CEO) and Prerit Oberai (CTO) in the San Francisco Bay Area, it targets hardware teams in robotics, AI infrastructure, energy, automotive, and defense, aiming to cut hardware iteration cycles from weeks to days with no minimum order quantities and tight tolerances. The company is in early-access/waitlist stage and does not yet publish a public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Pura Mente
providers.description: Pura Mente is the most-downloaded meditation and sleep app in the Spanish-speaking world, offering guided meditations, sleep stories, breathing exercises, and mindfulness programs designed to reduce stress, improve focus, and help people rest deeply. Backed by 500 Global, it operates as a consumer mobile app (iOS and Android) with a private, authentication-gated backend and no public developer API program.

providers.name: Qognify
providers.description: Qognify is an enterprise physical-security software provider whose portfolio spans video management systems (Ocularis, Qognify VMS formerly Cayuga, and NiceVision), physical security information management / PSIM (Situator), and video analytics used to protect critical infrastructure, transportation, utilities, and enterprise campuses worldwide. The business was formed in 2015 when Battery Ventures acquired NICE Systems' physical security unit, and was acquired by Hexagon AB in 2023, becoming part of Hexagon's safety and security operations. The brand and products are transitioning to Octave Security, with next-generation offerings delivered under the Coda line (formerly HxGN dC3). Qognify sells through channel partners and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; integrations are handled via partner and professional-services channels and the Hexagon support organization.

providers.name: Radionetics Oncology
providers.description: Radionetics Oncology is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing precision radiopharmaceutical treatments for cancer. The company designs small-molecule radioligands that target G-protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) to selectively deliver targeted radiation therapy to solid tumors, including breast and lung cancer, combining GPCR biology expertise with medicinal chemistry. Radionetics entered a strategic agreement with Eli Lilly in 2024. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public developer, API, or technical-integration surface at this time.

providers.name: Shopee
providers.description: Shopee is Southeast Asia's largest e-commerce marketplace, operated by Sea Limited and active across Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Taiwan, and select markets in Latin America (Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Chile) and Europe (Spain, Poland). Shopee Open Platform (open.shopee.com) exposes a partner / seller-facing REST API (v2) covering shop configuration, product / SKU management, order processing, logistics and shipping label generation, returns and refunds, discounts and vouchers, payments, push notifications, and global cross-border product management. Authentication uses a partner ID + partner key with per-shop access tokens issued via OAuth- style shop authorization.

providers.name: Solda.ai
providers.description: Solda.ai is an AI sales-agent platform that provides fully automated, autonomous sales departments powered by AI agents. Its voice- and text-based AI sales representatives execute the full sales cycle end to end, handling outbound cold outreach, inbound calls, follow-ups, callbacks, conversion optimization via A/B testing, and use cases such as credit-card and loan upselling, card activation, debt collection, and B2B lead qualification. The company markets primarily to banking and fintech customers and states compliance with SOC 2, HIPAA, and the EU AI Act. Solda.ai is a venture-backed company (Accel portfolio) headquartered in Middletown, Delaware. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes a marketing site, blog, and legal pages, but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: SVT
providers.description: Sveriges Television (SVT) is Sweden's public service television company, providing news, sports, culture, and entertainment across multiple channels and digital platforms. The organization operates a comprehensive online presence at svt.se, offering up-to-date news articles, video streaming, regional coverage, and specialized sections such as SVT Play and SVT Barn. As a major media outlet, SVT delivers content in Swedish and serves a broad audience with a commitment to public service broadcasting.

providers.name: Tempo Labs
providers.description: Tempo (Tempo Labs) is an AI app builder at tempo.new positioned around the "Prompt. Develop. Design. Collaborate." loop - users describe an app in natural language, Tempo generates code, and developers iterate either in the visual canvas or directly in code. The product targets design-to-code and prompt-to-code workflows for React / Next.js apps and is primarily consumed as a hosted web product rather than as an API. Public developer surface is limited; integrations and connected services (auth, database, hosting) are surfaced inside the product rather than via a documented public API.

providers.name: The Bot Company
providers.description: The Bot Company is a San Francisco robotics startup founded in 2024 by Kyle Vogt, the co-founder and former CEO of Cruise, building a helpful general-purpose robot for every home to automate everyday household chores. Its team draws from Tesla, Cruise, OpenAI, Google, and Pixar, and the company has raised roughly $301M (reportedly valued near $2B) from investors including Spark Capital and SV Angel. As of this profile the company operates a marketing and careers site only and publishes no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: TigerEye
providers.description: TigerEye is an AI company for the construction industry, helping builders get answers faster and spend less time searching for information across construction, business intelligence, and home planning and delivery workflows. Founded as an Initialized Capital-backed startup and acquired by homebuilder Lennar to scale its capabilities nationally, TigerEye operates a public marketing site with an About page, Terms of Use, and Privacy Policy. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, documentation, or well-known discovery surface, and its former Secureframe-hosted trust center now redirects to a 404.

providers.name: Tryprism
providers.description: Prism (tryprism.com) is a San Francisco, Y Combinator-backed AI-powered recruiting agency that delivers qualified talent leads to hiring teams faster and more affordably than traditional recruiters. Clients describe the role they need to fill, Prism's AI handles sourcing, screening, and candidate outreach end-to-end, and clients interview only pre-screened candidates. Pricing is 15% of first-year salary per hire (versus the typical 20-30% agency fee) plus a retainer to initiate and prioritize the search, charged only when a hire is made. As of this profile Prism operates as a managed recruiting service and publishes no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or discovery surface.

providers.name: Tweezr
providers.description: Tweezr is a system-intelligence platform for safe legacy change, helping banks and insurers understand and incrementally evolve legacy core systems without risky big-bang modernization. The platform maps mainframe and heritage codebases (COBOL, PL/I, CICS, IMS, DB2 z/OS, VSAM, IBM i RPG, Adabas/Natural) into a deterministic, queryable, cited model that grounds engineering teams and AI tools in what the code actually does before anything is changed. Tweezr deploys on-premise by default, is a member of the Banking Industry Architecture Network (BIAN), partners with 10x Banking, is distributed through AWS Marketplace and Microsoft AppSource, and is a Techstars portfolio company. Tweezr publishes no public API or developer program as of July 2026.

providers.name: Universal Forest Products
providers.description: UFP Industries (formerly Universal Forest Products) is a leading global manufacturer and distributor of wood and wood-alternative products serving retail, industrial, and construction markets. UFP operates over 200 facilities globally supplying lumber, engineered wood products, packaging, and building materials. The company has integrated OnBase-based business system integration for document management and workflow automation across its supply chain operations.

providers.name: Vercept
providers.description: Vercept is an AI startup building AI that works directly on your computer rather than in a distant cloud — software that understands your screen, workflows, and intent and can act on your behalf safely and transparently. Its product, Vy, is a personal computer AI assistant offered as a paid subscription. Vercept was founded by Kiana Ehsani, Luca Weihs, and Ross Girshick, backed by Point Nine, Fifty Years, AI2 Incubator, and Madrona, and was acquired by Anthropic in early 2026. Vercept does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Vesta
providers.description: Vesta is an AI-native mortgage Loan Origination System (LOS) — a modern, open system-of-record platform that orchestrates the loan manufacturing process through configurable software workflows and AI agents that run real loans end to end. Founded in 2020 by former Blend employees Mike Yu and Devon Yang and headquartered in San Francisco, Vesta gives mortgage lenders a cloud, API-and-integration-friendly LOS to replace legacy origination systems, connecting to the broader mortgage technology ecosystem. The company raised an Andreessen Horowitz (a16z)-led Series A. Vesta sells to lenders through a demo/partner-signup enterprise motion and does not currently expose a public self-serve developer API, portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Volteum
providers.description: Volteum provides fleet electrification and EV fleet management software that helps companies plan, execute, and operate the transition of their vehicle fleets to electric. The platform covers electrification planning, charging optimisation, and live fleet management, connecting directly to vehicles through OEM APIs across 30+ brands with no hardware installation to track mileage, fault codes, charging sessions, maintenance intervals, and costs across electric, diesel, petrol, and hybrid fleets. Volteum is a Techstars portfolio company and publishes no public developer portal; its telematics and fleet-system API integrations are offered to customers directly.

providers.name: Vosbor
providers.description: Vosbor is a digital trading platform for bulk agricultural commodities, headquartered in Amsterdam with offices in Singapore and Shanghai. Founded in 2019 and backed by Lux Capital, its exchange lets trading firms and end users trade corn, wheat, soybean, palm oil and other grains and oilseeds in spot and forward markets, with integrated KYC, encrypted trade data, straight-through processing, and a WhatsApp AI broker that negotiates with multiple counterparties simultaneously. Market data is downloadable in CSV, and the company advertises data access through an API for customers, but publishes no public developer portal or API documentation.

providers.name: Welltower
providers.description: Welltower Inc. (NYSE: WELL) is an S&P 500 healthcare REIT that invests in senior housing, post-acute care, and outpatient medical properties across the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada. The company operates an internal operator portal at portaldev.welltower.com for property operators and partners. Welltower uses the Welltower Business System (WBS) and has integrated AI and data science capabilities including OpenAI. No public developer API has been identified; Welltower primarily uses internal proprietary systems for property management and operator coordination.

providers.name: Whova
providers.description: Whova is an award-winning all-in-one event management platform built around a mobile event app that carries the agenda, speaker profiles, attendee networking, live polls, and session Q&A, plus registration, ticketing, name badges, surveys, abstract/speaker management, and exhibitor/sponsor tools. Whova does NOT publish an open, self-serve developer API - there is no public developer portal, no documented REST reference, no OpenAPI definition, and no SDKs. Its only programmatic surface for organizers is a partner/CRM integration layer exposed through Zapier (triggers for attendee, order, and registrant changes plus a create/update-attendee action), reached from the organizer dashboard under Attendees > Integrations > CRM Integration, alongside prebuilt connectors to Eventbrite, Cvent, Constant Contact, RegFox, OpenReview, SharePoint/OneDrive, MailChimp, Wild Apricot, and Google Drive. The API entries below are logical, HONESTLY MODELED views of that integration surface (see endpointsModeled) - they are not sourced from a public Whova API reference, and no base URL, auth scheme, or endpoint paths are published by Whova.

providers.name: Zenflow
providers.description: Zenflow is a San Francisco-based medical device company founded in 2014 (Y Combinator W15) that develops the Zenflow Spring, a small permanent implant delivered in a minimally invasive in-office procedure to relieve urinary obstruction caused by benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH). The company positions the Spring as a long-lasting alternative to daily BPH medications and to more invasive surgical procedures, avoiding their side effects and recovery burden. Zenflow is a medical-device / hardware company and does not publish a public API, developer platform, SDKs, MCP server, or webhooks; this record is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: ZenMaid
providers.description: ZenMaid is scheduling and business-management software for maid and house cleaning services - booking, calendar/dispatch, automated SMS and email communication, GPS-verified clock-in/out on a cleaner mobile app, online payments and invoicing, payroll, and reporting. ZenMaid has no public, self-service developer portal, no published REST/GraphQL API reference, and no OpenAPI specification of its own. Its only documented programmatic surface is a Zapier integration (triggers - New Customer Created, Appointment Booked, Appointment Cancelled, Appointment Updated, Contact Created/Updated, One-Time Service Created/Updated, Recurring Service Created/Updated/Cancelled, Invoice Created, Invoice Paid; actions - Create Appointment, Create Booking, Create Cleaner, Create Customer) built and maintained by ZenMaid against a private, undocumented backend API. No API keys, base URL, endpoint reference, payload schema, or SDK are published for third-party developers; the public GitHub organization (github.com/zenmaid) has no public repositories. This entry is documented as a stub because there is no public API to catalog.

providers.name: Aeronext
providers.description: Aeronext Inc. (株式会社エアロネクスト) is a Tokyo-based industrial drone technology startup, founded April 2017 by Keisuke Toji in Ebisu-Nishi, Shibuya-ku. Its core product is 4D GRAVITY(R), a patented airframe design that separates the flight unit from the payload unit and actively controls the center of gravity, improving stability, flight efficiency and payload performance. Aeronext monetizes through technology licensing and joint development — the Next-series airframes (AirTruck, LogiAir, PD4B-M-AN with PRODRONE) are built by licensee manufacturers — rather than through software. Its subsidiary NEXT DELIVERY Inc. operates SkyHub(R), a drone-plus-ground smart logistics platform co-developed with Seino Holdings and deployed across Japanese municipalities, with the SkyHub TMS system and a SkyHub Provider License program. Aeronext publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Airex Energy
providers.description: Airex Energy (Airex Énergie) is a Laval, Québec cleantech company that converts residual biomass — forest residues, sawdust, bark and recycled wood — into biocoal, biochar and biocarbon using its patented CarbonFX torrefaction technology. Founded in 2014 as a division of Airex Industries, it operates a commercial biocoal pellet plant in Bécancour, Québec, has partnered with SUEZ to industrialize biochar production in Europe and North America, and raised a CAD $38 million Series B in 2024. It is an industrial manufacturer and does not publish a developer program or public API.

providers.name: Arkedgespace
providers.description: ArkEdge Space is a Japanese satellite technology company developing low‑Earth‑orbit positioning, navigation and timing (LEO‑PNT) services, maritime communication, lunar infrastructure and deep‑space exploration capabilities. It builds its own satellites, onboard computers and ground‑segment solutions to empower safe, connected futures for people and industries worldwide.

providers.name: Aspen RxHealth
providers.description: Aspen RxHealth is a healthcare technology company that transforms medication management by connecting healthcare organizations with a nationwide network of licensed clinical pharmacists who deliver remote, patient-facing consultations. Its web-based BeWell platform supports CMS-compliant clinical programs including medication therapy management (MTM), medication adherence, chronic disease management, medication reconciliation, and statin-therapy gap closure, using proprietary matching algorithms to pair pharmacists with patients by language, geography, and clinical condition. Aspen RxHealth was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners; it does not currently publish a public developer portal or API.

providers.name: Atlas
providers.description: Atlas is an AI implementation partner built for independent accounting firms, deploying supervised, firm-specific AI "junior accountants" that automate repetitive, data-intensive workflows such as client onboarding, follow-ups, bookkeeping, compliance, and financial reporting while keeping human accountants in control of every decision and client relationship. Founded by Arpit Maheshwari (CEO) and Jagmal Singh (CTO) and co-led by Accel and Stellaris with Felicis participation, Atlas raised a $6M seed round in 2026 to scale its network of partner firms across North America. Atlas is currently a services-led AI company and publishes no public API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Atlas Copco
providers.description: Atlas Copco is a global industrial company that provides sustainable productivity solutions, including compressors, vacuum solutions, generators, pumps, power tools, and assembly systems. With a presence in over 180 markets, it focuses on innovation, energy efficiency, and digital services to help customers improve performance and reduce environmental impact. The company’s extensive portfolio serves industries such as manufacturing, construction, mining, and automotive, delivering equipment and services that enhance operational efficiency and reliability.

providers.name: Azafaros
providers.description: Azafaros B.V. develops therapeutic candidates for severe rare metabolic disorders. Its lead program is the orally available azasugar nizubaglustat, designed to treat central nervous system involvement and modulate glycosphingolipid metabolism in lysosomal storage diseases. The company focuses on patients with conditions such as GM1/GM2 gangliosidoses.

providers.name: Bridebook
providers.description: Bridebook is a free online wedding planning platform that helps couples plan their weddings across 185 countries. It offers tools for budgeting, guest list management, vendor selection, and timeline creation. The service is featured by major media outlets such as Apple, The New York Times, and the BBC, and operates as a SaaS solution for the wedding industry.

providers.name: Calificadas
providers.description: Calificadas is a Mexico-based, AI-powered human development company that combines artificial intelligence, strategic consulting, and training to help organizations and teams adapt to rapid change. Its tagline is "human infrastructure for the era of artificial intelligence." Its flagship product, CUALY (cualy.tech), is an AI-native platform for developing human capabilities through diagnosis, personalization, and continuous AI-driven feedback across communication, leadership, and collaboration, using voice and video analysis and AI coaches, plus organizational dashboards and iOS/Android apps. The company also delivers organizational consulting, leadership training, and adaptive training programs, and counts Coca-Cola FEMSA, ManpowerGroup, and Alsea among its clients. Backed by 500 Global, Calificadas was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, or API documentation; artifacts below reflect its public web and domain-security surface only.

providers.name: Californianaturals
providers.description: California Naturals (Californianaturals) is a women‑founded, California‑based personal care brand offering clean, naturally derived hair, body, and skincare products. Their lineup includes shampoos, conditioners, body washes, and bundles, all formulated without sulfates, parabens, silicones, and packaged in PCR‑plastic bottles. The company emphasizes eco‑conscious ingredients, cruelty‑free certification, and affordable pricing, shipping free on orders over $40.

providers.name: Carlaf042
providers.description: Carla (carlaf042) is a next‑generation private travel platform offering seamless, transparent, and instant booking of private jets, yachts, and villas. It supports both fiat (Stripe) and cryptocurrency payments, provides 24/7 concierge service, and emphasizes privacy, security, and advanced data protection. The company operates from its website carla.com, presenting its services, pricing, terms, and privacy policies, and offers a loyalty program and partner opportunities for jet owners.

providers.name: Close Brothers
providers.description: Close Brothers Group plc (LSE: CBG) is a UK merchant banking group founded in 1878 and a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index, headquartered at 10 Crown Place, London EC2A 4FT. The group provides specialist lending across motor, premium, asset, invoice, and property finance; takes personal and business deposits through Close Brothers Savings; manages wealth through Close Brothers Asset Management; and trades securities through Winterflood. Its banking entity, Close Brothers Limited, is authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority and the PRA. Close Brothers is not one of the CMA9 mandated banks; it offers savings and deposit products rather than online payment (current) accounts, and therefore carries no UK Open Banking (OBIE / PSD2) Read/Write or Open Data publishing obligation. As of this profile no public developer portal, Open Banking Open Data endpoint, or documented API surface could be confirmed for the group.

providers.name: Dare Drop
providers.description: Dare Drop is a gaming influencer marketing platform that connects game publishers and brands with content creators across Twitch, YouTube, and TikTok. The platform runs reward-driven "Dares" — challenges that incentivize streamers and creators to produce longer, more engaging content around a title, while automating creator targeting, campaign management, and reporting. Dare Drop offers influencer campaigns, ongoing influencer programs, and organic outreach, and has facilitated over 18,000 publisher Dares and distributed more than 30,000 rewards to creator communities. Its customers include game studios and publishers such as EA, Respawn, Raw Fury, Tencent, Obsidian, and Gearbox. Surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API surface has been found to date.

providers.name: Dronamics
providers.description: Dronamics is a European deep-tech company that designs, builds, and operates autonomous long-range cargo drones for middle-mile logistics. Its flagship aircraft, The Black Swan, is a remotely piloted UAV that carries up to 350 kg (770 lb) of cargo over distances up to 2,500 km (1,550 mi), enabling same-day, cross-border, point-to-point deliveries that are faster, cheaper, and lower in CO2 emissions than traditional air freight. Founded in 2014 in Sofia, Bulgaria by brothers Svilen and Konstantin Rangelov and operating as Dronamics Group Limited, the company is building the world's first cargo drone airline, operating a proprietary drone fleet from a network of low-cost droneports. The public dronamics.com marketing site is built on Wix and exposes a Wix Site MCP endpoint for agentic access; Dronamics does not publish a developer-facing logistics API, OpenAPI, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Dune Security
providers.description: Dune Security is a cybersecurity company whose User Adaptive Risk Management platform uses AI-driven behavioral analysis to quantify and reduce user-layer cyber risk. It runs omni-channel attack simulations (email/spear phishing, smishing, vishing, deepfakes, and encrypted-app lures) tailored to each employee's role and behavior, generates a live User Risk Score from five inputs (business impact, simulations, training activity, external security integrations, and historical data), and automatically adapts micro-training and security controls in real time. The platform integrates with IAM, EDR, SEG, DLP, and HRIS systems to escalate or restrict access for high-risk users, and ships an in-house training library (Security Awareness, Compliance, and Functional-Specific Training) covering NIST 800-53, NIST CSF, HIPAA, PCI DSS, SOX, ISO 27001, FFIEC, GLBA, and GDPR. Dune Security is backed by Craft Ventures.

providers.name: Equilibrium Energy
providers.description: Equilibrium Energy is a venture-backed clean energy technology company building PowerOS, an agentic AI platform for the power and energy sector. The platform is designed to solve the extreme data and systems fragmentation across the power tech stack, uniting enterprise data, models, and systems under a common ontology and code frameworks so that power companies can deploy power-specific AI with guardrails they control. PowerOS bundles enterprise agents (trader and research copilots, app co-developers, data ingestion and transformation), configurable application suites (portfolio management, portfolio construction, development workbenches, middle and back office), and reusable core services (optimization, forecasting, risk, grid and market fundamentals, trading). The company's Mission Control product is in invite-only beta. Equilibrium Energy is backed by DCVC and is headquartered in the United States. It currently exposes no public developer API; this profile tracks its public web, news, and organization surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Fold
providers.description: Fold (NASDAQ: FLD) is a bitcoin financial services company founded in 2014 and based in Atlanta, Georgia, billed as the first publicly traded bitcoin financial services company. Fold makes it easy for individuals and businesses to earn, save, and use bitcoin through consumer products including the Fold App, the Fold Bitcoin Rewards Credit Card, the Fold Debit Card, and the Fold Bitcoin Gift Card marketplace, paying real bitcoin rewards (not points or a proprietary token) on everyday purchases and bill payments. Bitcoin custody and Lightning Network payouts are powered by partners such as BitGo and OpenNode. Fold is a consumer-facing fintech application and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: FutureFit AI
providers.description: FutureFit AI is an AI-powered workforce technology company that connects people to careers, employers to talent, and workforce partners to tools for integrated and intelligent workforce systems. Its Pathways Platform powers workforce-system transformation while its Career Copilot delivers AI-driven career guidance across career navigation, labor exchange, employment services, virtual career centers, upskilling and reskilling, and industry talent pipelines. The company serves workforce development, economic development, and enterprise customers. As of this enrichment pass FutureFit AI publishes a marketing and product site but no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Goin
providers.description: Goin is a European consumer fintech platform, backed by Anthemis and based in Barcelona, Spain, that helps more than 700,000 users across Europe grow their money and spend less. The app bundles automated savings (fixed daily, weekly or monthly rules and goal-based portfolios), investing, buying and selling of cryptocurrencies, cashback and rewards at hundreds of online and physical stores, gift cards and coupons, and a browser extension that surfaces discounts while shopping. Bank accounts are connected securely under Europe's PSD2 open banking regulation, and a referral program rewards users for inviting friends. Goin is a business-to-consumer mobile product distributed through the Apple App Store and Google Play; it does not publish a public developer program, API, or documentation surface. This API Evangelist profile tracks Goin as a portfolio lead and captures its public web, help, and legal presence.

providers.name: GrayMatter Robotics
providers.description: GrayMatter Robotics is an American industrial AI and robotics company founded in 2020 by SK Gupta, Ariyan Kabir and Brual Shah, headquartered at a 100,000-square-foot AI Robotics Innovation Center in Carson, California. The company builds smart robotic cells for surface treatment and finishing in high-mix, high-variability manufacturing — sanding, grinding, polishing, buffing, blasting, spraying, trimming and AI-based dimensional inspection and defect detection — pairing off-the-shelf industrial robot arms, 3D scanners and tools with its own physics-informed AI stack (GMR-AI, marketed as Factory SuperIntelligence / FSI). Its flagship Scan&Sand cell 3D-scans each incoming part and generates the toolpath autonomously, so a cell can change over between parts in minutes without fixturing or teach-pendant programming, and the company claims 4-12x throughput over manual finishing with 30-70% less consumable waste. GrayMatter sells robots-as-a-service on a monthly subscription that bundles hardware, software, training, remote monitoring and 24/7 support instead of an upfront capital purchase, and counts Boeing, Caterpillar and Oshkosh among its customers. It raised a $45M Series B in June 2024 led by Wellington Management with NGP Capital, Euclidean Capital, B Capital, 3M Ventures, Calibrate VC, OCA Ventures, Pathbreaker VC, Stage Venture Partners and Swift VC participating. GrayMatter Robotics is a robotics hardware and AI systems manufacturer: as of the August 2026 enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, CLI or machine-readable API contract (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, gRPC), no MCP server and no A2A agent card. Note that this company is unrelated to greymatter.io, the service-mesh vendor with a similar name.

providers.name: GuruHotel
providers.description: GuruHotel is AI-native direct-booking infrastructure for independent hotels: an AI-powered hotel website builder, a conversion-optimized direct booking engine, and a Stripe-powered payment-orchestration platform that turns a hotel's official website into a commission-free direct booking channel with real-time inventory, multi-currency checkout and a guest-first experience. Founded in 2019, GuruHotel is trusted by 1000+ hotels, serves 200,000+ guests a year and processes $15M+ in annual gross booking value across the United States, Mexico, the Caribbean and Europe. It connects to hotel PMS platforms directly (Cloudbeds) and through Channex (280+ PMS incl. Mews, apaleo, Oracle OPERA Cloud, Guesty, Hostaway), plus Google for Hotels. GuruHotel is a portfolio company of 500 Global and Anthemis.

providers.name: Hub
providers.description: Hub (Hub.xyz) is a distributed physical-AI data infrastructure company that creates, annotates, and curates custom real-world datasets — egocentric first-person video, image, video, and audio — used to train AI and robotics models. Data is sourced through a global network of 500,000+ retail contributors and verified small and medium businesses across 150+ countries and 100+ languages. Hub offers both off-the-shelf labeled datasets and bespoke, custom-scoped data collection projects quoted within hours, delivered through a fully managed pipeline that couples automation with human-in-the-loop validation for frontier AI labs and Fortune 500 companies.

providers.name: Hyperproof
providers.description: Hyperproof is a continuous compliance and risk management platform that automates evidence collection, control management, and audit workflows. It exposes a public REST API covering 20+ resources (Controls, Policies, Programs, Risks, Proof, Tasks, Issues, Vendors, Users, Groups, Roles, Scopes, Questionnaires, Custom Apps, Labels, and more) plus the Hypersync SDK for custom integrations.

providers.name: insitro
providers.description: insitro is a machine-learning-driven drug discovery and development company founded in 2018 by Daphne Koller and headquartered in South San Francisco, California. It combines large-scale in vitro cellular data generated in its own automated labs with human clinical and genetic data to build predictive models of biology, aiming to bring better drugs faster to the patients most likely to benefit. Its therapeutic focus spans metabolism, oncology, and neuroscience, and its interdisciplinary teams pair life scientists, data scientists, and engineers. insitro operates no public developer API; it maintains open-source research and infrastructure tooling (such as the redun workflow engine) on its GitHub organization. Backed by a16z, GV, and the SoftBank Vision Fund.

providers.name: Karnott
providers.description: Karnott is a French agricultural technology company based in Lille that builds connected tracking devices and a digital management platform for farms, equipment cooperatives (CUMA), agricultural contractors (ETA), and wine growers. Its beacon automatically records equipment usage and field interventions without manual data entry, enabling real-time fleet and equipment monitoring, fuel-cost tracking, parcel mapping, and precise billing and regulatory documentation. Karnott is a portfolio company of Partech. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal was found on the provider's public surface as of this pass.

providers.name: Lassen Peak
providers.description: Lassen Peak, Inc. is a Seattle-area public-safety technology company founded in 2019 by veterans of ultra-high-speed wireless, imaging radar, broadband communications and law enforcement. It builds AirFrisk, a handheld terahertz imaging-radar scanner that detects concealed weapons at a distance without a hands-on pat-down, and ImageVault, the companion cloud console that manages AirFrisk users, devices, scan data, retention policy, alerts, reporting and audit logs for an agency under FBI-CJIS compliant storage. The company has raised roughly $22M across Series A and A1 rounds and holds multiple issued US patents. Lassen Peak sells a device plus a customer-tenant cloud console to police, sheriff and security agencies; as of this profile it publishes no public developer program, no API documentation, no SDKs and no machine-readable contract of any kind on its own domain.

providers.name: Lendify
providers.description: Lendify provides financing solutions for businesses in Sweden, offering factoring, corporate loans, real‑estate loans, and consumer credit. Their platform enables fast cash flow improvements with quick approvals, flexible terms, and transparent pricing, aiming to support growth for companies of all sizes.

providers.name: Lucidum
providers.description: Lucidum is a cyber asset and security data platform (CAASM) that ingests, correlates, and enriches data from more than 500 sources to give security and IT teams a unified inventory of assets, identities, data, and their relationships. The Security Data Fabric platform eliminates blind spots by connecting to existing SIEM, cloud, endpoint, and identity systems without extra ingestion charges, and surfaces unseen systems and accounts for exposure and attack-surface management. Lucidum was acquired by Cyderes and its capabilities are now delivered as part of the Cyderes "Meridian" platform. This profile originated as a GGV Capital portfolio lead and was enriched from Lucidum public web surface; the company publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Lumotive
providers.description: Lumotive is a Seattle-based semiconductor company building programmable optics on its patented Light Control Metasurface (LCM) technology — solid-state, software-defined beam steering implemented in a standard CMOS process with no moving parts. Its products include the LM10 and LX10 LCM beam-steering chips, the LCM Evaluation Kit (LEK), the M30 iToF and NM120 3D-sensing development kits, and the M30/TX10 reference designs, applied to industrial automation, intelligent traffic systems, automotive ADAS and autonomy, defense, and optical circuit switching for AI data centers. Lumotive publishes an "Open Lidar API" — a real-time control interface for software-defined Lidar 2.0 hardware covering region-of-interest scanning, frame rate, resolution and range, plus a common point-cloud format — and ships C/C++ LCM control libraries with Python bindings alongside its evaluation kits. That interface is an embedded hardware-control API, not a public web API: no developer portal, documentation site, machine-readable specification, or self-service sign-up is published, and access is granted to selected partners through the Technology Access Program by contacting the company.

providers.name: Mindset
providers.description: Mindset is a mobile self-care and wellness application by DIVE Studios that pairs audio content from celebrity artists and musicians with expert-led mental health resources. Features include Celebrity Mindsets audio collections, a five-minute Daily Check-In routine, Daily Reflections community sharing, licensed-professional advice, and daily quotes, delivered on iOS and Android with a 50,000+ member Discord community. Mindset operates a private, login-gated mobile backend at api.getmindset.com behind Google OAuth; no public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or well-known discovery surface is published.

providers.name: Modak
providers.description: Modak (Modak Makers) is a US consumer fintech that offers a family money-management app built around a free Visa debit card for kids and teens. Parents can assign chores and automate allowance, set savings goals with reward boosts, and use co-parenting tools, gift links, ATM access, bill splitting, and spending controls such as instant alerts, card freeze, and biometric security. Kids earn MBX reward points through daily steps and challenges that convert to pocket money, so they learn to spend, save, and manage money in real life. Modak is delivered as a mobile consumer application and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. Backed by GGV Capital.

providers.name: Neolink
providers.description: Neolink is an open-source bridge for Reolink cameras that provides an RTSP stream gateway and REST API for managing Reolink IP cameras, enabling integration with NVR software, home automation, and other camera management tools.

providers.name: Nutrisystem (Wellina by Nutrisystem)
providers.description: Nutrisystem is a direct-to-consumer subscription meal delivery service for weight loss, founded in 1972 by Harold Katz and headquartered in Fort Washington, Pennsylvania. The company pioneered prepackaged weight-loss meal subscriptions, transitioned from physical retail to a direct-to-consumer Internet and telephone model in 1999, and added mobile delivery beginning in 2010. Nutrisystem is now operated under the marketing umbrella "Wellina by Nutrisystem" — a multi-brand health and wellness marketplace covering Nutrisystem, Jenny Craig, High Protein, Menopause Support, Low Carb (GLP-1 friendly), and the Club Advantage à la carte membership. The legal operating entity is Nutrisystem, LLC, a subsidiary of Wellful, Inc. (the parent organization formed after Kainos Capital acquired Nutrisystem from Tivity Health in October 2020). Tivity Health no longer owns the brand. Wellful's portfolio also includes South Beach Diet (acquired by Nutrisystem in December 2015 for $15 million) and the Jenny Craig intellectual property (acquired by Wellful in fall 2023 after Jenny Craig's Chapter 7 bankruptcy and relaunched as an e-commerce meal-delivery brand). LinkedIn classifies the company under Wellness and Fitness Services with 501–1,000 employees. Stephen Mikulak was named President in 2021. Nutrisystem publishes no public developer APIs, OpenAPI specs, SDKs, or developer portal. Its only digital surface beyond the e-commerce sites is the consumer-facing Nutrisystem mobile app (iOS / Android) for food logging, weight tracking, journaling, and meal-plan adjustments — and the equivalent Jenny Craig app — neither of which advertise integrations with Apple Health, Google Fit, Fitbit, or any third-party platform. The github.com/nutrisystem GitHub organization exists but contains a single inactive CSS repository last updated in March 2015. The technology footprint is a closed consumer subscription stack with no public developer touchpoints.

providers.name: Open Voice Network
providers.description: The Open Voice Network is a Linux Foundation project advancing open standards for AI-enabled voice assistance systems. Its core initiatives around TrustMark and interoperability promote ethical, accessible, and interoperable voice technology across platforms and devices.

providers.name: OpenAPI Initiative
providers.description: The OpenAPI Initiative is a Linux Foundation project that promotes the OpenAPI Specification for defining standard, language-agnostic interfaces to RESTful APIs. It provides governance, tooling ecosystem support, and community collaboration for the most widely adopted API description format.

providers.name: Pack
providers.description: Pack is an AI-powered skill management platform for HR and People teams. The product helps organizations map skills into future-proof ontologies, assess proficiency across teams, identify strategic skill gaps, and build personalized development plans for employees. Additional capabilities include business impact analysis, a Return on Development Investment (RODI) calculator, and access to a network of 1,000+ certified trainers for mentoring and coaching. Pack integrates with existing HRIS and LMS systems. The company (Pack SRL) has raised approximately EUR 5.8M and is backed by Anthemis and Techstars. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead; as of this enrichment pass Pack publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Pariti
providers.description: Pariti is an AI-powered talent acquisition platform that helps companies source, vet, and hire candidates through a community-driven referral network of thousands of leaders, technologists, and recruiters. It pairs recruiter-trained AI/ML candidate screening with salary benchmarking (Salary Insights) and a Talent Engine that aims to move roles from open to offer in about four weeks. Pariti is a portfolio company of 500 Global. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, MCP server, or developer documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's public web presence and security posture as a lead awaiting a real API surface.

providers.name: Philips
providers.description: A Dutch multinational health technology company focused on diagnostic imaging, patient monitoring, image-guided therapy, ultrasound, sleep and respiratory care, and connected care solutions. Philips transitioned from a diversified electronics conglomerate to a dedicated healthcare technology leader and operates the HealthSuite Digital Platform (HSDP) as its cloud-based platform for connected health applications. HSDP exposes Identity & Access Management, Provisioning, IoT/Connect, Foundation, Cognitive, Clinical Data, and Notification building blocks to enable consumer health and professional healthcare applications, but access is gated behind a customer portal at www.hsdp.io with developer documentation distributed to authenticated customers and partners rather than the open public web. Philips also operates vertical Connected Care offerings (Patient Monitoring, eICU/Capsule, Sleep & Respiratory Care/SimplyGo, IntelliSpace) layered on HSDP. The legacy Philips Hue lighting API is no longer a Philips offering - Hue has been spun off into Signify and is published at developers.meethue.com.

providers.name: Physicsx
providers.description: PhysicsX is an AI-native engineering software company, founded in 2020 and headquartered in London (Shoreditch) with an office in New York, building a platform that embeds physics AI directly into industrial engineering and manufacturing workflows. The platform unifies simulation, physics AI, data, and engineering applications into a single foundation, pairing fast AI-driven physics inference (Deep Physics Models) with numerical simulation to compress development cycles and expand the design space engineers can explore. It integrates with industry-standard CAE/CAD tooling (ANSYS, CATIA, Siemens NX, OpenFOAM, Siemens Star-CCM+), runs cloud-agnostically across AWS and Azure plus hybrid and on-premises deployments, and serves aerospace and defense, automotive, semiconductors, materials, and energy and renewables. Born out of Formula One, PhysicsX has raised roughly $489M across five rounds from investors including General Catalyst, Atomico, Temasek, NVIDIA, Siemens, and Applied Materials. There is no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures the company identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Portland General Electric
providers.description: Portland General Electric is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Portland General Electric API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: PrisonDB
providers.description: PrisonDB is a project that aims to provide information and tools to help folks gain access to data about prisons, jails, immigrant detention centers and other correctional institutions in the United States.

providers.name: Rapattoni
providers.description: Rapattoni Corporation is a California-based provider of multiple listing service (MLS), association management, accounting and REALTOR association software for boards and MLSs in the United States. It maintains a developer section on rapattoni.com (/dev/) covering its RETS data service and change log and a RESO Web API section for licensed third-party data access to MLS listing data. The rapattoni.com site geo-blocks non-US traffic and returned 403 to every probe in this pass, so no endpoint, base URL or machine-readable contract could be verified; the record holds only what was observable.

providers.name: Regbase
providers.description: Regbase is an AI-native regulatory intelligence platform that helps legal teams, compliance professionals, researchers, and government vendors monitor new and proposed laws worldwide. The platform uses AI agents to identify regulatory changes across 195 countries and 50 US states, surfacing draft bills, consultations, compliance requirements, and opportunities like grants from hard-to-find government sources, non-English publications, and informal channels that traditional tools miss. Regbase then analyzes those changes automatically and alerts users to updates relevant to their practice areas, spanning employment and labor, AI governance, healthcare, privacy, climate and sustainability, government contracting, and other regulated industries. Founded in 2026 and part of Y Combinator's Spring 2026 batch, Regbase is based in San Francisco. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist network; at the time of enrichment Regbase publishes a login-only web application and no public API, developer documentation, or SDK.

providers.name: Remind
providers.description: Remind is a K-12 school-home communication platform that lets teachers, schools, and districts message students and families by text, app, email, and voice without exchanging personal phone numbers. The product line includes Remind Chat, a free two-way messaging service used by individual teachers and classrooms, and Remind Hub, a paid district-wide communications platform with administrative controls, SIS integration, delivery analytics, and translation into 90+ languages. Remind reports use in roughly 80% of US public schools and by a majority of US teachers. In November 2023, Santa Barbara-based ParentSquare acquired Remind, and the combined company now operates under the ParentSquare name with Remind Hub continuing for existing district customers and Remind Chat continuing for classroom-level use; Remind Tutoring was discontinued as part of the combination. Remind's only externally documented developer surface is the Share on Remind SDK (the "Remind Share SDK"), a partner program that lets approved third-party content providers embed the Remind composer into their own product, authenticate Remind users via OAuth 2.0, serve shareable content and previews via partner-hosted webhooks, and ship messages back through Remind. The Share SDK is accessed by application through partners@remind.com and the developer console at remind.com/integrations; there is no public self-serve REST API, no published OpenAPI specification, and no general-purpose messaging API for sending Remind messages from third-party systems.

providers.name: Solfacil
providers.description: Solfacil is a Brazilian clean-energy fintech and photovoltaic distributor that operates the largest solar-energy ecosystem in Latin America. Through a B2B2C model it connects more than 20,000 partner solar integrators to 100% digital solar financing (approval in ~30 seconds, terms up to 120 months), distribution of homologated PV equipment (own branches in Jundiai-SP, Jaboatao dos Guararapes-PE and Tubarao-SC), the Solfacil Smart monitoring and asset-management platform, battery/BESS storage, insurance products, and the Solfacil Academy training programs. Financial products are regulated by the Banco Central do Brasil via Solfacil SCFI S.A. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Fifth Wall and QED Investors; no public developer API was found - the customer surface is the partner Integrator Portal, storefront, and monitoring platform.

providers.name: Somos Internet
providers.description: Somos Internet is a Colombian residential and business fiber-optic internet service provider (ISP) delivering high-speed home and enterprise broadband across cities including Medellin, Bogota, Sabaneta, Rionegro, Caldas and Laureles. The company is building AI-ready digital infrastructure for Latin America and raised a $40M Series B backed by Ribbit Capital. It offers fiber internet plans, parental controls, TV channel line-ups, and Wi-Fi routers to homes, businesses, and property developers. No public developer API, SDK, MCP server, or other programmatic surface has been identified for Somos Internet; it is a consumer and enterprise connectivity provider rather than an API platform.

providers.name: South Jersey Industries
providers.description: South Jersey Industries is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The South Jersey Industries API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Stegra
providers.description: Stegra (formerly H2 Green Steel) is a Stockholm-headquartered industrial company, founded in 2020 and backed by Vargas Holding, building what it describes as Europe's first large-scale near-zero-emission steel plant in Boden, northern Sweden. The 270-hectare Boden site integrates a giga-scale electrolyzer producing green hydrogen from renewable Nordic electricity, a direct-reduction plant making green iron without coking coal, and a downstream steel mill — a combination Stegra says cuts steelmaking emissions by roughly 95 percent versus the blast-furnace route. Its commercial products are green steel, green iron and green hydrogen, sold to automotive, construction and appliance customers. Stegra is a heavy-industry manufacturer rather than a software vendor: it operates no public developer portal, publishes no API documentation, and serves no machine-readable API contract. Its only public engineering surface is the stegraab GitHub organization, which maintains community Terraform providers and a tflint ruleset used for its own internal infrastructure.

providers.name: Study Edge
providers.description: Study Edge is an education technology company that builds online learning, tutoring, and test-preparation platforms for students. Its products deliver on-demand instructional video, live and scheduled study sessions, practice problems, and course-specific study resources, and the company is known for operating statewide math learning platforms such as Algebra Nation / Math Nation. Study Edge is a consumer- and institution-facing learning service rather than a developer platform; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio company.

providers.name: Stylight
providers.description: Stylight is an online fashion and home-decor shopping aggregator that curates and compares products from more than 100 retailers, letting shoppers browse women's and men's apparel, footwear, accessories, beauty and home furnishings across many brands in one place and then complete the purchase on the partner retailer's own store. The platform operates localized sites across the US, UK, Germany, Austria, Switzerland, France, Italy, Spain, Belgium, the Netherlands and Canada, runs an editorial style magazine, and monetizes through affiliate partnerships with the retailers it links to. HV Capital was an early backer. Stylight publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its public web, legal and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Supponor
providers.description: Supponor is a virtual advertising technology company for live sports broadcasting, now part of TGI Sport. Its software digitally replaces and inserts in-venue brand placements with real-time overlays, letting broadcasters serve region-targeted advertising across multiple feeds, languages, surfaces, and camera angles. Core products include AIR, an AI-driven virtual advertising platform for live broadcast; HUB, a pre-event suite for fixtures, inventory, playlists, creative and approvals; and Data Room, a post-event analytics platform for reporting, video storage, and performance metrics. Supponor works across any sport and surface with remotely deployable, all-weather technology, and is used by organizations including FC Bayern, the NHL, The FA, Serie A, and La Liga. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Northzone; it publishes a corporate and careers web presence but no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Syneos Health
providers.description: Syneos Health is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Syneos Health API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Textron
providers.description: Textron Inc. is a $14.8 billion Fortune 500 multi-industry company employing 34,000 people worldwide. Textron operates through five business segments: Bell (military and commercial helicopters), Textron Aviation (Cessna, Beechcraft, Hawker aircraft), Industrial (Kautex fuel systems, Textron Specialized Vehicles including E-Z-GO and Jacobsen), Textron Systems (defense and autonomous systems), and Textron Financial. As of 2026, Textron does not offer publicly documented developer APIs or integration portals.

providers.name: TomoCredit
providers.description: TomoCredit is a consumer fintech that helps people build credit without requiring a credit score or prior credit history. Its flagship products are the Tomo Card, a credit-building card marketed as an all-new black card, and TomoBoost, an AI-powered credit-building tool. The company positions itself around fast approval (apply in minutes), no credit-history requirement, and cardmember benefits and coverage it values at over $1,300, aiming to help thin-file consumers such as newcomers and students establish and grow their credit. TomoCredit was surfaced through the Techstars portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Tovala
providers.description: Tovala is a Chicago-based food-technology company that pairs a fresh meal delivery service with its proprietary smart countertop ovens. Weekly rotating, chef-crafted meals ship with QR codes that the Tovala Smart Oven (5-in-1) and Smart Oven Pro (6-in-1 with steam) scan to cook automatically, eliminating shopping, prepping, and cleanup. The company also offers GLP-1 balanced and high-protein menus, flexible meal plans, and a consumer mobile app backed by its api.tovala.com platform. Tovala is a Y Combinator portfolio company.

providers.name: Transportstyrelsen
providers.description: Transportstyrelsen is the Swedish Transport Agency responsible for overseeing all aspects of transportation in Sweden, including road, rail, air, and maritime sectors. It develops regulations, issues permits, and provides public services such as vehicle registration, driver licensing, and safety oversight. The agency also publishes statistical data, guidelines, and digital services for citizens and industry stakeholders through its website.

providers.name: Tuli
providers.description: Tuli Health operates a UK-wide network of over 300 high-street pharmacies as local diagnostic hubs, making clinical services - primarily blood testing and phlebotomy - accessible in every neighbourhood so people can get care close to home. It offers healthcare providers three models - One Network (white-label phlebotomy), One Solution (end-to-end test kits, draws and lab analysis), and an Enterprise tier with custom integration. Tuli exposes an API and web portal for booking and managing tests, though public developer documentation is not yet published.

providers.name: Xalts
providers.description: Xalts (operated by Tokuten Pte Ltd) is an Accel-backed fintech building an AI agent platform for corporate treasury and finance teams — a copilot that automates trade finance operations (guarantees, trade payments, documentary credit and collections), liquidity management, and revenue operations. Task-specific agents learn internal processes and policies and integrate with ERPs, accounting systems, payment processors, and banks through the company's Omni Connect Protocol, which provides multi-bank connectivity via a single API. Xalts does not currently publish a public developer portal or API documentation; its connectivity APIs are offered to enterprise customers.

providers.name: 410 Medical
providers.description: 410 Medical, Inc. is a privately held medical device company headquartered in Durham, North Carolina, founded in 2013 by pediatric intensivist Dr. Mark Piehl and named for the pediatric septic shock guideline of four 10 ml/kg fluid boluses. It designs, engineers and assembles the LifeFlow family of handheld rapid infusers — LifeFlow for crystalloid resuscitation and LifeFlow PLUS for blood and blood components — which let a single clinician deliver a unit of blood or 500 ml of fluid in under two minutes without a pump or pressure bag. LifeFlow received FDA clearance in 2016 and is used by hospital emergency departments, trauma centers, pediatric and obstetric units, EMS agencies, fire departments and military and public safety teams for sepsis, trauma, hemorrhagic shock and postpartum hemorrhage. 410 Medical is a physical medical device manufacturer: it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, OpenAPI or any other machine-readable specification, and its entire web surface is a WordPress marketing, clinical-evidence and training site.

providers.name: 8fit
providers.description: 8fit is a consumer health and fitness application offering personalized home workout programs (HIIT, boxing, Pilates, yoga, and meditation), custom healthy meal and nutrition plans, and holistic wellness guidance built around sustainable habit-building rather than quick fixes. Founded in Berlin and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Creandum, 8fit reached more than 40 million downloads before being acquired by Withings (a Gilde Healthcare portfolio company) in February 2022. Withings announced the discontinuation of the standalone 8fit app effective June 26, 2026, folding its nutrition and activity content into the Withings app and Withings+ service. 8fit is a mobile/web consumer app and does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web, security, and identity surface.

providers.name: Aiden Auto
providers.description: AiDEN Auto (Aiden Automotive Inc.) is a connected-vehicle software company founded in 2021 by former Volvo Cars connected-services and infotainment engineers, with offices in San Ramon, California and Gothenburg, Sweden. Its software-only platform runs natively on Android Automotive OS (AAOS) infotainment head units and lets automakers, fleets and third-party service providers deliver in-cab mobility services — tolling, parking, fueling and charging, payments, insurance, roadside assistance, maintenance and regulatory compliance such as Poland's SENT cross-border freight reporting — without a phone, a downloaded app, or a bespoke per-OEM integration. AiDEN brokers real-time vehicle signals (fuel level, tire pressure, battery state, engine data, location) to partner backends under an application-level, GDPR/CCPA-aligned consent model, and partners configure signal access and triggers through the AiDEN Portal rather than proprietary OEM APIs. The company is a COVESA member, has raised roughly $11M (a $6.1M oversubscribed seed announced February 2025), holds three patents covering in-vehicle consent, payments and data sharing, and works with Volvo Trucks, HERE Technologies and IF Insurance among others.

providers.name: AlgoX2
providers.description: AlgoX2 is a data streaming operating system that unifies ingestion, ordering, fan-out, transformation, and durable storage into a single fault-tolerant engine, positioned as an alternative to assembling Kafka, Flink, and Redis. Built by veterans of NYSE Pillar's matching engine, the platform offers a partition-free API, compute-storage separation, a zero-copy runtime, and native multicast fan-out, with native support for Kafka, NATS, MQTT, Redis, HTTP, and WebSocket protocols and protocol bridging between them. Streams automatically materialize as Apache Iceberg, Delta, or Hudi tables in S3-compatible Parquet storage for lakehouse integration. AlgoX2 raised a $3.5M seed round led by Bessemer Venture Partners and serves real-time use cases including exchange and matching-engine infrastructure, market-data distribution, risk and surveillance, backtesting, and AI feature streaming.

providers.name: Alongsidefinance
providers.description: Alongsidefinance provides a financial platform that helps users manage personal finances, budgeting, and investment tracking. The service offers tools for expense categorization, goal setting, and real-time financial insights, aiming to simplify financial planning for individuals and small businesses. Through its web application and mobile integrations, users can securely link bank accounts, monitor cash flow, and receive personalized recommendations to improve financial health.

providers.name: Angstrom
providers.description: Angstrom Sports provides advanced sports forecasting and data analytics solutions for the US betting industry. Leveraging over 50 years of combined experience in bookmaking, modelling, proprietary trading, risk management, and service delivery, the company offers Monte‑Carlo simulations, granular play‑by‑play data, and neural‑network driven player valuation. Their platform delivers real‑time insights and predictive analytics to help clients make informed betting decisions.

providers.name: Anzen
providers.description: Anzen Technologies builds AI-powered market access software for commercial insurance agencies. Its flagship product, Anzen Pro, automates the commercial insurance quoting workflow: intelligent market matching predicts which carriers are most likely to respond to a submission based on historical quoting data, automated submission routing delivers each submission to a carrier's preferred channel (email, portal, or form), and submission intake extracts data from ACORDs, emails, and PDFs to generate branded client proposals in seconds. Anzen reports recovering roughly 80% of the time agency teams spend on administrative tasks and serves 200+ agencies while reducing errors-and-omissions exposure. The company holds a SOC 2 Type II attestation and anchors its security program on the NIST Cybersecurity Framework. Backed by a16z. No public developer API, documentation, or SDKs are published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Apnaklub
providers.description: Apnaklub is an Indian B2B platform that empowers small retailers by providing access to a wide assortment of FMCG products, credit facilities, free delivery, and other business solutions. It aims to increase retailer profits and reduce risks, serving over 60,000 retailers and 400+ brands, handling more than 1 million annual orders across Tier 2 and 3 markets.

providers.name: ARTI Analytics
providers.description: ARTI Analytics provides an enterprise AI platform offering solutions such as AI security & governance, DSML model development, and AI applications. Their flagship product ARTI Dominion acts as a control layer to enforce policy across models, agents, and tools in real time, delivering audit‑proof records. The company also delivers custom AI models, data science pipelines, and consulting services to help enterprises adopt trustworthy AI at scale.

providers.name: Aseon Labs
providers.description: Aseon Labs builds robotic pitstops for self-driving cars — distributed robotic micro-depots (the "Aseon Pod") that automate charging, interior and exterior cleaning, and inspection for autonomous vehicle fleets directly within their operating zones, so vehicles reset locally instead of returning to centralized facilities. The company says the approach can cut reset costs by up to 50%, reduce downtime by ~65%, and add $50,000+ in annual revenue per vehicle. Founded in 2026 and backed by Y Combinator (Spring 2026 batch), the Redwood City, CA startup is a physical-infrastructure and robotics company; it does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specifications.

providers.name: Atom Bank
providers.description: Atom Bank plc is a UK app-only digital bank headquartered in Newcastle upon Tyne, and the first mobile-only bank in the United Kingdom (no branches, no web banking). Authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FS Register 661960), Atom offers fixed savings accounts, residential and commercial mortgages, and secured business lending, all delivered through its iOS and Android apps. Atom does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; it is a consumer of UK Open Banking, letting customers share a one-off snapshot of their bank data (via aggregators such as Plaid, Tink and TrueLayer) to speed lending decisions. Backed by Anthemis and others, Atom runs a Go/Python/Java/Kafka technology stack and operates a four-day working week.

providers.name: Audacy
providers.description: Audacy, Inc. is a U.S. multi-platform audio and entertainment company that operates the country's second-largest radio group alongside the Audacy streaming app, a major podcast network, and the Amperwave audio ad-tech and distribution platform. Formerly known as Entercom (rebranded to Audacy on March 30, 2021), the company filed prepackaged Chapter 11 bankruptcy on January 7, 2024 and emerged on September 30, 2024 as a privately held company after equitizing approximately $1.6 billion of funded debt and reducing total debt from roughly $1.9 billion to $350 million. The current portfolio spans ~230 radio brands across 47 markets, 200+ million monthly listeners, ~2 billion annual podcast downloads, and the Cadence13, Pineapple Street Studios, Podcorn, and BetMGM Network (formerly BetQL) audio brands. There is no public developer API, no published OpenAPI, and no GitHub organization with public repositories; integration is brokered through ad sales, programmatic marketplaces, and the Amperwave platform.

providers.name: Axis 2
providers.description: Axis (axis.xyz) is a Y Combinator-backed (W2022) knowledge base platform for corporate affairs, government relations, and compliance teams that helps large companies understand their markets and regulatory obligations across the world. The platform delivers regulatory intelligence for international expansion - which laws to comply with and which officials to seek approvals from - spanning 40+ countries and 200+ industries across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. This is a product SaaS company; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Bonfy.AI
providers.description: Bonfy.AI provides advanced data security solutions for enterprises, protecting against data risks, shadow AI, and ensuring contextual data enforcement across AI agents and platforms. Their offerings include data surface visibility, secure AI systems, and compliance tools for financial services, healthcare, and technology sectors, helping organizations mitigate AI‑driven threats and maintain governance.

providers.name: BRICKS
providers.description: BRICKS is a no-code Platform-as-a-Service from BRICKS DAG, Inc. (Taipei, Taiwan) for building and managing interactive digital signage, kiosks, and multi-display stitched screens. A WYSIWYG editor lets designers and businesses create dynamic, data-driven displays — menu boards, wayfinding and crowd control, meeting-room panels, sports scoreboards, promotional posters, and NFT frames — deploy them to app-bound devices, control them remotely from mobile, and connect live data sources and APIs, all without writing code.
