BRICKS is a 500 Global Accelerator Taiwan (TTA 2022) company.

providers.name: Brickschain
providers.description: Brickschain provides a blockchain-based fractional ownership platform for real estate in India, enabling investors to buy and trade shares of property assets with regulatory backing. The platform offers a transparent, secure ledger for property transactions, targeting high returns and democratizing access to real estate investments.

providers.name: BTI Systems (Juniper)
providers.description: BTI Systems was an Ottawa, Ontario based supplier of cloud and metro packet-optical networking systems and software, best known for the BTI 7800 Series Packet Optical Transport platform, the BTI 800 Series, and the proNX family of management software (proNX Service Manager and proNX Optical Director). Juniper Networks acquired the remaining ownership interest in BTI Systems for approximately $25.8 million in cash, closing the acquisition on April 1, 2016, to accelerate open and automated packet-optical transport and SDN/NFV capabilities. BTI no longer operates as an independent company and publishes no independent developer portal or public API; the BTI Series and proNX product lines are documented and supported under Juniper Networks, whose proNX Optical Director exposes REST APIs northbound for OSS/BSS integration with NETCONF and telemetry southbound. This profile is retained as an acquired-company record in the API Evangelist network, with the live vendor surface tracked in the juniper-networks profile.

providers.name: Bugswagger
providers.description: BugSwagger provides senior security engineers who hand‑test web, API, mobile, cloud, and red‑team assessments. Their services include thorough penetration testing with real findings, detailed reports, and retesting. The team emphasizes manual testing over automated scanners, offering expert insight without junior outsourcing.

providers.name: Buildertrend
providers.description: Buildertrend is an Omaha, Nebraska-based cloud construction-management platform serving residential home builders, remodelers, and specialty trade contractors. The product consolidates sales (CRM, leads, proposals, contracts, email marketing), project management (schedule, daily logs, selections, change orders, warranties, sub portal, client updates), and financial management (estimates, bids, takeoff, job-costing budgets, bills, purchase orders, invoices, online payments) into a single web and mobile application used by 20,000+ builders. Pricing is custom-quoted by sales rather than published self-serve tiers, with unlimited users and projects on every plan, and the platform integrates with QuickBooks, Xero, and other accounting and trade tools through a partner integrations marketplace. The company exposes a REST API at api.buildertrend.com that is gated by partner agreement — endpoints return 401 Unauthorized to the public and there is no open developer portal, public OpenAPI specification, or self-serve API key signup. As a result Buildertrend is profiled here as a non-public (partner-only) API provider; the public surface documented is limited to marketing, support, integrations marketplace, mobile apps, and corporate resources.

providers.name: Campus Apartments
providers.description: Campus Apartments is a privately held student housing developer, owner, and operator headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Founded in 1958, the company originally served students of the University of Pennsylvania and has grown into one of the largest privately held student housing companies based in the United States, operating over 145 properties across more than 25 states with a portfolio of roughly 70,000 beds. The firm is led by CEO David J. Adelman and operates alongside affiliated brand presence historically associated with the Campus Crest student housing portfolio. Campus Apartments does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI documentation, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Canway
providers.description: Canway Holdings Ltd. is a Swiss holding company operating in the European cannabis industry. It acquires, invests in, and manages cannabis businesses across the value chain, including cultivation, processing, distribution, and retail. The group includes brands such as Green Passion, CannaBroker, and Dolocan, offering premium CBD products and innovative wellness solutions. Its mission is sustainable growth, regulatory compliance, and delivering high‑quality cannabis experiences worldwide.

providers.name: Central Intelligence Agency
providers.description: The Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) is the United States' civilian foreign intelligence service of the federal government, tasked with gathering, processing, and analyzing national security information from around the world. While the CIA does not maintain a formal public developer program, it publishes a small number of digital resources of interest to civic technologists and researchers, including the CIA.gov public website, the FOIA Electronic Reading Room (CREST) of declassified records, the World Factbook country profiles (open dataset, public domain), the CIA Museum digital collection, the Studies in Intelligence journal archive, and the agency's careers portal. Note that the World Factbook web product was discontinued on 4 February 2026, but a CC0-licensed JSON dataset of all 260 Factbook entities is preserved on GitHub by the community.

providers.name: CEPS (Centre for European Policy Studies)
providers.description: Founded in Brussels in 1983, the Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) is a leading independent think tank and forum for debate on EU affairs, with strong in-house research capacity and an extensive network of partner institutes. CEPS conducts evidence-based policy research on European and global issues (Data Governance Act, Data Act, AI Act, climate, energy, migration, trade, defence, financial markets) and disseminates it through publications, events, task forces and podcasts rather than through any programmatic interface. CEPS publishes no API, SDK or developer program, and as of 2026-09-05 has no working machine-readable surface: the RSS feed this record once pointed at returns HTTP 500 ("No feed available") and is robots-disallowed, and no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL SDL, MCP server, A2A agent card or /.well-known/ document exists on any ceps.eu host. Following CEPS now means the newsletter or the HTML listings on ceps.eu.

providers.name: Chronextcom
providers.description: Chronextcom is a luxury watch retailer based in Germany, offering certified pre-owned and new high-end watches from brands such as Rolex, Omega, Patek Philippe, Audemars Piguet, and Cartier. The company provides secure online purchasing, free delivery, a 14‑day return policy, and a dedicated customer service team. Their platform includes detailed product pages, a blog, and a contact center, positioning Chronext as a trusted source for premium timepieces.

providers.name: Cogni
providers.description: Cogni is a non-custodial cryptocurrency wallet and digital-asset management app that consolidates cash, crypto, and NFTs in a single mobile experience. Users hold their own private keys, back up their seed phrase to iCloud, manage assets across multiple blockchains and Layer 2 networks, store and view NFTs, and connect to web3 dApps directly from the app. Backed by Techstars, Cogni is a consumer-facing mobile product and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI at this time; this profile captures its public web properties and domain-security posture.

providers.name: CoinTracker
providers.description: CoinTracker is a cryptocurrency portfolio tracker and crypto tax software that connects a user's exchange accounts and blockchain wallets to automatically track holdings, calculate cost basis and capital gains, and generate tax reports and IRS forms. It supports a large catalog of exchanges, wallets, and cryptocurrencies, and offers tax-loss harvesting, performance tracking, and integrations with consumer tax-filing products. For developers and partners, CoinTracker publishes a first-party JavaScript SDK (@cointracker/tax-kit) for supplying cost-basis data; its core HTTP API is offered through enterprise and partner integrations rather than a self-serve public developer program. This profile was surfaced as a VC-portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from publicly discoverable surfaces (npm, GitHub, status page, DNS/TLS).

providers.name: Collegedekho
providers.description: CollegeDekho is an Indian education technology platform that helps students discover, compare, and apply to colleges and universities across India. It offers tools for exam preparation, career guidance, and admission counseling, aggregating data on courses, fees, placements, and rankings to assist students and parents in making informed decisions about higher education.

providers.name: ELV8
providers.description: ELV8 Inc. operates Scout, a financial platform built for college athletes and athletic departments navigating Name, Image, and Likeness (NIL) income. Scout provides NIL income tracking and management, financial education with one-on-one coaching, payment processing for schools (per diems, bonuses, and NIL payments), roster cap-management and compliance tooling, and business-setup assistance such as LLC formation and tax filing. ELV8 Inc. is an SEC-registered investment adviser and works with 30-plus college athletic programs serving thousands of athletes. It was surfaced as a Techstars-backed portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. Scout is a consumer/institutional fintech product and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: FANUC
providers.description: FANUC Corporation is a Japanese multinational headquartered in Oshino, Yamanashi at the base of Mount Fuji, and is one of the world's largest suppliers of factory automation, industrial robots, and CNC (computer numerical control) systems. Founded in 1972 after spinning out of Fujitsu's numerical control division (originated 1955) under Seiuemon Inaba, FANUC pioneered commercial NC and CNC technology and by the early 1980s held roughly half of the global CNC market. The company operates three primary business segments: FA (CNC systems, servo motors, lasers, and PMC controls for machine tools), Robot (industrial arms from the LR Mate and M-series through the heavy-payload M-2000iA, plus the CRX collaborative robot family), and ROBOMACHINE (ROBODRILL machining centers, ROBOCUT wire EDM, and ROBOSHOT all-electric injection molding machines). FANUC's primary developer surface is FOCAS (FANUC Open CNC API Specification), a licensed C/C++ library (fwlib32.dll) used by machine builders and MES/OEE vendors to read CNC state over Ethernet, plus KAREL and Teach Pendant (TP) programming on the robot controllers and a published ROS 2 driver for the CRX collaborative arms. FANUC does not operate a public REST developer portal or publish OpenAPI specifications; integrations are partner-driven through MTConnect adapters, OPC UA servers, FIELD system edge apps, and the FANUC America customer/training portals.

providers.name: Fortune Brands Innovations
providers.description: Fortune Brands Innovations is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Fortune Brands Innovations API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Forward Air
providers.description: Forward Air is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Forward Air API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Gin
providers.description: Gin is a high-performance HTTP web framework for Go that provides a fast and productive way to build microservices and APIs.

providers.name: Grade
providers.description: Grade is the API for performance-based payroll, letting companies pay workers, creators, contractors, and AI agents based on results rather than hours worked. Companies push performance signals into Grade via webhooks or direct API calls (task completed, milestone hit, content published, views tracked, invoice processed), and Grade runs them against configurable payout rules — flat fees, tiered commissions, threshold bonuses, or blended structures — handling the math, de-duplication, and approval workflows automatically. Grade tracks every post across platforms, approves and distributes bulk payouts in one click, and handles compliance end to end: KYC verification, tax-form collection, DAC7 reporting, worker classification, and merchant-of-record services. Payouts reach 190+ countries via local bank transfers, PayPal, Wise, Payoneer, Revolut, Airtm, and USDT, with no separate creator account required. Grade (YC W26) is based in San Francisco and has paid out $10M+ to date.

providers.name: Guide Labs
providers.description: Guide Labs is a product-focused AI research company building a new class of inherently interpretable AI systems and foundation models that humans and domain experts can reliably understand, steer, and debug. Its flagship platform, Clarity, is presented as the first inherently interpretable AI platform and surfaces the internal concepts driving a model's decisions, while its Steerling-8B is presented as the first inherently interpretable large language model. The team has published more than two dozen interpretability papers at top machine-learning venues and ships research artifacts such as PRISM training-data prototypes, the FineWeb Concept Atlas, and Atlas for orienting LLM pre-training data. Access to Clarity is available through platform.guidelabs.ai. The company is backed by Initialized Capital.

providers.name: Heartland Express

providers.description: Hundsun Technologies Inc. is a leading Chinese fintech company providing software solutions and services for financial institutions including securities, funds, futures, banking, asset management, and wealth management. Hundsun's products are typically delivered as enterprise software with bespoke customer integrations rather than as a public developer API platform.

providers.name: Ionis Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Ionis Pharmaceuticals is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Ionis Pharmaceuticals API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Kaman

providers.name: Konga
providers.description: Konga is a Lagos, Nigeria-based e-commerce company founded in July 2012 and now operating as Nigeria's leading online shopping marketplace, combining a first-party retail business with a third-party seller marketplace across consumer electronics, mobile phones, home appliances, fashion, groceries, beauty, and lifestyle categories. Konga runs a vertically integrated stack alongside its storefront: KongaPay, a Central Bank of Nigeria-licensed and NDIC-insured payments platform offering checkout, transfers, virtual accounts, multi-currency wallets, POS, bill payments, savings, and merchant payouts; Konga Travel & Tours, an IATA-certified travel agency providing flight bookings, hotels, and vacation packages; Konga Health (Medical Direct); Konga Foods/Groceries; KongaNow same-day delivery; and KXpress Logistics for nationwide fulfillment. Konga's revenue model spans marketplace commissions, first-party retail margin, KongaPay transaction fees, logistics fees, travel agency commissions, and seller advertising. Konga does not operate a unified public developer program: the marketplace exposes no documented public REST API for orders, products, or sellers; KongaPay published Android, iOS, and WooCommerce SDKs and SDK docs at kongapay.github.io, but that GitHub organization was archived on July 1, 2023, and the current KPay aggregator API documentation lives at kpayment-org.gitbook.io with limited public surface area focused on POS, Web Payment Gateway, Virtual Account, and Payment Link integrations for approved merchants. As a result, Konga is profiled here as a provider index rather than as an actively documented public-API company.

providers.name: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions
providers.description: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Kratos Defense & Security Solutions API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.description: Linde is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Linde API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Lyra Health
providers.description: Lyra Health is a Burlingame, California enterprise mental health benefits company founded in 2015 that provides employer-sponsored behavioral health care to more than 20 million members across a network of 30,000+ providers in over 200 countries and territories. The platform combines preventive self-care resources, coaching, evidence-based therapy, medication management, family and pediatric services, and specialized acute care delivered through a benefits-administration model sold to large employers and health plans rather than directly to consumers. Lyra's product surface includes the Lyra App for members, the Lyra Empower AI-powered care platform launched in 2025, Centers of Excellence for pediatric mental health and neurodiversity, a manager coaching program, and a clinical-grade AI guide. Customers include Salesforce, Lululemon, Morgan Stanley, Genentech, Starbucks, JE Dunn, VCA, and the School District of Philadelphia, and in March 2026 the company became Workday Wellness's preferred mental health partner. Lyra acquired pediatric and family mental health provider Bend Health in July 2025. Lyra is led by CEO Jennifer Schulz, with Jenny Gonsalves as Chief Product & Technology Officer, Alethea Varra as Chief Clinical Officer, and co-founder Bob Kocher, MD on the board. The company's revenue model is per-member-per- month employer contracts plus utilization-based clinical billing; Lyra does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDK, CLI, or self-service API, and its only public GitHub repository is an internal fork of an unrelated infrastructure module. All employer, member, HRIS/eligibility, SSO, and EHR integrations are negotiated and delivered through the Lyra customer success and implementation teams rather than through a self-serve developer surface.

providers.name: MIDAS Technologies
providers.description: Midas (Midas Technologies / Midas Inc.) is a free consumer cash-rewards and loyalty app in Mexico, built around the slogan "Tu efectivo cuenta" (your cash counts). Shoppers earn points worth up to 5% back when paying at affiliated merchants, where one Midas point equals one Mexican peso and accumulated points can be spent to pay the full total of a bill at participating stores. The app lets users create an account in under three minutes with just a name and phone number, view their points balance, browse promotions and discounts, find nearby affiliated stores on an interactive map, and track a full history of transactions and purchase tickets. Merchants can affiliate their business ("Afilia tu negocio") to reward customers. The company is a consumer-facing mobile app and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Mirado
providers.description: Mirado is a B2B card-linked-offer and rewards infrastructure company that sits between marketers and publishers. Marketers — from Fortune 500 retailers to local businesses — fund cash-back offers that Mirado delivers into the apps of publishers such as banks and fintech apps, and Mirado attributes the resulting sales with first-party card and bank transaction data so marketers can measure incremental lift rather than impressions. The company states a reach of more than 100 million cardholders across 15+ financial partners, and describes itself as having evolved from its origins in consumer rewards into B2B advertising infrastructure. Mirado is an early-stage company backed by Version One Ventures. As of this enrichment pass (2026-08-12) it publishes a marketing site at mirado.ai (marketers, publishers, about, blog, get-started, privacy) and a login-gated customer console at app.mirado.ai, but no developer portal, no API documentation, and no machine-readable API surface of any kind. Full contract discovery across all three hosts returned 404 on every OpenAPI, GraphQL, MCP, llms.txt and /.well-known/ path. Onboarding for both sides of the marketplace is a lead-capture form handled by partnerships@mirado.ai.

providers.name: Modine Manufacturing
providers.description: Modine Manufacturing is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Modine Manufacturing API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Newlight Technologies
providers.description: Newlight Technologies, Inc. is a Huntington Beach, California biotechnology company founded in 2003 and incorporated in Delaware that produces AirCarbon, a PHB biomaterial made by naturally-occurring ocean microorganisms that consume air and greenhouse gas. The company operates a commercial-scale biomanufacturing plant and sells AirCarbon as resin to industrial partners and as finished goods under the Restore foodware and Covalent fashion-accessory brands, positioning the material as a carbon-negative, home-compostable, ocean-degradable replacement for petroleum plastic. Newlight is a materials manufacturer, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, no API reference and no machine-readable contract. Its only agent-reachable surface is the Wix platform Site MCP endpoint that its marketing site advertises in its own llms.txt.

providers.name: Nimbus Health
providers.description: Nimbus Health is a technology-enabled network of outpatient pulmonary care clinics treating chronic respiratory disease. Founded in 2022, it acquires and unifies established pulmonary practices onto a shared clinical and operational platform, operating eight clinics across Arizona, Georgia, and South Carolina and serving more than thirty thousand patients with care for COPD, asthma, interstitial lung disease, pulmonary fibrosis, bronchiectasis, sleep apnea, and chronic cough. It is backed by 8VC, 2048 Ventures, and General Catalyst. No public developer API, documentation, or developer portal surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures company identity and domain-security posture as a portfolio lead.

providers.name: Oasdiff
providers.description: Oasdiff is an open-source tool for detecting breaking changes and generating changelogs from OpenAPI specifications.

providers.name: Open mHealth
providers.description: Open mHealth is a nonprofit, community-driven initiative that develops open standards and open-source software for making patient-generated health data interoperable across mobile apps, wearables, clinical systems, and electronic health records. Its core contribution is a library of clinically validated JSON Schema data point schemas — covering physical activity, sleep, heart rate, blood pressure, body weight, blood glucose, and other vital signs — with the sleep, physical-activity, and metadata schemas now superseded by IEEE 1752.1, the IEEE standard for Mobile Health Data co-shepherded by the Open mHealth community. Around the schemas Open mHealth ships a stack of Apache-2.0 reference implementations: Shimmer (a Java/Spring server that pulls health data from Fitbit, Google Fit, iHealth, Misfit, RunKeeper, and Withings APIs and normalizes it into Open mHealth or IEEE 1752.1 data points), omh-dsu-ri (a Data Storage Unit reference implementation exposing an OAuth 2.0-secured Data Point REST API on top of MongoDB and PostgreSQL), Granola (an Objective-C library that serializes Apple HealthKit samples into Open mHealth JSON), a web visualizations library built on D3 and Plottable.js, the OMH-on-FHIR mapping that aligns Open mHealth data points to HL7 FHIR resources, and a sample-data-generator. Open mHealth operates as the steward of the standard, the schema and unit registry at registry.openmhealth.org, and a developer community of thousands of developers and health organizations including Cornell Tech, Kaiser Permanente, Stanford School of Medicine, UC Davis, and UCSF. The project has no commercial API, no paid tier, and no hosted SaaS — all artifacts are open source under Apache 2.0 and the standard itself is openly published.

providers.name: OVIA
providers.description: OVIA is listed via wepow.com, the domain of Wepow, a video-interviewing and candidate-assessment startup backed by 500 Global. Wepow is now part of Harver, a Talent Intelligence platform offering pre-employment assessments, automated interview scheduling, video interviewing, game-based assessments (pymetrics), and reference checking (Checkster). wepow.com 301-redirects to harver.com, and the served /.well-known documents and llms.txt are Harver's. This entry has no independent, self-service public API surface; enrichment captured the live security, well-known, and AI-governance signals published on the domain.

providers.name: pandas
providers.description: pandas is a fast, powerful, flexible, and easy to use open source data analysis and manipulation tool, built on top of the Python programming language. It is a Python library that provides DataFrame and Series data structures and analysis tools; pandas itself does not expose an HTTP API, but is widely used to build data APIs alongside frameworks like FastAPI and Flask.

providers.name: Petal
providers.description: Petal is a New York-based consumer fintech that issues Visa credit cards aimed at people with limited or no credit history, underwriting applicants from their bank-account cash flow (its proprietary CashScore metric) rather than a traditional credit score alone. Its Petal 1, Petal 1 Rise and Petal 2 cards are issued by WebBank, and the business is now part of the Tilt family of consumer finance brands (Tilt Card, Inc., NMLS #2295169). Petal reaches customers through iOS and Android apps plus a web dashboard and help center. It is a direct-to-consumer card issuer: as of this profile it operates no developer program, publishes no API documentation, and exposes no machine-readable API contract on any of its public hosts.

providers.name: Pickle
providers.description: Pickle is a peer-to-peer fashion rental and resale marketplace that makes closets across the United States shareable. Through its iOS app and web storefront, shoppers rent, lend, buy, and sell clothing and accessories directly from one another at a fraction of retail, with same-day local courier delivery and nationwide two-day shipping, while owners earn income on pieces they already own between wears. Founded in 2022 and headquartered in New York City, Pickle has raised roughly $20M (including a $12M Series A) from investors including Craft Ventures. The company operates a consumer marketplace with no publicly documented developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Plumery
providers.description: Plumery is an Amsterdam, Netherlands-based fintech that provides a headless, mobile-first digital banking engagement platform it markets as the "Digital Success Fabric" — a "Digital Engagement Platform for Banks." It lets banks, credit unions, and financial institutions build and launch branded mobile and web banking experiences on top of their existing core banking systems, delivered to engineering teams as an API-first, composable platform with SDKs and developer documentation (built on the Stainless docs/SDK toolchain). Plumery maintains a public GitHub organization of supporting engineering tooling and publishes a security & compliance program (SOC 2, ISO 27001). The company is backed by QED Investors and Seedcamp.

providers.name: Presidio
providers.description: Presidio Inc is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Presidio Inc API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Protectt AI
providers.description: Protectt.ai (Protectt.ai Labs Pvt Ltd) is an AI-native, full-stack mobile application security and fraud-control platform for Android and iOS. Its products — AppProtectt (RASP with 100+ runtime protections against hooking, spoofing, reverse engineering, tampering, MITM and SMS exploitation), SDKProtectt (SDK hardening/obfuscation), and ApiProtectt (API security) — embed as a lightweight SDK with zero performance overhead and no disruption to release cycles. The company targets banking, financial services and regulated enterprises (RBL Bank, Yes Bank, BSE, Bajaj Finserv, LIC), is ISO 27001 / ISO 42001 / ISO 22301 and PCI DSS certified, and aligns to RBI, SEBI and NPCI security mandates. It is headquartered in Mumbai with offices in Dover (Delaware, US) and Dubai (UAE). Protectt.ai ships enterprise SDKs to customers rather than a public developer portal or open API — no OpenAPI, SDK registry package, or public API reference is published.

providers.name: Ralph Lauren
providers.description: Ralph Lauren is a global leader in the design, marketing, and distribution of premium lifestyle products across apparel, footwear, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. The company operates ralphlauren.com, Polo Ralph Lauren, Lauren, Club Monaco, and other brands. No public developer API has been verified; the company participates in affiliate programs via Rakuten and Sovrn Commerce, and uses Microsoft Azure OpenAI for the Ask Ralph AI shopping assistant launched in 2025.

providers.name: Regal Rexnord
providers.description: Regal Rexnord is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Regal Rexnord API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Resolute Forest Products
providers.description: Resolute Forest Products is a global leader in the forest products industry, producing market pulp, tissue, wood products, and newsprint. Formerly one of the largest pulp and paper companies in North America, the company operates manufacturing facilities across Canada and the United States. In 2023, Resolute was acquired by the Paper Excellence Group and now operates as a subsidiary of Domtar. The company supplies products to customers in more than 70 countries.

providers.name: Rgenix
providers.description: Rgenix, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded by scientists from The Rockefeller University to discover and develop first-in-class small molecules and biologics against previously undruggable drivers of cancer metastasis, using its proprietary RNA-DRIVEr target-discovery platform. Its programs include ompenaclid (RGX-202), an oral SLC6A8/creatine-transporter inhibitor in Phase 2 for RAS-mutant colorectal cancer, abequolixron (RGX-104), an oral LXR agonist in Phase 1b/2, and RGX-019-MMAE, a MERTK-targeting antibody-drug conjugate. The company changed its corporate name from Rgenix to Inspirna in September 2021 and operates from Long Island City, New York. It is a therapeutics developer with no public API, developer program, or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: roli
providers.description: ROLI (Luminary ROLI Ltd.) is a British music-technology company known for expressive electronic instruments — the Seaboard, LUMI Keys keyboards, and the modular BLOCKS system — together with companion software such as ROLI Dashboard, ROLI Connect, Equator, and ROLI Learn. Its instruments pioneer MPE (MIDI Polyphonic Expression) for per-note pitch, timbre, and dynamics control. For developers, ROLI publishes first-party SDKs under the github.com/weareroli organization — the C++ BLOCKS-SDK and roli_blocks_basics for building applications that talk to BLOCKS hardware, and the archived mpejs library for MPE MIDI in the browser. ROLI is backed by Balderton Capital and Index Ventures. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched with real developer, SDK, and domain-security artifacts.

providers.name: Sahi
providers.description: Sahi is a high-performance Indian stock trading platform built for active retail traders, operated by Aaritya Broking Private Limited (SEBI INZ000317632) and based in Bangalore. Founded by Dale Vaz (former Swiggy CTO) and Manish Jain (former Kotak Securities executive), Sahi offers futures & options trading, equity/stock trading, IPO applications, and ETF investing at a flat brokerage of Rs.10 per executed order. The mobile-native platform emphasizes millisecond order-execution latency, an in-house charting tool (Sahi Charts), real-time stock scanners, AI-backed market intelligence, and SEBI-registered research. Sahi is an Accel portfolio company. It does not currently publish a public developer API, but it does publish a machine-readable /llms.txt.

providers.name: Sakana AI
providers.description: Sakana AI is a Tokyo-based AI R&D company founded by ex-Google researchers focused on collective intelligence, evolutionary optimization, and nature-inspired AI methods. The company's first commercial product is Sakana Fugu - a multi-agent orchestration system with an OpenAI-compatible API (currently in beta). Sakana also publishes Sakana Chat (consumer) and Sakana Marlin (beta).

providers.name: SCANA
providers.description: SCANA Corporation was an American regulated electric and natural gas public utility headquartered in Cayce, South Carolina. Its primary subsidiaries included South Carolina Electric & Gas (SCE&G), which provided electric and natural gas service to approximately 660,000 electric customers in South Carolina, and PSNC Energy, which served over one million natural gas customers in North Carolina and Georgia. SCANA was acquired by Dominion Energy in January 2019, after which the SCANA, SCE&G, and PSNC names were retired and operations were integrated into Dominion Energy's Southeast Energy Group. SCANA Energy Natural Gas continues to operate as a retail natural gas marketer in Georgia.

providers.name: Sensata Technologies
providers.description: Sensata Technologies is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Sensata Technologies API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Skeps
providers.description: Skeps is a business-to-business embedded finance and pay-over-time platform that lets merchants and lenders offer point-of-sale financing directly inside their own websites, retail stores, and one-to-one sales channels. Built as a microservices platform, Skeps embeds banking and lending services into the buyer journey: its patented technology securely and in real time matches a customer to the best financing offer from a multi-lender network of national banks, credit unions, and fintech lenders, powering pre-approval, offer testing, and checkout financing. Skeps serves verticals including home improvement, retail, telecom, travel and hospitality, health and wellness, automotive, veterinary, financial institutions, and cobrand card programs. It operates an enterprise, request-a-demo sales model and is backed by Accel; this API Evangelist profile was enriched from its public web surface.

providers.name: stc
providers.description: stc (Saudi Telecom Company) is the leading telecommunications provider in Saudi Arabia, offering a wide range of services including mobile, fixed-line, broadband internet, and digital solutions for consumers and businesses. The company operates a extensive network infrastructure and provides innovative digital platforms, aiming to connect people and enterprises across the Kingdom and beyond.

providers.name: Sykes Enterprises
providers.description: Sykes Enterprises is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Sykes Enterprises API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: TIM
providers.description: TIM S.p.A. (formerly Telecom Italia) is the incumbent Italian telecommunications operator headquartered in Rome and one of the largest telcos in Europe. The group operates fixed and mobile networks across Italy under the TIM Consumer and TIM Enterprise brands, runs TIM Brasil (the second-largest mobile operator in Brazil), and owns a portfolio of technology subsidiaries including Sparkle (international connectivity and quantum-safe infrastructure), Noovle (cloud), Telsy (cybersecurity), and Olivetti (IT services). TIM exposes its mobile network as a programmable platform through the developer.tim.it portal in Italy and through TIM Open Gateway in Brazil, both implementing CAMARA-standard network APIs (SIM Swap, Number Verification, Know Your Customer, IP-to-MSISDN, IP-to- Number, Device Location) jointly defined by the Linux Foundation, TM Forum, and GSMA. These APIs let banks, fintechs, insurers, retailers, and online services authenticate users, detect SIM-swap fraud, verify customer identity, and locate devices using TIM's mobile network as the trust anchor. As of late 2025 TIM Brasil reported 50 million Open Gateway API queries across its catalog.

providers.name: Tower International
providers.description: Tower International was a global manufacturer of engineered structural metal components and assemblies for the automotive industry, primarily serving original equipment manufacturers (OEMs). The company supplied body-structure stampings, frame and chassis structures, and complex welded assemblies for cars, crossovers, pickups, and SUVs. Tower International was acquired by Autokiniton Global Group in 2019 and merged with L&W Group to form the second largest Body-in-White and vehicle frame supplier in North America. As a private manufacturing company with no public developer API offering, Tower International does not expose public REST or web APIs.

providers.name: TradeDepot
providers.description: TradeDepot is a Lagos-based B2B commerce and distribution platform that connects consumer-goods brands and distributors with neighborhood retailers across Africa. Its ShopTopUp platform lets small retailers order and pay for inventory, and its first-party developer surface is a set of ShopTopUp "Agent/Shop Checkout" mobile SDKs (Android, React Native, Cordova) published under github.com/tradedepot and npm, initialized with partner API keys. TradeDepot publishes no public REST API, developer portal, or API documentation. Backed by Partech.

providers.name: Trex Company
providers.description: Trex Company is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Trex Company API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: TTEC Holdings
providers.description: TTEC Holdings is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The TTEC Holdings API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: WNS Holdings
providers.description: WNS Holdings is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The WNS Holdings API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: XebiaLabs
providers.description: XebiaLabs was an enterprise DevOps software company behind XL Deploy (deployment automation), XL Release (release orchestration), and XL Impact (DevOps analytics), backed by Accel and Susquehanna Growth Equity. In February 2020 XebiaLabs merged with CollabNet VersionOne to form Digital.ai; xebialabs.com now redirects to digital.ai and the products continue as Digital.ai Deploy and Digital.ai Release. The XebiaLabs GitHub organizations, Maven/PyPI/Docker Hub packages, and the dist.xebialabs.com distribution site remain live, still shipping the xl CLI on the current Digital.ai version train. No public hosted API is served under the XebiaLabs brand — the product REST APIs are customer-hosted and documented at docs.digital.ai.

providers.name: Zimmer Biomet
providers.description: Zimmer Biomet is a global medical technology company that designs, manufactures, and markets orthopedic reconstructive products, sports medicine, biologics, extremities, trauma products, dental implants, and related surgical products. The company is a Fortune 500 organization with operations in over 25 countries and a portfolio of digital and robotic technologies including ZBEdge Dynamic Intelligence, ROSA Robotics, the mymobility patient app, Persona Knee, and ZBEdge Analytics. Zimmer Biomet does not currently publish a public REST API developer portal; its digital platforms are surfaced through partner integrations, hospital systems, and proprietary devices.

providers.name: Zumba Fitness
providers.description: Zumba Fitness is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of insight-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: 1Balance
providers.description: 1Balance (1Balance Living) is a personalized herbal-wellness and tea brand offering curated caffeinated and caffeine-free tisane blends formulated for different times of day — spanning gut health, energy, metabolism, adaptogenic immune support, relaxation, and menopause support. The company blends traditional herbal science and personalization (drawing on Ayurveda and naturopathy) with modern subscription commerce, selling whole-herb capsule and loose-leaf tea blends directly to consumers through a Shopify-powered storefront with free shipping over $30 and a 30-day money-back guarantee. Backed by an Accel-led seed round, 1Balance operates as a US/India direct-to-consumer consumer-wellness company. This API Evangelist profile tracks 1Balance as a consumer brand; it runs a retail e-commerce experience and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: 1hai
providers.description: eHi Car Rental (一嗨租车), operated by Shanghai eHi Information Technology Services Co., Ltd., is one of China's leading car rental and mobility companies. Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Shanghai, eHi offers self-drive car rentals, chauffeured car service, used-car sales, and corporate and government mobility programs across more than 500 cities nationwide, with cross-city return and airport pickup. eHi is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners, added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile. The business operates consumer web and mobile (iOS, Android, HarmonyOS) booking channels; no public developer or API platform was found during enrichment.

providers.name: 2Eyes Vision
providers.description: 2EyesVision (2Eyes Vision, S.L.) is a Madrid, Spain based ophthalmic and optical technologies company, founded as a spin-off of the Spanish National Research Council (CSIC) out of the Visual Optics and Biophotonics Lab. It designs, manufactures and sells SimVis Gekko, a binocular visual simulator built on tunable liquid-lens temporal multiplexing that lets a patient experience premium presbyopia and cataract corrections - monofocal, EDOF, trifocal, monovision and mix-and-match intraocular lens designs - before implantation or refractive surgery. The device is CE, UKCA and FCC marked, is controlled from a wireless iPad, is cloud-connected for remote app and lens-simulation updates, and is distributed across 18 countries on 4 continents. 2EyesVision publishes no public API, SDK, webhook surface or developer program: the product is an end-user clinical instrument, and the only machine-readable document it serves is an SEO-generated llms.txt.

providers.name: Actio Biosciences
providers.description: Actio Biosciences is a San Diego-based clinical-stage biotechnology company developing precision medicines that translate insights from Mendelian (single-gene) genetics into treatments for both rare and common diseases. Its pipeline targets genetically defined conditions including KCNT1-related epilepsy and TRPV4-related Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2C (CMT2C), following a strategy of expanding from rare indications into more prevalent diseases that share the same underlying biology. The company is backed by Canaan Partners. Actio publishes no developer or API surface; this profile captures its public identity and corporate web properties.

providers.name: Asto CT
providers.description: Asto CT, Inc. is a Middleton, Wisconsin medical-imaging device manufacturer that designs and builds Equina, a robotically positioned, weight-bearing fan-beam computed tomography (CT) scanner purpose-built for imaging mildly sedated, standing horses. Founded on a 2016 concept and first installed at UW-Madison in 2019, the company sells capital imaging equipment plus installation, training and ongoing clinical support to equine hospitals and veterinary teaching hospitals worldwide, with offices in Middleton, Wisconsin and Crawley, United Kingdom. Asto CT is a hardware company: the Equina system is operated from an on-site console and the company publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable interface contract.

providers.name: Atlas Data Storage
providers.description: Atlas Data Storage provides secure, scalable cloud storage solutions for enterprises, enabling efficient data management, backup, and disaster recovery. The company offers APIs for data ingestion, retrieval, and lifecycle management, supporting compliance and high availability across multiple regions. As a participant in the secondary market ecosystem, Atlas Data Storage connects investors and stakeholders with data-driven insights and services.

providers.name: Averna Therapeutics
providers.description: Averna Therapeutics is a genetic-medicine biotechnology company creating what it calls the last, great missing tool required to break through the most persistent barriers in genetic medicine. Backed by Insight Partners, the company was recognized as an Endpoints 11 Most Promising Biotech Company in 2025 and has presented at the 44th Annual J.P. Morgan Healthcare Conference. As a therapeutics R&D company it does not currently publish any public developer program, API, SDK, or API documentation surface; this API Evangelist profile tracks it as a company identity record only.

providers.name: Azra Games
providers.description: Azra Games is a mobile role-playing game studio founded in 2022 by Mark Otero and headquartered in Sacramento, California. The studio builds RPGs on its proprietary "RPG GameKit" technology, with its flagship title UnGodly, a dark sword-and-sorcery RPG. Azra Games is backed by a16z and Pantera Capital and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile. As a game studio it publishes a public website, news, careers, terms, and privacy pages but does not expose a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Bing Maps
providers.description: Create/customize digital maps based on Bing Maps data

providers.name: Blavity
providers.description: Blavity Inc. is a Black-owned digital media and technology company founded in 2014 by Morgan DeBaun, operating a portfolio of premium content brands and events for Black millennials and Gen Z around culture, technology, travel, and lifestyle. Its properties include Blavity.com (news and culture), AfroTech (the largest Black tech conference and media brand), Travel Noire (travel), Shadow and Act (film and entertainment), and 21Ninety (women's lifestyle). Blavity Inc. monetizes through advertising, branded content, events, and its Blavity Media Group agency. It is a privately held company backed by investors including 500 Global and GV, and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specifications. This profile tracks Blavity as a company in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Cakejp
providers.description: Cake.jp is a Japanese e‑commerce platform specializing in the online sale and delivery of cakes, sweets, and assorted confectionery. The site offers a wide range of products for occasions such as birthdays, holidays, and themed events, with options for custom designs, character cakes, and seasonal specialties. Customers can browse categories, place orders, and arrange delivery across Japan, while the platform provides membership, loyalty points, and promotional campaigns.

providers.name: Candel Therapeutics
providers.description: Candel Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: CADL) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts, developing off-the-shelf multimodal viral immunotherapies for solid tumors. Founded as Advantagene, the company advances two engineered viral platforms: aglatimagene besadenovec (CAN-2409), a replication-defective adenovirus delivered intratumorally alongside a prodrug to trigger immunogenic cell death, and linoserpaturev (CAN-3110), a replication-competent oncolytic herpes simplex virus. Its clinical programs span prostate cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, pancreatic cancer and recurrent high-grade glioma. Candel is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor: it operates no developer program, publishes no public API, SDK or machine-readable specification, and its only credentialed surface is a clinical-trial investigator portal.

providers.name: Carlsmed
providers.description: Carlsmed (Nasdaq: CARL) is a Carlsbad, California medical technology company that builds personalized spine surgery. Its aprevo technology platform combines AI-enabled segmentation of a patient's own imaging with prior-outcomes data to produce a personalized surgical plan and patient-specific interbody fusion devices, manufactured on a digital production line and delivered to hospitals in under ten days. The platform is FDA-cleared for lumbar and cervical indications, holds FDA Breakthrough Device Designation, and earned CMS New Technology Add-On Payment status for cervical fusion in 2025. Surgeons review, approve and track plans through the myaprevo iOS application. Carlsmed operates under ISO 13485 and MDSAP certification and completed its IPO in July 2025. It publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Carolina BioOncology Institute
providers.description: Carolina BioOncology Institute (CBOI) is a physician-owned Phase I oncology clinical research clinic and translational laboratory in Huntersville, North Carolina, founded by Dr. John Powderly II. It runs first-in-human and early-phase immunotherapy trials for patients with advanced solid tumors, having opened more than 100 oncology trials over fifteen years, and operates the Human Applications Lab — a cGMP-capable cell-processing and biorepository facility developing autologous cellular therapies — alongside research-use-only analytical and clinical lab analysis services for trial sponsors. CBOI is the parent company of BioCytics and an openEHR Industry Partner. It publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract; the only machine-readable surface on its domain is the stock WordPress REST API its CMS emits, which is not a product API and is deliberately not registered here.

providers.name: Clinicasim
providers.description: Clínica SiM is a Brazilian health services provider offering in‑person and tele‑medicine consultations, diagnostic exams, dental care and subscription‑based health plans across Fortaleza, Recife and Salvador. Patients can book appointments online, access medical records, and receive virtual urgent care through its web portal and mobile apps.

providers.name: Clush
providers.description: Clush is a Korean‑based AI and cloud services company offering a suite of platforms such as AXLEON for data, MLOps, and cloud-native infrastructure, alongside enterprise collaboration tools, security consulting, and GPU‑as‑a‑Service. The firm focuses on AI transformation, cloud-native application development, and secure, scalable infrastructure for enterprises.

providers.name: conrizon
providers.description: conrizon AG is a German holding company, founded in 2020 and headquartered in Essen, that unites four of Europe's leading Enterprise Content Management (ECM) brands - easy software, PROXESS, HABEL, and Portal Systems (Shareflex), alongside the friendWorks professional-services unit - under one roof. The group provides legally compliant, audit-proof digital archiving (GDPR, GoBD, eIDAS), document management (DMS), invoice and procure-to-pay (P2P) processing, contract management, and HR/HCM software with automated workflows, plus AI services and connectors for SAP and Microsoft 365 / SharePoint. Solutions are offered cloud-native, in a private cloud, on-premises, or hybrid, and are relied on by more than 8,700 companies and organizations worldwide. conrizon is a portfolio company of Battery Ventures. It publishes a corporate marketing site but no public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: CropX
providers.description: CropX is an Israeli ag-IoT company that combines in-field soil and weather hardware with a cloud Farm Management Software (FMS) platform. The hardware portfolio includes SV-series soil sensors (moisture, temperature, conductivity, salinity at depth), ET-series evapotranspiration sensors, WS-series weather stations, RG rain gauges, the Apex root-zone sensor, an in-development nitrate sensor, and TD-series cellular telemetry gateways. The FMS covers farm / field / crop data, device management, irrigation scheduling, disease monitoring, nutrition, effluent, and reporting. CropX does not publish a public developer portal; integrations with third-party sensors and machinery are arranged through their team.

providers.name: Doccla
providers.description: Doccla is a UK-founded virtual care platform delivering remote patient monitoring and virtual wards across Europe. It combines pre-configured, Bluetooth-connected medical devices, a patient app, and a clinician dashboard to monitor patients at home, reducing hospital admissions and freeing bed capacity for health systems. The platform integrates bidirectionally with electronic health record (EHR) systems, including Oracle Cerner for the Northwest London Virtual Hospital, and is deployed with NHS trusts and European providers. Doccla holds ISO 27001 and ISO 13485 certifications, UKCA and CE medical-device marks, is GDPR compliant, and is registered with the UK Care Quality Commission (CQC). No public developer API or portal is published at this time; integration is delivered via managed EHR and medical-device connections.

providers.name: EduAdvisor
providers.description: EduAdvisor is a Malaysian education platform that helps students compare, plan and apply for tertiary education. It provides course and university comparison tools, scholarship matching, study-abroad guidance, and free education counseling, working directly with 100+ universities and colleges in Malaysia and abroad to streamline applications for prospective students. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. EduAdvisor currently operates as a consumer-facing WordPress web platform with no public developer program, API, or documentation surface at the time of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: ElevateBio
providers.description: ElevateBio is an advanced therapies technology company and contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) for cell and gene therapies, headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts. Through its BaseCamp cGMP manufacturing and process-development business and its centers of excellence, ElevateBio provides end-to-end capabilities spanning gene editing, viral vectors (AAV and lentivirus), mRNA and RNA therapeutics, induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs), analytical and process development, and regulatory CMC support, helping partners advance genetic medicines from concept through commercialization. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the SoftBank Vision Fund and profiled in the API Evangelist network, ElevateBio operates as a science- and manufacturing-driven organization rather than a public API provider; this profile captures its identity and domain security posture.

providers.name: Epic Bio
providers.description: Epic Bio (legally Epicrispr Biotechnologies, Inc.) is a clinical-stage genetic medicines company in South San Francisco, California, founded in 2018 by Stanford CRISPR pioneer Stanley Qi, Ph.D. It develops epigenetic editing therapies that modulate gene expression without cutting DNA, built on its proprietary Gene Expression Modulation System (GEMS) platform — a combination of ultracompact DNA-binding proteins (CasMINI, CasONYX), tailored guide RNAs, and a large library of transcriptional and epigenomic modulators. Its lead program EPI-321 is in first-in-human clinical study for facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy (FSHD), with preclinical programs in alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency and heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia. The company is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor: it publishes a corporate and scientific website but no developer program, public API, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Experic
providers.description: Experic is a specialist powder-handling contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) founded in 2018, headquartered in Cranbury, New Jersey, with an EU clinical supply center in Ireland. The company provides process, analytical and formulation development, clinical and commercial cGMP manufacturing, dry powder inhalation (DPI) and capsule/powder dosing, autoinjector and pen assembly, and clinical trial packaging, labeling, storage and logistics. Experic is a physical-goods manufacturing and clinical supply services business; it publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Fintech
providers.description: Fin (fin.tech) is a crypto-native payments company that lets users and businesses move millions of dollars instantly — to other Fin users, directly into bank accounts, or across crypto rails. It provides business-grade payment rails that feel like a consumer payment app rather than crypto: instant global settlement in seconds, native support to deposit and withdraw to bank accounts, and send/receive of USDT, USDC, ETH, and BTC, while Fin abstracts the underlying crypto settlement behind a clean fintech interface. Backed by Sequoia, Multicoin, and Pantera Capital, Fin operates a private, auth-gated production API surface (api.fin.tech) and publishes an llms.txt for agents; it does not currently publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDKs. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Pantera Capital portfolio company (sector: crypto) and enriched from its public web surface.

providers.name: Gammastack
providers.description: GammaStack is a sports betting and iGaming software provider that integrates third-party APIs (betting odds, fixtures, payments, KYC) into customer-facing sportsbook platforms. GammaStack does not publish its own public API; this repository tracks the company and the categories of APIs it integrates.

providers.name: Geneos Therapeutics
providers.description: Geneos Therapeutics is a clinical-stage (Phase 2b) biotherapeutics company in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania developing DNA-based personalized immunotherapies for cancer (PICs). Its GT-EPIC neoantigen-targeting platform sequences a patient's tumor, identifies the targetable neoantigens, and encodes up to roughly 40 of them into a synthetic DNA plasmid drug product delivered intradermally alongside a plasmid-encoded IL-12 adjuvant and CELLECTRA electroporation. Geneos was spun out of Inovio Pharmaceuticals and licenses that immunotherapy platform exclusively; it has run clinical work in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and glioblastoma (GBM) and is advancing toward a Phase 2b HCC trial. Geneos is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor: it publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: GenM
providers.description: GenM (now operating as Acadium) is a digital marketing career and apprenticeship platform that connects emerging marketers with mentors and businesses. The platform offers free digital marketing courses (SEO, social media, email, and content marketing), hands-on MicroTasks for portfolio building, three-month remote apprenticeships, and Acadium Plus, an eight-week program that leads to full-time hiring. Businesses use Acadium to crowdsource marketing work and mentor emerging talent while growing their operations. GenM was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the company operates a consumer/business web application at app.acadium.com and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Glyph
providers.description: Glyph is a sustainable footwear brand that designs digitally knit, versatile everyday shoes engineered to be worn for every occasion. Backed by 500 Global, the company sells direct-to-consumer through its Shopify storefront at glyph.earth, emphasizing low-waste digital knitting, single-shoe versatility, and eco-conscious materials. Glyph is a physical consumer-products (DTC e-commerce) company and does not currently publish a public developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures its web and policy surface for network completeness.

providers.name: Groyyo
providers.description: Groyyo is a Gurugram, India based B2B manufacturing and supply-chain company for the fashion, apparel and lifestyle industry, founded in July 2021 by Subin Mitra and Pratik Tiwari. It connects global brands with a vetted network of small and mid-sized Asian factories and gives those factories production software — sales-order management, bill-of-materials creation, production tracking, quality control and business reporting — delivered as the Groyyo and Groyyo + mobile apps and an internal factory ERP rather than as a public developer platform. The company also runs sourcing, fabric and consulting lines, plus RFQ and supplier-KYC intake on its own website. As of August 2026 Groyyo publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract on any host it controls.

providers.name: Heyclicky
providers.description: Heyclicky (product name Clicky) is a consumer macOS application from the Y Combinator Spring 2026 batch that puts an AI assistant right next to your cursor. In Talk Mode a hotkey lets you ask about whatever is on screen and get spoken, on-screen guidance; in Agent Mode you can command autonomous agents to build, research, or perform tasks in the background, and it can connect to services like Notion, Gmail, and Calendar. The app is screen-aware, works across any application with no plugins, and ships as a notarized macOS binary distributed via a Sparkle appcast on GitHub. Heyclicky is a consumer desktop product; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: High Alpha
providers.description: High Alpha is a venture firm and venture studio based in Indianapolis, Indiana that creates and funds early-stage B2B SaaS companies. Through its Capital arm it makes pre-seed to Series B investments across the United States, and through its Studio it co-founds companies with entrepreneurs, providing design, brand, marketing, recruiting, product design, and go-to-market services. Founded by ExactTarget co-founder and CEO Scott Dorsey along with Eric Tobias, Mike Fitzgerald, and Studio Science founder Kristian Andersen, High Alpha pioneered the venture studio model and publishes the annual SaaS Benchmarks Report. Studio and portfolio companies include Salesloft, Lessonly, Attentive, Logik.ai, LogicGate, Dwolla, Zylo, and project44.

providers.name: Hiphen Plant
providers.description: Hiphen Plant provides advanced image analytics solutions for agricultural research. As plant scientists, they build tools that revolutionize how plants can be assessed, bringing the power of image analytics to agricultural research programs for decision-making on genetics, chemistry, and practices.

providers.name: Hobart
providers.description: Hobart is a leading commercial food service equipment manufacturer that offers an API integration to automate work order workflow and streamline the exchange of data between partner systems and Hobart service operations.

providers.name: Hongene Biotech
providers.description: Hongene Biotech Corporation is a nucleic acid contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) founded in 1998, with nearly 30 years of RNA-focused expertise. It offers vertically integrated services spanning oligonucleotide API manufacturing (from preclinical to commercial, GMP up to tonne scale), mRNA CDMO services (raw materials through enzymes and lipids to GMP manufacture and fill-finish), custom chemical synthesis of nucleic acid building blocks, and chemoenzymatic ligation for siRNA and sgRNA. Hongene supplies premium nucleic acid raw materials worldwide and runs an online store for direct-purchase reagents. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan and enriched from Hongene public web surfaces; the company publishes no developer API.

providers.name: In Your Shoe
providers.description: In Your Shoe is an Egyptian streetwear and apparel brand, founded in 2018 and based in Cairo, Egypt, that designs and sells playful, statement-driven ready-to-wear pieces — oversized and boxy tees, shirts, jeans, jorts, loungewear, kids' lines, and accessories — letting Millennials and Gen-Z express themselves through high-quality, self-expressive fashion. The company sells direct-to-consumer through a Shopify storefront and is backed by 500 Global and the Misk 500 MENA Accelerator. It publishes no first-party developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: JetZero
providers.description: JetZero is a Long Beach, California aerospace company founded in 2021 by Tom O'Leary and Mark Page to bring the blended wing body (all-wing) airframe to commercial aviation. Its flagship program is the Z4, a 250-seat, international-range jetliner the company says will burn up to 50% less fuel than comparable tube-and-wing airliners, and the Jet1 full-scale demonstrator being built with Scaled Composites in Mojave, California ahead of a first flight targeted for 2027. JetZero broke ground in 2026 on a manufacturing and final-assembly campus in Greensboro, North Carolina and is opening an engineering office in Wichita, Kansas at NIAR. It is backed by the U.S. Air Force, NASA, United Airlines, Alaska Star Ventures and a $175M Series B led by B Capital, with letters of intent from Gulf Air and Japan Airlines. JetZero is an aircraft manufacturer, not a software or data provider: as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, no API documentation, no SDKs, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind. Its public technical surface is a supplier registration and supplier standards program.

providers.name: Kiko Labs
providers.description: Kiko Labs is a neuroscience-based early-learning company (a 500 Global portfolio company) that builds adaptive brain-training games for children ages 3-7. Its flagship product, Kiko's Thinking Time, is a voice-guided iOS app developed with Harvard and UC Berkeley neuroscientists with support from the US Department of Education and National Science Foundation. The program trains executive functions — working memory, inhibition, focus, and cognitive flexibility — through progressive games, and includes a parent and educator dashboard for tracking skill development. Kiko Labs is a consumer edtech company and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Live Aware Labs
providers.description: Live Aware Labs (LIVE AWARE) is a virtual playtesting and player-insights lab for game studios and researchers. The platform consolidates gameplay footage, player feedback, and community discussion from sources such as Discord, Twitch, YouTube, and internal playtests into a single dashboard, then applies AI to surface trends, player sentiment, and critical feedback in real time. A PC-based SDK captures video, telemetry, and in-game events, with plugins for Unreal Engine and Unity and no-code integrations into Slack, Jira, Monday.com, and OBS. Live Aware Labs is backed by a16z and was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead; this profile is enriched from the company's public web surface.

providers.name: LTSE
providers.description: The Long-Term Stock Exchange (LTSE) is a U.S. national securities exchange, approved by the SEC, built to help companies and investors focus on long-term value creation over short-term results. LTSE operates a stock exchange and trading platform with listing standards organized around five long-term principles covering stakeholders, strategy, executive compensation, board governance, and investor engagement. The company also publishes market and governance insights and produces The Eric Ries Show podcast. LTSE previously offered a cap-table management product (LTSE Equity, formerly Captable.io) which has since been sunset and transitioned to Astrella. LTSE exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web and security posture.

providers.name: MediaBeacon
providers.description: MediaBeacon is a Digital Asset Management (DAM) platform from Esko with a highly flexible architecture and open APIs that enable integration into many products. Its APIs support hands-off data transfer between services, reducing human intervention and enabling workflow automation.

providers.name: Medwing
providers.description: MEDWING is Germany's largest digital service platform for jobs and staffing in the healthcare sector, founded in 2017 and headquartered in Berlin. It operates a recruitment marketplace that matches hospitals, clinics and care facilities with nurses, caregivers, doctors, midwives, pharmacists and other healthcare professionals across Germany and the United Kingdom. Beyond permanent placement, MEDWING combines career brokerage with temporary-staffing (Zeitarbeit) operations and HR/workforce tooling, offering an end-to-end digital workflow that spans job search, matching, contracts, digital signatures and timesheets. The service is free for candidates, with employers paying on successful placement. MEDWING is backed by Northzone and other investors. This profile was enriched from public web sources; MEDWING does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Mission Control Games
providers.description: Mission Control Games is a mobile game studio building casual puzzle games, co-founded by Kivanc Okutur (CEO) and Murat Gurel (CTO), veterans of the team behind Merge Dragons. Headquartered across London and Istanbul (legal entity Mission Control Games Yazilim Anonim Sirketi), the studio works in small teams to create new casual puzzle sub-genres through rapid iteration and AI-assisted development. It launched publicly in April 2026 alongside a $4M pre-seed round led by General Catalyst, with participation from Arcadia Gaming Partners and e2vc. The company operates a marketing website only and publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable developer surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: MODIFI
providers.description: Welcome to the MODIFI partnership API developer hub. You'll find comprehensive guides and documentation to help you start working with the partnership API as quickly as possible, as well as support if you get stuck.

providers.name: Nervonik
providers.description: Nervonik, Inc. is a clinical-stage medical device company in Los Angeles, California, founded in 2020 by CEO Aydin Babakhani, developing miniaturized peripheral nerve stimulation (PNS) neuromodulation implants for chronic neuropathic pain in high-motion anatomy. Its platform pairs proprietary wireless power delivery and miniaturized implantable leads with integrated sensing circuitry that records evoked compound action potentials (ECAPs) and other biomarkers, enabling closed-loop, patient-specific stimulation as an opioid-free alternative to spinal cord stimulators and pharmacological therapy. The company completed a first-in-human feasibility study and closed an oversubscribed $52.5M Series B in April 2026 led by Amzak Health, after a $13M Series A in March 2025. Nervonik publishes no developer program, public API, SDK, or machine-readable API contract; its public web surface is a WordPress marketing and investor-relations site.

providers.name: NHL Records and Stats
providers.description: NHL historical data and statistics

providers.name: Norbert Health
providers.description: Norbert Health, Inc. builds "Norbert", an autonomous care manager for nursing homes and rehabilitation facilities — a robot-mounted or tabletop AI module that plans rounding schedules, contactlessly senses patient vitals and behavior, and writes clinical notes without additional staff. Its multimodal sensing stack captures pulse and respiratory rate, room presence and activity, mobility and gait, environmental context, and cognitive signals from vocal biomarkers, then turns them into tasks, role-specific alerts, and structured EMR notes. Founded in 2019 by Alexandre Winter with offices in Brooklyn, Paris, and Montreal, the company raised a $5M Seed II in 2021 co-led by Serena Capital and HCVC. The device is investigational and limited by US federal law to investigational use pending FDA clearance. Norbert Health publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable contract; integration is arranged through a sales conversation.

providers.name: ODAIA
providers.description: ODAIA is a commercial intelligence platform for the pharmaceutical industry, using AI to replace manual analysis and static annual segmentation with real-time, predictive insights. Its products (ODAIA Field, Marketing Intelligence, and Opportunity Analysis) help pharma field reps, brand marketers, and commercial operations teams identify the right healthcare professionals (HCPs), prioritize outreach, and surface untapped prescription opportunities. ODAIA integrates with Veeva CRM to deliver insights directly inside existing rep workflows. It is a Toronto-based, enterprise-focused SaaS vendor backed by Threshold Ventures; the product is sold via sales/discovery calls rather than a self-service public API.

providers.name: Onsitego
providers.description: Onsitego is a Mumbai-based Indian consumer device-protection company that sells extended warranty, accidental and liquid damage protection, and repair and maintenance (AMC) plans for consumer electronics and home appliances including mobile phones, laptops, televisions, refrigerators, washing machines and air conditioners. Sold at point of sale through 10,000+ retail stores and serviced via 3,300+ service centers, the company reports 2.5+ crore (25M+) customers and lets buyers activate coverage, manage devices and plans, and request service online. Onsitego is a portfolio company of Accel. No public developer API, documentation, or programmatic surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and probed domain security posture.

providers.name: Palmstreet
providers.description: Palmstreet is a live shopping marketplace where sellers host interactive live-stream sales and buyers browse more than a million listings across rare plants, handmade goods, vintage items, jewelry, crystals, coins, fashion, beauty, aquatics, reptiles, and designer toys. The platform pairs real-time video commerce with a traditional marketplace, free seller onboarding, and Seller Hub inventory tooling. Backed by Craft Ventures, Palmstreet operates as a consumer mobile app (iOS/Android) and web storefront. No public developer API, documentation portal, or partner API surface is published as of this enrichment pass; this profile captures the company identity and public web properties only.

providers.name: Parklio
providers.description: Seamlessly integrate your existing systems or products with Parklio API so you can scale your operations and monitor parking space usage in real time. It provides access to your data in a way that works best for you, whether through integration, automation, or full customization. The API is RESTful with JSON responses, and Android and iOS SDKs are available on request.

providers.name: Pavilion
providers.description: Pavilion is a government purchasing platform that helps public-sector buyers find vendors, get quotes, and buy what they need without the guesswork. It connects procurement teams at 3,500+ SLED (state, local, and education) agencies with qualified vendors, surfaces the most direct compliant route to purchase based on each agency's rules and existing cooperative contracts, and lets vendors claim a free supplier profile to get discovered. The product is 100% free for public agencies. Pavilion is a SaaS marketplace backed by Forerunner Ventures.

providers.name: Pharmaron
providers.description: Pharmaron is a life-science contract research, development, and manufacturing organization (CRO/CDMO) providing R&D services across the full drug-discovery and development pipeline for the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry. Its services span laboratory research, chemistry, biology, drug metabolism and pharmacokinetics, safety assessment, chemistry-manufacturing-and-controls (CMC), and clinical development for small molecules, biologics, and cell and gene therapies. Pharmaron operates globally with facilities in China, the US, and the UK and is publicly listed. It is a B2B partner to drug developers and does not currently publish a public developer portal or API.

providers.name: Pillar Technologies
providers.description: Pillar Technologies provides construction jobsite risk management through environmental monitoring and data analytics. Its wireless, rugged "Pod" sensors measure eight environmental metrics on the jobsite (temperature, humidity, carbon monoxide, VOCs, particulates, noise, light, and pressure) with cellular connectivity and a one-year battery life, feeding a real-time software platform with customizable dashboards, floorplan integration, and drill-down reporting by site, floor, or sensor. A configurable alert system notifies teams via text, email, or phone. Pillar serves data centers, hospitality and multi-family housing, and science and healthcare construction projects to improve safety and protect schedules and budgets. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company. No public developer API, documentation, or developer portal was found as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: PolyXLabs
providers.description: PolyXLabs is a Techstars-backed biotechnology and sustainable-materials company developing biodegradable plastic alternatives from lignocellulose-based biomass, including food waste such as spent coffee grounds.
