The company produces customized, toxin-free, microplastic-free polymers designed to be lightweight and durable as drop-in replacements for conventional plastics in consumer goods and packaging, with operations across the United States and Europe and headquarters in Martonvasar, Hungary. PolyXLabs currently publishes no public API or developer surface; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: QuickChart
providers.description: Generate chart and graph images

providers.name: Raspire
providers.description: Raspire (RASPIRE) provides runtime security for mobile applications, positioning itself as the first line of defense for Android and iOS apps against AI-powered fraud attacks, API abuse, and runtime threats. Developers upload compiled apps (APK/IPA) and Raspire automatically hardens them with anti-fraud protection, app integrity verification, reverse-engineering prevention, and API protection, without requiring changes to application source code. The platform gives security teams real-time visibility into threats and blocks attacks in real time, and can integrate with existing SIEM systems and application monitoring platforms as part of a CI/CD pipeline. Raspire is a Y Combinator company. As surfaced to the API Evangelist network it does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Regal Beloit
providers.description: Regal Beloit was a global manufacturer of electric motors, electrical motion controls, power generation, and power transmission products before merging with Rexnord's Process & Motion Control segment in October 2021 to form Regal Rexnord Corporation. Major brands included Marathon, Leeson, Genteq (HVAC brushless DC motors), and Browning (power transmission). Regal Rexnord continues these product lines and is developing the Perceptiv IIoT platform for motor condition monitoring and predictive maintenance.

providers.name: Reiner.ai
providers.description: Reiner.ai (operated by AI Mapping GmbH of Cologne, Germany) is a construction- and planning-industry AI platform for architects, engineers, and planners. It combines leading LLMs with domain-specific "Reiner Knowledge" and "Reiner Logic" layers to deliver Reiner Chat, task-specific KI-Agenten (AI agents) for site protocols, explanatory reports and project applications, company-knowledge integration, and a library of 50+ prebuilt construction prompts. The product is delivered as a hosted web application (app.reiner.ai); as of this enrichment pass there is no public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Rondo Therapeutics
providers.description: Rondo Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in Hayward, California, developing immune-cell engaging bispecific antibodies designed to treat solid tumors by unleashing the immune system while maximizing efficacy and minimizing side effects. Founded in 2019 by Shelley Force Aldred and Nathan Trinklein, its pipeline includes RNDO-564 (Phase 1 for bladder cancer) plus programs targeting ovarian, endometrial, and renal cancers, backed by a Series A led by Canaan and Red Tree Venture Capital and a collaboration with Eli Lilly. Rondo publishes a corporate and pipeline website but exposes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API surface; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of canaan-partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Saxbys Coffee
providers.description: Saxbys is a Philadelphia-headquartered hospitality company founded in 2005 by Nick Bayer that operates a small chain of cafes across the U.S. East Coast and Midwest. The brand is unique for its "Experiential Learning Platform" (E.L.P.) — 100% student-run cafes embedded inside college and university campuses. Each E.L.P. cafe is operated by a Student Cafe Executive Officer (SCEO) who takes full responsibility for running the location while earning paid, experiential learning credit. Saxbys describes itself as "a national education company and For Students, By Students" with a mission to "Make Life Better." Saxbys does not publish a public REST API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, developer portal, or partner integration program. The only public digital surfaces are the marketing website (saxbyscoffee.com), location-specific online ordering powered by BentoBox, a "Saxbys Stories" blog, and a mobile ordering / rewards app. The Saxbys GitHub organization exists but currently holds a single internal inventory-analyzer repository. This apis.yml records the company as a non-API hospitality + education brand for the API Evangelist network catalog.

providers.name: Sectra
providers.description: Sectra is a Swedish medical technology company providing an enterprise imaging platform (PACS/VNA) for radiology, pathology, cardiology, orthopaedics, and other -ologies. Integration is delivered through established healthcare interoperability standards rather than a single open developer API - DICOM and DICOMweb for imaging, HL7 for orders/results messaging, IHE XDS for cross-enterprise document sharing, FHIR/FHIRcast for clinical context synchronization, and a Web Content API for embedding third-party content and applications into the diagnostic viewer. AI and third-party applications integrate through the Sectra Amplifier Marketplace / Amplifier Services ecosystem. Sectra's API and integration surface is partner- and customer-gated (deployed per-site, no public self-service developer portal); the API entries below are honestly modeled from Sectra's documented standards and interfaces, not scraped from an open OpenAPI catalog. Sectra also authored the first open-source FHIRcast sandbox and reference implementation.

providers.name: Sensei
providers.description: Sensei is an autonomous retail technology company that uses computer vision and artificial intelligence to enable checkout-free, "frictionless" shopping with no scanning and no queues, while giving retailers real-time inventory visibility and operational insights. It ships in four formats — Store (full-store), Pod (24/7 autonomous unit), Cabinet (plug-and-play), and Lane (human-assisted express checkout) — serving supermarkets, workplaces, mobility hubs, education, hospitality, leisure, and health/wellness venues. Founded in Portugal (HQ Castelo Branco, with Lisbon, São Paulo, and Milan offices), Sensei is a Techstars-backed company that works with retailers such as Continente, Conad, NOS, Muffato, and Galp and technical partners including Mastercard and HP. Sensei is a hardware and computer-vision provider and publishes no public API, SDK, or developer documentation; engagement is demo-based ("book a demo") rather than developer self-serve.

providers.name: Skandia
providers.description: Skandia is a Swedish financial services company offering pensions, insurance, and banking solutions. The company provides a range of products for private individuals and businesses, focusing on retirement planning, savings, and investment services. It operates primarily in Sweden and aims to help customers secure their financial future through tailored financial products and advisory services.

providers.name: Subaru of America
providers.description: Subaru of America, Inc. is the United States subsidiary of Subaru Corporation (Japan), headquartered in Camden, New Jersey. SOA sells, services, and supports the Subaru lineup through more than 600 U.S. dealers and operates the MySubaru / STARLINK connected-vehicle platform that powers the MySubaru mobile app, owner portal, remote vehicle commands, safety and security services, in-vehicle Wi-Fi, and dealer integration. None of these surfaces are exposed as a public developer API; all known interfaces are private, OEM-internal, or partner-only.

providers.name: Tejas Networks
providers.description: Tejas Networks is an India-based telecommunications networking products company (part of the Tata group) that designs and manufactures a wall-to-wall portfolio of wireline and wireless networking equipment for telecom carriers, internet service providers, utilities, defense, and governments. Its product lines span Radio Access Network (4G/5G RAN), fiber broadband access (FTTx/GPON), packet-optical and DWDM/OTN transport (TJ1600), converged broadband (TJ1400), switching and routing, mobile packet core, satcom, and Direct-to-Mobile broadcast, all managed through the TejNMS (TJ5500) network management system. Tejas exposes an EMS/NMS management API for its equipment, but that interface and its product documentation are delivered through a login-gated customer documentation library rather than a public developer program; there is no public REST API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or open developer portal at this time. This profile was surfaced as a Mayfield portfolio company and enriched from public sources.

providers.name: TimesTen
providers.description: TimesTen is an in-memory relational database company that spun out of Hewlett-Packard Labs in Palo Alto in 1996 as TimesTen Performance Software, taking venture backing that included Lightspeed Venture Partners, and was acquired by Oracle Corporation in 2005. The product lives on as Oracle TimesTen In-Memory Database, a persistent, ACID-compliant OLTP database with SQL support, replication, JSON support, and a Kubernetes operator, documented today under Oracle Help Center with releases 11.2.2, 18.1, 22.1, and 26.1. The company no longer operates independently and publishes no standalone web API; timesten.com redirects into oracle.com.

providers.name: Tiney
providers.description: Tiney is the UK's fastest-growing Ofsted-approved childminder agency, connecting parents with quality-assured home childminders and supporting educators through training, registration, and ongoing quality assurance. Operating as a government-regulated Childminder Agency (CMA), tiney runs a consumer marketplace plus a mobile app for finding local childcare and managing payments, communication, and children's learning updates. Tiney publishes no public developer API; its backend at api.tiney.co powers the parent and childminder apps and is access-restricted (HTTP 403) and undocumented.

providers.name: TrueBlue
providers.description: TrueBlue (NYSE: TBI) is a leading provider of workforce solutions and specialized talent services. TrueBlue connects people and work through three operating segments: PeopleReady (industrial staffing), PeopleScout (RPO and talent advisory), and Staff Management | SMX (managed staffing). TrueBlue's digital platforms include JobStack for on-demand industrial staffing and Affinix for recruitment process outsourcing.

providers.name: Vedana Therapeutics
providers.description: Vedana Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing next-generation medicines for migraine prevention. Founded by biotech investor Anurag Agarwal and antibody-development veteran Leon Garcia, the company emerged from stealth in June 2026 with a $46 million Series A co-led by Westlake BioPartners and Canaan Partners, with participation from Dawn Biopharma and Alexandria Venture Investments. Vedana is building a portfolio of long-acting, subcutaneously dosed monoclonal antibodies that go beyond CGRP by targeting PACAP (pituitary adenylate cyclase-activating peptide) and other CGRP-independent pathways, aiming to deliver complete and lasting relief for the majority of migraine patients who remain suboptimally controlled on current standard of care. Its preclinical pipeline includes VDN-0100 (anti-PACAP antibody, first-in-human planned 2027), VDN-0200 (PACAP x CGRP bispecific), and two undisclosed programs. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Vedana is a therapeutics company and publishes no public API or developer surface; this record captures its corporate identity for discovery.

providers.name: Vexcel Imaging
providers.description: Vexcel Imaging provides professional aerial imaging and photogrammetry solutions, including the UltraCam series of high‑resolution cameras and the UltraMap processing software suite. The company serves mapping agencies, survey firms, and defense customers worldwide, delivering accurate, reliable airborne data for large‑scale mapping projects.

providers.name: Visolis
providers.description: Visolis is a biomanufacturing company that combines synthetic biology with chemical catalysis to convert plant biomass into MEV (mevalonic acid), a proprietary platform molecule used to make sustainable, bio-based alternatives to petroleum-derived chemicals and fuels. Its products include bio-isoprene for synthetic rubber (a partnership with Zeon), AroSAF 100% bio-based sustainable aviation fuel, and non-toxic bio-based industrial solvents (piloted with the U.S. Department of Defense). Headquartered in San Leandro, California and led by CEO Deepak Dugar, Visolis is a climate-tech company surfaced as a DCVC portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Visolis publishes a corporate marketing site but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: VulcanForms
providers.description: VulcanForms operates integrated digital metal manufacturing factories in the United States, combining in-house designed industrial-scale laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) additive machines, precision machining, automation, inspection, and proprietary AI-enabled software into a single end-to-end production workflow. The company produces mission-critical metal components at production scale for the aerospace, defense, medical, compute, consumer, and industrial sectors, compressing the supply chain into one secure, vertically integrated system. Headquartered in Devens, Massachusetts, VulcanForms is backed by Eclipse, 1789 Capital, D1 Capital and others. This profile currently exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: WelbeHealth
providers.description: WelbeHealth is a California public benefit company and provider-sponsored health plan operating Programs of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE). Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California, it is both insurer and care provider for frail seniors who qualify for nursing-home level of care, coordinating and paying for all medical, behavioral, pharmacy, home care, rehabilitation, transportation and social services through interdisciplinary teams at PACE centers across California including Fresno, Long Beach, Los Angeles, Modesto, North Hollywood, Pasadena, Rosemead, Stockton and the Inland Empire, funded by capitated Medicare and Medi-Cal payments. In 2022 it became the first PACE organization to convert to public benefit company status. API Evangelist finds no public developer program, no API documentation and no machine-readable contract on any WelbeHealth-controlled host as of September 2026.

providers.name: Weshine
providers.description: Weshine (闪萌, Shanmeng), operated by Beijing Shanqu Information Technology Co., Ltd (北京闪趣信息技术有限公司), is a Chinese GIF and animated-sticker (表情) search engine. It offers a business-to-business "Expression API" (表情API) with three documented interfaces — a hot/trending interface (热门接口) that returns trending GIFs by category refreshed hourly, a real-time search interface (搜索接口) supporting gif/webp/mp4 and multi-dimensional ranking, and a "magic image" interface (神配图接口) that semantically matches a phrase to a background GIF and composites a caption onto it. The platform reports 800M+ users covered, 300M+ daily searches, and 200M+ animated images sent per day, powering social apps, input methods (including its own KK Keyboard), and browsers. API access is via business partnership; no public self-serve developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or SDK is published.

providers.name: West Technology Group
providers.description: West Technology Group is a cloud-based global technology company providing customer experience and communications solutions through its WestCX platform. The company operates through two main brands: Mosaicx, which delivers AI-native conversational automation for enterprise customer engagement, and TeleVox, which provides digital patient engagement solutions for healthcare organizations including providers, payers, and life sciences companies.

providers.name: Wukong Education
providers.description: WuKong Education is an online education company headquartered in Auckland, New Zealand that delivers live online classes in Chinese language, math, and English ELA for kids, taught by certified teachers to students across more than 100 countries and regions. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners, it is a consumer edtech business with a student classroom portal but no public developer portal or documented APIs.

providers.name: Zyg
providers.description: ZyG is an agentic operating system for eCommerce scale that helps product inventors and direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands validate, scale, and finance their growth. Instead of stitching together fragmented tools and agencies, ZyG offers a unified, AI-agent-powered platform that turns great products into successful brands. The company pairs a data-driven ZyG Score with a pay-as-you-grow consumption model and cohort-based financing, positioning itself as a risk-reduction partner across the brand-building journey. ZyG is backed by Accel, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.

providers.name: 6K
providers.description: 6K Inc is a North Andover, Massachusetts advanced-materials company that produces engineered powders and battery materials with UniMelt, its patented microwave-based production-scale plasma system. Named for the roughly 6,000 K plasma temperature it operates at — the temperature of the surface of the sun — UniMelt uses tightly controlled thermal plasma beams to melt or vaporize precursor feedstock into particles with precise size distribution and crystalline phase, in seconds rather than the days conventional processes require, while cutting energy use and eliminating wastewater. The company operates through two divisions. 6K Additive, with production in Burgettstown, Pennsylvania, makes sustainably sourced metal powders for additive manufacturing — titanium Ti-6Al-4V, nickel superalloys Ni625 and Ni718, stainless SS316L, refractory tungsten, niobium C103, copper C18150 and the HEA1000 refractory alloy — reclaiming CNC scrap and revert metal into premium AM powder. 6K Energy produces domestically sourced lithium-ion battery cathode and solid-state materials including NMC, LFP, LLZO, LMO, LTO and LNMO. Additional applications span semiconductor CMP, specialty ceramics, advanced coatings, lighting and display materials, nano-engineered powders, and federal/defense programs; 6K has received US Department of Defense and Department of Energy awards for domestic critical-materials capacity. 6K is a privately held company whose shares trade on secondary markets. Enrichment probing on 2026-07-31 found no public developer API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL contract, developer portal, SDK, MCP server, agent card, or event surface — 6K is a materials manufacturer, not an API provider.

providers.name: ALICE Technologies
providers.description: ALICE Technologies is a Menlo Park, California construction technology company that builds an AI-driven generative scheduling and construction optioneering platform. The product simulates millions of possible construction sequences for a project — varying crews, equipment, methods, and constraints — to find optimal schedules, accelerate timelines, recover delayed projects, and de-risk capital project delivery. ALICE's suite includes ALICE Optimize (generative scheduling from imported Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project schedules), ALICE Plan (a 2D visual planning canvas overlaid on drawings), ALICE Model (BIM-driven schedule generation from 3D models), and the Schedule Insights Agent (an LLM-powered conversational interface for analysing and recommending schedule changes, including automated DCMA 14-point schedule quality scoring). The platform is sold as SaaS to general contractors, owners and developers, and consultants working on industrial (data centres, energy, semiconductors), infrastructure (rail, highway, tunnels), and commercial projects, with reported impacts including up to 17% reduction in project duration and 14% labor cost savings. ALICE was founded in 2015 by René Morkos (Stanford PhD) and is backed by Merus Capital, Foundamental, Future Ventures, Lightspeed, Blackhorn Ventures, and Brick and Mortar; in 2026 it announced a formal alliance with McKinsey to deploy generative scheduling on capital projects. ALICE integrates by importing from Primavera P6, Primavera Cloud, Microsoft Project, and BIM/drawing formats, but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or open-source repository — integration is delivered via the product's import/export surface and customer-success engagements.

providers.name: Altvia
providers.description: Altvia is fund management software purpose-built for private capital markets, serving private equity, venture capital, fund of funds, real estate, hedge funds, family offices, and placement agents. Built on the Salesforce platform, Altvia unifies a purpose-built CRM, a virtual data room (VDR) and LP investor portal, analytics and reporting, and an AI assistant (AIMe) into one system that spans the full fund lifecycle — capital raising, investor relations, and deal management. Founded in 2006 and based in Broomfield, Colorado, Altvia was acquired by Marlin Equity Partners in 2022. The company exposes no public developer/API portal; integrations are delivered through the platform and the Salesforce ecosystem.

providers.name: Ambition
providers.description: Ambition (theambitionapp.com) is a consumer mobile application that helps teenagers get ready for real life. The app delivers short daily life-skills courses and 30-day simulated virtual internships across careers such as entrepreneurship, sales, game design, nursing, and wealth management, where US middle- and high-school students pick a path, build technical and life skills in about fifteen minutes a day, and can earn gift-card rewards for completing an internship. Ambition ships as native iOS and Android apps ("Ambition - Shape Your Future" / "Learn and Earn"); it is a business-to-consumer product with no public developer API, SDK, or documented integration surface as of this profile. This entry was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and enriched with the real, publicly verifiable identity, legal, and domain-security surface of the product.

providers.name: American Family Insurance
providers.description: American Family Insurance is a private mutual company that offers auto, homeowners, life, renters, umbrella, business, and farm/ranch insurance throughout the United States. The company serves customers through a network of exclusive agents, digital tools including the MyAmFam mobile app, and online self-service capabilities. American Family is headquartered in Madison, Wisconsin, and is one of the largest property-casualty insurers in the country.

providers.name: Arkema
providers.description: Arkema S.A. is a French specialty materials company headquartered in La Defense, Paris and listed on Euronext Paris under ticker AKE. The group is organized around three Specialty Materials segments — Adhesive Solutions (anchored by the Bostik brand), Advanced Materials (high-performance polymers including Kynar PVDF, Rilsan polyamides, Pebax elastomers, Sartomer photocurable resins) and Coating Solutions (acrylic monomers, waterborne and solvent-borne resins, additives) — plus a smaller Intermediates business. Arkema employs roughly 21,000 people across 55 countries with about 154 production plants and 17 R&D centers, generating around EUR 9.1 billion in 2025 revenue. Strategy is anchored in materials science, decarbonization and a validated 1.5 degree SBTi pathway toward Net-Zero by 2050. Arkema does not publish a public developer portal or REST API; customer integrations and product data are exchanged through commercial sales channels, the Product Finder web UI and Safety Data Sheet downloads.

providers.name: Aruna
providers.description: Aruna is Indonesia's largest integrated fisheries commerce platform, on a mission to make the sea a better livelihood for all by building a fair and sustainable fisheries ecosystem. Aruna connects more than 40,000 small-scale fishermen to domestic and global markets using technology, a network of processing partners, and 177+ distribution hubs (Aruna Hubs) across the Indonesian archipelago, trading 23+ seafood commodity types into 31+ countries. The company pairs commerce with sustainability work, including fisherman education, fish-population tracking, and coastal-community empowerment. Aruna is a portfolio company of Prosus Ventures and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company lead; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: Augustrobotics
providers.description: August Robotics provides autonomous robotic fleets for construction, exhibition, and industrial applications. Their AI‑driven platform automates dirty, dangerous and dull jobs, improving productivity and safety across sectors. The company offers modular robot solutions, leasing options, and a comprehensive service ecosystem to accelerate project delivery.

providers.name: AutoZone
providers.description: AutoZone is the nation's leading retailer and a leading distributor of automotive replacement parts and accessories with more than 7,000 stores across the Americas. AutoZone serves both do-it-yourself (DIY) customers and professional automotive service providers (DIFM) through retail stores, e-commerce, and electronic ordering integrations for commercial accounts via AutoZone Pro.

providers.name: Bastille Networks
providers.description: Bastille Networks is a wireless airspace cybersecurity company that detects, localizes, and continuously monitors radio-frequency emitting devices and threats across 50+ wireless protocols including Bluetooth, BLE, Wi-Fi, cellular, and IoT. Its platform delivers real-time inventory of wireless assets, rogue-device and insider-threat detection, and localization down to a 1-3 meter radius, integrating through an API-led architecture with SIEM, SOAR, XDR, and CAASM tooling such as Splunk, ArcSight, and QRadar. Bastille serves Fortune 100 enterprises, government agencies, classified facilities, and data center operators, and is a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners. It exposes integration APIs to enterprise customers but publishes no public developer portal or OpenAPI specification.

providers.name: Bluenote
providers.description: Bluenote is an AI platform for life sciences that automates regulatory and clinical documentation for pharmaceutical, medical device, diagnostic, and CDMO companies. Its AI agents, workflow builder, document generation, dataset search, and translation tooling accelerate regulatory submissions by 50-75% across the pre-clinical, clinical, CMC, regulatory, quality, and commercial stages of the product lifecycle. Bluenote is an enterprise, sales-led company with no public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface published as of this profile; it maintains a Vanta-hosted trust center and a public privacy policy. Backed by Electric Capital and Lux Capital, tracked in the API Evangelist network as a healthcare / life-sciences AI company.

providers.name: Cargo X
providers.description: Cargo X (CargoX) is a Sao Paulo based Brazilian logistics technology and fintech company, founded in 2013, that operates one of Brazil's largest digital freight marketplaces - matching shippers (embarcadores) with carriers (transportadoras) and independent truck drivers. Beyond freight brokerage the platform provides dedicated freight desk operations, driver qualification and real-time cargo monitoring, automated issuance of Brazilian transport tax documents (CT-e and MDF-e), cargo insurance, receivables financing and working-capital credit for carriers, and green-freight / ESG programs that reduce empty return trips. The company reached unicorn status with a USD 200M Series F in October 2021 co-led by Tencent and SoftBank, with Valor Capital Group, Lightrock and Oikos participating.

providers.name: Character.AI
providers.description: Character.AI is a consumer conversational-AI platform that lets users create and chat with AI personas (Characters) via web and mobile apps. Character.AI does not publish a public developer API; product surfaces are accessed through the consumer apps. Community-maintained reverse-engineered clients exist but are unofficial and unsupported.

providers.name: Claros
providers.description: Claros is a data center power delivery company reimagining how energy moves from chip to grid for AI and high-performance computing infrastructure. Based in Torrance, California with an office in McLean, Virginia, the company builds two hardware-and-software product lines: an Integrated Voltage Regulator (IVR) that targets the roughly 40 percent of chip power lost to heat at the point of delivery, and a Power Gateway that manages broader data center power distribution where 30 to 50 percent of power is lost to transmission, conversion, and cooling. Claros is an early-stage hardware company backed by General Catalyst and Red Cell Partners; its founding team collectively holds 286 patents and has brought more than 80 gigawatts of projects to market. As of 2026 it is pre-product (prototypes in development, engineering samples planned for 2026, low-volume production 2027, high-volume scale 2028) and publishes no developer API, SDK, or public documentation surface yet — this profile captures its public identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Codagenixinc
providers.description: Codagenix is a biotechnology company focused on engineering live‑attenuated viruses using codon deoptimization to create safe, effective vaccines. The firm combines synthetic biology with advanced virology to develop next‑generation vaccines for infectious diseases, aiming to improve global health outcomes through rapid, scalable, and stable vaccine platforms.

providers.name: ConversionPoint Technologies
providers.description: ConversionPoint Technologies, Inc. is a privately held e‑commerce technology company that provides AI‑enabled media optimization, customer relationship management, and post‑purchase platforms to help brands, advertisers, and agencies acquire and retain customers. The company was slated for acquisition by Inuvo, Inc., and operates under the ConversionPoint Holdings umbrella, with its public presence now integrated into the Inuvo website.

providers.name: ECOVACS Robotics
providers.description: ECOVACS Robotics is a global home service robotics company founded in 1998 and headquartered in Suzhou, China, that designs, manufactures, and sells AI-powered autonomous cleaning devices for consumer and commercial use. Its product families include DEEBOT robotic vacuum and mopping robots, WINBOT window-cleaning robots, GOAT robotic lawn mowers, ULTRAMARINE pool-cleaning robots, and the DEEBOT PRO commercial line, all managed through the ECOVACS HOME mobile app. The company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of IDG Capital; as of this enrichment pass ECOVACS publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documented API surface — this profile captures its public web, support, and legal properties plus a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Embroker
providers.description: Embroker is a San Francisco-based digital business insurance broker and insurtech platform founded in 2015 by Matt Miller, on a mission to make commercial insurance simple, clear, and tailored to each industry. Embroker operates a digital-first online platform where businesses can compare, quote, purchase, and manage commercial insurance policies directly, with industry-specific programs for funded startups, tech companies, law firms, venture capital and private equity firms, financial services professionals, consultants, real estate agents, and small businesses. Its coverage portfolio includes Business Owners Policy (BOP), commercial general liability, professional liability, technology errors and omissions, cyber insurance, directors and officers, employment practices liability, commercial crime, key person, workers compensation, and lawyers professional liability, often bundled into industry packages such as the Startup Bundle, Law Bundle, and MPL Bundle. In 2017 Embroker partnered with Munich Re to underwrite its own digital insurance products; in 2020 it launched Embroker Access for retail and wholesale brokers; and in 2023 it launched Embroker One, an AI- and machine-learning-driven platform for real-time risk assessment and policy recommendations. The company has protected 9,500+ businesses across 16,000+ policies and raised a $100M round in 2021 led by FTV Capital. Embroker's revenue model is brokerage commissions, managing general agent (MGA) underwriting fees on its own products, and platform access for partner brokers; there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release — its GitHub organization contains only archived forks of third-party libraries and a small number of internal tooling repositories.

providers.name: Ennis
providers.description: Ennis Inc is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Ennis Inc API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: EZ Farming
providers.description: EZ Farming is an agriculture investment and farm-ownership platform that lets individuals start or co-own a working farm without doing the day-to-day work themselves. Members can buy land in the EZFarming farm estate, join a farmer cooperative to co-own a farm alongside other investors, buy produce directly from managed farms, or invest in agricultural projects for returns. Backed by 500 Global, the company packages land acquisition, farm management, and produce offtake into a single managed offering aimed at first-time farm owners and agriculture investors.

providers.name: Fazla Gida
providers.description: Fazla (formerly Fazla Gida / Whole Surplus) is a Turkish technology-driven waste management and circular-economy company founded in 2017 in Istanbul. Its digital, decision-support platform helps B2B clients across the supply chain — manufacturers, retailers, e-commerce, distributors, HoReCa, food banks and municipalities — prevent waste at the source and recover value from surplus inventory through a food-recovery hierarchy of secondary-sales marketplace, donation, animal-feed conversion and recycling modules, backed by logistics support, a smart-scale IoT inventory system and an AI analysis tool that reports financial, CO2 and social impact. The company operates the Fazla Iyi surprise-box consumer app, is the first B Corp-certified waste-management organization in Turkey, and is backed by 500 Global among other investors.

providers.name: Get Lighthouse
providers.description: Get Lighthouse (Lighthouse Lessons) is a management-training and leadership-development company that helps managers run better one-on-ones and grow their teams. It offers bite-sized, actionable online management-training programs, including a 1-on-1 Master Class, Managing Up, and the Secret Habits of Senior Leaders, delivered as self-paced solo study and structured team training, alongside a widely-read management and leadership blog. Get Lighthouse is a content and training provider with no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile captures its web identity and domain-security posture. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: HAAWK
providers.description: HAAWK is a Los Angeles-based music rights management and monetization company that administers digital rights across YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok for record labels, music publishers, and independent artists. Its products include HAAWK (full-service YouTube Content ID and Meta Rights Manager administration), Identifyy (self-service UGC rights management for independent creators), Keyframe Audio (a micro sync-licensing catalog of 50,000+ production music tracks), and Diistro (digital music distribution to Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube Music, and TikTok). HAAWK has administered 100B+ video views and manages 1.1M+ music copyrights for 2,000+ rights holders. Backed by 500 Global. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Hamilton Lane
providers.description: Hamilton Lane is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Hamilton Lane API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Humeo
providers.description: Humeo, INC. is a San Francisco-based applied AI research lab focused on creative intelligence, blending design, social science, and frontier AI research. Its products include VideoClaw, a desktop creative production agent that transforms existing media and automates media creation, and Studio, a web application for producing high-impact short-form video content. Humeo's research spans creative attunement, taste modeling, universal media transformation, world models of attention, and creative efficiency. The company is backed by 500 Global. As of this profile Humeo publishes no public API, developer portal, or documentation; VideoClaw is in private alpha with access granted by request.

providers.name: I-Pulse
providers.description: I-Pulse Inc. is a U.S.-based industrial technology company founded in 2007 by Robert Friedland and Laurent Frescaline that commercializes High Pulsed Power (HPP) — releasing very short, extremely high-power electrical discharges from small amounts of stored energy to generate magnetic forces, shockwaves, electrical arcs and electric fields. I-Pulse holds 55 patents licensed exclusively to its operating businesses across natural-resource transformation (I-ROX rock comminution, I-Mine, iTerra non-chemical weed control, IPW), the energy transition (G-Pulse pulsed-power geothermal drilling, Blue Spark Geothermal), manufacturing (Bmax electromagnetic metal forming and welding, CSI Technologies high-energy capacitors) and R&D (I-Cube, Typhoon). It operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico and Toulouse, France, with offices in Canada, the UK and Singapore, and signed a $250 million CHIPS R&D award with the U.S. Department of Commerce in 2026 for semiconductor and pulsed-power development. I-Pulse is a hardware and industrial-process company; it publishes no developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Institute of Museum and Library Services
providers.description: The Institute of Museum and Library Services (IMLS) is an independent federal agency that advances, supports, and empowers America's museums, libraries, and related organizations through grantmaking, research, and policy development. IMLS provides data access to grant and museum information through its APIs.

providers.name: Isembard
providers.description: Isembard is a UK- and US-based advanced manufacturing company building a distributed network of software-powered precision factories for critical industries including aerospace, defence, space, satellites, drones, nuclear energy, and motorsport. Founded in 2024 by Alexander Fitzgerald and named after engineer Isambard Kingdom Brunel, the company runs its factories on MasonOS, a proprietary AI-powered operating system that manages quoting, scheduling, production, and quality control across its factory network. Its model reshores high-precision component manufacturing closer to home to address supply-chain vulnerabilities in the Western industrial base, scaling from prototypes to production and offering factory franchise opportunities. Isembard has raised a Series A led by Union Square Ventures and operates factories across the UK, US, France, and Germany. There is no public developer API; MasonOS is an internal software platform, so this profile captures the company's identity and web surface rather than an API.

providers.name: Joggr
providers.description: Joggr is a documentation platform purpose-built for software teams. It bridges the gap between traditional dev docs and modern development workflows, helping engineering teams create and maintain technical documentation. Joggr ships native MCP integration with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf) and APIs for building custom Slackbots, agents, and workflows on top of the platform. The primary domain has moved from joggr.io to joggr.ai.

providers.name: KK直播 (KK Live)
providers.description: KK直播 (KK Live) is a Chinese mobile-first video livestreaming and social entertainment platform operated by 杭州米络文化传播有限公司 (Hangzhou Melot Culture Communication Co., Ltd.), part of 米络星集团 (Melot Group), headquartered in Hangzhou with offices in Beijing, Changsha, Xi'an, Shenyang, Los Angeles and Mumbai. Founded in 2012 to fill the gap in mobile livestreaming variety shows, the platform pairs talent and performance streaming with interactive social features — virtual gifting, bullet comments (弹幕), multi-person live connections, PK mini-games, karaoke rooms, outdoor streaming and paid companionship. The company reports more than 100,000 independent streamers, over 600 partner talent agencies and 150 million registered users. Melot Group runs three business lines — entertainment livestreaming, online education and video service solutions — under the KK, 棒直播 and 米乐 brands. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners (启明创投), Sequoia China (红杉资本), CMC Capital (华人文化基金) and Shanda Capital (盛大资本). KK Live is a business-to-consumer product: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs or machine-readable API specifications.

providers.name: Lean
providers.description: Lean is an open-source theorem prover and programming language based on dependent type theory, designed for formal verification of mathematics and software. It supports interactive proof development and is used by mathematicians and computer scientists.

providers.name: Mask API
providers.description: Mask API is a powerful and flexible tool designed to help programmers and companies customize the response format of endpoint APIs, enabling selective field filtering and data transformation in API responses.

providers.name: MorphCast
providers.description: We expertly craft safe browser-processing, energy-efficient, accurate Emotion AI solutions to analyze facial emotions, empowering AI Agents and delivering empathetic, data-driven, and dynamic digital experiences.

providers.name: Mos
providers.description: Mos is a consumer fintech that helps students find and win money for college. Founded in 2017 by Tunisian human-rights activist Amira Yahyaoui and backed by Sequoia Capital, Lux Capital and Expa, the company began as a financial-aid application service — FAFSA filing plus human advisor support — then added a fee-free student checking account and debit card in 2021. Mos shut the banking product down and cut staff in 2023 after press and investor scrutiny of its account metrics, refocusing on its original financial-aid business. The live product at mos.com is a scholarship-matching app: students swipe through awards drawn from a database the company describes as $160 billion in available funding, with college financial-planning tools and access to a personal advisor. Sequoia's own company page records Mos as acquired in 2025; the acquirer is not disclosed. Mos ships only an end-user consumer app — it publishes no developer portal, API documentation, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Nebu
providers.description: NEBU (legal entity NEBU LAH SDN. BHD., Malaysia) is an early-stage, AI-powered DevOps-as-a-Service platform positioned as "the missing brain for your cloud" — offering intelligent understanding of cloud infrastructure rather than scripted automation alone. Founded in 2024, the company markets AIOps/MLOps-style cloud management, cost optimization, and intelligent automation for enterprise cloud estates, and self-states a security posture of SOC 2 Type II readiness, ISO 27001, and GDPR compliance. As of this profile the product is pre-launch ("we're building what comes next") with a single-page marketing site and no public API, developer documentation, or SDKs yet. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead; the only machine-readable surface found is a valid RFC 9116 /.well-known/security.txt.

providers.name: Net Worth
providers.description: netWorth (networth.mx) is a Mexico City fintech founded in 2016 and a 500 Startups (500 Global) Batch 10 company that helps individuals plan and manage retirement in Mexico. It specializes in Planes Personales de Retiro (PPR) and long-term savings and investment plans, combining human financial advisors (asesores) with digital tools such as retirement calculators and simulators, and commercializes plans backed by insurers and financial institutions such as Allianz and Skandia (Optimaxx Plus). The consumer product surfaces are a Webflow marketing site plus a client app at retiro.networth.mx and an authenticated portal at api.networth.mx; there is no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK program at this time.

providers.name: Nium
providers.description: Nium is a global payments infrastructure platform for cross-border payouts, collections, FX, and card issuing. Serves financial institutions, fintechs, and corporates with a single API.

providers.name: Oak
providers.description: Oak is an AI-native identity operating system that governs human, machine, and AI-agent identities from a single platform. Its Identity Intelligence Layer unifies identity data into a graph that serves as a foundational security layer, paired with Agentic Identity governance for AI agents, a Connect Any connector layer spanning on-premises, SaaS, cloud, and custom systems, and White Glove enterprise onboarding services. Oak is an early-stage, enterprise/sales-led identity-security company backed by CRV; it currently exposes a customer login app but no public API, developer portal, or documentation.

providers.name: Obsidian Security
providers.description: Obsidian Security is a SaaS security platform providing threat detection, posture management, and compliance monitoring for cloud applications.

providers.name: Officebanao
providers.description: Officebanao is a technology-enabled office interior design and build company headquartered in Gurugram and Bengaluru, India, and founded in 2021. It delivers turnkey commercial workspace solutions — space planning, interior design, furniture procurement, office renovation, and end-to-end project execution — for startups, enterprises, and coworking spaces across 40+ Indian cities. Its "Tech plus Touch" delivery model pairs real-time 3D visualization and online progress tracking with an in-house team of designers and project managers. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. Officebanao publishes a public marketing website and an llms.txt discovery file but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer platform surface as of this profiling.

providers.name: PlantShop.me
providers.description: PlantShop.me (operated by Lamento Trading LLC, Dubai) is the largest online plant store in the Middle East, selling indoor and outdoor plants, pots and planters, seeds, terrariums, fertilizers and plant-care accessories with UAE-wide delivery and localized shipping to Saudi Arabia, Bahrain and Kuwait. It offers cash on delivery, same-week delivery, and free plant-care support from a real team. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. The company publishes no public developer API; its machine-readable surface is a first-party /llms.txt AI overview, an AI-crawler-friendly robots.txt, and schema.org structured data on product pages.

providers.name: Project Canary
providers.description: Project Canary is a Denver-based climate technology company that helps oil and gas operators and natural gas utilities turn methane emissions data into operational intelligence. Founded in 2019, its Canary SENSE platform unifies measurement data from sensors, satellites, aircraft, SCADA, and field teams into a single view that drives decisions, reduces costs, and supports regulatory reporting (OGMP 2.0 and other frameworks). The company builds high-precision methane detection hardware (Canary RECON, Aeris PICO) and a proprietary predictive emissions model (methaneML) trained on a multi-year, high-fidelity methane dataset, serving upstream and midstream operators as well as gas distribution utilities across the United States. Project Canary has raised $121M (Series B) and was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and Techstars. No public API, developer portal, SDK, or OpenAPI is published at this time; this profile captures identity, a verbatim llms.txt, and security posture.

providers.name: Python Standard Library and Popular
providers.description: A collection of commonly used Python APIs and libraries including the standard library and popular frameworks like Flask, Django, FastAPI, Pandas, and NumPy.

providers.name: REGENT Craft
providers.description: REGENT Craft Inc. is a Rhode Island maritime mobility manufacturer building the Seaglider, an all-electric wing-in-ground-effect (WIG) vessel that floats on its hull, hydrofoils, and then flies within a wingspan of the water's surface at up to 180 mph. The company builds the 12-passenger Viceroy, the larger Monarch, and the uncrewed Squire defense drone, and operates a defense product line for ISR, contested logistics and MEDEVAC missions. REGENT is a vehicle manufacturer rather than a software company: it publishes no developer program, no public API and no machine-readable API contract. It does serve a real, hand-authored llms.txt at its website root, which is the only machine-readable artifact on its public surface.

providers.name: Reserv
providers.description: Reserv is an insurance technology company and third-party administrator (TPA) that combines AI-powered automation with human claims expertise to handle property and casualty (P&C) claims for MGAs and carriers across North America, the UK, and the EU. Its platform pairs adjuster workflows with analytics dashboards, reporting, and structured claims data, positioning itself as the simplicity of a TPA with the benefits of an in-house team. Reserv is backed by 8VC, Anthemis, and Bain Capital Ventures. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs.

providers.name: Saia
providers.description: Saia Inc is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Saia Inc API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Sealed
providers.description: Sealed is a New York-based climate technology company, founded in 2012, whose Sealed Pro platform helps home-improvement contractors sell and finance home weatherization and electrification projects — insulation, air sealing, heat pumps, smart thermostats and heat-pump water heaters. Sealed pairs energy data and analytics with a rebate and incentive engine that qualifies a project at the point of sale, guarantees a minimum rebate amount, files the utility and Inflation Reduction Act (HOMES / HEAR) paperwork on the contractor's behalf, and pays the contractor after installation while Sealed carries the incentive-collection risk. The company began as a direct-to-consumer home energy retrofit provider with the first residential energy-savings guarantee, and relaunched as Sealed Pro, a contractor-facing software platform, working with utilities and state energy offices on measured- and modeled-savings programs.

providers.name: Silicon Box
providers.description: Silicon Box Pte Ltd is an independent advanced semiconductor packaging and chiplet integration company headquartered in Tampines, Singapore, founded in 2021 by Byung Joon Han, Sehat Sutardja and Weili Dai. It operates a $2B panel-level packaging foundry and provides the back-end interconnection infrastructure that makes chiplet adoption practical — from early design collaboration through final manufacture and test — functioning as an OSAT with an added design-consulting practice. It has shipped over 500 million units at high yield, joined the imec Automotive Chiplet Program, and is building a second €3.2B facility in Novara, Piedmont, Italy. Silicon Box is a semiconductor manufacturer, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract. See x-coverage below for the measured basis of that statement.

providers.name: Silvur
providers.description: Silvur (Silvur Technology Services, Inc.) is a white-label financial-wellness platform that helps credit unions and financial institutions deliver personalized retirement education and planning tools to their members and customers. Its patent-pending Retirement Score answers "how long will their money last in retirement?" and its SmartDraw technology generates personalized recommendations across Social Security, Medicare, retirement savings, and state-specific planning. Institutions launch a fully branded retirement website in weeks and use it to educate members and market financial products such as loans, mortgages, and insurance against the multi-trillion-dollar retirement wallet. Silvur is a venture-backed fintech (Anthemis portfolio). As of this enrichment pass Silvur publishes only a marketing site with legal and support pages and exposes no public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or webhooks.

providers.name: SkySafe
providers.description: SkySafe is a San Diego-based drone-detection and airspace-intelligence company (founded 2015, backed by a16z) whose cloud SaaS platform lets airports, critical infrastructure, law enforcement, universities, correctional facilities, and government customers detect, track, analyze, and act on every drone in their airspace in real time. The platform surfaces precise drone location, altitude, velocity, flight status, launch point, and pilot location, receives and analyzes Remote ID, retains historical flight telemetry for forensic "Prosecutor-Ready" reporting, and pushes instant notifications via SMS, Microsoft Teams, Slack, or CommandCentral Aware. SkySafe advertises integration APIs that push detection, forensics, and analytics into third-party command centers and mitigation workflows, but its developer surface (app.skysafe.io, docs.skysafe.io, api.skysafe.io) sits entirely behind customer authentication — there is no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI specification to harvest.

providers.name: Sunrun
providers.description: Sunrun is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Sunrun API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: SuperAgent
providers.description: SuperAgent is an open-source framework for building and deploying AI agents with APIs.

providers.name: Symbotic
providers.description: Symbotic is an AI-powered warehouse automation company that designs, manufactures, and operates end-to-end robotic distribution and micro-fulfillment systems for food and beverage, retail grocery, healthcare, apparel, retail general merchandise, and consumer packaged goods customers. Its portfolio includes the Symbotic distribution solution for case handling, SymMicro for less-than-case micro-fulfillment, autonomous SymBots mobile robots, warehouse AI software, and Warehouse-as-a-Service offerings. Symbotic operates as a hardware-and-services vendor and does not publish a public developer portal or open APIs.

providers.name: Tecost
providers.description: Tecost SA is a Swiss health-information-technology company, founded in 1997 and based in Fribourg, that designs, develops, implements, hosts and operates clinical information systems for hospitals, clinics, psychiatric and rehabilitation institutions, long-term care facilities and home-care organizations across French- and German-speaking Switzerland. Its product line is the Carefolio suite — Acute, Rehabilitation, Psy, LongTerm, AtHome, Critical Care 3C, Network, Portal, Workshop, AI and the openEHR-based Carefolio DIH Data Integration Hub — alongside consulting, change management, custom development, 24/7 maintenance and SaaS operations. Tecost is a named industry partner of the openEHR Foundation and states that it is making openEHR the cornerstone of its clinical-data interoperability. It publishes no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable contract; Carefolio is delivered as per-customer tenants behind Microsoft Entra ID single sign-on, so any integration contract reaches integrators under a commercial agreement rather than through a public surface.

providers.name: Teserac
providers.description: Teserac is an AI-native infrastructure intelligence company building Neuron™, a unified platform for data center observability, intelligence, and workflow automation. Neuron ingests telemetry from every system in a facility and correlates it across existing DCIM, BMS, EPMS, and ITSM platforms into a single intelligence layer, surfacing anomalies before they become incidents to protect SLAs and shrink MTTR. Its proprietary Neuron Connect™ technology auto-discovers and configures devices and supports protocols including SNMP, OPC-UA, MQTT, Redfish, REST APIs, and Niagara/Tridium. Teserac is backed by Mayfield. As of this profile the company exposes a marketing site and an authenticated product demo (neuron.demo.teserac.ai) but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Tugende
providers.description: Tugende is a for-profit social enterprise founded in 2012 in Uganda that uses asset finance, technology, and a customer-centric model to help informal-sector entrepreneurs (MSMEs) own income-generating assets through lease-to-own financing — motorcycles (boda bodas), taxis, matatus, boat engines, smartphones, and small-business equipment like salon kits, fridges, and sewing machines. Operating in Uganda and Kenya with 800+ full-time staff, Tugende has served over 52,000 clients. Backed by Partech. Tugende publishes no public API or developer program as of this profile.

providers.name: Ubiq (now NECTURE)
providers.description: Ubiq is a Vienna, Austria mobility-intelligence company (NECTURE GmbH) that rebranded from UBIQ to NECTURE in 2024. Its "distributed operations" SaaS platform turns fleet data into action for shared-mobility operators, business fleets transitioning to EVs, autonomous fleets, and last-mile delivery -- offering automated rebalancing, predictive charging (Charging as a Service), and airport peak services, alongside StreetCrowd, its decentralized community workforce for fleet operations. Founded in 2015 around city parking optimization, it pivoted to shared-mobility SaaS in 2020 and is backed by Speedinvest among other investors. No public developer portal, API documentation, or client packages were found.

providers.name: Uniko
providers.description: Uniko is a Mexican gift registry (mesa de regalos) SaaS platform for weddings, events, and baby showers, letting couples convert gifts into cash deposited directly to their bank account. The platform bundles a personalized wedding website, save-the-date digital invitations, WhatsApp-based guest confirmation, and planning tools, and also offers store-credit gift registries for ecommerce shops. Uniko is a 500 Global portfolio company; it is consumer-facing and publishes no public API or developer documentation.

providers.name: WeDoctor
providers.description: WeDoctor (微医, formerly Guahao.com / 挂号网) is a Hangzhou-based Chinese digital health platform founded in 2010 by Liao Jieyuan. It began as an online hospital-appointment registration network and grew into a full-stack "Internet + Healthcare" operator spanning online consultation and internet hospitals (it launched China's first, the Wuzhen Internet Hospital, in 2015), e-prescription and pharmacy fulfilment, screening and diagnostics, chronic-disease management, medical insurance settlement, and the WeDoctor Cloud platform sold to hospitals and regional health authorities. The company reports connections to thousands of Chinese hospitals and hundreds of thousands of registered physicians. Its public surface is consumer- and clinician-facing (web portal plus the 微医 patient app and 微医生 doctor app); as of this profile it operates no public developer program, publishes no machine-readable API contract, and exposes no documented partner API — hospital and insurer integrations are handled through private commercial agreements rather than a self-serve developer portal.

providers.name: Wingstop
providers.description: Wingstop Inc. (NASDAQ: WING) is a US-based quick-service restaurant chain specializing in cooked-to-order chicken wings, tenders, and sides across thousands of franchised and company-owned locations. Wingstop is digital-first - digital transactions account for the large majority of systemwide sales - built on its proprietary MyWingstop ordering platform and the Club Wingstop loyalty program, with consumer ordering via wingstop.com, native iOS and Android apps, and third-party delivery marketplaces (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub). Wingstop does not operate a public developer program or publish open API documentation. There is no developer.wingstop.com (the host does not resolve), and ordering, loyalty, menu, and POS integrations flow through bilateral corporate and franchisee technology programs rather than open developer endpoints.

providers.name: Wonderful
providers.description: Wonderful is an applied-AI company building an enterprise AI platform for critical, high-volume workflows. It combines an AI platform (run any model, any modality, any use case, fully governed) with local deployment teams and a strategic partnership model to help large organizations accelerate AI adoption. Wonderful powers agentic automation for enterprises such as national telecom operators, energy providers, and financial-services firms, covering customer-service containment, collections across millions of clients, internal IT automation, and end-to-end billing resolution, with reported outcomes like a 91.5% containment rate across millions of customers. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and IVP. Wonderful sells an enterprise platform with deployment services rather than a self-serve public developer API; its developer documentation is login-gated.

providers.name: Xtalic
providers.description: Xtalic Corporation is a materials technology company founded in 2005 out of MIT by professor Chris Schuh and Dr. Alan Lund, headquartered in Marlborough, Massachusetts, with technical support and sales teams in Shanghai, South China, and Singapore. Its patented computational materials design platform tailors nanostructured metal alloys - XTRONIC nickel, LUNA silver, XTALIUM aluminum, PALLEX palladium, XENERGY soft magnetic, and XEFORM nickel-gold - as high-performance, sustainable replacements for traditional metals and precious-metal plating in electronics connectors, EV powertrains and charging systems, wireless charging, and wearables. Xtalic publishes no public API or developer surface.

providers.name: Zalos
providers.description: Zalos is a Y Combinator-backed (F25) company building AI "computer agents" for finance operations. Rather than integrating through APIs, its agents log into a company's existing systems — ERPs, accounting platforms, banks, invoicing and CFO tools such as NetSuite and SAP — and operate the user interface the way a human would, learned from screen recordings. Zalos automates repetitive, multi-step finance workflows including reconciliation, transaction categorization, billing, form filling, month-end close and cross-system KPI reporting, while building a living process graph of an organization's finance operations for documentation and compliance. Founded in 2025 by William Fairbairn (CEO) and Hung Hoang (CTO, previously Apple Pay), the company is based in London and San Francisco and raised a $3.6M seed round led by 14 Peaks. Because Zalos operates entirely through computer-use automation of third-party interfaces, it does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs or developer portal.

providers.name: Zauber
providers.description: Zauber is an AI agent platform purpose-built for sea and air freight forwarding operations. Freight forwarders describe their processes in plain language and Zauber's AI agents execute them consistently across global operations, automating rate and booking workflows with exception handling, deploying global workflows with local execution, and giving operators real-time operational visibility into conversion rates, response times, and exception patterns. The platform integrates with existing systems including Office 365, CargoWise One, carrier portals, and proprietary tooling. Zauber is a portfolio company of Point Nine. No public API, developer portal, or developer documentation is currently published; this profile captures the company's identity and security posture.

providers.name: 99Bill
providers.description: 99Bill Corporation (快钱, Kuaiqian) is one of China's leading independent third-party electronic payment service providers, offering a comprehensive suite of online payment, mobile payment, and settlement solutions for merchants and enterprises. Its Kuaiqian Merchant Open Platform (open.99bill.com) exposes standardized payment interfaces over common internet protocols, covering protocol/agreement (card-free) payments, online banking (B2C and B2B) payments, and WeChat Official Account and Mini-Program payments, with SDKs and demo code published for Java, PHP, and .NET. Developers select a product in the Product Center, build against a sandbox using provided demos, then contact 99Bill business staff to activate a production merchant account (issued MerchantAcctID and product keys) before going live. 99Bill was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCM Ventures and is profiled here in the API Evangelist network. No public OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, or package-registry SDK was found during enrichment; developer resources are distributed through the authenticated open platform and help center.

providers.name: Agryco
providers.description: Agryco — trading as Agriconomie until its September 2024 rebrand — is a French online marketplace and e-commerce platform that sells agricultural supplies direct to farmers: mineral, organic and foliar fertilizers, conventional and organic seeds, phytosanitary products, animal nutrition and livestock equipment, plus tractor, spraying, harvesting and soil-working spare parts. Founded in 2014 by Clement Le Fournis, Dinh Nguyen and Paolin Pascot, the company operates a one-stop procurement site for professional farmers across France, Belgium, Germany, Spain and Italy, wrapping the catalog in advisory services (agronomy experts on the phone six days a week), fertilizer blending, equipment valuation and 60-day payment terms. It raised a EUR 60 million Series B in 2022 co-led by Treis Group, Temasek and Aliment Capital with Eurazeo participating, and publishes the Agrycomag technical magazine at agryco.com/blog. Agryco is an end-user commerce product: as of this profile it publishes no public developer program, API reference, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Aigen
providers.description: Aigen ("AI Generated Agriculture") is a Kirkland, Washington robotics company founded in 2020 that builds fully autonomous, solar-powered farm robots for daily, chemical-free weed control. Its flagship product, the Element, uses AI vision to identify and mechanically strike weeds — including herbicide-resistant weeds — with no herbicides, running on solar power with onboard battery storage and coordinating as a crew over a mesh network. In 2026 Aigen introduced Alchemy, a generative world model for outdoor physical AI that produces self-labeling synthetic training data. Aigen sells a managed robotics-as-a-service engagement rather than a self-serve developer product: growers are onboarded through a local Aigen agent and an intake form, and Aigen operates and maintains the fleet through the growing season. As of this profile Aigen publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: American Battle Monuments Commission
providers.description: The American Battle Monuments Commission (ABMC), established by Congress in 1923, commemorates the service, achievements, and sacrifice of U.S. Armed Forces. ABMC administers and maintains 26 American military cemeteries and 31 memorials, monuments, and markers on foreign soil. The commission maintains a searchable database of more than 200,000 fallen service members buried or commemorated abroad, accessible via the We Remember burial search portal. ABMC is working on a data roadmap to provide open datasets on data.gov per the Foundations for Evidence-based Policymaking Act (2019).

providers.name: AppFolio
providers.description: AppFolio is a Santa Barbara, California cloud-based real estate technology company providing property management software to residential, commercial, community association (HOA), student housing, single-family, and affordable housing operators, plus investment management tooling for sponsors and funds. Its flagship AppFolio Performance Platform unifies workflow automation, accounting and reporting, marketing and leasing, maintenance, resident communication, and resident services on a single multi-tenant SaaS. AppFolio embeds Realm-X, an in-house agentic AI layer (Realm-X Assistant, Performers, Flows) directly into the platform rather than as an add-on. Integrations are delivered through the AppFolio Stack marketplace, where certified partners (ButterflyMX, Conservice, HappyCo, Knock, Lowe's, Property Meld, and many more) connect via the AppFolio Stack API. The Stack API is gated behind a partner application, security-compliance questionnaire, and terms-of-service signing; OAuth 2.0, a sandbox environment, webhooks, and an OpenAPI/Swagger reference are made available only to approved partners through the developer.appfolio.com portal, so no public specification is reachable for catalog inclusion. AppFolio's revenue model is per-unit SaaS subscription plus value-added services (payments, screening, insurance, marketing). The AppFolio GitHub organization publishes internal Ruby on Rails, React, and tooling libraries (react-gears, ae_page_objects, store_base_sti_class) but no public API SDK, CLI, or OpenAPI artifact.

providers.name: Argus Software
providers.description: Argus Software (ARGUS) is a commercial real estate software provider whose products are the industry standard for cash-flow modeling, valuation, asset and investment management, and development-project appraisal for owners, investors, lenders, and advisors. Founded in Houston, Texas and acquired by Altus Group in 2011, the ARGUS product line is now delivered through Altus Group as the ARGUS Intelligence platform and includes ARGUS Enterprise, ARGUS EstateMaster, ARGUS Developer, ARGUS Taliance, ARGUS ValueInsight, ARGUS Voyanta, and Forbury. ARGUS software is used across the global commercial real estate industry to underwrite acquisitions, perform discounted cash-flow analysis, run portfolio and fund analytics, and standardize valuations. As of this enrichment pass ARGUS exposes no public developer portal, OpenAPI description, or self-service API program; its cloud platform is accessed through the Altus Platform / ARGUS Cloud portal.

providers.name: Arthexbiotech
providers.description: Arthex Biotech is a biotechnology company focused on developing antisense RNA therapeutics for unmet medical needs, notably an anti‑miR program targeting Myotonic Dystrophy. The company emphasizes innovative RNA medicine delivery, with a pipeline of microRNA‑based treatments and a commitment to advancing clinical trials and patient support. Based in Valencia, Spain, Arthex Biotech engages with partners and investors to bring next‑generation RNA therapies to market.

providers.name: Assembly OSM
providers.description: Assembly OSM is a New York City off-site manufacturing company founded in 2019 by SHoP Architects co-founders Bill and Chris Sharples to industrialise the construction of high-rise urban housing. The company calls its method "post-modular": rather than trucking finished volumetric boxes from a single factory, Assembly designs a kit-of-parts chassis and distributes fabrication across a network of specialist suppliers — an aerospace and automotive supply-chain model applied to buildings — then stacks the resulting units on site, claiming delivery of market-competitive high-rise residential architecture in roughly 60% of conventional schedule. Its buildings are all-electric and passive-design led, targeting 55-70% energy-efficiency improvement and 35% less embodied carbon today, net-zero operational carbon by 2027 and climate-positive buildings by 2040. Completed and in-progress work includes Prototype Alpha, 147 St. Felix Street and 247 East 117th Street in New York, plus an AOSM Canada operation. The company has raised more than $60 million, including a $38 million Series A in 2022, and draws engineering staff from SpaceX, Tesla and Boeing. Assembly runs a digital-twin engineering platform — a heavily scripted CATIA environment carrying each module from design through fabrication to installation — but that platform is an internal manufacturing tool, not a product: Assembly OSM sells buildings, and publishes no developer program, no public API, no SDK and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Autosled
providers.description: Autosled is a marketplace for vehicle shippers and transporters, providing a modern digital platform to manage shipments, payments, and logistics. It connects carriers with customers, offering tools for tracking, quoting, and optimizing transport processes across the United States.

providers.name: Baozhunniu
providers.description: Baozhunniu (保准牛) is a Chinese insurance technology platform offering customized insurance solutions for enterprises and individuals. It provides a range of products such as group insurance, study abroad insurance, sports event coverage, and corporate risk management services. The platform integrates with major insurers, offers digital enrollment, claims assistance, and a user‑friendly portal for policy management, aiming to simplify insurance procurement and improve risk mitigation for businesses across various sectors.

providers.name: Boardable
providers.description: Boardable is board management software for nonprofits, associations, foundations, and other mission-driven organizations, covering meeting scheduling, agenda building, a document center, minutes and AI-generated meeting summaries, e-voting, task assignments, groups/committees, member directories, and built-in video conferencing. As of this review Boardable does NOT publish a documented public developer API: there is no developer portal, no published API reference, no OpenAPI, no self-serve API keys, and no documented webhooks. A private, authentication-gated backend API exists at https://api.boardable.com (for example, GET https://api.boardable.com/accounts returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized) that powers the Boardable web and mobile apps, but it is undocumented and not offered as a public/partner integration surface. Third-party listings occasionally describe Boardable as having an "open API," but Boardable provides no public developer documentation to substantiate that. Integrations are delivered through pre-built connectors (Salesforce, Microsoft 365 / Teams / Outlook / SharePoint / OneDrive, Google Drive & Calendar, Zoom, Dropbox, LinkedIn) rather than a documented API. This entry is therefore an honest stub: no APIs are listed because none are publicly documented.

providers.name: Bravehaeart Bio
providers.description: Braveheart Bio is a biotechnology company focused on transforming the standard of care for hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) and related cardiac conditions. The company develops novel therapeutics, including gene‑editing and small‑molecule approaches, aiming to improve patient outcomes and quality of life. Their platform integrates scientific research, clinical development, and patient advocacy to accelerate innovative treatments for rare heart diseases.

providers.name: Classif.io
providers.description: Classif.io was a machine-learning classification service that offered to build a custom classification model from a written description of the customer's task, publish it as a REST API, and let prospects try an interactive demo before buying. Its site listed sixteen such demo APIs — Fashion Style Classification, Custom Car Part Identification, Surgical Instrument Classification, Retail Planogram Compliance and others — each on its own landing page, alongside a "describe your use case" intake form. The homepage credited Kindwise, the team behind Plant.id, Insect.id, Mushroom ID and crop.health, as the maker. The service is retired: the classif.io domain is no longer registered, the last live capture of the site is 2025-03-21, and no developer documentation, OpenAPI definition or other machine-readable contract survives in any public archive. See lifecycle/classif-io-lifecycle.yml for the retirement evidence.

providers.name: Codec
providers.description: Codec (CODEC AI) is an AI-powered audience-intelligence consultancy that helps ambitious global brands identify, understand, and activate high-value cultural communities to accelerate growth. Its work spans marketing strategy, brand and creative, and activation and measurement, powered by an award-winning proprietary AI platform, with case studies for enterprise brands such as Stella Artois, Frank's RedHot, and Moncler. Codec is a B2B consultancy rather than a developer-facing API provider — it publishes no public API, SDKs, or developer documentation. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Comau
providers.description: Comau is a global leader in industrial automation and advanced robotics, providing innovative solutions for automotive, aerospace, logistics, and manufacturing sectors. The company designs and integrates robotic systems, digital twins, and IoT platforms to enhance productivity and sustainability. With a presence in over 30 countries, Comau delivers engineering expertise, turnkey automation cells, and collaborative robots to help customers accelerate Industry 4.0 transformations.

providers.name: Defer
providers.description: Defer was a TypeScript-first background job and workflow automation platform for Node.js applications that let developers schedule, queue, and orchestrate serverless functions with built-in retries, throttling, concurrency controls, and scheduled (CRON) execution. Defer integrated with frameworks such as Next.js, Remix, and SvelteKit through an SDK and a managed control plane.
