The runtime behind them, the Gateway Vendor Management Suite, is invite-only.

providers.name: Cardinal
providers.description: Cardinal is an AI platform for precision outbound sales — it markets itself as "revenue agents for high-growth companies" — built for go-to-market teams that want outbound to run as one engine instead of a stack of disconnected tools. Its agents build and refresh account lists from signals, monitor what prospects post and engage with, generate personalized snippets, and orchestrate end-to-end email and LinkedIn plays, while capturing inbound from website visitors, product signups and ad impressions. The company is a Y Combinator Winter 2026 company founded by Devishi Jha and Jianna Liu, based in San Francisco, and names Mintlify, Deepgram, Greptile, Giga and Luminai among its customers. Cardinal moved its primary web presence from trycardinal.ai to trycardinal.com during 2026: https://trycardinal.ai/ now HTTP 301s to https://www.trycardinal.com/ and the former deep pages on the .ai domain (/company, /product) return 404, though the company still runs its customer application, its email and its analytics identity on trycardinal.ai. The product is sold as half-software and half-service ("we wire into your existing stack and build agents around plays that already work for you"), delivered through a customer app at app.trycardinal.ai behind a Stytch login, with a Calendly GTM chat as the only publicly reachable entry point. It reads from and writes back to customer CRMs and says it adds a new integration every two weeks, but names none of them publicly and publishes no outbound API of its own: across four hosts on two domains this pass found no OpenAPI, GraphQL SDL, AsyncAPI, MCP server, agent card, webhook catalog, SDK, CLI, developer portal or documentation site. docs.trycardinal.ai does not resolve in DNS, api.trycardinal.ai is a dangling custom domain whose Render origin answers x-render-routing: no-server, and every /api/* path on the customer app returns HTTP 401 {"error":"Unauthorized"}.

providers.name: Celaidtherapeutics
providers.description: Celaidtherapeutics is a Japan‑based biotechnology company developing cell therapy products using cord‑blood‑derived hematopoietic stem cells. The firm aims to provide alternative treatments to bone‑marrow transplantation, focusing on leukemia, other blood cancers, and genetic disorders. It operates from Tokyo and collaborates with academic institutions and pharmaceutical partners.

providers.name: Center
providers.description: Center is a personal assistant platform that operates via SMS and messaging. Users can text Center to ask questions, make bookings, manage errands, and access integrated services like Gmail, Google Calendar, Drive, and Contacts. The service emphasizes privacy, offering opt‑out options and clear terms. It targets consumers seeking convenient, text‑based interactions for daily tasks and information retrieval.

providers.name: Clearbit Logo
providers.description: Search for company logos and embed them in your projects

providers.name: Closure
providers.description: Closure (Closure Intelligence, Inc.) builds an AI-powered digital analyst platform for law enforcement agencies that securely transcribes, translates, searches, organizes, and analyzes case evidence — jail communications, warrant returns, and large multi-lingual case files — to help investigators overcome evidence overload and resolve homicides and cold cases. The platform runs under a zero-access security model with SOC 2 Type II, CJIS, and HIPAA compliance. Backed by CRV. No public API or developer program is currently published.

providers.name: ColorChip
providers.description: ColorChip accelerates mega‑datacenter performance, minimizing $/Gbps rates and maximizing power efficiency. It offers hyperscalable optical engines and SystemOnGlass™ technology to meet massive data flow challenges worldwide. The company provides products and solutions for large‑scale data centers, focusing on power efficiency, high bandwidth, and innovative optical networking.

providers.name: Diligen
providers.description: Diligen provides machine‑learning powered contract analysis software that helps law firms, legal service providers, and corporations streamline review, extract key provisions, generate summaries, and manage projects at scale. Its AI‑driven platform automates insight extraction, improves review efficiency, and supports regulatory change response, delivering faster, higher‑quality outcomes for legal teams.

providers.name: Donnelley Financial Solutions
providers.description: Donnelley Financial Solutions is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Donnelley Financial Solutions API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: EcoPlant
providers.description: EcoPlant provides an intelligent air compressor control and monitoring platform for industrial facilities. The Ecoplant 360 solution uses IoT sensors, AI-powered dynamic controls, and predictive analytics to optimize compressed-air systems in real time, preventing downtime, improving reliability, and reducing compressed-air energy costs by up to 50 percent. It installs in under a week with no installation fees and is compatible with most compressor brands and existing plant technology.

providers.name: Elligo Health Research
providers.description: Elligo Health Research is a healthcare-enabling clinical research organization (CRO) that embeds clinical trials directly into real-world healthcare settings. Through its proprietary IntElligo Research Stack and System of Accelerated Research (SOAR) model, Elligo connects sponsors and CROs to known, diverse patient populations across 115+ hospitals and health systems, 200+ healthcare-based sites, and 100+ research-based sites. Services span site networks, patient access and recruitment, decentralized and hybrid trial solutions, site support and staffing, and concierge patient retention and travel logistics. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners, Elligo is tracked as a portfolio-lead in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Energizer Holdings
providers.description: Energizer Holdings is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Energizer Holdings API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: EnPro Industries
providers.description: EnPro Industries is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The EnPro Industries API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Ethan Allen Interiors
providers.description: Ethan Allen Interiors is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Ethan Allen Interiors API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: ExlService Holdings
providers.description: ExlService Holdings is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The ExlService Holdings API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Gabit
providers.description: Gabit is a one-stop health and wellness platform on a mission to add more healthy years to people's lives. Headquartered in Gurugram, India and founded in 2022 by Gaurav Gupta (ex-Zomato cofounder) and Arpana Shahi, Gabit treats health as an interconnected system across four pillars — fitness, nutrition, sleep, and mindfulness. Its consumer ecosystem spans the titanium Gabit Smart Ring, a smart body-composition scale, at-home Blood Work diagnostics, a continuous glucose monitor (CGM), the Sweden-born Näck nutrition supplement line, all-good-no-harm skincare, and coached Fitness & Nutrition Plans — all unified in the Gabit app, which tracks 150+ biomarkers and includes the free PEP AI health coach. India is the primary market, with Ring-only storefronts in the UAE and UK and an informational US/global page.

providers.name: Geopipe
providers.description: Geopipe uses AI and machine learning to build game-ready digital twins of real-world cities and environments. It ingests raw sensor data (imagery and laser scans) and reconstructs regions as semantically-modeled, multi-level-of- detail 3D models that developers stream or download into games, simulations, training, architecture, and metaverse applications without any manual 3D modeling. Delivery is through Cesium 3D Tiles streaming for Unity and Unreal Engine, downloadable 3D meshes in common file formats, ready-to-use Unity Asset Store packs, and a first-party Unity SDK, backed by an open-source geospatial and 3D-tiles toolchain on GitHub. Founded in New York City by Christopher Mitchell and Thomas Dickerson and backed by Techstars.

providers.name: Healx
providers.description: Healx is a Cambridge, UK clinical-stage biotechnology company that uses artificial intelligence to discover and develop new treatments for rare diseases. Its Healnet platform pairs generative AI with drug-discovery and rare-disease expertise to build a biomedical knowledge graph from public and proprietary sources - biomedical literature, disease and biochemical datasets, clinical trials and patents - and to identify novel uses for known compounds. Founded by David Brown and Tim Guilliams, Healx advances its own therapeutic pipeline (including its NF1 lead candidate HLX-1502) and partners with pharma companies such as Sanofi. Healx does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile tracks its identity and public web surface in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: HEICO
providers.description: HEICO Corporation is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The HEICO Corporation API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Immunai
providers.description: Immunai is a New York-headquartered biotechnology company, founded in December 2018, that maps the human immune system at single-cell resolution and applies machine learning to drug discovery and development. Its central asset is AMICA (Annotated Multiomic Immune Cell Atlas), a cell-level immune knowledge base built from single-cell multiomics — RNA transcriptome, surface proteome, TCR/BCR repertoire and spatial transcriptomics — harmonized across thousands of public and proprietary studies covering hundreds of diseases and immune cell types, paired with an ImmunoDynamics Engine used for target discovery, preclinical evaluation and clinical trial optimization. Immunai works through partnerships with biopharmaceutical companies and research institutions rather than a self-serve product, and as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable specification or SDKs. Offices are in New York, Tel Aviv, Prague and Zurich; the company acquired Dropprint Genomics (2021) and Nebion (2021).

providers.name: Interface Inc
providers.description: Interface Inc is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Interface Inc API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: INZMO
providers.description: INZMO is a European insurtech, founded in 2017, delivering 100% digital, embedded insurance for consumer goods and rental deposits. Its products cover mobile phones, laptops and tablets, bicycles, e-scooters, and rental deposit warranties, sold direct-to-consumer and embedded into partner checkout flows. INZMO offers partners an embedded-insurance API that adds insurance to the customer journey with real-time policy issuance, payment, and delivery of policy documents, and applies AI and large language models to streamline fraud prevention and claims handling. INZMO is a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: Jazz Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Jazz Pharmaceuticals is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Jazz Pharmaceuticals API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Knight-Swift Transportation
providers.description: Knight-Swift Transportation is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Knight-Swift Transportation API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: KromaTiD
providers.description: KromaTiD (KROMASURE) is a Boulder, Colorado single-cell analysis life-science tools and services company founded in 2016, built around its proprietary directional Genomic Hybridization (dGH) platform. dGH probes only the parental strand of DNA, which lets it resolve orientation-specific structural variation — inversions, translocations, insertions and other complex rearrangements — cell by cell, at resolutions that next-generation sequencing and conventional FISH cannot reach. The company sells the KROMASURE platform and the dGH in-Site, dGH SCREEN, kBand and PinPoint product lines as kits and as lab services, aimed at cell and gene therapy developers who need insertional-mutagenesis risk assessment, genotoxicity profiling, edit optimization, starting-material and donor qualification, cell-line characterization and batch-release testing for CMC and FDA IND submissions. Its work has also been used by NASA for spaceflight radiation research. KromaTiD publishes no developer program, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract; its only authenticated surface is a Cognidox-backed customer document portal at my.kromatid.com.

providers.name: LoginRadius
providers.description: Managed User Authentication Service

providers.name: MDClone
providers.description: MDClone is a healthcare data company whose ADAMS platform gives health systems, life-sciences organizations, and researchers self-service access to explore, analyze, and share clinical data. Its signature capability is a synthetic-data engine that generates non-reversible, artificially created datasets which preserve the statistical characteristics and correlations of real patient data without carrying any protected health information (PHI), removing re-identification risk. The platform lets users organize source data, generate synthetic versions on demand, run analytics, and apply generative AI to accelerate research and improve patient outcomes. MDClone is enterprise/customer-gated: access, support, and any programmatic data-export API are provisioned to licensed customers rather than published as a public developer program.

providers.name: Nordson
providers.description: Nordson Corporation is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Nordson Corporation API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Odessa Technologies
providers.description: Odessa is a Philadelphia-headquartered lease and loan management software company founded in 1998 that powers asset finance for banks, captive finance companies, and independent lenders. The Odessa Platform manages roughly $200B in assets across equipment finance and auto finance, covering the full asset lifecycle from origination through servicing and remarketing on a modern, API-first, Microsoft Azure-hosted SaaS stack with low-code developer tools, packaged integrations, and an Odessa AI layer for agentic asset-finance workflows. The platform's APIs and developer tooling are delivered to licensed customers (no public developer portal, no OpenAPI, no public SDK or GitHub org); profiling here captures the surface visible from the marketing site, integrations catalog, and engineering blog.

providers.name: OpenEI
providers.description: OpenEI (Open Energy Information) is a collaborative platform that provides free, open access to energy data, models, and analysis tools. It aims to accelerate the transition to sustainable energy by sharing information, fostering community contributions, and supporting research and policy development. The site hosts a wiki, datasets, and APIs for developers to retrieve energy-related information.

providers.name: Opsani
providers.description: Opsani was an enterprise software company based in Redwood City, California that delivered an ML-driven cloud platform for Continuous Optimization as a Service (COaaS), automatically and continuously tuning cloud-native (Kubernetes) application configurations for the best balance of performance, availability, and cost. Opsani was acquired by Cisco in January 2022 and folded into the Cisco AppDynamics full-stack observability portfolio (subsequently part of Splunk). The company no longer operates an independent API surface — opsani.com now redirects to Splunk and docs.opsani.com no longer resolves. The one surviving public first-party artifact is the open-source Servo (servox) optimization agent, still published on PyPI and hosted at github.com/opsani.

providers.name: OWLR
providers.description: OWLR (OWLR Technologies) is a London- and Fort Lauderdale-based consumer IoT company that builds universal remote-monitoring apps for home IP cameras, letting users view and manage cameras from many brands through a single mobile application. Its products include the OWLR Multi-Brand Viewer and brand-specific viewers for Foscam and D-Link, plus motion-alert notifications. OWLR emphasizes a privacy-first design in which camera credentials stay on the user's phone and nothing is stored on OWLR's servers. The company reports over two million users and was backed by 500 Global. OWLR is a consumer mobile product and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Pakistan Open Data
providers.description: Pakistan Open Data is a national government open-data portal for Pakistan running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 1,471 datasets.

providers.name: Path
providers.description: Path Crypto is an SEC‑registered financial advisory firm offering crypto investing and portfolio management services. It provides managed crypto portfolios, a self‑directed wallet, and institutional solutions, guiding clients through regulated cryptocurrency investment strategies.

providers.name: Patrick Industries
providers.description: Patrick Industries is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Patrick Industries API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Paynas
providers.description: Paynas is an Egyptian HR, payroll, and employee-benefits platform offering hassle-free, digitized human-resources management for businesses. Through a single web and mobile interface, Paynas handles attendance tracking, vacation and leave management, payroll processing, and reporting analytics, while extending financial services to employees through the Paynas Card — a Visa-powered payroll card issued in partnership with Banque Misr — and affordable medical-insurance packages provided in partnership with Libano-Suisse. Backed by 500 Global, the company serves employers across Egypt. Paynas publishes no public developer or API surface; this profile is a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Petco Animal Supplies
providers.description: Petco Animal Supplies is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Petco Animal Supplies API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Pollinate
providers.description: Pollinate is a London-headquartered financial technology company that builds a cloud-based, bank-grade digital experience platform helping banks and payment processors reinvent merchant acquiring and value-added services for their small and medium business (SMB) customers. The platform wraps around a bank's legacy payment systems to deliver dynamic merchant onboarding, a bank-branded Merchant Command Center dashboard (transaction reconciliation, dispute management, statements, service discovery), integrated merchant services inside online banking, and ISV enablement. Built on Microsoft Azure and open-banking ready, it powers live bank deployments including Tyl by NatWest (UK), NAB Hive (Australia), and Tyl by CIBC (Canada), with clients including Truist and partners including Fiserv, Endava, and Dun & Bradstreet. Pollinate's APIs are private and partner-facing; it does not publish a public developer portal or OpenAPI.

providers.name: PrognomiQ
providers.description: PrognomiQ Inc. is a Redwood City, California multi-omics diagnostics company, spun out of Seer (NASDAQ: SEER) in 2020, that combines proteomic, genomic, transcriptomic and metabolomic measurement with machine learning to detect cancer and other complex diseases earlier from a blood draw. Its first commercial product, ProVue Lung, is a proteomics-based laboratory developed test (LDT) intended to aid early detection of lung cancer. PrognomiQ is a clinical laboratory and life sciences business rather than a software vendor: as of this profile it publishes a six-page corporate marketing site, a public GitHub organization holding forks of open-source data-engineering tooling, and no public developer portal, API documentation or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: re3data
providers.description: re3data.org is a global registry of research data repositories, providing structured metadata and a searchable catalog of repositories across disciplines. It offers an API for programmatic access to repository records, supporting open science and data discovery. The platform also supplies documentation, schemas, and analytics to help researchers locate and reuse data assets worldwide.

providers.name: Regency Energy Partners
providers.description: Regency Energy Partners LP (NYSE: RGP) was a publicly traded master limited partnership focused on midstream natural gas services including gathering, processing, contract compression, treating, and transportation of natural gas, crude oil, and natural gas liquids. Regency operated in North Louisiana, West Texas, and the Mid-Continent region before being acquired by Energy Transfer Partners in a $11 billion transaction in 2015 and merged into Energy Transfer's broader midstream operations.

providers.name: Reshop
providers.description: Reshop (Reshop US, Inc.) is a fintech company that provides instant refunds for e-commerce returns. When a shopper initiates a return at a partner retailer, Reshop pays out the refund immediately rather than making the customer wait for the item to ship back and be processed, delivering funds to the original payment method, a debit card, or a bank account. Reshop partners with clothing and lifestyle brands such as Volcom, RVCA, Vince Camuto, and Roxy, operates in the United States, and offers iOS and Android mobile apps. The company is backed by Matrix Partners. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; Reshop publishes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Rexnord
providers.description: Rexnord was a global industrial company headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, with two strategic platforms — Process and Motion Control (bearings, couplings, gear drives, industrial chain, and conveyor systems) and Water Management (plumbing components for commercial, industrial, municipal, and institutional settings). In 2021, Rexnord's Process and Motion Control segment merged with Regal Beloit to form Regal Rexnord Corporation, while the water management business was acquired by Zurn Elkay. Rexnord does not offer a public developer API or data services.

providers.name: Skyline Champion
providers.description: Skyline Champion is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Skyline Champion API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Spring Labs
providers.description: Spring Labs is an AI-native compliance and customer-experience platform for financial institutions, deploying autonomous AI agents that complete operational work rather than only surfacing insights. Its agents score customer-service calls, run 100% QA/QC review coverage, identify and file complaints, and (soon) automate the dispute lifecycle, alongside SummerGRC, an AI-driven governance, risk, and compliance product. Spring Labs targets sponsor banks, fintech lenders, enterprise banks, BaaS platforms, and debt-collection (ARM) organizations. Originally a blockchain-based data and identity company backed by Multicoin Capital, the firm has repositioned around applied AI for regulated financial operations. This profile was surfaced from a VC portfolio and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the company publishes a marketing/product site but no public API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Stepan Company
providers.description: Stepan Company is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Stepan Company API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Stere
providers.description: Stere is a New York-based insurance infrastructure company (founded 2021) that lets insurers, MGAs, and distribution partners build and launch digital insurance products - rating, quoting, binding, policy issuance, claims, and premium payments - in weeks rather than years. Its core offering is a "Stere API-as-a-Service" underwriting API (insurers can bring their own API or have Stere build one) plus a separate Stere Unified API and Stere Distribution layer that let brokers, wholesalers, fintechs, and embedded partners reach multiple carriers/products through a single connection (API, SDK, and webhooks). Stere Claims handles FNOL and claims workflow (portions of claims assessment and resolution are marketed as in-development/coming soon), and Stere Pay / Stere Pay Later provides a buy-now-pay-later gateway for insurance premiums. There is no self-serve public developer portal, published API reference, OpenAPI/Swagger document, or sandbox signup on stere.io; the marketing site references a "Stere Docs," "API Changelog," and "API Status" area under /developer/, but those paths return 404 publicly and integration is provisioned per customer after a sales-led partner/insurer onboarding engagement. The APIs below are honestly modeled from Stere's own product marketing pages, not from a published API reference.

providers.name: Tienda Pago
providers.description: Tienda Pago is a fintech lender providing working capital and short-term inventory financing to small retailers - bodegas, convenience stores, bars and restaurants - across Mexico and Peru. Operating as a non-regulated financial entity (SOFOM E.N.R.), it offers three core products: LanaYa instant cash deposits, buy-now-pay-later 7-day terms for buying inventory from distributors, and no-upfront-cash mobile phone top-up (recargas). The platform reports serving over 80,000 businesses and more than 18 million families through mobile apps and a web onboarding portal. It is backed by QED Investors. No public API, developer portal, or SDK surface has been identified.

providers.name: Tilt
providers.description: Tilt is a consumer fintech mobile app for building and rebuilding credit. It offers cash advances of up to $400, a line of credit with potential limit increases, and three credit cards (Essentials, Motion, and Engage), evaluating applicants from real-time bank-linked financial data rather than credit history alone. The app adds credit-score monitoring with personalized tips, customizable budgeting and spend tracking, AI-assisted automatic savings, and on-time-payment rewards, for an $8/month subscription after a 14-day trial. Tilt is a consumer application with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: TransFS
providers.description: TransFS (Transparent Financial Services, LLC) is the Chicago fintech that operated FeeFighters, a marketplace helping small and medium-sized businesses compare credit-card processors and reduce merchant-account fees. It also built the Samurai payment gateway, a developer-facing API for tokenizing cards and processing payments. FeeFighters was acquired by Groupon in March 2012 and folded into Groupon Payments / the Merchant Operating System, after which the Samurai gateway API was retired. The feefighters.com domain today operates as a credit-card fee-negotiation and chargeback-management consultancy under the FeeFighters name, promising fee reductions without switching processors; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API definition.

providers.name: Udemy(instructor)
providers.description: API for instructors on Udemy

providers.name: United States Botanic Garden
providers.description: The United States Botanic Garden (USBG) is a living museum in Washington, D.C. that showcases a diverse collection of plants from around the world. Established by the U.S. Congress in 1820, the Botanic Garden serves as a resource for education and inspiration, promoting an understanding and appreciation of plants and their importance to the environment and human well-being. The Garden maintains more than 9,500 accessions representing approximately 44,000 plants, managed through its Living Collections database (BG-BASE). The USBG is administered by the Architect of the Capitol and is located adjacent to the U.S. Capitol on the National Mall.

providers.name: Upswing
providers.description: Upswing Financial Technologies is an Indian open finance-as-a-service platform headquartered in Bengaluru and Mumbai. Its full-stack API platform lets consumer companies embed financial products such as deposits and lending from regulated partner banks (AU Small Finance Bank, DCB Bank, Utkarsh, Shivalik, Unity, South Indian Bank, Suryoday), while Upswing manages the bank integrations and compliance. Backed by QED Investors and Quona Capital. Upswing publishes no public developer portal or API documentation; its APIs are offered to partners under commercial agreements.

providers.name: VeriSIM Life
providers.description: VeriSIM Life is an AI-driven drug discovery and development company that applies mechanistic artificial intelligence and quantitative simulation to reduce the cost, time, and failure rate of translating drug candidates into clinical trials. Its BIOiSIM platform is a biosimulation decision engine that can screen large libraries of drug-like compounds and run simulation scenarios across species and dosing regimens, while AtlasGEN designs novel molecules and evaluates them for safety and efficacy. The company operates PulmoSIM Therapeutics as a subsidiary. VeriSIM Life exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; the platform is accessed through partnerships and demos. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for discovery and monitoring.

providers.name: Via Global Health
providers.description: Via Global Health (VIA Global Health) is a medical equipment and pharmaceutical supplier serving distributors, healthcare providers, and NGOs across Africa, Asia, and Latin America. The company sources quality diagnostic equipment, surgical instruments, maternal and reproductive health devices, infection control and sterilization equipment, cold chain and laboratory supplies, and pharmaceutical-grade consumables from vetted manufacturers, and handles logistics, compliance, and last-mile delivery for low-resource health settings. Buyers request USD-priced quotes on any product page and receive a response within 24 hours, guided by an AI assistant named Amara. It is a quote-and-fulfillment marketplace with no publicly documented developer API surface; a private, robots-disallowed /api/* backs the storefront only. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Warrior Met Coal
providers.description: Warrior Met Coal is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Warrior Met Coal API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Waters
providers.description: Waters Corporation is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Waters Corporation API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Watts Water Technologies
providers.description: Watts Water Technologies is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Watts Water Technologies API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Whole Foods Market
providers.description: Whole Foods Market is an American multinational supermarket chain owned by Amazon, exclusively selling products free from hydrogenated fats and artificial colors, flavors, and preservatives. Acquired by Amazon in 2017, Whole Foods integrates with Amazon Prime for delivery, pickup, and member discounts. Supplier integrations are handled through EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) and the Whole Foods Supplier Portal.

providers.name: Wunder
providers.description: Wunder (formerly Wunder Capital, wewunder.com, now wunderpower.com) is a commercial clean-energy company that deploys solar, battery storage, and EV charging infrastructure across real estate portfolios with no-CapEx energy solutions, managing projects from design through operations in 40+ US states. Backed by Techstars and a $650M partnership with Blackstone, Wunder runs its project development on Astra, a proprietary internal platform for energy data analysis, forecasting, and automation. Wunder publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: Acacus Group
providers.description: Acacus Group (Acacus Technologies) is a Dubai-headquartered mobility technology company founded in 2013 that builds artificial-intelligence and machine-learning software for the transportation and airline industries. Its Lynx product family — Lynx, Lynx Pro and Lynx Vision — provides intelligent fleet management, optimized dispatch built on mathematical combinatorics, disruption management, telematics and vehicle diagnostics, and deep-learning video analytics from in-vehicle cameras covering driver fatigue, lane departure, tailgating and passenger counting. Acacus also develops autonomous vehicle technology and Peregrine, an optimization solution for airline crew and airport operations. It won Best Global Startup at GITEX 2016 in Dubai and signed an MOU with Dubai Police for driverless patrol vehicles. Lynx sells as an enterprise SaaS subscription through a demo request; Acacus publishes no public developer program or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Afterpay
providers.description: Afterpay (acquired by Block / Square) is a buy-now-pay-later platform offering Pay-in-4 installments at thousands of merchants. APIs for merchants to integrate via Square or direct.

providers.name: Agomab Therapeutics
providers.description: Agomab Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company (Nasdaq: AGMB) developing novel disease-modifying therapies for fibro-inflammatory diseases, with an initial focus on chronic fibrotic indications of high unmet medical need such as Crohn's disease and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. Building on deep expertise in growth factor biology, Agomab advances a pipeline of small-molecule and antibody candidates targeting the pathways that drive tissue fibrosis and inflammation. Headquartered in Belgium with operations across Europe and the United States, the company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a biopharmaceutical company it publishes a corporate and investor-relations web presence rather than a public developer API surface; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the network catalog.

providers.name: Airforestry
providers.description: AirForestry is a Swedish climate-technology company developing autonomous electric drones that perform forest thinning from the air. Its system pairs AI and computer vision for tree identification and selection with a lightweight aerial harvesting tool, letting a fleet of drones fell and extract trees without ground machinery. The result is forestry with zero soil compaction, no root damage and no machine tracks, higher operational efficiency, and lower emissions than conventional harvesters, while increasing forest growth and carbon sequestration. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Northzone and added to the API Evangelist network. It currently publishes a marketing and news presence but no public developer, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Akagera Medicines
providers.description: Akagera Medicines is a Rwandan biotech company focused on developing liposomal nanotherapeutics for tuberculosis and other infectious diseases. It aims to improve vaccine delivery and drug efficacy through innovative lipid-based platforms, partnering with global health organizations and investors to advance its pipeline.

providers.name: AlmostApps
providers.description: AlmostApps is a Sacramento, California sports-gaming studio founded in 2022 that builds free-to-play mobile entertainment experiences for sports fans, blending casual gameplay with real-life sports scores and stats. Its flagship product, Tailgate, is a free-to-play mobile sports entertainment app designed to enhance the game-day experience for casual sports enthusiasts. The company is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Parade Ventures. AlmostApps is a consumer application company and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or API documentation; only a marketing site with Terms of Service and Privacy Policy is publicly available. This profile was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a company lead.

providers.name: Andustry
providers.description: Andustry is an AI-native industrial equipment broker that streamlines sourcing and procurement for manufacturers. The platform combines AI-powered supplier discovery with manual qualification and commercial negotiation to source industrial machines (CNC mills, lathes, press brakes, laser cutters, robotic cells), machined/forged/cast parts, and robotics and electronics across Europe, China, India, and the United States. Clients hand off a sourcing need and Andustry returns a verified supplier shortlist within 24-48 hours, delivering an average of roughly 30% cost savings and 2x faster sourcing timelines on a commission-only basis with no subscription. Founded in 2026 (Y Combinator Spring 2026 batch) by Het Dave and Johann Stuerken and operated as Andustry GmbH.

providers.name: Artin Energy
providers.description: Artin Energy provides solar and renewable energy solutions for businesses, including solar modules, green hydrogen, energy storage, EV charging stations, and hydroponics powered by AI. The company offers engineering, procurement, and construction services, power purchase agreements, and consulting to optimize energy use for commercial clients.

providers.name: Auradine (Velaura AI)
providers.description: Auradine, Inc. is a Silicon Valley semiconductor and infrastructure company founded in 2022, in 2026 rebranded as Velaura AI, Inc. The company designs ultra-low-power compute solutions for data center, edge, and physical AI applications, anchored by its Titan Core silicon design and IP platform that reduces the power required for AI compute while maintaining performance. Its Teraflux product line delivers high-efficiency Bitcoin mining hardware (3nm ASICs, air- and hydro-cooled miners, containers, and fleet management software) deployed by leading Bitcoin data center operators. Auradine raised over $300 million across its funding rounds, including a $153M Series C, and is backed by investors including DCVC. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Auradine/Velaura AI publishes no public developer API or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: AXA
providers.description: AXA is a French multinational insurance firm and one of the world's largest providers of life, health, property & casualty, and asset management services. AXA does not publish a single global developer portal; technology integration is delivered through country-specific broker and partner portals, AXA Partners B2B2C distribution channels, AXA XL specialty insurance APIs for commercial brokers, and ACORD / EDI standards used across the insurance industry.

providers.name: Bain & Company
providers.description: Bain & Company is a global management consulting firm and one of the prestigious Big Three strategy consultancies. Bain does not publish a commercial public developer portal; technology integration is delivered through client-specific advisory engagements, Bain proprietary tools (NPS Prism, Helix, Vector), and a Bain-published Insights / research surface that is consumed via the bain.com website and feeds rather than developer APIs.

providers.name: Barksocial
providers.description: Barksocial operates a dog‑friendly bar and community space offering memberships, day‑care, grooming, boarding, and a full‑service restaurant. Located in Baltimore and Columbia, it provides a social hub for dog owners to connect, host events, and enjoy amenities for both pets and people. The brand emphasizes a safe, dog‑centric environment with park rules, events, and a loyalty program.

providers.name: BlueLayer
providers.description: BlueLayer is an operating-system platform for carbon-project developers, providing infrastructure to collect project data, run automated digital measurement, reporting and verification (dMRV), manage the carbon-credit lifecycle from estimation through retirement, and generate revenue by distributing and selling credits while reducing compliance burden. The product spans project operations, a revenue engine, credit management, a stakeholder DataHub, customizable dashboards, and integrations with registries, CRMs, accounting software, and ERPs. Backed by Point Nine, BlueLayer was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; as of this enrichment pass no public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface was found — the platform is accessed via its hosted web application.

providers.name: Boomy
providers.description: Boomy is a consumer-facing generative music platform that lets anyone create original AI songs in a browser or mobile app and release them to Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music, TikTok, YouTube, and other DSPs with Boomy collecting and paying out streaming royalties. Boomy does not publish a public, self-serve developer API; integrations and partner arrangements (DSP distribution, licensing) are handled directly by the Boomy team rather than through a documented public API surface.

providers.name: Branded
providers.description: Branded is a placeholder company identified in the API Evangelist secondary-market harvest. It currently has no publicly documented API or official website. The entry exists to allow future enrichment should the company publish an API, documentation, or other digital assets. This stub includes basic maintainer information and placeholder tags, awaiting further discovery.

providers.name: Brunt
providers.description: Brunt is a workwear and apparel company that designs, manufactures, and sells high‑quality boots, clothing, and accessories for professionals in demanding environments. Based in the United States, Brunt focuses on durability, safety, and comfort, offering a range of products from waterproof boots to insulated work pants. The brand emphasizes American‑made craftsmanship and a strong commitment to customer service and product innovation.

providers.name: Cega
providers.description: Cega is a decentralized exotic derivatives protocol building on-chain structured products for investors: exotic options such as Fixed Coupon Notes (pure options and bond + options) and Dual Currency Swaps that generate yield with built-in downside protection. Cega is live on Ethereum Mainnet and Arbitrum One (EVM) and on Solana, and exposes its protocol to developers through first-party TypeScript SDKs on npm (@cega-fi) plus a GraphQL subgraph rather than a hosted REST API. Backed by Pantera Capital and surfaced into the API Evangelist network from its VC portfolio.

providers.name: CG Oncology
providers.description: CG Oncology is a publicly traded biotechnology company focused on developing bladder‑sparing immunotherapies for non‑muscle invasive bladder cancer. The firm leverages oncolytic viral platforms to create novel treatments, maintains an active pipeline, and provides extensive investor information through its corporate site. It engages clinicians, patients, and investors with detailed scientific, clinical, and financial resources.

providers.name: China Electronics Cloud
providers.description: China Electronics Cloud (CECloud) is a leading Chinese cloud computing provider focused on secure, high‑performance distributed storage, AI computing, and industry‑specific cloud solutions. Established in 2020, CECloud serves government agencies, state‑owned enterprises, and critical infrastructure sectors, offering IaaS, PaaS, and AI‑native services across X86, ARM, and MIPS architectures. The platform emphasizes security compliance, data sovereignty, and integrated AI capabilities for smart city, finance, and public sector applications.

providers.name: Chipcitycookies
providers.description: Chipcitycookies is a bakery and catering company that offers a wide variety of cookie flavors across the United States. After operating for over a decade, the company announced the closure of its physical locations due to macro‑economic challenges but continues to ship cookies nationwide, provide catering services, and sell gift cards online. The site includes information on flavors, catering options, nutritional details, and a support portal for customers.

providers.name: Clicker
providers.description: Clicker is a consumer-facing streaming guide and discovery platform that helps people find where to watch popular and new movies and TV shows across streaming providers, aggregating title availability from services such as Netflix, Hulu, Disney+, Max, Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV+, Paramount+, Peacock, Starz, BET+, Philo, and FuboTV into a single searchable catalog. The product is a web application (Next.js) organized around TV Shows and Movies browse and search experiences. Clicker is backed by Redpoint Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Clicker publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or developer documentation; its only backend surface is a private, robots disallowed internal application API.

providers.name: Connected Cannabis
providers.description: Connected Cannabis is a retail cannabis brand operating storefronts in Sacramento, Stockton, and San Francisco. The company offers a curated selection of flower, vapes, pre-rolls, extracts, edibles, and merchandise through its online ordering platform. It emphasizes quality, sustainability, and community engagement, providing customers with detailed strain information and a loyalty program. Connected Cannabis aims to enhance the cannabis shopping experience with convenient pickup options and a modern e‑commerce site.

providers.name: Contentful Images
providers.description: Used to retrieve and apply transformations to images

providers.name: COUNTRY Financial
providers.description: COUNTRY Financial is the marketing name for an Illinois-headquartered family of affiliated insurance and financial services companies that includes COUNTRY Life Insurance Company, COUNTRY Mutual Insurance Company, COUNTRY Casualty Insurance Company, COUNTRY Preferred Insurance Company, and related subsidiaries based in Bloomington, IL. Founded in 1925 by Illinois Agricultural Association members, COUNTRY today offers auto, home, life, farm, crop, and commercial insurance along with investment, retirement planning, and trust services through a captive agent network in 19 U.S. states. COUNTRY does not publish a public developer API; partner and agency integrations occur through internal agency systems.

providers.name: Cyngn
providers.description: Cyngn (NASDAQ: CYN) is a Mountain View, California autonomous vehicle technology company that develops and deploys industrial autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) for material handling. Its flagship DriveMod stack is a vehicle-agnostic, AI-powered autonomy system that retrofits onto standard industrial vehicles such as tuggers and forklifts, paired with the Cyngn Insight fleet-management, teleoperation, and analytics platform and the Cyngn Evolve data toolkit — together marketed as the Enterprise Autonomy Suite. Cyngn targets warehousing, manufacturing, and logistics operators facing labor shortages and safety challenges, and integrates with major warehouse management systems (Manhattan, Blue Yonder, SAP EWM). The company traces its corporate lineage to Cyanogen Inc. (the CyanogenMod company), whose dormant GitHub organization still links to cyngn.com.

providers.name: DailyMealz
providers.description: DailyMealz is a Saudi Arabia-based meal subscription service that delivers fresh daily lunches and full-day meal plans sourced from a network of more than sixty partner restaurants. Subscribers choose a package (healthy, keto, diet, and similar options), select meals from a rotating menu, and control delivery timing through the DailyMealz mobile app. The company also operates a DailyMealz for Business offering for corporate meal programs. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; DailyMealz is an app-first consumer brand and publishes no public developer API surface, documentation portal, or API specifications as of this profiling round.

providers.name: Devon Energy
providers.description: Devon Energy Corporation (NYSE: DVN) is an independent oil and natural gas exploration and production company operating across U.S. onshore basins, anchored by a leading position in the economic core of the Delaware Basin. On May 7, 2026 Devon completed an all-stock merger with Coterra Energy, creating a large-cap shale operator with an estimated combined enterprise value of about $58 billion; the combined company retains the Devon Energy name and the DVN ticker, is headquartered in Houston and keeps a significant presence in Oklahoma City. Devon publishes a corporate website, an investor-relations site, sustainability and cybersecurity reporting, and a supplier and interest-owner information section, but operates no public developer program, no API and no machine-readable API artifacts. Owner statements are delivered through EnergyLink and supplier invoicing through Enverus OpenInvoice — both third-party platforms, neither a Devon API.

providers.name: Dewu (POIZON)
providers.description: Dewu (POIZON) is a leading Chinese online marketplace for sneakers, streetwear, luxury goods, and collectibles, distinguished by its integrated product authentication (legit-check) service that verifies items before they ship to buyers. Operated by Shanghai-based Poizon and backed by Hongshan (formerly Sequoia China), it runs both the domestic Dewu (得物) app and the global POIZON marketplace. For developers it operates the POIZON / Dewu Open Platform (open.poizon.com and open.dewu.com), a partner program that lets sellers, ISVs, and ERP integrators connect to the marketplace over an app-key plus request-signature authenticated API covering product data, pricing, catalog search, delivery modes, and vendor information.

providers.name: E-3 Tech
providers.description: E3Tech (E-3 Tech) is an investment firm that partners with entrepreneurs through programmatic M&A and technology amplification, providing private-equity-style investment in profitable service-industry platforms while letting founders retain control and preserve their entrepreneurial culture. It combines strategic acquisitions, operational enhancements, and technology to drive growth across multi-trade construction services, marketing agencies, managed service providers, wealth management, pharmaceutical services, and vegetation management. Surfaced as an a16z-associated portfolio lead and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as an investment/advisory firm it publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Esper Satellite Imagery
providers.description: Esper Satellite Imagery is an Australian space-technology company building an 18-satellite hyperspectral Earth-observation constellation (the Over The Rainbow / OTR program) to deliver global chemical-composition data of the planet's surface from orbit. Its Esperesso hyperspectral imagers capture more than 100 contiguous spectral bands spanning roughly 400 to 1000 nm, which Esper turns into mineralisation maps that identify lithium, rare earths, gold, nickel, cobalt and alteration zones for critical-mineral exploration — faster, cheaper and greener than traditional ground surveys. Founded in 2021 in Melbourne, Victoria by Iqbal and Joey Lorenczak, Esper sells custom area-of-interest mineral maps and a pre-built Northern Territory mineral map. It does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures the company's public web, security and code-repository surface.

providers.name: Five Jack
providers.description: Five Jack (PT. Five Jack) is the Indonesian company behind itemku, one of Southeast Asia's largest digital-goods marketplaces for gamers. Founded in 2014 as a game price-comparison and classifieds platform, itemku grew into a full marketplace where buyers and sellers trade in-game items, currency, account top-ups, game keys, and vouchers across 200+ game categories including Roblox, Genshin Impact, Mobile Legends, Dota 2, Steam, and Growtopia. The company reached one million orders in 2018, launched its Android app and gaming blog in 2020, and became part of Bukalapak (IDX: BUKA) in May 2021. Five Jack was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. It operates a consumer-facing marketplace and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Formula 1
providers.description: Formula 1 (F1) is the premier international auto racing sport, governed by the FIA. It features a series of Grand Prix races across the globe, showcasing cutting‑edge automotive technology, elite drivers, and massive fan engagement. The sport’s official website provides news, race schedules, results, live timing, ticketing, merchandise, and a rich media experience for fans worldwide.

providers.name: GetInsured
providers.description: GetInsured (Vimo, Inc.) is a SaaS technology provider for public-sector healthcare that powers state-based health insurance marketplaces (SBMs). Its platform handles eligibility and enrollment, plan shopping and comparison, and consumer-assistance contact-center operations for state ACA exchanges. GetInsured powers ten state marketplaces (including Idaho, Illinois, Minnesota, Nevada, New Jersey, New Mexico, Pennsylvania, Georgia, Virginia, and Oregon, with Oregon launching in 2027) and supported the migration of roughly 4.5 million people off Healthcare.gov. It sells to state governments, insurance carriers, agents/brokers, and enrollment assisters. GetInsured does not publish a public self-serve developer portal or API; integrations are delivered under contract. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Grand Games
providers.description: Grand Games (Grand Games Oyun ve Yazılım) is an Istanbul-based hybrid-casual mobile game studio founded in early 2024 by Bekir Batuhan Çelebi, Mehmet Çalım, and Mustafa Fırtına, a team that previously built Zen Match at Moon Active. The studio develops genre-defining puzzle games for iOS and Android played by millions worldwide, including Magic Sort, Car Match, and Block Out, and has grown to six live titles with fivefold year-over-year revenue. It has raised roughly $103M across three rounds, most recently a $70M Series B led by Balderton Capital's Growth Fund in May 2026. Grand Games publishes consumer mobile games and does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Heineken
providers.description: A Dutch multinational brewing company and one of the world's largest beer producers. Operates over 165 breweries across 70 countries producing iconic brands including Heineken, Amstel, Tecate, and Dos Equis. Maintains an internal HEIWAY API portal (api-portal.production.az.heiway.com) used for partner, distributor, and on-trade B2B integrations; access is gated and not openly published.

providers.name: HODL Media
providers.description: HODL Media (hodl.mobi) is the maker of HODL Real-Time Cryptocurrency, a consumer mobile application for iOS and Android that tracks cryptocurrency and stock market prices in real time. The app aggregates pricing from 180+ global exchanges, offers customizable charting with technical indicators, price alerts and bracket management, portfolio tracking with exchange and wallet synchronization (Coinbase Pro, Binance, Ethereum wallets), aggregated news and social feeds, and stock market data from NYSE and NASDAQ. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this profile HODL Media publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or programmatic documentation; this repo is maintained as an API Evangelist network lead.

providers.name: Hudl
providers.description: Hudl is a Lincoln, Nebraska sports performance and analytics technology company founded in 2007. The company started as a video sharing and review platform for high school, college, and professional teams and has grown into a global provider of video capture hardware, performance analysis software, and sports data services. Hudl operates across basketball, baseball, football, ice hockey, rugby, soccer, softball, and volleyball, serving customers from youth clubs through professional leagues. The company's product portfolio spans the core Hudl video platform, Hudl Focus AI-powered capture cameras (Indoor, Outdoor, Flex, Point), Hudl Replay and Hudl Studio for live and tactical analysis, Hudl IQ for American football analytics, Volleymetrics, the Hudl TV livestreaming product, and Hudl Tickets digital ticketing. Through acquisitions Hudl has consolidated several leading performance analysis and football data brands under its umbrella, including Sportscode (performance analysis software), Wyscout (the largest soccer video and stats database), Statsbomb (advanced football analytics), Instat (video and scouting), WIMU and Titan (athlete tracking and wearables), and Signal and ADI. Hudl exposes commercial developer surfaces primarily through Hudl Wyscout (Wyscout Data API, documented as OpenAPI 3.0 at apidocs.wyscout.com, with Database, Stats, Events, and Physical Data packs) and Hudl Statsbomb (the Statsbomb Aggregated API for player-match, player-season, team-match, and team-season data, accessed via the Data Hub, plus the Raw X&Y Tracking Data API and a Wyscout/Statsbomb ID Mapping API). Core Hudl video and Hudl Focus do not publish a public developer API; B2B integrations are sales-mediated. Hudl maintains a public GitHub organization (github.com/hudl) with infrastructure, resilience, and media tooling open source projects (Mjolnir, Fargo, HudlFfmpeg, react-native components), but these are engineering libraries, not product SDKs. Hudl's revenue model is SaaS subscriptions for video, analytics, and data packages, plus camera hardware sales and data licensing.

providers.name: iChase
providers.description: iChase Co., Ltd. (iCHASE) builds AI-powered biosecurity and precision-farming systems for modern agriculture. Its integrated computer-vision monitoring platform protects livestock and optimizes growth for dairy, poultry, warehouse/industrial, and utility operations. Flagship products include the AI Bird Repeller, which detects birds in real time and deploys automated, chemical-free laser deterrence to reduce avian-flu and contamination risk, and InsightScale, which uses 3D scanning and AI weight prediction to track poultry Average Daily Gain and uniformity without stressful manual weighing. iCHASE is a member of the NVIDIA Inception program, a 2024 THRIVE Top 100 Global Innovator, and a 500 Global portfolio company. The site markets an "Open API" capability, but no public developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI definition, or SDKs were discoverable at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Instacoach
providers.description: Instacoach is an AI-powered baseball training app that generates personalized, on-demand workout programs for athletes across hitting, pitching, arm care, fielding, catching, lifting, and mental performance. Programs are built by college and pro athletes and adapt to the user's equipment and goals, with short guided drills, progress tracking, and stat logging. It is delivered as consumer iOS and Android apps plus a web experience, and also offers team training programs for coaches. Sector: consumer sports/fitness technology. Backed by GGV Capital. No public developer API surface was found during enrichment (no api./developer./docs. host, no /.well-known, llms.txt, or OpenAPI).

providers.name: Lawhive
providers.description: Lawhive is a UK consumer legal-services marketplace that connects individuals and small businesses with regulated solicitors online at fixed, transparent prices, positioned as roughly half the cost of a traditional high-street law firm. Clients answer intake questions on the site, receive a quote or a callback, and are matched with a vetted consultant lawyer who then runs the matter end to end through the Lawhive platform, covering conveyancing, divorce and family, employment, immigration, landlord and tenant, and property work. Lawhive Ltd is not a law firm and does not give legal advice itself; regulated legal services are delivered by its network, including affiliate firm Lawhive Legal Ltd, which is authorised and regulated by the Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA ID 8003766). The company is backed by Balderton Capital and GV. Lawhive publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation, so this profile captures its identity, legal and compliance posture, and probed domain-security surface rather than an API contract.

providers.name: Lucid Motors
providers.description: Lucid Motors is the consumer-vehicle brand of Lucid Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: LCID), a Newark, California–headquartered American luxury electric vehicle manufacturer. The company designs and manufactures high-performance battery-electric sedans and SUVs, with its flagship Lucid Air (Pure, Touring, Grand Touring, and Sapphire trims) and the Lucid Gravity SUV (Touring and Grand Touring), assembled at its AMP-1 factory in Casa Grande, Arizona. Lucid develops its own electric powertrain, battery, and software stack — including the Lucid UX in-vehicle experience, the Lucid mobile app, Lucid Assistant, and over-the-air updates — and operates a vertically integrated direct-to-consumer sales, financing, leasing, and service model across North America, Europe, and the Middle East, supported by a growing network of Lucid Studios, Service Centers, and DC fast charging partnerships. Lucid is majority-owned by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF). Beyond consumer vehicles, Lucid licenses its powertrain and battery technology to other OEMs (notably Aston Martin) and supplies battery systems through its Lucid energy storage initiatives. Lucid Motors does not publish a public developer API portal, SDK, or OpenAPI specification; the Lucid mobile app and vehicle telematics are powered by private backend services that are not documented for third-party use.

providers.name: Mars
providers.description: Mars, Incorporated is one of the world's largest privately held companies, producing confectionery, pet food, food, and providing veterinary care. The company owns iconic brands including M&M's, Snickers, Twix, Milky Way, Skittles, Wrigley, Orbit, Extra, Pedigree, Whiskas, Royal Canin, IAMS, and Sheba, and operates Mars Petcare clinical brands including Banfield Pet Hospital, VCA Animal Hospitals, BluePearl, and Antech Diagnostics. Mars operates in over 80 countries. Mars operates a public Azure-API-Management developer portal at developer.mars.com for partner and B2B integrations, alongside closed channels such as the Mars Supplier Gateway.

providers.name: Mia-Platform
providers.description: Mia-Platform is an Internal Developer Platform (IDP) that harmonizes infrastructure, applications, and data for intelligent engineering at scale. It provides an API-first platform for building and managing microservices and cloud-native applications.

providers.name: Mindgard
providers.description: Mindgard is a UK-based offensive AI security company (London/Lancaster, spun out of Lancaster University) that provides an automated AI red-teaming and security testing platform for large language models, AI agents, and generative AI systems. Mindgard's platform combines AI Discovery and Recon (mapping the AI attack surface and shadow AI usage), continuous AI Red Teaming against evolving attacker techniques, AI Assessment, AI Runtime Protection, and Model Scanning, backed by a research-led attack library covering jailbreaks (ActorAttack, Crescendo, EvilConfidant, PersonGPT, DevModeV2, AsciiArtAttack, AntiGPT), prompt-injection techniques (Ascii85, AnsiEscaped, AnsiRaw and others), and policy/violation testing (MaliciousGeneration, PromptAlignment). Developers and security teams integrate Mindgard via a public REST API (projects, tests, multi-turn tests, datasets, findings, reconnaissance), a Python CLI (`pip install mindgard`), a Python SDK, a Burp Suite extension, and a GitHub Action for adding red-team checks to MLOps pipelines. The company also maintains and contributes to open-source security tooling including PyRIT integrations, an OpenAI-compatible LLM-Guard proxy, a chatbot API wrapper for testing web chatbots, and proof-of-concept vulnerability demonstrations (document RCE in LangChain agents, hidden audio jailbreaks, prompt-jailbreak demos). Mindgard's commercial model is enterprise SaaS with platform and services tiers; pricing is gated behind a sales conversation, and the platform is positioned for security, AppSec, and AI governance teams testing customer-facing or internally deployed AI systems.

providers.name: MLOps
providers.description: MLOps (Machine Learning Operations) is an engineering discipline that unifies machine learning development with operations to deploy, monitor, govern, and maintain machine learning models in production. MLOps.org publishes an end-to-end reference for designing, building, and managing reproducible, testable, and evolvable ML-powered software, including the CRISP-ML(Q) process model, the MLOps Stack Canvas, MLOps principles, and ML model governance practices. This index curates the canonical references, frameworks, and ecosystem resources for practicing MLOps across data engineering, ML pipelines, and model serving.

providers.name: Newgen Software
providers.description: Newgen Software is a global provider of NewgenONE, a unified low-code digital transformation platform that orchestrates content services (enterprise content management), business process management (BPM/workflow), and customer communication management (CCM) for banks, insurers, government agencies, and healthcare organizations. Founded in 1992 and headquartered in New Delhi, India, the company is publicly listed (NSE/BSE) and serves enterprises worldwide with document management, intelligent document processing, case management, and process automation. Platform capabilities are exposed to customers and system integrators via REST APIs, but Newgen does not operate a public, self-service developer portal or publish OpenAPI/SDK artifacts on its marketing site.

providers.name: nextbike
providers.description: Nextbike GmbH is a leading European bike‑sharing provider offering tailored mobility solutions for cities, campuses and businesses since 2004. Operating in over 400 locations across more than 20 countries, it delivers innovative bike‑sharing platforms, advertising options, and sustainability initiatives, supporting public transport integration and corporate mobility programs.

providers.name: Nightingale
providers.description: Nightingale REST Client is a modern, resource-friendly REST API client for Windows.

providers.name: Northstar
providers.description: Northstar is an employer-sponsored financial wellness benefit that helps employees understand, manage, and get the most out of their total compensation and personal finances. Delivered as a workplace benefit (offered by employers to their workforce), Northstar pairs financial guidance with tools for budgeting, saving, equity/compensation planning, and overall money management. The company is a fintech provider backed by GGV Capital. It was surfaced as a portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass, Northstar publishes a marketing site, blog, and legal pages, but exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface — its product is consumed as an employee benefit, not as a developer API.

providers.name: Operation Support Equipment
providers.description: API for managing and accessing operation support equipment data, inventory, maintenance records, and deployment information for operational logistics and equipment lifecycle management.

providers.name: Packmind
providers.description: Packmind captures and governs your development playbook so every AI agent follows your rules consistently, across teams and repos. It helps teams maintain code quality and consistency standards.

providers.name: PHP
providers.description: PHP is a widely-used server-side scripting language especially suited for web development and embedded in HTML. It powers a large portion of the web including platforms like WordPress and Drupal, and provides extensive database support, framework options, and a mature ecosystem. PHP itself is a language and runtime, not a hosted API service.

providers.name: Pocket Protector
providers.description: Pocket Protector is a consumer peer-to-peer trading application operated by Pocket Protector Inc. Under the tagline "Trade Better Together," it lets users trade items and assets with one another through an iOS app and an accompanying Telegram bot (@pocketprotectorbot). The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Electric Capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as of this pass it publishes a marketing site with privacy and terms pages but no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Pollen
providers.description: Pollen Technologies is a London-based, FCA-authorised white-label fintech platform that lets any business launch its own banking and payments product with no code and a fully managed back office. The platform delivers programmatic payment delivery, instant named IBAN account opening, third-party bank account linking for real-time balances and transaction data, multi-currency payments across 148 currencies into more than 160 countries, local payment schemes, and virtual and physical cards. A managed compliance layer covers KYC, AML, transaction monitoring, client fund safeguarding and help-desk support under SLAs. Pollen Technologies Ltd is authorised by the Financial Conduct Authority under the Payment Services Regulations 2017 (firm reference 768011), founded in 2015 and backed by Seedcamp, Level39 and Q-Advisers. Access to the underlying payments and banking APIs is delivered as a managed, partner-only service rather than a public self-serve developer program, so no public API specifications, SDKs or developer portal are currently published.

providers.name: Powerledger
providers.description: Powerledger (Powerledger AG / Power Ledger Pty Ltd, Perth, Western Australia) builds software for tracking, tracing and trading renewable energy and environmental commodities. Its platform is modular and sold to utilities, retailers, network operators, generators and corporates rather than to developers: xGrid and uGrid for peer-to-peer energy trading across and behind the meter, TraceX as a marketplace for Renewable Energy Certificates and other Energy Attribute Certificates (integrated with the M-RETS and ERCOT registries), Vision and PPA Vision for 24/7 renewable portfolio and PPA tracking, plus hydrogen and EV settlement products. Powerledger originally ran its own permissioned Solana-derived chain (the Powerledger Energy Blockchain, source at github.com/PowerLedger/powr) and has since moved to Solana mainnet, where the POWR SPL token lives. As of this profile Powerledger publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Prestige Consumer Healthcare
providers.description: Prestige Consumer Healthcare is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Prestige Consumer Healthcare API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: ProPublica Data Store
providers.description: Enhance your own applications with fast, reliable access to the data that powers our newsroom.

providers.name: Proxyman
providers.description: Proxyman is a modern, native macOS app for HTTP/HTTPS debugging proxy with advanced features for API development and testing.

providers.name: Puddle
providers.description: Puddle is a technical-interview platform for evaluating software-engineering candidates in real-world, AI-enabled conditions. Candidates work through live coding assessments inside a sandboxed environment with an integrated IDE and terminal, and are free to use modern AI tools (such as Claude Code) during the session. Puddle captures detailed signals about how a candidate approaches a problem across structured phases (problem discussion, architecture, implementation, and debrief) and produces an outcome report with confidence scores, focus and iteration-pace metrics, and hiring recommendations. It is sold as a B2B SaaS recruitment-assessment tool via demo and early-access waitlist. Puddle was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this pass Puddle publishes no public API, developer documentation, SDK, or OpenAPI surface; the profile below captures its verifiable public web and security presence.

providers.name: Reflection AI
providers.description: Reflection AI is an artificial intelligence research lab building frontier open intelligence — open models that let anyone control their own intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Founded by former Google DeepMind researchers and backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, the company frames its work as a path to superintelligence, sharing research and perspectives through its blog rather than a public developer product. As of this profile Reflection AI publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or MCP server; this entry captures the company's verified identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network and will be re-enriched if a developer surface appears.

providers.name: Remix 3
providers.description: Remix (YC W26, "remix-3" in the Y Combinator directory) is a San Francisco AI startup building a consumer social-media content platform under the tagline "Trends, remixed by you." Users connect their accounts and drop in photos, voice notes, or messages, and Remix uses hundreds of parallel AI agents to auto-generate posts in their style — articles, tweets, carousels, and short-form videos, including riffs on trending formats — without manual prompting. The company was founded in 2025 by Sam Kaplan (Harvard CS; early Brex employee). As of this enrichment pass Remix ships a consumer web/mobile product only and publishes no public developer API, SDK, docs, or webhook surface, so this remains an identity-only profile in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Ryland Group
providers.description: The Ryland Group was one of the largest U.S. homebuilders and a leading mortgage finance company before merging with Standard Pacific Corp in October 2015 to form CalAtlantic Group, Inc., which was subsequently acquired by Lennar in 2018. During its operation, Ryland Homes built homes across 17 states and provided financial services including consumer mortgage loans, title, and escrow services. The company's technology stack included Akamai, Amazon CloudFront, ASP.NET, Fiserv for financial services, and Microsoft Dynamics for CRM and ERP.

providers.name: Salus
providers.description: Salus provides runtime validation and governance for AI agents. It sits between an agent and its tools as a policy-aware proxy that intercepts each action before it executes, then clarifies, rewrites, escalates for human review, or blocks it against organizational policies — managing commit-time risk on financial transfers, appointment changes, and data modifications before they alter customer data, finances, or records. Integration requires only an endpoint URL change (no agent rewrite), and Salus works across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Retell, Vapi, and custom tools. Capabilities include evidence-based validation, PII detection, budget and loop protection, idempotency checks, human-in-the-loop escalation, self-repair of blocked actions, and integrated evals and observability. Salus is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) company based in San Francisco.

providers.name: Seamflow
providers.description: Seamflow builds AI-native software for the Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) industry, automating end-to-end regulatory certification workflows for notified bodies and certification organizations while preserving human oversight and accreditation compliance. Its platform spans four core products: the Notified Body Suite (intake-to-certificate workflow management), Scheduling Agents (automated auditor assignment and travel optimization), Tech File Review (structured technical-documentation assessment against regulatory requirements), and Report Writing (AI-assisted drafting of compliance reports). Seamflow is an early-stage enterprise-SaaS company ($4.5M seed) backed by Initialized Capital and Northzone. As of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI specification; this record captures its verified public company surface.

providers.name: Sensemesh
providers.description: Sensemesh builds an AI-powered operating system that unifies cameras, sensors, and drones into a single intelligent network for real-time perception and autonomous response. The platform fuses visual, thermal, audio, and pressure sensor data so organizations can detect threats, investigate incidents, dispatch drones autonomously, and query sensor history in natural language across law enforcement, corrections and prisons, events and venues, homeowners associations, and schools and universities.
