It is implanted on the beating heart in a minimally invasive, suture-free procedure by a heart team. The company reported first-in-human implantations in 2023 and runs an EIC co-funded EU project toward market entry; the device remains investigational. AdjuCor is a hardware manufacturer rather than a software business, and publishes no developer program, public API, SDK, or machine-readable API contract on any host it operates.

providers.name: Affirmed Networks
providers.description: Affirmed Networks is a mobile networking company founded in 2010 (Andover, Massachusetts) that pioneered fully virtualized, cloud-native mobile core software for service providers. Its portfolio spanned a Virtualized Evolved Packet Core (vEPC), the UnityCloud 5G Core, Private Network Service, Network Slicing, and service-automation/analytics tooling, deployed by 100+ mobile operators including AT&T, Orange, Vodafone, and Telus. The company was acquired by Microsoft in March 2020 and folded into the Azure for Operators initiative; the affirmednetworks.com site now operates as a Microsoft company marketing presence with no independent public developer portal or API. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Matrix Partners.

providers.name: AHARA
providers.description: AHARA is a Los Angeles personalized-nutrition company founded in 2022 by physician nutritionist Dr. Melina Jampolis and The RealReal founder Julie Wainwright, funded with a $10.25M seed round led by Greycroft. It pairs a health questionnaire and at-home genetic, epigenetic and blood-biomarker testing with registered-dietitian guidance and a consumer app (Food Health Rx) that turns the results into a personalized food-as-medicine plan, sold direct to consumers and through employers, health plans and providers. In late 2024 the company rebranded as Food Health Collective and moved its web presence to foodhealthcollective.org; the original ahara.com domain is now registrar-suspended (clientHold, NXDOMAIN) and the ahara.health Squarespace site has expired. AHARA operates no developer program: there is no portal, no documentation, no API reference, no public package, no GitHub organization and no machine-readable contract on any host it controls.

providers.name: ANSR
providers.description: ANSR Global is a workforce and operations company that helps enterprises build, manage, and scale Global Capability Centers (GCCs) — captive technology and shared-services hubs, most often in India and other emerging markets. Its end-to-end offering spans four areas: Talent Solutions (AI-driven recruiting, sourcing, onboarding, and talent management), Workspace (managed, customized office space and workplace strategy), Business Operations (payroll, HR, employer-of-record, compliance, legal, and finance/tax), and Research & Advisory (organizational design, capability planning, and market intelligence). ANSR engages clients through Global Capability Center subscriptions, Build-Operate-Transfer arrangements, and Managed Teams, and operates a proprietary workforce platform, 1Wrk. The company reports 20+ years of operations, 210+ global centers established, 225,000+ professionals hired, and 14M+ square feet of managed workspace. ANSR is a portfolio company of Accel. It is a business-services provider and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or developer documentation; this profile captures its public web surface and web-domain security posture.

providers.name: Apar Infotech
providers.description: Apar Infotech Corporation, which operates publicly as Apar Technologies, is a Singapore-headquartered IT services and consulting group serving clients across Asia Pacific, the Middle East and the Americas. The firm delivers technology consulting and application services, data management and business intelligence, collaboration and content management, enterprise applications, managed services, staff augmentation and collaborative development centres, with practice areas spanning artificial intelligence, cloud, CRM, ServiceNow workflow, RPA/BPM hyperautomation, enterprise mobility and IoT. Apar also publishes a small set of its own products — the Otomeyt HR technology and technical-assessment platform, the Innoculate IoT monitoring platform, and the eLite SIS and eLite BAM applications. Apar is part of the Apar Group and is backed by Insight Partners. As of this enrichment pass Apar publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable API specification or self-service sign-up; its API work is delivered inside client engagements rather than as a public product surface.

providers.name: API Harmony
providers.description: API Harmony was an API discovery and recommendation tool from IBM Research that used graph-based search, machine learning, and cognitive technologies to help developers find, compare, and select compatible APIs. It was offered as a cloud service on IBM Bluemix and has since been discontinued.

providers.name: Artemis Security
providers.description: Artemis Security is an AI-native security operations platform that detects and responds to threats faster than traditional SIEMs, cutting mean time to detection and response with claims of up to 96% reduction in resolution times. The platform performs environment-specific threat detection, multi-source correlation across identity, cloud, endpoint, network, and SaaS signals, natural-language AI threat hunting, and autonomous investigation with automatic case generation and detection-gap closure. It integrates with enterprise tools such as Okta, AWS, Salesforce, Snowflake, and Databricks. The company emerged from stealth with $70M in funding from Felicis Ventures, First Round Capital, and Brightmind Partners. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched from the company's public surface; no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is currently published.

providers.name: Autobahn Therapeutics
providers.description: Autobahn Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in San Diego, California, developing regenerative medicines for central nervous system (CNS) disorders. The company pairs a proprietary brain-targeting chemistry platform - which creates orally administered small-molecule prodrugs designed to cross the blood-brain barrier - with validated human biology and biomarker-driven development strategies. Its pipeline includes elunetirom (its lead clinical program, being developed for indications such as bipolar depression), ABX-101 (a next-generation CNS-active S1P molecule), and ABX-003. Autobahn is backed by venture investors including Canaan Partners and Insight Partners. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; the company does not currently publish a public developer API, so this record captures company identity and published web properties only.

providers.name: Bagel Labs
providers.description: Bagel Labs is an AI research lab building distributed diffusion training infrastructure for frontier diffusion workloads on commodity and heterogeneous GPU fleets. Its core method, Distributed Diffusion Models (DDM), replaces a single large diffusion model with an ensemble of smaller expert models trained independently on dataset partitions with no gradient synchronization, then ensembled at inference by a lightweight router (the Paris Inference Engine, PIE). Public releases include Paris-1 (image diffusion) and Paris 2.0 (video generation), with open weights on Hugging Face and papers on arXiv. Founded in 2023 by Bidhan Roy and backed by Polychain Capital, the lab targets image, video, world-model, and robotics / physical AI workloads.

providers.name: Beesafe Ai
providers.description: Beesafe AI is a fraud-prevention and anti-scam platform whose tagline is "Stopping Scams Before They Reach Your Customers." Its AI-powered anti-scam agents proactively engage scammers to uncover the fraudulent accounts, money-mule networks, and criminal financial infrastructure behind trust-based scams such as romance scams, pig-butchering, and investment fraud, which bypass traditional detection by convincing victims to authorize transactions themselves. Beesafe serves financial-services firms, cryptocurrency companies, telecommunications providers, and government agencies. It was founded by AI and security PhDs from Carnegie Mellon and UC San Diego and is backed by Y Combinator, Obvious Ventures, and SBIR/STTR funding. The platform is currently in early access with no public self-service API, developer documentation, or pricing published.

providers.name: biolink
providers.description: BioLink (百林科医药科技（上海）有限公司) is a Shanghai-based bioprocessing company that manufactures core equipment and single-use consumable solutions for biopharmaceutical manufacturing. Its product lines span cell culture and bioreactors, fluid management, chromatography purification, process filtration, and pre-formulated aqueous products (buffers, water for injection, defoamers), serving antibody therapeutics and ADCs, vaccines, cell and gene therapy, and recombinant protein production. BioLink is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: Biostack Platforms
providers.description: BioStack Platforms is a San Francisco healthcare-data company (Y Combinator Spring 2026, backed by Afore Capital, Verdict, Heroic VC, and angels from Meta and Google DeepMind) building the data engine for healthcare and drug-discovery AI. It sources and structures ML-ready biomedical datasets — longitudinal, multimodal data across EHR, medical imaging, ECGs, labs, clinical notes, audio, and outcomes — and turns real clinical and preclinical workflows into training environments, evals, reward functions, and verifiable tasks for reinforcement learning and post-training. It serves biotech startups, frontier AI labs, and healthcare data companies. At profiling time BioStack publishes a marketing site and blog only; it exposes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or other machine-readable developer surface, so this remains an identity-only profile in the API Evangelist network pending a public developer offering.

providers.name: BitOoda
providers.description: BitOoda is an institutional, AI-native brokerage and market infrastructure firm that builds markets around compute, power, infrastructure and capital, covering GPU rental rate and memory futures, energy and metals hedging, origination, structuring and price discovery for institutional clients. It publishes no public developer program or API.

providers.name: Bonum Coaching
providers.description: Bonum Coaching is an enterprise coaching platform based in Latin America that pairs personalized human coaching with technology to develop talent and improve organizational performance. Its offering spans one-to-one executive coaching, group and team coaching, structured mentoring programs, and CLARA, an AI coach-bot for practicing workplace conversations in a safe environment. The company positions itself around democratizing access to coaching, leadership development, talent retention, building a growth culture, and diversity, equity and inclusion, and counts enterprises such as Uber, Davivienda, Farmatodo, and Mi Banco among its clients. Backed by 500 Global, Bonum Coaching is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Brrr
providers.description: Brrr is a fashion‑tech company that creates cooling performance fabrics using its proprietary Triple Chill Effect™ technology. The fabrics draw heat and moisture away from the skin, providing continuous cooling for everyday wear. Brrr offers a range of products, including the brrr° Pro line with micro‑mineral enhancements and recycled polyester blends, and provides custom fabric development for clients.

providers.name: Cameron International
providers.description: Cameron International (formerly Cooper Cameron Corporation) was a leading provider of flow equipment products, systems, and services to the worldwide oil, gas, and process industries. In 2016 the business was acquired by Schlumberger (now SLB) and its pressure-control, drilling, subsea, valves, measurement, and compression product lines were integrated into SLB's digital oilfield portfolio. Cameron-branded capabilities are now delivered and integrated through the SLB DELFI digital platform and its developer APIs rather than through a standalone Cameron developer program.

providers.name: Centivax
providers.description: Centivax is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in South San Francisco, California, developing broad-spectrum vaccines to prevent infectious diseases at scale. Its lead program is a universal, broadly protective influenza vaccine in Phase 1 clinical development designed to protect against all strains of the virus. The company's pandemic-prevention work received a Gates Foundation Grand Challenge award and was featured in Netflix's "Pandemic: How to Prevent an Outbreak." Centivax's mission is to accelerate the world's transition to a post-pathogen humanity. This is a life-sciences company profile in the API Evangelist network; Centivax does not currently publish a public developer or API platform.

providers.name: Cognitive Space
providers.description: Cognitive Space is an aerospace software company delivering AI-powered automated satellite operations for constellation and fleet management. Its CNTIENT.Optimize platform automates mission planning, tasking, and multi-ground-station pass scheduling for satellite operators and government agencies, reporting large per-operator time savings, while CNTIENT.Earth delivers satellite Data-as-a-Service. The company integrates with customer systems via APIs and serves clients including Terran Orbital, the Space Development Agency, the Air Force Research Lab, and NOAA. Backed by Techstars.

providers.name: Contraline
providers.description: Contraline is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing non-hormonal, long-acting, reversible contraceptive options for men and couples. Its lead product, ADAM, is an investigational implant designed to provide long-lasting reversible contraception, and NES/T is a daily topical gel intended to pause sperm production. Backed by GV (Google Ventures), Contraline runs clinical trials and participant programs from its Charlottesville, Virginia base. Its products are investigational and have not been approved by the FDA. The company operates a marketing and clinical-trial website with no public developer program or API; this API Evangelist profile captures its web presence, privacy posture, and domain security for the network catalog.

providers.name: Corvia Medical
providers.description: Corvia Medical, Inc. is a medical device company headquartered in Tewksbury, Massachusetts that develops interventional cardiology solutions for heart failure. Its lead product is the Corvia Atrial Shunt System (IASD), a transcatheter implant indicated for improving quality of life and reducing heart-failure symptoms in patients with elevated left atrial pressures who remain symptomatic despite guideline-directed medical therapy. The company has been backed by General Catalyst since 2009. Corvia Medical publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable interface; its web presence is clinical, patient, and regulatory information only.

providers.name: Data Innovations
providers.description: Data Innovations LLC is a clinical laboratory informatics company that builds enterprise laboratory management and instrument-connectivity software for hospitals, health systems, and diagnostic labs. Its flagship Instrument Manager middleware connects analyzers, laboratory information systems (LIS), and EHR platforms such as Epic Beaker and Oracle Cerner, while EP Evaluator supports method validation and quality control, and Lab GPS delivers operational analytics. The company helps clinical labs optimize productivity, connectivity, and risk management across regional, community, and federal health systems. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures.

providers.name: DeepSight Technology
providers.description: DeepSight Technology is a medical-imaging company reinventing diagnostic ultrasound. It is building a semiconductor-based ultrasound sensor and imaging platform (including its NeedleVue technology) to deliver a step-change in ultrasound performance, making this safe, non-invasive, radiation-free, low-cost imaging modality far more usable across clinical applications. The company is a hardware and medical-device business backed by Wing Venture Capital and Deerfield; it is added to the API Evangelist network as a Wing portfolio lead. It does not currently publish a public developer program, API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Diamond Foundry
providers.description: Diamond Foundry is a deep-tech materials company that manufactures semiconductor-grade single-crystal diamond wafers and diamond transistors to overcome the thermal limits of silicon in AI chips, datacenters, and electric vehicles. The company operates its own foundries and has built a full technology stack for producing diamond at scale as a sustainable substrate for high-performance and power electronics. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a planetary-health portfolio company of Obvious Ventures; it publishes no public developer API or documentation at this time.

providers.name: eHealth
providers.description: eHealth, Inc. (NASDAQ: EHTH) operates a licensed online health insurance marketplace where U.S. consumers can compare and enroll in health coverage from more than 180 insurance carriers across all 50 states and Washington, D.C. Founded in 1997, the company offers individual and family plans, Medicare products (Medicare Advantage, Medigap, and Part D prescription drug plans), small-business coverage, and Individual Coverage Health Reimbursement Arrangements (ICHRA). eHealth also provides a partner-facing developer API, documented at its gated developer portal, that lets affiliates and partners embed health-insurance shopping, quoting, and enrollment into their own applications.

providers.name: Eyebot
providers.description: Eyebot is a health-technology company building automated, self-serve vision testing kiosks that generate precise eyeglass prescriptions in minutes without a traditional eye-doctor appointment. The company deploys robotic screening kiosks into retail environments — partnering with large retailers such as Walmart and Sam's Club — to make refractive vision care faster, cheaper, and more accessible. Founded by Matthias Hofmann (CEO) and Jack Moldave (CTO) with Chief Medical Officer Alex Martin OD FAAO, Eyebot raised a $20M Series A and is backed by General Catalyst, Ubiquity Ventures, Village Global, and the National Science Foundation. Eyebot is currently a hardware-and-retail company with no public developer program, API, or SDK surface; this profile tracks its identity in the API Evangelist network pending any future developer offering.

providers.name: feld.energy
providers.description: feld.energy (Feld.Energy GmbH) is a Freising, Germany based Agri-PV (agrivoltaics) project developer and investment company that helps farmers and landowners install turnkey agricultural photovoltaic systems on their fields. It combines expertise from agriculture, energy, and project development to co-locate crop or livestock production with solar generation, offering landowners lease income, revenue sharing, or full-ownership models with state-secured grid feed-in over roughly 20 years. The company handles every step from land assessment and permitting through construction and operation. It reports 800+ partner farmers, 900+ hectares of projects, and 320+ MW of secured grid capacity. It is a portfolio company of HV Capital and is in the API Evangelist network as a climate-energy company profile; it publishes no public developer API, portal, SDK, or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Firestorm
providers.description: Firestorm (Firestorm Labs, Inc.) is a San Diego based defense technology company founded in 2022 that builds expeditionary manufacturing systems and modular unmanned aerial systems. Its xCELL containerized production unit uses HP Multi Jet Fusion additive manufacturing to 3D print industrial-grade PA-12 nylon composite airframes and spare parts at the tactical edge, feeding modular UAS platforms including the Tempest fixed-wing family and the Squall FPV drone. The company holds a five-year, $100M U.S. Air Force IDIQ and closed an $82M Series B in April 2026 led by Washington Harbour Partners. Firestorm ships hardware, not software: as of this profiling pass it publishes no developer portal, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Flatlooker
providers.description: Flatlooker (founded 2016) is a French digital real-estate agency for online rental search, tenant placement, and full rental property management (gestion locative). It now operates under the Manda brand (formerly Flatlooker and Hello Syndic); flatlooker.com redirects to manda.fr. Manda covers rental and property management, sales, condominium (syndic) management, and energy renovation for owners, tenants, investors, and co-ownerships across France, working primarily online — remote viewings, electronic dossiers and signatures, and mobile apps to track properties in real time — while relying on local agents in Paris, Lyon, and Marseille. Flatlooker was surfaced as a Partech portfolio company. It publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its live llms.txt and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Freespira
providers.description: Freespira is a digital therapeutics company that provides an FDA-cleared, at-home, medication-free treatment for panic disorder and PTSD symptoms. The program pairs a compact breathing sensor with a tablet app that gives patients real-time feedback while they retrain their breathing across two 17-minute daily sessions over a 28-day course, supported by weekly check-ins with Care Specialists. Freespira is sold through health plans, employers, provider organizations, and veterans programs rather than as a public developer platform. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Genesis Medtech
providers.description: Genesis MedTech is a global medical device company founded in Singapore in 2019, building and commercializing advanced clinical solutions across surgical, vascular intervention, and structural heart categories. It operates a vertically integrated platform that sources global medical technologies, develops them through in-house and partner R&D, manufactures at scale, and distributes across more than 30 countries. Its portfolio includes the J-Valve structural heart system, the iReach Omnia articulating powered surgical stapler, and neurovascular and peripheral vascular intervention product lines. Genesis MedTech is a portfolio company of Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China). It publishes a corporate and product marketing presence only; no public developer program, API, or technical documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Granata Bio
providers.description: Granata Bio is a reproductive-health biopharmaceutical company founded in 2018 and headquartered in the United States, focused on expanding access to fertility and IVF therapeutics across North America. The company identifies, licenses, and develops biopharmaceuticals spanning the in-vitro fertilization medication lifecycle from ovarian stimulation through luteal phase support, and is advancing a clinical pipeline that includes the Phase III GRACE Study. Granata Bio has raised over $30M, including a $14M Series A led by GV (Google Ventures) and a subsequent $15M Series A+. It operates a corporate and clinical web presence only and does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, or machine-readable interface; this profile captures its identity and web properties within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: GreatSchools
providers.description: GreatSchools provides school information, ratings, and quality data via its Developer Hub APIs, including the School Essentials API for school details and the School Quality API for GreatSchools rating bands.

providers.name: Grey Wolf Therapeutics
providers.description: Grey Wolf Therapeutics (Greywolf Therapeutics) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing a new therapeutic class of immunotherapies through antigen modulation, aimed at treating people living with cancers and autoimmune disorders. Its approach modulates antigen presentation on cell surfaces so T cells can correctly recognize and target diseased cells, and it is pioneering modulation of Signal 1 in the T cell activation cascade. Lead assets include GRWD5769, a first-in-class oral ERAP1 inhibitor for oncology in Phase 1/2 trials, and GRWD0715, an autoimmunity-focused asset also in Phase 1/2. Backed by Canaan Partners, the company was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio company profile. It is a corporate/scientific organization and publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Halia Therapeutics
providers.description: Halia Therapeutics, Inc. is a privately held clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Lehi, Utah, founded in 2017 and led by CEO Dr. David Bearss. Halia discovers and develops small-molecule therapies that target the immune system's inflammatory response — chiefly allosteric NEK7/NLRP3 inflammasome inhibition and LRRK2 inhibition — to resolve the chronic inflammation that drives hematologic, metabolic and neurodegenerative disease. Its lead clinical program, ofirnoflast (HT-6184), holds FDA Fast Track and Orphan Drug designation for lower-risk myelodysplastic syndromes; HT-4253, an LRRK2 inhibitor aimed at neuroinflammation and Alzheimer's prevention in APOE4 carriers, has completed a first-in-human Phase 1 study. The company also markets a "genetic resilience" research platform (GENMOR) built on family-cohort genomics. Halia is a drug developer, not a software vendor: it publishes a Webflow corporate site with pipeline, platform and press pages, and no developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Hexcel
providers.description: Hexcel Corporation (NYSE: HXL) is a global leader in advanced composite materials for the aerospace, defense and space, and industrial markets. Headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut and operating roughly 18 manufacturing facilities worldwide with about 5,800 employees, Hexcel produces HexTow carbon fiber, HexPly prepregs, HexWeb honeycomb, HexForce reinforcements, HexBond adhesives, HexFlow infusion resins, and HexTool tooling materials supplied into commercial aircraft, military platforms, space launch vehicles, wind energy blades, and industrial structures. Hexcel is a critical materials supplier to Boeing and Airbus and supports more than 100 defense programs; it has no public developer portal, REST APIs, SDKs, or machine-readable product catalog. Customer interaction with technical resources is PDF-based (datasheets, technology manuals, brochures), and the company's GitHub organization (github.com/Hexcel) is registered but empty.

providers.name: Integral Geometry Science
providers.description: Integral Geometry Science Inc. (IGS) is a Kobe University deep-tech spinout founded on 2 April 2012 by Dr. Kenjiro Kimura, who published the first analytical solution to the inverse problem of wave scattering. IGS turns that mathematics into measurement hardware and imaging software that makes the inside of an object visible without cutting it open: microwave mammography for painless, radiation-free breast cancer screening (designated under Japan's Sakigake scheme), non-destructive current-density imaging for rechargeable battery inspection, walk-through security screening for concealed hazardous materials, and rebar corrosion and fracture inspection for civil infrastructure. The company is headquartered in Kobe, Hyogo, Japan, holds patents across Japan, the United States, China and Europe, and is backed by SBI Investment and Japan's NEDO deep-tech program. IGS sells instruments and diagnostic systems to hospitals, manufacturers and infrastructure operators; it publishes no public developer program, API, or SDK.

providers.name: INURU
providers.description: INURU (Inuru GmbH) is a Berlin-based printed-electronics company that manufactures ultra-thin, flexible printed OLED lighting for smart packaging, labels, apparel, and medical products. Its core product, the Elf (Embeddable Luminous Film), combines an inkjet-printed OLED, a power source, and a microchip into a paper-thin, waterproof film that can glow in any shape and respond to touch, motion, or sound. Founded in 2016, Inuru operates the automated "Dragon Factory" OLED production line in Wildau and works with brands such as Coca-Cola and Marvel on interactive, sustainable smart-packaging and medication-adherence labels. This is a company/provider record in the API Evangelist network; Inuru is a hardware and smart-packaging manufacturer and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Istante
providers.description: Istante is an Italian technology company (VAT IT03635230547, based in the Perugia area) that develops and operates Athena, a business-process-automation platform built around a team of specialized AI assistants. Athena covers assistants for communication routing and email classification, credit management and collections, a 24/7 voice/phone assistant, quote and order processing, automated tender monitoring and scoring, outbound lead engagement, contract and legal analysis, and HR and onboarding. It is positioned to collaborate with staff rather than replace them, keeping critical decisions under human oversight, and is offered on a fixed-cost "Digital Working Units" (DWU) pricing model rather than variable token pricing. The platform integrates across email, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp, SMS, and phone, and is presented as GDPR and EU AI Act compliant. Istante was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Jarvie
providers.description: Jarvie is a consumer AI assistant from All Day Technologies, Inc. that lives inside iMessage and SMS group chats. Marketed as "your group chat sidekick," it helps people who text together plan events, learn things, and have fun, and can draft emails and create calendar events on a user's behalf. It offers memory features to personalize responses across conversations. Jarvie is a mobile-messaging consumer product surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners; as of this profile it does not publish a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Jobvetta
providers.description: Jobvetta is a jobs API for India — live openings gathered and checked against official employer sources, exposed as a REST API and a hosted MCP server that share one key. Search by keyword, Indian city or state, and posting age; fetch full structured detail for a single job. It is India-only by design: non-Indian locations return no results. The MCP server answers tools/list without credentials, so an agent can discover the two tools before signing up, and installation is a single documented `claude mcp add` command. Free during early access, with a shared limit of 50 tool calls per day and up to 20 jobs per search across both surfaces.

providers.name: Kanvas Biosciences
providers.description: Kanvas Biosciences is a spatial biology company building a microbiome drug screening, discovery, and manufacturing platform to accelerate development of next-generation live biotherapeutics. Its proprietary High-Phylogenetic-Resolution Spatial Mapping (HiPR-Map) platform uses oligonucleotide probes targeting ribosomal and messenger RNA to visualize microbial identity and cellular function within tissue across all kingdoms of life, illuminating host-microbiome interactions. The company advances a microbiome-based immuno-oncology pipeline (lead candidate KAN-001) and operates GMP manufacturing. Backed by DCVC. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company profile; the enrichment pass found no public developer API, SDK, or well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: LB Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: LB Pharmaceuticals Inc (Nasdaq: LBRX) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered at One Pennsylvania Plaza, New York, developing novel therapies for neuropsychiatric diseases including schizophrenia and bipolar depression. Its lead asset, LB-102, is an oral small-molecule benzamide antipsychotic with potent D2, D3 and 5HT7 antagonism, positioned to become the first benzamide antipsychotic approved for neuropsychiatric disorders in the United States. The company reported positive Phase 2 schizophrenia results from its NOVA1 trial in January 2025 and initiated the ILLUMINATE-1 Phase 2 bipolar depression trial in January 2026. LB Pharmaceuticals is a drug developer, not a software vendor: it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract, and its web presence is a WordPress corporate and investor-relations site.

providers.name: Level AI
providers.description: Level AI (legally Ujwal Inc.) is a Mountain View, California contact center AI company founded in 2019 by Ashish Nagar, a former member of Amazon's Alexa conversational AI team. The company builds LLM-native customer experience intelligence and service automation for enterprise contact centers, with a platform spanning two product surfaces: a CX Delivery suite (AI Virtual Agent, Agent Assist, AgentGPT, Coaching, Manager Assist, Knowledge Bot, Auto Summary, Agent Screen Recording) and a CX Strategy suite (Auto-QA on 100% of interactions, Voice of the Customer theme detection, omnichannel Analytics, iCSAT, AI Workers). The proprietary full-stack AI platform includes Level AI's own ASR/Voice AI and semantic-intelligence layer trained on customer-service data, and is positioned for financial services, insurance, healthcare, retail, banking, and collections operations. Level AI exposes a public REST API for bidirectional data exchange with BI tools and existing contact center stacks, and ships native integrations across telephony, CRM, customer support, workforce management, CX management, communication, learning management, and SSO categories. The company has raised $73.1M to date (Series A 2021, Series B 2022 led by Battery Ventures, Series C $39.4M 2024 led by Adams Street Partners with Cross Creek, Brightloop, Battery Ventures and Eniac Ventures), holds a 4.7/5 rating on G2, and reports customer outcomes including 25% CSAT lift, 45% agent satisfaction improvement, and 90% time savings on manual QA. The Level AI GitHub organization (github.com/Level-AI) exists but is currently empty — there is no public OpenAPI specification, public SDK, or open-source release; the API is documented and credentialed through the customer's tenant of the Level AI platform.

providers.name: Levicept
providers.description: Levicept Ltd is a UK-based clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered at Innovation House, Discovery Park in Sandwich, Kent, developing LEVI-04, a fully human chimeric fusion protein combining the Fc fragment of human immunoglobulin G1 with the p75 neurotrophin receptor (p75NTR) for the treatment of chronic pain. LEVI-04 is a first-in-class neurotrophin-3 (NT-3) inhibitor designed to restore neurotrophin homeostasis and deliver analgesia without the use-limiting side effects — notably rapidly progressive osteoarthritis — seen with anti-NGF antibodies. The company completed a 510+ participant Phase II study in osteoarthritis of the knee (NCT05618782) that met all primary and secondary endpoints, published the results in The Lancet in March 2026, and had its IND accepted by the US FDA in January 2026. Levicept is backed by Medicxi, Pfizer Ventures, Gilde Healthcare, Advent Life Sciences and Innovate UK. Levicept is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor: it operates a WordPress corporate website and publishes no API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Linux Foundation Europe
providers.description: Linux Foundation Europe is a regional hub under the Linux Foundation for European open source projects, governance, and collaboration. It hosts OpenWallet Foundation, Servo, NeoNephos, and other projects, providing a European framework for open source innovation and digital sovereignty.

providers.name: Loyal
providers.description: Loyal (Cellular Longevity, Inc.) is a clinical-stage veterinary biotechnology company developing drugs intended to extend the healthy lifespan of dogs. Its lead programs — including LOY-002 for metabolic dysfunction in senior dogs and LOY-001/LOY-003 for large- and giant-breed dogs — are advancing through the FDA Center for Veterinary Medicine approval process, with more than 1,300 dogs enrolled across clinical studies. Loyal also runs a veterinary Learning Hub for practitioner education. The company is backed by Bain Capital Ventures and First Round Capital. As of this enrichment pass Loyal publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface; this profile captures its public web identity and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Lyte
providers.description: Lyte is a Mountain View, California perception company building an end-to-end integrated vision system for robotics and Physical AI. Founded in 2021 by Alexander Shpunt, Arman Hajati and Yuval Gerson — architects of Apple's depth-sensing and Face ID perception stack, and, in Shpunt's case, co-founder and CTO of PrimeSense — the company emerged from stealth in January 2026 with $107M in aggregate funding from Fidelity Management & Research, Atreides Management, Exor Ventures, Key1 Capital, Avigdor Willenz's group and Venture Tech Alliance. Its flagship product, LyteVision, combines 4D sensing (distance plus velocity), RGB imaging and inertial motion awareness with custom silicon and software into a single plug-and-play perception platform for robots, mobility and next-generation automation; it won a CES 2026 Best of Innovation award in Robotics and was named an honoree in Vehicle Tech and Advanced Mobility. Lyte is collaborating with NVIDIA to stream perception into GPUs over Holoscan Sensor Bridge (zero-copy, Jetson Thor, CUDA, NITROS) and into Omniverse and Isaac Sim for real-time digital twins. Lyte ships hardware and an embedded perception stack rather than a developer platform, and publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract as of this profile.

providers.name: Mestag Therapeutics
providers.description: Mestag Therapeutics is a clinical-stage immunotherapy company based in Cambridge, UK, developing new treatments for cancer and inflammatory diseases by targeting the understudied role of activated fibroblasts in immune responses. Its lead cancer program, MST-0312, is a targeted LTBR-agonist bispecific antibody designed to drive tertiary lymphoid structure (TLS) formation in solid tumors and is now in the Phase I STARLYS trial. Its inflammatory-disease program, M402, uses agonist antibodies against stromal inhibitory receptors for conditions including rheumatoid arthritis, inflammatory bowel disease, and lupus. Backed by GV, Mestag is a privately held biotech and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Moonwalk Biosciences
providers.description: Moonwalk Biosciences is a biotechnology company pioneering therapeutics in adipose (fat) biology, driven by deep genetic and epigenetic insights. Co-founded by Alex Aravanis (CEO), Arash Jamshidi (President & CTO), Justin Valley (Chief Platform Officer), and CRISPR pioneer Feng Zhang, the company develops epigenetic and siRNA-based programs — including obesity therapies — and is backed by Khosla Ventures, ARCH Venture Partners, Google Ventures, Future Ventures, Alpha Wave Global, and YK Bioventures. Moonwalk does not currently publish a public developer program, API, or API documentation; this profile captures its corporate identity and web presence in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Nchroma Bio
providers.description: nChroma Bio is a genetic medicines company developing durable in vivo therapies by pairing best-in-class genetic cargoes, including epigenetic editing approaches, with targeted delivery technologies for diseases of significant unmet need. Headquartered at 201 Brookline Avenue in Boston, Massachusetts, the company is backed by DCVC and GV. This is a corporate research and therapeutics organization; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, documentation portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: NWMLS
providers.description: NWMLS is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: market-gap:real-estate) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Octant Bio
providers.description: Octant (Octant Bio) is a precision-medicine and therapeutics company based in Emeryville, California, founded by Sri Kosuri and Ramsey Homsany. Octant engineers small-molecule drugs that modulate cellular mechanisms behind serious disease, with a focus on protein misfolding and mistrafficking disorders. Its Navigator platform merges synthetic biology, massively parallel experimentation in human cells, high-throughput chemistry, and AI/ML to understand and modulate how target proteins actually behave inside cells. Programs span rare genetic diseases (including autosomal dominant retinitis pigmentosa and Fabry disease), oncology, metabolism, and immunology. Octant is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Catalio Capital Management. As of this profile Octant publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this record captures the company's public web identity in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: PacifiCorp
providers.description: PacifiCorp, a Berkshire Hathaway Energy subsidiary headquartered in Portland, Oregon, is an electric utility serving customers in six western states as Pacific Power (Oregon, Washington, California) and Rocky Mountain Power (Utah, Wyoming, Idaho), and operates the PACE and PACW balancing authority areas. It publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: PIN
providers.description: PIN (getpin.xyz) is a fintech platform that makes it easy to launch and operate an investment club or syndicate, handling the administrative, legal, and tax work for group startup investments so a community can pool capital and invest in VC-backed startups together. Members onboard in a few simple steps, commit to deals, vote, and PIN manages the tax filings and portfolio support for the lifecycle of the club. PIN is venture-backed by Initialized, NEA, Industry Ventures and others. As of this enrichment pass PIN publishes only a marketing site and a member web app (app.getpin.xyz); no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, or /.well-known discovery surface was found.

providers.name: Preveta
providers.description: Preveta is a healthcare software company that builds an AI-driven care navigation platform and "command center" for specialty clinics. Built on clinical pathways, its software transforms EMR data into actionable insights, giving oncology, urology and gastroenterology practices an entirely new way to view, navigate and manage their patient populations across the cancer care continuum. Preveta is backed by Bullpen Capital and Techstars. As of this profile the company markets a closed clinical SaaS product and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Razor Group
providers.description: Razor Group (Whele LLC) is a Berlin- and Boston-headquartered consumer goods holding company that acquires, consolidates and scales profitable e-commerce brands selling on Amazon FBA, Walmart, Target, Chewy and other online marketplaces. Founded in 2020, the company has raised over $1 billion, employs 450+ people across five offices in Europe, North America and Asia, and operates more than 40,000 SKUs across brands including GymKeg, POWRX, Tranquil Spa and Porto Vino. In August 2025 Razor merged with Infinite Commerce to form the largest consolidator in the FBA aggregator space, operating a unified internal technology platform for demand forecasting, pricing and advertising. Razor Group is a buyer and operator of physical consumer products, not a software vendor: it publishes no public API, SDK, webhook surface or developer portal.

providers.name: Reify Health
providers.description: Reify Health is a clinical research technology company whose mission is to remove clinical trial operations as the bottleneck to delivering new therapies to patients. It is the parent organization behind OneStudyTeam, whose StudyTeam platform is a cloud-based patient enrollment and recruitment management system connecting research sites, sponsors, patients, and vendors on a unified workspace, and Care Access, a business unit expanding trial access to underserved communities. StudyTeam is used by roughly 70% of the sponsors running the most clinical trials (including Amgen, AstraZeneca, and Eli Lilly), across 10,000+ research sites in 100+ countries. Reify Health is backed by Altimeter Capital, Battery Ventures, ICONIQ Capital, and Sierra Ventures. No public developer API, developer portal, or API specification was found during enrichment; this profile captures company identity, links, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Riksbank
providers.description: Riksbank, Sveriges Riksbank, is Sweden's central bank responsible for monetary policy, financial stability, and issuing currency. It provides statistical data and APIs for interest rates, exchange rates, and financial market statistics, supporting developers and researchers with programmatic access to economic indicators.

providers.name: sanegenebio
providers.description: SanegeneBio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing RNAi (RNA interference) genetic medicines for metabolic, cardiovascular, and complement-mediated autoimmune diseases, including obesity. Its proprietary LEAD (Ligand and Enhancer Assisted Delivery) platform enables receptor-mediated, targeted delivery of siRNA therapeutics to adipocytes, skeletal myocytes, and other tissues beyond the liver. The company operates as a fully integrated global biotech and has raised over $150 million to advance its pipeline. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes a corporate website (about, technology, pipeline, news, contact) but no public developer, API, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Scribe Therapeutics
providers.description: Scribe Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company founded in 2018 and headquartered in Alameda, California, engineering CRISPR-based genetic medicines through its proprietary "CRISPR by Design" platform. Co-founded by molecular engineers Benjamin Oakes, Brett Staahl, and David Savage alongside CRISPR co-inventor Jennifer Doudna, the company builds highly engineered CasX-derived enzymes — including its X-Editing (XE) molecules for precise gene editing and ELXR epigenetic long-term X-repressor technology for durable gene silencing without altering the underlying DNA sequence. Scribe focuses initially on cardiometabolic disease, the leading cause of death globally, and expands into areas such as sickle cell disease and neurological conditions through strategic pharmaceutical partnerships. The company is backed by a16z and Menlo Ventures and was surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a venture portfolio company. Scribe Therapeutics is a therapeutics and drug-discovery company and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documented API surface.

providers.name: Semios
providers.description: Semios (legally SemiosBio Technologies Inc., Vancouver, British Columbia, founded 2010 by Michael Gilbert) is a precision-agriculture company that operates a large in-canopy IoT sensor network for permanent crops - almonds, apples, cherries, citrus, grapes, pears, pistachios, stone fruit and walnuts. Its sensors report climate, soil moisture, insect trap counts and plant-stress readings on roughly ten-minute intervals, and its platform layers degree-day models, disease and frost risk models and machine learning on top of that feed to drive insect pest management (including variable-rate aerosol mating disruption), disease management, frost management, irrigation and water management, plant-stress monitoring, and alerting and reporting. Growers and agronomists consume it through the Semios Hub web and mobile applications, backed by the hub-api.semios.com service. Semios acquired Agworld, Altrac and Centricity, and in October 2024 the group unified those brands under the Almanac name, with Semios continuing as the sensing and crop-protection brand. Semios does not operate a public developer portal - the Hub API is customer and partner authenticated, and integrations such as the WiseConn irrigation integration are arranged directly.

providers.name: Sequence Bio
providers.description: Sequence Bio is a life sciences and population genomics company based in St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada, focused on discovering the genetic causes of disease to power the development of new medicines. The company leverages the founder-effect genetics of the Newfoundland and Labrador population, running a large-scale Study of the Genetic Causes of Inherited Disease to identify novel drug targets and predictors of treatment response for pharmaceutical partners. Surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and profiled in the API Evangelist network; the company publishes a corporate and research website but does not currently expose a public developer program, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Silo
providers.description: Silo is a cloud-based ERP platform built specifically for the fresh-produce supply chain, serving growers, packers, shippers, and distributors. The platform unifies produce operations across five modules - a diversified produce ERP, labor and asset management, payments and financial operations, EDI and traceability, and analytics and intelligence - to improve operational efficiency and financial visibility for small to midsize produce businesses. Silo is backed by a16z and Initialized Capital. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation.

providers.name: TakeCareOS
providers.description: TakeCareOS is an AI-powered operating system for home care and disability-services agencies. It consolidates fragmented back-office operations — shift rostering and scheduling, GPS-enabled clock-in/out, participant/client CRM, shift notes and incident reporting, timesheet management with variance detection, invoice generation synced to accounting tools (Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks), team messaging, and compliance and credential tracking — into a single platform. An AI assistant called Atlas drafts documentation, converts PDF forms to digital, and automates administrative work while requiring human approval. Founded by Ragav Sachdeva and backed by Y Combinator (Spring 2026), the company is based in San Francisco and serves NDIS and Medicaid HCBS providers. As of this profile the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or programmatic integration surface.

providers.name: Tarefa
providers.description: Tarefa (tarefa.co) is an online study companion — "tu compañero de estudio" — for Spanish-speaking university and high-school students, offering structured learning paths, solved exercises ("ejercicios resueltos"), video tutorials, and practice materials across mathematics (calculus, differential equations, probability and statistics, numerical methods), physics (electromagnetism, Newtonian mechanics, energy), and chemistry (inorganic, organic, gas laws, atomic structure, electrochemistry). It is a subscription-based B2C EdTech platform backed by 500 Global. Tarefa exposes no public developer API or documentation at this time; this profile captures its public web surface and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Teap
providers.description: Teap is a collaboration and productivity platform providing APIs for workspace management, team coordination, real-time notifications, and analytics. The platform offers core REST APIs for managing users, workspaces, and tasks, along with webhook support for event-driven integrations and analytics endpoints for workspace insights.

providers.name: TouchBistro
providers.description: TouchBistro is an iPad-based restaurant point-of-sale (POS) and management platform covering payments, online ordering, reservations, loyalty, gift cards, marketing, inventory, labor, and reporting. TouchBistro does not publish an open, self-serve developer API or a public developer portal; it exposes a private, partner-only integration API. The CEO has publicly confirmed an API exists but is not openly promoted. Third-party software providers must apply to the integration partner program, be approved, and are issued monitored API keys under negotiated commercial terms (contact integratedpartners@touchbistro.com).

providers.name: TutorABC
providers.description: TutorABC (formerly iTutorGroup) is a Taiwan-headquartered online language-learning platform offering live one-on-one and small-group English and Chinese instruction to learners worldwide. Courses span conversational and business English, Mandarin Chinese, certification-exam prep, and study-abroad advising, delivered through a proprietary web and mobile classroom with matched tutors and partnerships with institutions such as Oxford and Cambridge. The company runs consumer learning sites alongside separate portals for tutor recruitment, learning consultants, and interviewer/onboarding workflows. TutorABC is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. It publishes no public developer API; this profile captures the company identity, its agent-facing llms.txt, and its domain-security posture surfaced by the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Universal Health Services
providers.description: Universal Health Services (UHS) is one of the nation's largest hospital management companies, operating acute care hospitals, behavioral health facilities, and ambulatory care access points across the United States and the United Kingdom. UHS manages approximately 400 facilities across 37 states, Washington DC, and the United Kingdom, providing acute care, behavioral health, and outpatient services. As a healthcare provider, UHS operates under CMS interoperability mandates using HL7 FHIR standards for patient data access.

providers.name: Warren
providers.description: Warren (Warren Investimentos e Gestao Patrimonial) is a Brazilian digital wealth-management and investment platform founded in 2017 and based in Porto Alegre. Regulated by Brazil's Central Bank, the CVM securities commission, and ANBIMA, Warren offers a goals-based, fee-only model spanning managed portfolios, ETFs, fixed income, global stocks, gold and crypto, private pension plans, life insurance, currency exchange, and business (PJ) accounts, plus a Warren for Business platform for investment professionals. It is backed by QED Investors, Ribbit Capital, and Citi Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Warren exposes no public developer API, documentation portal, or first-party SDK; its GitHub organization (warrenbrasil) contains internal engineering tooling and courseware rather than a consumer-facing API surface.

providers.name: Werner Enterprises
providers.description: Werner Enterprises is a leading transportation and logistics company providing truckload transportation services, logistics solutions, and supply chain management throughout North America. Founded in 1956 and headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska, Werner operates one of the largest fleets in the United States and offers freight brokerage, dedicated carriage, intermodal, and final-mile delivery services through its Werner Bridge℠ digital freight platform.

providers.name: WEX
providers.description: Fortune 1000 company WEX. Public API documentation has not yet been catalogued in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Wikimapia
providers.description: Wikimapia is a collaborative geographic wiki that layers crowdsourced place information onto satellite imagery. Launched in 2006, the platform covers over 32 million geographic objects contributed by its community. The REST API provides programmatic access to places, categories, streets, and geographic searches using API-key authentication. Responses are available in JSON and KML formats. The API supports bounding-box queries, coordinate-based nearest-place lookups, full-text search, and detailed place retrieval including geometry, photos, comments, and community-tagged categories.

providers.name: xiaoyi
providers.description: Xiaoyi Technology (小蚁科技), operated by Shanghai Yunyi Zhilian Technology (上海云蚁智联) and best known for its YI-brand cameras, is a Shanghai-based smart-imaging company that emerged from the Xiaomi ecosystem. It builds action cameras, the M1 mirrorless camera, smart home/security cameras, dash cams and in-car rearview systems, VR cameras, and handheld gimbals, and now positions itself around computer vision, edge intelligence, and edge computing solutions for smart mobility, smart home, smart retail, smart parks, and smart communities, selling through JD and Tmall storefronts. Surfaced as a Qiming Venture Partners portfolio company. No public developer API surface was found during enrichment - the developer subdomain (dev.xiaoyi.com) returns 502, api.xiaoyi.com serves only a placeholder page, and no API documentation, OpenAPI specs, official GitHub organization, or first-party registry packages were located.

providers.name: Acre Open Data
providers.description: Acre Open Data is a state government open-data portal for Brazil running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 20 datasets.

providers.name: AKASA
providers.description: AKASA is a generative AI company for healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM), building AI-powered products that automate coding, clinical documentation integrity (CDI), prior authorization status, and claim status work for hospitals and health systems. Its platform includes the Prebill Optimization Suite (Coding Optimizer and CDI Optimizer), AI Advisor, Auth Status, and Claim Status, trained on millions of clinical and financial documents. AKASA reports serving 650+ hospitals and 6,500+ outpatient facilities across all 50 states, with customers citing reductions in A/R days and hundreds of monthly staff hours saved. The company was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; it publishes no public developer API or documentation at this time.

providers.name: Alchemab Therapeutics
providers.description: Alchemab Therapeutics is a UK-based clinical-stage biotechnology company developing next-generation antibody therapeutics for hard-to-treat diseases. Its "Adaptive Immunity" platform identifies naturally resilient individuals, such as long-term cancer survivors, and harnesses their protective antibodies, using artificial intelligence and deep learning to translate these natural immune responses into novel human-derived therapeutics across neurodegeneration, oncology, and other areas of high unmet need. Alchemab was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and added to the API Evangelist network. As a research-stage therapeutics company it publishes no public developer API program, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications at this time.

providers.name: Aurelius Systems
providers.description: Aurelius Systems is a defense technology company building autonomous directed-energy laser defense platforms for counter-unmanned-aerial-system (C-UAS) missions. Its flagship product, Archimedes, fuses high-power lasers, advanced optical sensing, and AI-guided autonomous tracking into a compact, field-deployable platform that detects, tracks, and neutralizes Group 1 and Group 2 drone threats at the speed of light and a fraction of the cost of traditional interceptors. The system runs on grid, generator, or commercial off-the-shelf batteries, is designed to operate without human operators, and can be networked into modular defensive grids to protect troops, bases, and critical infrastructure. Founded in 2025 by Michael LaFramboise and John Marmaduke, the company raised a $10M seed round co-led by General Catalyst and Draper Associates and is partnered with American Rheinmetall. Aurelius currently publishes no public API, developer portal, or software developer surface — it is a directed-energy hardware company.

providers.name: AVI Networks
providers.description: AVI Networks builds a software-defined application delivery platform - the Avi Vantage Platform / Avi Load Balancer - providing multi-cloud load balancing, web application firewall (WAF), GSLB, container ingress, and analytics driven by a central Avi Controller with a fully programmable REST API. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Santa Clara, California, AVI Networks was acquired by VMware in 2019 and the product is now offered by Broadcom as the VMware Avi Load Balancer. The controller exposes a comprehensive REST API with first-party Python, Go, and Java SDKs, a Terraform provider, and Ansible automation for intent-based, self-service application services across VMware, AWS, Azure, GCP, OpenStack, and bare-metal environments.

providers.name: Aware Health
providers.description: Aware Health is an AI-powered musculoskeletal (MSK) care platform that helps employers, health plans, and brokers reduce MSK spend while preventing orthopedic surgeries and chronic pain. The company pairs licensed clinicians (physical therapists and health coaches) with an AI "Predict" engine to triage, navigate, and manage musculoskeletal conditions virtually, and reports reducing MSK costs by roughly 30%. Its platform spans MSK care, chronic care, surgery decision support, member navigation, analytics, and an employer dashboard, delivered via web and an iOS app. Aware Health is a Techstars portfolio company and has raised seed funding (including a $3M round led by Boomerang VC with Bright Ventures). This profile was enriched from the company's public web surface; Aware Health does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Bahia Blanca Open Data
providers.description: Bahia Blanca Open Data is a municipal government open-data portal for Argentina running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 221 datasets.

providers.name: Bahia Open Data
providers.description: Bahia Open Data is a state government open-data portal for Brazil running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 21 datasets.

providers.name: Beacon Power Services
providers.description: Beacon Power Services (BPS) is an African energy-technology company building software that helps electricity utilities and energy consumers manage the power grid more efficiently. Its platform spans three products: CAIMS, a customer and asset information management system for utility network, survey, installation, and new-service-connection management; Adora, a grid network management solution for commercial operations, network management, and field operations that helps utilities optimize operations and increase profitability; and Xepp, a consumer mobile app for energy consumption monitoring, instant electricity top-up, solar integration, and flexible payments. BPS serves utilities and distribution companies across Africa (clients include ECG and AEDC) and is backed by Partech. This profile currently has no public API or developer surface; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company lead.

providers.name: Bloomingdale's
providers.description: Bloomingdale's is an American luxury department store chain and a subsidiary of Macy's, Inc. Bloomingdale's does not publish a public developer portal; partner integration is delivered through the parent Macy's Inc. vendor and trade partner programs, drop-ship and EDI channels with suppliers, the Bloomingdale's affiliate program for marketing partners, and the shared Macy's Inc. technology platform powering Bloomingdale's commerce, loyalty, and fulfillment.

providers.name: Botamedi
providers.description: Botamedi Inc. develops marine phytochemical‑based therapeutics aimed at improving human and animal health. Established in 2001, the company leverages its proprietary SEANOL® technology to create safe, effective treatments derived from marine algae, targeting chronic degenerative diseases and promoting cellular health through natural compounds.

providers.name: Breaking
providers.description: Breaking is a biotech company focused on plastic degradation using engineered microorganisms and enzymes. Based in Cambridge, MA, Breaking develops solutions to break down various plastics, offering data, research, and commercial applications to reduce plastic waste in the environment.

providers.name: Candela
providers.description: Candela is a Swedish manufacturer of electric hydrofoiling boats and ferries, on a mission to decarbonize waterborne transportation. Its proprietary computer-controlled hydrofoil system, C-Pod electric propulsion, and C-Foil technology lift the hull clear of the water to cut energy consumption by roughly 80% versus conventional planing hulls, enabling silent, long-range, zero-emission travel. Products span leisure craft (the C-8 and C-7 dayboats) and professional vessels (the P-12 electric ferry and shuttle for public and commercial transport). Backed by EQT Ventures, Candela is a hardware and mobility company; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation. This record captures its public web presence and domain security posture.

providers.name: Causality Link
providers.description: Causality Link is a cloud‑based platform that reads and understands millions of words each day from thousands of sources worldwide. It surfaces the knowledge of millions of authors as causal links, explaining not just what is happening but why. The platform offers automated causation identification and analysis for finance, corporate strategy, and government policy, delivering transparent attributions and insights across industries.

providers.name: Codoxo
providers.description: Codoxo is an AI-driven healthcare cost-containment and payment-integrity platform serving health plans, PBMs, and government agencies across more than 80 million lives. Its Forensic AI Platform powers Provider Scope (pre-claim provider education), Audit Scope, Fraud Scope, and Payment Scope, alongside the generative ClaimPilot suite for clinical record review, compliance validation, and concept data mining. Codoxo was surfaced as a portfolio company of QED Investors and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, portal, or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures company identity and security posture only.

providers.name: Convergent Dental
providers.description: Convergent Dental, Inc. is a privately held dental equipment and technology manufacturer headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, best known for Solea, a 9.3 micron CO2 all-tissue dental laser cleared by the FDA for hard tissue, soft tissue and osseous indications. The Solea platform is marketed for anesthesia-free, blood-free and suture-free restorative, soft tissue, pediatric, implant and cosmetic procedures, and has been extended with Solea Perioguide for minimally invasive periodontal therapy, Solea Sleep and Solea Protect. The company sells and services through its own commercial organization and a distribution partnership with Patterson Dental, and supports clinicians with training and education, clinical studies, case studies and the annual Solea Summit. Convergent Dental publishes no public developer program, API documentation, machine-readable API contract or agent surface as of this profiling pass.

providers.name: Convergent Therapeutics

providers.name: First Tech Federal Credit Union
providers.description: First Tech Federal Credit Union is a federally chartered, member-owned, not-for-profit financial cooperative headquartered in San Jose, California, and one of the largest credit unions in the United States. It was founded to serve employees of the technology industry and their families, and its membership is drawn heavily from workers at major technology employers. As an NCUA-insured credit union, First Tech offers consumer and business deposit accounts, lending, mortgages, credit cards, and wealth services delivered primarily through its website and mobile apps. Like the vast majority of US credit unions, First Tech publishes no first-party public developer portal or documented open API; consumer-permissioned financial data sharing is handled through third-party data aggregators (such as Plaid, MX, Finicity, and Akoya) rather than a directly documented first-party API surface. US open finance is voluntary and fragmented — the Financial Data Exchange (FDX) standard and the CFPB Section 1033 Personal Financial Data Rights rule are still emerging — and no first-party FDX-conformant data-access API or published Section 1033 posture was found for First Tech during this review.

It also publishes Intent, a newsletter for careerists, and runs CareerMakers, a cohort course hosted on Maven. Powered by its agentic graphx foundation and built on Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Kubernetes), the suite unifies source intake, case processing, aggregate reporting, signal detection, risk management and regulatory compliance into one connected ecosystem via modules including /intake, /nucleus, /report, /signal, /assure and /comply. Available on Google Cloud Marketplace, the company raised a $3M seed round led by Bessemer Venture Partners in October 2025. Graph AI is in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: HALO Precision Diagnostics
providers.description: HALO Precision Diagnostics (HALO Dx) is a Menlo Park, California precision-diagnostics company that acquires community imaging centers and rebuilds them as what it calls Imaging Center 2.0 — next-generation diagnostic hubs where advanced imaging, genomics and biomarker testing are all performed under one roof. Its diagnostic ensemble combines whole-body and multiparametric MRI, PSMA-targeted PET (PYLARIFY), digital pathology, polygenic risk scoring, hereditary and proteomic testing, and AI-assisted interpretation, applied first to cancer — the prostate program adds MRI-guided targeted biopsy and MRI-guided TULSA-PRO focal ablation — and expanding into cardiovascular disease and dementia. The company is led by CEO Michael Uhl with co-founder Brian Axe as Chief Product Officer and Dr. John Feller as Chief Medical Officer. Clinical delivery happens in HALO's own centers; referring physicians reach orders, results and images through a vendor-operated provider portal (RoyalMD) and the eUnity enterprise image viewer, and HALO advertises EMR integration for pushing orders and pulling results as a service its vendors deliver rather than as an interface it publishes. HALO operates no public developer program, publishes no API documentation, ships no SDK, and serves no machine-readable API contract; the only JSON on halodx.com is the marketing site's stock WordPress core REST API.

Swoop uses an ultra-low-field (0.064T) magnet — a fraction of the field strength of conventional MRI — to deliver diagnostic brain imaging at the point of care in hospitals, neurology clinics, ICUs, and pediatric settings without dedicated shielded infrastructure. Its Optive AI software applies deep-learning image reconstruction to reduce noise and blur. Hyperfine is headquartered in Guilford, Connecticut and is backed by GV (Google Ventures). providers.name: Insurance Australia Group
providers.description: Insurance Australia Group (IAG, ASX: IAG) is the largest general insurance company in Australia and New Zealand, headquartered in Sydney and operating a portfolio of underwriting brands rather than a single consumer-facing label. In Australia it trades as NRMA Insurance, CGU, WFI, Swann Insurance and the digital-native ROLLiN'; in New Zealand as State, AMI, NZI and Lumley. Its lines of business are property and casualty — home and contents, motor, commercial, rural and farm, compulsory third party and specialty — split across a Direct Insurance Australia arm and an Intermediated Insurance Australia arm that sells through brokers and authorised representatives. IAG has no public, self-serve API surface. Probing every conventional developer hostname on iag.com.au, cgu.com.au and nrma.com.au found no developer portal and no published reference documentation; docs.iag.com.au exists but immediately redirects to a Microsoft Entra ID sign-in and is an internal wall, not a portal. What the probes did confirm is a real Apigee API gateway fronting three brand virtual hosts — api.iag.com.au, api.cgu.com.au and api.nrma.com.au — each returning an Apigee ApplicationNotFound fault at the root, meaning proxies exist but none is discoverable or documented to the public. A second round of probing added a fourth brand virtual host, api.wfi.com.au, and a publicly resolvable non-production Apigee organisation at test-api.iag.com.au. IAG has also deployed MuleSoft's Anypoint API Experience Hub and is migrating roughly 600 APIs onto it, with a stated intent to make them agent aware — a substantial API estate that is entirely internal. Broker and partner integration in this market runs through human-facing trading portals — CGU's PolicyPlace quote-and-bind platform, the Ebix Sunrise Exchange and the Steadfast Client Trading Platform — not through an open API programme. IAG does run a HackerOne vulnerability disclosure programme, and published an RFC 9116 security.txt across seven brand domains until it was withdrawn in mid-2025. Australia has the legal machinery for open insurance and no live obligation: the Consumer Data Right that opened banking and energy was flagged for general insurance and then paused, so nothing compels IAG to publish. This record is therefore an honest stub: a partner-gated carrier with a private gateway and zero public specifications.

providers.name: Path Robotics
providers.description: Path Robotics is a Columbus, Ohio autonomous welding robotics company founded in 2018 by brothers Andy and Alex Lonsberry (CEO and CTO) out of Case Western Reserve University. Its core technology is Obsidian, a physical-AI reinforcement-learning agent trained inside Path's proprietary Weld World Model on tens of millions of welded inches; Obsidian runs at the edge of each cell and makes real-time, seam-by-seam welding decisions using a sensor stack of two cameras plus four lasers that deliver sub-millimeter 360-degree awareness around the torch. Path markets the cells with a CapEx-free consumption model and reports 97%+ first-pass yield, 4x productivity, and 30% lower welding costs across customers including HII (America's largest military shipbuilder), Saronic, LAD Services, Tycrop, Mine Rite Technologies, and Millerbernd. In April 2026 Path announced Rove, a mobile welding system mounted on a quadruped platform, extending its addressable geometry beyond fixed-cell applications. The company has raised approximately $271M across Seed through Series D from Drive Capital, Matter Venture Partners, Tiger Global, Addition, and Yamaha Motor Ventures, with the most recent $100M Series D closing in October 2024. Path Robotics has no public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface; its GitHub organization contains roughly 50 repositories that are almost entirely upstream open-source forks (ROS, protobuf, abseil, ceres-solver, pytorch3d, etc.) used as internal build dependencies rather than published developer artifacts. Securly is deployed by school districts and integrates with the school technology stack - Google Workspace, Microsoft 365/Entra, Apple School Manager, and Student Information Systems via the OneRoster and rostering standards. Securly's public developer surface is limited and access-gated - it primarily CONSUMES rostering and identity APIs from external systems rather than exposing a documented public developer API. The one provider-exposed API is a credential-gated Securly MDM API used by third-party device/asset systems to pull device inventory and assign or unassign students to devices; its endpoints and base URL are provisioned per tenant and are not publicly documented as a reference.

providers.name: SheetRocks
providers.description: SheetRocks is a spreadsheet engine embedded directly into the business platforms teams already use. Branded "The Spreadsheet for Everywhere," it brings keyboard-driven data entry, formula-based analytics, and spreadsheet-in-the-loop workflows inside host applications such as Salesforce (live), WooCommerce and Gravity Forms (beta), and Shopify, HubSpot, and ServiceNow (announced). The product targets operators, analysts, and builders who want a familiar grid plus instant workflow invocation without leaving their platform of record. SheetRocks is a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta. As of this enrichment pass it exposes no public REST/GraphQL API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or webhook surface; it does publish product documentation, a free sandbox, and a responsible security-disclosure policy.

providers.name: SigTuple
providers.description: SigTuple Technologies is a medical-technology company that combines artificial intelligence, robotics, microfluidics and high-resolution digital microscopy to automate the microscopic analysis of biological samples across human and veterinary diagnostics. Its product portfolio includes AS76, a CE-IVDR compliant automated digital cell morphology analyzer for peripheral blood smears with true 100X oil immersion; AI100, an FDA- and CE-cleared multi-purpose analyzer for blood smear and urine sediment analysis; and SigVet, an AI point-of-care platform for veterinary clinics. Backed by Accel, the company reports 10+ years of R&D, 27 patents and 350+ deployments globally. As of this enrichment pass SigTuple publishes no public developer/API surface (no docs portal, OpenAPI, /.well-known discovery, or llms.txt were found); this profile captures identity plus a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: SunEdison
providers.description: SunEdison was a renewable energy company that developed, financed, installed, owned, and operated solar power plants and wind energy plants globally. Originally founded as MEMC Electronic Materials in 1959, SunEdison became the world's leading renewable energy developer before filing for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in April 2016 and emerging as a restructured private company in 2017. No public developer API was documented.

providers.name: Synaptic
