providers.description: Synaptic is a vertical AI solutions company that extends Salesforce and Agentforce environments with pre-built, industry-specific AI agents and applications. Its AQ Platform ships purpose-built agents for healthcare payers and providers (Provider AQ), government citizen services (Citizen AQ), and high-tech customer service (Service AQ), using a value-first methodology that promises measurable results within 30 days and full implementation within 90 days. Synaptic is a managed-delivery solutions and consulting firm rather than a self-service developer platform; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or technical documentation. Backed by Bloomberg Beta and Ribbit Capital.

providers.name: tagSpace
providers.description: tagSpace is a Spatial AI platform, part of the tagStorm group, that lets creators and brands publish interactive augmented-reality experiences and spatial content anchored to real-world places. Through its create, explore, and publish surfaces, tagSpace offers a creator-economy platform where makers showcase spatial "tags," and its tagAI layer applies AI to spatial content. It markets to brands and enterprises (B2B) with named partners including RTL, Telekom, Telstra, Warner Music Group and others. The public site is a Framer marketing presence; as of this enrichment pass tagSpace exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or well-known API metadata. This profile remains an identity-only company record.

providers.name: Tantalus
providers.description: Tantalus Systems (TSX: GRID; OTCQX: TGMPF) is a technology company that has served public power utilities and electric cooperatives for over 35 years, modernizing electrical distribution grids through data-centric solutions. Its Tantalus Grid Modernization Platform (TGMP) unifies intelligence across the distribution grid, connecting metering, load and DER management, grid automation, and data management across both legacy and modern infrastructure. Product lines include TRUConnect advanced metering infrastructure (AMI), TRUFlex load and DER management, TRUGrid automation analytics, TRUSync grid data management, and the TRUSense behind-the-meter gateway. Tantalus does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; integration with back-end utility software is delivered through standard data formats and handled via its technical support and integration teams.

providers.name: Tapestry
providers.description: Tapestry is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Tapestry API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: TPG
providers.description: TPG Inc is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The TPG Inc API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: TrustPoint
providers.description: TrustPoint, Inc. is a space technology company building a fully commercial, next-generation global navigation satellite system (GNSS) — a C-band LEO microsatellite constellation delivering secure positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) independent of GPS, with improved accuracy, faster time to first fix, and anti-jamming / anti-spoofing capabilities for automotive, aviation, critical infrastructure, and national security applications. Headquartered in Northern Virginia with an office in Mountain View, California, and backed by DCVC, TrustPoint does not currently publish a public API or developer portal.

providers.name: Una Brands
providers.description: Una Brands is a Singapore-headquartered, digital-age e-commerce house of brands that acquires and operates consumer e-commerce businesses across the APAC region, accelerating their growth with operational expertise and AI-led innovation from teams in Singapore, China, and Indonesia. The company publishes no public developer API, but its website ships an llms.txt and a live Wix Site MCP endpoint that lets AI agents retrieve business details, search products and services, book appointments, and start purchases.

providers.name: United Continental Holdings
providers.description: United Continental Holdings, now known as United Airlines Holdings, Inc., is the parent holding company of United Airlines. It was formed through the merger of United Airlines and Continental Airlines in 2010. As the parent company, it oversees United Airlines' operations, which include one of the world's largest airline route networks. The company's APIs and digital services are delivered through United Airlines.

providers.name: Vannevar Labs
providers.description: Vannevar Labs is a defense technology company that builds agentic AI for national security missions. Its Agent Orchestration platform fuses defense-grade foundational data, mission requirements, and strategic reasoning into mission-focused AI agents — spanning course-of-action, force-protection, information-operations, and cross-border pattern-analysis agents — used from tactical kill-chain decisions to theater-level campaigns. The company collects hard-to-reach data from adversarial information environments to train models for national security, and works across mission areas including Indo-Pacific deterrence, homeland security, and intelligent statecraft. Backed by General Catalyst; no public developer portal or API surface is published.

providers.name: Vedantu
providers.description: Vedantu is an Indian online-learning (edtech) company headquartered in Bangalore that delivers LIVE interactive classes, recorded courses, offline centres, and one-to-one tutoring for school students from Class 1 to 12 and competitive-exam aspirants, covering CBSE, ICSE, IGCSE and major State Boards plus JEE, NEET, CUET and Olympiad preparation, alongside a large free library of NCERT solutions, revision notes, sample papers and study material. Backed by Accel, Vedantu is consumer-facing and operates no public developer API today; its only published integration surface is a legacy External-Integration (EI) kit for institutes on GitHub, though it does publish an llms.txt for agents.

providers.name: Verkor
providers.description: Verkor is a French cleantech manufacturer founded in 2020 to fast-track low-carbon lithium-ion battery production in Europe. Operating a "digital by design" industrial model, Verkor produces high-performance battery cells and modules for electric mobility and stationary energy storage, scaling through its Dunkerque Gigafactory toward 16 GWh of annual cell capacity to serve the European market. Verkor is a physical-products/industrial company and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation; this profile captures its identity and public web surface within the API Evangelist network. Backed by EQT Ventures.

providers.name: Vivodyne
providers.description: Vivodyne is a bio-AI company working to make human biology computable through large-scale human tissue engineering. Its TissueDisk platform cultivates hundreds of self-assembling, vascularized human tissues on a single microfluidic disk, and its autonomous HIVE robotic labs cultivate, perturb, and analyze thousands of tissues to generate multi-modal phenomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic data at single-cell resolution for pharmaceutical drug discovery and AI model training. The company operates as a B2B partner to pharma and does not publish a public developer API; this profile tracks its public web surface within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Whiting Petroleum
providers.description: Whiting Petroleum was an independent oil and gas company engaged in the exploration, development, and production of crude oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids primarily in the Williston Basin (Bakken Shale) in North Dakota and Montana. In July 2022, Whiting Petroleum merged with Oasis Petroleum to form Chord Energy Corporation, which trades on NASDAQ under the ticker symbol CHRD.

providers.name: Aclarity Water
providers.description: Aclarity, Inc. (Aclarity Water) is a Medway, Massachusetts cleantech company that designs and manufactures on-site PFAS destruction technology. Its flagship Aclarity Octa system uses electrochemical oxidation to break the carbon-fluorine bond in per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), destroying these "forever chemicals" at landfills, centralized waste-treatment facilities, industrial sites (laundry, pulp and paper, automotive), municipal and industrial wastewater, drinking-water treatment, and AFFF-contaminated aviation sites. Aclarity is a portfolio company of DCVC. It is a physical water-treatment hardware and services business with no public developer API surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company intelligence.

providers.name: AcuraStem
providers.description: AcuraStem, Inc. is a privately held, patient-based biotechnology company headquartered in Monrovia, California, developing therapeutics for neurodegenerative diseases including sporadic ALS (amyotrophic lateral sclerosis) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD). The company's proprietary iNeuroRx drug-discovery platform builds disease models from induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSC) taken from individual patients, in place of animal models, and pairs them with machine-learning analysis to identify and validate targets. Its lead antisense oligonucleotide candidate, AS-241 (PIKFYVE), is advancing toward first-in-human testing with California Institute for Regenerative Medicine (CIRM) grant support. AcuraStem is a therapeutics developer rather than a software vendor: it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable contract of any kind. This profile records that absence with the probe evidence behind it.

providers.name: AI Dev Jobs
providers.description: AI/ML engineering job aggregator with REST, RSS, and MCP endpoints

providers.name: Allen Control Systems
providers.description: Allen Control Systems is a defense technology company building autonomous precision weapon stations that detect, track, and neutralize unmanned aerial systems (drones) for military and partner forces. Its Bullfrog family of robotic gun mounts (M240C, M2, M230, M134) pairs passive machine-vision drone detection with autonomous fire-control targeting, synthetic training-data generation, and low-collateral engagement options such as laser dazzlers and composite rounds. The systems use an open architecture to integrate with command-and-control platforms. Backed by Craft Ventures, the company is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a defense-sector provider; it publishes no public developer API, portal, or specification at this time.

providers.name: Alphaeon Credit
providers.description: Alphaeon Credit provides a credit card that allows patients to finance medical procedures such as dental work, plastic surgery, ophthalmology and dermatology treatments. The card offers special financing options for purchases over $250 with credit lines up to $25,000 and uses a soft inquiry that does not affect credit scores. Credit plans require minimum payments and are issued by Comenity Capital Bank, with approval subject to credit review.

providers.name: Andes
providers.description: Andes (Andes Ag, Inc.) is a climate-technology and agricultural-biotechnology company founded in 2018 and headquartered in Alameda, California. Andes engineers and selects beneficial soil microorganisms that are applied alongside seed in commodity row-crop production — corn, soybean, wheat and canola — where they accelerate the natural conversion of atmospheric carbon dioxide into stable soil inorganic carbon (carbonate minerals), a process the company calls Microbial Carbon Mineralization. Andes sells the resulting durable carbon dioxide removal as verified credits to corporate buyers and Scope 3 programs, and pays participating growers through the Andes Carbon Program. The company published the first Microbial Carbon Mineralization methodology, developed with EcoEngineers under ISO 14064, and has run field trials with Bayer, Cargill, Corteva, Nutrien and Wilbur-Ellis. Andes has raised roughly $38M, including a Series A co-led by Leaps by Bayer and Cavallo Ventures, and its shares trade on private secondary venues including EquityZen and Nasdaq Private Market. Andes publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Ashvattha Therapeutics
providers.description: Ashvattha Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing a new class of precision nanomedicines built on hydroxyl dendrimer therapeutics (HDTs), a platform exclusively licensed from Johns Hopkins University. Hydroxyl dendrimers traverse tissue barriers such as the blood-retinal and blood-brain barrier and are selectively taken up by activated cells in regions of inflammation, allowing known small-molecule drugs to be delivered intracellularly to diseased tissue with sustained effect and reduced off-target exposure. The company is advancing programs across ophthalmology, neurology, and inflammatory disease, led by migaldendranib (MGB), a first-in-class subcutaneously administered nanomedicine in Phase 2 development for diabetic macular edema and neovascular age-related macular degeneration, plus hydroxyl dendrimer PET imaging tracers such as [18F]OP-801. Founded by Jeffrey L. Cleland, Kannan Rangaramanujam, and Sujatha Kannan. Ashvattha publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: ATB Financial
providers.description: ATB Financial (formerly Alberta Treasury Branches) is a financial institution and Crown corporation wholly owned by the Government of Alberta, established in 1938 and operating under the provincial ATB Financial Act rather than the federal Bank Act. Headquartered in Edmonton, it is Alberta's largest home-grown financial institution and the largest public bank in North America, with roughly C$64 billion in assets, more than 800,000 customers, about 5,000 team members, and 300+ branches and agencies across the province; deposits are guaranteed by the Province of Alberta rather than covered by CDIC. On the open-finance front, ATB does NOT operate a public first-party developer portal or documented public API surface (developer.atb.com returns HTTP 404), and Canada's federal Consumer-Driven Banking framework (legislated in Budget 2024 and the Fall Economic Statement 2024, with the FCAC as overseer) is not yet operational. Consumer financial-data access to ATB today is therefore voluntary and aggregator-mediated — reached through third-party aggregators such as Finicity (by Mastercard) and Flinks rather than a direct bank API.

providers.name: AutoChilango
providers.description: AutoChilango (Auto Chilango) is a Mexico City-based mobile application that consolidates the everyday services drivers in CDMX and the State of Mexico need into a single app. It covers the "Hoy No Circula" driving-restriction calendar, vehicular verification schedules, traffic fines (multas) lookup and payment, annual registration (tenencia), insurance, parking, gas stations, and mechanical services for private cars, motorcycles, taxis, and special plates. Backed by 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer/API surface has been found, so this profile captures the provider's identity, information surface (blog, FAQs, privacy), and probed domain security.

providers.name: Axolotl
providers.description: Collection of axolotl pictures and facts

providers.name: B&L Information Systems
providers.description: B&L Information Systems, LLC is a metalcasting-focused enterprise resource planning (ERP) software company founded more than 50 years ago and headquartered in Bridgman, Michigan. Its flagship product, Odyssey ERP, is a cloud-based ERP purpose-built for foundries, die casters, and investment casters, spanning manufacturing, sales, inventory, quality, finance, and data analytics. B&L pairs the software with implementation, consulting, data-conversion, training, and support services tailored to the metalcasting industry. The company is a portfolio company of Battery Ventures. As of this enrichment pass, B&L does not publish a public developer portal, REST API documentation, SDKs, or an OpenAPI definition, so this profile captures company identity and public web properties rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Ball Corporation
providers.description: Ball Corporation is a global supplier of sustainable aluminum packaging for beverage, food, personal care, and household products, as well as aerospace and other technologies and services for commercial and government customers. Ball operates more than 80 manufacturing plants worldwide and is a leader in aluminum can sustainability and recycling.

providers.name: Beautyhaul
providers.description: Beautyhaul is an Indonesian e‑commerce platform specializing in beauty products, offering a wide range of makeup, skincare, fragrance and personal care items. The site emphasizes original, BPOM‑approved products with discounts up to 50% off, catering to both local and multinational brands. It provides online shopping, store pick‑up, and detailed product information, aiming to solve skin concerns and deliver affordable beauty solutions.

providers.name: Billplz
providers.description: Payment platform

providers.name: Biosqueeze
providers.description: BioSqueeze is a biomineralization platform company that provides engineered solutions for challenging subsurface problems across energy, defense, mining, infrastructure, and environmental sectors. By strengthening soils, sealing fluid pathways, and healing fractures, BioSqueeze enables increased bearing capacity, leak control, and infrastructure repair, with over 400 field deployments worldwide.

providers.name: Bizongo
providers.description: Bizongo is a Mumbai-based B2B commerce and supply-chain platform founded in 2015 that digitizes procurement, vendor management, and supply-chain financing for enterprises across India, with a focus on packaging, raw materials, and made-to-order goods. It operates a SaaS-led vendor digitization stack plus an embedded-finance offering, connecting large buyers with a network of manufacturing partners. Bizongo is backed by Accel, Chiratae Ventures, B Capital, and others. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; as of this enrichment pass Bizongo publishes no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI definition, or /.well-known discovery surface — third-party logistics integration is offered only through carrier aggregators such as ClickPost, so most API-artifact scoring dimensions are not applicable.

providers.name: Bondai
providers.description: Bondai is a group-travel planning and booking platform, delivered primarily as a mobile app, that helps friends organize trips together in one place. It targets millennials and tackles the friction of collaborative travel by combining itinerary coordination, deal discovery, destination inspiration, group communication, expense splitting, and booking of experiences into a single social workflow. The company frames its mission around "travel dreams made real" and lasting friendships formed through travel. Bondai also curates and sells local experiences and stays (villas, tours, and guided outings), with early activity concentrated around Saudi Arabian destinations such as AlUla, Makkah, Madina, Jazan, and Tabuk. It is a consumer travel product with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time. Bondai is a portfolio company of 500 Global and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Brandywine Realty Trust
providers.description: Brandywine Realty Trust (NYSE: BDN) is a publicly traded, fully integrated real estate investment trust (REIT) headquartered at Cira Centre in Philadelphia. The company owns, develops, leases, and manages a roughly 22 million square foot portfolio of office, life science, mixed-use, multifamily, retail, and education properties concentrated in the Greater Philadelphia, Austin, and Washington, D.C. markets. Brandywine is the developer behind Schuylkill Yards, uCity Square, Uptown ATX, Broadmoor, and Discovery Point, and has delivered roughly $2.6 billion and 12.1 million square feet of ground-up developments, master-planned communities, and adaptive reuse projects over a 30+ year operating history.

providers.name: Brightspec
providers.description: Brightspec provides advanced molecular rotational resonance (MRR) spectroscopy instruments, consumables, and software solutions for analytical chemistry. Their platform offers high‑resolution spectral analysis for pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, cosmetics, and chemical industries, enabling precise identification, quantitation, and chiral analysis of compounds. Brightspec’s offerings include hardware such as SpectraMRR, IsoMRR, NanoMRR, and software like BrightHub and Edgar, supporting comprehensive analytical workflows.

providers.name: Calamu Technologies
providers.description: Calamu Technologies is a data-first cybersecurity company founded in 2019 and headquartered in Clinton, New Jersey. Its flagship product, Calamu Protect (Data Harbor), is a cyber vault for backup and recovery data that uses a patented process to fragment and scatter data across multiple storage locations, rendering it valueless ("Digital Sludge") to attackers even if breached and instantly reassembling it for authorized applications and users. Calamu integrates with enterprise backup platforms including Veeam, Veritas NetBackup, Dell EMC, Nutanix, Wasabi, and StarWind, and exposes an S3-compatible storage interface for data protection. The company is backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Canworks
providers.description: Canworks is a digital printing company specializing in direct‑to‑can aluminum printing for beverage brands. Based in the United States, it offers low‑minimum runs, fast turn‑around, and sustainable, sleeve‑free packaging solutions. The service includes artwork upload, prototyping, and full‑production printing, serving over 700 brands with high‑quality custom cans.

providers.name: Celerion (H.I.G. Capital)
providers.description: Celerion is a global contract research organization (CRO) specializing in early-stage clinical research, Phase I clinical trials, clinical pharmacology, and bioanalytical services that accelerate drug development from first-in-human studies through proof-of-concept. Headquartered in Lincoln, Nebraska with clinical and bioanalytical sites across North America and Europe, Celerion supports pharmaceutical and biotechnology sponsors with healthy-volunteer and special-population studies, bioanalysis, biomarker assays, ECG/cardiac safety, and its LabNotes bioanalytical data-management software. The company is a portfolio holding of H.I.G. Capital and was surfaced to the API Evangelist network via the bain-capital-ventures portfolio graph. As a corporate/marketing web presence with no public developer or API program, this profile carries only the artifacts that could be observed on the public web (llms.txt, domain-security posture).

providers.name: Chairish
providers.description: Chairish is an online marketplace for buying and selling vintage and used furniture, decor, and art. It connects collectors and designers with curated, high-quality pieces, offering a curated shopping experience and a platform for sellers to consign items. The site features a wide range of categories including furniture, lighting, rugs, and accessories, emphasizing style and sustainability.

providers.name: Chefs for Seniors
providers.description: Chefs for Seniors is an in-home personal chef service for older adults, founded in 2013 by Barrett and Nathan Allman. Locally-owned franchise chefs come to a senior's home to plan menus, grocery shop, and cook 10-15 servings of fresh, customized meals each visit for about the cost of meal delivery. Menus rotate across 175+ options and accommodate diabetic, low-sodium, kidney-friendly, vegetarian, and other dietary needs, reviewed by a Registered Dietitian. The company operates across roughly 99 US locations, serves about 15,000 clients, and has prepared over 2.5 million meals. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global. Chefs for Seniors publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or machine-readable specifications; this profile captures its public web and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Cholamandalam
providers.description: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company (Chola) is an Indian non-banking financial company (NBFC) headquartered in Chennai and part of the Murugappa Group (CIN L65993TN1978PLC007576). It provides lending across vehicle finance (commercial vehicles, cars, two-wheelers, three-wheelers, tractors and construction equipment), home loans and loan against property, SME/MSME and business loans, supply chain finance, gold loans, and consumer and personal loans through a branch network across India. No public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs were found during enrichment; the company operates consumer/branch and mobile-app (Chola One) channels rather than a published developer program. Group affiliates include Chola Securities and the Gaadi Bazaar vehicle marketplace.

providers.name: CityBlock Capital
providers.description: CityBlock Capital is an early‑stage venture fund focused on building infrastructure for capital markets. Based in New York, the firm invests in fintech, trading technology, and related services, aiming to support innovative solutions that improve market efficiency and accessibility. The team leverages deep industry expertise to partner with founders, providing capital, strategic guidance, and network connections to accelerate growth.

providers.name: Clasp Therapeutics
providers.description: Clasp Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage precision immuno-oncology company developing next-generation T cell engagers (TCEs) built on its proprietary pHLAre platform, which redirects T cells to mutant peptides — such as p53 R175H and mutant KRAS — presented by specific HLA molecules on the surface of tumor cells. The approach is intended to yield off-the-shelf, antibody-like medicines that hit common oncogenic driver mutations with tumor-exclusive specificity. Its lead candidate CLSP-1025 (p53 R175H / HLA-A*02:01) is in the Phase 1 GUARDIAN-101 trial (NCT06778863), and CLSP-5282, a first-in-class KRas-directed TCE, was unveiled at AACR 2026. Founded on research from Bert Vogelstein, Drew Pardoll and colleagues at Johns Hopkins, the company launched in March 2024 with $150 million led by Catalio Capital Management, Third Rock Ventures and Novo Holdings, and operates from Cambridge, Massachusetts and Rockville, Maryland. Clasp Therapeutics is a therapeutics developer and publishes no public API, developer program, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Clearwave
providers.description: Clearwave is a patient revenue-cycle and self-service engagement platform for healthcare practices, covering online scheduling, self-service registration and intake, multi-factor insurance eligibility verification, and patient payments. Rather than publishing an open developer API, Clearwave connects to more than 50 electronic health record (EHR) and practice management (PM) systems - including athenahealth, NextGen, eClinicalWorks, Modernizing Medicine, Veradigm, Nextech, Greenway, and Unlimited Systems - through formal, partner-gated API license and integration agreements. Data such as appointments, patient demographics, eligibility results, and payments flows bidirectionally between Clearwave and the practice's EHR/PM in real time. There is no public, self-service developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or documented public WebSocket API; the API surfaces below are logical capability areas modeled from Clearwave's product documentation, not publicly documented endpoints.

providers.name: Clever Real Estate
providers.description: Clever Real Estate operates a real‑estate brokerage platform based in Dallas, Texas, offering a low‑commission model for buying, selling, and renting properties. The site provides tools for agents, listings, community information, and a streamlined process for clients, emphasizing customer service and transparency. It includes a public API for accessing property data, agent details, and transaction services, supporting integration with third‑party real‑estate applications.

providers.name: Cloudwell
providers.description: Cloudwell (cloudwell.io) is a Microsoft 365 and Azure-focused software partner founded in 2012, offering a suite of SharePoint and Teams apps: Calendar Overlay, Org Chart, Staff Directory, Team Members, and Viva Announcements - all distributed via Microsoft AppSource. Cloudwell does not publish a public REST API; their products are consumed inside SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, and Viva Connections via SharePoint Framework (SPFx) web parts and the Microsoft Graph API. The "opal" suffix in this repository name is preserved for index continuity but Cloudwell does not currently ship a product named Opal.

providers.name: Complementtherapeutics
providers.description: Complement Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing precision therapies for complement-mediated diseases, including geographic atrophy, a form of age-related macular degeneration. The company advances novel treatments targeting the complement system, with a pipeline of programs and a dedicated scientific team.

providers.name: Crewline
providers.description: Crewline is an autonomous heavy-equipment company that retrofits existing construction machinery to operate self-driving. Its hardware retrofit kit installs on-site in about an hour and adds autonomy to drum rollers today (compatible with Caterpillar, Bomag, Hamm, Volvo, and CASE), with dozers on the 2027 roadmap and rock trucks, excavators, motor graders, and wheel loaders in development. It is offered on a subscription model with zero upfront cost, a fixed monthly rate per machine, and 24/7 technical support, targeting earthworks and grading crews. Crewline is backed by Initialized Capital and headquartered in San Francisco. It publishes no public API or developer program at this time.

providers.name: Culina Health
providers.description: Culina Health provides virtual registered dietitian nutrition services, offering personalized nutrition care through telehealth. Their mission is to make expert nutrition accessible for everyone, addressing chronic health conditions with science‑based, inclusive, and culturally affirming dietitian support. They serve patients across the United States via an online platform, offering specialty programs for hormone health, weight loss, eating disorders, gastrointestinal health, and more.

providers.name: DailyDeal.de
providers.description: DailyDeal.de is a German consumer deals, coupons, and discounts platform ("Deals, Gutscheine & Schnäppchen") that aggregates daily deals across categories including electronics, fashion, home and garden, beauty, kids, sports, and free-to-try product samples ("gratis testen"). Shoppers browse discounted products, brand vouchers, and shop-specific coupon codes, and read shopping guides in the site's Magazin. Originally founded in Berlin in 2009 and briefly owned by Google, DailyDeal today operates as a WordPress-based consumer commerce and content site and publishes no public developer API program. It was added to the API Evangelist network as an Insight Partners portfolio lead.

providers.name: DayOne
providers.description: DayOne is a hyperscale data center company delivering next-generation digital infrastructure for cloud, AI, and edge computing workloads. Spun out of the GDS International business and backed by SoftBank Vision Fund 2, DayOne develops and operates strategically located, interconnected data center campuses across Asia-Pacific — Singapore, Johor (Malaysia), Batam (Indonesia), Hong Kong, Tokyo, and Bangkok — and is expanding into Europe with a launch market in Finland. The company positions itself as a build-to-suit and hyperscale partner focused on power availability, connectivity, and sustainable operations rather than as a public API or developer-platform provider; there is no public developer portal, API, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Dorado Software
providers.description: Dorado Software, Inc. is a Roseville, California infrastructure management software company whose Cruz and Redcell product families deliver resource management, orchestration, monitoring, and automation for data centers, AI infrastructure, enterprise campuses, and service-provider networks. The Cruz suite spans DCIM, network performance management, fabric and compute orchestration, compliance, and agentic-AI operations, discovering and controlling multi-vendor devices over SNMP, CLI, NETCONF, and REST/HTTPS. Dorado Software is backed by Insight Partners. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API, portal, or SDK surface was found.

providers.name: Dotterel
providers.description: Dotterel Technologies is an Auckland, New Zealand acoustics and audio-hardware company founded in 2015 out of the Callaghan Innovation C-Prize. It began by solving drone noise, building acoustic shrouds, low-noise propellers, and onboard active audio-recording systems for UAVs used in film, security, and noise mapping. That work led to Konos (now marketed as Konos Digital), an 80-element directional MEMS microphone array with a continuously variable 60-300 degree beam width that streams four channels of AES67 / SMPTE ST 2110 audio over a single Power-over-Ethernet cable, targeting film, broadcast, and live-sports production. The microphone exposes a firmware-updatable on-device HTTP control interface (a web page plus a POST control endpoint for beam steering) rather than a public developer web API. Dotterel is backed by Techstars (Adelaide 2017 cohort) and is tracked here as a hardware company; it publishes no public API specification, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Dycom Industries
providers.description: Dycom Industries is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Dycom Industries API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Eleqtron
providers.description: eleQtron GmbH is a German quantum computing hardware company founded in 2020 as a spin-off from the Quantum Optics Department at the University of Siegen by Prof. Dr. Christof Wunderlich, Dr. Michael Johanning (CTO), and Jan Leisse (CEO). Based in Siegen, Germany, eleQtron develops freely programmable, scalable trapped-ion quantum computers built on its proprietary MAGIC (Magnetic Gradient Induced Coupling) technology, which controls qubits with microwaves rather than lasers for higher precision and a clearer path to scaling. The company aims to become a leading provider of quantum computing time for industrial applications across chemicals, pharmaceuticals, automotive, logistics, finance, and machine learning. eleQtron's systems are made accessible to developers through cloud platforms and standard quantum frameworks (Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane) rather than a first-party public REST API. Backed by Earlybird Venture Capital.

providers.name: Encentive
providers.description: encentive GmbH is a German industrial energy-technology company founded in 2020 and headquartered in Neumuenster. Its AI-driven smart energy management platform, flexOn, automatically optimizes and controls electricity consumption for industrial and commercial operations, orchestrating assets such as PV/solar systems, battery storage, heat pumps, cooling and thermal storage, CHP, wind, and EV charging infrastructure alongside existing energy management systems. flexOn combines plant data, weather forecasts, and real-time market prices to shift loads to periods when energy is cheapest and greenest, cutting energy costs by up to 20% and CO2 emissions by up to 30%. It integrates with industrial assets over REST API, SFTP, OPC UA, and Modbus TCP. encentive publishes no public developer API, portal, or specification; integration is delivered as part of its managed platform, so this profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Evercore
providers.description: Evercore Inc is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Evercore Inc API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Every.tv
providers.description: Every, Inc. (株式会社エブリー, corp.every.tv) is a Tokyo-based Japanese video-media and advertising company that runs consumer lifestyle products including DELISH KITCHEN (recipe video media), retailHUB (a retail promotion and data platform connecting physical stores with digital channels), トモニテ / Tomonite (parenting video media and community), and MOMENTH (a professional video production and social team). Led by CEO Taissei Yoshida and headquartered in Roppongi, Minato, Tokyo, the company approached an IPO on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. Every, Inc. publishes an engineering blog and owned media but exposes no public developer API program.

providers.name: Evox Therapeutics
providers.description: Evox Therapeutics is an Oxford, United Kingdom based biotechnology company developing genetic medicines that expand the reach of gene therapy into the brain to transform the treatment landscape for severe neurodegenerative diseases. Its proprietary ExoEdit platform combines the natural transport capabilities of exosomes with CRISPR-based gene editing to improve the delivery, potency, and safety of genetic treatments for central nervous system disorders such as Rett Syndrome. Evox is a venture backed life-sciences company (investors include GV) and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes a corporate and scientific website but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Evreka
providers.description: Evreka is a smart waste and recycling management technology company offering an end-to-end "Sustainability as a Service" platform that digitizes the entire waste management lifecycle. Its software suite spans operations, fleet, asset, MRF, and workforce management, route optimization, citizen engagement, and EPR/PRO management, complemented by IoT hardware such as fill-level sensors, vehicle and container trackers, and RFID readers. Evreka serves dumpster rental, recycling centers, medical, hazardous and liquid waste, construction and demolition, local authorities, and cross-border waste operators. Backed by 500 Global, it is tracked in the API Evangelist network; no public API or developer portal is currently published.

providers.name: ExpressSteuer (fka Express Group)
providers.description: ExpressSteuer (formerly Express Group) is a German tax-technology company, originally a Hamburg-based fintech backed by Insight Partners that offered an app-based, largely automated income-tax-return (Steuererklärung) service aimed at consumers and employees. The expresssteuer.de domain currently presents a German-language tax-information and guidance website (built on WordPress) covering income tax, self-employment, and everyday financial topics. No public developer program, API, SDK, or /.well-known/ discovery surface is published. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a company lead for enrichment.

providers.name: Fernride
providers.description: FERNRIDE (FERNRIDE GmbH) is a Munich, Germany based ground-autonomy company delivering human-assisted autonomous driving for logistics. Its platform automates electric and diesel trucks and terminal tractors across container terminals, yard operations, manufacturing supply, defence logistics, and open-road trucking, pairing on-vehicle autonomy with remote human oversight (teleoperation) for reliability at scale. A centralized Management Suite lets fleet managers monitor and control the autonomous fleet and integrates with existing terminal operating systems (TOS) and yard management systems (YMS). Customers and partners have included DB Schenker, Volkswagen, HHLA, and NVIDIA. FERNRIDE was acquired by Quantum Systems in December 2025. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest; the company exposes no public developer portal, API, or documentation surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Fivestargroup
providers.description: Five Star Group (Five Star Business Finance) is an India-based non-banking financial company (NBFC) that provides small-business and mortgage loans to self-employed and underserved borrowers, primarily across southern India. Its public web presence is an investor-relations and customer-service portal covering board and management disclosures, financials, annual reports, NCD and SEBI (LODR) compliances, RBI policies, credit ratings, and investor grievance redressal, alongside customer tools such as a loan mobile app, online EMI payments, and NACH mandate cancellation. It is listed in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. No public developer program, API, or SDK was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Flexkeeping
providers.description: Flexkeeping is a hotel operations automation platform (owned by Mews) that streamlines housekeeping, maintenance, front-office collaboration, and quality assurance for hotels and resorts. It centralizes staff task management, automated room cleaning schedules, checklists, lost-and-found, and guest service requests, and connects to major property management systems so operational teams can reduce manual work, coordinate across departments, and improve the guest experience across thousands of properties worldwide. Flexkeeping is an integration consumer rather than an API producer: it does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or API keys. Instead it ships pre-built connectors into PMS platforms including Mews, Apaleo, Oracle OPERA Cloud, Cloudbeds, RMS Cloud, Guesty, Shiji, Protel, SiHot, and Beds24.

providers.name: Flo Health
providers.description: Flo Health operates the Flo app, a leading consumer period, ovulation, pregnancy, and reproductive health tracker with hundreds of millions of downloads worldwide. The product surface includes cycle tracking, ovulation and pregnancy predictions, an AI-assisted symptom checker, Secret Chats, Flo for Partners (partner-shared mode), Anonymous Mode, and a Premium subscription tier. Flo's Medical Affairs team partners with clinicians and researchers on women's health science. Flo is a consumer mobile product; no public developer API or partner API portal has been identified at this time. This entry catalogs the company surface for the API Evangelist index.

providers.name: Flycrates
providers.description: Flycrates is an international shipping service, founded in 2015 and headquartered in San Francisco, that lets shoppers outside the United States buy US Amazon.com Prime items and have them delivered worldwide. Instead of filling an Amazon cart, customers fill a fixed-size crate (small, medium, or large); Flycrates then purchases the items, consolidates them, clears customs, and pays import duty and tax on the buyer's behalf before shipping via DHL, FedEx, or UPS to more than 117 countries. It also offers a Chrome browser extension that adds "Add to Flycrates" buttons directly onto Amazon product pages. Flycrates raised a seed round led by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass the company operates a consumer web application only and exposes no public API, developer portal, or partner integration program.

providers.name: Fortera
providers.description: Fortera is a Silicon Valley materials-technology company advancing zero-CO2 cement. Its ReCarb process economically converts captured CO2 into ReAct green cement that meets regulatory standards and can be blended with or used in place of Ordinary Portland Cement inside existing production infrastructure. Fortera operates its first commercial ReCarb plant in Redding, California, holds 100+ patents, and is backed by Khosla Ventures and Temasek. The company is a climate-tech materials producer rather than a software/API provider; it publishes a public marketing website and an llms.txt but no developer API surface.

providers.name: FREE NOW
providers.description: FREE NOW is one of Europe's leading multi-mobility "super apps," letting riders book taxis and private-hire vehicles and, in many cities, e-scooters, e-bikes, e-mopeds, carsharing and public-transport tickets from a single application. Founded in Hamburg in 2009 as mytaxi and rebranded FREE NOW in 2019, the company operates across nine European countries and 150+ cities. It ran as part of the YOUR NOW mobility joint venture between Mercedes-Benz and BMW and was acquired by Lyft. FREE NOW exposes a partner/business integration API (FREE NOW for Business) through a password-gated developer portal at developer.free-now.com, and maintains an active open-source presence — including the Wave design system — under the freenowtech GitHub organization.

providers.name: Freemodel
providers.description: Freemodel is a presale home renovation platform that helps real estate agents and homeowners prepare properties for sale by coordinating design, renovation, and project management through local project directors. It offers pay-at-close financing so clients can defer renovation costs until the home sells, and provides transparent online project tracking. Freemodel operates across Northern California (Bay Area, Sonoma, Santa Cruz/Monterey) and Southwest Florida. This profile was surfaced as a QED Investors portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Freemodel publishes no public API or developer program at this time.

providers.name: Frore Systems
providers.description: Frore Systems is a Silicon Valley thermal-management company that develops solid-state active cooling technology for high-performance computing in space-constrained devices. Its flagship AirJet solid-state cooling chips (AirJet Mini and AirJet PAK families) and LiquidJet direct-to-chip liquid cooling for data centers enable higher power density, quieter operation, and thinner designs across consumer devices, mini PCs, industrial embedded systems, and data-center compute trays. The company partners with Intel, Qualcomm, NVIDIA, AMD, Phison, and Zotac, is headquartered in Silicon Valley with manufacturing in Taiwan, and reached unicorn status following a Series D round. Frore is a hardware/semiconductor company with no public developer API surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company identity and market coverage.

providers.name: GeographQL
providers.description: A Country, State, and City GraphQL API

providers.name: Go X
providers.description: Go X is an electric micromobility sharing company that lets riders rent scooters, e-bikes, and cars on demand, 24/7, through a consumer mobile app. Operating in cities such as New Orleans, Go X builds its own connected electric vehicles and manages fleet access, unlocking, ride sessions, and payments entirely in-app on iOS and Android. It is a consumer-facing mobility service rather than a public API provider: it exposes no developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or documented public API surface (its api.goxapp.com host is the private backend for the mobile apps).

providers.name: Graphite Innovation and Technologies
providers.description: Graphite Innovation and Technologies Inc, operating as GIT Coatings, is a Canadian materials-science company that develops sustainable, graphene-based marine coatings for commercial ships. Its biocide-free hard foul-release hull and propeller coatings, including XGIT-FORCE, XGIT-VORTEX, and XGIT-PROP, cut fuel consumption, reduce drag, and eliminate leaching to protect the marine environment. The company is a Techstars-backed portfolio company. It is a physical-products manufacturer and publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company-level discovery and coverage.

providers.name: Green Thumb Industries
providers.description: A leading U.S. cannabis consumer packaged goods company operating a nationwide portfolio of retail dispensaries under the RISE brand and a collection of cannabis brands. Operates manufacturing facilities and retail locations across multiple states.

providers.name: Grip Security
providers.description: Grip Security is a SaaS security control plane providing identity governance, shadow SaaS discovery, and data loss prevention for cloud applications.

providers.name: hallo theo
providers.description: Hallo theo (rebranding to "Theo") is a German residential property management company (Hausverwaltung) that manages homeowners' associations (WEG/HOA), rental apartment buildings, and commercial properties across Germany. With 150+ experts and local teams in Berlin, Frankfurt am Main, Munich, Stuttgart, and Wildeshausen, the company manages over 20,000 units and is Section 26a HOA-certified, combining on-the-ground regional teams with central specialists in law, technology, and finance. Backed by Insight Partners, it offers HOA management, property management, commercial property management, succession, and sale-and-stay-on services to co-owners and building owners. This is a services company with a marketing/lead website (built on Framer + HubSpot); it publishes no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Helaina
providers.description: Helaina is a New York based biotechnology and nutrition company that uses precision fermentation to produce bio-identical human proteins. Its flagship ingredient, effera(R), is described by the company as the world's first bio-identical human lactoferrin, designed to match the lactoferrin naturally found in mother's milk and in the human body rather than being extracted from cow's milk. Helaina sells effera(R) as a business-to-business ingredient to supplement and nutrition formulators across women's health, gut health, longevity, hair and skin, active nutrition, and infant and child nutrition, and has announced a partnership with Nestle to advance science-based early-life nutrition. Helaina is an ingredient manufacturer, not a software vendor: it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API specification. The only machine-readable surface it publishes is an llms.txt at its website root, alongside a robots.txt that explicitly allows AI answer engines.

providers.name: HER
providers.description: HER is a dating and community platform built exclusively for queer women, non-binary, and trans people, with more than 15 million users across 125+ countries. The app pairs sapphic dating with community spaces, events, and richly customizable profiles (pronouns, gender identity, sexual orientation, and Pride Pins). Core features are free, with optional HER Premium tiers. HER was surfaced as a portfolio company of Initialized Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a consumer mobile application and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation at this time.

providers.name: Hinge
providers.description: Hinge is a relationship-oriented dating app owned by Match Group, marketed as "designed to be deleted" with a product focus on prompt-driven profiles and compatibility matching intended to drive actual dates rather than prolonged in-app engagement. Hinge Labs is the company's in-house research arm publishing data on dating behavior and outcomes. Hinge is a consumer mobile product; no public developer or partner API has been identified. This entry catalogs the company surface for the API Evangelist index.

providers.name: HONESS (Shanghai Hongji Environmental Protection)
providers.description: HONESS (泓济环保 / Shanghai Hongji Environmental Protection, honess.cn) is a Chinese environmental services provider founded in 2006, specializing in industrial wastewater treatment and the broader treatment of the "three wastes" (wastewater, waste gas, and hazardous waste). It offers customized environmental solutions, environmental equipment manufacturing and integration, EPC delivery for energy and chemical full-water systems, fine-chemical waste treatment, process packages for new and upgraded wastewater plants, and technology-enabled ("smart") digital operations and maintenance. The company holds top-grade design and contracting qualifications, has delivered 500+ design/build/operation projects for 300+ clients across China and abroad, and operates manufacturing and R&D bases in Shanghai and Anhui. It is not a developer/API company; the public surface is a WordPress corporate site with no developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or OAuth. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: ilovewoof
providers.description: ilovewoof (ilovewoof.com) is a UK-focused pet-care and lifestyle content publication covering companion animals and wildlife. It publishes pet-care guides, behavioral insights, health articles, rescue stories, and animal-world news across four sections — Cats, Dogs, News, and Other pets (small and exotic animals) — with health and medical content reviewed by licensed veterinary professionals, and offers a weekly email newsletter. It is an editorial content site, not an API provider; no public API, developer documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable interface was found during enrichment. Surfaced as a qiming portfolio lead and profiled in the API Evangelist network for completeness.

providers.name: Impossible Foods
providers.description: Impossible Foods is a Redwood City, California food-technology company that develops plant-based substitutes for meat, including Impossible Beef, Sausage, Chicken, Meatballs, and Pork. Founded in 2011 by Patrick O. Brown, the company engineers its products around heme (soy leghemoglobin) to replicate the taste and texture of animal meat while reducing the environmental footprint of food production. Its products are distributed through grocery retail and tens of thousands of restaurants across the United States and international markets including Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong, Singapore, the United Arab Emirates and the United Kingdom. Impossible Foods is a private, venture-backed company surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a GV (Google Ventures) portfolio company; it does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Impulse Space
providers.description: Impulse Space is an American aerospace company founded in 2021 by Tom Mueller, building in-space transportation and mobility infrastructure. The company designs and operates orbital transfer vehicles (OTVs) that host, maneuver, and deliver payloads across and between orbits for commercial, civil, and government customers. Its product line includes Mira, an agile spacecraft for precise payload hosting and deployment across any orbit; Helios, a high-energy kick stage capable of moving up to 4,000 kg of payload from Low Earth Orbit to Geostationary Orbit in under 24 hours; and a GEO Rideshare program offering economical access to geostationary orbit. Impulse Space is a hardware and launch-services company rather than a software API provider, and does not publish a public developer portal, API, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and Founders Fund and enriched from the company's public website.

providers.name: Insempra
providers.description: Insempra is a biotechnology company that produces sustainable, bio-based ingredients using precision fermentation. It develops alternatives to petrochemical and naturally-extracted ingredients for the beauty and personal care, food and nutrition, and fibers and performance materials industries. Products include a bio-based Phenyl Ethyl Alcohol fragrance ingredient, an Omega-7 biolipid, and Biomelanin (in development), produced from agricultural and forestry waste streams through circular manufacturing. Insempra is a portfolio company of EQT Ventures and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes no public API or developer surface at this time.

providers.name: Iwarranty
providers.description: iWarranty is a London-based, AI and machine-learning powered warranty management software platform that digitizes the entire warranty lifecycle for manufacturers, retailers, warrantors, and consumers. The platform covers QR-code product registration, automated claims processing and verification, repair and replacement coordination, fraud detection, and real-time product performance analytics, and integrates with existing ERP and CRM systems such as SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, and NetSuite. iWarranty emphasizes sustainability by reducing paper waste and e-waste through digitized processes. The company is backed by Anthemis and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile is maintained as an API Evangelist network enrichment lead.

providers.name: Junto Education
providers.description: Junto is a Berlin-based leadership-development company and a portfolio company of Earlybird Venture Capital. Junto delivers cohort-based, live and interactive online training led by certified coaches who previously held senior leadership roles at leading technology companies. Its programs combine the accountability and personal interaction of offline training with the scalability of online learning, and cover first-time managers, high-performance teams, and custom leadership tracks. Junto sells directly to organizations, who nominate high-potential employees for the programs. Junto operates a marketing site at junto.eu and a customer learning application at app.junto.eu. As of this profile, Junto publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: KEENON Robotics
providers.description: KEENON Robotics is a global commercial service-robotics company founded in 2010 and headquartered in Shanghai, China, designing and manufacturing autonomous service robots deployed across more than 70 countries and 600+ cities. Its product lines span catering and delivery robots (the T-series and W3), the KLEENBOT commercial floor-cleaning range (C20/C30/C40/C55), heavy-load delivery robots (S100/S300), humanoid service robots (XMAN-R1/XMAN-F1), hospital and hotel logistics solutions (including the WITMED medical line), and the Keenmow K1 domestic robot. KEENON is a hardware-and-solutions company; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI. This record is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Let's Do This
providers.description: Let's Do This is an endurance-events marketplace where participants discover and register for mass-participation sport — marathons, road races, trail runs, triathlons, obstacle races and cycling events — across the United Kingdom and the United States. The platform covers event discovery, entry purchase and entry management, team entries, memberships, referral credits and discount codes, and it works with event organisers and charity partners who list and sell places through it. Backed by EQT Ventures. As of July 2026 Let's Do This publishes no public API program: there is no developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable specification, SDK or webhook surface. A live but undocumented GraphQL endpoint backs the consumer marketplace with introspection disabled.

providers.name: Leyden Labs
providers.description: Leyden Labs is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Leiden, The Netherlands, with a regional office in Singapore, developing intranasal antibody products that protect people against known and newly emerging respiratory viruses. Its approach pairs mucosal immunity — delivering antibodies directly into the nasal passages, the gateway respiratory viruses use to enter the body — with broad protection, by targeting conserved regions of viral proteins so a single product can cover circulating strains and future variants. Its lead program, PanFlu, is an intranasal antibody candidate in clinical trials derived from CR9114, among the most broadly neutralizing influenza antibodies identified to date. Founded in 2021 by Koenraad Wiedhaup and Ronald Brus with founding scientist Jaap Goudsmit, the company is backed by GV and the SoftBank Vision Fund alongside the European Innovation Council Fund, the European Investment Bank and Invest-NL. Leyden Labs publishes no public developer program, API, or SDK; this profile captures its public web, security and identity surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Lifemote
providers.description: Lifemote Networks is an Istanbul-based provider of AI-driven home Wi-Fi analytics and experience management for broadband ISPs and network operators. A software agent running on the subscriber gateway or access point streams detailed in-home Wi-Fi performance telemetry to Lifemote's cloud, which scores quality of experience per household and per device and isolates root causes such as poor coverage, misplaced repeaters, congested or co-channel Wi-Fi, legacy client devices, and non-Wi-Fi interference. Operators consume the results through a web application for first-line support, proactive maintenance, churn detection and mesh/gateway upselling, plus quarterly expert-reviewed QoE reports. Lifemote markets a full-featured API for integrating this data with in-house OSS/BSS systems and support workflows, but that API is sold and provisioned through direct enterprise engagement — there is no public developer portal, documentation site, machine-readable specification, or self-service sign-up. Customers named publicly include A1, Community Fibre, Online.nl, and Tusass.

providers.name: Lilac Solutions
providers.description: Lilac Solutions is an Oakland, California climate-technology company founded in 2016 that develops direct lithium extraction (DLE) technology built on proprietary ion exchange media. Its ion exchange beads and modular brine processing systems pull battery-grade lithium from high-grade, low-grade and complex brines without evaporation ponds, cutting water use and shrinking the land footprint and time-to-production of conventional lithium operations. Lilac operates mini-pilot, field-pilot and commercial deployments across the Great Salt Lake in Utah, Nevada, Argentina, Chile, Germany and Indonesia, and manufactures its ion exchange media on a dedicated production line in Nevada. The company is venture-backed with roughly $350M raised, employs about 200 people, and sells industrial hardware and process technology to lithium producers — it publishes no public developer platform, API, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Mach Industries
providers.description: Mach Industries develops and manufactures asymmetric aerospace and defense systems and components at scale, with a product portfolio that includes the Viper vertical-takeoff attack drone, the Glide precision strike munition, the Stratos high-altitude pseudo-satellite, the Pike long-range munition, the Dart counter-drone kinetic interceptor, and energetics testing services. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Ribbit Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. The company is a defense hardware manufacturer and publishes no public developer or API surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Maman
providers.description: Maman is a French-inspired bakery and cafe chain founded in New York City, with locations across the United States and Canada. Maman serves seasonal pastries, coffee, salads, sandwiches and its signature nutty chocolate chip cookie in design-forward spaces, and operates online ordering for pickup and delivery, a nationwide cookie and gift shop, full-service event and corporate catering, private event venues, a loyalty mobile app, and a published cookbook. This API Evangelist profile tracks Maman's public web and commerce properties; the company exposes no first-party developer API surface.

providers.name: Material Evolution
providers.description: Material Evolution is a UK-based cleantech manufacturer of ultra-low carbon cement for the construction industry. Its MevoCem and MevoXL products use a proprietary "Alkali Fusion" process to transform industrial byproducts into cement feedstocks, achieving a 52.5N strength rating at roughly 144-196 kg CO2e per tonne versus ordinary Portland cement. The company operates compact, automated factories (including its Wrexham facility) and applies AI to material development and feedstock optimization. It is a B2B cement supplier and does not currently publish any public developer-facing API, developer portal, or technical documentation surface.

providers.name: Matterway
providers.description: Matterway is an enterprise-grade, AI-native intelligent assistance platform built for operations teams at large organizations and BPOs. Its screen-aware digital Assistant sits on top of the systems employees already use, guiding people through complex workflows while automating document data extraction, data verification, form pre-fill, and cross-application navigation. Processing stays client-side inside the corporate network, and the Assistant acts with the same rights as the logged-in user, which is aimed at regulated industries such as banking, insurance, and healthcare. Skills are authored in a no-code Designer, exported to a low-code SDK, and monitored from a management console. Matterway was acquired by Cognizant in October 2025. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of HV Capital and enriched by the local pipeline; Matterway publishes no public developer API, SDK registry package, or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: MeetFuture Technology
providers.description: MeetFuture Technology (弥费科技) is a Shanghai-based, global-leading supplier of semiconductor Automated Material Handling Systems (AMHS) and core components, founded in 2014. It designs and manufactures overhead hoist transport (OHT), stocker/storage, purge, and AMHS control-software solutions for semiconductor wafer fabrication plants, integrating with fab MES systems over SEMI equipment communication standards (E37/HSMS, E30/GEM, E82, E84, E10). MeetFuture holds 300+ intellectual-property items, operates China's largest AMHS cleanroom test center, authored China's first semiconductor OHT standard (T/SICA 006—2024), and won the 2025 SEMI Product Innovation Award. It is a Qiming Venture Partners portfolio company. MeetFuture is an industrial semiconductor-equipment maker and does not publish a public web API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile is maintained for network identity and discovery.

providers.name: MemeChat
providers.description: MemeChat is an Indian consumer social and creator-economy mobile app from MemeChat Private Limited (Memetech), where users make, share, and compete with memes — including a Face Swap AI feature and a MemeChat keyboard — and earn money when their content goes viral. Marketed as a self-reliant ("Atmanirbhar") Indian app that has crossed five million users, it is backed by 500 Global. This API Evangelist profile is a network stub: MemeChat is a consumer application with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface discovered at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: merama
providers.description: Merama is a Latin American e-commerce company that invests in and scales established online brands selling on marketplaces such as Amazon and MercadoLibre. It acquires a substantial stake while founders retain operational control, then provides working capital, business intelligence, digital marketing, cross-border expansion across Latin America and the US, and proprietary operating technology to accelerate growth. Merama operates as a brand aggregator / roll-up rather than a developer platform and publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK surface.

providers.name: MisterSpex
providers.description: Mister Spex SE is a European online-first eyewear and optical retailer selling prescription glasses, sunglasses, and contact lenses across more than 100 premium, luxury, independent, and private-label brands. Founded in Berlin in 2007 and listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange, the company serves more than 8 million customers online in five countries and operates 65 stores in Germany plus a network of over 300 partner opticians. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Point Nine and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public consumer or developer API, so this profile captures corporate identity and security-surface artifacts derived from live probes rather than an API catalog.

providers.name: Mombak
providers.description: Mombak is a Brazilian nature-based carbon removal company that acquires degraded and deforested land in the Amazon and restores it through large-scale, biodiverse reforestation with native species, generating high-integrity, high-quality carbon removal credits for corporate buyers. Founded by former Nubank executives and backed by investors including Union Square Ventures, the company combines science, technology, forestry, and carbon-market expertise to remove carbon at scale while restoring native ecosystems. Mombak operates as a corporate and carbon-markets business and publishes a public marketing and news presence; it does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Union Square Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Moove
providers.description: Moove is a mobility fintech providing revenue-based vehicle financing and ownership programs that let drivers acquire cars, motorcycles, and trucks and build businesses on ride-sharing and delivery partner platforms. Applicants apply to Moove, get verified, and start driving toward owning their vehicle, typically within days. Moove partners with major manufacturers including Hyundai, Toyota, Tesla, Volkswagen, and Bajaj, and centers its model on financial inclusion, gender equality, and a hybrid/EV fleet transition. Backed by DCM Ventures and Speedinvest. Moove publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation at this time; this profile captures the company's public identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Noetica
providers.description: Noetica AI is a New York-based legal and financial market-intelligence platform that uses natural language processing and a proprietary knowledge graph to extract, benchmark, and analyze deal terms from millions of public and private transactions. It serves transactional attorneys, capital-markets and M&A lawyers, credit and private-lending professionals, and legal-innovation teams at leading global law firms, delivering real-time quantitative and qualitative benchmarking across 60+ transaction types. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Thomson Reuters Ventures. As of this profiling Noetica exposes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, documentation, or /.well-known discovery surface; it operates as an enterprise B2B SaaS platform.

providers.name: Ofbusiness
providers.description: OfBusiness is one of India's largest B2B raw-materials procurement and credit platforms, serving more than two million SMEs and corporates. It operates as an aggregator, manufacturer, and importer/exporter across supply chains including steel, aluminium, chemicals, polymers, and agriculture, pairing live commodity pricing, quotations, and order tracking with working-capital credit through its NBFC arm Oxyzo. Related brands include BidAssist (government tender and procurement intelligence), SMEAssist, and Ved AI. The company is backed by Norwest Venture Partners and the SoftBank Vision Fund. OfBusiness reaches customers primarily through its website and iOS/Android mobile apps; no public developer API or API documentation was found during enrichment.

providers.name: OnPlan
providers.description: OnPlan (onplan.co) publishes guidance and content on project controls, budgeting, and forecasting for organizations managing projects and capital programs. The site covers cost planning and budget management, risk management frameworks, change control procedures, earned value management, and benefit realization tracking across infrastructure, construction, and technology projects. It is presented as an informational and educational resource rather than a self-service SaaS platform: at the time of enrichment the public surface consists of a homepage, a blog of dated articles, a contact page, a privacy policy, and a sitemap, with no developer portal, public API, documentation, pricing, sign-up/login, or terms-of-service pages exposed. This profile was surfaced as a VC-portfolio lead and enriched from the live site; no machine-readable API artifacts were found to harvest.

providers.name: Orqa
providers.description: Orqa is an aerial robotics company founded in 2018 and headquartered in Osijek, Croatia, that designs and manufactures mission-ready FPV (first-person view) drone systems for the defense and enterprise markets. With full vertical integration, Orqa builds every component in-house — tactical drones such as the MRM1-5 and MRM2-10, FPV goggles (FPV.One Pilot), controllers, simulators, and detection equipment — to keep its supply chain secure and its systems high-performance. The company is ISO 9001 certified and backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners (Seed round, 2024, partners Antoine Moyroud and Alexander Schmitt). As of this profile Orqa is a hardware manufacturer and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a programmatic developer surface; this repository tracks it for identity and network completeness.

providers.name: Overland AI
providers.description: Overland AI is a Seattle- and Washington, DC-based defense technology company building autonomous ground vehicle systems for military and national-security applications. Its product line spans ULTRA (a fully autonomous tactical vehicle with modular payloads), OverDrive (an off-road autonomy stack for tactical maneuver in GPS- and comms-denied environments), OverWatch (a command-and-control platform for single-operator control of multiple ground vehicles, which the company describes as offering an open API for integration with existing C2 systems), and SPARK (modular hardware that adds autonomous mobility to existing platforms). Overland AI is a portfolio company of 8VC. The company publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI specification; its "open API" is referenced only in marketing material and integration is handled through direct contact.

providers.name: Oxford Ionics
providers.description: Oxford Ionics is a quantum computing hardware company founded in Oxford, UK that designs and builds trapped-ion quantum computers powered by its proprietary Electronic Qubit Control (EQC) technology, which uses integrated semiconductor chips rather than lasers to control qubits. The company holds published records across single-qubit gate fidelity, two-qubit gate fidelity, and state preparation/measurement, and builds compact, field-upgradeable, data-center-ready QPUs that fit standard server racks and integrate with AWS and NVIDIA stacks. Its roadmap targets 16-64 qubits (2025), 256+ qubits (2026), and 10,000+ qubits (2027). Oxford Ionics was acquired by IonQ in 2025. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, SDKs, MCP server, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: Parting
providers.description: Parting operates parting.com, a consumer-facing funeral-home and cremation price-comparison platform that indexes more than 15,000 funeral homes and mortuaries across all 50 U.S. states, letting families research locations, photos, reviews, and pricing and contact providers directly. Founded in 2015 and based in Los Angeles, the company also publishes Parting Pro (partingpro.com), funeral-home arrangement and cremation software with third-party integrations to Passare, Keeper, and QuickBooks. As of this enrichment pass Parting exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI/spec surface, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web presence and a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Personal Capital
providers.description: Personal Capital is a digital wealth management and personal finance company, now operating as an Empower company, that pairs free online money-management tools with paid registered-investment-adviser services. Its Personal Capital / Empower Personal Dashboard app lets individuals link bank, brokerage, retirement, and loan accounts to track net worth, analyze investment fees, plan for retirement, and manage cash flow, while Personal Capital Advisors Corporation (an SEC-registered investment adviser) offers human financial advisors and managed portfolios for clients who link at least $100,000 in investable assets. Personal Capital was acquired by Empower Retirement (Great-West Lifeco / Power Corporation) in 2020. The company is consumer-facing and, as of this enrichment pass, does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: Pluton Biosciences
providers.description: Pluton Biosciences is a microbial discovery company that uses a proprietary Discovery Platform - high-throughput soil microbiome screening combined with computational analysis - to find naturally occurring microbial consortia for agriculture and carbon sequestration. Its lead product is a Biological Nitrogen System: photosynthetic microbial consortia that operate at the soil surface to fix atmospheric nitrogen and mobilize phosphorus. Pluton is a research-and-product company, not an API company; it has no public developer portal. Partnership and licensing inquiries are handled directly.

providers.name: Podcastpage
providers.description: Podcastpage.io was a podcast website builder that provided programmatic access for managing podcast websites and content. The product is now operating under the Beamly brand (beamly.com) following a rebrand. As of this entry the service does not publish a public OpenAPI specification or open developer documentation, and integration support is provided through customer support and Help Center articles.

providers.name: Pomerium
providers.description: Pomerium is an identity-aware reverse proxy that enables secure, zero-trust access to internal applications without a VPN.

providers.name: Positive Development
providers.description: Positive Development is a developmental therapy provider specializing in autism care for children, delivering a family-centered, play-based, home-based model that coaches parents rather than relying on intensive clinic hours. Services span emotional regulation, communication development, social engagement, daily living skills, and 1:1 parent coaching, with insurance-based access across multiple US locations. Surfaced as an obvious-ventures portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; the enrichment pass found no public developer, API, or machine-readable surface.

providers.name: Powerup Money
