providers.description: PowerUp Money is an India-based mutual fund advisory app that helps retail investors select, monitor, and rebalance their mutual fund portfolios. It is operated by a SEBI-registered Investment Advisor (RIA No. INA000019798) and BSE member (IA-BSE Membership No. 2465), and describes itself as "India's trusted Mutual Fund Advisory App" serving 900,000+ investors. Consumer-facing features include portfolio performance analysis, fund recommendations (start/pause/exit SIP guidance), monthly portfolio reports, and Elite membership tools such as Power Rank fund selection, Rank Trends monitoring, and Power Rebalancing for tax-efficient quarterly adjustments. It is distributed as iOS and Android mobile apps; no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface was found. Added to the API Evangelist network as an Accel portfolio company.

providers.name: Prewitt Ridge
providers.description: Prewitt Ridge builds SysGit, "the collaboration layer for complex hardware" — an enterprise platform that applies software development practices to systems engineering. SysGit provides Git-based version control for requirements and system models, Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) workflows, AI-assisted systems engineering automation, and SysMLv2 compliance for open-standards adherence. The platform targets defense and aerospace teams, with customers including the US Air Force, GTRI, Leidos, and Anduril. Prewitt Ridge is a Techstars-backed company added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, SDK, developer documentation, or .well-known documents.

providers.name: Primmune Therapeutics
providers.description: Primmune Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Carlsbad, California, developing systemic cancer immunotherapies designed to activate the immune system in a precise and controlled manner. Its lead program, PRTX007, is an orally administered, systemically active small-molecule agonist of toll-like receptor 7 (TLR7) engineered to activate plasmacytoid dendritic cells so they produce interferons, enhance antigen presentation, recruit natural killer cells and support cytotoxic T cell expansion, while minimizing pro-inflammatory signaling. The company was founded by researchers in oral small-molecule drug design and immune agonist pharmacology and has completed Phase 1 evaluation in healthy volunteers. Primmune operates no developer program and publishes no API product, SDK, or interface contract; its public web presence is a WordPress marketing and investor-relations site, whose only machine-readable surfaces are the Yoast-generated /llms.txt and WordPress's default /wp-json/ CMS endpoint.

providers.name: Propagate Ventures
providers.description: Propagate (formerly Propagate Ventures) is a regenerative-agriculture company founded in 2017 that helps farmland owners, farmers, and investors design, plant, finance, and manage agroforestry and tree-crop systems. Its flagship SaaS product, Overyield, lets farmers, developers, and investors model tree-crop economics, choose crops, and design tree-crop systems that work alongside existing farm operations. Propagate pairs the software with technical assessments, site prep and planting services, improved tree genetics, and ongoing project monitoring, and is a partner in the USDA Partnerships for Climate-Smart Commodities. The company advises 30,000+ acres of agroforestry supporting over 760,000 trees and shrubs. Propagate publishes no public API or developer platform at this time.

providers.name: PropTiger
providers.description: PropTiger.com is one of India's leading online real estate advisory and transaction platforms, founded in 2011 and now part of the REA India group (alongside Housing.com). It helps home buyers discover, evaluate, and purchase residential property across major Indian cities, combining property search and locality research with on-ground advisory, legal paperwork guidance, and home-loan assistance. The public surface is a consumer-facing web and mobile marketplace; as of this enrichment pass PropTiger publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, or MCP server. This profile captures verifiable company identity, published consumer pages, and live domain-security posture. Backed by Accel.

providers.name: Proteinea
providers.description: Proteinea is an AI-driven biotechnology company engineering next-generation therapeutic antibodies. It integrates protein language models, computational biology and biological automation to design, optimize and validate biologics faster and more safely. Proteinea is the creator of Ankh, an optimized general-purpose protein language model, and operates a Protein Engineering Platform (PEP) for multi-parameter optimization and RaGene for AI-driven codon/gene optimization, with a focus on rational Fc-domain engineering for context-specific immune tuning, enhanced half-life and targeted biodistribution. Headquartered in Cairo, Egypt with offices in Cambridge/ Boston, MA and a presence at KAUST, Saudi Arabia. Backed by 500 Global, IndieBio/SOSV, Shorooq Partners, Sawari Ventures and others. The company exposes research software (open-source models and benchmarks) rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Qardy
providers.description: Qardy is the first online lending aggregator marketplace in Egypt and the wider MENA region, connecting micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) with banks and financial institutions for debt financing. Its digital matchmaking platform collects and digitizes business and individual financial data, runs bank-statement and financial-statement analysis, produces credit ratings and predictive profiles, then matches eligible applicants to partner financial institutions by loan amount, industry, and risk rating. Qardy offers business loans (from EGP 50,000), micro-company financing (up to EGP 242,000), small and medium company financing (from EGP 250,000 to over EGP 10,000,000), supply chain / invoice financing, leasing, and factoring — free of charge to applicants through a fast, transparent three-step application process.

providers.name: Rebag
providers.description: Rebag is an online marketplace for buying, selling, and trading pre-owned luxury goods — designer handbags, watches, fine jewelry, shoes, apparel, and accessories from houses such as Chanel, Hermes, Louis Vuitton, Prada, Goyard, and Gucci. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in New York City, Rebag authenticates every item in-house and is known for Clair (Comprehensive Luxury Appraisal Index for Resale), an AI-driven pricing engine that gives sellers instant, guaranteed buyback quotes. Rebag operates a mobile app, physical retail stores, and consignment/trade-in programs, and is backed by investors including General Catalyst. This profile tracks Rebag's public web presence; no public developer API has been identified.

providers.name: Relay
providers.description: Relay is an online business banking and cash-flow management platform for small and medium-sized businesses, offering up to 20-50 checking accounts, virtual and physical Visa debit/credit cards, accounts payable and bill pay, and one-way data integrations with accounting and payroll tools such as QuickBooks Online, Xero, and Gusto. Banking services are provided by Thread Bank, Member FDIC. Relay does not publish a public developer API; the surfaces below are product features and inbound integrations rather than developer-facing APIs.

providers.name: Reno
providers.description: Reno (Reno Home) is a Dubai, UAE based one-stop home renovation platform that connects homeowners and businesses with professional interior designers and vetted contractors, managing renovation projects end-to-end from design and contracting through quality inspections and completion. Its Reno mobile app lets clients track project progress, budgets, timelines and change requests in real time, and it offers a "Renovate Now, Pay Later" financing model with 3, 6 or 12 month installment plans. Reno is backed by 500 Global (500 Sanabil), Hub71 and other regional investors. It is a consumer-facing service and publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Rgenta Therapeutics
providers.description: Rgenta Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered at 300 TradeCenter, Woburn, Massachusetts, developing a pipeline of oral, small-molecule RNA-targeting medicines with an initial focus on oncology and neurological disorders. Its discovery platform mines large-scale genomics data to identify targetable RNA processing events, then designs small molecules that modulate the interactions among the spliceosome, RNA-binding regulatory proteins and RNA itself in order to shut down production of disease-driving proteins previously considered undruggable. Its lead clinical asset, RGT-61159, is an orally available modulator of MYB splicing in development for adenoid cystic carcinoma and colorectal cancer, and its RSwitch technology applies the same chemistry to tune transgene expression in AAV-delivered gene and cell therapies. Rgenta is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor: it publishes no API, no developer portal and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Scanii
providers.description: Simple REST API that can scan submitted documents/files for the presence of threats

providers.name: Serviceware SE
providers.description: Serviceware SE is a German enterprise software, consulting, and managed-services company with more than 25 years in business, roughly 420 employees, and over EUR 100 million in annual revenue. Its platform spans Enterprise Service Management (ESM) for IT, HR, and customer service, IT Financial Management (ITFM) for cost tracking and technology business management, Corporate Performance Management (CPM) for budgeting, planning, and reporting, AI-powered Knowledge Management, and Field Service Management. Serviceware positions its platform as AI-native, with no-code workflows, data integration, governance, and self-service capabilities. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Shift EV
providers.description: Shift EV is an electric-mobility company that retrofits existing commercial vehicles to electric power through an "electrofitting" service, converting fleet vehicles to EV drivetrains in under an hour with zero upfront cost. The company designs and installs plug-and-play EV drivetrains, lithium-ion battery packs, on-site charging infrastructure, and fleet-management software for FMCG, e-commerce, service, and OEM fleets. Backed by Union Square Ventures, Shift EV was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: SiamSquared
providers.description: SiamSquared Technologies (Thailand) Co., Ltd. is the Bangkok-based company behind StockRadars (stockradars.co), a retail stock-investment analysis platform branded "investing made simple." StockRadars offers mobile apps (iOS and Android, including a paid StockRadars PLUS tier) and a web app for the Thai stock market, with features such as customizable screening "radars," Top100 rankings, income-statement views, shareholder tracking, volume analysis, real-time price alerts, and an in-house news feed (stockradars.news). The company is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass StockRadars publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or API documentation — it is a consumer-facing application, so most machine-readable API artifacts are not applicable and this profile captures identity plus a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Smallhold
providers.description: Smallhold is a specialty organic mushroom company founded in 2017 by Andrew Carter and Adam DeMartino and headquartered in Brooklyn, New York. A Certified B Corporation, Smallhold grows gourmet mushroom varieties — including blue oyster, lion's mane, maitake, royal trumpet, and shiitake — using modular, automated "minifarm" growing environments designed for distributed, locally grown supply to grocery retailers and restaurants. Its public presence is a direct-to-consumer and retail-partner storefront built on Shopify; the company publishes no first-party developer API, developer portal, or API documentation. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio lead and run through the enrichment pipeline, which confirmed no bespoke API surface — only Shopify's platform OAuth discovery documents are exposed on the shop domain.

providers.name: Spider Capital
providers.description: Spider Capital is a seed-stage venture capital firm investing in applied-AI enterprise cloud software that modernizes complex industrial sectors. The firm backs founders across construction, financial services, energy, government, healthcare, insurance, mining, manufacturing, supply chain, and transportation, citing 100+ enterprise cloud investments, a 70%+ seed-to-Series-A graduation rate, and portfolio companies including Mechanical Orchard, Imubit, CoLab, Percepto, Codoxo, Klir, Elara Spatial, and Logiwa. Surfaced as a portfolio company of foundry-group; it publishes no public API or developer surface (venture-capital firm), so this profile carries firm identity rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Stoke Space
providers.description: Stoke Space Technologies is an American space launch company based in Kent, Washington, founded in 2020 by a team of former Blue Origin and SpaceX engineers, led by co-founders Andy Lapsa and Tom Feldman (both ex-Blue Origin). The company is developing Nova, a medium-lift, 100% fully reusable rocket aimed at dramatically lowering the cost of access to orbit, along with its Zenith full-flow staged-combustion first-stage engine, the Andromeda second-stage engine, and a reusable metallic reentry heat shield. Stoke operates a 168,000 sq ft assembly facility and headquarters in Kent and a rocket test site near Moses Lake, Washington. Backed by Spark Capital and others, the company extended its Series D financing to $860 million in 2026. Stoke Space is a physical aerospace/hardware manufacturer and launch provider; it publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Supermaven
providers.description: Supermaven was an AI code completion tool founded by Jacob Jackson (previously co-founder of Tabnine) and known for shipping the first code completion product with a 1,000,000-token context window — over thirty times the context of contemporary copilots — backed by the in-house Babble model and roughly 250 ms response latency. Supermaven delivered plugins for VS Code, JetBrains IDEs, and Neovim, plus a chat surface that proxied GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and GPT-4 alongside inline completions, style adaptation, and codebase-aware suggestions. Anysphere — the company behind the Cursor AI code editor — acquired Supermaven on 12 November 2024 to power Cursor's next-generation Tab model, and on 21 November 2025 Supermaven was formally sunset: subscribers received prorated refunds, agent/chat features were retired, VS Code users were migrated to Cursor, and free autocomplete inference continues for existing JetBrains and Neovim users for the foreseeable future. There is no public developer API, OpenAPI spec, or SDK — Supermaven shipped as an IDE plugin product, and its long-context completion technology now lives inside Cursor.

providers.name: Syntetica
providers.description: Syntetica is a French cleantech company using green chemistry to close the loop on synthetic textiles, starting with nylon. Its proprietary chemical process depolymerises nylon-blend fabrics, separating and purifying Nylon 6 and Nylon 6,6 from elastane, cotton, and other fibres in a single process to produce virgin-quality, low-carbon recycled polymers that drop in as replacements for fossil-derived nylon across textile, automotive, and high-performance applications. Backed by EQT Ventures, Bpifrance, SWEN Capital Partners, lululemon, and MAS Holdings, the company raised a $30M Series A in July 2026 to build its first commercial demonstration facility in France. Syntetica is a materials-science and manufacturing company; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Tavern Research
providers.description: Tavern Research is a political opinion research and communications firm that integrates polling, message testing, and original ad production for Democratic campaigns and advocacy organizations. It pairs rapid survey research (marketed as "insights in 48 hours"), AI-powered content creation, and large-scale creative experimentation to learn which messages move voters, then produces and optimizes ads through placement. Surfaced as a Bloomberg Beta portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; the firm runs a marketing website on Squarespace and publishes no public API, developer documentation, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: ThatGameCompany
providers.description: ThatGameCompany is an American independent video game studio founded in 2006 by Jenova Chen and Kellee Santiago, known for emotionally driven, art-forward titles including Flow, Flower, Journey, and the free-to-play social adventure Sky: Children of the Light. The studio focuses on creating timeless interactive entertainment that inspires human connection across all ages. It publishes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a technology / gaming entity and records domain-security posture from live probes.

providers.name: The Human Utility
providers.description: The Human Utility (formerly the Detroit Water Project) is a Y Combinator-backed not-for-profit organization founded in 2014 by Tiffani Ashley Bell whose mission is to preserve human dignity by increasing water affordability for families across the United States. It matches families who are behind on their water bills with donors who want to help, paying utility companies directly on their behalf through crowdfunded donations, community-building, and policy action. Operating in Detroit, Baltimore, and dozens of other cities, it has helped thousands of households avoid water shutoffs. The Human Utility runs a public-facing web application for donors and recipients rather than a developer-facing API product; its source code lives in the humanutility GitHub organization. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched with identity and link details; no public API surface was found.

providers.name: The Vampire Diaries
providers.description: TV Show Data

providers.name: TheNoor
providers.description: TheNoor is a Shariah-inspired and guided company behind "TheNoor" — an Islamic lifestyle mobile application for Muslims, available on iOS and Android. The app bundles daily religious and lifestyle utilities such as prayer times, Qibla direction, Quran, Islamic calendar, and related community and content features into a single consumer product. TheNoor is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes only a consumer website and a private mobile backend at api.thenoor.co; it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: TMRW Sports
providers.description: TMRW Sports is a sports, media, and entertainment company founded by professional golfers Tiger Woods and Rory McIlroy, with Mike McCarley as Founder and CEO, focused on building modern, tech-forward approaches to live sports. Its ventures include TGL, a primetime team golf league played in partnership with the PGA TOUR; WTGL, a professional women's golf league; and a professional flag football league launching in partnership with the NFL. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners, TMRW Sports operates consumer sports and entertainment properties and does not publish a public developer platform, API, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Treadwell Therapeutics
providers.description: Treadwell Therapeutics is a clinical-stage, multi-modality oncology company developing novel small-molecule therapeutics for highly aggressive cancers by targeting tumor-specific vulnerabilities such as aneuploidy and immunogenicity. Co-founded by Tak Wah Mak, PhD and Mark R. Bray, PhD, the company keeps drug discovery and clinical development under one roof and works out of Toronto (with a research footprint at the University Health Network), New York and Hong Kong. Its internally developed pipeline includes CFI-400945, an oral PLK4 inhibitor in Phase 1/2 studies across triple-negative breast cancer, prostate cancer and acute myeloid leukemia (FDA Fast Track designation); CFI-402257, a TTK inhibitor in Phase 1b/2; and CFI-402411, a first-in-class HPK1 inhibitor. Treadwell is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor - it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract. Profiled by API Evangelist from its own public corporate site.

providers.name: Treeline Biosciences
providers.description: Treeline Biosciences is a drug discovery and development company that aspires to make great medicines reliably and repeatedly, matching compelling disease targets with clinically proven drug approaches -- small-molecule inhibitors, protein degraders, and antibody drug conjugates -- enabled in-house at its U.S. and EU research facilities and integrated with in silico and machine learning models that help its scientists understand protein targets at an atomic level. The company pursues a target-centric preclinical pipeline serving patients with serious diseases across oncology, immunology, and neurology, and is a portfolio company of GV. Treeline publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Treet
providers.description: Treet is a branded recommerce (resale) platform that lets e-commerce brands run their own secondhand marketplaces. Founded in 2021 by marketplace veterans Jake Disraeli and Sonia Yang (formerly of Indiegogo and Airbnb), Treet powers resale for 250+ global brands through four stackable programs: Peer-to-Peer (customers buy and sell from each other for cash or brand credit), Trade-In, Off-Price liquidation of excess inventory, and Returns rerouting. Treet integrates into a brand's existing commerce stack — Shopify, Adobe Commerce, BigCommerce, WooCommerce and Salesforce Commerce, plus logistics (ShipHero, ShipBob), marketing/loyalty (Klaviyo, Yotpo, LoyaltyLion) and returns (Loop, Happy Returns) partners via its "Infinite Integrations" platform. Treet is an API consumer rather than an API producer: it publishes no public developer API, API documentation, developer portal, SDKs or webhooks of its own, and delivers to brands as a managed SaaS and Shopify app. Backed by Two Sigma Ventures and Techstars.

providers.name: Varda
providers.description: Varda Space Industries is a microgravity-enabled life sciences company that processes materials in orbit and returns them to Earth. Its in-house W-Series spacecraft are free-flying orbital production satellites with reentry capability, used for in-orbit pharmaceutical crystallization for biopharma partners and as a hypersonic reentry testbed for government flight testing. Backed by Founders Fund, General Catalyst, Khosla Ventures, and Lux Capital, Varda publishes no public API or developer surface as of July 2026.

providers.name: Veritasfin
providers.description: Veritas Finance Limited is a non-banking finance company (NBFC) in India focused on retail and micro, small and medium enterprise (MSME) lending to underserved and self-employed customers. Its lending products include MSME and business loans, loan against property, home loans, mortgage and working-capital finance, and used commercial vehicle loans, supported by an EMI calculator, branch network, online payment portals and an investor-relations and corporate-governance section. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. Public probing of veritasfin.in finds a corporate financial-services website with no developer portal, documentation, or public API surface at this time.

providers.name: Verse
providers.description: Verse (verse.inc) is a private company backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, surfaced into the API Evangelist network from Bessemer's portfolio. Its public marketing site is served entirely behind a Cloudflare bot challenge, so the product and sector could not be independently characterized from the site itself during enrichment. What is verifiable: Verse operates a live, authenticated backend API at api.verse.inc built on the Connect RPC protocol (a gRPC-compatible framework — the host advertises the Connect-Protocol-Version header and OPTIONS/GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE methods), fronted by Google infrastructure, and it publishes an RFC 9116 security.txt naming a security contact. No public OpenAPI, developer docs, SDKs, or MCP server were discoverable. Sector remains undetermined pending further research.

providers.name: ViaLase
providers.description: ViaLase, Inc. is a globally-minded, venture and strategic capital-backed, clinical stage medical technology company headquartered in Aliso Viejo, California, founded and led by Tibor Juhasz, PhD. The company develops the ViaLuxe Laser System, which combines femtosecond laser technology with micron-resolution OCT image guidance to perform femtosecond laser image-guided high-precision trabeculotomy (FLigHT) — a noninvasive, non-incisional procedure that creates drainage apertures through the trabecular meshwork to lower intraocular pressure in patients with open-angle glaucoma. The system pairs the ViaLuxe laser with the ViaLens patient interface and the ViaVue gonio camera. The company closed an approximately $40 million Series C financing in April 2024 with participation from Venture Investors Health Fund, Arboretum Ventures and Falcon Vision. The ViaLase Laser received CE Mark approval in the European Union in 2024 for adult patients with primary open-angle glaucoma and is under evaluation in a US IDE clinical trial; it is not approved for sale in the United States. ViaLase is a medical device manufacturer rather than a software vendor: it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification, and vialase.com is a WordPress marketing and clinical-education site.

providers.name: Visage Imaging
providers.description: Visage Imaging is a global enterprise imaging vendor and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Pro Medicus Limited (ASX PME). Its flagship Visage 7 Enterprise Imaging Platform delivers server-side rendered images adaptively streamed to an intelligent zero-footprint thin-client viewer for diagnostic radiology, cardiology, and mobile reading, alongside Visage 7 Open Archive and the Visage AI Accelerator research platform. Interoperability is built on healthcare imaging standards - DICOM / DICOMweb, HL7, FHIR, and IHE profiles - and Visage exposes REST and open-API surfaces for AI algorithm integration and QA workflows. There is no public self-service developer portal; API access is partner- and customer-gated (Client Portal login, product documentation login, and an invitation-only AI Accelerator Program), so the API entries below are logically modeled from public product and release-note material rather than a published API reference.

providers.name: yesmro
providers.description: YESMRO (易买工品), operated by Shanghai Sheti Information Technology Co., Ltd. and founded in April 2016, is a self-operated Chinese B2B e-commerce platform for MRO (maintenance, repair and operations) and factory-automation parts. It carries millions of SKUs across mechanical components, industrial control (PLCs, HMIs, servos, drives), sensors, low-voltage electrical, pneumatics, tools, safety and factory consumables from 800+ brands, targeting the small and medium-sized end factories that make up the long tail of industrial demand. The company runs automated (AGV) warehouses in Shanghai, Hefei and Dongguan and 10+ regional offices, and in 2020 launched an open platform for upstream suppliers. It is backed by Qiming Venture Partners, Matrix Partners China and Sequoia Capital China. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming; no public developer API, open-platform docs, or specification surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: 01 Exchange
providers.description: 01 Exchange (01.xyz) was a full-suite decentralized derivatives exchange on Solana, offering cross-margined and cross-collateralized Perpetual Futures and Power Perpetuals (SQUOL) built on a fully on-chain Serum limit orderbook, with support for up to 100 markets and 50 collateral tokens and up to 20x leverage. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of multicoin-capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. The people and product behind 01 are now part of N1 (app.n1.xyz), where trading, points, and rewards have migrated. This profile captures 01 Exchange's historical developer surface: the TypeScript, Python, and Rust SDKs and on-chain program interface published by the Zero One Global Foundation (github.com/01protocol).

providers.name: Adaptive Innovations
providers.description: Adaptive Innovations Co. is an AI-native home health provider headquartered in New York, NY, with operations centered in Texas. Founded in 2025 by Alex Wendland and Logan Stinson (co-CEOs), Hunter Stinson (COO) and Ryan Tolsma (CTO), the company pairs clinicians in the home with an internally built "AI operating system" that automates medical intake, scheduling, charting, and compliance billing. It delivers care under the Adaptive Home Health brand (adaptivehh.com), a Medicare-certified agency that reports 100,000+ patient visits, 500+ referring healthcare organizations and roughly 500 clinical staff. Adaptive raised $60M across a Seed and a $50M Series A (June 2026) led by Felicis and Bain Capital Ventures, with Optum Ventures, BoxGroup, Conviction, SV Angel, Sunflower Capital, Constellation and Dorm Room Fund participating. Its software is operated internally and shipped to patients and clinicians as an iOS/Android app; as of this profile Adaptive publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Addionics
providers.description: Addionics is a Smart Metals manufacturer headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with operations in Israel, Korea and the USA, building Smart 3D Porous Current Collectors that replace the flat copper and aluminium foils inside a battery cell with a porous, ion-permeable metal architecture. The technology is chemistry-agnostic and drop-in, produced roll-to-roll on existing coating lines, and is sold into robotics, defence, space and EV programmes. Addionics is a hardware and materials company: it operates no developer program and publishes no API, SDK, webhook or machine-readable API contract. It does run a deliberate agent-readable content surface on its own domain — a served /llms.txt digest, a published /agents.md agent guide, a markdown twin of every page under Accept: text/markdown, a complete /sitemap.xml and an RSS blog feed — all captured in this profile.

providers.name: Aerodyne
providers.description: Aerodyne Group is a Malaysia-headquartered DT3 (drone technology, data technology, and digital transformation) enterprise solutions provider, founded in 2014. Through its Drone-as-a-Service (DaaS) model and the AI-powered, cloud-based vertikaliti asset-management platform, Aerodyne turns aerial and sensor data into deep analytics and actionable insights for infrastructure, power line, wind turbine, solar, and agricultural (Agrimor) asset inspection and management. Operating across 45 countries with a global network of AeroRangers, it was ranked the world's number-one drone service provider by Drone Industry Insights in 2021 and 2022. Aerodyne is a 500 Global portfolio company. No public developer portal, API, or machine-readable specification has been identified at this time.

providers.name: AI Fleet
providers.description: Aifleet (aifleet.com) is a technology-driven, full-stack trucking carrier founded in 2020 and headquartered in Austin, Texas. The company describes itself as the first full-stack, AI-driven carrier, pairing company drivers with proprietary AI algorithms and its own Transportation Management System (TMS) to optimize truck utilization, routing, load matching, fuel usage, and scheduling across the roughly $400B U.S. freight sector. Aifleet emphasizes a driver-centric model — better pay, predictable schedules, and reduced wait times — alongside shipper-facing services with proactive tracking updates and predictive ETAs. It has raised roughly $50M since founding (Series A 2021, venture round 2023, Series B 2024) from investors including Obvious Ventures, Ibex Investors, Volvo Group Venture Capital, Compound, and Heron Rock. Aifleet is a logistics service provider rather than a developer-facing API platform; as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI definition.

providers.name: Aiperia
providers.description: Aiperia (formerly PlanerAI) is a German AI company whose SaaS platform automates demand forecasting and fresh-food supply-chain planning from production through to the end consumer. Its machine-learning models predict fresh-food demand up to 21 days ahead using around 150 external factors, then generate automated order and production suggestions for bakeries and self-service stations, food manufacturers, and supermarkets to reduce food waste and overproduction. Aiperia is a portfolio company of Earlybird Venture Capital.

providers.name: Aisle Planner
providers.description: Aisle Planner is a cloud-based business management platform for wedding and event professionals - planners, venues, caterers, florists, and photographers - bundling lead management, proposals/contracts with e-signatures, invoicing and online payments, timelines, budgets, guest and vendor management, seating charts, event websites, and online RSVP into one system. Aisle Planner does NOT publish a public, self-service developer API. There is no developer portal, no public API reference, and no OpenAPI definition. The only "API key" Aisle Planner issues is a private per-account key found in Business Settings that plugs into a single pre-built Zapier integration - triggers are new project, new lead, and payment received; actions are create wedding project, create event project, and create lead - it is not a general-purpose, self-serve REST API a third-party developer can register for and call directly.

providers.name: Arbeitnow
providers.description: API for Job board aggregator in Europe / Remote

providers.name: Arondite
providers.description: Arondite is a defence technology company building Cobalt, a defence software platform for accelerated decision making that orchestrates missions and manages operational intelligence. Cobalt brings together sighting reports, real-time notifications and alerts, mapping and visualisation, task management and kanban workflows, and observation and monitoring tools to support complex military and defence operations across use cases including Hybrid Navy, C-UAS, Recce-Strike, and Site Security. Arondite combines operational and technical expertise to deliver technology with immediate, real-world impact on a global scale. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures. Arondite does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface, so this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Aspect Biosystems
providers.description: Aspect Biosystems is a Vancouver, British Columbia biotechnology company developing Bioprinted Tissue Therapeutics — implantable, allogeneic living tissues designed to replace, repair, or supplement biological function in the body. Spun out of an interdisciplinary medicine-and-engineering collaboration at the University of British Columbia in 2013, the company operates a self-described full-stack tissue therapeutic platform that integrates proprietary AI-powered microfluidic bioprinting, computational tissue design tools, therapeutic and hypoimmune-engineered cells, and advanced biomaterials. Its clinical pipeline targets metabolic and endocrine disease, led by pancreatic tissue programs for type 1 diabetes and programs in rare endocrine disorders and liver disease. Aspect has raised more than US$350M, including a US$115M Series B, and holds partnerships with Novo Nordisk (announced 2023, valued at over US$2.6B in milestones) and the governments of Canada and British Columbia. It is a private, pre-commercial therapeutics developer: it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Astrocade
providers.description: Astrocade is an online gaming platform that leverages artificial intelligence to let users play and create free games. It offers a community-driven experience where players can discover, share, and develop AI-powered games, fostering creativity and social interaction across its web-based service.

providers.name: Aurion Biotech
providers.description: Aurion Biotech is dedicated to developing and delivering paradigm‑shifting therapies that empower physicians to provide efficient care, restore vision, and transform lives. Focused on eliminating blindness globally, the company advances innovative cell‑based treatments for corneal endothelial disease and other vision‑loss conditions, leveraging regenerative medicine and drug development expertise.

providers.name: Besample
providers.description: Besample provides access to vetted research participants across emerging markets, enabling behavioral scientists to conduct studies globally. The platform offers a searchable database of participants from Africa, Asia, Latin America, and Eastern Europe, with tools for recruitment, consent, and data collection, supporting academic and commercial research initiatives.

providers.name: Bond Biosciences
providers.description: Bond Biosciences, Inc. is a privately held, clinical‑stage biopharmaceutical company focused on discovering and developing first‑in‑class non‑absorbed oral therapeutics that bind excess ions locally in the gastrointestinal tract to treat or prevent ion‑related human diseases. Their lead candidate, BBI‑001, aims to provide a safe, convenient solution for conditions such as hyperphosphatemia and hyperkalemia, leveraging a novel mechanism of action to improve patient outcomes.

providers.name: Cajal Neuroscience
providers.description: Cajal Neuroscience, which now operates publicly as Cajal Therapeutics, is a Seattle, Washington biotechnology company founded in 2020 by Alex Vaughan, Andrew Dervan and Ian Peikon, and launched in November 2022 with a $96 million Series A led by The Column Group and Lux Capital with participation from Two Sigma Ventures and Bristol Myers Squibb. The company develops small-molecule and RNA medicines that restore iron homeostasis, built around "iron mobilizers" — small molecules that transport iron across membranes into the compartments where it is required, bypassing disease-driven bottlenecks such as chronic inflammation, altered iron transporter expression and lysosomal dysfunction. Its pipeline spans systemic disease (CTX001, a clinical-stage iron mobilizer for anemia of chronic kidney disease; CTX201 and CTX211, preclinical siRNA programs for inflammatory anemia and myelofibrosis anemia) and CNS disease (a discovery-stage brain-penetrant iron mobilizer for Parkinson's disease). This is a therapeutics company, not a software or data platform company: it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract. Its public GitHub organization contains open-source laboratory hardware and firmware (a drone-motor spin coater, a microfluidic pressure sensor, a flow sensor) plus forks of third-party single-cell and genomics analysis tooling — none of which expose a network API.

providers.name: Caju AI
providers.description: Caju AI provides a generative AI‑powered customer engagement platform for regulated organizations. It captures, archives, and analyses communications across channels like WhatsApp, SMS, iMessage, Signal, Telegram, and WeChat, delivering actionable intelligence, compliance support, and CRM insights. The solution serves life sciences, financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, and education sectors, offering integrations with Microsoft Teams and other enterprise tools.

providers.name: Camion
providers.description: Camion is an infrastructure-intelligence platform accelerating the electrification of real estate portfolios. Its AI-driven platform indexes properties by their readiness and potential for electrification, forecasts energy demand, and optimizes the placement of solar, storage, and EV-charging infrastructure so the largest real estate owners and infrastructure developers can underwrite and deploy energy upgrades at scale. Camion positions itself as an "always-on energy department" that delivers consultant-grade investment cases without manual dashboard monitoring. Founded in 2023 and based in London, Camion raised a EUR 2.7M pre-seed round led by EQT Ventures in April 2024. Sector: energy-and-environmental. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; Camion publishes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Clue (BioWink)
providers.description: Clue, operated by BioWink GmbH in Berlin, Germany, is a science-driven menstrual, ovulation, pregnancy, and reproductive health tracking app with 100M+ downloads across 190+ countries. The product portfolio spans Clue (free tier), Clue Plus (subscription), Clue Conceive, Clue Pregnancy, Clue Perimenopause, and a "Clue (No Period)" mode for non-bleeding hormonal cycles. Clue Connect provides partner sharing. The company contributes anonymized real-world data to academic research partnerships with Stanford, University of Oxford, UC Berkeley, MIT, and the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. Clue is a consumer mobile product; no public developer API or partner API portal has been identified. This entry catalogs the company surface for the API Evangelist index.

providers.name: Cognito Therapeutics
providers.description: Cognito Therapeutics is a clinical-stage neurotechnology company in Cambridge, Massachusetts, founded in 2016 out of MIT research by Ed Boyden and Li-Huei Tsai into the link between gamma-frequency neural oscillations and Alzheimer's disease progression. Its lead investigational product, Spectris, is a non-invasive at-home neuromodulation device that delivers synchronized 40Hz light and sound stimulation through a headset and glasses for one hour daily, evoking gamma activity to slow cognitive and functional decline in mild-to-moderate Alzheimer's disease. Spectris AD received FDA Breakthrough Device Designation in 2021, and the company closed an oversubscribed $105M Series C in March 2026 led by Morningside Ventures. Cognito Therapeutics is a medical device and therapeutics company: it publishes a corporate and clinical-information website and no public developer program, API, SDK, or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: CoinStats
providers.description: Crypto Tracker

providers.name: Concerto Biosciences
providers.description: Concerto Biosciences is a biotechnology company that harnesses microbial ecology to develop innovative products for human health, nutrition, and agriculture. Founded in 2019, it builds large-scale microbial interaction datasets and AI models to create microbe‑based ingredients and therapies, offering solutions for skin health, chronic disease, and crop improvement.

providers.name: Connected Robotics
providers.description: Connected Robotics Inc. is a Japanese foodtech startup, founded in 2014 by Tetsuya Sawanobori and headquartered in Koganei, Tokyo, that develops specialized robotics and AI systems to automate labor-intensive work across food factories and restaurants. Its product line pairs AI image-processing and robot-control technology with purpose-built machines including the Delibot S plating robot, Delibot X filling robot, AI inspection software, a soft-serve ice-cream robot, and a french-fry cooking robot, targeting labor shortages, productivity, and food safety. The company has raised multiple rounds (including a July 2019 Series A led by Global Brain and a Series B closed in 2023 with strategic investors such as Yaskawa Electric, Hoshizaki, and Mitsubishi HC Capital) and was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company. As a hardware and robotics manufacturer, Connected Robotics publishes no public web API, developer portal, or SDK at this time.

providers.name: Convergys
providers.description: Convergys Corporation was a global leader in customer management services — contact center outsourcing, workforce management, customer analytics and digital customer experience platforms — serving communications, financial services, healthcare, retail and technology clients. SYNNEX acquired Convergys in October 2018 and merged it into Concentrix; the brand was retired and its offerings were folded into the Concentrix portfolio. Convergys published no public API or developer program that survives. Probed 2026-09-07: www.convergys.com is an Azure App Service redirect app that has been switched off and now answers "403 Site Disabled" on every path with an expired TLS certificate, and developer.convergys.com still resolves to an address block registered to Concentrix CVG Brite Voice Systems LLC with both HTTP ports closed. The successor company, Concentrix, is profiled separately and delivers most platform integration through enterprise contracts rather than a public developer program.

providers.name: coohua
providers.description: Coohua (酷划在线) is a Beijing-based Chinese mobile advertising company founded in 2014 and backed by Qiming Venture Partners. It pioneered the incentive- and lock-screen-advertising model in China, rewarding users with cash for unlocking their screens, reading content, and engaging with ads. Its flagship products include Coohua Lockscreen (酷划锁屏) and the Tao News (淘新闻) reading-rewards app, serving advertisers across internet, finance, automotive, and e-commerce verticals. At its peak Coohua captured a majority share of China's lock-screen advertising market and returned billions of yuan in cash rewards to users annually. No public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification could be found during enrichment; advertising business is transacted through a sales contact (sale@coohua.com) on the 广告合作 page rather than through any self-serve or programmatic surface. The company does maintain a GitHub organization (github.com/coohua-dev) publishing CocoaPods spec repositories for the iOS modules behind its two apps, but every podspec resolves its source to an unreachable internal gitlab.coohua.com host, so none of it is consumable by a third party. This profile is retained as a company/provider record surfaced from the Qiming portfolio.

providers.name: Cortex Sumare
providers.description: Cortex Sumare is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: secondary-market) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Covariant
providers.description: Covariant is an Emeryville, California warehouse-robotics AI company founded in 2017 (originally as Embodied Intelligence) by UC Berkeley professor Pieter Abbeel and his former students Peter Chen, Rocky Duan, and Tianhao Zhang. The company builds the Covariant Brain, a universal AI platform that enables industrial picking robots to handle virtually any SKU regardless of shape, size, or packaging, and in March 2024 it introduced RFM-1 (Robotics Foundation Model 1), an 8-billion-parameter multimodal transformer trained on text, images, video, robot actions, and numerical sensor readings to give robots human-like reasoning over the physical world. Covariant ships AI-powered solutions for order picking, sortation, item induction, kitting, depalletization, and goods-to-person workflows, delivered through long-running integration partnerships with KNAPP (Pick-it-Easy Robot, since 2020) and ABB (warehouse robotics, since 2020), as well as deployments with retailers and logistics providers worldwide. In August 2024, Amazon announced a non-exclusive license to Covariant's robotic foundation models and hired its three co-founders along with roughly a quarter of its workforce in a reverse-acquihire arrangement; Covariant continues to operate independently under COO-turned-CEO Ted Stinson and co-founder Tianhao Zhang. The Covariant Brain and RFM-1 are proprietary, deployed on-premise on partner robotics hardware, and the company has no public developer API, SDK, open-source release, or third-party developer program.

providers.name: Cron Systems
providers.description: Cron Systems (now operating as Cron AI) builds deep-learning perception software for 3D sensor and LiDAR data. Its flagship platform, senseEDGE, performs real-time 3D object detection, classification, and tracking from point-cloud data at the edge, with multi-sensor fusion and adverse-weather resilience. The technology serves intelligent transportation systems, smart infrastructure, autonomous mobility, smart cities, and security and surveillance — powering use cases such as traffic management, autonomous tolling, crowd and queue management, smart parking, vehicle counting, and airport and aircraft-movement monitoring. Object output is emitted as JSON and Flatbuffers binary over WebSocket, with a web-based configuration and visualizer utility, VPN and PTP time-synchronization support, and a privacy-preserving, GDPR-compliant design. Cron AI was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; the company currently publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Cx2
providers.description: CX2 is a defense technology company building AI-enabled electromagnetic spectrum (electronic warfare) systems for the tactical edge. Founded in 2024 and headquartered in El Segundo, California, CX2 develops attritable, machine-learning-powered hardware and software that detect, disrupt, and geolocate RF threats across land, air, sea, and space. Its flagship products are Wraith, a roughly 32-pound autonomous airborne EW platform that geolocates and identifies hostile emitters such as jammers and radars in GPS-denied environments, and Vadris, an RF-seeking payload for FPV drones that hunts ground control stations and other emitters of interest. CX2 is backed by 8VC, Point72 Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, and others, and sells directly to military and government customers. It does not currently publish a public API or developer portal.

providers.name: Cylake
providers.description: Cylake is an AI-native cybersecurity company founded in 2026 by Nir Zuk, Wilson Xu, and Ehud (Udi) Shamir — veterans of Palo Alto Networks — to deliver complete, data-driven security for the world's largest and most regulated organizations that require total data sovereignty. Its platform combines hardware and software with agentic workflows on a single, sovereign data foundation, running on-premises or in a private cloud with no dependence on public cloud or external AI services. Cylake launched publicly in March 2026 with a $45M seed round led by Greylock Partners (with IQT participating), is being built alongside several design partners, and plans general availability in early 2027. As of this writing Cylake does not publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs — this profile tracks the company's identity and public surface pending an API program.

providers.name: data.egov.bg (Open Data Portal of Bulgaria)
providers.description: data.egov.bg is the national government open-data portal for Bulgaria, operated by the Ministry of e-Government (Министерство на електронното управление). It is a custom Laravel application exposing a REST API with action-style endpoints (predominantly POST with JSON bodies) under the /api prefix. It is not CKAN. Public read endpoints require no key; write/admin endpoints require an api_key obtained via a free account.

providers.name: data.gov.hr
providers.description: data.gov.hr (Portal otvorenih podataka) is the national government open-data portal for Croatia, operated by the Ministry of Justice and Public Administration. It runs CKAN 2.9.9 and exposes the standard CKAN Action API over approximately 3,858 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access, plus DCAT-AP RDF/XML catalog feeds for EU harvesting. Note that the CKAN API is mounted under a non-default /ckan/ path prefix; root-level CKAN URLs return the Vue single-page-app HTML rather than JSON.

providers.name: dataset.gov.md (Portalul Datelor Deschise)
providers.description: dataset.gov.md is the national government open-data catalog for the Republic of Moldova (Portalul Datelor Deschise). The landing portal at date.gov.md links out to this catalog, which runs CKAN 2.10.4 and exposes the standard CKAN Action API over approximately 1,275 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. No API key is required for read endpoints.

providers.name: Deepnight
providers.description: Deepnight is a San Francisco defense-technology company building AI-powered digital night vision. It embeds edge AI models into commoditized digital (CMOS) image sensors, using a deep neural network that aggregates photons temporally to recover true information in near-total darkness — down to overcast moonless starlight (0.1 millilux) — exceeding the performance of conventional Gen 3 analog image-intensifier tubes at a fraction of the cost. By using mass-manufactured consumer-electronics sensors, Deepnight aims to turn night vision from a scarce defense capability into a scalable digital product for people, robots, drones, and autonomous vehicles. Founded by former Google engineers Lucas Young and Thomas Li, the company is backed by Initialized Capital and has won U.S. Army and Air Force contracts. Deepnight publishes no public developer API; this profile tracks its web and security surface.

providers.name: DEFCON AI
providers.description: DEFCON AI is a modeling, simulation, and analysis (MS&A) company based in McLean, Virginia, building AI-driven optimization for contested logistics and mobility across defense and commercial operations. Founded in 2022, it develops mission-tailored optimization and intelligent-agent simulation products - including ARTIV (delivered to U.S. Air Force Air Mobility Command) and R-ALIGN for resilient multimodal logistics - that let planners rapidly generate and evaluate mission scenarios in dynamic, disrupted environments. The company was awarded a five-year, $115M prototype agreement supporting U.S. Marine Corps logistics modernization. DEFCON AI publishes no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Derq
providers.description: Derq is an MIT spinoff (founded 2016, with operations in Dubai and Detroit) building AI-powered intelligent transportation systems that help cities, departments of transportation, and infrastructure operators prevent crashes and improve traffic flow. Its hardware-agnostic platform ingests data from video cameras, radar, LiDAR, signal controllers, and connected/V2X infrastructure, then runs real-time edge computer vision and machine learning to detect, track, and predict the movement of vehicles, pedestrians, and cyclists. Derq surfaces safety and traffic intelligence — crashes, near misses, violations, conflicts, counts, and ATSPMs — through its dashboard and via APIs to third-party systems. Flagship products include Derq SENSE (real-time traffic detection and V2X perception) and Derq INSIGHT (road safety and traffic management analytics).

providers.name: designstripe
providers.description: The designstripe.com domain, blog and social handles were acquired by Visual (visual.app) in March 2025. Visual states on its own site that it acquired the marketing assets only and that Designstripe Inc. continues to operate independently, so this is an asset purchase rather than a rebrand. designstripe.com now 308-redirects to visual.app, an AI-first presentation and design-agent product for go-to-market teams — it generates presentations, proposals, QBRs and campaign assets through conversational agents with brand-lock consistency for sales, marketing and customer success. The legacy designstripe illustration marketplace and AI ad-maker have been retired. As of August 2026 the product is waitlist-only and markets an API on its homepage ("every agent is an endpoint... integrate design agents with your existing automation workflows or applications using our API"), but publishes no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI definition, GraphQL endpoint, MCP server, SDK on any package registry, pricing page, or /.well-known discovery document. The one API-shaped host, api.designstripe.com, sits behind Google Cloud Identity-Aware Proxy and answers every request with "Invalid IAP credentials: empty token" while presenting a TLS certificate for an unrelated host. This profile was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: dForce
providers.description: dForce is a decentralized stablecoin protocol powered by an integrated DeFi matrix spanning assets, lending, trading, and an omni-chain bridge. It positions itself as an AI-native on-chain capital markets platform, unifying its USX USD-pegged stablecoin, permissionless lending markets, yield vaults, a real-world-asset (RWA) marketplace, a DEX, the InteNet launchpad, and DF-native cross-chain bridging under DAO governance driven by the DF token. dForce ships as smart contracts across multiple EVM chains rather than a hosted REST API; its developer surface is on-chain contracts, open documentation, and the dforce-network GitHub organization. Backed by Multicoin Capital.

providers.name: Dryft
providers.description: Dryft, Inc. is a Palo Alto, California startup building an AI operating system for manufacturing operations. The platform pairs context-aware, agent-based intelligence with mathematical optimization to mimic, optimize, and automate complex human decisions across the shop floor and supply chain. Dryft reads operational data from existing ERPs and inventory systems, identifies issues such as late items or stockouts, and autonomously recommends and executes actions like adjusting order quantities and safety stocks or following up with suppliers. The company frames this as a shift from static Enterprise Resource Planning to Enterprise Resource Automation, freeing planners to focus on strategy over administrative work. Founded in 2024 by CEO Anna-Julia Storch and CTO Leonie Freisinger, Dryft raised a $5M round led by General Catalyst with participation from Neo and Sandberg Bernthal Venture Partners. Dryft does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or documentation; this profile captures its company identity in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: eBird
providers.description: Retrieve recent or notable birding observations within a region

providers.name: Elucid Bioimaging
providers.description: Elucid Bioimaging, Inc. (operating as Elucid) is a Boston, Massachusetts medical technology company building AI-based image analysis software for cardiovascular disease. Its flagship product, Plaque-IQ, is an FDA-cleared CT-based plaque analysis platform indicated for both coronary and carotid anatomies: it applies image-restoration and segmentation algorithms to coronary CT angiography (CCTA) studies to quantify and classify lesion-level plaque morphology — including lipid-rich necrotic core — producing CAD-RADS classifications, straightened multi-planar reconstructions and a physician-validated PDF report. Elucid also offers an FFR-CT capability. The company sells to health systems, cardiologists, radiologists and vascular specialists through a clinical sales motion, and its go-to-market runs on reimbursement (Medicare Administrative Contractor, United Healthcare and EviCore coverage) rather than self-service signup. Elucid publishes no public developer program, API reference, SDK or machine-readable specification; the product is delivered as an end-user clinical platform.

providers.name: Enveil
providers.description: Enveil is a privacy-enhancing technologies (PETs) company whose ZeroReveal platform lets organizations securely use, search, and analyze data while it is being processed, without moving, replicating, or exposing it. Built on homomorphic encryption, secure multiparty computation, and trusted execution environments, ZeroReveal Search delivers encrypted search, analytics, and watchlisting as a point-to-point proxy layer, while ZeroReveal Machine Learning provides encrypted training (SMPC-based federated learning) and encrypted model evaluation. Enveil serves financial services, healthcare and insurance, government and public sector, and secure-AI use cases spanning cross-silo data collaboration, fraud detection, secure data monetization, and privacy-preserving AI. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of bloomberg-beta.

providers.name: EverestLabs
providers.description: EverestLabs builds AI, computer vision, and robotics for the recycling industry. Its RecycleOS platform identifies, tracks, and sorts recoverable materials on the conveyor lines of Materials Recovery Facilities (MRFs), giving recyclers, reclaimers, and packaging manufacturers analytics, bale tracing, plant optimization, and compliance reporting to increase recovery rates, cut labor costs, and verify recycled content. Headquartered in Fremont, California and backed by Sierra Ventures. EverestLabs does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web, GitHub, and discovery surface.

providers.name: EXMO
providers.description: Cryptocurrencies exchange based in UK

providers.name: Flowbird
providers.description: Flowbird is a global urban mobility and parking technology company that builds pay stations, mobile parking apps, digital permits, EV charging, and transit ticketing systems for cities and transport authorities worldwide. Flowbird was acquired by EasyPark Group in an acquisition that closed in January 2025. Its integration surface is the Flowbird HUB, an open platform that exposes documented but partner/agency-gated APIs (OAuth2 and client-certificate secured, with role-based access control and ownership filters) for tariffs, rights/permits, parking sessions, pay stations, and transactions. There is no self-service public sign-up; access is granted to cities, transport agencies, and integration partners under contract.

providers.name: FourKites
providers.description: FourKites is a real-time supply chain visibility platform that tracks shipments and assets across road, rail, ocean, and yard modes worldwide.

providers.name: Infinitopes
providers.description: Infinitopes is an Oxford University spinout biotech company (founded 2021, based at the BioEscalator in Oxford, UK) developing off-the-shelf precision cancer vaccines aimed at preventing deaths from cancer metastases. Its proprietary Precision Immunomics platform identifies tumor-specific antigens by integrating immunopeptidomics, advanced laboratory methods, machine learning, and validated biological testing across cancer types, paired with engineered viral vectors that elicit protective CD8 T-cell responses. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Amplify Partners (also supported by Cancer Research UK). This is a digital-biology company profile; Infinitopes publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or technical integration surface at this time.

providers.name: Jumba
providers.description: Jumba is a Nairobi-based construction technology company founded in 2022 that digitizes the sourcing and financing of construction materials across Africa. Its B2B marketplace connects hardware retail stores and construction sites to manufacturers and suppliers of materials such as cement, steel, tiles, plumbing, electrical, paint and finishes, offering real-time price comparison and online ordering. Jumba OS is a management application for tracking sales, inventory and creditor accounts, while Jengwa provides buy-now-pay-later inventory financing. The company operates a consumer mobile app and reports processing over 12.6 million cement bags through more than 1,350 hardware stores, and is backed by Speedinvest. Jumba does not publish a public API; its developer presence is limited to open-source tooling on its GitHub organization.

providers.name: Kinvey
providers.description: Kinvey was a mobile Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS / mBaaS) platform providing app developers with hosted data storage, user management and authentication, file storage, push notifications, caching/offline sync, and serverless business logic through its Flex (FlexData / FlexFunctions) services. It shipped first-party client SDKs for web, Node.js, iOS/macOS (Swift), Android/Java, Xamarin/.NET, NativeScript, Angular/Ionic, and Cordova/PhoneGap, plus a command-line utility for managing apps, environments, and Flex microservices. Kinvey was acquired by Progress Software; the standalone developer surface has since been retired (kinvey.com redirects into Progress and the GitHub organization was archived in February 2025), though the published SDKs and CLI remain available on their package registries.

providers.name: Knit Health
providers.description: Knit Health Technologies, Inc. is a healthcare AI company spun out of the University of California, Berkeley, building what it calls a Large Clinical Behavior Model (LCBM) — a healthcare-native intelligence layer trained on real clinical decision patterns rather than text alone. Where conventional clinical AI is built on large language models trained on medical literature, Knit learns from the actions of practicing clinicians captured in electronic medical records: referral decisions, scheduling behavior, patient routing, discharge timing, and care coordination. The model is trained on Truveta EMR data representing more than 130 million patients across 30 U.S. health systems, using deep reinforcement learning, causal inference, and behavioral cloning, then fine-tuned to an individual health system's own practice patterns. Knit sells to health systems as an enterprise intelligence platform spanning intelligent specialist routing, predictive patient flow, optimized care team allocation, clinical variation insight, and proactive care recommendations. The company launched from stealth in May 2026 with an $11.6M seed round co-led by Uncork Capital and Frist Cressey Ventures, following a pre-seed led by Moxxie Ventures with Coalition Operators. Knit states that its engineers work alongside customer teams to design and deploy APIs tailored to each health system; as of this profile there is no public developer portal, API documentation, or self-serve API surface.

providers.name: LAMMA Toscana Open Data
providers.description: LAMMA Toscana Open Data is a government agency open-data portal for Italy running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 184 datasets from Tuscany's meteorological and environmental research agency.

providers.name: Levelset
providers.description: Levelset is a New Orleans-based construction payment software company that helps contractors, subcontractors, material suppliers, and equipment rental firms manage mechanics lien rights, preliminary notices, lien waivers, and payment compliance across all 50 U.S. states. The platform automates preliminary notice delivery, lien filing and release, conditional and unconditional lien waiver exchange, job and stakeholder research, and contractor payment-history monitoring, with deep state-by-state lien-law templates and deadline tracking. Founded as zlien in 2011 and rebranded to Levelset in 2018, the company was acquired by Procore Technologies for approximately $500 million in November 2021 and now operates as part of Procore's invoicing and payments suite. Customer-facing integrations exist with Procore, Sage, Viewpoint, Foundation, Acumatica, QuickBooks and other construction ERP and accounting platforms, but Levelset does not currently publish a self-serve public REST API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or a developer portal — integrations are delivered through partner-built connectors, the Procore Marketplace, and direct enterprise engagements with the Levelset integrations team. The Levelset GitHub organization is empty and developers.levelset.com / developer.levelset.com are not publicly reachable as of this profile date.

providers.name: Lydia AI
providers.description: Lydia AI is an enterprise AI company whose flagship platform, ORCA, reasons through complex operational problems and delivers structured work product rather than chat replies. ORCA spans three domains: Content & Commerce (generating product content, campaign assets, and structured search data), Evidence & Analysis (analyzing large document sets for legal discovery), and Operations & Logistics (optimizing routing, dispatch, and disruption response). The company is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Lydia AI exposes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API surface; engagement is via a book-a-demo/contact sales motion.

providers.name: Lyten
providers.description: Lyten is a San Jose, California advanced-materials company founded in 2015 that invented and commercializes Lyten 3D Graphene, a tunable three-dimensional carbon supermaterial produced by converting methane into nanostructured carbon while co-producing hydrogen. Lyten applies that materials platform across four product lines: lithium-sulfur battery cells and battery systems that contain no cobalt, nickel or manganese and target roughly 40% weight savings versus lithium-ion; 3D graphene reinforced 3D printer filament; concrete admixture and structural adhesives; and chemical/environmental sensors, including the Lyten Atmos continuous methane-intelligence platform that pairs solar-powered LTE field sensors with cloud analytics and dashboards for landfill and oil-and-gas emissions monitoring. The company has raised over $600 million from investors including Stellantis, FedEx and Honeywell, operates a 145,000 sq ft pilot manufacturing facility in the Alviso district of North San Jose, acquired Cuberg's San Leandro battery assets in 2024, and in 2025 acquired Northvolt battery manufacturing assets in Poland and Sweden, establishing a European headquarters in Gdansk, Poland. Lyten is a private company; its shares trade on secondary markets such as Forge Global. It publishes no public developer API, SDK or developer portal.

providers.name: Mangata Finance
providers.description: Mangata Finance (Mangata X, since rebranded GASP) is a decentralized exchange built as a Substrate parachain in the Polkadot and Kusama ecosystem. It is designed for algorithmic traders and DeFi frontends, offering gas-free swaps, an omnichain ZK-rollup architecture, and a Proof-of-Liquidity consensus model where liquidity providers help secure the network. There is no REST or OpenAPI surface; developers integrate through a TypeScript SDK (@mangata-finance/sdk) that communicates with the Mangata Substrate node over Polkadot.js JSON-RPC/WebSocket, with published type-definition packages and open-source node, bridge, and dev-kit repositories under the gasp-xyz GitHub organization.

providers.name: Nothing
providers.description: Nothing is a London-based consumer technology company designing smartphones (Phone series), wireless earbuds (Ear series), and other consumer hardware under the Nothing and CMF by Nothing brands, backed by EQT Ventures and GV. Surfaced as a portfolio-company lead in the API Evangelist network. An enrichment pass confirmed Nothing publishes a consumer web presence (support centre, community, careers, playground) but no public developer API, API documentation, developer portal, SDK, or webhook surface as of this pass.

providers.name: Novo Space
providers.description: Novo Space develops high-performance, radiation-tolerant, modular electronics for the most ambitious space missions. Founded by Rodrigo Diez (CEO) and Facundo Jorge (CTO), the company builds SpaceVPX single-board computers, mass memory and GPU boards, tailored subsystems, and radiation-tolerant FPGA IP cores (SpaceWire, SpaceFibre, Ethernet/TCP-IP, CCSDS, NAND controllers, floating-point units) that let satellite and spacecraft builders reuse qualified hardware instead of re-engineering every mission. Customers and partners include Maxar, MIT, Thales Alenia Space, BAE Systems, Leonardo DRS, Mitsubishi, the US Air Force, Nvidia, Ansys, and Microchip. Novo Space is a space-computing hardware provider and does not publish a public web API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Oncor Electric Delivery
providers.description: Oncor Electric Delivery is the largest regulated transmission and distribution utility in Texas, operating the poles, wires and advanced meters that serve ERCOT customers. It publishes no public developer API; meter data access runs through the multi-utility Smart Meter Texas portal and retail electric provider exchanges use ERCOT Texas SET EDI transactions.

providers.name: opendata.rks-gov.net (Kosovo Open Data) [offline]
providers.description: opendata.rks-gov.net (RKS Open Data) was the national government open-data portal for the Republic of Kosovo, historically running CKAN (~v2.7). As of mid-2025 the hostname no longer resolves (NXDOMAIN) and the portal is offline; the last Internet Archive snapshots are from June 2025. It is cataloged here as historical pending restoration. Sectoral government open-data services remain available (e.g. Kosovo Customs at dogana.rks-gov.net/OpenData and the national geoportal at geoportal.rks-gov.net).

providers.name: Opolskie Open Data
providers.description: Opolskie Open Data is a regional government open-data portal for Poland running DKAN.

providers.name: Podqi
providers.description: Podqi is an AI-native intellectual property and brand protection platform that automatically detects and removes brand infringements across digital platforms. It scans major marketplaces, storefronts, and domains for counterfeit listings, stolen imagery, fake products, and copycat sites, then packages evidence and files takedowns at scale with minimal human intervention. The company reports roughly 95% AI automation with same-day detection and an average resolution time of about 1.2 days, and also operates Brandsweep.ai, a free public brand-protection scanning tool. Podqi serves brand owners, entertainment and creative companies, e-commerce sellers, and law firms. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network; as of this enrichment pass Podqi publishes no public API, developer documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Pool
providers.description: Pool.com is a Web3 domain service provider offering Infinity Domains, enabling ICANN-accredited registrars and other partners to mint and distribute Second Level Domains and integrate Web3 naming into their services through Pool's registrar API.

providers.name: PopCom
providers.description: PopCom is an AI-powered automated retail technology company founded by e-commerce entrepreneur Dawn Dickson. Its flagship product, the PopShop, is a robotic self-service kiosk that dispenses physical and digital products while capturing customer data through computer vision, facial recognition, and real-time analytics. The platform gives brands and entrepreneurs the kind of sales metrics, inventory monitoring, targeted advertising, and customer-sentiment insight that online retailers enjoy, but for physical, unattended retail. PopCom sells its hardware on an annual lease with a monthly software subscription. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company; as of this enrichment pass PopCom publishes no public developer platform, API, or specification.

providers.name: Potrero Medical
providers.description: Potrero Medical — which completed a restructuring and now operates as Accuryn Medical — is a Hayward, California predictive-health medical device company founded in 2012. Its FDA-cleared Accuryn Monitoring System turns a Foley catheter into a critical-care sensor, automatically measuring urine output, intra-abdominal pressure and core body temperature so clinicians can detect acute kidney injury, sepsis and abdominal compartment syndrome earlier while reducing CAUTI risk. The monitor reaches the EMR through Capsule medical device integration rather than a first-party developer API: as of August 2026 the company publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract of any kind, and its only web surface is a WordPress marketing site at accuryn.com.

providers.name: Privacy.com
providers.description: Generate merchant-specific and one-time use credit card numbers that link back to your bank

providers.name: Pronovix
providers.description: Developer portals with multiple api gateways. No vendor lock-in. Enjoy the freedom of an open source developer portal that can connect to many API gateways.

providers.name: Proprio
providers.description: Proprio is a Seattle-based surgical technology company modernizing how surgery is predicted, performed, and perfected by combining physician expertise with immersive, intelligent technology. Its FDA-cleared Paradigm platform fuses proprietary light-field imaging, an array of advanced sensors (the Prism sensor array), and artificial intelligence to build a continuous, real-time 3D model of anatomy during spine and orthopedic procedures. Paradigm delivers radiation-free intraoperative measurement, per-vertebra registration, and structured surgical data capture, reducing radiation exposure while streamlining surgical workflows. Founded in 2016 and backed by DCVC, Proprio is commercializing surgical navigation, real-time surgical intelligence, and a growing surgical data registry. Proprio is a hardware- and software-based medical device company; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Shield AI
providers.description: Shield AI builds autonomous defense systems anchored by Hivemind, an AI-powered autonomy stack that pilots aircraft and robotic platforms without GPS or communications. Hardware products include the V-BAT vertical-takeoff ISR aircraft, the Nova quadcopter, and the announced X-BAT AI-piloted VTOL fighter. Hivemind itself is delivered as a layered platform: EdgeOS (real-time C++ autonomy middleware), Pilot (autonomy behavior catalog), Forge (autonomy factory for build, sim, and test), and Commander (C2 and fleet integration). In 2025 Shield AI introduced Hivemind Enterprise, a partner-facing SDK for building, evaluating, testing, and deploying mission autonomy on customer platforms.
