There is no public, self-service API; access to Hivemind SDKs and developer tooling is gated through partnership and is subject to U.S. export controls (ITAR/EAR).

providers.name: SilverStream
providers.description: Silverstream AI builds infrastructure for autonomous AI agents, focused on making web-browsing and enterprise-workflow agents reliable enough for real-world, production use. Its work includes Silverstream Bench (a platform for storing, reviewing, and sharing Claude Code sessions), the open Pasta-1T dataset of web trajectories for training browser agents, and benchmark results such as 94% accuracy (2-sigma reliability) on ServiceNow tasks. The company emerged from stealth in March 2025 with a $1.2M pre-seed round. As of this profile it publishes a marketing site and product pages but no public API, developer documentation, SDK, or OpenAPI surface, so most API-facing enrichment is not applicable.

providers.name: Spectora
providers.description: Spectora is home inspection software used by more than 10,000 inspectors to build inspection reports, schedule jobs, manage clients and agents, run a website, take payments, and automate follow-up. Spectora does NOT publish a public, self-serve developer REST API and there is no developer portal, API reference, or API keys for third-party programmatic access as of this writing. Integration with outside systems is instead delivered three ways: (1) a Zapier integration (requires the paid Spectora Advanced add-on) that fires triggers when agent or client contacts are created or updated; (2) outbound webhooks configured through Advanced Actions that POST event data to a URL you supply (e.g. Zapier, Make, or your own endpoint); and (3) a fixed set of named, vendor-built partner integrations (QuickBooks Online, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Mailchimp, HomeBinder, RecallChek, Repair Pricer, Blipp Reviews, InterNACHI BuyBack, and call-center partners). All of these are configuration-time connectors and one-way (outbound) event flows rather than a documented request/response API you can call.

providers.name: State Employees' Credit Union
providers.description: State Employees' Credit Union (SECU / NCSECU) is a member-owned, not-for-profit financial cooperative headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina. Founded in 1937 with 17 members and $437 in deposits, it is a state-chartered credit union regulated by the Credit Union Division of the North Carolina Department of Commerce and federally insured by the NCUA (NMLS #430055). SECU is the second-largest natural-person credit union in the United States by both assets and membership, serving nearly 2.9 million member-owners with roughly $56 billion in assets across 275 branches in all 100 North Carolina counties. Membership is primarily limited to North Carolina state employees and their families. On the open-finance front, SECU operates no public first-party developer portal and publishes no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger specifications; its consumer digital banking (Member Access) supports connecting external accounts for aggregation, and outbound consumer-permissioned data sharing is handled through data aggregators rather than a documented first-party API. No public FDX-conformant data-access endpoint or CFPB Section 1033 data-rights posture is published as of July 2026.

providers.name: Stessa
providers.description: Stessa is a financial reporting, accounting, and management platform for rental property owners and small-to-mid-size landlords, headquartered in San Francisco and operated as a brand of Roofstock alongside Mynd and RentPrep. The platform helps owners track unlimited properties and portfolios with automated bank and credit card feeds, transaction categorization, mileage tracking, receipt scanning, Schedule E-ready tax reporting, online rent collection, tenant screening through RentPrep, e-signature leasing with 50+ legal templates, maintenance request tracking, and property-specific Stessa Cash Management accounts with high-yield APY and FDIC insurance up to $3M per entity. Stessa is delivered as a web app and iOS/Android mobile apps with three tiers — Essentials (free), Manage, and Pro — and serves more than 350,000 landlords. Bank, credit card, and payment data flows in through aggregator partners (Plaid-style open banking) rather than a public Stessa API, and the only developer-facing GitHub presence is an org with a handful of forked Ruby and Vue.js utilities. There is no public Stessa REST API, no developer portal, no SDKs, and no published webhooks; the Stessa community has open feature requests for a public API to pull reports and transactions, but none has shipped.

providers.name: Stride
providers.description: Stride is a multichain liquid staking protocol built as a Cosmos SDK appchain (chain-id stride-1) and secured by Cosmos Hub interchain security. Users stake proof-of-stake assets such as ATOM, TIA, DYDX, OSMO, DYM, SAGA, and LUNA and receive liquid staking receipt tokens (stATOM, stTIA, and others) that keep accruing staking rewards while remaining usable across DeFi for trading, lending, collateral, and liquidity provision. Stride is IBC-connected and uses a Hyperlane bridge for cross-chain reach. Its machine-readable surface is the Cosmos SDK gRPC and REST (LCD) query interface plus IBC, wrapped by the official stridejs TypeScript SDK; Stride does not publish a REST OpenAPI. Backed by Multicoin Capital.

providers.name: Swift Transportation
providers.description: Swift Transportation, now operating as Knight-Swift Transportation Holdings (KNX), is the largest full truckload motor carrier in North America. The company provides truckload, LTL, logistics, and intermodal transportation services across the US, Mexico, and Canada. Technology integration is primarily through EDI for freight tendering, shipment status, and invoicing workflows with trading partners and shippers.

providers.name: The Estée Lauder Companies
providers.description: The Estée Lauder Companies Inc. (NYSE: EL) is one of the world's leading manufacturers, marketers and sellers of quality prestige skin care, makeup, fragrance and hair care products. Founded in 1946 by Estée and Joseph Lauder, the family-controlled, New York-headquartered conglomerate operates a portfolio of more than 20 prestige brands sold in approximately 150 countries and territories, employs roughly 57,000 people worldwide, and reported fiscal 2025 net sales of approximately $14.32 billion. ELC's corporate website (elcompanies.com) does not expose any public developer APIs, OpenAPI specs, SDKs, sandboxes, or a developer portal — the EsteeLauder GitHub organization is empty of public repositories. The technology surface is instead expressed through enterprise partnerships: the AI Innovation Lab (announced 2023, expanded April 2024) jointly run with Microsoft on Azure OpenAI Service; the ConsumerIQ tool built on Microsoft Copilot Studio (2025); an Adobe Firefly Services generative AI collaboration for digital marketing assets (March 2025); a Google Gemini / Vertex AI–powered Jo Malone London Scent Advisor (December 2025); and a Shopify-based unified global direct-to-consumer commerce platform (announced October 2025, ~50% rolled out by calendar year-end 2026). ELC's strategic vision, "Beauty Reimagined" (announced February 2025), and the Profit Recovery and Growth Plan ($0.8–1.0B gross benefits; $1.2–1.6B restructuring charges) anchor the One ELC operating model now led by CEO Stéphane de La Faverie and Board Chair William P. Lauder.

providers.name: United Solar
providers.description: United Solar (United Solar Polysilicon FZC SPC) is a clean-technology company producing ultra-high-purity polysilicon for the photovoltaic industry from one of the world's most advanced manufacturing facilities in Oman's Sohar Free Zone, with an annual capacity of 100,000 metric tons supporting roughly 40 GW of solar module production. Backed by IDG Capital and the IFC, the company completed a $1.6 billion capital raise in 2026 and is the largest polysilicon producer of its kind outside China. United Solar is an industrial manufacturer and does not publish a developer portal or public APIs.

providers.name: United States European Command
providers.description: United States European Command (EUCOM) is one of the eleven unified combatant commands of the U.S. Department of Defense. EUCOM is responsible for U.S. military operations and security cooperation in Europe, as well as parts of North Africa and the Middle East. The command works to support NATO allies, deter aggression, and ensure regional stability through military exercises, humanitarian operations, and partnership activities. EUCOM does not expose public-facing REST APIs; access to EUCOM data systems requires DoD Common Access Card (CAC) authentication through restricted portals including the EUCOM intranet portal and milSuite collaboration platform.

providers.name: VeriSign
providers.description: VeriSign is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The VeriSign API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Volterra
providers.description: Volterra was a Santa Clara-based distributed cloud company founded in 2017 by Ankur Singla, Harshad Nakil, and Ashish Ranjan, offering the VoltMesh (multi-cloud networking and security) and VoltStack (edge application deployment) SaaS platforms on a global application delivery network. Backed by roughly $50M from Khosla Ventures, Mayfield, M12, Samsung NEXT, and Itochu Technology Ventures, Volterra was acquired by F5 in January 2021 for approximately $500M and became the foundation of F5 Distributed Cloud Services. Its API surface (ves.io.schema, console.ves.volterra.io) is catalogued in the F5 Distributed Cloud Services profile, while the Volterra-branded Terraform provider and vesctl CLI remain published and maintained by F5.

providers.name: Westbound Equity Partners
providers.description: Westbound Equity Partners is a venture capital firm that invests financial and social capital into values-aligned founding teams, aiming to build a virtuous cycle of wealth and opportunity. The firm backs ventures across workplace equity and wealth-building, climate tech and decarbonization, AI and advanced technology, and social impact, and supports founders through the Westbound Network of entrepreneurs, operators, and investors plus culture coaching and talent services. Portfolio companies include Esusu, Planet FWD, Syndio, Sierra, Mon Ami, The Browser Company, Conduit Tech, Manas AI, and Laborup. Surfaced as a portfolio company of foundry-group. Westbound publishes a marketing and careers website but no public developer or API program.

providers.name: Western & Southern Financial Group
providers.description: Western & Southern Financial Group is a Fortune 500 diversified family of financial services companies headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio. Founded in 1888, the group offers life insurance, annuities, mutual funds, asset management, retirement planning, and investment management through a family of subsidiaries including Western & Southern Life, Columbus Life, Gerber Life, Integrity Life, Lafayette Life, Fort Washington Investment Advisors, Touchstone Investments, and W&S Financial Group Distributors, with over $112 billion in assets under management.

providers.name: Wise Systems
providers.description: Wise Systems provides autonomous routing and last-mile delivery optimization software powered by machine learning. Its platform helps fleet operators plan strategy, optimize and dynamically re-route deliveries, dispatch in real time, track driver performance, and improve last-mile efficiency across industries including auto parts, beverage, building materials, container management, field service, food service, healthcare, linen services, parcel/courier, and retail. Wise Systems exposes an internal "Engine API" during customer implementations to connect data inputs and outputs, but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs. Backed by Techstars and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.

providers.name: Witness AI
providers.description: WitnessAI is an AI security and governance platform that lets enterprises safely deploy and manage AI across their workforce. Its platform spans three pillars: Observe (visibility into all AI activity, shadow-AI discovery, and cataloging of applications and agents), Control (governance policies, audit trails, and compliance across human and AI workforces), and Protect (runtime security that blocks prompt injection and jailbreaks and filters harmful outputs). It addresses data leakage, prompt-injection attacks, unauthorized agent activity, and compliance gaps. The company is backed by GV. As of this profile no public API, developer portal, or SDKs are published; engagement is via sales/demo.

providers.name: XFuel
providers.description: XFuel develops, patents, and deploys technologies that transform diverse waste into low-carbon drop-in transport fuels, using its Chemical Liquid Refining (CLR) and Mechanical Carbon Conversion (MECC) processes to produce marine (ISO 8217 DMA), road (EN590), and in-development sustainable aviation fuels. Headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, with operations in Bunyola, Spain, and backed by Union Square Ventures. XFuel publishes no public API or developer program as of 2026-07-21.

providers.name: Yield Guild Games
providers.description: Yield Guild Games (YGG) is a decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) and one of the world's first and largest web3 gaming guilds, founded in 2020 by Gabby Dizon, Beryl Li, and the pseudonymous "Owl of Moistness" out of the Philippines. YGG invests in NFTs and blockchain-game assets, lends them to players, and shares the resulting yield with its community and YGG token holders. Its onchain Guild Protocol (launched on Base) equips guilds with a modular library of smart-contract tooling for treasury wallets, programmable quests, and contribution tracking, while YGG Play acts as a publisher for casual crypto games. The company was backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), which led a $4.6M round in 2021. Note: this repository slug "yield-guide-games" preserves an upstream typo of the real company name, Yield Guild Games.

providers.name: Zenysis
providers.description: Zenysis is a health intelligence infrastructure company that helps governments and organizations across low- and middle-income countries turn fragmented, messy health data into actionable insight. Its flagship Harmony Analytics Platform is open source (AGPL-3.0) and transforms, cleans, enriches, and integrates data from many disparate sources for analysis, visualization, and decision support. Zenysis powers national health information systems, disease surveillance, and program monitoring. There is no public hosted API product; Harmony is self-hosted and exposes its own REST (Flask-Potion) and GraphQL interfaces on a per-deployment basis. This repo was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched from the company's public web and GitHub presence.

providers.name: Zurich Open Data
providers.description: Zurich Open Data is a municipal government open-data portal for Switzerland running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 925 datasets.

providers.name: 280 Earth
providers.description: 280 Earth is a direct air capture (DAC) company that permanently removes carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. Originally launched in 2018 inside X, the Alphabet moonshot factory, and spun out as an independent company in 2022, it is backed by Sergey Brin, Builders VC and a $50M Series B. Its proprietary sorbent moves through a gravity-fed dual-chamber system that continuously cycles material between capturing and releasing CO2, running on low-grade industrial waste heat or clean electricity and producing fresh water as a byproduct. Its first pilot plant, in The Dalles, Oregon, captures 500 tons of CO2 per year on a site sized for more than 20,000 tons per year at full build-out, and underpins a $40M offtake agreement with the Frontier carbon removal buyer consortium (Google, Meta, Stripe, Shopify and others). 280 Earth is a hardware and carbon-removal operator; as of this profiling pass it publishes no public developer surface, API, or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: 2bytes
providers.description: 2bytes Corporation (투바이트) is a South Korean game services and publishing company founded in 2020 in Seoul, providing game localization, QA testing, player support, content marketing, live operations and global launch support to more than 40 game company partners including Pearl Abyss and Kakao Games. The company also builds and operates an H5 (HTML5) game platform that runs in-app without installation, covering platform construction, global H5 game sourcing, localization and live operations, integrated by partner apps through an SDK. Its service brand is 2bytes Play. As of this profile 2bytes publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API contract; the H5 platform SDK is offered through a business contact channel rather than a self-serve developer program.

providers.name: A Security
providers.description: A Security (Ⓐ) is an Israeli-founded cybersecurity company building an autonomous offensive security and remediation platform. The product continuously discovers real attack paths inside an organization, validates whether they can actually be exploited by following each path until it proves what is truly exploitable, and then helps close those gaps before adversaries chain vulnerabilities into a breach. Positioned for organizations where failure is not an option, A Security is designed to operate at machine speed to keep pace with AI-enabled attackers. The company emerged from stealth in June 2026 with $37M in funding led by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Cyberstarts, with participation from Cerca Partners and angel investors including Wiz CEO Assaf Rappaport and Cyera CEO Yotam Segev. It was founded by Yossi Torati (CEO), Omer Gull (CPO), and Yuval Itzchakov (CTO), veterans of Check Point, Hunters, Sygnia, and the IDF's Unit 8200. A Security maintains SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certifications.

providers.name: Akura Medical
providers.description: Akura Medical develops and markets the Katana™ Thrombectomy System, a medical device for treating venous thromboembolism. The company aims to address the high incidence of clot-related conditions in the United States, focusing on innovative solutions for vascular health. Their mission is to improve patient outcomes through advanced technology and dedicated research.

providers.name: Amalan
providers.description: Amalan (amalan International) is an Indonesian financial-services technology company headquartered in Jakarta and registered with Indonesia's Financial Services Authority (OJK). It helps distressed consumers and small-business owners restructure and refinance credit-card debt, personal loans (KTA), online loans (pinjol), and mortgages back toward creditworthiness. Its consumer platform provides a debt-relief negotiation program, amalanPROTECT protection against unethical debt collectors, Credit Score by amalan credit-score checks and history reports, and Credit Checkup loan-rejection consultation. Amalan is not a lender and does not take deposits or originate loans. It is backed by 500 Global. The company runs a consumer web app and marketing/blog site but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Amca
providers.description: Amca (Advanced Manufacturing Company of America) is an El Segundo, California aerospace and defense manufacturer rebuilding America's industrial base by acquiring specialized component suppliers and expanding competition and capacity for critical parts — actuators, switches, hydraulics, pressure sensors, power electronics, and flight-control electronics. Founded in 2024 by Eli Giovanetti and Jai Malik, Amca combines design, testing, and production into a single RAPID platform across a network of AS9100D-certified factories (Electro-Mech Components, Electrocube, Aerospace Control Products, Payne Magnetics, Cal-Draulics, BC Power Systems), and serves nearly every major aerospace and defense prime and Tier 1 supplier — Boeing, Lockheed Martin, Airbus, GE Aerospace, Honeywell, Textron, BAE Systems, and the Defense Logistics Agency. It is a hardware manufacturing company with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Astra Space
providers.description: Astra is a commercial space company providing dedicated small satellite launch services and flight-proven electric propulsion systems. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Alameda, California, Astra sells two products: Launch Services on Rocket 4 — targeting roughly 600 kg to low Earth orbit at a weekly cadence — and the Astra Spacecraft Engine, a flight-proven Hall-effect electric propulsion system sold in single- and multi-thruster configurations for satellite constellations. Astra became the fastest privately funded U.S. company to reach orbit in 2021 and returned to private ownership in July 2024. Astra publishes no public developer API, SDK, or machine-readable specification; its buyer-facing surface is a set of launch-services and spacecraft-engine inquiry forms alongside a published Rocket 4 Payload User's Guide and engine data sheet.

providers.name: Baebies
providers.description: Baebies is a diagnostics company specializing in digital microfluidics technology to deliver rapid, multifunctional point‑of‑care tests. Based in Durham, North Carolina, Baebies creates platforms such as the FINDER series for G6PD, Flu A/B, SARS‑CoV‑2, and Anti‑Factor Xa, aiming to bring high‑quality testing to laboratories and bedside settings worldwide.

providers.name: Barinthus Biotherapeutics
providers.description: Barinthus Biotherapeutics plc (Nasdaq: BRNS) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel immunotherapies designed to guide and reprogram T cells to overcome autoimmunity, inflammatory disease, chronic viral infection, and cancer. Its lead SNAP-TI and SNAP-CI antigen-specific platforms and ChAdOx/MVA immunotherapeutic candidates power a five-program pipeline including VTP-1000 (celiac disease), VTP-300 (chronic hepatitis B), VTP-200 (high-risk HPV), VTP-850 (recurrent prostate cancer), and VTP-1100 (HPV-related cancer). The company was formed in 2021 through the merger of Oxford University spinout Vaccitech plc and NIH/Johns Hopkins spinout Avidea Technologies, and is headquartered in Germantown, Maryland with research facilities in the UK. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan and added to the API Evangelist network. As a therapeutics company it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or agent surface.

providers.name: Buglance
providers.description: Buglance is a crowdsourced software testing platform that connects companies with a global community of more than 50,000 professional bug hunters to find defects and quality issues in mobile apps, games, e-commerce sites, and web platforms before release. Testers can be targeted by country, age, gender, and device type across a fleet of 10,000+ real devices, and detailed, validated, severity-classified bug reports are typically delivered in under 24 hours through live analytics dashboards. Buglance is a 500 Global portfolio company and markets to mobile gaming, e-commerce and retail, and lifestyle and productivity teams. It is added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal was found during enrichment.

providers.name: CareClinic
providers.description: CareClinic MCP is a private OAuth-connected health-tracking service for supported AI assistants: user-authorized schedule and wellness reads, observational summaries, and explicitly confirmed symptom or mood writes. Medication writes remain disabled. MCP-only surface -- there is no public REST contract, by design.

providers.name: Carnival
providers.description: Carnival Corporation & plc is the world's largest cruise company operating eight cruise line brands (Carnival Cruise Line, Princess Cruises, Holland America Line, Seabourn, Cunard, P&O Cruises, Costa Cruises, AIDA Cruises), plus the White Pass and Yukon Route. Carnival operates the OceanMedallion wearable IoT technology and mobile experience platform, the Carnival HUB app, the Princess MedallionClass app, and a portfolio of guest-facing digital experiences across its fleet of over 90 ships.

providers.name: Cartame
providers.description: Cartame is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: secondary-market) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Cellboxsolutions
providers.description: Cellbox Solutions develops innovative logistics solutions for the global bio‑medical industry, focusing on portable CO₂ incubators and temperature‑controlled transport systems that keep living cells and biological samples viable during shipment. Their flagship products enable safe, regulated transport for cell and gene therapy, drug discovery, and pre‑clinical research, integrating hardware, software, and logistics expertise to support the warm‑chain logistics needs of modern life‑science workflows.

providers.name: Changingtek
providers.description: Changingtek Robotics Technology (Suzhou) Co., Ltd., founded in August 2018, is a Chinese high‑tech enterprise specializing in the research, development, and manufacturing of dexterous robotic hands, humanoid grippers, and embodied intelligent robots. The company provides a portfolio of collaborative robot grippers, parallel gripper series, integrated actuators, and mobile manipulators for industrial automation, warehouse logistics, aerospace, and other fields. It serves global customers with product selection manuals, digital models, user manuals, and software support, positioning itself as a leader in intelligent gripping solutions.

providers.name: Chingona Ventures
providers.description: Chingona Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm that writes first institutional checks into pre-seed companies, typically investing $250,000 to $2 million into founders building in industries that are massively changing. The firm concentrates on financial technology, the future of work, the future of learning, and health technology, backing founders with unique market positioning in large, often overlooked growth markets. Its portfolio spans 40+ companies including Finix, Hologram, Suma Wealth, Honey Homes, Connect Care Hero, and Boom Pay. This API Evangelist profile was originally surfaced as a venture-capital lead and has been enriched with firm identity and domain-security signals; the firm publishes no public API, so API-specific artifacts are not applicable.

providers.name: Cogitativo
providers.description: Cogitativo delivers precision health solutions for health plans and public programs, using AI to connect decisions with outcomes. Their platform offers products like Vision, Conciencia, and Cognitive CxO to manage clinical costs, provider access, payment integrity, and care fragmentation, helping organizations improve care quality and reduce expenses.

providers.name: Conapto
providers.description: Conapto provides scalable, secure and sustainable data center colocation and cloud connectivity services. Based in Sweden, Conapto offers flexible colocation solutions, interconnect, cloud‑connect, and sale‑leaseback options for enterprises seeking reliable infrastructure with low carbon footprint. The company emphasizes climate‑responsible operations, high availability, and competitive electricity costs, serving customers across Europe and globally.

providers.name: Copernicus
providers.description: Copernicus is the European Union’s Earth observation programme, providing free, open access to satellite data and services that monitor the environment, climate, and security. It delivers a wide range of products from Sentinel satellites, enabling applications in agriculture, disaster management, climate change, and more. The programme supports public authorities, businesses, and researchers with timely, high‑resolution imagery and analytics, fostering innovation and sustainable development across Europe and globally.

providers.name: Corpay
providers.description: Corpay (formerly FLEETCOR) is a corporate payments company that provides commercial cards, accounts payable automation, cross-border payment solutions, fuel and fleet cards, and workforce travel management services. The company serves over 800,000 customers globally through its Corpay Complete spend management platform and ERP integrations. A public, openly accessible developer API portal could not be confirmed from the corporate website at the time of this review.

providers.name: Craftview
providers.description: Craftview Software GmbH is a Frankfurt-headquartered European software group that builds ERP and project-management software for the skilled trades. Formed as a buy-and-build platform, Craftview operates a portfolio of long-established regional ERP brands — C'FLUIDE, ES2000, EXTRABAT, GILDE, KS21, MOSER, OSD, PLENION, RITA BOSSE and WINWORKER — serving green industries, construction-related trades, technical services and specialized crafts across Germany, Belgium, the Netherlands and France. The group reports 25,000+ active customers, 330+ employees and 11 locations across 41 key European regions. Craftview publishes no public developer portal, API documentation or machine-readable API definitions; its software is sold and delivered per brand as on-premise and cloud ERP for trade businesses.

providers.name: Deposco
providers.description: Deposco is a cloud supply chain execution platform combining order management (OMS) and warehouse management (WMS) for retailers, brands, 3PLs, and DTC ecommerce sellers. Its Bright Suite gives real-time visibility into inventory, orders, and shipments across the fulfillment lifecycle - receiving, putaway, picking, packing, and shipping. Deposco integrates through a REST API exposed on its Developer Portal (developer.deposco.com) using resource paths under /integration/{code}/, secured with OAuth 2.0 / per-merchant API credentials and scoped by tenant code and business unit. API access is provisioned per customer through a Deposco account manager rather than through open self-service signup, and Deposco also ships 150+ pre-built connectors and EDI integrations.

providers.name: edX
providers.description: edX is an online learning platform now operated by 2U; the underlying Open edX software is open source. Open edX exposes a comprehensive REST API surface (Enrollment, Courses, Users, Catalog, Discussion, Grades, LTI, Enterprise) and hosts a public API at api.edx.org for partners.

providers.name: Gatik
providers.description: Gatik is an autonomous trucking company founded in 2017 by Gautam Narang, Arjun Narang and Apeksha Kumavat, headquartered in Silicon Valley, California. Gatik builds and operates the Gatik Driver, an SAE Level 4 autonomy system purpose-built for the middle mile: short-haul, repeatable freight routes between distribution centers, dark stores and retail endpoints. Gatik runs driverless medium-duty box trucks in commercial service for Fortune 50 retailers and grocers including Walmart, Loblaw, Kroger, Tyson Foods, Pitney Bowes and PepsiCo, across Texas, Arkansas, Arizona, Ontario and other North American markets. The company partners with Isuzu, Ryder, Goodyear and NVIDIA, runs the Gatik Arena simulation platform, and publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK or developer portal — its surface is a corporate marketing site plus a legacy archive site carrying about, safety, news, careers and legal pages.

providers.name: Genomatica
providers.description: Genomatica (which markets itself as Geno) is a San Diego, California biotechnology and sustainable materials company founded in 1998 that engineers microbes and fermentation processes to make widely used chemical building blocks from plants instead of fossil fuels. Its commercialized process technology covers Geno BDO (bio-based 1,4-butanediol, licensed to partners including BASF and Novamont), Brontide butylene glycol for personal care, Avela (R)-1,3-butanediol, plant-based nylon-6 intermediates developed with lululemon and manufacturing partners such as Hyosung and Sojitz, plus palm-oil alternatives and fragrance building blocks. Genomatica licenses its process technology to chemical producers rather than operating a software platform; as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable specification, or agent-facing discovery surface.

providers.name: Icardio.AI
providers.description: Icardio.AI (iCardio.ai) builds artificial-intelligence software that automates the interpretation of cardiac ultrasound (echocardiography). Its FDA 510(k)-cleared products include EchoMeasure, which identifies cardiac phases and automatically measures anatomical structures to produce comprehensive echo reports, and CardioVision, which automatically detects aortic stenosis and structural heart disease from ultrasound clips (also granted FDA Breakthrough Device Designation). Additional tooling includes EchoCheck image-quality and view classification, quantitative linear and volumetric measurements, qualitative structural-disease analysis, and EchoGPT image-to-text description. The company trains on a database of 200M+ echocardiography images and partners with ultrasound manufacturers, PACS vendors, and healthcare systems, offering API integration into enterprise PACS workflows. Icardio.AI is a Techstars portfolio company.

providers.name: Inari
providers.description: Inari Agriculture, Inc. — "The SEEDesign company" — is a Cambridge, Massachusetts agricultural biotechnology company founded by Flagship Pioneering in 2016, with additional sites in West Lafayette, Indiana and Ghent, Belgium. Its SEEDesign platform combines genomics, artificial intelligence and predictive design with a multiplex gene-editing toolbox to accelerate crop improvement in soybean, corn and wheat, targeting 10-20% yield gains alongside roughly 40% reductions in nitrogen and water use. Inari runs a partner-first, business-to-business model, licensing designed seed to independent seed companies and breeders rather than selling to farmers directly. Inari publishes an llms.txt at inari.com/llms.txt but operates no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API contract; its data platform (Databricks-based) is internal. Not to be confused with the unrelated medical-device company Inari Medical.

providers.name: ISAAC Instruments
providers.description: ISAAC Instruments is a Canadian provider of in-cab technology and fleet management for the trucking industry - electronic logging devices (ELD), telematics, hours-of-service (HOS) compliance, driver workflow, messaging, and fuel/performance analytics, delivered as a fully managed hardware-plus-software platform. ISAAC runs an "Open Platform" with a documented API that lets fleets and 80+ integration partners (TMS/dispatch, maintenance, fuel tax, visibility, safety/compliance) share ISAAC data with their chosen vendors. API access is partner-gated - vendors apply through the ISAAC partner program and the full API Guide and reference live behind the ISAAC InRealTime portal and Client Center rather than on a public developer site. The API surface documented here is modeled from ISAAC's public platform and partner materials; exact endpoints, base URLs, and authentication are provisioned to approved partners.

providers.name: Jimmy
providers.description: Jimmy (Jimmy Energy SAS) is a French nuclear-technology company, founded in 2020 as a spin-off from the CEA, that designs, builds and operates small modular high-temperature reactors it calls thermal generators — helium-cooled HTR units the company describes as bus-sized — to deliver carbon-free process heat directly to industrial sites under secured 20-year supply-and-price contracts. Jimmy is headquartered in Paris with an industrial platform at Le Creusot in Burgundy, targets food, paper, sugar and chemicals producers that currently burn natural gas for process heat, and filed the first SMR creation-authorization request in France for a generator at the Cristanol site in Bazancourt. Jimmy sells heat, not software: it publishes no API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification, and this profile records that measured absence rather than assuming it.

providers.name: Kaiser Permanente
providers.description: One of the largest nonprofit health plans in the United States integrating health insurance with healthcare delivery. Serves over 12 million members through its network of hospitals, medical offices, and health plan services. Publishes a patient access FHIR API at kp.org/fhir in compliance with the CMS Interoperability and Patient Access Final Rule.

providers.name: Kyverna Therapeutics
providers.description: Kyverna Therapeutics (Nasdaq: KYTX) is a patient-centered, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Emeryville, California, developing engineered T cell therapies for patients suffering from autoimmune diseases. Kyverna adapts CD19 CAR T-cell therapy — originally developed for B cell cancers — to deeply deplete the B cells that drive autoimmunity, with the goal of durable, drug-free remission. Its lead candidate, mivocabtagene autoleucel (miv-cel, KYV-101), is a fully human CD19 CAR T-cell therapy in Phase 2 development for stiff person syndrome, myasthenia gravis and multiple sclerosis, and in Phase 1/2 development for systemic sclerosis and lupus nephritis in the United States and Germany. The pipeline also includes next-generation autologous and allogeneic CAR T constructs, including KYV-201, built on the company's Ingenui-T rapid manufacturing platform. Kyverna is a biopharmaceutical operating company and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile tracks its public web, corporate and investor surface within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: L3Harris Technologies
providers.description: L3Harris Technologies is an agile global aerospace and defense technology innovator delivering end-to-end solutions in space, air, land, sea, and cyber domains for government and commercial customers. No publicly documented APIs are available; product integrations are delivered through customer engagements.

providers.name: Lean Six Sigma Black Belt
providers.description: Lean Six Sigma Black Belt is an advanced certification in Lean Six Sigma methodology focused on leading complex improvement projects, statistical analysis, and change management to reduce defects and variability in business processes.

providers.name: Levit
providers.description: Levit Inc. (레브잇) is a software company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, best known for Alwayz (올웨이즈) — a mobile-first team-purchase commerce app launched in July 2021 that lets shoppers group together with other buyers to unlock prices below normal retail. Levit describes itself as building "a service that everybody uses everyday," and previously launched Ping in March 2021. The company runs the Alwayz Seller Center for merchants selling on the platform and publishes a seller-focused commerce blog. As of this profile Levit publishes no public developer API program, no API documentation or reference, no developer portal, and no SDKs — the enrichment pipeline probed the company and product domains and found no developer surface.

providers.name: Numos
providers.description: Numos is an AI agent platform that automates accounting and financial planning & analysis (FP&A) workflows for finance teams. It layers above existing ERPs with "zero disruption to your current architecture" and learns a company's accounting policies and entity structures to run strategic FP&A and variance analysis, continuous month-end close, accounts payable orchestration, and accounts receivable / revenue recognition. Numos is headquartered in San Mateo, California and is backed by General Catalyst. Its product is delivered as a hosted web application (app.numosai.com); the company exposes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal at this time. This profile was surfaced from the General Catalyst portfolio and enriched from Numos's public web surface.

providers.name: Pump.fun
providers.description: Pump.fun is a Solana-based memecoin launchpad and livestreaming platform that lets anyone deploy a token with a bonding-curve market in seconds; tokens that reach a target market cap graduate to PumpSwap, the project's own AMM. The project does not publish a formally documented public REST API - the canonical integration surface is the on-chain Solana programs for token creation, bonding-curve trades, and PumpSwap liquidity, plus the open-source pump-fun-sdk client. Most "Pump.fun APIs" used in the wider ecosystem are third-party indexers (Bitquery, Helius, Jupiter, Tatum) wrapping that on-chain activity.

providers.name: Riiico
providers.description: RIIICO is a Duesseldorf-based industrial software company building 3D-AI tools that digitalize the factory shop floor. Its platform turns reality scans (point clouds) of existing plants into CAD-ready, pre-classified 3D models, cutting 3D modeling time by up to 80% and accelerating factory retrofit, robot programming, and simulation. RIIICO integrates with NVIDIA Omniverse (OpenUSD) and Siemens Xcelerator, and counts Siemens, Volvo, and Schaeffler among its customers. It won the Siemens Inventors of the Year Award 2024 and is backed by Earlybird, PiLabs, and seed + speed. No public API, SDK, or developer documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: SAGARIS
providers.description: SAGARIS is an agentic revenue operating system for B2B sales teams — CRM, dialer, inbox, SMS, social, an AI receptionist and an AI coach in one system, where AI agents act on the pipeline under approval gates and an audit trail rather than only reporting on it. Pricing is public at 499 USD per founding seat per month, with a custom Enterprise plan. SAGARIS describes a Model Context Protocol endpoint that lets an AI client read the CRM, sequences and workspace with a workspace API key, read-only and scoped to the workspace.

providers.name: SCENARIO-X GLOBAL HOLDING
providers.description: SCENARIO-X GLOBAL HOLDING PTE. LTD. (Scenario X) is a financial-technology company building an AI- and quantum-computing-powered platform for financial risk analysis, stress testing, and regulatory reporting. The integrated platform is organized into four modules — Scenario (adverse market-condition design), PPNR (Pre-Provision Net Revenue projection), Risk (market, counterparty, credit, and operational risk), and Console (financial-data aggregation) — plus a quantum-computing offering for predictive financial modeling. It serves banks, insurers, family offices, independent wealth managers, and commodity traders. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and tracked in the API Evangelist network; no public API or developer surface has been found to date.

providers.name: Skool
providers.description: Skool is an all-in-one community platform that combines discussion communities, online courses, live calls, and gamification in a single product, founded by Sam Ovens and popularized in partnership with Alex Hormozi. As of this review, Skool does NOT publish an official public or partner developer REST API. The only official programmatic surface is a Zapier integration, gated to the paid Pro plan, that exposes a small set of triggers and actions via a per-group API key used solely to link a Skool group to Zapier - it is not a general-purpose developer API. All broader "Skool API" offerings found in the wild (Apify actors, docs.skoolapi.com, reverse-engineered clients, Chrome extensions) are unofficial third-party tools built on Skool's undocumented internal endpoints and are not endorsed or supported by Skool. This catalog entry is an honest gated stub: no public API surface is modeled because none is documented.

providers.name: Stanza Living
providers.description: Stanza Living is one of India's largest managed accommodation and co-living platforms, founded in 2017 by IIM-Ahmedabad alumni Anindya Dutta and Sandeep Dalmia and headquartered in Gurugram. It provides professionally managed, fully furnished, brokerage-free residences — student housing, co-living for working professionals, and managed apartments — across 24+ Indian cities, operating 450+ residences and more than 70,000 beds under the promise of "your second home in a new city." The company is backed by investors including Accel, Falcon Edge, Sequoia Capital and Matrix Partners. Stanza Living operates as a consumer web and mobile brand for discovering, booking and living in managed accommodation, and does not publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: SteadyGateway
providers.description: Enterprise AI gateway providing production access to leading model families — GLM, Qwen, MiniMax, DeepSeek and Kimi — through a single OpenAI-compatible interface under one contract, with governed controls, per-customer isolation, documented model-freshness evidence, and a 99.9% availability commitment carrying tiered service credits. Access is CONTRACT-GATED: there is no self-serve signup, no published base URL and no public OpenAPI definition. The base URL and credentials are issued per contract, so the publicly consumable surface is an llms.txt plus buyer-oriented guides, a model catalogue and freshness benchmarks.

providers.name: SunGard Data Systems
providers.description: SunGard Data Systems was a software and technology services company that provided software and processing solutions to financial services, education, and the public sector. In November 2015, SunGard was acquired by Fidelity National Information Services (FIS) for approximately $9.1 billion. Key product lines included SunGard Financial Systems (trading, treasury, risk management, capital markets), SunGard AvantGard (cash and liquidity management), SunGard K-12 (student information systems), and SunGard Higher Education (ERP for universities). Post-acquisition, these products were integrated into the FIS portfolio.

providers.name: Sylvera
providers.description: Sylvera is a London-headquartered carbon data and climate intelligence platform — often described as the "Moody's for the voluntary carbon market" — providing independent ratings, market data, and geospatial analytics that help corporate buyers, investors, project developers, governments, and standards bodies make informed decisions across carbon and commodities markets. Founded in 2020 by Allister Furey and Samuel Gill, Sylvera combines remote sensing, machine learning over satellite imagery and LiDAR-derived biomass data, and on-the-ground project assessment to produce letter-graded ratings (e.g., AA, A, B) for carbon credit projects across nature-based (REDD+, ARR, IFM), engineered removals, renewable energy, and cookstove methodologies. The platform's product surface spans Ratings, Market Intelligence (supply, demand, and pricing signals), an Article 6 & CORSIA Hub for compliance risk, a Market Gateway to roughly 400 million tonnes of project inventory, Earth Analytics and a Biomass Atlas for geospatial MRV, and Commodity Insights covering CORSIA, LCFS, CFR, and FuelEU Maritime mechanism eligibility and carbon intensity assessments. Sylvera distributes its data through a web platform, downloadable reports, and a gated Carbon Credit Analytics API (base URL https://api.sylvera.com/v1, JSON API style, API-key auth) used to syndicate ratings and pricing into ESG and sustainability reporting tools such as Workiva, Persefoni, and Watershed. Commercial packaging runs Freemium, Essentials, and Enterprise tiers, with Accelerated Ratings, Market Forecasts, and Geospatial add-ons all sold via contact-sales; there is no public OpenAPI specification, no published SDK, and no Sylvera GitHub organization — the API and full ratings catalog are available only to authenticated enterprise customers.

providers.name: Teller Finance
providers.description: Teller Finance (Teller Protocol) is a decentralized, multi-chain lending and borrowing protocol on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, and BNB Chain. Borrowers take fixed-APR, time-based loans from isolated lending pools using their tokens as collateral, with no oracle-driven margin-call liquidations, through an open order-book of markets governed by the TellerV2 smart contract. The developer surface is on-chain (Solidity smart contracts) plus a GraphQL subgraph for read-side data and an embeddable Cash Advance widget (npm) that any dapp can drop into its front end - there is no hosted REST API, OAuth server, or API-key program; authentication is wallet-based. Teller was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and enriched here from its public developer surface.

providers.name: Thor Industries
providers.description: Thor Industries is the world's largest manufacturer of recreational vehicles, owning subsidiary brands including Airstream, Jayco, Heartland RV, Keystone RV, and others. Thor Industries operates primarily as a manufacturing company and does not publish a public developer API. Dealer integrations and connected vehicle features are managed through subsidiary brands and OEM partnerships.

providers.name: Tre (Hi3G)
providers.description: Tre (Hi3G) is one of Sweden’s largest mobile network operators, offering mobile phone plans, broadband internet, and a range of connected devices. With over 3 million customers, Tre focuses on delivering fast 5G connectivity, flexible contracts, and innovative services for both private and business users. The company emphasizes sustainability, customer support, and digital self‑service through its website and mobile apps, positioning itself as a modern telecom provider in the Nordic market.

providers.name: United States Africa Command
providers.description: United States Africa Command (AFRICOM) is a unified combatant command of the United States Department of Defense responsible for military operations and coordination in Africa. AFRICOM's primary mission is to advance U.S. national security interests and promote regional stability through security cooperation, military assistance, and joint training exercises with African partner nations. AFRICOM is headquartered at Kelley Barracks in Stuttgart, Germany and maintains relationships with 53 African nations. The command is led by a four-star general and conducts operations spanning humanitarian assistance, counter-terrorism, peacekeeping support, and capacity-building activities across the continent.

providers.name: Universal Corporation
providers.description: Universal Corporation is a global leaf tobacco merchant and processor that selects, buys, processes, packs, stores, ships, and finances leaf tobacco for sale to manufacturers of consumer tobacco products. Operating in approximately 30 countries, Universal Corporation is the world's leading supplier of leaf tobacco, providing supply chain management, processing, and blending services. The company has developed digital platforms including MobiLeaf, a tablet-based grower management system for tobacco farmer support and crop tracking.

providers.name: Zwift
providers.description: Zwift is a Long Beach, California online fitness company that operates a multiplayer indoor cycling and running platform combining stationary smart trainers and bikes with a 3D virtual-world game client. Riders and runners use a smart trainer, smart bike (such as the in-house Zwift Ride), treadmill, or pod to drive an avatar through fictional worlds (Watopia, Makuri Islands) and licensed real-world routes, joining structured workouts, group rides, races, training plans, and 24/7 events alongside a global community of more than a million members. The platform pairs with smart trainers and heart-rate monitors over Bluetooth and ANT+, and the Zwift Companion mobile app provides in-game messaging, ride control, and route discovery. Zwift does not operate a general public developer portal, OpenAPI reference, or open-source SDK. Its developer surface is limited to a private, application-only Structured Training API for approved training partners (TrainingPeaks, TrainerRoad, Wahoo SYSTM, JOIN Cycling and similar coaching platforms) that lets external workout builders push custom workouts into a rider's Zwift account, plus one-way activity-export connections to Strava, TrainingPeaks, Garmin Connect, MapMyRide, MapMyRun, Adidas Running, Technogym, Fitbit, Wahoo, Apple Health, and Withings. There is no public REST surface, OAuth client registration, or partner self-service available to general developers — third-party tools (community libraries, ZwiftPower, Sauce for Zwift) interact with Zwift via reverse-engineered private endpoints, not a sanctioned API. Zwift is a paid consumer subscription business; revenue comes from monthly memberships and hardware sales (Zwift Ride, Zwift Cog, Zwift Click, Zwift Play).

providers.name: Above
providers.description: Above (Above Security) is an AI-native insider risk management platform that detects and investigates risky human and AI-agent activity across SaaS, identity, and endpoints. Rather than flagging statistical anomalies, Above focuses on intent-based insider risk — understanding what a person or AI agent was actually trying to do — and assembles investigation-ready narratives from behavioral signal without invasive screen or keystroke content capture. Its platform pairs real-time user guidance with AI investigative agents to catch data exfiltration, credential leaks, shadow and personal AI use, custom GPT risk, and pre-departure flight-risk data theft. Above is the inaugural sponsor of the Forscie Insider Threat Matrix and publishes the Insider Risk Index. The company is backed by Norwest Venture Partners and was added to the API Evangelist network from that portfolio.

providers.name: African Rainbow Minerals
providers.description: African Rainbow Minerals Limited (ARM) is a niche, diversified South African mining and minerals company, founded by Dr Patrice Motsepe and created in its present form in May 2004 through the merger of ARMgold and Harmony assets. ARM is listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange under the ticker ARI and is headquartered in Sandton, Gauteng. The company mines and beneficiates iron ore, manganese ore and alloys, chrome ore, platinum group metals, nickel and coal through ARM Ferrous, ARM Platinum and ARM Coal, plus a strategic gold investment in Harmony Gold Mining Company — spanning Khumani iron ore, Black Rock manganese, Two Rivers, Modikwa and Bokoni platinum, Nkomati nickel, Goedgevonden coal and Sakura Ferroalloys in Malaysia. ARM sells physical mined commodity, not software: it runs no developer program and publishes no public API, SDK, webhook or machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Amparo
providers.description: Amparo is a Brazilian fintech that supports bereaved families in the days after a funeral. Its Central de Cadastros uses automated document reading and data extraction to register a family once and share that data across partner systems, while a WhatsApp assistant delivers personalized financial guidance covering INSS pension advances, life-insurance payouts, credit, repatriation reimbursements, and debt and inventory organization. Amparo exposes integration APIs so its Central de Cadastros can connect with funeral-home and insurer client systems. Backed by QED Investors.

providers.name: Apoha
providers.description: Apoha is a deep-tech molecular-science company teaching machines to understand matter at the molecular level. Its Liquid State sensory-intelligence platform captures dynamic molecular fingerprints, measuring the biophysical behavior of molecules under stress from minimal sample amounts, to unlock a new fundamental data class for AI. Its first commercial product, VIBE (Variations in Inter-facial Behaviour Under Excitation), predicts how drugs, foods, and materials will behave in the real world, serving pharmaceutical, biotech, food-and-beverage, and materials-science R&D. Based in San Francisco and London, Apoha emerged from stealth in 2026 with $36M in funding led by Singular, alongside Draper Associates, Redalpine, Seedcamp, Wilbe, and Nucleus.

providers.name: Apriori Bio
providers.description: Apriori Bio is a pioneering biotech company founded in 2020, developing AI‑enabled vaccine design platforms. Leveraging its Octavia™ platform, Apriori Bio predicts viral evolution to create prospective vaccines, aiming to stay ahead of emerging health threats. The company focuses on innovative immunology, AI/ML integration, and collaborative research to accelerate vaccine development and improve global health outcomes.

providers.name: Aquamembranes
providers.description: Aquamembranes provides optimized reverse osmosis technology with patented, precision printed elements that improve industrial RO systems. Their solutions lower energy costs, reduce cleaning cycles, and boost water recovery without retrofits. The company serves global leaders in water treatment, offering products, resources, and design software to enhance system performance.

providers.name: Avicena Tech
providers.description: Avicena Tech Corp. is a privately held semiconductor company founded in 2019 and headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with a subsidiary in Edinburgh, Scotland. Avicena develops LightBundle, a microLED-based optical interconnect architecture for chip-to-chip, die-to-die and rack-scale links in AI/ML training clusters, high-performance computing, memory disaggregation, sensors, 5G wireless and aerospace. The technology pairs patented microLED emitter arrays with photodetector arrays and an integrated ASIC, supporting greater than 1Tbps/mm shoreline density at sub-picojoule-per-bit energy efficiency over reaches beyond 10 meters. The company ships a LightBundle eKit evaluation system to AI infrastructure customers and is backed by Tiger Global, SK hynix, Samsung Catalyst Fund, Micron Ventures, Clear Ventures, Cerberus Capital Management, Hitachi Ventures, LAM Research, Maverick Silicon, Prosperity7 Ventures and VentureTech Alliance. Avicena is a hardware and photonics company: it publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Axiom Cloud
providers.description: Axiom Cloud provides a suite of blockchain-based trading and settlement services, offering APIs for on‑chain asset management, market data, and automated trading. The platform aims to simplify decentralized finance integration for developers and enterprises, delivering secure, scalable, and compliant solutions across multiple blockchain networks. It supports real‑time data feeds, order execution, and portfolio analytics through RESTful endpoints and WebSocket streams.

providers.name: Bankbazaar
providers.description: BankBazaar is India’s Largest FinTech Co-Branded Credit Card issuer & Online Platform for Free Credit Score with over 60 Million Registered Users. It offers credit card comparison, loan services, and financial products through its digital platform.

providers.name: Banyan Infrastructure
providers.description: Banyan Infrastructure provides project finance software for infrastructure funds, developers, and green banks. Their platform unifies workflow and data across origination, underwriting, portfolio management, and compliance, accelerating capital flow into infrastructure projects. The solution replaces fragmented systems like Salesforce and Excel with a single data layer, supporting owners, operators, and financiers.

providers.name: Being
providers.description: Being (Being Juice, operated by Being Global Sdn Bhd) is a Malaysian smoothie and cold-pressed juice brand founded by Sayantan Das, the former CEO of foodpanda Malaysia and Brunei, on the promise that "you are what you drink." The company sources ingredients from local farmers and handcrafts fresh, feel-good smoothies and juices daily, sold through physical outlets across the Klang Valley and through a mobile rewards app. Being is backed by 500 Global and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company profile awaiting enrichment. It publishes a consumer web presence but no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Betterfly
providers.description: Betterfly is a Latin American insurtech and employee-benefits platform that combines voluntary insurance coverage with daily health engagement and rewards. Its integrated benefits product serves three audiences — brokers, employers, and employees — pairing guaranteed-issue life and health insurance with wellness programs, health assessments, and engagement mechanics so that employees actively use their benefits and employers gain visibility into participation and ROI. Founded in Chile, Betterfly operates across the region and is backed by QED Investors. This profile was surfaced from the QED Investors portfolio and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Betterfly publishes no public developer or API surface as of this pass.

providers.name: Biren Technology
providers.description: Biren Technology (Shanghai Biren Technology Co., Ltd.) is a Chinese fabless semiconductor company that designs general-purpose GPUs (GPGPUs) for AI training, inference, and high-performance computing. Its flagship BR100-series accelerators are programmed through BIRENSUPA, a CUDA-like software platform that bundles the BRCC compiler, a hardware abstraction layer, deep-learning and general-compute acceleration libraries, and a developer toolchain with support for PyTorch, TensorFlow, and PaddlePaddle. Biren distributes its drivers, SDK, and documentation through its developer.birentech.com developer community rather than a public web/REST API. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: Blue Earth Diagnostics
providers.description: Blue Earth Diagnostics is a Bracco-owned company providing advanced nuclear medicine diagnostics and imaging services. It offers a range of PET, SPECT, and therapeutic radiopharmaceuticals, supporting clinical trials and research partnerships. The company focuses on innovative diagnostic solutions and collaborates with healthcare professionals worldwide.

providers.name: BOK Financial
providers.description: BOK Financial Corporation (NASDAQ: BOKF) is a regional financial-services holding company headquartered in Tulsa, Oklahoma, delivering banking under the Bank of Oklahoma, Bank of Texas, and BOK Financial brands across the Southwest and Midwest, along with wealth management and commercial treasury services. As of July 2026 it does not publish a first-party public developer portal or any documented API products — developer.bokfinancial.com does not resolve and /developer and /api return 404. Its public, machine-accessible surface is consumer-permissioned account data access delivered through third-party aggregators (Plaid coverage confirmed), while commercial treasury and ERP connectivity is offered privately to clients under contract rather than through a self-serve documented developer program.

providers.name: Cainiao
providers.description: Cainiao, also known as 菜鸟网络, is a leading global e‑commerce logistics platform under Alibaba Group. It provides end‑to‑end supply chain services, including domestic and international warehousing, parcel delivery, cross‑border logistics, and smart infrastructure. Leveraging AI, IoT, and a massive network of warehouses and sorting centers across over 200 countries, Cainiao enables merchants to ship efficiently worldwide, offering solutions such as same‑day delivery, automated customs clearance, and a digital parcel tracking ecosystem.

providers.name: Cambridge Terahertz
providers.description: Cambridge Terahertz (thzcorp.com) is an MIT-spinout physical security company building compact, AI-powered terahertz imaging sensors that detect concealed weapons -- guns, knives, explosives, and 3D-printed weapons -- as people walk naturally through entrances, without pat-downs or metal detectors. The 2-pound sensors mount like security cameras, serve hospitals, enterprises, and government facilities, and integrate with existing VMS and security systems over standard REST APIs, though the company publishes no public developer portal or API documentation. Backed by Felicis with a $12M seed round and an NSF SBIR Phase II grant.

providers.name: CAPS
providers.description: CAPS Inc. (CAPS株式会社) is a Tokyo-based Healthcare x IT company founded in December 2014 whose mission is to maximize the total amount of happiness through health management (健康経営). CAPS operates a chain of primary-care clinics plus its Doctor365 telemedicine and urgent-care service, provides corporate health-support and wellness programs for employers, runs 24-hour IT-enabled fitness gyms, and delivers health-education programs including a Sesame Street partnership. Headquartered in Roppongi, Minato-ku, Tokyo, the company was seed-funded by 500 Startups Japan (500 Global) in 2018. This API Evangelist profile tracks CAPS as a company; enrichment found no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Car IQ
providers.description: Car IQ provides a modern, card‑less vehicle payments platform that enables fleets, merchants and drivers to transact seamlessly. Their solution replaces traditional fuel cards with digital payments, offering real‑time receipts, fraud prevention, and streamlined back‑office operations. Car IQ’s technology integrates with banks and telematics to deliver secure, efficient payments across local, short‑haul, and national fleets.

providers.name: CareBridge *
providers.description: CareBridge is a home and community-based healthcare company that delivers 24/7 virtual and in-home care coordination to high-risk, largely Medicaid populations on behalf of health plans. Its interdisciplinary care teams address members' physical, behavioral, and social health needs, and the company operates three core service lines: 24/7 member support, decision support (durable medical equipment and technology provisioning), and Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) technology used by state Medicaid programs and managed-care organizations. Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, CareBridge was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface; this profile therefore captures its public identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: CHIPS Alliance
providers.description: CHIPS Alliance is a Linux Foundation project (founded in 2019) that develops open-source hardware (silicon) and tools, including CPUs, SoC subsystems, peripherals, IP blocks, and FPGA tooling. The Alliance fosters collaboration among 50+ member organizations across industry (AMD, Antmicro, Google, Microsoft, SiFive, Intel, Nvidia, Cisco, Synopsys, Microchip, SanDisk and others) and academia (Berkeley, Stanford, MIT, and more) to lower the cost of hardware design, accelerate innovation in silicon, and provide an open and accessible alternative to proprietary EDA flows. CHIPS Alliance hosts more than a dozen technical projects including Chisel (Hardware Construction Language), F4PGA, Caliptra (Root of Trust), VeeR (RISC-V cores), Surelog/UHDM (SystemVerilog parsing), and the FPGA Interchange format. The Alliance does not publish a centralized REST API; technical assets are distributed via GitHub repositories under github.com/chipsalliance and member-driven mailing lists.

providers.name: Cloudburst Technologies
providers.description: Cloudburst Technologies is a Texas‑based provider of next‑generation IT solutions, offering cloud, SaaS, unified communications, and security services. They help enterprises with network assessment, cloud migration, and digital transformation, delivering voice, data, and security products to Fortune‑100 companies and midsize businesses.

providers.name: CNO Financial Group
providers.description: CNO Financial Group is an Indiana-based insurance holding company that develops, markets, and administers life and health insurance, annuities, and workforce benefits solutions through brands including Bankers Life, Colonial Penn, Washington National, Optavise, and PMA USA. CNO does not publish a public-facing developer portal or API; integrations are run via partner channels (CRM, Pega Cloud platform, and brand-specific producer portals).

providers.name: Comerica
providers.description: Comerica Incorporated is a Texas-headquartered super-regional financial services holding company providing retail, small-business, commercial, and wealth-management banking across the United States, with market concentrations in Texas, California, Michigan, Arizona, and Florida. As of July 2026 Comerica publishes NO first-party developer API portal: developer.comerica.com, api.comerica.com, and related developer subdomains do not resolve, and directory trackers (Open Banking Tracker, API Tracker) list no documented API products, OpenAPI/Swagger specs, SDKs, or Postman collections. Consumer and small-business account data is reached indirectly through US open-finance aggregators (Plaid, MX, Finicity, Akoya) and through Financial Data Exchange (FDX) APIs — the CFPB-recognized standard-setting body for the Section 1033 Personal Financial Data Rights rule — rather than a Comerica-published endpoint. Commercial treasury, cash-positioning, ACH/wire initiation, and reporting are delivered through Comerica's Cash Management and Commercial Information Management platforms under direct customer contract (host-to-host files, portal, and BAI/ISO 20022 feeds), not a public REST API. Note: Fifth Third Bancorp completed its all-stock acquisition of Comerica in February 2026, so Comerica's future digital and API surface is being integrated into Fifth Third's platform.

providers.name: Commsignia
providers.description: Commsignia is a Budapest-based V2X (Vehicle-to-Everything) technology company building connected vehicle and smart infrastructure solutions for the automotive and transportation industries. Its portfolio spans roadside units (RSUs) and onboard units (OBUs), a V2X software stack, and cloud services grouped into product suites: Roadway Intelligence, Emergency Safety, Fleet, Automotive, Smart Infrastructure, and Connected Vehicle. The company turns isolated roadway and vehicle data silos into real-world operational intelligence for safer roads and improved traffic flow. As of this enrichment pass Commsignia publishes no public developer API, REST/OpenAPI reference, SDK, or developer portal; technical integration is handled through direct engagement. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech.

providers.name: Corpay (formerly FLEETCOR)
providers.description: Corpay is a global S&P 500 corporate payments company (NYSE: CPAY) that resulted from the March 2024 rebrand of FLEETCOR Technologies. The company serves more than 800,000 business clients across 200+ countries in 140+ currencies and processed approximately $400 billion in payments in 2024 with reported revenue of about $4.0B. Corpay operates across five product lines built largely through acquisition — Commercial Cards (including Corpay Mastercard), AP Automation (extended by the 2024 acquisition of Paymerang), Cross-Border Payments (built on the 2017 acquisition of Cambridge Global Payments and the 2025 acquisition of Alpha Group International), Fuel & Fleet Cards (the original FLEETCOR business plus the 2014 acquisition of Comdata), and Workforce Lodging & Travel. Despite this scale, Corpay does not operate a public developer portal — there is no developer.corpay.com, no public OpenAPI catalog, no public GitHub presence, and no self-service API key issuance. All integration surfaces (ERP connectors for NetSuite, Sage, Microsoft Dynamics, QuickBooks, Acumatica, CMiC, Deltek, Trimble; the former Cambridge cross-border payments API; AP-automation API hooks) are sales-led and gated behind enterprise contracts.

providers.name: CountertopSmart
providers.description: CountertopSmart is an online marketplace that lets users browse, visualize, and purchase a wide variety of countertop materials such as quartz, granite, marble, and porcelain. The site offers instant quotes, detailed product categories, and a showroom map, enabling homeowners and designers to select and buy countertops directly through an e‑commerce platform.

providers.name: Ctrip
providers.description: Ctrip (Ctrip.com International / Trip.com Group, NASDAQ: TCOM) is one of the world's largest online travel agencies, founded in 1999 and headquartered in Shanghai, China. Its consumer platform sells hotels, flights, train tickets, car rentals, tours, cruises, and travel packages across China and internationally, and the broader Trip.com Group also operates the Trip.com, Qunar, and Skyscanner brands. Ctrip exposes partner and B2B travel-distribution capabilities through the Ctrip Open Platform (openapi.ctrip.com), the Trip.com Group open platform (connect.trip.com), and a corporate-travel developer platform (ctripbiz). These developer surfaces are partner-gated and largely account-restricted; no public OpenAPI or first-party SDK has been discovered for this profile.

providers.name: dMed Global (Caidya)
providers.description: dMed Global, now operating as Caidya, is a global, full-service clinical research organization (CRO) headquartered in Shanghai, China and backed by Qiming Venture Partners. The company provides flexible, patient-centric clinical trial solutions to biopharmaceutical innovators, running studies across more than 40 countries and regions. Its capabilities span clinical operations, regulatory services, data management, biostatistics, and complex trial execution across core therapeutic areas. Caidya operates an English-language corporate site at caidya.com and a Chinese-language site at caidya.cn. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record; the company publishes no public API or developer program at this time.

providers.name: Doctorly
providers.description: Doctorly (doctorly GmbH, Berlin) builds a modern cloud-based practice management system (Praxisverwaltungssystem / PVS) for medical practices in Germany, positioned as a replacement for legacy systems such as Medistar, Turbomed and ALBIS. The platform covers KV quarterly billing, e-prescription (eRezept), electronic sick leave (eAU), real-time collaborative patient records, GDT device integration and cross-platform access on Windows, macOS, Linux and Android, and it is KBV-, gematik- and GDPR-compliant. Doctorly is a Seedcamp portfolio company. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/FHIR specification, SDKs or GitHub organization; this entry is maintained as a company/provider record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Draig Therapeutics
providers.description: Draig Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing transformative, best-in-class therapies for major neuropsychiatric disorders, including Major Depressive Disorder. A Cardiff University spinout co-founded with SV Health Investors, Draig ("dragon" in Welsh) leverages its founders' expertise in modulating the core glutamate/GABA pathways that underlie synaptic excitation and inhibition imbalance in the brain. Its pipeline is led by DT-101, a next-generation AMPA receptor positive allosteric modulator (PAM) advancing toward Phase 2 in MDD, alongside DT-201 and DT-301, subtype-selective GABAA receptor modulators. The company launched from stealth in June 2025 with a $140 million (£107 million) oversubscribed Series A led by Access Biotechnology, with participation from Canaan Partners, SR One, Sanofi Ventures, Schroders Capital, SV Health Investors, and ICG. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners.

providers.name: Dreams Technology
providers.description: Dreams Technologies is a custom software development company operating in the UK and India, offering AI development, mobile app, SaaS platform, cloud & DevOps, digital transformation, and MVP services. They serve enterprise and startup clients across multiple regions, with a portfolio of products such as SmartHR, Doccure, Kanakku, TruelySell, DreamsPOS, and DreamsSchool. The company emphasizes end‑to‑end engineering, product development, and modernization for businesses.

providers.name: Dynegy
providers.description: Dynegy is a retail electric service provider and part of the Vistra Corp family of companies, delivering simple, price-protected retail electricity plans for homes and businesses across the Northeast, Mid-Atlantic, and Midwest, including Ohio, Illinois, and Pennsylvania. No public APIs have been documented for Dynegy.

providers.name: EcoDataCenter
providers.description: EcoDataCenter is a European leader in sustainable compute infrastructure, operating high‑performance data centers across Sweden. Founded in Sweden, the company combines world‑class engineering with minimal climate impact, offering services that enable customers to achieve net‑zero goals while scaling seamlessly. EcoDataCenter focuses on efficiency, renewable energy use, and transparent sustainability reporting, positioning itself as a pioneer in green data center solutions for the European market.

providers.name: Forus Health
providers.description: Forus Health Pvt Ltd is a Bengaluru, India based medical device manufacturer specializing in advanced eye-care and retinal-imaging technology. Its 3nethra family of devices covers adult and neonatal retinal imaging, refraction and myopia management, and anterior-segment imaging, complemented by the FH-POISE AI diagnostic platform that screens for diabetic retinopathy, glaucoma, cataract, hypertensive retinopathy, age-related macular degeneration, and dry eye. Forus also operates connected telemedicine platforms (FH TeleCare, FH TeleEye, FH TeleOpticals) for remote eye screening. The company reports more than 5,000 installations across 85+ countries. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network; no public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Generate Biomedicines
providers.description: Generate Biomedicines is a Somerville, Massachusetts therapeutics company pioneering Generative Biology, a machine-learning-driven approach to de novo protein design across antibodies, peptides, enzymes, and gene therapies. Founded out of Flagship Pioneering and chaired by Noubar Afeyan, the company trains generative models on the full compendium of natural protein structures and sequences plus proprietary wet-lab data to design novel protein therapeutics computationally rather than by trial-and-error discovery. Its open-source flagship is Chroma, a programmable diffusion-based generative model for joint protein structure and sequence design published in Nature 2023 ("Illuminating protein space with a programmable generative model", doi:10.1038/s41586-023-06728-8) and released on GitHub under Apache 2.0 with pretrained weights available under a custom Chroma Parameters License (free for academic and nonprofit use).
