Chroma uses equivariant graph neural networks, diffusion modeling, and conditional random fields to sample all-atom protein structures with sub-quadratic complexity, supporting conditional generation via composable Conditioner modules for symmetry, substructure, shape, and secondary-structure constraints. The internal Generate Platform iterates on a "generate, build, measure, learn" loop that pairs in-silico design with high-throughput protein synthesis and characterization; the company reports having generated, built, and tested more than 42,000 proteins. Generate Biomedicines has platform collaborations with Amgen (six programs, January 2022) and Novartis (multiple programs, September 2024) and a CAR T collaboration with Roswell Park. Its clinical pipeline is led by GB-0895, a long-acting anti-TSLP antibody for severe asthma now in Phase 3 (SOLAIRIA study) with a parallel Phase 1 in COPD, plus preclinical programs GB-4362 (anti-free-MMAE for ADC oncology safety) and GB-5267 (MUC16 armored CAR T for ovarian cancer). The company priced its initial public offering in February 2026. Revenue derives from drug development, partner collaborations, and (for Chroma) commercial weights licensing; there is no public developer REST/HTTPS API or SDK for the Generate Platform itself — Chroma is consumed as a Python library installed via pip with model weights downloaded from chroma-weights.generatebiomedicines.com after registering for an API key.

providers.name: Globetouch
providers.description: Globetouch is a global mobile and IoT connectivity provider founded in 2010 and headquartered in San Ramon, California, which rebranded to Airlinq in February 2020 — globetouch.com now 301-redirects to www.airlinq.com. Its GConnect / CloudSIM heritage (physical SIM, soft SIM and eSIM provisioning with rule-engine-driven subscription-profile management for mobile operators and IoT enterprises) is carried forward in Mobilinq, the company's IoT connectivity and application management platform, alongside Autolinq for the connected-vehicle ecosystem, Utilinq for electric, gas and water utilities, and Marketlinq, an operator-branded private-5G and IoT marketplace and dashboard. Airlinq markets a "comprehensive API library" for BSS/OSS integration and data and voice plans "enabled via API", but as of August 2026 it publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification of any kind; the only entry point is a contact-sales form.

providers.name: Inhabit
providers.description: Inhabit is a global PropTech software company operating a portfolio of specialized platforms for the residential and vacation rental property management markets, including ResMan, Streamline, LiveRez, Anyone Home, ResidentIQ, ePremium, Rental Guardian, Lynnbrook Group payments, Western Reporting screening, and Bluetent marketing. Its integrated tools span property management, resident and guest CRM and contact center, payments processing, renters and property insurance, tenant screening and income verification, utility billing, and marketing websites, serving multifamily, single-family, student, affordable, HOA and condo, and short-term vacation rental operators worldwide. Backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: ironSource
providers.description: ironSource is a Tel Aviv-based mobile game growth platform, acquired by Unity Technologies in a $4.4B all-stock deal that closed in November 2022 and is now operated as part of Unity's Grow Solutions group. The company builds an end-to-end suite for mobile game developers spanning ad monetization, user acquisition, and ad operations. Its flagship product LevelPlay is a unified in-app bidding and ad mediation platform that brokers Rewarded Video, Interstitial, and Banner ad demand across the ironSource Ads network, AdMob, AppLovin, Meta Audience Network, Pangle, Mintegral, Unity Ads, Vungle, and dozens of other ad sources. ironSource Ads is its self-serve ad network and user-acquisition platform offering CPI, CPE, ROAS-optimized, and SKAdNetwork-aware campaign management. Adjacent products include Aura (an on-device content marketplace for carriers and OEMs that originated from the 2021 Bigabid/Soomla portfolio and earlier hardware OEM deals), Tapjoy Offerwall (acquired 2022) for rewarded engagement, and Ad Quality for ad-content monitoring. Developer access is via a REST surface hosted at platform.ironsrc.com — including the Monetization Reporting API (v5/v4), ironSource Ads Reporting API, Application API (v6), Campaign API suite (Campaigns, Audiences, Country Groups, Bidding, Assets, Creatives), SKAN Reporting API, and Cost API — authenticated with Bearer tokens issued from the platform dashboard. Real client integration is delivered via native SDKs (iOS, Android, Unity, Flutter, React Native, Adobe AIR, Xamarin) plus the LevelPlay mediation adapter ecosystem published on github.com/ironsource-mobile. As of 2026 the developers.is.com knowledge center 301-redirects to docs.unity.com, consolidating ironSource documentation inside Unity Grow alongside Unity Ads. No public OpenAPI, Postman collection, or JSON Schema bundle is published by ironSource for the REST surface; documentation is human-readable HTML on docs.unity.com/en-us/grow.

providers.name: Kos
providers.description: Kos (Kosai, Inc.) builds what it calls the world's first virtual finance employee: an AI agent given its own workstation, org identity, software licenses, RBAC and audit logs, which completes finance and back-office workflows for capital- and inventory-heavy operators across datacenters, defense, energy, long-lead equipment, space and contracting. Kos reviews pay applications and vendor invoices line-by-line against GMP contracts, catching missing backup, overbills and calculation errors; generates, routes and closes out purchase orders inside a customer's ERP; and is taught new workflows over screenshare like a new hire. It is reached over email, Slack, Teams, phone and Zoom rather than through a UI, app or public API. Founded by Tanuj and Mani, who met as graduate researchers at Stanford under Sachin Katti; backed by 8VC, XYZ Ventures, MVP Ventures and Launch, with advisors including former Equinix CFO Keith Taylor. Headquartered in San Francisco, California.

providers.name: Magnific
providers.description: Magnific is a Spanish AI image enhancement startup, founded in 2023 by Javi Lopez and Emilio Nicolas, best known for its AI image upscaler and enhancer that hallucinates believable new detail at higher resolutions. The product line expanded from the original Upscaler into Relight (AI-driven scene relighting), Structure (compose-from-sketch), Style Transfer, Mystic (text-to-image), and Fluffy (consistent characters). Magnific was acquired by Freepik in May 2024 and continues to operate under the Magnific brand while powering Freepik's image enhancement surface. There is no publicly documented developer API for Magnific itself; access is via the web application at magnific.ai (now magnific.com) and through the Freepik AI suite, where related image generation and upscaling capabilities are exposed via the Freepik API. Customer support is handled through an Intercom-backed help center and the founders maintain a high-visibility presence on X/Twitter.

providers.name: MasterClass
providers.description: MasterClass is an online education streaming platform where members learn from a roster of 200+ world-renowned instructors across categories including Arts & Entertainment, Business, Design & Style, Sports & Gaming, Writing, Food, Music, Science & Tech, Home & Lifestyle, Community & Government, and Wellness. Content is delivered as video lessons with downloadable workbooks on web, iOS, Android, Apple TV, Roku, and Amazon Fire TV under Standard, Plus, and Premium membership plans. Newer offerings include MasterClass at Work, MasterClass On Call, and the AI-native MasterClass Executive program. Founded by David Rogier; backed by Atomico, Bloomberg Beta, and IVP. MasterClass exposes no public developer API — it is a consumer edtech product, not an API provider.

providers.name: Merit Systems Protection Board
providers.description: The Merit Systems Protection Board (MSPB) is an independent quasi-judicial agency that protects federal merit systems against partisan political and other prohibited personnel practices. It safeguards the rights of federal employees and adjudicates employee appeals.

providers.name: morewis
providers.description: Morewis (摩尔元数) is a Chinese industrial software company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Xiamen, Fujian, that develops cloud-based Manufacturing Execution System (MES) and Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM) software for the manufacturing sector. Its Morewis Cloud industrial internet platform, MoreDEV low-code development platform (including the WisIDE cloud IDE), and MoreAgent / N³ industrial AI large model let manufacturers build and run smart-factory applications with reduced hand coding. Reference clients include Haier, Hisense, Aisino, Inspur, and 3Trees Group. The company raised a ~100M yuan Series B led by Qiming Venture Partners. No public English-language REST API, OpenAPI, SDK, or GitHub organization was found; the developer surface is a China-hosted low-code industrial application platform.

providers.name: Musement
providers.description: Musement is a travel experiences platform that lets users discover, book, and manage tickets for attractions, museums, tours, and activities worldwide. It offers a curated selection of experiences with flexible cancellation policies, detailed information, and a user-friendly interface for planning trips.

providers.name: Noodle Partners
providers.description: Noodle Partners (Noodle) is a higher education solutions company providing full-funnel services and AI-powered products spanning student recruitment through graduation and workforce development. Its product suite includes the Noodle Learning Platform (a customizable LMS for lifelong learning and continuing education), Noodle Companion (an in-platform AI assistant), Noodle Engage (conversational AI for recruitment and enrollment), Noodle Dialogue (AI-assisted faculty content and curriculum design), and Noodle Manage (data integration and analytics). Noodle also delivers marketing, enrollment, learning design, retention, and strategic consulting services to universities. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API surface was found during enrichment; the company publishes a SOC 2 trust center.

providers.name: One Assist
providers.description: OneAssist is an Indian consumer protection and services company that provides device and appliance protection, extended warranty, and financial-fraud assistance to retail customers. Its offerings span gadget protection for mobile phones, laptops, wearables, and tablets (accidental damage and extended warranty coverage), home appliance repair and maintenance for air conditioners, televisions, washing machines, refrigerators, water purifiers, and geysers, wallet and card fraud protection, credit-card bill-payment assistance, and furniture, motor, and jewelry insurance plans. The company reports serving over 1.8 crore active customers across 19,000+ pincodes and resolving more than 25 lakh issues. OneAssist is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. As of this profile, OneAssist publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; it operates a consumer-facing web and mobile experience only.

providers.name: Ossus
providers.description: Ossus builds AI-native intelligence for cultural institutions, starting with libraries. Its flagship product is Ossus ILS, a modern integrated library system that unifies cataloguing, circulation, acquisitions, analytics, and patron discovery in one interface, with an AI copilot that drafts MARC records, subjects, and classifications for librarian approval. A lighter product, Librar, targets school libraries with fast mobile setup. AI add-ons cover camera-based shelf inventory, vendor comparison for purchasing, and grant finding. Ossus emphasizes privacy-first design: it does not train on or sell customer data and works only with catalogue metadata rather than borrower records. Ossus is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) company based in San Francisco.

providers.name: Pairio
providers.description: Pairio is an AI-powered maintenance assistant for manufacturing and industrial teams, built by Pairio GmbH in Munich, Germany and backed by Y Combinator. Technicians capture voice, photos, and video on the shop floor, and Pairio troubleshoots machine breakdowns, searches technical documentation and maintenance history, identifies spare parts, generates structured maintenance reports, and creates work instructions. It preserves expert knowledge across shifts, sites, and teams to reduce mean time to repair (MTTR) and unplanned downtime, integrating with common ERP, CMMS, EAM, and document-management systems such as SAP, IFS, IBM Maximo, Oracle EAM, Hexagon, SharePoint, and Outlook. Pairio is a consumer-facing mobile/web application and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Personify
providers.description: Personify (Personify Inc., part of Momentive Software as of January 2026) is a constituent and association management software provider for associations, nonprofits, and member-based organizations. Founded in 1996 and headquartered in Austin, Texas, Personify offers a family of products - the enterprise Personify360 / ThreeSixty AMS, MemberClicks (MC Professional) for mid-sized professional and trade associations, Wild Apricot for small associations and clubs, and A2Z Events for event management. Several products expose documented REST APIs secured with OAuth 2.0. Wild Apricot and MemberClicks publish public developer documentation, while Personify360's Novus APIs (Swagger-documented) are provisioned through a customer's account manager. API access generally requires being a paying customer of the respective product.

providers.name: Pimento
providers.description: Pimento is an AI ad-creative platform that helps marketing and advertising teams generate, analyze, and benchmark advertising creatives at scale. Its published product surface spans creative generation (Create), performance analysis (Analyze), competitive benchmarking (Benchmark), reusable brand kits, a Meta Score for predicting ad performance, multiformat output, and Meta Advantage+ support. Pimento is a venture-backed company in Partech's portfolio. It ships an end-user SaaS application at app.pimento.design backed by a private REST API and an Auth0 tenant, but that API is first-party only: it is undocumented, returns 401 to anonymous callers, and is not offered to developers. No developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI or other machine-readable specification, SDK, package, webhook catalog, CLI, changelog, status page, public pricing page, or MCP/A2A agent surface is published anywhere on a Pimento-controlled host.

providers.name: PlanSwift
providers.description: PlanSwift is Windows desktop takeoff and estimating software for construction estimators - turning digital plans (PDF/image/CAD) into measurable, countable, exportable material takeoffs and estimates across trades like roofing, concrete, earthwork, flooring, and electrical. PlanSwift is owned by ConstructConnect. IMPORTANT - PlanSwift does NOT publish a public web/REST API. Its developer surface is a desktop extensibility SDK embedded in the Windows application - OLE Automation (COM), an internal scripting engine, and a plugin/starter-pack model - exposed through a password-gated "Under-The-Hood" (U-T-H) tab enabled by contacting ConstructConnect (takeoff@constructconnect.com). The public SDK examples on GitHub target PlanSwift9 and are written in Pascal (2008) and Visual Basic (2010). There is no documented HTTPS base URL, no API keys/OAuth token surface, and no web endpoints to model - this entry is an honest stub reflecting a desktop-plugin/COM SDK, not a web API.

providers.name: PraxiPal
providers.description: PraxiPal GmbH (Berlin, Germany) builds Luna, an AI voice receptionist for medical, dental, therapeutic, and veterinary practices. Luna answers incoming phone calls 24/7, handles patient questions, books and reschedules appointments, and processes prescription requests autonomously, integrating directly with 40+ German practice-management systems (PVS) such as CGM MEDISTAR, tomedo, charly by solutio, DAMPSOFT, and DENSoffice. It operates in a GDPR-compliant manner on European servers with medical-confidentiality safeguards under German law. PraxiPal is backed by HV Capital. No public API, developer portal, or SDK is currently published; this profile tracks the company as an API Evangelist network lead.

providers.name: pulseData
providers.description: PulseData, Inc. is a healthcare artificial-intelligence company that applies machine learning and predictive analytics to chronic disease management, with a focus on chronic kidney disease. Its platform helps payers, providers, ACOs, and value-based care organizations identify at-risk patient populations, predict disease progression, and act by directing patients to targeted interventions and care programs. Named customers include Quest Diagnostics, US Renal Care, Vytalize, and HealthEdge. The company is SOC 2 Type II certified and was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta. No public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable documentation were found during enrichment.

providers.name: Qvin
providers.description: Qvin is a women's health diagnostics company that develops the Q-Pad, described as the first and only FDA-cleared diagnostic menstrual pad, enabling non-invasive at-home health screening from menstrual blood. The company analyzes collected samples in its CLIA-certified laboratory to test biomarkers for conditions such as diabetes (A1c), and is researching screening for cervical cancer, endometriosis, sexually transmitted infections, and uterine fibroids. Qvin operates as a consumer and clinical diagnostics provider rather than a developer platform, and does not currently publish a public API, SDKs, or developer documentation. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Version One Ventures.

providers.name: Reliv
providers.description: Reliv is a digital medical ecosystem operating in Ecuador and Mexico that aims to simplify healthcare management for clinics, hospitals, doctors, and patients. Its platform combines a Hospital Information System (HIS) for hospital and clinic operations, an Electronic Health Record (EHR) offering digital clinical histories with online scheduling and electronic prescriptions, and a patient-facing Pacientes mobile app for appointments, digital prescriptions, and offers. Reliv positions itself as the first integrated digital medical ecosystem of Ecuador and runs a Reliv Academy training platform. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Schwarz Charite Health Data
providers.description: Schwarz Charite Health Data GmbH is a German health-data joint venture announced on 2026-03-20 by Charite - Universitaetsmedizin Berlin and Schwarz Digits, the IT and digital arm of the Schwarz Group (Lidl, Kaufland, STACKIT). Schwarz Digits holds 75 percent and Charite 25 percent. The venture takes the HIVEPRO platform to market: a clinical data platform whose core is an openEHR-based Clinical Data Repository queried with Archetype Query Language (AQL), able to exchange data over HL7 FHIR - including the German Medical Informatics Initiative (MII) core dataset - and to feed OMOP-compliant analytics. HIVEPRO harmonises and networks records that are otherwise trapped in incompatible hospital source systems, and is delivered as a managed cloud service running on STACKIT's sovereign cloud so that data residency and control stay in Germany under European data-protection rules. The technical lineage comes from the BMBF-funded HiGHmed consortium, active since 2016. openEHR International lists the company as an industry partner. As of this pass the company has no website, developer portal, documentation host or public API of its own; every public surface it has is a press page on its parent's site.

providers.name: Servo
providers.description: Servo is a Linux Foundation Europe project providing an open source, high-performance web rendering engine written in Rust. It aims to be a lightweight, embeddable alternative for web technologies in applications, leveraging Rust's safety guarantees for secure and concurrent web content rendering.

providers.name: StoneEagle F&I
providers.description: StoneEagle F&I is an automotive Finance & Insurance (F&I) technology company that has spent more than 35 years building the software backbone of dealership F&I operations. Its product suite spans Variable Ops (StoneEagleMENU, an electronic F&I menu-selling and product-presentation system, and StoneEagleMETRICS, real-time DMS-sourced sales and F&I reporting), Fixed Ops (PENCILWRENCH and StoneEagleMETRICS SERVICE for the service drive), and industry benchmarking (StoneEagleDATA, transaction-level insight across more than half of U.S. franchised dealers). StoneEagle connects to dealerships through certified DMS integrations and partners such as Dealertrack and F&I Express, but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal — integration is delivered as private, certified dealer and partner connections. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures.

providers.name: Swept
providers.description: Swept (sweptworks.com) is workforce management software for commercial cleaning and janitorial businesses - scheduling, GPS-verified time tracking and payroll reporting, mobile crew messaging, quality inspections, supply requests, client portals, and one-time work order management. As of this catalog entry, Swept does NOT publish a documented, self-serve public or partner developer API. There is no developer portal, API reference, API key or OAuth signup, published OpenAPI/Swagger specification, or webhook documentation on sweptworks.com or in the Swept Support Center knowledge base. The only documented outbound data path is a one-way, manually-activated QuickBooks Online payroll sync set up per account by a Swept Customer Success Manager - not a self-serve developer integration. Swept's public GitHub organization contains only take-home coding-challenge repositories used for hiring, not a first-party API client, SDK, or spec. This entry is therefore an honest stub documenting the provider and its access model; no API definitions are asserted because none are publicly documented.

providers.name: Synthace
providers.description: Synthace is a London-headquartered life-science software company (offices in London, Boston and San Diego) behind Antha, a cloud digital-experiment platform for R&D teams. The platform lets biologists design multifactorial Design of Experiments (DOE) and Quality by Design (QbD) studies, simulate them ahead of time, compile them into machine-executable protocols that run on third-party lab automation hardware (Tecan, Formulatrix, SPT Labtech and others), and capture the resulting experimental data and metadata in a single structured, AI-ready record. Synthace is delivered as an authenticated tenant application at antha.com rather than as a developer product - as of 2026-08-29 the company publishes no developer portal, no API reference, no SDKs and no machine-readable contract on any public host, and the platform's own /api/* surface answers every unauthenticated request with a blanket JSON 401.

providers.name: Tenzai
providers.description: Tenzai is an AI-native cybersecurity company building an autonomous, agentic AI "hacker" for the enterprise. Its AI agents continuously discover, chain, and exploit hard-to-find vulnerabilities across enterprise software and validate them in production the way a human red team would, aiming to bring nation-grade offensive security to every engineering organization. Founded in 2025 by Guardicore founders Pavel Gurvich and Ariel Zeitlin together with Ofri Ziv, Itamar Tal, and Aner Mazur, the Tel Aviv-based company launched out of stealth in November 2025 with a $75M seed round (one of the largest in cybersecurity) led by Greylock Partners, Battery Ventures, and Lux Capital at a reported $330M valuation. Tenzai targets the penetration-testing market with continuous, AI-driven offensive validation. As of this profile the company exposes a marketing site, a research blog, careers, and a SOC 2 Type 1 trust center, but no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: VidCruiter
providers.description: VidCruiter is a Moncton, Canada based recruitment technology company that provides a modular hiring platform - pre-recorded and live video interviewing, automated interview scheduling, skills and pre-employment testing, automated reference checking, audio interviews, and video proctoring. VidCruiter does not publish a public, self-service developer API. Its programmatic surface is a partner and enterprise integration capability: pre-built connectors to major ATS/HCM, background-check, calendar, job-board, SSO, and video-conferencing providers, plus a bidirectional web-services integration in which an institution's unique, account-provisioned API endpoint is exchanged with a system of record (for example Slate) to push application records into VidCruiter and pull completed interview results back out. API access is gated behind a VidCruiter account representative; there is no public API reference, OpenAPI document, base URL, or self-serve key issuance.

providers.name: Vornamencheck
providers.description: Vornamencheck provides a REST API that determines the gender probability of a given first name based on the specified country. The service returns a likelihood for male or female, helping businesses clean and personalize data, suggest appropriate salutations, and automate gender-based workflows. It supports multiple languages and countries, offering a simple HTTP GET endpoint for integration into forms, databases, and applications.

providers.name: Aetion
providers.description: Aetion is a healthcare technology company that builds real-world evidence (RWE) software for biopharma, medical device manufacturers, payers and regulators. Its Aetion Evidence Platform (AEP) turns claims, electronic health record, registry, patient-reported and trial data into transparent, reproducible, regulatory-grade evidence, delivered as a set of applications: Discover for exploratory analysis, Substantiate for study implementation, Activate as a low-code plus hosted-code workbench, and Generate for synthetic data. Founded by two Harvard Medical School professors, Aetion was acquired by Datavant; the acquisition closed 11 July 2025 and Aetion now operates inside Datavant's Life Sciences business. As of this profile the aetion.com domain redirects wholesale to datavant.com and Aetion publishes no standalone developer program, public API reference or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: AmpMe
providers.description: AmpMe is a mobile application that synchronizes music playback across multiple smartphones to create a collective, portable sound system. Users connect friends' phones together so their device speakers play the same track in sync, amplifying the audio for parties and gatherings. The app supports streaming sources such as Spotify, YouTube, SoundCloud, and Deezer, and runs natively on iOS and Android. AmpMe was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; it is a consumer mobile product that does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Amyris
providers.description: Amyris, Inc. is a synthetic-biology and precision-fermentation company that engineers microbes to convert plant-derived sugars into high-performance renewable molecules — including farnesene, squalene, squalane, and bisabolol — at industrial scale. The company offers strain development, process development, piloting, scale-up, and manufacturing services for custom renewable chemistry used across personal care, cosmetics, flavors and fragrances, and other industries, emphasizing resilient supply chains, product consistency, and reduced ecological impact. Amyris is a private company that emerged from a 2023 Chapter 11 restructuring; it does not currently publish a public developer API or technology platform.

providers.name: Appsforbharat
providers.description: Appsforbharat is a digital platform dedicated to serving the devotional and spiritual needs of millions of devotees in India and abroad. It offers a suite of products such as Sri Mandir, daily darshan, puja booking, and spiritual content, aiming to provide a trusted, end‑to‑end tech solution for religious practices and community engagement.

providers.name: Arc Simulations
providers.description: Arc Simulations is a London-based sports technology company, founded in 2022 by Henry Smith and Michael Armenakis and part of the Techstars London Spring 2024 accelerator cohort. Arc builds ball-tracking and simulation technology for cricket and other ball sports: professional-standard cricket balls carry embedded tracking tags that transmit position data to sensors up to 200 times per second, feeding a real-time simulation and analytics platform. The system predicts ball trajectory post-impact from velocity, angle and spin to deliver millimetre-accurate, autonomous feedback for every shot, with customisable field configurations that mirror live match scenarios. Arc serves players, coaches, scouts, analysts, broadcasters and fans through a hosted application (app.arcsim.io) and a player-facing app (player.arcsim.io) offering ball-by-ball 3D simulations. Arc's technology is built first for cricket but is designed to track nearly any sports ball. No public developer API, SDK, or API documentation is published at this time; this profile captures the company's identity and web/security posture in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Ariasystems5d5a
providers.description: Aria Systems provides a cloud billing platform that simplifies commercial complexity into adaptive and automated billing experiences. It unifies traditional and new business models, offering solutions like Aria Billing, Aria Allegro, and AI-powered Aria Billie to help enterprises manage subscriptions, usage, and revenue recognition across industries.

providers.name: Bepro11
providers.description: Bepro11, operating under the brand BEPRO, provides analysis software, cameras, and data solutions for sports teams. Their platform enables recording, analysis, and collaboration on match footage, offering products such as fixed and portable sports cameras, data APIs, and bespoke data services. The company targets professional and amateur sports organizations seeking comprehensive performance analytics and video management tools.

providers.name: Bisichem
providers.description: BiSiChem is a leading biotech company focused on discovery and development of innovative therapeutic drugs in immuno‑oncology, targeted therapy, and neuro‑degenerative diseases. They partner early‑stage programs, retain profit rights, and aim for first‑in‑class or second‑generation small‑molecule drugs, emphasizing good lives, better innovation, and best therapy.

providers.name: Bland Company
providers.description: The Bland Company is a London-based food-technology and biotechnology startup building functional plant proteins that replace eggs in food manufacturing. Its feedstock-agnostic process upcycles underused agricultural side streams into flavor-neutral, cost-stable proteins engineered to match animal-protein functionality — solubility, foaming, gelling, and emulsifying — for bakery, sauces, beverages, and snacks. The company raised a ~$2.7M pre-seed round led by Initialized Capital. It publishes no public developer API surface (no docs, SDKs, or GitHub); this profile is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company/portfolio lead.

providers.name: Blixt
providers.description: BL!XT (Blixt) is a Swedish deep-tech company building intelligent, programmable power infrastructure that turns electrical distribution from analog systems into digitally controlled, software-defined platforms. Its products include ZERO, a solid-state current-control switchgear for circuit-level protection, monitoring, and automation; X-VERTER, a software-defined voltage conversion system with integrated energy storage; and THE ZONE, an AI-driven software intelligence layer that coordinates connected distribution devices for real-time analysis, failure prediction, and load balancing. BL!XT serves data centers, industrial manufacturing, maritime vessels, grid providers, and defense. Headquartered in Kista, Sweden and backed by Union Square Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API or developer surface.

providers.name: BlocPower
providers.description: BlocPower is a Brooklyn-based climate technology and building decarbonization company, founded in 2014 as a Public Benefit Corporation, that makes urban buildings smarter, greener, and healthier with a focus on historically underserved communities. It combines deep building-science expertise with accessible financing to deliver energy-efficiency retrofits and electrification measures such as heat pumps, pairing construction management with clean-energy upgrades. As of late 2023 BlocPower reported more than 1,200 completed measures across 1,100+ buildings nationwide, thousands of metric tons of CO2e reduced, and hundreds of local job placements, earning recognition from the White House, EPA, and TIME. BlocPower is a portfolio company of a16z and is tracked in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or GitHub organization at this time.

providers.name: Bugworks Research
providers.description: Bugworks Research is a clinical‑stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2014 and incubated at C‑CAMP in Bangalore, India. It focuses on developing novel antibiotic and oncology therapeutics to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) and cancer, leveraging small‑molecule platforms to create affordable, accessible treatments for multidrug‑resistant infections and refractory solid tumours. The company partners globally and aims to address critical unmet medical needs through innovative science and strategic collaborations.

providers.name: Capitual
providers.description: Capitual provides digital asset integration, liquidity, and payment infrastructure for large enterprises. It offers multi‑currency digital accounts, blockchain connectivity, and bespoke consulting to enable secure, scalable financial operations across jurisdictions. The platform supports high‑volume transactions, regulatory compliance, and custom liquidity solutions for institutional clients.

providers.name: ClearMotion
providers.description: ClearMotion is an automotive motion-technology company founded out of MIT in 2012 by Zack Anderson and Shakeel Avadhany, headquartered at its US innovation lab in Billerica, Massachusetts, with a UK engineering hub at MIRA Technology Park in Nuneaton, a Shanghai office, and a production plant in Changshu, China. Its CM1 fully active suspension system pairs the ActiValve digital hydraulic actuator with software that counteracts road disturbances in milliseconds, and its RoadMotion service is a crowdsourced, cloud-based road-surface intelligence layer that fuses data from vehicle sensors into a high-definition surface map accurate to better than 20mm, feeding proactive suspension, chassis and ADAS decisions. The company absorbed the Bose Ride and Project Sound active-suspension programs, is led by CEO Christian Steinmann, and ships with NIO (ET9, ES9) alongside collaborations with Porsche, BWI Group and Sona Comstar. Marketing material describes RoadMotion as an "end-to-end cloud API solution", but ClearMotion publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable specification, SDKs or /.well-known discovery surface — the API is an OEM/B2B integration rather than a self-serve public API.

providers.name: Cognida.ai
providers.description: Cognida.ai provides enterprise AI solutions that bridge the gap between frontier AI capabilities and production systems. The company offers practical AI and data solutions for enterprises, including AI builders, FDE+ solutions, and automation tools. Their platform helps organizations automate finance, operations, and other business processes, delivering scalable, secure, and compliant AI implementations. Cognida.ai also offers consulting, integration, and support services to accelerate AI adoption across industries.

providers.name: commandbar
providers.description: CommandBar is a product-adoption and in-app user-assistance platform that helps SaaS teams onboard, guide, and support users directly inside their web applications. Its embeddable widget bundles a command palette / universal search (Spotlight), an AI copilot, contextual help (HelpHub), nudges and product tours, checklists, and in-app surveys, all driven by a JavaScript SDK (npm `commandbar`) that boots against an organization ID. CommandBar was founded in 2020, backed by Insight Partners among others, and acquired by Amplitude in 2024; the product is now delivered as Amplitude Guides & Surveys. The standalone commandbar.com developer surface (SDK reference, REST API, changelog) has been retired and redirects to Amplitude, though the npm SDK remains published.

providers.name: Common Trust
providers.description: Common Trust provides guidance and resources for employee ownership trusts (EOTs), helping companies transition to employee ownership models. The platform offers educational content, playbooks, case studies, webinars, and tools such as an EOT fit analyzer. It serves business owners, advisors, and stakeholders interested in exploring EOT structures as alternatives to traditional ownership, aiming to promote inclusive and sustainable business ownership.

providers.name: convergence
providers.description: Convergence AI was a London-based artificial-intelligence startup founded in 2024 by Marvin Purtorab (CEO) and Andy Toulis (CTO) building Proxy, a personal AI agent designed to complete open-ended administrative and web-browsing tasks across domains. Its approach centered on long-term memory and continual learning via a new class of models it called Large Meta Learning Models (LMLM). Convergence raised a $12M pre-seed led by Balderton Capital with participation from Salesforce Ventures and Shopify Ventures, and was acquired by Salesforce in May 2025 to strengthen Agentforce. Its lasting public surface is the convergence-ai GitHub organization, which open-sourced proxy-lite (a mini open-weights web-browsing agent), the proxy-lite-3b vision-language model on Hugging Face, the LM2 memory-model paper repo, and the WebGames agent benchmark.

providers.name: CorWave
providers.description: CorWave SA is a French clinical-stage medical device company, incorporated in 2012 by the startup studio MD Start and headquartered in Clichy, France, that develops implantable cardiac assist pumps for patients with advanced heart failure. Its patented wave membrane technology — a biomimetic polymer membrane driven by an electromagnetic actuator, inspired by the undulating movement of marine animals — produces truly pulsatile, physiological blood flow, differentiating the CorWave LVAS and Nemo pumps from commercially available rotary-pump LVADs. The company has raised more than EUR 80 million, operates an urban manufacturing facility in Clichy, employs more than 90 people, and announced the first in-human implantation of its Left Ventricular Assist System in 2025. CorWave LVAS remains an investigational device and is not approved for commercial use in any country. CorWave publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Crema
providers.description: Crema.co is an online specialty-coffee subscription platform and curated marketplace that connects coffee drinkers with independent roasters. Customers take a preference quiz, pick a delivery cadence ranging from every few days to monthly, and receive freshly roasted beans by mail from a rotating selection of more than a thousand coffees sourced from dozens of small-batch roasters. Crema also runs a workplace coffee program for offices. This is a consumer e-commerce brand with no public developer API or developer platform; the repository is retained in the network for completeness and provenance.

providers.name: Crosslend
providers.description: CrossLend is a Berlin-based fintech providing digital debt technology for the private lending and securitisation space. Its platform offers Portfolio Analytics for loan-level data validation, granular portfolio insights and automated reporting, and Securitisation-as-a-Service that digitises and automates the issuance of financial instruments, including SPV setup, legal and compliance frameworks and audit-proof reporting. CrossLend serves banks, asset managers and institutional lenders across Europe, and is backed by Earlybird and Northzone. The company exposes no public developer API surface today; this profile tracks its identity and security posture in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: CureApp
providers.description: CureApp, Inc. is a Japanese digital therapeutics company that develops evidence‑based software medical programs (DTx) to treat chronic conditions. Their platform recreates treatment with software, aiming to provide high‑quality care accessible to all. The company focuses on innovative therapeutic effects through technology, sustainability, and patient outcomes, as described on their official website.

providers.name: Dayforward
providers.description: Dayforward is a New York-based life insurance technology and services group founded in 2019 by Aaron Shapiro. It owns Commercial Travelers Life Insurance Company (NY-domiciled carrier) and Dayforward Insurance Agency LLC (licensed in all 50 states), and sells income-replacement term life insurance direct to consumers at dayforward.com. Since pivoting to B2B at dayforward.io it licenses Workbench — a SaaS platform covering the full life insurance lifecycle from agent selling and automated underwriting through policy administration and service — plus managed distribution, underwriting and administration services to other carriers and distributors. Workbench is marketed as including "APIs, plug-and-play widgets, single sign-on support, and robust administration tools", but Dayforward publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI definition or SDKs.

providers.name: Ducommun
providers.description: Ducommun is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Ducommun API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: ELKROOM
providers.description: ELKROOM CO., LTD. is a consumer mobile-gaming studio and 500 Global portfolio company behind the OXO product family. Its flagship OXO Game Launcher is an Android game launcher and optimization tool that organizes a player's games and automatically tracks play history, journals, monthly reports, rankings, and community activity, and has surpassed five million downloads on Google Play. The company also builds OXO Gameplay, an AI-powered gaming content and social platform for Android and iOS, and Stricer, a cloud-based AI video analysis and highlight-editing tool on the web. ELKROOM operates consumer applications rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its public identity, product surface, and legal/policy pages. Tagline: "You Chase Glory. We Make It Legendary."

providers.name: Ephemeral Solutions
providers.description: Ephemeral Solutions is the company entity behind Ephemeral Tattoo, the direct-to-consumer brand at ephemeraltattoos.com (ephemeral.tattoo) known for "made-to-fade" semi-permanent tattoos applied with a vegan ink formulated to fade naturally over roughly one to three years, removing the need for laser removal. The company operates two sides of a marketplace: a consumer service that connects people with approved partner tattoo artists, and a business line that sells its proprietary fading ink to professional tattoo artists and studios. It runs an editorial blog, a lookbook of tattoo examples, a How It Works explainer, and an FAQ. It was surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio lead. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, or agent surface, so this profile carries only verified identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: FanDuel
providers.description: FanDuel is a major US sports betting and daily fantasy sports operator (FanDuel Sportsbook, FanDuel Casino, FanDuel Fantasy, FanDuel TV). FanDuel does not publish a public developer REST API for its sportsbook, casino, or fantasy products. Internal/private APIs power the apps and a Sportradar/SBTech-derived trading stack but are not available to third-party developers.

providers.name: Genesco
providers.description: Genesco is a specialty retailer and branded company selling footwear, apparel, and accessories through more than 1,400 retail stores and e-commerce sites under banners including Journeys, Schuh, Johnston & Murphy, and Genesco Brands. Genesco publishes no public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI document — it says so itself in the llms.txt it serves on journeys.com. What it does publish is an agent-access posture: an llms.txt for AI assistants, a Content-Signal AI-usage declaration in robots.txt on Journeys and Johnston & Murphy, a named allow list for AI search and user-requested agents, an llm= referral attribution convention, and server-rendered schema.org ProductGroup JSON-LD on every product page.

providers.name: Graco
providers.description: Graco Inc is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Graco Inc API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: HelioRec
providers.description: HelioRec is a floating photovoltaic (FPV) engineering and manufacturing company that designs and builds floating solar power plants for lakes, reservoirs, and nearshore waters. It uses an engineering-led, load-based methodology focused on structural behavior, mooring integrity, installation practicality, and long-term operability on water, delivering grid-connected, utility-scale systems engineered for real water conditions. HelioRec serves independent power producers and utilities, hydropower and reservoir owners, industrial and infrastructure operators, and water and agriculture stakeholders, supporting projects from site-specific concept through execution. The company is backed by Techstars.

providers.name: Hinge Health
providers.description: Hinge Health is a San Francisco-based digital musculoskeletal (MSK) care company founded in 2014 by Daniel Perez and Gabriel Mecklenburg, delivering virtual physical therapy, pelvic health, and chronic pain care to enterprise health plans, employers, and their members. The platform combines on-demand exercise therapy with a multidisciplinary care team — physical therapists, health coaches, board-certified physicians, and orthopedic specialists — augmented by 3D motion tracking, computer vision, and an in-house AI Care Assistant. Hinge Health develops Enso, an FDA-cleared, drug-free wearable that delivers proprietary electrical stimulation waveforms for pain relief, and operates HingeConnect, an EMR/claims interoperability layer that ingests records from more than one million external providers across 120,000+ care sites to coordinate care, surface surgical and opioid risk, and feed real-time clinical context into the digital clinic. The company also runs HingeSelect, a national provider network for in-person MSK care, and contracts with all five major US national health plans plus employers including Boeing, Salesforce, and US Foods. Hinge Health raised more than $1 billion from Insight Partners, Tiger Global, Coatue, and Atomico before completing its IPO on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker HNGE on May 22, 2025, pricing at $32/share and opening at $39.25 for an initial market capitalization above $3 billion. There is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release for Hinge Health, Enso, or HingeConnect — the platform is sold as a managed clinical service to health plans and employers, and the HingeConnect interoperability surface is operated internally rather than exposed to third-party developers.

providers.name: Hireguide
providers.description: Hireguide is a structured-interviewing and hiring-intelligence platform, originally a Techstars-backed startup, that helped talent teams run consistent, evidence-based interviews with guided question banks, scorecards, interview recording and AI-assisted candidate evaluation grounded in industrial-organizational hiring science. Hireguide's team and technology were acquired by HireVue in 2026; the primary domain now redirects to HireVue's AI Interviewer platform, while trust.hireguide.com remains live and Hireguide-branded, publishing the company's compliance posture (SOC 2 Type 2, GDPR, CCPA, EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF). This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio lead; no independent public developer/API surface was found for Hireguide.

providers.name: Huckberry
providers.description: Huckberry is an American direct-to-consumer online retailer of men's apparel, outdoor gear and lifestyle goods, founded in 2010 by Andy Forch and Richard Greiner and headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Austin and Columbus. It pairs a first-party e-commerce storefront with a large editorial operation — the Huckberry Journal — and an in-house brand portfolio, selling an "everyday adventure" assortment that sits between traditional outdoor retail and menswear. Huckberry is a retailer, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, no public API, no SDK and no machine-readable contract. Its public GitHub organization (Huckberry Inc) holds eight repositories, seven of them forks of third-party Ruby e-commerce gems — Solidus AvaTax, Affirm, Paperclip, omniauth-slack — which evidence a self-hosted Ruby storefront rather than a published platform. Partner and affiliate integration is outsourced to the Partnerize network, and customer self-service runs on a Zendesk help center tenant at help.huckberry.com.

providers.name: Kakehashi
providers.description: Kakehashi is a Japanese healthcare technology company digitally transforming the country's roughly 60,000 community pharmacies, a traditionally paper-based sector. Its flagship cloud platform Musubi provides electronic medication history, automated dispensing records, and personalized patient guidance, and is used by more than 14,000 pharmacies across Japan. The product suite extends to Musubi Insight (pharmacy management analytics), Pocket Musubi (patient follow-up app), Musubi AI Stock Management (machine-learning demand forecasting and inventory optimization), and Pharmarket. Kakehashi is backed by investors including 500 Global and Goldman Sachs. No public developer API or platform is currently published.

providers.name: Kobalt
providers.description: Kobalt Music Group is an independent music rights management and administrative publishing company founded in 2000 by Willard Ahdritz, operating from New York and London. Unlike traditional publishers it administers copyrights rather than owning them, running Kobalt Music Publishing, a neighbouring rights division, and AMRA, the digital-first collection society it acquired in 2014. Royalty and rights processing runs on KTech, the rights and content management platform built to independently serve both Kobalt Music Publishing and AMRA at the scale of billions of music micro-transactions, with songwriters and rightsholders viewing statements and analytics through the authenticated Kobalt Portal. Kobalt publishes no public developer program: a 2026-07-19 probe found no developer portal, no API documentation, no OpenAPI or AsyncAPI description, and no API discovery documents under /.well-known/. Integration is arranged commercially through Kobalt or KTech rather than through a self-service API.

providers.name: Latitud
providers.description: Latitud is an early-stage venture capital firm and founder platform that writes first checks for Latin American founders, positioning itself as a bridge between the LatAm startup ecosystem and Silicon Valley. Its flagship program is the Latitud Fellowship, an eight-week remote program for pre-founders, dealmakers and technical builders that ends with a week-long roadshow in San Francisco, and which invests a $62,500 ideation check on a SAFE for a 2.5 percent stake in a cohort of eight fellows. Latitud also runs a portfolio support practice, a mentor network drawn from companies such as Mercado Libre, Vercel, Auth0 and Cornershop, and a Spanish- and Portuguese-language media surface including a podcast and community channels. Latitud publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs or machine-readable specifications; its public surface is a three-page marketing site (home, fellowship, portfolio) plus an application form, so this profile is an identity and web-properties record rather than an API profile.

providers.name: Link Cell Therapies
providers.description: Link Cell Therapies is a South San Francisco clinical-stage cell therapy company founded by Stanford investigators Robbie Majzner and Crystal Mackall in partnership with Samsara BioCapital, working on the development of safe and effective CAR T agents for patients with solid tumors. The company's logic-gate technology produces AND-gate CAR T cells that require co-expression of two cancer targets before driving cell cytotoxicity, giving greater tumor specificity than existing logic-gate approaches and aiming to avoid off-tumor toxicity. Alongside additional platforms under development, Link is advancing therapeutic programs across solid tumors and certain hematologic cancers, including a dual-targeting AND-gated CAR program (LNK001) directed at clear cell renal cell carcinoma, and in January 2026 entered a strategic collaboration with Johnson & Johnson to develop logic-gate LINK CAR T therapies. Link Cell Therapies publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable interface; this profile captures company identity and probed public-surface posture only.

providers.name: MokN
providers.description: MokN is a cybersecurity company that helps organizations detect external threats before attackers can weaponize them. Founded by SOC practitioners after a major cyber crisis, MokN builds the detection layer around two products: Baits, defensive deception pages that lure attackers into revealing stolen credentials and validate compromise in real time, and Lantern, an external attack surface management tool that maps and remediates perimeter exposures. The platform reports processing over one billion login attempts and protecting hundreds of thousands of users across organizations. MokN publishes no public API, SDK, or developer documentation as of this pass; this profile captures the company's public web presence and domain-security posture.

providers.name: NEO TECH MOBILITY HOLDINGS LIMITED
providers.description: NEO TECH MOBILITY HOLDINGS LIMITED (Neo Mobility) is a UAE-based B2B electric-mobility startup driving sustainable transportation across the MENA region. Neo bundles electric-vehicle fleets, charging infrastructure, an integrated fleet/driver/operations/energy management platform, driver-safety programs, and human-capital support into a single subscription-based ecosystem — delivering EV Delivery-as-a-Service for e-commerce, food delivery, and last-mile logistics, alongside e-taxi mobility. The company publishes no public developer or API program; this profile is maintained for API Evangelist network discovery.

providers.name: Newleos Therapeutics
providers.description: Newleos Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company co-founded by Longwood Fund and seasoned CNS drug-development leaders, headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. Its pipeline, licensed from Roche, develops oral small-molecule therapeutics targeting GABAA-gamma1, V1a, TAAR1 and GABAA-alpha5 mechanisms, with first- or best-in-class potential for general anxiety, social anxiety, substance use disorders, and cognitive impairment. Newleos is a pharmaceutical R&D company with no public developer or API product surface; this profile captures its corporate web presence for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Parlevel
providers.description: Parlevel Systems is a San Antonio-based vending technology company (founded 2012, now part of 365 Retail Markets) providing a Vending Management System (VMS) and related tools for unattended retail operators across vending, micro markets, and office coffee service. The platform covers real-time machine telemetry, dynamic route optimization, cashless payments (PayPlus), inventory and warehouse management, and cash accountability. No public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, or documented webhook surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's public identity and probed domain security only.

providers.name: Poplin
providers.description: Poplin (formerly SudShare) is a nationwide on-demand laundry pickup and delivery marketplace connecting customers with independent, work-from-home "Laundry Pros" who wash, dry, and fold laundry, serving 500+ cities and 150,000+ customers. Poplin operates two consumer-facing mobile apps - the customer app and the Laundry Pro app - plus a Laundry Pro web portal (laundry-pro.poplin.co), but it does not expose a public or partner developer API. No developer portal or API reference was found at poplin.co, and the api.poplin.co subdomain resolves but returns a bare 404 with no documentation, indicating internal-only use. Business/SMB accounts (property managers, hospitality) are onboarded through sales and an account manager rather than through self-service API keys.

providers.name: Presence
providers.description: Presence is a student engagement and co-curricular involvement platform for higher education, now part of Modern Campus. It helps colleges and universities manage student organizations, campus events, involvement and attendance tracking, co-curricular records, forms, and engagement analytics so institutions can attract, engage, and retain learners. Modern Campus serves more than 1,700 colleges, universities, and education providers. Presence is delivered as a closed SaaS product with support and reference code available through the Modern Campus customer support portal; there is no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or self-service API surface published at this time, so this profile captures company identity and probed domain security rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Procuri
providers.description: Procuri (procuri.ai) presents itself as an AI-powered procurement automation platform that uses specialized AI agents to discover and vet suppliers, optimize contract negotiation and pricing, monitor policy and regulatory compliance, and assess supplier and market risk for enterprise procurement teams. It was surfaced as a portfolio-lead stub of insight-partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as of this pass the public site publishes no developer/API surface (no docs, developer, API-reference, or OpenAPI pages resolve).

providers.name: Prodigy Education
providers.description: Prodigy Education is a Canadian K-8 game-based learning company best known for Prodigy Math and Prodigy English — fantasy RPG-style products in which students battle and quest by answering curriculum-aligned questions. The product is free for teachers and is monetized through optional parent memberships. Prodigy is consumer- and classroom-facing with no public developer API or partner program. Its integration surface is school rostering and SSO: Clever (SSO + Secure Sync district rostering), ClassLink (SSO, with OneRoster district rostering rolling out), and Google (SSO + Google Classroom assignment creation).

providers.name: Project Admission
providers.description: Project Admission is a ticketing technology company serving the live event industry — professional sports teams, leagues, artists, theaters, and venues. It layers on top of existing ticketing systems such as SeatGeek, Ticketmaster, and AXS to expand opportunities around the ticket and capture more value before, during, and after an event. Its platform provides branded storefronts, multi-channel inventory management, bulk ticket distribution, split season-ticket ingestion, and fan-engagement tools including influencer and group-sales programs. Project Admission does not publicly expose a developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures its verified public web and security surface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Anthemis and Techstars and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Proximitty
providers.description: Proximitty is a Y Combinator-backed company building an AI operating system for commercial lending. Its platform deploys regulator-grade AI agents that ingest and parse borrower documents, spread financials, generate credit memos, automate loan operations, and continuously track covenants and closing obligations for FDIC-insured banks, credit unions, and non-bank lenders originating C&I, CRE, and SBA loans. The system is designed to align with SR 11-7 and OCC guidance on AI governance and third-party risk, and claims to compress underwriting from weeks to minutes while enabling loan closures in under ten days. Proximitty publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal; it is delivered as a hosted SaaS product, and its public surface is limited to a marketing site, blog, security/compliance page, and a hosted Trust Center.

providers.name: Pulmocide
providers.description: Pulmocide Ltd. is a privately held, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered at 44 Southampton Buildings in London, United Kingdom, with a US entity (Pulmocide Inc.) in Boston, Massachusetts. It develops novel inhaled medicines for pulmonary aspergillosis and other difficult-to-treat respiratory diseases, delivering drug directly to the site of infection in the lung to achieve high local exposure with low systemic exposure. Its lead asset is opelconazole (formerly PC945), an inhaled triazole antifungal active against Aspergillus that has received US FDA Orphan Drug, Fast Track and Qualified Infectious Disease Product designations; the company reported Phase 2 OPERA-S safety results in 2024 and announced termination of the Phase 3 OPERA-T study in 2025. Pulmocide is a drug developer, not a software or platform company: it publishes no developer program, no public API, no SDKs and no machine-readable API contract of any kind. This profile therefore records identity, corporate web properties and probed absence rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Pulse API
providers.description: The Pulse API allows you to programmatically access the data stored in your Pulse account with ease.

providers.name: Rebel Girls
providers.description: Rebel Girls is a global media and publishing brand that celebrates inspiring stories about girls and women, empowering young audiences through books, a podcast, a YouTube channel, apparel and accessories, activities, and the Rebel Girls Sport program. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass Rebel Girls publishes no developer, API, or well-known discovery surface: rebelgirls.com redirects to www.rebelgirls.com and every standard well-known endpoint returns 404, and there are no developer/api subdomains. This profile captures the company's public identity and a live domain-security posture probe; it carries no API artifacts because there is no public API to describe.

providers.name: Reynolds American
providers.description: Reynolds American Inc. is the second-largest tobacco company in the United States and a subsidiary of British American Tobacco (BAT). Its subsidiaries include R.J. Reynolds Tobacco Company (Camel, Newport, Pall Mall), American Snuff Company (Grizzly, Kodiak), Santa Fe Natural Tobacco Company (Natural American Spirit), and R.J. Reynolds Vapor Company. Reynolds American does not offer a public developer API or data services.

providers.name: Savi Technology
providers.description: Savi Technology provides Internet of Things (IoT) and active RFID (aRFID) solutions for real-time supply chain visibility, asset tracking, and cargo security. Combining active RFID tags, environmental condition sensors, and machine intelligence, Savi delivers location, condition, and estimated-time- of-arrival data for cargo and high-value assets across government, military (including U.S. Department of Defense in-transit visibility), and commercial supply chains. The company is headquartered in Wilmington, North Carolina. As of this enrichment pass, Savi Technology exposes no public developer portal, OpenAPI/Swagger definition, SDKs, or documented web API; its only authenticated surface is the aRFID-VI customer catalog (savirfidcatalog.net).

providers.name: sento
providers.description: sento is a Munich-based B2B software company (sento GmbH) building a cloud-based EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) platform that automates complex business-partner processes, letting companies replace slow, manual partner-integration workflows with automated document and data exchange. Founded by Nimar Blume and Felix Krauth and backed by Insight Partners, sento raised a EUR 9 million seed round to expand its partner-onboarding and document-automation product. As of this profile sento does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation - only its corporate marketing site and legal pages are publicly available.

providers.name: Shippio
providers.description: Shippio is a Japanese logistics-technology company positioning itself as "Japan's first digital forwarder." It provides cloud-based SaaS for visualizing and streamlining international trade and freight-forwarding operations, combining domain expertise with AI-era digital technology. Its product line includes Shippio Forwarding (a digital forwarding service), Shippio Cargo (trade-management SaaS for shippers/importers-exporters), and Shippio Works (trade-management SaaS for logistics operators), delivered through a multi-sided platform that connects shippers and operators. The company is backed by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Shippio publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or pricing; its APIs are internal platform APIs referenced only in engineering job postings, so this profile is identity-only with no public API surface.

providers.name: SoundBetter
providers.description: SoundBetter is an online marketplace that connects musicians and artists with professional audio talent for hire — mixing and mastering engineers, music producers, singers, songwriters, beat makers, and studio session musicians. Clients post jobs or browse curated professional profiles, audition portfolio tracks, and hire and pay through the platform, which handles escrow, milestones, and delivery. The company also operates a storefront (my.soundbetter.com) and a plugins shop (shop.soundbetter.com / Imagine Plugins). SoundBetter was acquired by Spotify in 2019. As of this enrichment pass, SoundBetter publishes a consumer/creator web marketplace but exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface; this profile therefore captures company identity and a live domain-security probe rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Stockio
providers.description: Free stock photos, vectors, and videos platform with a REST API for searching and downloading creative assets for commercial and personal use projects. Stockio offers thousands of high-quality photos, vectors, icons, fonts, and video clips all available at no cost with no attribution required.

providers.name: Superb
providers.description: Superb is a Denmark-based all-in-one Guest Experience Management (GXM) platform for restaurants, cafes and bars, bringing reservations, point of sale, payments, gift cards, online takeaway, guest CRM and marketing together in a single system. Superb does not publish a self-serve, documented public developer API. Guest bookings are taken through a hosted reservation widget, and third-party systems connect through Superb's catalog of pre-built connectors (accounting, payments, staff and stock management, marketing) plus a partner portal at partner.superbexperience.com. Any programmatic reservation, guest, booking or CRM access is partner-gated and arranged directly with Superb. The APIs listed below are logical capability groupings modeled from Superb's public product and help-center material - they are marked endpointsModeled because Superb does not publish endpoint-level REST documentation.

providers.name: Tera-ai
providers.description: Tera AI is a San Francisco-based robotics AI company (founded 2023, out of stealth March 2025 with $7.8M seed co-led by Felicis and Inovia) that builds the first unified, software-only spatial reasoning stack for camera-based mapping and navigation across air, onroad, offroad, and sea platforms. Its foundation-model approach delivers GPS-denied, manufacturer-interoperable autonomy that runs on a robot's existing camera and onboard GPU. Tera publishes research (TARDIS/STRIDE) and technical field results but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal; this profile captures its public web, research, and GitHub surface.

providers.name: Touchten
providers.description: Touchten (Touchten Pte. Ltd.) is an award-winning mobile game studio headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia, and an early 500 Global (500 Startups) portfolio company. Its casual games - including Piper's Pet Cafe, Royal Garden Tales, Dessert Chain, Warung Chain Go Food Express, and the Teka-Teki Saku (TTS) crossword series - are published on the App Store and Google Play, are played by millions worldwide, and cater especially to the underserved women gamers market in the US and Europe. Touchten won the Google Play Indonesia Games Contest and received the Forbes Indonesia Rising Global Stars Award. The company publishes no developer portal or public API surface.

providers.name: United States Capitol Police
providers.description: The United States Capitol Police (USCP) is a federal law enforcement agency responsible for protecting the U.S. Capitol Building, members of Congress, and visitors to the Capitol complex. The agency is tasked with maintaining security and order within the Capitol grounds, conducting background checks on individuals entering the buildings, and responding to emergencies and threats. Capitol Police officers also provide security for large events and demonstrations taking place on Capitol Hill. As a legislative branch entity, the USCP operates under unique legal frameworks. In 2024, the agency adopted a FOIA-like request process making certain records publicly available upon request.

providers.name: Windfall Bio
providers.description: Windfall Bio transforms methane emissions into organic fertilizer and carbon credits using proprietary non-GMO methane-eating microbes (methanotrophs). The company operates across agriculture, coal mining, oil & gas, and waste management, capturing methane at the source and converting it into a soil amendment while generating verifiable carbon credits. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As of the latest enrichment pass the company publishes no developer API, SDK, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: Zeromatter
providers.description: Zeromatter is a deep-tech simulation platform that lets teams build, test, and train autonomous systems in one environment. It provides high-performance sensor simulation, automatic environment generation, and multi-agent co-simulation frameworks used to accelerate development across autonomy, aerospace, automotive, agriculture, drones, and green energy. Backed by Spark Capital, Zeromatter currently exposes a marketing and company site only; no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs were found during enrichment. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a lead pending any future public API surface.

providers.name: Abogen Biosciences
providers.description: Abogen Biosciences (Suzhou Abogen Biosciences, 苏州艾博生物科技有限公司) is an industry-leading clinical-stage biotech company founded in January 2019 and headquartered in Suzhou, China, dedicated to developing transformative medicines through messenger RNA (mRNA) innovation. The company has built full-scale in-house capabilities spanning the entire mRNA drug-development cycle — protein engineering, mRNA sequence design and synthesis, lipid nanoparticle (LNP) delivery, formulation, and commercial-scale manufacturing — underpinned by proprietary mRNA and nano-delivery technology platforms. Its pipeline covers infectious-disease prevention and tumor immunology, including an EUA-authorized product and multiple clinical-stage candidates. Abogen is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. This profile was surfaced through the API Evangelist VC-portfolio enrichment pipeline; the company publishes a corporate website but no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Agripedia
providers.description: Agripedia (アグリぺディア株式会社) is a Tokyo agricultural technology company, founded in June 2019 and headquartered in Nishi-Gotanda, Shinagawa-ku, that connects mid- and large-scale Japanese farms and production areas with food-service and food-manufacturing buyers. It supports growers from GAP certification through to the sale of the certified produce, runs a B2B direct-sales channel for GAP-certified commercial agricultural products, sells crop-protection materials and fertilizer, and operates its own production management system for cultivation history and traceability. It holds JGAP group certification (March 2023) and is a GAP partner of Japan's Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries. Its software reaches farms, buyers and staff as closed, credentialed web applications; the company publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable contract on any host it operates.

providers.name: AheadComputing
providers.description: AheadComputing Inc. is a Portland, Oregon fabless semiconductor startup founded in 2024 by former Intel CPU architects — CEO Debbie Marr, Jonathon Pearce, Mark Dechene and Srikanth Srinivasan — that designs and licenses high-performance 64-bit RISC-V application processor cores. The company markets a clean-slate, massive out-of-order "big core" architecture aimed at eliminating per-core CPU bottlenecks for AI, cloud, client, mobile and edge workloads, and has raised roughly $53M across a $21.5M seed and a $30M Seed2 round co-led by Eclipse, Toyota Ventures and Cambium. Its product is silicon IP licensed to chip designers rather than software, so it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Arcus Biosciences
providers.description: Arcus Biosciences is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing differentiated cancer immunotherapies, headquartered in Hayward, California. Its pipeline pairs multiple novel molecules across intra-tumoral immune pathways, including the HIF-2a inhibitor casdatifan, the CD73 inhibitor quemliclustat, the anti-TIGIT antibody domvanalimab, the anti-PD-1 antibody zimberelimab, and the CD39 inhibitor AB598. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and added to the API Evangelist network as a life-sciences company profile. Arcus publishes an agent-facing surface (llms.txt, an AI content map, and an Organization schema) but no public developer API.

providers.name: Axelspace
providers.description: Axelspace has been leading the space business industry as a pioneer of microsatellite technology since 2008. With the vision of “Space within Your Reach,” Axelspace is determined to demonstrate its continued leadership in the realization of an advanced society, offering satellite imagery, data services, and innovative space solutions to customers worldwide.

providers.name: Azurengine
providers.description: AzurEngine Technologies develops innovative reconfigurable parallel processor (RPP) architecture, delivering high‑performance, power‑efficient chips for AI, edge, and data‑center workloads. The company offers advanced processor solutions, engineering services, and developer support to accelerate parallel computing applications across industries.

providers.name: Bbodek
providers.description: Bbodek provides dish‑washing‑free solutions through a large‑scale dishware rental and cleaning service. As Korea’s leading provider, it offers automated cleaning, delivery, and collection of plates and utensils for businesses and institutions. The company emphasizes hygiene, convenience, and cost‑effectiveness, serving over 2,000 client companies with smart‑factory technology and a focus on clean, convenient, and cost‑effective services.

providers.name: Bejewel
providers.description: Bejewel is a sustainable jewelry brand that creates eco‑friendly jewelry pieces with a focus on preserving the environment. The company sources ethically sourced materials and offers a range of necklaces, bracelets, earrings and rings through its online store.

providers.name: Blendid
providers.description: Blendid operates fully autonomous robotic smoothie kiosks that prepare chef-created blended beverages from real whole fruits, vegetables, seeds, nuts, and juice with no artificial flavors or added sugar. Each kiosk uses AI and robotics to run without on-site staff, taking mobile-app orders with customization and payment, producing up to eight simultaneous drinks and roughly thirty per hour. Blendid deploys its Blendid M2 platform into retail, colleges and universities, health clubs, and hospitals as a low-labor, low-capex, 24/7 automated food-service offering. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Partech in the Food & Agritech sector; the company publishes no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Bnovatetechnologies
providers.description: bNovate Technologies is a Swiss technology company specializing in real-time microbiological water monitoring. It provides automated flow cytometry solutions for continuous, rapid detection of microbial contamination in drinking water, wastewater, pharmaceutical, food & beverage, and industrial water systems, helping customers improve safety, compliance, and operational efficiency.

providers.name: Breathe Life
providers.description: Breathe Life is a Montreal, Quebec based life insurance technology company — an enterprise SaaS core-systems vendor rather than a carrier or a broker — founded in 2018 to sell life insurers a modern new-business origination and distribution platform.
