Its product was the Breathe Life Hybrid Origination (Hybrid Distribution) Platform, sold either end-to-end or as four separately licensable modules: Quoter, Hybrid e-App, Advisor Tools and Data Dashboards, supporting advisor-driven, consumer self-serve, or blended selling of individual life products with simple and complex underwriting paths. Its home market is Canada, and its named clients were Canadian and North American life carriers, fraternals and faith-based insurers including Teachers Life, FaithLife Financial, National Bank Insurance, National Catholic Society of Foresters and La Capitale. The company raised CAD $11.5M in August 2020 from Diagram Ventures, Real Ventures and Investissement Quebec plus angels from AXA, AIG and RGA, was named to the 2020 InsurTech 100, and held PCI DSS, SOC 2 Type II and SOC 3 attestations. SE2, an Eldridge business, announced its acquisition of Breathe Life on 2022-03-28; SE2 subsequently rebranded as Zinnia, and the Breathe Life site carried a "We are now part of Zinnia!" banner before being decommissioned. Its API posture is closed and now historical: as of the 2026-07-25 review Breathe Life never published a developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI or Swagger definition, Postman collection, GraphQL endpoint, webhook catalog or ACORD/AL3 conformance claim on breathelife.com, and the domain no longer serves a site at all — breathelife.com returns an nginx "Site Not Configured" 404 and www.breathelife.com returns a WP Engine "Site is not available" 404. Quote, bind, issue and FNOL existed only as capabilities inside a carrier-licensed, login-gated SaaS product, never as an addressable public API.

providers.name: Caba
providers.description: CABA Design Co. is a direct-to-consumer home-furnishings company building the next generation of furniture brands powered by community and technology. It develops sustainable, high-quality furniture and gives customers choice through customization and modularity, selling directly through its Shopify-hosted storefront at cabadesign.co under the tagline "Your Home. Your Way." Caba was surfaced as a portfolio lead and added to the API Evangelist network as a company stub; it publishes a consumer e-commerce storefront and does not currently expose a first-party developer API, SDK, or developer portal. This profile captures the identity, storefront, and domain/security posture verified during enrichment.

providers.name: Candid Therapeutics
providers.description: Candid Therapeutics is a San Diego, California clinical-stage biotechnology company developing T-cell engager (TCE) antibody therapies for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. Launched publicly in September 2024 with a $370 million Series A financing and assembled by acquiring Vignette Bio and TRC 2004, Candid in-licenses differentiated bispecific TCE assets and advances them through US clinical development. Its approach redirects T-cells to selectively deplete autoreactive B-cells, aiming for deeper and more durable depletion than conventional antibody therapy without the manufacturing burden of cell therapy. Its lead investigational asset, cizutamig, is a BCMA x CD3 bispecific antibody. UCB completed its acquisition of Candid Therapeutics on 17 June 2026 for up to $2.2 billion ($2.0 billion upfront plus up to $200 million in milestones), and the company now operates as part of UCB. Candid Therapeutics publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Car2go
providers.description: Car2go was a car‑sharing service founded by Daimler in 2008, operating in numerous cities across Europe and North America. It allowed users to locate, reserve, and unlock vehicles via a mobile app, charging by the minute. Over its lifespan, Car2go amassed millions of members and a fleet of thousands of Smart, Mercedes‑Benz, BMW, Mini, and other vehicles. In 2019, Car2go merged with DriveNow to form Share Now, and the service was gradually discontinued in North America by 2020, with remaining European operations winding down later.

providers.name: Caremo
providers.description: Caremo is a private in‑home caregiving company owned by Four Vanguards LLC, providing personalized nursing, therapy, and companion services to seniors and post‑operative patients in the San Mateo County area. Founded in 2018, CareMo emphasizes compassionate, family‑like care, offering customized care plans, 24‑hour support, and a range of specialized services such as stroke recovery, Alzheimer’s care, and COVID‑19 rehabilitation. The company’s mission is to make clients feel loved, valued, and well‑cared for through high‑quality, affordable home health solutions.

providers.name: Carthera
providers.description: Carthera® is a clinical‑stage med‑tech company focused on developing innovative ultrasound‑based medical devices to treat severe brain disorders such as glioblastoma, brain metastases, Alzheimer’s disease and spinal‑level amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Founded in 2010 as a spin‑off from AP‑HP, it operates in France and the USA, with a team of scientists, clinicians and industry experts aiming to revolutionize brain disease treatment.

providers.name: Celldom
providers.description: Celldom provides a high‑throughput single‑cell biology platform that captures cellular morphology, phenotypes, activity, and molecular profiles in real‑time. The platform enables drug screening, T‑cell potency assays, and detailed cell‑cell interaction studies, delivering multi‑parameter data from thousands of cells per plate. It serves researchers and biotech companies seeking scalable, automated single‑cell analysis for discovery and development.

providers.name: Check24
providers.description: CHECK24 is Germany's largest online comparison portal (Vergleichsportal), founded in 1999 and headquartered in Munich. It lets more than 20 million customers compare prices and switch providers across over 50 categories, including car, life and health insurance, loans and bank accounts, electricity and gas, DSL and mobile tariffs, travel, rental cars, and online shopping. CHECK24 runs its own comparison calculators and a licensed bank (CHECK24 Bank), and integrates partner providers such as Allianz Direct through API-based connections. Backed by Accel, it is profiled in the API Evangelist network as a consumer company. CHECK24 maintains a verified GitHub organization and a GenDev developer scholarship program but publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: CloudAStructure
providers.description: Cloudastructure Inc. is a cloud-based AI video surveillance and remote guarding company that combines cloud infrastructure, computer-vision machine learning, and live human monitoring to detect and deter crime in real time. Its platform offers license plate recognition, facial recognition, motion-zone detection, and cloud storage with instant playback across multifamily, commercial, construction, storage, logistics, and campus properties. As of this profile the company operates a marketing and product website with no public developer API, documentation portal, or OpenAPI surface; the company has stated an intent to offer an open API platform for integrations in the future. This API Evangelist profile is a portfolio-lead stub enriched with domain-security probe data and verified public link properties.

providers.name: Cloudmileltd
providers.description: CloudMile (Cloudmile Ltd.) is a leading AI solutions provider based in Asia, offering services such as MileAI, MileData, MileInfra, MileOps, MileSec, and LumiTure.ai FinOps platform. The company focuses on enterprise AI, cloud infrastructure, and technical training, serving clients across multiple regions with a strong emphasis on innovation and partnership.

providers.name: Convoke
providers.description: Convoke is building an AI-native operating system for the biopharmaceutical industry. Founded in 2024 and based in South San Francisco, the platform unifies fragmented internal knowledge, workflows, and external data into a continuously updating workspace, codifies the decision logic behind high-stakes choices, and generates critical deliverables such as competitive intelligence briefs, portfolio strategy analyses, market research, and scientific manuscripts across the drug development lifecycle. Convoke serves biopharma teams working in business development, competitive intelligence, portfolio strategy, market research, and medical affairs. The company raised an $8.6M seed round co-led by Kleiner Perkins and Dimension. As of this profile, Convoke publishes a public marketing and company site but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Council on Environmental Quality
providers.description: The Council on Environmental Quality (CEQ) is an office within the Executive Office of the President of the United States that coordinates federal environmental policy, advises the President on environmental and natural resource policies, and oversees the implementation of the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA). CEQ does not publish a public developer API. Federal NEPA documents and related environmental data are surfaced through partner federal agencies and platforms (NEPAtool, the Federal Permitting Dashboard, regulations.gov, EPA EJScreen, and the Climate and Economic Justice Screening Tool).

providers.name: dopl technologies
providers.description: Dopl Technologies is a Seattle-based data and AI company (founded 2022, Techstars-backed) democratizing access to diagnostic exams and interventional procedures through telerobotic ultrasound. Its Dopl Traverse platform and SonoFlex app let a remote sonographer operate an ultrasound probe over a network from significant distances, extending specialist-level imaging into rural and workforce-constrained regions. Field testing in rural Washington hospitals has reduced patient wait times by over 90 percent. The company cites 50M+ missed ultrasound exams annually and $19.5B in lost revenue from unequal imaging access, and expects FDA clearance in 2027 before expanding into minimally invasive procedures. As of this profile the company publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or API documentation; this record is a network stub maintained for discovery and future enrichment.

providers.name: eBPF
providers.description: eBPF (extended Berkeley Packet Filter) is a technology that allows programs to run in a sandboxed virtual machine within the Linux kernel without changing kernel source code or loading kernel modules. It enables high-performance networking, security monitoring, observability, and tracing capabilities at the operating system level with minimal overhead. eBPF is governed as a standard by the eBPF Foundation under the Linux Foundation.

providers.name: Edra
providers.description: Edra is an AI automation platform that analyzes an organization's existing business data - tickets, logs, messages, and system records - to automatically discover and document how operational processes actually run, then turns that knowledge into workflows that AI agents can execute reliably. The company targets knowledge-intensive functions such as IT service management and technical support, and integrates with common enterprise systems including ServiceNow, JIRA, Zendesk, Salesforce, and Outlook. Edra was surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Edra publishes a corporate marketing site but no public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Endless Studios
providers.description: Endless Studios LLC is a game development learning platform where aspiring creators learn to build video games through real, pro-studio projects. Its Endstar game engine lets creators code and collaborate in real time, while structured programs (Launchpad for beginners, Capstone for advanced participants) pair learners with 30+ game-industry mentors, expert playtesting, and collaborator matching across design, art, and programming. Learners build portfolios of shipped games to show potential employers. The company runs university, government, and partner programs (including a UAE national game-making competition) and is a 500 Global portfolio company. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; no public developer/API surface was found during enrichment (consumer/creator-facing product on the studio.endlessstudios.com app).

providers.name: Entalpic
providers.description: Entalpic is an AI-driven materials science company that designs molecules and materials for industrial processes by combining machine learning, atomistic simulations, and experimental feedback loops to engineer surfaces and materials at the atomic scale. Its work spans a Discovery Engine for high-throughput screening of chemical spaces, process modeling with ML-plus-CFD digital twins, and quantum/atomistic simulation for surface chemistry, applied to semiconductors and thin-film coatings, battery cathode and interface chemistry, catalysis and active-site design, and advanced specialty materials. Founded in 2024 with research roots at the Mila AI lab, the company is based at Station F in Paris and Mila in Montreal and raised an 8.5M euro seed round. Entalpic does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile tracks its public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: ESPN
providers.description: ESPN, the worldwide leader in sports broadcasting, provides comprehensive coverage of live events, news, scores, and analysis across a multitude of sports. Through its digital platforms, ESPN delivers real-time updates, video highlights, and in-depth articles to fans globally. The company also offers a suite of APIs that enable developers to integrate sports data, media content, and interactive features into applications, enhancing user engagement with timely and accurate sports information.

providers.name: FabFitFun
providers.description: FabFitFun is a members-only lifestyle subscription company that delivers curated seasonal boxes of full-size beauty, fashion, wellness, and home products from premium brands, plus a members' community, customization, and weekly flash-sale shopping. Founded in Los Angeles and backed by 500 Global, Bond Capital, and Kleiner Perkins, FabFitFun serves over one million members with seasonal boxes valued up to $350 for as low as $65 per season. The company operates a direct-to-consumer commerce website, a members' account and box-customization experience, a support/help center, and the FabFitFun Magazine content property. As of this profile FabFitFun publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or API reference; this entry captures its public web and legal surface plus a probed domain-security posture, and remains a portfolio-sourced lead for further enrichment.

providers.name: Fidu
providers.description: Fidu is an operating system and financial-services platform for private K-12 schools across Spanish-speaking Latin America. Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Buenos Aires, Argentina, Fidu digitizes the academic, administrative, financial, and communication processes of educational institutions in a single platform. School administrators send tuition statements and pay slips to families, who then pay tuition directly through the Fidu mobile app, and a "Parent Copilot" AI layer handles 24/7 automated responses, content generation, and academic-data synchronization with school information systems. Fidu raised a $5M seed round led by NFX and Lightspeed Venture Partners and reports more than 1,000 institutions across 10 countries and over 500,000 active users. Fidu does not currently publish a public developer program, API reference, or OpenAPI definition; this profile captures the company's real public web properties only.

providers.name: Fintech Farm
providers.description: Fintech Farm is a London-based fintech company that builds and operates credit-led digital banks (neobanks) in emerging markets in partnership with licensed local banks. Founded in 2020 by Dmytro Dubilet (co-founder of Monobank), Nick Bezkrovnyy and Oleksandr Vityaz, the company supplies an end-to-end stack — mobile banking apps, an AI-driven credit engine and credit-risk models, customer acquisition and retention programs, and customer service operations — and is compensated on the performance of the resulting bank. Its launches include Leobank in Azerbaijan, Liobank in Vietnam, Simbank with DosCredoBank in Kyrgyzstan, Roarbank with Unity Bank in India, Tez with Hamkorbank in Uzbekistan, and Credit+ in Morocco. Fintech Farm is a business-to-business bank-partnership provider and publishes no public developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract; its integration surface is delivered privately to partner banks.

providers.name: Flix
providers.description: Flix SE is a Munich-based global travel-tech company founded in 2013 that operates an asset-light, platform-based long-distance mobility network across more than 40 countries and 8,000+ destinations. Under the Flix umbrella it runs four consumer brands — FlixBus (green intercity coaches across Europe, North and South America, and Asia), FlixTrain (long-distance rail in Germany and Sweden), Greyhound (North America), and Kâmil Koç (Turkey) — having carried more than 500 million travelers. Flix pairs a technology and data-analytics platform with partner bus operators who run the physical fleet, selling and servicing trips through its consumer apps and website. Flix does not currently publish a public developer API or partner developer portal; its public technical surface is limited to a coordinated vulnerability-disclosure program (security.txt) and the flix-tech open-source GitHub organization. This profile was surfaced as an HV Capital portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Flowcarbon
providers.description: Flowcarbon is a climate-finance company that provides project finance and bespoke capital solutions for companies working in infrastructure, decarbonization, and frontier climate industries. Its end-to-end services span project origination, screening and due diligence, deal structuring, and tax-credit solutions, with a focus on engineered carbon-removal technologies such as biochar and enhanced rock weathering. Founded with a web3 heritage in tokenized voluntary carbon credits and backed by a16z and General Catalyst, Flowcarbon today operates primarily as a climate project-finance firm rather than a developer platform, and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation.

providers.name: Haladir
providers.description: Haladir is a Y Combinator-backed startup building a decisional AI platform for logistics operations. Describing itself as "the decisional AI layer for logistics," Haladir unifies fragmented operational data from existing warehouse management (WMS), transportation management (TMS), and order management (OMS) systems into a single operational graph, then applies constraint-optimization solvers and machine-learning models to automate supply chain decisions across routing, picking, labor allocation, and inventory. Its approach treats large language models as formalization tools that translate messy operational rules into precise constraints for traditional solvers, rather than as decision-makers. Target customers include third-party logistics providers (3PLs), contract logistics providers, distributors, and shippers managing global supply chains. The company has raised $4.3M in seed funding led by BoxGroup and Susa Ventures. This profile currently exposes no public API or developer documentation; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Hill-Rom Holdings
providers.description: Hill-Rom Holdings was a global medical technology company best known for its hospital beds, patient support systems, Welch Allyn vital signs monitors, and Bardy Diagnostics cardiac monitoring devices. Hill-Rom was acquired by Baxter International (NYSE: BAX) in December 2021 for $12.4 billion and now operates as Baxter's Hillrom and Front Line Care segment, continuing to deliver connected care, smart beds, vital signs monitoring, and clinical workflow solutions to hospitals and health systems worldwide.

providers.name: Houlihan Lokey
providers.description: Houlihan Lokey is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Houlihan Lokey API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Incite Interactive
providers.description: Incite Interactive is an AI-native gaming studio founded in 2023 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz's Speedrun program, building AI-powered emergent narrative games where the stories players tell matter more than the ones they are told. Its "Everything Story Engine" is an agentic game engine that lets anyone create AI characters and living-world scenarios, powering products such as Embark and Incite Worlds — a roleplaying sandbox of human and AI-driven characters. The founding team are veterans of Zynga, Roblox, and Manticore Games with deep expertise in language models, user-generated content, and live-game operations. There is no public developer API or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures the company's public identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: INDOS
providers.description: INDOS (Garment IO) is an AI-powered manufacturing operations platform built for labor-intensive garment and apparel production facilities. Its cloud-based system unifies Manufacturing Execution (MES), Quality Management (QMS), Maintenance Management (MMS), and Warehouse Management (WMS) into a single real-time view of the factory floor. A shop-floor hardware device captures operator and production-line data, and the platform surfaces operator efficiency, AI anomaly detection, performance scorecards, and end-to-end control from cutting through packing. Founded by Ahmed Nounou and Mahmoud Sabae and backed by 500 Global, it serves garment manufacturers across the Middle East, North Africa, and South Asia. INDOS does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its identity, web properties, and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Ireland Open Data Catalogue
providers.description: Ireland Open Data Catalogue is a national government open-data portal for Ireland running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 1,467 datasets.

providers.name: Jet2
providers.description: Jet2 plc (London Stock Exchange: JET2, formerly Dart Group plc) is a British leisure travel group headquartered at Low Fare Finder House, Leeds Bradford Airport, Yeadon, Leeds, West Yorkshire — an address confirmed verbatim in the Extended Validation TLS certificate served by www.jet2.com, issued to "JET2.COM LIMITED", company serial number 02739537, jurisdiction GB. Its home market is the United Kingdom. The group combines two businesses that are unusual in this sector for being deliberately fused: Jet2.com (IATA code LS, ICAO code EXS), the UK's third-largest airline, and Jet2holidays, the UK's largest ATOL holder and leading provider of ATOL-protected package holidays to the Mediterranean, the Canary Islands and European city destinations. For the year ended 31 March 2026 the group reported revenue of £7,482.1 million, operating profit of £439.6 million and a record 20.83 million passengers, flying from 14 UK airport bases including newly added London Luton and London Gatwick, with more than 63% of flown passengers buying an end-to-end package holiday and 155 Airbus A321neo aircraft on order. Jet2holidays sells through its own website and through more than 2,500 independent UK travel agent partners, and carries ABTA number Y1256. Where Jet2 sits in the distribution chain is the point of this record. Like easyJet and Ryanair, Jet2.com was built with no Global Distribution System dependency at all: it never filed fares into the GDS rail that Amadeus, Sabre and Travelport have intermediated for forty years, and it therefore never needed IATA's New Distribution Capability as a remedy. Travelport supports Jet2 in Smartpoint only as a "Direct Payment Carrier" — its low-cost-carrier workaround — point-to-point only, no connecting flights, and with no post-booking change or cancellation possible through the GDS at all ("Requests for changes must be made directly through Jet2"). In June 2025 Jet2.com signed a distribution agreement with airline technology company Kyte, whose Kyte Direct Connect (KDC) JSON/REST API "standardises airline NDC and LCC proprietary content", opening Jet2 seats and ancillaries to travel management companies and corporate booking tools for the first time, with the same content reaching agency desktops through AirGateway. Separately, Jet2holidays operates an agency API that lets independent agents sell Jet2 packages on their own bookable websites for commission. Its API posture, stated honestly, is that Jet2 runs real production distribution APIs and publishes nothing about them. There is no developer portal — developer.jet2.com, developers.jet2.com, docs.jet2.com, apis.jet2.com, ndc.jet2.com, partner.jet2.com and trade.jet2.com all fail to resolve — no API reference, no OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI or GraphQL contract, no security.txt, no .well-known catalogue and no official GitHub organisation. api.jet2.com resolves and answers HTTP 200 with nothing but the stock Microsoft IIS 10.0 default page, 404 on every spec path probed. Access is by commercial agreement only, negotiated bilaterally or through Kyte, whose own FAQ states that "Access to airline products is controlled by each airline." This record is an honest stub: apis[] is intentionally empty because no Jet2 API is publicly documented, and listing an undocumented hostname as an API would be fabrication. The evidence, including every URL probed with its HTTP status, is in review.yml. A second enrichment pass on 28 July 2026 found the one genuinely public first-party developer surface Jet2 has, and it is not an API: the Jet2 Design System, published as two npm packages under the @jet2 scope (design tokens for seven brand themes, and a React component library containing a single Button), sourced from Jet2's private Azure DevOps organisation at jet2tfs.visualstudio.com/Jet2Digital and documented at design.jet2.com behind a Supernova login. Both packages were last published in April 2024. The same pass confirmed no /.well-known/ document on any host that answers, no security.txt, no vulnerability disclosure programme, no trust centre, no public Postman collection and no SDK in any package registry. Jet2's engineering voice, such as it is, comes from Jet2 Travel Technologies (J2TT), its in-house development centre in Pune, India, which runs a public blog with an RSS feed.

providers.name: Knowify
providers.description: Knowify is a New York-based construction management SaaS for trade contractors (electrical, plumbing, HVAC, painting, remodeling, concrete, excavation), covering the full job lifecycle from bidding through payment on a single platform. The product spans project execution (estimating, proposals and contracts, change orders, RFIs and submittals, scheduling, daily logs, document and photo management), service work (dispatch, invoicing, payments, field operations, asset and inventory management), and financial management (AIA billing, job costing, prevailing wage, purchase orders, expenses, WIP and reporting). Knowify is positioned as the official construction software partner of QuickBooks Online and offers deep two-way sync with QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, Intuit Enterprise Suite, QuickBooks Payroll, QuickBooks Payments, and QuickBooks Time, alongside native integrations with CompanyCam, Billd, Lumber, eBacon, and AIA Contract Documents. Third-party automation is available via Zapier. Pricing starts at $99/month (Core), $249/month (Advanced), and custom Enterprise, with paid add-ons for Service Pro, Live Equipment Tracking (FleetSharp), AI Dashcams, and Tool Tracking. Knowify does not publish a public REST API, webhooks specification, SDK, CLI, or developer portal; programmatic access for third parties is limited to Zapier and the QuickBooks ecosystem.

providers.name: Kony
providers.description: Kony was a U.S. digital banking and low-code application platform company, best known for the Kony Quantum multiexperience development platform and the Kony DBX digital banking suite. Temenos acquired Kony and folded the digital banking business into Temenos Infinity and the Quantum platform into Temenos Quantum; non-banking Kony Quantum customers were transitioned to HCL Volt MX, managed by HCL Software. Kony no longer operates an independent developer program or public API. The kony.com apex and www hosts now redirect to the Temenos "Kony is now Temenos" announcement, docs.kony.com resolves to the Temenos Base Camp Quantum documentation, and only the authenticated Quantum Fabric Console at manage.kony.com is still served on the Kony domain. This profile is retained as an acquisition record pointing at its successors rather than as a live API provider.

providers.name: Kozadat Hungary Open Data
providers.description: Kozadat Hungary Open Data is a national government open-data portal for Hungary running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 2,283 datasets.

providers.name: Kuda
providers.description: Kuda is a Nigerian digital-first retail bank — branded "the money app for Africans" and "the bank of the free" — founded in 2019 by Babs Ogundeyi and Musty Mustapha and headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria with operations in the United Kingdom. Kuda's Nigerian entity, Kuda Microfinance Bank, holds a national microfinance bank license from the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN), and Kuda EMI Limited operates as an FCA-authorised electronic money institution in the UK. Kuda offers retail banking accounts with zero or low fees, debit cards, instant transfers, bill payments, savings ("Spend+Save"), investments, overdrafts, and personal loans through its iOS, Android, and web apps, plus a Business banking suite covering expense accounts and cards, payroll, invoicing, softPOS and physical POS terminals, business loans, and CAC business registration. Kuda also exposes an Open API ("Kuda Open API") aimed at fintechs, marketplaces, and businesses that want to embed Nigerian banking primitives — virtual accounts, name enquiry, intra- and inter-bank transfers, balance inquiry, transaction history, bill payments, and disbursements — directly into their own products, with sandbox and live environments, RSA-encrypted request payloads, and client libraries for Node.js, PHP, C#, Rust, and Kotlin hosted under the kudabank GitHub organization.

providers.description: Montenegro Open Data (data.gov.me) is a national government open-data portal for Montenegro running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 894 datasets.

providers.name: Motional
providers.description: Motional is a Boston-headquartered autonomous-vehicle company formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv. Its core product is an all-electric IONIQ 5 robotaxi built on a Hyundai E-GMP platform with Motional's full Level 4 autonomous driving stack and a sensor suite including lidar, radar, and cameras. Motional operates commercial robotaxi service in Las Vegas in partnership with Uber, Uber Eats, and Lyft, with additional operations in Boston, Pittsburgh, Santa Monica, Singapore, and Seoul. The company's most influential developer artifact is nuScenes, the open large-scale multimodal autonomous-driving dataset originally released by nuTonomy (a Motional predecessor), now a de facto benchmark for 3D perception research. Motional also publishes the nuscenes-devkit Python library and AVCDL cybersecurity development lifecycle materials on GitHub. Motional does not publish a traditional public developer API; the developer surface is research-dataset access plus open-source devkits.

providers.name: Myu
providers.description: Myu (MyU Interactive Learning) is an education-technology company offering an integrated learning management system (LMS) and school management platform that unifies class delivery, a student information system (SIS), grading and academic reporting, attendance and compliance tracking, and parent/teacher communication in a single interface. It serves early-childhood centers, K-12 schools, higher-education institutions, training institutes, and individual teachers across 1,000+ institutions worldwide, with a notable presence in the GCC region. Myu is delivered as web and mobile (iOS/Android) applications and, as of this profiling, exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Neolaiacampus Open Data
providers.description: Neolaiacampus Open Data is a organization open-data portal running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 70 datasets.

providers.name: Noetik
providers.description: Noetik is an AI-native biotechnology company headquartered in South San Francisco, California, focused on discovering and developing cancer therapies with machine learning. The company has assembled one of the largest multimodal tumor datasets and trained foundation models (including its OCTO world model for cancer biology) to represent tumor microenvironments and simulate spatial biology with virtual cells. Its platform spans human data generation, foundation models, and therapeutic applications aimed at enriching clinical trials, repositioning drugs to the right patient populations, and discovering novel oncology targets. Noetik is backed by DCVC. As of this profile the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or API documentation; this record captures its public web and organizational surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Numerion Labs
providers.description: Numerion Labs is an AI-driven drug discovery company building an "AI superplatform" that explores chemical space to uncover novel, drug-like molecules using machine learning. The company pairs computational drug-hunting with its own development programs, applying generative and predictive models to surface previously unseen chemical matter and advance therapeutic candidates. Surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network, Numerion Labs currently publishes a marketing and corporate web presence (platform overview, pipeline programs, team, news/blog, and contact) but does not expose a public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or other machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: NuProbe
providers.description: NuProbe is a genomics and molecular diagnostics company founded in 2016 on technology licensed from the Wyss Institute at Harvard University and Rice University, with headquarters in Shanghai, China and a US subsidiary, NuProbe USA, in Houston, Texas. Its two core chemistries are Blocker Displacement Amplification (BDA), which enriches low-frequency DNA variants ahead of sequencing or PCR, and Quantitative Amplicon Sequencing (QASeq), a UMI-based multiplexed amplicon method for the simultaneous ultrasensitive detection of mutations and copy number variations from FFPE tissue, fresh or frozen tissue and cell-free DNA. The company sells research-use assay panels for oncology and reproductive health, custom assay development, and biopharma services, and has licensed or co-developed its chemistry with Bio-Rad, Oxford Nanopore, QIAGEN, Illumina and Bionano. NuProbe is an assay and reagent company: its bioinformatics and primer-design algorithms are delivered inside its products and services rather than as a public developer platform, and it publishes no API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Ostra Security
providers.description: Ostra Security is a managed security services provider (MSSP) that delivers enterprise-grade cybersecurity as an outcome-focused, fully managed service under the tagline "Your Trusted Cybersecurity Team." Its Pulse platform consolidates managed detection and response (MDR), managed SIEM, endpoint security, penetration testing, and risk and cyber maturity assessments, and integrates with 90-plus third-party security and enterprise tools including CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Microsoft Sentinel/Defender, Palo Alto Networks, Tenable, Okta, and the major cloud platforms. Ostra serves finance, education, healthcare, legal, manufacturing, retail, and trades customers, emphasizing measurable risk reduction, board-ready reporting, and partnership over raw alerting. It is backed by General Catalyst. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or API reference; this entry captures its identity and public web surface.

providers.name: Peoplise
providers.description: Peoplise (now Logo Peoplise) is a Turkish human-resources technology SaaS that digitalizes recruitment and hiring workflows for enterprises. The platform covers the full talent-acquisition funnel: candidate sourcing and application tracking, automated pre-screening and assessments, one-way and live video interviews, reference checking, and digital onboarding. Originally a 500 Global (500 Startups) portfolio company, Peoplise was acquired by Logo (Logo Yazilim), one of Turkey's largest enterprise-software vendors, and is marketed as "Logo Peoplise" at logo.com.tr. Public probing found a marketing/product site only; no developer portal, OpenAPI/Swagger specification, /.well-known/ discovery surface, or documented public API was found at this time.

providers.name: Photocert
providers.description: Photocert is a London-based visual AI company (a Techstars portfolio company) that authenticates photos and videos at the point of capture to prevent fraud, waste, and abuse across insurance and enterprise visual-inspection workflows. Its platform detects AI-generated images and deepfakes at scale, certifies media with claimed 99.99% accuracy, and automates motor, content, and property (water-leak) insurance claims. Photocert markets REST APIs and SDKs plus a white-label claim/onboarding platform and a camera API component for image certification, though no public developer documentation, OpenAPI, or self-service portal is published — integration is arranged via sales/demo. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from the Techstars portfolio and enriched with the honest public surface.

providers.name: Piper Sandler Companies
providers.description: Piper Sandler Companies is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Piper Sandler Companies API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Propmatic
providers.description: PropMatic (PropMatic Inc.) is an AI-powered residential leasing platform that helps property managers and multifamily operators lower cost-per-lease across both traditional and AI-driven discovery channels. Its three products are AI Smart Sites (dynamic, search-optimized landing pages), an AI Concierge chatbot that engages, nurtures, and converts prospects into residents, and an AI-to-AI hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) service that structures a client's listings, data, and APIs so AI assistants such as ChatGPT can find, recommend, and act on inventory and even schedule tours. The platform integrates with existing property-management, CMS, and CRM tools. PropMatic is a proptech portfolio company backed by Fifth Wall.

providers.name: Rabobank
providers.description: Rabobank is a Dutch multinational banking and financial services company organized as a cooperative with a strong focus on the food and agriculture sector. It serves retail, business, corporate, and wholesale customers in the Netherlands and operates a global Food & Agribusiness practice through Rabobank Wholesale & Rural and the Rabobank Group internationally. Rabobank publishes a developer portal at docs.developer.rabobank.com (legacy URL developer.rabobank.nl redirects there) exposing PSD2-mandated open banking APIs (Account Information, Payment Initiation, Funds Confirmation) as well as Premium / Beyond-PSD2 commercial APIs for corporate cash management and notifications, with sandbox endpoints for development and a regulated production tier under PSD2 Strong Customer Authentication. Underlying schemes are aligned with the Berlin Group NextGenPSD2 XS2A Framework.

providers.name: Racing Data
providers.description: Racing Data is a developer-focused API providing real-time updates and historical statistics across racing series, including Formula One, IndyCar, and others. It is intended for building custom data sets and analytics experiences on top of motorsports data.

providers.name: Reclip
providers.description: Reclip is a social mobile app that captures moments instantly, allowing users to share photos and videos with friends in real time. It emphasizes quick, spontaneous sharing, reducing time spent on editing and focusing on authentic experiences. The platform offers features like story creation, private messaging, and AI-powered highlights, positioning itself as a unique social networking tool for on‑the‑go users.

providers.name: SALARY HERO
providers.description: Salary Hero is a Singapore-headquartered financial wellness and earned wage access (EWA) platform offered to employees through their employers. Its products include Salary on Demand (accessing earned wages before payday), budgeting and spending-tracking tools, savings accounts (a partnership with Dime offering 3% interest), and financial-literacy education covering debt management and investing. The service is delivered via iOS and Android apps and is provisioned by employers, integrating with existing payroll and HR systems. Salary Hero is a portfolio company of 500 Global. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public developer API, portal, or documentation surface was found.

providers.name: Sensome
providers.description: Sensome is a clinical-stage medical technology company developing tissue-sensing microchip technology and proprietary integration processes that embed real-time bio-impedance sensing into minimally invasive medical devices. Its lead product, the Clotild Smart Guidewire System (manufactured with Asahi Intecc), is the first tissue-sensing neurovascular guidewire, providing physicians real-time blood clot characterization to guide Acute Ischemic Stroke treatment; additional indications include lung cancer biopsy guidance. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech, Sensome is a medical-device hardware company with no public API, SDK, or developer platform at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Simple HealthKit
providers.description: Simple HealthKit is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of initialized-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: healthcare. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: SL Green
providers.description: SL Green Realty Corp. (NYSE: SLG) is "Manhattan's largest office landlord, a fully integrated real estate investment trust, or REIT, that is focused primarily on acquiring, managing and maximizing the value of Manhattan commercial properties." Founded in 1997 by Stephen L. Green (as successor to S.L. Green Properties, established 1980) and headquartered in New York City, SL Green is led by Chairman & CEO Marc Holliday. As of fiscal year-end 2024 the company reported 39 properties totaling approximately 25.3 million square feet, US$886M in revenue, US$10.47B in total assets, and 1,221 employees. The portfolio includes flagship trophy assets One Vanderbilt (1,401 ft, 1.75M sq ft, 62 stories, fully leased; home to Summit One Vanderbilt observation deck) and One Madison Avenue (2026 ULI Award for Excellence in Office Development), plus 420 Lexington Avenue, 1185 Avenue of the Americas, 1350 Avenue of the Americas, 800 Third Avenue, 825 Eighth Avenue, Worldwide Plaza, the Pershing Square Building, and 15 Laight Street in Tribeca. The company is the New York joint-venture partner for Caesars Palace Times Square, the proposed casino/entertainment complex at 1515 Broadway (and adjacent 1185 Avenue of the Americas redevelopment), pending issuance of one of three New York State downstate gaming licenses. Business divisions span leasing, finance, investments, construction, development, hospitality, property management, security & life safety, sustainability, and technology. SL Green publishes no public developer APIs, no OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specs, no SDKs, no developer portal, no public GitHub organization, and no public sandbox. Its tenant-facing technology surface is delivered through third-party platforms — the "My Building" tenant portal, RequestCom for building services, and ADP Workforce for recruitment — none of which expose a programmable interface attributable to SL Green. This profile documents the REIT, its portfolio, leadership, and verified absence of a public API footprint.

providers.name: Spring Global
providers.description: Spring Global is an AI field intelligence platform for the consumer packaged goods (CPG) industry, marketed as an AI operating system for the CPG field workforce. Its Field Intelligence Platform provides real-time AI coaching for field representatives, drivers, and merchandisers, compliance validation and break-adherence monitoring, automated communication with personalized recommendations, image recognition, and custom workflow automation. The platform is built on modern enterprise infrastructure (Node.js, React, AWS) and integrates with existing mobile workforce management, ERP, and retail systems rather than replacing them. Spring Global is backed by Sapphire Ventures. No public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI definition is currently published.

providers.name: Thrive Market
providers.description: Thrive Market is a membership-based online grocery retailer headquartered in Marina del Rey, California, selling organic and natural food, pantry staples, frozen meat and seafood, beauty and personal care, baby, pet and household products directly to consumers across the United States. Members pay an annual or monthly fee in exchange for below-retail pricing, and the company operates its own Thrive Market private label alongside thousands of third-party brands. It filters its catalog by diet, ingredient, certification and social value, accepts EBT/SNAP for grocery purchases, and funds free memberships for lower-income families through its Thrive Gives program. Thrive Market is a direct-to-consumer commerce company: it ships a website and mobile apps to shoppers, but publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Truveris
providers.description: Truveris is an independent pharmacy benefits consulting and analytics firm, founded in 2009 and headquartered in New York, that helps employers, benefits consultants, and brokers optimize their pharmacy programs and reduce drug spend. The company turns complex pharmacy claims and contract data into clear, actionable insight through products including the Truveris Marketplace for PBM plan procurement, truGuard for ongoing contract and pricing oversight, pharmacy audits, and PBM contract analytics. Truveris serves hundreds of clients with data-driven cost containment strategies. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures its identity and public web properties. Backed by Canaan Partners.

providers.name: Turbine
providers.description: Turbine (Turbine Ltd) is a Budapest-based AI biotechnology company that virtualizes biological experiments to accelerate and de-risk drug discovery. Its Simulated Cell platform trains virtual cells on genomic, transcriptomic, and perturbation-response data, then runs millions of in silico experiments per day to predict therapy response across cell lines, patient-derived organoids and xenografts, and patient samples. Turbine offers partner-facing products for target discovery and de-risking, combination design, and ADC (antibody-drug conjugate) intelligence, and works with pharmaceutical partners including AstraZeneca and MSD. The company publishes research code and benchmarks on GitHub but exposes no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Twig
providers.description: Twig (twig.bio) is a UK biotechnology company using artificial intelligence and machine learning to design sustainable bioengineered ingredients — "AI defined ingredients that don't cost the earth." Its proprietary twig:tech platform pairs bio:drive, an AI/ML design engine that generates and scores novel microbe designs across pathway and enzyme selection, gene edits, and expression levels, with grow:bot, an automated high-throughput lab that builds and tests those designs and feeds every result back into the next design cycle. Twig aims to cultivate clean ingredients from bacteria via fermentation rather than extracting them from the ground or sea or producing them with fossil fuels. Twig is a Seedcamp portfolio company and is backed by additional early-stage investors. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from a VC portfolio lead; Twig currently exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface — its api./app. subdomains resolve to internal infrastructure — so this pass captures company identity and a domain-security probe only.

providers.name: Umbria Region Open Data
providers.description: Umbria Region Open Data is a regional government open-data portal for Italy running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 457 datasets.

providers.name: Ventus Therapeutics
providers.description: Ventus Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in Waltham, Massachusetts, with research operations in Montreal, Canada. Ventus uses its proprietary, machine-learning-enabled computational chemistry and structural biology platform, ReSOLVE, together with deep protein-science expertise, to design differentiated small-molecule therapeutics targeting the innate immune system (including cGAS and NLRP3 inhibitors) for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases, neurological disorders, and cancer. It was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. Enrichment confirmed Ventus operates a corporate/investor website only and publishes no public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: VideoPoint
providers.description: VideoPoint is a Shopify app from TouchPoints Inc. (a 500 Global portfolio company) that turns a merchant's existing product photos and videos into shoppable, on-site experiences on product-detail and collection pages, with the company reporting an 11-35% conversion uplift and 60-120x ROI from existing content. It is part of the broader TouchPoints suite of AI-powered Shopify apps (alongside TryPoint virtual try-on, plus A/B testing and AI-powered chat) built to engage shoppers, boost conversions, and drive more sales. VideoPoint ships as an embedded Shopify app installed from the Shopify App Store; it exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface at this time. Added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile and enrichment lead.

providers.name: Vornado Realty Trust
providers.description: Vornado Realty Trust (NYSE: VNO) is a fully integrated Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) focused on owning and operating premier office and retail properties in New York City. With nearly 20 million square feet of office space and over 2.4 million square feet of Manhattan street retail, Vornado is among the largest commercial real estate companies in the United States. The company also owns residential units, marketplaces, and advertising signage in Times Square and Pennsylvania Station.

providers.name: Wisear
providers.description: Wisear is a Paris-based neurotechnology company building an AI-powered neural interface that lets people control devices through voiceless and touchless commands. Its technology reads biosignals captured by everyday wearables such as wireless earphones, AR/VR headsets and smartglasses, turning subtle facial and neural gestures into hands-free device controls. Wisear targets use cases across consumer audio, industrial augmented reality, walkie-talkie and emergency communications, gaming headsets, the metaverse and accessibility. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; as of this enrichment pass Wisear publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal — this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: AcadArena
providers.description: AcadArena is a Philippine campus gaming and esports company founded in 2019 by Ariane Lim, Kevin Hoang and Justin Banusin, and trades today as a brand owned by AcadArena Digital Education Solutions OPC. It builds student communities around games across high-school and college campuses in the Philippines and Southeast Asia, running the AcadArena Alliance student-club accreditation network, an Incubator that helps students stand up a club on a campus that has none, the Buffs marketplace that supplies loot and sponsorship for campus events, an Alliance for Teachers practice community for moderators and educators, and collegiate competitions. The company has served hundreds of schools, has been the Philippine collegiate licensee for Riot Games titles, and raised a $3.5M seed round. Its public surface is a Next.js marketing site backed by a key-gated Supabase project; AcadArena publishes no developer portal, API reference, SDK or machine-readable contract, and the api.acadarena.com hostname it once used now resolves only to a dangling CNAME.

providers.name: Aeon Industrial
providers.description: Aeon Industrial is an American defense technology company, founded in 2023 and headquartered in the Austin, Texas area, that designs and manufactures affordable precision tactical weapon systems. Its two named products are ODIN, an autonomous precision targeting software package that observes, detects, interrogates and neutralizes threats and is advertised as an open architecture installable on third-party hardware, and Zeus, a modular software-defined tactical missile system powered by ODIN. The company is vertically integrated, building in-house from commercially available American-made components, and sells to U.S. and allied defense customers. Aeon publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable specification; its only public machine-readable documents are the OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 discovery files served by its own WorkOS AuthKit identity host for its login-gated partner portal.

providers.name: Apex.AI
providers.description: Apex.AI is an embedded and autonomous software company whose tagline is "software that moves," focused on safe, real-time, software-defined systems (SDx) for automotive, robotics, and other safety-critical embedded platforms. Its product line includes Apex.Grace (deterministic embedded execution framework, an automotive-grade evolution of ROS 2), Apex.Ida (high-speed fault-tolerant middleware for sensor, compute, and cloud connectivity), Apex.OS for V&V (data recording and replay for validating autonomous systems), and Apex.Alan (automated tooling and CI/CD workflows for safe software development at scale). Apex.AI also provides technical assessment, architecture, embedded and cloud software development, CI/CD pipeline, and ROS 1 to ROS 2 migration services. The company is a maintainer of substantial ROS 2 and embedded middleware open source. It is backed by Canaan Partners and Lightspeed Venture Partners. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Apex.AI publishes no public developer REST API at this time.

providers.name: Apptronik
providers.description: Apptronik is an Austin, Texas-based humanoid robotics company founded in 2016 as a spinout from the Human Centered Robotics Lab at the University of Texas at Austin. Co-founded by Jeff Cardenas (CEO), Dr. Nick Paine (CTO), and Dr. Luis Sentis (scientific advisor), the company designs and manufactures Apollo, a general-purpose humanoid robot standing 5'8", weighing 160 lbs, capable of lifting 55 lbs, and running for roughly 4 hours on a swappable battery. Apollo targets warehouse, manufacturing, and logistics applications including trailer unloading, case picking, palletization, machine tending, and workcell delivery. Apptronik has commercial pilot programs and partnerships with Mercedes-Benz (automotive manufacturing logistics), GXO Logistics (multi-phase R&D in U.S. distribution centers), Jabil (supply-chain partner helping scale production and an internal Apollo deployment), and Google DeepMind (Apollo integrates Gemini Robotics vision-language-action models). The company previously built NASA's Valkyrie humanoid and ten-plus other research robots. As of February 2026 Apptronik had raised more than $935M (including a $520M Series A-X extension) at a reported $5B valuation, with investors including B Capital, Google, and Mercedes-Benz. The company sells/leases Apollo to enterprise customers via a direct contact-sales motion and ships a proprietary "point-and-click" control suite for deploying solutions; there is no public developer portal, no published REST/AsyncAPI/gRPC API, no public SDK, no open-source release, and no public GitHub repositories under the `apptronik` org.

providers.name: AQEMIA
providers.description: AQEMIA is a physics‑based AI drug discovery company that leverages generative AI and deep physics to accelerate the creation of new medicines. Based in Paris and London, the firm offers a platform that integrates advanced computational models, high‑throughput simulations, and data‑driven pipelines to discover and optimize therapeutic candidates at scale. Their mission is to reinvent drug discovery by combining cutting‑edge science with AI to reduce time and cost, aiming to bring innovative treatments to patients faster.

providers.name: Arithmer
providers.description: Arithmer Inc. provides AI-driven solutions across multiple industries, including manufacturing, construction, logistics, retail, wind power, bio, and flood risk assessment. Their platform offers AI agents that automate complex tasks, improve operational efficiency, and enable data-driven decision making for enterprises worldwide.

providers.name: Audi Connect / myAudi
providers.description: Audi Connect is the connected-vehicle services platform from Audi AG, the Ingolstadt, Germany-based luxury automaker and member of the Volkswagen Group. Delivered to drivers through the embedded MMI infotainment system and the myAudi companion app for iOS and Android, Audi Connect spans remote vehicle control (lock/unlock, remote start, climate pre-conditioning, EV charge management), safety and security (Emergency Call/eCall, Audi Service Request, stolen-vehicle locator, geofencing, speed alerts), and in-car infotainment (real-time traffic, satellite map imagery, parking and fuel information, weather, news, natural voice recognition, Amazon Alexa, Amazon Music, Wi-Fi hotspot, and an in-vehicle app store with Disney+ and passenger gaming on supported models). Services are packaged as Audi connect CARE (included for ten years on new U.S. Audis), Audi connect NAV (navigation and live traffic), and Audi connect PLUS (premium streaming and Wi-Fi). For EVs and PHEVs, Audi Connect adds charging-station search, remote charge monitoring, and cabin pre-conditioning. Audi does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, OAuth program, or partner SDK for myAudi/Audi Connect; programmatic access today is brokered by third-party connected-car aggregators (Smartcar, High Mobility, Enode, Mojio) under Audi's commercial agreements, and community projects reverse-engineer the mobile-app endpoints. Audi has publicly discussed an internal OpenAPI-driven API management strategy (with Nagarro) but the surface remains private to Audi, VW Group brands, and authorized partners.

providers.name: Auto1
providers.description: AUTO1 Group is Europe's leading digital automotive platform for buying, selling, and financing used cars, headquartered in Berlin, Germany. It operates the B2B wholesale marketplace AUTO1.com (used by 60,000+ professional car dealers across 30+ European countries), the consumer retail brand Autohero, and the consumer purchasing service wirkaufendeinauto.de (with localized variants across Europe). The group combines inspection, logistics, documentation, and digital financing into an end-to-end remarketing and retail platform. AUTO1 Group publishes open-source engineering work through its auto1-oss GitHub organization, but does not expose a public developer API, developer portal, or published API documentation; this profile therefore captures verified company identity and domain-security posture only. Surfaced as a SoftBank Vision Fund portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Ayr Energy
providers.description: Ayr Energy is a power grid equipment manufacturer founded in 2024 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, backed by General Catalyst. The company designs and builds custom-engineered electrical infrastructure - power, distribution, and special-purpose transformers, high-voltage circuit breakers, and medium-voltage switchgear - for renewable energy, data center, utility, industrial, and oil & gas customers. Ayr operates six manufacturing facilities across India (Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Tamil Nadu) and emphasizes accelerated delivery of grid hardware in months rather than years. Ayr Energy does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures company identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Beisen
providers.description: Beisen (北森) is a China-based enterprise software company and the country's largest cloud-native Human Capital Management (HCM) and talent-management SaaS provider, delivered through its iTalent platform. Its integrated suite spans recruiting and applicant tracking, talent assessment and psychometric testing, performance and goals (OKR), core HR and personnel records, compensation, learning and development, and succession planning for large enterprises. Beisen operates an Open Platform (open.italent.cn) that lets partners and customers integrate HR data and workflows into the iTalent ecosystem via web APIs. The company is publicly listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (9669) and was surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a SoftBank Vision Fund portfolio company.

providers.name: Bertis
providers.description: Bertis is a South Korean biotechnology company specializing in AI-driven proteomics solutions for precision medicine. It offers integrated platforms for protein analysis, early cancer detection biomarkers, and collaborative research services, aiming to accelerate drug development and personalized healthcare.

providers.name: CarbonChain
providers.description: CarbonChain is a London- and New York-based carbon accounting platform founded in 2019 that is purpose-built for the highest-emitting, hardest-to- track commodity supply chains — metals and mining, energy, manufacturing, and agriculture. Its AI-assisted platform builds asset- and transaction- level emissions pictures using activity-based emission factors, and packages those calculations into modules for supply-chain emissions, corporate carbon footprints (Scope 1, 2, 3), product carbon footprints, scenario analysis, and regulatory compliance. The flagship CarbonChain Comply release ships a Carbon Reporting Hub aligned with EU CSRD, UK SECR, US SEC, and CDP, along with EU/UK CBAM declaration validation, automated CBAM XML generation, and a Supplier Engagement Module for collecting and validating supplier emissions data. CarbonChain Connect links producers and importers through shared installation-level CBAM infrastructure. The company is a CDP Accredited Provider (2024), is ISO 27001 certified, and is backed by Y Combinator, Union Square Ventures, Voyager VC, and Aera VC, with $10M Series A funding (2023). CarbonChain serves manufacturers, commodity traders, banks, and procurement teams, and offers system-to-system API integration for delivering activity data in and pulling gold-standard emissions calculations out — but it does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or open-source client library. API access is offered as part of customer integration projects rather than as a self-serve developer surface.

providers.name: CarbonSix
providers.description: CarbonSix is a Physical AI company developing deployment‑ready robotic intelligence and automation solutions for manufacturing. It combines Six‑Sigma robot dexterity with AI‑powered imitation learning to create adaptable robot skills for high‑variance factory environments, aiming to transform industrial operations worldwide.

providers.name: Carlisle Companies
providers.description: Carlisle Companies Incorporated (NYSE: CSL) is a global diversified manufacturer of highly engineered building envelope products and solutions, serving commercial and residential construction, insulation, roofing, waterproofing, and specialty markets. Carlisle's primary operating segment is Carlisle Construction Materials (CCM), which includes brands such as Carlisle SynTec Systems, Hunter Panels, Henry Company, MB Technology, and WIP Industrial. Carlisle does not publish a public developer API; distributors and direct contractors transact through the Carlisle Customer Success Portal, and commercial trading partners integrate with Carlisle using standard X12 EDI transactions (850, 855, 856, 810) over AS2/SFTP.

providers.name: Centrly
providers.description: Centrly is a technology company focused on providing advanced data integration and workflow automation solutions for enterprises. Founded with backing from leadout-capital, Centrally builds platforms that enable seamless connectivity between disparate SaaS applications, offering robust APIs, real-time synchronization, and customizable automation tools. The company aims to simplify complex data pipelines, improve operational efficiency, and empower businesses to orchestrate their digital ecosystems with greater agility and control.

providers.name: Cheetah
providers.description: Cheetah (Cheetah Technologies, with its software platform also marketed as Kimelo) is an AI-enabled, app-based restaurant supply and wholesale ordering marketplace launched in 2015 to bridge the digital gap in foodservice. Its eCommerce platform gives small to medium-sized food distributors and restaurants tools for online ordering, process automation, delivery route optimization, supply chain management, and customer retention, with next-day delivery of daily supplies. In June 2024 the company divested its physical distribution business (Pleasanton, CA) to Palo Alto Foods to focus on commercializing its software platform nationwide. The platform provides digital product catalogs, personalized purchasing insights, integrated payment processing, routing management, and automated inventory tracking, and lets distributors integrate directly with their ERP or inventory management and point-of-sale systems to automate order placement. Cheetah does not appear to publish a public developer API or developer portal; integration is offered through direct ERP, inventory, and POS system connections arranged with the company rather than self-service documented endpoints.

providers.name: Circuit Clinical
providers.description: Circuit Clinical is an Integrated Research Organization (IRO) that connects physicians, patients, and industry to accelerate clinical research. It offers a physician‑focused, patient‑centric platform to improve trial enrollment, retention, and completion, aiming to make clinical trials more accessible and inclusive across diverse communities.

providers.name: Cloocus
providers.description: Cloocus is a global cloud management services provider headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. It is a Microsoft Azure Expert MSP offering consulting, migration, managed services, data innovation, AI business solutions, and multi‑cloud operations across Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, and Naver Cloud. Founded in 2019, Cloocus serves enterprises with cloud strategy, implementation, and ongoing optimization.

providers.name: Collegepulse
providers.description: College Pulse is an American market research and data analytics firm that specializes in survey-based insights from college students. Through an online student panel of 800,000+ verified undergraduates across 1,500+ campuses in all 50 states, it has collected 130+ million survey responses and offers custom research, brand trackers, and syndicated reports to brands, media, and nonprofit organizations. Its work is used by outlets and institutions including The New York Times, the Knight Foundation, FiveThirtyEight, Forbes, Dell, GE, and Chegg. College Pulse is a research services company and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its public web surface and domain security posture.

providers.name: Continental
providers.description: Continental AG is a German multinational automotive supplier and tire manufacturer headquartered in Hanover. As a global Tier 1 automotive supplier, Continental designs and manufactures tires, automotive electronics, brake systems, powertrain components, ADAS, and interior solutions for vehicle manufacturers worldwide.

providers.name: Crown Holdings
providers.description: Crown Holdings, Inc. is a global leader in the design, manufacture, and sale of rigid packaging products for consumer goods, including metal beverage cans and ends, food cans, aerosol cans, specialty closures and promotional tins, as well as transit and protective packaging products for industrial markets. The company operates in more than 40 countries and supports customers with design, decoration, reprographics, compound development, pilot facilities, and seaming training services. Crown Holdings does not publish a public developer API program; technical collaboration with customers happens through B2B and EDI channels.

providers.name: Delta Regional Authority
providers.description: The Delta Regional Authority (DRA) is a federal-state partnership established in 2000 to promote and encourage economic development of the lower Mississippi River and Alabama Black Belt regions. DRA does not publish a public REST API; this profile indexes the public website, grants information, and program resources.

providers.name: Elephantech
providers.description: Elephantech Inc. (founded January 2014 in Tokyo as AgIC Inc., renamed Elephantech in September 2017) develops, manufactures and sells precision metal inkjet printing equipment, advanced conductive materials, and flexible printed circuit board products, including its SustainaCircuits multilayer PCB line and NeuralJet printing technology. The company positions itself as decarbonizing electronics manufacturing by replacing subtractive copper etching with additive inkjet deposition. It is a hardware and materials manufacturer with roughly 150 employees, headquartered at 4-3-8 Hatchobori, Chuo-ku, Tokyo; it publishes no developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Eye Security
providers.description: Eye Security is a European cybersecurity company providing managed detection and response (MDR) and managed XDR for mid-market organizations across logistics, manufacturing, healthcare, and professional services. It combines AI-driven threat detection with a 24/7 Security Operations Center (SOC), incident response and threat hunting, security awareness training, EU-native log retention, and integrated cyber insurance. Headquartered in Europe with an EU-focused stance on compliance and data residency, Eye positions itself as enterprise-grade security made for the mid-market. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public developer, security, and product surface.

providers.name: Govport
providers.description: GovPort is a Software-as-a-Service platform built specifically for government contractors (GovCons) to manage subcontractor performance, compliance, and collaboration. It centralizes critical contract records, sends primes and subs automated requirements to keep every party compliant, and lets GovCons securely share and manage deliverables with one another across teams. Positioned as subcontractor management software for the federal contracting ecosystem, GovPort emphasizes high levels of data privacy and security. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of QED Investors and added to the API Evangelist network; the company references APIs in its terms of service but does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification at this time.

providers.name: icy.tools
providers.description: GraphQL based NFT API

providers.name: Involve.AI
providers.description: Involve.AI was an AI-driven customer intelligence platform for customer success and revenue teams. It unified data from CRM, support, product-usage, and billing systems to calculate customer health scores and power an Early Warning System that predicted churn and surfaced renewal and upsell opportunities, with a 9Factor model scoring qualitative and quantitative signals. Founded as a Techstars-backed startup, Involve.AI was renamed into Jeeva.ai rather than shut down — the GitHub organization login is still Involve-AI while its display name is now Jeeva AI, and involve.ai redirects to jeeva.ai. The product surface is retired: app.involve.ai no longer resolves, the involve.ai web origin answers Cloudflare 522 on every path but the root redirect, and api.involve.ai answers 530 with no origin behind it. Only the customer knowledge base at city.involve.ai survives. Involve.AI never published a developer API — it took admin-granted read access into a customer's source systems (Salesforce, Zendesk, Snowflake, Azure SQL, Pendo) through a no-code Data Mapping tool and returned health scores through configured write-backs into the system of action — so this profile documents company identity and a retirement record rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Kiva Systems (Amazon Robotics since 2012)
providers.description: Kiva Systems was a warehouse robotics company founded in 2003 that pioneered the goods-to-person mobile fulfillment model, in which fleets of low-profile drive units lift and carry mobile storage pods to human pick stations instead of moving workers to static shelving. Amazon acquired Kiva Systems in March 2012 for approximately US$775 million and renamed it Amazon Robotics in 2015. Since the acquisition the technology has been developed exclusively for Amazon's own fulfillment and sortation network and is no longer sold to third parties. Amazon Robotics publishes no public API, developer portal or SDKs; amazonrobotics.com now redirects to Amazon's internal identity provider and kivasystems.com no longer resolves. This profile is retained as a historical and acquisition record in the physical-AI and warehouse-robotics space rather than as an integratable API provider. Not to be confused with AWS RoboMaker or AWS IoT RoboRunner, which are AWS product APIs.

providers.name: Lizee
providers.description: Lizee is a Paris-based Retail-as-a-Service platform that helps brands and retailers launch and operate circular commerce programs — rental, resale, and second-hand — end to end. Its stack pairs a rental platform, a resale/e-commerce platform, and a logistics platform (returns, refurbishment, reverse logistics) behind an operations API so a brand can offer rent or buy-back experiences on top of its existing catalog. Lizee runs a production API (api.lizee.io) and publishes a public Atlassian Statuspage, though it does not expose a public developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or SDKs — the API surface is partner and integration facing. Lizee was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Speedinvest.

providers.name: Mercari
providers.description: Mercari is a peer-to-peer marketplace for new and used goods, operating in Japan and the United States. Mercari does not maintain a public developer API; integration is restricted to approved partners (e.g., shipping carriers, payment partners) under direct agreements.

providers.name: One More Game
providers.description: One More Game is a fully remote game development studio founded by veterans behind titles such as Warcraft, Diablo, StarCraft, and Guild Wars. The team builds delightful, social online games designed to be played with friends, emphasizing fast iteration and a mission to help players have more fun. One More Game was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. The studio publishes a consumer gaming website, a company blog, careers listings, and a GitHub organization (PlayOneMoreGame) of game-development tooling and forks, but does not currently operate a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Oomnitza
providers.description: Oomnitza is an enterprise technology management platform providing IT asset lifecycle management, SaaS management, and technology workflow automation.

providers.name: Pet Circle
providers.description: Pet Circle is Australia's largest online pet-supplies retailer, selling pet food, flea and worming treatments, toys, bedding and prescription veterinary products direct to consumers across Australia. Founded in mid-2011 in Sydney by Mike Frizell and James Edwards as Paws for Life and rebranded to Pet Circle in early 2014, the company reached unicorn status with a valuation above AU$1 billion after a $125 million Series C in December 2021, and extended into adjacent lines with Pet Circle Pharmacy (petcirclepharma.com.au) and Pet Circle Insurance (petcircleinsurance.com.au, launched May 2023). Its storefront is a headless commerce stack — a commercetools back end fronted by a Vue Storefront / Alokai layer on Vercel, with Google Cloud Functions gluing SaaS services together — but Pet Circle operates that architecture internally: it publishes no public developer portal, no API reference, and no machine-readable API contract. Trading-partner integration is handled out of band through EDI, and consumer-side partner traffic runs through third-party affiliate networks rather than a first-party API program.

providers.name: Politico
providers.description: Politico illuminates the forces shaping global power. Since 2007, we have delivered intelligence that anticipates tomorrow’s headlines, not reports on yesterday’s news. Our 1,100+ publishing professionals across key democratic capitals provide premier politics and policy newsroom, offering analysis for leaders and decision‑makers.

providers.name: Praan
providers.description: Praan (Praan Climate Technologies) is a deep-tech climate startup working to democratize access to clean, healthy air and to rebuild the atmosphere by capturing air pollution and greenhouse gases with novel filterless technology.
