Its products include HIVE, an air-purification device for homes and commercial spaces paired with a companion mobile application, and MK II, an air-purification system for industrial environments. Praan is backed by Prosus Ventures. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and enriched through the API Evangelist pipeline; as of this pass Praan publishes a consumer hardware and mobile-app surface but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation.

providers.name: PrizePicks
providers.description: PrizePicks is a US daily-fantasy/pick-em sports operator focused on player-prop projections (more/less). PrizePicks does not publish a public developer REST API. Internal/private endpoints power the web and mobile apps but are not documented or licensed for third-party use.

providers.name: Qunnect
providers.description: Qunnect Inc. is a quantum networking hardware company headquartered at the Brooklyn Navy Yard in New York, founded in 2017 by Mehdi Namazi and Mael Flament and led by CEO Noel Goddard. Qunnect builds room-temperature, rack-mountable devices that turn existing telecommunications fiber into scalable quantum networks without cryogenics or vacuum systems: the Qu-Source polarization-entangled photon-pair generator, the Qu-Mem atom-based quantum memory, and the turnkey Carina product suite, which combines entangled photon generation, single-photon counting detection and adaptive polarization compensation in a single rack unit for fiber spans up to 100 km. Carina deployments include New York City, Berlin, Montana State University and the ABQ-Net network in New Mexico. Qunnect is backed by Airbus Ventures, Cisco Investments and Quantonation. The company sells physical quantum networking hardware to research, defense and telecommunications customers and publishes no public API, SDK, or developer program.

providers.name: Raymond James Financial
providers.description: Raymond James Financial is a diversified financial services holding company headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, providing investment banking, wealth management, capital markets, asset management, and banking services to individuals, corporations, and municipalities. With more than 7,100 financial advisors serving approximately 3 million client accounts and total client assets exceeding $637 billion, Raymond James is a Fortune 500 firm and one of the largest independent broker-dealers in the United States. The company offers client-facing portals and mobile apps for account management and reporting but does not publish a general-purpose public developer API or machine-readable specification at this time.

providers.name: ReqBin
providers.description: ReqBin is an online HTTP/REST API client for testing API requests directly from the browser without plugins or software installation. It supports all HTTP methods, custom headers, request bodies, authentication schemes, and code generation for multiple languages. ReqBin is widely used by developers to test REST APIs, debug HTTP requests, and generate code snippets for API integration.

providers.name: Schedex
providers.description: Schedex is a workforce management platform built for food and beverage businesses, consolidating staff scheduling, shift management, attendance tracking, and payroll into a single mobile-first application. It offers mobile clock in/out with location technology, schedule optimization across multiple locations, real-time labor-cost tracking and reporting, automated wage and payroll calculation, leave requests and shift exchange, and a multilingual branded app, with the goal of reducing labor costs by up to 15 percent. Schedex was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Second Dinner
providers.description: Second Dinner is an independent, remote-first video game studio headquartered in Irvine, California, founded in 2018 by a group of former Blizzard Hearthstone developers including Hamilton Chu, Ben Brode, Yong Woo, Jomaro Kindred and Michael Schweitzer. Its debut title, MARVEL SNAP, is a fast-paced digital collectible card game built in Unity that won Mobile Game of the Year at both The Game Awards and the DICE Awards along with an Apple Design Award, and the studio has since been reported to be building its next title on the Godot engine. Second Dinner raised a $100M Series B led by Griffin Gaming Partners in January 2024. The studio ships consumer games rather than developer platforms: it publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or machine-readable specification, and its public engineering footprint is a small GitHub organization of Unity build and test tooling forks.

providers.name: ShelterLogic Group
providers.description: ShelterLogic Group is the world leader in shade, shelter, storage, and outdoor lifestyle products with over 70 years of industry experience. Launched in 1991, ShelterLogic develops tough, affordable shelter solutions for everyday consumers and commercial customers. The company operates three manufacturing facilities in the US and China and maintains worldwide distribution. The ShelterLogic brand portfolio includes ShelterLogic, SOJAG, Arrow Storage Products, Quik Shade, CAMP&GO, RIO Beach, and licensed brands including Tommy Bahama, Margaritaville, Life is Good, and Scotts Miracle-Gro. As a B2C manufacturer and retailer, ShelterLogic does not expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Silgan Holdings
providers.description: Silgan Holdings Inc. is a leading global sustainable packaging provider for consumer goods products. The company partners with customers to deliver essential products to the world in efficient, sustainable, and cost-effective packaging formats. Silgan operates through three primary business segments: Dispensing and Specialty Closures, Metal Containers, and Custom Containers. With 123 manufacturing facilities on four continents, over 17,200 employees, and approximately $6 billion in annual sales, Silgan serves the food, beverage, healthcare, home and garden, personal care, fragrance, and beauty end markets.

providers.name: SL Storstockholms Lokaltrafik
providers.description: SL Storstockholms Lokaltrafik (SL) is the public transport authority for Stockholm County in Sweden, operating buses, metros, commuter trains, trams and ferries. It provides travel planning, ticketing, real‑time departure information and service updates for millions of passengers each year. While its primary focus is on passenger services, SL also offers data feeds and APIs for developers to integrate schedule, stop, and route information into third‑party applications, supporting open data initiatives and smart mobility solutions.

providers.name: TensorFeed
providers.description: Real-time AI news, model pricing, service status, and agent activity feeds

providers.name: The Farmer's Dog
providers.description: The Farmer's Dog is a direct-to-consumer pet health company that delivers fresh, human-grade dog food on a personalized subscription. Customers complete an online profile of their dog (breed, age, weight, activity, health goals) and the company formulates and ships pre-portioned meal plans on a recurring cadence. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in New York City, it is backed by Forerunner Ventures among others and has delivered over one billion meals nationwide. The business runs on a JavaScript/TypeScript stack with an internal "Core API" that powers ordering, subscription management, and its veterinarian program, but the company does not publish a public developer platform, API documentation, or client SDKs. This profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture; there is no public API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Tomba email finder
providers.description: Email Finder for B2B sales and email marketing and email verifier

providers.name: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE)
providers.description: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) is a federal law enforcement agency under the U.S. Department of Homeland Security responsible for enforcing federal immigration and customs laws. ICE does not publish a general-purpose developer API portal, but provides public-facing systems, open data, statistics, and FOIA resources used by researchers, attorneys, journalists, and the public.

providers.name: Verdex
providers.description: Verdex builds AI for the clinical workflow. Its first product rooms patients and takes their history by voice before the physician walks into the room: the agent gathers and organizes the patient's story, hands the physician a three-sentence summary, and lands a structured, signable history back in the electronic health record (EHR) the practice already runs. The agent never diagnoses or advises, escalates anything urgent to staff immediately, keeps every line of the note traceable to its source, and is built to be HIPAA compliant. Verdex is aimed at clinicians, practice owners, and health-system teams. The company is an early-stage Y Combinator startup; verdexai.com is a browser-rendered marketing site that publishes machine-readable llms.txt, robots.txt, and a security.txt but does not (yet) expose a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: WhiteWave Foods
providers.description: The WhiteWave Foods Company was a consumer packaged food and beverage company headquartered in Denver, Colorado. It offered plant-based foods and beverages, coffee creamers, dairy, and organic produce under brands including Silk, So Delicious, Horizon Organic, International Delight, LAND O LAKES, Vega, Wallaby Organic, and Earthbound Farm. WhiteWave was acquired by Danone in April 2017 and is now part of Danone North America.

providers.name: YNAB
providers.description: Budgeting & Planning

providers.name: Yoshi
providers.description: Yoshi Mobility is a mobile vehicle-care and fleet-services platform founded in 2015 (Y Combinator S16). It brings automotive services to the vehicle wherever it is parked: mobile maintenance and oil changes, car washes and detailing, tire and battery service, EV charging, and live-video vehicle inspections that produce API-ready, signed results for fleets and rideshare platforms. Yoshi originally pioneered on-demand fuel delivery (that division was acquired by EZFill Holdings in January 2025) and now concentrates on mobile auto care and inspection technology, backed by strategic investors including General Motors Ventures, Bridgestone, and ExxonMobil. Integrations and APIs are offered to partners through direct sales rather than a public self-service developer portal.

providers.name: ZipRecruiter
providers.description: Job search app and website

providers.name: 10x Science
providers.description: 10x Science is an AI-native software company building the first AI-native protein characterization platform for the life sciences, starting with drug development. A Y Combinator W26 company founded out of Nobel laureate Carolyn Bertozzi's laboratory at Stanford University, it automates peptide mapping for protein therapeutics, delivering explainable molecular insights in minutes where legacy tools and manual workflows take months. The company raised a $4.8M seed round led by Initialized Capital and is headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company; it does not yet publish a public developer API.

providers.name: AAK Tele-Science
providers.description: AAK Tele-Science, Inc. (aakscience.com) is a Davis, California software company founded in 2020 that operates a cloud-based collaborative platform for the global scientific research community. The AAK platform connects researchers, institutions, service providers, venture capitalists and investors around shared research projects, layering machine-learning-assisted discovery, predictive analytics and a data-fragmentation privacy protocol over a subscription SaaS product. The platform is delivered as a React single-page application backed by a Django REST API at django.aakscience.com; that API is real but is not publicly documented — its drf-yasg schema endpoints require HTTP authentication and the production API host answers 401 to every path, so no machine-readable contract is reachable without credentials.

providers.name: AI Medical Service
providers.description: AI Medical Service Inc. (AIM) is a Tokyo-based med-tech company founded in September 2017 with the mission to save lives worldwide by eliminating gastrointestinal cancers through earlier detection. AIM develops endoscopic AI (artificial intelligence) that assists physicians in real-time diagnostic imaging of the digestive tract, drawing on joint research with more than 100 medical institutions. Its flagship gastroAI family of endoscopic image diagnosis support software has secured regulatory approval in Japan, Singapore, and Thailand, and an earlier FDA approval in the United States. The company distributes its AI on-premise today and is building an in-house cloud platform to broaden access; it currently publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a health-tech lead backed by SoftBank Vision Fund.

providers.name: American Endovascular
providers.description: American Endovascular & Amputation Prevention is a vascular medical practice operating outpatient centers across New York City (Brooklyn, Harlem, and Queens) that specializes in minimally invasive, same-day endovascular treatment of peripheral artery disease (PAD) and related circulatory conditions. Services include atherectomy, angioplasty, stent placement, amputation prevention, diagnostic imaging (angiogram, ultrasound, CTA, MRA), neuropathy neurostimulation, dialysis access management, and venous insufficiency care. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes a public website, blog, and privacy policy but exposes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Ampersand Biomedicines
providers.description: Ampersand Biomedicines is a Boston-based biotechnology company founded in 2020 out of Flagship Pioneering that designs programmable biologic medicines intended to act only at the site of disease. Its computationally powered Address, Navigate, Determine (AND) Platform pairs a multi-omics "Address Map" of healthy and diseased human tissue with high-throughput microfluidic binder generation and AI-guided binder prediction to design AND-Body therapeutics, which combine a localizing element with an actuator so activity is conditional on the target tissue. The company raised a $65M Series B in March 2025 from Flagship Pioneering and Eli Lilly, and partners with Pioneering Medicines and Pfizer. It is a preclinical therapeutics developer, not a software vendor: the computational platform is internal tooling for its own drug discovery and is not offered to third parties, and the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Ancsonic
providers.description: Ancsonic (安声科技) is a Beijing‑based technology company specializing in intelligent acoustic solutions for smart earphones, automotive, appliance and industrial applications. It offers R&D, core algorithms, manufacturing services and ODM solutions, serving global customers with advanced sound processing and acoustic design.

providers.name: Antabio
providers.description: Antabio is a biotechnology company focused on developing innovative antimicrobial therapies to combat resistant infections. The firm leverages advanced peptide engineering and proprietary platforms to create novel treatments aimed at addressing the growing global challenge of antimicrobial resistance. Antabio engages in research collaborations, clinical development, and seeks partnerships to bring its pipeline candidates to market, targeting both hospital and community settings.

providers.name: Aon
providers.description: Aon plc is a London-headquartered global professional services firm delivering integrated risk and human capital advisory through two reporting pillars — Risk Capital (broking, reinsurance, risk analytics) and Human Capital (health, wealth, talent, rewards). The firm operates in over 120 countries, lists on the NYSE under the ticker AON, and grew its US middle-market footprint with the April 2024 acquisition of NFP for roughly $13B. Aon publishes named analytics platforms (Risk Analyzer suite, ReMetrica, CyQu, Spectrum, Impact Forecasting catastrophe models, Radford McLagan Compensation Database, SkillsGraph, Gauge, Revenue GPS) but those tools are delivered through gated client portals — no developer portal, OpenAPI catalog, SDK org, or public API reference is published on aon.com.

providers.name: Assurly
providers.description: Assurly provides online loan insurance services, allowing borrowers to obtain mortgage, student, and personal loan protection entirely digitally. Their platform offers quick quotes, customizable coverage, and seamless integration with lenders, aiming to simplify the borrowing process and reduce risk for both borrowers and financial institutions. Assurly operates across France and Europe, emphasizing transparency, speed, and customer support throughout the insurance journey.

providers.name: Asylon
providers.description: Asylon Robotics is an American-made robotic security company founded in 2015 and headquartered in Norristown, Pennsylvania, that automates physical perimeter security with autonomous drones, ground robots, software, and AI. Its flagship products include the Guardian automated security drone (the most widely used automated security drone system, with tens of thousands of patrol and alarm-response missions completed), the DroneDog quadruped ground robot built on Boston Dynamics Spot with the Asylon DogHouse charging enclosure and PupPack cellular PTZ payload, and DroneIQ, the Robotic Security Operations Center (RSOC) and software platform that coordinates robotic assets, fixed surveillance, and human operators. DroneIQ exposes an open-architecture integration layer for third-party alarms and sensors (radar, smart fences, Bosch alarm panels, gun-detection computer vision, Genetec), but the company publishes no public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs; API and integration access is arranged directly with Asylon. Asylon raised a $26M Series B in July 2025 led by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Aven
providers.description: Aven is a consumer fintech that issues a home-equity-backed Visa credit card, letting homeowners tap their home equity (a HELOC) through a card with credit-card convenience at lower, home-equity-secured rates. Its product line spans the Aven HELOC card, a Bitcoin-backed Visa card, and educational tooling such as a payment calculator, positioning itself as an AI-driven "machine bank." Founded in the fintech sector and backed by Electric Capital, Founders Fund, General Catalyst, GGV Capital, and Khosla Ventures, Aven operates a consumer marketing and account-servicing web presence at aven.com. As of this enrichment pass Aven publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, or MCP server; this profile captures its verifiable public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Axiom Trust
providers.description: Axiom Trust Company is a vertically integrated trust company and technology platform serving investment advisors, attorneys, trustees, and private families. Founded in 2025 by David Meister and headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, Axiom pairs a regulated corporate trustee with a proprietary data-driven administration platform, using technology to remove the administrative bottleneck of traditional trust administration so named trust officers can focus on fiduciary judgment and family relationships. The company positions itself as infrastructure rather than a competitor for the client relationship: it acts as independent or directed trustee, handles bill pay, notices, distributions, approvals and principal & income accounting, and takes on complex mandates other institutions avoid — closely held entities, private investments, contested situations, and special needs trusts. Axiom raised $11.8M in pre-seed and seed funding led by Lightspeed Venture Partners, with Wischoff Ventures, Runa Capital, SNR, Primetime Partners, and Mercury founder Immad Akhund participating. As of this profile Axiom Trust publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts; its client-facing application is a private authenticated web app.

providers.name: Beacon Therapeutics
providers.description: Beacon Therapeutics is a clinical-stage ophthalmic gene therapy company founded in 2023 to save and restore the sight of people living with rare and prevalent retinal diseases that lead to blindness. Built around adeno-associated virus (AAV) gene therapy, the company delivers functional copies of mutated genes into retinal cells so the body can produce the missing therapeutic protein. Its lead clinical program, laru-zova (laruparetigene zovaparvovec), targets X-linked retinitis pigmentosa (XLRP), alongside preclinical programs in dry age-related macular degeneration (dAMD) and cone-rod dystrophy (CRD), the latter in-licensed from the University of Oxford. Beacon operates across the United Kingdom and the United States, with a corporate base in London and a US presence in the Cambridge, Massachusetts area. It is a therapeutics developer, not a software or data platform company, and publishes no public API, SDK or developer program.

providers.name: Beazer Homes USA
providers.description: Beazer Homes USA, Inc. (NYSE: BZH) is an Atlanta, Georgia-headquartered national homebuilder founded in 1985 and publicly listed since 1994. The company designs, sells, and builds single-family and multi-family homes across approximately thirteen U.S. states under brand differentiators such as Choice Plans (customizable floorplans), Mortgage Choice (competitive lender program), Style Choice (interior personalization), and Livable Features (accessibility options). Beazer markets itself as "America's #1 Energy-Efficient Homebuilder," citing homes that are 44% more efficient than the average HERS-rated new home and shipping whole-house ERV ventilation in 100% of homes. As of the most recent public data point (FY2016 10-K), Beazer reported revenue of $1.822B, delivered 5,419 homes, operated 161 active communities, and employed approximately 1,100 people. The company has no public developer program or external APIs; its digital surface is a consumer-facing marketing/community-finder website plus an investor relations portal.

providers.name: Beeyond Media
providers.description: Beeyond Media provides a programmatic digital out‑of‑home (DOOH) advertising platform that connects brands and agencies with over 2.1 million billboards and screens worldwide. Their solution enables premium, data‑driven campaigns, real‑time inventory management, and detailed performance analytics for elite advertisers.

providers.name: Benchmarkspacesystems
providers.description: Benchmark Space Systems provides heritage propulsion and mobility solutions, offering high‑test peroxide, ASCENT, and electric propulsion systems for aerospace missions. The company partners with customers across design, testing, integration, and launch phases, delivering reliable propulsion hardware and support for dynamic space missions.

providers.name: Berry Genomics
providers.description: Berry Genomics (Beijing Berry and Kang Biotechnology Co., Ltd., 贝瑞基因) is a Chinese genomics and genetic-testing company operating across reproductive health screening, hereditary disease detection, tumor and cancer diagnostics, laboratory solutions, sequencing equipment and reagents, and genomic big-data services. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. The company publishes a corporate marketing site (news, investor relations, careers, and a legal statement) but does not currently expose a public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts, so this profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Bindbridge
providers.description: Bindbridge is an AI-driven molecular discovery company founded in 2025 and based in Cambridge, UK, developing next-generation crop protection through targeted protein degradation. Its BRIDGE platform uses AI to discover and design molecular glues and targeted protein degraders with novel modes of action against weeds and crop diseases, combining AI candidate generation, computational docking, molecular dynamics simulation, and free-energy binding calculations to accelerate agricultural R&D across herbicides, insecticides, and fungicides. The company raised $3.8M to help reduce billion-dollar crop losses and is backed by Speedinvest. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead company profile; it publishes no public API or developer surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Biolinq
providers.description: Biolinq Incorporated is a San Diego, California medical device and digital health company founded in 2012 that develops intradermal biowearable sensors. Its lead product, Biolinq Shine, is an autonomous needle-free continuous glucose sensor built on an array of electrochemical microsensors that sit just below the surface of the skin, combined with an accelerometer and an ambient light sensor so a single wearable measures glucose alongside activity and sleep. The sensor carries an on-body LED color indicator for time-in-range and pairs with a companion mobile application for trends and insights. The FDA granted Biolinq Shine De Novo classification for adults with type 2 diabetes not on insulin therapy, with a planned US market launch. Biolinq publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract; its public web presence is a corporate marketing site.

providers.name: BioNTech
providers.description: BioNTech is a Mainz-based biotechnology company that pioneered the use of messenger RNA (mRNA) technology in human therapeutics. Best known for co-developing Comirnaty, the COVID-19 mRNA vaccine with Pfizer, BioNTech is building a broad oncology pipeline across mRNA cancer immunotherapies, next-generation immunomodulators such as the bispecific antibody BNT327, and targeted therapies, as well as continuing infectious disease vaccine development. BioNTech does not currently expose a public developer API; this index captures the company's products, pipeline, clinical trials, and corporate resources as an API Evangelist profile.

providers.name: Blackcube
providers.description: Blackcube is a global boutique intelligence firm offering sophisticated human intelligence (HUMINT) and open source (OSINT) services for high‑profile litigations, arbitrations, and white‑collar crime investigations. With offices in London, Tel‑Aviv, Madrid and Singapore, the company leverages former Israeli intelligence officers and legal experts to provide evidence‑gathering, asset recovery, and counter‑intelligence solutions worldwide.

providers.name: Body Vision Medical
providers.description: Body Vision Medical is a medical technology company developing AI‑powered intraoperative imaging solutions. In August 2026 the company announced a new funding round to accelerate global expansion of its platform, aiming to improve surgical outcomes through real‑time visualisation. The firm focuses on integrating advanced computer‑vision algorithms with imaging hardware to provide surgeons with enhanced decision‑making tools during procedures.

providers.name: Boliden
providers.description: Boliden is a Swedish mining and smelting company that extracts and processes metals such as copper, zinc, gold, and silver. The company operates mines and smelters across Europe, focusing on sustainable practices, safety, and community engagement. Boliden’s website provides information on its operations, corporate governance, environmental policies, and career opportunities, reflecting its commitment to responsible metal production for generations.

providers.name: Bonumtherapeutics
providers.description: Bonumtherapeutics, operating as Bonum Tx, develops antibody‑controlled therapeutics that deliver potent activity only where needed, aiming to improve safety and efficacy across oncology, autoimmunity, metabolic disorders, and pain management. The company leverages a novel regulated protein platform validated by Roche’s acquisition of its predecessor Good Therapeutics in 2022, and is advancing preclinical programs targeting immune cells and tumor microenvironments.

providers.name: Brookdale Senior Living
providers.description: Brookdale Senior Living is one of the largest operators of senior living communities in the United States, offering independent living, assisted living, memory care, skilled nursing, continuing care retirement communities (CCRCs), and in-home care through Brookdale at Home. The company operates hundreds of communities across the US, serving tens of thousands of residents and their families.

providers.name: Cailabs
providers.description: Cailabs designs and manufactures advanced optical ground systems for laser communications, providing line‑of‑sight optical terminals, optical ground stations, and related technologies for aerospace and defense applications. Their portfolio includes laser welding, additive manufacturing, and directed‑energy solutions, serving both government and commercial customers worldwide.

providers.name: CANbridge Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: CANbridge Pharmaceuticals (CANbridge Life Sciences Ltd.) is a global, China-based biopharmaceutical company founded in 2012 that focuses on the research, development, and commercialization of transformative therapies for rare diseases and rare oncology. The company in-licenses and develops differentiated drug candidates from around the world for the Chinese and global markets, with a portfolio of approved products and a gene-therapy and enzyme-replacement pipeline. Headquartered in Beijing with offices in Shanghai, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Suzhou, and Burlington, Massachusetts (USA), CANbridge is listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming; CANbridge publishes no public developer API, SDK, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: Carefull
providers.description: Carefull is a financial safety platform that protects the personal finances of older adults and their family caregivers from fraud, scams, and identity theft. It monitors bank accounts, credit cards, and investment accounts across 12,000+ financial institutions (via Plaid, MX, and Finicity) to detect suspicious activity, duplicate billing, and unusual withdrawals in real time. The service bundles $1M identity theft insurance, dark web and credit-file monitoring, home-title monitoring, a ScamCheck message tool, a secure document Vault and LegacyKit, and view-only access for trusted contacts. Carefull is offered direct to consumers (about $29.99/month with a free trial) and B2B to banks, credit unions, wealth advisory firms, and employers. It is SOC 2 certified. The company is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. This API Evangelist profile enriches the company as a network lead; Carefull publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or /.well-known discovery surface (all /.well-known/* paths return the SPA HTML shell).

providers.name: Carrick Therapeutics
providers.description: Carrick Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, developing novel oncology therapies aimed at improving outcomes for patients with aggressive and treatment-resistant cancers. Its pipeline centers on transcriptional CDK inhibition, led by samuraciclib (a CDK7 inhibitor in Phase 2) and CT7439 (a CDK12/13 inhibitor in Phase 1), pursued as combination therapies across advanced hormone-receptor-positive/HER2-negative breast cancer, prostate cancer, ovarian cancer, and additional indications. The company is backed by GV (Google Ventures) and was added to the API Evangelist network as a life-sciences company profile; it publishes no developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: CereVasc
providers.description: CereVasc, Inc. is a clinical-stage medical device company developing novel, minimally invasive treatments for patients with neurological diseases. Its lead product, the eShunt System, uses percutaneous transvenous-transdural access to the central nervous system to treat communicating hydrocephalus — including normal pressure hydrocephalus (NPH) — as a less invasive alternative to conventional neurosurgical shunt placement. The eShunt System is an investigational device limited by United States federal law to investigational use, and is being evaluated in the STRIDE pivotal study (NCT06498960). CereVasc raised a $70M Series B in 2024 and has received FDA Breakthrough Device Designation. The company builds implantable hardware and publishes no public API, developer program, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Cit Vericash
providers.description: CIT Vericash is a fintech enablement platform from CIT Global (founded in Toronto, Canada in 1993) that empowers banks, neo banks, microfinance institutions, and fintechs to launch and operate digital financial services. Its high-configuration, no-code/low-code VERICASH platform delivers digital banking, agency banking, digital payments, and mobile wallet capabilities across an omnichannel surface (mobile, USSD, web, and agent networks), with AI-powered customer intelligence and fraud prevention. The platform is live across roughly 25 markets in Africa and the Middle East, serving banked and unbanked communities to advance financial inclusion in emerging markets. CIT Vericash is a portfolio company of Anthemis and was added to the API Evangelist network from the VC portfolio pipeline.

providers.name: Cityscape Residential
providers.description: Cityscape Residential is a real‑estate development and investment firm focused on luxury multifamily rental communities across the Midwest and Eastern United States. With over 30 years of experience, its principals have financed and built billions of dollars in residential projects, delivering thousands of units. The company emphasizes community, design, and sustainable development, offering residents high‑quality living spaces and investors strong returns.

providers.name: Climate Robotics
providers.description: Climate Robotics Network is a community-driven organization focused on advancing climate‑positive robotics across aerial, marine, and ground platforms. It connects innovators, researchers, and practitioners through projects, summits, internships, and consulting services, fostering inclusive collaboration to accelerate climate‑resilient technology development.

providers.name: CMC Materials
providers.description: CMC Materials is a global supplier of consumable materials primarily to the semiconductor industry, including chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) slurries and polishing pads. Acquired by Entegris in 2022, CMC's materials portfolio is now part of the Entegris specialty chemicals and CMP solutions business, serving semiconductor manufacturers through advanced materials and process technologies.

providers.name: Cofactor Genomics
providers.description: Cofactor Genomics is a precision-medicine biotechnology company that applies RNA-sequencing and machine learning to build predictive immuno-oncology diagnostics. Its flagship OncoPrism assay is designed to predict which cancer patients will respond to immunotherapy, and the company runs the multi-center PREDAPT clinical trial across more than 24 healthcare systems spanning 11 solid-tumor cancers. Cofactor Genomics is a diagnostics and life-sciences company rather than an API provider; it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record surfaced from venture-capital portfolios (DCVC, Menlo Ventures, Y Combinator) and enriched with identity and domain-security metadata.

providers.name: CoinRoutes
providers.description: CoinRoutes provides an institutional algorithmic crypto trading platform offering portfolio management, risk solutions, and execution across multiple digital asset exchanges. The company delivers award‑winning algorithms, real‑time market data, advanced charting, and order management tools for asset managers, prop traders, and prime brokers.

providers.name: CVS Health
providers.description: CVS Health is a Fortune 50 healthcare services and retail pharmacy company. Its core operating units include CVS Pharmacy (retail pharmacy and mail-order), CVS Caremark (pharmacy benefit management / PBM), Aetna (health insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, dental and vision), MinuteClinic (walk-in clinics), Oak Street Health (primary care for Medicare patients), and Signify Health (in-home health evaluations). CVS Health does not currently operate a public developer portal or generally available REST API. Programmatic integrations with CVS Pharmacy, Caremark, and Aetna are typically established through business partnership agreements, EDI / NCPDP pharmacy networks, and HIPAA-aligned interoperability channels (e.g., FHIR endpoints exposed to qualifying healthcare partners under regulatory mandates such as the CMS Interoperability Rule). Developer-facing artifacts in this index are limited to public marketing, corporate, and digital health references.

providers.name: Delphia Therapeutics
providers.description: Delphia Therapeutics is a Cambridge, Massachusetts oncology biotechnology company pioneering "activation lethality," a precision-medicine approach that targets cancer cells' vulnerability to oncogene overactivation by selectively over-activating cancer-linked signaling until tumor cells can no longer survive. Founded by oncology drug developers Kevin Marks, Bill Sellers, and Mike Dillon, the company launched with a $67 million Series A financing led by GV, with participation from Nextech Invest, Polaris Innovation Fund, and Alexandria Venture Investments. Delphia is a preclinical-stage drug developer and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Distributional
providers.description: Distributional is an a16z-backed company (security contact Scott Clark) tracked in the API Evangelist network. As of July 2026 distributional.com serves a pre-launch holding page ("Something new is coming") with no public API, backend, or authentication surface. The site does publish machine-readable discovery surfaces, however: an RFC 9116 security.txt at /.well-known/security.txt and an llms.txt with plain-markdown page twins for direct LLM ingestion. This profile captures those published surfaces and probed domain-security posture, and will be enriched further once the company launches a developer or API offering.

providers.name: Diverge Health
providers.description: Diverge Health is a value-based care company that partners with primary care practices to improve outcomes for underserved and Medicaid patient populations. It embeds community-based care teams, health coaches, and behavioral health clinicians into medical practices to address medical, social, and behavioral needs, supported by data aggregation and technology. The company backs providers with chronic disease management (diabetes, COPD, hypertension, heart failure), collaborative behavioral health, and social-needs support across multiple states. Backed by GV, Diverge Health operates as a services and enablement organization rather than a public API provider; it currently publishes no developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable interface. This profile tracks its public web presence in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Dream
providers.description: Dream (Dream Security / Dream Group) is an AI company for national cybersecurity and sovereign AI, founded in 2023 by Shalev Hulio, former Austrian Chancellor Sebastian Kurz, and Gil Dolev, with offices in Tel Aviv, Vienna, and Abu Dhabi. Dream builds a full sovereign AI stack that nations own, control, and operate with zero foreign reliance, delivered on-premises and air-gapped with no foreign telemetry. Its platform spans three products: Atlas, a national AI platform that turns government data into knowledge and decisions across intelligence, finance, health, and supply chain; Sphere, a unified cyber-defense system protecting government and critical infrastructure against nation-state threats; and Hero, an autonomous multi-agent solution for vulnerability discovery and patching. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures and others at a multibillion-dollar valuation, Dream has no public developer API surface; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Drone Racing League
providers.description: The Drone Racing League (DRL) is a New York-based professional drone racing property founded in 2015 by Nicholas Horbaczewski, staging first-person-view (FPV) races in which pilots fly identical, league-built quadcopters - the Racer series - through three-dimensional courses in stadiums, arenas and landmark venues at speeds above 80 mph. DRL designs its own racing drones, timing and telemetry hardware, produces and distributes its race broadcasts across NBC, Sky Sports, ProSiebenSat.1 and streaming platforms, and operates the DRL Simulator, an FPV racing game on Steam, PlayStation and Xbox that feeds the Swatch DRL Tryouts esports pipeline used to recruit professional pilots. The company was acquired by Infinite Reality (now Napster) in April 2024. DRL publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs or machine-readable API specification, and as of the 2026-08-04 enrichment pass its primary web properties (thedroneracingleague.com, drl.io) were not completing a TLS handshake.

providers.name: Enigma Public
providers.description: Broadest collection of public data

providers.name: Esperion Therapeutics
providers.description: Esperion Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: ESPR) is a commercial-stage pharmaceutical company based in Ann Arbor, Michigan, focused on discovering, developing, and commercializing innovative medicines that lower LDL cholesterol and reduce cardiovascular risk. Its lead products are NEXLETOL (bempedoic acid) and NEXLIZET (bempedoic acid and ezetimibe), oral, once-daily, non-statin therapies indicated to lower elevated LDL-C in adults. As a life-sciences company, Esperion operates a corporate and scientific marketing web presence rather than a developer program; it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or technical documentation. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead and enriched with verifiable company identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Everstring
providers.description: EverString was a B2B predictive marketing and sales intelligence platform that used data science, machine learning, and a proprietary business data cloud to help go-to-market teams identify their best-fit accounts. Its capabilities included predictive lead and account scoring, account-based marketing segmentation, firmographic enrichment, similar-company discovery, ML-generated keywords, and industry classification, exposed to developers through an Enrichment API on developer.everstring.com secured with access-token authentication. Founded in 2012 and backed by investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, EverString was acquired by ZoomInfo in November 2019 and its data and predictive capabilities were folded into the ZoomInfo platform; the everstring.com website now redirects to ZoomInfo Operations and the standalone developer portal has been largely decommissioned. This profile documents the historical API surface and current public footprint.

providers.name: Featurespace
providers.description: Featurespace is an enterprise financial-crime prevention company founded in 2008 out of the University of Cambridge and acquired by Visa (announced September 2024). Its flagship ARIC Risk Hub applies Adaptive Behavioral Analytics and Automated Deep Behavioral Networks to risk-score events in real time, detecting payment fraud, scams, and money laundering while reducing false positives for banks, payment processors, merchant acquirers, insurers, and gaming operators. The platform processes 100bn+ events per year across 180+ countries. Featurespace does not publish a public, unauthenticated developer API; its ARIC documentation portal and mobile SDKs are gated behind customer access.

providers.name: Figure1
providers.description: Figure 1 is a Toronto-based social platform and mobile app for verified healthcare professionals to view, share, and discuss real-world, de-identified patient cases and medical images. Founded in 2013 by Dr. Joshua Landy, Richard Penner, and Gregory Levey, it has grown to more than one million healthcare professionals and one of the world's largest libraries of crowd-sourced medical cases, with trained specialists reviewing and de-identifying each image before publication. Figure 1 also produces the DDx medical podcast and a clinical blog, and in 2024 formed the parent company Formedics with Physician's Weekly to deepen healthcare-professional engagement. It is a portfolio company of Union Square Ventures. Figure 1 is a consumer/professional, mobile-first product with no publicly documented developer API.

providers.name: Fitmint
providers.description: Fitmint is a mobile move-to-earn fitness application from Rabbit Technologies Inc that gamifies everyday walking. Users set daily step goals, level up, open mystery boxes, and earn an in-app currency called $GRIT that can be redeemed for Amazon and other gift cards. The app layers social features such as leaderboards, challenges, and streaks on top of activity tracking to help people build a lifelong habit of walking. Fitmint is a consumer mobile app and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this record is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company/provider profile and was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst.

providers.name: Fnality International
providers.description: Fnality International is a London-headquartered financial market infrastructure company that builds and operates distributed-ledger wholesale payment systems settling in tokenised central bank money. Backed by a consortium of 24 global financial institutions — including Banco Santander, BNY, Barclays, BNP Paribas, Citi, Goldman Sachs, State Street and UBS — Fnality launched the Sterling Fnality Payment System (£FnPS) in 2024 as the first regulated DLT-based payment system supervised by the Bank of England, with US Dollar and Euro payment systems in development. The systems run on private Ethereum networks, giving participant banks 24/7 availability, real-time atomic and PvP settlement, programmable money and T+0 cross-border liquidity movement. Fnality Services is the operational and product-delivery arm that licenses software to participants and runs inter-system arrangements. Technical documentation for participants is hosted in a credential-gated Archbee space at docs.fnality.com; Fnality publishes no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Genial Care
providers.description: Genial Care is a Brazilian healthtech network providing multidisciplinary, evidence-based care for children with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) and atypical development up to roughly eight years of age. Founded in 2020 in Sao Paulo, it operates a network of clinics ("Casas Geniais") across Greater Sao Paulo delivering ABA (applied behavior analysis), speech-language therapy, and occupational therapy, alongside family assessments, in-person and online consultations, educational content, and a professional training academy. Care is coordinated through a proprietary mobile app that supports continuous monitoring and family engagement. The company partners with major Brazilian health plans (operadoras), which account for the majority of its revenue, and is backed by General Catalyst. Genial Care operates as a consumer/clinical care provider and does not publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Getinge
providers.description: Getinge is a global medical technology company that develops, manufactures and supplies products and solutions within the areas of surgery, intensive care, infection control and sterile reprocessing. The company focuses on improving patient outcomes and enhancing the efficiency of healthcare providers through innovative devices, digital health solutions, and services. Getinge operates worldwide, serving hospitals and healthcare facilities with a broad portfolio that includes surgical tables, ventilators, patient monitoring systems, and sterilization equipment.

providers.name: Google NotebookLM
providers.description: Google NotebookLM is an AI-powered research and thinking partner that helps users analyze, summarize, and explore sources such as documents, PDFs, web pages, and notes. It leverages Google's Gemini models to ground responses in user-provided source material, generating summaries, study guides, FAQs, and Audio Overviews. NotebookLM does not currently expose a public API; integration with the service is limited to the web interface and supported Google Workspace contexts.

providers.name: Granza Bio
providers.description: Granza Bio is an early-stage biotechnology company reprogramming immunity for target-specific medicines. Founded in 2024 by Dr. Ashwin Nandakumar, Dr. Ashwin Jainarayanan, and Prof. Michael Dustin, the company builds on the discovery of "attack particles" — killing entities released by cytotoxic immune cells, characterized in Prof. Dustin's laboratory at the University of Oxford. Granza Bio is developing an engineered delivery-shell platform that directs therapeutic cargo to specific tissues, with the goal of advancing treatments for cancers, autoimmune disorders, and infections. The company raised $7.14M in seed funding co-led by Refactor Capital and Felicis, with participation from Pioneer Fund and Y Combinator. It is a research-stage life-sciences company and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: HomeGP
providers.description: HomeGP is a Malaysian on-demand house-call healthcare platform, founded in 2015 and headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, that connects patients with a network of over 300 vetted healthcare practitioners who visit them at home. Services include general practitioner consultations, homecare nursing, licensed physiotherapy, blood and urine testing, medical concierge, wound dressing, and private and live-in caregivers. Bookings are placed through WhatsApp with confirmation typically within ten minutes, operating Monday to Saturday 8am-10pm. HomeGP positions itself as a marketplace connecting individuals to independent professionals rather than a healthcare provider itself, and is backed by 500 Global (500 Southeast Asia), 8capita, and IncuVest.

providers.name: Homethrive
providers.description: Homethrive is a technology-enabled caregiving-support benefit sold to employers, health plans, financial institutions, ancillary insurers, brokers, and platform partners. It pairs a digital assistant (Homethrive Dari) with human Care Guides to help family caregivers navigate backup care, aging, complex health, estate planning, and loss for their loved ones. Homethrive is a B2B2C member platform - it is delivered to covered members through their employer or health plan, not as a self-serve product. There is no public or partner developer API, API reference, or developer portal. Customer integration is handled during enterprise onboarding via an eligibility-file specification (typically SFTP/CSV batch files) and Single Sign-On (SSO), with utilization and engagement data returned to the sponsor - all arranged through implementation, not a documented self-service API.

providers.name: HSBC
providers.description: One of the world's largest banking and financial services organizations headquartered in London. Serves over 40 million customers globally with a strong presence in Asia, Europe, and the Americas. Operates a public Developer Portal (develop.hsbc.com) exposing Open Banking, payments, accounts, and global payments solutions APIs for partners and third-party providers.

providers.name: IKF Finance
providers.description: IKF Finance Limited is an India-based non-banking financial company (NBFC) that has provided asset financing for more than 35 years through a network of 300+ branches pan-India, serving over one lakh customers. Its lending products include commercial vehicle loans, construction equipment loans, tractor loans, car and MUV loans, and MSME and business loans, with home loans offered through the affiliated IKF Home Finance entity. Operating under the tagline "Powering Progress with Prompt Financing," the company focuses on prompt, accessible credit for transport operators, small businesses, and individuals across India. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio lead and enriched with public identity, legal, and domain-security signals; IKF Finance publishes no public developer/API surface.

providers.name: ImmuneBridge
providers.description: ImmuneBridge is a San Francisco biotech company building a first-in-class integrated screening and manufacturing platform for allogeneic cell therapies. The company screens and expands stem cells from multiple sources (umbilical cord blood, mobilized blood, bone marrow), uses high-throughput automated assays with machine-learning models to predict donor and process performance early, and scales production with IBR403, a small molecule enabling up to 100,000-fold expansion of hematopoietic stem cells. The stated goal is to manufacture tens of thousands of affordable, high-quality immune cell doses (HSCs, NK cells, T cells, and more) from a single cord blood unit. ImmuneBridge is backed by Insight Partners, NFX Bio, M Ventures, and other institutional investors. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the company publishes no public API or developer surface.

providers.name: IMP Software
providers.description: IMP Software builds MAT-first financial management software for the UK education sector. Its flagship product, IMP Planner, is a single-database, trust-wide platform for budgeting, forecasting, reporting, Integrated Curriculum Financial Planning (ICFP) and purchasing, used by Multi-Academy Trusts (MATs) and their schools. Based in Exeter, UK, the company is trusted by more than 550 trusts across roughly 6,000 schools and secured a growth investment from Partech in September 2025. IMP Planner is a closed SaaS application for trust finance teams; IMP Software does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Iress
providers.description: Iress is a technology company providing software for financial markets, wealth management, and trading. Iress QuantFeed is a signature end-to-end ultra-low latency market data API that connects over 240 normalized market data feeds from 80+ sources.

providers.name: Kema
providers.description: Kema (Kema FZ-LLC) is a UAE-based B2B fintech providing cash-flow and accounts-receivable tools for SMEs across the MENA region. Its platform combines invoice financing that advances up to 95% of invoice value, accounts-receivable automation with automated reminders, invoice tracking and reconciliation, and branded payment links delivered over email, WhatsApp and SMS that accept cards and wire transfers. Additional capabilities include practice-management tooling for accounting firms, recurring-payment automation, credit assessment and a real-time AR dashboard and analytics. Kema is backed by Speedinvest and reports 4,000+ companies transacting on its network.

providers.name: Kuaidian Reading
providers.description: Kuaidian Reading (快点阅读) is a Chinese mobile reading community operated by Beijing Tiantong Interactive Technology Co., Ltd. (Sky Platanus Interactive, 天桐互动), positioning itself as China's first dialogue-based reading app. Instead of long-form web fiction, the platform publishes chat-style novels rendered as character dialogue, which it argues gives clearer characterization, tighter pacing and stronger reader immersion. Content is user-generated at scale — the company claims over 20,000 new novels uploaded daily — and distributed through a decentralized recommendation algorithm rather than editorial merchandising. Social mechanics include barrage-style inline comments, author tipping, and a co-writing mode that lowers the barrier for first-time writers. Authors work in a separate creation console at editor.kuaidianyuedu.com. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCM Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Kuaidian Reading publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or /.well-known/ discovery surface; it is a consumer-app company with no developer-facing program.

providers.name: Mediaspectrum
providers.description: Mediaspectrum is a cloud-based SaaS provider of multichannel advertising, content management, and publishing software for media companies and publishers. Founded in 2001 and headquartered in Miami, its platform manages the full advertising lifecycle -- proposal generation, packaging, scheduling, rating, workflow, trafficking, optimization, and billing -- alongside an integrated CRM and the ContentWatch content management system spanning print, web, mobile, video, social, and broadcast channels. The company raised a $35.8M investment from Insight Venture Partners in 2013 and counts Gannett, Dow Jones, and Trinity Mirror among its clients. No public API, developer portal, or SDKs are published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: MediSage
providers.description: MediSage is an India-based digital health company that operates one of Asia's largest online medical communities, connecting doctors and healthcare practitioners with first-hand, peer-reviewed medical information, live CME webinars, clinical discussion forums, medical news, and professional networking. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, MediSage delivers its knowledge platform primarily through consumer-facing web and mobile applications for physicians; no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or partner integration surface has been identified at this time.

providers.name: Microlink.io
providers.description: Extract structured data from any website

providers.name: MindRhythm
providers.description: MindRhythm is a medical technology company focused on improving outcomes caused by neurological injury. Founded by scientific experts with prior commercialization success, the company builds a detection and monitoring platform — anchored by its Headpulse technology — that provides real-time visibility into life-threatening neurological events such as large-vessel-occlusion stroke and concussion, across the home, EMS, battlefield, and clinical settings. MindRhythm publishes clinical studies, news, and company/leadership information on its site; it does not expose a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Nava Therapeutics
providers.description: Nava Therapeutics is a life-sciences company developing lipid nanoparticle (LNP) technology for delivering RNA therapeutics precisely to specific organs and cells, aiming to extend genetic medicines to previously untreatable diseases. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) and added to the API Evangelist network, Nava operates in the therapeutics / RNA-delivery sector and, as a private clinical-stage biotech, publishes a corporate marketing site (pipeline, team, newsroom) but no public developer, API, or integration surface at this time.

providers.name: Noora Health
providers.description: Noora Health is a healthcare nonprofit that turns the time patients and their families spend in hospitals into an opportunity to learn high-impact health skills. Working through public and private health systems across South Asia, its Care Companion Program trains family caregivers at the bedside so they can care for their loved ones after discharge, reducing preventable complications and readmissions. Founded in 2014 and a Y Combinator-backed organization, Noora Health operates in India, Bangladesh, Indonesia, and Nepal and has trained tens of millions of caregivers and patients. It is a mission-driven organization rather than an API provider, and no public developer portal, API, or SDK surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Parallel Finance
providers.description: Parallel Finance is a decentralized money-market protocol built on the Polkadot ecosystem, offering lending, staking, and borrowing where depositors can lend and stake simultaneously to earn combined yield and borrowers can post collateral to borrow. It runs as a Substrate/Polkadot parachain (Parallel mainnet and the Heiko canary network on Kusama). Rather than a REST API, developers integrate through a JSON-RPC node over WebSocket (wss://rpc.parallel.fi) using polkadot.js, aided by Parallel's first-party @parallel-finance TypeScript SDK packages on npm that supply the chain types, RPC definitions, and connection options. Source, chain specs, and the auction toolkit are published under the parallel-finance GitHub organization.

providers.name: Peloton
providers.description: A connected fitness company offering stationary bikes, treadmills, rowers, and a digital platform for live and on-demand fitness classes. Peloton pioneered the premium at-home fitness category, blending hardware, software, and instructor-led content into an interactive workout experience available across Peloton equipment and a standalone Peloton App on iOS, Android, web, and connected TV. Peloton does not publish a public developer API, partner portal, or third-party integration program; all API surfaces are internal and only reachable through the consumer apps. Reverse-engineered community libraries exist on GitHub but are unsupported by Peloton.

providers.name: PrimaryIO
providers.description: PrimaryIO is a Silicon Valley cloud workload management and data mobility company based in Los Altos, California, that helps enterprises safely leverage the public cloud. Its portfolio includes ProtectIO, a Disaster-Recovery-as-a-Service offering; RecoverIO, a Ransomware-Recovery-as-a-Service offering; ConvertIO, which migrates VMware VMs into cloud-native virtual server instances; and a tech-enabled Migration-as-a-Service. The platform uses changed-block replication to cloud object storage with data encryption in transit and at rest for non-disruptive migrations and on-demand VMware infrastructure. PrimaryIO is backed by Accel and Partech. It currently publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Quest Diagnostics
providers.description: Quest Diagnostics is a Fortune 500 company and the world's leading provider of diagnostic information services that patients and doctors can rely on to make better healthcare decisions. Quest operates 2,000+ patient service centers, performs 200+ million tests annually, and supplies its Quanum family of solutions for connecting laboratories, EHR systems, and health plans.

providers.name: ResWare
providers.description: ResWare is customizable title and escrow production software for real estate closings, originally built by Adeptive Software Corporation and acquired by Qualia Labs in December 2020 (now shipping as ResWare 10 within the Qualia ecosystem). It is an on-premises, workflow-driven platform covering title and escrow production, document management and auto-generation, secure communications, and escrow accounting. ResWare exposes an integration API to partners and customers that is historically a SOAP/XML web-service API (built on Windows Communication Foundation / WCF, Microsoft binary protocol by default with Basic Authentication available on request), complemented by newer REST APIs for document handling. There is no public, self-serve developer portal - API access is gated behind a partner/integration program and an "API assistance" package (developer support hours, REST/WCF code samples, and documentation), with pricing on request via sales@adeptivesw.com. The logical service areas below are modeled from partner-integration behavior; ResWare publishes no public API reference or OpenAPI, so no REST surface is fabricated here.

providers.name: Revolution Foods
providers.description: Revolution Foods is an Oakland, California food company founded in 2006 by Kristin Groos Richmond and Kirsten Saenz Tobey that manufactures and delivers nutritious, freshly prepared meals to schools and senior communities. It is the largest K-12 school meal vendor in California, serving more than 35 million meals a year across 800+ schools and senior centers, with programs spanning district and charter school food service, after-school and summer meals, senior center dining and homebound delivery. The company has been a Certified B Corporation since 2009 and a Public Benefit Corporation since 2021, and reports a 100% audit pass rate across NSLP, SBP, CACFP, SFSP and Title III compliance. Customers order through Centro, a login-gated web ordering portal; Revolution Foods publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Rhyme (fka PriorAuthNow)
providers.description: Rhyme (formerly PriorAuthNow) is a healthcare technology company that eliminates prior authorization burden by automating the exchange between payers and providers. Its platform delivers touchless prior authorization, gold carding (removing auth requirements entirely through payer-provider collaboration), and a shared dashboard for tracking efficiency. Rhyme processes over four million prior authorizations annually and connects 83 of the largest US health systems with 300+ payers. The company is backed by Insight Partners and was surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead; it publishes no public developer or API surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Rover
providers.description: Rover is the world's largest online marketplace for pet care, connecting pet parents with sitters and dog walkers for boarding, house sitting, drop-in visits, doggy daycare, and dog walking. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in Seattle, Rover was a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: ROVR) until Blackstone completed its acquisition of Rover Group for approximately $2.3 billion on February 27, 2024, taking the company private and delisting its stock. As of this catalog entry, Rover does NOT publish a public, documented developer API or a developer portal. Its platform is a closed consumer/provider marketplace; the only outward-facing integration program is a marketing affiliate program offered through third-party affiliate networks (Impact, CJ, Rakuten, Skimlinks, ShareASale, etc.), not a data/booking API. Programmatic access to Rover data today is only available via unofficial third-party web scrapers (e.g. Apify), which are outside Rover's supported surface. This entry is an honest stub documenting the absence of a public API; it should be revisited if Rover launches a partner or developer API.

providers.name: Rubric Labs
providers.description: Rubric Labs is an applied AI lab based in Canada that helps companies build and ship intelligent, agent-powered applications. Rather than selling a public API product, Rubric Labs operates as an engineering partner and maintains open-source tooling for AI-first development, including create-rubric-app (a full-stack AI project scaffold inspired by create-next-app), maige (open-source infrastructure for running natural-language workflows on your codebase), and tokenmaxx (a local proxy that aggregates LLM token usage across Codex and Claude Code accounts). The team partners with companies such as Cal.com and Trigger.dev, works with Neon, Vercel, and LangChain, and publishes engineering writing on its blog. As of this profile there is no self-service developer API, hosted API reference, SDK, or pricing surface to score — this is a services and open-source lab, not an API provider.

providers.name: SceneRay
providers.description: SceneRay Medical Technology (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. is a Chinese medical-device and brain-computer-interface company founded in 2011 and headquartered in the Suzhou Industrial Park. It designs and manufactures implantable neuromodulation systems, focusing on Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS) devices and "brain-machine control chip" technology used to treat Parkinson's disease, movement disorders, epilepsy, and treatment-resistant psychiatric conditions. Its product line spans implantable pulse generators, programmable external controllers, and clinician programming systems. SceneRay reports over 100 international patents and 700+ total patent applications, with devices used across 18+ countries. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming. As a medical hardware manufacturer, SceneRay publishes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or other machine-readable technical surface at the time of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Shoulder Innovations
providers.description: Shoulder Innovations is a commercial-stage medical technology company headquartered in Grand Rapids, Michigan, focused exclusively on the shoulder surgical care market. Founded in 2009 by Dr. Steve Gunther, it develops the InSet(R) shoulder arthroplasty portfolio - the InSet Glenoid, InSet Total Shoulder and InSet Reverse Shoulder systems, the I-Series humeral stems and a streamlined one- and two-tray instrument system - built around inset glenoid fixation designed to reduce the "rocking horse" forces implicated in glenoid implant failure. It also publishes ProVoyance(R) Shoulder, a first-party AI/ML pre-operative planning application that turns CT imaging into 3D bone reconstructions and is delivered to surgeons through a customer login portal. The company listed publicly in July 2025 under the ticker SI. It ships no public API, SDK, webhook surface or developer program; ProVoyance is an end-user clinical application, not a platform.

providers.name: Simile
providers.description: Simile is a simulation platform for human behavior. Its AI-driven simulations show how and why customers, employees, or populations respond to change, so enterprise teams can find their audience, reach niche populations, de-risk decisions, segment sentiment at scale, and test concepts before a real-world launch. Simile is building a foundation model that predicts human behavior and a product that deploys it at scale. It raised a $100M Series A led by Index Ventures and is backed by Bain Capital Ventures; named customers include CVS Health, Wealthfront, Suntory, Garnett Station Partners, and Banco Itau.

providers.name: Studocu
providers.description: Studocu (operated by StudeerSnel B.V., Amsterdam) is a global online learning platform and study-materials marketplace where students access, share, and upload course documents, lecture notes, summaries, and exam prep across thousands of institutions and subjects. The platform layers AI study tools on top of its crowdsourced document library — an Ask AI chat, AI Notes generation, and an AI Quiz Generator — alongside course organization, study lists, and a Premium subscription for unlimited downloads and full document access. Backed by Partech and Point Nine, Studocu was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company. It exposes no public developer API; this profile captures its public security, trust, and web-property surface.

providers.name: Styleseat
providers.description: StyleSeat is an online booking and business-management marketplace for beauty and grooming professionals — hair stylists, barbers, nail technicians, estheticians, and other independent service providers. Professionals use StyleSeat to publish a bookable profile, manage their calendar and appointments, accept online payments and deposits, reduce no-shows, and market their services, while clients discover local pros, browse portfolios and reviews, and book appointments online. Founded in 2011 and based in San Francisco, StyleSeat operates as a consumer-facing web and mobile platform. It currently exposes no public developer API or partner API program; this profile was surfaced as a venture-portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline with domain-security and public-property signals.

providers.name: Systems Engineering, Inc. (SEI)
providers.description: Systems Engineering, Inc. (SEI) is a US multiple listing service (MLS) software vendor whose NAVICA product line serves REALTOR boards and associations: NAVICA MLS, NAVICA NEXT, Showing Manager, Mobile Plus and Client apps, Association Management System (AMS), STREAMline, Data Share, Tax/public-data and web solutions. For data access SEI operates both RETS and RESO Web API servers that meet RESO compliance requirements including the RESO Data Dictionary (RESO certification record T00000075); access requires an agreement between the board/MLS, the participating office, the third party and SEI, with monthly fees. Partner integrations (dotloop, zipLogix, CRS, Property Panorama) use SSO and per-listing integration. No public API reference, base URL or machine-readable contract is published.

providers.name: Tala
providers.description: Tala is an AI-native digital financial services company providing instant credit, digital wallets, money transfers, and cash-out services to underserved consumers in informal economies. Built on a proprietary, patent-pending credit-decisioning model trained on billions of dollars of lending data, Tala has delivered more than $7B in credit access to over 13 million customers across Kenya, Mexico, the Philippines, India, Vietnam, Guatemala, Panama, and the Dominican Republic. The company also offers Embedded Credit infrastructure for partners. Tala reaches customers primarily through consumer mobile apps; no public developer API or documentation portal is currently published.

providers.name: Tamadé
providers.description: Tamadé is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. Its public surface at flowly.world is Flowly, a virtual telehealth clinic offering an evidence-based program for chronic pain and anxiety recovery, delivered through licensed therapists, a mobile relaxation-training app, and VR wellness tools. As of this enrichment pass it publishes a consumer healthcare product with no public developer platform, API, SDKs, or developer documentation. This profile records the honest no-API-surface result plus a live domain-security probe of the flowly.world host.

providers.name: Teradar
providers.description: Teradar is a Boston, Massachusetts semiconductor and sensing company founded in 2020 by Matthew Carey, Gregory Charvat and Nicholas Saiz that is commercializing terahertz-band vision sensors for vehicles, defense and security screening. Its Modular Terahertz Engine (MTE) is an all-solid-state chip architecture built from proprietary transmit (TX), receive (RX) and Teracore processing silicon, delivering 0.13-degree native angular resolution at 300+ meters in day, night, rain, fog and snow, positioned to sit alongside cameras and to displace radar and lidar in SAE L1-L5 driver assistance and autonomy programs. The company emerged from stealth in late 2025 with a $150M Series B led by VXI Capital with Ibex Investors, Capricorn Investment Group, The Engine Ventures and Lockheed Martin Ventures, and is working with global OEMs and Tier-One suppliers toward a 2028 model-year launch. Teradar is a hardware and silicon company: it publishes a marketing site and product specification sheets, but no public developer program, API, SDK, or machine-readable interface contract.

providers.name: Terrascope
providers.description: Terrascope is a Singapore-headquartered climate-tech and sustainability software company building an enterprise carbon measurement, management, and decarbonization platform. Launched in 2022 after being incubated and spun out of Olam Group (a Temasek-linked Singapore agribusiness), and led by former Google and AWS executive Felipe Daguila, Terrascope serves large food, agriculture, retail, and manufacturing enterprises that need to quantify Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions across their operations, products, and supply chains. The platform centers on four core modules: Corporate Carbon Footprint (CCF) for organization-level inventories, Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) for product-level lifecycle emissions, Supplier Engagement for Scope 3 primary-data collection, and Climate Reporting for audit-ready disclosure. Terrascope's differentiator is its AI-assisted data ingestion layer (built on Amazon Bedrock) that reduces measurement cycles by roughly 80% versus manual baselines, intelligent emissions factor matching with FLAG (Forestry, Land, and Agriculture) breakdowns, data gap-filling claiming 92% accuracy versus supplier data, and a curated library of over 20,000 decarbonization best practices used to power what-if scenario modeling and ROI-ranked recommendations. The platform supports the GHG Protocol (including Land Sector and Removals guidance), SBTi FLAG, CDP (Terrascope is a CDP Gold Accredited software provider), TCFD, California SB253, and Australia's S2 climate disclosure regimes. Notable customers include Kellanova, Princes Group, iNova Pharmaceuticals, Mandai Wildlife Group, Olam Food Ingredients, Tetra Pak, Mitsubishi, Japan Tobacco, and Kagome. Investors include Olam Group and Plug and Play Tech Center. Terrascope is delivered as a closed enterprise SaaS — there is no publicly documented developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, CLI, or open-source release. The github.com/terrascope organization exists but has no public repositories, and docs.terrascope.com is not publicly resolvable. Integration with customer ERP, procurement, and energy systems is handled through bespoke implementation engagements rather than self-serve developer onboarding.

providers.name: Tongal
providers.description: Tongal is a Santa Monica, California creative content platform ("your studio on demand") that connects brands and studios with a global community of writers, directors, and production companies. Founded in 2009 and backed by Insight Partners, Tongal runs branded video, advertising, and original-content projects through ideation, pitch, and production phases for clients such as LEGO, Procter & Gamble, Unilever, NASA, and Lucasfilm. Tongal publishes no public developer API — api.tongal.com is the private GraphQL backing API for its web app, with introspection disabled.

providers.name: Umoja Biopharma
providers.description: Umoja Biopharma is a Seattle-based clinical-stage immuno-oncology company developing in vivo CAR T cell therapies for cancer. Its VivoVec lentiviral platform generates CAR T cells directly in a patient's body, removing the ex vivo manufacturing step of traditional cell therapy, and the company operates its own manufacturing facility in Louisville, Colorado.
