Its pipeline includes UB-VV111 (CD19), UB-VV400 (the industry's first known CD22-directed in vivo CAR T candidate, FDA IND clearance July 2026), and UB-VV500. Umoja is backed by investors including DCVC (DCVC Bio) and SoftBank Vision Fund 2. The company publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; this profile captures the company identity and the security posture of its public web surface.

providers.name: UPMC
providers.description: A world-renowned health care provider and insurer headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. One of the largest nonprofit health systems in the United States, operating hospitals, physician practices, and a health insurance division (UPMC Health Plan) serving millions of members. UPMC Health Plan exposes an ONC 21st Century Cures Act Developer API for patient-authorized access to clinical and claims data over HL7 FHIR.

providers.name: Upshift
providers.description: Upshift is a San Francisco fractional car subscription service — "a 2-car garage, in your pocket." Members choose 4, 8, or 12 driving days a month and get a premium Toyota hybrid delivered clean, fueled, insured, and maintained, then picked up when they are done, with plans from $399/month including insurance, delivery, and maintenance. A 500 Global and URBAN-X portfolio company, Upshift publishes no public developer program or API surface; the member experience runs through its iOS/Android apps and go.upshiftcars.com.

providers.name: Vaulted Deep
providers.description: Vaulted Deep is a permanent carbon removal and organic waste disposal company that injects carbon-filled organic waste — biosolids, agricultural byproducts and manure, and pulp and paper sludge — thousands of feet underground as a slurry, using patented geologic slurry sequestration technology adapted from oil and gas practice so the carbon is trapped permanently beneath impermeable rock. Spun out of Advantek Waste Management Services in 2023 and co-founded by Julia Reichelstein and Omar Abou-Sayed, it operates the Great Plains site in Hutchinson, Kansas and the Terminal Island site in Los Angeles, California, serving municipal wastewater utilities and agricultural operators while selling durable carbon removal credits to corporate buyers. It publishes no public API, SDK, or developer program.

providers.name: Vegrow
providers.description: Vegrow is a Bengaluru-based B2B fruits marketplace founded in 2020 by IIT alumni that connects Indian fruit farmers with demand outlets across retail channels, using technology to match produce such as apples, bananas, pomegranates, and grapes with buyers, handling grading, sorting, quality assurance, and delivery, and paying farmers digitally. Backed by GIC, Prosus Ventures, Matrix Partners India, Elevation Capital, Lightspeed, and Ankur Capital, it raised a $46M round led by GIC in December 2023. Vegrow publishes no public API or developer program today.

providers.name: Warby Parker
providers.description: Warby Parker (NYSE: WRBY) is a direct-to-consumer eyewear and vision care company founded in 2010, selling prescription eyeglasses, sunglasses, contact lenses, and eye exams online and across 900+ retail stores. It operates a headless, modular commerce architecture and a proprietary point-of-sale system (Point of Everything), plus consumer-facing tools like Virtual Vision Test and PD measurement. Warby Parker does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; its API surface (api.warbyparker.com) is internal. The company does publish a public llms.txt for AI agents and an RFC 9116 security.txt with a bug-bounty contact. This API Evangelist profile captures that agent-facing and security posture; there is no OpenAPI/AsyncAPI or SDK surface to harvest.

providers.name: Wildcard
providers.description: Wildcard is a PvP collectible-card-based MOBA (multiplayer online battle arena) developed by Playful Studios and currently in Early Access on Steam. Players pick Champions, assemble decks of Summon creature cards, and compete in real-time strategic arena battles where deck-building matters as much as mechanical skill. The game ships collectible cosmetics (Wildpass, Flair, Wildfile) with a web3 angle — the Wildpass is a Polygon NFT collection tradeable on Magic Eden — and is backed as a portfolio company of the crypto venture firm Paradigm. Its backend gaming services are built on Beamable and Unreal Engine. No first-party public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal is published; this profile is a company/lead record in the API Evangelist network. Sector: gaming.

providers.name: Xiudan (Showball)
providers.description: Shenzhen Xiudan Technology Co., Ltd. (深圳秀蛋科技有限公司) is the Chinese company behind Showball (秀蛋), a virtual social "meta" mobile app where users create avatars and socialize in virtual spaces, distributed through the iOS App Store and an Android download on xiudan.net. A Qiming Venture Partners portfolio company, Xiudan publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts as of July 2026 - this profile records the company identity and probe results for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Zanskar
providers.description: Zanskar (Zanskar Geothermal & Minerals, Inc.) is a Salt Lake City-based geothermal energy company founded in 2021 by Carl Hoiland and Joel Edwards. It uses custom artificial intelligence, machine learning, and subsurface geoscience to discover and develop conventional geothermal resources, with a mission to make geothermal the most affordable form of widely-deployable, 24/7 carbon-free power. The company raised a $115M Series C and is backed by Obvious Ventures and Union Square Ventures. Zanskar publishes public geothermal datasets on the Snowflake Marketplace; it does not currently expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Ace Turtle Services
providers.description: Ace Turtle Services Pvt Ltd (brand "ace turtle") is a Bengaluru, India based retail technology company founded in 2014 that operates a vertical commerce model for international fashion and lifestyle brands. It is the exclusive licensee in India and South Asia for brands including Lee, Wrangler, G-STAR, Toys"R"Us and Dockers, and it runs three proprietary platforms: Rubicon, an omnichannel commerce platform combining distributed order management, inventory, catalogue, pricing and logistics management; Connect App, a store-operations application for in-store fulfilment, helpdesk and visual merchandising; and Albus, a machine-learning layer for inventory optimisation, safety-stock calculation and dynamic markdown. Rubicon is marketed as a channel-agnostic platform that integrates into a brand's existing technology ecosystem, but as of the September 2026 enrichment pass the company publishes no developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable contract on any host it controls.

providers.name: Aerospace Yuxing
providers.description: Aerospace Yuxing (Chinese: 航天驭星; English brand: Emposat Co., Ltd.; legally Beijing Aerospace Yuxing Technology Co., Ltd.) is a Beijing-headquartered commercial space-infrastructure operator founded in 2016 by a core team drawn from the China Academy of Space Technology and the wider China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation system. It builds and operates the ground segment that commercial satellites depend on: a global network of more than 60 satellite ground stations across China, Kenya, South Africa, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand, the South Pacific and South America, plus the Ningxia Zhongwei remote-sensing calibration site. Its service catalog spans launch-vehicle and spacecraft telemetry, tracking and command (TT&C), long-term on-orbit operations management, payload data reception and processing, remote-sensing satellite calibration, space situational awareness and collision warning, debris mitigation, frequency coordination and launch licensing support, and aerospace engineering consulting. It also manufactures ground-system, communication and software-system products - multifunction baseband units, on-board transceivers and transponders, portable and integrated TT&C/data-reception ground stations, and TT&C operations software. The company has served over 370 satellites and rockets, employs roughly 300 people, and closed nearly CNY 2 billion across D, D+ and D++ rounds in 2026. Its customer-facing systems are delivered as installed software and a China-hosted service portal; center-to-center integration is offered over space ground-segment protocols (PDXP, CSP, KISS, CORTEX, AX.25) rather than a public web API. Aerospace Yuxing publishes no developer portal, no public API documentation, no SDK and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Arago
providers.description: Arago (Arago Computing SAS) is a Paris-based deeptech semiconductor startup, founded in 2024 by Nicolas Muller, Ambroise Muller, and Eliott Sarrey, building energy-efficient AI accelerators powered by light rather than electricity. Its photonic processor, codenamed JEF, uses a proprietary multi-physics computing core that encodes values with lasers instead of thousands of transistor switches, targeting 10x to 30x reductions in energy and cost overhead for AI workloads at equivalent performance to leading GPUs. Arago pairs the hardware with a full software stack called CARLOTA, which abstracts the complexities of photonic computing and exposes a programmable interface compatible with mainstream AI frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow, while remaining fabbable using standard semiconductor processes. The company operates across France, North America, and Israel, and in July 2025 raised an oversubscribed $26 million seed round co-led by Earlybird, Protagonist, and Visionaries Tomorrow, with backing from executives and investors tied to Apple, Arm, Nvidia, Microsoft, Amazon, Uber, PayPal, and Hugging Face. Arago was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Earlybird; as an early-stage hardware company it does not yet publish a public developer API or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Artnguide
providers.description: Artnguide (아트앤가이드) is a Korean platform that issues art‑investment contract securities, enabling fractional ownership of artworks. It provides a digital marketplace where users can easily start investing in art pieces through a user‑friendly interface, offering transparency, liquidity, and regulatory compliance for art‑based financial products.

providers.name: AssistIQ Technologies
providers.description: AssistIQ Technologies builds AI-powered computer vision for the healthcare supply chain, automatically capturing the implants, supplies, and tissues used during surgical cases in real time so hospitals can bill with confidence. Its platform pairs three products - Capture (computer-vision recognition of implants and supplies at point of use), Charge Capture (automated charge data submission and review), and Insights (analytics on supply variation and utilization) - and integrates with major EHR and ERP systems including recognition in the Epic Showroom and a GE HealthCare partnership. AssistIQ reports up to an 80% increase in billable product revenue, a 48% reduction in expiry-related costs, and 15+ minutes saved per case. The platform is HIPAA and SOC 2 Type II compliant. The company is a portfolio company of Battery Ventures. It does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation portal, or machine-readable API description.

providers.name: Atomic AI
providers.description: Atomic AI is a biotechnology company fusing machine learning with structural biology to unlock RNA drug discovery. Founded in 2017 by Raphael Townshend and based in San Francisco, the company builds ATOM-1, an AI foundation model that predicts the three-dimensional structure of RNA to enable the discovery and optimization of RNA-targeted small molecules and RNA-based medicines for previously undruggable targets, including certain cancers and neurodegenerative diseases. Atomic AI pairs its proprietary 3D RNA structure engine with large-scale in-house wet-lab assays. It is backed by Playground Global, 8VC, Greylock, and others. Atomic AI operates as a proprietary R&D drug-discovery platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its public identity and web-surface signals for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Atonarp
providers.description: Atonarp Inc. develops advanced digital molecular profiling technologies for semiconductor manufacturing, industrial process control, pharmaceutical production, and EV battery fabrication. Their in‑situ, high‑speed, high‑sensitivity mass spectrometry platforms enable real‑time monitoring and decision‑making, improving efficiency, reducing waste, and lowering costs across multiple industries.

providers.name: Billergenie
providers.description: Billergenie is a SaaS platform that offers merchants a comprehensive billing and payment solution. The service includes account management, invoicing, subscription handling, and integrated payment processing. It provides a web portal for merchants to manage their business, view analytics, and configure licensing. The platform emphasizes security and compliance, offering terms of use and privacy policies directly through its merchant portal.

providers.name: Buckeye Partners
providers.description: Buckeye Partners, LP is a master limited partnership that owns and operates one of the largest independent liquid petroleum product pipeline and terminal systems in the United States. Buckeye transports and stores refined petroleum products including gasoline, jet fuel, diesel, and heating oil, connecting refineries and import terminals to local distribution markets across the Eastern US, Midwest, and internationally. Buckeye was taken private by IFM Investors in 2019.

providers.name: Cabal
providers.description: Cabal is an AI-powered relationship-intelligence and warm-introduction platform that turns an organization's professional relationships into warm introductions. It infers connections across millions of professional records without CSV uploads or calendar syncs, letting teams "ask who's connected to anyone." Cabal serves VC platform / deal-sourcing teams, sales organizations, and investor-relations and partnerships teams, and ships Cabal Mail for bulk personalized outreach (company updates, LP communications, strategic asks). The relationship graph is queryable through in-app chat, Claude and ChatGPT via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), a Slack bot, or an API. Backed by Craft Ventures. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from Cabal's public surface; the company advertises API and MCP access but does not publish a public OpenAPI spec or open developer reference (both are account-gated).

providers.name: Calienttechnologies
providers.description: Calient Technologies (Calient.AI) is a leading provider of pure photonic optical circuit switching solutions. The company offers high‑bandwidth, scalable optical circuit switches for network service providers and data center operators, reducing costs and enabling flexible network architectures. Their portfolio includes the S320 optical circuit switch and related products, with extensive documentation and support resources available online.

providers.name: CashDirector
providers.description: CashDirector is a fintech platform delivering AI-powered financial management for small businesses through a white-label, B2B2C partner model. It embeds banking and accounting automation directly into financial institutions' online banking platforms so banks can offer their SME clients a "beyond banking" daily digital business assistant. The platform automates invoicing, expense tracking, cash flow forecasting and receivables management, using AI and OCR to process financial documents automatically. It supports multibanking with minimal IT involvement and reports over 250,000 users across partnerships with six major European banks, positioning itself as Europe's first online accounting system with full banking integration. CashDirector is a Techstars portfolio company; it publishes no public developer portal or open API surface — integration is delivered privately to bank partners.

providers.name: Cellinobio
providers.description: Cellino Bio develops AI-driven optical bioprocessing technology for personalized regenerative medicine. Its proprietary Nebula platform combines deep learning, laser-based cell management, and closed-loop optical bioprocesses to manufacture patient-specific, induced-pluripotent-stem-cell-derived cell and tissue replacements at scale. The company targets degenerative and chronic conditions including kidney disease, lung disease, spinal cord injury, Alzheimer's, and diabetes. Cellino is a life-sciences/biotech company with no public developer API surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company intelligence and is backed by Felicis and Khosla Ventures.

providers.name: Celsius
providers.description: Celsius Network is a cryptocurrency lending and mining platform that filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in early 2024 and is currently in the process of winding down its operations. The company provides services for earning interest on crypto assets, borrowing against holdings, and operates a mining business. Following reorganization, creditors receive distributions in cryptocurrency, USD, or equity in the successor entity Ionic Digital LLC. The platform’s website offers detailed information on claims, distribution processes, and corporate updates.

providers.name: Chargerhelp
providers.description: ChargerHelp provides Reliability as a Service for electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure. Their platform offers data‑first monitoring, predictive maintenance, and performance analytics to ensure high uptime for EVSE operators. Founded to address the growing need for operational excellence in the EV charging ecosystem, ChargerHelp serves utilities, OEMs, and charging network owners with a SaaS solution that combines real‑time telemetry, fault detection, and actionable insights.

providers.name: CHINT
providers.description: CHINT (Chint Group) is a global smart-energy and intelligent-electrical solutions provider founded in 1984 and headquartered in Wenzhou, China, with operations across more than 140 countries. Its portfolio spans low-voltage electrical equipment (IEC and UL), power transmission and distribution systems, switchgear, instruments and meters, EV charging, and clean-energy systems including solar PV and battery storage, serving power utilities, buildings, telecom and data centers, industrial, and OEM sectors. CHINT does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal; this profile captures the company identity and its public web properties. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Hongshan (HongShan / former Sequoia China).

providers.name: Chiquita Brands International
providers.description: Chiquita Brands International is a leading global producer, marketer, and distributor of bananas and other fresh produce, recognized worldwide by the iconic Blue Sticker on its bananas. Founded in 1899 as the United Fruit Company and rebranded as Chiquita in 1990, the company is headquartered in Etoy, Switzerland (with significant operations in Fort Lauderdale, Florida) and sources fruit from plantations across Latin America (Honduras, Guatemala, Costa Rica, Panama, Colombia, and Ecuador) for distribution in the United States, Europe, and other markets. Beyond core Cavendish bananas, Chiquita markets specialty banana varieties (organic, Reds, Manzanos, Minis), plantains, pineapples (including the Sunburst Gold variety), and partners with retailers worldwide. Chiquita does not currently publish a consumer-facing developer API; supplier, retailer, and grower integrations are managed through internal portals and bilateral EDI systems, and consumer-facing digital experiences focus on recipes, sticker collection campaigns, and retail merchandising.

providers.name: CleanCapital
providers.description: CleanCapital is a New York based clean energy investment firm, founded in 2015, that develops, constructs, acquires, owns and operates distributed-generation solar and energy storage projects across the United States. It concentrates on the commercial and municipal middle market between residential rooftop and utility-scale generation, selling power to businesses, schools, nonprofits, municipalities and community solar subscribers, and it buys operating and late-stage development projects from developers through a dedicated project-acquisition practice. The firm reports more than $1.5 billion of capital deployed, 450+ MW under management, 235 MW developed and constructed, 200+ energy customers and over 1,000 GWh of emissions-free generation, backed by institutional partners including Manulife Investment Management / John Hancock, BlackRock and CarVal Investors. CleanCapital is an asset owner and investment manager rather than a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract, and its customer portal at app.cleancapital.com now redirects to the third-party Dock Energy platform.

providers.name: Cliffs Natural Resources
providers.description: Cliffs Natural Resources is the legacy corporate name for what is now Cleveland-Cliffs Inc., a major mining and natural resources company that produces iron ore pellets primarily for steelmaking customers in North America. The company was renamed Cleveland-Cliffs in 2017 and the canonical profile lives at the cleveland-cliffs repo. Cliffs Natural Resources / Cleveland-Cliffs does not publish a public developer portal or general-purpose REST API surface.

providers.name: Colorifix
providers.description: Colorifix engineers nature’s brilliance to pioneer a new approach to colour. It replaces harmful chemicals in textile dyeing with a biological process, drastically reducing environmental impact while maintaining industry quality standards. The company partners with fashion and textile leaders to create sustainable, high‑quality colours, aiming to redefine the future of colour in the industry.

providers.name: Commonwealth Fusion Systems
providers.description: Commonwealth Fusion Systems (CFS) is a commercial fusion energy company headquartered in Devens, Massachusetts and spun out of the MIT Plasma Science and Fusion Center in 2018. CFS is developing tokamak-based fusion systems built around high-temperature superconducting (HTS) REBCO magnet technology that enables substantially smaller, faster, and lower-cost fusion machines than prior generations. The company's technology pipeline starts with SPARC, a net-energy demonstration tokamak under construction at the Devens campus, and continues with ARC, the planned first commercial fusion power plant, sited in Chesterfield County, Virginia in partnership with Dominion Energy and targeted to deliver approximately 400 MW of electricity to the grid in the early 2030s. CFS is backed by a deep investor base including Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Eni, Equinor, Google, Temasek, Tiger Global, Khosla Ventures, Bill Gates, Soros Fund Management, Lowercase Capital, John Doerr, and TIME Ventures. CFS does not publish a public developer API or SDK; engagement is via partnerships, careers, and investor channels.

providers.name: Continental Resources
providers.description: Continental Resources, Inc. is a privately held independent oil and natural gas exploration and production company headquartered in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, and present on the web at clr.com. Its U.S. asset base spans the Bakken of North Dakota, South Dakota and Montana, the Anadarko Basin of Oklahoma, the Powder River Basin of Wyoming and the Permian Basin of Texas, with international positions in Argentina's Vaca Muerta shale and a joint venture in the Diyarbakir Basin of Turkey. The company was taken private in November 2022 in a $4.3B transaction with the Hamm family and is no longer publicly traded. Continental Resources publishes no developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable contract of any kind; this profile catalogs its corporate, owner-relations, operational and sustainability web properties and records that its royalty-owner, vendor-invoicing and employee-access surfaces are each operated by a third-party software vendor rather than by Continental itself.

providers.name: Coty
providers.description: Coty Inc. is one of the world's largest beauty companies with an iconic portfolio of brands across fragrance, color cosmetics, skin and body care. The company operates two divisions: Prestige (premium fragrance, cosmetics, and skincare brands such as Gucci, Burberry, Calvin Klein, Hugo Boss, Marc Jacobs, Tiffany, Chloe, Davidoff, Lancaster, philosophy, and Kylie Cosmetics) and Consumer Beauty (mass-market color cosmetics, hair care, and body care brands such as CoverGirl, Rimmel, Max Factor, Sally Hansen, Bourjois, and Adidas). Coty does not publish a public developer API; supplier and partner integrations occur through the Coty Supplier Portal and B2B / EDI channels.

providers.name: Craon
providers.description: Craon (craon.ai) is an AI-native video editing platform where users edit through natural-language chat instead of a traditional timeline. Creators describe their intent in plain language — "make this more cinematic", "build tension before the reveal", "warm golden-hour grade" — and Craon's AI performs the cuts, color grading, pacing, silence removal, scene detection, subtitle generation, and emotional storytelling automatically. It targets content creators, YouTubers, social and short-form creators, filmmakers, and marketing teams who want professional results without timeline experience or color-theory skills, positioning itself as an AI-native alternative to CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, iMovie, Filmora, Runway, and Descript. Craon is an early-stage company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. The product is a consumer web application with no public developer API; its only machine-facing surface today is a published /llms.txt for AI discovery.

providers.name: CSX
providers.description: CSX Corporation is a Class I freight railroad operating one of the largest rail networks in the eastern United States, serving 23 states with roughly 20,000 route miles of track. CSX moves bulk commodities, intermodal shipments, and merchandise for industrial customers and operates the ShipCSX customer portal for shipment management, EDI integration, and freight tracking.

providers.name: Cyber Resilience
providers.description: Cyber Resilience provides cyber insurance and cybersecurity risk management tools to enterprises, including risk quantification, security investment prioritization, and multi‑entity portfolio risk assessment. Its solutions target risk managers, CISOs, and CFOs, offering AI‑driven models that translate technical security posture into financial impact and 24/7 in‑house claims support.

providers.name: Deep Genomics
providers.description: Deep Genomics is an AI-driven genetic medicines platform company based in Toronto, Canada. It uses biological foundation models (its BioFM Platform) and lab-integrated AI workflows to discover and develop RNA-based genetic medicines, combining AI model development, high-throughput screening technologies, and information systems to accelerate drug discovery and advance new treatments. Founded by deep learning researcher Brendan Frey, the company is backed by investors including Bloomberg Beta and SoftBank Vision Fund. It surfaces no public developer API, portal, or documentation at this time; this profile tracks the company in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: DRINKOTEC
providers.description: DRINKOTEC is a Swiss beverage technology company headquartered in Nyon, Vaud, that designs, builds and services connected beverage dispensing systems and the software that runs them. Its hardware line covers all-in-one and modern postmix dispensers (NEO, VISION PX), compact premix dispensing (DRAFTER), cocktails and blends (MANHATTAN), self-service walls, contactless payment (BEVPAY), beer and wine counting and control (LEVELUP, BEERMAX), automatic keg switching, cellar cooling monitoring and water fountains. LOOP360, its cloud beverage productivity and analytics platform, connects dispensed beverages to a central system and is marketed as integrating with ERP and CRM platforms. DRINKOTEC sells into breweries, bars, pubs, nightclubs, restaurants, hotels, festivals, sports arenas, cruise ships, offices, schools and healthcare, and markets a RESTful DRINKOTEC API for third-party integration whose reference documentation is not published publicly.

providers.name: Earli
providers.description: Earli is a biotech company using AI-designed genetic switches for early cancer detection and treatment. Its synthetic-biomarker technology forces cancer cells to reveal themselves for earlier, more accurate detection, and can program cancer cells to self-destruct while sparing healthy tissue. Founded by Cyriac Roeding and backed by a16z and Menlo Ventures, Earli is a research-stage company with no public developer platform, API, or SDK surface. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead awaiting further enrichment.

providers.name: Echo Labs
providers.description: Echo Labs is a San Francisco-based company building AI-powered media accessibility for higher education. Its platform audits, captions, and audio describes entire institutional video libraries within 24 hours, producing ADA / Title II and WCAG 2.1 AA compliant closed captions and audio descriptions at claimed accuracy above 99 percent and roughly $0.75 per minute — a fraction of legacy vendor pricing. Echo integrates with major learning management systems (7+ LMS platforms) so universities and colleges can bring existing course video into compliance at institutional scale. The company is SOC 2 certified, completed a pre-seed round, and is a Techstars portfolio company. This API Evangelist profile tracks Echo Labs as a company in the network; the provider does not publish a public API or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: ECO2GROW
providers.description: ECO2GROW is a German renewable-energy procurement company serving mid-sized businesses. It builds an individually optimized electricity procurement mix that combines Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) sourced directly from German solar and wind farms with spot-market and forward contracts, giving companies enterprise-level pricing, long-term fixed rates, and traceable green power. The service automates the optimization of a company's procurement strategy and reduces the complexity and transaction costs of closing a PPA, helping industrial and mid-market buyers lower CO2 emissions through verifiable renewable sourcing. ECO2GROW is a Techstars portfolio company. As a B2B energy procurement and advisory business it operates a marketing/consulting web presence and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Entrino.net
providers.description: Entrino.net provides access control and pass management solutions for venues and events. Their platform enables organizers to manage visitor entry, issue digital passes, and enforce security policies in real time. With multi‑regional support, Entrino offers customizable access rules, analytics, and integration options for ticketing systems, ensuring smooth and secure experiences for both staff and attendees.

providers.name: ether.fi
providers.description: ether.fi is a non-custodial, decentralized Ethereum liquid restaking protocol where stakers retain control of their validator keys. Users deposit ETH to mint eETH, a rebasing liquid restaking token (LRT), or wrap it into weETH, the non-rebasing ERC-20 used across DeFi and bridged cross-chain via LayerZero to networks including Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Linea, Mode, Scroll, BNB Chain, Blast, Mantle, and Solana. Beyond ETH liquid restaking, ether.fi has expanded into eBTC (Bitcoin restaking) and eUSD (stablecoin restaking), Liquid auto- balancing strategy vaults, the ether.fi Cash non-custodial credit card with cashback, "The Club" membership tier program, and an AVS operator stack that runs services on EigenLayer, Symbiotic, and Karak. The protocol is governed by the ETHFI token via governance.ether.fi. ether.fi has no public REST API or developer SDK — its public surface is on-chain: open-source Solidity smart contracts on Ethereum mainnet (eETH, weETH, LiquidityPool, EtherFiNodesManager, EtherFiOracle, MembershipManager, ETHFI), cross-chain bridge contracts (weETH-cross-chain via LayerZero, ETHFI via Wormhole NTT), AVS operator contracts, plus operator tooling (etherfi-avs-operator, eigenpod-proofs-generation) and a public subgraph indexing protocol events. ether.fi is one of the largest LRT protocols by TVL with deep integrations across Aave, Pendle, Gearbox, Morpho, and other DeFi venues.

providers.name: Exelon
providers.description: Exelon Corporation is one of the largest energy delivery companies in the United States, serving more than 10 million customers through its regulated electric and gas utility subsidiaries: Atlantic City Electric, BGE, ComEd, Delmarva Power, PECO, and Pepco. Headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, Exelon operates across multiple U.S. states. No public consumer-facing developer APIs have been identified for Exelon; customer self-service is conducted through utility portals.

providers.name: EY
providers.description: One of the Big Four professional services firms providing audit, tax, consulting, and advisory services. Operates in over 150 countries helping businesses navigate regulatory and strategic challenges, and runs proprietary technology platforms such as EY Helix (analytics), EY Atlas (research), and EY Canvas (audit) for internal and engagement use.

providers.name: Future Trash
providers.description: Future Trash is a Los Angeles-based independent, multidisciplinary creative game studio and the developer behind FOAD, a user-generated-content (UGC) native video game franchise. Founded around 2022, the team first built a vertical-slice MVP of FOAD in Unreal Engine 5 and released it in early access on Steam. After Epic Games launched Unreal Editor for Fortnite (UEFN) in 2023, the studio pivoted to building FOAD experiences natively inside Fortnite's UGC ecosystem, spanning MOBA, tycoon, and combat modes, while planning to resume the standalone UE5 core game. Future Trash raised a $5M seed round in September 2024 led by TIRTA Ventures with participation from General Catalyst. This profile was surfaced from General Catalyst's portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network; Future Trash is a game studio and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Gardens
providers.description: Gardens (Gardens Interactive) is a distributed, remote-first video game studio founded in 2021 by veterans of Journey, What Remains of Edith Finch, Sky: Children of the Light, Blaseball, Dustforce, Guild Wars 2, and Firewatch. The studio builds lush, living worlds that bring players together to cultivate lasting friendships, and is developing an upcoming shared fantasy adventure — an ever-evolving online multiplayer sandbox set in a shapeshifting, unpredictable wilderness filled with mystery and magic, designed around meaningful moments shared between strangers. Co-founded by Chris Bell, Lexie Dostal, and Stephen Bell and based primarily out of Portland and Los Angeles, Gardens raised a $31.3M Series A co-led by Lightspeed Venture Partners. As a game studio, Gardens publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its identity within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Generative Engineering
providers.description: Generative Engineering (Generative Vision Ltd) is a London-based deep-tech startup, founded in 2021, building a platform that generates, tests, and simulates thousands of engineering designs in parallel, in a fraction of the time traditional processes take. A code-first integration framework lets engineers plug in their existing tools alongside out-of-the-box integrations, spanning concept engineering, systems integration, and cost engineering. Parallel engineering aims to radically cut product development time for real-world products across energy, decarbonization, agriculture, and mobility. The company is backed by a pre-seed round led by EQT Ventures with participation from Join Capital. It publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Greenlyte
providers.description: Greenlyte Carbon Technologies is an Essen, Germany based climate-tech company building its LiquidSolar platform, which liquefies air, sun, and water into 99% pure carbon and hydrogen feedstocks to produce synthetic e-fuels (sustainable aviation fuel, synthetic methanol, and synthetic natural gas) for hard-to-decarbonize industries. Founded as a direct air capture and power-to-liquid venture, Greenlyte has raised more than 55M EUR from Carbon Removal Partners, Earlybird, Partech, AENU, and Green Generation Fund. It was surfaced through VC portfolio mining and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Greenlyte publishes no public developer, API, or documentation surface; this profile captures its verifiable web identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: InstaAgent
providers.description: InstaAgent is a Y Combinator-backed AI marketing platform that turns a single campaign brief into hundreds of audience-specific creatives. It generates persona-, trend-, and format-grounded ad variants, distributes them across Meta, TikTok, and niche social accounts built for specific audiences, then tests which personas, hooks, formats, and channels drive performance and scales the winners into the next campaign. The company reports serving 500+ clients across 10+ countries with 10x ad variants and 30%+ ROI improvement. InstaAgent operates a marketing product surface only and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Insurdata
providers.description: Insurdata is a re/insurance technology company providing global, best-in-class geocoding and property exposure data. Its unique multi-sourced methodology delivers the highest-resolution, building-level geocoding available worldwide, together with building-perimeter and property-characteristic data that lets underwriters and catastrophe modelers assess risk at the individual-property level at the point of underwriting. Insurdata's augmented exposure data has been used in collaborative studies with carriers such as Canopius and flood modelers such as Fathom to sharpen exposure levels and average-annual-loss (AAL) forecasts. The company is a portfolio company of Anthemis and serves the global re/insurance market.

providers.name: Involve Space
providers.description: Involve Space is an Italian stratospheric aerospace company building real-time Earth intelligence. It operates autonomous high-altitude balloon platforms (Stratostats) that loiter around 20 kilometers for hours, days, or weeks to deliver continuous, high-resolution Earth observation, bridging the gap between satellites, drones, and ground sensors. Its Neurostar AI flight software autonomously controls individual balloons and networks of them (LoonHive), while the CLEAR GeoAI platform turns captured imagery into geospatial insights for disaster response, infrastructure and environmental monitoring, security, and in-orbit-demonstration / payload validation. A certified B Corporation headquartered in Italy with U.S. operations at the Houston Spaceport, Involve Space is backed by Earlybird Venture Capital, CDP Venture Capital, and an EIC Accelerator grant.

providers.name: Kayum
providers.description: Kayum (KAYUM, S.A.P.I. de C.V.) is a Mexico City-based insurance data-analytics and software company serving the Mexican insurance market. It gives insurers exclusive, continuously updated market intelligence and actionable analysis: monthly price panels for GMM (major-medical), Life, and Auto lines backed by data from more than ten leading insurers, competitive pricing models, a quotation-processing tool (Claveteador) that compresses quote data preparation from days to minutes, customer-facing quoting platforms (Cotizadores) processing over 100,000 auto quotes a month, and compliance/document verification tooling (Suite 492 / ID Documental). Backed by 500 Global. The company publishes a marketing website but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Kinder Morgan
providers.description: Kinder Morgan is one of the largest energy infrastructure companies in North America, owning and operating pipelines and terminals that transport natural gas, refined petroleum products, crude oil, carbon dioxide, and other commodities. Kinder Morgan publishes pipeline informational postings and capacity data through Electronic Bulletin Board (EBB) portals; no public REST API or developer program has been identified at this time.

providers.name: Mandolin
providers.description: Mandolin (operating as Coral Automation, Inc.) is a San Francisco-based AI automation platform for specialty pharmaceutical workflows, serving infusion centers and specialty pharmacies. Its AI agents handle the complete back-office lifecycle — patient intake, benefits verification, prior authorization, claims, and revenue cycle management — by navigating existing systems, reading faxes, and reasoning over data rather than through developer integrations. The company explicitly markets a no-API, no-integration approach ("Every step, fully automated"), citing outcomes such as 24x faster document processing and eliminated prescription backlogs. Backed by Greylock and SV Angel.

providers.name: Menten AI
providers.description: Menten AI is a biotechnology company pioneering generative AI for peptide drug design. Its MAUD 1.0 platform designs peptide macrocycles de novo for complex, previously undruggable targets by combining generative AI with physics-based models and quantum simulations, reporting nanomolar potency, oral bioavailability, cell permeability, and a greater-than-90% hit rate. The company operates through enterprise partnerships with pharmaceutical organizations rather than a public developer platform, and at the time of this profile publishes no public API, SDK, or developer documentation. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: MISMO
providers.description: MISMO — the Mortgage Industry Standards Maintenance Organization — is the standards development body for US real estate finance, founded in 1999 and a not-for-profit wholly owned subsidiary of the Mortgage Bankers Association since 2004. Its Reference Model defines the data of a loan from application through closing, servicing and the secondary market, and version 3.6 ships an XML schema, a Logical Data Dictionary, a Unique ID Matrix and a YAML file set that conforms to the OpenAPI Specification, alongside a MISMO API Toolkit and services such as a FIPS Code API. Around the Reference Model sit sixteen dataset specifications — iLAD, the Mortgage Compliance Dataset, the IRS 4506-C, the VA forms, adverse action, closing instructions — plus SMART Doc and the eMortgage and eNote work, and certification programmes for RON, eClosing, eVault and SMART Doc systems. MISMO standards are accepted and deployed by every type of entity involved in creating mortgages and are required by most regulators, housing agencies and the GSEs. It governs in the open — fourteen bodies and their rosters are published — and distributes behind a $3,500 annual membership and a licence agreement, which is the exact inverse of the specifications-as-code posture CAMARA and NMFTA took.

providers.name: Model Medicines
providers.description: Model Medicines is an AI-first biotechnology company based in San Diego, California, discovering and developing first-in-class small-molecule drugs by targeting fundamental disease mechanisms it calls biological choke points. Its end-to-end GALILEO AI engine spans drug design, target discovery, and preclinical development, supported by specialized models including AmesNet for regulatory-grade toxicology prediction and ChemPrint for chemical property prediction. Lead programs target RdRp Thumb-1 (a conserved allosteric pocket on viral RNA-dependent RNA polymerase) and BRD4, with lead assets MDL-001, a broad-spectrum oral antiviral candidate, and MDL-4102. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Model Medicines publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface; its AI platform is used internally for drug discovery.

providers.name: Mtailor
providers.description: MTailor is a Y Combinator-backed custom-clothing company that measures your body with your phone's camera and manufactures made-to-order apparel on demand. Its mobile apps capture a short video or 360-degree turn and use machine-learning models to compute roughly 60 body measurements, which the company claims are about 20 percent more accurate than a professional tailor. MTailor produces custom shirts, polos, tees, pants, jeans, blazers and suits for men and jeans for women, each cut to the customer's unique measurement pattern. The business is a direct-to-consumer mobile app and e-commerce brand; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or first-party SDK. This APIs.json profile captures the company's identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: MultiLynq
providers.description: MultiLynq is a fixed income trading technology company founded in 2018 by Patrick Scheideler and Scott Collins and based in Shrewsbury, New Jersey. It sells market integration as a service: a single high-performance API that normalizes the messaging and trading protocols of every major and emerging electronic U.S. fixed income trading venue — including MarketAxess, Tradeweb, Trumid, Bloomberg, ICE Bonds, LTX by Broadridge, Liquidnet, Octaura, TMC Bonds and Bonds.com — into one interface for credit, municipal bond and loan trading. The platform covers pre- and post-trade workflows including price dissemination, market data aggregation, RFQ negotiation, portfolio trading, auction mechanisms, quoting conventions, smart order routing, and post-trade reporting and reconciliation, delivered as a fully hosted solution in which clients establish a single physical connection to a MultiLynq data center while MultiLynq maintains all upstream venue connectivity. The company has raised funding from Citadel Securities and Jane Street. The API is the entire product, but it is sold and onboarded through a sales conversation: MultiLynq publishes no public developer portal, documentation, specification, SDK or pricing.

providers.name: Nabla Bio
providers.description: Nabla Bio is a Cambridge, Massachusetts biotechnology company founded in 2021 as a Harvard spinout, building generative protein design systems for de novo biologics discovery. Its platform is JAM (Joint Atomic Modeling), a multimodal generative model trained on large-scale protein sequence and structure data that takes partial molecular context — a disease target or an epitope — and computationally designs the rest, producing de novo antibodies, VHH-Fc and full-length mAb formats, epitope scaffolds, cytokines, receptor traps and multi-domain multispecifics. The company pairs the model with an integrated wet lab that feeds mammalian, cellular and in vivo measurements back into training, and has published work on de novo design of GPCR-targeting antibodies against CXCR4 and CXCR7. Nabla Bio engages exclusively through pharmaceutical partnership and molecule licensing — with AstraZeneca, Bristol Myers Squibb and Takeda — and does not operate a public developer program, API, SDK or self-serve platform.

providers.name: New Story
providers.description: New Story is a US 501(c)(3) nonprofit building a housing market that helps vulnerable families in Latin America become homeowners. It develops underused land into affordable communities, enables families to own land, and connects them to credit and home financing. Founded in 2014 (Y Combinator W15), New Story has housed thousands of people across Haiti, Bolivia, Mexico, and El Salvador, partnered with ICON to build the first community of 3D-printed homes, and reports outcomes like 60% of land titles going to women and a 100% portfolio repayment rate. Its impact-investing arm operates as New Story Capital. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; New Story publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Onramp Payments
providers.description: Onramp Payments, Inc. (ONRAMP) is a fintech company building modern payments infrastructure for the commercial trucking and fleet industry. Founded by logistics and payments veterans and backed by Canaan Partners, the company operates an enterprise-grade digital platform that replaces legacy card-based fleet payment systems. For carriers it offers cardless fuel payments at the pump, administrative spend controls, and maintenance payment solutions; for merchants it provides digital payment acceptance, pricing controls, and fraud prevention that work both in-store and at fuel pumps; and for partners it offers API integrations, broker solutions, and Transportation Management System (TMS) connections. The company markets itself as the easiest, most secure payments platform for carriers and merchants and has raised roughly $21M from investors including Canaan Partners, CEAS Investments, Contour Venture Partners, Javelin Venture Partners, and RedBlue Capital. As of this enrichment pass ONRAMP publishes no public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or OpenAPI, so this profile captures verified company identity and probed domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Ossia
providers.description: Ossia, Inc. is a Redmond, Washington wireless power technology company founded by physicist Hatem Zeine (incorporated as Omnilectric in 2008, operating as Ossia from 2013) and the inventor of Cota Real Wireless Power — a patented RF smart-antenna system that delivers targeted energy over the air to multiple moving devices at a distance, without pads, plugs, cables or line of sight. A Cota receiver emits a beacon and the Cota transmitter returns a focused 2.4 GHz or 5.8 GHz power signal along the same path, which is how the system tracks and powers devices in motion. Ossia does not manufacture products for sale: it licenses the Cota technology to manufacturers, brands and OEMs, ships Cota developer and reference design kits (receiver chip, sample hardware, software components, test instructions) to authorized licensees, and works through joint ventures and development partners such as Motherson Ossia. The company holds 180+ US and international patents, is FCC certified under Parts 15 and 18, and carries regulatory approval in the US, UK and 45+ other countries. Ossia publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind — the developer surface it does have is hardware and firmware delivered under license.

providers.name: Panta
providers.description: Panta is an AI-native commercial insurance brokerage that automates the operations layer of insurance placement. Rather than selling software to brokers, Panta operates as a licensed broker (all 50 states) whose AI operators handle submissions, follow-ups, service, and renewals across file systems, carrier portals, email, phone, and PDFs. It focuses on hard-to-place Excess & Surplus (E&S) and heavy-industry risk — construction and trades, transportation and logistics (trucking fleets, owner-operators, cargo), manufacturing, and hospitality — placing coverage across General Liability, Workers Compensation, Commercial Auto, Property, Cyber, Professional Liability, Umbrella/Excess, and Employment Practices Liability through an A-rated carrier panel. Surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company. Panta publishes no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Pinnacle Financial
providers.description: Pinnacle Financial Partners, Inc. (NASDAQ: PNFP) is a Nashville, Tennessee based regional bank holding company whose principal subsidiary, Pinnacle Bank, is a Tennessee state-chartered, FDIC-insured commercial bank (FDIC Cert #35583) originally founded in 2000 as Pinnacle National Bank and renamed in 2012. Pinnacle operates across the Southeast — Tennessee, the Carolinas, Virginia, Georgia and Alabama — serving consumer, small-business, commercial and wealth clients. On the open-finance side Pinnacle runs NO public first-party developer API portal; its consumer digital and mobile banking is delivered on a third-party core/digital platform (Apiture), and consumer-permissioned account and transaction data is made available to fintechs only through data aggregators (Plaid and Finicity/Mastercard) rather than through a documented bank-operated API. No direct Financial Data Exchange (FDX) membership or published CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture was found; open-finance participation is aggregator-mediated.

providers.name: Pulse US Income API
providers.description: It was designed to solve the problem of calculating the future income trajectory of applicants in real-time.

providers.name: Realta Fusion
providers.description: Realta Fusion is a fusion-energy company developing compact, scalable, modular magnetic-mirror fusion systems branded CoSMo fusion to deliver zero-carbon heat and electricity for industrial energy needs. Backed by Khosla Ventures, the company designs prefabricated fusion modules that can be assembled to meet a variety of industrial power and process-heat requirements, targeting decarbonization of the roughly 37 billion metric tons of annual CO2 emissions from energy production. Realta Fusion is a hardware and energy-systems company and does not currently publish a public API, SDK, or developer platform; this profile tracks it in the API Evangelist network as a Khosla Ventures portfolio company.

providers.name: Relation Rx
providers.description: Relation Therapeutics (Relation Rx) is a London- and Boston-based end-to-end biotechnology company developing transformational medicines with technology at its core. The company combines single-cell multi-omics analysis of patient tissue, functional genomics and disease-relevant assays, and machine learning to decode disease biology, identify and validate therapeutic targets, and advance its own pipeline of drug candidates. Relation is a DCVC portfolio company and has announced research collaborations with partners including Novartis. It operates as a therapeutics developer rather than a software or API provider, and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications at this time.

providers.name: Rette
providers.description: Rette AI is a revenue cycle management (RCM) platform for small specialty medical practices, with an initial focus on orthopedic and other specialty clinics. It uses AI to convert clinical notes into structured, specialty-specific ICD-10 and CPT claim data, run payer-specific claims validation and eligibility checks, and manage denial appeals by analyzing root causes and generating payer-specific appeal letters. Rette integrates read-only with existing EHRs such as Athena, Epic, and eClinicalWorks without requiring data migration or workflow changes, and is HIPAA-compliant with Business Associate Agreements. Backed by 500 Global and a participant in StartX and Mayo Clinic Platform Accelerate. No public developer API is published at this time.

providers.name: Simr
providers.description: Simr (a registered trademark of The UberCloud, Inc., based in Los Altos, California) is a Simulation Operations Automation (SimOps) platform that streamlines complex engineering simulations across the product-development lifecycle. It provides self-service, automated infrastructure for running CFD, FEA, multi-physics, and system-level simulations with major solvers such as ANSYS, Abaqus, and COMSOL, deploying directly into customer-owned cloud environments on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, or on-premises. Simr targets enterprise manufacturers, reducing operational overhead for engineering teams while keeping data control and compliance security-first. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Earlybird and profiled in the API Evangelist network; as of this pass Simr publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Sizable Energy
providers.description: Sizable Energy is a Milan, Italy based clean-energy company developing offshore pumped hydro energy storage. Its patented system pairs subsea and floating reservoirs connected by pipes with reversible pump-turbines that move saturated sea-salt brine between them to deliver long-duration, grid-scale energy storage. The modular, scalable design leverages proven pumped-hydro technology with zero land use and integrates with floating wind and solar installations. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Playground Global; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Skeleton Technologies
providers.description: Skeleton Technologies is an Estonian-German energy storage manufacturer, founded in Tartu, Estonia in 2009 by Oliver Ahlberg and Taavi Madiberk, that designs and builds high-power supercapacitor and SuperBattery systems on its patented Curved Graphene material. Its product line spans SkelCap ultracapacitor cells, supercapacitor modules, and the GrapheneUPS, GrapheneGPU and GrapheneBBU power systems aimed at AI data centers, grid stability, defense, automotive, heavy transportation and industrial customers. The company has raised close to EUR 400 million, counts Marubeni and Siemens among its backers, and manufactures at its ISO 9001 / ISO 14001 certified Leipzig Superfactory in Germany, a Varkaus facility in Finland and a Curved Graphene plant in Bitterfeld-Wolfen. Skeleton sells physical power hardware; it operates no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Snowball *
providers.description: Snowball * is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of gv and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: consumer. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Spacee
providers.description: Spacee Inc. (株式会社スペイシー) is a Tokyo-based space-sharing and rental marketplace operator in Japan. Its consumer platforms let people discover and book temporary spaces by the hour: Yoyappin, a booking marketplace for meeting rooms, conference rooms, studios, kitchens and event venues across the Tokyo metropolitan area; THE POINT, a premium coworking and creative "third place" for remote workers; and Office Connect, a nationwide search service for shared offices, rental offices, coworking spaces and virtual offices. Spacee also expands via partnerships (e.g. JR West Japan) and acquisitions (GYYM pay-per-use fitness). It operates as a consumer web and mobile marketplace and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: tab32
providers.description: tab32 is a cloud-based dental practice management, imaging, and analytics platform for dental practices and dental service organizations (DSOs). tab32 offers a real, commercial API - powered by Google Apigee and HIPAA / SOC 2 Type II compliant - that exposes tab32's patient, provider, schedule, charts, notes, ledger, and payments data objects to DSOs and third-party developers. Access is partner-gated, not open self-service - developers reach the API through tab32's developer API portal after establishing a partnership or enterprise relationship, and full endpoint reference, authentication, and base URL details live behind that portal rather than on the public website. The API entries below are modeled from tab32's publicly documented data objects and API messaging; their endpoint paths are not published publicly and are therefore illustrative, not confirmed.

providers.name: Techmate
providers.description: Techmate is an on-demand IT field-services network that provides on-site, boots-on-the-ground ("Smart Hands") technical support across 450+ cities. It matches businesses and overstretched IT teams with certified local technicians for desktop and hardware support, network setup, audio/visual work, IT project management, and staff augmentation, with dashboards to track requests, spend, and work history across distributed offices. Techmate is a services marketplace rather than a developer/API platform; it publishes a public website and blog but no developer portal, API, or documentation surface. Added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio lead.

providers.name: Theta EdgeCloud
providers.description: Theta EdgeCloud is a distributed, hybrid AI and video cloud built on the Theta Network blockchain, offering on-demand GPU compute for AI model training, fine-tuning, inference, video transcoding, and live streaming. EdgeCloud aggregates GPU capacity from data-center hyperscaler partners and a global community of Edge Nodes (consumer and enterprise GPUs) into a single dispatchable compute layer addressable via REST, JSON-RPC, and SDK clients. Core services include EdgeCloud AI Services (on-demand model inference APIs for LLMs, image, audio, and multimodal models such as Llama, Stable Diffusion, FLUX, and Whisper; agentic RAG chatbots; GPU-backed Jupyter notebooks; dedicated GPU pod deployments; and AI training with GPU clusters), EdgeCloud Video Services (the Theta Video API for upload, transcoding, livestream ingestion, DRM, NFT-gated playback, and webhooks), EdgeStore (decentralized object storage), and the EdgeCloud Client (an installable node that earns TFUEL for contributing GPU and bandwidth). Developers authenticate with x-api-key tokens issued from the EdgeCloud dashboard, manage deployments programmatically through api.thetaedgecloud.com and the Node.js SDK @thetalabs/theta-edgecloud, and access on-demand model endpoints (also distributed through RapidAPI). The Theta blockchain layer is EVM-compatible with an Ethereum RPC adaptor, supports TNT-20 tokens and NFTs, and underwrites EdgeCloud's payment, rewards, and staking economy through the THETA governance token and TFUEL gas token. Theta operates as Theta Labs, headquartered in San Jose, California.

providers.name: Torus
providers.description: Torus is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) startup building an AI-powered engineering intelligence platform for capital projects. Its agents analyze engineering documents such as P&IDs, datasheets, specification sheets, and drawings to extract parameters, flag cross-document inconsistencies across 50+ categories, and automate workflow deliverables like procurement approvals and RFIs for infrastructure, data center, and energy projects. Torus runs as a managed cloud or a sovereign in-VPC deployment and publishes no public API or developer surface as of July 2026.

providers.name: Trial Library
providers.description: Trial Library is an AI-native oncology clinical trials technology company that integrates clinical trials into routine cancer care. Its provider-facing decision-support platform helps community oncology practices and health systems identify eligible patients and match them to open trials at the point of care, while a navigation layer supports patients through enrollment and completion by proactively addressing transportation, food, language, and scheduling barriers. Trial Library works across health systems, biopharma sponsors, and research sites to expand equitable access to cancer clinical trials. The company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of lux-capital.

providers.name: Vector Legal
providers.description: Vector Legal is an AI-native law firm and legal operating system for startups, combining senior startup attorneys (averaging 10+ years of Big Law experience) with proprietary software for formation, fundraising, commercial contracts, employment and equity, and M&A, priced around outcomes rather than billable hours. Legal services are provided by Vector Legal, P.C., a licensed California law firm; the platform is built by Vector Systems, PBC. A Y Combinator Winter 2026 company headquartered in San Francisco, also backed by Base10, Palm Drive Capital, and Amino Capital.

providers.name: Vial
providers.description: Vial is a next-generation biotech company advancing first and best-in-class biologics to treat unmet need in Immunology and Inflammation. The company pairs AI-driven drug discovery with automated, technology-enabled clinical trials, working across target discovery (identifying high-value therapeutic targets), molecule design (generating and optimizing molecular candidates), and experimental validation (high-throughput approaches to accelerate development). Its lead pipeline program is an IL-13 x TSLP bi-specific antibody in Phase 1. Vial was originally built as a tech-enabled contract research organization (CRO) focused on reimagining clinical trials, and was backed by General Catalyst. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; as of this enrichment pass Vial publishes no public developer, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Workplaced Technologies
providers.description: Workplaced (Workplaced Technologies Ltd) is a workplace-strategy and hybrid-work SaaS platform that helps companies create workplaces that work. Its products cover workplace experience surveys (Dynamics), office occupancy measurement beyond sensor data (Occupancy), space taxonomy and office planning (Taxonomy), desk and meeting-room booking (Booking), and hybrid work policy modelling (Balance), alongside a pricing calculator, free planning tools, research reports, and a partner program. Workplaced is a 500 Global portfolio company. It publishes no public developer program - the api.workplaced.com backend is fully authentication-gated with no public documentation or specification.

providers.name: AAK
providers.description: AAK AB is a Swedish producer of value-adding plant-based oils and fats, headquartered in Malmö and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (ticker AAK) in the Food & Beverage large-cap segment. It was formed in 2005 through the merger of Denmark's Aarhus United and Sweden's Karlshamns AB, and describes more than 150 years of combined experience in specialty vegetable oils. The company employs roughly 4,000 people across 19 production facilities, 25 regional sales offices and 16 Customer Innovation Centers, and works through a co-development model with customers in chocolate and confectionery, bakery, dairy and ice cream, plant-based foods, special nutrition, foodservice and retail, personal care, animal nutrition, candles and technical products such as fatty acids and glycerine. Its product is a physical industrial ingredient, not software: no developer program, public API, SDK, developer portal, machine-readable contract or GitHub organization could be found, and no api/developer/docs/portal hostname resolves under aak.com.

providers.name: Advance Composite
providers.description: Advance Composite Corporation (アドバンスコンポジット株式会社) is a Japanese advanced-materials manufacturer founded on 22 July 2015 and headquartered at 2259-9 Oobuchi, Fuji City, Shizuoka Prefecture, with a Tokyo branch in Otemachi, Chiyoda-ku. The company develops, manufactures and sells metal matrix composite (MMC) materials and joined products using a proprietary squeeze-casting / molten-metal forging process that impregnates reinforcement materials such as graphite, alumina and other ceramics with molten aluminium under high pressure, producing parts with few internal voids. Its published material families include the ACM-H series (New ACM-H1/H2/H3 aluminium-graphite composites), AC-Alox (aluminium/alumina) and AC-Albolon, marketed on high thermal conductivity, low thermal expansion, low density and high stiffness for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, data centres, air conditioning, medical devices, mobility and rail. It is ISO 9001:2015 certified (Intertek registration 15556, UKAS accredited, first issued 2023-11-08), won the IVS2025 LAUNCHPAD, and raised a Series B from Kyoto iCAP in 2026. Advance Composite is a physical-materials manufacturer, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, public API, SDK, or machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Aerofugia
providers.description: Aerofugia (沃飞长空, Sichuan Aerofugia Technology Development Co., Ltd.) is a Chengdu-based advanced air mobility company founded in 2020 under Zhejiang Geely Holding Group's Geely Technology Group, focused on the research, certification and commercial operation of low-altitude passenger aircraft. Its flagship product is the AE200 series, a six-seat all-electric piloted eVTOL with a roughly 200 km range aimed at intercity air mobility, low-altitude tourism and emergency medical transport; the AE200 was the first piloted eVTOL type certificate application accepted by the Civil Aviation Administration of China, has completed full tilt-transition flight testing, and the company holds a CCAR-135 air operator certificate. As of this profile Aerofugia publishes no public developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract: it is an aircraft manufacturer and future air-mobility operator, not a platform vendor.

providers.name: Agrist
providers.description: AGRIST Inc. (AGRIST株式会社) is a Japanese deep-tech agricultural robotics company founded in October 2019 and headquartered in Shintomi-cho, Koyu-gun, Miyazaki Prefecture, with an AI robot farm in Higashikushira (Kagoshima), an AI robot test facility in Shintomi-cho and the AGRIST Joso Farm in Joso City, Ibaraki. Its flagship product is "L", an automatic bell-pepper harvesting robot that travels along overhead wires strung between greenhouse rows rather than on ground rails, using multiple cameras and a proprietary computer-vision model to find and cut harvest-ready fruit through layered foliage; a cucumber harvesting robot followed. Around the hardware the company sells AGRIST Ai, a greenhouse cultivation-support and yield-forecasting system fed by robot patrol data and environmental sensors, and it operates its own farms plus Smart Agri University (SAU), a nine-month smart-agriculture training program. AGRIST is venture-backed through a Series B that includes Mizuho Capital, Global Infrastructure Management, Nippon Steel Kowa Real Estate, Nippon Express Holdings, Takamiya and Sparx, and has taken more than 27 domestic and international awards including a CES 2023 Innovation Award and a Japanese Minister of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries Award. It is a robotics and farm-operations business, not a software vendor: as of 2026-09-13 it publishes no developer program, no public API, no SDK and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: AgroUrbana
providers.description: AgroUrbana SpA is a Chilean vertical-farming company founded in 2018 in Santiago by Pablo Bunster and Cristian Sjogren, and widely described as the first commercial vertical farm in Latin America. It runs climate-controlled indoor grow facilities combining hydroponics, spectrum-programmed LED lighting, renewable energy, automation and data analytics to produce leafy greens year round, reporting up to twelve growing cycles a year and up to 95% less water use than open-field agriculture. Produce is sold to Chilean retailers including Cencosud and Walmart Chile, and direct to consumers under the Urban Rabbit brand through a hosted online store. The company has raised roughly USD 12 million, including a USD 4 million Series A led by Kayyak Ventures and a USD 6 million pre-Series B led by ALB Inversiones. AgroUrbana operates its technology internally to run its own farms and publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Ajaxhealth
providers.description: Ajaxhealth is a global investment firm focused on building and scaling high-quality healthcare businesses. It partners with industry leaders to innovate in medical technology, supporting companies through growth capital and strategic guidance. The firm operates across multiple locations including Menlo Park, New York, Austin, and Los Angeles, and engages in activities such as investing, mentorship, and fostering collaborations to advance healthcare solutions.

providers.name: Ajeer
providers.description: Ajeer (iajeer.com) is a Saudi Arabian on-demand services platform for home and facility maintenance and operations (خدمات الصيانة والتشغيل). Through its mobile application customers request residential maintenance, general labor, installation, plumbing, electrical, and air-conditioning services, connecting them with vetted service providers. Ajeer is a portfolio company of 500 Global, surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a company profile. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's public web surface and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Altos Labs
providers.description: Altos Labs is a biotechnology company pursuing cellular rejuvenation programming to restore cell health and resilience, with the goal of reversing disease, injury, and the disabilities that can occur throughout life. Launched publicly in January 2022 with roughly $3 billion in initial funding from investors including Jeff Bezos and Yuri Milner, the company operates geographically distributed Institutes of Science in the San Francisco Bay Area, Cambridge (UK), and San Diego, alongside an Institute of Medicine and an Institute of Computation. Altos combines experimental biologists with computational scientists to translate laboratory discoveries in cell biology into transformative medicines. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network; as a research-stage life-sciences company it currently exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Anycubic
providers.description: Anycubic is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: secondary-market) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: ApnaMart
providers.description: ApnaMart (Apna Mart) is a Bengaluru-based Indian retail and quick-commerce company founded in 2022 by Chetan Kumar Garg and Abhishek Singh. It operates a network of franchise-model neighborhood grocery and FMCG stores combined with a 15-minute delivery app, serving customers across roughly 14 cities including tier-2 and tier-3 markets such as Ranchi, Hazaribagh, and Bilaspur. Backed by Accel, Peak XV, and Fundamentum, the company blends brick-and-mortar retail with on-demand delivery of daily essentials. ApnaMart is a consumer retail business and does not publish a public developer platform or API surface; this profile in the API Evangelist network captures its identity, domain-security posture, and published web properties.

providers.name: Apogee Interactive
providers.description: Apogee Interactive, operating as Apogee Entertainment, is an indie game publisher that supports developers with marketing, global exposure, and publishing services. Founded on the legacy of pioneering titles from the 1990s, it continues to partner with modern indie studios to bring innovative games to market, offering resources such as dev blogs, community engagement, and distribution support.

providers.name: Arfa
providers.description: Arfa Technologies is a web development and digital services company offering graphic design, e‑commerce, app development, SEO, and social media marketing. Based in New York, it serves consumer brands with custom digital solutions and a portfolio of design and development projects.

providers.name: Ariacv
providers.description: Aria CV, Inc. is developing a medical device to treat pulmonary hypertension, a life‑threatening disease with limited therapeutic options. The company aims to provide a less invasive, cost‑effective solution compared to expensive drug therapies, addressing a significant unmet medical need.

providers.name: Art19
providers.description: Art19 (ART19, Inc.) is a podcast hosting, distribution, and monetization platform, and an Amazon company. It provides publishers, networks, and enterprises with a content management system for audio, automated RSS feed generation, dynamic ad insertion and targeting through its WarpFeed feed technology, and an embeddable Web Player. The platform serves podcast delivery, analytics, and advertising workflows at scale. Art19 does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal; its public presence consists of a marketing site, a contact page, a privacy policy, and a system status page tracking CMS, RSS, WarpFeed, and Web Player availability.

providers.name: Barakah
providers.description: Barakah is a Saudi foodtech company operating a consumer mobile marketplace that fights food waste by connecting restaurants, cafes, hotels, bakeries, and grocery retailers with consumers who buy their surplus, still-fresh meals and food products at discounts of up to 70 percent for pickup or delivery. Founded in Jeddah and backed by 500 Global, FoodLabs, and Salica Investments, Barakah has grown into one of the most downloaded food and drink apps in Saudi Arabia with partnerships across more than 800 merchants, including global brands. Barakah is a business-to-consumer mobile application and does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, or SDK; this profile captures its identity and public web surface.

providers.name: Barnes & Noble
providers.description: Barnes & Noble is the largest retail bookseller in the United States and the operator of the Nook digital reading platform. Barnes & Noble does not currently publish a public general-purpose developer portal. Trade and affiliate partners integrate through B&N's affiliate program, the B&N Press self-publishing platform for independent authors, EDI-based wholesale channels with publishers, and the Nook content distribution and reading ecosystem.

providers.name: Bitauto
providers.description: Bitauto (易车, Yiche) is one of China's largest automotive internet companies, founded in 2000 with the mission of making car ownership simpler. It operates consumer-facing platforms that provide car buyers with pricing, reviews, specifications, and automotive news across new and used vehicles, alongside an enterprise EP (dealer) platform offering web-based digital marketing and CRM applications to Chinese automobile dealers. Bitauto runs regional informational portals across 20+ countries cataloging Chinese car brands. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCM Ventures; as of enrichment Bitauto publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: BLAST
providers.description: BLAST is a Danish esports and gaming entertainment company headquartered in Copenhagen, founded in 2016.
