It produces and operates premier competitive gaming tournaments and leagues (notably Counter-Strike BLAST Premier) and runs the blast.tv streaming and fan-engagement platform, delivering live events, broadcasts, and interactive esports content to a global audience. Backed by Creandum, Heartcore, Maki.vc, and Vaekstfonden, BLAST was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead company. No public developer API, portal, or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures verifiable identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Breadfast
providers.description: Breadfast is an Egyptian quick-commerce and online grocery platform, founded in 2017 in Cairo by Mostafa Amin, Muhammad Habib, and Abdallah Nofal. It delivers groceries, freshly baked bread, dairy, fresh produce, ready-to-eat meals, household essentials, pharmacy, and beauty products — more than 7,000 SKUs — to customers in roughly 60 minutes through a vertically integrated network of dark stores and company-owned bakeries, and also operates Breadfast Pay fintech services. The company serves 300,000+ active users across Cairo, Giza, Alexandria, and Mansoura and processes close to a million orders a month. Breadfast runs a consumer WordPress/WooCommerce marketing site and native iOS/Android apps and does not publish a public developer API; this profile tracks the company in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Brimstone
providers.description: Brimstone is a materials technology company decarbonizing heavy industry through a single-rock co-production process it calls the Rock Refinery. From ordinary calcium silicate rock it extracts multiple high-value materials at once - carbon-negative Portland cement and supplementary cementitious materials, alumina and aluminum, magnesium, titanium, iron/steel feedstock and critical minerals - aiming to use 100% of the feed rock and eliminate tailings while cutting process emissions. The company uses commercially available equipment for a low-cost, market-ready approach, and has secured commitments including Amazon as a buyer of low-carbon cement from its first commercial plant. Brimstone is a private heavy-industry / climate-tech company backed by DCVC and Fifth Wall; it operates no public developer API.

providers.name: Bruce Markets
providers.description: Bruce Markets operates as a secondary market platform enabling the buying and selling of private company shares. Hosted on the Nasdaq Private Market, it provides liquidity solutions for pre-IPO stock, structured secondary transactions, and capital solutions for private firms and investors. The platform facilitates secure, compliant transactions, offering tools for investors, companies, and advisors to manage equity ownership and liquidity events in the private market ecosystem.

providers.name: Brumby
providers.description: Brumby (formerly GrazeMate) is a Y Combinator-backed (W2026) precision-grazing company based in Sydney, Australia, building an autonomous drone toolkit for cattle ranchers. Brumby drones plan routes and move herds with gentle, AI-guided pressure, fly scheduled monitoring missions that locate and count every animal, measure standing dry-matter pasture biomass from the air, and inspect water troughs, tanks and fences on every flight — all managed from a single phone app that works online or in a local base-station mode without connectivity. The company is running pilot programs and does not yet publish a public API, developer portal, or documentation; this profile is a company lead maintained in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Buildots
providers.description: Buildots is an AI-powered construction intelligence platform headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel, with offices in London and the United States. The company combines 360-degree hardhat-mounted cameras with computer vision and machine learning models that automatically capture, locate, and classify on-site construction progress against the project BIM model and schedule, producing trade-level performance data, deviation and delay detection, and portfolio-wide analytics for general contractors, project teams, executives, and owners. Buildots reports that projects using the platform together with a performance-driven operating approach have reduced delays by up to 50%. The product family includes Buildots (the AI construction intelligence platform), Genda (workforce intelligence), and a fully managed Capture Services operation that handles routine site capture for customers. Verticals served include data centers, commercial, multifamily, healthcare, industrial, education, and airports. Notable customers shown on the website include Intel, Mortenson, JE Dunn, Turner, Wates, and STO. Buildots was founded in 2018 and is led by CEO and co-founder Roy Danon with co-founders Aviv Leibovici (CPO) and Yakir Sudry (CCO). Investors include Lightspeed Venture Partners, Future Energy Ventures, Viola Ventures, TLV Partners, OG Ventures, and Tencent. Buildots does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; integrations with construction software (e.g., Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud) are arranged directly through the company.

providers.name: Cambium
providers.description: Cambium is an advanced materials company (Cambium Biomaterials, El Segundo, California, founded 2019) that molecularly re-engineers polymers from first principles, pairing AI-driven molecular design with chemistry, materials science, biology, and agile domestic manufacturing to develop and scale next-generation materials roughly 10x faster than traditional methods. Product lines span thermal protection systems, high-temperature structural polymers, and laser/directed-energy protection, serving aerospace, space, defense, motorsport, automotive, marine, and industrial customers. Its SHD Advanced Composites business runs rapid-response prepreg manufacturing across the US, UK, and EU. Backed by 8VC. Cambium publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures corporate identity and probed domain security only.

providers.name: CAMP4 Therapeutics
providers.description: CAMP4 Therapeutics is a clinical-stage RNA-medicines biotechnology company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, pioneering a new class of antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) therapeutics designed to increase targeted gene expression. Built on the company's RAP Platform (Regulatory RNA Activating Platform), which combines epigenomics, computational biology, and machine learning to map the regulatory RNA and signaling circuits controlling gene expression, CAMP4 develops first-in-class medicines for diseases caused by insufficient protein expression, with an initial focus on central nervous system and metabolic disorders such as urea cycle disorders and SYNGAP1. Founded by CEO Josh Mandel-Brehm with scientific co-founders Rick Young (Whitehead Institute/MIT) and Len Zon (Boston Children's Hospital/Harvard), CAMP4 is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). This is a corporate/therapeutics company profile in the API Evangelist network; CAMP4 publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal, so no API artifacts apply.

providers.name: Coinone
providers.description: Coinone (코인원) is a South Korean cryptocurrency exchange offering trading of Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other digital assets. It provides a user-friendly platform with features such as staking, smart trading, and a public Open API for developers. The exchange emphasizes security, fast transaction processing, and a range of services including fiat deposits, withdrawals, and market insights.

providers.name: Corflowtherapeuticsag
providers.description: Corflow Therapeutics AG develops diagnostic and therapeutic solutions aimed at restoring healthy microvascular blood flow in patients suffering from microvascular obstruction, such as those experiencing heart attacks. The company’s vision is to be the leader in delivering innovative platforms that address critical microvascular needs across the human body, leveraging advanced imaging and drug delivery technologies to improve outcomes.

providers.name: Crete Professionals Alliance
providers.description: Crete Professionals Alliance (rebranded in 2025 as "Current", current.co) is a growth platform for independent accounting firms, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. The alliance provides member firms with technology, talent, capital, and strategy to compete at enterprise scale, spanning 48 partner firms across 39 states and 3 countries with more than 2,000 employees. Service lines include accounting, advisory, audit and attest, client accounting services, and tax. This is a professional services / accounting company, not a developer-facing API provider: it publishes no developer portal, API, SDKs, or technical documentation. The record is maintained in the API Evangelist network for portfolio-graph coverage of Bessemer holdings.

providers.name: Cyclic Materials
providers.description: Cyclic Materials is a Kingston, Ontario cleantech company founded in 2021 that is building a circular supply chain for rare earth elements and other critical materials. It recovers neodymium-praseodymium (NdPr), samarium, gadolinium, terbium and dysprosium from end-of-life magnet-containing products — electric-vehicle motors, wind-turbine generators, MRI machines and e-waste — using its proprietary MagCycle magnet-separation and REEPure refining processes, and supplies recycled mixed rare earth oxide (rMREO) and recycled copper back into automotive, data-centre, defence and energy manufacturing. The company operates a REEPure commercial demonstration plant and a MagCycle pilot in Kingston, with a Centre of Excellence under construction there and campuses planned in Arizona and South Carolina. It is a materials producer, not a software vendor: it publishes no API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable specification, and its only public application surface is an Auth0-gated supplier portal for recyclers, aggregators and core buyers.

providers.name: Dailymotion
providers.description: Dailymotion Developer API

providers.name: Disrupt
providers.description: Disrupt Technology Venture is a Bangkok, Thailand-based organization focused on building the country's startup ecosystem and developing future-ready business leaders through education, executive training, and venture investment. Its offerings include the House of Talents (HOT) executive leadership curriculum, the Advanced Executive Program (AXP), corporate in-house training, and the Disrupt MBA online course platform, alongside investment vehicles such as the Disrupt Health Impact Fund (deep-tech healthcare) and the Stormbreaker edtech startup accelerator. Disrupt reports 1,500+ program alumni, 20+ corporate clients (including KBank, PTT, Unilever, and Central Group), and that 7 of the top 10 Thai startups count Disrupt alumni among their founders. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. Disrupt publishes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Distance
providers.description: Distance (Distance Technologies) is a Helsinki-based frontier-tech company pioneering glasses-free extended reality (XR) built on computational optics and lightfield technology. Its systems turn transparent surfaces — vehicle windshields, aircraft canopies, and head-mounted visors — into intelligent heads-up displays without screens, overlays, or wearable glasses. Products include the Acuity visual-intelligence platform and Acuity OS for defense, the Field Operator HUD (FOH) head-mounted system in field trials across NATO countries, and panoramic lightfield HUDs for automotive ADAS and navigation. Distance is backed by GV (Google Ventures) and partners with defense, aerospace, and automotive organizations including Kia, Supacat, Galvion, Patria, and General Dynamics. The company publishes no public API or developer program; this profile tracks its identity and public web surface in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: ENGIE
providers.description: ENGIE is a global energy player headquartered in France, providing electricity, natural gas, and energy services to millions of customers worldwide. The company focuses on sustainable development, renewable energy projects, and digital transformation of its operations. ENGIE’s portfolio includes power generation, distribution, and innovative solutions for energy efficiency, electric mobility, and smart grids, positioning it as a leader in the transition to low‑carbon economies.

providers.name: Excite Japan Co., Ltd. (JASDAQ:3754)
providers.description: Excite Japan Co., Ltd. (エキサイト株式会社), listed on JASDAQ as ticker 3754, is a Tokyo-based internet media and services company founded in August 1997 and headquartered in the Azabudai Hills Mori JP Tower in Minato, Tokyo. It operates the long-running excite.co.jp web portal — offering web, image, and news search, the Excite Blog (exblog.jp) blogging platform, translation and dictionary tools, fortune-telling, recipe, and lifestyle content — alongside the BB.excite broadband/ISP business. Under parent Excite Holdings Co., Ltd., the group organizes its operations into four segments: Platform, Broadband, Medical, and SaaS/DX (including the FanGrowth customer-growth platform). The company does not currently publish a public developer API program or portal; this profile tracks its corporate and web presence within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Foxintelligence
providers.description: Foxintelligence was a French e-commerce measurement and consumer-insights company that aggregated anonymized online purchase data from email receipts across millions of e-shoppers to give brands and retailers competitive intelligence on where, when, and how much consumers buy online. It was acquired by NielsenIQ and operates today as the "NIQ Digital Purchases" product; the original www.foxintelligence.io domain now 301-redirects to nielseniq.com. The surviving first-party surface is the customer web application at app.foxintelligence.io (login only). No public API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer documentation is published; this profile is maintained as an acquired-company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: freshEHR
providers.description: freshEHR Clinical Informatics Ltd is a UK open-standards health and social care informatics consultancy, founded in 2014 by Dr Ian McNicoll and registered in England as company 08989238. It provides openEHR and HL7 FHIR expertise rather than a software product: openEHR strategy, analysis, design and governance of clinical models (archetypes and templates), curation, terminology and data mapping across SNOMED CT, dm+d and ICD, data exchange work across HL7 V2, HL7 CDA and HL7 FHIR, plus specialist training and mentoring in clinical modelling. Its work spans NHS England, NHS Education for Scotland, Digital Health and Care Wales, HSE Ireland, One London, CatSalut in Catalonia, the Jamaican Ministry of Health and Wellness, and Karolinska University Hospital. freshEHR operates no API of its own — no developer portal, no public API reference, and no machine-readable contract on any host it controls, verified 2026-09-02.

providers.name: Fullcourt
providers.description: Fullcourt is an ecommerce helpdesk built for direct-to-consumer (DTC) Shopify brands, consolidating email, Shopify, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok into a single fast support inbox with live chat, a self-service knowledge base, AI-assisted agent and customer replies, keyboard-driven navigation (command-K search), and automation and triage rules. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network under the stub slug "japan"; enrichment found a Webflow marketing site plus a hosted web app but no public developer API, docs, SDKs, or MCP surface.

providers.name: Genesis Digital Assets
providers.description: Genesis Digital Assets (GDA) is a global digital infrastructure company that designs, builds, and operates industrial-scale data centers for high-performance computing workloads, including Bitcoin networks and AI operations. GDA runs mining and computing facilities across multiple countries and does not sell products or services to the public. Surfaced as a portfolio company of electric-capital, paradigm, and ribbit-capital in the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, portal, or SDK is published as of this pass.

providers.name: Grassroots Unwired
providers.description: Grassroots Unwired is a mobile-first platform for face-to-face (F2F) outreach, advocacy, and fundraising, purpose-built for political campaigns, nonprofits, labor unions, and community organizations. Its offline-capable mobile apps let field teams run GPS-enabled door-to-door canvassing, capture in-person and peer-to-peer donations, send SMS and digital content from the field, and manage event check-in, registration, and merchandise operations for 4EventDay. The platform keeps collecting data, donations, and check-ins even when Wi-Fi and cell coverage are spotty, then syncs in real time with major CRM, donor, and payment systems (EveryAction, NGP VAN, Blackbaud Luminate, NeonCRM, Stripe, and others).

providers.name: GuildFi
providers.description: GuildFi was a Web3 gaming platform and guild that aggregated blockchain games, quests, achievements, and rewards into a single account layer, letting players discover games and earn across the play-to-earn ecosystem (native token GF). It was backed by Pantera Capital, Coinbase Ventures, Animoca Brands, and other crypto investors. In 2024 GuildFi rebranded and consolidated into Zentry (zentry.com), a self-described "Human-Agentic OS" spanning gaming (Radiant), a data layer (zData), an agent layer (zAI), and the ZENT token. The original guildfi.com domain is now defunct (expired TLS certificate, 404s) and GuildFi/Zentry publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or agent surface as of this enrichment pass. This record is a portfolio-lead stub retained for lineage; see x-successor for the live entity.

providers.name: Habyt
providers.description: Habyt is a flexible-living and co-living accommodation provider offering furnished studios, apartments, and private rooms for stays ranging from a single night to several months. Positioned as "a new category of living for people in motion," the company blends hotel-style service and amenities with residential flexibility, targeting mobile professionals, relocators, and long-term travelers. Habyt operates properties across Europe (Berlin, Madrid, Vienna, with Lisbon and Milan announced) and Asia (multiple locations in Singapore), and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of HV Capital. Habyt is a consumer real-estate and hospitality operator rather than an API-first technology provider; as of this enrichment pass no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface was found.

providers.name: Hertha Metals
providers.description: Hertha Metals is a hard-technology steel production company based in Conroe, Texas, working to decarbonize and modernize primary steelmaking after centuries of coke-based blast-furnace iron and steel production. Founded by Laureen Meroueh, the company has developed proprietary pyrometallurgical HERS and Flex-HERS technology that produces steel from flexible feedstocks in a single reactor, and has raised roughly $17M toward a commercial steel plant. Hertha Metals is an industrial / climate-tech manufacturer with no public API, developer portal, or programmatic surface; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a Khosla Ventures portfolio company profile.

providers.name: IndieFlow
providers.description: IndieFlow is an all-in-one music management platform for independent artists and their managers, positioning itself as a "Shopify for musicians." Made by musicians, it centralizes the business side of an independent music career in one place: distributing releases to 30+ streaming services (Spotify, Apple Music, Tidal, Deezer, TikTok and more), collecting and registering royalties and songwriter/publisher credits with performing rights organizations, managing creative projects and release schedules, promoting music, booking gigs, and handling payments and collaborations. Founded in 2020, the company raised a $4M round led by State of Mind Ventures with participation from Techstars and other investors, and its artist-facing distribution is delivered through a Revelator-powered back end. IndieFlow does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile tracks the company's public web presence.

providers.name: Inventa
providers.description: Inventa is a Brazilian B2B commerce platform — a "B2B commerce cloud" — that integrates technology, credit, and logistics on a single platform so brands and distributors can scale wholesale sales in Brazil. Its products include a sales platform that syncs catalogs, orders, inventory, and prices across B2B e-commerce sites and marketplaces via ERP integrations; a field-sales mobile app for sellers; automated credit analysis and approval; shared distribution-center logistics (OMS/WMS/TMS) with fulfillment and 72-hour delivery in the São Paulo region; multichannel customer support; and business-intelligence dashboards. Solution packages span Fulfillment, Response, FullService, and a pay-per-use OnDemand model. The company is headquartered in São Paulo. Inventa configures the API and connector integrations for its customers rather than publishing a public developer portal, so it has no public API artifacts as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Inyad
providers.description: Inyad is an all-in-one business management and payments platform for small and medium businesses across Morocco, the Middle East, and Africa. Its mobile-first apps let merchants sell, get paid, and run their operations from one place — including a smart point-of-sale (POS Mahaal), automatic invoicing, an online store builder, employee attendance and payroll (Staff), a digital credit book (Konnash), in-store card terminals and terminal-free digital collection (Collect), professional business accounts, and money-transfer services. The company reports 250,000+ professionals on the platform and is backed by investors including Partech, Al Mada Ventures, CDG Invest, and FJ Labs. Inyad exposes an internal application backend (api.inyad.com) but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: iTAC Software
providers.description: iTAC Software AG is an independent company of the Duerr Group and a leading provider of Manufacturing Execution System (MES) and Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM) software for discrete manufacturing. Its iTAC.MOM.Suite delivers production control, end-to-end traceability, quality management, and AI-supported analytics that help automotive, electronics, and medical-technology manufacturers implement Industry 4.0 and smart-factory operations. iTAC does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; system integration is delivered through the MOM platform's IoT and connectivity layers as part of a project engagement.

providers.name: K2 Integrity
providers.description: K2 Integrity is a global risk, compliance, and investigations advisory firm specializing in financial crimes risk management, regulatory compliance, fraud detection, asset tracing and recovery, cybersecurity and AI resilience, crypto and digital-asset solutions, internal audit, and independent monitoring. It serves financial institutions, corporations, governments, and law firms worldwide. K2 Integrity was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; this profile has been enriched but the firm publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Khmer Home
providers.description: Khmerhome (khmerhome.com) is Cambodia's real estate marketplace, based in Phnom Penh, connecting buyers, renters, and property owners across houses, apartments, condos, villas, boreys, land, warehouses, and commercial spaces. The platform offers property search and browsing, sales and rental listings with photos and agent details, property valuation and appraisal tools, an articles section covering Cambodian economic and property developments, and community events for real estate professionals and expats. Khmerhome ships native iOS and Android mobile apps and operates alongside sister sites khmerload.com and khmercars.com. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and profiled in the API Evangelist network. No public developer/API surface, OpenAPI specification, or documentation portal has been found at this time.

providers.name: LIMRA
providers.description: LIMRA is a member-based research and trade association for the life insurance and financial services industry, operating alongside LOMA under the LL Global umbrella. It provides industry research, sales and market data, benchmarking, experience studies, and professional development to member companies - primarily life insurers, annuity providers, and workplace benefits carriers. LIMRA does not operate a public developer API or developer portal. Its research, benchmarking, and experience-study data are delivered through the member-gated LIMRA.com portal, reports, and consortium programs rather than a programmatic interface. LIMRA's most API-relevant offering is the LIMRA Data Exchange (LDEx) Standards - free, industry-developed data exchange standards for workplace benefits (benefits enrollment management, benefits configuration management, and evidence of insurability) that define payloads in XML and JSON and, in recent releases, REST endpoints specified in OpenAPI 3.1. LDEx is a specification that insurance carriers and benefits administration platforms implement between themselves; LIMRA publishes the standard (registration required to download, membership not required) but does not host any live endpoints. This entry is an honest documentation stub kept for catalog completeness; it will be updated if LIMRA ever ships a hosted public API.

providers.name: Lynq
providers.description: Lynq Networks develops infrastructure-free, long-range wireless connectivity for enterprise and OEM devices, bridging the gap between short-range Bluetooth and infrastructure-dependent cellular/5G. Its technology lets original equipment manufacturers build large-area device networks without deploying traditional network infrastructure, targeting construction, agriculture, military, and public-safety use cases. Lynq is a Techstars-backed portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API documentation; this profile captures its identity and a domain-security probe for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Maywood
providers.description: Maywood is a Y Combinator (W26) artificial-intelligence startup building a finance-compliant, proactive AI platform that automates deal execution for investment banks. The product runs continuously across a banker's network, pipeline, and active M&A processes, generating client-ready CIMs, pitch decks, and financial models, drafting outreach in the banker's voice, and managing due-diligence workflows through a connected data layer that updates automatically. Maywood is built to FINRA and SEC requirements: autonomous within scope, human-approved at every external boundary, and fully reconstructable in between. Founded in 2026 and based in New York City, it is an early-stage SaaS company with no public developer API at this time; this profile tracks its public web, security, and trust surfaces so the network can detect an API program when one appears.

providers.name: McDonald's
providers.description: McDonald's is the world's leading global foodservice retailer, operating and franchising fast food restaurants serving hamburgers, chicken, breakfast items, soft drinks, milkshakes, and desserts in countries around the world. McDonald's does not operate a public developer program or publish open API documentation. Its digital surface — the Global Mobile App, MyMcDonald's Rewards loyalty, mobile order & pay, kiosks, and drive-thru personalization — runs on internal platforms, and integrations with delivery marketplaces (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub) and technology partners (Google Cloud, Dynamic Yield) are bilateral and gated to approved partners and franchisees.

providers.name: MeridianLink
providers.description: MeridianLink provides a powerful web service enabling software applications to retrieve consumer credit data in XML format. It offers lending and credit platform solutions for financial institutions.

providers.name: Mighty Buildings
providers.description: Mighty Buildings is a construction-technology and advanced-manufacturing company that industrializes homebuilding using large-format 3D printing, proprietary polymer-composite materials and robotic automation. Founded in 2019 and originally based in Oakland, California, it raised more than $150 million from investors including Khosla Ventures, Bold Capital and Aramco's Wa'ed Ventures, and was the first company certified under the UL 3401 standard for evaluating building structures and assemblies, as well as being certified under California's Factory Built Housing program. Its current product is the Mighty Kit System / Mighty Wall System - factory-made complete wall panels that arrive on site with integrated structure, insulation, waterproofing and exterior finish, so builders assemble a building envelope with conventional methods and fewer on-site steps. After a January 2025 restructuring and sale process, the full suite of Mighty Buildings technologies was acquired by LUMUS Inc., and Mighty Buildings now operates as a LUMUS brand headquartered in Beaverton, Oregon. The company sells physical building systems to developers and builders; it operates no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Miniso
providers.description: MINISO is a global value retailer of lifestyle and consumer products — home goods, accessories, cosmetics, stationery, toys and seasonal items — known for its IP-collaboration merchandise (Harry Potter, PEANUTS, Sanrio, BT21 and others). Founded in Guangzhou, China and publicly listed (NYSE/HKEX), the company operates 7,700+ stores across 112 markets worldwide. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Hillhouse; the public web presence is consumer- and investor-facing and exposes no developer API, developer portal, or partner integration platform at this time.

providers.name: Mitra Chem
providers.description: Mitra Chem is an AI-enabled innovator and manufacturer of battery and critical materials for energy, AI infrastructure and defense applications, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Mountain View, California. Its first commercial product is iron-based lithium iron phosphate (LFP) and lithium manganese iron phosphate (LMFP) cathode active material produced for Western battery cell makers and energy-storage OEMs as a non-China supply source. The company operates The Foundry, an instrumented shared pilot manufacturing facility spanning wet chemistry, hydrometallurgy, particle sizing, drying and heat treatment, and runs an internal full-stack AI platform of physics-based models, digital twins and engineering co-pilots used to compress materials scale-up cost and timelines. The AI platform is internal tooling for Mitra Chem's own manufacturing operations; it is not sold or exposed as a software product, and the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Mosa Meat
providers.description: Mosa Meat is a European food technology company headquartered in Maastricht, the Netherlands, founded in 2016 as a spin-off of Maastricht University by Mark Post and Peter Verstrate. The company develops cultivated (cell-cultured) beef using cellular agriculture: a small cell sample taken from a cow is nurtured through natural processes into muscle and fat tissue, which the company states can yield up to 80,000 burgers from a single sample. Mosa Meat produced the world's first cultured beef hamburger in 2013 and now operates the Mosa C.A.M.P.U.S. (Center for Advanced Meat Production, Upscaling, and Sustainability) in Maastricht, reported as the largest cultivated meat campus in the world. It is a B Corp certified organization pursuing regulatory approval and market entry for cultivated beef burgers. Mosa Meat is a laboratory and food production business; it publishes no developer program, public API, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: NcodiN
providers.description: NcodiN is a French deep-tech company developing optical interconnect technology for high-performance computing and AI infrastructure. Founded in Palaiseau, France, the company builds miniaturized lasers integrated directly on silicon to replace traditional copper connections between chiplets and processors, aiming to break the "copper wall" that limits AI scaling. Its photonic interconnects promise petabit-per-second bandwidth with roughly a thousand times less energy to move data than copper links, targeting AI, telecommunications, autonomous driving, smart cities, healthcare, and climate modeling. NcodiN is backed by venture firms including Earlybird, Elaia, OVNI Capital, and Verve Ventures, is advised by major chip and equipment makers such as NVIDIA, Qualcomm, Intel, and ASML, and joined the FrenchTech2030 cohort in November 2025. As a semiconductor and photonics hardware company it sells to chipmakers and does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Neocarbon
providers.description: NeoCarbon GmbH is a Berlin-based climate-technology company building integrated cooling and carbon-capture systems for data centers. Its patented Hollow Fiber platform converts low-grade waste heat (30-55C) simultaneously into efficient cooling, captured CO2 for industrial reuse, and recovered water, deployed as a retrofit without redesigning existing infrastructure. Backed by Speedinvest, the company operates as an industrial hardware and climate-infrastructure business and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or an API developer portal.

providers.name: newmo
providers.description: newmo (newmo株式会社, "ニューモ") is a Japanese mobility company with the mission "移動で地域をカラフルに" — coloring regions through movement. It modernizes regional transportation through a consumer ride-hailing app and taxi service (newmo-taxi.jp), driver recruitment and dispatch, and its newmo Autonomy initiative (newmo.ai), which since 2025 has run Level 4 autonomous-driving taxi trials spanning safety, remote monitoring, operations design, and vehicle integration. newmo is a consumer transportation service rather than a developer/API platform; probing found no public API, developer portal, documentation, or well-known discovery surface. Backed by DCM Ventures.

providers.name: Nodal Industries
providers.description: Nodal Industries, operating as Nodal Security, is a network security company and 500 Global portfolio startup that makes Numa, a plug-and-play network security appliance providing protective oversight of every connected device on a home or small-office network. Rather than per-device antivirus software, Numa works at the network layer, intercepting malicious traffic before it reaches devices using real-time threat intelligence powered by Suricata, with automatic updates and minimal setup. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing website only and exposes no public API, SDK, developer documentation, or event surface.

providers.name: Notco
providers.description: NotCo (The Not Company) is a food-technology company founded in 2015 in Santiago, Chile that uses artificial intelligence — its proprietary "Giuseppe" platform — to reverse-engineer animal-based foods from plant ingredients. Its consumer brand at notco.com sells plant-based products including NotMilk, NotMayo, NotBurger and NotIceCream across the Americas, while NotCo AI (notco.ai) licenses the Giuseppe AI R&D platform to global CPG manufacturers such as PepsiCo, Magnum and Barry Callebaut to accelerate food-product innovation. The company is backed by General Catalyst and other investors. NotCo publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its corporate, product, AI-platform and trust/compliance web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Nqoodlet
providers.description: Nqoodlet is a Saudi Arabia-based (Riyadh) corporate spend and expense management platform for businesses from SMEs to enterprises. It lets teams issue unlimited virtual and physical company cards, track every transaction in real time, manage and control cards from a single dashboard, and pay globally in local currency without conversion fees. Over 600 companies use Nqoodlet to streamline expense management, eliminate paperwork, and gain clearer visibility into company spending. It is backed by 500 Global. Nqoodlet does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures the company's public web identity plus a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: OpenLDAP
providers.description: OpenLDAP is an open source implementation of the Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) that provides directory server daemons, client libraries, and utilities for managing distributed directory services. The suite includes slapd (the standalone LDAP daemon), lloadd (a load balancer), protocol libraries, and command-line tools for searching, modifying, and administering directory data. OpenLDAP does not expose a REST API; access is via the LDAP protocol over TCP using SASL, simple bind, or TLS-secured authentication.

providers.name: Openlight
providers.description: OpenLight Photonics is a silicon photonics company that designs and manufactures custom Photonic Application-Specific Integrated Circuits (PASICs) using a heterogeneously integrated, open silicon photonics platform that builds active components such as lasers and modulators onto the same chip as passive waveguides. Operating an open foundry model out of Goleta, California, OpenLight offers three services: design enablement through its Process Design Kit (PDK) with component libraries, evaluation kits, and a PDK Sampler; in-house custom PASIC design; and production manufacturing. Its technology targets datacom, telecom, AI data-center interconnect, lidar, HPC, healthcare, quantum, and IoT sensing. Spun out of Synopsys as an independent, venture-backed company in 2025, OpenLight has raised roughly $84M (a $34M Series A in 2025 and a $50M Series A-1 in 2026) from investors including Mayfield. This is a hardware/semiconductor company; it publishes no public web API, developer portal, or OpenAPI at this time — its developer surface is the chip-design PDK.

providers.name: Oshkosh
providers.description: Oshkosh Corporation is a Fortune 500 industrial company that designs and builds purpose-built vehicles and vehicle bodies, including access equipment, defense vehicles, fire and emergency apparatus, refuse collection vehicles, and concrete mixers.

providers.name: Point
providers.description: Point (Point Digital Finance, Inc.) is a San Francisco fintech founded in 2015 by Eddie Lim, Eoin Matthews, and Alex Rampell that gives homeowners access to their home equity without monthly payments or income requirements. Its flagship Home Equity Investment (HEI) provides lump sums up to $600,000 in exchange for a share of a home's future appreciation over a 30-year term, alongside a HELOC product offering lines up to $750,000. Point has served more than 25,000 homeowners and facilitated over $2 billion in home equity investments, and is backed by a16z, Bloomberg Beta, and Ribbit Capital. Point is a consumer-facing platform with no public developer API; this profile was surfaced as a VC-portfolio lead and enriched with the API Evangelist pipeline (identity + domain-security probe only — no API surface found).

providers.name: Pretred
providers.description: Pretred is a Techstars-backed manufacturer of sustainable rubber safety barriers made from recycled waste tires, serving the infrastructure, traffic control, and construction sectors with a circular-economy model. Its product line spans the Standard Rubber Barrier, TL-2 and TL-3 crash-tested barriers, a Load-Rated Barrier rated for heavy machinery, and Paceline bike-lane barriers, each engineered for energy absorption, durability, and modularity. Every Pretred facility can divert over 100 million pounds of waste tires from landfills or incineration annually. As a physical-goods manufacturer, Pretred publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable interface; this profile captures the company identity and a domain-security probe.

providers.name: RefineRE
providers.description: RefineRE is a commercial real estate (CRE) SaaS platform that unifies benchmarking, data analysis, and portfolio usage tools into a single product suite for corporate real estate teams. Its eight modules span data foundations, portfolio management, market analysis, ESG tracking, and workplace analytics, helping occupiers and CRE managers optimize their real estate portfolios. A Techstars-backed company, RefineRE is added to the API Evangelist network as a provider profile; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Resolute Ventures
providers.description: Resolute Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm that typically writes a founder's first VC check, backing pre-seed and seed-stage companies. Co-founded by Mike Hirshland and Raanan Bar-Cohen, the firm invests in people rather than ideas, backing mission-driven founders with the grit, energy and conviction to bring their ideas to life and offering community, mentorship, health & wellness, and team-building support. Portfolio companies include Vercel, Opendoor, Greenhouse, Hello Heart and Signifyd. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Foundry Group.

providers.name: RugShield Solana Safety API
providers.description: RugShield provides a parallel Solana risk advisory API for AI agents, offering token risk checks, transaction preflight, and aggregated independent advisor panels. It operates on a pay-per-call model using x402 USDC payments on Base or Solana, with no signup or API key required. The service is publicly documented, includes an OpenAPI spec, and supports free discovery of advisor pricing and capabilities.

providers.name: Sandvik
providers.description: Sandvik is a global engineering group that provides equipment, tools and services for the mining, construction, and manufacturing industries. With a focus on innovation, sustainability and digitalization, Sandvik delivers solutions that improve productivity, safety and environmental performance across the entire value chain. The company operates in more than 150 countries, serving customers in mining, rock processing, metal cutting, tooling and additive manufacturing, while investing heavily in research and development to drive future technologies.

providers.name: Seismic Therapeutic
providers.description: Seismic Therapeutic is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing transformative biologic medicines for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. The company pairs structural biology with machine learning through its proprietary IMPACT platform to design multi-functional antibodies and Immunoglobulin Sculpting (IgSc) enzymes across cell-mediated, allergic, and antibody-mediated immune diseases. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners, GV, and Lightspeed Venture Partners, it was added to the API Evangelist network as a lead for enrichment. As a therapeutics R&D company it publishes no public developer or API surface at seismictx.com; this profile captures its corporate identity only.

providers.name: Send4 Tecnologia
providers.description: Send4 Tecnologia (rebranded as After Sale) is a Brazilian post-purchase platform for e-commerce, automating product exchanges, returns, and reverse logistics. Founded in 2017, it has processed over 6 million reverse-logistics transactions and offers intelligent authorization rules for approvals and blocks, a self-service customer exchange portal, real-time returns dashboards, revenue-retention offers (vouchers and cashback), integrated shipping labels and tracking, automated refunds and store credit, and multi-channel WhatsApp and email support. It advertises a simple, flexible API to connect with any e-commerce platform in minutes, though no public developer documentation is currently published. After Sale is now part of the Confi ecosystem alongside Neotrust and the Confi consumer app.

providers.name: Sensmore
providers.description: Sensmore (sensmore GmbH) is a German industrial-automation and embodied-AI company that turns robotics research into field-proven systems for heavy machinery in raw material operations. Its platform connects machines, sites, and data across mining, aggregates/construction, and defense, spanning products including Site Intelligence (live site operations), Machine Assist (driver assistance and collision warning), Eye (visual monitoring), Live Mapping (real-time site mapping), and Loader Automation (autonomous vehicle systems), with claims of reducing downtime by up to 30% while improving safety and resource efficiency. Sensmore was surfaced as a portfolio company of Point Nine and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or developer documentation; its web presence is a marketing and corporate site.

providers.name: Smart & Final Stores
providers.description: Smart & Final Stores is a warehouse-style food and supply retailer operating over 250 stores in the Western United States and 15 stores in northwestern Mexico. The company sells a wide variety of fresh perishables, everyday grocery items, and warehouse-club-sized products to both households and businesses. Smart & Final does not operate a public developer API program but participates in grocery industry digital commerce integrations through third-party platforms.

providers.name: Smartsign
providers.description: Smartsign (SmartSign) is a Brooklyn, New York-based e-commerce retailer of customizable signs, labels, and tags for regulatory, compliance, and safety applications, founded in 1999. It sells pre-designed and custom signage - safety, parking, traffic, property, and facility signs, plus banners and labels - online to businesses of all sizes, including a large share of the Fortune 1000 across education, healthcare, and industrial verticals. Norwest Venture Partners acquired the company in 2019 and Sentinel Capital Partners acquired it in September 2022. SmartSign operates as a business-to-business and business-to-consumer e-commerce storefront and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Snackpass
providers.description: Snackpass is an all-in-one marketing, point-of-sale (POS), and payments platform built for quick-service and fast-casual restaurants. It unifies front-of-house and back-of-house operations in one system: cloud POS, integrated card and mobile payments, self-serve kiosks, online and QR/table ordering, a consumer mobile app, kitchen display systems, loyalty and rewards, SMS/marketing automation, and commission-free delivery. Snackpass serves thousands of restaurants from independent boba and coffee shops to national franchises and has facilitated tens of millions of guest transactions. The company is privately held and backed by a16z, Craft Ventures, and General Catalyst. Snackpass does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or a developer portal; third-party ordering and delivery integrations (Uber Eats, DoorDash, GrubHub) are brokered through partners such as Deliverect and GetOrder rather than a documented public API surface.

providers.name: Southern California Gas Company
providers.description: Southern California Gas Company (SoCalGas), a Sempra subsidiary, is the largest natural gas distribution utility in the United States, serving Southern California. It runs an Apigee integrated developer portal at developer.socalgas.com, but the portal publishes no public API catalog or specification; no Green Button Connect My Data documentation was found on its own site.

providers.name: Sublime Systems
providers.description: Sublime Systems is a Somerville, Massachusetts cement manufacturer spun out of MIT that makes Sublime Cement, a low-carbon replacement for ordinary portland cement. Its ambient-temperature electrochemical "refinery for rocks" process extracts reactive calcium and silicates from low-value rocks and industrial byproducts and blends them into an ASTM-compliant cement that drops into existing concrete mix designs and equipment. The company sells through general-contractor distribution partners and publishes no developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Subset
providers.description: Subset is an AI-powered spreadsheet editor built for finance professionals, letting them generate P&L statements from PDFs, build DCF and returns models, and process CIMs and teasers through natural-language instructions inside a familiar spreadsheet interface. Built in NYC and SF by former Wall Street professionals, Subset targets investment and financial-modeling workflows. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Subset ships a consumer/prosumer web application and help documentation but no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or webhook surface.

providers.name: Suiteness
providers.description: Suiteness is a hotel booking platform specializing in connecting rooms and suites that hotels do not make public. Through partnerships with hotels, it surfaces adjoining rooms and suites - marked with a "+" symbol - so families and groups can book twice the space at roughly half the price of booking multiple standard rooms. It combines suite inventory, a concierge collaboration service, and a membership program. Suiteness is a consumer travel booking company backed by Bullpen Capital; it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or partner API surface at this time.

providers.name: Synthekine
providers.description: Synthekine is a clinical-stage biotechnology company discovering, developing, and commercializing the next generation of selective cytokine therapeutics. The company believes cytokine therapeutics engineered to be selective can fundamentally change the treatment paradigm for cancer and inflammatory disease. Synthekine's engineering platforms (including its surrogate/partial agonist and orthogonal cytokine-receptor approaches) are used to design cytokines and cytokine-based cell therapies with improved selectivity and tolerability. Backed by Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; Synthekine is a therapeutics developer and publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: THG
providers.description: THG plc (formerly The Hut Group) is a UK-based consumer brands group founded in 2004 in Manchester and listed on the London Stock Exchange. Following the 2025 demerger of its Ingenuity technology and fulfilment division, THG is a pure-play consumer brands business operating two divisions: THG Beauty (home to Lookfantastic, Cult Beauty, Dermstore and prestige brand partners) and THG Nutrition (led by Myprotein, one of the world's largest online sports-nutrition brands). THG designs, manufactures and sells beauty and nutrition products direct-to-consumer across global markets. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Balderton Capital, an early investor. THG operates corporate, investor-relations and careers web properties but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile captures its identity and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: THIS
providers.description: THIS™ is a UK plant-based food company making high-protein vegan meat alternatives — including meat-free chicken, bacon, sausages, burgers and mince — sold through major British supermarkets such as Tesco, Sainsbury's, Waitrose, Ocado, Morrisons, Asda and Co-op. Founded in 2019 and backed by Seedcamp, THIS™ is a consumer packaged goods (CPG) brand focused on absurdly tasty plant-based food rather than a developer platform. It operates a marketing and recipe website but publishes no public API, developer documentation, or SDK at the time of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Those Beyond
providers.description: Those Beyond is a fandom entertainment company that merges gaming and community into immersive, location-based and online experiences for fans, gamers, and creators. Built by the Cauldron Co studio and backed by Seedcamp, it runs interactive worlds and events tied to major fandoms (including Invincible- and SCP-branded experiences) alongside a Discord community. Its public surface is a consumer marketing site on Squarespace; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no developer API, SDK, OpenAPI, or /.well-known/ discovery documents.

providers.name: Titan Invest
providers.description: Titan (titan.com), operating the brand Titan Invest, is a wealth management firm founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City that serves high-performing technology professionals. Titan combines AI-assisted technology with dedicated human wealth teams to deliver actively managed portfolios, direct indexing and equity-diversification strategies, tax planning, and financial advisory for pre- and post-IPO tech employees, charging a 0.4% annual advisory fee. The company reports managing roughly $1.2B in assets for more than 10,000 clients and is backed by General Catalyst. Titan delivers its service through consumer web and mobile applications and advisor relationships; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal, so this profile captures the company identity and domain-security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Tomo Guides
providers.description: Tomo Guides is the home-buying guide and educational content produced by Tomo Mortgage (tomo.com), a consumer digital mortgage lender backed by a16z. Tomo offers home purchase mortgages and refinancing with $0 lender fees and rates advertised at roughly 0.25% below the market median, alongside its TrueRate tool that shows a fair rate before applying and state-by-state interest-rate pages. The "Guides" surface is Tomo's home-buying-guide blog content aimed at first-time and repeat buyers, not a developer product. As of this enrichment pass Tomo publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, developer portal, documentation site, or .well-known metadata; the company's web presence is entirely consumer-facing. This profile was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and is retained as a company record with no API artifacts.

providers.name: Tractive
providers.description: Tractive is an Austrian pet-technology company, founded in October 2012 in Pasching, Austria and led by CEO Michael Hurnaus, that builds GPS location and health-monitoring trackers for dogs and cats. Its collar-attached devices (such as the DOG and CAT GPS trackers) pair with a subscription mobile app to deliver real-time worldwide location, virtual fences, activity, sleep and, more recently, resting heart-rate and respiratory-rate health intelligence to more than 1.4 million active subscribers. Tractive was acquired by Italy's Bending Spoons in 2026. Tractive does NOT publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal — its backend HTTP API (api.tractive.com) is private to its own apps; the only clients are unofficial, community reverse-engineered libraries. This profile enriches the company's identity for the API Evangelist network; there is no official API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Trucks Venture Fund I
providers.description: Trucks Venture Capital (Trucks VC) is an early-stage venture firm headquartered in San Francisco investing in companies building the future of transportation — making mobility decarbonized, safer, and more accessible. Its focus spans autonomous vehicles, electric aviation, agricultural robotics, fleet management, and mobility infrastructure. Trucks Venture Fund I is the firm's first fund; notable portfolio outcomes include Joby Aviation (NYSE: JOBY), Bear Flag Robotics (acquired by John Deere), nuTonomy (acquired by Delphi), Roadster (acquired by CDK Global), and Zendrive (acquired by Intuit). Surfaced as a portfolio relation of 500 Global and profiled in the API Evangelist network as a venture-capital firm; it publishes a marketing/portfolio website but no developer API surface.

providers.name: Variant Bio
providers.description: Variant Bio is a biotechnology company developing life-saving therapies by studying the genes of people with exceptional health-related traits. Working with partner communities around the world under an ethical, benefit-sharing approach, the company pairs large-scale genomic discovery with data science to turn genetic diversity into novel drug targets across metabolic, cardiovascular and other disease areas. Surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst, Lux Capital and SoftBank Vision Fund and profiled in the API Evangelist network; Variant Bio publishes no public developer/API surface at this time.

providers.name: Vermeer
providers.description: Vermeer is an American-Ukrainian defense-technology startup (founded 2018 by Brian Streem; headquartered in New York with forward operations in Kyiv) building vision-based autonomy for unmanned aerial platforms. Its Visual Positioning System (VPS) uses electro-optical and infrared cameras plus onboard AI (NVIDIA) to match imagery to 2D/3D maps and deliver precise navigation in GPS-denied, jammed, or spoofed environments. Products include Air (absolute positioning without GPS), Celestial (star-based navigation), and Terminal Guidance (precision targeting). The technology has been fielded by the Armed Forces of Ukraine and is aimed at defense customers including Lockheed Martin, General Atomics, Northrop Grumman, and the U.S. Air Force and Army. Vermeer exposes no public API, SDK, or developer platform at this time; this profile is a company/marketing surface with no API artifacts.

providers.name: Wishbird Experiences
providers.description: Wishbird Experiences is Mexico's largest online marketplace for gift experiences, offering more than 450 original activities across the country, from adrenaline adventures like skydiving and bungee jumping to spa treatments, gourmet dining, hot-air-balloon and helicopter flights, and weekend getaways. Experiences are sold as gift cards (Wishcards and Wishbox products) redeemable within a twelve-month window, with checkout via credit card, PayPal, and Mercado Pago. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce business and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: 4D Path
providers.description: 4D Path, Inc. is a Newton, Massachusetts computational-pathology company founded in 2016 that builds the Q-plasia OncoReader (QPOR) platform, a patented, cloud-based precision oncology and computer-aided cancer diagnostic system. Rather than conventional image-classification AI, QPOR applies statistical physics and cancer biology to digitized H&E-stained whole-slide biopsy and resection images to measure and quantify cell-cycle deregulation and tumor immune microenvironment dynamics, producing biomarker profiling, grading and therapy-response prediction without additional molecular assays such as IHC, FISH, RNA-Seq or NGS. Its lead software-as-a-medical-device product, 4D Q-plasia OncoReader Breast, received FDA Breakthrough Device Designation in November 2020, and the company has partnered with PathPresenter to distribute the reader inside the ClinPx clinical workflow platform. 4D Path publishes no public developer program, API reference, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind — see x-coverage.

providers.name: 7Invensun Technology
providers.description: 7Invensun Technology (Beijing 7invensun Technology Co., Ltd. / 北京七鑫易维信息技术有限公司) is a Beijing-based eye-tracking company founded in 2009 that develops eye-tracking hardware, gaze-estimation algorithms and device SDKs. Its aSee product family spans glasses-style, desktop and high-speed research eye trackers (aSee Glasses, aSee Glasses Elite, aSee Pro, aSee Pro Plus, aSee A series), aSee VR modules embedded in XR headsets, an aSee Mobile developer accessory, and eye-controlled communication aids for people with ALS, high paraplegia and cerebral palsy. The company packages these into solutions for in-vehicle driver monitoring (DMS), spatial computing and XR foveated rendering, phone and tablet gaze interaction, and safety monitoring, and states it serves more than 1,000 customers across research and education, healthcare, energy, transport and aerospace. Its developer surface is a native device SDK distributed from its own download center and through OEM agreements, not a public web API.

providers.name: Acalvio
providers.description: Acalvio Technologies is a cybersecurity company specializing in cyber deception technology for preemptive defense. Its platform detects, disrupts, and defeats advanced threats, ransomware, and identity-based attacks by deploying autonomous, AI-driven deception across enterprise, cloud, and government environments. Acalvio integrates with existing security infrastructure such as CrowdStrike Falcon Identity Protection, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, and other SIEM/SOAR solutions, and partners with AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud. Acalvio does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDK; this profile captures its public web and security posture.

providers.name: Alliant Credit Union
providers.description: Alliant Credit Union is a federally chartered, member-owned credit union headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, regulated by the National Credit Union Administration (NCUA). Founded in 1935 as the United Airlines Employees' Credit Union and rebranded Alliant in 2003, it is one of the largest credit unions in the United States, with more than 800,000 members and over $19 billion in assets. Alliant operates as a digital-first, branchless institution offering consumer and commercial deposit accounts, high-yield savings and checking, credit cards, auto and home loans, and business banking. Like nearly all U.S. credit unions, Alliant publishes no public first-party developer API or developer portal; consumer-permissioned data access is available to members only through third-party aggregators (Plaid, MX, Finicity, Akoya) rather than a directly documented open-finance API.

providers.name: Aqtual
providers.description: Aqtual, Inc. is a Hayward, California precision-medicine company founded in 2019 by Diana Abdueva (Founder and CEO) and co-founder Rich Rava, developing blood-based diagnostics on a proprietary "active chromatin" cell-free DNA (cfDNA) platform. Rather than reading cfDNA for mutations alone, Aqtual captures the previously unexplored cfDNA fragments bound to active chromatin, so a single routine blood draw reports on DNA, epigenetic regulation and protein-DNA binding together — surveying on the order of 200,000 gene promoters, 400,000 enhancers, 50,000 insulators, 20,000 silencers and a million transcription-factor binding sites. Its lead product is a therapy-response prediction test for rheumatoid arthritis, evaluated in the prospective PRIMA-102 observational trial (NCT05936970), with oncology programs in leiomyosarcoma immunotherapy response and early colorectal cancer detection, and stated expansion into immunology, cardiovascular, metabolic and neurological disease. The company raised a USD 16 million Series A in October 2023 and over USD 31 million in Series B funding announced July 2025 from Bold Capital, the Bold Longevity Growth Fund, Genoa Ventures, Manta Ray Ventures and Yu Galaxy. Aqtual is a clinical-diagnostics and life-sciences business, not a software vendor: as of August 2026 it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract of any kind, and every /.well-known/ and contract-discovery path on aqtual.com returns 404.

providers.name: Augmenta
providers.description: Augmenta is a Toronto-based generative AI company building the Augmenta Construction Platform (ACP), a Spatial AI system that automates building design — starting with electrical raceway routing and expanding into mechanical and plumbing (MEP). ACP ingests Revit models, accepts conduit run schedules, fly/no-fly zones, and project specifications, then generates clash-free, constructable 3D conduit routes in the cloud and exports them back into Revit as system conduit ready for detailing and prefabrication. The platform combines computational geometry, advanced optimization, and machine learning to handle data-center, hospital, and school-scale electrical builds, and is marketed to VDC teams and electrical contractors as a way to cut BIM time by roughly two-thirds. Augmenta was founded by veterans of generative design for advanced manufacturing, won EC&M 2026 Product of the Year, was named to the 2026 Global Cleantech 100, and signed a five-year strategic partnership with E-J Electric Installation Co. The product is delivered as a SOC2-certified Revit add-in with a cloud back-end; there is no public REST API, SDK, or open-source release.

providers.name: BallerTV
providers.description: BallerTV (Baller, Inc.) is a Pasadena, California sports media company that live streams and provides on-demand replays and highlights of youth and amateur sports, including basketball, volleyball, soccer, lacrosse, softball, and football, from thousands of tournaments and showcases nationwide. Subscribers range from families following athletes to NCAA and professional scouts using the footage for recruiting and scouting. The platform includes a Game Finder for locating events, purchasable athlete highlight reels, and BTVision, an AI-powered ball-tracking streaming technology that improves the basketball viewing experience. BallerTV is a consumer streaming product delivered through its website and iOS/Android apps; it does not publish a public developer API or SDK program. This profile was surfaced as an index-ventures portfolio company and enriched from public web sources.

providers.name: BiggerPicture
providers.description: BiggerPicture provides a comprehensive visual analytics platform that helps businesses understand their market landscape through interactive dashboards, data visualizations, and strategic insights. Leveraging advanced data aggregation and AI-driven analysis, the service enables users to track competitors, monitor industry trends, and make data‑driven decisions. Founded with backing from leadout‑capital, BiggerPicture aims to democratize access to high‑quality market intelligence for enterprises of all sizes, fostering growth and informed strategy development across sectors.

providers.name: Bindingsolutionslimited
providers.description: Binding Solutions Ltd is a fast‑growing technology company focused on decarbonising steel production. It develops green steel technologies, operates a first‑of‑a‑kind plant, and offers process and steel solutions to enable large‑scale low‑carbon steel manufacturing.

providers.name: BioAge Labs
providers.description: BioAge Labs (Nasdaq ticker BIOA) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in Emeryville, California, developing therapies that target the biology of human aging to treat metabolic diseases such as obesity and its related conditions. Its proprietary discovery platform mines longitudinal human multi-omics data to identify aging-related molecular pathways, which feed a therapeutic pipeline that includes BGE-102, an oral NLRP3 inhibitor aimed at chronic inflammation and cardiovascular risk, and an APJ (apelin receptor) agonist developed as an exercise mimetic for obesity. The company is backed by a16z and Redpoint Ventures and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company profile. BioAge Labs publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface at this time; this profile captures its corporate and web-property identity plus a domain-security probe of its primary web host.

providers.name: Bioportkorea
providers.description: Bioportkorea (바이오포트코리아) is a Korean food and health product company that aims to deliver healthy happiness by discovering value in nature. It operates as a global comprehensive food company, focusing on product development, R&D, and quality management, offering domestic and overseas products, and providing detailed corporate information, investment data, and customer support through its website.

providers.name: BiVACOR
providers.description: BiVACOR, Inc. is a privately held, clinical-stage medical device company with corporate operations in Huntington Beach, California, clinical operations in Houston, Texas, and engineering operations on the Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia. It develops the BiVACOR Total Artificial Heart (TAH), a titanium biventricular rotary blood pump built around a single magnetically levitated rotor with a dual-sided impeller that replaces both ventricles of a failing heart, with no valves, flexing diaphragms or mechanical bearings, and flows above 12 L/min. Founded by Chief Technical Officer Daniel Timms, PhD, and led by CEO Jim Dillon with Chief Medical Officer William E. Cohn, MD, the company completed the first-in-human implantation at The Texas Heart Institute in July 2024 under an FDA Early Feasibility Study, received FDA Breakthrough Device Designation in May 2025, and was accepted into the FDA Total Product Life Cycle Advisory Program in August 2025. The TAH is an investigational device, limited by federal law to investigational use, and is not approved for commercial sale. BiVACOR is a medical hardware and clinical-research business - it publishes no developer program, public API, SDK, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Blue River Technology
providers.description: Blue River Technology is an agricultural robotics and machine-learning company headquartered in Santa Clara, California, and a wholly owned subsidiary of John Deere (Deere & Company), which acquired it in 2017. Founded in 2011 by Jorge Heraud and Lee Redden out of Stanford University, the company builds intelligent machinery that combines computer vision, machine learning, robotics, and full-stack software to make farming more precise and sustainable. Its flagship product, See & Spray, uses onboard cameras and deep-learning models to distinguish crops from weeds in real time and target herbicide only where it is needed, dramatically reducing chemical use. Blue River operates as John Deere's autonomy and computer-vision engineering hub, applying the same perception and edge-AI stack across agriculture, construction, and mining equipment. The company does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal; its technology ships embedded in John Deere machinery and is surfaced to growers through John Deere Operations Center rather than a standalone developer program.

providers.name: Boaoxin

Leveraging its proprietary H³ antibody discovery platform, SynTracer® high‑throughput internalization platform, and Flexibody® bispecific technology, Biosion aims to address unmet clinical needs with differentiated biologics. The company is headquartered in Nanjing, China, and has raised over $31 million across multiple funding rounds to advance its pipeline.

providers.description: Clinflash (易迪希医药科技 / Clinflash Healthcare Technology) is a Chinese clinical-research technology company founded in 2014 that provides a cloud-based clinical trial information platform for pharmaceutical sponsors, CROs, and research sites. Its self-developed suite spans more than ten systems, including Clinflash EDC (electronic data capture), IRT/IWRS (randomization and trial supply management), eCOA/ePRO (electronic clinical outcome and patient-reported outcomes), Safety/PV (pharmacovigilance and drug-safety alerting), CTMS (clinical trial management), eTMF (electronic trial master file), eCTD, eConsent, eSign, Coder (medical coding), and ePAY (subject payment). Clinflash has supported thousands of clinical trial projects for over a thousand pharmaceutical, generic, medical-device, and IVD organizations, including pivotal Phase III and international multi-center studies. The platform is delivered as a login-gated SaaS at cloud.clinflash.com and, as of this profile, publishes no public developer/API program, OpenAPI, SDKs, or GitHub organization.

It designs high-end networking and communication silicon — high-performance programmable Ethernet switch chips, DPUs (Data Processing Units), and SmartNIC intelligent network cards — along with cloud-native infrastructure hardware and customized software for data centers and 5G networks. Its switch platforms run the open-source SONiC network operating system, and the company maintains a public GitHub organization with SONiC/SAI networking software. Clounix is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. It currently publishes no public developer-facing API, SDK, or documentation portal.

providers.name: Diffusion
providers.description: Diffusion Software is a small independent software vendor that develops audio-encoding and RDS (Radio Data System) tooling for FM radio broadcasters. Its flagship product, Airomate, is a software-based RDS/RBDS encoder that generates a high-quality RDS signal using a 192 kHz-capable soundcard, letting stations broadcast professional-looking RDS information (station name, RadioText, program service data) at low cost without dedicated hardware. The company also ships complementary broadcast utilities: StereoCoder (an FM stereo/MPX encoder), Little SineGen (a sine-wave generator that runs at any sample rate the soundcard supports), and Chronos (a free scheduler that sequences Programme Service name and RadioText messages for Airomate). The products are Windows desktop applications distributed as low-cost licensed downloads. Diffusion Software is a seed-stage Canaan Partners portfolio company and does not publish a public API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile is maintained as a network identity record.

providers.name: DisplayLink
providers.description: DisplayLink, a brand of Synaptics Incorporated, develops USB-based virtual graphics technology that pairs host driver software with a device-side decoder SoC to act as a virtual graphics card. Its adaptive-compression technology powers universal docking stations, USB monitors, adapters, and multi-display setups over USB-C, USB, and Ethernet, spanning products from the entry-level DL-3000/4000 series to the quad-display DL-7000 professional series. DisplayLink is a hardware/semiconductor and driver-software product line rather than a public web-API provider; its developer surface consists of chip SDKs, firmware tooling, and host driver software.

It manages and operates marine and inland terminals across more than 40 countries and operates a portfolio of digital platforms - including the CARGOES suite (Flow, Runner, TOS+, PCS, Customs), Searates, and the Digital Freight Alliance - that expose APIs and integrations for shipment visibility, freight pricing, terminal operations, and trade workflows.

Elementary inspects over one billion parts annually for Fortune 500 manufacturers across food & beverage, automotive, consumer packaged goods, electronics, and life sciences, and is backed by Rockwell Automation, Tiger Global, Toyota Ventures, Threshold Ventures, Fika Ventures, and Idealab. Its flagship product, Tetsu-Navi Inspection AI (鉄ナビ検収AI), uses high-resolution cameras and computer-vision models to grade incoming scrap, detect impurities and hazardous materials, and standardize what was previously a manual, expert-dependent process — advancing steel recycling and reducing CO2 emissions from steel production. The company works with major Japanese steel producers including JFE Steel and Kyoei Steel, and is backed by DCM Ventures, Mitsui & Co., Coreline, and the University of Tokyo.

providers.name: Eyeriss

providers.name: Fennix - AI Business Intelligence & Analytics Platform
providers.description: Fennix is an AI business intelligence and decision-intelligence platform that unifies databases, documents, and social/marketing data into one AI layer, letting teams ask questions in plain language (English, French, or Arabic) and receive governed, traceable answers with live charts, dashboards, sentiment analysis, anomaly detection, and forecasting instead of building dashboards or writing SQL.

providers.name: Fora

Fora runs a consumer traveler app plus an advisor portal and is building agentic AI tooling (Via / Sidekick) to streamline advisor workflows. providers.name: Nirmidas Biotech
providers.description: Nirmidas Biotech, Inc. is a Mountain View, California life-science company founded in September 2013 that develops and manufactures diagnostics and imaging products built on near-infrared (NIR) fluorescence enhancement. providers.name: Pramaana Labs

Its stack compiles domain rules into formal systems that return proofs, counterexamples, and traceable explanations. Pramaana Labs raised $27M to build a compiler for mission-critical AI and is backed by Accel. providers.name: Science On Call
providers.description: Science On Call provides 24/7 AI-powered technology support built specifically for restaurants. Combining intelligent automation with human experts, the service helps restaurant staff triage and resolve operational technology issues across point-of-sale (POS) systems, kitchen display systems (KDS), loyalty programs, staff scheduling, online ordering, training platforms, phones, internet, and Wi-Fi. Staff reach support anytime via text, email, or phone with no app or login required, and issues are typically resolved in about 25 minutes. Science On Call is a Techstars-backed company; billing is handled through a hosted customer portal. providers.name: Scope

It captures field data through voice, video, and forms (offline-capable), extracts structured data from P&IDs, ASME forms, and inspection drawings, surfaces historical inspection context, and automates report generation in Word, Excel, and PDF. The product pushes results into enterprise CMMS/EAM systems via webhooks and prebuilt connectors, but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or documentation surface at this time. Backed by Index Ventures and Y Combinator; raised a ~$18-20M round led by Index Ventures in 2026.

providers.name: Seedsight
