providers.description: Ratio Therapeutics Inc. is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company headquartered at One Design Center Place in Boston, Massachusetts, developing next-generation precision radiopharmaceuticals for solid tumors. Founded in 2022 by Jack Hoppin, Ph.D. and John Babich, Ph.D., the company pairs two proprietary R&D platforms — Trillium, a tunable albumin-binding targeting scaffold that modulates pharmacokinetics, and Macropa, a bifunctional chelator built for the alpha emitter actinium-225 — to improve drug availability, tumor delivery and tumor loading. Its lead program, [Ac-225]RTX-2358, is a FAP-targeted radiotherapeutic in the ATLAS Phase 1/2 trial, alongside a next-generation GRPR program, mono- and bispecific radioligand therapies, and PET imaging assets. Ratio has licensing and collaboration agreements with Novartis, Merck, Bayer and Lantheus, isotope supply agreements with Nusano, TerraPower Isotopes and PanTera, and manufacturing partnerships with PharmaLogic and Eckert & Ziegler. It closed a $70 million Series C in July 2026, bringing total capital raised past $240 million. Ratio is a therapeutics developer rather than a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, no public API and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: React Foundation
providers.description: The React Foundation is a Linux Foundation project announced in February 2026 that supports React, React Native, and supporting components after Meta contributed the React project to the Linux Foundation. It ensures the continued open governance, neutral stewardship, and long-term development of the React ecosystem used by millions of front-end and mobile developers worldwide. The Foundation does not currently expose a public, programmatic REST API; engagement with the project happens primarily through GitHub repositories and documentation channels.

providers.name: Rebellion Defense
providers.description: Rebellion Defense (rebelliondefense.com) is a defense-technology company building an AI-driven "intelligence shield" for protecting critical infrastructure and military assets — combining multi-band AESA radar sensing (ARGUS/SPECTRUM), AI track-fusion and threat prediction (PRISM), operator alerting and situational awareness (IRIS/STATUS), and effector command-and-control (HADES) on an integrated RBLN-OS platform. Recent public activity includes U.S. Navy contracts and designation as an awardable vendor on the CDAO Tradewinds Solutions Marketplace. The company publishes a marketing site only: as of this enrichment pass no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable discovery surface is exposed. Added to the API Evangelist network as an Insight Partners portfolio lead.

providers.name: Resolyst
providers.description: Resolyst is a specialty-care platform that positions itself as the intelligence layer for AI-enabled specialty care, extending the reach of the world's leading clinicians with continuous, research-first expertise. Rather than episodic consultations, Resolyst provides ongoing multidisciplinary medical oversight for patients with chronic conditions through specialist nurses, pharmacists, dieticians, physiotherapists and psychologists, connecting patients with local and international experts, embedding clinical research into care pathways, and convening condition-specific international expert panels for second opinions and clinical pathway oversight. Backed by Seedcamp, it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation surface is currently published.

providers.name: Revolution Medicines
providers.description: Revolution Medicines is a clinical-stage precision oncology company headquartered in Redwood City, California, developing targeted therapies for RAS-addicted cancers. Its pipeline centers on RAS(ON) inhibitors — including daraxonrasib (RMC-6236), zoldonrasib (RMC-9805), and elironrasib (RMC-6291) — designed to directly target the active, GTP-bound (ON) state of oncogenic RAS proteins across mutations such as KRAS G12X. The company pairs structure-based drug discovery with clinical development to pursue treatments for pancreatic, lung, colorectal, and other RAS-driven tumors. Revolution Medicines is a publicly traded corporate entity (Nasdaq: RVMD) and does not currently expose a public developer API surface; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Satellite Bio
providers.description: Satellite Bio is a biotechnology company developing off-the-shelf liver cell therapies to treat severe and life-threatening liver diseases. Its tissue therapeutics platform engineers functional hepatocytes designed to engraft and restore liver function, combining the biological power of liver cells with scalable manufacturing and distribution. The company is headquartered in Newton, Massachusetts and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. Satellite Bio is a life-sciences company and does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: Setpointmedical
providers.description: SetPoint Medical is a bioelectronic medicine company developing an FDA-approved implantable neuroimmune modulation platform. The SetPoint System is a small, wireless, implantable device that stimulates the vagus nerve to reduce inflammation, delivering an automatic one-minute daily therapy for up to ten years to treat adults with moderate-to-severe rheumatoid arthritis who have not responded well to biologics. The company is backed by Norwest Venture Partners. It is a medical-device company with no public API or developer surface; this profile captures its identity and the security/disclosure posture surfaced by the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Socrata
providers.description: Access to Open Data from Governments, Non-profits and NGOs around the world

providers.name: Story Health
providers.description: Story Health was a virtual specialty care company founded in 2020 by Tom Stanis (a Google Verily co-founder), Nikhil Roy, and cardiologist Dr. Ashul Govil. Its platform went beyond video visits to give specialty clinicians digital tools for continuous, protocol-driven care at scale, focusing initially on cardiology with care-plan optimization, therapy titration, and evidence-based adjustments between visits. The company raised roughly $27M (a $4M seed in 2020 and a $22.6M Series A in 2022) from investors including General Catalyst and Define Ventures, and was acquired by Innovaccer in September 2025. It operates a marketing web presence but publishes no public developer, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Sunday
providers.description: Sunday (Sunday Lawn Care, getsunday.com) is a direct-to-consumer, subscription lawn and yard care brand. It builds a personalized annual plan for each customer's exact lot from satellite imagery, soil data, and local climate patterns, then ships pesticide-free, phosphorus-free fertilizer, weed control, grass seed, and pest-control products on a seasonal cadence. Plans include Sunny AI guidance and Yard Advisor expert support, plus regional lawn-care guides for 1,700+ US cities. Sunday is a consumer commerce company rather than an API provider: it publishes a machine-readable llms.txt for agents and runs an internal application API (api.getsunday.com), but exposes no public developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or documented API surface. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bond Capital and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Surglasses
providers.description: Surglasses Inc. (SURGLASSES) is a medical technology manufacturer of augmented reality surgical guidance systems and medical education products. Its portfolio includes AR-guided surgical navigation for orthopedic, spine, and neurosurgery procedures (the Foresee-X AR surgical glasses), 3D computer surgical navigation and planning software, and the Asclepius AI Table and Virtual Dissection Table for anatomy, radiology, and histopathology education. Backed by 500 Global. The company operates as a B2B medical-device manufacturer and publishes no public developer, API, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Tierra Biosciences
providers.description: Tierra Biosciences is a San Leandro, California synthetic biology company using AI-guided, cell-free protein production to synthesize custom proteins on demand for pharmaceutical, industrial, and agricultural research. Its customer-facing Tierra Protein Platform is a web-based eCommerce ordering portal where researchers enter protein sequences and get custom proteins synthesized, validated, and shipped. The company (rebranding toward Revr Bio) is backed by prosus-ventures and Material Impact. No public developer API, SDK, or programmatic-access surface is currently published; this profile was enriched and confirmed as a web-platform-only provider.

providers.name: Topos Bio
providers.description: Topos Bio is an AI-native drug discovery company building all-atom foundation models for intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) — dynamic, flexible proteins implicated in diseases such as Alzheimer's and prostate cancer. Its Topos-1 foundation model generates physically realistic conformational ensembles for flexible proteins, aiming to make previously undruggable targets therapeutically viable. The company is backed by Threshold Ventures. No public API or developer platform is currently published.

providers.name: Travelier
providers.description: Travelier (founded 2016, formerly Bookaway Group, headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel) is a travel technology group digitizing ground and sea transportation — the segment of travel that is still largely sold offline. The group operates seven consumer and operator brands: Bookaway, 12Go, Plataforma10, DeOnibus, Traveling.com, Sisorg and SeatOS, together reaching more than 120 countries and roughly 14 million monthly visitors. Its commercial developer surface is Travelier Connect, a single partner API that the company markets as the largest ground and sea transportation GDS — 12,000+ operators across 122 countries and around 500,000 routes for buses, ferries, trains and shuttles — alongside the SeatOS transportation management system, which exposes the same inventory to OTAs, GDSs, resellers and agent networks through one API connection. Both are partner integrations: as of this profile no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable contract is published, and access runs through a sales contact form.

providers.name: Truman's
providers.description: Truman's is a venture-backed company identified in the API Evangelist harvest backlog. It appears to be a portfolio company of starting-line-vc, but its public website (trumans.com) redirects to Henkel Consumer Brands, indicating no dedicated corporate site. The company likely operates within a larger corporate structure, and no direct API documentation or developer portal is evident. Further investigation is needed to confirm its services and API offerings.

providers.name: UL Solutions
providers.description: UL Solutions is a global leader in applied safety science, providing testing, inspection, certification, advisory, and software solutions to help customers innovate safely, demonstrate compliance, and bring trusted products to market. The company offers software products such as ULTRUS and ComplianceWire, customer portals (myUL, Product iQ), and the Marks and Labels Hub. UL Solutions does not currently expose a public developer-facing API portal with open documentation.

providers.name: Umeå Open Data
providers.description: Open data of the city Umeå in northen Sweden

providers.name: University of Oslo
providers.description: Courses, lecture videos, detailed information for courses etc. for the University of Oslo (Norway)

providers.name: Vitara
providers.description: Vitara (Vitara Biomedical) is a Philadelphia-based medical technology company developing EXTEND, an investigational neonatal support platform that surrounds extremely premature newborns in a fluid-filled, fetal-physiology-modeled environment for their first 28 days, delaying the stress of early air exposure so vital organs can continue to develop. The company aims to improve survival and reduce long-term complications for infants born as early as 22 weeks gestation. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Khosla Ventures portfolio company; Vitara publishes no public API, developer portal, or documentation, and its technology has not received U.S. FDA market clearance.

providers.name: Windward
providers.description: Windward is a Maritime AI company headquartered in London and Washington D.C. delivering mission-grade, multi-source maritime intelligence for defense agencies, law enforcement, customs, energy and commodity traders, marine insurers, shippers, and financial institutions. Founded by CEO Ami Daniel, Windward fuses AIS data, remote sensing (EO, SAR, RF GEOINT), proprietary behavioral analytics, and generative AI into a single Maritime AI platform covering vessel screening, ownership and entity resolution, sanctions exposure, deceptive shipping detection, ship-to-ship transfer analysis, IUU fishing detection, smuggling detection, container tracking, and maritime infrastructure protection. Windward exposes its intelligence through the API Insights Lab, a unified GraphQL API at developer.windward.ai providing programmatic access to vessel risk scores, Organization Defined Risk (ODR), ultimate beneficial ownership, early detection signals, tracked shipments, carriers, and detention & demurrage data, along with webhooks and workflow automation. The company has no public REST/OpenAPI surface, no public SDKs, and no public GitHub org — its API is GraphQL-only with managed onboarding and expert-led implementation support.

providers.name: XPO Logistics
providers.description: XPO Logistics, Inc. is a leading provider of less-than-truckload (LTL) transportation in North America. The company offers freight transportation through a proprietary network of service centers and uses technology to drive efficiency for more than 50,000 customers. XPO Logistics historically operated as part of XPO, Inc. (NYSE: XPO), the publicly traded company that spun off GXO Logistics (contract logistics) in 2021 and RXO (brokerage) in 2022, leaving XPO focused on LTL trucking. XPO Logistics does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; integrations are arranged through enterprise account managers.

providers.name: Actionize AI
providers.description: Actionize AI provides a no‑code platform that lets developers and creators add custom actions to OpenAI GPTs. By connecting to thousands of apps through integrations like Zapier, Make.com, ActivePieces, n8n and more, users can build workflows that trigger external services from within a GPT. The service offers a marketplace of pre‑built actions, a visual builder for creating new ones, and pricing plans ranging from free trials to lifetime deals. Actionize aims to simplify the integration of AI assistants with real‑world tools without writing code.

providers.name: Agilon Health
providers.description: Agilon Health is a healthcare services company that partners with primary care physicians to transform care for seniors through a value-based, total care model. The company supports physician groups with a platform that combines clinical, operational, and financial capabilities to manage Medicare populations. Agilon Health does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Agrostar
providers.description: AgroStar (Ulink Agritech Private Ltd) is a leading Indian agri-tech company on a mission to help farmers grow more and earn more, sustainably. Founded in Pune, it operates India's largest digital farmer network and agri-inputs platform, serving millions of farmers across Gujarat, Rajasthan, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh through its Kisan (AgriDoctor) mobile app. AgroStar builds a connected ecosystem across the agricultural value chain — farm advisory, quality agri-inputs, omnichannel retail access and global market linkages — backed by data and agronomy expertise, with a focus on climate-smart agriculture, water conservation and reducing food waste. It is a portfolio company of Accel. AgroStar's public corporate site is Wix-powered and exposes a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint plus an /llms.txt for agentic AI access to public site content; it does not publish a developer-facing product API.

providers.name: Alliance Holdings
providers.description: Alliance Holdings GP, L.P. (AHGP) was a limited partnership formed to own and control Alliance Resource Management GP, LLC, the managing general partner of Alliance Resource Partners, L.P. (ARLP), the second largest coal producer in the eastern United States. AHGP held a general partner interest, incentive distribution rights, and a direct stake in ARLP common units. In 2018 AHGP was absorbed into ARLP in a simplification transaction and ceased to exist as a separate public entity. ARLP (NASDAQ: ARLP) continues as a diversified energy company earning income from coal production and from coal, oil and gas mineral royalties. Alliance Holdings never maintained a public developer API program and neither does the surviving entity. The legacy ahgp.com host no longer resolves and alliancecoal.com redirects to www.arlp.com; probes on 2026-09-04 of arlp.com, www.arlp.com and investor.arlp.com found no OpenAPI, GraphQL, AsyncAPI, gRPC, WSDL, MCP, agent card, or served /.well-known/ document.

providers.name: Alluva
providers.description: Alluva operates a global analyst marketplace centered on cryptocurrency and digital-asset price predictions. Users forecast the future price of assets such as Bitcoin and Ethereum across timeframes from 24 hours to six months, follow leading analysts, and earn redeemable rewards for accurate forecasts with no upfront investment. Asset pages surface detailed analysis and Buy/Hold/Sell recommendations. Alluva also packages its predictive market data for B2B customers - data providers, media houses, and financial institutions - with named clients including 500 Global, Refinitiv, Thomson Reuters, Economic Times, and Times of India. The company is a 500 Global portfolio company. No public API, developer portal, or SDK is published at this time.

providers.name: Alpha Finance
providers.description: Alpha Finance Lab, now operating as Alpha Venture DAO, is a Web3 builders' DAO and DeFi studio backed by Multicoin Capital. It builds and incubates on-chain financial applications, most notably Homora, a leveraged yield-farming protocol on Ethereum, BNB Chain and Avalanche, along with an on-chain lending protocol and Alpha X derivatives work. Its stack is delivered as audited Solidity smart contracts (with Python/JavaScript/TypeScript tooling and integration docs) published on GitHub rather than as a hosted REST API; developer integration is contract- and subgraph-oriented. This API Evangelist profile tracks the organization's public developer surface — documentation, GitHub organization, and blog. The legacy alphafinance.io domain has been retired in favor of alphaventuredao.io.

providers.name: Amerigroup
providers.description: Amerigroup is a US health insurance company specializing in publicly funded health care, offering Medicaid managed care coverage to low-income families, children, pregnant women, seniors, and people with disabilities. It operates today as Amerigroup Community Care in Georgia and is part of Elevance Health (formerly WellPoint/Anthem), which acquired the company in 2012 and has since rebranded most Amerigroup plans to Wellpoint. Amerigroup coordinates benefits, provider networks, and care management for state Medicaid and related government health programs. Members and health-care providers interact through the amerigroup.com member site and a separate provider portal; the company exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Anywhere 2 Go
providers.description: Anywhere 2 Go Co., Ltd. is a Bangkok, Thailand insurtech company and the maker of Claim Di, a mobile application ecosystem that streamlines motor insurance claims and vehicle inspection between drivers, independent surveyors, and insurance companies. Its flagship "Shake and Go" (K4K) feature lets two Claim Di users resolve minor accidents on the spot, while Emergency Alert, self-service Car Inspection, photo-based Non-Accident Claims, and the Claim Di Bike surveyor-dispatch program cut claim processing time and help insurers reduce fraud. The company is a 500 Global portfolio company. Claim Di is a consumer/B2B mobile product (iOS and Android); no public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: APX
providers.description: APX (APX Logistics Solutions) is a Southeast Asian less-than-truckload (LTL) digital logistics platform headquartered in Bangkok, with operations in Thailand, Malaysia, and Singapore. It positions itself as the region's first LTL digital logistics provider, offering domestic and cross-border shipping, international sea and air freight, customs brokerage, warehousing and distribution, project logistics, and heavy-lift/breakbulk services. Its proprietary technology platform provides online shipment booking, real-time tracking with ETA notifications, digital proof-of-delivery, AI-assisted route optimization, a driver app, and analytics dashboards including CO2/ESG reporting. APX is a portfolio company of 500 Global and was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass APX publishes no first-party public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; shipment tracking is currently integrable only via third-party aggregators.

providers.name: AscentX Medical
providers.description: AscentX Medical, Inc. is a regenerative medicine company focused on advanced soft tissue engineering and injectable autologous tissue therapies. The company aims to improve quality of life for aging populations by developing innovative regenerative treatments that restore tissue function and vitality. It offers technology services, contract manufacturing, and literature on its research and development efforts.

providers.name: Beijing Lanweitong Technology (蓝卫通 / BSC)
providers.description: Beijing Lanweitong Technology Co., Ltd. (北京蓝卫通科技有限公司), branded BSC, operates one of China's longest-running telemedicine networks — the 蓝卫通远程医学服务平台 (Lanweitong Remote Medical Service Platform). Founded in 1998 and headquartered in Beijing, the company connects thousands of member hospitals and clinics to specialist physicians at Grade-A tertiary hospitals for remote consultation (远程会诊), remote outpatient clinics, multidisciplinary MDT consultations, remote imaging and DICOM cloud reading, remote ECG, remote pathology, remote ultrasound, remote ward rounds, and continuing medical education. The platform is delivered as hospital-facing web applications (BSCTelmed, DicomCloud, BSCEcg, BSCUltrasound, BSCEdu) plus a mobile app, and is sold to health systems and medical alliances (医联体) rather than exposed as a public developer API. The company reports 19 patents and 199 software copyrights and has been recognized as a national-level "little giant" specialized enterprise. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Qiming Venture Partners portfolio company. Its original domain chinabsc.com is still registered but no longer resolves; the live platform runs on bsc1.cn / bscm.cn.

providers.name: Bestow
providers.description: Bestow is a Dallas, Texas life insurance technology company building a unified SaaS platform for life insurance carriers, agents, and embedded partners. Founded in 2016, Bestow provides end-to-end and modular solutions across new business and policy administration, including a digital Application Suite for quote, illustration, and application journeys; an Underwriting engine and workbench with instant, fully automated decisioning powered by machine learning on actuarial data; an Agent Portal and sales management tooling; an Admin Portal and Customer Portal for self-service; TPA (Third-Party Administrator) services; a Performance IQ analytics surface; and a Data Optimization Suite for modeling, integrations, and activation. Bestow's Protect API and associated SDK power embedded life insurance — letting fintechs, banks, financial institutions, P&C carriers, mortgage platforms, and benefits providers offer instant term life, final expense, and IUL coverage inside their own apps and websites, with Bestow handling underwriting, payment, billing, policy delivery, and ongoing administration behind the scenes. Integrations span ACORD life and annuities data standards, Adyen for payments, Cloudflare for identity and security, and data vendors including Bevel, Clareto, EIS, ExamOne, and Human API ReFlex Select. There is no publicly accessible developer portal or API reference — partner documentation, sandbox access, and Protect API onboarding are gated behind a partner login at docs.bestow.com and arranged through Bestow's sales and partnerships team.

providers.name: Bossa Nova Robotics
providers.description: Bossa Nova Robotics develops autonomous retail robots and AI solutions for inventory management. Their flagship robot, Bossa Nova, scans store aisles in Walmart and other retailers, providing real‑time out‑of‑stock detection and analytics. The company shares its technology and learnings through open documentation and APIs to help other businesses build similar automation solutions.

providers.name: Bunge
providers.description: Bunge Global SA is a multinational agribusiness and food company connecting farmers to consumers by sourcing, processing, and supplying oilseed and grain products. Operates across grain origination, oilseed processing, refined and specialty oils, milling, sugarcane and biofuel production, and fertilizer sales. In 2025 Bunge completed its merger with Viterra to create a major global agricultural trading and processing platform.

providers.name: BYD
providers.description: BYD Company Ltd. is a Chinese multinational manufacturing conglomerate headquartered in Shenzhen, founded in 1995 by Wang Chuanfu and publicly listed in Hong Kong (1211) and Shenzhen (002594). Originally a rechargeable-battery maker, BYD has grown into one of the world's largest producers of new-energy vehicles (battery-electric and plug-in hybrid cars, buses, and trucks), power batteries (including the Blade Battery), consumer and automotive electronics, rail transit systems (SkyRail/SkyShuttle), forklifts, and solar and energy-storage products. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of hongshan and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; BYD is a hardware and manufacturing company and does not publish a public developer or API program.

providers.name: Claripi
providers.description: Claripi provides innovative solutions for medical imaging through AI-powered image processing, data analytics, and software tools. Founded in 2015, the company offers products such as Clari CT.AI, Clari Pulmo, and Clari SIGMAM, helping clinicians improve diagnosis, reduce radiation dose, and streamline workflows across radiology, pulmonology, and musculoskeletal imaging.

providers.name: Complete Omics
providers.description: Complete Omics is a Baltimore, Maryland based, CLIA- and CAP-accredited molecular diagnostics company building ultra-deep, clinically reproducible proteomics and multi-omics testing. Its Complete360 liquid- and tissue-biopsy platform and Valid-NEO companion-diagnostics platform apply AI-assisted analysis of high-dimensional biological data across oncology, neurology, cardiovascular, and immunology testing. The company holds 40+ global patents and 20+ top-tier journal publications. Complete Omics is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. No public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface exists at this time; this profile captures company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Cooper Standard Holdings
providers.description: Cooper Standard Holdings is a global automotive supplier headquartered in Northville, Michigan, that designs, engineers, manufactures, and sells sealing systems, fuel and brake delivery systems, and fluid transfer systems for global automotive original equipment manufacturers including Ford, General Motors, Stellantis, and Volkswagen. The company operates in approximately 20 countries with around 32,000 employees and is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker CPS. Cooper Standard does not publish a public developer program or REST APIs. Its digital presence centers on corporate, investor, supplier, and careers websites.

providers.name: Corepowerholdingspteltd
providers.description: Corepowerholdingspteltd, operating as Core Power, is a UK‑based engineering company developing ship‑based nuclear energy systems to provide reliable, low‑carbon power for maritime and remote industrial applications. The firm designs, integrates and deploys modular reactors, propulsion technologies and supporting infrastructure, aiming to accelerate the energy transition for shipping, offshore platforms and coastal communities. With a focus on safety, regulatory compliance and scalable solutions, Core Power combines expertise in nuclear engineering, marine architecture and clean‑tech innovation to deliver power where it is needed most.

providers.name: Democracy Earth
providers.description: Democracy Earth Foundation is a Y Combinator- and Fast Forward-backed 501(c)(3) nonprofit building free, open-source, blockchain-based software for incorruptible digital governance and voting. Its flagship Sovereign application is a liquid-democracy platform that lets communities vote directly on issues or delegate their voting power to trusted peers over a decentralized, censorship-resistant network. The Foundation also develops self-sovereign identity (a proof-of-humanity protocol), a universal basic income token, and a minimal quadratic-voting DAO, publishing all of its work as open-source repositories rather than as a commercial, hosted API. Democracy Earth is a protocol-first, decentralized project without a hosted REST API or developer program.

providers.name: E-Pal
providers.description: E-Pal is a gaming social platform with the tagline "Never Battle Alone" that connects gamers to find teammates, compete, and socialize around competitive and casual gaming experiences. Its mobile apps (iOS and Android) let users discover gaming companions ("ePals"), form squads, use voice chat, play minigames, and hang out in social spaces. Product surfaces include Games (finding great teammates for titles like League of Legends and Valorant), Chilling (social hangout spaces), and Custom personalized experiences, plus a tiered community of eStars, Legend ePals (professional-rank players), and E-Chat. E-Pal is a consumer application and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts at this time; this profile was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and enriched as an identity-only lead.

providers.name: Efference AI
providers.description: Efference AI is a robotics perception and compute company building the hardware-plus-software foundation for data-driven robotics at scale. Founded in 2025 by Gianluca Bencomo and based in San Francisco (Y Combinator Fall 2025), Efference treats machine vision as a software problem, pairing affordable stereo-camera hardware with learned 3D-perception foundation models ("cheap hardware + great algorithms"). Its M1 device targets distributed, robotics-grade data collection at scale, while the H1 stereo system is built for real-time cloud inference with foundation models. The company serves autonomous vehicles, humanoid robots, and drones, and publishes hardware-interfacing documentation and firmware through its GitHub organization. As of this profile Efference exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or authenticated service surface.

providers.name: Enlitic
providers.description: Enlitic is a healthcare AI company building the Curie platform to standardize, anonymize, and manage medical imaging data across radiology and enterprise imaging workflows. Its products include ENDEX for real-time DICOM data standardization and enrichment, ENCOG for automated PHI/PII anonymization of imaging data, Migratek for large-scale imaging data migration, and Ensight for imaging data management and analytics. Enlitic serves radiologists, imaging IT teams, executives, and researchers to improve imaging data quality, interoperability, and operational efficiency. Enlitic does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; integration is delivered through its products and a customer support portal. Backed by Amplify Partners and DCVC.

providers.name: Examedi
providers.description: Examedi is a Latin American healthtech company providing at-home medical and laboratory testing. Patients book online and a healthcare professional visits their home to collect samples (blood, urine, PCR and more), with results delivered digitally through the company's app and website. Examedi operates in Chile (examedi.cl) and Mexico (examedi.mx) and runs a live authenticated application backend at api.examedi.com. The company is backed by General Catalyst. No public developer program, API documentation, or OpenAPI definition is published at this time; this profile records the company's identity and discovered surfaces for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Finless Foods
providers.description: Finless Foods is an Emeryville, California cellular-agriculture company founded in 2017 by Michael Selden and Brian Wyrwas to grow real seafood from fish cells instead of harvesting it from the ocean. Its scientists established proprietary marine cell lines and a culture-media and bioreactor process that cultivates bluefin tuna and other high-value species into three-dimensional tissue with comparable taste, texture and nutrition to wild-caught fish, and the company has also shipped a plant-based tuna alternative into foodservice while the cell-cultivated line moves toward regulatory clearance and commercial launch. Backed by SOSV/IndieBio and a USD 34 million Series B closed in March 2022, and now led by co-founder and CEO Brandon Chen with co-founder Brian Wyrwas as CSO, Finless Foods is a food-biotechnology and consumer-products business rather than a software vendor: it operates a single-page Squarespace marketing site with a Squarespace Commerce cart, publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract, and its 2017-era GitHub organization holds one dormant static-HTML repository.

providers.name: FRISS
providers.description: FRISS builds AI-powered fraud detection and risk assessment software (Trust Automation Platform) for property and casualty insurers, scoring policies, claims and renewals in real time. No public API documentation or machine-readable API contract was found on its public surface.

providers.name: Gbatteries
providers.description: GBatteries (GBatteries Energy Canada Inc.) is an Ottawa, Ontario battery technology company developing lithium-metal battery cells and an intelligent, adaptive battery management system for the next generation of electric mobility, from land to air. Its technology targets fast charging (sub-15-minute charge), high energy density (450+ Wh/kg), extended cycle life, and enhanced safety by actively reducing irreversible internal cell damage. The company reports 60+ granted or pending patents and 9+ years of R&D, and was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company. GBatteries is a hardware and battery-management deeptech firm; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Givecampus
providers.description: GiveCampus is a digital-first fundraising and alumni-engagement platform built for educational institutions - K-12 schools, colleges, universities, and their affiliated foundations, alumni associations, and nonprofits. The platform provides online giving pages, Giving Days, crowdfunding and peer-to-peer (advocacy) fundraising, matching and challenge gifts, event and volunteer management, donor management and advancement CRM tooling, payment processing, and stewardship and engagement features that help advancement teams raise more money at a lower cost. Founded in 2015 and backed by Y Combinator, GiveCampus is used by thousands of schools and institutions across the United States and internationally. This API Evangelist profile tracks GiveCampus as a company in the network; the company operates a closed SaaS product and does not publish a public developer API, so this record is identity- and infrastructure-focused.

providers.name: Homzmart
providers.description: Homzmart is a Cairo, Egypt-based online marketplace for furniture, home decor, appliances, and workspace products that connects thousands of local manufacturers, brands, and merchants with consumers across Egypt and the wider MENA region. Founded in 2019 by Mahmoud Ibrahim and Ibrahim Mohamed, the platform lists more than 55,000 products and layers in flexible financing, delivery, and assembly services. Homzmart runs consumer web and mobile storefronts alongside merchant-facing "Sell With Us" and "Homzmart For Business" programs, and has raised roughly $40M in venture funding including a $15M Series A, with 500 Global among its backers. No public developer API program, SDK, or API documentation was found during enrichment; the company publishes a vulnerability-disclosure page and standard trust/policy pages.

providers.name: Hyro
providers.description: Hyro is a responsible AI-powered conversational and agentic communications platform, best known for deploying AI assistants and voice/chat agents for large healthcare systems as well as other regulated enterprises. Its platform automates patient and customer engagement across web, SMS, and voice channels — handling tasks such as appointment management, IT help-desk requests, call routing, and answering high-volume repetitive questions — using a knowledge-graph-driven natural language engine positioned around explainability and control. Hyro is headquartered in New York and is backed by Norwest Venture Partners. At enrichment time Hyro exposes no public developer API or OpenAPI specification; its public technical surface consists of a customer product dashboard (docs.hyro.ai) and a live operational status page (status.hyro.ai). This profile was surfaced from the Norwest portfolio and enriched from verifiable public signals only.

providers.name: Image API
providers.description: Image API was a digital business automation company specializing in the digitization, optimization, and management of business processes, forms, and content. The company has rebranded as Docufree and provides enterprise services including document scanning and imaging, digital mailroom automation, business process automation (RPA/AI), electronic signature, cloud document management, and outbound print and mail. Despite the legacy brand name "Image API", the company does not publish a public developer API or API portal. This repository tracks APIs, SDKs, and developer resources should they become available.

providers.name: Insurify
providers.description: Insurify is an insurance comparison marketplace licensed in all 50 U.S. states with real-time API integrations into 120+ carriers (500+ across the carrier network), covering auto, home, renters, pet, commercial auto, life, motorcycle, and travel. Consumers get side-by-side quotes in roughly two minutes and can buy online or through licensed agents. Insurify's Evia AI agent (Expert Virtual Insurance Agent) is a voice-and-chat agent that handles end-to-end shopping conversations with bind-ready quotes and renewal-cycle re-shopping. In February 2026 Insurify launched the insurance industry's first ChatGPT app via OpenAI's app library.

providers.name: Irreducible
providers.description: Irreducible is a cryptography company accelerating the zero-knowledge (ZK) revolution by turning advanced proof systems into cost-efficient, production infrastructure. The company invented and leads Binius, a state-of-the-art zero-knowledge SNARK built on towers of binary fields that natively handles bitwise operations to deliver order-of-magnitude speedups over prime-field systems on ordinary CPUs, GPUs, mobile devices, and custom FPGA hardware. Irreducible operates its own FPGA-based proof-generation service and publishes Binius as open-source Rust crates. Target applications include self-sovereign identity, on-chain privacy, content provenance for AI-generated media, and verifiable supercomputing. Irreducible was backed by a Series A co-led by Paradigm and Bain Capital Crypto. This profile was seeded as a Paradigm portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the company exposes an open-source developer surface (crates + docs) rather than a public REST API.

providers.name: Irregular
providers.description: Irregular (formerly Pattern Labs) is a frontier AI security lab founded in 2023 by Dan Lahav and Eli David with the mission of protecting the world as AI systems become increasingly capable and sophisticated. The company runs security assessments and red-team evaluations against advanced frontier AI models, works to set security standards for the frontier AI industry, and is trusted by major AI labs to evaluate model risk. Irregular raised $80M co-led by Sequoia Capital and Redpoint Ventures at a $450M valuation. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a Redpoint Ventures portfolio company; Irregular publishes no public API, SDK, or developer portal at this time, so this record captures company identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Knight Fintech
providers.description: Knight Fintech is a Mumbai-based banking technology company that sells digital lending infrastructure to Indian banks and NBFCs. It positions itself as "India's leading digital lending infrastructure platform", stating it powers 500+ financial institutions across co-lending, digital lending, treasury management, supply chain finance, embedded finance and credit line on UPI, alongside a Knight Aurix product line. The company describes its approach as cloud-first, API-driven middleware that integrates with legacy core banking systems without displacing them. It is enterprise sales-led: there is no public developer portal, no published API documentation, no SDKs and no self-service signup — evaluation runs through a scheduled demo.

providers.name: Kytopen
providers.description: Kytopen Corp. is a Cambridge, Massachusetts life-sciences instrument company, spun out of MIT, that builds non-viral, continuous-flow cellular engineering hardware for cell and gene therapy discovery and manufacturing. Its Flowfect technology combines continuous fluid flow with electric fields to deliver mRNA, DNA and CRISPR payloads into cells, and is sold as two benchtop platforms: Flowfect Discover, an automated small-volume system that runs up to 96 high-throughput transfections in about ten minutes, and Flowfect TX, a closed-system instrument that processes 10-50 million cells per mL at 25-50 mL per minute for GMP-scale manufacturing. The company sells laboratory instruments and consumables to biopharma and CDMO customers through a quote and technology-access motion; it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind. Instrument data integration for Flowfect customers is delivered by a third party, Ganymede Bio, under its own platform and its own contract - that surface belongs to Ganymede, not to Kytopen.

providers.name: Las Vegas Sands
providers.description: Las Vegas Sands Corp. is the world's leading developer and operator of integrated resorts, including The Venetian Resort in Las Vegas (divested in 2022) and Marina Bay Sands in Singapore. The company operates in the casino, hospitality, convention, and entertainment industries.

providers.name: Logility
providers.description: Logility is an AI-powered supply chain planning platform providing solutions for demand sensing, inventory optimization, supply planning, S&OP process management, and supply chain analytics. Part of Aptean, Logility serves 600+ clients across 80 countries with capabilities for demand planning, inventory optimization, scenario planning, manufacturing execution, and supplier management across 12+ industry verticals.

providers.name: Mips
providers.description: MIPS is a processor IP and compute company building embedded and edge AI silicon for automotive, robotics, and mission-critical systems. Its portfolio spans the MIPS RISC-V CPU families (M8500, I8500, P8700, S8200), the ARC processor and NPX/VPX accelerator lines, and development tooling such as MIPS Atlas Explorer virtual platforms and the ASIP Designer / ASIP Programmer toolchains. MIPS frames its offering around a "Sense, Think, Act, Communicate" signal chain for real-time autonomy — what it calls Physical AI at the edge. MIPS is a semiconductor IP licensor rather than a public web-API provider; this profile was surfaced as a Mayfield portfolio company and enriched with identity and probed security posture.

providers.name: Moog
providers.description: Moog Inc. is a worldwide designer, manufacturer, and integrator of precision motion and fluid control products and solutions for aerospace, defense, industrial, and medical applications. Product divisions include actuation, motion systems, motors, propulsion, valves, aerospace components, and defense systems. Moog does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Nisshi
providers.description: Nisshi (formerly Tansu) is an open-source (Apache-2.0), Rust-built, Apache Kafka compatible message broker that stores data in S3, PostgreSQL, SQLite/libSQL or memory and can write schema-validated topics (JSON Schema, Avro, Protocol Buffers) as Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake tables. Its surface is the Kafka wire protocol rather than an HTTP API, and no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI or GraphQL contract is published. The project has been renamed Nisshi (README: 'Nisshi (nee Tansu)'); github.com/tansu-io/tansu redirects to github.com/nisshi-io/nisshi and tansu.io no longer resolves in DNS.

providers.name: Numetric
providers.description: Numetric operates a cloud data-analytics platform exposed through the Numetric REST API (api.numetric.com) alongside a developer portal and an Intercom-hosted help center for support. It is a portfolio company of Insight Partners, added to the API Evangelist network and enriched from its public API surface. The public API is authentication-gated and the marketing site is bot-protected, so this profile captures the verified developer, API, and support surfaces discovered by live probes.

providers.name: Optain
providers.description: Optain (Optain Health) is a healthcare technology company delivering AI-powered retinal imaging and oculomics for early, non-invasive detection of chronic disease at the point of care. Its platform pairs the FDA 510(k)-cleared Resolve robotic fundus camera and Eyetelligence Assure Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) with teleophthalmology grading to screen for diabetic retinopathy, glaucoma, age-related macular degeneration, hypertensive retinopathy and cardiovascular risk in seconds, without dilation. Rooted in Australian-founded Eyetelligence (2019) and research from the Centre for Eye Research Australia, Optain integrates with major EHR systems and returns ICD-10-coded reports, typically same day. Backed by Insight Partners. No public developer API surface is currently published.

providers.name: Osseus
providers.description: Osseus is a secure research intelligence platform - "the secure research brain for R&D" - that connects the tools teams already use, scattered documents, and the knowledge in people's heads into one permissioned research brain. Permission-aware AI agents surface relevant evidence, experts, and next actions; proactive watchers flag integration issues and repeated work before costly mistakes; and background automations run across connected systems. The company also exposes a memory API for connecting internal agents to a governed evidence layer. Osseus (Y Combinator S2026) was founded by Anish Mariathasan and Ayush Patel and serves R&D teams across aerospace, automotive, robotics, electronics, pharma, and biotech.

providers.name: Pomelo Health
providers.description: Pomelo Health (formerly Chronometriq, founded 2012, headquartered in Montreal with offices in Boston and Toronto) is a Canadian patient-engagement software company operating within the TELUS Health ecosystem. Its cloud platform helps medical clinics reduce no-shows and modernize the front-desk experience with online booking/e-booking, automated SMS/voice/email appointment reminders, digital intake eForms, telemedicine, secure two-way messaging, patient broadcasts, and a patient portal. Pomelo ships as an EMR add-on that syncs with TELUS Health EMRs — Accuro, Medesync, and TELUS CHR — rather than as an open integration platform. As of this review Pomelo Health publishes NO public developer portal, NO documented REST/OpenAPI, and NO public HL7 FHIR CapabilityStatement or SMART-on-FHIR surface; third-party connectivity is achieved through the underlying EMR partner APIs, so this profile is an honest identity stub for a company with a gated, partner-only integration model. Home market: Canada.

providers.name: Printi
providers.description: Printi is a Brazilian online commercial print marketplace founded in 2012 and based in Barueri / Sao Paulo, offering business cards, flyers, stationery, labels and stickers, packaging, brochures and folders, and promotional items through an online configurator that prices each job dynamically by format, paper, finish, and quantity. Printi is a Cimpress brand - Vistaprint took a minority stake in 2014 and Cimpress acquired a majority stake in 2020 - and sits in the same Cimpress portfolio as Vistaprint. Printi formerly published a public developer portal at developer.printi.com.br ("Printi API", hosted on ReadMe with a Run in Postman button) covering catalog, quoting, and order operations, but that portal is no longer resolvable and appears decommissioned. There is no live, documented, self-serve public API today; programmatic and reseller integration is now partner-gated, channeled through Cimpress's mass-customization / developer platform and Printi's "Comprar com Vendedor" reseller channel. The APIs below are modeled from the historical portal and observable storefront behavior - they are NOT sourced from a currently published public specification (see review.yml, endpointsModeled).

providers.name: Quantstamp
providers.description: Quantstamp is a blockchain security firm founded in 2017 that provides expert Web3 security assessments, including smart contract audits, infrastructure and Layer 2 audits, zero-knowledge circuit reviews, and economic exploit analysis. The company has conducted over 1,300 audits across more than 60 blockchain ecosystems and helped secure billions of dollars in digital assets. Quantstamp publishes public audit reports through its certificate portal, maintains open-source Web3 security tooling on GitHub (L2 block explorer standards, ERC-4337 checkers, halo2 zero-knowledge libraries), and runs a research blog. Quantstamp is a services and consulting provider rather than an API-first platform, and does not currently publish a first-party developer API or OpenAPI specification. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund.

providers.name: Ramre
providers.description: Ramre (RamRe) is the brand associated with Ram Reinsurance, now operating as American Overseas Group Limited (AOG) — a Bermuda-based insurance holding company that is tax resident in the United Kingdom. Through its U.S. subsidiaries the group writes non-standard automobile insurance and provides related management services, and it operates as a reinsurer through a subsidiary based in Barbados. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. An enrichment pass found no public developer program, API, documentation, or SDK surface: this is a financial-services holding company whose public web presence (ramre.com now redirects to aoreltd.com) is corporate and investor-relations oriented, with no machine-readable API artifacts to catalog.

providers.name: ReadSoft
providers.description: ReadSoft was a provider of intelligent automation and business process management solutions for accounts payable and other document-intensive processes. Acquired by Lexmark in 2014, the technology was rolled into Kofax and is now part of Tungsten Automation. ReadSoft no longer publishes a public developer-facing REST API; its capture and AP automation products are delivered as installed enterprise software with partner-only integration resources.

providers.name: Redesign Health
providers.description: Redesign Health is a global venture and applied technology firm that backs and builds next-generation healthcare companies. Founded in 2018, it partners with founders and existing businesses through AI-native venture capital and buyout strategies, and reports having touched more than 15 million patient lives while raising over $1.5 billion in capital. The firm operates from New York, Los Angeles, Riyadh, and Bengaluru. Redesign Health surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of General Catalyst; this profile captures its public identity. Redesign Health publishes no public developer API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: RoomRaccoon
providers.description: RoomRaccoon is an all-in-one hotel management software platform for independent hotels, B&Bs, guesthouses, hostels, and small chains, founded in 2017 by Tymen van Dyl and Nadja Buckenberger and headquartered in Breda, Netherlands with major operations in Cape Town, South Africa, plus offices in Valencia, Spain and Lisbon, Portugal. The platform bundles a cloud Property Management System (PMS), a Channel Manager that synchronises rates, availability, and restrictions across 200+ OTAs, metasearch engines, GDSs, and bedbanks, a commission-free Booking Engine for direct website bookings with bookable add-ons, RaccoonPay for integrated, multi-currency guest payments, and RaccoonRev for competitor insights and revenue management. RoomRaccoon advertises 400+ integrations with partners such as Booking.com, Expedia, Lightspeed, and Sage, and was named World's Best Hotel Channel Manager at the 2023 World Travel Tech Awards. A connectivity / partner API exists at api.roomraccoon.com (e.g. POS endpoint at /api/?type=POS&version=2) but is access-controlled: prospective integrators must request an API key and Hotel ID by emailing connectivity@roomraccoon.com, and no public OpenAPI specification, public SDKs, or public GitHub organisation are published.

providers.name: Seed Club
providers.description: Seed Club is a web3 accelerator and community focused on consumer crypto, helping founders build "a dramatically more interesting internet" where the value created by online communities is captured by people rather than platforms. It runs a cohort-based accelerator (currently SC07: Consumer Crypto), a ventures/investment arm, and a portfolio program, alongside a broader community of builders, creators, and token communities. Seed Club operates as a community-owned organization and publishes a public Community Handbook, a blog, and open-source dApp code (Farcaster frames, crowdfunding smart contracts). It is a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures. Seed Club is a program and community brand rather than an API provider — it exposes no public developer platform, REST/GraphQL API, SDKs, or machine-readable discovery surface at this time.

providers.name: Sila Nanotechnologies
providers.description: Sila Nanotechnologies is a next-generation battery materials company founded in 2011 and headquartered in Alameda, California, with a commercial-scale manufacturing plant in Moses Lake, Washington. Sila develops silicon-based anode materials — marketed as Titan Silicon — that replace conventional graphite anodes to increase the energy density of lithium-ion batteries used in consumer electronics, electric vehicles, and other applications. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 8VC and Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Sila is a physical materials and manufacturing company and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public web and security posture only.

providers.name: Slip Robotics
providers.description: Slip Robotics is an Atlanta, Georgia-based robotics company that builds SlipBots, autonomous omnidirectional Automated Loading Robots (ALRs) that load and unload any truck trailer in about five minutes without a forklift ever entering the trailer. Each SlipBot carries up to eight pallets and roughly six tons, cutting driver dwell time from around ninety minutes to five while reducing material-handling damage and loading-dock accidents. The company also offers SlipLift, a platform that extends autonomous trailer loading and unloading to heavier freight and regional and last-mile routes. Slip Robotics markets its robots-as-a-service offering as requiring no IT integration, is backed by DCVC, and won Best New Innovation in supply chain technology at MODEX 2024. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Substrate
providers.description: Substrate is a semiconductor manufacturing company building America's next-generation chip foundry, with the stated mission of returning the United States to dominance in advanced semiconductor fabrication. Rather than designing chips, the company is inventing manufacturing technology intended to extend Moore's Law while lowering the cost of building state-of-the-art fabs and the wafers they produce. Substrate is a hard-tech / advanced-manufacturing venture backed by General Catalyst; it is a physical-infrastructure company and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced from the General Catalyst portfolio and enriched with the provider's public identity and security surface.

providers.name: Sun Basket
providers.description: Sun Basket is a San Francisco-based meal-kit and prepared-meal delivery service offering organic, chef-designed recipes and ingredients shipped as weekly subscription boxes, with menus spanning dietary programs such as paleo, keto, vegetarian, gluten-free, and diabetes-friendly options. Surfaced as a portfolio company of sapphire-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment, Sun Basket operates a consumer e-commerce and subscription-delivery product; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment probing.

providers.name: University of Bologna Open Data
providers.description: University of Bologna Open Data is a university open-data portal for Italy running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 34 datasets.

providers.name: Until
providers.description: Until (Until Labs) is a biotechnology company building the medical infrastructure to pause biological time. It is developing reversible cryopreservation systems for human organs, starting with organ-scale reversible cryopreservation to solve the donor-organ procurement and matching problem, and methodically scaling toward whole-body preservation. The lab translates the fundamentals of cryobiology into engineered workflows across five dimensions — perfusion, cryoprotectants, cooling, rewarming, and organ health assessment — using vitrification (glass, not ice) to prevent ice formation during preservation and safe rewarming. Founded by Laura Deming and Hunter Davis, Until has raised $100M+ to date and is backed by Founders Fund. Until is a research-and-development company with no public API surface; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Viatris
providers.description: Viatris Inc. is a global healthcare company formed in November 2020 through the combination of Mylan and Pfizer's Upjohn division. Viatris is one of the world's largest producers of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) and generic medicines, serving patients in more than 165 countries. The company has undergone significant strategic restructuring, divesting its India API business and women's healthcare business. Viatris focuses on branded generics, complex generics, biosimilars, and branded specialty medicines. No public developer API program or developer portal has been identified; the company operates in B2B pharmaceutical supply chain contexts without a public technology integration API offering.

providers.name: Vymo
providers.description: Vymo is a sales-engagement and distribution-management platform for financial institutions — banks, insurers, and asset managers — helping field sales and collections teams manage leads, allocate and prioritize activities, and capture engagement in a mobile-first app. It layers AI-driven nudges, activity capture, and analytics on top of CRM and core systems, and integrates with existing enterprise ecosystems. Vymo does not publish a self-serve public developer API or documentation portal; its integrations are delivered through enterprise/partner connections. Backed by Emergence Capital and headquartered in Sunnyvale, California.

1919 (壹玖壹玖 / 1919酒类直供) is a Chengdu-based Chinese alcoholic-beverage retail and supply-chain platform operated by Sichuan 1919 Wines & Spirits SCM Co., Ltd. Founded in 2006, it runs an omnichannel online-to-offline model: the 1919吃喝 consumer app and a third-party e-commerce matrix layered on more than 3,000 franchised stores across 1,000+ Chinese cities, marketed on a 19-minute rapid-delivery promise, alongside a B2B liquor supply-chain business selling order management, logistics and data-marketing services to distributors. The company listed on China's NEEQ board in 2014 (830993), took a RMB 2 billion strategic investment from Alibaba in 2018, and delisted from NEEQ in 2023; its shares now change hands on private secondary marketplaces.

providers.name: 51Talk
providers.description: 51Talk is an online English-language education platform that connects learners with certified teachers through one-on-one live video lessons. Founded in 2011 and listed on the NYSE, the company operates across 90+ countries with a large base of accredited teachers, delivering a structured curriculum and ready-made teaching materials for both children and adult learners. Following a strategic shift, 51Talk focuses on international markets outside mainland China, including the Philippines and the broader Southeast Asia region, and recruits teachers globally. It is a consumer education company backed by DCM Ventures; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface, so this repo carries only identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: A-Frame
providers.description: A-Frame Brands is a Los Angeles-based consumer brand incubator and product-development company founded in 2019 by entrepreneur Ari Bloom and actor Hill Harper. It partners with celebrities and cultural figures to build purpose-driven personal-care, beauty, fragrance, home-care, and pet-care brands, taking each from opportunity identification through product development, design, sourcing, production, and retail go-to-market. Brands in its portfolio include LOVED01 (John Legend), Kinlo (Naomi Osaka), Proudly (Gabrielle Union and Dwyane Wade), and Purrfect Paws, sold through retailers such as Target, Walmart, Amazon, CVS, JCPenney, QVC, and Bath & Body Works. Backed by Initialized Capital. This is a consumer company profile in the API Evangelist network; A-Frame publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: aardaia
providers.description: Aardaia is a Wageningen (Netherlands) agri-biotech startup that turns wild plant species into new commercial crops through accelerated domestication, combining classical plant breeding with modern genomics and AI rather than genetic modification. Its flagship is the aardaker, a nitrogen-fixing legume-tuber that yields a naturally protein-rich crop (roughly 10g protein per 100g of fresh tuber) without synthetic fertilizer. The company raised a EUR 5M seed round led by Point Nine in 2026. Aardaia does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a Point Nine portfolio lead.

providers.name: agavegames
providers.description: Agave Games is a mobile game publisher based in Istanbul, Turkey, founded in 2021 by Alper Oner, Burak Kar, and Ali Baran Terzioglu. The company specializes in casual puzzle games played by millions, with titles including Find the Cat, Wonder Link, What The Hex, Soda Match, and Art Block Puzzle across iOS and Android. Backed by Balderton Capital and Felix Capital (Series A, December 2024), Agave Games is a consumer-facing gaming company; it publishes no public developer portal, API, or documentation surface. This profile was surfaced as a Balderton Capital portfolio company and enriched with a live domain-security probe and identity hygiene.

providers.name: APT Medical
providers.description: APT Medical (Suzhou APT Medical Inc., Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market 688617.SH) is a Chinese interventional medical-device manufacturer specializing in electrophysiology and cardiovascular intervention. Its product portfolio spans electrophysiology navigation systems, navigated, mapping and ablation catheters, transseptal needles and steerable sheaths, interventional cardiology access, diagnostic and therapeutic products (guiding catheters, PTCA balloon catheters, guidewires), peripheral intervention devices, and OEM/ODM catheter and nitinol components. The company sells globally and publishes clinical cases, expert education, and investor relations material. It is a hardware medical-device manufacturer and does not currently expose a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and enriched from public company properties.

providers.name: Archimetis
providers.description: Archimetis builds an AI-powered Operational Reasoning System for refineries, chemicals, and heavy process industries. The platform unifies data from disparate operational sources — plant historians, linear programs, advanced process control models, and digital engineering documents — into a single intelligence layer, then continuously monitors operations, performs complex engineering analysis, and applies industry best practices to surface actionable insights for operators and engineers. Marketed as "See more. Solve smarter," it targets margin improvement, cost savings, and process safety across refining, chemicals, and other heavy industries. Founded in 2023, the company raised $11.5M led by Inspired Capital. Archimetis is an enterprise B2B platform engaged through guided working sessions and demos; it does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Axton
providers.description: Axton Inc. is a custom equipment manufacturing company based in Delta, British Columbia, Canada. Founded in 1976, it serves heavy industries such as petro‑chemical, oil & gas, pulp & paper, mining, and environmental sectors. The firm designs, engineers, fabricates and assembles pressure vessels, heat exchangers, tanks, rotating equipment, and complex mechanical systems, offering end‑to‑end solutions from concept through delivery.

providers.name: Base
providers.description: Building quick backends

providers.name: Beike
providers.description: Beike (KE Holdings Inc.) is China's largest integrated online-and-offline platform for housing transactions and services, connecting home buyers, sellers, renters, and real estate agents. It operates the Beike (贝壳) platform and the Lianjia (链家) brokerage brand, along with businesses spanning existing-home and new-home transactions, home rentals, and home renovation and furnishing. Its Agent Cooperation Network (ACN) lets brokerages and agents share listings and commissions across a standardized workflow. KE Holdings is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: BEKE) and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (HKEX: 2423) and is headquartered in Beijing. This API Evangelist profile was created from venture-portfolio sourcing and enriched via the pipeline; Beike operates consumer-facing housing web and mobile properties and does not currently publish a public developer API program.

providers.name: Bemyfriends
providers.description: Bemyfriends is a global fandom business company that transforms the value of fandoms into successful enterprises. It offers comprehensive solutions including IT platforms, e‑commerce fulfillment, fan‑based platforms, and strategic consulting to help brands leverage fan communities worldwide. The company connects fans, brands, and creators, delivering total solutions for the growing global fandom market.

providers.name: Bluevoyant
providers.description: BlueVoyant is a cyber defense company that combines managed detection and response (MDR), digital risk protection, and supply-chain (third-party) cyber risk management into a cloud-native platform backed by a global security operations capability. It continuously monitors customers' internal networks, endpoints, and cloud along with their external attack surface and vendor ecosystem, using threat intelligence to detect, investigate, and remediate threats. BlueVoyant serves enterprises and governments across sectors and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead (8vc); this profile is maintained by the enrichment pipeline against public sources.

providers.name: Botalys
providers.description: Botalys develops and supplies premium botanical ingredients through biomimetic indoor farming. The company offers rare botanicals such as Korean Ginseng, Rhodiola, and Sichuan Red Sage for nutraceuticals and cosmetics, emphasizing quality, traceability, and sustainability. It provides a platform for tailored plant development and sample packs, aiming to make sourcing of rare botanicals possible and sustainable for clients.

providers.name: Brain Jar Games
providers.description: Brain Jar Games is a fully-remote independent video game studio founded by AAA industry veterans who have shipped franchises including Mass Effect, Dragon Age, RIFT, and Call of Duty. The studio builds bold, vibrant, music-driven action games designed to be shared; its debut title, Dead as Disco, blends kinetic gunplay with rhythm-synced choreography. Brain Jar Games is backed by Menlo Ventures and Transcend, having raised $12.2M across seed funding, and operates a four-day, 32-hour work week with team members across North America, Europe, and Turkey. The company publishes no public API, SDK, or developer platform; this profile tracks it as a venture-portfolio lead in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Butler Electric Group
providers.description: Butler Electric is a residential and commercial electrical contractor based in Sandy, Utah, offering services such as panel upgrades, basement wiring, EV charger installations, remodel electrical work, and general electrical repairs. With over 25 years of experience, the licensed team provides reliable, code‑compliant solutions across the Salt Lake City area, emphasizing safety, professionalism, and customer satisfaction.

providers.name: Carbon38
providers.description: Carbon38 is a performance‑fashion brand offering activewear, accessories and apparel designed for movement. The company focuses on high‑quality, functional clothing for yoga, Pilates, running and everyday wear, emphasizing sustainability and innovative fabrics. Their online store provides a wide range of products, including leggings, sports bras, shoes, and digital gift cards, serving a global customer base.

providers.name: Central Coast Agriculture
providers.description: Central Coast Agriculture, Inc. (CCA) is a vertically integrated California cannabis cultivator and manufacturer headquartered in the Santa Ynez Valley north of Santa Barbara, best known for its Raw Garden brand of fresh-frozen concentrates, vapes and infused pre-rolls. The company describes itself as a progressive farm focused on utilizing science and sustainability to grow quality, modern crops, and operates its own farming, genetics/breeding and extraction programs. It is a physical agricultural and consumer-packaged-goods business: it publishes a corporate site, a consumer brand site and a wholesale ordering page, but no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Cerula Care
providers.description: Cerula Care provides integrated psycho‑oncology collaborative care for health systems and oncology practices. It embeds expert psychosocial support into cancer treatment workflows, improving patient outcomes and unlocking reimbursable collaborative‑care billing codes. The company combines clinical expertise with AI‑driven models to deliver coordinated mental‑health services, reporting outcomes and revenue for providers.

providers.name: Circles - Online Group Support
providers.description: Circles (legal entity 7Chairs Ltd, founded 2020 by Irad Eichler and Guy Winch) is a consumer digital mental-health company operating an online emotional support platform at circlesup.com. It runs live, facilitator-led audio and video support groups plus peer chat for people working through narcissistic abuse, toxic relationships, breakups, divorce, grief, anxiety and stress, delivered through iOS and Android apps and a web app at app.circlesup.com. It is a direct-to-consumer subscription service, not a developer platform: as of the 2026-09-05 enrichment pass the company publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable contract, and its api.circlesup.com host answers every request with an HTTP 503 edge page.

providers.name: CityMall
providers.description: CityMall is an Indian social-commerce and e-commerce platform operated by Rashanbox Retail Private Limited (CIN U52190HR2020PTC086114), serving Tier-2 and Tier-3 towns through a community-group-buying model. Customers shop across groceries, staples, fashion, electronics, home and kitchen, beauty and health, kids and toys, and books and stationery, with cash-on-delivery and free-delivery options via web and native Android/iOS apps. The company runs on modern web infrastructure (CloudFront CDN, next-gen image optimization) and is backed by Accel, General Catalyst, and Norwest Venture Partners. No public developer API, portal, or documentation surface is currently published; this profile captures the company identity and its verified domain-security posture.

providers.name: Codebase
providers.description: Codebase is a global technology services company that provides dedicated software development teams to help businesses build, scale, and maintain high-quality digital products. They specialize in offering offshore talent, agile development processes, and end‑to‑end project management, enabling clients to accelerate product delivery while reducing costs. Codebase serves a wide range of industries, delivering custom web, mobile, and cloud solutions, and emphasizes transparent collaboration, robust security, and long‑term partnership with its customers.

providers.name: Coretissuebioengineering
providers.description: Coretissuebioengineering, operating as CoreTissue BioEngineering Inc., is a Japan‑based deep‑tech medical‑device startup founded in 2016. It develops regenerative ligament implants for ACL reconstruction using proprietary decellularization technology, aiming to restore athletes’ performance quickly. The company runs clinical trials and plans commercial rollout of its tissue‑regenerated ligaments.

providers.name: Credibly
providers.description: Credibly is a small business lending platform offering a REST API (API V2) for originating merchant cash advances, working capital loans, business lines of credit, equipment financing, and SBA loans through an approved broker and referral partner network. The API supports application submission, multi-part document uploads, stipulation identification, and webhook-based status notifications within a SOC 2-compliant environment.

providers.name: Crossover Markets
providers.description: Crossover Markets operates CROSSx, an execution‑only digital‑asset electronic communication network (ECN) that provides institutions with ultra‑low‑latency trade execution and custom dark and lit liquidity pools. The platform does not offer custody or brokerage services and connects participants via FIX API or a GUI, trading 24/7 with sub‑20 µs matching engine latency. Fees start at 0.01% and decrease with volume, with commissions waived for certain stablecoin pairs.

providers.name: Databolt
providers.description: Databolt is a digital design agency that builds software applications, websites, and custom web platforms for startups and businesses. The agency offers UI/UX design, web development, WordPress and Prestashop premium themes, SEO services, and operates GPU- and CPU-optimized clusters for rendering and computational data processing.

providers.name: Diametric Capital
providers.description: Diametric Capital is an equity long/short, multi-manager investment fund firm headquartered in Boston and New York. The firm builds customizable funds that isolate what it calls "True Alpha" — returns uncorrelated to the broader market — by removing beta and factor risk exposure to deliver performance with below-average volatility. Alongside its funds it offers aligned fee structures, capital partnerships, and business development support to entrepreneurs and emerging managers. Diametric Capital is a private financial firm and does not publish a public developer program, API, or SDK surface; it operates a secure client data room for investors and partners.

providers.name: Entocycle
providers.description: Entocycle is a London-based insect farming technology company building industrial-scale, controlled-environment facilities that use black soldier fly bioconversion to turn organic waste streams into insect protein for animal feed and organic fertilizer (frass). Its platform combines modular climate-controlled farm infrastructure, real-time AI-driven insect monitoring that counts and tracks insects across their lifecycle, and fully automated production systems to standardize output across deployments worldwide. Entocycle partners with waste management companies, agricultural producers, insect companies, and offtake buyers to develop and operate circular-economy insect farms. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Ergast F1
providers.description: F1 data from the beginning of the world championships in 1950

providers.name: Espressive
