providers.description: Espressive is an enterprise conversational-AI company whose flagship product, Barista, is a GenAI-based virtual support agent that automates the resolution of employee questions, issues, and requests across IT service management (ITSM), HR, and other internal help desks. Barista connects natural-language employee requests to automation by integrating with any REST-API-enabled third-party system (ServiceNow, Jira, Slack, Teams, Okta, Workday, Microsoft 365) via its Integration Designer and Barista Integration Marketplace, and reports employee adoption rates of 80-85% with 50-70% reductions in help-desk call volume. Espressive was acquired by Resolve (resolve.io) in September 2025 and folded into Resolve's agentic automation and orchestration platform; the standalone www.espressive.com surface now redirects to resolve.io. Espressive exposes no public developer API of its own -- Barista is a consumer of customer REST APIs, and product/developer documentation sits behind the Espressive support portal.

providers.name: EvolutionIQ
providers.description: EvolutionIQ is an AI-native insurance technology company providing claims guidance software for the insurance industry. Its platform surfaces claim-specific, actionable guidance to help claims professionals resolve complex cases, spanning Auto Casualty, Group & Individual Disability, Workers' Compensation, and Income Protection lines of business, plus Medhub, which converts unstructured medical records into claim-specific insights. Backed by First Round Capital and ICONIQ Capital, the company reports outcomes such as a 5-10 point reduction in combined ratio and 20%+ improvement in handling capacity. EvolutionIQ operates as a B2B enterprise vendor and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its identity and public-surface security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: firsthand
providers.description: firsthand is a healthcare company delivering peer-based support to individuals living with serious mental illness and substance use disorders, helping them access care, benefits, and community resources. Its guides and specialists have lived experience of mental illness, and its HITRUST r2-certified helpinghand platform coordinates care across states including Florida, Ohio, Michigan, Virginia, and Washington. firsthand is a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). This profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network; firsthand publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Fishbit
providers.description: Fishbit is a smart-aquarium management company whose platform pairs a mobile app (iOS/Android) with connected hardware — the Fishbit Monitor, which tracks water parameters such as pH, temperature, and salinity in real time, and the Fishbit Controller, which wirelessly automates aquarium equipment. Hobbyists and reef keepers use the system to remotely monitor tank conditions and automate lighting, pumps, and dosing. The company sells its monitoring and control hardware through an online store and ran a device-manufacturer partner program (e.g. RapidLED Corona integration). No public API, developer portal, or SDK is currently published; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a connected-hardware / IoT lead.

providers.name: Foodology
providers.description: Foodology is a Bogota-based food-tech company building what it calls the largest group of delivery-focused virtual restaurant brands in Latin America. Founded in 2019 by Daniela Izquierdo and Juan Guillermo Azuero, it operates a cloud-kitchen (ghost kitchen) model, creating restaurant brands from scratch and running them out of shared commissaries and kitchens so multiple brands share real estate, ingredients, and staff. Marquee brands include Brunch & Munch (the #1 breakfast delivery brand in Colombia) and Avocalia (a leading salad brand). Foodology runs more than 85 cloud kitchens across Colombia, Mexico, Brazil, and Peru and reports over 300,000 delivered orders per month. It is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Base10/Base Partners, Wollef, Kayyak, Chimera, and artist Maluma, having raised a $15M Series A and a later $50M round. This profile was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; Foodology is a consumer food-delivery operator and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: GATE Space
providers.description: GATE Space is an Austrian aerospace company redefining in-space mobility with high-thrust chemical propulsion systems for satellites, capsules, and landing vehicles. A TU Wien spinout founded in 2022 and backed by Techstars, the company builds the GATE Jetpack — a plug-and-play, refuelable propulsion module running on green propellants that lets satellites perform rapid orbit and attitude maneuvers with no integration effort. Its patented engines have been validated across 8,000+ hot-fire tests in atmospheric and vacuum conditions, manufactured in a European facility with a 98% local supply chain. GATE Space raised €6.3M via the EIC Accelerator and its propulsion system will fly on BeaconSat, Austria's first military satellite. This is a hardware manufacturer with no public developer/API surface; the profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company identity record.

providers.name: Hedge
providers.description: Hedge is a decentralized, non-custodial lending protocol built on the Solana blockchain that lets users mint USH, a stablecoin soft-pegged to the US dollar. Users deposit collateral into vaults to take out 0% interest loans for a one-time fee, maintaining a collateral-to-debt ratio above 110% to avoid liquidation. A stability pool absorbs liquidations and rewards depositors with discounted collateral, while a Peg Stability Module and a multi-source oracle (Pyth Network primary, Switchboard fallback) keep USH near its peg. Hedge is an on-chain protocol rather than a hosted REST API; its documentation, whitepaper, and audited Solana program are its public surface. Backed by Pantera Capital and Y Combinator; smart contracts audited by Kudelski, OtterSec, and Sec3.

providers.name: Helix
providers.description: Helix is a population genomics company operating an end-to-end precision health platform - a proprietary Exome+ next-generation sequencing assay, a CLIA/CAP-certified clinical lab, and bioinformatics tooling - that enables health systems, life sciences companies, and payers to integrate genomic data into clinical care and research at population scale. Through its DNA Product Studio, Helix exposes a partner-gated developer surface - a Genomics API (direct programmatic access to 100M+ base pairs including SNPs, indels, and copy number variants with panel-grade coverage of actionable genes), an Ancestry API (continental ancestry for 6 global populations or regional ancestry for 26+ populations), and an Insight API (user-specific results for hundreds of traits and conditions, from single-marker traits to machine-learning polygenic risk scores) - alongside Embedded Apps and an App Acceleration Framework for building white-label DNA products. API access is enterprise/partner-gated and provisioned through Helix partnerships; there is no public self-serve developer portal or openly published API specification, so the API surface below is modeled from Helix's public product documentation.

providers.name: Huuva
providers.description: Huuva is a Finnish food-court aggregator that lets customers order from multiple partner restaurants in a single order under the tagline "The hottest restaurants, all in one address." It operates physical food-court locations across Finland and runs a consumer web and mobile ordering platform for delivery and pickup, alongside lunch services and gift cards. Huuva is a consumer marketplace in the restaurant-technology and food-delivery space and does not currently publish a public developer or API program. It is a General Catalyst portfolio company based in Europe.

providers.name: Hyatt Hotels
providers.description: Hyatt Hotels Corporation (NYSE: H) is a Chicago-headquartered global hospitality company that develops, owns, operates, manages, franchises and licenses hotels, resorts, branded residences and vacation-ownership properties across brands including Park Hyatt, Grand Hyatt, Hyatt Regency, Andaz, Alila, Thompson Hotels, Hyatt Centric, Hyatt Place, Hyatt House and Miraval. No Hyatt developer portal, API reference, machine-readable contract or first-party SDK was found on any reachable Hyatt host or in any public registry as of September 2026; api.hyatt.com resolves to a live but undocumented gateway, and hyatt.com sits behind an edge bot challenge no automated client can read. Partner connectivity runs through third parties (Hapi for event streams and transactional APIs, Sabre SynXis for reservations), and Hyatt's conversational surface ships as a Hyatt-branded app inside ChatGPT rather than an endpoint Hyatt hosts. Hyatt has run a public HackerOne bug bounty program since January 2019.

providers.name: IKEA U.S.
providers.description: IKEA U.S. is the United States retail operation of IKEA, run by Ingka Group, the largest IKEA franchisee. The U.S. business operates ~50+ full-service stores, ~40+ Plan & Order Points, and ~80+ pick-up locations across the country, alongside the ikea.com/us e-commerce site and the IKEA mobile app. Inter IKEA Systems B.V. separately owns the IKEA Concept and brand. IKEA U.S. offers home furnishings, kitchens, appliances, lighting, the IKEA Family loyalty program, the IKEA Business Network for B2B customers, home delivery and Click & Collect, design and planning services, the Buy Back & Resell program, and IKEA Home smart products controlled via the IKEA Home smart and IKEA Home smart 1 apps. IKEA U.S. does not publish a public developer API; supplier and trading-partner integrations are handled through IKEA's vendor systems and Ingka Group's internal digital platforms.

providers.name: ING
providers.description: A Dutch multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered in Amsterdam. Provides retail banking, direct banking, commercial banking, and wholesale banking services to millions of customers across Europe and globally. Operates a public Developer Portal exposing Open Banking, PSD2, and payment-related APIs for third-party developers and fintech partners.

providers.name: Insurello
providers.description: Insurello is a Swedish digital claims service that helps individuals obtain compensation from insurance after accidents or injuries. The platform offers a free case initiation, takes a 35% fee on successful payouts (capped at 35,000 SEK), and provides ongoing case updates via a personal dashboard and email. It covers personal injury, traffic accidents, sports injuries, work injuries, and assault, but not theft or loss. Insurello aims to simplify the claims process and increase success rates for claimants.

providers.name: JOBDOH
providers.description: JOBDOH is a Hong Kong-based on-demand hiring and staffing platform that connects employers with temporary, part-time, and short-term workers, letting businesses staff up within 24 hours and job seekers find flexible work in one minute. The bilingual (English/Chinese) service spans market research, sales and promotion, exhibitions and events, hospitality, personal assistance, logistics, creative, and beauty roles. Hiring and job applications run through a mobile-app and web experience; there is no public API, developer portal, or SDK at this time. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Seedcamp and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Kela Technologies
providers.description: Kela Technologies (kela.io) is a defense technology company founded by veterans of elite Israeli intelligence units, providing a secure, open platform that enables rapid and seamless integration of commercial and military systems in service of Western defense. The company emerged from stealth in 2025 after raising $39M from Sequoia Capital, Lux Capital, and In-Q-Tel (the CIA's venture arm). Kela is building "Sovereign Sky," a low-Earth-orbit satellite constellation for resilient communication and navigation independent of foreign infrastructure, and acquired cloud-management company Pelanor. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a single-page marketing site with a privacy policy but no public API, developer portal, documentation, or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Kinro
providers.description: Kinro is an AI-powered commercial insurance brokerage for small businesses, founded in the Y Combinator Spring 2026 batch and based in San Francisco. Its autonomous AI agents run the full broker workflow around the clock, from prospect identification and quote preparation through comparison, binding, and ongoing certificate and renewal servicing. Kinro targets the roughly 77% of the 36 million U.S. small businesses that are underinsured because traditional brokers cannot profitably serve low-premium accounts. It is licensed across 30 states, appointed by 15+ carriers with access to 50+ markets, and offers general liability, business owner's policies, workers' compensation, commercial auto and trucking, professional liability, cyber, and more. Kinro was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched in the API Evangelist network; it currently publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Lazard
providers.description: Lazard is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Lazard API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Lexoo
providers.description: Lexoo is a commercial legal services provider that operates as an outsourced in-house legal team for businesses, concentrating on commercial contract review and negotiation. The company handles routine contract work at fixed rates per agreement with a stated maximum two-day turnaround, so internal legal and sales teams are freed for more strategic work. Alongside contract review, Lexoo runs multi-country projects that engage local counsel across more than 70 countries for work such as terms and conditions localisation and regulatory research, and it builds playbooks and training materials that let client teams handle standard agreements independently. The practice is led by Nathalie Lambert and serves scale-ups and start-ups, with published client references including Trustpilot, Nielsen, ComplyAdvantage, Xeneta, Chattermill and Jokr. Lexoo is not an API-first company: it publishes no developer portal, documentation or SDKs, and its only machine-readable surfaces are the standard WordPress REST API and RSS feed exposed by its marketing site.

providers.name: Liberty Energy
providers.description: Liberty Energy is a North American oilfield services company providing hydraulic fracturing, wireline, sand logistics, and power generation services to onshore exploration and production operators. The company also develops technology solutions for energy completion, ESG reporting, and natural gas fueling. Liberty Energy does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Lingua Robot
providers.description: Word definitions, pronunciations, synonyms, antonyms and others

providers.name: Lunar-X
providers.description: Lunar-X (Lunar X) is a global digital content studio that acquires, develops, and operates creator-driven entertainment brands into globally recognized franchises across animation, educational content, functional music, ecommerce, and live events. Its properties include Economics Explained, Theorist Inc, Music Labs, and Lunar Kids, collectively spanning tens of billions of views and over a hundred million subscribers. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Creandum and added to the API Evangelist network. As a media/content operator it publishes a marketing website and privacy policy but exposes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Magoosh
providers.description: Magoosh is an online test-preparation company serving over 10 million students across 185 countries with affordable, self-paced courses for the GRE, GMAT, SAT, ACT, TOEFL, IELTS, MCAT, and LSAT. Its platform pairs expert-crafted practice questions, video lessons, and detailed explanations with progress tracking, flashcard tools, AI-assisted tutoring, and iOS/Android apps, plus school and district plans. Magoosh publishes a marketing website and a company blog but exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile captures its public web footprint and domain security posture.

providers.name: Meituan
providers.description: Meituan (美团) is a Chinese technology-retail company operating one of the world's largest on-demand local-services and food-delivery super-apps. Its platform spans restaurant food delivery, in-store dining and group buying (Dianping), grocery and instant retail, hotel and travel booking, bike and moped sharing, and payments. Meituan runs a partner/developer cooperation center exposing merchant, delivery/logistics, and local-services integration APIs to business partners; these are partner-gated and documented in Chinese, with no public OpenAPI specification, SDK registry, or self-serve developer signup surfaced at this time.

providers.name: MicroBenefits
providers.description: MicroBenefits is a workforce-engagement and HR technology company, backed by 500 Global, that created CompanyIQ — a scalable mobile platform for improving engagement, learning, and communication for factory and manufacturing workers, particularly across Asia. CompanyIQ bundles Worker Voice (employee feedback and dialogue), Digital Learning (safety, rights, and professional-development training), an Employee Portal (wage, hours, and benefits transparency), and Business Intelligence workforce analytics, alongside professional and learning services. The company operates a marketing and support presence but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or specification surface at this time.

providers.name: Mixt
providers.description: MIXT is a chef-driven fast-casual salad and grain-bowl restaurant chain operating across the San Francisco Bay Area and Los Angeles. Founded on sourcing fresh, local, seasonal, and organic ingredients, MIXT prepares its greens, grains, grilled meats, dressings, and drinks in-house and offers customizable salads (80+ ingredients), warm grain bowls, sandwiches, catering, and a rewards loyalty program. MIXT is a Certified B Corporation (since 2018), reflecting a commitment to sustainable sourcing and environmental responsibility. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Obvious Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. MIXT is a consumer restaurant brand and does not publish a public developer platform, API, or SDKs; online ordering is offered through a hosted ordering surface at order.mixt.com.

providers.name: MoonFrost
providers.description: MoonFrost is a cozy life-sim RPG developed by Oxalis Games Ltd., set in a world ravaged by constant meteor storms where players farm, fish, craft, and build their dream home. Positioned as a Web3 game, it is backed by crypto investor Pantera Capital and is available to wishlist on Steam and the Epic Games Store, with a community on Discord. As of this profile, MoonFrost publishes no public API, developer documentation, SDK, or developer portal — it is a consumer game rather than an API provider, so this record is identity-only pending any future developer surface.

providers.name: MyVaccination
providers.description: Vaccination data for Malaysia

providers.name: Netic
providers.description: Netic (legal entity Cybernetic Labs Inc.), headquartered in San Francisco, builds production-grade autonomous AI systems for America's essential service industries — home services, pest control, roofing, consumer health, and veterinary. Its AI Growth Engine spans speech, text, and data with products including Convert (autonomous multi-channel job booking into CRM/FSM systems), Cultivate (autonomous upsell and membership campaigns), Empower (analytics and data-driven decision support), and Evaluate (AI call-center scoring), with Expand announced as coming soon. Netic is backed by Founders Fund, Greylock, and SV Angel. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity, blog, privacy policy, domain-security posture, and its Secureframe-hosted trust center.

providers.name: Nicolette
providers.description: Nicolette, Inc. is a digital health company that empowers patients and families fighting acute health battles by democratizing electronic health record (EHR) data, curated education, and participation tools. Its flagship product, NicoBoard, is a hospital-provided bedside platform for parents of babies in the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU): it visualizes a baby's plan of care and clinical data, surfaces curated research and education, provides a care-team directory, and offers engagement, insights, and diary tools so parents can partner competently and confidently in their child's care. NicoBoard ships as iOS and Android apps distributed to families by hospitals. Founded in 2016 and backed by Techstars among others, Nicolette exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: NOTHS
providers.description: NOTHS (Not On The High Street, notonthehighstreet.com) is a UK online marketplace that curates and sells unique gifts, jewellery, homeware and personalised products made or sourced by thousands of small UK creative businesses. Founded in 2006 and backed by Index Ventures, the platform connects independent sellers ("partners") with consumers through a curated storefront, seller onboarding, and an affiliate programme. It exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or documentation surface; its api.notonthehighstreet.com host is a private backend serving the company's own web and mobile storefront. This profile is a VC-portfolio lead enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline via live domain/security probing.

providers.name: Owl Labs
providers.description: Owl Labs is a Boston-based video conferencing hardware and software company building smart devices for hybrid meetings. Its flagship Meeting Owl line is a 360-degree AI-powered camera, microphone, and speaker that automatically focuses on whoever is speaking, alongside accessories such as the Owl Bar, Whiteboard Owl, and Expansion Mic. The Nest is its cloud fleet-management platform for provisioning, updating, and monitoring deployed devices across an organization. Owl Labs sells to enterprises, schools, and distributed teams, and publishes an annual State of Hybrid Work report. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Matrix Partners and Playground Global. Owl Labs does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or webhook surface; this profile captures its identity, security posture, and public web properties.

providers.name: Parkhub
providers.description: Parkhub provided parking management and payment processing APIs for parking operators and venues. Parkhub has been acquired and the parkhub.com domain now redirects to JustPark Business. Public API documentation is no longer available.

providers.name: Photobucket
providers.description: Photobucket is a consumer image and video hosting service founded in 2003 and now operated by Photobucket Inc. of Seattle. It provides cloud photo/video storage, organization, and private group sharing through subscription plans (My Bucket and +Group Buckets, each including 1TB of storage) alongside a free tier. Historically one of the largest image-hosting platforms on the early social web, Photobucket opened a public developer API in 2008, but no current public/documented API surface could be found during enrichment: the developer portal is bot-blocked, the GitHub organization holds only forks and hiring challenges (no official SDK), and the app runs as a single-page application with no published /.well-known/ discovery documents. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Trinity Ventures.

providers.name: PlugShare
providers.description: PlugShare provides the most comprehensive map of electric vehicle (EV) charging stations worldwide. Users can find, filter, and navigate to charging locations, read reviews, see photos, and get real-time availability where supported. The platform also offers an embed map, permalinking, and API access for developers to integrate charging data into apps, services, and navigation solutions. PlugShare supports community contributions, charging tips, and detailed station information, helping EV drivers plan trips and locate reliable charging infrastructure.

providers.name: Pluralis
providers.description: Pluralis Research is a decentralized AI lab pioneering Protocol Learning, a third path between closed proprietary models and open-weight models in which large transformer models are collaboratively pre-trained across many low-bandwidth, geographically distributed consumer GPUs without any single participant holding the full model weights. Its work spans communication-efficient model parallelism, asynchronous pipeline-parallel optimization, and community-owned training runs (Agora, node0), published as research papers at NeurIPS, ICML, and ICLR and as open-source libraries. Pluralis is backed by Union Square Ventures. It exposes research libraries, a participation CLI, and live run dashboards rather than a conventional REST/GraphQL developer API.

providers.name: Project Eaden
providers.description: Project Eaden (PROJECT EADEN GmbH) is a Berlin-based food-technology company building fiber-spinning technology to power the next generation of whole-cut plant-based protein. Its platform reconstructs the fibrous structure of animal muscle from plant ingredients to create alternatives such as plant-based fish and meat, and it collaborates on consumer brands including LEKKA. Backed by Creandum and co-funded through EIT Food and the European Union, the company operates as a consumer food-tech producer and currently publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Puzzlium
providers.description: Puzzlium is a mobile puzzle platform and social network built around the tagline "Play. Create. Compete." Founded in 2014 by veteran puzzle designers Serhiy Grabarchuk, Serhiy Grabarchuk Jr., Peter Grabarchuk, and Mehmet Murat Sevim, the iOS and Amazon Kindle app lets a community of hundreds of thousands of solvers and creators play, generate, publish, and compete with interactive puzzles. Based in San Jose, California and backed by 500 Startups (500 Global), Puzzlium is a consumer application that does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Pyka
providers.description: Pyka is an Alameda, California company that designs and manufactures large, dual-use heavy-lift autonomous electric aircraft for commercial and defense operations. Its flagship products are the Pelican 2 autonomous crop-protection aircraft for aerial application and the DropShip long-range heavy-lift cargo UAS. Pyka builds a fully integrated, vertically owned autonomy stack — an Autonomy Engine (real-time OS, sensor fusion, flight control, and path planning), a Mission Control operator suite (simulation, communications, and operator interface), and custom aerospace-grade hardware. The company is backed by DCVC and Obvious Ventures. Pyka does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web and domain-security footprint. Surfaced via VC portfolio enrichment.

providers.name: QMC
providers.description: QMC Telecom is a provider of shared telecommunications infrastructure for mobile networks, operating across Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Peru, and Chile. The company develops, owns, operates, and leases indoor connectivity solutions, street-level solutions (SLS), and towers, rooftops, and special sites, positioning itself as a partner in 5G network densification. Originally surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub, this is a hardware and telecommunications-infrastructure company that publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: RacingHub
providers.description: Formula 1 historical data and statistics

providers.name: REEF
providers.description: REEF Technology operates a network of urban logistics and proximity real-estate locations, transforming underutilized spaces such as parking lots into multi-purpose neighborhood hubs for goods, services, and experiences. Through its "Power of Proximity" model and its Ulysses operator program, REEF connects brands, cloud/ghost kitchens, delivery, and mobility services to local consumers while helping property owners diversify revenue. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, REEF is a logistics and real-estate operator; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Riksdagen
providers.description: Riksdagen (Swedish Parliament) is the national legislature of Sweden, responsible for lawmaking, overseeing the government, and representing the Swedish people. The official website provides information about parliamentary work, members, legislation, debates, and public services. It serves as a portal for citizens to access documents, watch live sessions, and engage with democratic processes.

providers.name: Rio Tinto
providers.description: Rio Tinto is a British-Australian multinational mining and metals corporation and one of the world's largest producers of iron ore, aluminum, copper, and diamonds. Rio Tinto does not publish a public developer API, but operates supplier portals (Supplier Master Data Management and a transactional platform) and a START traceability program. Its GitHub presence is limited to a small number of internal forks (ai-sentry, xpano).

providers.name: Rocket Internet
providers.description: Rocket Internet SE is a Berlin-based internet company builder and technology investment firm founded by the Samwer brothers. It incubates and scales internet and technology ventures globally and invests through its venture arm, having built and backed more than 200 companies across six continents in e-commerce, marketplaces, fintech, food delivery, and consumer internet. Rocket Internet operates as a holding and operational-support platform rather than a product or API provider, so it exposes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of HV Capital and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Rolls-Royce
providers.description: Rolls-Royce plc is a British multinational aerospace and defense company manufacturing aero engines (Trent series), defense propulsion, and power systems. Rolls-Royce does not publish a public developer API. The company operates supplier portals at suppliers.rolls-royce.com and maintains a small GitHub presence with the qc-cfd open-source repository covering quantum computing for computational fluid dynamics research.

providers.name: Sadbhav Engineering
providers.description: Sadbhav Engineering Limited (SEL), operating at sadbhaveng.com, is an Indian infrastructure and civil-engineering contractor founded in 1988 by Vishnubhai M. Patel and headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. The company builds and operates large-scale roads and highways, mining, and irrigation projects, including Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) concessions of national significance, and is publicly listed on the NSE and BSE. This is a traditional infrastructure/construction firm: it publishes an investor-relations and corporate website but exposes no developer API, SDK, documentation, or other machine-readable API surface. Surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a stub via vc-portfolio harvesting; an enrichment pass confirmed there is no API product to catalog.

providers.name: Sahl
providers.description: Innovatrix Tech, Corp. operates Sahl (getsahl.io), an AI-powered Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platform built in the MENA region for MENA organizations. Sahl automates policy generation, control mapping, risk assessment, evidence tracking, vulnerability scanning, and audit preparation across 20+ regulatory frameworks including PDPL, ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, NCA ECC, and SAMA CSF, aiming to reduce compliance work from months to weeks with an AI DPO assistant and compliance copilot. The company was part of the Sanabil Investments x 500 Global Accelerator (Batch 8). It surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company; as of this pass it publishes a marketing site and a customer application login but no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Savahq
providers.description: Sava (Savahq) is an early-stage Y Combinator company building what it calls the intelligence layer for enduring legacies and the future of trusts, operating at the intersection of financial and legal technology for trust administration and estate management. As of this profile the public presence is a pre-product landing page at savahq.com that collects email signups, and the company publishes no developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or other machine-readable API surface. This record tracks Sava within the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead surfaced from the Y Combinator portfolio, to be re-enriched once a developer or API surface is published.

providers.name: Secuvy
providers.description: Secuvy is an AI data filtering and data security platform that combines data discovery, classification, data security posture management, privacy automation, and AI governance into a single product. The platform automates detection and classification of sensitive data across hybrid and multi-cloud environments and prevents regulated data from leaking into AI tools, assistants, and inference pipelines. Secuvy offers more than 250 connectors covering AWS, Azure, GCP, Microsoft 365, Salesforce, Slack, Jira, ServiceNow, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, MongoDB, and on-premise systems like Windows File Servers, SharePoint, and NFS. Authentication options include OAuth, SAML, and API key based integration, and developers can build custom connectors against any system with a public API. Public API reference documentation was not located during research; technical detail is provided through Secuvy's sales and onboarding teams.

providers.name: SFX
providers.description: SFX (SFX Entertainment, now operating as LiveStyle, Inc) is a Beverly Hills based global live-events and electronic dance music company. Originally founded by Robert F.X. Sillerman as a roll-up of EDM festival and event brands, the company reorganized as LiveStyle and continues to produce live music experiences, festivals, and fan events under the banner "For the Love of Music." It was surfaced as a portfolio-linked company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. The company presents a corporate marketing web presence and publishes no public developer, API, or technical integration surface at this time.

providers.name: Soria
providers.description: Soria is an AI-native financial terminal built for healthcare investors. The platform aggregates financial data from 125+ public and private sources into continuously updated financial models and delivers them through a terminal UI, an MCP server, an API, warehouse sync, and a research feed. Soria targets bulge-bracket banks, boutique research firms, and the largest hedge funds that specialize in the healthcare sector, turning fragmented healthcare and life sciences data into live, analyst-ready models. Backed by Y Combinator. Its public surface is a single-page marketing site; the API and MCP delivery channels are gated to customers and are not publicly documented.

providers.name: Sortera Technologies
providers.description: Sortera Technologies (formerly Sortera Alloys) is an AI-driven metals recycling company founded in 2020 and headquartered in Markle / Fort Wayne, Indiana. It combines sensor fusion (XRF plus optical), machine-learning image and data analytics, and an advanced high-throughput scrap feeder to sort end-of-life scrap by metal type and alloy composition, upgrading feedstock streams and removing contaminants at industrial scale. From a 200,000 square foot sortation facility opened in 2023 the company produces specification aluminum scrap across cast, extrusion and sheet fractions - including 380, 356, 319 and wrought grades such as 3105 - and sells it back into domestic manufacturing. Its stated vision is 100% reuse of metals recovered from end-of-life products. The artificial intelligence runs inside Sortera's own sorting lines as an in-house platform; the product sold is recycled metal, not software, and the company publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Spark Therapeutics
providers.description: Spark Therapeutics is a Philadelphia-based gene therapy company founded in 2013 with roots at Children's Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP). Spark developed Luxturna (voretigene neparvovec-rzyl), the first FDA-approved gene therapy for a genetic disease in the United States, approved in December 2017 for the treatment of inherited retinal disease caused by biallelic RPE65 mutations. Roche acquired Spark Therapeutics in December 2019 for approximately $4.3 billion, and Spark has since been integrated into the Roche Group, operating as a Genentech subsidiary. The original sparktx.com domain now redirects to gene.com/spark. Spark does not publish any public developer APIs, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, or GitHub organization. As a pharmaceutical/biotech operating under Roche, Spark's public technical surface is limited to patient and prescriber information for Luxturna and adverse event reporting channels (FDA MedWatch and 1-855-SPARKTX).

providers.name: Stealth Worker
providers.description: Stealth Worker is a cybersecurity staffing marketplace (Y Combinator W2016) that connects companies with vetted, contract-based information security, cloud security, privacy, and compliance professionals at competitive hourly rates. Engagements range from a few hours a week to full-time, covering InfoSec staffing, GDPR / data protection officer services, penetration testing, security architecture, SOC 2 / SOX / HIPAA / PCI audit and compliance, and CISO-as-a-service. Roughly 80% of consultants are US-based, with coverage across Europe, Asia, and Australia in 15+ countries. It is a professional-services company with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Swiss Education Group
providers.description: Swiss Education Group (SEG) is a Montreux-based alliance of internationally celebrated hospitality, business, and culinary arts schools in Switzerland, comprising Cesar Ritz Colleges, Culinary Arts Academy Switzerland, Swiss Hotel Management School, and HIM Business School. Across five campuses it educates more than 6,000 students from over 110 nationalities in hospitality management, culinary arts, and business. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass SEG publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface; this profile is maintained as a company/identity record rather than an API provider.

providers.name: teaBOT
providers.description: teaBOT is a Toronto-based hardware startup (Y Combinator, Summer 2015) that builds an automated loose-leaf tea-making robot offered to offices, showrooms, and lounges as an amenity-as-a-service. For a flat monthly fee, teams use the companion teaBOT app to explore premium teas and dispense a custom-blended cup in under 30 seconds, which companies such as Google, HubSpot, and McKinsey use as a workplace recruiting and retention perk. Founded by robotics PhD Rehman Merali, teaBOT runs a physical-product and mobile-app business and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: The Coterie
providers.description: The Coterie is a financial technology company founded in 2022 by Ethan Agarwal, Jeson Patel, and Chris Boies to give startup founders access to venture capital investments, estate-planning strategies (including its ATOM Trust product), and lending. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz, the company has since rebranded and now operates as Allocate (allocate.co), positioning itself as "an operating system for private markets" serving wealth advisors and asset managers with deal sourcing, white-labeled fund creation, AI-powered portfolio management, and unified reporting. The company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: The Cru
providers.description: The Cru (now branded "The Cru Empowered by Luminary") is a membership community founded by Tiffany Dufu that matches women and allies into small peer-coaching accountability circles ("Crus") of 6-8 members who meet in monthly 90-minute gatherings to advance their personal and professional goals. It was acquired by Luminary, a New York City based professional community and coworking organization, and the thecru.com site now redirects to weareluminary.com/luminary-crus. This is a consumer community and coaching business, not a technical platform - it publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK surface.

providers.name: The Vanguard Group
providers.description: The Vanguard Group is an American investor-owned asset manager headquartered in Malvern, Pennsylvania, and is "the largest provider of mutual funds in the world" and the second-largest exchange-traded fund (ETF) provider after BlackRock's iShares. Vanguard manages approximately $12 trillion in assets as of 2025 and employs roughly 20,000 people (the "crew") as of December 31, 2024. The firm was founded on May 1, 1975 by John C. ("Jack") Bogle and is structured as a mutual: "Vanguard is owned by the funds managed by the company and is therefore owned by its customers." Salim Ramji was appointed Chief Executive Officer in July 2024. Vanguard's business spans index and active mutual funds, ETFs, personal advisor services, retirement plan recordkeeping (Vanguard Retirement Plan Services), institutional asset management, fixed income, and a financial-advisor channel served through Vanguard Financial Advisor Services. Vanguard operates across the Americas, Europe, and Asia Pacific. Despite that scale, Vanguard does not publish a public developer API program — there is no public OpenAPI specification, no SDKs, no CLI, no public webhooks, and no Vanguard-published public RSS feed. Investor, advisor, recordkeeping, and distribution-platform integrations are delivered through authentication-gated portals (investor.vanguard.com, advisors.vanguard.com, institutional.vanguard.com), PDF reporting, brokerage/custodian rails, fund-administrator data feeds, and industry recordkeeping interfaces.

providers.name: TransCrypts
providers.description: TransCrypts is a blockchain-based identity and credential verification platform that lets individuals own, encrypt, and share verified records — employment and income history, background checks, and (with HIPAA certification) health and education credentials — directly with employers, background checkers, and other verifiers. Encrypted data is stored off-chain while cryptographic hashes are anchored on-chain, so users can prove authenticity without exposing personal data. The company reports 5M+ verifications across 4M+ users and 450+ enterprise clients, and connects to HR and payroll systems such as ADP, BambooHR, and Namely. It raised a $15M seed round led by Pantera Capital, with Techstars, Lightspeed Faction, Alpha Edison, Motley Fool Ventures, Mark Cuban, and Protocol Labs participating.

providers.name: TRIC Robotics
providers.description: TRIC Robotics builds autonomous agricultural robots that replace chemical pesticides with ultraviolet light. Its flagship platform, Luna, is a tractor-scale robot that roams California strawberry fields after dark, using UV-C light to kill fungal pathogens such as powdery mildew and botrytis while a mechanical "Bug Vac" removes pests like Lygus bugs, spotted wing drosophila, and spider mites — without a single drop of pesticide. Founded in 2017 by Dr. Adam Stager and Vishnu Somasundaram out of the University of Delaware and now based in California, TRIC operates a robotics-as-a-service model that requires no upfront investment from growers, and reports pesticide reductions of up to 70% across the farms it serves. The company raised a $5.5M seed round led by Version One Ventures to expand its fleet across Santa Maria, Oxnard, and Watsonville. TRIC Robotics is an agricultural robotics operator and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its company identity in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: TripScout
providers.description: TripScout is a travel media and deals company that curates flight and hotel recommendations for consumers and operates a portfolio of large travel-focused social brands (including the @hotel property at athotel.com). Its core product scans millions of flights weekly and emails subscribers a small set of vetted deals, each paired with featured, splurge, and budget hotel options plus destination context such as weather, festivals, and local activities. TripScout runs a free tier (one deal per week) and a premium subscription. It is a consumer-facing, email- and social-first business and does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation portal, or SDKs. Backed by 500 Global; added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead.

providers.name: Unrivaled Sports
providers.description: Unrivaled Sports is a youth sports platform and experience operator founded in March 2024 by Josh Harris and David Blitzer (Harris Blitzer Sports & Entertainment) with a strategic investment from The Chernin Group, later joined by DICK'S Sporting Goods and Under Armour as strategic investors. The company owns and operates a portfolio of youth sports destinations, tournaments and camps across baseball, softball, flag football and action sports — including Ripken Baseball, Cooperstown All Star Village, Baseball Factory, Softball Factory, Diamond Nation, Big League Dreams, Sports Force Parks, ForeverLawn Sports Complex at the Pro Football Hall of Fame Village, Rocker B Ranch, Unrivaled Flag, Under the Lights Flag Football and the We Are Camp action-sports properties (High Cascade, Windells, Snöbahn, Seek Skate Camp, Milepost 35). It reports 15 venues, 2 million annual visitors and 800,000 athletes served. It is a venue and event operator rather than a software company: as of 2026-09-02 it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract on any of its own or its portfolio brands' hosts.

providers.name: Vend
providers.description: Vend was a cloud-based retail point-of-sale and inventory management software company founded in Auckland, New Zealand, backed by investors including Point Nine. Lightspeed announced its acquisition of Vend in March 2021 for approximately US$350 million, and the product lives on as Lightspeed Retail (X-Series). vendhq.com redirects to lightspeedhq.com/vend/, and the former Vend API is documented today at x-series-api.lightspeedhq.com. The X-Series API surface is profiled in the API Evangelist network under the Lightspeed provider, so this profile records the acquired Vend brand rather than duplicating that API.

providers.name: Vetstoria
providers.description: Vetstoria provides real-time online appointment booking, veterinary websites, and online payments for veterinary practices, integrating in real time with 40+ practice management systems (PIMS) - including ezyVet, IDEXX Neo, IDEXX Cornerstone, IDEXX Animana, Covetrus Ascend, AVImark, RxWorks, visionVPM, Provet Cloud, OpenVPMS, and others - to sync availability, prevent double-bookings, and match clients and pets back into the PIMS. Founded in 2015 and used by more than 5,000 practices worldwide (operating as PetDesk Direct Booking in the United States), Vetstoria does NOT publish a public, self-service developer API. Its integration surface is partner-gated - software vendors connect through a contact-based Integrations Partner program, and each PIMS integration is typically driven from the PIMS side (for example, ezyVet exposes Vetstoria as an "API Partner" and IDEXX Neo auto-generates an API key when the Vetstoria connection is enabled). No public API reference, developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or documented WebSocket exists as of this cataloging.

providers.name: YOURIKA
providers.description: YOURIKA (YOURIKA Labs) is a Kitchener-Waterloo, Canada AI platform and venture studio that creates and scales purpose-built, verticalized AI ventures in partnership with industry experts, prioritizing accuracy, trust, and measurable outcomes over technology-first approaches. Its ventures include smart'n, a nurse-first intelligence and learning platform that helps nurses learn, grow, and make more informed decisions throughout their careers, and Retain / Workforce Intelligence for senior and long-term care, which helps operators identify, hire, and retain caregivers while reducing turnover. yourikaLABS also offers AI advisory services connecting businesses with experts to build data-driven strategies and roadmaps. YOURIKA is backed by Amazon, Techstars (Amazon Alexa Accelerator), and the University of Waterloo. The company exposes no bespoke public developer API; its marketing site is built on Wix and advertises a Wix Site MCP endpoint plus an llms.txt for agentic access.

providers.name: Zest AI
providers.description: Zest AI is an AI-powered lending technology company that provides credit underwriting, fraud detection, and lending intelligence software to credit unions, banks, and specialty lenders. Its machine-learning models automate credit decisioning and risk assessment, and the company reports operating over 600 active lending models in production. Zest AI operates as a B2B SaaS platform delivered to financial institutions rather than as a public developer API; no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or self-service developer surface were found during enrichment.

providers.name: ZF Friedrichshafen
providers.description: ZF Friedrichshafen AG is a German global Tier 1 automotive supplier headquartered in Friedrichshafen. ZF designs and manufactures driveline, chassis, active and passive safety, and ADAS technology for passenger cars and commercial vehicles. ZF acquired TRW Automotive in 2015.

providers.name: 1X Technologies
providers.description: 1X Technologies is a humanoid robotics company headquartered in Palo Alto, California with vertically integrated manufacturing at the NEO Factory in Hayward. Its product line includes EVE (an earlier wheeled-base humanoid used for commercial pilots) and NEO, the company's bipedal consumer humanoid marketed as the "world's first consumer-ready humanoid robot for the home," with NEO Beta and NEO Gamma development variants and a consumer pre-order program. 1X is an OpenAI portfolio company and collaborates with NVIDIA on training-data generation and on-board model execution. The company maintains a public GitHub organization (github.com/1x-technologies) with 24 repositories, most notably 1xgpt — a world-modeling challenge for humanoid robots — alongside Halodi robot URDF models, ROS2 examples for the EVE robot, and robotics infrastructure tools. 1X does not publish a public hosted API or developer SDK; engagement is via product purchase, research challenges, and open-source code.

providers.name: Achats Group
providers.description: Achats Group (아샤그룹) is a South Korean media-commerce company founded in February 2017 and led by CEO Vivian Eun Young Lee, with offices in Pangyo (Seongnam) and Magok (Seoul). It manufactures and sells everyday consumer goods — sanitizing and deodorizing sprays, foot care, living care, health drinks and cosmetics — under its own brands Cellomon, ND247 / Neverdie, Biotreat and BringB, marketing them through short-form video and social advertising that routes buyers into its own Cafe24 storefronts and a Naver Smart Store. Public records put total funding near USD 6.2 million through a Series B. It is a direct-to-consumer consumer-goods business, not a software vendor: as of 2026-09-06 achatsgroup.co.kr is a Cafe24-hosted brochure site still carrying unedited pages from its purchased template, with no developer portal, no API documentation, no SDK and no machine-readable API contract, and the brand storefronts are hosted Cafe24 malls whose only /api path is Cafe24's own.

providers.name: Amalgamrx
providers.description: Amalgam Rx is a health‑technology company delivering AI‑powered software‑as‑a‑medical‑device (SaMD) solutions for providers, health plans, and life‑science partners. Their modular platform supports digital products, clinical AI, enterprise platforms, patient‑derived usage‑recording systems (PDURS) and EHR integrations, serving millions of patients across four continents with regulatory clearances.

providers.name: Andco
providers.description: Andco is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) startup building an AI-agent platform that automates the pre-litigation case workup process for personal injury law firms. Its agents retrieve and synthesize case documents across fax, phone, email, mail, web portal, and SMS channels, including police and accident reports, insurance coverage verification, medical records, and medical bills, then draft demand letters and calculate damages. Andco covers auto accident, premises liability, medical malpractice, workplace injury, and mass tort practice areas, offering same-day go-live and a free trial on the first case. This profile was surfaced from Andco's Y Combinator portfolio listing and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Andco publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification at this time.

The company leverages N‑halamine chemistry to create surface‑protecting solutions for healthcare, consumer, and industrial markets, aiming to reduce reliance on traditional antibiotics. Founded in 2018 as Halomine, AvantGuard has secured multiple NIH grants and a $1.7 M seed round to advance its decolonization platform.

providers.name: Barnes & Noble Education
providers.description: Barnes & Noble Education, Inc. (NYSE: BNED) is one of the largest operators of college bookstores in the United States, operating physical and virtual campus stores alongside digital course-materials and educational services. BNED reaches more than 5.7 million students through 1,125+ physical and virtual stores across higher education and K-12 institutions, primarily through its Barnes & Noble College Booksellers subsidiary and the MBS Textbook Exchange wholesale business. Flagship offerings include the First Day and First Day Complete affordable-access course-materials programs, BNC OER+ digital courseware, faculty adoption tools, campus retail and ecommerce services, and BNC AI Tools. BNED separated from Barnes & Noble, Inc. in August 2015 and is not affiliated with the Barnes & Noble retail bookstore chain. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts associated with BNED. No public developer APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time; integrations with campus systems and learning-management systems are delivered through institutional partnerships rather than a public API surface.

providers.name: Bayshore
providers.description: Bayshore (bayshore AI GmbH) is a Munich-based legal and compliance technology company building an agentic AI platform that turns any ruleset — from sector regulations to internal corporate policies — into deterministic, machine-readable guardrails for AI agents. Positioned as a "Legal & Compliance Front Door," the platform handles incoming requests from business teams, auto-clears low-risk cases with instant responses, escalates complex matters to human reviewers, and maintains audit-ready documentation for every decision. Founded in 2024 by Paul F. Welter, Philipp Wiegand, and Erik Krauter, the company focuses on highly regulated industries including finance (MaRisk, DORA, NIS2), pharma, defense (export controls, sanctions), and cross-industry programs (GDPR, anti-bribery, antitrust, third-party due diligence). Bayshore raised an $8M seed round led by Earlybird Venture Capital in 2026. This profile currently exposes no public API, developer portal, or specifications.

providers.name: Bemycar
providers.description: Bemycar develops and commercializes generative artificial intelligence technology to maximize efficiency and increase sales for companies in the automotive and mobility sectors. Their solutions include AI-driven lead management, enriched lead capture, automated record reactivation, and automated NPS surveys, all delivered via a cloud platform tailored for the automotive industry.

providers.name: Birdstop
providers.description: Birdstop is an American autonomous-drone and remote-sensing company that lets organizations monitor and inspect field assets at scale without personnel onsite. Its Fealty system is an all-weather, always-on drone that launches in under three seconds, flies for up to 45 minutes, cruises at 45 mph, and patrols 24/7 across public safety, utilities, transportation, construction, and data-center sites. Birdstop pairs networked UAVs and ground stations with computer vision and a patented optical/acoustic detect-and-avoid system to enable safe beyond-visual-line-of-sight flight under some of the FAA's most advanced approvals, delivering Observation-on-Demand intel over the internet. The company is FAA-authorized, SOC 2 certified, and NDAA compliant, and builds its drones in Detroit. Backed by Techstars, Birdstop currently exposes no public developer API; this profile tracks the company for the API Evangelist network.

The platform provides a range of courses for professionals, implementors, and marketers, aiming to equip learners with AI literacy and practical skills for the modern workforce.

Capabilities include patient and family ICU dashboards, interactive diagnostic and procedural content, therapy and virtual exercises, actionable clinical-guideline creation and management, continuous patient education, automated discharge documentation, an interactive day planner, and progress visualization and analytics. Based in San Diego, California, and backed by 500 Global. This profile was surfaced from a VC portfolio and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Cognuse publishes a company/marketing site but no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Cumulus Networks
providers.description: Cumulus Networks was a computer networking company founded in 2010 that developed Cumulus Linux, an open Linux-based network operating system for bare-metal and white-box data-center switches, along with NetQ, a network operations and telemetry platform. It was a pioneer of open, disaggregated networking, letting operators run a standard Linux distribution on commodity switching hardware. NVIDIA acquired Cumulus Networks in May 2020, and the products are now part of NVIDIA's Ethernet switching and networking software line. The former cumulusnetworks.com and docs.cumulusnetworks.com domains now redirect to NVIDIA's networking documentation. Surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z, Battery Ventures, and Wing Venture Capital.

providers.name: data.gov.rs
providers.description: data.gov.rs is the national government open-data portal for the Republic of Serbia, operated by the Office for IT and eGovernment. It runs the uData platform and exposes the uData REST API over approximately 3,452 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, organization listings, and resource access. The API provides a consistent JSON-over-HTTP interface and is harvested into the EU data portal.

providers.name: Dayjob
providers.description: Dayjob is an AI-powered scheduling agent built for waste management and skip hire fleets, operated by Gaea Technology Ltd and backed by Y Combinator (Spring 2026). Its autonomous agents analyze millions of potential route combinations to build optimized daily schedules that factor in travel times, skip sizes, driver availability and priority job assignments, then continuously re-optimize in real time as new jobs, driver changes and exceptions arrive. Dayjob integrates with existing ERP and telematics systems (Weighsoft, PurGo, Wastelogics, plus custom report setups) and claims customers see revenue and efficiency gains, tighter time-window hit rates and materially less planning admin. It is a vertical logistics application rather than an API platform - no public developer portal, API reference or SDKs are published at this time. This profile has been enriched from the company's public website.

providers.name: DocuTAP
providers.description: DocuTAP was an urgent care EHR and practice-management software company based in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. In 2019 DocuTAP merged with Practice Velocity to form Experity, the on-demand and urgent-care healthcare technology vendor. The DocuTAP EMR/PM product continues under the Experity portfolio, with customer sign-in at dtlogin.experityhealth.com; the legacy docutap.com domain is no longer actively maintained (its TLS certificate has expired). No public developer portal or API is currently published for DocuTAP.

providers.name: Dux
providers.description: Dux is a cybersecurity company building an Agentic Exposure Management platform that uses AI agents to identify which vulnerabilities are truly exploitable, recommend lightweight mitigations, and accelerate patch and remediation work across an organization's attack surface. The company raised a $9M seed round led by Redpoint and TLV Partners in December 2025. It was surfaced as a Redpoint Ventures portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; as of this enrichment pass Dux publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: ElMetr
providers.description: ElMetr (المتر) is a Middle East legal-tech company providing online legal consultation and guidance for companies, entrepreneurs, and individuals. The platform combines licensed lawyers with modern technology to connect users with qualified legal help, offering subscription legal packages that cover company formation and registration, contract review, compliance, intellectual property, and dispute resolution. Founded in Egypt and now operating in Saudi Arabia, ElMetr aims to make legal work clear, fast, and fair so businesses can move faster and reduce risk from first idea through expansion. ElMetr is a 500 Global (500 Startups) portfolio company. This company profile has been through the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline; ElMetr does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Equitable Bank
providers.description: Equitable Bank is Canada's seventh largest independent Schedule I bank by assets and a wholly owned subsidiary of EQB Inc. (TSX: EQB), a Toronto-based Canadian financial services company with over CAD $144 billion in combined assets under management and administration. Federally chartered and Canadian owned, Equitable Bank markets itself as "Canada's Challenger Bank" and, in 2016, launched EQ Bank, its digital-only banking platform offering high interest savings accounts, GICs, and payments alongside the parent bank's single-family residential and commercial lending. Equitable Bank and Equitable Trust are members of the Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation (CDIC). On the open-finance front, Equitable Bank does not operate a public first-party developer portal or publish downloadable API specifications; consumer permissioned data sharing is delivered through the Canadian aggregator Flinks (Flinks Outbound) rather than a first-party API. Canada's federal Consumer-Driven Banking framework (legislated in Budget 2024 with the Financial Consumer Agency of Canada as overseer) is not yet operational, so the bank's data-access posture today is voluntary and aggregator-mediated.

providers.name: Eversight
providers.description: Eversight is an AI-powered pricing and promotions software company serving consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands and retailers. Its SaaS platform runs continuous, controlled experiments testing untried everyday prices and promotional offers with real shoppers, then applies advanced analytics and AI-powered experimentation to surface revenue-optimizing price and offer recommendations. The product is delivered as two suites — a Retail Pricing Suite that integrates with physical and digital store networks, and an Offer Innovation Suite for CPG trade-promotion teams that deploys standalone or on top of existing TPM systems. Eversight was founded in 2013, acquired by Instacart in 2022, and targets revenue-management, trade-marketing, sales, pricing, and merchant teams. It is a portfolio company of Emergence Capital. No public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal is published — the platform is an enterprise SaaS engagement.

providers.name: FilmTrack
providers.description: FilmTrack is a cloud-based content and rights management platform for the media and entertainment industry, streamlining the intellectual property lifecycle from project inception through distribution. Its software gives distributors and studios a holistic view of the data behind rights, availabilities, contracts, invoicing, licensing, revenue recognition, royalties, and workflow management. Founded in 1996 by Jason Kassin and headquartered in Studio City, California, FilmTrack was acquired by City National Bank in 2019 and now operates alongside Rightsline. Its API-first architecture enables integration with ERP and financial systems such as SAP and NetSuite, and an event bus for change-driven automation. Customers include Lionsgate, Miramax, Focus Features, Starz, and Screen Australia.

providers.name: FTN Network
providers.description: FTN Network is a New York-based sports data, analytics, and content company founded in 2020 that helps fans, fantasy players, and sports bettors make smarter decisions. FTN operates the FTN Fantasy platform (ftnfantasy.com), publishing proprietary NFL charting data, projections, DFS ownership, and betting analytics through articles, livestreams, videos, and podcasts. FTN also sells a REST/JSON sports-data API covering NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, PGA, CFB, and CBB across CSV, mid-tier API, and enterprise white-label plans. The company went through the Techstars Sports Tech Accelerator (2022) and is backed by 11 Tribes Ventures.

providers.name: GlamSt
providers.description: GlamSt (GlamST LLC) builds customized virtual makeover and try-on solutions for beauty brands and retailers, combining augmented reality (AR), artificial intelligence, and machine learning to power virtual makeup and cosmetics try-on across mobile, web, and in-store experiences. Founded with offices in San Francisco, Montevideo (Uruguay), and Wilmington (Delaware), the company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. GlamSt was acquired by Ulta Beauty in 2018 and integrated into Ulta's digital innovation team; it exposes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or documentation surface, so this profile is identity-only.

providers.name: Iman
providers.description: IMAN (mobile app IMANUM, operated by IMAN CAPITAL LTD) is a halal fintech and Islamic-finance super-app serving Muslim-majority, largely unbanked markets in Central Asia. Headquartered in Uzbekistan and expanding into Kazakhstan, Pakistan, South Asia and MENA, IMAN bundles Sharia-compliant financial products into a single consumer app: IMAN Invest, a faith-based investing platform where users and IMAN enter Mudarabah contracts to finance real trade in goods, and IMAN Pay, an interest-free buy-now-pay-later / point-of-sale installment product for the previously unbanked. All services are certified compliant with Islamic finance principles by scholars including the Muslim Board of Uzbekistan. IMAN was the first Central Asian startup backed by 500 Global and has raised over $6M from strategic and institutional investors.

providers.name: Inherent
providers.description: Inherent (Inherent Laboratories Ltd) is an early-stage AI research lab building recursively self-improving AI systems for scientific discovery — "AI scientists" intended to augment human researchers rather than replace them. Incorporated as a Public Benefit Corporation and backed by Index Ventures, the company frames itself as a reimagined research institution pursuing general-purpose inventive AI, autonomous-lab capabilities, and human-machine teaming across scientific domains. As of this profile it publishes a manifesto and careers page but no public API, SDK, developer documentation, or product surface — this repo tracks it as a lead for enrichment as those surfaces emerge.

providers.name: ISO
providers.description: The International Organization for Standardization (ISO) develops and publishes international standards covering technology, manufacturing, food safety, and many other industries. ISO standards provide globally recognized frameworks that help organizations ensure quality, safety, interoperability, and consistency in their products and processes.

providers.name: Kaizntree
providers.description: Kaizntree is a New York-based operations platform for growth-stage consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands, giving multi-channel manufacturers and sellers a single system to run purchasing, inventory, sales, fulfillment, production, and lot-level traceability. Its two products are Kaizntree OS, a cloud ERP that centralizes stock across raw materials, intermediate goods, packaging, finished and bundled products with COGS, margin, multi-location, batch/expiry and audit-ready records, and JP, an ERP-agnostic AI operations assistant that automates high-volume workflows such as purchase-order processing, reporting, data synchronization, and OTIF tracking. Kaizntree integrates with sales channels (including Shopify), accounting, WMS, and fulfillment platforms. Backed by 500 Global (seed, 2022), it operates on usage-based pricing. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company; Kaizntree publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Lumachain
providers.description: Lumachain provides computer-vision AI for the food supply chain, delivering real-time detection of critical production events across high-throughput meat and food processing plants. Its on-site platform monitors deboning-equipment yield, animal welfare, foreign-object detection, and quality control across beef, pork, poultry, and finished-goods facilities, generating structured signals that integrate with existing plant systems. The company is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners with investors including Chipotle. No public developer portal, API documentation, or SDK is currently published.

providers.name: LVMH
providers.description: LVMH Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton is the world's largest luxury goods conglomerate, headquartered in Paris and operating over 75 prestigious brands. Its portfolio spans fashion and leather goods (Louis Vuitton, Christian Dior, Fendi, Loewe, Celine), wines and spirits (Moët & Chandon, Hennessy, Veuve Clicquot), perfumes and cosmetics (Givenchy, Guerlain), watches and jewelry (Tiffany & Co., Bulgari, TAG Heuer), and selective retailing (Sephora, DFS). LVMH does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal at the group level; technical and partner integrations are handled brand-by-brand and through closed innovation partnerships such as the Aura Blockchain Consortium.

providers.name: Maestro PMS
providers.description: Maestro PMS is an all-in-one property management software solution serving independent hotels, resorts, and multi-property groups. The platform advertises open APIs that support more than 800 third-party integrations, but does not publish public OpenAPI documentation; integrations are arranged through the partner program.

providers.name: Mecka AI
providers.description: Mecka AI is the data and deployment layer for physical AI — it captures, structures, and evaluates real-world human and robot activity into datasets that robotics and embodied-AI teams can train on. Rather than building robots, Mecka positions itself as the integrator of the robotics ecosystem, plugging into hardware makers, frontier model labs, and commercial partners and owning the last-mile data, annotation, QA, and evaluation layer between them. Its Egoverse dataset captures large-scale first-person (egocentric) human activity across tasks and environments, and a companion iOS app lets teams collect task-specific data at scale. Mecka is backed by Forerunner Ventures and raised a $60M Series A in 2026. As of this pass Mecka publishes a marketing site, an iOS data-collection app, and the Egoverse data platform, but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Medeor Therapeutics
providers.description: Medeor Therapeutics is a clinical-stage cellular immunotherapy company in San Mateo, California, developing MDR-101, a one-time cell therapy manufactured from a living kidney donor's blood that induces mixed chimerism so HLA-matched transplant recipients can withdraw from lifelong immunosuppression while preserving graft function. The platform originated in roughly two decades of research at Stanford University led by Dr. Samuel Strober. The company completed a Phase 3 registration trial that exceeded its target success rate, and has since suspended operations and is seeking an acquirer to complete the BLA filing. Medeor is a therapeutics developer, not a software company: it publishes no developer portal, API, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: MouseCat
providers.description: MouseCat is an agentic AI infrastructure company for risk operations, founded in 2026 and a graduate of the Y Combinator Winter 2026 batch. The platform runs human-quality fraud investigations to help risk teams automatically detect, investigate, and mitigate emerging fraud, scale investigations, build better models, and make faster decisions. MouseCat deploys entirely within customer-owned cloud environments, integrating with the data, vendors, and APIs a risk team already relies on so companies retain complete control of sensitive data. The company was founded by Nicholas Aldridge (CEO) and Joseph McAllister (CTO) and is backed by Y Combinator, Imagination Capital, and SurgePoint Capital. As of this profile MouseCat is an early-stage startup with a public marketing site and a private application; it publishes no public API, SDK, developer documentation, or MCP server yet.

providers.name: Northvolt
providers.description: Northvolt AB is a Swedish lithium-ion battery developer and manufacturer, founded in Stockholm in 2016, that built and operated the Northvolt Ett gigafactory in Skelleftea and the Northvolt Labs R&D and qualification campus in Vasteras, with further sites in Heide (Germany), Gdansk (Poland) and Montreal (Canada). Its product line covered lithium-ion, sodium-ion and lithium-metal cells, the Voltpack Core and Voltpack Mobile System battery energy storage systems, the Revolt battery recycling operation, and a Connected Battery telemetry and fleet-management service. Northvolt AB filed for bankruptcy in Sweden on 12 March 2025; through 2025 its remaining assets in Sweden, Germany and Poland were acquired by Lyten. The company never published a public developer program, API reference or machine-readable API contract; its only named developer-facing surface, api.northvolt.com, no longer has a reachable origin.

It is not CKAN or DKAN. Read endpoints live under the /api prefix using PascalCase, action-style routes.
