As of this enrichment pass, Matchday does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or documentation surface: probing api.matchday.com, docs.matchday.com, and developer.matchday.com returned no reachable developer hosts, and the marketing site is a single-page application. This profile therefore carries company identity plus a domain-security probe rather than API artifacts, and remains a lead to revisit if a public API surface is launched.

providers.name: Meta4
providers.description: Meta4 is a human capital management (HCM) software provider founded in Madrid, Spain, delivering cloud-based payroll, talent, and time-management applications widely used across the Spanish-speaking world and Europe. Backed by Insight Partners, Meta4 was acquired by Cegid in 2019 and its PeopleNet HCM platform is now delivered as part of the Cegid HR product family. The developer surface — Core HR, payroll, and talent APIs — is published through the Cegid HR developer portal rather than a standalone Meta4 developer program.

providers.name: Nuvelar
providers.description: Nuvelar is an Argentine technology solutions firm founded in 2014 that designs and builds digital experiences across consulting, hardware, software, and design. Its flagship product, Nuvelar Display, is a cloud platform for creating, distributing, and managing digital-signage content networks with content scheduling, player monitoring, dynamic templates, multi-format support, and social/weather/RSS integrations. Beyond the platform, Nuvelar builds custom interactive installations — videowalls, interactive tables, and branded experiential systems for clients such as Adidas. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of the latest enrichment pass Nuvelar publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or specification.

providers.name: Pax Historia
providers.description: Pax Historia is an alternate-history sandbox game backed by Y Combinator, where players explore branching "what if" scenarios and reshape the course of history through open-ended, simulation-driven play. It is a consumer-facing game product reached at paxhistoria.co with a single "Get Started" entry point; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer platform, API, SDKs, documentation, pricing page, or other machine-readable API surface. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company lead surfaced from the Y Combinator portfolio and enriched here with verified identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Plena Health
providers.description: Plena Health is an AI operating system for specialty medical practices, founded in 2025 and part of Y Combinator's Spring 2026 batch. Plena automates the complex administrative workflows a clinic's staff shouldn't have to do — referrals, fax intake, patient calls, scheduling, prior authorization, procedure compliance, and collections — end to end, running in the background across the EHRs, clearinghouses, and other systems a practice already uses, rather than requiring the practice to adopt new software. Founded by Eyad Abdalla (CEO) and Ahmed Al Mudarris (CTO) and based in San Francisco, the company reports operating across six specialties in eight states. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; as of this enrichment pass Plena publishes only a marketing site (a single-page React application) with no public API, developer portal, documentation, or well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Printique
providers.description: Printique (An Adorama Company, formerly AdoramaPix) is a professional online photo lab based in Brooklyn, NYC that produces photo prints, fine-art giclee prints, photo books, albums, wall decor (metal, acrylic, canvas, glass, framed, wood), cards, calendars, and photo gifts. Printique does NOT publish a documented public developer or fulfillment API. There is no developer portal, no published REST reference, no API keys, and no OpenAPI definition on the open web. Programmatic and automated ordering is instead delivered through prebuilt partner-platform integrations - a Squarespace integration that syncs products and automates order fulfillment, a PhotoShelter wholesale print-and-product integration for professional photographers, Fundy Designer album integration, and desktop plugins for Adobe Lightroom and Capture One that publish images directly to Printique. A Pro membership tier ($14.95/month or $159.95/year) unlocks tiered wholesale savings, white-label blind shipping, and dedicated support for photography businesses. The logical API surfaces below (catalog, orders, order status) are honestly modeled from Printique's public product, Pro, and integration pages to describe how ordering works conceptually; they are NOT transcribed from any released or documented Printique API. No public endpoints, paths, or request/response schemas are published, so endpointsModeled is true and no endpoint surface has been fabricated beyond these named, integration-delivered capabilities.

providers.name: Respondus
providers.description: Respondus builds assessment-integrity tools for online exams - most notably LockDown Browser, a custom browser that locks down the testing environment, and Respondus Monitor, an automated webcam-based online proctoring service that adds AI-assisted review on top of LockDown Browser. Over 2,000 institutions across 50+ countries use Respondus to deliver hundreds of millions of online exams a year. Respondus does not publish a self-service public developer API. Its products reach learning platforms through LMS integration rather than an open REST surface - native plugins/building blocks plus the IMS Global LTI (Learning Tools Interoperability) standard for Blackboard, Brightspace, Canvas, Moodle, Sakai, and Schoology, and a privately-licensed LockDown Browser SDK for third-party assessment platforms that must be arranged through Respondus sales. No public OpenAPI, developer keys, or documented endpoints are offered.

providers.name: Saronic Technologies
providers.description: Saronic Technologies designs, manufactures, and deploys AI-enabled autonomous surface vessels (ASVs) for maritime security, domain awareness, reconnaissance, logistics, and payload delivery. The Austin-based company sells to the U.S. Navy, allied defense forces, and select commercial and government customers. Vessel models include Spyglass, Cutlass, Corsair, and Marauder, ranging from 6 to 150 feet. The Echelon software platform provides mission planning, high-fidelity simulation, fleet command-and-control, and open architecture for third-party payload integration (ISR sensors, EW, comms, weapons). Saronic does not publish a public, self-service developer API; integrations are arranged through partnership and are subject to U.S. export controls (ITAR/EAR).

providers.name: Sensee
providers.description: Sensee is a French direct-to-consumer online optician and contact-lens retailer, operating since 2005 and run by licensed opticians. It sells contact lenses, lens-care solutions, eye-health products and eyewear across six European markets (France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Switzerland and Austria) under localized storefronts, and supports third-party insurance payment (tiers payant) via networks such as Kalixia, Santeclair, Almerys and Optilys. Sensee is a subsidiary of Vision Group Holding AG. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the enrichment pass found no public API, SDK or developer program, only a corporate security.txt / responsible-disclosure surface.

providers.name: Soma
providers.description: Soma (Soma Insurance Services) is a commercial insurance brokerage that positions itself as the fastest brokerage for complex businesses, placing customized commercial-lines coverage across industries including retail, trucking, hospitality, healthcare, finance, technology, manufacturing, and construction. Coverage lines include general liability, commercial auto, cyber liability, professional liability, and builder's risk. Backed by Accel and Cowboy Ventures in the insurance-tech sector. As of this enrichment pass Soma publishes no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public web presence and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Sonic Automotive
providers.description: Sonic Automotive is one of the largest automotive retailers in the United States, operating 100+ franchise dealerships across 13 states representing 25+ automotive brands, and operating EchoPark Automotive used-vehicle stores. The company invests in digital retail, inventory management technology, and automotive data platforms to enhance customer experience across vehicle sales, service, finance, and insurance. Technology partners include Stripe, NETSOL, and CDK Global.

providers.name: Sonoco Products
providers.description: Sonoco Products Company is a global leader in sustainable metal and fiber consumer and industrial packaging, operating 285 facilities across 40 countries with 23,000+ employees. Products include metal packaging (aerosol cans, steel food cans, closures), rigid paper packaging (paper containers, fiber cartridges), industrial paper packaging (tubes, cores, recycled paperboard), and industrial specialty packaging (plastic components, reels, spools). Serves food and beverage, pet care, household products, beauty, automotive, and industrial markets. A Fortune 500 company (NYSE: SON).

providers.name: Synthesis AI
providers.description: Synthesis AI was a San Francisco synthetic-data company, founded in 2019 by Yashar Behzadi, that generated photorealistic, pixel-perfectly labeled images of humans for training computer-vision models. It sold that capability as an API: FaceAPI for labeled facial imagery and, from November 2021, HumanAPI for whole-body 3D digital humans, plus an Identities API for selecting subjects. Jobs were described as JSON documents (identities, expressions, gaze, head turn, hair, accessories, bodies and clothing, gesture animations, camera and light rigs, HDRI environments) and submitted through a command-line client or web console, with rendered output downloaded by job ID. The company raised a $17M Series A in 2022 on more than $24M total funding and was dissolved during 2024-2025. Its API is gone: synthesis.ai is a parked Gandi holding page reachable only over HTTP, and docs.synthesis.ai and api.synthesis.ai no longer resolve. What survives publicly is the Synthesis-AI-Dev GitHub organization (17 public repositories, including the Human API input-JSON appendix and the client tooling) and the official synthesisai package on PyPI.

providers.name: Tema
providers.description: Tema is a thematic, active ETF issuer founded in 2022 by CEO Maurits Pot (formerly of Goldman Sachs, Vitol and Kingsway Capital) and backed by Index Ventures, Accel and Zinal Growth in what the firm described as the largest venture round in ETFs to date. Tema builds institutional-grade, expert-led thematic exchange-traded funds spanning growth themes (space, oncology, electrification, reshoring, luxury) and core strategies, and is underpinned by an end-to-end ETF issuance infrastructure that also enables turnkey launches for external fund managers. The company is a consumer-facing asset manager; it publishes investor resources, fund pages, insights and educational content but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDKs, or technical documentation.

providers.name: TheraNest
providers.description: TheraNest (now marketed as Ensora Mental Health) is a behavioral and mental health practice management and EHR platform for therapists, counselors, psychologists, and social workers. It covers client intake, scheduling, telehealth, clinical documentation and notes, treatment plans, client portals, insurance billing and claims, and reporting. TheraNest is the flagship mental health product of Ensora Health (formerly Therapy Brands). As of this review, Ensora does not publish a documented, self-serve public developer API for TheraNest - integration is via partnerships, HIPAA-gated interoperability, and contact-sales arrangements rather than an open developer portal. The API entries below are logical resource groupings modeled from the product surface; their endpoints are NOT documented public endpoints (endpointsModeled true).

providers.name: Thirty Madison
providers.description: Thirty Madison is a US direct-to-consumer telehealth and digital-health company founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City. It operates a family of condition-focused virtual care brands, including Keeps (hair loss), Cove (migraine), Facet (dermatology), and Nurx (sexual and reproductive health), pairing online medical consultations with mail-order pharmacy fulfillment; the company merged with Nurx in 2022. Thirty Madison publishes no public developer API program, so this profile captures its public security-disclosure and domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Tigris
providers.description: Tigris is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z, general-catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: VeeFriends
providers.description: VeeFriends is a character-driven collectibles and entertainment company founded by Gary Vaynerchuk, built around 250+ original characters that embody human values like empathy, patience, and kindness. Operated by Vee Friends, LLC out of New York, the brand spans NFT collections (Series 1, Series 2, Iconics, Book Games), Topps Chrome trading cards and a trading card game, comic books and cartoons, collectible stickers and pins, apparel and plush merchandise, and the Burn Island platform where holders burn NFTs to unlock rare collectibles, events, and prizes. VeeFriends is an a16z portfolio company and publishes no public developer API surface today.

providers.name: VF Corporation
providers.description: VF Corporation is a global apparel and footwear company headquartered in Denver, Colorado. VF owns major brands including Vans, The North Face, Timberland, Altra, Eastpak, Icebreaker, JanSport, Kipling, Napapijri, and Smartwool. The company does not offer a public developer API program; its technology integrations are handled through third-party e-commerce platforms and enterprise supply chain systems. VF Corporation operates more than 1,500 stores globally and integrates with platforms such as Shopify, Amazon, Magento, WooCommerce, and BigCommerce via third-party integration services.

providers.name: 451 Degrees
providers.description: 451 Degrees is a marketing-technology and ad-tech company founded in 2006 that builds Graffiti, a patented AI content ecosystem for digital content and ad-tech businesses. Graffiti uses machine learning, artificial intelligence, and natural language processing to analyze user-generated comments and digital content in real time, converting comment "noise" into structured data that powers brand safety, contextual relevancy, content recommendation, and first-party data strategies. It is designed as a platform-agnostic tool that complements existing comment platforms, ad delivery networks, and content systems rather than replacing them, and markets itself as privacy-compliant with GDPR and CCPA while using no cookies, mobile IDs, or IDFA for targeting.

providers.name: Accusilicon
providers.description: Accusilicon (Guangzhou Ruixin Microelectronics Co., Ltd. / 广州睿芯微电子有限公司) is a fabless mixed-signal semiconductor company founded in July 2014 and headquartered in the Huangpu district of Guangzhou, China, with additional sites in Xi'an and Shanghai. It designs and sells ultra-low phase noise timing silicon and related analog ICs — XO/VCXO/TCXO and OCXO oscillator chips, clock ICs, crystal-oscillator modules, RF and analog switch ICs, mobile-interface protection ICs, ADC/DAC converters, digital audio processor (DSP) and audio ICs, and spectral image sensor chips — alongside clock stability analyzers and other test and measurement instruments, and ASIC/SoC, module, system and clock custom design services. Its parts are used in smartphones, digital communications and high-speed Ethernet, audio/video and professional audiophile equipment, medical, security, payment and measurement systems. The company is a hardware component supplier: it operates a corporate marketing site in Chinese only and publishes no developer program, developer portal, API documentation, SDK or machine-readable API description of any kind.

providers.name: Aisin
providers.description: Aisin Corporation is a Japanese global Tier 1 automotive supplier headquartered in Kariya, Aichi. Part of the Toyota Group, Aisin manufactures automatic transmissions, drivetrain components, body, chassis, and electronics for major automakers.

providers.name: Ajar Online
providers.description: Ajar Online is a cloud-based property management and rent-collection platform headquartered in Kuwait and founded in 2015. It lets landlords, real-estate agencies, and property managers digitize rent collection and property administration, sending payment requests to tenants over SMS and email and accepting payment via credit and debit cards, KNET, and Sadad so tenants can pay in under a minute from anywhere. The platform adds portfolio dashboards, tenant and contract management, and analytics for data-driven property decisions, and has expanded across the GCC into the UAE and Saudi Arabia. The company operates a live, authenticated API backend at api.joinajar.com; there is no public API documentation, OpenAPI definition, or SDK published at this time, so this profile captures verifiable identity and domain-security signals pending a public developer surface.

providers.name: Alpine Bio
providers.description: Alpine Bio is a molecular-farming biotechnology company (formerly Nobell Foods and Alpine Roads), founded in 2016 and based in South San Francisco, California. It produces next-generation protein ingredients and bioactives from plants using advanced purification and molecular farming, having expressed more than 15 complex proteins including the world's first plant-derived casein, fractionated soy protein isolates, and activated iron-loaded lactoferrin. The company sells high-purity, clean-label ingredients to food and beverage formulators for applications such as protein shakes, bars, coffee creamers, iron supplements, yogurt, and clear protein sodas, and markets animal-free dairy products under the Nobell Foods brand. It is a portfolio company of a16z surfaced in the API Evangelist network; Alpine Bio publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Arcion Labs
providers.description: Arcion Labs, Inc. built a distributed, in-memory change data capture (CDC) platform for real-time enterprise database replication. Its agentless, zero-code pipelines replicated data with low latency and high availability across 20+ enterprise databases and data warehouses (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks Delta Lake and more), driven by a YAML CLI, a workflow UI, and an API, with built-in schema conversion and evolution. Founded by CTO Rajkumar Sen and later led by CEO Gary Hagmueller, and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Databricks Ventures, Arcion was acquired by Databricks in November 2023 (deal valued at over $100M) and its technology now underpins Databricks Lakeflow Connect. This profile is retained for network history; the standalone product is no longer independently marketed.

providers.name: Bbot
providers.description: Bbot is an order-and-pay solution for the hospitality industry, letting guests scan a QR code to view menus, order, and pay from their phones, including placing orders with a server on the same tab. Bbot was acquired by DoorDash and is now offered as Tableside Order & Pay by DoorDash, serving restaurants, bars, breweries, and hotels with on-premise digital ordering and payment, plus POS integrations such as Toast. Bbot operates owner and admin web portals but does not publish a standalone public or partner-facing developer API or documentation portal, so no API products are listed here.

providers.name: Beeline Bikes
providers.description: Beeline Bikes (now operating as Beeline Connect) is a B2B software platform for the bicycle industry that links riders, retailers, and brands across North America, with roughly 3,300 participating retailers. The platform provides real-time service scheduling and 24/7 appointment booking, live market inventory management, test-ride booking, local bicycle assembly coordination, warranty submission and reimbursement tracking, an affiliate e-commerce sales channel with revenue sharing to local dealers, and a dynamic dealer locator. It supports both mobile and in-shop retail operations and serves established brands such as Aventon, Priority, Lectric, and Pedego. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, documentation, or integration surface has been found at this time.

providers.name: Best Food Trucks
providers.description: Best Food Trucks (BFT) operates a food truck booking, scheduling, and mobile ordering platform that connects food truck vendors with property managers, office buildings, event organizers, and hungry customers. The platform lets locations schedule rotating food trucks, lets customers browse menus and place mobile orders ahead of time, and gives trucks a point-of-sale and payments surface for on-site service. Backed by Techstars, the company was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and enriched into the API Evangelist network. This profile currently carries only public infrastructure and security artifacts; no public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface was discoverable during enrichment.

providers.name: Bluespine
providers.description: Bluespine is an AI‑driven platform that helps self‑insured employers and health‑plan sponsors reduce medical claims overbilling, monitor plan performance, and meet fiduciary duties under ERISA. Founded in 2023 and based in New York, the company leverages machine‑readable price transparency files, carrier billing guidelines, and proprietary data sources to detect policy violations and recover savings for plan participants.

providers.name: BrightSource Energy
providers.description: BrightSource Energy is a renewable energy technology company founded in 2006, historically known as a pioneer of utility-scale Concentrated Solar Power (CSP) — it designed, developed and built the 377 MW Ivanpah Solar Electric Generating System in California along with CSP projects in Israel, Dubai and South Africa. In 2022 the company transformed into a software business and now commercializes OASES, a cloud-based, AI-powered Energy Management System (EMS) that forecasts, optimizes and dispatches portfolios of photovoltaics, battery energy storage (BESS), wind, microgrids and EV charging. OASES combines physics-based digital twins, big-data analytics and sensor fusion with an on-site SCADA edge controller ("OASES Gateway + IoT") to run asset management, energy-market bidding and arbitrage, PPA management, grid services and frequency regulation. Engineering is based in Jerusalem, Israel, with a UK office in London. BrightSource does not publish a public developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract as of August 2026.

providers.name: Buena
providers.description: Buena (Buena GmbH) is a Berlin-based modern property management company serving real estate owners across Germany, managing over 70,000 units. It provides WEG (condominium / Wohnungseigentümergemeinschaft) management, rental property management (Mietverwaltung), and property-management succession (Nachfolge) for owners seeking an alternative to conventional, reactive administrators. Buena positions itself as a technology-forward, proactive Hausverwaltung. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of EQT Ventures and GV and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Buena publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or technical documentation — this profile captures verified company identity and public web properties only.

providers.name: Capitaliq
providers.description: Capital IQ, part of S&P Global Market Intelligence, provides a comprehensive platform delivering essential intelligence, financial data, analytics, and research tools for professionals. The service offers deep company fundamentals, credit analytics, market insights, and specialized products such as Panjiva and Research Online, enabling informed decision‑making across industries.

providers.name: Captain's Eye
providers.description: Captain's Eye is a Haifa, Israel-based maritime AI company (founded 2020 by Uri Ben Dor and Doron Oizerovich, backed by Techstars) that delivers real-time video analytics software for maritime and industrial safety. Its SaaS platform connects to existing CCTV cameras, radar, and thermal sensors aboard merchant vessels, yachts, cruise ships, ports, and on-land petrochemical and energy sites, applying custom neural networks and commercial AI models to detect fires, smoke, leaks, sea pollution, missing protective gear, unauthorized access, and equipment failures. It provides real-time alerts, remote monitoring, incident documentation, and operational data collection, monitoring 5,000+ cameras and having detected 100,000+ events. Access is delivered through a private web application and mobile apps rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: CeleCor Therapeutics
providers.description: CeleCor Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing innovative therapies for patients experiencing ST-segment elevation myocardial infarctions (STEMI). Their flagship program, Disaggpro™, aims to deliver a rapid, pre-hospital treatment to reduce mortality and improve outcomes for heart attack patients. The company provides background resources, clinical trial information, and an expanded access policy through its website.

providers.name: ClearCam
providers.description: ClearCam provides AI-powered object detection and search for CCTV camera feeds. It runs locally on user hardware for privacy, supporting RTSP streams and offering premium mobile notifications. ClearCam aims to simplify camera integration while leveraging GPU compute, and is open-source with a Python/FFmpeg foundation.

providers.name: Climavision
providers.description: Climavision is a Louisville, Kentucky weather intelligence company that combines a proprietary nationwide supplemental network of low-altitude X-band, dual-polarization gap-filling weather radars with AI-driven numerical weather prediction (NWP) to deliver enterprise-grade forecasts and observational data. Its Horizon AI product line includes Horizon Point for site-specific forecasts, Horizon Global for ground-to-high- altitude global models, Horizon HI-RES for custom high-resolution local forecasting, and Horizon S2S for subseasonal-to-seasonal prediction. Climavision exposes a Weather API hosted at point-forecast-api.climavision.com with 1,800+ parameters, 15-day forecasts, and bearer-token authentication, plus a separate Radar Status API and Radar-as-a-Service offering that supplies Level II files, NetCDF, and GeoTIFF radar data products (reflectivity, velocity, dual-pol-derived QPE at 1km, precipitation type, tornado debris detection) for coverage below 4,000 feet where NEXRAD cannot see due to Earth curvature. The company integrates its radar feed into MRMS and has provided supplemental data into the National Weather Service's AWIPS software. Climavision processes 1.5+ billion datasets daily, serves customers across agriculture, aviation, commodity trading, drones and Advanced Air Mobility, energy and utilities, government, insurance and reinsurance, media, and transportation and logistics, and raised a $100 million strategic investment from TPG's Rise Fund. API access is gated through a sales-led contact process; no public sandbox or open-source SDKs are published, and the Climavision GitHub organization (github.com/Climavision) currently has only two minor public repositories (an archived Azure Table Storage helper and a GeoServer Helm chart fork).

providers.name: CloudFrame
providers.description: CloudFrame provides mainframe modernization and COBOL transformation solutions, helping enterprises modernize legacy mainframe applications with confidence and velocity. Their platform offers tools like Continuum, CodeNavigator, and Atlas to analyze, transform, and migrate mainframe workloads to cloud-native environments, accelerating digital transformation and reducing operational risk.

providers.name: ConKay Medical Systems
providers.description: ConKay Medical Systems is an early‑stage medical device company focused on developing minimally invasive solutions to treat valvular regurgitation in patients with progressive heart failure. Founded in 2020 and based in Pleasanton, CA, the company advances annular repair catheter systems for the tricuspid valve, aiming to reduce the need for open‑heart surgery.

providers.name: Creator Stack
providers.description: CreatorStack is a consumer creator-economy platform that helps independent creators own their audience instead of renting it from social networks. Its core product, the "Superclub," lets a creator build a membership community of paying super-fans, capture first-party audience data, and deepen engagement and loyalty that translates into stronger brand sponsorships. A forthcoming Royalty product will let creators share and sell royalties in their future content directly to the top fans who invest early, in exchange for perks and exclusive benefits. Backed by Accel, CreatorStack positions a creator's brand and audience as a true, ownable asset on the internet rather than a rented one.

providers.name: Defense Information System for Security
providers.description: The Defense Information System for Security (DISS) is the enterprise-wide Department of Defense system of record for personnel security, suitability, and credentialing management for military, civilian, and contractor personnel. Operated by the Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA), DISS replaced the Joint Personnel Adjudication System (JPAS) as the system of record on March 31, 2021. DISS is restricted to authorized DoD and federal users and contractor security officers; it does not expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Deutsche Bahn
providers.description: Deutsche Bahn AG is Germany's national railway company, operating passenger and freight services across Europe. It provides a comprehensive digital platform offering journey planning, ticket booking, real-time traffic information, and various travel-related services via web and mobile applications. The API ecosystem includes endpoints for timetables, fare calculation, reservation management, and service alerts, supporting developers building travel solutions and integrations.

providers.name: Dollar Tree
providers.description: Dollar Tree is a leading operator of discount variety stores in North America, operating more than 16,000 stores under the Dollar Tree and Family Dollar banners. Vendor and supplier integration is primarily handled through EDI, SAP, and ERP systems via the Dollar Tree Vendor Portal. No public REST API is currently available.

providers.name: Eventup
providers.description: EventUp is a global online marketplace and directory for event venues, operated by Tripleseat. It lists over 15,000 restaurants, hotels, breweries, rooftop bars, museums, libraries, and other unique spaces that people can browse and request quotes from for parties, weddings, corporate events, and meetings. Event planners and consumers search venues by city, capacity, event type, and amenities and submit free quote requests directly to venue owners, while venue owners list and market their spaces to receive booking inquiries. A companion product, EventUp Planner, adds marketing, planning, and analytics tooling. EventUp is a consumer-facing web marketplace and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or agent/MCP surface. This API Evangelist profile was seeded as a 500 Global portfolio lead and enriched with the discoverability, identity, and domain-security signals that are publicly observable.

providers.name: Fi Money
providers.description: Fi Money is a Bengaluru, India based money-management application and consumer fintech operated by Epifi Technologies, founded in 2019 by ex-Google Pay (Tez) executives Sujith Narayanan and Sumit Gwalani together with Neeraj Bhope and Prasanna Ranganathan. Fi is not a chartered bank; it delivers a millennial-focused mobile experience layered on top of partner RBI-licensed Federal Bank, providing zero-balance digital savings accounts, a Visa debit card, deposits, mutual funds, Indian and US stocks, EPF tracking, credit cards, personal loans, jump-style automated savings rules ("FIT Rules"), and an AI-powered money assistant. Fi has raised roughly US$169M across multiple rounds from investors including Sequoia Capital India (Peak XV), Ribbit Capital, Temasek, Alpha Wave, and B Capital, and serves Indian retail consumers via iOS and Android apps. There is no classic public REST developer API or partner banking-as-a-service surface; Fi's only developer-facing interface is the Fi MCP (Model Context Protocol) server — a JSON-RPC streaming endpoint at https://mcp.fi.money:8080/mcp/stream that lets users connect their own Fi account to LLM clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini, ChatGPT) and call read-only tools such as fetch_net_worth, fetch_credit_report, fetch_epf_details, fetch_bank_transactions, fetch_mf_transactions, and fetch_stock_transactions to expose their net worth, holdings, EPF balance, credit report, and transactions to AI assistants. A hackathon-friendly mock server (epiFi/fi-mcp-dev, Go) and developer documentation (epiFi/mcp-docs) are published publicly on GitHub.

providers.name: Flexion
providers.description: Flexion Robotics builds the autonomy stack for humanoid robots — from command to control, from manipulation to locomotion, across any hardware and task. Founded by former NVIDIA and ETH Zurich reinforcement-learning researchers (Nikita Rudin, David Höller, Julian Nubert), the Zurich- and San Francisco-based company uses large-scale simulation and reinforcement learning to train generalizable robot policies that transfer to real-world hardware. Its Flexion Reflect model line targets long-horizon autonomous humanoid work. The company raised $50M and is backed by Prosus Ventures. Flexion does not currently expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Forvia
providers.description: Forvia is a French global Tier 1 automotive supplier formed in 2022 by the combination of Faurecia and Hella. Forvia designs and manufactures cockpits, seating, interiors, lighting, electronics, hydrogen storage, and clean mobility systems for global automakers.

providers.name: FreeAPIData
providers.description: A free, curated directory of public APIs — an editorial catalog of third-party APIs across 17 categories. FreeAPIData is itself an API-discovery directory, not an API provider; it exposes machine-readable discovery surfaces (llms.txt, apis.json, sitemap) but no consumable data API.

providers.name: Fwb
providers.description: Friends With Benefits (FWB) is a Web3 cultural community and member-owned organization that blends online culture, IRL events, and token-gated membership. It operates the $FWB token, publishes an editorial arm, runs member governance, and produces gatherings such as FWB FEST (its annual festival in Idyllwild, CA) alongside builder programs like World Build Labs. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. At the time of enrichment FWB publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable developer surface — this profile captures its public identity and member-facing web properties.

providers.name: GOAT
providers.description: GOAT (operated by GOAT Group) is a global online marketplace for authentic sneakers, apparel, and accessories, launched in 2015 and headquartered in the Los Angeles area. The platform pairs a consumer buying-and-selling experience with in-house authentication that verifies new and used footwear and streetwear from thousands of brands, and GOAT Group also operates the Flight Club consignment stores and the alias seller platform. GOAT was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z, accel, index-ventures, initialized-capital, matrix-partners, and sv-angel and added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-backed company profile. It runs a consumer commerce platform rather than a public developer API, so this enriched profile focuses on verified company identity and the security surface probed from its public domain.

providers.name: Gyre Energy
providers.description: Gyre Energy is a UK-based climate-tech company that reduces cooling costs for operators of cold storage facilities, data centers, and building portfolios by combining artificial intelligence with thermal energy storage. Its platform pairs Gyre AI, a digital twin that learns a facility's thermal behavior and shifts cooling cycles to run when grid energy is cheapest and greenest, with an integrated thermal energy storage "cold battery" and a real-time monitoring and controls layer that tracks temperature, energy use, and door-open events. The company reports up to 50% lower cooling expenses, 38% verified energy cost savings at its first commercial cold storage deployment, a 91% reduction in temperature excursions, and a payback period of under 1.5 years. Gyre Energy is a portfolio company of Speedinvest and, as of July 2026, secured $1.3m in funding to support a major blue-chip deployment and global scaling. It currently exposes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal; this profile captures its identity and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Hapag-Lloyd
providers.description: A German multinational container shipping company and one of the world's largest liner shipping companies. Operates a fleet of over 250 vessels serving approximately 600 ports across 130 countries with a focus on quality and reliability. Provides a public API portal (api-portal.hlag.com) exposing container tracking, schedule, and booking APIs to customers, partners, and logistics platforms.

providers.name: Hosta a.i.
providers.description: Hosta a.i. is an AI-powered remote property assessment platform that turns ordinary photographs from any camera into precise measurements, detailed floor plans, material classifications, condition assessments, and bills of materials. Using patented AI spatial and material analytics, Hosta automates onsite property analysis without specialized equipment or site visits, and exposes these capabilities through configurable APIs so insurers, appraisers, inspectors, contractors, property managers, home-improvement platforms, and furniture retailers can embed remote assessment into their existing workflows and systems. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, Hosta is a Techstars- and Eclipse-backed company operating on a secure AWS cloud platform with PII filtering protections.

providers.name: Hutchinson
providers.description: Hutchinson SA is a French global Tier 1 automotive supplier headquartered in Paris, a subsidiary of TotalEnergies. Hutchinson designs and manufactures anti-vibration systems, sealing systems, fluid transfer, precision rubber components, and aerospace systems for the automotive, aerospace, defense, and industrial sectors.

providers.name: INF Tech
providers.description: INF Tech (无限光年, "Infinite Light Year") is an AI-native technology company headquartered in Shanghai, with a global entity in Singapore (inf.sg), building safe and trustworthy agentic AI for mission-critical industries. Its flagship is an enterprise "Agentic OS" — an intelligent-agent operating system with unified governance, a private AI code-execution engine that supports custom LLMs and skills, and full-stack application security spanning model training through deployment. INF also develops and open-sources multimodal foundation models, including the Infinity-Parser document-parsing family, the INF-Retriever bilingual dense-retrieval models, OpenCoder code LLMs, and VL-Rethinker vision-language reasoning models, all published on Hugging Face and GitHub. Vertical "industry agents" target finance (AI index customization, compliance intelligence, investment research, and SME credit rating) alongside science and education. The company exposes API, CLI, and SDK access and supports MCP integration.

providers.name: Intellilake
providers.description: Intellilake is an early-stage company backed by Anthemis and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. Its public presence at intellilake.com is currently a placeholder landing page with a corporate contact address and a published privacy policy; the site references online services that require user accounts and login, affiliates, and third-party service providers, but as of this enrichment pass it publishes no developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI, SDKs, or other machine-readable API surface. This profile remains a lead awaiting a public API before deeper enrichment.

providers.name: Intello
providers.description: Intello was a SaaS management platform providing SaaS discovery, usage analytics, and spend optimization for IT teams seeking visibility and control over their software portfolio. The product line is now offered by Zylo, an enterprise SaaS spend optimization and AI consumption cost management platform. There is no separate public developer API.

providers.name: IONA
providers.description: IONA (IONA Drones) is a UK-based autonomous drone delivery company building the full technology stack for logistics operators. Its tilt-rotor Sonnet aircraft performs VTOL from compact sites and carries up to 20 parcels up to 200 km per autonomous flight. IONA pairs the aircraft with an onboard autonomy operating system, GPS/LiDAR sensor-fusion precision landing, a SORA-aligned BVLOS compliance engine, an operations centre for real-time fleet monitoring and analytics, and a digital twin for simulation and predictive maintenance. The platform integrates with existing TMS/WMS logistics systems and targets healthcare, rural/remote, express e-commerce, industrial, and maritime delivery. Backed by Techstars.

providers.name: Isengard Industries
providers.description: Isengard Industries builds sovereign production capability for defense: the means for allied nations to manufacture precision-strike and counter-drone (counter-UAS) systems by the thousand, on their own soil, at a fraction of what traditional prime contractors charge. The company describes its approach as "Weapons of Mass Production." Founded in 2026 and part of Y Combinator's Summer 2026 batch, it is led by Francisco Serra-Martins (previously co-founder/CEO of Terminal Autonomy) and James Tennant (former Australian Army officer), and is headquartered in San Francisco. As a hardware and defense-manufacturing company it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its public identity and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Jeh Aerospace
providers.description: Jeh Aerospace is a precision aerospace manufacturing company building "future factories" across the US-India corridor to supply aerostructures and aero-engine components for the commercial aerospace supply chain. From certified facilities in India spanning more than 160,000 square feet, Jeh delivers machining, sheet metal, tubes and pipes, surface treatment, structural assembly, and engineering services on time and at scale. The company is fully compliant with AS9100, ISO 9001, OEM requirements, and export regulations, and weaves a digital thread across its supplier networks for radical transparency. Jeh operates from both the US and India and is backed by General Catalyst and IndiGo Ventures.

providers.name: Jumia
providers.description: Jumia is a pan-African e-commerce company often described as the "Amazon of Africa." Headquartered in Berlin and listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker JMIA since its 2019 IPO, Jumia Technologies AG operates a third-party marketplace, a logistics network (Jumia Logistics), and a digital payments arm (JumiaPay) across eight African markets as of 2026: Egypt, Ghana, Ivory Coast, Kenya, Morocco, Nigeria, Senegal, and Uganda. The company exited Algeria in February 2026 and previously wound down Cameroon, Gabon, Rwanda, and Tunisia as part of a multi-year restructuring program targeting full-year profitability in 2027. Jumia's commerce platform connects more than 100,000 sellers with consumers across diverse categories including phones and electronics, fashion, home and living, beauty, FMCG, and groceries. Its developer surface is non-trivial: the Jumia Vendor API (vendor center, OAuth 2.0) supports order, inventory, product, and shipment integration for marketplace sellers, while the legacy SellerCenter API (a SellerCenter / Rocket Internet lineage shared with Lazada and Daraz) remains documented with PHP, Python, Ruby, and Node SDKs. JumiaPay exposes a Merchant API for payment creation, verification, refund, recurring-payment agreements, and callback-based webhooks, plus official WooCommerce and Magento payment-gateway plugins. The Jumia GitHub organization is sparse (an open-source playbook, Jumia Tech Blog, and Tech in Porto event site) while the JumiaPay AIG GitHub org hosts the WooCommerce and Magento gateway plugins under Apache 2.0.

providers.name: Kev
providers.description: Kev is an open-source (Apache-2.0) family of small decision models built on Qwen3.5/Qwen3.8 by Jared Palmer, released on GitHub and Hugging Face. Its self-hosted server exposes an HTTP API that, per the README, "matches TypeSafe's System One" (POST /v1/systemone with noul, choice and score questions). Not a Cognition product. No OpenAPI or JSON Schema file is published in the repository.

providers.name: Living Carbon
providers.description: Living Carbon is a reforestation and carbon removal company that restores abandoned mineland and degraded agricultural land in the United States, generating income for landowners while producing high-quality carbon removal credits with true additionality, limited leakage, and unique co-benefits. It develops fast-growing poplar trees for permanent land restoration and for custom biomass feedstock sited near processing facilities. Backed by Homebrew and surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a climate-sector company profile; the company publishes no public developer, API, or technical surface at this time.

providers.name: Magna International
providers.description: Magna International is a Canadian global Tier 1 automotive supplier headquartered in Aurora, Ontario. Magna designs and manufactures vehicle bodies, chassis, exteriors, seating, powertrain, ADAS, electronics, mirrors, and complete vehicle assembly through its global operations.

providers.name: Mathem
providers.description: Mathem is Sweden's largest pure-play online grocery retailer, delivering fresh food, household goods and pantry staples directly to consumers' homes across Sweden. Customers browse and order the full assortment of a physical supermarket through the mathem.se website and native iOS/Android apps, and receive scheduled home delivery. Mathem merged with the Norwegian online grocer Oda to form one of the Nordics' largest online grocery groups, and its security and careers functions are now operated under the shared Oda organization. Payments are handled through Klarna and the major card networks. Mathem operates a consumer e-commerce storefront and mobile apps; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal. This API Evangelist profile was created as a SoftBank Vision Fund portfolio lead and enriched via the enrichment pipeline; the substantive public technical surface found is an RFC 9116 security.txt and an invite-only YesWeHack bug-bounty program run through Oda.

providers.name: Metafy
providers.description: Metafy is a consumer marketplace for gaming coaching and mentorship, connecting players with expert coaches and professional gamers for personalized one-on-one lessons, VOD reviews, and guides across popular competitive titles. Metafy operates a consumer web platform at metafy.gg and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; the only machine-discoverable surface found was an RFC 9116 /.well-known/security.txt security contact. Surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures.

providers.name: MoonActive
providers.description: MoonActive is a mobile game developer and publisher best known for the casual titles Coin Master and Pet Master. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As a consumer gaming company MoonActive publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; the enrichment pass captured its security and domain posture only (a published RFC 9116 security.txt with a security contact and disclosure page, plus probed TLS/SPF/DMARC).

providers.name: MotorMia
providers.description: MotorMia is an AI-powered automotive platform for car enthusiasts, built around Mia, an AI modding partner, build advisor, and performance analyst. Users add their vehicles, set build and performance goals, and Mia returns personalized upgrade recommendations across engine, transmission, brakes, suspension, cooling, and exhaust systems, tuned to the user's level of mechanical experience. The platform is backed by a proprietary automotive intelligence dataset combining over 5 million aftermarket parts, more than 50 million fitment records, and real-world enthusiast build behavior from 1M+ community projects, and ships as iOS and Android mobile apps plus a web store. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, MotorMia raised $8M led by investors including Lerer Hippeau and Seedcamp. As of this profile MotorMia is a consumer mobile product and publishes no public developer API, documentation, or specification surface.

providers.name: Mozart AI
providers.description: Mozart AI is a generative audio workstation and AI music-creation platform (mozartai.com) that lets musicians compose, produce, and distribute songs using AI-assisted and agentic tools. Rather than generating finished tracks from a single prompt, it operates as a full digital audio workstation built around context-aware stem generation, real-time MIDI suggestions, synth and effects generation, and automated production tasks such as quantization and time-stretching, letting users work at the level of stems, instruments, or individual notes. Founded in 2025 and based in London, the company raised a $6M seed round led by Balderton Capital in February 2026 and reports more than 100,000 artists and over 1 million songs created. The product is delivered as a consumer web and mobile app (built on the ElevenLabs Eleven Music API) and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: mth Sense
providers.description: mth Sense (Mth Sense Inc.), operating as RevSense, is a mobile ad-technology company founded in 2011 by Mandar Agte and Mohan Balachandran and backed by Y Combinator (Summer 2012). It began as a mobile on-device profiling and ad-serving platform that inferred demographic and psychographic audience profiles from app-usage data, and has evolved into a programmatic yield and revenue-optimization platform for digital publishers. The RevSense product suite provides machine-learning yield optimization (real-time price floors, frequency caps, geo controls), automated header-bidding tag management, a unified reporting and data platform aggregating ad-server and demand-partner data, and one-click demand/buyer integration. mth Sense markets to publishers, agencies, SSPs, ad networks, and advertisers, and will build private exchanges with an RTB engine and common reporting dashboards. As of this profile the company publishes a static marketing website with no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: NaroIQ
providers.description: NaroIQ is a European ETF issuance and infrastructure platform that lets capital management companies and ETF initiators launch and operate their own exchange-traded funds while retaining control over their value chain. It acts as a single coordination layer across the full ETF lifecycle — fund setup, basket and portfolio composition file (PCF) management, intraday indicative net asset value (iNAV) calculation, an in-house indexing engine, optional portfolio management, and end-to-end regulatory compliance under Germany's BaFin and the EU's ESMA regimes. The company is a General Catalyst portfolio company based in Europe. As of this enrichment pass NaroIQ publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or machine discovery surface (no /.well-known/*, no llms.txt); this profile captures the company identity and published web properties.

providers.name: Noise
providers.description: Noise is a consumer "attention markets" / trend-prediction platform built on Base where curators propose trend pages and communities trade markets on how relevant a topic, brand, or movement becomes over time. Market price reflects a central "relevance" number, with funding and liquidation mechanics familiar from perpetual markets. Noise raised a $7.1M seed round led by Paradigm and launched an invite-only testnet beta. It is a mobile-first consumer app rather than a developer platform; its public surface is product documentation (Mintlify) at docs.noise.xyz — no first-party developer API, SDKs, or authentication scheme is currently published.

providers.name: Octavewealth
providers.description: Octave Wealth (octavewealth.com) is a Y Combinator-backed company that, based on its name and branding, operates in the wealth and personal-finance space. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Y Combinator and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass the company's public web presence sits behind Cloudflare and exposes no public developer API, documentation, OpenAPI specification, or SDK surface; the only machine-discoverable artifact found was a published RFC 9116 security.txt with a security contact. This profile records that verifiable state rather than a developer program.

providers.name: Pass It Down
providers.description: Pass It Down is a Chattanooga, Tennessee digital storytelling company that helps museums, libraries, universities, sports organizations, brands, and nonprofits build interactive online exhibits, digital collections, timelines, and cloud-based touchscreen kiosks. Its stated mission is that every organization should be able to build Smithsonian-quality exhibits in minutes for a fraction of the cost. Related properties include Iconic Moments (a cultural-heritage NFT marketplace) and a sports-storytelling offering. The company was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Pass It Down publishes a marketing/product website but no public developer API, documentation, SDKs, packages, or other machine-readable surface.

providers.name: Petra Power
providers.description: Petra Power is an on-site power generation company based in Solon, Ohio, and backed by Techstars, building rapidly deployable, high-efficiency generation systems positioned as "the next 100GW of on-site power." Its technology runs on natural gas, diesel, or hydrogen, claims up to 3x fuel savings versus conventional generators and turbines, and operates silently and odorlessly for use in populated areas. Target applications include data centers, critical backup power, heavy industry, and utility-scale deployment. Petra Power is a hardware/energy company with no public developer or API surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Pheon Therapeutics
providers.description: Pheon Therapeutics is a preclinical-stage oncology biotechnology company developing next-generation antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) for a wide range of hard-to-treat solid tumors. Leveraging two decades of ADC experience, Pheon arms monoclonal antibodies against both novel and clinically validated targets with warheads from its proprietary payload platform, which offers a novel mechanism of action, or with off-the-shelf linker-payload combinations, balancing safety and efficacy for each target. The company is privately held and backed by specialist healthcare investors. Pheon publishes a corporate and scientific web presence only; it exposes no public developer API, SDKs, documentation, or well-known API discovery surface.

providers.name: Photon Crystal Energy
providers.description: Photon Crystal Energy Technology Ltd. (广东光晶能源科技有限公司) is a China-based perovskite photovoltaic module manufacturer, founded May 2022 and headquartered in Foshan, Guangdong. The company commercializes full wet-process, full-printed perovskite PV modules for building-integrated photovoltaics (BIPV), photovoltaic curtain walls, rooftop distributed solar, carports and architectural solar applications. Product families include standard, semi-transparent, textured, architectural color and solar tile modules, and the firm operates a 100 MW full-printed perovskite pilot line with IEC 61215 / IEC 61730 certification milestones. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes a marketing/corporate website but no public API, SDK, or developer surface.

providers.name: Planetary
providers.description: Planetary is a decentralized, peer-to-peer social networking company built on the Secure Scuttlebutt (SSB) protocol, offering an iOS app for algorithm-free social media where users own and store their data locally with no advertising and no data selling. The team has since migrated its design, app, and philosophy to the Nostr protocol under a new app, nos.social. The project is fully open source, developed in the open on GitHub, and is a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta. Planetary exposes no commercial REST/HTTP API; its developer surface is the underlying SSB/Nostr protocol documentation (RPC methods, replication, blobs) rather than a hosted web API.

providers.name: Retailo
providers.description: Retailo (Retailo Technologies) operates a B2B marketplace that helps independent retailers across the MENAP region (Middle East, North Africa and Pakistan) restock their shops, offering thousands of products, instant price comparisons and next-day delivery through the Retailo App. Its ecosystem also includes the Hisaab App, a fintech and bookkeeping product for merchants, and HORECA supply services for the hospitality trade. Founded by Talha Ansari, Muhammad Nowkhaiz and Wahaj Ahmed and backed by 500 Global, the company is operational in markets including the UAE and Pakistan. Retailo distributes its products as native iOS and Android mobile applications and, as of this profile, publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or programmatic integration surface.

providers.name: Royal Caribbean Group
providers.description: Royal Caribbean Group is a global cruise vacation company operating Royal Caribbean International, Celebrity Cruises, and Silversea Cruises. Royal Caribbean does not publish a public developer API. Travel partner and agent integration is operated through the CruisingPower B2B portal (cruisingpower.com), which requires authenticated agent access. The company also operates loyalty (Crown & Anchor Society) and consumer booking platforms with no public API surface.

providers.name: Saint-Gobain
providers.description: Saint-Gobain is a French multinational corporation founded in 1665, headquartered in Courbevoie, France. It designs, manufactures, and distributes materials and solutions for the construction, mobility, healthcare, and industrial markets. The group operates through well-known brands including CertainTeed (North American roofing, insulation, gypsum), Norton (abrasives), Weber (mortars and facades), Placo (plasterboard, France), and ISOVER (insulation). Saint-Gobain trades on Euronext Paris under the ticker SGO and is a component of the CAC 40 and Euro Stoxx 50 indices. As a building materials and industrial manufacturer, Saint-Gobain operates no public developer program, API portal, or machine-readable surface. The GitHub organization at github.com/saint-gobain exists but hosts zero public repositories. Any digital integration with customers, distributors, or partners happens through private B2B channels (EDI, custom integrations, e-commerce portals for trade buyers) rather than a documented public API. This repo exists in the API Evangelist network as a placeholder record for the company — to mark that the surface area was assessed and found to be absent — rather than to catalog APIs.

providers.name: Sanofi
providers.description: Sanofi is a French multinational pharmaceutical and healthcare company focused on immunology, oncology, rare diseases, and vaccines, and a leading vaccines manufacturer. Sanofi does not publish a public developer API. Its GitHub organization exists but has no public repositories. The company operates patient assistance and HCP portals as well as clinical trial information services that require authenticated access.

providers.name: SAS
providers.description: Scandinavian Airlines (SAS) is the largest airline in Scandinavia, operating a network of flights across Europe, North America, and Asia. Founded in 1946, SAS provides passenger and cargo services, loyalty programs, and a range of travel solutions. The airline is a member of the Star Alliance and focuses on sustainability, digital innovation, and customer experience.

providers.name: Smart Crowd
providers.description: SmartCrowd is MENA's first and biggest regulated real estate crowdfunding and investment platform, based in Dubai and licensed by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA). It lets retail investors pool capital to co-own income-generating Dubai properties from as little as AED 500, offering both long-term Hold properties (rental yield) and short-term Flip properties (renovation upside), plus a secondary Share Transfer Facility for liquidity. SmartCrowd operates a consumer web and mobile app experience with no public developer API surface documented at this time.

providers.name: SpotPay
providers.description: SpotPay is a global neobank that operates as a stablecoin-based global bank account, letting users hold, send, receive, and spend money anywhere in the world from a single identity-verified digital wallet without a traditional bank account. The service settles payments on blockchain rails using stablecoins and pairs the wallet with the SpotPay Calypso debit card plus Apple Pay and Google Pay support, and lets merchants accept QR-code payments with instant settlement. Founded by Zsika Phillip (CEO, ex-Google) and Thomas Cesare-Herriau (CTO, ex-Brex), SpotPay is a Y Combinator Winter 2026 company operating across 40+ countries and registered as a Money Services Business with FinCEN in the United States. As of this enrichment pass SpotPay is a consumer mobile-app product with no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface; api.spotpay.ai serves only the app's private backend.

providers.name: Springboard
providers.description: Springboard is an online education company offering mentor-led, career-focused bootcamps and courses in software engineering, data science, data analytics, UX/UI design, cybersecurity, and machine learning. Programs pair a structured, self-paced curriculum with 1:1 industry mentorship, career coaching, and a job guarantee on eligible tracks. Springboard was surfaced from a 500 Global portfolio list and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; it operates as a consumer/B2B learning platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, so this profile carries identity and security-posture signals rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Swile
providers.description: Swile is a French fintech that operates an all-in-one employee-benefits and engagement super-app built around a single Mastercard smartcard and mobile app. Founded in 2018 as Lunchr and rebranded Swile in 2020, it consolidates meal vouchers (titres-restaurant), gift and culture vouchers, mobility and work-from-home allowances, and team/recognition budgets that were historically spread across paper vouchers and multiple providers. The company merged with Bimpli in France, expanded into Brazil through Vee Benefícios, and is backed by investors including Index Ventures, SoftBank Vision Fund, and Bpifrance. Swile serves employers and their employees rather than external developers: as of this enrichment pass it publishes a security surface (RFC 9116 security.txt, a coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy, and a researcher hall of fame) but no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or API reference.

providers.name: Syscap
providers.description: Syscap is a Monterrey-based Mexican financial technology company that provides a private-credit and funding-management platform for non-bank financial intermediaries (SOFOMs and financieras). Its software helps loan originators manage funding lines, organize documentation, automate tax compliance, generate amortization tables and electronic signatures, and give funders a 24/7 transparency portal with balance reports and transaction tracking. More than 140 financial institutions across Mexico use Syscap to manage private debt. The company operates a web application and a mobile app; it does not publish a public API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Ten63 Therapeutics
providers.description: Ten63 Therapeutics is an AI-driven drug-discovery company spun out of Duke University in 2019 and operating from San Francisco, Durham and Boston. It builds BEYOND, which the company describes as the world's first Large Quantum Chemistry Model — pairing generative chemistry at scale (Move37) with a quantum-accurate forcefield and molecular-dynamics engine (Astrolabe) in an approach it calls Superlearning. BEYOND is used to design therapeutics for previously undruggable and under-drugged targets, with an internal pipeline focused on oncology and platform partnerships such as the multi-target collaboration with Boehringer Ingelheim. Ten63 is a therapeutics company, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract. It does publish an llms.txt describing the company and platform for AI agents.

providers.name: Tezbor
providers.description: Tezbor is a Tashkent, Uzbekistan based courier and last-mile logistics company that automates the delivery of documents, parcels, and cargo across Uzbekistan. Beyond its consumer and business courier service, Tezbor operates a technology platform that exposes delivery ordering and tracking through an integration API, ready-made e-commerce plugins (WooCommerce, OpenCart, Magento), mobile apps, dashboards, and Telegram bots, so that any online store can automatically generate a Tezbor delivery order from each purchase. The company is backed by 500 Global, Activat, and StartupBase, and counts brands such as Beeline, Ozon, and OQ among its delivery clients.

providers.name: Universal American
providers.description: Universal American was a health insurance holding company that focused on providing Medicare Advantage and Medicare prescription drug benefit plans to seniors. The company operated Medicare managed care plans in partnership with Accountable Care Organizations and primary care physicians before being acquired by WellCare Health Plans in 2017 for approximately $800 million.

providers.name: UPM YODA Open Data Portal
providers.description: UPM YODA Open Data Portal is a university open-data portal for Spain running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 201 datasets.

providers.name: Vendease
providers.description: Vendease is a Nigerian B2B food procurement platform (founded 2020, Y Combinator W21, backed by Partech Africa and TLcom) that helps restaurants, hotels, and other food businesses buy fresh and processed food supplies, offering Buy Now, Pay Later financing, supplier consolidation, cold-chain logistics, and 24-hour delivery in Lagos. Vendease publishes no public developer API or SDKs; its procurement, payments, inventory, and tenant management service APIs are internal-only, though its engineering handover documentation is publicly available on GitHub.

providers.name: vestiairecollective
providers.description: Vestiaire Collective is a global online marketplace for pre-owned luxury and designer fashion, founded in Paris in 2009. The platform lets members buy and sell authenticated second-hand clothing, bags, shoes, watches, and accessories, with in-house physical authentication and quality control on higher-value items and a mission centered on circular fashion and sustainable consumption. It operates a consumer marketplace across web and mobile apps in dozens of countries. It is backed by Balderton Capital among other investors. This API Evangelist profile was added as a VC-portfolio lead; enrichment probes found no public developer/API program, but did verify the company's published security disclosure surface and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Vestris
providers.description: Vestris is an AI-powered platform that automates the real estate pre-closing process for mortgage title and closing operations. It uses browser agents to log into county tax portals, extract property records, parse purchase contracts, run tax calculations, generate title abstracts, and produce title commitments and closing documents. Positioned as "the AI processing unit for mortgage title and closing," Vestris aims to replace manual title searchers and accelerate property deal closing. The company is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) startup based in San Francisco. As of this profile it operates a product application (waitlist / demo access) with no publicly documented developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or webhook surface.

providers.name: Viajanet
providers.description: Viajanet is a Brazilian online travel agency (OTA) operated within the Despegar group, selling flights, hotels, vacation packages, car rentals and travel insurance to consumers in Brazil through www.viajanet.com.br. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Redpoint Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. Viajanet publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; the enrichment pass captured its live security surface (a published security.txt with a Bugcrowd private bug bounty program run by the Despegar application-security team) and its domain-security posture.

providers.name: Yazaki
providers.description: Yazaki Corporation is a Japanese global Tier 1 automotive supplier headquartered in Tokyo. Yazaki is a leading manufacturer of automotive wiring harnesses, connectors, instrumentation, and electrical distribution systems for global automakers.

providers.name: Zudo
providers.description: Zudo builds AI-powered agents purpose-built for the warranty industry, automating customer service and back-office operations for home warranty, auto warranty, and OEM third-party administrators. Its agents (Adam for customer service, Emma for operations) handle claim follow-ups, initiations, and authorizations around the clock to improve warranty customer experience and operating margins. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; the public site is marketing-only with no developer/API surface published at enrichment time.

providers.name: Abaxx
providers.description: Abaxx Technologies is a financial software and market infrastructure company whose principal operating business, Abaxx Exchange, is a centrally-cleared commodity futures and derivatives exchange headquartered in Singapore and focused on energy-transition commodities across four markets: Energy (LNG), Environmental (carbon credits), Battery Materials (nickel, lithium), and Precious Metals. Abaxx Clearing (Abaxx Singapore Clearing Corporation) centrally clears the contracts, and the group also develops SMX (smart data / consensus-formation) technology. Trading runs on the markets.abaxx.exchange platform; market data is distributed to third parties including TradingView (ABAXX: symbol prefix), ipushpull (Microsoft Excel add-in) and LSEG/Refinitiv. Abaxx Technologies is publicly listed (Cboe Canada: ABXX; OTCQX: ABXXF). Abaxx does not currently publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI/FIX specification, SDKs or an MCP server; connectivity is arranged through member/broker onboarding. This profile originated as an earlybird portfolio lead in the API Evangelist network and has been enriched with verified public identity and security-posture signals.

providers.name: adresse.data.gouv.fr
providers.description: Address database of France, geocoding and reverse

providers.name: Alchemize
providers.description: Alchemize is an AI-enabled customs brokerage that automates import compliance workflows for importers. The Y Combinator (Spring 2026) company pairs licensed customs expertise with artificial intelligence to answer regulatory and tariff questions in minutes rather than days, reduce manual data-entry errors before shipments reach the port, and give importers a single view of every shipment, status, and communication via API, EDI, or web portal. Founded by Robert Hou (previously Confido, YC) and Samuel Fu (previously Netflix), Alchemize targets inefficiency in the $30B+ customs brokerage industry with an AI-native compliance and trade-operations platform.

providers.name: AltexSoft
providers.description: AltexSoft is a technology and solution consulting company that provides software development and IT consulting services to businesses across various industries. Specializing in travel and hospitality, healthcare, and finance sectors, AltexSoft helps companies design, build, and implement innovative technology solutions to improve operational efficiency, enhance customer experience, and drive business growth.

providers.description: Anime industry news

providers.description: Extract device details from user-agent string

providers.name: ApogeoAPI
providers.description: Bundled API for countries, states, cities, IP geolocation, and live exchange rates

providers.name: AQICN

providers.name: AssetWorks
providers.description: AssetWorks is an enterprise fleet and asset management software company with more than 40 years of history and over 1,000 customers across commercial and private fleets, government and public works, and higher education. Its products include FleetFocus fleet and enterprise asset management (EAM), Active Assets fixed-asset tracking, Recoup Ops surplus management, and Scan and Validate mobile inventory management. AssetWorks sells on-premise and hosted enterprise software to large fleet and facility operators; as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or self-serve API program. This repo is a company profile in the API Evangelist network, backed by Battery Ventures.

providers.name: Avistone
providers.description: Beijing Avistone Biotechnology Co., Ltd. is a commercial-stage innovative biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Beijing, China, focused on the research, development, and commercialization of first-in-class and best-in-class oncology therapies. Founded in 2012 (originally Beijing Pearl Biotechnology) and renamed Avistone in 2018, the company has two approved cancer drugs on the market: Vebreltinib (万比锐®), a MET inhibitor approved for non-small cell lung cancer and glioma indications and included in China's National Reimbursement Drug List, and Andamertinib (安比锐®), an EGFR exon 20 insertion inhibitor approved in 2026 for advanced NSCLC. Avistone maintains a pipeline of additional candidates (ANS01 through ANS09) across solid-tumor indications and is backed by IDG Capital. The company publishes no public developer API or programmatic surface; this profile captures its corporate and investor identity.

providers.name: Ayrshare
providers.description: Social media APIs to post, get analytics, and manage multiple users social media accounts

providers.name: AZ511
providers.description: Access traffic data from the ADOT API

providers.name: Bank of Russia
providers.description: Exchange rates and currency conversion

providers.name: BAYCON
providers.description: BAYCON Inc. is a Seoul, South Korea-based mobile connectivity company, founded in 2018 and backed by 500 Global and Shorooq Partners (seed round, 2024). BAYCON operates a global data eSIM platform and a family of international communication apps: eSIM Easy (이심이지), which delivers multi-country data eSIM plans as a QR code within minutes of purchase; ModuCall (모두의 국제전화), affordable VoIP international calling that lets users place overseas calls using their domestic mobile plans; and BayTalk. The company partners with local network operators and global carrier infrastructure so international travelers and businesses can access local mobile networks without physical SIM cards, cut roaming costs, and stay connected across borders, and is expanding into travel content such as attraction tickets and transportation passes. BAYCON publishes consumer mobile apps rather than a public developer API surface.

providers.name: BioConsortia
providers.description: BioConsortia, Inc. is an agricultural biotechnology company headquartered in Davis, California, with additional laboratories in New Zealand, that discovers and commercializes microbial biologicals for row crops and specialty agriculture. Its patented Advanced Microbial Selection (AMS) process, RhizoViz microbe-visualization tool and GenePro genomics and gene-engineering platform are used to screen a collection of more than 60,000 characterized microorganisms — including roughly 9,000 endophytes — into nitrogen-fixation biofertilizers, biocontrol products (bionematicides and biofungicides) and biostimulants, largely delivered as seed treatments. Evri sits at the last-mile end of the supply chain — the carrier a shipper, retailer or e-commerce platform hands a parcel to for final delivery in the UK. Its API posture is customer-contract portal only: Evri publishes no developer portal, no public API reference and no machine-readable specification. The host api.evri.com resolves to a live Tyk API Gateway (5.13.0) whose only publicly reachable path is an unauthenticated health check; every other probed path returns 404 and no listen path is discoverable without credentials. Shipment, label, ParcelShop, Print in Store and tracking credentials are issued by an Evri account manager or sales representative to contracted Corporate or Business accounts, with sandbox and production credentials handed over by email. In practice most integrators reach Evri indirectly through shipping-API aggregators such as EasyPost, ShipEngine / ShipStation, Sendcloud, AfterShip and Intersoft Sapient rather than directly.
