providers.name: Valinor
providers.description: Valinor Enterprises is a defense and government technology operational holding company — a "company of companies" that builds and buys mission-critical technologies to fill the gaps others ignore. It centralizes go-to-market, compliance, security, and operations while decentralizing engineering across lean Product Companies including Condor (attritable aerial systems), Dispatch (drone charging infrastructure, selected by DIU for the CADDS program), Harbor (expeditionary medical systems for the Marine Corps), Reflex (smart optics with onboard vision models), and Streamline (AI-enabled data collection with structured ontology write-back). Backed by General Catalyst; raised a $54M Series A led by Friends & Family Capital. Valinor publishes no public API or developer portal; its developer footprint is a GitHub organization and the @valinor-enterprises npm scope.

providers.name: VerdaFresh
providers.description: VerdaFresh is a Wayne, Pennsylvania materials-science company that develops water-based, saran-free oxygen barrier coatings for recyclable flexible food packaging. Its High Oxygen Barrier and Ultra High Barrier coatings are applied to BOPP, HD-BOPE, MDO-PE and PET film substrates to extend shelf life while keeping the finished package mono-material and recyclable, replacing PVdC and metallized structures. The company sells coatings and coated films to converters and CPG brands, is APR-recognized and a member of the U.S. Plastics Pact, and publishes technical datasheets rather than software. It is a physical-products manufacturer with no developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable interface of any kind.

providers.name: Xscape Photonics
providers.description: Xscape Photonics is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of addition and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: ai-infrastructure. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Yipitdata
providers.description: YipitData is a market-intelligence and alternative-data company that delivers daily insights on consumer behavior, market share, pricing, and company performance to the world's largest hedge funds, investors, brands, and retailers. Its Proprietary Data Network combines owned-and-operated B2C and B2B panels with 40+ always-on sources (consumer receipts, card transactions, B2B and cloud spend, web-scraped signals), analyzed on a Databricks/Delta Lake lakehouse and delivered through data-sharing, hosted apps, and its AI-powered Insight Agent rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: 83 Sciences
providers.description: 83 Sciences is an AI-native materials-discovery company (Y Combinator Summer 2026) that helps research labs unlock value from unpublished and discarded experimental data. Roughly 90% of experimental data never reaches publication; 83 Sciences works on-site with researchers to capture and structure that hidden data into a queryable database, then applies AI-powered analysis and generative models to learn from a lab's full experimental history — including failed experiments — to surface novel materials, co-authored manuscripts, and patents. Founded by researchers from MIT, Stanford, Harvard, and Columbia and based in San Francisco. The company currently ships no public API or developer surface; this profile tracks its identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Acchromtech
providers.description: Acchromtech (Acchrom Tech, legally Huapu Instrument (Beijing) Technology Co., Ltd.) is a Beijing-based analytical-instrument company founded in 2015 that develops, manufactures and services high-end chromatographic separation products: high-performance and ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography systems, triple-quadrupole LC-MS/MS, preparative and online-SPE instruments, and Alphasil / StarCore / SelectPrep / Marsil chromatographic columns and consumables. It also ships Chromloong, a self-developed chromatography data system (CDS) for chromatographic information management with distributed storage, network deployment and full-link audit. Its products are used in pharmaceutical, food-safety, environmental, disease-control, clinical-testing, inspection-and-quarantine, petrochemical and academic laboratories. It publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract; Chromloong is distributed as an end-user laboratory product.

providers.name: Aero
providers.description: Aero Technologies, Inc. is a Van Nuys, California semi-private airline founded in 2019 by Uber co-founder Garrett Camp, selling individual seats on scheduled flights and on-demand charters operated exclusively from private terminals. Its fleet comprises Embraer ERJ135 and Legacy 600 jets plus Gulfstream IV-SP aircraft, flying Los Angeles to New York City, Aspen, Sun Valley, Napa Valley, Los Cabos, Las Vegas, Maui, Miami, Heber and Greater Palm Springs. Aero distributes through aero.com, its mobile app, a travel-advisor channel, and Sabre GDS under airline designator 5E with plating carrier 307. It is a consumer travel brand: no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, webhook surface or machine-readable specification is published.

providers.name: Alinea Health
providers.description: Alinea Health is an AI-powered clinical trial recruitment intelligence platform that analyzes global trial registry data (ClinicalTrials.gov, ISRCTN, EU CTR) alongside patient availability to detect enrollment risk before it causes delays and to match eligible patients to appropriate studies for sponsors, CROs, sites, and healthcare providers. The platform surfaces at-risk trials, benchmarks sites, and visualizes enrollment pipelines, positioning delay prevention as protecting $1.1M-$1.7M per month in trial spend. The company advertises enterprise-grade RESTful APIs and custom data pipelines with end-to-end encryption and SOC 2 compliance, but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable specification; access is gated behind a partner platform and an early-access program. Backed by General Catalyst, with offices in Toronto and Barcelona.

providers.name: Angie’s List
providers.description: Angie’s List is a consumer marketplace for finding, reviewing, and hiring local home-service professionals — plumbers, electricians, roofers, landscapers, house cleaners, and hundreds of other trades. Founded in 1995 by Angie Hicks and William Oesterle, it pioneered member-submitted, verified reviews and letter-grade ratings of service providers across U.S. metro markets. In 2017 Angie’s List merged with HomeAdvisor to form ANGI Homeservices (now Angi Inc., NASDAQ: ANGI, part of IAC), and in 2021 the consumer brand and website were rebranded from angieslist.com to angi.com. Angi is a consumer/pro home-services platform and does not currently publish a public developer API program; this API Evangelist profile tracks its public web and security surface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures.

providers.name: Auditocity
providers.description: Auditocity is an HR compliance software platform that helps organizations of any size master regulatory requirements and best practices. It maintains a library of more than 14,000 questions spanning federal, state, and industry-specific HR compliance, automatically generating custom-built audits tailored to an organization's industry, size, and location. The platform produces actionable findings reports that identify compliance gaps, tracks requirements across all 50 states, and delivers real-time regulatory updates through an HR technology partner network. Auditocity is a Techstars portfolio company. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification has been published at this time; this profile captures its identity and public web surface in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Autoliv
providers.description: Autoliv is the world's largest automotive safety supplier, designing, manufacturing, and selling airbags, seatbelts, steering wheels, inflators, pyrotechnic actuators, and related safety electronics for vehicle manufacturers worldwide. The company operates in 25 countries with 13 technology centers and serves all major OEMs.

providers.name: BlaBlaCar
providers.description: Search car sharing trips

providers.name: BlockFills
providers.description: BlockFills provides crypto trading solutions and financial technology services, offering liquidity solutions, OTC trading, crypto options, SaaS platforms, FIX API, REST API and more. The company focuses on end‑to‑end digital asset technology for institutional and retail clients, delivering bespoke trading infrastructure and market access.

providers.name: Chronicle Labs
providers.description: Chronicle Labs is a Y Combinator-backed (Spring 2026) company building infrastructure for teams running AI agents in production. The platform turns production data into staging environments: it reconstructs real end-to-end workflows from production data streams, generates test scenarios from those workflows, runs agents against replicated production environments (its Backtest Arena), and monitors live agents with autonomous fix and rollback. The pitch is to help engineering teams prove their AI agents work before they ship, replacing hand-built evals and "vibe-deploying" with backtesting against a team's actual operational reality. Typical customers run AI agents in customer service, payments, refunds, and other high-stakes workflows, and Chronicle Labs reports integrating with 100+ production tools. Founded in San Francisco by Ayman Saleh (CEO) and Rowan Zyadeh. At profiling time the product is accessed via a hosted web application behind sign-up; there is no public API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK, and the company publishes an llms.txt at its primary host.

providers.name: Clearbos (clearorthod)
providers.description: Clearbos (clearorthod / 可丽尔博士) is a Chinese clear-aligner orthodontics company that designs and manufactures invisible teeth-alignment systems for adults and children, delivered through a network of partner dental clinics and orthodontists. Its digital treatment platform pairs the C4 adult-correction system with the C3 pediatric full-cycle system, and is supported by a doctor-facing web portal for case submission, treatment planning, and aligner ordering. The company reports more than 11,900 registered doctors and 9,200 partner clinics across 321 cities. Clearbos was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners; no public developer API, OpenAPI, or /.well-known discovery surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Codi
providers.description: Codi is a managed flexible office-space provider (office-as-a-service) operating in San Francisco and New York City. Codi delivers fully-managed private offices for teams, bundling furniture, cleaning and restocking, tech and network management, vendor coordination, room booking, and an AI office assistant into a single turnkey monthly subscription — positioned as an alternative to traditional commercial leases, coworking, and short-term space marketplaces such as Regus, Breather, and Peerspace. Codi was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio company; as of this profile it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation — its digital surface is a members' web app and a hosted help center.

providers.name: Concentro
providers.description: Concentro makes tax credit transactions seamless and accessible for developers and corporate buyers, handling diligence, insurance, and transaction management. It offers a platform to buy, sell, and manage tax credit assets with an API-driven approach.

providers.name: Culturehero
providers.description: Transform workplace culture with Culture Hero's expert solutions. We specialise in workplace culture improvement, team collaboration, employee engagement strategies, and leadership development. Our tailored workshops, executive coaching, and research-backed programs drive productivity, employee retention, and organizational success.

providers.name: data.gov.mt (Open Data Malta)
providers.description: data.gov.mt is the national government open-data portal for Malta, operated by MITA (Malta Information Technology Agency) as a bespoke "Shared Data Governance and Data Management Platform" with a JavaScript single-page-app front end (served at portal.data.gov.mt / open.data.gov.mt). It is DCAT-AP-compliant for EU harvesting (~230+ datasets) but exposes no publicly documented JSON catalog API. Malta's geospatial APIs are available separately via the MSDI geoportal.

providers.name: Deep Rooted
providers.description: Deep Rooted.Co is a direct-to-consumer fresh produce brand operated by Clover Ventures Pvt. Ltd, a Bengaluru-based agritech company founded in 2018 that launched the Deep Rooted consumer brand in 2020. The company works with a network of small-scale farmers using greenhouse and hydroponic techniques within roughly 150km of Bengaluru and Hyderabad, providing agronomy support from seed to harvest and delivering fruits, vegetables, Indian staples and greens, exotic produce and an easy-cook range direct to households the morning after ordering. Deep Rooted is backed by Accel. It sells through a consumer web storefront and mobile apps; it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification, so this profile captures company identity and web properties only.

providers.name: Epic! Creations
providers.description: Epic! Creations, Inc. operates Epic, an award-winning digital reading and learning platform for children twelve and under. The service gives families and educators unlimited access to a library of more than 40,000 books, audiobooks, and learning videos, with reading-level personalization, quizzes, and progress tracking. Epic offers a consumer family subscription and Epic School, a version that is free for teachers and students during the school day via class codes. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. Epic is a business-to-consumer application and does not publish a public developer program, API, or SDK surface.

providers.description: Translate Text into funny languages

providers.name: gameSense Sports
providers.description: gameSense Sports is a Denver, Colorado sports-technology company that builds interactive, HD video-based cognitive training tools for baseball and softball. Its core Skill Recognition Training (SRT) uses the scientifically validated method of visual occlusion to measure and teach pitch recognition, reaction time, and decision-making so athletes learn to "see" plays before they happen. The platform packages this as SRT, Mini SRT, the Hitter IQ Challenge, and Skills Camps, and serves individual athletes, coaches, parents, teams, tournament organizations, and training facilities. gameSense sells subscriptions directly to athletes (B2C) and partners with college programs, professional organizations, and youth-sports groups (B2B). The company was selected for the inaugural Techstars SportsTech Melbourne accelerator. Its web application is built on the base44 platform. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched by the pipeline; it does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: GodHands
providers.description: GodHands is a Y Combinator-backed startup (2026, San Francisco) building deterministic computer-use infrastructure for AI agents. It provides a high-fidelity execution layer that acts as a translation interface between any model or agent runtime and the operating system, letting agents reliably operate across desktop and browser applications - including legacy software and API-less systems, on the premise that "if a human can see it, GodHands can interact with it." Instead of fragile, probabilistic vision-based UI automation, every action is designed to be repeatable and predictable, removing hallucination risk from the execution layer, and every action is captured in comprehensive, immutable audit logs for debugging, accountability, and regulatory compliance. The platform is organized around a Control Plane plus Iceberg and Vector surfaces, and is built as the execution engine for any LLM or agent framework. Positioned for regulated teams, claims-approval workflows, and moving records from legacy terminals into browser-based systems.

providers.name: HD Supply Holdings
providers.description: HD Supply is one of the largest industrial distributors in North America, providing maintenance, repair, and operations products and value-added services to multifamily, hospitality, healthcare, and government facilities. HD Supply operates as a wholly owned subsidiary of The Home Depot following its acquisition in 2020.

providers.name: ICA Gruppen
providers.description: ICA Gruppen is a leading Swedish retail and service conglomerate operating supermarkets, pharmacies, banks, and real estate. It focuses on sustainable growth, digital innovation, and customer convenience across Scandinavia, offering a wide range of products and services while emphasizing environmental responsibility and community engagement.

providers.name: Inera
providers.description: Inera is a Swedish digitalization company that works on behalf of municipalities and regions to develop and maintain digital services for the welfare sector. It provides platforms such as 1177 Vårdguiden, NLL (National Patient Overview), and various digital portals for citizens, healthcare professionals, and public administrations. Inera focuses on secure, interoperable, and user‑centric solutions that enable access to health information, appointment booking, and other public services through modern web and mobile applications.

providers.name: innRoad
providers.description: innRoad is a cloud-based hotel property management system (PMS) that bundles PMS, a direct booking engine, and a channel manager (OTA distribution to Expedia, Booking.com, Airbnb, and others) into one platform, built for independent hotels, boutique properties, and small hotel management companies. innRoad also offers 40+ pre-built partner connections - point-of-sale (Lightspeed, Oracle Hospitality, Squirrel, Positouch, Uniwell), door locks (RemoteLock, Saflok, ONITY), guest messaging (Akia), accounting (M3, Inn-Flow), and in-house payment processing (innRoad Payments) - that are toggled on inside the application. innRoad does NOT publish a public, self-service developer API. There is no developer portal, no public API reference, no OpenAPI definition, and no documented WebSocket or webhook API as of this cataloging; every listed integration is a pre-built, partner-gated connection rather than an open surface a third-party developer can register for and call.

providers.name: Kinnevik
providers.description: Kinnevik is a Swedish investment company that builds, invests in and scales digital consumer businesses. It focuses on long‑term growth across sectors such as e‑commerce, fintech, health, and media, supporting portfolio companies with capital, expertise, and strategic guidance. The firm operates globally, managing a diversified portfolio of high‑growth ventures and public listings, and is known for its active involvement in shaping innovative business models.

providers.name: Lego
providers.description: The LEGO Group is a Danish toy company and the world's largest manufacturer of interlocking plastic building bricks. The company extends its brand across video games, theme parks, movies, educational products, and licensed sets for children and adults. LEGO does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; consumer-facing systems and partner integrations are closed. A public GitHub organization hosts internal engineering tooling and open-source contributions.

providers.name: MailboxValidator
providers.description: Validate email address to improve deliverability

providers.name: Monell Chemical Senses Center
providers.description: The Monell Chemical Senses Center is "the world's only independent, non-profit scientific institute dedicated to interdisciplinary basic research on the senses of taste and smell." Founded in 1968 and headquartered in Philadelphia, Monell conducts chemosensory research organized around three strategic themes: Healthy Senses and Happy Lives, Senses for a Thriving Planet, and Nourishing Our Future. The center runs postdoctoral training, the Dr. Charis Eng Monell Science Apprenticeship Program, the Monell Science Entrepreneurship Program, an Academic Partnership Program, and the Monell Insiders corporate partnership program. Monell does not publish a public developer API surface; its "product" is knowledge disseminated through scholarly publications and conferences.

providers.name: Niyo Solutions
providers.description: Niyo Solutions (brand: Niyo, goniyo.com) is a Bengaluru, India based consumer fintech founded in 2015 by Vinay Bagri and Virender Bisht, focused on international travel banking and savings for Indian retail customers. Niyo is not a chartered bank; it operates as a neo-banking front end layered on partner RBI-licensed banks — DCB Bank (current flagship for the Niyo zero-forex savings + debit card), SBM Bank India (previous "Niyo Global" forex card, now wound down for new customers and operating a secured credit card variant), Equitas Small Finance Bank (salary / "Niyo Bharat" account) and IDFC FIRST Bank (earlier Niyo Global issuer) — plus card network rails (Visa, RuPay). Niyo's flagship surface is the "zero forex markup" Niyo Global / DCB Niyo Global / SBM Niyo Global Visa debit and prepaid travel cards accepted in 180+ countries, paired with a digital savings account delivered through partner banks. The company has expanded beyond cards into a full travel-banking stack including currency exchange and forex cash delivery, outbound remittance (Send Money Abroad), international flights, hotels and curated experiences, Niyo Express airport services, an international travel eSIM, travel visa assistance, travel insurance, a premium subscription tier, a student program (Niyo Scholarship, NISAP) and a DCB Niyo Secured Credit Card backed by a fixed deposit. Niyo serves over one million international travellers and has raised capital from investors including Accel, Lightrock, Beams Fintech Fund, Tencent, Horizons Ventures, Prime Venture Partners and JS Capital. There is no public REST developer API, partner banking-as-a-service surface, SDK, MCP server, or GitHub organisation — Niyo is delivered exclusively as a B2C iOS and Android mobile application with a marketing and tools website at goniyo.com.

providers.name: NuStar Energy
providers.description: NuStar Energy was one of the largest independent liquids terminal and pipeline operators in the United States, transporting and storing crude oil, refined products, and renewable fuels. Sunoco LP completed its acquisition of NuStar on 3 May 2024, and nustarenergy.com now redirects to sunocolp.com. NuStar published no public APIs or developer resources.

providers.name: Omate
providers.description: Omate designs and manufactures Wearable-as-a-Service (WaaS) safety solutions built around cellular-connected smartwatches for people who need protection — seniors, children, and lone workers. Its devices (such as the O6L Pro line, marketed under the Omahome brand) combine GPS location tracking, SOS calling, fall detection, and two-way voice into a managed hardware-plus-service offering sold direct to consumers and through partners. Omate is a hardware and connected-device company; as of this profile it exposes no public developer program, API, or SDK. This entry was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio lead and enriched with an identity and domain-security pass.

providers.name: Orchestra
providers.description: Orchestra is an agentic operations platform for drug development and life sciences R&D organizations. The software helps biotech and pharmaceutical teams unify planning, automate operations, and reduce the risks that derail breakthrough science by creating centralized roadmaps across leadership, programs, and scientific groups, applying AI agents to operational automation, and delivering data-driven decision support across scenarios, planning, and CRO management. Orchestra is a portfolio company of 8vc and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile. As of this enrichment pass the company operates a marketing and product site only and publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal.

providers.name: Papa John's International
providers.description: Papa John's International, Inc. is a major US-based quick-service pizza restaurant chain and Fortune 1000 company operating company-owned and franchised locations worldwide. Papa John's runs consumer-facing online ordering, a Papa Rewards loyalty program, and mobile apps, and integrates with third-party delivery aggregators and restaurant-technology platforms. Papa John's does NOT publish a public developer API or developer portal; its technology surface is internal, franchise-facing, and partner-only. Integrations are arranged through enterprise and franchise partner agreements.

providers.name: paralelo.bo
providers.description: Bolivia parallel-market USD/BOB exchange rate, aggregated from P2P sources every 60s

providers.name: Pattern Ag
providers.description: Pattern Ag was a predictive-agronomy company founded in 2018 and headquartered in Emeryville, California, that applied DNA sequencing and soil metagenomics to forecast agronomic outcomes twelve months ahead of a growing season. Its Complete Bio and Pattern 360 products profiled the soil microbiome to predict pest, pathogen and nutrient-deficiency pressure, informing crop-protection, seed-selection and fertility decisions for corn and soybean growers, and in 2023 the company announced what it described as the world's largest single-ecosystem metagenomics database. In August 2024 Pattern Ag merged with soil-sensing company EarthOptics; the combined business operates under the EarthOptics name and the Pattern Ag brand has been retired. As of this profile the pattern.ag website issues an HTTP 301 to www.earthoptics.com, every Pattern Ag deep link returns 404, and the Pattern Ag LinkedIn page redirects to an EarthOptics company page. Pattern Ag never published a public developer program, API documentation, SDKs or a machine-readable API contract under its own brand, and no Pattern Ag API surface survives. The successor company's private REST API is profiled separately at all/earth-optics.

providers.name: Pawfinity
providers.description: Pawfinity is pet service business management software for grooming salons, mobile groomers, kennels, dog daycares, pet sitting, training, and pet therapy businesses - handling online booking, client and pet records, scheduling, point of sale, and staff management. Pawfinity does not publish a public or partner developer API or developer portal. The product is a closed, single-tenant SaaS web application; the only outbound data integration is a built-in, one-way nightly QuickBooks Online sync bundled with the subscription, not a documented API a third party can call.

providers.name: Poultry sync
providers.description: PoultrySync is an AI-powered data management platform for the poultry value chain, helping producers increase productivity and reduce errors across broilers, breeders, hatchery, layers, slaughterhouse, feedmill, grandparents, lab, and quality management. The platform automates data collection, provides real-time dashboards, detects anomalies, forecasts production, and supports compliance reporting and audits, integrating with existing ERP systems in days. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. No public API, SDK, or developer documentation is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Purpose Green
providers.description: Purpose Green is a Berlin-based sustainability consulting firm and 360-degree provider for sustainable real estate development, serving property owners and investors who manage multi-unit residential and commercial buildings. The company combines energy auditing (its Energy Light Report tool), ESG reporting, subsidy and grant consultation, renovation project management, and a web-based portfolio management portal (Green+ Portal) to help reduce a building's final energy demand by up to 80%. It is backed by Speedinvest and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; the company publishes web tools and a customer portal but no public developer API or documentation at this time.

providers.name: Quantum
providers.description: Quantum is a Saudi Arabian advertising-technology (adtech) enabler that bridges online publishers and advertisers with data and technology. Its Quantum One omnichannel platform connects online and offline retail experiences across programmatic ads, in-app media buying, e-sampling, on-ground activations, influencer marketing, and out-of-home media, with goal-attainment tracking, ROI measurement, customer-engagement analytics, and conversion-rate analysis. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal; the Quantum One tenant application does carry an API-key management screen, so the platform issues keys to signed-in customers, but no contract, reference, or machine-readable spec is published anywhere.

providers.name: Rollup AI
providers.description: Rollup is a browser-based, real-time collaboration platform for engineering teams building complex hardware. It supports the full hardware development lifecycle across modular tools for systems engineering, systems modeling, requirements management, technical documentation, CAD viewing, and design reviews, with modules that interlink so changes propagate across a project. Rollup markets first-class APIs and developer-friendly features so teams can integrate it into new and existing systems; the platform exposes a REST API (authenticated with API keys or OAuth tokens) with pagination and websockets. Rollup serves early-stage hardware companies from small satellite builders to robotics firms, and offers Self-hosted and GovCloud options for ITAR/EAR export-controlled data. The company is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Thiel Capital ($5.6M seed) and was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio company.

providers.name: Samtrafiken
providers.description: Samtrafiken i Sverige AB is a Swedish public transport collaboration platform that aggregates and distributes timetable, ticketing and service data from multiple operators. It provides open traffic data through its Trafiklab portal, enabling developers and innovators to build applications that improve sustainable travel. The organization also offers services like Resplus for combined travel solutions and supports operators with data management tools. Recent initiatives include the ARTUR project for automated schedule updates, reflecting its commitment to modernizing transport information.

providers.name: ServiceNow Flow Designer
providers.description: ServiceNow Flow Designer is an enterprise workflow automation tool for building automated processes within the ServiceNow platform.

providers.name: Shennon Biotechnologies
providers.description: Shennon Biotechnologies is a San Francisco based biotechnology company accelerating drug development by screening millions of single cell-cell interactions to identify novel therapeutic agents for cancer and autoimmune disease. Its proprietary TCELERATOR platform combines ultrafast single cell-cell interaction mapping with proprietary AI models to discover new targets and develop more effective medicines. The company is backed by DCVC and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes a corporate marketing site but no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Skyscanner
providers.description: Skyscanner is an Edinburgh, Scotland–headquartered global travel marketplace that helps travellers compare flights, hotels, and car hire across hundreds of airlines, hotel providers, and online travel agents. Founded in 2003 and acquired by Trip.com Group (formerly Ctrip) in 2016, Skyscanner operates the consumer site skyscanner.net and a B2B partner programme that powers travel search experiences for third-party publishers and apps. The Skyscanner Travel APIs — Flights Live Prices, Flights Indicative Prices, Hotels Live Prices, Hotels Indicative Prices, Hotels Content, Hotels Reviews, Car Hire Live Prices, Car Hire Indicative Prices, Car Hire Agents, plus utility services for Culture, Geo, Autosuggest, and Carriers — are gated behind a partner application process and exposed only to approved partners with significant audience scale; full API documentation, base URLs, and OpenAPI specifications are published inside the partner portal rather than on the public developer site. Alongside the Travel APIs, Skyscanner runs an Affiliate Programme (commission on referred bookings) and a Distribution Network connecting airlines, hotel providers, car-hire suppliers, and OTAs to its 160M+ monthly users. Its public GitHub organisation is best known for the Backpack design system and for open-source infrastructure tooling such as cfripper and turbolift, rather than for SDKs against the Travel APIs.

providers.name: SoLo Funds
providers.description: SoLo Funds is a Techstars-backed, Los Angeles fintech that operates a community-driven peer-to-peer lending marketplace delivered as a consumer mobile app for iOS and Android. Members request small, short-term loans that other members choose to fund, with borrowers offering an optional tip and donation rather than mandated interest, positioning the platform as a member-to-member alternative to payday and overdraft borrowing. SoLo Funds is a consumer financial-services product and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its only publicly reachable operational surface is a hosted status page.

providers.name: SupplyHog
providers.description: SupplyHog is an ecommerce platform built specifically for hardware and building-materials retailers, giving independent hardware and building-supply stores a branded online storefront to sell their products. The platform provides co-op and custom product catalogs, flexible fulfillment (in-store pickup, ship-to-store, local delivery, and ship-to-home with Shippo shipping labels), Stripe-powered payments, TaxJar tax calculation, real-time ERP inventory and pricing synchronization, custom branding and domains, location-aware search, and admin tools for order fulfillment and abandoned-cart recovery. Founded in 2010 as the Nopone.com reverse-auction marketplace, SupplyHog went through the DreamIt and 500 Startups accelerators, pivoted to full ecommerce services, and was acquired by construction-supply retailer R.P. Lumber in 2016. It does not publish a public developer API surface; it acts as a consumer of Stripe, TaxJar, and Shippo.

providers.name: Sveriges Radio
providers.description: Sveriges Radio is Sweden’s national publicly funded radio broadcasting organization, providing news, music, culture and educational programming across multiple channels and digital platforms. It operates several national and regional stations, offers podcasts, live streaming, and a comprehensive news service. The organization also provides open data and APIs for program schedules, news feeds, and media assets, supporting developers and researchers in accessing public broadcasting content.

providers.name: TE Connectivity
providers.description: TE Connectivity is a global manufacturer of connectors and sensors headquartered in Galway, Ireland with operational headquarters in Berwyn, Pennsylvania. TE provides electrical connectivity and sensor solutions for transportation, industrial, and communications markets, with strong automotive Tier 1 supply relationships.

providers.name: TRW Automotive Holdings
providers.description: TRW Automotive Holdings was one of the world's largest automotive parts suppliers, specializing in active and passive safety systems including braking systems, steering systems, suspension systems, seat belts, airbags, and advanced driver assistance systems. TRW Automotive was acquired by ZF Friedrichshafen AG in 2015 and is now part of ZF Group, operating as ZF TRW. The company's automotive safety technologies are integrated across major global OEMs. TRW no longer operates an independent developer API program; developer and partner integrations are handled through ZF Group's partner ecosystem.

providers.name: Whatnot
providers.description: Whatnot is a live-stream commerce marketplace focused on collectibles and resale categories. Whatnot offers limited public APIs for sellers/streamers and approved partners; integration is largely managed through the Whatnot Seller App and partner program rather than a self-serve developer portal.

providers.name: 4DBIM
providers.description: 4DBIM is the product brand of Beijing Yunjianxin Technology Co., Ltd. (北京云建信科技有限公司), a Beijing construction-technology company founded in 2015 that commercializes Tsinghua University 4D-BIM and BIM-FM research as a full-lifecycle Building Information Modeling platform for infrastructure. Its 4DBIM Cloud data centre combines a lightweight BIM+GIS graphics engine, multi-source model fusion and IoT ingestion on a microservice architecture, packaged as Power4D (construction management), Wonder4D (operations and maintenance), Skill4D (3D work instructions) and Smart4D (smart precast beam yards), plus a BIM consulting practice. It targets municipal and "national lifeline" infrastructure — metro, bridge, highway, tunnel and utility corridors — and has raised about USD 13.7M through a Series B. The 4DBIM Cloud page markets an "API开放平台" (API open platform), but 4DBIM publishes no developer portal, API reference or machine-readable contract, and www.4dbim.ren is an HTTP-only marketing site.

providers.name: Aijieboya
providers.description: Suzhou Aijie Boya Technology Co., Ltd. (苏州艾捷博雅科技有限公司), trading internationally as Agilebio, is a Suzhou Industrial Park manufacturer of chromatography separation and purification technology founded in 2020 by Dr. Wang Qunjie. It develops high-purity spherical silica gel chromatographic media, magnetic solid-phase extraction (mSPE) consumables and precision fluid automation instruments — the AutoY32 automated sample pretreatment system, the SmartPurifier preparative MPLC series and the Bonnasil filler lines — for biopharmaceutical manufacturing, clinical mass spectrometry, peptide and nucleic-acid drug purification and food testing laboratories. It runs the Agilebio and Biosepur brands and an "Industrial Chromatography 4.0" platform. An instrument and consumables maker: it publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Amblea
providers.description: Amblea is a French mission-driven ("entreprise à mission") healthcare-logistics platform that centralizes and optimizes patient (medical / sanitary) transport across the French health system. Formed in 2023 from the merger of Ambler (founded 2018) and Sanilea (2013), it operates a marketplace connecting healthcare establishments (hospitals, clinics, EHPADs, day-care centers) with licensed transport providers (ambulance companies and medical taxi services). The platform handles centralized booking and digital prescription management, shared-transport optimization (grouping patients per trip), real-time tracking, budget and contract management, and automated billing between facilities and transporters. Amblea reports 800+ healthcare establishments, 6,300 transport partner companies, and roughly 8,000 daily trips, making it one of France's largest healthcare-transport coordination platforms. It exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs; access is via its web application and direct business arrangements.

The company provides clinical trial data, publications, and resources for physicians and patients, aiming to extend lifespan and enhance health outcomes for those with heart failure.

Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Yongin-si, the firm serves both domestic and international pharmaceutical manufacturers and platform operators, aiming to drive digital transformation in the medical industry.

providers.name: Brattea

Founded in 2013, it develops transvascular nerve ablation platforms and expands into chronic disease areas such as diabetes, COPD, and heart failure. The company operates globally with a vision to advance intelligent, automation‑driven medical devices.

providers.name: Bunkerhill Health

The company also develops FDA-cleared imaging algorithms, such as opportunistic bone-mineral-density screening on routine abdominal CT. Backed by Felicis, Bunkerhill Health raised $55M to put AI agents to work inside hospitals. providers.name: California Catalysts
providers.description: California Catalysts develops advanced materials and stack components for electrolyzers, offering non‑iridium catalysts that lower the levelized cost of hydrogen. It partners with leading manufacturers and provides testing‑as‑a‑service, aiming to make green hydrogen more affordable and scalable.

The company operates out of Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, and focuses on research, development, and commercial deployment of carbon removal solutions.

providers.description: Cyberwrite is an AI-powered cyber insurance intelligence platform that turns raw data into explainable, defensible financial decisions for the cyber insurance lifecycle. Founded in 2016 and operating from Tel Aviv and New York, its platform combines the 4SEEN AI risk-profiling algorithm with Vivaldi cyber insurance orchestration to deliver real-time cyber risk analytics, cyber risk quantification, third-party risk management, and cyber catastrophe (accumulation) modeling. Users enter a company name, URL, industry, and country and receive a one-page cyber risk report in under a minute, with coverage spanning the vast majority of businesses globally in multiple languages. Cyberwrite delivers its data to insurers, reinsurers, brokers, MGAs, corporates, ILS investors, and private equity firms in real time through the Cyberwrite API for underwriting automation and aggregated portfolio risk management. Partners include Markel, Howden, HSB, Mastercard Start Path, and Navacord. Added to the API Evangelist network via the speedinvest portfolio and enriched here from Cyberwrite's public web surface.

providers.description: Lexius is a Y Combinator-backed AI loss-prevention platform that turns a retailer's existing security cameras into proactive, revenue-protecting systems. It detects shoplifting in real time (concealment, product sweeping, known-offender entry), sends instant mobile alerts with video clips, and offers traceback search — natural-language search across every connected camera feed. Lexius also builds case files for law enforcement, flags known offenders chain-wide, and detects slip-and-fall events for liability protection. It connects to existing NVR/VMS systems from any brand, including Hikvision, Axis, Dahua, Hanwha, Bosch, Honeywell, Uniview, Lorex, LTS, Avigilon, and Genetec, and is typically deployed remotely in under 24 hours without replacing hardware. MoveitPro advertises "Open API & Custom Integrations" and ships native integrations (QuickBooks, Twilio, Mailchimp, Google Maps/Calendar), but does not publish a self-serve public developer API, reference documentation, or OpenAPI. providers.name: MSC Mediterranean Shipping Company
providers.description: MSC (Mediterranean Shipping Company) is a privately-held, family-owned global container shipping and logistics group headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, founded in 1970 by Gianluigi Aponte and now led by CEO Soren Toft under the Aponte-Diamant family. MSC is the world's largest container shipping line by fleet size and capacity, operating roughly 900 cargo vessels with a combined intake of about 7 million TEU and controlling more than a fifth of global container capacity as of late 2025. The carrier offers a portfolio of digital shipment-management products through its myMSC e-business platform — including Instant Quote for online rate generation, online booking, electronic Bill of Lading and Sea Waybill issuance via eDocs, container Track & Trace, and the myMSC mobile app — and exposes a Direct Integrations program for shippers, freight forwarders, and NVOCCs that combines REST APIs and EDI message exchange. The MSC Developer Portal (developerportal.msc.com), hosted on Microsoft Azure API Management, publishes documentation and EDI message implementation guides for products such as the DCSA-aligned Track & Trace API (v1.2 and v2.2), Booking, Booking Confirmation (X12 301 / EDIFACT IFTMIN), and Shipping Instructions, alongside ANSI X12 and EDIFACT IFTMIN / IFTMBC / COPRAR reference documents. MSC also runs direct-integration partnerships with INTTRA, Infor Nexus, and CargoSmart. API and EDI access is not self-service: prospective integrators must submit a Direct Integration request, and fees may apply.

providers.description: Let'sMOD (formerly Polyup) is a Sunnyvale, California company founded in 2015 that builds a consumer platform where users aged 8 and up can play, modify, remix, and share short 3D microgames and AI-powered interactive memes. Originally a computational-thinking and math learning tool under the Polyup brand, the product has evolved into a generative-AI-driven microgame and viral-content community at letsmod.com. providers.name: ProFrac Holding

The company operates through portfolio brands including ProFrac, Best Pump & Flow, Alpine Silica, IO-TEQ, and Livewire Power. ProFrac Holding does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation portal.

providers.name: PwC (PricewaterhouseCoopers)
providers.description: PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) is one of the Big Four professional services firms, with approximately 370,000 staff across a global network of member firms coordinated by PricewaterhouseCoopers International Limited (PwCIL). PwC organizes delivery across three primary service lines — Assurance (audit), Tax (tax compliance, planning, and reporting), and Advisory (consulting, deals, and risk). The firm operates proprietary technology platforms including PwC Halo (a suite of data analytics tools used to support audit engagements), the Trusted AI initiative (PwC's responsible-AI governance and assurance framework), and ProEdge (a workforce upskilling platform). In April 2024 PwC announced a multi-year alliance with OpenAI positioning the firm as both OpenAI's largest customer and its first reseller of ChatGPT Enterprise, supporting PwC's broader generative-AI consulting practice. PwC's research and insights surface — pwc.com/insights, the annual Global CEO Survey, the Global Workforce Hopes and Fears Survey, the Money Tree report, and regional industry outlooks — is the firm's primary public-facing knowledge product. PwC does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, partner API documentation, or a GitHub organization at the corporate level. The github.com/pwc handle is held by an unrelated individual user (Patrick Clearwater). Any technical integrations with PwC platforms are arranged through engagement contracts and the PwC Technology Consulting practice rather than through self-service developer credentials. PwC's content distribution is reader-facing (newsletter subscriptions, the PwC US Newsroom, LinkedIn, YouTube) with no documented public RSS feed endpoint exposing news, press releases, or insights as a syndication contract.

providers.name: Regeneron
providers.description: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals is a leading biotechnology company that invents, develops, and commercializes life-transforming medicines, including EYLEA and EYLEA HD for ophthalmology, Dupixent in immunology (co-developed with Sanofi), Libtayo and Lynozyfic in oncology and hematology, and Praluent for cardiovascular disease. Regeneron does not publish a public developer API; its Regeneron Genetics Center collaborates on large-scale genomic research via the UK Biobank, DiscovEHR, and partner platforms rather than a self-hosted API.

providers.name: Rizm
providers.description: RIZM is a holistic energy optimization platform for industrial enterprises, operated by Kerith GmbH of Münster, Germany. It integrates data from production, energy procurement, and infrastructure into a digital twin, then optimizes energy system design and day-to-day operational decisions — from long-term infrastructure investment and power purchase agreements to short-term asset dispatch and production scheduling — helping manufacturers cut energy costs and emissions at the same time. Named customers include BMW Group, Bosch, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, and BSH. The product is delivered as a login-gated web application (app.rizm.de) with authenticated documentation; no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface is published at this time. Backed by Point Nine, this profile was surfaced from the venture portfolio graph.

providers.name: Shenandoah Telecommunications
providers.description: Shenandoah Telecommunications Company (SHEN), doing business as Shentel, is a publicly traded telecommunications company headquartered in Edinburg, Virginia. For over 100 years, Shentel has provided internet, TV, and phone services to residential and business customers across Virginia, West Virginia, Maryland, Pennsylvania, Kentucky, Delaware, Ohio, and Indiana. The company operates a digital wireless and wireline network delivering broadband internet, video, and voice services. Through its Glo Fiber and Glo Fiber Business brands, Shentel provides high-speed fiber optic internet, Ethernet, wavelength services, managed network services, and dark fiber leasing to enterprise and wholesale customers. Shentel operates approximately 15,400 route miles of fiber on a MEF-certified network, with connectivity including the Washington D.C. market via CoreSite.

providers.name: Skyfri
providers.description: Skyfri is a cleantech software and hardware company headquartered in Oslo, Norway that builds an operating platform for owners and operators of solar and battery energy assets. Founded in 2021, Skyfri combines an edge-native monitoring and control device (the SSI hardware, which speaks Modbus and SCADA over isolated RS-485 ports to inverters, meters, and sensors) with a cloud platform that automates operations, maintenance, and asset performance management. The software delivers real-time data processing, operational management, weather forecasting, dynamic benchmarking, plant insights, and fault detection to monitor generation and address underperformance and equipment failure across a global portfolio of solar and battery assets. The company has offices in Denver, London, Oslo, Singapore, and Bangalore and is backed by Speedinvest. Skyfri exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time; its platform is delivered as a customer application at app.skyfri.com.

providers.name: Suncorp Group
providers.description: Suncorp Group Limited (ASX: SUN) is an Australian general insurance group headquartered in Brisbane, Queensland, serving customers across Australia and New Zealand. Following the sale of Suncorp Bank to ANZ on 31 July 2024 it operates as a pure-play insurer, underwriting personal lines (motor, home and contents, caravan, landlord) and commercial lines (SME packages, commercial motor and motor fleet, property/ISR, liability, professional and financial risks, workers' compensation, surety, and specialty lines including residential strata and equipment breakdown) through a portfolio of brands: in Australia AAMI, Apia, Bingle, CIL, GIO, Essentials by AAI, Shannons, Suncorp, Terri Scheer and Vero, and in New Zealand Vero and AA Insurance. Its API posture is partner-gated and there is no public API. As of a 2026-07-25 review, Suncorp Group publishes no first-party developer portal, no API reference, and no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger definition on suncorpgroup.com.au or on any brand domain: the developer/developers/docs/api subdomains of suncorpgroup.com.au do not resolve, /developers and /api return HTTP 404 on the brand sites, and the corporate sitemap (803 URLs) plus the AAMI, GIO, Suncorp and Vero brand sitemaps (2,007 URLs) contain zero developer, API or integration paths. The only machine-to-machine integration surface is intermediated and behind a login: the VeroEdge / Vero Intermediary Portal for brokers (Access Single ID), a third-party Uniwriter underwriting portal for Engineers PI and Strata, and distribution through Australian broker trading networks — the Steadfast Client Trading Platform (SCTP), Sunrise Exchange, and direct Broker Management System connections. Australia has no live open-insurance obligation: the Consumer Data Right that opened banking and energy was never switched on for general insurance, so unlike Suncorp Bank there is no mandated public product-reference-data endpoint here. No ACORD, AL3 or NGDS reference was found anywhere on Suncorp Group or brand properties.

providers.name: Tahoe Therapeutics
providers.description: Tahoe Therapeutics (formerly Vevo Therapeutics) is a South San Francisco digital-biology company building the "ground truth for biological superintelligence." Its Mosaic platform generates perturbative single-cell data in vivo at gigascale, and it trains AI models — including the Tahoe-x1 single-cell foundation model (up to 3 billion parameters) and the Rhaister family of perturbation-response models — on the resulting data to discover novel drug targets and predict how patient cells respond to drugs. Tahoe openly publishes datasets (including the 100-million-cell Tahoe-100M atlas) and model weights on Hugging Face, ships the tahoe-x1 Python package on PyPI, and operates Tara, an autonomous research agent. The company does not run a public REST API. Backed by Amplify Partners; raised $30M in 2025.

providers.name: Transition Bio
providers.description: Transition Bio is a preclinical drug discovery company built on biomolecular condensate science, operating as a joint spin-out of the University of Cambridge and Harvard University with sites in Cambridge, Massachusetts and Cambridge, United Kingdom. The company combines droplet-microfluidics high-throughput molecular screening with a machine learning engine to identify and optimize small molecules that modulate intrinsically disordered proteins and the condensates they form, an approach the company has described as its Condensomics platform. It was seeded in November 2020 and closed a $50 million Series A in June 2022 led by Northpond Ventures with Taiho Ventures, Bristol Myers Squibb and Magnetic Ventures participating, and in November 2025 announced a collaboration with Voyager Therapeutics on small molecules targeting TDP-43 in ALS and frontotemporal dementia. Transition Bio is a therapeutics developer rather than a software or data vendor: it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract on any host it controls.
