providers.name: Walter
providers.description: Walter is a San Francisco-based Y Combinator (Spring 2026) startup building an AI employee for the manufacturing back office. Founded in 2026 by Nikolas Keller (CEO) and Lukas Postulka (CTO), Walter logs into the enterprise systems a company already runs on — SAP, Oracle NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Teams, Outlook and Gmail — the way a new hire would, and takes over manual paperwork: reading sales orders and purchase orders from emails and PDFs, capturing and validating the data, cross-checking it against the ERP, ordering from suppliers and catching pricing errors before they ship. It uses a purpose-built document-understanding model (rather than legacy template OCR) that supports 270+ languages and reaches 90%+ accuracy after minimal training, cutting an order that used to take 15 minutes down to about one. Walter requires no integration project and no rip-and-replace, operating the same screens the team already uses. It is an early-stage company with no public API, developer program, SDKs or documentation; this profile captures its public identity and security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Western Refining
providers.description: Western Refining was an independent crude oil refiner and marketer of refined petroleum products headquartered in El Paso, Texas. The company operated refineries in El Paso, Texas; Gallup, New Mexico; and St. Paul Park, Minnesota before being acquired by Tesoro Corporation in 2017 for approximately $6.4 billion. Western Refining's assets are now part of Andeavor (formerly Tesoro), subsequently acquired by Marathon Petroleum in 2018.

providers.name: Xiaopangxiong
providers.description: Xiaopangxiong (小胖熊, "small fat bear") is a Chinese B2B e-commerce platform for home and office renovation materials, operated by Shanghai Miju Network Technology Co., Ltd. (上海米居网络科技有限公司). The platform connects building-material suppliers with renovation contractors, crew foremen, and decoration companies, selling the full range of auxiliary materials (辅材) — sand, cement, paint and coatings, electrical wiring, pipes, tiles, and leveling supplies — through a self-operated model that spans factory-direct procurement, warehousing, logistics, delivery, installation, and after-sales service. Headquartered in Shanghai with service stations and warehouses in Suzhou, Hangzhou, Hefei, Ningbo, Wuxi, and Jiaxing, Xiaopangxiong is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund 2 and distributes primarily through its 小胖熊 mobile app; the company publishes no public developer portal or API surface.

providers.name: Zeal
providers.description: Zeal is a self-custodial onchain crypto wallet built for everyday life, pairing a non-custodial multi-chain wallet with real-world spending through a Gnosis Pay Visa debit card. Users hold USD and EUR stablecoins, earn yield via DeFi protocols such as Sky and Aave, and spend in 150+ countries with cashback, all while retaining full control of their own keys. Security features include Safety Checks, a Privacy Shield, biometric authentication, real-time transaction alerts and card freeze. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Northzone and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as of this pass Zeal publishes a consumer product and help documentation but no public API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, or developer platform.

providers.name: ZIM Integrated Shipping Services
providers.description: ZIM Integrated Shipping Services Ltd. (NYSE: ZIM) is a global container liner shipping company founded in 1945 and headquartered in Haifa, Israel. ZIM operates in more than 90 countries, serving over 30,000 customers across more than 300 ports worldwide with a differentiated global-niche strategy focused on agile fleet management and select trade lanes. The company is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange and, as of 2026, is the subject of a pending acquisition by Hapag-Lloyd at approximately $35.00 per share. ZIM's digital surface includes the myZIM customer area, ZIMonitor cargo visibility, an electronic Bill of Lading (eB/L) service, a Draft B/L tool, EDI integrations for booking and shipping instructions, a mobile application, and a developer API portal at api.zim.com hosted on Microsoft Azure API Management. Access to the ZIM API requires registering through ZIM API Support and obtaining a security token; rate limits are set per organization at registration. No public OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or GitHub organization are published, so ZIM is profiled here as a Tier-3 catalog entry pending spec disclosure or partner access.

providers.name: 4-Horn Industrial
providers.description: 4-Horn Industrial is an industrial equipment rental, sales and contractor supply company headquartered in Nederland, Texas, serving the petrochemical, refinery, pipeline and construction markets across the Gulf Coast from branches in Nederland, Pasadena and Hutto, Texas and Sulphur, Louisiana. It rents and sells manlifts, air compressors, forklifts, compaction and welding equipment, light towers, pneumatic tools and general contractor supplies on a 24/7/365 basis. It is an equipment leasing and distribution business rather than a software company: it publishes no developer program, no public API and no machine-readable API contract. Customer account access is delivered through a third-party rental-management portal (Intempo Software) and payments through Jack Henry ProfitStars SmartPay, both operated by vendors rather than by 4-Horn Industrial itself.

providers.name: 500net
providers.description: 500net Technology Co., Ltd. (五百戶科技股份有限公司) is a Taipei-based systems integrator, founded in 2004, that combines telecommunications integration, electromechanical engineering, hardware design and custom software development into smart-building, smart-factory, smart-parking and AI+IoT platforms for enterprise clients. Its published solution set covers BA central-monitoring systems, smart property-management and parking operations, the 500net-EMS energy-management platform, carbon-footprint / ESG inventory reporting, digital twins, AMR robotics and AI/AOI inspection, integrated across heterogeneous controllers over RS-485/Modbus, wired, wireless and 4G/5G links. Work is delivered as project-based system integration for named enterprise customers; the company publishes a corporate site and an investor section but no public developer program, API reference, SDK or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: 58.com
providers.description: 58.com (58同城, "58 Tongcheng") is China's largest online classifieds and local-services marketplace, often called the "Chinese Craigslist." Founded in 2005 and headquartered in Beijing, it operates listings across recruitment and jobs, real estate and housing (Anjuke), used goods (Zhuanzhuan), automobiles, local services, and yellow-pages business directories. Formerly listed on the NYSE (WUBA), it was taken private in 2020 by a Warburg Pincus / General Atlantic consortium. Its 58 Open Platform (open.58.com) exposes payment, recruitment/jobs data, housing, local-service information, security risk-control, marketing, and social capabilities to approved third-party partners via reviewed developer accounts and API keys. Backed historically by DCM Ventures.

providers.name: Accountable
providers.description: Accountable is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of pantera-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: crypto. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Aday
providers.description: Aday is a direct-to-consumer sustainable fashion brand founded in 2015 in New York City by Nina Faulhaber and Meg He. It designs technical, long-lasting capsule wardrobes built for outfit repetition, using custom recycled fabrics (including post-consumer recycled plastic) and plant-based, beechwood-derived materials produced in closed-loop processes. Aday has raised more than $10 million in venture capital, is backed by Cowboy Ventures, and has been named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, with coverage in Vogue, Refinery29, and Conde Nast Traveler. The company sells globally through its Shopify-powered storefront at thisisaday.com and does not publish a public developer API. This profile was created as an API Evangelist network stub from Cowboy Ventures' portfolio and enriched with company identity and domain-security signals; the storefront returned a Shopify "store is unavailable" lock at the time of the enrichment probe.

providers.name: Airloom Energy
providers.description: Airloom Energy is a Laramie, Wyoming wind-energy hardware company engineering next-generation utility-scale turbines that use a low-profile track-and-wing architecture instead of a conventional tower, aiming for low-cost, mass-manufacturable, high-energy-density generation that can be deployed at low-wind, height-restricted and hard-to-access sites. Backed by Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Lowercarbon Capital, MCJ, Crosscut and Woven Earth, the company ran a kilowatt-scale prototype in 2023, engineered a pilot system in 2024, is operating the pilot in 2025 and targets a commercial demonstration in 2027. It builds physical generation equipment and publishes no developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Aixinsemiconductortechnology
providers.description: Axera Semiconductor Co., Ltd. (Aixin Semiconductor Technology) is a global leader in AI inference SoC solutions, delivering high‑performance perception and computing platforms for on‑device computing, edge AI inference, and smart vehicles. Listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in February 2026, the company focuses on advanced edge and terminal‑side AI technologies, serving industries such as smart vehicles, vision, and edge AI chips.

providers.name: Alpha Natural Resources
providers.description: Alpha Natural Resources is a producer of metallurgical and thermal coal in the United States, mining and processing coal for steelmaking and electric power generation. The company does not offer public developer APIs, but participates in commodity trading data exchanges and supply chain integration with steel producers and utilities.

providers.name: Area 1 Security
providers.description: Area 1 Security was a cloud-native email security company that built preemptive anti-phishing and business-email-compromise (BEC) protection, discovering and blocking phishing campaigns before they reached inboxes. It could be deployed inline (MX/journaling) or via API connectors to Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace. Cloudflare acquired Area 1 Security in February 2022 for approximately $162 million and folded the technology into its Zero Trust / Cloudflare One platform, where it is now sold as Cloudflare Email Security. The independent area1security.com developer surface has been retired and now redirects to Cloudflare; the product API and documentation live under the Cloudflare developer platform.

providers.name: Arrivo BioVentures
providers.description: Arrivo BioVentures is a biopharmaceutical holding company developing first‑of‑its‑kind medicines for hard‑to‑treat diseases. It focuses on targeting the root cause of conditions such as major depressive disorder and severe acute pancreatitis, aiming for meaningful outcomes that extend patients’ lives. The company partners with institutions like the Mayo Clinic and Daiichi Sankyo and is backed by investors including Jazz Pharmaceuticals and Orlando Health Ventures.

providers.name: Asian Credit Fund
providers.description: Asian Credit Fund (ACF) is a Kazakh microfinance organization founded in 1997, providing microloans and non‑financial services to individuals and small businesses. Regulated by the National Bank of Kazakhstan, ACF aims to promote financial inclusion and sustainable development, offering ESG‑focused products and transparent reporting through annual and audit reports.

providers.name: Astraea
providers.description: Astraea is a Y Combinator-backed (Spring 2026) clinical trial automation platform that gives pharmaceutical sponsors, biotechs, and CROs an AI operating system for clinical development. Founded by Joshua Wang and Sanmay Sarada, the platform orchestrates specialized AI agents across the full biometrics lifecycle - standards mapping, data normalization, CDISC mapping, SDTM and ADaM dataset generation, TFLs/TLFs, SAP, eCRFs, Define-XML, QC, and submission documents - turning a protocol and raw study data into FDA-submission-ready output. Astraea is positioned as sponsor-run software rather than a CRO: it runs inside the customer's own secure environment so clinical data never reaches Astraea's servers, with 21 CFR Part 11 compliance and audit-ready, standards-native traceability. The company reports serving 10+ global pharma and biotech sponsors with 30-50% faster reporting cycles.

providers.name: Beast Games
providers.description: Beast Games is a reality‑competition entertainment brand created by MrBeast, featuring large‑scale physical and mental challenges with a $5 million grand prize. The platform showcases elite strength, intelligence and strategy contests, partnering with major brands and streaming on Amazon Prime Video.

providers.name: Bezahl
providers.description: Bezahl provides digital payment management solutions tailored for the automotive trade. It offers a modern payment experience, digital financing, anti-money laundering prevention, and white‑label platforms for dealerships, aiming to automate financial processes and improve transparency across the automotive sector.

providers.name: Biorchestra
providers.description: BIORCHESTRA develops transformational RNA medicines and delivery systems aimed at addressing major unmet medical needs in neurodegenerative and rare diseases of the Central Nervous System. The company focuses on novel target discovery, first‑in‑class drug development, and nanomedicine platforms to create innovative therapies for patients and their families.

providers.name: Bluechipart
providers.description: Bluechipart is an art dealer specializing in sourcing and selling high-value blue-chip artworks for collectors and dealers. They provide discreet, cost-effective transactions, expert consultation, and access to masterpieces by artists such as Picasso, Warhol, and Rothko, operating in the secondary art market.

providers.name: Bossanovaroboticsinc
providers.description: Bossanovaroboticsinc, operating as Bossa Nova Robotics, provides autonomous inventory management robots and AI-driven retail automation solutions. Their platform deploys robots across large retail chains to continuously scan shelves, detect out‑of‑stock items, and feed real‑time data to store associates, improving inventory accuracy and reducing labor costs. The company also shares extensive operational insights, guides, and resources for startups via their public documentation site.

providers.name: Bumo
providers.description: Bumo provides an on‑demand childcare booking platform that connects families with vetted daycare centers, preschools, and seasonal camps. Through its Ellie AI assistant, Bumo streamlines enrollment, bookings, billing, and parent‑provider communication, offering real‑time availability and pricing. The service operates across hundreds of U.S. cities, aiming to simplify child‑care discovery and management for both parents and providers.

providers.name: Canary
providers.description: Canary is an AI QA engineer that reads your source code to understand developer intent. Push a pull request and Canary reads the diff, understands the intent, and runs feature and regression tests against your preview app across real browsers, catching broken auth flows, slow page loads, and failing checkouts before they reach production. Built by ex-Google, Windsurf, and Cognition engineers, Canary is a Y Combinator Winter 2026 company positioned as the validation layer for AI-generated code.

providers.name: Capri Holdings
providers.description: Capri Holdings Limited (NYSE: CPRI) is a global luxury fashion group whose portfolio is the Michael Kors and Jimmy Choo brands (Versace was sold to Prada in 2025 and no longer appears on the company's overview). It designs, markets and sells apparel, footwear, handbags and accessories through its own stores, wholesale partners, licensees and brand e-commerce sites. Capri Holdings publishes no developer program: the corporate site at capriholdings.com is a Q4-hosted investor-relations property (news, SEC filings, governance, ESG resources, careers) with no API, documentation, SDK, package, OpenAPI, GraphQL, MCP or A2A surface, and the api.capriholdings.com and developer.capriholdings.com hosts an earlier scaffold named do not resolve in DNS. Every /.well-known/* path answers with the IR platform's 'Invalid key' catch-all rather than a document. This profile records that absence honestly; nothing has been authored on the company's behalf.

providers.name: CapsoVision
providers.description: CapsoVision, Inc. (Nasdaq: CV) is a commercial-stage medical technology company headquartered in Saratoga, California that develops advanced imaging and artificial-intelligence technologies for gastrointestinal disease detection and screening. Its CapsoCam Plus single-use capsule endoscope captures a 360-degree panoramic view of the small-bowel mucosa without external receiver equipment, and is paired with CapsoCloud, an account-gated cloud application, and CapsoView review software for physician image review and reporting. A next-generation CapsoCam Colon system is in development. CapsoVision publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable specification; CapsoCloud is an end-user clinical web and mobile application whose JSON backend is private to the product.

providers.name: Chef Robotics
providers.description: Chef Robotics is a San Francisco, California physical-AI company building AI-enabled robots for high-mix food production. Its core product is an NSF-certified food-assembly robot that picks, scoops, and deposits a wide range of ingredients — fresh, cooked, IQF, sauces, leafy greens, mixed vegetables, and discrete piece items — into trays, burritos, wraps, pizza bases, and other containers on conveyor lines. The robots are powered by ChefOS, a proprietary Generalized Food Manipulation Model trained on tens of millions of real-world servings and tens of thousands of hours of production data, combining vision, decision-making, and robot control across a See / Think / Act stack with continuous Fleet Learning. Chef Robotics sells via a Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model that bundles hardware, software updates, 24/7 monitoring, and customer success. Deployed customers include Amy's Kitchen, Sunbasket, Cafe Spice, and Chef Bombay, with the fleet having produced 98+ million servings across the US, Canada, and Europe. The company is venture-backed (Kleiner Perkins, Avataar Ventures-led $43M Series A, Bloomberg Beta, Construct Capital) and serves frozen meals, fresh meals, co-manufacturing, D2C meal delivery, medically tailored meals, meatpacking, airline catering, and foodservice verticals. There is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release for ChefOS — the platform is operated as a closed, fleet-managed service on Chef-owned hardware deployed inside customer facilities.

providers.name: Clarabridge
providers.description: Clarabridge was a customer experience management (CEM) and conversational analytics company known for its natural-language-understanding platform that analyzed unstructured customer feedback — contact-center transcripts, chat, email, surveys, social media, and online reviews — to surface sentiment, emotion, effort, intent, and emerging topics. Qualtrics acquired Clarabridge in 2021, and the technology has since been integrated and rebranded inside the Qualtrics XM platform: Clarabridge Studio became Qualtrics XM Discover and Clarabridge Engage became Qualtrics Connect. Clarabridge no longer operates an independent developer portal or public API; its capabilities are now delivered through Qualtrics. This profile is retained as a company/brand record in the API Evangelist network with an acquisition pointer to Qualtrics.

providers.name: Clinomic
providers.description: Clinomic provides data intelligence and network medicine solutions for critical care, offering platforms such as Mona PDMS, Mona OS, and cloud services to streamline patient management, interoperability, and analytics in intensive care settings. Their suite includes teleICU, webICU, and AI tool integration, aiming to improve clinical outcomes through standardized, automated data workflows.

providers.name: CloudCraze
providers.description: CloudCraze was an enterprise B2B commerce platform built natively on the Salesforce Platform, letting businesses launch online B2B storefronts fast and scale them on top of Salesforce CRM data. Brands including Coca-Cola, Cummins, Ecolab, Land O' Lakes, and WABCO ran global B2B commerce on it. Salesforce acquired CloudCraze in 2018 and folded it into the Salesforce B2B Commerce product line (now the legacy "B2B Commerce for Visualforce" managed package), where its Apex/JavaScript developer surface continues to be documented on Salesforce Developers. CloudCraze no longer operates as an independent company or developer portal — www.cloudcraze.com redirects to Salesforce B2B Commerce.

providers.name: Coherentbiopharma
providers.description: Coherentbiopharma (CBP) is a biopharma company focused on pioneering bi‑targeting XDC technology to develop novel cancer therapies. The company’s website presents its mission, pipeline, scientific approach, clinical trials, publications, and patient safety information, offering insight into its drug discovery platform and corporate culture.

providers.name: Column98c0
providers.description: Column98c0 is a technology-focused company identified through the API Evangelist secondary-market harvest. While detailed public information is limited, the company is positioned as a provider of data services and API-driven solutions. Further investigation is required to uncover its exact product offerings, target markets, and operational scope. This placeholder description will be refined as more concrete information becomes available through subsequent profiling steps.

providers.name: Commerceblock
providers.description: Commerceblock is a blockchain technology company focused on building public and hybrid blockchain infrastructure for the distribution, exchange, and storage of tokenized assets and securities. The company develops enterprise‑grade systems that combine the immutability and security of public blockchains with the operational flexibility of permissioned environments, targeting regulated financial markets. Their platform offers sidechains, attestation services, and tools for clients to create, manage, and trade digital securities on multiple public networks, aiming to enable compliant tokenization and decentralized finance solutions.

providers.name: Commerzbank
providers.description: Commerzbank AG is a major German universal bank offering a wide range of financial services including retail banking, corporate banking, investment banking, and asset management. The bank provides digital banking platforms for private and business customers, offering online account access, payment services, loan applications, and financial advisory. Through its developer portal, Commerzbank exposes APIs for account information, transaction processing, payment initiation, and other services to enable fintech integration and open banking solutions.

providers.name: CTR
providers.description: CTR (Central to your safe mobility) is a South Korean mobility solutions company focused on safety, innovation, and sustainability. It offers OEM and aftermarket services, R&D networks, and ESG initiatives, aiming to create safer transportation experiences worldwide. The company emphasizes employee happiness, customer trust, and societal development through continuous technological advancement.

providers.name: Dada
providers.description: Dada Group (Dada Nexus, NASDAQ: DADA) is a leading Chinese instant retail and local on-demand delivery platform, headquartered in Shanghai and founded in 2014. It operates an open, crowdsourced delivery network of more than one million rider partners serving supermarkets, pharmacies, fresh-food and restaurant merchants across thousands of counties and cities, alongside merchant fulfillment products such as the Haibo in-store logistics system and the Dada Youjian picking service. Now integrated into the JD.com ecosystem, its core delivery brand was rebranded to JD Instant Delivery (京东秒送) in May 2024. Dada runs a merchant Open Platform (开放平台) for order, delivery-tracking and fulfillment integrations. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Downjoy (当乐网)
providers.description: Downjoy (当乐网, d.cn) is a Chinese mobile game distribution and community platform operated by Beijing Downjoy Information Technology Co., Ltd (北京当乐信息技术有限公司). The site offers mobile game downloads, gaming news and original editorial content, game-related video, community features, and game rankings and recommendations. Downjoy also runs an open platform at open.d.cn where game publishers and developers register, create and submit games, integrate the Downjoy SDK, and manage launch and updates. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; enriched with verified public identity and infrastructure probes.

providers.name: Eneryield
providers.description: Eneryield is a Gothenburg, Sweden based company (a Techstars portfolio company) building AI-powered fault prediction and analytics for electric power systems. Its flagship product, Eneryield IntelliView, uses explainable AI to forecast power outages before they occur by analyzing voltage and current signals from digital relays and merging units on overhead lines, underground cables, and underwater cables. The cloud-based platform integrates directly into existing utility monitoring systems without additional hardware, giving grid operators transparent root-cause analysis so they can move to proactive maintenance and reduce operational cost and downtime. As of this profile, Eneryield publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this record captures its identity and infrastructure posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Environment and Climate Change Canada
providers.description: Environment and Climate Change Canada (ECCC) is the federal department responsible for weather, climate, water and environmental protection in Canada, and operates the Meteorological Service of Canada. It runs an OGC-standard GeoServer at geo.ec.gc.ca which responds correctly to WMS, WFS and OGC API - Features requests but, when probed on 2026-08-20, published no layers, no feature types and no collections through it.

providers.name: Ergo
providers.description: Ergo (ergo Offers, Inc.) is a New York-based e-commerce pricing company that lets online shoppers name their own price. Its flagship product is a Shopify app that adds a "Make an Offer with ergo" button to product pages: a customer submits the price they are willing to pay and how long they are willing to wait, and the merchant accepts or rejects the offer from a backend dashboard. Beyond bartering, Ergo captures true willingness-to-pay data and turns it into pricing analytics and a price-discovery and optimization tool, helping retailers clear excess inventory and reduce blanket discounting. Founded and led by CEO Claire Stepanek (previously supply chain at Apple), Ergo raised a $1.5M pre-seed round in October 2023 led by Anthemis with Wischoff Ventures. Ergo does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its company identity.

providers.name: ERGO NEXT Insurance
providers.description: ERGO NEXT Insurance (formerly NEXT Insurance) is a Palo Alto, California technology-first Property & Casualty insurer focused on the specific needs of U.S. small and medium-sized business owners. Founded in 2016, the company offers fully digital commercial coverage including General Liability, Workers' Compensation, Business Owner's Policy (BOP), Professional Liability / Errors & Omissions, Commercial Property, Commercial Auto, Tools & Equipment, Employment Practices Liability, Product Liability, and Liquor Liability — serving more than 750,000 customers across 1,300+ professions. In March 2025 Munich Re signed a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of NEXT Insurance at a valuation of $2.6 billion; ERGO Group AG (Munich Re's primary insurance arm) closed the full acquisition on July 1, 2025 and on January 15, 2026 the company rebranded as ERGO NEXT Insurance, becoming Munich Re/ERGO's foothold in the U.S. SMB market. ERGO NEXT's partner-facing surface is NEXT Connect, an embedded insurance platform that lets payroll, point-of-sale, accounting, e-commerce, payments, banking, and fintech platforms quote and bind small-business coverage from within their own product through low-code components and API calls. NEXT Connect aggregates 15+ carriers (including ERGO NEXT itself, Travelers, Liberty Mutual, Chubb, CNA, The Hartford) and is documented in the wild through embedded-payroll partners such as Check, Gusto Embedded, Intuit QuickBooks, Square, LegalZoom, and Amazon Business Prime, but ERGO NEXT does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or self-serve SDKs — partner onboarding is gated through a partnerships team. The company also offers a pay-as-you-go Workers' Comp product that integrates with partner payroll runs so premium is calculated against actual per-cycle W-2 wages.

providers.name: GeoCat
providers.description: GeoCat bv is a Dutch company built around the open-source geospatial stack, and is the primary maintainer of GeoNetwork, the catalogue software that runs a large share of Europe's INSPIRE metadata infrastructure. It sells GeoCat Bridge, GeoCat Live and hosted catalogue services, and runs a public demonstration estate serving both classic OGC web services and a modern OGC API - Features endpoint.

providers.name: GeoSolutions
providers.description: GeoSolutions is an Italian company and one of the principal maintainers of the open-source geospatial server stack — GeoServer, GeoNetwork, MapStore and GeoNode. It sells enterprise support, deployment and custom development around those projects. Its public demonstration server is a reference OGC deployment, serving classic OGC web services alongside a modern OGC API - Features endpoint.

providers.name: Haaven
providers.description: Haaven is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of speedinvest and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline. The company's primary web presence is haaven.com, which sits behind a Cloudflare bot challenge; a published RFC 9116 security.txt (security@haaven.com, languages en,nl) and an api.haaven.com host were confirmed during enrichment, but no public OpenAPI, docs, or developer portal could be read.

providers.name: HCA Healthcare
providers.description: HCA Healthcare (formerly HCA Holdings) is one of the largest for-profit operators of healthcare facilities in the world, operating hospitals, surgery centers, freestanding emergency rooms, and urgent care centers. The company was named HCA Holdings until May 2017. No public developer portal or production APIs are advertised.

providers.name: igetget
providers.description: igetget is the English name for 得到 (Dedao), a Chinese knowledge-service and lifelong-learning platform operated by Beijing Siwei Zaowu Information Technology Co., Ltd. (北京思维造物信息科技股份有限公司), the company behind Luojisiwei (罗辑思维) founded by Luo Zhenyu. The app sells curated courses, expert lectures, ebooks, and audiobooks across finance, economics, law, management, psychology, and self-improvement, alongside an enterprise edition, a web edition, and the annual "Time's Friend" (时间的朋友) New Year's Eve lecture. It is a consumer content product; enrichment found no public API specification or developer documentation, only an open-platform (开放平台) login surface at open.igetget.com. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: Ipsy
providers.description: IPSY is a personalized beauty subscription company founded in 2011 by Michelle Phan, Marcelo Camberos, and Jennifer Goldfarb. Members take a detailed beauty quiz and receive monthly curated "Glam Bag" drops of deluxe samples and full-size makeup, skincare, hair, and fragrance products across tiers (Original, Boxycharm, and Ultimate). IPSY operates as a direct-to-consumer commerce and membership platform under the BFA Industries umbrella; it exposes no public developer API, running on internal GraphQL and REST services with Auth0-based consumer identity. This API Evangelist profile tracks IPSY's public web, security, and identity surface rather than a documented developer program.

providers.name: Jar
providers.description: Jar is a Bengaluru-based fintech company operating India's first micro-savings app, enabling tens of millions of Indians to save in 24K digital gold from as little as ₹10. The app supports daily, weekly, monthly, and instant savings mechanisms, plus a round-up feature that automatically invests spare change from everyday transactions into 99.5%+ pure digital gold held in insured vaults. Founded in 2021 by Nishchay AG (CEO) and Misbah Ashraf (CPO) under Changejar Technologies Private Limited, Jar has grown to 50+ million registered users across 12,000+ Indian zip codes. The company recently vertically integrated its gold operations, moving away from a third-party distribution model to purchase, store, and manage gold directly. Jar partners with Brink's for global custody, ICICI Lombard for insurance, Vistra as independent trustee, and BDO as statutory auditor. Adjacent products include Nek, a direct-to-consumer gold and silver jewellery brand sold via shopnek.com. Jar reached profitability in 2025 after backing from Tiger Global, Arkam Ventures, Rainfall Ventures, Yes VC, and others at a $300M+ valuation, and is preparing for an IPO. There is no public developer API, SDK, or partner integration program — Jar is a B2C consumer mobile app distributed exclusively through Apple App Store and Google Play.

providers.name: Libra Robotics
providers.description: Libra Robotics is a Silicon Valley robotics startup building autonomous robots that install solar panels in the field, targeting projects from 1 MW upward across utility-scale, commercial and industrial, community solar, and agrivoltaic applications. The company's field system — marketed as Libra 001 — combines purpose-built end-effectors, suction-based panel handling and transport, vision and positioning systems that align each module with the tracker structure, and fastener workflows compatible with multiple commercial racking systems, operating across day and night shifts. Libra Robotics was founded by Yaojing Huang and Jermaine Zhao, is part of the Y Combinator Summer 2026 batch, and operates out of Newark, California. As of this profile the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable specifications; its web presence is a six-page marketing site covering solutions, technology, safety, company, and contact.

providers.name: Liveprofile
providers.description: LiveProfile is a cross-platform mobile messaging and chat product ("Stay connected with people and things that matter. Chat securely and express yourself freely."). It was originally backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and is surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-derived company profile. As of this enrichment pass, liveprofile.com is an invite-only relaunch teaser ("The New LiveProfile") running a waitlist, with apps advertised for Android, iPhone & iPad, and Mac/PC. The company maintains a public GitHub organization and a BetterUptime status page, but publishes no public API surface, developer documentation, OpenAPI, or SDKs at this time — so this profile carries identity and operational signals only, awaiting a real developer/API surface.

providers.name: Midas
providers.description: Midas is an onchain asset-management protocol that brings institutional-grade investment strategies onchain as tokenized real-world assets (RWAs). It issues permissionless, fully-backed tokenized products — including tokenized US Treasury bills (mTBILL), yield and basis strategies (mBASIS) and other onchain investment products — that offer full transparency, instant liquidity and native composability across DeFi. Investors mint and redeem Midas tokens directly against the underlying assets, and the resulting ERC-20 tokens can be used as collateral and as building blocks throughout the onchain economy. Positioned as "the standard for onchain investment products," Midas surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a fintech portfolio company for enrichment.

providers.name: MisMar
providers.description: MisMar (مسمار) is a Saudi Arabian automotive maintenance and repair platform that connects vehicle owners with certified service centers. It runs a consumer mobile app (B2C) alongside a Network-as-a-Service (NaaS) platform and Workshop Management System (WMS) that digitize fleet management, order processing, and workshop operations for business (B2B), government (B2G), and insurance partners. Services span fault diagnostics, accident restoration, oil and battery and tire changes, periodic maintenance, car wash, and protective treatments across 45+ Saudi cities, with at-home or center-based delivery and warranty coverage. MisMar is a portfolio company of 500 Global. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface is currently published.

providers.name: MyCash
providers.description: MyCash (operated by IN REMIT PTE LTD, Singapore) is a mobile-only cross-border remittance service built for migrant workers. Through the MyCash Money mobile app, users send money home instantly, reload / top up mobile airtime, and pay bills across supported corridors without needing a traditional bank account. The service targets the unbanked and underbanked migrant population with low-cost digital money transfer and mobile financial services. As of this profile MyCash publishes a consumer mobile application and marketing site (inremit.co) but exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile records the company's public web and security posture.

providers.name: Nectero Therapeutics
providers.description: Nectero Therapeutics (also operating as Nectero Medical) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing a novel, minimally invasive treatment to stabilize growth and prevent rupture of mid-sized abdominal aortic aneurysms (AAA). Its lead investigational therapy is delivered as a single endovascular procedure intended to remodel and strengthen the aneurysm wall, offering an alternative to watchful waiting or open surgical repair. The company is backed by Norwest Venture Partners and other life-sciences investors, and maintains a corporate marketing and news presence. It does not publish a developer program, public API, SDKs, or any machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Porch
providers.description: Porch Group is a home services and home insurance platform operating across the full lifecycle of the home. Trading on Nasdaq as PRCH, the company combines a vertical software business for home inspectors, moving companies, title and mortgage providers, and contractors with a consumer-facing home insurance carrier (Porch Insurance Reciprocal Exchange), home warranty, and a moving-concierge app that helps homeowners set up utilities, security, and services. Porch reaches a large share of U.S. homebuyers each year through its inspection-software network, using that unique early-in-the-home-lifecycle data to power insurance, warranty, and moving offerings. This profile was seeded as a Battery Ventures portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Porch publishes no public developer API, but it does operate a responsible disclosure program and RFC 9116 security.txt.

providers.name: PowerLight Technologies
providers.description: PowerLight Technologies is an American engineering company headquartered in Kent, Washington that develops laser power beaming systems — wireless transmission of kilowatt-level electrical power over free space and over optical fiber. Founded as LaserMotive and renamed in 2017, the company builds power-over-fiber and free-space laser power links for defense unmanned aerial systems, telecom sites, temporary and disaster power, smart-grid applications, and lunar and satellite power distribution, including work under DARPA's LunA-10 program. Its products are hardware energy-transmission systems rather than software, and the company publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Roon
providers.description: Roon is a digital health platform (operating as CareSpace Health Inc.) that helps people navigate serious and critical health conditions by connecting them with trusted answers from leading medical experts. Rather than relying on "Dr. Google" or legacy content sites, Roon publishes thousands of short, doctor-created video answers covering conditions such as ALS, glioblastoma (GBM), dementia, PCOS, fertility, and women's health, organized so patients and caregivers can quickly find vetted guidance for their journey. Founded in 2021 by Vikram Bhaskaran, Arun Ranganathan, and Dr. Rohan Ramakrishna, Roon delivers its experience primarily through consumer iOS apps and its website, and raised a $15M Series A co-led by Forerunner Ventures and FirstMark. Roon is a consumer-facing health information product and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Sansan
providers.description: Sansan, Inc. is a Tokyo-based enterprise SaaS company that builds cloud contact- and business-card management software. Its flagship Sansan platform digitizes and centralizes business cards and customer contact data so sales teams can share information across the organization, surface opportunities, and integrate contact data with external systems. The company also offers the Eight business-card app and Bill One invoice-management product. As of this enrichment pass Sansan does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI definition on its English or Japanese websites; this profile captures the company identity and probed domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Sephora
providers.description: Sephora is a French multinational chain of personal care and beauty stores and a subsidiary of LVMH, operating 2,700+ locations worldwide and a large ecommerce footprint. Sephora does not publish a public developer API and does not maintain a public GitHub organization. The Sephora storefront and Beauty Insider loyalty program are accessed only through consumer apps and the website; affiliate marketing partnerships are brokered through third-party networks such as Rakuten Advertising and Skimlinks rather than a Sephora-owned API.

providers.name: Shape Security
providers.description: Shape Security was an enterprise application-security company (backed by gv and wing-venture-capital) specializing in bot mitigation, credential-stuffing defense, and online-fraud prevention for login, checkout, and account-recovery flows. It was acquired by F5 in 2020 and its technology now ships as F5 Distributed Cloud Bot Defense; the shapesecurity.com domain 301-redirects wholesale into f5.com. Shape Security no longer operates an independent developer portal, public API, OpenAPI spec, or SDK surface of its own — its capabilities are delivered through the F5 Distributed Cloud platform. This profile is retained as an acquisition/lineage record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: SlideRule
providers.description: SlideRule is a no-code risk decisioning platform that lets risk and operations teams build, test, and deploy automated decision logic for fraud, credit, compliance, and trust-and-safety use cases without writing code. Its rules engine combines SQL and API data connectors, real-time analytics, A/B testing, backtesting, shadow mode, and case-management automation, and exposes a single API to trigger decision workflows. SlideRule has announced it is joining Block, Inc.; its standalone developer documentation surface (docs.sliderule.io) is no longer publicly reachable, so no live API specification could be harvested during enrichment.

providers.name: Smashfly
providers.description: SmashFly Technologies was a recruitment-marketing software company whose Total Recruitment Marketing Platform combined a career-site CMS, a candidate CRM, programmatic job advertising, and recruiting analytics for enterprise talent-acquisition teams. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, SmashFly was acquired by Symphony Talent in 2019 and its product folded into the Symphony Talent (SFX / SmashFlyX) suite. SmashFly historically exposed RESTful integration APIs — a Job Import API, a Contact Import API, a Contact Export API, and a List Lookup API — secured with per-organization API keys generated by an administrator in the SmashFly Console. The standalone developer documentation at recruit.smashfly.com has since been retired (the host now returns an empty 302), smashfly.com redirects to symphonytalent.com, and the remaining SmashFly developer resources are hosted in the Symphony Talent support center.

providers.name: SpringSource
providers.description: SpringSource was the software company behind the open-source Spring Framework for Java. Founded in 2004 as Interface21 by Rod Johnson and colleagues, it was venture-backed (Accel, Benchmark) and acquired by VMware in 2009. The Spring portfolio subsequently moved through Pivotal and VMware Tanzu and is maintained today by Broadcom. The springsource.com domain now 301-redirects to spring.io, the current home of the Spring ecosystem. SpringSource exposed no standalone public API of its own; this profile documents the historical company and its lineage into today's Spring projects.

providers.name: TeamLift
providers.description: TeamLift provides personalized AI training for teams, turning top performers into AI Champions through 1:1 instruction tailored to company priorities and existing systems. Their platform offers customized training programs, methodology guides, and hands‑on support to help organizations develop useful AI solutions and measurable business outcomes.

providers.name: Text'nPayMe
providers.description: Text'nPayMe is an award-winning B2B fintech company, established in Armenia and incorporated in the USA in 2022, that builds embedded payment solutions for banks, fintechs, telecoms, and online shops. Its two core products are a Payment Keyboard SDK, which embeds send-money transactions directly inside 150+ messaging, social, and gaming apps via a payment keyboard for iOS, Android, and a Chrome extension, and a Payment Gateway Hub for transaction routing, reconciliation, and reporting. The company markets an "Apex Security Layer" with proprietary encryption and risk management, supports cross-border payments, and joined the 500 Global accelerator after winning the Entrepreneurship World Cup 2022 National Finals. The SDK is delivered to enterprise customers through direct integration engagements rather than a public self-serve developer portal, so no public API specification, developer documentation, or client packages are currently published.

providers.name: Transfix
providers.description: Transfix is a New York-based freight technology company that, since divesting its brokerage operation to NFI Industries in June 2024, operates as a SaaS and data company providing AI-powered Transportation Management System (TMS) software to freight brokers, third-party logistics providers (3PLs), shippers, and carriers across the United States. The Transfix TMS unifies pricing, planning, execution, and billing in a single platform, with feature areas covering Smart Pricing and Quoting, RFP Management and Collaboration, Coverage and Carrier Management, Streamlined Scheduling, Operations and Automation, Invoicing and Payments, and Reporting and Insights. Core AI capabilities include the Custom Rate Prediction Suite for spot and contract pricing across Dry Van, Reefer, and Flatbed equipment, and the RFP Workflow with a Smart Upload feature that structures bid data from heterogeneous file formats. Transfix markets integrations with existing TMS, carrier networks, and data sources, and references freight API integrations in marketing material, but does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or open-source repositories. NFI Industries is the platform's anchor third-party customer following the brokerage divestiture.

providers.name: WestRock
providers.description: WestRock (now Smurfit Westrock following its 2024 merger with Smurfit Kappa) is one of the world's largest paper and packaging companies. The company provides differentiated paper and packaging solutions including corrugated containers, consumer packaging, displays, and specialty packaging. WestRock serves consumer and industrial markets with an integrated supply chain connecting mills, converting operations, and customers globally.

providers.name: Wing
providers.description: Wing is Alphabet's drone delivery subsidiary, spun out of Google X in 2018, with operating headquarters in Palo Alto, California and significant operations in Australia, Finland, Ireland, and the United States. Wing designs, builds, and operates a fleet of small fixed-wing electric VTOL aircraft that autonomously pick up and deliver packages to customers' homes, and it operates an unmanned traffic management (UTM) stack used by drone pilots and aviation authorities. Wing was the first company to receive an FAA Part 135 Air Carrier Certificate for drone delivery (2019) and is an approved LAANC USS in the United States and an approved drone airspace authorization provider for CASA in Australia. Wing's commercial surface is split across two main platforms — the Wing Delivery Platform, a partner-only API and UI suite that lets retailers, restaurants, and logistics providers embed drone delivery into their own order flows (Walmart, DoorDash, Papa Johns, and others), and OpenSky, a consumer drone airspace authorization app and partner API. Wing also co-founded the InterUSS Platform open-source UTM project, now hosted by the Linux Foundation. Wing's revenue comes from per-delivery fees charged to merchant partners and from drone-as-a-service operations rather than from public developer APIs; the Delivery Platform API and OpenSky API are not openly published and there is no public OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal at the time of profiling.

providers.name: XellSmart Biomedical
providers.description: XellSmart Biomedical (士泽生物医药) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in Suzhou and Shanghai, China, founded in 2021 by Dr. Xiang Li. The company develops clinical-grade, allogeneic, off-the-shelf iPSC-derived cell therapies for central nervous system diseases, with NMPA- and U.S. FDA-cleared registrational clinical trials in Parkinson's disease, spinal cord injury, and ALS. XellSmart is a Qiming Venture Partners portfolio company and publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Advancechip
providers.description: Advancechip Technology (Hunan) Co., Ltd. — 进芯科技（湖南）股份有限公司, formerly Hunan Jinxin Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. — is a fabless integrated-circuit design company founded in October 2012 and headquartered in Changsha, Hunan, China. It develops digital signal processor (DSP) chips and embedded solutions, and states that it has taken three DSP families to mass production: 16-bit fixed-point (ADP16), 32-bit fixed-point (ADP32) and 32-bit floating-point (AVP32), alongside single-core and multi-core SoC parts such as the ADM32F036 motor-control family. The company describes its core technologies as DSP core design, compilation technology, large-scale SoC digital integration and core drive algorithms, held as a fully independent intellectual-property stack, and targets automotive electronics, thermal management, smart home and white goods, small household appliances, health equipment and power tools. Its developer-facing surface is hardware, not web software: evaluation and development boards (AVP32F379QP176, AVP32F00157QP80, AVP32F0039QP100S, ADM32F036A5Q/A6Q/A7Q low-voltage motor boards), a technical-support page and a download section that serves chip data manuals as PDFs from a third-party file host. As probed on 2026-09-07 Advancechip publishes no public web API, no developer portal or API reference, no OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL contract, no SDK in any public package registry, no GitHub organization and no /.well-known documents; the corporate site itself is served over plaintext HTTP only.

providers.name: Aerialoop
providers.description: Aerialoop is a drone technology and urban logistics company that designs, builds, and operates intelligent aerial networks for cargo delivery, surveillance, and infrastructure inspection. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Miami with operations rooted in Quito, Ecuador, it is one of the fastest-growing drone delivery operations in Latin America. Its ALT 6-8 delivery drone carries a 5kg payload for urban logistics, while the ALT 6-ISR line adds HD, infrared, and night-vision cameras with AI-powered intrusion detection; extended-range variants operate up to 120km using LEO satellite connectivity for beyond-visual-line-of-sight flights. The company has completed over 50,000 flights across six countries. Aerialoop is a Techstars Miami (powered by J.P. Morgan) portfolio company. It currently publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

(江苏德速智能机械股份有限公司), a Changzhou, Jiangsu-based manufacturer of machine-tool core functional components founded in 2009. Its product lines are physical assemblies — CNC tool magazines (刀库), motorized spindles (主轴), rotary / index tables (转台) and mineral-cast machine beds (矿物铸件) — which the company states account for more than 60% of a machine tool's total cost. It also builds five-axis machining-centre platforms, ultra-precision grinders and turnkey automated production lines for automotive and general manufacturing customers, and operates provincial R&D centres for CNC machine-tool functional components. The company is pre-IPO and runs a Chinese-language corporate site with an investor-relations section; it publishes no developer portal, API documentation, SDK, or machine-readable contract of any kind.

Ampaire is backed by Techstars and has worked with partners including NASA and ARPA-E. Augmate’s platform offers device provisioning, app distribution, data analytics, and integration via robust APIs, supporting blockchain‑enabled, protocol‑agnostic, tokenized architectures for secure IoT deployments.

The platform spans first-tier Chinese cities including Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen plus more than ten second-tier cities, listing over one million properties. Baletu is a consumer proptech company backed by DCM Ventures, Tiantu Capital, Nan Fung Group, and ZWC Partners, having raised roughly $140M through a 2018 Series C. It ships consumer iOS/Android apps and a partner portal; it does not publish a public developer API program (api.baletu.com serves its own apps).

The integrated platform handles leases, purchases, and utility payments in one place. Behja is a portfolio company of 500 Global and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it does not currently publish a public developer program, API, SDKs, or technical documentation.

Founded in 2007 by Sheila Lirio Marcelo, the company went public on the NYSE (CRCM) in 2014 and was acquired by IAC (IAC Inc.) in February 2020 for approximately $500 million, taking it private. Care.com is consumer- and enterprise-facing and does NOT publish a documented public developer API - there is no developer portal, no public API reference, and no self-service API keys. Its GitHub organization (github.com/caredotcom) contains only internal DevOps/infra tooling, not customer-facing API libraries. The only partner-facing programmatic surface is a private job-import integration inside Care.com Recruiting Solutions / Care for Business, used to sync job postings from an employer ATS; it is provisioned through a partnership agreement rather than openly documented. Note - Care.com is frequently confused with Caring.com (a separate senior-care directory owned by Caring, Inc. that DOES publish a JSON API at docs.caring.com); this entry is about care.com only. Access to the marketplace itself is via paid Basic and Premium memberships; there is no published API pricing.

Deben targets finance teams in Saudi Arabia and the wider region, referencing Open Banking, and is backed by 500 Global. providers.name: PSEG
providers.description: Public Service Enterprise Group (PSEG) is a diversified energy holding company headquartered in Newark, New Jersey. Its regulated utility subsidiary Public Service Electric and Gas (PSE&G) is New Jersey's largest electric and gas distribution utility, and PSEG Long Island operates the transmission and distribution system on behalf of the Long Island Power Authority. PSEG sits squarely in the utility-retailer tier of the United States energy value chain — it meters, bills, and serves end customers, and it sells generation into the PJM wholesale market rather than publishing that market's data itself. Its API posture is honestly closed. There is no developer portal: developer., developers., api., docs., and data.pseg.com do not resolve, and /developers, /api, and /docs on pseg.com return the site's soft-404 page. Green Button is present only as a file: PSEG Long Island's MySmartEnergy FAQ states customers can "download data information in CSV or Green Button (.XML) format," which is Download My Data behind a customer login, not Connect My Data. There is no documented programmatic third-party access to customer usage data — in the New Jersey BPU AMI docket PSE&G described manual secondary-user sharing, a Letter of Authorization with spreadsheets emailed back, and EDI for BPU-licensed suppliers. Grid data is equally closed: the PSE&G NJ and PSEG Long Island outage maps are vendor-hosted KUBRA StormCenter applications with no published data API. Open market data for this territory comes from PJM and the EIA, not from PSEG.

Its portfolio includes globally recognised brands such as Lysol, Dettol, Mucinex, Strepsils, Nurofen, Veet, Finish, Vanish, Air Wick, Calgon, Durex, and Enfamil/Mead Johnson infant nutrition, sold in nearly 200 markets. Reckitt operates as a pure consumer packaged-goods company with retail and e-commerce distribution; it does not publish a public developer API or open partner integration portal at the corporate level. B2B trading-partner connectivity with retailers and distributors is handled via standard EDI / GDSN flows rather than a public REST API.

providers.description: RedWing Aerospace Laboratories (RedWing Labs, operated by Kitemaps AMS Pvt Ltd) is a Bangalore, India based, Techstars-backed company that designs, develops and deploys fully autonomous drones to transform logistics supply chains. It offers a fleet of long-range, urban and medium-range delivery aircraft plus an operations software suite, and runs an autonomous four-step delivery flow (order, handoff to flight operations, proof of delivery, return to hub) used to move healthcare products, food and other goods within the hour. The company reports operational milestones including 145,930+ kilometers flown and thousands of deliveries completed. RedWing does not publish a first-party developer API; its public agent surface is the platform-provided Wix Site MCP endpoint advertised in its llms.txt.

providers.description: Retro Biosciences is a Redwood City, California longevity biotechnology company founded in 2021 whose stated mission is to add ten years to healthy human lifespan. Its published preclinical pipeline spans RTR242, a small-molecule autophagy-flux booster aimed at Alzheimer's disease; RTR888, iPSC-derived microglial progenitors for CNS conditions; RTR890, iPSC-derived hematopoietic stem cells for blood disorders; AAV-delivered in vivo tissue reprogramming for osteoarthritis and age-related hearing loss; and AI-designed protein therapeutics, the last built on a 2025 collaboration with OpenAI on a protein-engineering model for reprogramming factors. Retro was seeded with $180M from Sam Altman and reported a $1.8B valuation in 2026. It is a therapeutics company rather than a software company: it operates a public GitHub organization of internal lab-automation and bioinformatics tooling, but publishes no API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract of any kind.

Ring Radar is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this profile the company runs a consumer web application (login and signup) but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, OpenAPI, or developer documentation surface that could be discovered.

providers.name: Spiral
providers.description: Spiral (SpiralDB) is a multimodal data platform built for the "machine consumer" — frontier AI systems and agents. It unifies video, images, audio, embeddings, point clouds, sensor streams, tables, and text under one query language and coordinate-frame system, serving everything from raw bytes to model-ready tensors at machine-scale throughput for pretraining pipelines and agentic access. Spiral is the creator of Vortex, a high-performance extensible columnar data format (100x faster random access and 10-20x faster scans vs. Apache Parquet) now incubating under the Linux Foundation, along with the FastLanes, FSST, and ALP compression libraries. The hosted Spiral warehouse is currently invite-only (Request Access); the public developer surface today is the open-source Vortex ecosystem (Python and Rust bindings). Backed by Amplify Partners and General Catalyst.

It targets the traditionally manual, expertise-intensive process of writing optimized low-level accelerator code, operating at the CUDA and PTX level to fully exploit new hardware features rather than relying on higher-level abstractions, delivering better performance on compute-bound machine-learning workloads and newer accelerator architectures. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Felicis and added to the API Evangelist network; the company is early-stage and publishes no public API, developer portal, or specification at this time.

providers.description: StartEngine is a Los Angeles based online private-market investment platform that lets everyday investors buy equity in startups and pre-IPO companies, and lets founders raise capital under Regulation Crowdfunding, Regulation A+ and Regulation D. The company operates StartEngine Capital, its FINRA-registered funding portal; StartEngine Private, a fund vehicle for later-stage pre-IPO companies; a secondary marketplace for trading eligible private shares; and StartEngine Secure, an SEC-registered transfer agent and cap-table management service sold to issuers on a published monthly plan. StartEngine publishes no public developer API, SDK, webhook catalog or developer portal - its public engineering output is an internal design-system npm scope, agent examples, and Ethereum security-token standards work (the ERC-1450 reference implementation).

The developer surface was a client-side (browser and native player) delivery SDK distributed as video-player plugins (video.js, Clappr, hls.js, AVPlayer) rather than a server-side REST API. Streamroot was acquired by CenturyLink — now Lumen Technologies — in 2019 and folded into Lumen's CDN / Mesh Delivery product line. The standalone streamroot.io website and developer docs are offline; the surviving public assets are the (now Lumen-operated) GitHub organization and a set of official but deprecated npm player-plugin packages.

providers.description: Yield Protocol was a decentralized Ethereum protocol that brought fixed-rate, fixed-term borrowing and lending to DeFi via collateralized debt vaults and its YieldSpace automated market maker for fyTokens (fixed-yield tokens). Backed by Paradigm, the protocol reached a v2 implementation before winding down, and the yieldprotocol.com site now displays a closure notice. There is no REST/HTTP API surface; Yield Protocol is consumed on-chain through its Solidity smart contracts, with first-party developer libraries (vaults, interfaces, YieldSpace AMM, utility contracts) published to npm under the official @yield-protocol scope and source code maintained across the github.com/yieldprotocol organization. This profile was surfaced as a Paradigm portfolio company and enriched from public package and repository evidence.

providers.name: 858 Therapeutics
providers.description: 858 Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in San Diego, California, developing first-in-class and best-in-class small-molecule therapies that target tumor dependencies in DNA damage response (DDR) pathways. Its lead program, ETX-19477, is an oral, potent, and selective PARG (poly(ADP-ribose) glycohydrolase) inhibitor being evaluated in a Phase 1/2 study for patients with advanced solid tumors, exploiting cancer-cell vulnerabilities tied to replication stress and defects in replication-fork protection. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a clinical-stage therapeutics company it publishes a corporate and scientific web presence but no public developer, API, or documentation surface, so API artifacts are not applicable.

providers.name: Acornmed
providers.description: AcornMed Biotechnology Co., Ltd. (金橡医学) is a Beijing-headquartered precision-oncology company founded in 2018, with subsidiaries in Tianjin and Qingdao. It develops and operates next-generation-sequencing (NGS) diagnostics for solid tumors and hematologic malignancies — the AcornUI urine-based series for bladder, ureteral and renal-pelvic cancer rule-out and recurrence monitoring, AcornUPro-SEEK for prostate cancer screening, AcornOne 808 for solid tumors and AcornHema 521 for blood cancers — alongside CAP/ISO 15189 central-laboratory testing, companion-diagnostic co-development and real-world-data services for pharmaceutical partners. AcornMed is a clinical laboratory and IVD developer: it sells testing services to hospitals, physicians and pharma sponsors and publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Aculys
providers.description: Aculys Pharma, Inc. is a Japanese clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on neurological and psychiatric diseases where there is high unmet medical need. The company works to eliminate Japan's drug lag and drug loss by bringing innovative medicines already approved in Western markets to Japanese patients as early as possible. Its lead product is Spydia (diazepam nasal spray), Japan's first domestically developed intranasal anti-seizure agent, approved in June 2025 and administrable outside medical facilities. Originally funded by SoftBank Vision Fund (Series C, March 2025), Aculys was acquired by and became part of the Viatris Group in October 2025. Aculys publishes no public developer program, API, or technical documentation surface; this profile is maintained for network completeness and identity.

providers.name: Adient
providers.description: Adient is a global automotive seating supplier headquartered in Plymouth, Michigan. Spun off from Johnson Controls in 2016, Adient designs and manufactures seating systems for global automakers across passenger and commercial vehicles.

providers.name: aeonmed
providers.description: Beijing Aeonmed Co., Ltd. is a Chinese medical device manufacturer founded in 2001 and headquartered in Fengtai District, Beijing. Aeonmed researches, designs, and manufactures anesthesia and respiratory equipment for operating rooms and intensive care units, including anesthesia machines, ICU and emergency/transport ventilators, operating tables, surgical lights, ceiling pendants, patient monitors, infusion and syringe pumps, homecare CPAP/BiPAP devices, high-flow oxygen therapy, and digital OR/ICU system solutions. 61 of its products carry EU CE certification and its equipment is sold in more than 160 countries. In 2019 Aeonmed acquired HEYER Medical AG of Germany. The company is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. Aeonmed publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: Agamon Health
providers.description: Agamon Health is a healthcare AI company that improves imaging patient workflow management through automation across the continuum of care. Its Coordinate platform uses proprietary deep-learning natural language processing (NLP) models, trained on tens of millions of radiology reports, to automatically extract actionable findings from signed radiology reports, determine whether follow-up is needed, and capture modality, body part, and timeframe so radiology teams can automate patient communications, personalize outreach, and track follow-up adherence. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York City, Agamon has helped radiology teams increase productivity by up to 30 percent. The company was surfaced as a Seedcamp portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; it does not currently publish a public developer API, so this profile captures company identity and domain security rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Akara
providers.description: Akara is a healthcare automation company building AI-powered systems for the operating room and clinical environments. Its platform combines the Akara AI Sensor, a thermal-only computer-vision system that passively tracks surgical and procedure events without capturing identifiable patient data (named to TIME's Best Inventions list); the Akara AI Platform, which delivers real-time OR monitoring, automated alerts, interactive dashboards, analytics, and Clara, an AI chat assistant for exploring surgical data and optimizing scheduling; and the Akara UV Robot (Violet), a fully autonomous UV-C disinfection robot that generates 3D UV dose maps and disinfects occupied clinical spaces up to six times faster than manual cleaning. Akara is trusted by hospitals across Europe and the US. The company does not currently publish a public API or developer program; this profile tracks its identity and public web surface.

providers.name: Andie Swim
providers.description: Andie Swim (operating as Andie Co.) is a modern swimwear and essentials brand offering a wide range of swimwear, activewear, and lifestyle apparel. The company emphasizes inclusive sizing, high-quality materials, and a seamless online shopping experience with global shipping. Their website showcases collections, detailed product information, and a focus on comfort and confidence for all body types.

providers.name: Anyware Robotics
providers.description: Anyware Robotics builds and deploys advanced physical AI robots designed for the toughest industrial tasks. Their AnywareOS platform combines perception, motion planning, and autonomous decision‑making, allowing robots to collaborate safely with human workers, adapt to dynamic environments, and continuously learn from each operation. Solutions include palletizing, case picking, trailer loading, machine tending, and custom automation, all aimed at cutting labor costs, boosting productivity, and enhancing workplace safety across manufacturing, logistics, and warehousing sectors. The company also offers integration services, remote monitoring, and a developer ecosystem to extend robot capabilities.

providers.name: Arrakis
providers.description: Arrakis Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company pioneering RNA-targeted small molecules (rSMs) as a new class of genetic medicines. Its rSM platform enables orally available small molecules to bind RNA and modulate previously undruggable biological pathways, with an industrialized discovery toolkit spanning multiple modalities. The lead proprietary program targets Type 1 Myotonic Dystrophy (DM1) at the root cause of the disease, alongside a pipeline of proprietary and partnered programs. A GV (Google Ventures) portfolio company in the life-sciences sector, Arrakis was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it publishes a corporate and scientific website but no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Aspen Neuroscience
providers.description: Aspen Neuroscience is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing personalized regenerative cell therapies for Parkinson's disease. Its lead candidate, ANPD001, is an autologous induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived neuron replacement therapy that uses a patient's own cells to restore dopamine function without requiring immunosuppression, with manufacturing designed for scalable, reproducible production. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) and added to the API Evangelist network. It operates a corporate website only and publishes no public developer API, documentation, or specification surface at this time; artifact coverage here is limited to domain/identity signals.

providers.name: Athos Therapeutics
providers.description: Athos Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company in Torrance, California developing precision small-molecule therapeutics for autoimmune and chronic inflammatory diseases, led by co-founder and CEO Dr. Dimitrios Iliopoulos. Its AI/ML discovery platform integrates multi-omic patient data — genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, epigenomics, metabolomics and microbiomics — collected with global hospital systems to identify novel drug and gene targets, and produced ATH-063, an AI-generated G9A methyltransferase inhibitor advancing in inflammatory bowel disease. The computational side of the business is commercialized through Chiron AI Labs (formerly AthosOmics.AI), a deliberately no-code omics analysis SaaS suite (Athos-Multi, Athos-T, Athos-P, Athos-G, Athos-PM) that is pre-launch and gated behind a demo waitlist. Athos publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Auransa
providers.description: Auransa Inc. is a clinical-stage, AI-native biopharmaceutical company based in Palo Alto, California, founded in 2014 by Pek Lum. Auransa uses its proprietary SMarTR Engine — a hypothesis-free machine learning platform that mines human disease data such as RNA transcriptome and gene-expression profiles — to discover novel small-molecule therapeutics without starting from a predefined drug target. The company has analyzed more than 500,000 gene-expression profiles across roughly 70 diseases to identify molecular disease subtypes and match them to candidate compounds. Its lead program, AU-409, is a first-in-human Phase 1 candidate for liver cancer (hepatocellular carcinoma), with additional pipeline work in heart-safe chemotherapy and other oncology indications. Auransa is a DCVC / DCVC Bio portfolio company, also backed by Lux Capital, 11.2 Capital, and Harmonix Fund. Auransa is a private drug-discovery company and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or SDK; this profile captures its identity and web presence in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Auxos
providers.description: Auxos is an AI-powered customer research platform that builds 1:1 AI clones of a company's real customers to simulate how they respond to business decisions before those decisions ship. The company recruits and interviews real people matching a client's ideal customer profile, then models each participant as an always-on AI avatar grounded in that interview data. Teams use the resulting synthetic audience to test surveys, messaging, ad creative, pricing, and product flows and retrieve population-scale quantitative results plus qualitative commentary in minutes rather than the weeks traditional market research takes. Auxos is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) company founded by Ashton Daniel, Jerry Wu, and Kerry Lu, targeting marketing, product, and research teams. This profile is maintained by API Evangelist; as of enrichment Auxos publishes no public developer or API surface.
