providers.description: A collection of information retrieval and natural language APIs

providers.name: Balerion
providers.description: Balerion (Balerion AI) is a San Francisco-based agentic AI platform for mortgage loan origination, underwriting, and processing. Its flagship product, Loan Intelligence, is an agentic reasoning engine embedded directly into the origination workflow that automates the loan manufacturing lifecycle — complex high-precision income calculation, guideline validation, document checks, and identifying derogatory conditions in bank and credit data through underwriting and closing. The company raised a $6M seed round in April 2026 led by Kleiner Perkins with participation from Formation and BoxGroup, and was co-founded by CEO Naren Krishna (previously a founding member of Snowflake-acquired Ponder) and CTO Vishal Satish. Early customers include residential lender FM Home Loans. As of this profile Balerion publishes a marketing website only — no public API, developer portal, documentation, or SDKs are available.

providers.name: Bexorg
providers.description: Bexorg, Inc. is a New Haven, Connecticut and San Francisco based digital-biology company building AI-powered drug-discovery infrastructure for central nervous system (CNS) therapies. Its BrainEx platform restores and sustains whole donated human brains to test drug candidates directly in human tissue, generating clinically predictive data on blood-brain-barrier delivery, target engagement, and brain exposure across small molecules, biologics, viral vectors, and lipid nanoparticles before human trials. Backed by Amplify Partners, Bexorg aims to reduce the high failure rate of CNS clinical trials. The company markets a scientific platform and does not currently publish a public API, SDK, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Biotree
providers.description: Biotree (Shanghai Biotree Biomedical Technology, 百趣生物) is a Shanghai-based life-sciences company founded in 2012 that provides mass-spectrometry-driven metabolomics, proteomics, transcriptomics, and multi-omics products and services. It operates non-targeted and high-throughput targeted metabolomics platforms, single-cell and spatial omics, pharmaceutical protein characterization, clinical diagnostic test kits, and CDMO services, backed by a proprietary compound spectral library of 20,000+ standards, automated sample-preparation systems (Starlid), a LIMS, and the MAPS cloud analysis portal. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and profiled in the API Evangelist network. No public developer API or specification is published at this time.

providers.name: Bitacora.io
providers.description: Bitacora.io is a Mexican field-data and operations platform (a 500 Global / 500 LatAm Batch 14 startup) that helps deskless teams in construction, maintenance, and field services capture reports, photos, tasks, and events from the field. Its mobile and web apps work offline and sync to the cloud when connectivity returns, turning field activity into searchable records, PDF and Excel exports, map and gallery views, and real-time analytics dashboards for managers. Bitacora is a SaaS product rather than a developer-API company - it offers custom development, integrations, and KPI dashboards as professional services, but does not publish a public self-serve API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK.

providers.name: Bitcliq
providers.description: Bitcliq Technologies is a Portuguese software company that develops innovative digital solutions for the transport, fisheries and agri‑food industries. Their platform enables smarter food chains through real‑time data integration, traceability, and operational management for fleets and packaging. Bitcliq offers products such as Big Eye Smart Fishing and Lota Digital, serving national and international clients with cloud‑based services.

providers.name: Blackforestlabs01de
providers.description: Black Forest Labs (bfl.ai) is a frontier AI lab offering the FLUX model API. The site provides API documentation and an OpenAPI spec at https://api.bfl.ai/openapi.json.

providers.name: Bloomsbury
providers.description: Bloomsbury AI was a London-based natural-language-processing startup, backed by Seedcamp, that built Cape — an API making it easy to build software that answers questions about the contents of documents (machine reading / document question answering). Bloomsbury AI was acquired by Facebook in 2018; the hosted Cape API is terminated and bloomsbury.ai now serves only a farewell page. The team open sourced the Cape stack (web services, document QA, machine reader, and clients) under the bloomsburyai GitHub organization, which remains publicly available as archival source. This API Evangelist profile preserves that identity and the open-source footprint.

providers.name: Bondent (博恩登特)
providers.description: Bondent (博恩登特, Bondent Group / 博恩集团) is a Chinese oral-healthcare technology company that provides an integrated, digitalized platform and hardware for dental clinics. It develops and manufactures its own clinical equipment — oral CBCT / CT imaging (Bojue series), dental microscopes (Semorr), dental chairs (Bomesin), dental lasers (Doctor Smile), UDG endodontic/root-canal systems, intraoral digital impression scanners, and periodontal/implant and digital-orthodontics solutions — alongside the Edent clinic-management software and the "Bondent Cloud" (博恩云) app for dentists. The company pairs manufacturing with training academies (Bondent Academy / 博恩学苑, Star EMBA), operating eight factories, four solution families across ten product series, over a thousand employees, and serving more than 200,000 dentists. This API Evangelist profile was seeded as a qiming portfolio lead; no public developer or API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Bookend AI
providers.description: Bookend AI is a healthcare automation company building a Gastroenterology Practice Automation Platform that combines Payer Policy Intelligence with intelligent workflow automation. Its Universal Policy Library aggregates and interprets prior authorization, eligibility, benefits, and reimbursement requirements from hundreds of medical and pharmacy payers, and its Benefits, Coverage, and Authorization Assistants automate eligibility verification, coverage triage, and prior-authorization creation, submission, and tracking to reduce claim denials, accelerate care, and improve practice margins across specialty pharmacy, infusion, procedures, and imaging service lines. Bookend AI is a Seedcamp portfolio company; this API Evangelist profile was enriched from the company's public website.

providers.name: Boxbot
providers.description: Boxbot builds next-generation supply chain automation, making logistics operations more productive, intelligent, and resilient through automated, high-density dynamic storage that unlocks new AI-driven capabilities. Its platform is designed for mission-control fulfillment facilities: real-time space allocation packs variable-sized items densely, hands-free load/unload moves items onto and off proprietary storage trays linked to standard conveyors with no pick or load stations, and a modular, gantry-based architecture delivers a robust, fault-tolerant design with no single point of failure. Boxbot is a hardware/robotics company backed by Playground Global; it publishes a marketing presence but no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Buybox
providers.description: Buybox provides an omnichannel gift card solution for brands, enabling B2C and B2B gift card programs across Europe and beyond. Their platform offers integrated tools for distribution, analytics, and compliance, supporting multiple languages, currencies, and regulatory environments. The company emphasizes rapid international deployment, ROI guarantees, and deep integrations with major CMS, PSP, and POS systems, positioning itself as a strategic partner for brands seeking efficient customer acquisition through gift cards.

providers.name: cargo.one
providers.description: cargo.one is a Berlin-headquartered digital freight platform that operates as an AI-native operating system for air and ocean freight logistics. The platform unifies freight forwarder operations by centralizing rates, partners, and systems on a single end-to-end surface shared between human teams and AI agents. For freight forwarders, cargo.one provides air e-booking with 76+ integrated airlines (300+ total network), ocean freight rate management with 10+ liner integrations, multimodal quoting across air, ocean, road, and local charges, a Rate Management System for buy/sell/internal rates, a branded 24/7 self-service Customer Portal, analytics dashboards, a 24/7 Global Network for cross-timezone quoting, and an API Suite with native TMS integrations for CargoWise, Cargospot, and Descartes. For carriers, cargo.one delivers a market-intelligence and customer-access platform spanning the end-to-end commercial cycle. AI workflows are offered in three deployment modes — Co-pilot (approval-based), Supervised (autonomous with escalation), and Autonomous — covering rate management, rate procurement, quoting, booking, and customer support automation, backed by retrieval-augmented generation and a cargo.one MCP Server for custom solutions. Notable customers include Lufthansa Cargo, Kuehne+Nagel, DSV, Maersk, CMA CGM, Hellmann, and Rhenus Logistics. cargo.one's API and TMS integrations are partner / enterprise offerings — there is no public self-serve OpenAPI specification, developer sandbox, or open-source SDK published outside of customer onboarding.

providers.name: Crater Studios
providers.description: Crater Studios is an AI-native game studio that builds core AI systems for game design, decision making, and live operations, trained on real player behavior in production environments. The company uses its own live game launches as production laboratories, shipping titles such as Dwarven Realms, Gravebound, and Doomspire on Steam while building agentic tooling around them - a GDD Maker that turns raw concepts into production-ready game design documents, a conversational decision engine wired to live telemetry, automated playtesting agents, content moderation, and localization. Crater publishes a set of playable browser prototypes on craterstudios.ai subdomains as proof that its design agents can produce working core loops. Surfaced as an a16z portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass Crater Studios publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable specification - its AI systems are internal platform infrastructure rather than a developer product.

providers.name: Credit Agricole
providers.description: Credit Agricole is a leading French banking group offering a wide range of retail, corporate and investment banking services. It serves millions of customers through an extensive network of branches and digital channels, providing accounts, loans, payments, insurance and wealth management solutions. The group emphasizes innovation and digital transformation, supporting developers with online services and APIs across its financial ecosystem.

providers.name: Cure Genetics
providers.description: Cure Genetics (克睿基因) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company founded in 2016 and based in Suzhou, Jiangsu, China, developing cell and gene therapies for solid tumors and genetic diseases. Its differentiated pipeline is built on two proprietary platforms: AIMS CAR-NKT, a cell-therapy approach engineered to improve solid-tumor infiltration and modulate the tumor microenvironment, and VELP, an AAV (adeno-associated viral) vector technology targeting the nervous system, heart, and kidneys. Lead programs include CGC729, an anti-CD70 CAR-NKT therapy in Phase I trials for renal cell carcinoma, and CGC-602, a PD-1-IL-2v bispecific molecule for cancer immunotherapy. The company is backed by Qiming Venture Partners, Advantech Capital, and Oriza Holdings. It publishes no public API, developer platform, or technical documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record surfaced from the Qiming portfolio.

providers.name: Duolingo
providers.description: Duolingo (NASDAQ: DUOL) is a Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania based learning technology company best known for the Duolingo language-learning app, the world's most-downloaded education app, offering courses in more than 40 languages including Spanish, English, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, and Chinese. Founded in 2011 by Luis von Ahn and Severin Hacker, Duolingo has expanded its consumer learning footprint beyond languages with Duolingo Math, Duolingo Music, a newly rolled-out Chess course, and Duolingo ABC for early literacy, all delivered through the same gamified, streak- driven mobile experience. The Company also operates the Duolingo English Test, a digital English-proficiency exam accepted by thousands of higher- education institutions, certification programs, and government agencies worldwide as an alternative to TOEFL and IELTS. Duolingo monetizes through Super Duolingo and Duolingo Max subscriptions, in-app advertising, in-app purchases, and Duolingo English Test fees. The company surpassed 50 million daily active users in Q3 2025 and reported 41% revenue growth in Q2 2025. Duolingo does not publish an official public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; integrations with the Duolingo English Test (score-send to institutional CRMs such as Slate) are handled through a private API-key program negotiated directly with accepting institutions. Community- maintained reverse-engineered clients exist against the unofficial https://www.duolingo.com/api/1 surface but are not endorsed by Duolingo.

providers.name: Dwight Capital
providers.description: Dwight Capital LLC is a leading commercial real estate finance company in the United States, with a loan servicing portfolio exceeding $15 billion across all affiliates. The firm originates Balance-Sheet Bridge and New Construction Loans, FHA/HUD Insured Loans, C-PACE Financing, Mezzanine Financing, and Preferred Equity for multifamily, healthcare, and mixed-use commercial real estate. Headquartered in New York City with an additional office in Sunny Isles Beach, Florida, Dwight is consistently ranked among the top FHA/HUD multifamily lenders in the country and operates as a privately held business specializing in bridge-to-HUD execution for commercial real estate sponsors.

providers.name: Embark Veterinary
providers.description: Embark Veterinary is a canine genomics and biotechnology company that sells at-home dog DNA test kits for breed identification, ancestry, and genetic health screening. Using a cheek-swab sample and a proprietary genotyping platform that analyzes over 200,000 genetic markers, Embark reports 400+ breeds, 270+ genetic health conditions, allergy risk, coat and trait predictions, a relative finder, and a breeder dashboard with a Pair Predictor tool. Embark is a direct-to-consumer service delivered through its website, mobile apps, and a research partner program (Cornell University, NIH, Morris Animal Foundation). As of this review it does not publish a documented public or partner developer API; results are consumed through Embark's own web/app dashboards, and customers can download their dog's raw genetic data file for personal use and sharing.

providers.name: EpiBiologics
providers.description: EpiBiologics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in San Mateo, California, developing bispecific antibodies for directed extracellular protein degradation. Its proprietary EpiTAC platform leverages an atlas of 270+ degradation-inducing cell-surface receptors to build tissue-selective therapies that degrade disease-causing proteins while sparing healthy tissue, targeting cancer, autoimmune, and other serious diseases. The company dosed its first patient with EPI-326 (an EGFR-driven solid-tumor bispecific) in a Phase 1 study in April 2026 and closed a $107M Series B round in January 2026. Backed by GV, EpiBiologics was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead profile; it publishes a corporate website but no public developer/API surface.

providers.name: Fortive
providers.description: Fortive Corporation is a Fortune 500 diversified industrial technology conglomerate headquartered in Everett, Washington. The company operates across two main segments, Advanced Healthcare Solutions and Intelligent Operating Solutions, providing essential technologies for medical device safety, radiation protection, workflow automation, hazard detection, and predictive maintenance through its operating companies. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Fortive at the parent company level. Most APIs and developer resources are maintained by Fortive's individual operating companies.

providers.name: Friend
providers.description: Friend is an AI companion pendant — a sub-two-inch wearable with a microphone that pairs with a phone app and communicates back to the user via text messages rather than speech. Originally announced at $99, the product shipped (after delays) in 2025 at $129 in North America. Friend is a consumer hardware company with no public developer API, SDK, or partner program; only the consumer site, an app, and the Wikipedia / press coverage exist as references.

providers.name: Glorify
providers.description: Glorify is a Christian devotional and worship mobile application that helps people build a daily faith and wellbeing practice. The app delivers daily devotionals, Bible passages and inspirational quotes alongside guided meditations, prayer, sleep stories, worship music playlists, and audio courses led by theologians and authors, plus a community for connecting with other believers. Glorify also offers a physical wearable, the Glorify Ring. The company reports more than 20 million downloads and a 4.9-star average across over one million reviews, and is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). Glorify is a consumer application and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Hemnet
providers.description: Hemnet is Sweden’s leading online real‑estate marketplace, connecting home buyers with property listings across the country. The platform aggregates listings from real‑estate agents, providing detailed property information, photos, price history, and neighborhood data. Users can search, filter, and save favorite homes, while agents use Hemnet’s tools to showcase properties and reach a broad audience. Hemnet’s API enables developers to integrate property data into applications, offering endpoints for search, property details, and market statistics, supporting innovative real‑estate solutions and data‑driven insights.

providers.name: Hera
providers.description: Hera is a Medicare-covered care-management company that pairs families with dedicated senior-care experts (called "Heroes") to coordinate healthcare for aging parents. Heroes handle Medicare/Medicaid and insurance navigation, appointment and medical coordination, pharmacy and benefits administration, and ongoing chronic-care support, with most families paying $0 out of pocket because services are covered by Original Medicare. Founded by Jenny Lee after a personal family dementia-caregiving experience, Hera augments its human care coordinators with an internal AI platform ("Juno") and is backed by Accel and Bain Capital Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Hera operates a consumer (B2C) healthcare service and publishes no public developer portal, API, or specification surface, so the technical-artifact tiers of the enrichment pipeline are not applicable.

No public developer APIs are documented at this time.

providers.name: Inscinstech
providers.description: Inscinstech (Suzhou Inscinstech Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.) is a Chinese life-sciences instrumentation manufacturer serving the biopharmaceutical industry. It designs and builds equipment for oligonucleotide and nucleic-acid synthesis, chromatography and protein purification, tangential-flow filtration, bioreactors and cell culture, nanomedicine (LNP) preparation, high-pressure preparative liquid chromatography, peptide synthesis, and analytical instruments (HPLC, capillary electrophoresis, pumps and valves), spanning laboratory, pilot, and production scale. It also delivers end-to-end process solutions for oligonucleotide drugs, mRNA, peptides, and recombinant proteins. The company is backed by Qiming Venture Partners. It is a hardware and instruments provider and publishes no public developer API surface at this time; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Interlink
providers.description: interLink is an abstraction layer that extends the Kubernetes Virtual Kubelet interface, enabling pods to execute on remote resources such as HPC batch systems (SLURM, HTCondor), virtual machines, remote Kubernetes clusters, and serverless platforms. It comprises a Virtual Kubelet that converts pod execution requests into remote API calls and a modular interLink API Server with provider-specific sidecar plugins, with built-in OpenTelemetry observability, TLS/mTLS, and OAuth2 authentication.

providers.name: InventisBio
providers.description: InventisBio Co., Ltd. (Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market: 688382) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in the Pudong New Area of Shanghai, China, with operations in New Jersey, United States. Built on independent R&D capabilities, InventisBio discovers and develops innovative small-molecule and targeted therapies for oncology, autoimmune, and metabolic diseases to address unmet medical needs. The company has advanced multiple drug candidates into clinical trials, including late-stage Phase III programs in non-small cell lung cancer and breast cancer, alongside earlier-stage assets targeting KRAS G12C, synthetic-lethal pathways, hyperuricemia/gout, and plaque psoriasis. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. InventisBio is a research-driven pharmaceutical company and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

The company also offers connected welding solutions and equipment monitoring software for industrial environments.

providers.name: Lotus
providers.description: Lotus (Lotus Health AI) is a consumer healthcare company delivering AI-driven medical care backed by real physicians through an iOS app. The service offers an AI Doctor that analyzes a member's health, prescriptions sent to any U.S. pharmacy, lab orders across 6,000+ test sites, centralized medical-record storage, and 24/7 care. Founded by KJ Dhaliwal (CEO) and Zekka Nelson (CTO) with clinicians from UCLA Health, UCSF, and Johns Hopkins, and backed by CRV among others. As of this enrichment pass Lotus publishes no public developer/API surface: no developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI, well-known discovery, or security.txt were found. Only an end-user Intercom help center and a careers page are public.

providers.name: ManoMano
providers.description: ManoMano is Europe's leading online marketplace dedicated to DIY, home improvement and gardening, operating consumer storefronts across France, Germany, Italy, Spain and the United Kingdom plus a ManoManoPro offering for construction professionals and craftsmen. Founded in France and backed by Partech, it connects millions of DIY, tools, heating, electrical, kitchen, bathroom, flooring and garden products from thousands of third-party sellers and brands to individuals and trade buyers. This API Evangelist profile was added as a portfolio-company stub; enrichment found a consumer marketplace with a published llms.txt and help center, but no public developer, seller or partner API surface (no developer portal, OpenAPI, or API subdomain resolves).

providers.name: MDaaS Global
providers.description: MDaaS Global builds a modern, technology-powered healthcare network delivering affordable diagnostic and imaging services across underserved communities in Africa. Through its BeaconHealth Diagnostics clinics and BeaconHealth Affiliate Network — supported by the BeaconOS facility operating system and the Medverse sample-logistics platform — MDaaS has served 650,000+ patients across 25+ African cities with 1,300+ clinical partners. Headquartered in Lekki, Lagos, Nigeria and backed by Techstars, the company also provides public-health data and insights services. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; MDaaS publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Mevo
providers.description: Mevo is a Brazilian healthtech company whose stated mission is to "descomplicar a saúde" (simplify healthcare) through a digital platform that connects doctors, patients, and pharmacies. Its products include Mevo Receita Digital (electronic/digital medical prescriptions replacing paper scripts), and Mevo Farma / Mevo Dispensação (online medication purchase, dispensing, and partner-pharmacy fulfillment with delivery). Mevo sells to hospitals, health operators, clinics, and telemedicine platforms as a B2B partner. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation portal is currently published; this profile tracks the company in the API Evangelist network. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Matrix Partners and Prosus Ventures.

providers.name: National Institute of Food and Agriculture
providers.description: The National Institute of Food and Agriculture (NIFA) provides leadership and funding for programs that advance agriculture-related sciences. NIFA invests in and supports initiatives that ensure the long-term viability of agriculture, partnering with land-grant universities and the broader agricultural research community.

providers.name: National Institute of Mental Health
providers.description: The National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH) is the lead federal agency for research on mental disorders. NIMH conducts and supports research that seeks to understand, treat, and prevent mental illness, working to transform the understanding and treatment of mental illness.

providers.name: NBC
providers.description: NBC (National Broadcasting Company) is a major American commercial broadcast television network and a subsidiary of Comcast through NBCUniversal. NBC produces news (NBC News, Today), entertainment, late-night, and sports programming (Sunday Night Football, Olympic Games). NBC and parent company NBCUniversal do not publish a public developer portal. Programmatic advertising APIs (NBCUniversal One Platform) and streaming partner integrations (Peacock) are offered only through direct sales relationships rather than self-serve developer signup.

providers.name: Ndata
providers.description: nData (ndata.cz) is a European pharmaceutical software company operating since 2005 that builds GxP-compliant, AI-assisted systems for the pharma lifecycle: portfolio and project management (ePM), regulatory affairs (eRA), quality control planning (eQCP), artwork and packaging management (eAW), controlled documentation (eDOCS), clinical trial documentation / eTMF, plus eLAB (R&D lab operations), and eGO and eTRANSFER (launching Q3/2026). Its public web presence is a marketing and product-catalog site; nData publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or machine-readable specifications. Note: this repo was seeded as a bain-capital-ventures ai-infrastructure portfolio stub, but the ndata.cz surface is a pharmaceutical GxP software vendor — the portfolio match appears to be a mismatch.

providers.description: Nueclear Healthcare Limited, founded in 2011 and powered by Thyrocare, is one of India's leading cancer-diagnostics chains, operating a nationwide network of PET-CT and CT scan centres. It offers advanced whole-body, PSMA, DOPA, brain and bone PET-CT scans plus plain and contrast CT imaging for cancer diagnosis at affordable rates, with centres across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Lucknow, Nashik and Surat. Nueclear is a consumer diagnostic-imaging provider and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Nurotron
providers.description: Nurotron (Zhejiang Nurotron Neural Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. / 诺尔康) is a Hangzhou, China-based medical device manufacturer specializing in neural electrical stimulation. Its self-developed neural-prosthesis and neuromodulation product lines span auditory reconstruction (cochlear implants and speech processors such as the CS-10A/CS-20A/CS-30A implant bodies and Airum/NSP processors), visual reconstruction, urological and pelvic-nerve disease treatment, and brain neuromodulation. The company runs a corporate marketing and patient-support website with product, technical-support, rehabilitation-community, and news sections. It is a hardware medical-device company and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or machine-readable API surface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for tracking.

providers.name: Occamnetworks
providers.description: Occam Networks was a broadband access equipment vendor that developed and marketed systems enabling telecommunications carriers to profitably deliver emerging voice, video, and high-speed data (triple-play) services over copper and fiber, including its BLC 6000 access platform and ONT/ONU customer-premises hardware. The company was acquired by Calix in early 2011 and no longer operates independently. The occamnetworks.com domain currently serves an archived circa-2010 marketing site (products, solutions, support, news, whitepapers) with no developer program, API, SDK, or documentation surface. Enrichment found no API artifacts to harvest.

providers.name: Orca Bio
providers.description: Orca Bio is a late-stage biotechnology company, headquartered in Menlo Park, California with a cGMP manufacturing facility in Sacramento, developing high-precision allogeneic cell therapies for cancer and autoimmune diseases. Its single-cell sorting platform separates donor blood with high purity and speed to build proprietary, precisely-defined mixtures of immune and stem cells. Orca Bio's lead program TREGZI is a precision-engineered allogeneic T-cell immunotherapy for hematological malignancies, alongside investigational programs Orca-T and Orca-Q. As a clinical/therapeutics company it does not publish a public developer or API surface; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Felicis and enriched with verified company identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Organon
providers.description: Organon & Co. is a Fortune 500 global healthcare company focused on improving the health of women throughout their lives. Spun off from Merck in 2021, Organon's portfolio spans women's health, biosimilars, and established medicines across more than 140 markets worldwide. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Organon. No public developer APIs or documentation portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Peptone
providers.description: Peptone is a computational drug-discovery biotech building a Product Engine that targets intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs). It couples experimental measurement of disordered proteins in solution with enhanced-sampling simulation and generative machine-learning models to resolve transient, druggable pockets and design small-molecule drug candidates against them. Peptone describes its stack as an end-to-end Protein Engineering Operating System (PeOS); its open-source research tooling (protein-disorder prediction, ensemble generators, protein language models) is published on GitHub. Peptone is a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio company. No public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface was found during enrichment.

providers.description: Plan0 AI is a real estate construction technology company that applies AI to preconstruction cost estimation and design analysis. Its platform turns architectural drawings into detailed cost estimates and 3D models in roughly 30 minutes rather than the traditional two-week cycle, and adds automated takeoff and pricing, value-engineering scenario simulation, and predictive analytics. Plan0 AI serves real estate developers underwriting and making preconstruction design decisions, general contractors producing business- development estimates and cost forecasts, and investors validating pro-formas and benchmarking. Surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing and demo-booking website only, with no public API, developer documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Profusa
providers.description: Profusa, Inc. (Nasdaq: PFSA) is a South San Francisco digital-health and medical-device company that builds tissue-integrated biosensors — injectable, biologically compatible hydrogel microsensors smaller than a grain of rice — for continuous, real-time monitoring of body chemistry. Its Lumee Oxygen Platform reports tissue oxygen for peripheral artery disease, chronic wounds and reconstructive surgery, and a long-duration Lumee glucose sensor is in development. A companion Data Platform turns raw sensor readings into clinical intelligence for clinicians, with EMR integration described as planned rather than shipped. Profusa has received more than USD 23M in NIH and DARPA funding and became publicly traded in July 2025 through a business combination with NorthView Acquisition Corporation. As of this profiling pass the company publishes no developer program, no public API documentation and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.description: Relatable is a Product Relationship Management (PRM) platform for the medical technology and medical device industry, based in Nashville, Tennessee and backed by Techstars. Its Product Data Catalog centralizes competitive product intelligence, its Guided Purchase Solution turns that data into commercial insight, and 3rd-party data integrations sync external sources such as pricing intelligence. The platform serves contracting (RFP responses), sales (business reviews), marketing (competitive intelligence management), and technical support (product lookups). As of this enrichment pass Relatable publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, docs portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Rubedo Life Sciences
providers.description: Rubedo Life Sciences is a clinical-stage biotechnology company discovering and developing precision medicines that target the biological drivers of aging and age-related diseases. Its proprietary ALEMBIC drug-discovery platform identifies and validates senescent ("zombie") cells that accumulate with age and drive chronic disease, enabling the design of selective senolytic therapeutics. The company's lead candidate, RLS-1496, is a first-in-class selective GPX4 modulator that has produced positive Phase 1 dermatology results (plaque psoriasis, atopic dermatitis, skin aging) and Phase 1b/2a data in actinic keratosis. Rubedo is backed by Khosla Ventures and operates as a therapeutics company rather than a software/API provider — this profile carries no developer or API surface.

providers.name: SaRA Health
providers.description: SaRA Health is a healthcare technology company that helps physical therapy, occupational therapy, orthopedic, and pain management practices engage patients between appointments through personalized SMS check-ins. The platform automates Remote Therapeutic Monitoring (RTM) by identifying eligible patients inside browser-based Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems, sending injury- and care-plan-specific text-message check-ins, and handling the associated billing and denial management for RTM CPT codes such as 98975, 98977, and 98980-98981. SaRA Health reports a 65% average patient engagement rate and operates on an "Effector Model" in which its revenue is tied to client success. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Shibboleth Consortium
providers.description: Shibboleth Consortium is a non-profit organization that supports the development, maintenance, and promotion of the Shibboleth open‑source software suite for federated identity and single sign‑on. It provides governance, community coordination, and resources for the Shibboleth Identity Provider, Service Provider, and related tools, ensuring long‑term sustainability and interoperability across academic, research, and enterprise environments.

providers.name: Shinehe (Hangzhou Xinzeyuan Medical Technology)
providers.description: Shinehe (Hangzhou Xinzeyuan Medical Technology Co., Ltd. / 杭州鑫泽源医疗科技有限公司) is a Hangzhou, China based contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) for the minimally invasive medical device sector. Founded in 2015, the company provides precision component manufacturing, customized development, and OEM/ODM services covering endoscope accessories (insertion, operation, and light guide components), single-use consumables (hemostasis, biopsy, EMR, dilation), rigid endoscope components, and minimally invasive surgical instruments, aiming to be a global minimally invasive medical device supply-chain platform. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. No public API, developer portal, or SDK surface was found during enrichment; this profile is maintained as a company identity record.

providers.name: SonoThera
providers.description: SonoThera, Inc. is a privately held, clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered at 201 Haskins Way in South San Francisco, California, founded in 2022 to make genetic medicine deliverable without a viral vector. Its RIPPLE platform pairs an intravenously administered lipid-and-microbubble formulation with an externally applied diagnostic ultrasound probe: the acoustic energy transiently permeabilizes cell membranes in the targeted organ so a nucleic-acid payload enters only where the probe is pointed, an approach built on the roughly 35 million ultrasound contrast-agent doses given safely each year in cardiac imaging. A companion payload engineering platform, PORE, carries DNA and RNA constructs, gene editing and gene silencing cargo of varied size and format. The company holds an exclusive license to GE HealthCare's Optison and Sonazoid microbubble products for use with the platform, and has raised approximately $186 million — a $60.75 million Series A and an oversubscribed $125 million Series B — from ARCH Venture Partners, Johnson & Johnson, Illumina Ventures and Eli Lilly, to push lead programs in Duchenne muscular dystrophy and autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease into the clinic, with preclinical work in Alport syndrome and hemophilia A. It was co-founded by Kenneth Greenberg (CEO), Steve Feinstein (Chief Scientific Officer) and Michael H. Davidson (Executive Chairman). SonoThera sells therapeutics, not software: it runs no developer program, publishes no API, SDK or machine-readable specification, and maintains no public source-code organization.

providers.name: Source.dev
providers.description: Source.dev builds AI-native software tooling that helps device manufacturers develop, build, and update the operating systems that run intelligent devices such as smartphones and electric vehicles. Its platform virtualizes source access (SourceFS) to cut Android checkout-and-build times from hours to minutes, replays build steps across languages and systems for faster CI, and uses LLM-driven merging (Harmony AI / Continuous Merges) to automatically resolve conflicts when applying security patches and OS upgrades to large, long-lived codebases like AOSP. The company is a sales/demo-led platform for device makers and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or self-serve documentation surface.

providers.name: Stone Ridge
providers.description: Stone Ridge (Stone Ridge Asset Management) is an alternative asset manager founded in 2012 that manages approximately $35 billion across "True Alternatives" — investment strategies designed to be uncorrelated with traditional stocks and bonds — including reinsurance, energy, alternative lending, single-family rentals, opportunistic credit, art, LifeX longevity income, and bitcoin. It is the parent of the digital-asset firm NYDIG and is backed by Ribbit Capital. Stone Ridge serves institutional investors, wealth professionals, and insurance companies and operates a private, authenticated investor/client portal (connect.stoneridgeam.com) rather than a public developer API. As of this enrichment pass no public API, SDK, OpenAPI, or developer documentation surface was found for the firm.

providers.name: Stream
providers.description: Czech internet television, films, series and online videos for free

providers.name: Susquehanna International Group (SIG)
providers.description: Susquehanna International Group (SIG) is a privately held global quantitative trading firm founded in 1987 by a group of college friends who began trading on the Philadelphia Stock Exchange, leveraging quantitative skills and poker-derived decision science. Headquartered in Bala Cynwyd, Pennsylvania, the firm employs more than 3,500 people across 17+ offices worldwide and operates as one of the largest options market makers globally. SIG's businesses span Quantitative Trading, Predictions, Institutional Sales, Growth Equity (Susquehanna Growth Equity / SGE), Sustainable Investments, Asia-focused Venture Capital (notably an early and large stake in ByteDance), and the River's Edge promotional arm. SIG does not operate a public developer portal, expose external trading APIs, or publish open-source repositories under a public GitHub organization; all technology is internal to the trading and quantitative research platform. Public surface is limited to sig.com (company / careers / insights), the SGE site, and corporate communications.

providers.name: SVAcademy
providers.description: SV Academy is a tech-sales training and talent-placement organization that runs an intensive Sales Development Representative (SDR) program and places pre-trained, job-ready graduates with employers at no placement fee. It has trained more than 6,000 graduates across the U.S. and Canada and is a portfolio company of 500 Global. SV Academy serves two audiences — job seekers who complete the SDR training program with no prior experience or degree required, and employers who hire and onboard vetted, pre-trained SDR talent. The organization publishes no public developer API surface at this time; this profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from SV Academy's public web presence.

providers.name: Swiftlane
providers.description: Swiftlane is a San Francisco-based physical security company providing cloud-based access control and video intercom systems for multifamily residential and commercial buildings. Its touchless, mobile-first platform combines face recognition, mobile and key-card credentials, visitor PIN access, vehicle readers, smart locks, and a centralized cloud management dashboard with access logs, user management, and remote unlock. Swiftlane publishes a customer product site, a large blog, and an Intercom-hosted help center, but exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or webhooks; integrations are delivered through partners such as Okta, Azure, Google Workspace, and Eagle Eye.

providers.name: Talofa Games
providers.description: Talofa Games is a mobile game developer and publisher backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). The studio builds social fitness games that turn real-world physical activity into cooperative multiplayer play. Its flagship title, Run Legends, is a free-to-play running RPG available on iOS and Android in which players' real-world runs and walks power team battles against monsters, and its newer title Monster Walk is in closed beta. Talofa Games is a consumer mobile-gaming company and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity and public web presence rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Teleradiology Solutions
providers.description: Teleradiology Solutions is a pioneer remote radiology reporting provider serving healthcare facilities across the USA and India. Services include emergency nighthawk coverage, subspecialty and elective reporting, 3D imaging and post-processing, quality-assurance overreads, clinical-trial imaging, and AI-enabled RIS-PACS workflow (via subsidiary Telerad Tech). Surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners. No public developer API surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Tellabs
providers.description: Tellabs is a networking infrastructure vendor focused on Passive Optical LAN (OLAN) and broadband access for enterprises, government, and service providers. Its portfolio includes the Passive Optical LAN solution, the Tellabs 1000 MSAP broadband digital loop carrier converging legacy copper and fiber, and the Tellabs Panorama Element/Integrated Network Manager (EMS/INM) for SDN-style management of optical LANs. Tellabs also runs a Technical Assistance Center, professional services, training, and a partner program. As of this enrichment pass, Tellabs publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API specification; its Panorama products reference a North Bound Interface (NBI) for back-office automation, but no OpenAPI/Swagger or public API documentation is available.

providers.name: Tessera Therapeutics
providers.description: Tessera Therapeutics is an early-stage life sciences company, founded and backed by Flagship Pioneering, pioneering Gene Writing — a new category of genetic medicine designed to write therapeutic messages into the genome to treat and potentially cure disease at its source. Its Gene Writing platform uses mobile genetic elements delivered via lipid nanoparticles to insert genes and exons, make small insertions and deletions, or change single or multiple DNA base pairs, with applications spanning sickle cell disease, in vivo CAR-T, HIV, and other monogenic, metabolic, autoimmune, and neurodegenerative diseases. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a health-tech portfolio lead; Tessera is a therapeutics developer and does not currently publish a public developer or API surface.

providers.description: A time series analysis API

providers.description: Deutsche Bahn (DB) API

providers.name: Transport for Hessen, Germany
providers.description: RMV API (Public Transport in Hessen)

providers.name: Truvio
providers.description: Truvio is a unified software portfolio company providing intelligent, AI-driven automation solutions for Microsoft Dynamics 365 across finance, operations, Business Central, and commerce. Its practitioner-built solutions span Accounts Payable automation (ExFlow), Banking & Treasury automation (SKSoft), eCommerce and Product Information Management (DynamicWeb), and Project & Production Management (Axtension), embedding expertise directly into Dynamics 365 to help organizations close the ERP value gap. Backed by Insight Partners. No public developer/API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Unconventional AI
providers.description: Unconventional AI (unconv.ai) is rethinking the foundations of the computer to optimize energy efficiency for AI, working to bring biology-scale efficiency to artificial intelligence through analog, dynamical-system hardware co-evolved with neural software. Founded by experts in AI systems, analog circuits, computing theory, and neuroscience, and backed by Felicis, the company publishes research including the Un-0 image-generation model built on coupled Kuramoto oscillators and an instruction set architecture for dynamical-system hardware, but does not yet publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Unleashed Games
providers.description: Unleashed Games is an independent game studio founded by industry veterans (World of Warcraft, Medal of Honor, Monopoly Go!) and backed by a16z Speedrun, building socially-driven cooperative games. Its flagship title Haven is a cross-platform co-op RPG for families and friends spanning PC, Mac, console, and mobile, with procedurally generated maps, village building, and collaborative combat. The studio publishes no public developer platform or API surface today.

providers.name: Unplugg
providers.description: Forecasting API for timeseries data

providers.name: Uxin
providers.description: Uxin (优信) is a Chinese used-car e-commerce company backed by DCM Ventures. It operates the xin.com consumer used-car retail marketplace and the Youxinpai (优信拍) B2B online used-car auction and trading platform that connects dealers with buyers, including vehicle listings, auctions, logistics, and post-sale services. Uxin publishes no public developer portal or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: VANCL
providers.description: VANCL (凡客诚品) is a Chinese direct-to-consumer online apparel brand founded in October 2007 that sells its own-brand men's wear, women's wear, shoes, children's clothing, and home goods through vancl.com and official storefronts on Tmall, JD.com, Douyin, and Youzan. Once China's leading independent B2C fashion retailer, VANCL publishes no public API or developer platform today — its legacy open-platform hosts (open.vancl.com, api.vancl.com) no longer respond. Surfaced as a Qiming Venture Partners portfolio company in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Vayu Robotics
providers.description: Vayu Robotics is a Palo Alto, California robotics company building AI foundation models and sensing for autonomous mobile robots. Its stack spans Vayu Drive, an end-to-end learned, sim-first foundation model for mobility; Vayu Sense, a plenoptic sensor with embodied AI for high-resolution depth perception; a Vayu Sense Development Kit bundled with NVIDIA Orin; and Vayu One, a low-cost autonomous delivery robot for last- and middle-mile delivery. Backed by Khosla Ventures, the company was acquired by Serve Robotics in September 2025. Enrichment probing found no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or event surface.

providers.name: Venostent
providers.description: VenoStent is a clinical-stage medical device company based in Houston, Texas, developing SelfWrap, a bioabsorbable perivascular wrap designed to reduce arteriovenous (AV) access-site failures in chronic kidney disease patients requiring hemodialysis. The company combines biomedical engineering, materials science, and medical 3D printing to improve the maturation and durability of dialysis access, where an estimated 50-60% of access sites fail within the first year. SelfWrap holds FDA Breakthrough Device Designation (2022) and is being evaluated in a 200-subject US clinical trial. VenoStent is backed by Norwest Venture Partners, IAG Capital, and Y Combinator, with additional support from the NSF and NIH. This is a medical device / healthcare company with no public API or developer surface; profiled in the API Evangelist network for portfolio and market context.

providers.name: Virushee
providers.description: Virushee file/data scanning

providers.name: Vista
providers.description: Vista AI is a Redwood City, California medical technology company building AI-powered software that automates cardiac and general MRI acquisition. Its FDA-cleared Vista AI Scan product lets technologists of varying skill levels perform high-quality, standardized MRI exams across multiple hospital sites without on-site specialists, claiming faster scan times, more available scan slots, and reduced imaging backlogs. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Khosla Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a product/marketing website only — there is no public API, developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer surface to catalog.

providers.name: Vitesse
providers.description: Vitesse is a universal physical-AI platform for industrial machines, founded by the team behind Tesla's "Model 3 automation hell" fix alongside leaders from SpaceX, Siemens, and Safran. It connects any machine - Siemens, Allen-Bradley, Fanuc, KUKA, ABB, and legacy PLCs - through 135 native OT connectors, generates control logic from a natural-language description of a process (up to 15x faster than traditional PLC programming), and runs the full stack at the edge on purpose-built industrial controllers with no cloud required. The platform layers hardware, live data dashboards and SCADA views, interoperability, physical AI, and zero-trust OT/IT cybersecurity (NIS2 and NIST aligned) into one stack, with real-time browser-based monitoring across 800,000+ machine hours. The company traded as Full Speed Automation and renamed to Vitesse Automation after acquiring Niagara Tech; the legacy fullspeedautomation.com domain no longer resolves over TLS. Vitesse exposes a marketing website and a login-gated product application at app.vitesse.dev; as of August 2026 it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL specification, SDK, webhooks, developer portal, or pricing page, and serves no /.well-known discovery documents.

providers.name: Vsim
providers.description: Vsim (Vsim Technology Ltd) is a Manchester, UK physics-simulation startup founded in 2022 by ex-NVIDIA simulation engineers Michelle Lu (CEO) and Kier Storey (CTO). The company builds a next-generation physics simulation platform and an end-to-end reinforcement-learning training framework for robotics, reporting up to 100x training performance speed-ups over existing solutions, with applications across robotics, AI, visual effects, aerodynamics, gaming, and e-commerce. Vsim raised a $21.5M seed round led by EQT Ventures (total ~$24M). It does not currently publish a public API or developer program.

providers.name: XING Mobility
providers.description: XING Mobility (行競科技) is a Taiwan-based battery technology company building immersion-cooled lithium battery systems under the IMMERSIO brand, including cell-to-pack (CTP) battery platforms, battery backup units (BBU) for AI data centers, and the automotive-grade XBE energy storage series, serving electric mobility, energy storage (ESS), marine, and data center markets from its Taoyuan City headquarters. A 500 Global portfolio company, XING Mobility publishes no public developer API or API documentation as of July 2026.

providers.name: Zypl
providers.description: Zypl (zypl.ai) is an AI company building synthetic-data and machine-learning technology for financial services and government. Its core is proprietary zGAN generative synthetic-data technology, delivered through Lucid, a no-code platform for developing and deploying robust scoring models. Products include zScore for credit decisioning, plus fraud detection, collection scoring, and IFRS-9/GAAP-compliant provisioning for credit-loss estimation. Zypl serves banks, financial institutions, and public-sector entities, and operates an R&D lab (zehnlab.ai). It is backed by Prosus Ventures. Zypl publishes no public developer/API surface at this time; this profile carries verified identity and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Affy MedTech
providers.description: Affy MedTech is a UK- and Netherlands-based health technology company behind Lynx, a modular, cloud-hosted platform for hospitals and healthcare delivery organisations that consolidates authoritative treatment information, patient booking, electronic medical records, clinical documentation, billing and claims validation, reporting, remote diagnostics and ambulatory ECG into a single system. Its Patient Interaction Module gives patients access to their own records, prescriptions, diagnostic images and treatment plans with self-service booking, digital consent and online payment, while the Super Switch Module acts as a real-time integration bridge between hospital systems such as radiology, laboratory and billing. The platform is marketed alongside Total Doctor / Total Health and is deployed by international hospital groups as well as smaller clinics and specialist centres. Affy MedTech is a Silver Industry Partner of openEHR International and operates alongside Vertice Software Solutions, which publishes Lynx in other markets. AFFY MEDTECH UKI LTD (company number 17000777) was incorporated in England on 30 January 2026 and is controlled by Affy Medtech B.V. of Amsterdam. As of September 2026 affymedtech.com serves only a "Coming Soon" placeholder and the company publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Alpha Biopharma
providers.description: Alpha Biopharma is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Shanghai, China, with an additional office in Beijing. The company focuses on the clinical development and commercialization of global innovative drugs across oncology and immunotherapy, spanning medical affairs, clinical operations, regulatory affairs and commercialization. Its lead product is Zorifertinib (formerly AZD-3759, marketed as Zorifer), a next-generation EGFR TKI designed for EGFR mutation positive advanced NSCLC patients with central nervous system metastases, which received NMPA approval in November 2024 as the first EGFR-TKI indicated for lung cancer with brain metastases. Alpha Biopharma also partners with Wugen Inc. on universal off-the-shelf memory NK and CAR-T cell therapies. The company raised a Series A led by Qiming Venture Partners. Alpha Biopharma publishes a corporate marketing website only and operates no public API, developer portal, or software platform.

providers.name: AltoTech Global
providers.description: AltoTech Global is a Bangkok-based energy-management technology company building an AI and IoT (AIoT) platform that optimizes energy consumption and reduces carbon emissions across smart buildings. Its Alto CERO air-side and water-side products autonomously tune HVAC, VRF, and chiller-plant systems based on real-time occupancy and conditions, while Alto Digital Twin, Alto Multi-Property, and AltoACE deliver spatial building intelligence, centralized multi-site energy tracking, and AI-assisted facility engineering. Backed by 500 Global, AltoTech serves offices, malls, hotels, banks, and government facilities across Southeast Asia to help accelerate the net-zero economy.

providers.name: Alva Energy
providers.description: Alva Energy is a nuclear technology company rewriting the economics of nuclear deployment to deliver gigawatts of clean power in years, not decades. Rather than building new reactors, Alva productizes capacity upgrades ("uprates") for the existing U.S. reactor fleet: the Alva Uprate combines advanced steam generators with improved heat transfer, a second turbine plant (2TGP) sited outside the protected area, and the DUO-SYNC digital control system, adding roughly 250-300 MWe per reactor as a fixed-price, turnkey project deployable in under two years and targeting 10 GWe across the fleet. The company launched in February 2026 with $33 million in funding led by Playground Global to meet surging power demand from AI and industrial load. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of playground-global and added to the API Evangelist network; Alva Energy publishes a marketing and news presence but no public developer, API, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Amberstone Biosciences
providers.description: Amberstone Biosciences Inc. discovers transformative immunotherapeutics, focusing on tumor‑activated T‑MATE™ technology to develop precise, safe cancer treatments. The company pioneers next‑gen immunotherapies that trigger immune responses only in tumors, minimizing harm to healthy tissue. Their pipeline spans innovative antibody‑drug conjugates and novel biologics aimed at solid tumors, leveraging proprietary platforms to unlock therapeutic potential previously deemed undruggable.

providers.name: Astral Systems
providers.description: Astral Systems is a fusion-technology company based in Bristol, United Kingdom, developing Multi-State Fusion (MSF) reactors that produce high-flux neutron sources on demand. Co-founded by Talmon Firestone (CEO) and Dr. Tom Wallace-Smith (CTO), the company applies compact, modular fusion to near-term problems: large-scale medical isotope production to address the global isotope shortage affecting cancer diagnosis and treatment, spent fission fuel analysis, neutronics research, industrial neutron irradiation and accelerated lifetime testing, materials-damage testing, nuclear-waste burnup, and hybrid fission/fusion power. It is a Speedinvest deep-tech portfolio company. Astral Systems is a hardware/deep-tech provider and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specifications.

providers.name: Ateios
providers.description: Ateios Systems is an Indianapolis-based advanced battery manufacturer that produces high-energy, recyclable, PFA-free battery electrodes for global battery makers. Its proprietary RaiCure platform is a solvent-free, cure-on-command coating process using energy-curable polymers instead of solvent-based thermal drying, enabling thicker electrodes (>10 mAh/cm2), higher energy density, and roughly 5x faster coating throughput at lower cost and emissions. Ateios targets medical device, IoT, mobility, and defense markets. Founded in 2017 and backed by Techstars, TitletownTech, Good Growth Capital and others, the company is a materials/hardware manufacturer and publishes no developer API, SDK, or programmatic developer platform.

providers.name: Aumet
providers.description: Aumet is a MENA-based healthtech company building an AI-first procurement and pharmacy operating system for healthcare. Its platform connects pharmaceutical manufacturers, distributors, and pharmacies through a B2B marketplace and a suite of pharmacy software: Pulse (point-of-sale, inventory, and smart reordering for individual pharmacies), Chain (multi-branch pharmacy management), and Enterprise (solutions for government health systems and hospitals). The platform adds AI-powered demand forecasting, procurement automation, price transparency, and analytics, and reports serving 12,000+ pharmacies and 1,000+ suppliers across Jordan, Egypt, and Saudi Arabia with over $1B in gross merchandise value and millions of transactions annually. Aumet is backed by 500 Global and Techstars.

providers.name: Backline
providers.description: Backline Musician Services Inc. provides professional musicians, bands, and studios with high‑quality music equipment rentals. Since 1995, they offer a vast selection of instruments, amplifiers, keyboards, percussion, and accessories, delivering, setting up, and striking gear for concerts, festivals, and events across Canada.

providers.name: Beyond Imagination
providers.description: Beyond Imagination, Inc. is a Los Angeles based robotics and artificial intelligence company founded in January 2018 by Dr. Harry Kloor and Dr. Ray Kurzweil, building general-purpose humanoid robots and the AI software stack that runs them. Its flagship platform is Beomni, a wheeled humanoid robot with an articulated upper body and dexterous hands that can be teleoperated through VR headsets and haptic gloves or run autonomously. The software side is marketed as four products: AURA (Adaptive Unified Robotic/Human Administrator), a universal operating system for coordinating robots, humans and infrastructure across manufacturing ecosystems; ARCANA, an LLM-free synthetic brain architecture for real-time perception, decision making and coordination; Expert Minds, modular AI job modules trained for specialized roles such as chemical handling, bio-reactor operation, surgical prep and warehouse logistics; and Hive Mind Intelligence, a fleet learning layer where robots upload new skills to a shared cloud memory. The company has run pilot programs in commercial kitchens, laboratory work, healthcare and pharmaceutical manufacturing, and announced a manufacturing partnership with Korean electronics manufacturer Dreamtech. As of this profiling pass Beyond Imagination publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable API contract, SDKs or MCP/agent surface; its public web presence is a marketing site only.

providers.name: Byteboard
providers.description: Byteboard is a technical interview platform for software engineering hiring. It replaces traditional whiteboard interviews with project-based, real-world assessments and live coding interviews that measure practical skills such as systems design, code quality, and communication across 20+ engineering competencies. Candidate work is anonymized and evaluated by trained human graders against calibrated rubrics to reduce bias and interviewer time while improving hire quality. Founded to fix the false positives, prep burden, and inequities of conventional coding interviews, Byteboard integrates with applicant tracking systems (Greenhouse) and is now part of Karat. Byteboard exposes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures its company identity, web properties, domain security posture, and compliance program.

providers.name: Car Capital Technologies
providers.description: Car Capital Technologies provides technology solutions for automotive financing and capital management. The company focuses on delivering software platforms that enable lenders and dealers to streamline loan origination, underwriting, and portfolio management. Their services include data analytics, risk assessment tools, and integration capabilities for third‑party financial services. As a participant in the secondary‑market ecosystem, Car Capital Technologies aims to improve efficiency and transparency in automotive capital flows.

providers.name: Claira
providers.description: Claira is an AI-driven platform that streamlines private market investment analysis and decision-making. Founded in 2018 and based in New York City, it offers an agentic AI system to capture, organize, preserve, and analyze institutional knowledge, accelerating deal flow for financial institutions and investors. Backed by leading investors, Claira provides tools for deal management, data extraction, and workflow automation across the private markets.

providers.name: Clarametyx Biosciences
providers.description: Clarametyx Biosciences is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing novel immune‑enabling therapies targeting bacterial biofilms that drive chronic respiratory diseases such as cystic fibrosis. The company advances its pipeline through pre‑clinical and early‑stage clinical programs, aiming to modify disease progression rather than merely alleviate symptoms. Recent announcements include positive topline data from a Phase 2a study of CMTX‑101 and significant Series A financing to accelerate development.

providers.name: Clinc
providers.description: Clinc is a conversational AI platform for banking and financial services, founded in 2015 in Ann Arbor, Michigan. It provides the Natural Language Understanding (NLU), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Natural Language Generation (NLG) engine behind virtual assistants and chatbots, and is ASR/TTS-agnostic so it can be connected to phone, mobile, web, or smart-speaker devices. Once a user utterance is converted to text, Clinc's AI engine interprets intent and calls the appropriate third-party systems (such as an external database) to answer or carry out an action. Clinc has been deployed with customers including USAA, Ford, Barclays, and İşbank, and is backed by Insight Partners, Drive Capital, and eLab Ventures. NOTE — Clinc's public developer surface (clinc.com and api.clinc.com) is offline as of 2026-07-18: the clinc.com AWS Route53 delegation is dangling and its authoritative nameservers return REFUSED, so the domain resolves SERVFAIL everywhere. The documentation and API URLs recorded here are the genuine published locations, recoverable via the Internet Archive.

providers.name: Countly
providers.description: Countly web analytics

providers.name: Daqstra
providers.description: Daqstra is an AI-native operating platform for complex test infrastructure, giving aerospace, energy, and robotics teams observability and orchestration for the physical world. The platform connects data-acquisition hardware (National Instruments, PLCs, and custom equipment) at the edge, centralizes and versions test data in the cloud, and orchestrates hardware sequences and test logic as code through Python and REST APIs. Daqstra Edge streams live signals from physical hardware, Daqstra Hub (Strata Hub) organizes test-campaign data with AI-powered insight, and the Daqstra API lets engineers drive test runs programmatically instead of through manual CSV workflows. The company was founded by aerospace-propulsion and avionics engineers and is backed by Y Combinator (S26 batch).

providers.name: Doc Doc
providers.description: Doc Doc (DOCDOC, Inc.) is a Latin American telemedicine platform offering online medical consultations by chat and video across more than 20 specialties, including pediatrics, gynecology, nutrition, psychology, cardiology, dermatology, orthopedics, and general practice. It serves individual patients, healthcare professionals, and companies running employee wellbeing programs, and delivers its consumer product through the app at app.doc-doc.com. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs; enrichment found only the marketing site and the patient app.

providers.name: Docker Swarm
providers.description: Native clustering and orchestration solution for Docker containers that turns a pool of Docker hosts into a single virtual host. Docker Swarm enables deploying applications across multiple machines and provides high availability and load balancing for containerized workloads.

providers.name: Dockerfile
providers.description: A text file that contains instructions for building Docker container images, defining the application environment, dependencies, and configuration in a reproducible way. Dockerfiles accelerate software delivery cycles and improve collaboration between development and operations teams.

providers.name: Domtar
providers.description: Domtar is committed to turning responsibly sourced wood fiber into essential products like paper, pulp, recycled packaging, tissue, and lumber. No public developer-facing APIs have been identified at this time; this index will be updated if any are made available.

providers.name: Doxel
providers.description: Doxel is a Menlo Park, California construction technology company providing AI-powered observability and progress tracking for large capital projects. Founded in 2015 by CEO Saurabh Ladha, the company combines 360-degree reality capture (via Insta360 X5 hardware partnership) with computer vision models that compare site video against BIM models to automatically quantify work-in-place by trade, system, and stage. The platform layers a "rules of credit" engine on top of those quantities to drive earned-value, schedule, and budget analytics — including 3D Progress View, Production Rates, Schedule (a visual Gantt replacement), Utilities Underground Tracking from drone imagery, and Portfolio-level dashboards. Doxel uses advanced language models to map schedule line items to physical progress and supports Procore-style construction management workflows, with deployments across data centers, healthcare, semiconductor fabs, and EV battery factories. Doxel has raised approximately $57M from Insight Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, and others, and counts 18 of the top 30 U.S. general contractors, 14 of the top 20 data center developers, and 3 of 4 hyperscalers as customers. There is no public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, or GitHub organization — the platform is delivered as a managed SaaS application at app.doxel.ai with hardware-assisted capture and enterprise integrations arranged via direct engagement.

providers.name: Duane Morris
providers.description: Duane Morris LLP is a Philadelphia-headquartered, full-service U.S. and international law firm founded in 1904 by Russell Duane, Steven Heckscher, and Roland S. Morris. Chaired by Matthew A. Taylor, the firm describes itself as "a law firm with more than 900 attorneys in offices across the United States and internationally" — with a U.S. footprint spanning the East Coast, Texas, the Mountain West, and California, plus international offices in London, Singapore, Vietnam (Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City), Shanghai, Myanmar, and joint ventures/alliances reaching Mexico and Latin America. An Am Law 100 firm since 2001, Duane Morris is known for depth in intellectual property (including patent prosecution and PTAB practice), trial and appellate litigation, real estate, corporate transactions, employment, healthcare, cannabis, and life sciences. The firm publishes an extensive LexBlog-powered thought-leadership network of more than 50 practice-area blogs, all of which expose RSS 2.0 feeds via the standard WordPress /feed/ convention. Duane Morris does not expose any public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI spec, GraphQL endpoint, webhooks, status page, or developer portal; the GitHub organization github.com/duanemorris exists but has no public repositories. The firm's only machine-readable surfaces are the RSS feeds of its blog network.

providers.name: EFEX (Ventu)
providers.description: EFEX (efex.com, formerly efexpay.com) is a cross-border payments and treasury fintech serving businesses across the Americas. It enables international transfers to 140+ countries, bulk and mass payouts for payroll and multi-beneficiary disbursement, multi-currency business accounts (USD, MXN, EUR, GBP, CAD, JPY), international collections in local currency across 24+ countries, and FX and currency management for treasury optimization. Headquartered in Palo Alto, California with operations across Mexico (Mexico City, Monterrey, Tijuana, Queretaro, Guadalajara) and Colombia, EFEX is authorized by Mexico's CNBV as a money transmitter (registration 22469) and regulated by FinCEN in the United States. Backed by 500 Global. As of this profile the company exposes a business web/app product but no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Element Zero
providers.description: Element Zero is a green-materials technology company decarbonizing the production of iron and other critical metals. Its patented non-aqueous electrochemical process converts any grade of metal ore (iron, nickel, titanium, lithium) into high-purity metal with zero carbon emissions, using 30-40% less energy than conventional smelting and operating at low temperatures so it can run on intermittent renewable energy (wind, solar, hydro). Based in Perth and northern Western Australia near the world's largest iron-ore ports, the company is scaling a modular platform aimed at the roughly 8% of global CO2 emissions from iron and steelmaking, including its Pilbara Iron Super Hub at Port Hedland. Backed by a US$10M seed round led by Playground Global. This is an industrial deep-tech company with no public API or developer platform; the profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Enable Midstream Partners
providers.description: Enable Midstream Partners was a midstream energy company engaged in the gathering, processing, transportation, and storage of natural gas, natural gas liquids, and crude oil. Enable Midstream Partners was acquired by Energy Transfer LP in December 2021 and operations have been integrated into Energy Transfer's midstream business. No public developer APIs are published for this entity.

providers.name: Enigma Health
providers.description: Enigma Health (Enigma Global eHealth) is a Netherlands-based digital health startup building a secure, private eHealth portal intended to connect patients, doctors and healthcare institutions, and to give patients lifelong, worldwide access to their own electronic health record together with a digital vaccine passport kept in sync with that record. Founded by Dutch GP and global-health researcher Remko Schats and incubated at UtrechtInc, the company is a Startup level Industry Partner of the openEHR International Foundation, placing its intended data layer on the openEHR clinical data platform standard rather than a proprietary record format. As of September 2026 the company is pre-launch: enigma-health.org serves a single 'Coming Soon' page and Enigma Health publishes no API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Eos AI
providers.description: Eos AI is a San Francisco healthcare technology company building an autonomous operating system for healthcare that helps clinics and hospitals identify eligible patients and enable early care interventions. The platform connects to fragmented clinical systems (EHRs, imaging archives, labs, scheduling, and billing), resolves patient identities across sites and encounters, and links records into a continuous longitudinal history that can be searched and analyzed as one distributed database. Two harmonization products anchor the stack: VERA standardizes medical imaging across scanners, sites, and protocols to improve model performance and shorten deployment, and LUCIA structures EHR free text, ICD, SNOMED, and clinical signals into a unified representation for downstream analytics. On top of the harmonized data, Eos runs predictive models over full patient trajectories and drives automations into hospital workflows, reporting roughly 3x administrative productivity and 37% revenue recovery in early deployments. Founded in 2025 by Arya Khokhar and backed by Y Combinator (Winter 2026 batch). Its application is gated at my.helloeos.ai; no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal has been published to date, so this profile captures the company identity and the security posture of its public web surface.

providers.name: finern
providers.description: Finern (Finern Automation) is a China-based industrial automation company that designs and builds fully automated production lines and intelligent measurement systems for manufacturing. It serves five sectors — automotive, electronics, new energy (battery/EV), healthcare/pharmaceutical equipment, and consumer goods — with automated assembly, testing, and inspection systems. The company reports 600+ personnel, 30,000+ square meters of facilities, 100+ global clients, 8 international sites, and 4 R&D centers. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Finern publishes a corporate marketing website but does not currently expose any public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable discovery surface (no /.well-known/*, llms.txt, or OpenAPI found on probe).

providers.name: Fond
providers.description: Fond (formerly AnyPerk) is a U.S. employee rewards and recognition platform that lets companies run customizable recognition programs combining monetary and non-monetary rewards, perks, and a global rewards catalog. Fond offers a gated public/provider API that allows authenticated partners to programmatically manage a Fond account — provisioning, employee roster management, giving recognition to one or more employees, and rewards redemption — alongside integrations for Workday, ADP, Namely, Salesforce, Slack, and other HR systems.
