There is no open developer portal or published OpenAPI; API access is arranged directly via integration@fond.co. Fond was acquired by Reward Gateway in March 2023 and fond.co now redirects to rewardgateway.com. Originally added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of DCM Ventures.

providers.name: GitGuardian
providers.description: Scan files for secrets (API Keys, database credentials)

providers.name: Gokin
providers.description: Gokin Solar Co., Ltd. (高景太阳能股份有限公司) is a Chinese photovoltaic manufacturer founded in 2019 and headquartered in Jiangsu, China. The company produces monocrystalline silicon ingots and wafers (N-type and P-type) and high-efficiency solar modules (GOKIN BC and FLAMINGO series), operating four major production bases with roughly 100 GW of wafer and 16 GW of module annual capacity. Ranked among the top three global silicon-wafer shippers, Gokin employs 6,000+ people, holds 500+ patents, and serves utility, commercial, and residential solar projects across 30+ countries. Backed by IDG Capital, Gokin is a solar-hardware manufacturer with a corporate marketing website and no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Green Canopy NODE
providers.description: Green Canopy NODE is a Seattle- and Portland-based sustainable real estate development and construction technology company that designs and builds all-electric, low-carbon homes. The business operates across three lines: prefabricated "Building Kits" (including mass-timber panelized systems), full development services for multi-unit and infill housing projects, and impact investment funds that finance green housing. The company reports 300+ all-electric homes built, five real estate investment funds, and roughly 35K metric tons of greenhouse-gas emissions mitigated since inception. Green Canopy NODE was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes a marketing and investor website but no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: Green Revolution Cooling
providers.description: Green Revolution Cooling, which does business as GRC and brands itself "The Immersion Cooling Authority", is an Austin, Texas manufacturer of single-phase liquid immersion cooling systems for data centers. Founded in 2009, GRC builds the ICEraQ family of immersion-cooled racks (SX, Flex, Nano, Micro), the ICEtank containerized immersion data center, the ReliaSys IR500 coolant distribution unit, and ElectroSafe dielectric fluids, and sells them into AI/ML, HPC, edge, enterprise, cloud and hyperscale data centers in more than twenty countries. Its only software product is Systems Manager, an on-premises appliance that gives operators a single monitoring interface across connected ICEraQ and ICEtank systems over the customer's own secure network. GRC publishes no developer portal, no API reference, no SDKs and no machine-readable API description; its systems integrate with data center DCIM and BMS platforms through industrial protocols such as Modbus TCP, SNMP and BACnet rather than through a web API.

providers.name: Immune-Onc Therapeutics
providers.description: Immune-Onc Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Palo Alto, California, founded in 2016 by Charlene Liao and Guo Liang Yu. The company develops novel antibody therapeutics that target myeloid cell inhibitory receptors — with a current focus on the Leukocyte Immunoglobulin-Like Receptor subfamily B (LILRB) — to treat blood cancers, solid tumors, and autoimmune and inflammatory disease. Its clinical pipeline includes IO-108, a fully human IgG4 antagonist antibody targeting LILRB2 (ILT4) in Phase 1b/2 for solid tumors including hepatocellular carcinoma, and IO-202, a first-in-class IgG1 antibody targeting LILRB4 (ILT3) in Phase 1b for acute myeloid leukemia and chronic myelomonocytic leukemia, which holds FDA Fast Track and Orphan Drug designations. Preclinical programs include IO-312, a LILRB4-directed bispecific antibody, and IO-106 targeting LAIR1. The company has clinical collaborations with BeiGene, Regeneron, and Roche, and has raised approximately $138 million across Series A and Series B financings from investors including Northern Light Venture Capital, Vivo Capital, CLI Ventures, and the Stanford-StartX Fund. Immune-Onc is a therapeutics developer, not a software or platform company: as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI or other machine-readable contract, no SDKs, no public GitHub organization and no /.well-known/ discovery surface — its only machine-readable documents are two Squarespace RSS feeds for its news and press-release collections. This record therefore captures the company's verified public identity, its published web properties, its clinical-trial registry presence, and the probed security posture of its public web surface.

providers.name: Indio Technologies
providers.description: Indio Technologies is a cloud-based insurance application and submissions platform for commercial insurance agencies and brokers, acquired by and now part of Applied Systems. Indio replaces manual PDF forms and spreadsheets with a library of 10,000+ digitally enhanced "smart" insurance forms and ACORD applications, a submission workspace that packages digital applications, schedule workbooks, document-upload requests and e-signature requests, plus secure document sharing. Indio does not publish a self-service public developer API. Programmatic access is partner/carrier-gated and delivered through Applied Systems - the Applied Epic bi-directional integration and SDK, the IVANS data exchange API (used to move submission and proposal data between agencies, brokers and carriers), and the Applied DevCenter partner developer program. The API surfaces below are modeled from Indio's documented product concepts (submissions, forms/applications, clients, documents and e-signatures); they are logical groupings, not publicly documented endpoints (endpointsModeled).

providers.name: Interface Fluidics
providers.description: Interface Fluidics is a Calgary-based microfluidics company serving the energy industry with high-pressure, high-temperature (HPHT) laboratory testing systems and reservoir fluid analysis services. Its SapphireLab Pro+ platform and standard and custom microfluidic chips deliver direct visual insights for PVT and phase-behavior characterization, enhanced oil recovery (EOR) evaluation, flow assurance studies, and fracturing fluid testing, using small sample volumes at high throughput. Customers include Equinor, ExxonMobil, Chevron, TotalEnergies, and Shell, along with research institutions such as Rice University and PUC-Rio. The company operates customer-facing software (a SapphireLab LIMS portal and desktop apps) but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: iPrice
providers.description: iPrice Group is a Southeast Asian e-commerce aggregator and price-comparison platform headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. It aggregates billions of live product offers and thousands of coupons from more than a thousand retail partners, letting shoppers compare prices, discover deals, and make more informed purchases across seven markets: Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam, the Philippines, and Hong Kong. Backed by 500 Global as part of the Asia Venture Group portfolio, iPrice serves tens of millions of monthly visitors and is known for its large SEA e-commerce dataset. As of this profile, iPrice does not publish a public consumer or partner API, developer portal, or OpenAPI; this record is a company profile in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: LemonBox
providers.description: LemonBox (来檬) is a health-technology brand working in AI-generative personalized nutrition. Founded in 2016 in Silicon Valley, incubated at the University of Chicago Polsky Center in 2017, and accepted into Y Combinator in 2018, it entered the Chinese market that year and is now headquartered in Shanghai. LemonBox builds individualized daily vitamin and supplement packs from a three-minute FFQ (food frequency questionnaire) nutrition assessment scored by its LemonAlgo adaptive engine, then fulfills them one pack at a time (MOQ=1) through its Personalization Fulfillment Center in Hong Kong. The company reports serving more than 10 million cumulative users as of 2026 and sells both direct-to-consumer and B2B. Investors include Y Combinator and Partech. LemonBox operates a consumer web and WeChat mini-program experience and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its agent-facing surface is limited to a published /llms.txt and a robots.txt that explicitly allow-lists generative-AI crawlers.

providers.name: Macromedia
providers.description: Macromedia was a developer-tools and interactive-media software company (Flash, Dreamweaver, ColdFusion, Shockwave, Director, Fireworks) surfaced as a portfolio company of accel and kleiner-perkins. Adobe acquired Macromedia in 2005; www.macromedia.com now 301-redirects to www.adobe.com and the domain serves Adobe's canonical security.txt / PSIRT disclosure surface. This profile is a legacy company lead in the API Evangelist network with no independent live API surface of its own.

providers.name: Marley Medical
providers.description: Marley Medical is a venture-backed (Andreessen Horowitz / a16z) digital health company that delivers virtual, membership-based medical care to patients directly through a consumer web and mobile experience. Its patient-facing product runs as a web application (member portal at my.marleymedical.com) backed by Google Firebase, fronted by a Webflow marketing site and signup funnel, with member support delivered through Zendesk and transactional email via Mailgun on Google Workspace. As of this enrichment pass Marley Medical operates as a direct-to-consumer telehealth service and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures its verified public web and email infrastructure and its domain-security posture.

providers.name: Mentor Spaces
providers.description: Mentor Spaces is a structured mentorship platform that helps nonprofits, universities, and companies launch, manage, and measure mentorship programs at scale. The software handles automated mentor-mentee matching, scheduling, communication, and real-time outcome tracking so organizations can secure and renew grant funding with funder-ready impact reports, improve student persistence and career outcomes, engage alumni in time-bound structured mentorship, and run skills-based volunteering and corporate CSR/ESG programs. A public developer API and custom integrations are offered only on the enterprise Thrive tier (with SSO); no public API documentation is published. Founded by Chris Motley and backed by Techstars.

providers.name: Naborforce
providers.description: Naborforce is an on-demand home care and companionship platform that connects older adults with vetted, friendly local helpers called "Nabors" for non-medical assistance such as errands, rides to appointments, meal preparation, light housekeeping, technology help, and social companionship. Families and older adults book help on demand through the Naborforce website and iOS/Android apps on a pay-as-you-go basis with no long-term contracts. Naborforce is a Techstars-backed company and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile. As of this enrichment pass Naborforce operates as a consumer-facing (B2C) service and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: NeueHealth
providers.description: NeueHealth operates a healthcare platform that aligns interests across consumers, payors, and providers to enable value-driven, consumer-centric care. The company serves more than 600,000 health consumers and manages approximately $2.5 billion in medical expenses through partnerships with 21 payors and over 3,000 affiliated providers. NeueHealth operates two segments: NeueCare for direct clinical delivery and NeueSolutions for supporting independent providers in performance-based care arrangements.

providers.name: Open Souls
providers.description: Open Souls is an open-source framework and philosophy for building "AI souls" — agentic, embodied digital beings with personality, drive, and ego, built on top of large language models. The Soul Engine framework (distributed as the soul-engine npm package and CLI) models agency, memory, emotion, and goal-setting through WorkingMemory, cognitiveSteps, and MentalProcesses abstractions, describing itself as "NextJS + Vercel for the minds of digital beings." The project is now legacy: the opensouls.org site is parked and the hosted Soul Engine cloud service is no longer operating, but the open-source framework and npm packages remain published under the opensouls GitHub organization. Open Souls was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: PatientPing
providers.description: PatientPing is a real-time care-coordination network that delivers e-notifications ("Pings") and ADT-based admission, discharge, and transfer alerts across hospitals, post-acute facilities, health plans, pharmacies, and community providers. Its Route solution helps hospitals meet the CMS Interoperability and Patient Access Rule e-notifications Condition of Participation. PatientPing was acquired by Appriss Health in 2021 and rebranded as Bamboo Health; patientping.com now redirects to bamboohealth.com. No public developer portal or API documentation is published — clinical integration is handled privately via HL7/ADT data feeds embedded in provider workflow.

providers.name: PayRange
providers.description: PayRange is a fintech company providing cashless commerce and self-service retail technology for unattended machines. Its platform enables mobile payments, age and identity verification, and access control across laundromats, vending, car washes, campgrounds, hospitality, micro-markets, coffee, and transit ticketing. Hardware includes the BluKey family, BluCheck, and PayStation, paired with a consumer mobile app and an operator Business Management Suite. Backed by GV and Matrix Partners. No public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface was found during enrichment; integrations appear to run through direct partner and licensing channels.

providers.name: PECO Energy
providers.description: PECO Energy Company is the largest electric and natural gas utility in Pennsylvania, serving roughly 1.7 million electric and 553,000 natural gas customers across a 2,100-square-mile service territory in southeastern Pennsylvania. Headquartered in Philadelphia and a wholly owned subsidiary of Exelon Corporation, PECO operates a regulated transmission and distribution business that includes a fully deployed smart-meter network, an LNG storage facility in West Conshohocken, and a portfolio of energy-efficiency, demand response, and assistance programs marketed under the Smart Ideas brand. PECO does not publish a public developer portal or general-purpose API: its digital surface is delivered through the PECO web portal (peco.com / secure.peco.com), iOS and Android mobile apps, and an internal Exelon Utilities content / configuration API (eudapi.peco.com) that is not documented for third-party use. Customer-authorized programmatic access to interval energy usage is available through the customer-facing My Data / Energy Usage tools and, where supported via the Pennsylvania PUC EDI / data access framework, through third-party data aggregators (UtilityAPI, Arcadia, etc.) using customer credentials.

providers.name: PicoJool
providers.description: PicoJool is an optical connectivity company building Vertical Cavity Surface Emitting Lasers (VCSELs) and optical engines for AI and cloud data-center infrastructure. Its 50G NRZ, 100G PAM4, and 200G PAM4 VCSEL arrays target 800G and 1.6T transceivers for PCIe, Ethernet, and InfiniBand, aiming to raise bandwidth density and cut the power cost of moving data across hyperscale AI clusters. Founded in 2024 and based in Palo Alto, California, PicoJool emerged from stealth in November 2025 with $12M led by Playground Global. It is a semiconductor/photonics hardware company with no public API or developer platform; this profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network for portfolio and market tracking.

providers.name: Pilleve
providers.description: Pilleve is a medication-compliance and controlled-substance monitoring company in the digital health space. Its Amethyst System pairs a smart pill-dispensing device that releases one pill at a time and detects tampering with a patient mobile app and a clinician portal for real-time monitoring, adherence tracking, diversion prevention, compliance documentation, and medication disposal. Pilleve serves hospital systems, pain clinics, and pharmacies, and was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. As of this enrichment pass Pilleve publishes a marketing website and a clinician login but exposes no public API, developer portal, or documentation.

providers.name: PostNord
providers.description: Provides information about parcels in transport for Sweden and Denmark

providers.name: Protocol Labs
providers.description: Protocol Labs is an open-source research and development company founded in 2014 by Juan Benet, best known for creating foundational decentralized web protocols including IPFS (the InterPlanetary File System), Filecoin (a decentralized storage network), libp2p (a modular peer-to-peer networking stack), and IPLD (a data model for content-addressed systems). Since its founding it has grown into an innovation network connecting more than 750 startups, funds, accelerators, foundations, and open-source projects working across web3, AI, robotics, cryptography, and neurotechnology. Protocol Labs itself (protocol.ai) is a research and venture organization rather than a commercial API provider — it publishes no first-party REST API; its developer surfaces (IPFS HTTP APIs, Filecoin JSON-RPC, libp2p) live in their own separate open-source projects and GitHub organizations.

providers.name: Qnovia
providers.description: Qnovia, Inc. is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical and drug-device company developing inhaled therapeutics built on its proprietary RespiRx aseptically pre-filled, portable vibrating-mesh nebulizer platform. Its lead asset, the RespiRx Nicotine Inhaler (QN-01), is a prescription smoking-cessation therapy that cleared FDA IND review and has dosed patients in a U.S. Phase 1 study; a cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) program is advancing toward a second IND. The device is Bluetooth Low Energy connected and pairs with Neblit AI, a cloud-connected companion app and machine-learning platform that tracks dose events and delivers behavioral interventions, which the company positions as a digital therapeutic layer over the pharmacotherapy. Founded in 2018 as Respira Technologies and rebranded to Qnovia in 2022, the company is led by founder and CEO Mario Danek, operates R&D and manufacturing in Newport Beach/Irvine, California and an R&D facility in Richmond, Virginia, and has raised roughly $50 million to date. Qnovia publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable contract; its corporate site is a client-rendered single-page application whose only HTTP API is a private backend serving its own contact, careers and investor-portal forms.

providers.name: QueueDr
providers.description: QueueDr is a healthcare scheduling automation product that automatically fills unexpected appointment cancellations, rebooks no-shows, and balances provider schedules to reduce lost revenue for medical practices and health systems. Originally a 500 Global-backed startup, QueueDr was acquired by Phreesia and is now offered as the Phreesia Appointment Accelerator within Phreesia's patient intake and engagement platform. The queuedr.com domain now redirects to Phreesia; existing customers continue to sign in at the app.queuedr.com dashboard. No independent public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface is published for QueueDr as a standalone product.

providers.name: Radia
providers.description: Radia is a dual-use aerospace company founded in 2016 by MIT-trained aerospace engineer Mark Lundstrom, headquartered in Boulder, Colorado with a second operating base in Italy led by Giuseppe Giordo. After roughly seven years in stealth the company emerged in March 2024 with WindRunner, an aircraft it describes as the largest ever built: roughly ten times the cargo volume of a Boeing 777, sized to carry onshore wind turbine blades of up to about 105 metres, and designed to land on semi-prepared packed-dirt or gravel strips so that oversized cargo can be flown directly to a wind farm, a forward operating site or a disaster zone rather than trucked over highways it cannot fit on. Radia frames WindRunner as a deliberately low-novelty airframe assembled from existing certified technologies to shorten the certification path, targeting entry into service in the early 2030s across three markets: energy (delivering the very large blades that make low-wind onshore sites economic), defense (outsized-volume strategic airlift), and commercial supply-chain logistics. It has assembled an industrial ecosystem of more than twenty suppliers and technology partners including Aernnova, Leonardo, AFuzion, Atitech, Latecoere, Stirling Dynamics, Collier Aerospace and Maximus Air, and has raised roughly USD 128 million from investors including ConocoPhillips, Lauder Partners, LS Power Development and HCVC. Radia is an aircraft manufacturer and logistics operator rather than a software vendor: as of August 2026 it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation, no SDK and no machine-readable API contract of any kind. Its only machine-readable public surface is the Strapi headless-CMS backend at radia.com/strapi that renders its own marketing site, whose content API is permission-locked and undocumented.

providers.name: Reflect Orbital
providers.description: Reflect Orbital is a space-technology company developing satellite-based infrastructure to redirect natural sunlight to precise locations on Earth. It offers a Lighting service (adjustable illumination from moonlight to full-daylight intensity, controllable via app or website with no ground infrastructure) and an Energy service (augmenting solar-farm output by directing concentrated sunlight onto photovoltaic arrays). The company plans to expand its constellation from 2 satellites in 2026 toward 50,000+ by 2035. Reflect Orbital is backed by Lux Capital and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-sourced company profile. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, pricing, or sign-up surface.

providers.name: Shoelace
providers.description: Shoelace is an omni-channel growth marketing agency for direct-to-consumer (DTC) and e-commerce brands, founded in 2015 and trusted by 300+ brands. The team plans, creates, and optimizes paid acquisition across Meta, Google, TikTok and YouTube alongside email and SMS retention, performance creative, UGC, and in-house photo and video production. Shoelace operates as a managed growth partner delivering marketing services — it sells campaign management, not software, and publishes no developer API, SDK, webhook surface, or developer portal. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a 500 Global portfolio lead and captures its public web presence, its published llms.txt, and its domain-security posture.

providers.name: Sight Diagnostics
providers.description: Sight Diagnostics is an Israeli medical-device and diagnostics company, founded in 2011 and headquartered in Tel Aviv, that built Sight OLO — an FDA 510(k)-cleared, CE-marked point-of-care hematology analyzer producing a 19-parameter, five-part-differential Complete Blood Count from two drops of capillary or venous blood in about ten minutes. OLO replaces reagent-based flow cytometry with digital microscopy and machine vision: it images the sample across five illumination channels (405nm, 517nm and 633nm brightfield plus 365nm and 460nm fluorescence) and classifies cells with computer-vision models rather than impedance or optical scatter. The company raised roughly $124M across six rounds and has more recently repositioned around live immune-cell analysis and "immune signatures". Sight Diagnostics is an instrument and clinical-workflow business, not a software platform: it publishes no public API, no developer portal, no SDKs and no machine-readable contract. Device connectivity to LIS/EMR systems is delivered as a customer integration engagement rather than as a documented public interface, so there is no developer surface to profile.

providers.name: Solestial
providers.description: Solestial is a space solar energy company developing space-stable silicon photovoltaics — radiation-hardened, ultrathin flexible silicon heterojunction solar cells and modules for spacecraft. Its products are the only solar products on the market that self-cure radiation damage at operating temperatures, offering competitive performance at lower cost than III-V multijunction solar. Solestial has flight heritage across multiple spacecraft and works with customers including NASA, Boeing, and the U.S. Space Force. This is a hardware and manufacturing company with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Spext Labs
providers.description: Spext (Spext Labs) is an AI-powered audio and video editing platform that lets users edit recordings by trimming an auto-generated transcript rather than a waveform — a text-first "recording management system" for podcasts, interviews and other spoken-word media. Backed by 500 Global, the company operates from a Framer-hosted marketing site (spext.co) and a web application (app.spext.co). As of this enrichment pass Spext exposes no public developer surface — no documented API, developer portal, SDKs, OpenAPI, or well-known discovery endpoints were found; the profile is retained as a network company record.

providers.name: Sweep
providers.description: Sweep is an enterprise carbon and ESG data management platform helping large organizations measure, manage, report, and reduce their carbon emissions and broader sustainability performance across Scope 1, 2, and 3 following the GHG Protocol. Its platform centralizes sustainability data across an organization and its value chain to produce audit-ready data from a single source, covering carbon accounting, ESG disclosure, value-chain engagement with supplier portals and automated data collection, audit and assurance trails, and business intelligence with dashboards and scenario modeling. Sweep supports compliance with the CSRD, ISSB, GRI, CDP, SFDR, TCFD, UK SRS, the GHG Protocol, and US state regulation including California SB 253 and SB 261, with vertical solutions for asset managers, asset owners, private markets, banks, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, energy, and consumer goods. Sweep was named a Leader in the IDC MarketScape 2026 for Carbon Management and recognized in the Verdantix 2026 Green Quadrant. The platform exposes data ingestion via API and SFTP and integrates with ERP, procurement, and HRMS systems, but Sweep does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or open-source repos — API access is delivered through customer engagements rather than a self-serve developer surface.

providers.name: Topgolf Callaway Brands
providers.description: Topgolf Callaway Brands is a global golf and entertainment company that designs, manufactures, and sells golf clubs, balls, apparel, and accessories under the Callaway, Odyssey, OGIO, TravisMathew, and Jack Wolfskin brands, and operates Topgolf entertainment venues and the Toptracer ball-tracking technology. Topgolf Callaway Brands does not publish a single public developer API portal, though Toptracer ball-tracking technology is licensed to driving ranges through a separate commercial program.

providers.name: Torchdental
providers.description: Torchdental (Torch Dental) is a B2B dental-supply procurement platform for independent dental practices and dental groups. It runs a web application at app.torchdental.com that lets practices order dental supplies and equipment from multiple vendors in one place, compare prices, manage recurring ordering and budgets, and streamline back-office purchasing. The company is venture backed and was surfaced as a portfolio company of Felicis. As of this enrichment pass Torchdental exposes no public developer/API surface: no api/docs/developer subdomains resolve, and the application host publishes no /.well-known/ discovery documents. This profile therefore captures company identity and probed domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Umoja Labs
providers.description: Umoja Labs is the company behind Umoja Protocol, a decentralized finance product described as a next-gen yield vault token (YVT) protocol for earning yield on blue-chip cryptocurrencies, with automated hedging strategies and the $UMJA token. A 500 Global portfolio company. As of July 2026 the umoja.xyz website and app are offline and the Medium blog has been dormant since April 2025; no public API, developer documentation, or first-party SDKs were found.

providers.name: Usermind
providers.description: Usermind was a Seattle-based journey and experience orchestration platform that captured and analyzed contextual data at every touchpoint of the customer journey to personalize experiences across channels, and was named a Leader in The Forrester Wave Journey Orchestration Platforms, Q2 2020. Backed by a16z and Menlo Ventures, the company was acquired by Qualtrics (announced July 20, 2021); usermind.com now redirects to qualtrics.com and no independent Usermind API surface remains.

providers.name: Valthos
providers.description: Valthos is a New York City-based biodefense company developing frontier AI systems that identify biological threats and design medical countermeasures in real time. The company emerged from stealth in October 2025 with $30 million in backing from the OpenAI Startup Fund, Lux Capital, and Founders Fund, with a founding team drawn from Palantir, DeepMind, the Broad Institute, and the Arc Institute. Valthos is building AI-powered biodefense infrastructure to rapidly analyze biological sequences and update medicines at scale for experts in government and the life sciences. The company does not yet publish a public API, developer portal, or open-source surface.

providers.name: Vesta Healthcare
providers.description: Vesta Healthcare is a clinical and technology services organization for high-need, frail seniors receiving home-based care. It connects caregiver insights to the broader care team, delivering 24/7 telehealth support, remote patient monitoring, and chronic care management. Vesta partners with home care agencies, health plans, and providers to run value-based population health programs that emphasize clinical quality and personalized engagement, with services covered through Medicare, Medicare Supplemental, and many Medicare Advantage plans. The company (formerly HT Health) is backed by Lux Capital. No public developer/API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Xwing
providers.description: Xwing, Inc. is a San Francisco and Concord, California aviation company founded in 2016 that built Superpilot, a modular retrofit autonomy system enabling ground-supervised, uncrewed gate-to-gate flight on conventional fixed-wing aircraft. Flying a Cessna 208B Grand Caravan testbed, Xwing completed more than 250 fully autonomous flights and over 500 auto-landings, and in April 2023 became the first company to receive an FAA project designation toward certification of a large unmanned aircraft system. Joby Aviation acquired Xwing's autonomy division in June 2024; Xwing retained its Part 135 air cargo operation, and www.xwing.com is now an archived marketing site pointing visitors to Joby. Xwing never published a developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable contract; the domain's only agent-readable surfaces are the llms.txt and Site MCP endpoint that Wix generates for every site it hosts.

providers.name: Yuze Semiconductor
providers.description: Yuze Semiconductor — legally Yunnan Yuze New Energy Co., Ltd. (云南宇泽新能源股份有限公司), trading internationally as Unigrace New Energy — is a Chinese photovoltaic materials manufacturer founded in May 2019 and headquartered in Kunming, Yunnan. It produces N-type solar monocrystalline silicon rods and wafers covering the three mainstream N-type cell routes (HJT, TOPCon and IBC), operating manufacturing bases in Chuxiong, Wenshan and Kunming in Yunnan and Yichun in Jiangxi, with a sales centre in Suzhou. The company was named a 2022 Chinese Unicorn Enterprise and its shares trade on secondary private markets. It is a physical-goods manufacturer: its public web presence carries company, product, news and recruitment pages only, with no developer program, no API, and no machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: ZhongAn Insurance
providers.description: ZhongAn Online P&C Insurance Co., Ltd. is China's first online-only insurance company, founded in 2013 by Ant Financial, Tencent, and Ping An and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (6060) in 2017. Headquartered in Shanghai, ZhongAn sells digital insurance across health, consumer finance, auto, and lifestyle lines entirely through internet channels, and operates a partner "open platform" (open.zhongan.com) plus a technology arm, ZhongAn Technology (zhongan.io), that offers insurtech and cloud services. ZhongAn does not publish a self-serve public developer API program or OpenAPI documentation; integration is partner/ecosystem-driven. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of softbank-vision-fund and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: 360 Commerce
providers.description: 360 Commerce is a New Zealand and Australia B2B ecommerce platform that helps wholesalers, distributors and manufacturers bring customer ordering, account self-service and ERP-connected workflows online. More than a standard ecommerce website, it gives customers a secure ordering portal for contract and customer-specific pricing, ERP stock visibility, repeat ordering, quotes, approvals, invoices, credit notes and aged balances. The platform (built on its EcomCore product) integrates with leading ERP, accounting, inventory and CRM systems including Odoo, MYOB Advanced and NetSuite so online ordering reflects the way a business actually trades.

providers.name: A Capital
providers.description: A.Capital Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm founded by Ronny Conway, a former partner at Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and one of the first employees at Google Ventures. The firm provides funding, talent, and strategic counsel to founders building at the frontier of technology, with a portfolio spanning AI and machine learning (OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face, Character.ai), developer tools (Notion, Replit, Databricks), and crypto and consumer platforms (Coinbase, Uniswap, Reddit, Airbnb). A.Capital differs from standard venture models by customizing investment amounts rather than enforcing ownership thresholds, advising without mandatory board seats, and staffing full-time Talent Partners to help early-stage teams hire and build their organizational foundation. This profile was surfaced via the a16z network (through founder Ronny Conway's a16z tenure) and enriched from the firm's public website. A.Capital is a venture capital firm and does not publish a developer-facing API surface, developer portal, or API artifacts.

providers.name: Acacia
providers.description: Acacia (Acacia Communications) is a coherent optical networking company, an early Matrix Partners portfolio company that was acquired by Cisco. Acacia designs and manufactures high-speed coherent optical interconnect solutions built on silicon photonics, low-power DSP, and 3D siliconization, including performance-optimized modules (AC1200, CIM 8), MSA pluggable modules (CFP, CFP2, OSFP, QSFP-DD, QSFP28), and client optics components (PAM4 DSP, optical engines). These power AI scale-out and scale-across fabrics, data center interconnect, metro and long-haul networks, submarine cables, access and cable networks, and space communications. Acacia is a hardware/components provider and does not publish a public developer API or programmatic platform.

providers.name: ADChem Semi-Tech
providers.description: Anhui ADChem Semi-Tech Co., Ltd. (安徽安德科铭半导体科技股份有限公司) is a Hefei, China based manufacturer of electronic-grade semiconductor thin-film precursor materials, founded in 2018 and operating an R&D base in Hefei with production sites in Tongling plus sales and market-development offices in Shanghai and Wuhan. The company develops and produces high-purity ALD and CVD precursors — silicon-based precursors (BDEAS, BTBAS, DIPAS, DIS), High-K hafnium and zirconium precursors (TDMAHf, TEMAHf, CpHf, HfCl4, TEMAZ, CpZr, ZrCl4), metal and conductive-film precursors (TMA, TBTDEN, WCl5, MoCl5, CCTBA, Ru(EtCp)2) and perovskite photovoltaic precursors — alongside custom source canisters, liquid delivery systems and thin-film process solutions for integrated-circuit manufacturing, advanced display and new-energy customers. ADChem sells physical chemical products; it operates no public developer program, API, or software platform.

providers.name: Aerospace Times Feipeng
providers.description: Aerospace Times Feipeng Co., Ltd. (航天时代飞鹏有限公司) is a Chinese unmanned transport aircraft manufacturer founded in 2020 in the Huaqiao Economic Development Zone of Kunshan, Jiangsu, as a mixed-ownership enterprise launched by the China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation (CASC) together with SF Express. It designs, manufactures and operates cargo UAV systems across three payload/range classes — the Double 1000 (1000 kg / 1000 km trunk-line), Double 100 (branch-line) and Double 10 (last-mile) series — alongside special aircraft, ground control stations, an unmanned aircraft operation control system, and an AOPA-certified UAV pilot training centre. Its FP-98 "Leo" large fixed-wing UAV received a CAAC type certificate in April 2024. The company publishes a corporate marketing website in Chinese and English; it operates no public developer program and publishes no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Aerotech (Beijing)
providers.description: Aerotech — 中科艾尔（北京）科技有限公司, Zhongke Aier (Beijing) Technology Co., Ltd., founded in March 2008 as 泰科爱尔（北京）科技有限公司 (Taike Aier) with a Japanese engineering team — is a Beijing semiconductor components manufacturer that researches, produces and sells ultra-high-purity gas line tube and valve hardware: UHP pressure regulators, diaphragm valves, bellows and vacuum angle valves, ball and check valves, EP/BA electropolished stainless tubing and fittings, integrated gas distribution panels, measurement devices and precursor source bottles. The company developed its own EP (electrolytic polishing) process in 2009 and its own industrial electropolishing equipment in 2012, joined the MIIT domestic-substitution program piloted at SMIC in 2018, opened a 10,969 m² class-10 cleanroom plant in the Cangzhou Bohai New Area in September 2020 on a RMB 230M investment, and became a qualified SMIC (中芯国际) supplier in March 2021. Its product is physical hardware for semiconductor fab gas delivery; it operates no developer program, no public API, no SDK and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: AgroMatch
providers.description: AgroMatch is a Chilean agricultural technology (AgTech) platform, founded in 2018 and backed by 500 Global, that connects farmers, agricultural contractors, and machinery owners in a single collaborative marketplace. Often described as the "Airbnb of agricultural machinery," it lets machinery owners lease idle equipment (tractors, implements, portable bins) during low-use periods to farmers in regions whose seasons do not coincide, and lets farmers contract or offer agricultural services such as harvesting, soil preparation, and crop applications. The platform also supports buying and selling new and used machinery, operative leasing, and supplier networking, using artificial intelligence and IoT to match demand for machinery with available supply. AgroMatch reports more than 400 B2B customers across Chile and Perú with operations extending to the US, Colombia, and Mexico. The company operates as a web and mobile application at app.agromatch.cl; no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: AliciaBots
providers.description: AliciaBots is a maritime robotics company, backed by Techstars, that builds autonomous robot teams for cleaning and inspecting ship hulls. Its flagship Roverclean robot operates independently to remove marine growth and monitor hull condition in real time without interrupting a vessel's voyage, using self-learning adaptive systems, precision cleaning, and remote monitoring and control to improve fuel efficiency and help operators meet IMO regulatory standards. AliciaBots does not currently publish a public API or developer program; this profile tracks the company as a network lead.

providers.name: Ankyra Therapeutics
providers.description: Ankyra Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, developing "anchored" immunotherapies for cancer and immune-mediated diseases. Its proprietary platform tethers immune-modulating drugs to aluminum hydroxide so that treatment concentrates locally at the disease site, broadening the therapeutic window while reducing systemic toxicity and dosing frequency. The lead candidate, ANK-101, is an anchored IL-12 therapy in clinical evaluation for patients with advanced solid tumors. Ankyra is backed by investors including Google Ventures (GV), Mithril, Polaris Partners, Sands Capital, and Fidelity. The company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or technical platform; this profile exists in the API Evangelist network for discovery and enrichment.

providers.name: Ansun Biopharma
providers.description: Ansun Biopharma is a privately held, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in the Sorrento Valley district of San Diego, California, founded in 2003 by virologists and molecular biologists and led by CEO Dr. Nancy Chang. Rather than targeting viruses directly, Ansun develops host-directed immuno-biologic therapies built on a recombinant sialidase platform. Its lead candidate, DAS181 (Ansun-181), is a multi-function sialidase fusion protein that removes the sialic acid receptors respiratory viruses use to enter host cells, and has been studied in parainfluenza virus (PIV), severe influenza, human metapneumovirus and COVID-19 in immunocompromised and hospitalized patients. The company also advances earlier-stage programs in oncology and autoimmune disease from the same sialidase platform. Ansun is a drug developer, not a software vendor: it publishes a corporate WordPress site covering its pipeline, research and technologies, publications, intellectual property, investors, news and careers, and exposes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Aquafortus
providers.description: Aquafortus Technologies is a New Zealand-based deep-tech water treatment company that develops patented non-thermal, zero-liquid-discharge (ZLD) desalination technology for high-salinity industrial brines. Its ABX system uses a solvent-extraction and membrane-filtration process at ambient temperatures to turn up to 98% of high-salinity brine into fresh water while using significantly less energy than thermal alternatives, and can expose, isolate and extract valuable metals and minerals (lithium, copper, magnesium salts and others) from the treated brine. The company targets cooling towers, mining, oil and gas, inland desalination, flue-gas desulphurisation and other high-volume, high-salinity industrial processes. Aquafortus is backed by deep tech venture firm DCVC and Novo Holdings, and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; it publishes no public API or developer surface.

providers.name: Archive.org
providers.description: The Internet Archive

providers.name: Aris Machina
providers.description: Aris Machina builds AI-powered industrial software for advanced manufacturing, describing its mission as delivering "industrial superintelligence" that unifies design, production, and operations through AI agents and a shared semantic knowledge model. Its products include Protos, an AI co-engineer for R&D teams that accelerates design validation and simulation; Gemba, shopfloor operational agents that provide real-time equipment diagnostics; and the Ontology Toolkit, a knowledge-integration layer that bridges data across MES, ERP, and PLM systems. Aris Machina serves batteries, biopharma, robotics, defense, and aerospace, and is backed by Earlybird. The company operates from Stockholm, Bangalore, and California. This profile was surfaced as an Earlybird portfolio company and enriched from public web sources; Aris Machina does not currently publish a public developer API surface, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs.

providers.name: Aryacollateral
providers.description: Aryacollateral is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: secondary-market) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Astro Mechanica
providers.description: Astro Mechanica is a San Francisco aerospace company, founded in 2021 by Ian Brooke, reinventing supersonic flight for a new jet age. Its flagship Duality electric combined-cycle engine is engineered to stay efficient from takeoff through Mach 3+ by reconfiguring between turbofan, turbojet, and ramjet modes using a hybrid turboelectric architecture. The company designs engines, airframes, and flight systems in-house, has been selected to develop an engine for the U.S. Air Force Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) program, and is backed by a16z, Lowercarbon Capital, and Y Combinator. It was added to the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio company. As an aerospace hardware manufacturer, Astro Mechanica publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures the company's public web and identity surface only.

providers.name: AstroForge
providers.description: AstroForge is a commercial space startup founded in 2022 and based in Huntington Beach, California, focused on asteroid mining and the in-space extraction and refining of platinum group metals and other critical minerals. Backed by Initialized Capital and a Y Combinator alum, the company designs low-cost, autonomous, replicable interplanetary spacecraft to prospect and mine near-Earth asteroids, with its DeepSpace-2 mission targeting the first commercial rendezvous with a body outside Earth's gravity well. AstroForge does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a frontier-tech lead and will be enriched further if and when a developer program appears.

providers.name: Atimotors
providers.description: Ati Robotics (formerly Atimotors) provides autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) and AI-driven material orchestration software for factories. Their solutions include tugging, pallet movement, lifting, handling, and physical AI across industries such as automotive, medical, food & beverage, consumer goods, heavy equipment, and energy. With over 70 plants deployed and a 99% mission success rate, they claim rapid ROI and advanced automation capabilities.

providers.name: ATMI Sales
providers.description: ATMI Sales (Advanced Technical Marketing Inc.) is a manufacturers' representative and technical sales firm serving the electronics and semiconductor industry across the Pacific Northwest and Western Canada. The company connects customers with component suppliers through a research, development, and build model — identifying suitable technology solutions, building supplier relationships, and ensuring component availability and supply-chain sourcing in the regions where products are manufactured. ATMI maintains a line card of partner technologies and works with distributors to fulfill orders. This is a non-developer B2B sales and distribution company; it publishes no public API, SDK, or developer program. Surfaced as a portfolio company of sierra-ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Atom Semiconductor
providers.description: Atom Semiconductor (Atom Semiconductor Technologies Limited) is a fabless mixed-signal chip design company founded in Hong Kong in October 2020, with offices in Shenzhen and Shanghai. It designs high-performance analog and mixed-signal semiconductors for consumer and industrial IoT systems across three product lines: digital sensor chips (temperature/humidity, pressure, optical), analog-to-digital converters (24-bit Sigma-Delta, high-precision SAR, and high-speed GSPS ADCs), and microprocessors. Its first product, the AS1412 24-bit Sigma-Delta ADC, shipped for customer trials in late 2021. The company raised roughly 100M yuan in a pre-A round led by Qiming Venture Partners (with Venus Medtech and Alibaba Entrepreneurs Fund) and was named to the Forbes Asia 100 To Watch 2022. It is a hardware chip designer and does not publish a developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Atomica Informatics
providers.description: Atomica Informatics is an independent health-informatics consultancy founded and run by Dr Heather Leslie, specialising in what it calls "little data" design: the modelling of atomic clinical data so that individual data points carry consistent format and reliable meaning across projects, domains and systems instead of being locked into single-purpose silos. The practice delivers openEHR archetype and template authoring, clinical knowledge governance, clinician engagement, and openEHR clinical-modelling training - a two-day introductory course, advanced modelling workshops, and ongoing remote mentoring for in-house modelling teams. Dr Leslie pioneered the openEHR clinical modelling methodology in volunteer roles at the openEHR Foundation from 2006 and co-leads its Clinical Program. Atomica Informatics operates no API of its own; the machine-readable standards its work depends on are published by the openEHR Foundation.

providers.name: Atropos Health
providers.description: Atropos Health is a Stanford-spinout, New York / Bay Area real-world evidence (RWE) company founded in 2020 by Nigam Shah, Brigham Hyde, and Saurabh Gombar to close the medical "evidence gap" by converting routine healthcare data into publication-grade observational studies in minutes instead of months. Its flagship platform GENEVA OS (Generative Evidence Acceleration Operating System) is a federated, cloud-agnostic operating system that installs behind the customer's firewall, ingests longitudinal patient records as in-memory patient-timeline objects, and exposes a Temporal Query Language (TQL) and Advanced Cohort Engine (ACE) for rapid observational analyses without moving PHI. On top of GENEVA OS, Atropos offers ChatRWD, a conversational chat-to-database application that generates full observational studies from natural-language clinical questions, the Atropos Evidence Agent (an agentic AI deployed at Stanford Health Care and developed in collaboration with Microsoft to surface RWE directly inside clinical workflows and notes), Green Button (the original on-demand consult-style evidence service that gave rise to the company), Forge (study automation), and Alexandria, marketed as the world's largest body of precision evidence-based findings with 33M+ entries used for clinical decision support and LLM training. The company sells into health systems (pharmacy, research informatics, value-based care, GME) and life sciences (brand planning, HEOR, medical affairs, R&D, commercial analytics, precision-medicine AI/ML), is backed by Valtruis, Emerson Collective, Breyer Capital, McKinsey Ventures, Cencora Ventures, Presidio Ventures, Merck Global Health Innovation, Samsung Next, and others, and partners with Stanford Health Care, Mayo Clinic Platform, and Microsoft. Atropos has no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release; GENEVA OS, TQL, ACE, ChatRWD, and the Evidence Agent are proprietary enterprise software delivered under contract to health-system and life-sciences customers, and the company's public GitHub org contains only forks (FAISS, HELM, security-policy-templates, terraform-aws-github-runner) and a small number of internal research notebooks rather than any shippable client library.

providers.name: Aurora Innovation
providers.description: Aurora Innovation is a Pittsburgh-headquartered autonomous-vehicle company publicly traded on NASDAQ as AUR. Its core product is the Aurora Driver, a self-driving system designed as a single platform deployable across vehicle classes - first commercialized in long-haul Class 8 trucking through Aurora Horizon, with Aurora Connect intended for ride-hailing applications. The Aurora Driver is integrated into the Volvo VNL Autonomous and PACCAR Peterbilt 579/Kenworth T680 trucks, uses Aurora's proprietary FirstLight FMCW lidar with 450+ metre range, and benefits from a NVIDIA-powered compute platform and Continental hardware partnership. Aurora launched commercial driverless freight operations in Texas in 2025 between Fort Worth, El Paso, Dallas, and Houston, with freight customers including Werner, Hirschbach, Uber Freight, FedEx, Schneider, Ryder, and Toyota Motor North America. Aurora does not publish a public developer API; the public surface is product, safety, and investor material.

providers.name: Authorea
providers.description: Authorea is a collaborative online platform for writing, editing, reviewing, and publishing scholarly and scientific documents. Founded in 2012 by Alberto Pepe and Nathan Jenkins, it lets researchers co-author articles in rich text or LaTeX, manage citations and references, embed data, figures, and code, run version-controlled review, and export to journal-specific styles. Authorea was acquired by Atypon in 2018 and is now operated as part of John Wiley & Sons, hosted on Atypon's Literatum publishing platform, where it supports preprints, journal submission, and open collaboration for the research community. It has no public developer API today; its earlier REST API was retired after the Wiley/Atypon acquisition, and the GitHub organization now publishes only document-processing tooling (LaTeXML, Pandoc, TeX styling) rather than API client SDKs.

providers.name: AutoStore
providers.description: AutoStore is a global warehouse robotics and technology company headquartered in Nedre Vats, Norway, that pioneered the cube storage automated storage and retrieval system (AS/RS). Its goods-to-person solution combines autonomous robots, an aluminum storage grid of stacked bins, workstation ports, and controlling software (marketed as CubeVerse, spanning design, simulation, operations, and predictive diagnostics) to fulfill orders in a fraction of the floor space of conventional warehouses. With more than 1,950 systems deployed across nearly 65 countries, AutoStore serves retail, grocery, 3PL, healthcare, and industrial customers. Systems are distributed, designed, installed, and serviced through a global network of qualified system integrators rather than a public developer/API program. AutoStore was surfaced as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Awave
providers.description: Awave is a Stockholm‑based digital agency offering strategy, creative design, technology development, growth marketing and managed services. They help brands increase visibility, build modern web and app solutions, and provide accessibility consulting. Since 2021 Awave has been part of iO, expanding its expertise across Europe. Their services span digital transformation, SEO, e‑commerce, and custom software, targeting startups to large enterprises.

providers.name: BioTheryX
providers.description: BioTheryX is a private, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, discovering and developing first-in-class targeted protein degraders — both bifunctional degraders and molecular glues — for cancer and inflammatory disease. Its proprietary PRODEGY platform is built on Cereblon-binding expertise carried over from founders who worked on FDA-approved Cereblon modulators. The lead program BTX-9341, a dual CDK4/CDK6 degrader, is in Phase 1 for HR+/HER2- breast cancer, alongside BTX-10908 targeting SOS1 for pan-KRAS mutant cancers and PDE4 degraders for inflammatory conditions; the company also partners with Incyte on molecular glue degrader discovery. BioTheryX is a therapeutics developer with no public developer program: probes on 2026-08-02 returned 404 for /openapi.json, /swagger.json, /api-docs, /llms.txt and every /.well-known/ discovery path on biotheryx.com, and there is no api./developer./docs./portal. subdomain, GitHub organization, or published SDK.

providers.name: BlackBuck
providers.description: BlackBuck, operated by Zinka Logistics Solutions and incorporated in 2015, runs India's largest digital trucking platform, digitizing the truck-operator lifecycle for roughly a million truck operators (about 28% of India's truckers) across 100,000+ villages. Its super-app spans a loads marketplace, FASTag toll payments, fuel, GPS/telematics, vehicle and working-capital financing, and a used-trucks marketplace. Listed on the NSE as BLACKBUCK since November 2024, the company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer program, API documentation, or OpenAPI surface was found during enrichment; this profile carries the company identity plus a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Botristatechnologyinc
providers.description: Botrista Technology Inc provides automated beverage solutions and Beverage AI for foodservice operators, enabling fast, consistent, data‑driven drink dispensing across restaurants, campuses, theme parks and healthcare facilities. The platform includes the BotristaPro hardware, AI‑powered menu optimization, and a cloud service for analytics and remote management.

providers.name: Broadvision
providers.description: BroadVision spans two chapters of Dr. Pehong Chen's technology work. BroadVision, Inc. (NASDAQ: BVSN), founded in 1993 and backed by Mayfield, was a pioneer of e-commerce and enterprise self-service portal software and later the Vmoso enterprise collaboration platform; the operating company was acquired by ESW Capital in 2020. The broadvision.com domain is now home to BroadVision Group (BVG), a US-based private asset management firm formed in 2006 that funds, incubates, and operates ventures across artificial intelligence, cleantech, fintech, healthtech, biotech, medtech, semiconductors, and cloud/big-data. The company does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Bykea
providers.description: Bykea is a Karachi-based Pakistani mobility and logistics super-app that offers app-hailed motorbike rides, on-demand parcel and food delivery, cash pickup and drop-off, and digital payments across major Pakistani cities. It connects a large network of motorbike captains with riders and merchants, positioning itself as a low-cost transport, last-mile logistics, and financial services platform for the mass market. Backed by Prosus Ventures (Naspers), Bykea was added to the API Evangelist network as a mobility-sector portfolio lead; this profile has been enriched with the provider's public security surface (a live RFC 9116 security.txt and a HackerOne bug bounty program) and domain-security posture. No public developer portal, OpenAPI, or partner API documentation is exposed - the primary web surface sits behind Cloudflare bot protection.

providers.name: C7 Security
providers.description: Cerberus Tech, Inc. (C7 Security) is a Central Asian cybersecurity firm combining practical offensive security with research-backed methodology. Its flagship product, Cerberus, is an IDE and programming language purpose-built for ethical hackers to run faster penetration-testing assessments. Services span security assessment (penetration testing, audits, red teaming), secure development (code, design, and architecture reviews), OSINT reconnaissance, R&D grounded in type theory, and consulting. The company also runs C7 Academy, an elite penetration-testing training program, alongside free education and community initiatives. It reports 150+ security audits with a 95%+ penetration rate and 300+ students trained. Backed by 500 Global; surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead.

providers.name: Caira Surgical
providers.description: Caira Surgical is a pioneering medical technology company focused on advanced joint replacement software, scanning, and precision radar technologies. Their mission is to deliver sub-millimeter precision, intuitive workflows, and affordable solutions for surgeons worldwide. The team comprises experienced surgeons and engineers developing navigation systems for knee replacement, protected by multiple US patents. Caira aims to improve patient outcomes through innovative, reliable, and globally accessible surgical tools.

providers.name: Catalyx Space
providers.description: Catalyx Space Inc. is a San Francisco based space infrastructure company building an integrated platform for deploying payloads to low Earth orbit and returning them safely to the ground. The company develops autonomous orbital labs and reusable reentry vehicles (ReX) that use origami-inspired hypersonic decelerator technology to deliver heavy-mass downmass from orbit to ocean recovery zones, positioning itself as the fastest and most affordable way to deploy experiments and manufacture in orbit. Catalyx handles end-to-end space operations including spacecraft development, payload integration, launch logistics, mission control, and recovery. Surfaced as a Techstars (and Outlander) portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the company currently publishes a marketing and careers presence but no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Changba
providers.description: Changba (唱吧) is a Chinese mobile karaoke platform offering a large community for singing, sharing performances, and discovering music. The service provides a mobile app across iOS, Android, and Windows Phone, featuring millions of high‑quality backing tracks, user‑generated recordings, live streaming, and social interaction. It operates under Beijing CoolTech Technology Co., Ltd., with a focus on music entertainment and user‑generated content, and maintains a comprehensive website changba.com that showcases its features, licensing, and corporate information.

providers.name: Chaos
providers.description: CHAOS Industries is a U.S. defense-technology company founded in 2022 that builds advanced sensing and detection systems for military, border, and critical-infrastructure defense. Its Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN) technology powers a multi-product portfolio - including the Vanquish radar for early warning and tracking of unmanned aerial systems and missile threats, and HYDRA, a software-defined multi-application platform for detection, communications, and electronic effects. CHAOS markets domain dominance through counter-drone (counter-UAS) radar that detects threats up to ten minutes faster and tracks targets to 250 km. The company has raised roughly $1 billion from investors including 8VC, Accel, Valor Equity Partners, and NEA, with offices in Los Angeles, Washington DC, San Francisco, San Diego, London, and Amman. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; CHAOS publishes a marketing and newsroom presence but no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: ChurchTrac
providers.description: ChurchTrac is all-in-one church management software (ChMS) for small and large churches, covering people and member management, church directory, groups, attendance and check-in, event registration, worship planning and volunteer scheduling, online giving, and fund accounting/budgeting. ChurchTrac does NOT publish a public or partner developer API - there is no documented REST API, API keys, OAuth, or webhooks for building against ChurchTrac data. Its "integrations" are ChurchTrac consuming third-party services (Stripe for giving, SendGrid/Mailchimp for email, Twilio for texting, QuickBooks for accounting, Zoom); member-facing access is via the Church Connect app and embeddable online giving forms, not a programmable API surface. This entry is documented as an honest stub.

providers.name: Civil Maps
providers.description: Civil Maps was a San Francisco autonomous-vehicle mapping company founded in 2015 by Sravan Puttagunta and Scott Harvey, with Fabien Chraim and Anuj Gupta on the founding team. It built AI software that turned vehicle LiDAR and camera data into machine-readable HD 3D maps and delivered real-time six-degrees-of-freedom localization at 15-20 cm absolute accuracy, crowdsourcing map updates from production fleets rather than from dedicated survey vehicles, and packaged that as the Atlas DevKit and Atlas Lite DevKit car-mounted units. It raised roughly USD 17 million across four rounds, including a USD 6.6 million seed led by Motus Ventures with Ford Motor Company, Wicklow Capital, StartX and AME Cloud Ventures, and was acquired by Luminar Technologies in mid-2022 - an acquisition Luminar announced at CES in January 2023 and folded into its Sentinel platform. Civil Maps no longer operates as an independent business: civilmaps.com is a frozen four-page marketing archive stamped "Copyright 2019" with no developer section, it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract, and its 2015-era GitHub organization holds five C++ repositories last pushed between 2017 and 2020.

providers.name: contentbox
providers.description: ContentBox is a blockchain infrastructure company for the digital content industry, built by the team behind Castbox, a global podcast platform serving millions of users across 135 countries. ContentBox aims to give the industry three things: a shared content pool, a shared user pool, and a unified, token-based payout system. Its products include BOX Payout (a blockchain multi-party payment system), BOX Passport (blockchain identity and attribution across applications), and BOX Unpack (a turn-key platform for content creators). The foundation publishes open-source blockchain infrastructure (boxd) and first-party developer SDKs in JavaScript, Python, and Java through its BOXFoundation GitHub organization. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: Costco Wholesale
providers.description: Costco Wholesale Corporation is a Fortune 500 American multinational membership-only big-box retail chain that operates warehouse clubs offering a wide selection of merchandise at discounted prices. Costco does not publish a public developer API; supplier and trading partner integrations are conducted through EDI and B2B channels using ANSI X12 transactions and the Costco Supplier Portal. Costco operates an e-commerce site, the Costco Travel and Costco Pharmacy properties, and the Costco Photo Center.

providers.name: Culdesac
providers.description: Culdesac is a post-car real estate development company building walkable, car-free neighborhoods in the United States. Its first project, Culdesac Tempe in Tempe, Arizona, broke ground in 2019 and welcomed its first residents in 2021 — a 16-acre, roughly $140 million development of 636 apartment units plus 24,000 square feet of restaurant and retail space, designed with no resident parking. Residents receive transportation benefits such as free light-rail rides and discounted rideshare and scooter access in place of car ownership. Culdesac operates leasing, tours, and resident services through its website and HubSpot-backed portals, and intends to replicate the car-free neighborhood model in other cities. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Initialized Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Culdesac publishes no public developer API; this profile captures the company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: CytomX Therapeutics
providers.description: CytomX Therapeutics is a clinical-stage, oncology-focused biopharmaceutical company based in South San Francisco, California, pioneering a novel class of masked, conditionally activated biologic therapeutics built on its proprietary Probody platform. The Probody technology is engineered to remain inactive in healthy tissue and to become selectively unmasked and activated within the tumor microenvironment, with the goal of producing more potent, less toxic cancer medicines. The company's pipeline spans antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), T-cell engaging bispecific antibodies, and immunotherapies, advanced both internally and through partnerships with major pharmaceutical companies. CytomX is a publicly traded company (Nasdaq CTMX). This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners; as a biopharmaceutical research organization CytomX does not publish a public developer API, so this profile carries company identity and domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: DEM Bio
providers.description: DEM BioPharma is a Cambridge, Massachusetts biotechnology company developing first-in-class cancer therapeutics that target the signals solid tumors use to evade immune destruction. The company pioneers next-generation macrophage and innate-immune immunotherapies discovered through its proprietary CHoMP (Co-culture with Human Myeloid Phagocytes) functional-genomics platform, which uses CRISPR-based screening to identify novel "don't-eat-me" and activating targets on myeloid cells. DEM launched in 2022 with $70M in Series A financing and is backed by Longwood Fund, Emerson Collective, Pfizer Ventures, Astellas, and Insight Partners. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company profile; DEM publishes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Deutscher Bundestag DIP
providers.description: This API provides read access to DIP entities (e.g. activities, persons, printed material)

providers.name: Dimension
providers.description: Dimension is a nationwide, on-demand waste management and junk removal platform (formerly Trash Warrior) backed by 500 Global. It offers digital booking with instant AI-generated pricing (their "Mirror Mirror AI" quoter), same-day and next-day pickup for cardboard, appliances, mattresses, hazardous and medical waste, plus dumpster rentals, for both businesses and individuals. Every job includes tracking with detailed diversion data, receipts, and photos, and can be booked as a one-off or recurring service. Dimension has been awarded a State of California RFP contract for PPE waste removal. The company operates a customer-facing booking application and help center but does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Dispatch Goods
providers.description: Dispatch Goods is a reusable-packaging and reverse-logistics company that offers returnable containers and insulated bags as an alternative to single-use and compostable packaging for direct-to-consumer meal kits, grocery delivery, and food-service operations. The company handles the full circular loop — packaging, collection, washing, and redistribution — and markets its reusable system as a cheaper and lower-impact substitute for cardboard, gel packs, and insulation, citing reductions in water use and CO2 equivalent emissions. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or technical documentation.

providers.name: DivX, Inc. (NasdaqGS:DIVX)
providers.description: DivX is a San Diego-based digital video technology company best known for the DivX video codec and format. Under the former public company DivX, Inc. (NasdaqGS:DIVX), and today as DivX, LLC, it offers free and premium consumer software — DivX Software and DivX Pro for Windows and macOS — for playing, converting, and casting video, alongside a technology-licensing business that certifies DivX and HEVC playback in consumer electronics devices (the "DivX Certified" program). The company distributes desktop applications to end users and licenses codecs and playback technology to device manufacturers rather than operating a public developer API platform. Customer support is handled through a Zendesk help center, and enterprise/device partners are served via a Salesforce-based partner portal.

providers.name: Dognosis
providers.description: Dognosis is a Bengaluru, India deeptech company building olfaction AI that pairs trained detection dogs with machine learning to find disease from a single breath sample. Its product, BreathEasy, is a non-invasive breath test that produces a VOC-based cancer risk score for clinicians; a Phase 2 study published in the Journal of Clinical Oncology reported over 90% accuracy across seven cancer types, including at early and treatable stages. Dognosis is a portfolio company of Prosus Ventures. No public developer API is published today; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company's digital, discovery, and security surface (an llms.txt is served; no /.well-known discovery documents are published).

providers.name: doubleAI
providers.description: doubleAI (legal entity AAI Technologies Ltd.) is an Israeli AI research company building Artificial Expert Intelligence (AEI) — AI systems that focus their full training capacity on a single technical domain to match and surpass leading human experts, rather than pursuing broad general intelligence. Its flagship system, WarpSpeed, is an AI GPU performance engineer that optimizes NVIDIA kernels, beating hand-tuned expert baselines on the majority of tested kernels. Founded in late 2023 by Prof. Amnon Shashua and Prof. Shai Shalev-Shwartz and based in Ramat Gan, Israel, the company has raised roughly $221M from Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Michael Dell, Bessemer Venture Partners, Pitango First, and Greenfield Partners at a valuation exceeding $1B. doubleAI publishes research and open-source code but does not currently expose a public developer API.

providers.name: DPD
providers.description: DPD is a leading parcel delivery network, part of Geopost, operating in over 50 countries with brands such as DPD, Chronopost, SEUR, BRT, Speedy and Jadlog. It handles more than 8 million parcels daily, offering services across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas.

providers.name: Eco Gear
providers.description: Eco Gear (에코기어) is a South Korean food-technology company that develops natural biomaterial-based nano-coating preservation agents which extend the freshness of fresh produce and reduce food waste across the cold chain. Its product line — Flowting for cut flowers, Ecocell for stevia tomatoes, and Fruiting for citrus — forms an invisible, food-safe protective layer that slows moisture loss, browning, and mold without synthetic waxes or harmful emulsifiers, with field trials showing spoilage reduced by up to 71%. The company markets a physical-products and R&D business and does not currently publish a public developer API. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Ermetic
providers.description: Ermetic is a cloud security company founded in 2019 that pioneered cloud infrastructure entitlement management (CIEM) as part of a unified, identity-first cloud-native application protection platform (CNAPP) spanning AWS, Azure, and GCP. The platform provides full visibility into permissions and entitlements across multi-cloud environments, least-privilege and just-in-time access controls, anomaly detection against behavioral baselines, and compliance and cloud security posture management (CSPM). Ermetic raised roughly $100M from investors including Accel, Norwest Venture Partners, Glilot Capital Partners, and Target Global, and was acquired by Tenable in October 2023 for approximately $265M. The product now ships as Tenable Cloud Security; the ermetic.com domain redirects to Tenable, and the former Ermetic customer application (us.app.ermetic.com) exposes a login-gated REST API.

providers.name: Esar
providers.description: Esar (ايسار) is a Saudi Arabia and UAE based car rental marketplace that connects vehicle owners with renters through a mobile app, offering luxury, sports, family, and 4x4 vehicles across Riyadh, Jeddah, Mecca, and Dubai. The platform lets car owners list vehicles to earn recurring returns while giving travelers on-demand access to a curated fleet at competitive daily rates. Headquartered in Jeddah, Esar is an early-stage startup backed by 500 Global and the Taqadam accelerator. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a portfolio lead; no public developer API surface has been found to date.

providers.name: Fabheads
providers.description: Fabheads is a carbon fiber and composite manufacturing company (Fabheads Automation) that delivers end-to-end composite product development — design, analysis, tooling, prototyping, and production — using its own fiber-printing and automated-layup technology alongside traditional craftsmanship. It serves aerospace, mobility, marine, robotics, medical, and sports customers from aerospace-grade facilities, and publishes the C6 Slicer tool for composite fiber printing. Backed by Accel. As a hardware manufacturer it exposes no public developer API; this profile captures identity and domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Federal Committee on Statistical Methodology
providers.description: The Federal Committee on Statistical Methodology (FCSM) is an interagency committee, chartered by the Office of Management and Budget and supported by the OMB Statistical Policy Office, dedicated to improving the quality of U.S. Federal statistics. FCSM publishes methodology guidance, standards and conference proceedings — including A Framework for Data Quality — and convenes subcommittees and an annual research and policy conference. It is a policy and methodology body, not a data publisher: it does not operate or document a public developer API, and the statistical data itself is published by its member agencies under their own domains.

providers.name: FindMeCure
providers.description: FindMeCure is a Sofia, Bulgaria healthtech company (founded 2015, backed by Techstars) that connects patients with clinical trials through a patient-facing search engine often described as "the Google of clinical trials," letting people search, find, and join a trial within a few clicks. Its sister B2B product, TrialHub, is a clinical-trial strategy, feasibility, and patient-recruitment intelligence platform covering 70 countries and serving pharmaceutical sponsors and CROs including Takeda, Novartis, and Syneos Health.
