No public developer API is currently documented; this profile captures the company's identity and probed domain security posture.

providers.name: Flat
providers.description: Flat (now operating as Clau) is a Mexican proptech real-estate marketplace and financial-services platform backed by 500 Global and Anthemis. Clau lets people buy and rent apartments and houses across major Mexican cities including Mexico City, Guadalajara, Monterrey, and Queretaro, and originates mortgage credit (Cofinavit, construction, land-purchase, and liquidity loans). It also offers property valuations, a price-map database, renovation services, and seller listing tools, alongside "El Living", its real-estate education blog. The company is consumer-facing and does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile was surfaced from the 500 Global and Anthemis portfolios and enriched with domain-security and identity signals.

providers.name: FloSports
providers.description: FloSports is an Austin, Texas-based direct-to-consumer sports media and live-streaming company founded in 2006 by brothers Martin and Mark Floreani. It operates a network of vertical properties (FloWrestling, FloTrack, FloGrappling, FloRacing, FloHockey, FloRugby, FloFootball and more) that deliver live and on-demand event streaming, original programming, news, rankings, and results for underserved and passionate sports communities through a subscription model. FloSports surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures; enrichment probing found a consumer streaming site with no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI, well-known discovery documents, or SDK program at this time.

providers.name: fuboTV
providers.description: Fubo (fuboTV) is a live TV streaming service focused on sports, offering more than 100 live channels covering the NFL, NBA, MLB, soccer, Formula 1, NASCAR and major broadcast networks (ABC, NBC, CBS, FOX), alongside news, entertainment and on-demand content. The service includes cloud DVR, multi-device streaming and no-commitment monthly plans. fuboTV was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and northzone and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a direct-to-consumer streaming brand and does not publish a public developer API program; this profile captures its public web, legal, security and identity surface.

providers.name: Gain Credit
providers.description: GAIN Credit is a market-leading fintech providing responsible, AI-powered credit solutions for people underserved by traditional banks and lenders. The company combines deep financial expertise with advanced, AI-enabled credit-decisioning technology to offer affordable consumer lending, with funds disbursed within roughly 90 seconds of approval. GAIN Credit operates three consumer lending brands — Lending Stream, Drafty, and Afforda — serving the underserved credit market primarily in the UK, with operations across the US and India. Backed by QED Investors, Crosslink Capital, and Mohr Davidow. This corporate profile publishes no public developer API surface; it was surfaced as a QED Investors portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: GeoGrid
providers.description: Geogrid Co., Ltd. is a South Korean smart-building water technology company behind BLOS ("Building Oasis"), an integrated building-level water purification and monitoring system. BLOS delivers drinkable water from every tap using chemical-free ionization to eliminate rust, scale, and biofilm, and pairs it with real-time monitoring of water quality, usage, carbon emissions, and consumption plus predictive analytics for pipe condition, contamination risk, and filter replacement. Geogrid targets schools, hotels and resorts, public institutions, and healthcare facilities, and offers a BLOS Care membership service. The company is based at Seoul Startup Hub Seongsu, holds 21 registered patents, and has been recognized with venture certification, ESG awards, and selection as a Korean representative for WSA 2026. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio lead and enriched from the company's public website.

providers.name: Governata
providers.description: Governata is a Saudi Arabia-based data governance and management platform that helps government entities and enterprises turn complex data into business value through comprehensive, PDPL-aligned data management. Its product suite spans Data Governance (business glossary, data catalog, data classification, data lineage, metadata store, data quality), Master Data Management (domains, golden record, matching and survivorship), Data Privacy (personal-data discovery and protection under Saudi Arabia's Personal Data Protection Law, access management, and a service catalog), and Governata Core, an administrative backbone covering license management, audit trail, and workflows. Governata packages role-based solutions for chief data officers, compliance officers, data protection officers, and data stewards, and sector solutions for government, healthcare, financial services, insurance, telecom, retail, energy, and large enterprises. It is backed by 500 Global and is being profiled in the API Evangelist network. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification was found at the time of enrichment; this profile captures the company's identity and web presence.

providers.name: Haseel
providers.description: Haseel (حصيل) is a Riyadh-based technology startup, founded in 2018, that delivers fresh fruits and vegetables to consumers across Saudi Arabia through its iOS and Android mobile apps. The company sources high-quality produce and fulfills each order from the nearest of its branches inside Riyadh, pairing a curated selection with fast, reliable last-mile delivery. Haseel reports more than 400,000 app downloads, three branches inside Riyadh, and over 1,000 orders per day, and is backed by 500 Global. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Haseel is a consumer produce-delivery app and does not currently publish a public developer API or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Heart Aerospace
providers.description: Heart Aerospace is a hybrid-electric aircraft manufacturer founded in 2019 and headquartered in Torrance / Los Angeles, California, working to decarbonize and lower the cost of regional air travel. The company is developing the X1, a full-scale hybrid-electric technology demonstrator, and the ES-30, a 30-seat regional production aircraft, backed by strategic airline partners including United Airlines and Air Canada and investors such as Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Lowercarbon Capital, EQT Ventures, and Y Combinator. Heart Aerospace publishes no public developer or API surface; this profile tracks the company as an API Evangelist network entry in the sustainable-transport sector.

providers.name: Holo
providers.description: Holo (Holo AM, operating under Greene Group Industries) is an advanced metal additive manufacturing company founded in 2017 and backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. Its PureForm metal 3D printing platform uses digital light processing (DLP) with metal powder-filled photopolymer resins to produce high-resolution, complex metal components with features as small as 50 microns, in pure copper, stainless steels (17-4PH, 316), and in-development cobalt alloy, titanium, nickel superalloys, tool steels, and alumina. Customers submit CAD files and receive prototyped-to-production parts with roughly two-week turnaround, serving medical technology, precision micro-robotics, and general advanced manufacturing. Holo is a hardware manufacturer and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: HTML
providers.description: HTML (HyperText Markup Language) is the standard markup language for creating web pages and web applications. Maintained as a Living Standard by WHATWG and developed in close coordination with the W3C, HTML defines the structure and semantics of web content alongside CSS for presentation and JavaScript for behavior. The current specification covers semantic elements, multimedia (audio, video, picture, track), the canvas API, forms with rich input types and validation, web storage, custom elements, the dialog and popover patterns, and a broad set of DOM and document conformance rules. This index covers HTML-related standards, specifications, references, and resources relevant to API designers and web developers building on top of HTTP.

providers.name: HTML5
providers.description: HTML5 is the fifth major version of the HyperText Markup Language used for structuring and presenting content on the web. Standardized by the W3C in 2014 and now maintained by WHATWG as the HTML Living Standard, HTML5 introduced semantic elements (article, section, nav, header, footer, aside), native multimedia via the audio and video elements, the canvas drawing surface, web storage (localStorage and sessionStorage), geolocation, drag-and-drop, offline application support, Web Workers for background processing, and richer form input types with built-in validation. HTML5 remains the foundation for modern web applications and the substrate that HTTP-based APIs ultimately render and consume on the client.

providers.name: Hummingbird Bioscience
providers.description: Hummingbird Bioscience is a clinical-stage precision biotherapeutics company headquartered at The Galen, Singapore Science Park, with US operations, discovering and developing antibody-based medicines — including next-generation antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) — for hard-to-treat cancers and autoimmune disease. Its Rational Antibody Discovery (RAD) platform pairs computational target and epitope modelling with proprietary immunization strategies and Abvantage mice, and is combined with in-house linker-payload chemistry to engineer epitope-specific, high-affinity antibodies. Clinical programs include HMBD-001 (anti-HER3 monoclonal antibody) and HMBD-501 (HER3-targeted ADC, first patient dosed January 2026); HMBD-002 (anti-VISTA) was licensed to Percheron Therapeutics in 2025 and further antibodies were licensed to Immunome. The company sells drug programs and partnerships, not software: it publishes no developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: Hydroleap
providers.description: Hydroleap is a Singapore-based greentech company revolutionizing industrial water and wastewater treatment through proprietary electrochemical technology. Its chemical-free, modularized systems - electro-coagulation (HL-EC), electro-oxidation (HL-EO), and electro-oxidation for cooling towers (HL-EO-CT) - replace conventional chemical-intensive processes with automated, energy-efficient alternatives. Hydroleap serves data centers, palm oil mills, food and beverage production, pharmaceuticals manufacturing, and municipal wastewater operators, helping businesses cut operating costs, improve regulatory compliance, and reduce environmental impact. Backed by 500 Global, the company is profiled in the API Evangelist network; it publishes a product and marketing website but no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Internet Archive
providers.description: Internet Archive is a non-profit digital library offering free access to millions of books, movies, software, music, and archived web pages. It provides services such as the Wayback Machine, Open Library, and various APIs for searching and retrieving digital content, supporting researchers, historians, and the general public.

providers.name: Joes Future Food (Zhouzi Future)
providers.description: Joes Future Food (周子未来 / Nanjing Zhouzi Future Food Technology Co., Ltd.) is a Nanjing-based cellular agriculture and food-technology company pioneering cultivated (cell-cultured) meat in China. The founding team produced what it describes as China's first piece of cultivated meat, and the company develops cell-cultured pork products (pork belly, fatback, skin, meatballs, and a mixed family pack) alongside serum-free culture media and a catalog of primary and gene-edited animal cell lines (porcine adipose and muscle stem cells, bovine muscle and adipose cells, chicken embryo fibroblasts, and more) used across cultivated-meat research and biomanufacturing. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners. The company runs a corporate marketing website and publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Jow
providers.description: Jow is a consumer meal-planning and grocery-shopping application that turns personalized menu selection into an automated shopping list. From a catalog of thousands of recipes tailored to household size, dietary preferences and goals (keto, vegetarian, high-protein, gluten-free, kid-friendly, low-calorie), Jow builds a weekly menu and generates the matching grocery order, which users check out through integrated grocery-retail partnerships at optimized prices. Founded in France and available as iOS and Android mobile apps, Jow serves millions of active users. It is a portfolio company of Northzone. No public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and its probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Kadeya
providers.description: Kadeya is a Chicago-based, female-founded climate technology company operating a closed-loop, waste-free beverage vending system for workplaces. Its autonomous stations dispense filtered water and flavored, carbonated, and branded drinks into reusable stainless steel "Infinite Bottles," filling a cold beverage on demand in under seven seconds. Used bottles are returned to any station where they are autonomously cleaned, sanitized, and refilled for reuse, eliminating single-use plastic on site. Kadeya owns and operates the stations and sells hydration-as-a-service, charging workplaces per drink so beverages are free for employees. It serves industrial and manufacturing sites, fulfillment centers, offices, universities, and fitness centers, and reports up to a 75% carbon reduction versus PET plastic bottles. Kadeya was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI has been found.

providers.name: Knife River
providers.description: Knife River Corporation is one of the leading aggregates-led construction materials and contracting companies in the United States. The company mines, processes, and sells construction aggregates, ready-mix concrete, asphalt, and related products, and also performs heavy-civil construction services. Knife River operates across multiple western and central U.S. states.

providers.name: Lattice Health
providers.description: Lattice Health is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) healthcare company building AI governance as a managed service for hospitals. The platform sits beside an existing clinical stack and taps the HL7 and DICOM signals that deployed imaging and clinical AI models already emit, with no rip-and-replace integration, then continuously measures population drift (PSI), subgroup fairness disparity under HHS Section 1557, latency against target, and silent vendor model-update detection across every vendor model running in production. Rather than another dashboard, Lattice delivers a per-role signed PDF report each morning to IT directors, CMIO/CIO, and compliance officers, cryptographically signed with the institution's own signing key so any recipient, including outside counsel or a regulator, can verify the artifact offline with standard open-source tooling and no Lattice account or infrastructure. Radiologist thumbs-up/thumbs-down feedback on AI results is aggregated at model level and folded into the next morning's findings. The company positions itself around standards alignment (IHE UPS-RS work-list status, AI-Results and ERA classification, ONC HTI-1, FDA Predetermined Change Control Plan envelopes with automatic breach detection) and HIPAA-safe egress with a strict-mode PHI redactor, deployed on-premise or in the customer's private cloud so PHI stays behind the hospital firewall. As of this profile Lattice Health publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable API specification, SDKs, or pricing; it is a pre-public-API company tracked here as an AI governance and clinical AI oversight lead.

providers.name: Mana.bio
providers.description: Mana.bio is an AI-driven drug-delivery biotechnology company specializing in programmable lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) for nucleic-acid therapeutics and vaccines, including mRNA, DNA, and CRISPR-based gene therapy. The company runs a closed-loop design-build-test-learn platform that uses machine-learning models to design novel LNP candidates, synthesizes dozens of formulations weekly via high-throughput automation, screens them with comprehensive assays, and feeds results back to continuously improve its models — targeting precise, optimized extrahepatic delivery. Mana.bio also operates Mina (ChatLNP), an AI agent that helps scientists explore curated literature, predict LNP properties, and optimize formulations, plus an LNP patents / freedom-to-operate map. The company is backed by a16z. Mana.bio publishes no first-party developer or product API; its only public agent surface is a Wix Site MCP endpoint and an llms.txt on its site.

providers.name: Market Vibe
providers.description: MarketVibe (marketvibe.com) is a finance and technology news blog that publishes ongoing coverage under the tagline "The Financial Status of the World" — market trends, startup funding, and developer-focused technology news (for example, recurring roundups of Replit funding talks, feature releases, and AI developments). It is a WordPress.com / Newspack-hosted publication organized into Tech, Finance, and Lifestyle categories, offering articles and an RSS feed rather than a developer API product. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio lead and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found a content/media site with no product API surface (only the default WordPress REST API at /wp-json/).

providers.name: Matrimony Com
providers.description: Matrimony.com Ltd is India's largest wed-tech company and a pioneer in online matchmaking since 2000. Headquartered in Chennai, it operates BharatMatrimony, EliteMatrimony, CommunityMatrimony, Jodii, MeraLuv and 300+ community and regional matrimony portals, alongside wedding-services brands WeddingBazaar, Mandap.com, ManyJobs and WeddingGiftBox. Publicly listed on the NSE and BSE, the company serves roughly 7.5 million customers monthly and is backed by investors including Mayfield. It is a consumer-facing platform and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal surface at this time.

providers.name: MBA Polymers
providers.description: MBA Polymers is a global plastics recycling company founded in 1997 that transforms waste plastics recovered from end-of-life durable goods such as computers, electronics, appliances, and automobiles into high-quality post-consumer recycled polymer granulates. Grades include ABS, impact-modified PS, PC/ABS, PP copolymer, and HDPE, produced through a three-step separate, clean, and finish process across operations in several countries. The company publishes no developer API, SDK, or technical developer surface; it was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company profile of balderton-capital.

providers.name: Mediacao Online
providers.description: MOL (Mediacao Online) is Brazil's first online dispute resolution (ODR) platform, founded in 2014 in Sao Paulo. It is a 100% digital, automated platform for negotiation, conciliation, and mediation that lets individuals, companies, and institutions resolve conflicts extrajudicially without going to court. The CNJ-compliant platform covers the full flow, from capturing cases in the courts, building agreement policies, sanitizing and enriching data, through to agreement approval and payment. MOL has facilitated tens of thousands of agreements and counts Magazine Luiza, Itau, and Caixa Economica among its clients. It is backed by 500 Global, Wayra, Canary, and Redpoint eventures. MOL exposes no public developer API or documentation surface.

providers.name: MOLG
providers.description: MOLG (molg.ai) is a circular manufacturing company tackling electronic waste. It operates autonomous robotic microfactories that disassemble complex devices like laptops and servers to recover components and materials for reuse, remanufacturing, and recycling. MOLG also partners with manufacturers on design-for-circularity (modular snap/press-fit/latch assembly instead of screws and adhesives) and offers OriginMark, a traceability platform for tracking devices, components, and materials across their lifecycle to calculate embodied carbon and supply-chain transparency. As of this enrichment pass MOLG publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or technical documentation; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: MorphL
providers.description: MorphL was an AI and machine learning platform for e-commerce and digital publishing personalization, offering a suite of API-based, fully-automated models that predicted user behaviors (shopping stage, churn, search intent) to power click-through, conversion, and personalization KPIs across the customer journey. Founded circa 2017 and funded through the Google Digital News Initiative, the European Data Incubator, and the Techstars Montreal AI accelerator, MorphL also shipped an open-source MorphL Community Edition (big-data + Spark/Cassandra ML pipeline). MorphL was acquired by Algolia in January 2021 to power Algolia's AI-driven predictive experiences and personalization. The company's product APIs and hosted developer surface are no longer operated as a standalone service; the morphl.ai and morphl.io domains no longer resolve. The archived open-source code remains public under the Morphl-AI GitHub organization.

providers.name: Movopack
providers.description: Movopack is a Milan-based sustainability startup, founded in 2021 and backed by Techstars, 360 Capital, and Greiner Innoventures, that provides reusable, customizable packaging for e-commerce, retail, and B2B logistics. Its circular system pairs branded reusable mailers with pre-paid return labels and QR-code drop-off points, then handles quality checks, cleaning, and redistribution — cutting packaging waste by up to 98% and CO2 emissions by 84% after repeated reuse cycles. Movopack is a physical-product and reverse-logistics company and does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Neuroware.io
providers.description: Neuroware is a Malaysia-based blockchain infrastructure provider that has been building distributed-ledger applications since 2010, working with government agencies and regulated fintech operators. Its flagship Cortex platform offers a unified interface for managing multiple blockchains and protocols, powered by private, use-case-customized APIs delivering identity, authentication and role management, distributed data and document storage, custom token generation and analytics, and cryptographic keyless e-wallets. Related products include COKEEPS (regulated digital-asset custody), OVIATO (PassKey-native self-custody wallet infrastructure), and R1 (training and consultancy). Neuroware also created the earlier Blockstrap blockchain application stack and API. No current public, documented API or OpenAPI surface is published; APIs are delivered privately per engagement.

providers.name: Nexu
providers.description: Nexu is a Mexico City fintech that provides automotive financing at the point of sale. Founded in 2014 by Abdon Nacif and Fernando Gomez Arriola, the company began as an auto price and comparison site and now operates a digital lending platform used by car dealerships across Mexico to originate credit and leasing offers in real time. Nexu underwrites and funds two consumer products - credito automotriz (auto credit) and arrendamiento (leasing with a purchase option and no residual), distributed through partnerships with more than ten OEM dealer networks including Nissan, Volkswagen, Kia, Hyundai, Mazda, Honda, Ford, Chevrolet, BMW and Audi. Applicants complete an onboarding and identity flow in a browser application at nexu.mx and receive a decision without visiting a branch. The company has raised roughly $73M across five equity rounds, plus debt facilities, from Valor Capital Group, Altos Ventures, Wollef, Architect Capital, Clocktower, Tresalia Capital, FJ Labs, Gilgamesh Ventures and others. As of this profiling pass Nexu publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind - see x-coverage below.

providers.name: Nofence
providers.description: Nofence is a Norwegian agritech company (founded 2011, headquartered in Batnfjordsøra, Norway) that produces the world's first commercial virtual fencing system for livestock. Solar-powered GPS collars worn by cattle, sheep and goats keep animals inside virtual pastures that farmers draw on a map, with the collar teaching animals boundaries through audio cues before a mild electric pulse. The system is operated entirely from a mobile app (iOS and Android) and a web portal, communicating over GPS and the cellular network with no base stations or buried wire. Farmers get real-time animal location, boundary/escape push notifications, herd replay, grazing-history and multi-species management. Nofence is a consumer/farmer-facing product: as of this profile it publishes a mobile app and web portal but no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface. It is a portfolio company of Speedinvest, added to the API Evangelist network for tracking.

providers.name: Open Data Minneapolis
providers.description: Spatial (GIS) and non-spatial city data for Minneapolis

providers.name: Open Government, Ireland
providers.description: Ireland Government Open Data

providers.name: Open Government, Norway
providers.description: Norwegian Government Open Data

providers.name: OpenEyes Insurance
providers.description: OpenEyes Insurance (OpenEyes Insurance Agency, Inc.) is an Austin, Texas-based insurtech startup, with an additional New York office, that provides commercial auto insurance for truck and bus fleet operators bundled with proprietary risk-prevention technology. Its offering pairs fleet coverage with real-time driver monitoring, AI dashcams, safety analytics, customized driver training, and 24/7 claims management, serving both insurance agents (For Agents) and fleet operators directly (For Fleets). Founded by Yoav Oron (CEO), Dr. Omry Sendik (CTO), and Dan Charash (Chairman), OpenEyes emerged from stealth in February 2023 with a $23M Series A led by Insight Partners with Pitango First. The company operates a customer-facing fleet dashboard but does not publish a public developer API, portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Orbital Arc
providers.description: Orbital Arc is a Houston-based deep-tech spacecraft propulsion startup founded in 2023 by Jonathan Huffman, building Gas-Phase Field Effect Electric Propulsion (Gas FEEP) thrusters and the RIOT Drive (Relativistic Ion Thrust Drive) for satellites and in-space transportation. Its ultra-lightweight electric thrusters use solid naphthalene fuel that sublimates at room temperature instead of noble gases, targeting high specific impulse for satellite constellations. Backed by Techstars and Capital Factory, the company completed a sub-scale physics demonstration at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (TRL 3). This is a hardware company with no public API, SDK, or developer surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Otolith
providers.description: Otolith Labs, Inc. (trading as Otolith) is a privately held, clinical-stage medical device company headquartered at 200 Massachusetts Ave NW in Washington, D.C., founded in 2015 by Sam Owen and developing a non-invasive wearable headband — the OtoBand — that applies calibrated mechanical vibration to the vestibular system, a technique the company calls non-invasive Vestibular Resonance Therapy (nVRT) or vestibular masking, to reduce the symptoms of chronic vertigo and vestibular migraine without surgery, medication, or patient-specific calibration. The device holds an FDA Breakthrough Device designation, has been evaluated in clinical work spanning 600+ subjects, and is being studied for cybersickness in virtual reality. Otolith Labs is backed by Morningside Ventures, Mark Cuban Companies and a group of ENT physician investors. It is a physical medical device manufacturer: it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification, and its only web surface is a WordPress marketing, investor and clinical-trial site.

providers.name: Owens & Minor
providers.description: Owens & Minor is a global Fortune 500 healthcare solutions company providing essential products and services to healthcare providers and manufacturers across the continuum of care, including medical and surgical supplies distribution, home healthcare equipment (Apria, Byram Healthcare), and outsourced logistics. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: PierSight Space
providers.description: PierSight Space is an India-based space technology company building a constellation of Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and Automatic Identification System (AIS) satellites for persistent, all-weather maritime surveillance of the world's oceans. Founded by former ISRO engineer Gaurav Seth, PierSight delivers near-real-time ocean monitoring (targeting ~30-minute data latency and 100% ocean coverage) to detect illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing, monitor oil spills, protect Exclusive Economic Zones, support maritime insurance risk assessment, and improve shipping operations. The company has raised roughly $8M from investors including Alpha Wave Ventures, Elevation Capital, and Techstars. As of this enrichment pass PierSight sells data solutions to enterprise and government clients and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Punch Software
providers.description: Punch! Software is a consumer and professional home, interior, and landscape design software company, describing itself as the number-one global brand in home design with over twenty years of market innovation. Its Punch! Home & Landscape Design product line lets homeowners, remodelers, and designers plan and visualize renovation projects in 3D across Windows and Mac, with tools for paint, flooring, stone, decks, patios, and blinds. The company was recapitalized by Insight Partners (formerly Insight Venture Partners) and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. It sells packaged desktop design software directly to retail and professional customers and publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK at this time.

providers.name: Qarbotech
providers.description: Qarbotech (Qarbotech Sdn Bhd) is a Malaysian agritech and nanotechnology company that develops biocompatible organic compounds to optimize plant photosynthesis and raise agricultural productivity. Its flagship product, QarboGrow, is a photosynthesis-enhancing treatment marketed to boost photosynthetic efficiency and lift crop yields by roughly 20-30% while improving plant health, disease resistance, and crop quality, alongside the Harvast and Harvast+ product lines. Headquartered in Puchong, Selangor with additional offices in Bukit Mertajam, Penang and Jakarta, Indonesia, the company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. Qarbotech is a physical-product agritech business and publishes no public developer, API, or documentation surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Quantumdiamonds
providers.description: QuantumDiamonds (QD) is a Munich-based German deep-tech company that develops diamond-based quantum sensing systems for semiconductor inspection and failure analysis. The company markets what it describes as the world's first commercially available quantum sensing system for semiconductor inspection, using nitrogen-vacancy (NV) diamond quantum microscopy to detect defects and current-flow anomalies that traditional inspection methods miss. QuantumDiamonds is a portfolio company of the venture firm Earlybird and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile. As a quantum hardware and instrumentation company, it does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web presence and company identity.

providers.name: Quintessent
providers.description: Quintessent is a Goleta, California deep-tech photonics company developing quantum dot laser and optical interconnect technology to scale computing and AI infrastructure. The company builds quantum dot epitaxial wafer supply chains (in partnership with IQE) and optical connectivity solutions for AI optical interconnects, targeting the bandwidth and energy-efficiency bottlenecks of next-generation data centers. Backed by Sierra Ventures, Quintessent is a hardware and semiconductor company; as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API documentation.

providers.name: Rebaja Tus Cuentas
providers.description: Rebaja Tus Cuentas is a Latin American consumer fintech, backed by 500 Global, that helps individuals lower their debt and monthly loan payments. Through its website (rebajatuscuentas.com, redirecting to rtc.pe in Peru) it lets people compare refinancing and debt-consolidation offers from banks and lenders to reduce the cost of their existing loans, credit cards, and other obligations. It operates as a business-to-consumer marketing and lead-generation platform built on WordPress and fronted by Cloudflare, with a public blog and help center but no publicly documented developer program, API, or integration surface at the time of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Recreation Information Database
providers.description: Recreational areas, federal lands, historic sites, museums, and other attractions/resources(US)

providers.name: Riggs Distler
providers.description: Riggs Distler & Company is an energy and utility infrastructure construction firm operating since 1909. Now part of Centuri Group, the company delivers electric transmission and distribution, natural gas, renewable energy, emergency response, and heavy civil services across the United States and Canada. Riggs Distler is a field-services contractor with no public developer APIs or developer portal.

providers.name: Sailo
providers.description: Sailo is a global peer-to-peer boat rental and yacht charter marketplace, founded in 2014, that connects private boat owners and captains with renters across more than 3 continents, 50 countries, and 500 locations including New York, Miami, the Caribbean, Athens, and Phuket. The platform lists over 30,000 boats ranging from powerboats to luxury mega yachts for hourly, daily, and weekly charters with optional captain services, and provides verified listings, reviews, booking, and customer support to both sides of the transaction. Sailo is a Techstars-backed consumer marketplace and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Seppure
providers.description: SepPure Technologies (Seppure) is a deep-tech company building advanced organic solvent nanofiltration (OSN) membrane systems that make industrial chemical separation dramatically more sustainable, claiming processes up to 580x less energy intensive than conventional thermal separation. Its product line includes GreenMem organic solvent nanofiltration membranes, RE(SOLV) solvent recovery systems, and DE(SOLV) oil-refinery equipment, serving edible-oil refining, pharmaceutical filtration, semiconductor processing, and specialty chemicals across offices in Singapore and Calgary, Canada. It is a 500 Global portfolio company. Seppure sells membranes online at seppure.shop and publishes no public API, developer documentation, or GitHub organization at this time.

providers.name: Singularity6
providers.description: Singularity 6 is a Los Angeles-based video game development studio founded in 2018 by a team of experienced developers, several of them Riot Games alumni, with the mission of forging alternate worlds that deepen players' lives. The studio is the developer and publisher of Palia, a free-to-play community simulation MMO where players build a cozy life, craft, farm, fish, and explore a shared social world with friends. Palia launched into open beta on PC and Nintendo Switch and has grown to millions of registered players. Singularity 6 was acquired by Daybreak Game Company in 2024. The company operates a consumer gaming business and does not publish a public developer API program; this profile documents the company's public web presence rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Spotangels
providers.description: SpotAngels is a consumer parking application that helps drivers find free and cheap parking, understand and avoid confusing street-parking rules, get reminders before street cleaning and permit-zone changes, and book discounted garage and lot parking in major cities. The company also runs business programs for cities, universities, and parking operators/owners to surface availability and deals. SpotAngels is a Y Combinator-backed company. As of this enrichment pass it exposes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface; its integrations are business partnerships rather than developer-facing APIs.

providers.name: Stillwater
providers.description: Stillwater is an insurance provider offering home, auto, renters, condo, and business insurance solutions. Founded in 2000 as part of Fidelity National Property and Casualty Insurance Group, it has grown to serve customers nationwide with a focus on personalized service and comprehensive coverage options. The company emphasizes a smooth quoting process, leveraging technology to provide quick estimates and easy policy management for individuals and businesses alike.

providers.name: Storytree
providers.description: Storytree Inc. is a Palo Alto consumer photo company, backed by 500 Global, that operates SimplePrints (simpleprints.com, formerly getsimpleprints.com) — a mobile-first service that turns the photos on your phone into physical products: layflat and mini photo books, canvas prints, metal prints and metal desk prints, photo cards, and wall calendars. The app pulls images directly from the phone with no exporting or reformatting, and the business adds a referral program, promotional discounts, and a schools program. SimplePrints is a business-to-consumer mobile app and does NOT publish a developer API, SDKs, OpenAPI, or a developer portal. The one machine-consumable surface it exposes is a Wix-hosted llms.txt and a generic Wix Site MCP endpoint for agentic access to public site content (business details, site search, and a bridge to Wix business-solution APIs).

providers.name: Summoners Arena
providers.description: Summoners Arena is a blockchain-based, multi-genre play-to-earn game universe set in the antique lore of Summonia, where players summon, evolve, and battle NFT heroes across PvP modes (Arena, Battleground) and PvE content (Dungeon, Campaign), with an in-game NFT marketplace supporting hero renting, equipment collection, and forging. Backed by Pantera Capital, it operates in the Web3 / crypto gaming sector. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the company publishes a consumer game and community surface but no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or well-known discovery documents were found.

providers.name: TerraPower
providers.description: TerraPower is a Bellevue, Washington-based advanced nuclear innovation company founded in 2006 with Bill Gates as founder and chair. Its flagship product is the Natrium reactor, a 345 MWe sodium-cooled fast reactor co-developed with GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy and paired with an integrated molten salt energy storage system that can boost output to 500 MWe for up to five-plus hours to follow renewable grid load. TerraPower broke ground in 2024 on the first commercial Natrium demonstration plant in Kemmerer, Wyoming under the U.S. Department of Energy's Advanced Reactor Demonstration Program (ARDP), a 50/50 cost-share with up to $2 billion in federal funding. The company's second business line, TerraPower Isotopes (TPI), produces research-grade actinium-225 — an alpha-emitting radionuclide used in targeted alpha therapy for cancer — from DOE thorium-229 stockpiles in partnership with Isotek, with a lab in Everett WA and a cGMP manufacturing facility under construction in Philadelphia's Bellwether District. TerraPower has no commercial developer API, SDK, or public partner integration platform; its revenue model is reactor sales, plant operation, and isotope supply contracts with pharmaceutical partners including Aktis Oncology, Advanced Accelerator Applications, Cardinal Health, and Point Biopharma. The company does maintain a meaningful open-source nuclear engineering footprint on GitHub — most notably ARMI (Advanced Reactor Modeling Interface), an Apache 2.0 Python framework for nuclear reactor design and analysis automation used internally to design Natrium and made available to the wider reactor engineering community.

providers.name: The Bouqs
providers.description: The Bouqs Co. is a direct-from-farm online flower and plant delivery service headquartered in Marina del Rey, California, offering fresh cut bouquets, potted plants, wedding and event florals, and recurring flower subscriptions sourced from sustainable farm partners in South America and California. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Partech. This is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, API documentation, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API artifacts. This profile captures verifiable company identity plus live domain-security posture only.

providers.name: theCut
providers.description: theCut is a mobile application and web platform that connects clients with barbers and hair professionals across all 50 U.S. states. Users find a barber near them, browse portfolio photos and verified reviews, see upfront pricing, book and confirm appointments in real time, message their barber in-app, and pay with cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, or Cash App Pay. The service has facilitated over 100 million haircut bookings. theCut publishes no public developer API or documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: TripleW
providers.description: TripleW Ltd. (Belgian operating entity TripleW NV) is an industrial biotechnology and specialty-chemicals company founded in 2016, headquartered at Innovatiestraat 1, 2030 Antwerpen, Belgium, with a US office in Shorewood, Wisconsin and R&D split between Israel and Belgium. Its patented process treats food waste as a third-generation renewable feedstock: hydrolysis, fermentation and purification yield pure lactic acid, sold under the Circulac brand in grades for personal care, home care, food and beverage and industrial use, and as the building block of polylactic acid (PLA) bioplastic. The same process chemically recycles discarded PLA back into feedstock, and can be installed inside existing waste-management infrastructure. Its flagship commercial Circulac facility is at the Port of Antwerp. TripleW sells industrial chemical product and engineering services, not software: no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: TruKKer
providers.description: TruKKer is a tech-enabled logistics and transportation company serving businesses across the EMEA region. Its platform uses AI-driven freight matching and smart route visibility to connect shippers with carriers for land freight, cross-border transport, rent-by-trip, and home and office moving, alongside services such as ProcureCo and TruKKer Safe. TruKKer was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. During enrichment no public developer API, API documentation, SDK, CLI, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface was found on trukker.com; this profile captures the company's public web identity and a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Twine Ventures
providers.description: Twine Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm "transforming human and planetary health," writing first checks into interdisciplinary, data-obsessed founders who use data and AI to transform legacy industries across healthcare, industrials, and fintech/data. It was founded by Leshika Samarasinghe — early Google product team, founding member of ARPA-E, and former Managing Partner at The Production Board — who raised a $25M debut fund in 2022 (WSJ); Ethan Yeh, PhD, former Head of Data Science at Stripe, joined as Managing Partner. Its ~33-company portfolio includes Apella, Alaffia, Rupa Health (acq), Waltz Health (acq), Waymark, Teiko Bio, CloudCruise, and Rowspace. Surfaced as a Foundry Group partner-fund lead in the API Evangelist network; the firm runs a Webflow marketing site and publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable surface.

providers.name: UpsideHoM
providers.description: Upside (joinupside.com, originally UpsideHoM) is a housing-stability company for health plans and employers. It finds, houses, and stabilizes members whose housing instability disrupts health, care, and outcomes at scale - accepting referrals, assessing housing needs, executing stabilization or transitions, coordinating with community partners, and documenting outcomes for Medicaid and Medicare plans, health systems, and employer programs. A Techstars portfolio company, Upside publishes no public developer program or API surface as of 2026-07-21.

providers.name: Utility Global
providers.description: Utility Global is a Houston, Texas industrial decarbonization company founded in 2018. Its proprietary H2Gen and eXERO platform converts water into high-purity hydrogen using the residual electrochemical energy already present in industrial off-gases and biogenic gases — driving water electrolysis without electricity — while concentrating CO2 into a separate capture-ready stream. The company sells into steel, low-carbon fuels, and refining, petrochemicals and chemicals, and has run demonstration programs on blast-furnace off-gas at commercial steel facilities. It is a hardware and process-technology business, not a software vendor: its public web presence is a marketing site with no developer program, no API documentation, and no machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Vanti Analytics
providers.description: Vanti Analytics was an Israeli adaptive-AI-for-manufacturing company backed by Insight Partners, offering AI-based defect detection, early fault prediction, predictive quality, and process tuning across production lines via a hosted application (app.vanti-analytics.com). The company published no public API, OpenAPI spec, SDKs, or developer program, and as of 2026-07-21 it has no live web presence - vanti-analytics.com has lapsed and is parked by a third party, vanti.ai is for sale, and the former app/support/docs subdomains no longer resolve.

providers.name: Viki
providers.description: Viki (Rakuten Viki) is a global video streaming service specializing in Korean dramas, Chinese dramas, and other Asian television shows and movies, subtitled into more than 200 languages by a community of volunteer contributors (the name is a portmanteau of "video" and "wiki"). Founded as a startup backed by 500 Global, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), and CRV, Viki was acquired by Rakuten in 2013 and now operates as part of Rakuten's media portfolio. The consumer product streams licensed content on web, mobile, and connected-TV apps, funded by advertising and a Viki Pass subscription. Viki does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; it exposes an internal application API (api.viki.io) that powers its own clients and requires app credentials, and a community contribution platform for volunteer subtitlers and segmenters. This profile was surfaced as a venture-portfolio lead and enriched with the honest finding that there is no public API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Wikifarmer
providers.description: Wikifarmer is a global agricultural platform that connects producers with buyers through a B2B marketplace for agricultural products and educates farmers through expert-reviewed content. It provides practical agricultural knowledge, market access, and price insights for farmers, agribusinesses, traders, and food companies worldwide, with a multilingual educational library covering crop cultivation, livestock, sustainability, soil management, irrigation, pest control, and post-harvest handling, alongside a global marketplace connecting suppliers and buyers and a price-insights service for agricultural commodities.

providers.name: 6Cloud Technology
providers.description: 6Cloud Technology (Chinese name 六方云; legal entity Beijing 6Cloud Information Technology Co., Ltd. / 北京六方云信息技术有限公司) is a Beijing-based industrial and critical-infrastructure cybersecurity product vendor founded in 2018 and backed by China's Ministry of Science and Technology results-transformation fund. It builds and sells appliances and platforms across five product lines plus a security-services practice: industrial control security (LinSec — industrial firewall, industrial network audit and intrusion detection, industrial host guard, data diode/gateway, vulnerability scanner, asset and risk management), network security (NSec — next-generation firewall, IPS, IDS, operations management and audit, log audit and analysis, database audit), cloud security (CSec — distributed virtual firewall, distributed virtual IDS, cloud security resource scheduling), AI security (AiSec — network threat detection and retrospection), and situational-awareness security (CdSec — industrial situational awareness and security operations platform), alongside simulation and training range systems. It markets under an "AI gene, threat immunity" positioning and sells into rail transit, power, oil and gas and petrochemicals, public services, water conservancy, intelligent manufacturing, and smart mining. Products are delivered as vendor-sold appliances and platforms; the company publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: ADstruc
providers.description: ADstruc is a technology platform for the out-of-home (OOH) advertising industry, founded in 2010 in New York City by John Laramie and Sam Herbert. It provides workflow-automation software, including its Drive product, that lets brands and agencies plan, buy, and manage traditional and digital out-of-home media campaigns, and gives OOH operators cloud-based tools to manage and promote their inventory and interact with clients in real time. ADstruc was acquired by Vistar Media in April 2024 (from PJX Media) and the product is now sold as "Adstruc by Vistar Media" as part of that company's out-of-home advertising stack. ADstruc publishes no public developer API, portal, SDK or machine-readable contract of its own. The www.adstruc.com site is now a splash page whose only live routes are / and /login, and every developer and /.well-known/ path returns 404. The SSP and DSP APIs at developers.vistarmedia.com belong to Vistar Media, name Vistar hosts, and never mention ADstruc, so they are profiled under Vistar Media rather than credited here.

providers.name: Advanced Solar Power
providers.description: Advanced Solar Power (Hangzhou) Inc. is a Chinese photovoltaic manufacturer founded in 2008 that researches, produces and sells cadmium telluride (CdTe) thin-film solar modules, photovoltaic system engineering, and building-integrated photovoltaic (BIPV) application products. It was the first CdTe thin-film module manufacturer in China, is led by former CdTe conversion-efficiency world-record holder Professor Xuanzhi Wu, and has developed its own deposition equipment and process technology. Its S1, S2 and S4 standard modules and BIPV lines (photovoltaic floor tiles, imitation-aluminum and imitation-marble facade modules, shaped and insulated modules) carry ISO, TUV, CE, UL, CQC, Australia CEC and California CEC certifications, and have been deployed on the China Pavilion of the 2019 Beijing Horticultural Expo and other landmark facade and rooftop projects. The company sells physical hardware and system integration; it publishes no developer program, API, or machine-readable interface of any kind.

providers.name: AgotoZ Technology
providers.description: AgotoZ Technology (观脉科技 / Agotoz Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd.) is a Beijing-headquartered network-as-a-service provider, registered in 2016 and in commercial operation since 2017, that builds and operates ALLWAN — a self-built global SD-WAN overlay network the company says reaches more than 70 countries and regions — alongside the Linker and Linker Pro CPE intelligent access gateways, a global integrated CDN, cloud connection and one-stop public cloud services, SASE dynamic secure access, DDoS protection, worldwide data centre and co-location resources, and the Lingyin LinkTo real-time transmission service. Its stack applies layer 2 through layer 7 SD-WAN technology — VxLAN, millisecond-scale global dynamic routing, single- and bilateral TCP/UDP acceleration, efficient data compression and high-performance caching — to low-latency enterprise interconnect and application acceleration for gaming, VR/AR/MR, online education, audio and video conferencing, and internet companies. AgotoZ states it holds full MIIT telecommunications licences (A24-1, B11, B12, B13, B14), is a Chinese National High-tech Enterprise, and has served more than 200 global internet companies; it has raised roughly $57M from Legend Capital, SIG China, CICC Capital and NGP Capital, and runs offices in Beijing, Shanghai, Singapore and Hong Kong. The company sells through a trial-request and sales motion and publishes no developer portal, API reference, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind, though it does operate a credential-gated API host of its own at openapi.agotoz.com.

providers.name: AkashX
providers.description: AkashX is a Techstars-backed data and AI company building an Online Cognitive Processing (OLCP) Database and a declarative "Cognitive SQL" engine for reasoning over structured and unstructured data at scale. Its platform runs small language models in-database to deliver low-latency, token-efficient, deterministic inference as an alternative to probabilistic RAG, with semantic operations such as Cognitive Join, Cognitive Classify, and Cognitive Topic Discovery, plus Ontology Views that turn files into queryable tables for agents. It integrates with lakehouse environments like Databricks and targets financial intelligence, sales analysis, healthcare and clinical-trial, and talent-screening use cases. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio lead and enriched by the pipeline; no public API, SDK, or developer documentation is published yet.

providers.name: Aladdin B2B
providers.description: Aladdin B2B is a business-to-business matchmaking and meetings platform that helps enterprises, event organizers, government trade-promotion agencies, and trade shows create qualified B2B meetings that lead to transactions. Combining human expertise with artificial intelligence, Aladdin matches buyers and sellers based on their stated needs and hundreds of intelligent signals, then organizes pre-qualified, structured meetings and gives both parties the context they need beforehand. The platform is delivered through the Aladdin mobile app and the Aladdin Wish Chrome extension, with particular strength across the Middle East and Africa. Aladdin B2B is a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: Alyne
providers.description: Alyne is a cloud-native governance, risk and compliance (GRC) platform, founded in Munich in 2015 and acquired by Mitratech in 2021, where it is now offered as Mitratech's Alyne. The platform pairs a large curated library of controls and regulatory content with AI-assisted risk assessments, control mapping, maturity scoring and reporting, helping enterprises and FinTechs manage cyber, operational and third-party risk. Alyne is delivered as SaaS through app.alyne.com and is positioned to integrate with common IT, compliance and data systems. As of this profile Alyne exposes no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI definition; this record captures its public identity and probed domain security.

providers.name: Amberkinetics
providers.description: Amberkinetics is a biotechnology startup focused on synthetic biology and life‑science research. It develops engineered microbial platforms for sustainable production of high‑value compounds, aiming to accelerate innovation in biotech and provide scalable solutions for industry and academia. The company emerged from the API Evangelist harvest backlog and is being profiled for its API ecosystem.

providers.name: AMI Labs
providers.description: AMI Labs is a frontier AI research lab building intelligent systems that understand the real world. The lab develops world models trained with self-supervised learning on continuous, high-dimensional sensor data (cameras and other sensors), aiming for AI with persistent memory, reasoning and planning, and controllable, safety-oriented behavior. Targeted applications span industrial process control, automation, wearable devices, robotics, and healthcare. Founded by Yann LeCun as Executive Chairman with Alexandre LeBrun as CEO, AMI Labs launched officially on 2026-03-10 with a $1.03B USD round co-led by Cathay Innovation, Greycroft, Hiro Capital, HV Capital, and Bezos Expeditions, and operates from Paris, New York, Montreal, and Singapore. The lab operates as a research organization and publishes no public developer platform, API, SDKs, documentation, or machine-readable contract: amilabs.xyz is a two-page site whose own sitemap declares only / and /updates, and every OpenAPI, GraphQL, MCP, A2A and /.well-known/ discovery path probed on it returns HTTP 404.

providers.name: Ample
providers.description: Ample Foods is a nutrition company that makes single-serving meal-replacement shakes sold direct-to-consumer at amplemeal.com. Its lineup includes Ample Original, a low-carb meal shake with roughly 25g protein and 4g net carbs per 400-calorie serving, and Ample Recover, a higher-carb performance shake with about 31g protein and 33g carbs per 400-calorie serving, sold in ready-to-drink bottles and bulk canisters. Ample is a consumer packaged-goods brand running on a Shopify storefront; enrichment probing found no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, developer portal, or API reference. This profile is a portfolio lead backed by 500 Global and is retained as a company record with no API surface to enrich.

providers.name: Angiodroid
providers.description: Angiodroid SpA is a medical technology company specializing in CO₂-based solutions for vascular surgery, interventional radiology, cardiology, and angiology. It aims to improve patient outcomes by providing innovative, contrast‑free imaging technologies, reducing the risk of contrast‑induced nephropathy. The company offers products such as CO₂ injectors, disposables, and synchronization tools, and emphasizes innovation, passion, and quality in its mission.

providers.name: Animalindustrydatakorea
providers.description: Animalindustrydatakorea provides comprehensive data on the Korean animal industry, including livestock statistics, health monitoring, farm productivity, and sustainability metrics. The company focuses on digital health solutions for livestock, leveraging AI and data analytics to improve animal welfare and farm efficiency, supporting both domestic and global agricultural stakeholders.

providers.name: Aora
providers.description: Aora (Aora Servicios) is a Mexico-based on-demand home and office services marketplace that connects households and businesses with vetted technicians and providers for repairs, installations, and maintenance. Its catalog spans home and office repairs, white-goods and appliance service, air conditioning and mini-split installation, water heaters, plumbing and drainage, waterproofing, and home-technology work. Consumers browse and book services through the Aora web app and the Aora mobile app, while a B2B program serves business customers. The company is backed by 500 Global. Aora publishes a consumer-facing website and blog but does not currently expose a public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs; this profile captures its public web surface and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Applepie Capital
providers.description: ApplePie Capital is a San Francisco-based franchise-finance marketplace lender that connects franchisees and franchisors with the capital they need to start, refinance, and grow multi-unit franchise businesses. Founded in 2014 by Denise Thomas, the company operates an online lending platform focused exclusively on franchising, offering conventional term loans, SBA loans, refinancing, equipment financing, and accounts-receivable financing, and partnering with banks such as Fifth Third and providers like LSQ. ApplePie has provided billions in loans across 200+ franchise brand partners. It is backed by QED Investors and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a fintech company profile; no public API or developer program has been identified as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Applied Cognition
providers.description: Applied Cognition is a clinical-stage neuroscience company unlocking the therapeutic power of the brain's glymphatic system, the waste-clearance mechanism implicated in neurodegeneration. The company pairs a first-in-human, non-invasive platform for continuous, real-time measurement of glymphatic function (validated against contrast-enhanced MRI) with a small-molecule drug pipeline targeting Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and post-traumatic headache, supported by issued platform patents and datasets positioned for AI integration. Backed by Mayfield, it was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. It is a therapeutics/medical company and does not currently publish a public developer program, API, or developer documentation.

providers.name: ArrePath
providers.description: ArrePath is an AI-driven pharmaceutical company based in Princeton, New Jersey, applying machine learning to accelerate small-molecule drug discovery in infectious disease. Its platform treats heterogeneous, small, and noisy bioactivity datasets as a modeling opportunity, enabling work on novel chemical classes where conventional approaches struggle; a public-data oral bioavailability model lifted a lead series from roughly 22% to 89% bioavailability. Lead programs include an oral LpxH inhibitor for outpatient urinary tract infections (pre-IND targeted mid-2026) and antibacterial programs against non-tuberculous mycobacterial (NTM) lung disease and tuberculosis, plus an early non-infectious discovery effort. ArrePath is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. It publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs; this profile captures company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Arrivobioventuresllc
providers.description: Arrivobioventuresllc, operating as Arrivo BioVentures, is a holding company overseeing Sirtsei Pharmaceuticals and Panafina Inc., developing innovative medicines such as SP-624 for major depressive disorder and RABI-767 for severe acute pancreatitis. The company focuses on delivering meaningful health outcomes through advanced drug candidates and expanded access programs.

providers.name: Artiphon
providers.description: Artiphon is a Nashville-based music technology company that designs smart, portable musical instruments for everyday creativity. Its products, including the Instrument 1, Orba, Orba 2, Orba 3, and Chorda, combine strumming, tapping, sliding, and looping into palm-sized MIDI controllers and synthesizers, paired with companion apps that let anyone make beats, loop sounds, and explore music anywhere. Artiphon sells direct and through retailers such as Guitar Center and Sweetwater. It does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a consumer-hardware company reference.

providers.name: Atrium
providers.description: Atrium is a sales-effectiveness and sales-performance business intelligence platform for revenue teams. It continuously monitors sales KPIs to surface anomalies in rep and team performance, detects which behaviors and activities are driving (or dragging) output, and delivers AI-powered coaching recommendations to managers and reps. The product connects directly to Salesforce, HubSpot, data warehouses, and communication tools rather than exposing a public developer API. Founded in San Francisco by Jason Heidema (CEO) and Peter Kazanjy and backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Bullpen Capital, and Electric Capital, Atrium was acquired by Fullcast in 2025 and is now offered as Fullcast Performance; atriumhq.com redirects to fullcast.com and only the customer application login at app.atriumhq.com remains on the Atrium domain.

providers.name: Aurate
providers.description: Aurate New York is a sustainable fine jewelry brand offering ethically sourced, lab‑grown diamond and gemstone pieces. Their collections emphasize eco‑friendly materials, recycled gold, and customizable designs that reflect personal stories and values.

providers.name: AutoGen
providers.description: AutoGen is a Microsoft framework for building multi-agent conversational AI systems.

providers.name: Autonomic
providers.description: Autonomic is a connected-vehicle cloud company founded in 2016, acquired by Ford Motor Company in 2018 and fully integrated into Ford in 2023. Its flagship product, the Transportation Mobility Cloud (TMC), is one of the largest connected-vehicle cloud platforms in production, providing an API-driven platform for developers to build applications that interact with vehicles while abstracting the complexity of different vehicle models and connectivity devices. The public developer surface (the TMC Developer Portal) is gated behind partner authentication, so most technical artifacts are not publicly harvestable. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Craft Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Axera Tech
providers.description: Axera Intelligence (爱芯元智), operating as Axera Tech, is a Chinese fabless semiconductor company building AI-inference SoCs for edge and endpoint computing. Its chips pair the Axera Tongyuan mixed-precision NPU with the Axera Zhimu AI-ISP to power on-device vision perception, smart-vehicle autonomous-driving and intelligent-cabin platforms, and multi-tier edge-AI inference across IoT and industrial scenarios. Axera Tech was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners; it is a hardware/silicon provider and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: B/E Aerospace
providers.description: B/E Aerospace was a manufacturer of aircraft cabin interior products and a provider of aerospace services for commercial aircraft and business jets. The company was acquired by Rockwell Collins in 2017 and subsequently merged into Collins Aerospace (a Raytheon Technologies subsidiary) in 2020. B/E Aerospace products included seating, food and beverage preparation equipment, lighting systems, and oxygen systems for commercial and business aviation.

providers.name: bannerman
providers.description: Bannerman is a San Francisco-based technology company that operates a security guard marketplace, connecting businesses with screened, licensed, insured, and certified security professionals. Founded in 2014 (Y Combinator S14) and backed by Slow Ventures, FundersClub, and Y Combinator, Bannerman brings software and technology to the traditionally manual physical-security-services industry. Its web dashboard lets clients book, schedule, and manage on-site security officers, run real-time GPS patrol tracking and incident reporting, handle communications, and manage billing from a single security-officer-management platform. Clients have included Lyft, WeWork, BMW, Juul, and YSL, with service across San Francisco, Los Angeles, New York, and Chicago. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts are published at this time.

providers.name: Battlemotors
providers.description: Battlemotors designs and manufactures vocational and refuse trucks, offering custom‑engineered platforms for waste collection, delivery, and specialized industrial applications. Their products emphasize durability, uptime, and integrated technology such as the Fortris Control Hub for fleet management and safety. Battlemotors serves a nationwide distribution network with parts support and service, targeting sectors like recycling, infrastructure, agriculture, and oil & gas.

providers.name: Beacon (Software)
providers.description: Beacon Software is a permanent software holding company, founded in 2024 and led by CEO Nilam Ganenthiran, that acquires and operates essential vertical software businesses serving Main Street industries. Rather than flipping acquisitions, Beacon holds companies indefinitely, keeping each founder's team and brand intact while providing a centralized operating platform — engineering support, AI integration, sales, finance, and a network of portfolio operators — to help them better serve their customers. Backed by General Catalyst, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and D1 Capital. Beacon is an acquisition and operating company, not a developer-facing platform: it publishes no public API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Beijingcimccoldchain
providers.description: Beijing CIMC Cold Chain Technology Co., Ltd. (BeijingCIMCColdChain) is a leading global innovator and provider of passive temperature control packaging solutions for the pharmaceutical, life‑science and cold‑chain logistics industries. Founded in 2012, the company designs, manufactures and services insulated boxes, phase‑change material packs, gel packs and related cold‑chain products, serving over 600 million vaccine vials and numerous healthcare customers worldwide.

providers.name: Blue Vision Labs
providers.description: Blue Vision Labs was a London-based computer-vision company that built the first city-scale augmented reality cloud — crowdsourcing centimetre-accurate 3D maps of entire cities from images captured by car-mounted smartphone cameras, then letting developers use visual positioning to place shared and persistent AR content that every device sees in the same real-world spot. It emerged from stealth in March 2018 with a $14.5M round led by GV, alongside Accel and Horizons Ventures, and offered invite-only early access to iOS and Android SDKs covering San Francisco, New York City and London. Lyft acquired the company in October 2018 and made it the UK hub of its Level 5 self-driving division. The developer platform is retired: bluevisionlabs.com no longer resolves to a web host, the documentation and SDK downloads are offline, and no public API surface remains.

providers.name: BlueWillow Biologics
providers.description: BlueWillow Biologics is a clinical‑stage biotechnology company pioneering intranasal vaccine technology. Their NanoVax® platform delivers antigens via an oil‑in‑water emulsion, aiming to transform prevention and treatment of infectious diseases, pandemic preparedness, and food allergies. The company originated from University of Michigan research and now advances human clinical trials of its adjuvant and delivery system.

providers.name: BociMed
providers.description: Shanghai BociMed Pharmaceutical Research Co., Ltd. (上海博志研新药物研究有限公司) is a Chinese pharmaceutical CRO/CDMO founded in 2012 in the Zhangjiang Pharmaceutical Valley, Shanghai, with an R&D headquarters in Zhangjiang, a production base in Lingang, and a clinical subsidiary in Chengdu. BociMed offers small-molecule chemistry, CMC and process development, a portfolio of drug delivery technology platforms (oral, injectable, nasal, pulmonary, transdermal, ocular, implant, liposome and exosome), clinical research and SMO services, global regulatory registration consulting, and commercial API, intermediate and solid-dosage manufacturing. It is a laboratory and manufacturing services business rather than a software vendor: it publishes a marketing website in Chinese and English and no developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Bridgestone
providers.description: Bridgestone Corporation is a Japanese global tire and rubber manufacturer headquartered in Tokyo. Bridgestone produces tires for passenger, commercial, off-road, and aircraft applications, plus diversified rubber and chemical products, and is one of the largest tire makers in the world.

providers.name: Bsquare
providers.description: Bsquare is an IoT and edge-software company known for Windows IoT device licensing, OS consulting (Windows, Linux, Android), device management, and its DataV IoT analytics and SquareOne data platform. Bsquare was acquired by Kontron; the bsquare.com domain now 301-redirects to www.kontron-americas.com, and the Bsquare brand operates as part of Kontron's connected-device software portfolio serving healthcare, avionics, energy, manufacturing, logistics, transportation, and hospitality. No independent public developer API or documentation surface is currently published; this profile carries the honest enrichment of the domain's live security and DNS posture.

providers.name: Capacityai
providers.description: CapacityAI provides a Climate Communications Platform that enables organizations to share, visualize, and act on climate-related data and narratives. The service offers tools for data integration, stakeholder engagement, and impact reporting, helping companies meet sustainability goals and regulatory requirements.

providers.name: Cari Health
providers.description: Cari Health empowers clinicians with rapid, personalized methadone dosing data, delivering actionable clinical insights at the point of care. By bridging the data gap, CARI Health improves patient outcomes, supports clinicians with real-time metabolite measurements, and advances opioid use disorder treatment through innovative, data‑driven technology backed by NIH, NSF, and leading accelerators.

providers.name: Causal
providers.description: Causal (causal.app) is a financial planning and business modeling platform for building spreadsheet-style models, forecasts, dashboards, and scenario analysis, aimed at finance teams and startups doing FP&A and extended planning and analysis (xP&A). Causal was acquired by Lucanet and its capabilities are now delivered as part of the Lucanet CFO Solution Platform; the marketing site redirects to Lucanet while existing customers sign in at my.causal.app. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or docs surface is currently published. Backed by Accel and Kindred Ventures.

providers.name: Cloudeats
providers.description: CloudEats is a pioneer cloud restaurant company creating next‑generation digital brands and proprietary cloud kitchen technology. Based in Manila, it operates cloud kitchens across Southeast Asia, building persona‑driven online‑optimized brands and offering API integration with leading food delivery platforms for real‑time menu control and high conversion rates.

providers.name: COSY
providers.description: COSY (CosyRobo) is a retail-technology robotics company that builds autonomous inventory robots for physical stores. Its flagship robot, SCOUT, roams store aisles using AI and machine vision to scan shelves, map products, audit stock levels, and check planogram compliance, feeding the results into a cloud-based management system so retailers can reduce out-of-stocks and improve on-shelf availability. Backed by 500 Global, the company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; it publishes a marketing website but does not currently expose a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: CYBAVO
providers.description: CYBAVO was a digital asset security company (founded 2018, Taipei/Singapore) providing institutional-grade cryptocurrency custody and wallet infrastructure. Its flagship CYBAVO Vault delivered MPC-based (Multi-Party Computation) custody with a policy/workflow engine, REST API, and client SDKs, alongside the CYBAVO Wallet App SDK for embedding secure private-key storage into mobile apps. Circle Internet Financial acquired CYBAVO in June 2022; the team and technology became the foundation of Circle Web3 Services and Circle Programmable Wallets. The cybavo.com developer surface has since been wound down (redirects to circle.com), but the first-party @cybavo Wallet/Auth SDKs remain published on npm and are maintained under Circle's circlefin GitHub organization.

providers.name: dehaze
providers.description: dehaze is a Munich-area (Fürstenfeldbruck, Germany) healthtech company, part of the Techstars Berlin cohort, building proprietary causal AI infrastructure that detects chronic and autoimmune disease earlier by identifying overlooked diagnoses, health risks, and inappropriate treatments. Its platform unifies and harmonizes diverse health data (lab results, medical imaging, genomics, clinical notes) into doctor-validated patient journeys, risk-profiles individuals against millions of health journeys and medical guidelines, and runs targeted AI follow-ups to improve treatment adherence for patients, payers, and providers. dehaze has analyzed over 250,000 patient lives across 300 million health events and 200+ AI algorithms, and raised €3.2M in 2026. dehaze publishes no first-party developer API; it exposes a Wix Site MCP endpoint and an llms.txt for agentic AI access to public site content.

providers.name: Ditto Biosciences
providers.description: Ditto Biosciences (Ditto Bio) is a San Francisco biotechnology startup, founded in 2025 and backed by Y Combinator (Winter 2026 batch), that discovers drugs for autoimmune diseases by identifying and engineering immune-controlling proteins that parasites, viruses, ticks, and worms have naturally evolved over millions of years to modulate the human immune system. The company pairs an AI platform with wet-lab biology to mine more than a million natural proteins, identify candidates predicted to hit clinically validated human immune-disease targets, and transform them into therapeutic candidates. Ditto is an early-stage, three-person team led by founders Dennis Sun (CEO), Adair Borges (CSO), and Emily Weiss (CTO). This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Ditto Bio currently publishes a marketing and science website only and exposes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable developer surface.

providers.name: Eagle
