providers.description: Eagle is a next-generation engineering firm founded in 2025 and based in New York City that builds AI-powered software for civil, structural, and MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) engineers designing critical infrastructure. Rather than selling its technology, Eagle acquires and transforms engineering firms directly, pairing frontier design-automation, knowledge-infrastructure, and quality-control tooling with world-class engineers to deliver faster, higher-quality infrastructure design. It is a seed-stage portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners. Eagle publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK today; this profile captures verified company identity only.

providers.name: emergen
providers.description: emergen (智昌科技集团股份有限公司, Zhichang Technology Group) is a Chinese industrial intelligence company founded by Dr. Gan Zhongxue, an expert in intelligent manufacturing. Built around its proprietary "ternary control" technology and cluster (swarm) robotics, the company positions itself as "AI + Control," delivering integrated "industrial agent" solutions that install a control "brain" into individual machines, production lines, and whole factories. Its portfolio spans robot controllers, ubiquitous controllers, industrial and collaborative robots, life-science robots, GVision 2D/3D machine vision, the GSC-AI100 sense-compute-control AI controller, a swarm-intelligence network controller, a micro-control cloud platform, and the "Jiangxin" family of industrial large models (design, production, service, and management). emergen serves automotive, electronics, equipment manufacturing, steel, metallurgy, textile, furniture, and shipbuilding sectors, plus Robotics-as-a-Service. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of qiming and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this pass no public developer/API surface was found.

providers.name: Fossil Group
providers.description: Fossil Group is a global designer, marketer, and distributor of consumer fashion accessories including watches, jewelry, handbags, small leather goods, belts, and sunglasses sold under owned and licensed brands such as Fossil, Skagen, Michele, Relic, Misfit, and licensed lines for Michael Kors, Diesel, Emporio Armani, Tory Burch, and others.

providers.name: General Electric
providers.description: General Electric Company has reorganized into separate publicly traded companies: GE Aerospace, focused on jet engines and aviation systems, and GE Vernova, focused on energy and power generation. GE HealthCare was spun off in 2023. No unified public developer API portal is currently published by GE Aerospace or GE Vernova.

providers.name: GoTo
providers.description: GoTo (PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk, IDX: GOTO) is the largest technology group in Indonesia, formed in May 2021 through the merger of the on-demand and ride-hailing pioneer Gojek and the e-commerce marketplace Tokopedia. GoTo operates a super-app ecosystem spanning on-demand services (ride-hailing, food and grocery delivery, logistics), e-commerce, and financial technology through GoTo Financial (including GoPay, one of Indonesia's leading digital wallets). The group serves Indonesia's population of more than 270 million, connecting tens of millions of consumers with millions of merchants and driver-partners, and is estimated to contribute roughly 2 percent of Indonesia's GDP. GoTo is backed by a roster of blue-chip investors including SoftBank Vision Fund, Alibaba, Google, Tencent, Temasek, and Sequoia Capital India. This company profile was surfaced as a SoftBank Vision Fund portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline. Note that GoTo Group's developer surfaces are published per product (Gojek/GoBiz, Tokopedia, GoTo Financial/Midtrans) rather than at a single group-level developer portal; this record profiles the parent holding company.

providers.name: Helion Energy
providers.description: Helion Energy is an Everett, Washington fusion power company building commercial fusion electricity generators using a pulsed, magneto-inertial field-reversed configuration (FRC) approach burning deuterium and helium-3. Helion forms two FRC plasmas at opposite ends of its machine, accelerates them toward each other, merges them, and uses pulsed magnetic compression to drive them to fusion conditions; the expanding plasma pushes against the confining magnetic field and induces current directly back into the machine's capacitor bank via Faraday's Law, recapturing electricity without a steam cycle. Founded in 2013 by David Kirtley, John Slough, Chris Pihl, and George Votroubek, Helion is chaired by Sam Altman and has progressed through seven generations of prototypes (IPA, Venti, Trenta, and most recently Polaris) on its way to commercial generators. Polaris, brought online in late 2024, is the company's seventh-generation machine and the first privately developed fusion device to demonstrate measurable deuterium-tritium fusion, reaching 150 million degrees Celsius in February 2026. In May 2023, Helion signed the world's first commercial fusion power purchase agreement, committing to deliver 50 MWe to Microsoft starting in 2028, with the Orion plant planned for the Malaga, Washington area; a subsequent agreement with Nucor targets a 500-MWe facility. Helion is funded by Sam Altman, SoftBank Vision Fund 2, Nucor, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and others, with a reported $5.4B valuation as of early 2025. The company's revenue model is fusion electricity sales under long-term PPAs; Helion has no public developer API, SDK, or open-source software product, and its public GitHub organization (Helion-Energy) contains only forks of plasma-physics simulation tools (WarpX, FerroX, pyamrex, maestrowf).

providers.name: Hemster
providers.description: Hemster is a fashion-technology company that modernizes tailoring and garment fit through a digital "Fit Profile" system. Customers create a personalized fit pattern once, then match any garment — new or from their existing closet — to that saved profile so it can be tailored to their perfect fit rather than to a standard size. The platform aims to reduce returns, extend the life of clothing people already own, and remove size-related hesitation at purchase, with a sustainability angle around keeping garments out of landfill. Hemster operates a consumer web app at my.hemster.co and a related returns/deadstock product ((re)vive / byrevive.com). It is backed by Bullpen Capital. As of this profile Hemster publishes no public developer, API, or integration surface; this record is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company lead.

providers.name: Infra.Market
providers.description: Infra.Market is a technology-enabled building materials platform serving India's construction and real estate sectors across the entire project lifecycle. Operating as a house of brands, it supplies concrete, aggregates, steel, AAC blocks, plywood, tiles, sanitaryware, paints, plumbing, modular kitchens, hardware, electricals, appliances, and rental equipment through both B2B (direct corporate sales with site delivery) and B2R (retail via dealers and distributors across 17,000+ touchpoints). It is backed by 280+ manufacturing facilities across 22 Indian states under brands including Shalimar Paints, RDC, IVAS, Robo, and Ultrafine, and is headquartered in Thane, Maharashtra. Added to the API Evangelist network as an Accel portfolio company; no public developer API surface has been identified to date.

providers.name: Inkbox
providers.description: Inkbox is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce company selling semi-permanent temporary tattoos. Its proprietary "For Now Ink" formula is made with Genipa plant extract and develops into the skin to last up to about two weeks, longer than surface-level temporary tattoos. Inkbox sells thousands of pre-designed tattoos from independent artists and offers a custom service where customers upload their own artwork to create personalized designs. The business operates as a consumer retail brand with an online store, and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: International Game Technology
providers.description: International Game Technology (IGT) is a global gaming company that delivers entertaining and responsible gaming experiences across all gaming channels and regulated segments, including lottery, gaming machines, sports betting, and digital gaming. IGT does not currently offer a public developer API program; its technical resources are delivered through licensed B2B partner channels.

providers.name: Kairos Power
providers.description: Kairos Power is an Alameda, California-based advanced nuclear fission company developing the KP-FHR (Kairos Power Fluoride salt-cooled High-temperature Reactor), a Generation IV reactor design that uses TRISO (tri-structural isotropic) fuel pebbles cooled by molten fluoride salt (FLiBe) at low pressure and high temperature. Kairos Power is building Hermes, a low-power demonstration reactor at the East Tennessee Technology Park in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, which became the first non-light-water reactor authorized for construction by the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission in over 50 years (construction permit issued December 2023). A second unit, Hermes 2, will pair two reactors with a 28 MWe electricity-generating turbine. In October 2024 Google signed a corporate power purchase agreement with Kairos Power for up to 500 MW of nuclear electricity from multiple small modular reactors, with the first deployment targeted by 2030 and additional capacity through 2035 — the first corporate PPA for new advanced nuclear in the United States. The company's revenue model is reactor sales, electricity PPAs, and federal cost-share partnerships (DOE Advanced Reactor Demonstration Program). Kairos Power is privately held, does not expose a public developer API or SDK, and operates under NRC regulatory oversight as a safety-critical nuclear licensee.

providers.name: Kaiser Aluminum
providers.description: Kaiser Aluminum manufactures semi-fabricated aluminum products for industrial applications across aerospace, packaging, general engineering, and automotive markets. The nearly century-old company delivers highly engineered aluminum products focused on strength, weight efficiency, and sustainability. Kaiser Online serves as a customer portal for quotes, order tracking, depot stock searches, and material certifications.

providers.name: Key
providers.description: Key AI is a professional networking platform that rebuilds business connection-making around AI and consent-based introductions. Its Kai AI agent surfaces the right people through warm paths in your existing network, while Handshake handles consent-first introductions (launching summer 2026). The platform also offers matched Opportunities (jobs, deals, and partnerships), branded Communities and directories for alumni groups and associations, event and calendar pre-matching, a searchable knowledge Library, and Connectors for Slack, WhatsApp, and LinkedIn. Founded by Google alumni behind the 35,000-member Xoogler community and backed by Felicis, Key AI is an end-user and community-operator product; as of July 2026 it publishes no public API, developer platform, or API documentation.

providers.name: Korn Ferry
providers.description: Korn Ferry is a global organizational consulting firm that helps companies design optimal organization structures, recruit and develop talent, and drive performance. The firm offers services across executive search, leadership development, organizational strategy, total rewards, and talent acquisition. Korn Ferry serves clients across industries with a combination of consulting, data, and digital products.

providers.name: Lily Camera
providers.description: The domain lily.camera currently serves "Lily Camera", a consumer-facing marketplace that connects clients with certified drone pilots for aerial photography and videography across real estate, events, agriculture, construction, and media production. It is a client-rendered single-page application: every requested path returns the same HTML shell, and the routes defined in its JavaScript bundle cover browsing pilots and drones, comparisons, bookings, messaging, a pilot dashboard, and a drone raffle. There is no public API, no developer portal, no documentation, no OpenAPI or other machine-readable specification, no SDKs, and no /.well-known discovery surface. The site is built on Lovable (GPT Engineer), monetized with Google AdSense, and backed by a hosted Supabase project. No API artifacts could be harvested because the provider publishes none.

providers.name: Majestic Labs
providers.description: Majestic Labs is a semiconductor and AI-infrastructure company building power-efficient AI servers that put memory first. Its rearchitected server uses custom chips that disaggregate memory from compute, giving processors direct access to a massive uniform, high-bandwidth memory pool (reportedly up to 128 TB per server and roughly 1000x more memory available to compute than a conventional design). The company claims a single Majestic rack can hold the memory capacity of about 25 Nvidia NVL72-class racks while consuming a fraction of the power, targeting frontier language models, agentic and reasoning AI, graph neural networks, and video generation. Founded by Ofer Shacham, Sha Rabii, and Masumi Reynders, Majestic Labs is backed by Lux Capital (2024). This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a company lead; the company does not currently publish a public developer/API surface.

providers.name: MasterBrand
providers.description: MasterBrand, Inc. is the largest manufacturer of residential cabinets in North America, producing kitchen, bath, and home organization cabinetry across a portfolio of brands sold through dealers, retailers, and builders. The company designs, manufactures, and distributes a wide array of cabinetry products under brands such as Aristokraft, Diamond, Mid-Continent, Schrock, and others. MasterBrand does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation portal.

providers.name: McKesson
providers.description: McKesson is a Fortune 500 healthcare company providing wholesale medical supplies and equipment, pharmaceutical distribution, and healthcare technology solutions. No public developer APIs are currently documented.

providers.name: Metatheory
providers.description: Metatheory, Inc. is an independent studio of builders that makes games and, through an AI-led software division, tools built for makers. The team describes itself as builders, dreamers and doers applying what they have learned making games to software, building in public and sharing what they learn. Metatheory has been surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and Pantera Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the public site (metatheory.gg) is a single-page marketing site with no developer portal, documentation, API, OpenAPI, SDK, or public developer surface; the only public contact is support@metatheory.gg.

providers.name: Mira
providers.description: Mira is a San Francisco-based consumer hardware startup building AI-powered smart glasses positioned as an always-on "second brain." Founded in 2024 by Harvard builders AnhPhu Nguyen and Caine Ardayfio (rebranded from Halo), the camera-free glasses pair a dual-waveguide display, microphone, and iOS companion app to deliver live transcription, real-time translation across 60+ languages, hands-free AI assistance, and searchable memory of everyday conversations. Mira raised a $6.6M seed round led by General Catalyst and began shipping its first devices in January 2026. It is a privacy-first consumer wearable with an iOS companion app and does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Moss
providers.description: Moss is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of y-combinator and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Oak Ridge National Laboratory
providers.description: Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) is the largest US Department of Energy science and energy laboratory. ORNL provides public data and scientific computing resources for research including neutron science, materials science, computing, energy, and national security.

providers.name: Obvio
providers.description: Obvio is an AI-powered traffic-safety platform that helps cities and police departments detect and enforce reckless driving. Its context-aware computer-vision cameras identify stop-sign violations, crosswalk failures, school-zone speeding, and distracted driving, then support law enforcement in reducing infractions and improving road safety. Obvio is a physical-AI company deployed with police departments in Maryland and expanding into new states; it is backed by Bain Capital Ventures, Homebrew, and Khosla Ventures. Added to the API Evangelist network from a VC portfolio lead; no public API or developer surface is currently published.

providers.name: Occipital
providers.description: Occipital is a computer-vision and 3D-scanning company known for the Structure Sensor depth camera and the Canvas home-scanning app, built on more than fifteen years of spatial-computing expertise. The Canvas product line (formerly canvas.io) now operates as Twindo, a spatial intelligence platform that turns iPhone/iPad LiDAR scans, floor plans, and point clouds into accurate, editable CAD and BIM files for architecture, interior design, construction, remodeling, multifamily residential, retail, hospitality, and fire-safety professionals. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes end-user scanning apps, a web viewer, and a support center, but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Oxyzo
providers.description: Oxyzo Financial Services is an RBI-registered Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) providing customized SME and corporate financing across India. Founded as the lending arm of the OfBusiness group, Oxyzo offers purchase finance, work order finance, invoice discounting, vendor finance, business loans, machinery finance, and loan against property, serving industries such as auto manufacturing, capital goods, e-mobility, logistics, pharmaceuticals, and textiles. The company operates 145+ branches, has powered 10,000+ businesses, disbursed over Rs 77,000 crore, and holds A+ ratings from CRISIL and ICRA. Oxyzo publishes no public developer/API surface; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Payitoff
providers.description: Payitoff is an embedded-fintech platform that helps banks, lenders, credit unions, and fintech apps guide their customers through debt management and student-loan optimization. Its embeddable widgets and partner API let institutions surface personalized debt-payoff plans, federal student-loan repayment and forgiveness enrollment (IDR/PSLF), refinancing guidance, and consolidation workflows directly inside their own digital experiences. Payitoff was acquired by Array, the embeddable finance and consumer-credit platform, where it now powers the Student Loan Aid and broader debt product suite delivered through Array's embed layer. The developer surface is a partner-gated platform (sandbox, embed SDK, and partner portal) rather than a fully public, self-serve API. Payitoff is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners.

providers.name: petkit
providers.description: PetKit is a consumer smart pet-technology company that designs and sells connected pet-care hardware — automated feeders, smart water fountains, self-cleaning litter boxes, cameras, and health-monitoring accessories — paired with the PetKit mobile app that controls the devices over the cloud. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass, PetKit publishes no dedicated first-party developer portal or public API; petkit.com is operated as a Shopify storefront, so the only machine discoverable surface on the domain is Shopify's Customer Account OAuth/OIDC discovery documents. Third-party (community, reverse-engineered) integrations exist for the mobile-app backend but there is no officially documented API.

providers.name: Please Assist Me
providers.description: Please Assist Me (PAM) is an apartment-amenity and home-management service that partners with residential buildings to handle cleaning, errands, groceries, laundry, dry-cleaning, package handling, and custom special requests for residents. Dedicated per-building teams deliver the service, backed by a consumer mobile app (iOS and Android) and a web app for booking and account management, a 24-hour satisfaction guarantee, and body-camera transparency. Backed by Techstars. The company operates a consumer-facing product and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Poth Labs
providers.description: Poth Labs is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) startup building an AI-native customer research platform that positions itself as "the customer brain for your company." It aggregates scattered customer feedback from sources such as Fireflies, Slack, support tickets, CRM notes, surveys, in-app chat, docs, and product analytics into a unified, searchable system, then extracts patterns, runs thematic and root-cause analysis, generates hypotheses about user issues like churn or checkout abandonment, and validates them through adaptive user interviews and targeted follow-up surveys. Founded by Matthew Wong (CEO, ex-Palantir, Stanford) and Mojmir Horvath (CTO, ex-Tietoevry) and based between San Francisco and New York, the company targets product, growth, customer research, and analytics teams. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; as of this enrichment pass Poth Labs publishes a marketing site but no public developer, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Preemadonna
providers.description: Preemadonna is a consumer hardware and software company best known for the Nailbot, a compact inkjet nail-art printer that prints custom designs onto fingernails, press-ons, gel, or bare nails in about five seconds. Backed by Version One Ventures, the company is building a creative-expression platform that pairs smart hardware with AI-powered design tools, consumables, and a creator marketplace, delivered through companion iOS and Android apps. The company holds 10+ utility patents. Preemadonna currently exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public web, support, and policy footprint for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Properly
providers.description: Properly was a Toronto-based Canadian digital real estate brokerage founded in 2018 that began as one of the country's only iBuyers — making algorithmic cash offers on Calgary homes — before pivoting to Sale Assurance, a guaranteed-purchase backstop that let a seller buy their next home before selling the current one, wrapped around an online listing search and a machine-generated home valuation. It sat in the challenger layer of the Canadian value chain alongside HouseSigma, Wahi, and Zolo, competing on visibility into listing data controlled by CREA, the national cooperative that operates REALTOR.ca and the Data Distribution Facility (DDF) syndicating member boards' listings, in a market where land registration is provincially privatised and the public record is itself a commercial product. Properly was acquired by Pine Canada Financial Corporation in October 2023 and the brand has since been absorbed: properly.ca and www.properly.ca now answer HTTP 301 from an Amazon S3 and CloudFront redirect bucket to www.pine.ca, and the word "Properly" no longer appears anywhere on the surviving Pine real estate pages. Its API posture is closed and, as of this profile, non-existent. No developer portal, no API program page, no partner or data licensing page, and no published terms of API use were found. The developer., developers., api., docs., app., and blog. subdomains of properly.ca do not resolve in DNS, and every contract path probed — /openapi.json, /swagger.json, /api-docs, /$metadata, /odata — redirects into a Pine 404. The successor host api.pine.ca resolves to an AWS API Gateway that answers every path with HTTP 403 MissingAuthenticationTokenException: a private first-party backend, not a developer product. RESO is absent, which is the honest Canadian answer — Properly and Pine appear nowhere on RESO's own Canadian membership roster, and no Web API or Data Dictionary certification, OData $metadata document, or Universal Property Identifier usage was observed. No open, unlicensed dataset is published. The underlying listings reach the platform through licensed channels — CREA MLS trademark attribution appears in the site footer and listing media is served from cdn.repliers.io, the CDN of the licensed MLS data vendor Repliers, whose own developer guide names "Pine (formerly Properly)" as a customer — which is a brokerage and vendor licensing posture, not anything a third-party developer can sign up for.

providers.name: Ranker
providers.description: Ranker is a consumer internet company that runs ranker.com, a crowdsourced ranking and voting platform where users vote on and create rankings across pop culture, entertainment, film, TV, music, food, sports, and other consumer topics. Its business arm licenses "Ranker Insights" audience-intelligence and opinion-graph data - drawn from more than 1.5 billion votes, 115 million voters, and 260,000 rankings - to brands, agencies, publishers, and for AI/LLM training. Ranker does not publish a public, self-serve developer API; a private api.ranker.com powers the site and its robots.txt prohibits automated scraping and AI/LLM training use. Data access is sales-led via business.ranker.com. Backed by Bullpen Capital and DCVC.

providers.name: Readly
providers.description: Readly is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: stockholm-trip) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Safe Superintelligence
providers.description: Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI) is an AI research lab founded in 2024 by Ilya Sutskever, Daniel Gross, and Daniel Levy, with offices in Palo Alto and Tel Aviv. The company describes safe superintelligence as its single mission, sole focus, and "entire product roadmap," and is assembling a lean team of engineers and researchers dedicated to it and nothing else. SSI raised $1B in a Series A from NFDG, a16z, Sequoia, DST Global, and SV Angel; Ilya Sutskever serves as CEO and Daniel Levy as President. The company publishes no public API, developer platform, or technical documentation as of this enrichment pass — this profile captures its identity and domain security posture.

providers.name: Sagence AI
providers.description: Sagence AI is a semiconductor company building analog in-memory computing hardware for AI inference. Its "analog inference machine" combines deep subthreshold computing with multi-level flash memory cells to run large AI models at a fraction of the power and cost of conventional digital GPUs, targeting datacenter and edge workloads such as generative AI, recommendation systems, real-time defect detection, and video security. Backed by Khosla Ventures, the company positions its technology against offerings like Nvidia's B200, claiming large gains in performance-per-watt and cost efficiency for AI inference. Sagence AI is a hardware/silicon company and does not currently publish a developer API, SDK, or public developer portal.

providers.name: SambaAds
providers.description: SambaAds is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead for enrichment. As of this pass the registered website (ycontent.com.br) serves yContent, a Brazilian coupon and discount aggregation platform (part of Rede de Cupons / Ganhe de Volta) that verifies and publishes working promotional codes for major Brazilian e-commerce retailers such as Amazon, Americanas, Kabum and Sephora. The site is a consumer-facing web property; it publishes no developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface, so there is no public API surface to catalog at this time. This profile records the honest result of an enrichment pass (domain-security probe plus well-known and security.txt probes) and remains a lead awaiting any future developer program.

providers.name: Scalyr
providers.description: Scalyr was a cloud log management, server monitoring, and observability platform for engineering, DevOps, and security teams, known for an index-free, columnar architecture delivering sub-second queries across hundreds of terabytes of structured and unstructured log data. Founded in 2011, Scalyr was acquired by SentinelOne in 2021 and rebranded as DataSet; the scalyr.com domain now redirects to dataset.com. Its REST API (hosted at app.scalyr.com) covered log ingestion (addEvents), querying, and account/file management via API-key authentication. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of bloomberg-beta, gv, and susa-ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Simantic
providers.description: Simantic builds simulated hardware for embedded QA, modernizing embedded firmware development through hardware simulation designed for AI adoption in hardware engineering. Its platform emulates microcontroller (MCU) systems so engineers can inject sensor readings and observe how their firmware reacts over CAN, Ethernet, and BLE, running full firmware test suites in CI (for example GitHub Actions) on every push and pull request without physical boards. A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets AI agents step through firmware, inspect peripheral state, and replay scenarios against a simulated MCU, and a CLI drives simulations locally. Simantic offers private, self-hosted deployment so firmware and test data never leave a team's own servers. Founded in 2025, Simantic is a Y Combinator (Fall 2026) company.

providers.name: Skycatch
providers.description: Skycatch built spatial data capture, processing, and analytics for mining and construction sites, turning drone and aerial imagery into high-precision 3D data, volumetrics, and AI-driven site insights. Its products included Spatial Sight, Spatial DataHub (datahub.skycatch.com), and EdgeServer for on-site edge processing. Skycatch was acquired by Caterpillar Inc. on July 7, 2026 (following Caterpillar's RPMGlobal acquisition) to expand its mining technology capabilities. A developer platform exists at docs.skycatch.com but is password-gated, and no public API specification is available. Originally surfaced as a GV (Google Ventures) portfolio company.

providers.name: Smiler
providers.description: Smiler is an Amsterdam-based on-the-spot photography marketplace that connects travelers and consumers with a network of professional freelance photographers at popular tourist hotspots and leisure locations worldwide. Founded in 2020, Smiler lets people book fast, affordable photoshoots in advance across 100+ destinations, with photos delivered within 48 hours and free cancellation up to 24 hours before the shoot. The company also operates the Smiler Photographer Suite, an all-in-one tool for photographers to build portfolio websites, manage bookings, deliver mobile-friendly client galleries, and handle payments. Smiler is trusted by tens of thousands of photographers across 50+ countries and is backed by Speedinvest, Mosaic Ventures, Dutch Founders Fund, and PROfounders.

providers.name: Surgery Partners
providers.description: Surgery Partners is a leading operator of surgical facilities and ancillary services in the United States, including ambulatory surgery centers, surgical hospitals, multi-specialty physician practices, and anesthesia services. The company partners with physicians to deliver high-quality, cost-effective surgical care across short-stay surgical procedures. Surgery Partners does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation portal.

providers.name: SustainCERT
providers.description: SustainCERT is an independent, digitally-enabled climate impact verification company. It provides third-party validation and verification for carbon-market projects, corporate greenhouse-gas inventories and climate reporting, value-chain (Scope 3) decarbonization claims, and digital monitoring, reporting and verification (DMRV) for renewable energy and product carbon footprints. Customers work through the SustainCERT web platform; the company exposes no public developer API surface at this time. Added to the API Evangelist network from the Partech portfolio and enriched with domain-security probes and identity metadata.

providers.name: The Vendry
providers.description: The Vendry is a platform that connects event professionals with venues, vendors, and inspiration for planning and executing events. It offers a marketplace where users can browse venues across major cities, discover vendors ranging from catering to audiovisual services, and gain community insights. By aggregating event resources and providing tools for sourcing, The Vendry streamlines event production workflows and fosters collaboration among industry professionals.

providers.name: Unidesk
providers.description: Unidesk was a Marlborough, Massachusetts software company backed by Matrix Partners that pioneered application layering for virtual desktop infrastructure, packaging Windows applications and operating-system components into shareable virtual disk layers. Citrix acquired Unidesk in January 2017 and the technology lives on as Citrix App Layering. unidesk.com now 301-redirects to the Citrix App Layering product page, the GitHub organization has been dormant since the acquisition, and the company maintains no standalone API surface of its own.

providers.name: Wildtype

providers.name: Z-Trip
providers.description: Z-Trip (在途商旅) is a Shanghai-based enterprise travel and expense management SaaS platform (a corporate travel management company, or TMC) serving medium and large Chinese enterprises. It unifies booking of flights, hotels, trains, car rentals, visas, insurance, and MICE events with automated expense reporting, budget and policy controls, monthly invoicing, and up to 45 days of advance funding. The platform integrates with corporate OA, ERP, cost-control, and HR systems and offers single sign-on, aggregating supplier inventory from 200+ airlines and millions of hotels for 1,700+ enterprise clients. Surfaced from the dcm-ventures portfolio; no public first-party API/developer platform is published, though third-party integration connectors and SSO exist.

providers.name: 10percenthappier
providers.description: 10percenthappier (now branded Happier Meditation) is a personalized meditation and mindfulness company offering a consumer mobile app with over 500 guided meditations, multi-day courses, and daily mindfulness practices led by expert teachers. The app adapts to the user with monthly check-ins and daily recommendations, and is available on iOS and Android. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Techstars and added to the API Evangelist network. The company operates a consumer product and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Accurate International
providers.description: Accurate International Biotechnology (trading as ACCURATE, 广州创芯国际生物科技有限公司) is a Guangzhou, China biotechnology company founded in 2018 that builds the full industry chain around organoid technology for cancer precision medicine, new drug research and regenerative medicine. Its products are wet-lab reagents, instruments and consumables rather than software: Accuroid organoid culture media, the AccuArray microarray organoid chip, the AOMF microfluidic organoid chip and 3D bioprinter, the AccuLumi high-throughput chemiluminescence detector, and Accuauto automated organoid culture workstations. On top of those it sells services — BUDcare and BUDhealth patient-derived tumor organoid drug-sensitivity testing delivered through Guangzhou Chuangxin Independent Clinical Laboratory, and organoid-model new-drug R&D services for pharma — and reports 32,000+ organoid cultures, 5,000+ tumor organoid models, 200+ clinical collaborators and 100+ filed patents. It holds subsidiaries in Beijing, Shanghai and Macau plus a European entity, and has raised Pre-A (2020), Series A (2021), a 100M RMB Pre-B (2022) and a Series B (2024). ACCURATE describes internal digital assets — the AOD Tronchip organoid database launched in 2023 and a cancer "deep-thinking" AI model built in 2024 — but publishes no developer portal, API reference, SDK, CLI, status page or public GitHub organization, and no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, MCP or A2A agent-card surface was found on any host it operates.

providers.name: Aires (IRIS Xiamen Science)
providers.description: Aires is the EquityZen listing name for 爱睿思（厦门）科技有限公司 — IRIS (Xiamen) Science Co., Ltd. (ISC), a contact-lens research, development and manufacturing company founded in 2020 in Tong'an District, Xiamen, China. It runs a fully automated colour contact lens factory (22,500 m² phase-one plant, RMB 600 million-plus investment) with in-house-designed equipment, automated optical inspection and sterile filling, and sells 38% and 55% water-content daily and semi-annual clear and colour lenses as ODM/OEM contract manufacturing — lens and pattern design, licensing support, logistics — to consumer brands. Built as the captive supply chain of the moody colour-lens brand, it holds high-tech enterprise certification and 18 patents, and closed a RMB 100 million-plus B+ round led by Qianqi Capital in March 2026. It is a physical-goods manufacturer: iris-amoi.com is a Chinese-language brochure site with no developer program, API, SDK, webhook surface or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Airwavz Solutions
providers.description: Airwavz Solutions is a Charlotte, North Carolina in-building wireless infrastructure company founded in 2013 that funds, designs, builds, owns and operates neutral-host distributed antenna systems (DAS), public safety emergency responder radio systems (ERRCS), managed Wi-Fi (sold as Hyperwavz), fiber backbones and private LTE/5G smart-building networks for commercial office, healthcare, hospitality, multifamily and event-venue properties across the United States, with over 154 million square feet under agreement and carrier agreements with AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile. It is a physical wireless infrastructure operator rather than a software company: as of this profile it publishes no developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract, though it does serve an llms.txt describing the company for AI agents.

providers.name: Alio
providers.description: Alio is a technology company delivering innovative financial services solutions, including data‑driven platforms for asset management, investment analytics, and digital banking. It streamlines workflows, enhances decision‑making, and offers modern APIs for seamless connectivity across financial ecosystems, supporting both retail and institutional clients with robust, secure, and scalable services.

providers.name: Ansa Biotechnologies
providers.description: Ansa Biotechnologies is a synthetic DNA manufacturer headquartered in Emeryville, California, founded in 2017 as a UC Berkeley spinout. Its enzymatic DNA synthesis platform is built on TdT-dNTP conjugates — enzymatic reagents that add single bases to a growing DNA molecule — and is sold as a made-to-order laboratory service producing sequence-verified double-stranded DNA fragments up to 600 bp, clonal DNA up to 7.5 kb, and ultra-long clonal constructs up to 50 kb. Quotes and orders are placed through a Salesforce Experience Cloud customer portal at portal.ansabio.com. Ansa is a wet-lab manufacturer rather than a software company: it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Antigen
providers.description: Antigen is an AI-powered continuous offensive security platform for the enterprise. It deploys autonomous AI penetration-testing agents against production systems every night, maps and exploits the full attack surface, and pairs the automated testing with a monthly human red-team assessment. Findings ship with reproduction steps and remediation guidance delivered directly into engineering tools such as GitHub and Linear. Antigen serves financial services, healthcare, retail, and government sectors, and is a Y Combinator (Fall 2025) company backed by Lightspeed, DST Global, and Susa Ventures.

providers.name: Apifiny
providers.description: Apifiny provides liquidity and market making services for digital asset exchanges, offering a suite of APIs that enable trading, order management, and market data access. The company focuses on bridging traditional finance infrastructure with the crypto ecosystem, delivering robust, low-latency connectivity for institutional clients. Through partnerships with major exchanges, Apifiny facilitates seamless integration, risk management, and compliance tools, empowering firms to launch and operate digital asset markets efficiently.

providers.name: BandLab
providers.description: BandLab is a cloud-based music creation and social platform where musicians and fans make, collaborate on, publish, and discover music. It pairs a free browser- and mobile-based digital audio workstation (Mix Editor) with a social network for creators, plus sample packs, mastering, distribution, and community features. Part of BandLab Technologies (which also owns Cakewalk/SONAR and other music brands), it is backed by Prosus Ventures. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or official client SDK was found during enrichment; the GitHub organization publishes only internal engineering tooling (eslint/stylelint configs, audio libraries). This profile is a company identity record awaiting a documented API surface.

The company operates a Wix‑based website (bjstudios.be) showcasing its services, contact information, and portfolio. It appears to focus on corporate events, concerts, and media productions, providing technical expertise and equipment for visual displays and streaming.

providers.name: Callisto Media
providers.description: Callisto Media Inc. was a data-driven nonfiction book publisher founded in 2011 by chief executive Benjamin Wayne, operating from 1955 Broadway in Oakland, California (earlier Emeryville) and 220 West 19th Street in New York. It built a publishing model around demand signals rather than editorial instinct — mining point-of-sale data, search volume and category gaps to decide which instructional titles to commission, then matching each topic to a subject-matter author. Its primary imprint was Rockridge Press, best known for diet-, appliance- and condition-specific cookbooks and health titles, alongside the Callisto Kids line of pre-K through grade 12 workbooks, STEM, history and biography titles; the company said it had reached more than 50 million customers and ranked among the top fifteen US publishers by unit sales. It raised venture funding from 137 Ventures in 2017, then contracted sharply — cutting 35 percent of staff in July 2022 and a further 200 roles that October — and on 9 May 2023 its publishing assets were acquired by the independent publisher Sourcebooks in a deal funded by Penguin Random House, with Simon & Schuster Distribution Services continuing to distribute the titles. The brand now trades as Callisto Publishing, a Sourcebooks imprint: callistomedia.com 301-redirects to callistopublishing.com, which 301-redirects again to sourcebooks.com/callisto (chain verified 2026-08-02). Callisto Media is a consumer publishing business, not a software vendor, and has no public API surface. Probes on 2026-08-02 against callistomedia.com, www.callistopublishing.com and www.sourcebooks.com returned no machine-readable contract: /openapi.json, /swagger.json and /.well-known/ai-plugin.json all 404, /.well-known/agent-card.json and /.well-known/agent.json both 404 (no A2A agent card), and every other probed path answered with the Sourcebooks single-page Magento storefront shell rather than a document. There is no developer portal, no GitHub organization (callistomedia, callisto-media and rockridgepress all 404 on the GitHub API), no published SDK on npm or PyPI, and no llms.txt.

providers.description: Carnot Innovations is a Hong Kong-based building energy management company that applies AI, machine learning, and advanced data analytics to optimize HVAC systems and reduce energy consumption across commercial buildings, data centers, hospitals, railways, and sewage treatment facilities in the Asia-Pacific region. Its platform delivers AI-driven energy optimization, predictive maintenance and fault detection for chillers, pumps, cooling towers, and air handling units, analytics dashboards for facility managers, and continuous commissioning insights, reporting outcomes such as 15% energy cost reductions, 90% hidden-fault detection, and 15 million kWh per year of energy savings across its deployment portfolio. The company markets 99.9% effectiveness against viruses and bacteria, a 59-second disinfection cycle, and 24-hour air quality monitoring with real-time data. Cassie is a hardware and environmental-technology company backed by Techstars; it was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. providers.name: Cellanome

Its R3200 Platform combines live-cell imaging with single-cell transcriptomics using proprietary CellCage technology to isolate, observe, and perturb individual cells and track their dynamics over time, with applications across neurobiology, immunology, cancer research, aging, and CRISPR screening. Cellanome is venture-backed (8vc, DCVC, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Wing Venture Capital) and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing and scientific-resources website but no public developer, API, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Cellibre
providers.description: Cellibre is a biotechnology company that engineers microbes to produce sustainable products across food, cosmetics, and materials. By rewriting DNA, they enable precision fermentation and strain engineering to create high‑value ingredients with lower environmental impact, aiming to transform manufacturing toward a more sustainable future.

providers.name: Cofia
providers.description: Cofia is an AI automation platform that learns how a team actually works and automatically builds custom workflow automations without manual setup. By monitoring system events and recognizing repetitive patterns, Cofia proposes and assembles custom agents for tasks like prospect list building, outreach and follow-ups, recruiting pipeline management, and data report creation. The company markets itself as "AI automations that implement themselves." Cofia is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) company based in New York City, founded by Moses Wayne (formerly Engineering Director at Duolingo) and Paola Martinez (formerly Senior Product Manager at Brilliant.org). It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and enriched with what the company publishes publicly. As of this pass Cofia exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Cyrus Biotechnology
providers.description: Cyrus Biotechnology is a Seattle-based protein-design and drug-discovery company building novel biologics for serious unmet medical needs by re-engineering existing proteins with a tight loop between computational modeling and lab testing. providers.name: Hex Security
providers.description: Hex Security is a Y Combinator (W26) security startup building autonomous AI agents that perform continuous penetration testing against web applications, APIs, and infrastructure. Instead of point-in-time annual pentests, Hex's agents probe systems around the clock — chaining exploits together, validating each finding with a working proof-of-concept, and delivering triaged, reproducible results with no false positives. The product surfaces high-severity issues such as SQL injection, broken access control / IDOR, authentication bypass, and unauthenticated remote code execution. Founded by Ahmad Khan, Huzaifa Ahmad, and Prama Yudhistira. As of this profile Hex Security is pre-public-API: it operates a marketing site (hex.co) and a product application (app.hex.co) but does not yet publish a developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or public API surface.

providers.name: HiddenLayer
providers.description: HiddenLayer is an Austin, Texas-based AI security company founded in March 2022 by Chris Sestito (CEO), Tanner Burns (Chief Scientist), and Jim Ballard (CIO) — former Cylance researchers who encountered a real-world attack on production ML models. HiddenLayer builds an AI Security Platform that protects machine learning and generative AI systems across their entire lifecycle, comprising four integrated modules: AI Discovery (catalogs AI assets and eliminates shadow AI), AI Supply Chain Security (Model Scanner inspects models, weights, and pickle/RDS files for malicious payloads and backdoors), AI Attack Simulation (continuous adversarial red-teaming for agentic and generative systems), and AI Runtime Security / AIDR (a real-time detection-and-response firewall using deterministic classifiers that sit outside the model inference path to detect prompt injection, jailbreaks, indirect attacks, data leakage, and malicious tool calls in agentic and MCP systems). The platform exposes native connectors for CI/CD, MLOps, SIEM/SOAR, API gateways, and major data and cloud platforms, plus guardrail integrations for OpenAI Agents, LangChain, AWS Strands, Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure APIM, and a GitHub Action for Model Scanner. HiddenLayer publishes Python, TypeScript, and Java/Kotlin SDKs and research-grade tooling such as HiddenPickle (Python pickle disassembler/patcher) and HiddenPromise (R .rdx/.rdb/.rds disassembler). The company has raised $56M total ($50M Series A in September 2023 led by M12 / Microsoft's Venture Fund and Moore Strategic Ventures, with Booz Allen Ventures, IBM Ventures, Capital One Ventures, and Ten Eleven Ventures participating) and serves Fortune 500 enterprises, financial services, and US Federal agencies. The HiddenLayer SaaS console and REST API are gated behind enterprise sales and not publicly self-serve, placing this profile in Tier-3 (enterprise-gated) coverage.

providers.name: Hound Labs
providers.description: Hound Labs was a breath-measurement company founded in 2014 in the San Francisco Bay Area that built the HOUND CANNABIS BREATHALYZER, an ultra-sensitive analytical test that identifies THC molecules in breath down to picogram levels and so narrows cannabis detection to a two-to-three hour recent-use window rather than the days-to-weeks window of urine testing. The company shipped its first commercial product, the HOUND CANNABIS BREATHALYZER Collect + Send, in 2023 into construction, energy, gaming, manufacturing and transportation employers, pairing the handheld device with the Hound Labs Retriever results portal for paperless chain-of-custody and result delivery. The business now trades as Hound Diagnostics, whose about page states it is "formerly known as Hound Labs" and which sells Hound Breathalyzer, Hound Screens (a customizable panel covering cannabis plus up to nineteen substances), Hound Chart (a HIPAA-compliant cloud results platform) and Hound Check background screening. The original houndlabs.com host has been decommissioned and now answers a Flywheel "Unknown Domain" 404 behind a TLS certificate that does not cover the name; neither the retired domain nor the live successor site publishes a developer program, API reference, SDK, or machine-readable contract of any kind, so the products are sold and delivered as devices plus a customer-facing web dashboard rather than as a programmable surface.

providers.name: Isono Health
providers.description: iSono Health is a Sunnyvale, California medical device company behind ATUSA, described as the first AI-driven portable and automated 3D breast ultrasound scanner. ATUSA performs fully automated whole-breast imaging in about two minutes per breast without a trained sonographer, pairing a 3D ultrasound scanner and wearable accessory with a Windows desktop/tablet application and HIPAA-compliant cloud storage for real-time 2D and 3D visualization, lesion localization, and remote monitoring. The system is FDA 510(k) cleared and targets more accessible point-of-care breast cancer screening and monitoring. iSono Health is a Y Combinator-backed company. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface is currently published.

providers.name: Joint Fire Science Program
providers.description: The Joint Fire Science Program (JFSP) funds scientific research on wildland fires and distributes results to help policymakers, fire managers and practitioners make sound decisions. Operated jointly by the U.S. Departments of the Interior and Agriculture, JFSP coordinates the Fire Science Exchange Network across regional knowledge nodes. JFSP does not publish a self-service developer portal or OpenAPI; research outputs are surfaced through the firescience.gov website.

providers.name: KeyCare
providers.description: KeyCare is a telehealth platform that connects health systems to a national network of independent, virtual-first care providers through deep Epic EHR integration. Built on Epic using CareEverywhere, MyChart, Telehealth Anywhere, and Book Anywhere workflows, KeyCare lets member health systems extend their own Epic instance to on-demand urgent care (24/7/365 across all 50 states), behavioral health, neurology, primary care, and expanding specialties such as rheumatology, cardiology, and maternal care. The company serves health systems including Allina Health, Memorial Healthcare, Ochsner Health, WellSpan, and Confluence Health. KeyCare is backed by 8VC. This profile has no public API or developer surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Letel
providers.description: Shanghai Letel Communication Equipment (Group) Co., Ltd. (上海乐通通信设备（集团）股份有限公司) is a Chinese manufacturer of information and communication network infrastructure, founded in March 1992 and headquartered in Shanghai with over 1,500 employees and 20+ service locations nationwide. Letel builds data center physical infrastructure — cabinet micromodules, cold aisle micromodules, containerized micromodules, pallet IT cabins, and cabinets — alongside communication cabling equipment, optical communication devices, data communication equipment, broadband access equipment, and structural components for notebooks and servers. It operates through subsidiaries including Zhongle Communication Technology Co., Ltd. Letel publishes no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation; this is a company profile in the API Evangelist network, surfaced as a Qiming Venture Partners portfolio company.

providers.name: Lexmark International
providers.description: Lexmark International is a global imaging and IoT solutions leader that helps customers worldwide realize the full potential of their information through printers, multifunction devices, and managed print services. As of 2024, Lexmark was acquired by Xerox Holdings Corporation. Public developer APIs are not currently advertised through an open developer portal.

providers.name: LINSOL Co.,Ltd.
providers.description: LINSOL Co.,Ltd. (린솔) is a safety-technology company headquartered in Daejeon, South Korea, founded as an in-house venture spun out of Hanwha Aerospace. LINSOL adapts acoustic detection techniques originally developed for defense landmine applications into commercial real-time hazard, accident, and environmental detection. Its product line includes Karang F (driving-environment detection), Karang S (precision acoustic signal transmission), SkyShield (fall detection), BR, Acoustic Eye (aerial security), and Safety Nova (smart integrated safety platform), sold into industrial safety, ESG, and defense security use cases. The company operates a Daejeon headquarters and research center plus a Goheung branch. LINSOL ships hardware and integrated platforms; as of a 2026-07-19 probe it publishes no public developer API, portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Market IQ
providers.description: Market IQ is a predictive analytics platform for financial institutions, serving retail banking, investment banking, and capital markets. It ingests both structured and unstructured data, applies natural language processing and AI to generate insights, and delivers bespoke dashboards such as its Social Net Promoter Score and incident-monitoring tools. The company operates from Toronto, New York, and London and reaches customers through login-gated applications rather than a public developer API. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Marvell Technology
providers.description: Marvell Technology, Inc. is a Fortune 500 fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. The company designs and develops data infrastructure semiconductor solutions including custom ASICs, data processing units, Ethernet controllers, optical and copper PHYs, switches, and storage controllers used in data centers, enterprise networking, carrier infrastructure, automotive, and consumer markets. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Marvell. Public developer documentation is gated behind a customer support portal and is not openly accessible.

providers.name: Massive Dynamic
providers.description: Massive Dynamic is an AI-powered advertising platform that bills itself as "The Advertising Copilot" and "the human-AI interface for massive scale." It helps media and advertising teams coordinate large-scale digital ad campaigns by pairing an AI Analysis Copilot (automating daily analytics checks, quarterly business reviews, and Media Mix Modeling) with Execution Delegation, where an AI agent handles operational campaign setup so strategists can focus on decisions. The tool works inside existing Slack and email workflows as a conduit between strategy and activation teams, and emphasizes enterprise-grade data governance with ring-fenced customer data and an explicit commitment not to use customer data to train or improve models. Founded in Paris in 2025 by Trystan Chabert (formerly Head of Growth at Voodoo) and Guillaume le Roy (formerly Head of Engineering at Qonto), the company raised a roughly EUR 3M pre-seed led by Seedcamp in July 2025, with Founders Future, Kima Ventures and others participating, and is deployed with a select group of early design partners. It sells its product as an end-user application — the marketing site is a Figma Sites page whose only call to action is "Request a demo", and the product itself is a login-gated web app at app.massive-dynamic.ai. As of the 2026-08-12 enrichment pass Massive Dynamic publishes no public API, no developer documentation, no SDKs, and no machine-readable contract of any kind — every OpenAPI, GraphQL, MCP, agent-card and /.well-known/ probe against its marketing, API and app hosts returned 404 or an application shell.

providers.name: MAYD
providers.description: MAYD (Meds At Your Doorstep) is a Berlin-based on-demand medication delivery service building a digital healthcare platform for Europe. Founded in 2021 by Hanno Heintzenberg and Lukas Pieczonka (previously McMakler), MAYD partners with local pharmacies to deliver over-the-counter and prescription medications to consumers' doors in about 30 minutes, 365 days a year, across German cities including Berlin, Hamburg, Munich, Frankfurt, Cologne and Düsseldorf. The company operates a consumer mobile app and website (getmayd.com) and raised a ~EUR 30M Series A led by Lightspeed Venture Partners in January 2022, with participation from Target Global, 468 Capital and Earlybird Venture Capital. MAYD is a consumer-facing (B2C) delivery business and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or partner API surface; it is a Stripe payments customer for its checkout and billing.

providers.name: Microverse
providers.description: Microverse is an online education platform that trains people worldwide to become remote software developers, founded by Ariel Camus with the stated mission of connecting one million people to remote jobs by 2030. Its model pairs students across time zones for peer collaboration that mirrors distributed engineering teams, and it historically charged tuition only after graduates secured a job. Microverse also runs Leap, an English-practice platform for developers. It is a private, distributed company backed by investors including Y Combinator, Hack.VC, and General Catalyst. Microverse does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its public web presence and security posture.

providers.name: Ocean Network Express
providers.description: Ocean Network Express (ONE) is a Singapore-headquartered global container liner shipping company formed in 2017 through the integration of the container shipping businesses of three Japanese carriers — Nippon Yusen Kaisha (NYK), Mitsui O.S.K. Lines (MOL), and Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha (K-Line) — with commercial operations launching on 1 April 2018. Operating under the magenta "ONE" brand and the Standard Carrier Alpha Code ONEY, the company runs a fleet exceeding 2,200,000 TEU across 165+ weekly service loops calling at 244+ ports worldwide, making it one of the largest ocean container carriers globally. ONE participates in THE Alliance vessel sharing agreement and offers reefer, dangerous goods, out-of-gauge, and project cargo services alongside standard dry container moves. Its customer-facing digital surface centers on the ONE eCommerce platform (ecomm.one-line.com), which provides cargo tracking, instant quotation via ONE QUOTE (powered by Descartes Kontainers), spot booking, shipping instructions, electronic bill of lading, ePayment, and demurrage/detention inquiry. A partner-facing developer portal exists at developers.one-line.com alongside EDI integration channels, but ONE does not publish a fully open, self-service OpenAPI specification, public SDK, or open-source code at either the github.com/ocean-network-express or github.com/OceanNetworkExpress organizations (both exist with zero public repositories). Tracking, booking, and schedule integrations are most commonly accessed by shippers and BCOs through third-party aggregators (Vizion, Portcast, JSONCargo, Terminal49, Tradlinx) or via DCSA-conformant carrier APIs delivered under commercial agreement.

providers.name: Owens Corning
providers.description: Owens Corning is a global Fortune 500 building and industrial materials leader committed to building a sustainable future through material innovation, providing roofing, insulation, composite materials, and doors. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

The consumer product is organized around streaming, watching, earning, and community guidelines. As of this enrichment pass Playback publishes a consumer web/app experience and a Notaku-powered help center but exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or documented developer surface; this profile therefore carries identity and domain-security signal only.

providers.name: Powerus
providers.description: PowerUs is Germany's largest job platform for skilled trades and crafts, connecting tradespeople (electricians, plumbers, roofers, metalworkers, mechanics and more) with employers across construction, electrical and mechanical industries. The platform offers automated job matching based on location, salary and working conditions, one-click applications without cover letters, direct employer-to-worker discovery, and native iOS and Android apps. PowerUs reports 250,000+ registered skilled workers and 6,000+ open positions. It is a consumer/employer marketplace product and does not currently expose a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI-described API surface; its api.powerus.de and docs.powerus.de hosts are private/internal (docs gated behind Cloudflare Access). Backed by General Catalyst and HV Capital.

providers.name: Proclaim
providers.description: Proclaim, built by Fresh Health, Inc., makes a custom-jet oral health system that replaces traditional flossing with a 3D-scanned, custom-fitted mouthpiece that pulses water through up to 60 jets to clean between teeth and below the gumline in about seven seconds. The consumer device is clinically shown to reduce gum bleeding and plaque, and is backed by Khosla Ventures. Proclaim is a direct-to-consumer oral-care hardware and wellness brand; it publishes a marketing and e-commerce site, a dental-professional portal, a help/knowledge center, and a blog, but exposes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable specification. This profile was surfaced as a Khosla Ventures portfolio lead and enriched with the identity and web properties the company actually publishes plus a probed domain-security profile; there is no API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Red RidgeBio
providers.description: RedRidge Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company that identifies and develops biparatopic antibodies, an antibody class engineered to bind two distinct sites (epitopes) on a single target protein for greater potency and selectivity. Its programs span oncology (antibody-drug conjugates for solid tumors) and autoimmunity (immune-cell modulators), pursued through partnerships and internal discovery. The company operates from Basel, Switzerland with additional presence in Cambridge, Massachusetts and San Francisco. RedRidge Bio was surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a therapeutics developer and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or technical documentation surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and public web presence.

providers.name: Resti
providers.description: Resti Inc. (resti.cloud) is a cloud-based restaurant management platform used by restaurant chains, primarily across Kazakhstan and Central Asia. It automates HR and payroll (salary calculation from actual hours worked), operational checklists and standards with photo verification, review and reputation management aggregating 2GIS and Yandex Maps, a mobile learning management system (LMS) for staff onboarding and training, and AI-assisted invoice processing and reconciliation. Resti integrates with restaurant POS and back-office systems including iiko, r_keeper, Paloma 365, Poster, and 1C Retail, and is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this pass it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, OpenAPI, or developer documentation; the customer login portal is at my.resti.cloud.

providers.name: reTravel.io
providers.description: reTravel.io is a travel retention marketing platform that uses data science and machine learning to help travel companies, TMCs, and corporates retain customers, increase attachment rates, and grow revenue from their existing clients. Founded in 2020 by Revital Kristal and Nir Gurevich in Tel Aviv, the platform extracts booking information via predefined plugins and contextually engages travelers across multiple channels with personalized, policy-compliant products. It operates on a performance-based commercial model tied to the uplift it generates and is backed by Techstars. reTravel.io exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Rivos
providers.description: Rivos is a Santa Clara-based silicon startup founded in 2021 that designs data-center class GPUs and AI accelerators around the open RISC-V instruction set architecture, fabricated on TSMC's 3nm process. The company is also developing a CUDA-to-RISC-V translation layer to ease migration of Nvidia-based AI workloads onto its silicon. Rivos raised a 250 million dollar Series A in 2024 led by Matrix Capital Management with Walden Catalyst and Dell Capital Partners, followed by additional rounds bringing total funding above 370 million dollars at a valuation north of 2 billion dollars. In October 2025 Meta announced an agreement to acquire Rivos to bolster its in-house custom silicon program. The company has operated in near-stealth mode and currently exposes no public website content, SDKs, or APIs, so this profile is intentionally an empty apis list with external press and acquisition references.

providers.name: SignalFire
providers.description: SignalFire is a venture capital firm headquartered in San Francisco that manages approximately $3 billion in assets and operates more like a tech company than a traditional VC. The firm invests across eight sectors — Health and PharmaTech, Enterprise AI, Cybersecurity, Fintech, Consumer, Applied AI/ML and Vertical SaaS, AI/ML Infrastructure and Developer Tools, and Enterprise Infrastructure and Developer Tools — and supports portfolio founders with a team of engineers, data scientists, operators, recruiters, and advisors. SignalFire's differentiator is Beacon AI, a proprietary data platform the firm spent roughly a decade building that tracks more than 80 million companies and 650 million employees across hundreds of billions of data points to power sourcing, talent, and go-to-market intelligence for both the firm and its portfolio. SignalFire does not publish any public developer APIs — Beacon AI is an internal platform offered as a service to portfolio companies, not a third-party product.

providers.name: Squadio
providers.description: Squadio is a Tech Teams as a Service (TaaS) platform, backed by 500 Global, that lets companies spin up dedicated squads of vetted software engineers and tech talent to build, scale, and digitally transform their projects. The platform covers hiring tech talent, payroll management, MVP development, and talent buyout, and pairs clients with talent through an assisted onboarding flow that includes its Lama AI assistant. Squadio operates primarily across the MENA region and connects businesses with remote engineering teams rather than exposing a public developer API.

providers.name: Synphony
providers.description: Synphony builds and deploys robots that work in the real world, combining AI, robotics, and human-in-the-loop systems so machines can perform practical physical tasks across agriculture, assembly, and inspection. Its platform trains AI models on real-world data, tests robot performance in realistic scenarios, and deploys systems into production. The company's first application is autonomous strawberry-harvesting robots plus farm software services (bed-level analytics, data-pipeline integration, and agentic solutions), targeting California's roughly $3B strawberry industry where labor is about 60% of costs. Founded in 2025 and backed by Y Combinator (Spring 2026), Synphony runs a customer-facing platform at app.synphony.co but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK at this time.

providers.name: Tishman Speyer
providers.description: Tishman Speyer is a privately held, global real estate developer, operator, and investment manager founded in 1978 by Robert Tishman and Jerry Speyer and headquartered at 45 Rockefeller Plaza in New York City. The firm acquires, develops, operates, and manages first-class office, residential, retail, industrial, mixed-use, and life-science properties across roughly 40 global markets in the Americas, Europe, and Asia. Its signature portfolio includes Rockefeller Center and the MetLife Building in New York, the MesseTurm in Frankfurt, The Spiral at Hudson Yards, and Mission Rock in San Francisco. Tishman Speyer also operates the Zo tenant-experience program, the Studio flex-workplace platform, the Breakthrough Properties life-science joint venture with Bellco Capital, and the TS Ventures proptech investment arm. The firm has reported approximately $65 billion in assets under management and approximately 3,000 employees. Tishman Speyer does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, or open-source repositories; all engagement is handled through corporate, investor, leasing, and tenant-app channels.

providers.name: TotalEnergies
providers.description: A French multinational integrated energy company operating across oil, natural gas, and low-carbon electricity. One of the largest energy companies in the world with significant investments in solar, wind, and battery storage.

providers.name: Tripp
providers.description: TRIPP is a digital mental-wellness company whose consumer app delivers immersive, interactive meditation, breathwork and mood-management experiences across virtual-reality headsets (including Meta Quest and PlayStation VR) and mobile devices. It blends guided sessions, generative visuals, spatial audio and gamified "trips" to help people manage stress, focus, mood and sleep. Tripp is backed by Mayfield. As of this enrichment pass Tripp operates a consumer-facing application and an Intercom-powered help center but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal; its web properties sit behind a bot-mitigation (captcha) wall, so no OpenAPI, llms.txt, or /.well-known discovery documents were retrievable.

providers.name: ValueCo
providers.description: ValueCo (ValueCo Metrics SAS) is a Paris-based fintech building an objective ESG market view from the proprietary ESG scores of asset managers and institutional investors. Its platform aggregates investor-side scoring into a consensus view so listed and non-listed companies can understand how the market actually perceives their ESG performance and improve their strategies. A Techstars portfolio company, ValueCo serves asset managers, institutional investors, enterprises, and ESG contributors; it currently publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: Viacom
providers.description: Viacom was an American mass media conglomerate that merged with CBS Corporation in December 2019 to form ViacomCBS (later rebranded as Paramount Global). The combined entity, which included brands such as CBS, MTV, Nickelodeon, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount Pictures, Showtime, and Paramount+, was subsequently acquired by Skydance Media and ceased to exist as an independent public company in August 2025. Viacom maintained open source software through its GitHub organization (ViacomInc), including tools for Roku channel development, tvOS UI components, and broadcast calendar utilities. No public external developer API program was offered.

providers.name: Wintermute
providers.description: Wintermute is a leading global algorithmic trading firm and cryptocurrency market maker providing institutional-grade liquidity across centralized exchanges, decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols, and over-the-counter (OTC) markets. Its offerings span OTC spot trading for hundreds of tokens, options with bespoke structures, forwards, CFDs, programmatic "API liquidity", and a DeFi trading and liquidity-provisioning arm, plus Wintermute Ventures, an early-stage investment vehicle. Access to Wintermute's trading services is institutional and onboarding-gated through the node.wintermute.com portal (authenticated via an Auth0-backed OIDC / OAuth2 identity provider); there is no public self-serve developer API or open OpenAPI at this time. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and Pantera Capital.
