Aliro is backed by deep-tech investors including Cisco Investments and Accenture Ventures, reports more than 50 third-party quantum networking devices already integrated with its stack, and operates with hardware-agnostic positioning across photonic, trapped-ion, neutral-atom, and diamond-defect node technologies. There is no public developer API, SDK, CLI, or open-source repository — the AlirOS APIs referenced in Aliro's product materials are vendor-facing integration interfaces consumed under commercial engagement, and Aliro's GitHub organization carries no public repositories.

providers.name: Allorion Therapeutics
providers.description: Allorion Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2020 by Qiang Ding and Fang Li, developing novel small-molecule therapies for cancer and autoimmune disease. Operating from Natick, Massachusetts and Guangzhou, China, Allorion applies mutant-selective and isoform-specific medicinal chemistry across a pipeline that includes ARTS-011 (a TYK2 inhibitor), ARTS-021 (a CDK2 inhibitor targeting CCNE1-amplified tumors), and ARTS-023/AVZO-023 partnered with Avenzo Therapeutics, alongside an exclusive option and global license agreement with AstraZeneca for an allosteric EGFR L858R inhibitor. The company is a drug-discovery organization backed by Qiming Venture Partners and INCE Capital; it markets internal data and high-throughput screening platforms but publishes no public developer program, API, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Amprion
providers.description: Amprion is a leading European transmission system operator managing a high‑voltage electricity grid spanning over 11,000 km across Germany. It connects renewable energy sources, ensures reliable power supply for millions, and drives grid expansion and sustainability initiatives.

providers.name: ApiMedic
providers.description: ApiMedic offers a medical symptom checker API primarily for patients

providers.name: Apollo Atomics
providers.description: Apollo Atomics is a Y Combinator-backed (Spring 2026 / P26) nuclear technology company building compact, power-dense pressurized water reactors for electricity generation, industrial process heat, and data-center power. Founded by Assil Halimi and Drew Walker and based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, the company modifies the steam generator of proven pressurized water reactor technology to shrink the plant by roughly an order of magnitude without sacrificing power output, turning a decade-long construction project into a factory-built machine that can ship on a truck. Apollo has announced a research collaboration with MIT's Department of Nuclear Science and Engineering to validate its reactor design and has submitted a regulatory engagement plan to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission, targeting a construction permit application in 2028. This is a hardware/energy company with no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: AptDeco
providers.description: AptDeco is a full-service online marketplace for buying and selling used, new, and vintage furniture. Founded in 2014 in New York City by Reham Fagiri and Kalam Dennis, the company handles the entire resale transaction end to end: pickup, disassembly and assembly, delivery, payment, scheduling, and logistics are all carried out by its own trained delivery teams. AptDeco serves the New York City metro, New Jersey, Connecticut, Philadelphia, Delaware, and the San Francisco Bay Area, and has expanded to additional US metros with national shipping. Backed by Y Combinator and Initialized Capital. AptDeco does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its public web, support, legal, and developer surfaces for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Assurely
providers.description: Assurely is a United States insurtech and managing general agent (MGA) founded by David Carpentier and Ty Sagalow that builds and distributes commercial property-and-casualty insurance for companies with unconventional funding models, most notably TigerMark, a directors-and-officers (D&O) product written for Regulation CF / Regulation A crowdfunding issuers and early-stage startups that incumbent carriers decline. Assurely positioned itself as an "Insurance-as-a-Service" (IaaS) provider embedding industry-specific products plus a multi-carrier marketplace into vertical SaaS operating systems in fintech and capital raising, proptech and construction, property management, blockchain and digital assets, and SMB marketplaces (named partners include Wefunder, Silicon Prairie, Fairmint, Dalmore Group, Buildertrend and CoConstruct), and stated licensing in all 50 states and Bermuda. Its API posture is the honest floor of this sector — no public, self-serve developer portal, no API reference, and no downloadable OpenAPI was ever published. "Embedded" here meant a commercial partnership with white-labeled quote-and-bind web flows on client.assurely.com and tigermark.assurely.com plus human advisory and administration, not a documented partner API. Assurely was acquired by Equal Parts on 2025-06-26, and as of the 2026-07-25 review its entire public surface is offline — www.assurely.com returns HTTP 404 as an expired Squarespace site, and api./client./tigermark.assurely.com are dangling CNAMEs to a deleted AWS load balancer. Home market is the United States.

providers.name: Avicenna Biosciences
providers.description: Avicenna Biosciences, Inc. is a Durham, North Carolina drug development company using machine learning-enhanced medicinal chemistry to accelerate the lead-to-candidate optimization process for small molecule drug development. Founded in 2020 and led by president and CEO Chris Meldrum, the company applies computational screening of candidate molecules for drug-like properties to the "last mile" of small molecule discovery, targeting neurodegenerative disease programs including Rho kinase inhibitors for Parkinson's disease and ALS. Avicenna raised a seed round led by DCVC Bio and has signed research collaborations with partners such as Molecure S.A. The company publishes no public developer portal, API, or machine-readable interface as of this enrichment pass; it is catalogued here as an AI-for-drug-discovery company profile rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Axoft
providers.description: Axoft is an Argentine software company offering the Tango ERP suite, a cloud and on‑premise platform for accounting, HR, point‑of‑sale and business management. Founded over 35 years ago, it serves thousands of SMEs and large enterprises across Argentina, providing automation, compliance and scalable solutions. The company emphasizes community support, extensive training, and integration capabilities, positioning itself as a leading ERP provider in the region.

providers.name: Banco Central do Brasil
providers.description: Banco Central do Brasil (BCB) is the central bank of Brazil, responsible for ensuring price stability, overseeing the financial system, and promoting economic growth. It regulates monetary policy, supervises financial institutions, and provides a framework for payments and settlements. The BCB offers various public data APIs covering exchange rates, financial statistics, and regulatory information, supporting developers and researchers in accessing authoritative financial data.

providers.name: Basecamp Research
providers.description: Basecamp Research is a London-based biotech company mapping global genetic biodiversity to power AI-based design of biological systems. Its core asset is BaseGraph, a Neo4j-backed knowledge graph of billions of biological relationships assembled from novel protein and genome sequences collected under access-and-benefit-sharing partnerships with biodiversity-rich countries. On top of this data it builds foundation models and tools including EDEN (a large-scale biology sequence model), BaseFold (3D protein structure prediction that improves on AlphaFold2 for large, complex structures and small-molecule interactions), and BaseScan (an automated annotation pipeline). Basecamp works with pharma and biotech partners on drug discovery and enzyme/protein design, and has collaborated with NVIDIA to bring BaseFold to the BioNeMo platform. Backed by True Ventures. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Basecamp Research currently exposes no public self-serve developer API - data and models are accessed via partnerships, and product docs sit behind an authenticated portal.

providers.name: Bedrock Systems
providers.description: BedRock Systems (now operating as BlueRock Security, Inc) is a United States based cybersecurity company building formally verified systems software for critical infrastructure. Its work centers on the NOVA microhypervisor and virtual machine introspection (VMI) tooling, using machine-checked mathematical proofs written in Coq to establish strong security guarantees for virtualization, edge, and embedded platforms. The company open-sources core components — including the NOVA microhypervisor, the tenjint VMI platform, and supporting Coq libraries — on GitHub, and does not publish a public web/REST API surface.

providers.name: BigHat Biosciences
providers.description: BigHat Biosciences is a biotechnology company that pairs machine learning with a high-throughput, fully integrated wet lab to design next-generation antibody-based therapeutics. Its platform closes the loop between in-silico antibody design and in-house synthesis and characterization, generating proprietary experimental data that trains its models and speeds the discovery of biologics with improved developability. The company has publicly discussed its Reccy antibody design studio (RADS) and has entered machine-learning-enabled biologics collaborations with Eli Lilly (including Lilly TuneLab), Johnson & Johnson, and Lonza/Synaffix. BigHat is a private, venture-backed company (8VC, a16z) and maintains a public GitHub organization of open-source computational-biology tooling. It does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Blubblub
providers.description: Blub Blub Inc. is the company behind Speech Blubs, a speech-therapy and language-development app for children aged 1 to 8. Created by speech-language pathologists and child-development experts, the app uses video modeling, speech exercises, face filters, and play-based activities to help kids with speech delays, autism, Down syndrome, and apraxia learn to talk. Speech Blubs is available on iOS and Android, supports English, Spanish, and German, and has been downloaded by over 10 million families worldwide. Blub Blub is a portfolio company of Speedinvest. This is a consumer mobile-app company; it does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal, so the entry is limited to verified company identity and published web properties.

providers.name: Bringy
providers.description: Bringy, Inc. is a digital insurance brokerage operating in Egypt, founded in 2019 and licensed by the Egyptian Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA License #100). Through its website and iOS/Android mobile apps, Bringy lets consumers compare, select, purchase, and manage insurance policies online, positioning itself as a digital insurance advisor that guides customers from policy selection through claims and compensation. Coverage lines include car, business, medical, personal-accident, and home insurance, with payment via Visa, Mastercard, Meeza, mobile wallets, and installment providers (ValU, Sympl, Souhoola). Bringy was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes a consumer marketing site and blog but no public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation at this time.

providers.name: Brookfield Asset Management
providers.description: Brookfield Asset Management (NYSE: BAM, TSX: BAM) is a leading global alternative asset manager with over $1 trillion in assets under management and approximately $614 billion in fee-bearing capital. BAM describes itself as "a pure-play, asset-light investment manager with earnings derived from stable, predictable fee-related revenue." The publicly listed manager was formed in December 2022 when it was spun out of Brookfield Corporation (NYSE: BN), which remains the majority shareholder. BAM operates across five investment verticals — Renewable Power & Transition, Infrastructure, Real Estate, Private Equity, and Credit — and adjacent Insurance Solutions capability is delivered through Brookfield Wealth Solutions, a sister business within the broader Brookfield ecosystem. BAM does not publish a public developer API program. Institutional Limited Partners, financial intermediaries, distribution platforms, and portfolio companies interact with the firm through private, authentication-gated investor portals, PDF reporting (10-K, supplemental, letters to shareholders), data feeds from fund administrators, and the investor-relations website at bam.brookfield.com.

providers.name: Celanese
providers.description: Celanese Corporation is a global chemical and specialty materials company that produces high-performance engineered polymers and acetyl products used across automotive, medical, consumer, and industrial applications. Celanese has no publicly documented developer API; digital engagement is delivered through the Chemille digital materials assistant for product search and selection, and a Cognite Data Fusion based manufacturing data platform for internal operations.

providers.name: Celera Semiconductor
providers.description: Celera Semiconductor accelerates analog semiconductor development using AI-powered automated design flows. Founded to address the lag in analog R&D efficiency, Celera offers custom analog IC and mixed-signal solutions delivered up to ten times faster than traditional methods, serving a range of applications from PMICs to complex mixed-signal chips.

providers.name: Cellcontrol
providers.description: Cellcontrol is a biotechnology company developing tunable, armed in vivo CAR‑T cell therapeutics. It focuses on platform technologies for safe and potent cell therapy, offering modular solutions for oncology and hematology. The company aims to advance next‑generation cell therapies with controllable dosing and integrated payloads, targeting solid tumors and improving manufacturing efficiency.

providers.name: Cera
providers.description: Cera is a United Kingdom-based digital-first home healthcare company, founded in 2016 and headquartered in London, that describes itself as Europe's largest provider of in-home care. Cera delivers home care, live-in care, nurse-led and complex care, extra-care housing, supported living, and specialist learning-disability and autism support, all wrapped around a proprietary digital platform that uses data analytics and machine learning so its network of carers can collect, monitor, and react to vital-sign and health-condition changes in real time. Cera positions this technology as a remote-monitoring and predictive layer that surfaces deterioration in health earlier and reduces hospitalisations across its United Kingdom home-care operations. As of this review Cera exposes no public developer portal, no self-serve REST API, and no HL7 FHIR endpoint or CapabilityStatement; its platform is an internal, operator-facing product delivered through consumer and carer mobile apps rather than a documented partner API. This profile is an honest identity-only stub recording the absence of a public API surface for a United Kingdom telehealth-adjacent home-care provider.

providers.name: ChinaiST Testing Service
providers.description: ChinaiST Testing Service is a high‑tech enterprise founded in Shanghai in 2002, offering chip line modification, failure analysis, reliability verification, wafer micro‑structure and material analysis, automotive component reliability testing, and advanced packaging DPA analysis. It serves chip designers, wafer manufacturers, packaging houses, and high‑end wafer equipment vendors with comprehensive integrated circuit testing and validation services.

providers.name: Chiral Quest
providers.description: Chiral Quest (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. (凯瑞斯德生化（苏州）有限公司) is a Chinese pharmaceutical CDMO specializing in chiral chemistry. The company operates asymmetric catalytic hydrogenation, enzyme-catalyzed biosynthesis, flow chemistry, and process innovation technology platforms, using proprietary catalysts to develop and manufacture chiral drug molecules, key raw materials, regulatory starting materials (RSMs), and advanced GMP intermediates for global pharmaceutical companies. Founded around its asymmetric hydrogenation catalyst technology, Chiral Quest merged with Jiangxi Longlai in 2012 and with Suzhou Pengxu in 2020; the group employs more than 800 people including a research team of roughly 150. Suzhou is the parent company and R&D center, Jiangxi Longlai is the manufacturing base, and the company maintains offices in the United Kingdom and the United States. Chiral Quest is a brochure-site company with no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable data surface.

providers.name: Cirius Therapeutics
providers.description: Cirius Therapeutics, Inc. is a privately held clinical-stage pharmaceutical company based in Grand Rapids, Michigan, developing oral therapies for chronic metabolic diseases driven by insulin resistance, including Type 2 Diabetes, Type 1 Diabetes, obesity and gestational diabetes. Its lead candidate, azemiglitazone (CIR-0602K / MSDC-0602K), is a next-generation insulin sensitizer that inhibits the mitochondrial pyruvate carrier (MPC) to re-balance mitochondrial metabolism, improve glycemic control, preserve lean muscle mass and shift visceral fat to subcutaneous and brown adipose tissue, including in combination with GLP-1 receptor agonists such as tirzepatide. The company publishes a corporate marketing website only; it operates no developer program, public API, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: COVID-19 Tracker Canada
providers.description: Details on Covid-19 cases across Canada

providers.name: COVID-ID
providers.description: Indonesian government Covid data per province

providers.name: Crimson
providers.description: Crimson Education is a global education consultancy that helps students gain admission to top universities worldwide. It offers services including college admissions counseling, test preparation, athletic recruitment, and graduate school consulting. The company operates a network of former admissions officers and Ivy League graduates, providing personalized guidance and resources to improve applicants’ chances at elite institutions.

providers.name: Crowdtap
providers.description: Crowdtap is a consumer rewards platform that offers users the ability to earn points by answering surveys, sharing opinions, and completing offers. Users can redeem points for gift cards, product samples, and other rewards. The service operates via a web portal and mobile apps, targeting a broad audience seeking to monetize their feedback. Crowdtap partners with brands to gather market research, providing a marketplace for consumer insights.

providers.name: Darewise
providers.description: Darewise Entertainment is a European game studio founded by AAA industry veterans — game director Benjamin Charbit (Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag) and engine tech lead Samuel Kahn (Ubisoft Snowdrop, Crytek CryEngine) — with offices in Paris, London and Barcelona. It builds Life Beyond, a free-to-play sci-fi MMO on Unreal Engine 5 set on the alien world Dolos, combining Web3 asset ownership (NFTs and ERC-20 tokens) with player-driven settlement and governance. Animoca Brands announced the acquisition of a majority stake in April 2022, and the studio now trades as Life Beyond Studios. The original darewise.com website last served content in April 2025 and the host now refuses TCP connections on 80 and 443. Darewise publishes no API, developer portal, or API documentation of any kind; the only machine-readable developer artifact it has ever released publicly is an open-source AsyncAPI generator template that emits Unreal Engine C++ from an AsyncAPI 3.x document, published to npm under its own scope.

providers.name: Defense Contract Management Agency
providers.description: The Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA) is the Department of Defense component that works directly with defense suppliers to help ensure that DoD, federal, and allied government supplies and services are delivered on time, at projected cost, and meet performance requirements. DCMA performs contract administration, quality assurance, and earned value management oversight, but does not currently expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Double Click
providers.description: DoubleClick was an interactive marketing and advertising technology company founded in 1996 by Kevin O'Connor and Dwight Merriman. It pioneered ad serving, targeting, and campaign measurement for publishers and advertisers, went public on NASDAQ as DCLK, and was acquired by Google in 2008 for roughly $3.1 billion. Its products were folded into Google's advertising stack — DoubleClick for Publishers became Google Ad Manager and DoubleClick Digital Marketing became the Google Marketing Platform. DoubleClick no longer exists as an independent company or API provider; doubleclick.com now redirects to Google Marketing Platform. This API Evangelist profile is retained as a historical venture-portfolio record (surfaced via lightspeed-venture-partners) rather than a live, enrichable developer surface.

providers.name: Edgeware
providers.description: Edgeware AB was a Swedish video-delivery technology company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Stockholm, known for its TV CDN, origin and media server, and streaming video-delivery products used by telecom operators and broadcasters to run OTT and IPTV services. Backed by Creandum, it listed on Nasdaq Stockholm in 2016 and was acquired by Agile Content (Agile Content S.A.) in 2020. The Edgeware brand has since been consolidated into AgileTV: edgeware.tv now redirects to agiletv.com/edgeware/, and its developer/technical documentation lives under docs.agilecontent.com (AgileTV Origin & Media Server, CDN Solutions, Subtitling). Edgeware no longer operates as an independent company or publishes an independent developer API surface.

providers.name: Ensurance
providers.description: Ensurance Limited (ASX:ENA) was an Australian ASX-listed insurance underwriting agency headquartered in Perth, Western Australia, marketing itself as "innovating the online insurance sector." Its Australian arm, Ensurance Underwriting Australia, operated as a wholesale underwriting agency under an Australian Financial Services Licence, assembling a consortium of local and international capacity — including Lloyd's, Swiss Re and XL Catlin — behind construction-specific products sold exclusively through intermediaries: Licensed Builder Annual Construction, Plant and Liability, Project-Specific Construction, Trades Liability, Owner Builder, and Home and Contents insurance, distributed to a broker network the company described as 340-plus intermediaries. A sister company, Ensurance UK Limited, ran as a Managing General Agent authorised and regulated by the UK Financial Conduct Authority and a coverholder at Lloyd's. The group's API posture is nil and always was. Ensurance never published a public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI or Swagger definition, Postman collection, GraphQL endpoint, webhook or event catalogue. What the company called its "customised online platform" for intermediaries was BOB (bob.ensurance.com.au), a form-based, session-login ASP.NET MVC quote-and-proposal wizard keyed to per-agent codes — an agent login wall, not a programmable interface. No ACORD, AL3, ACORD XML or NGDS reference appears anywhere in the company's live or archived web estate. As of this review the ensurance.com.au TLS certificate has expired and every path on the domain, along with the ensurance.ltd domain family, blanket 301-redirects to Chase Underwriting Solutions Pty Ltd, an Australian professional-lines underwriting agency that likewise publishes no API. Ensurance is recorded here as a partner-gated, no-public-API insurance provider in the Australian market — a faithful data point for a sector where the Consumer Data Right was designated for general insurance and then deferred, leaving carriers and underwriting agencies with no forcing function to expose anything.

providers.name: Excelero Storage
providers.description: Excelero was a software-defined storage company whose flagship product, NVMesh, delivered distributed, low-latency shared NVMe block storage across a server cluster with a Kubernetes CSI driver and a management CLI. Excelero was acquired by NVIDIA in 2022 and no longer operates as an independent company; its NVMesh product and documentation are now part of NVIDIA. The former excelero.com domain 301-redirects to nvidia.com/en-us/excelero/. This profile was surfaced as a battery-ventures portfolio company; the enrichment pipeline found no independent Excelero API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal to harvest.

providers.name: Exscientia
providers.description: Exscientia was an Oxford UK-based AI-driven precision medicine and drug design company, founded in 2012 as a spin-out from the University of Dundee. Its platform combined generative chemistry (Centaur Chemist) with patient tissue-based screening (EVE, an automated single-cell platform for testing drug candidates directly against patient-derived tumor samples) to design small-molecule drug candidates faster and at lower cost than conventional pharma R&D. Notable firsts included EXS-21546 (an A2A antagonist developed with Evotec), DSP-1181 (the first AI-designed molecule to enter human clinical trials, with Sumitomo Dainippon Pharma), and DSP-0038 (a dual 5-HT1A/5-HT2A modulator for Alzheimer's psychosis). Exscientia maintained active pharma partnerships with Sanofi, Bristol Myers Squibb, Bayer, Sumitomo, and Merck KGaA. Exscientia was acquired by Recursion Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ: RXRX) in an all-stock deal that closed in November 2024; the combined company operates under the Recursion brand and the legacy exscientia.ai website now redirects to recursion.com. The Exscientia name persists primarily through its GitHub organization, which continues to host open-source scientific Python packages for molecular predictive modelling (molflux), physics-based ML potentials (physicsml), antibody structure prediction (abodybuilder3), and biomolecular simulation (biosimspace) used by the wider computational chemistry and structural biology community. Exscientia did not expose any public commercial APIs, SDKs, or developer products before or after the merger; platform access was always delivered through collaborative drug-discovery agreements.

providers.name: FazWaz
providers.description: FazWaz is a Thailand-based property technology company operating one of the most comprehensive real estate portals in Southeast Asia. Through fazwaz.com it aggregates residential and investment property listings — condos, houses, villas, and land for sale and rent — connecting buyers, sellers, renters, and agents across Thailand and neighboring markets, and pairs the consumer marketplace with agent tools, market data, and property-management services. FazWaz is backed by 500 Global. It runs an internal application API and a GraphQL endpoint that power its own web and mobile clients (both disallowed to crawlers in robots.txt); no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal has been published at this time.

providers.name: FBI Wanted
providers.description: Access information on the FBI Wanted program

providers.name: Firehawk Aerospace
providers.description: Firehawk Aerospace, Inc. is a Dallas, Texas defense-technology manufacturer founded in 2019 by Ronald Jones, Will Edwards and Steve Edwards that replaces conventional rocket-propulsion production with additive manufacturing. Its proprietary 3D-printed solid rocket fuel, branded 3D-Ultra, is used to build hybrid rocket engines and solid rocket motors whose fuel-grain geometry is printed rather than cast, cutting production timelines from years to weeks while removing the handling hazards of traditional energetics. The company works under U.S. Army Applications Laboratory SBIR Phase III and U.S. Air Force Test Center contracts, has flight-tested an additively manufactured GMLRS-class analog, and is expanding manufacturing capacity in Lawton, Oklahoma and Crawford, Mississippi. Firehawk now operates publicly as Firehawk Defense (firehawkdefense.com); the firehawkaerospace.com domain 301-redirects there. It is a hardware and energetics manufacturer, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation, no SDK and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Flowcharts
providers.description: Flowcharts are a visual modeling technique used across software engineering, systems analysis, business process design, and education to depict the steps, decisions, and flow of a process or algorithm. Within an API context, flowcharts are used to model workflows, integration patterns, retry logic, authentication flows, and the orchestration of services. This topic indexes the standards, notations, libraries, and rendering tools that practitioners use to create and exchange flowcharts as part of API documentation, design, and operations.

providers.name: Gallatin AI
providers.description: Gallatin AI builds AI-powered software for defense logistics, giving military planners and logisticians decision advantage across the tactical, operational, and strategic levels of the supply chain. Its products include Navigator, an AI decision-support "S4" that aggregates and analyzes brigade-level logistics reports in real time to streamline resupply planning; Burrow, a DoD-compliant third-party logistics (3PL) solution managing vendor qualification, transportation, inventory, storage, and fulfillment for domestic and international operations; and Phalanx, an automated asset and in-transit visibility system combining traditional reporting with hardware sensors and computer vision. Founded by veterans of Scale AI, Palantir, Amazon Prime Air, and the DoD, the company emerged from stealth in 2025 and is backed by 8VC, Silent Ventures, Timeless, Moonshots Capital, and Banter Capital.

providers.name: GetCalFresh
providers.description: GetCalFresh is a service delivered by Code for America on behalf of the people of California, providing plain-language guidance to help Californians understand and navigate CalFresh (SNAP) food benefits. Since California's statewide move to BenefitsCal.com on the CalSAWS platform, GetCalFresh.org no longer accepts applications directly - it is an informational and guidance site that hands off to BenefitsCal and county agencies for eligibility determination and case processing. No public developer API is documented; historically, before BenefitsCal existed, Code for America's application tooling submitted CalFresh applications to county systems via generated PDF forms, fax, and secure email rather than a documented API.

providers.name: Gun Policy
providers.description: International firearm injury prevention and policy

providers.name: Hims & Hers Health
providers.description: Hims & Hers Health, Inc. (NYSE: HIMS) is a direct-to-consumer telehealth platform headquartered in San Francisco that connects consumers with licensed providers and ships personalized treatments across men's and women's health categories. Hims serves men with offerings spanning sexual health, hair loss, mental health, dermatology, and weight loss; Hers serves women with birth control, hair, skin, mental health, and weight management; both brands include compounded GLP-1 weight-loss programs. International expansion has been driven by the acquisitions of ZAVA (Europe, 2025) and Eucalyptus Health (Australia, 2026). Hims & Hers is primarily a consumer D2C product; no public developer API has been identified, and B2B and partner integrations are gated. This entry catalogs the company surface for the API Evangelist index.

providers.name: IDEX
providers.description: IDEX Corporation (NYSE: IEX) is a global engineered products company that designs and manufactures pumps, flow meters, valves, fluidics systems, precision components, and fire and safety equipment. IDEX serves health, science, water, energy, semiconductor, aerospace, fire and safety, and industrial markets through three segments: Fluid and Metering Technologies, Health and Science Technologies, and Fire and Safety / Diversified Products.

providers.name: Indian Pincode
providers.description: Free India PIN code lookup with GPS coordinates, 165k+ post offices, state & district data

providers.name: INEI
providers.description: Peruvian Statistical Government Open Data

providers.name: IQVIA
providers.description: IQVIA empowers life sciences organizations to accelerate innovation, improve patient outcomes, and bring treatments to market faster through advanced analytics and technology. IQVIA is a Fortune 500 company offering data, analytics, clinical research, and connected intelligence services.

providers.name: Lettuce
providers.description: Lettuce (Lettuce Inc.) is a venture-backed startup headquartered in Venice, California, surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company. As of the July 2026 enrichment pass the company operates no live public surface: lettuceapps.com and every probed subdomain (www, api, docs, developer, app) return the same wildcard domain-parking page rather than first-party content, and no developer portal, documentation, API reference, OpenAPI or AsyncAPI specification, SDK, package-registry release, or .well-known discovery document could be located. The company's remaining public footprint is a GitHub account holding one internal Node.js proxy project and one empty repository. This profile therefore records verified identity and live probe results only; it is retained as a dormant portfolio lead rather than an active API provider, and carries no fabricated API artifacts.

providers.name: Love Bonito
providers.description: Love, Bonito is a Singapore-headquartered direct-to-consumer womenswear brand, founded in 2010 out of the BonitoChico blogshop and now one of Southeast Asia's largest vertically integrated fashion labels. It designs, manufactures and retails women's apparel — Signatures, Staples and Capsule collections spanning tops, dresses, bottoms, matching sets, petites and maternity — through its own e-commerce storefront, iOS/Android shopping apps and physical stores across Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Hong Kong, Cambodia and the Philippines. The commerce stack is a Next.js storefront on a Magento-derived backend with Storyblok for content, fronted by Cloudflare, with an internal Kong API gateway at api.lovebonito.com serving its own first-party apps. Love, Bonito publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable contract; its partner surface is an affiliate program run through third-party networks (Impact, FlexOffers), not a first-party API.

providers.name: Maker.me
providers.description: Maker.me is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Mazda
providers.description: Mazda is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: gap-automotive-real-estate) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Mytheresa
providers.description: Mytheresa is a German luxury fashion e‑commerce retailer offering a curated selection of designer clothing, shoes, bags and accessories for women. The platform provides a premium shopping experience with worldwide shipping, exclusive collections, and a focus on high‑end brands. Founded in 2006, MyTheresa has grown into a leading online destination for luxury fashion, combining curated editorial content with a seamless digital storefront.

providers.name: Novartis
providers.description: Novartis AG is a Swiss multinational pharmaceutical corporation headquartered in Basel, Switzerland, and one of the largest pharmaceutical companies in the world by revenue. The company focuses on innovative medicines across oncology, immunology, neuroscience, cardiovascular, renal, and metabolic disease areas. Novartis does not publish a public external developer API. The company does maintain an Open Source Science programme that releases scientific computing libraries, Drupal modules, and informatics tooling on GitHub for use by the research community.
