providers.name: Openbay
providers.description: Openbay is an award-winning online automotive service platform and marketplace that connects vehicle owners with local repair shops and service providers, offering upfront estimates, online booking, messaging, and payment. Its consumer marketplace lets drivers compare and book automotive repair and maintenance, while Openbay+ embeds that commerce into partner and OEM channels and Openbay Otis provides a SaaS platform for repair shops. Backed by a16z and GV, the company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; this pass found no publicly accessible self-serve developer API surface (the marketing site and consumer app are Cloudflare-protected and expose no real /.well-known documents or llms.txt).

providers.name: Rapid Silicon
providers.description: Rapid Silicon is a fabless semiconductor company founded in 2019 and headquartered in Los Gatos, California, building AI- and intelligent-edge-focused FPGAs and embedded FPGA (eFPGA) IP on an open-source technology base. Its product line covers the Gemini FPGA family, the Vega eFPGA IP core (a customizable, scalable embeddable FPGA fabric from roughly 1.5K to 100K+ logic cells with configurable BRAM and DSP MAC tiles), and the Rapid eFPGA Configurator for self-service eFPGA resource sizing. Design work is done in the Raptor Design Suite, the company's RTL-to-bitstream EDA tool-chain covering simulation, synthesis, placement, routing, bitstream generation and device configuration, released under GPL3 as what the company describes as the first complete commercially available open-source FPGA tool-chain. Rapid Silicon raised a $15M seed round in 2021 and a $30M Series A in January 2023 from Cambium Capital Partners and Chengwei Capital, and is led by chairman and CEO Naveed Sherwani. The company's products are silicon IP and locally installed design software rather than a hosted service, so it publishes no public web API, developer portal or machine-readable API contract; as of 2026-05-25 its rapidsilicon.com website no longer serves company content and redirects to a domain-brokerage page.

providers.name: Raytheon
providers.description: Raytheon is an American aerospace and defense manufacturer operating as a business of RTX Corporation, the world's largest aerospace and defense company. Raytheon designs, develops, and produces advanced defense systems including precision weapons, air and missile defense systems, sensors, radar, electronic warfare, command-and-control solutions, and cyber capabilities for the U.S. military and allied governments worldwide. Key products include the Patriot missile defense system, StormBreaker smart weapons, RAIVEN electro-optical/infrared sensor suites, and advanced electronic attack systems. Raytheon also develops world-class logistics software through the EAGLE team supporting production management, technical manual development, and product support data. No public developer API or machine-readable specification is available at this time; Raytheon's software solutions are deployed within government program contracts.

providers.name: Rfmd
providers.description: RFMD (RF Micro Devices) was a semiconductor manufacturer of radio-frequency (RF) components for mobile, infrastructure, defense, and aerospace markets. In January 2015 RFMD merged with TriQuint Semiconductor to form Qorvo, and the rfmd.com domain now redirects to qorvo.com. Qorvo designs and manufactures RF and power solutions — amplifiers, filters, integrated circuits, wireless connectivity, and power management devices — spanning mobile, defense/aerospace, network infrastructure, IoT, automotive, and consumer electronics. As a hardware semiconductor company, RFMD/Qorvo publishes no public developer web API; its developer-facing resources are simulation models, QSPICE circuit-simulation software, datasheets, evaluation boards, and a technical support forum. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio lead of norwest-venture-partners and enriched to reflect the RFMD-to-Qorvo identity; there is no API surface to catalog.

providers.name: RoboDock
providers.description: RoboDock is an autonomous robotics company (Y Combinator W2026) building the robotics layer that powers autonomous EV and AV depots, starting with charging and inspections. Its robots automate depot operations for electric and autonomous vehicle fleets, handling vision-guided plug insertion with verified connection, automated post-trip vehicle inspection, and closed-loop learning that improves efficiency with each charge event. The company targets live EV and AV depots, ports, and logistics yards where charging and core depot operations are still performed manually multiple times per day across mixed fleets. RoboDock is a hardware and robotics business rather than an API provider; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or technical documentation. Founded by Zinny Weli (CEO, ex-Zipline and Amazon robotics) and Celine Wang (CTO, ex-Plus autonomous systems).

providers.name: Scorce
providers.description: Scorce is a Mexico-based API aggregation platform that gives businesses a single integration point to connect to multiple Latin American and global identity APIs for customer authentication, KYC (Know Your Customer), digital identity verification, and fraud prevention. The platform lets teams connect in under 24 hours, obtain provider trials, and monitor API performance across providers from one unified dashboard. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Puebla, Mexico, Scorce is backed by 500 Global, Finnovista, and Tenity.

providers.name: Searchlight
providers.description: Searchlight (searchlight.ai) is an Accel-backed company in the services sector, added to the API Evangelist network from Accel's portfolio. Its primary web presence is a Webflow-hosted marketing site at www.searchlight.ai, with a product application at app.searchlight.ai and an internal API host at api.searchlight.ai — both of which sit behind Cloudflare and return HTTP 525 (origin unreachable to the public), and the marketing site rejects non-browser TLS clients, so no public developer documentation, OpenAPI, or SDKs could be discovered. A public Instatus status page is live at status.searchlight.ai (monitoring Website and App components). Email runs on Google Workspace with HubSpot, and the domain publishes SPF and DMARC records. This profile captures the verifiable public infrastructure; no public API surface was found.

providers.name: Shepherd
providers.description: Shepherd is a technology-driven commercial insurance provider offering coverage for the builders and operators shaping the physical world. It underwrites Primary Casualty, Excess Casualty, and Builder's Risk lines for the construction and renewable-energy sectors, using data and an in-house AI underwriting engine (Nova) to deliver faster indications and modernized risk assessment. Shepherd sells through insurance brokers rather than exposing a public developer platform; it has issued 1,500+ policies across $400B+ in insured volume. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Costanoa Ventures and enriched by the pipeline; no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification was found.

providers.name: Soma Energy
providers.description: Soma Energy is an AI-powered energy intelligence platform that optimizes how power is produced, stored, and consumed. Founded by former Amazon and technology leaders, it coordinates power generation, battery storage, and large energy consumers such as data centers. Its Intelligence Platform combines three products: AI Trader, which automates energy procurement, hedging, and dispatch for independent power producers (IPPs); BESS Dispatcher, which manages battery energy storage systems; and Load Optimizer, which coordinates data-center workloads with grid conditions to cut energy costs and turn facilities into flexible grid assets. Soma Energy is an early-stage company backed by Uncork Capital. As of this profile the company exposes no public API, developer platform, or documentation.

providers.name: Sophont
providers.description: Sophont is a frontier medical AI lab (est. 2025) building open, universal, multimodal foundation models for medicine, working toward open medical superintelligence for clinicians. Its open-weight models are evaluated publicly and built with the research community (in collaboration with MedARC), spanning computational pathology (OpenMidnight and the nanopath challenge), functional MRI (CortexMAE), fMRI vision decoding (Brainmarks), and clinical-text benchmarks (Medmarks). Sophont aims to unify every modality of patient data (clinical notes, labs, imaging, pathology, physiological signals, genomics, medications, and demographics) into a single model of patient state to model disease trajectory, predict intervention response, and accelerate biomedical research. Backed by Kindred Ventures. Enrichment note (2026-07-21) — Sophont is a research lab that publishes open model weights, benchmarks, and papers; it does not currently expose a public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or docs portal.

providers.name: Sportlogiq
providers.description: Sportlogiq is a Montreal, Quebec-based sports analytics company that applies patented computer vision and machine learning to broadcast video to generate high-resolution player tracking, event, and performance datasets across ice hockey, soccer/global football, American football, and youth sports. Founded in 2015 by Olympic figure skater Craig Buntin and computer-vision PhD Mehrsan Javan, the company is led by CEO Mitchell Wasserman and employs roughly 75 people, including a research team of ~13 AI scientists with 180+ patents and publications. Sportlogiq describes itself as the global leader in hockey analytics, with adoption across the majority of NHL franchises, 150+ professional and amateur hockey clubs worldwide, international hockey federations and leagues (SHL, PWHL, IIHF), NCAA hockey programs, NFL franchises, and global football organizations — collectively serving 220+ clients. In November 2024 Sportlogiq acquired 8BY8, a sports video infrastructure platform that combines multi-angle video, data streams, and audio for officiating, coaching, and player health workflows. In January 2026 Sportlogiq was itself acquired by Teamworks, where it continues to operate as the AI analytics layer of Teamworks' broader operating system for sport. Sportlogiq exposes its tracking and event data to teams, leagues, broadcasters, and analytics partners through a private partner API and bulk data feeds; there is no public developer portal, no self-service signup, no published OpenAPI specification, and no public SDKs or open-source repositories. Access is sold as part of commercial contracts and integrated directly into partner workflows.

providers.name: StuffThatWorks
providers.description: StuffThatWorks is a community-driven health research platform where patients with chronic conditions share their real-world experiences to figure out, together, which treatments work best. Members complete structured surveys about their diagnoses, symptoms, and treatment outcomes, and the platform applies collective-intelligence and machine-learning models to turn thousands of patient reports into comparative, condition-by-condition treatment rankings across hundreds of chronic illnesses such as fibromyalgia, IBS, migraine, PCOS, and endometriosis. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Tel Aviv, StuffThatWorks is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. The consumer product is delivered as a web and mobile (PWA / Capacitor) application; probing the public domain surfaced no public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI, or developer portal at this time — only the SPA's private backend under /api/.

providers.name: TakeOff
providers.description: Takeoff Technologies, Inc. is an eGrocery micro-fulfillment company founded in 2016 and headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts. It paired KNAPP-built robotic storage-and-retrieval hardware with its own cloud software stack — order management, inventory, pick routing, labor management, and delivery orchestration — into micro-fulfillment centers (MFCs) installed inside or beside existing supermarkets, so grocers could assemble online orders in minutes instead of sending shoppers down the aisles. Customers and partners included Albertsons, Wakefern Food Corp., Woolworths Group and Chilean grocer SMU. The company filed for Chapter 11 in May 2024 and Woolworths Group acquired its micro-fulfillment assets in August 2024. Takeoff never published a public developer program: there is no developer portal, API reference, SDK or machine-readable specification anywhere on its public surface, and the marketing site at www.takeoff.com no longer serves TLS. A closed API gateway at api.takeoff.com remains live and actively certificate-maintained, serving customer integrations behind authentication.

providers.name: Teleport
providers.description: Quality of Life Data

providers.name: TeraWatt Technology
providers.description: TeraWatt Technology Inc. is a next-generation lithium-ion battery company founded in 2020 by Ken Ogata (CEO) and Yifan Tang, headquartered in California with an R&D center in Santa Clara and operations in Japan, including its first mass-production facility in Shizuoka. The company develops, manufactures and commercializes lithium-ion cells engineered for ultra-high energy density, high power output, improved safety and competitive cost, aimed at electric vehicles, drones, eVTOL aircraft and grid-scale energy-storage systems. It closed a Series C round with investors including Khosla Ventures, Temasek, JIC Venture Growth Investments, JBIC, JERA and ITOCHU Technology Ventures. TeraWatt Technology is a hardware manufacturer: it publishes no public API, developer portal, machine-readable contract or SDK, which was verified by probing its only public host rather than assumed.

providers.name: Textio
providers.description: Textio is an augmented-writing platform that uses AI to help managers and HR teams write clearer, more actionable, and less biased performance feedback, recruiting outreach, and job posts. Used by 100,000+ managers at companies including T-Mobile, NASDAQ, Strava, and Upwork, Textio analyzes tone and language as people write and flags biased, low-impact, or unclear phrasing in real time. It is delivered as a web application with browser and editor integrations. Probing textio.com found no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, developer portal, or .well-known discovery documents (the site is a HubSpot-hosted single-page app that serves a soft-404 shell for all such paths); api.textio.com exposes only an application health check. Textio does operate a public system status page.

providers.name: ThayerMahan
providers.description: ThayerMahan, Inc. is a U.S. maritime autonomy and ocean-intelligence company headquartered in Groton, Connecticut, founded in 2016 and led by former U.S. Navy Vice Admiral Michael Connor. It builds and operates uncrewed surface and subsurface sensing systems — Outpost, SeaPicket, SeaGuard (a non-kinetic counter-UUV defeat system) and the TransparenSea data platform — combining passive acoustic arrays, electronic sensors, edge processing, AI classification and human analysts to deliver persistent undersea surveillance, port and critical-infrastructure security, subsea infrastructure monitoring, passive acoustic marine-mammal monitoring and illegal-fishing (IUU) detection for defense, government and commercial offshore customers. ThayerMahan sells outcomes as a service rather than developer tooling: it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable contract. The only public reference to programmatic access is on the TransparenSea page, which states that contact reports are delivered by application programming interface (API), voice report, or other means in near real-time — a customer-delivery integration negotiated per engagement, not a self-serve public API. Its GitHub organization holds two forks of third-party tools and no first-party libraries.

providers.name: ThriveHive
providers.description: ThriveHive was a Boston-based guided marketing platform for small businesses (10 or fewer employees), founded in 2011 by Max Faingezicht and Adam Blake and part of the Techstars Boston 2015 class. It was acquired by Propel Marketing (GateHouse Media) in 2016 for $11.8M and the brand was folded into Gannett's LocaliQ after the 2019 GateHouse-Gannett merger. The company published no public API or developer portal; thrivehive.com now serves LocaliQ content behind an expired TLS certificate.

providers.name: Twirl
providers.description: Twirl is a data platform and orchestrator that lets teams build data products faster by combining BigQuery, dbt, Python, and Google Cloud services (GCS, Dataflow) in a single git-backed project. Backed by Creandum. As of July 2026 the twirldata.com website and docs.twirldata.com both return 404 (GitHub Pages) and no public API surface is available; the remaining public artifacts are the twirldata GitHub org (twirl-examples) and a placeholder PyPI package (twirldata 0.0.0, "Client SDK for the Twirl data platform").

providers.name: Twyla
providers.description: Twyla is an online marketplace for limited-edition art prints from contemporary artists, backed by GV (Google Ventures). As of July 2026 the twyla.com site is a landing page under redevelopment ("pardon our dust as we work on creating an even better online art marketplace and community") pointing visitors to its social channels, and the company publishes no developer portal, documentation, or public API surface — api.twyla.com and docs.twyla.com do not resolve.

providers.name: Ulu Ventures
providers.description: Ulu Ventures is a seed-stage venture capital firm based in Palo Alto, California, founded by Miriam Rivera and Clint Korver. The firm applies decision analysis to venture investing and backs diverse founder teams, having funded 200+ companies producing 10 unicorns and 3 public companies over 14+ years, growing from $3.5M in initial capital to a $138M second institutional fund. Ulu Ventures publishes no public API surface; this profile captures the firm's identity, web properties, and probed security posture.

providers.name: Unbound
providers.description: Unbound (Unbound Finance) was a DeFi protocol describing itself as "The DeFi Treasury for Liquidity Pool Tokens," enabling liquidity providers to collateralize LP tokens on Ethereum. It is a Pantera Capital portfolio company (sector: crypto). As of 2026-07-21 the project appears inactive: unbound.finance returns HTTP 404, its documentation host (wiki.unbound.finance) no longer resolves, and its GitHub organization contains only forked repositories - no public API surface, developer portal, or first-party packages were found.

providers.name: Valence
providers.description: Valence (Valence OS) is an early-stage mental-healthcare company backed by 500 Global, building continuous care that bridges the gap between therapy sessions. Its site describes an evidence-based system grounded in peer-reviewed research on mental-health trends, attrition factors, between-session care, and AI-augmented clinical support. Valence publishes no developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts as of July 2026.

providers.name: VonBox
providers.description: VonBox operated as Vonjour (vonjour.com), a Santa Monica, CA cloud communications startup offering phone, text messaging, and contact center services for small businesses, backed by 500 Global (then 500 Startups) and Kima Ventures circa 2014-2015, including a Vonjour for 500 Startups perk program. The vonjour.com website is no longer live (DNS resolves but HTTP does not respond), and no public API, developer documentation, or client packages are published. The founding team (Daniel Tawfik, Aman Fahimullah) went on to build ZenPatient (zenpatient.com), a digital health platform, and the company GitHub organization github.com/Vonjour is now branded ZenPatient.

providers.name: Wivity
providers.description: Wivity Inc. is a Web3 governance consultancy that helps organizations form blockchain consortia and infrastructure DAOs, design Web3 infrastructure, and optimize decentralized governance through its Wivity Governance framework, drawing on experience running standards working groups for organizations like the SunSpec Alliance and OMA3. A 500 Global portfolio company, Wivity does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or client libraries.

providers.name: Xairos
providers.description: Xairos Systems is a Techstars-backed company building quantum time transfer (QTT) technology - a space-based, quantum-resilient global timing and synchronization system positioned as a secure alternative to GPS for positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT). The company targets sub-nanosecond accuracy while mitigating GPS jamming and spoofing, serving critical infrastructure sectors such as transportation, finance, data centers, and power grids. Xairos publishes no first-party developer API, but its site ships an llms.txt and a live Wix Site MCP endpoint for agentic access to public site content.

providers.name: XtalPi
providers.description: XtalPi is an AI-and-quantum-physics drug discovery and materials research platform company with headquarters in Cambridge, Massachusetts and major operations in Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen, publicly listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under stock code 2228.HK. The company combines a hybrid AI plus quantum mechanics (QM) discovery engine with large-scale robotic laboratory automation to accelerate molecular research and development for pharmaceutical, agrochemical, and materials customers, including engagements with Pfizer, Eli Lilly, and Novartis. XtalPi's offering spans proprietary software platforms — PatSight for patent extraction, XFEP for free-energy perturbation binding-affinity prediction, XMolGen for generative chemistry, and XtalGazer for solid-state research — and intelligent automation hardware including the XmartChem intelligent synthesis workstation and ChemPlus desktop solid dispenser. Its drug discovery services cover hit discovery, hit/lead optimization, biology capabilities, focused library synthesis, and the PepiX peptide platform, complemented by sister brands Ailux (biology) and AiFChem (chemistry). XtalPi's products are delivered as enterprise collaborations, licensed software, and CRO-style services; there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release.

providers.name: Zet
providers.description: Zet is a Bengaluru, India fintech that helps unserved and underserved Indians enter the formal credit system. Its core product is a fixed-deposit-backed (FD-backed) secured credit card starting at very low deposits, requiring no income proof or prior credit history, alongside credit-score monitoring and improvement tools, UPI payments, cashback rewards, a ZET Plus subscription tier, and a ZET Fixit credit-report error-resolution service. Backed by General Catalyst and Sequoia Capital, Zet operates as a consumer mobile app (iOS and Android) and, as of this enrichment pass, exposes no public developer platform, API, OpenAPI, or documented developer surface.

providers.name: Advex AI
providers.description: Advex AI (Advex AI, Inc., San Francisco / Pleasanton, California; founded 2022 by Pedro Pachuca and Qasim Wani) builds generative-AI synthetic data and self-healing computer vision for industrial quality inspection. Its flagship product, Composer, is a no-code AI vision system that lets manufacturing and logistics teams train, deploy and manage visual inspection tasks — defect and anomaly detection, pick-and-place, kitting and assembly verification, counting — from a handful of real images, using diffusion models to synthesize the missing training data and VLMs to run the inspection. Composer is sold as an on-premises appliance (the "Advex box") paired with plant cameras and is explicitly designed to run entirely on-device without network connectivity. The company raised a $3.5M seed round in November 2024 led by Construct Capital with Pear VC and Emerson Collective. As of this profile Advex publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification of any kind, and its own website is currently unpublished.

providers.name: Afalight
providers.description: Afalight (Shenzhen Afalight Co., Ltd. / 深圳市埃尔法光电科技有限公司) is a Shenzhen-based optoelectronics manufacturer founded in 2016 that designs and builds next-generation photoelectric modules, optical engines and active optical cable assemblies. Its HDFiberLink, HEXWaveLink and FSO AxisLink product families cover HDMI, USB-C, DVI and LC single/dual-fiber optical modules plus fiber-optic extenders carrying IR and RS-232 control, aimed at ultra-high-definition and 8K video transport, split TVs, mobile handsets, projectors, VR gaming rigs, industrial and medical imaging, and automotive electronics. The company is a Chinese national high-tech enterprise, a member of the World Ultra HD Video Industry Alliance (CUVA) and the Shenzhen 8K Ultra HD Video Industry Cooperation Alliance (SUVA), holds ISO 9001 / ISO 14001 / ISO 45001 and IECQ HSPM certification, and reports more than 60 patents, four PCT filings and a CNAS- accredited laboratory. It is a hardware supplier: it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Aicheng Technology
providers.description: Aicheng Technology (Suzhou Innovation Ceramic Technology Co., Ltd., "SiCT" — 苏州艾成科技技术有限公司) is a Suzhou, China advanced-ceramics manufacturer founded in July 2021 that makes power-electronics substrates: AlN and Si3N4 ceramic substrates, DCB (direct copper bonding) and AMB (active metal brazing) substrates, DPC, and active solder/brazing pastes, for industrial control, new energy, consumer electronics and rail transport. It states it is the only Chinese manufacturer running the full "ceramic blank — copper bonding — etching — electroless plating" flow in mass production, with a factory and head office in the Suzhou High-Tech District and an R&D center in Korea. It sells physical components to hardware and semiconductor packaging customers; it operates no developer program, publishes no API, and its public site is a static corporate brochure with a product catalog, a datasheet download center, and a contact form.

providers.name: Aiva
providers.description: AIVA (Artificial Intelligence Virtual Artist) is an AI music generation platform that composes original music across more than 250 styles in seconds. Musicians, content creators, and studios generate tracks from prompts or from uploaded audio and MIDI influences, build custom style models, edit the resulting compositions, and export to MP3, MIDI, and WAV. Paid plans add higher download limits, longer tracks, social monetization rights, and full copyright ownership. AIVA is a consumer- and creator-facing product; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery documents.

providers.name: AiVF
providers.description: AIVF develops AI-powered software for in vitro fertilization (IVF) clinics, embryology laboratories, and patients. Its EMA platform applies computer vision and machine learning to embryo evaluation (AIVF Day-3 and Day-5), genetics, outcomes analytics, and clinic-patient communication to improve embryo selection and IVF success rates, alongside ART Compass by AIVF for fertility-lab benchmarking. AIVF holds a CE mark and names ISO 27001, ISO 27799, ISO 13485, HIPAA, and GDPR compliance; in the US an AI component is an investigational device. AIVF was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes no public developer API — this profile captures the company's identity, security, and compliance surface.

providers.name: Alba Robot
providers.description: ALBA Robot is a Turin, Italy based autonomous micro-mobility company building a fleet of self-driving robots for indoor and pedestrian spaces such as airports, hospitals, and large facilities. Its product line includes ALBA One, ALBA Ride, ALBA Ride +, and the ALBA Caddie autonomous baggage transport robot, and it layers digital services such as Digital Twins and Digital Out-of-Home (DOOH) advertising on top of the mobility platform. ALBA Robot runs pilots and deployments with airports including Cagliari, London Gatwick, Dallas, Milan, Turin, and Dubai (with dnata), and operates from Turin with a US presence in Detroit, Michigan. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or GitHub organization; it is a hardware/robotics fleet operator rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Allevi
providers.description: Allevi is a bioprinting company that designs and manufactures 3D bioprinters, bioinks, and accompanying software for tissue engineering, regenerative medicine, and life-sciences research. Its desktop bioprinters and biomaterials let researchers fabricate living tissue constructs for drug discovery, disease modeling, and organ-on-chip work. Allevi was acquired by 3D Systems and operates as part of its regenerative medicine portfolio. The company publishes bioprinting protocols, application notes, webinars, and white papers, but exposes no public web API, developer portal, or SDK at this time.

providers.name: Amazentis
providers.description: Amazentis is a Swiss longevity-biotech pioneer focused on developing mitochondrial health solutions. For over 18 years, they have researched aging, discovering Urolithin A and creating Mitopure®, a proprietary, highly pure form of the molecule. Their work includes 25 human clinical trials, 100+ global patents, and extensive scientific publications, aiming to translate rigorous aging research into clinically validated cellular nutrition.

providers.name: Anda
providers.description: Anda (andaafrica.com) is an Angolan mobility and delivery company that operates ride-hailing and courier services using motorcycles, electric motorcycles, and tuk-tuks, integrating technology, finance, and sustainability to serve people and businesses across Angola. Anda runs a drive-to-own model that empowers drivers to own their vehicles through training (ANDA Academia), insurance, maintenance support, and safe operating hubs, turning informal transport work into stable livelihoods. Moto-taxi rides are fulfilled through the Yango app, alongside green electric-motorcycle options, tuk-tuk transport, and express delivery. The company is based in Talatona, Angola, and is a portfolio company of Speedinvest (invested 2025). Anda does not currently publish any public API or developer documentation; this profile captures the verified company identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Arctus Aerospace
providers.description: Arctus Aerospace is a Bengaluru, India based deep-tech startup building high-altitude, long-endurance autonomous unmanned aircraft (MALE/HALE UAVs) for real-time Earth observation and geospatial intelligence. Its platforms are designed to operate near 45,000 feet for over 24 hours while carrying payloads up to 250 kg, delivering centimeter-level multispectral imagery as a "zero-infrastructure" alternative to satellites. The company positions itself as a data-as-a-service provider, selling subscription-based aerial coverage for energy, infrastructure, climate, defense, and agriculture use cases. Founded in 2024 by Shreepoorna S. Rao, Arctus raised a $2.6M pre-seed round led by Version One Ventures (with South Park Commons, gradCapital, and angels). As of this writing the company is pre-product from an API standpoint and publishes no public developer surface, API, or documentation; this profile was surfaced as a Version One Ventures portfolio lead.

providers.name: Artelon
providers.description: Artelon, now part of Stryker, develops dynamic synthetic implants for tendon and ligament injuries. Founded by orthopedic surgeon Lars Peterson, the company combines expertise in chemistry and textile engineering to create the Artelon FlexBand product, enhancing tissue strength and recovery. Their website offers detailed information on science, surgical indications, patient experiences, and product education, reflecting a commitment to innovative orthopedic solutions.

providers.name: Artue
providers.description: Habitus Associates Co., Ltd. is the company behind Artue (artue.io), an AI-powered online marketplace for original artworks by Korean and international artists. Artue lets collectors discover, purchase, and resell paintings, photography, sculptures, and prints, with natural-language search that finds works by mood, color, style, room type, or budget. The platform is explicitly agent-native: it publishes an llms.txt and ships a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server so AI assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT can search its collection directly. Backed by 500 Global and surfaced into the API Evangelist network from that portfolio.

providers.name: Asymchem
providers.description: Asymchem (Asymchem Laboratories (Tianjin) Co., Ltd.) is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) with more than 25 years of experience delivering integrated, cGMP-compliant services across the pharmaceutical value chain. Its single-source model spans route scouting, process research and development, scale-up, and commercial manufacturing for small molecules, peptides, oligonucleotides, chemical macromolecules, biologics, and synthetic biology, and is known for green chemistry and continuous flow chemistry. Headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina with major R&D and manufacturing operations in China, the U.S., and the U.K., Asymchem employs roughly 9,000 people and is publicly listed (002821.SZ / 6821.HK). Surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan and added to the API Evangelist network. Note: "API" in Asymchem's context refers to Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient manufacturing, not a public web/developer API — the company publishes no developer API surface.

providers.name: Atlas Motion Systems
providers.description: Atlas Motion Systems (atlasmotion.com) designs and builds brushless DC (BLDC) motors and actuators for defense and robotics applications, engineered around a customer's specific program and manufactured at scale. The public web presence is a single-page marketing site (hero plus a contact page); it is a hardware company that does not publish a developer portal, public API, SDKs, documentation, or well-known discovery surface. This profile was seeded as a Homebrew-portfolio lead and enriched with verifiable identity and live domain-security probe data only. Enrichment found no API surface to harvest.

providers.name: Atmee.ai
providers.description: Atmee.ai is a consumer platform for creating and video-calling AI avatars and personas, made by Atmanity (founded 2024). Anyone can build custom AI avatars or browse thousands of community-created personas across comedy, companion, productivity, and lifestyle categories, then hold real-time voice and video conversations with them. The platform includes identity verification with a Verified badge, a creator monetization program that pays people when others talk to their persona, and LoRAvatar, an adaptation method that personalizes avatars while preserving identity-specific details like wrinkles, tattoos, and facial textures. A developer API is documented as "coming soon"; today Atmee is a finished consumer product rather than a developer toolkit. Backed by Forerunner Ventures.

providers.name: AusperBio
providers.description: AusperBio — AusperBio Therapeutics, Inc. in the United States and Ausper Biopharma Co., Ltd. (杭州浩博医药有限公司) in Hangzhou, China — is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2019 that develops oligonucleotide and targeted delivery technologies, with an initial focus on achieving a functional cure for chronic hepatitis B infection. Its proprietary Med-Oligo antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) platform pairs novel ASO design and optimization with targeted delivery conjugation chemistry, and its Au-HALO hepatocyte-targeting delivery technology extends the same modular approach to siRNA. The lead candidate AHB-137 is an unconjugated ASO that completed enrollment in two Phase II trials and received China CDE clearance to enter Phase III; a second clinical candidate, AHB-171, is a hepatocyte-targeted siRNA. The company has raised more than $200M across Series B, B+ and B2 rounds from investors including Qiming Venture Partners, HanKang Capital, CDH Investments, Sherpa Capital, YuanBio Venture Capital and Genesis Capital. AusperBio sells therapeutics, not software: it publishes no developer program, no public API, no SDK and no machine-readable API contract. Its only machine-readable surface is the private Spring Boot CMS backend that renders ausperbio.com, whose springdoc API description is correctly locked behind authentication.

providers.name: Autobia
providers.description: Autobia is a B2B e-commerce marketplace for the automotive aftermarket in Saudi Arabia, connecting auto-parts retailers, workshops, and service centers with wholesalers and dealers. The platform offers real-time pricing and instant ordering across more than 20,000 spare parts from multiple brands, centralizing sourcing to streamline procurement and improve supply-chain efficiency for the automotive sector. Backed by Techstars, Autobia operates via a web platform and native iOS and Android apps. No public developer API, documentation, or SDK is currently published.

providers.name: AutoX
providers.description: AutoX is an autonomous driving technology company based in San Jose, California. It develops AI‑enabled self‑driving platforms for robo‑taxis and grocery delivery, aiming to democratize autonomy. Founded in 2016, AutoX has raised significant funding and operates Level‑4 driverless services in China, with a focus on safety through advanced sensors, solid‑state LiDAR, radar, and AI perception.

providers.name: Axio Biosolutions
providers.description: Axio Biosolutions Private Limited is a medical technology manufacturer headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, focused on advanced chitosan-based solutions for bleeding control, trauma care, surgical care, and advanced wound care. Its Axiostat hemostatic dressings deliver rapid hemostasis for emergency, military, and surgical bleeding, while its MaxioCel microfiber gelling wound dressings support wound healing, exudate management, and infection risk reduction across chronic and acute wounds. Axio operates its own manufacturing and quality systems and holds FDA and CE regulatory certifications. The company publishes no public API or developer platform; this profile captures its public web and discovery surface.

providers.name: Barrelllithium
providers.description: Barrelllithium, operating under Barrell Energy Inc., focuses on diversified energy solutions including oil, natural gas, lithium brine extraction, solar power, data centers, battery storage, and carbon sequestration. The company aims to meet U.S. energy needs through expansion and diversification of energy sources, leveraging extensive projects and investments across the energy sector.

providers.name: Bash Shell
providers.description: GNU Bash (Bourne Again SHell) is the default Unix shell and command-line interpreter on most Linux distributions and macOS. Developed by Brian Fox for the GNU Project as a free replacement for the Bourne shell, Bash provides a rich scripting language with variables, control structures, functions, I/O redirection, job control, and process management. Bash scripts are the foundational automation tool for system administration, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps tooling, and software build systems.

providers.name: BenchLLM
providers.description: BenchLLM provides a comprehensive benchmarking platform for large language models (LLMs), enabling developers and researchers to evaluate model performance across a variety of tasks such as text generation, summarization, translation, and question answering. The service offers detailed metrics, comparative analysis, and customizable test suites, helping users make informed decisions about model selection and optimization. BenchLLM aims to accelerate AI development by delivering transparent, reproducible, and scalable benchmarking solutions for the rapidly evolving LLM landscape.

providers.name: Berry Health
providers.description: Berry Health is a consumer digital-health company founded in 2023 by British-Ghanaian physician Dr. Fredua Akosa, headquartered in Accra, Ghana, that delivers online medical consultations, prescriptions and nationwide medication delivery for stigmatized and underserved conditions — sexual health, mental health and therapy, dermatology and skincare, and hair loss. Patients consult licensed doctors and clinical psychologists remotely, receive a personalized treatment regimen, and have medication delivered discreetly to their door. The company is licensed by Ghana's Health Facility Regulatory Agency and the Data Protection Commission. In June 2023 it raised a $1.6M pre-seed round co-led by Lightspeed Venture Partners — Lightspeed's first investment in Africa — and General Catalyst, with angels including Reddit COO Jen Wong, Thirty Madison co-founders Demetri Karagas and Steven Gutentag, and former US Surgeon General Regina Benjamin. Berry Health is a direct-to-consumer telehealth service; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK, and its consumer web properties (ourberry.com, app.ourberry.com, ourberry.io) are offline or parked.

providers.name: Bidgely
providers.description: Bidgely is a Mountain View, California energy analytics company that builds AI software for electric and gas utilities. Its flagship platform, UtilityAI, applies patented non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM) and disaggregation techniques to smart meter interval data to infer appliance-level energy usage — air conditioning, heat pumps, electric vehicles, pool pumps, water heaters and more — from the whole-home meter signal alone, without surveys, sub-meters, or smart plugs. The platform layers GenAI natural-language interfaces and Agentic AI workflows on top of disaggregation to support utility programs across demand-side management, customer engagement and high-bill alerts, load flexibility and time-of-use, electrification (EV and heat pump targeting), grid resiliency and DER planning, affordability and income-qualified outreach, gas efficiency, small and mid-sized business programs, and energy theft detection. Bidgely is sold to utilities as SaaS or deployable into customer AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, and Oracle environments, and exposes embeddable customer-facing widgets to utility digital channels. Bidgely has been deployed by more than 50 utilities across four continents — including FortisBC, Arizona Public Service, PacifiCorp, Avista, NV Energy, Nova Scotia Power, and SoCalGas — covering tens of millions of meters. Bidgely operates an internal REST API surface across regional endpoints (naapi.bidgely.com, api.eu.bidgely.com) for its own pilot deployments and embeddable widgets, but does not currently publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or self-service API key program; integration is conducted under utility contracts.

providers.name: Bids.com
providers.description: Bids.com operates an online auction marketplace specializing in jewelry, watches, accessories, and collectibles. The platform offers both auction and fixed-price formats, allowing users to bid on items without registration and purchase instantly after winning. With a wide selection ranging from rings and earrings to art and fashion, Bids.com provides products at significant discounts, often over 80% off retail prices. The site includes comprehensive buyer guides, shipping and return policies, and a dedicated support center, reflecting a fully operational e‑commerce experience.

providers.name: Bindx
providers.description: Bindx is an Argentine fintech company offering a modular, integrated financial ecosystem through APIs. It provides services such as digital wallets, payments, lending, insurance, and identity verification, targeting businesses to embed banking and financial functionalities. With a focus on scalability and automation, Bindx serves hundreds of companies and millions of users across Latin America, delivering secure and compliant API solutions for banking, payments, crypto, and more.

providers.name: Brisk Health
providers.description: Brisk Health is a Colorado urgent care and primary care provider operating a cash-pay clinic in the Denver metro area plus a fleet of mobile vehicles staffed by acute care clinicians for in-home visits, with same-day visits advertised from $49 and no insurance required. In October 2025 it announced a move from its Lakewood location to a purpose-built facility in Littleton, Colorado. Brisk Health is a healthcare services business rather than a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, no public API documentation, no SDKs, and no machine-readable specification of any kind. Its patient-facing mobile app has been delisted from both the Apple App Store and Google Play, and both of its brand domains now serve parked-domain error pages.

providers.name: BRND.ME
providers.description: BRND.ME (legally Mensa Brand Technologies Private Limited) is an India-based house-of-brands company that acquires, builds, and scales digital-first consumer brands across Health, Wellness, Lifestyle, Fashion, Party & Celebration, and Home Decor. Founded by Ananth Narayanan and backed by Accel, the company combines technology, data insight, and centralized operations to grow market-leading D2C brands from India for global customers. Its portfolio includes brands such as Majestic Pure, Botanic Hearth, Dennis Lingo, House of Ishin, and MyFitness. This is a company/provider profile in the API Evangelist network; BRND.ME operates a corporate marketing presence and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Business Leads World
providers.description: Business Leads World is a US lead-generation and B2B data company serving the alternative business-finance market. Operating since 2016 from Queens, New York, it supplies merchant cash advance (MCA) and business loan leads to lenders, ISOs, funding companies and loan brokers — MCA live-transfer calls, call-back leads, aged MCA leads, business loan leads, digital marketing leads and B2B email data. Leads are sourced through SEO, PPC and email marketing and pre-qualified against published criteria (credit score above 550, no bankruptcies, at least one year in business, and monthly bank deposits above $15,000). The company sells lead lists through a self-service storefront on its own website; it publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: C2FO
providers.description: C2FO is a fintech company operating the world's largest on-demand working capital platform, connecting enterprise buyers with their suppliers to enable early invoice payment. Through dynamic discounting, supply chain finance, and marketplace-based funding, suppliers name the discount rate at which they are willing to be paid early while buyers put idle cash to work or free up liquidity. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund and Union Square Ventures, C2FO serves a global network of businesses across supply chains. No public developer API or developer portal is currently published; this profile captures the company's public web, security, and legal surface.

providers.name: Captain Fresh
providers.description: Captain Fresh is a Bangalore, India based B2B technology company building sustainable seafood and animal-protein supply chains worldwide, connecting fishermen, farmers, processors and retailers through a technology-enabled sourcing, cold-chain and distribution marketplace. Backed by Accel and Prosus Ventures, the company operates across India and international markets. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a consumer / supply-chain company profile; no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal was found during enrichment (a marketing website only).

providers.name: Cooper Tire & Rubber
providers.description: Cooper Tire & Rubber Company is an American manufacturer of replacement tires for passenger cars, light trucks, SUVs, and commercial vehicles, founded in 1914 and headquartered in Findlay, Ohio. Cooper was acquired by The Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company in June 2021 and now operates as a subsidiary, retaining the Cooper brand alongside Goodyear. The Cooper brand portfolio covers all-season, winter, all-terrain, and sport performance tires distributed through retailers and dealers worldwide. Cooper Tire does not publish a public developer program or REST APIs. Its digital presence is consumer-facing tire selection, retailer locators, and post-purchase tire registration.

providers.name: CreatorDAO
providers.description: CreatorDAO supports content creators through funding, bespoke tooling, and training, backing a roster of YouTube and social channels ranging from tens of thousands to millions of subscribers. It operates a decentralized autonomous organization model with an on-chain creator token, promoting its creator app (district.xyz) and community channels rather than a developer platform. Surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and Initialized Capital, CreatorDAO publishes no public API, developer documentation, or API specifications as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Cross Universe
providers.description: Cross Universe Card Data

providers.name: Cryptoys
providers.description: Cryptoys is an Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) backed Web3 digital collectibles company that lets fans buy, own, and play with blockchain-based interactive toys featuring licensed characters from Disney and Star Wars alongside original IP. Products are sold as blind boxes containing randomized digital toys across multiple power tiers and rarity levels. The company has since rebranded and now operates its consumer experience as Digitoys at digitoys.io, while retaining its identity account service at auth.cryptoys.com. Cryptoys is a consumer-facing collectibles platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web and identity surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Curlie
providers.description: Curlie is a multilingual, human-edited web directory and the official successor to the Open Directory Project (ODP), also known as DMOZ. After the DMOZ directory was shut down in March 2017, the editor community relaunched the project as Curlie to continue cataloging websites by topic across more than 90 languages. Curlie is maintained entirely by volunteer editors who review and categorize submitted sites into a hierarchical taxonomy used as a reference by search engines and researchers.

providers.name: Daero Group
providers.description: DAERO (Daero Group) is a construction-technology company building mobile-first tools for trades and field teams. Its flagship product, ZeroPunch, is a field-operations platform that turns real-time field intuition into structured construction data: voice-first capture lets crews speak field observations in natural language, photos are paired with contextual field data, work is auto-assigned by scope, and stream-of-consciousness notes are converted into organized daily logs. ZeroPunch offers a two-way integration with Procore for project-management sync. The company positions itself around the daily needs of the people actually doing the work, aiming to make construction operations smarter and faster. As of this profile DAERO publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; integration is partnership-level (Procore) and inquiries go to support@daerogroup.com. Backed by Threshold Ventures.

providers.name: Daya Medika Pratama
providers.description: PT Daya Medika Pratama (DMP) is an Indonesian healthcare IT company in Central Jakarta that builds and implements hospital information systems and insurance core systems. It has worked in IT since 2007 — first as a systems integrator building data-acquisition systems for textile production machinery, later as a Microsoft Business Solution Partner in healthcare and education — and today sells AFYA Better HIS (a hospital information system with an openEHR-based clinical data repository, stated as connected to BPJS Kesehatan, Kemenkes/SATUSEHAT, FHIR and Better, and in use at more than 40 Indonesian hospitals), AFYA Insurance (policy and claims management), implementation of the Better digital health platform, and Microsoft Dynamics 365 as hospital back office. It is an openEHR industry partner and a Better (better.care) partner for the Indonesian market, and runs AFYA Better Academy, an openEHR and FHIR training programme for hospital IT staff. Its positioning line is "One Patient One Record for Better Health". DMP publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract; the standards it names are national platforms its products consume on a hospital's behalf, not APIs it ships.

providers.name: Daze
providers.description: Daze is a mobile "freeform chat" application for iOS and Android, published by Marble Media (Android package com.marblemedia.dazechat, iOS App Store id 6497405419). It is a consumer social messaging product with an active Discord community and is venture-backed by a16z, Kindred Ventures, and Menlo Ventures. As of this enrichment pass, Daze exposes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, documentation, or machine-readable discovery surface (all /.well-known/ and /llms.txt probes returned 404); it is a consumer app rather than an API provider. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead company record.

providers.description: Contains D.C. government public datasets, including crime, GIS, financial data, and so on

providers.name: EchoStar
providers.description: EchoStar Corporation (Nasdaq: SATS) is a global, fully integrated communications and content delivery leader and provider of technology, spectrum, and connectivity. Through its DISH, Boost Mobile, Hughes, and EchoStar Mobile brands, EchoStar delivers satellite communications, wireless services, and IoT connectivity to consumers, enterprises, governments, and aviation customers worldwide.

providers.name: Element Science
providers.description: Element Science is a San Francisco-based medical device and digital health company focused on high-risk cardiovascular patients. Its flagship product is the Jewel Patch-Wearable Cardioverter Defibrillator (P-WCD) — a low-profile, water-resistant wearable that continuously monitors for and treats life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias in patients at temporary elevated risk of sudden cardiac arrest. The Jewel received FDA Premarket Approval in 2025 and CE Mark / UKCA marking in January 2024. Element Science is a portfolio company of GV. Added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; no public developer API or machine-readable specification has been identified for this provider at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Elemental Cognition
providers.description: Elemental Cognition is a New York based artificial intelligence company founded in 2015 by Dr. David Ferrucci, the researcher who led the IBM Watson Jeopardy! project. The company builds a neuro-symbolic AI platform that pairs fine-tuned large language models with a formal, multi-strategy reasoning engine, so that answers are produced by the reasoning engine over an explicit Formal Knowledge Model rather than by the language model itself. The platform is marketed for high-stakes decision work in supply chain, life sciences, higher education, travel and investment management, and it was the reasoning layer behind Bridgewater's AI investment fund. Elemental Cognition packaged this as the Cogent and Cora enterprise applications, delivered as SaaS on Google Cloud, in a customer's own cloud, or on premises. The company does not run a public developer program: the platform generates callable cloud APIs automatically from each customer's own knowledge model, so the contract is tenant-specific and never published publicly.

providers.name: Epirus
providers.description: Epirus is a Torrance, California-based defense technology company building solid-state, software-defined high-power microwave (HPM) directed-energy systems for counter-electronics and counter-unmanned-aerial-systems (cUAS) missions. Its flagship product is Leonidas, a non-kinetic HPM weapon system designed to defeat single drones and large drone swarms by disabling their onboard electronics, with a growing product family that includes Leonidas IFPC-HPM (Indirect Fire Protection Capability — High-Power Microwave) for the U.S. Army, Leonidas Expeditionary (ExDECS) for the U.S. Marine Corps, Leonidas H2O for maritime interdiction, the portable Leonidas Pod, and Stryker Leonidas (with General Dynamics Land Systems). Epirus also collaborates with Anduril, Northrop Grumman, L3Harris, Kodiak AI, Peraton, and Palantir, and has received contracts from the U.S. Army, U.S. Air Force, U.S. Navy, DARPA, ONR, and Singapore's DSTA. The company is privately held, has raised more than $550M across Series B/C/D, and operates under CMMC Level 2 certification. Its product surface is classified defense hardware and embedded firmware — there is no public developer portal, REST API, SDK, or open-source software offering.

providers.name: Examity
providers.description: Examity is an online exam proctoring and test integrity platform used by universities, certification bodies, and enterprises to authenticate test-takers and monitor online assessments. It offers automated (AI/ML) proctoring, live proctoring, audit-based review, and ID verification, and integrates with learning management systems (Canvas, Blackboard, D2L Brightspace, Moodle, Sakai, Schoology, and others). Examity's programmatic surface is a partner/LMS integration - single sign-on via IMS LTI (consumer key plus shared secret) and a partner integration REST API that platform vendors use to register exams, schedule proctoring appointments, launch sessions, and retrieve completion status and integrity flags. Access is gated - there is no public self-service developer portal, and integration keys plus the integration manual are provided on request via developers@examity.com. Because no endpoints are publicly documented, the APIs below are modeled from the known integration model rather than a published reference.

providers.name: Federal Register
providers.description: The Daily Journal of the United States Government

providers.name: Fig
providers.description: Fig (Fig Loans) is a socially conscious, CDFI-certified fintech lender founded in 2015 and based in Texas that offers small-dollar installment loans as a responsible alternative to payday loans, along with credit-builder loans that help underserved borrowers establish and improve their credit. Loans typically range from a few hundred dollars over four-to-six-month terms, and Fig reports repayment to the three major consumer credit bureaus so on-time payments build credit history. Fig operates across a growing set of U.S. states including Texas, Missouri, Ohio, Utah, Florida, Illinois, and California, and partners with CDFIs and nonprofits on community-lending programs. Backed by General Catalyst and Techstars, Fig is profiled in the API Evangelist network as a company; it is a consumer-facing lender and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: FIMI Technology
providers.description: FIMI Technology Ltd. (Beijing FIMI Technology Co., Ltd. / Shenzhen FIMI Robot Technology Co., Ltd.) is a consumer aerial-imaging hardware manufacturer founded in May 2014 as a member of the Xiaomi ecosystem. FIMI designs and sells affordable camera drones, handheld gimbal cameras, and smartphone gimbals, with a product lineup that includes the X8 series (X8 SE, X8 Pro, X8 Tele, X8T enterprise), the compact Mini 3, the Manta VTOL fixed-wing drone, and the PALM series gimbal cameras. The company holds hundreds of patents across flight control, wireless transmission links, mechatronic design, gimbal image-stabilization, and computer vision. FIMI is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. This is a consumer-electronics company with no public developer program, API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: First Day Entertainment
providers.description: First Day Entertainment Inc. is a Sunnyvale, California game studio building AI-powered games, founded by Stephen Gou (formerly a founding engineer at Cohere) and Mike Mei, and funded by the a16z SPEEDRUN accelerator (batch 002) and MiraclePlus. The studio ships two titles - Heroes of Magic & Cards, a poker deckbuilding roguelike distributed on Steam, and Mana Land, a single-player RPG in which players adventure alongside conversational AI companions, published on itch.io. First Day Entertainment is a consumer games company; it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Fixed
providers.description: Fixed (fixed.com.au) is a Brisbane, Australia based construction, refurbishment and facility-maintenance company specialising in the childcare sector. The business delivers centre refurbishments, reactive and preventative maintenance, emergency repairs, landscaping and outdoor play-space (yard) services for childcare and early-learning facilities across Australia, with licensed and inducted teams and 24/7 after-hours availability. It is a services trades business with a WordPress marketing website and no public developer program, API, SDK, or machine-readable surface. This entry was auto-created as a stub from a venture-portfolio match; that match is almost certainly a domain/name collision (see x-notes) and the profile is retained here as an enriched, no-API-surface company record.

providers.name: Floward
providers.description: Floward is a leading online flowers and luxury gifting company headquartered in Kuwait and operating across the Middle East and the United Kingdom. Founded in 2017, the company delivers fresh flower arrangements, curated gift boxes, chocolates, cakes, and personalized gifts to more than 40 cities across 9 countries, sourcing blooms daily from ethical growers worldwide and offering same-day and scheduled delivery through its web store and mobile apps. Floward is backed by investors including 500 Global. This API Evangelist profile tracks Floward as a company in the network; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes a consumer e-commerce storefront and corporate site but no public developer API, documentation portal, or SDKs were found.

providers.name: Fluent.ai
providers.description: Fluent.ai is a Montreal-based speech recognition software company, founded in 2015, that voice-enables the world's devices with embedded, offline voice AI. Its patented "speech-to-intent" technology maps a user's speech directly to their intended action using acoustic deep neural networks, with no speech-to-text transcription and no cloud connection required. The result is a small-footprint, private-by-design engine that runs fully on-device, is robust to noise, and works across languages and accents. Fluent.ai licenses two core products to OEMs and ODMs: Fluent.ai Air (Automatic Intent Recognition), an on-device command-recognition engine, and Fluent.ai Wakeword, a small-footprint wake-word / keyword-spotting solution. Target markets include smart-home devices, wearables and hearables (including True Wireless Stereo), and industrial IoT and robotics. The company distributes its technology as embedded SDKs and reference designs through hardware partnerships (e.g. Arm, Cadence Tensilica, Knowles) rather than a public cloud API. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global.

providers.name: Food Standards Agency
providers.description: UK food hygiene rating data API

providers.name: forgame
providers.description: Forgame Holdings Limited (HKEX 00484) is a Hong Kong-listed technology holding company founded in 2009 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China. It operates across cloud/light gaming, fintech, electronic trade, and cloud storage. Its web and mobile game publishing platform 91wan, run by PRC entity Guangzhou Weidong Internet Technology Co., Ltd., has distributed over 100 web games and attracted more than 200 million registered players. In 2016 the group obtained an internet micro-lending (fintech) license in the PRC, and since 2019 has explored e-sports and virtual-reality games. Forgame is tracked by API Evangelist as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners; no public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: GE HealthCare Technologies
providers.description: GE HealthCare Technologies (NASDAQ: GEHC) is a global medical technology, pharmaceutical diagnostics, and digital solutions innovator providing imaging, ultrasound, patient care solutions, and pharmaceutical diagnostics. Spun off from General Electric in January 2023 and headquartered in Chicago, Illinois.

providers.name: Geneva
providers.description: Geneva is an all-in-one communication app for groups, clubs, and communities — "the online place to find your offline people." It bundles full-featured group chat (threaded replies, reactions, GIFs, attachments, polls, pins), audio/video rooms and livestreaming for hundreds of viewers, event planning, and wallet-connect with token-gated rooms for tokenized communities. Geneva ships as free iOS, Android, and web apps and was acquired by Bumble Inc. This API Evangelist profile entered the network as a VC-portfolio-sourced stub; the company publishes a consumer app with no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or documentation surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: GM OnStar
providers.description: GM OnStar is General Motors' connected vehicle services platform, originally launched in 1996 as an in-vehicle safety, security, and concierge service and since extended into a commercial data platform under OnStar Business Solutions. The OnStar Business Solutions API and Data Services product delivers near-real-time embedded telematics straight from properly equipped 2015-model-year-or-newer GM vehicles — Chevrolet, Buick, GMC, and Cadillac — without aftermarket hardware, exposing vehicle location, speed, ignition status, odometer, fuel level, EV state-of-charge and charging status, tire pressure, seatbelt status, diagnostic trouble codes, and driver-behavior events such as hard brake and hard acceleration. The product is packaged into tiered plans (commonly referenced as API Starter and API Pro) and is distributed primarily through OnStar's enterprise channel under the GM Envolve commercial brand, plus integrations with fleet management providers including Samsara, Geotab, Wheels, Verizon Connect, and other approved telematic service providers. There is no public self-serve developer portal or published OpenAPI specification — access is gated through GM/OnStar sales (developer.gm.com is a request-access endpoint) or via an authorized integration partner. Consumer-facing OnStar mobile features (remote start, remote lock, vehicle locate, in-vehicle Wi-Fi, Super Cruise telemetry) are delivered through GM's myChevrolet, myBuick, myGMC, and myCadillac apps and are not part of the published API surface.

providers.name: Grace
providers.description: Grace (Grâce) is a Paris-based insurtech that lets luxury maisons offer their clients complimentary, embedded protection against theft, loss, and damage for high-value goods such as watches, jewelry, and accessories. Founded in 2022 and backed by Speedinvest and FinTech Collective, Grace pairs a top-tier underwriter with a technology platform that handles instant coverage, fraud detection, claims processing, and logistics through the Grace app, and integrates into a brand's existing purchase journeys via a customizable API. The company raised a €5.9M seed round in 2025 and operates across Europe and beyond. Grace publishes no public developer portal or API specification; its API is a private, partner-facing integration offered to luxury brands.

providers.name: Grain
providers.description: Grain is a Singapore-based online restaurant and catering company founded in 2013 that delivers freshly prepared, thoughtfully sourced meals across Singapore. Its products include Meals On Demand (same-day ready-to-eat delivery), wedding catering, event catering, gift cards, and the Grain Savers program, with MUIS Halal and ISO certifications. Grain was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio stub (500 Global among its early backers). As of this enrichment pass it publishes a consumer web storefront but no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or other machine-readable API artifacts, so this profile captures company identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Hammoq
providers.description: HAMMOQ is an AI-powered resale and recommerce platform that streamlines the processing and listing of secondhand goods for resellers, liquidators, thrift and retail organizations. Its Listing Solution turns photographs into marketplace-ready listings: machine vision identifies each item's attributes and category, generative AI writes SEO-optimized titles and descriptions, and virtual assistants quality-check each listing before it is published across resale marketplaces such as eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Amazon and Etsy. HAMMOQ also offers Sorting and Photography solutions and an Infinity AI Chrome extension that autofills item specifications during listing. The company raised a $24M round to tackle the growing retail-returns and used-goods market. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Sierra Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; HAMMOQ publishes no public API, developer portal, or specification at this time.

providers.name: Healthcaresource.com
providers.description: HealthcareSource is a healthcare-focused talent management software provider whose recruiting, applicant tracking, onboarding, behavioral assessments, learning, and employee performance-management products are used across U.S. healthcare organizations. HealthcareSource was acquired by symplr in July 2021 (from Francisco Partners) and its products are now delivered as part of symplr's healthcare talent-management suite, including symplr Recruiting. No public developer program, API documentation, SDK, or /.well-known discovery surface was found for the brand at profiling time; the healthcaresource.com domain 301-redirects to symplr.com/healthcaresource.

providers.name: JD Logistics
providers.description: JD Logistics (Hong Kong listed as 2618.HK) is a technology-driven supply chain and logistics service provider spun out of JD.com and backed by the SoftBank Vision Fund. It operates one of China's largest integrated logistics networks, offering express and freight delivery, integrated warehouse-and-fulfillment, cold-chain and pharmaceutical logistics, cross-border shipping, oversized-item handling, and smart supply-chain technology. Through its JD Logistics Open Platform (open.jdl.com) it exposes enterprise integration services for order fulfillment, warehousing, waybill/shipment creation, tracking, and reconciliation to merchants and partners. This profile tracks the company's public developer and open-platform surface in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Kencko Foods
providers.description: Kencko is a direct-to-consumer functional-food company that makes no-fuss instant smoothies and other whole-food products from 100% organic, vegan, freeze-dried fruits and vegetables with no added sugars. Customers subscribe and shop through a Shopify-hosted online store at kencko.com. Kencko is a Techstars-backed portfolio company and was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub lead for the enrichment pipeline. It publishes no first-party developer API; the only machine-readable discovery surface on its domain is the Shopify Customer Account API OIDC/OAuth well-known configuration that backs storefront customer login.

providers.name: Kovr.ai
providers.description: Kovr.ai is a security and compliance automation company surfaced through the Battery Ventures portfolio and profiled in the API Evangelist network. Its verified public engineering presence is the GitHub organization github.com/kovr-ai, whose open-source kovr-aws-nist-compliance project validates AWS environments against NIST 800-53 Rev 5 and NIST 800-171 Rev 2 and maps findings across the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark, MITRE ATT&CK, OWASP Cloud Security, the AWS Well-Architected Framework, the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, the CSA Cloud Controls Matrix, the SANS Critical Security Controls, and NIST SP 800-207 Zero Trust Architecture, running roughly 160 checks across 50+ AWS services. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification has been located for this company; the corporate website is served behind a bot-protection interstitial that blocks automated retrieval, so link properties beyond the homepage and the GitHub organization remain unverified.

providers.name: Kubota
providers.description: Kubota Corporation is a Japanese multinational manufacturing agricultural, construction, and industrial machinery, including compact tractors, excavators, mowers, utility vehicles, engines, and water and environmental infrastructure systems sold in over 120 countries. Kubota does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; equipment telematics (KubotaNOW) and dealer integrations are handled through partner channels rather than open APIs.

providers.name: Kuehnle AgroSystems
providers.description: Kuehnle AgroSystems, Inc. (KAS) is a Honolulu, Hawaii microalgae biotechnology company founded in 2007 by Dr. Adelheid "Heidi" Kuehnle, with a second site in Cork, Ireland. KAS produces high-value natural products from microalgae for the food, feed and health markets using a patented heterotrophic "dark fermentation" process and proprietary non-GMO Hawaiian algal strains that run in standard fermentation equipment rather than open ponds or photobioreactors, compressing production from weeks to days with substantially lower cost, land, water and energy use. Its lead products are natural astaxanthin and algal protein, sold into nutraceuticals, cosmetics and skincare, functional foods and beverages, and aquaculture and animal feed; in August 2025 KAS entered a development and commercialization partnership with Corbion for an esterified natural astaxanthin. KAS sells ingredients, strains and fermentation process technology rather than software: it publishes no API, developer program, SDK, or machine-readable contract, and kuehnleagro.com is a six-page Squarespace marketing site.

providers.name: Latent Space
providers.description: Latent Space is an artificial intelligence company building generative models for businesses and creatives, described by General Catalyst as creating "AI technology for predictive analytics and data-driven insights." The company raised a Series A from Greylock and General Catalyst and is listed in the General Catalyst portfolio under the Artificial Intelligence industry in North America. As of a July 2026 probe, Latent Space publishes no developer surface: the company domain latentspace.co returns an HTTP 302 redirect to its X/Twitter profile for every path probed, no docs/api/developer/app/status subdomains resolve in DNS, there are no /.well-known/ discovery documents, no llms.txt, and no public repositories under its GitHub organization. This profile therefore records verified company identity and domain posture only — no API, SDK, or documentation artifacts exist to harvest.

providers.name: Liberate Bio
providers.description: Liberate Bio is a genetic medicine company developing in vivo cell therapies that reach cell populations beyond the liver, the long-standing limit of lipid nanoparticle delivery. Its RAPTOR discovery platform is a scalable in vivo screening system that identifies LNP delivery vehicles which work with existing biology to carry genetic payloads into immune cells in blood, bone marrow, and the spleen. Liberate Bio applies that delivery capability to in vivo CAR-M (chimeric antigen receptor macrophage) programs, reprogramming monocytes and macrophages to eliminate disease-driving cells without ex vivo manipulation, with programs in hematologic oncology and in autoimmune disease via depletion of pathogenic B-cell populations. Founded by Nessan Bermingham, Theresa M. Reineke, and Michael Mitchell, and led by CEO Shawn Davis and CSO Walter Strapps, the company raised $31M from Khosla Ventures in October 2025. It is pre-clinical and publishes no public API or developer surface.

providers.name: Magic The Gathering
providers.description: Magic The Gathering Game Information

providers.name: Mauna Kea Semiconductors
providers.description: Mauna Kea Semiconductors (mk-semi.com) is a Silicon Valley-based fabless semiconductor company founded by industry veterans to develop what it describes as the world's lowest-power Ultra-Wideband (UWB) solution for high precision location and direction-finding applications. Its UWB chips, modules, and integrated System-on-Chip solutions target smartphones, wearables, IoT devices, and automotive use cases, combining digital and analog/mixed-signal design expertise. Headquartered in Cupertino, California, with engineering operations in Shanghai, Beijing, and Shenzhen, the company is led by CEO Dr. Yifeng Zhang and is backed by Qiming. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Qiming; it is a hardware/silicon vendor with no public API or developer surface at this time (documentation, blog, and careers pages are marked "Coming Soon").

providers.name: Mirana Toys
providers.description: Mirana Toys (Mirana Innovations Pvt Ltd) is an India-based smart-toy company and OEM/ODM manufacturer of electronic toys — RC cars, monster trucks, drones, educational toys, and AI/AR toys. It pairs its consumer products with the Mirana smart app (iOS and Android), a mobile gaming platform that lets kids and adults control and play with Mirana toys over Bluetooth. As an OEM partner it offers in-house PCB/PCBA design and SMT assembly, tooling and mold design, mobile app development, compliance support (ASTM, EN-71, RoHS, ISO, SMETA), and global logistics for toy brands and retailers. Backed by Accel. The company publishes a consumer e-commerce storefront and support center but no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Mississippi River Commission
providers.description: The Mississippi River Commission (MRC) is a federal agency established in 1879 that operates under the United States Army Corps of Engineers Mississippi Valley Division. The seven-member commission oversees the Mississippi River and Tributaries Project, managing flood control from the river's mouth to Cape Girardeau, Missouri, and improving navigation from Baton Rouge to Cairo, Illinois. The MRC is responsible for federal stewardship of the Mississippi River, including flood control, navigation, environmental management, and related engineering and policy work executed through six district offices.

providers.name: Mu Sigma
