providers.description: Mu Sigma is a decision sciences and AI services company founded in 2004, headquartered in Northbrook, Illinois with its principal delivery centre in Bangalore, India, working with 140+ Fortune 500 clients across retail, pharma, financial services, manufacturing, energy, technology and logistics. Its work is delivered as engagements and platforms rather than as a public developer product: the Art of Problem Solving System (muAoPS), the Akashic Architecture enterprise intelligence foundation, the muTalos agentic-AI ecosystem, Enablers of Confidence, and a Continuous Service-as-a-Software operating model. Mu Sigma publishes no developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable API contract; its only public machine-readable engineering output is a set of open-source R packages for decision science (HVT, muHVT, analysisPipelines, RImpala, Rdrools) released to CRAN from the github.com/Mu-Sigma organization.

providers.name: MWI Veterinary Supply
providers.description: MWI Veterinary Supply, a subsidiary of AmerisourceBergen, is a leading distributor of animal health products to veterinarians across the United States and the United Kingdom, providing pharmaceuticals, vaccines, supplies, diagnostics, and practice management software to veterinary practices.

providers.name: National Cemetery Administration
providers.description: The National Cemetery Administration (NCA) is an agency of the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs that provides burial and memorial benefits to veterans and their eligible family members. NCA does not currently expose a documented public REST API; access is via web tools such as the Nationwide Gravesite Locator and Cemetery Finder, with broader data available through VA Open Data.

providers.name: New Residential Investment Corp (Rithm Capital)
providers.description: New Residential Investment Corp (NYSE: NRZ) was a mortgage real estate investment trust (REIT) that **rebranded as Rithm Capital Corp (NYSE: RITM) in August 2022** to reflect its evolution from a pure mortgage REIT into a diversified global asset manager focused on real estate, credit, and financial services. Rithm Capital is headquartered in New York City, led by Chairman & CEO Michael Nierenberg, and as of 2024 reported approximately $46 billion in assets under management, ~$5.2 billion in revenue, and ~6,045 employees across its operating businesses (Newrez mortgage origination/servicing, Genesis Capital business-purpose lending, Sculptor Capital Management alternatives platform, Rithm Property Trust REIT [formerly Great Ajax], Adoor single-family rental, Crestline credit, and Elecor Properties [formerly Paramount Group] office real estate). This profile carries forward the legacy `new-residential-investment` repo identity under the API Evangelist network. The active corporate identity, public filings, and investor communications are at rithmcap.com. Rithm Capital and its subsidiaries operate as financial-services businesses serving institutional investors, mortgage borrowers, and real-estate sponsors. None of the public-facing Rithm Capital, Newrez, Genesis Capital, Sculptor, Rithm Property Trust, Adoor, Crestline, or Elecor Properties websites expose a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, REST/GraphQL API, SDK, CLI, webhook system, status page, or RSS feed. There are no public GitHub organizations of substance for any of the brand surfaces (the `newrez` GitHub org exists with zero public repositories; `rithmcap` does not exist). Integration with these businesses occurs through traditional B2B mortgage / capital-markets channels, not a public API surface.

providers.name: Newmark Group
providers.description: Newmark Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: NMRK) is a global commercial real estate advisory and services firm headquartered in New York City. Founded in 1929 and acquired by BGC Partners in October 2011, Newmark provides capital markets, leasing, valuation & advisory, global corporate services (GCS), property management, industrial and logistics, multifamily, and retail services. The firm expanded its international footprint with the 2023 acquisition of UK-based Gerald Eve and its multifamily platform via Open Realty Advisors. Newmark publishes recurring industry research under the MarketBeat / market-report brand but does not operate a public developer program or expose machine-readable APIs.

providers.name: Nordstrom
providers.description: Nordstrom is a leading fashion retailer offering compelling clothing, shoes, and accessories for men, women, and children through Nordstrom and Nordstrom Rack stores and online. Nordstrom does not currently operate a public developer portal or expose general-purpose APIs to third-party developers; this repository captures the company profile and any future developer-facing artifacts.

providers.name: Nouscom
providers.description: Nouscom AG is a private, clinical-stage immuno-oncology company developing next-generation neoantigen-targeted cancer immunotherapies, founded in 2015 by Riccardo Cortese and Alfredo Nicosia, with headquarters in Basel, Switzerland and research and manufacturing operations in Rome, Italy. Its proprietary viral vector platform — great ape adenovirus and MVA vectors able to encode large neoantigen payloads together with other immunomodulators — is used to build both off-the-shelf and personalized cancer vaccines. The lead program, NOUS-209, targets 209 shared frameshift neoantigens for cancer interception in Lynch Syndrome carriers and for the treatment of dMMR/MSI metastatic colorectal cancer in combination with pembrolizumab; its second clinical program, NOUS-PEV, is a personalized immunotherapy for advanced solid tumors. Nouscom raised an oversubscribed EUR 67.5 million Series C in November 2023, co-led by Andera Partners, Bpifrance (InnoBio 2) and M Ventures. Nouscom is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor: it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable API contract, and is profiled here as an identity-only record.

providers.name: Numa
providers.description: Numa is the AI Operating System for car dealerships. Its voice AI and messaging platform answers dealership calls and texts, connects directly to the DMS (CDK, Tekion, Reynolds & Reynolds) with roughly 90% DMS coverage, books service appointments, and coordinates the service lane and fixed operations. Used by over 1,300 dealerships, Numa reports cutting average customer response time from 23 hours to under 10 minutes and lifting repair-order dollars per advisor. Numa publishes no public API or developer portal; integrations are delivered through native DMS, CRM, and scheduler connectors.

providers.name: omio
providers.description: Omio (formerly GoEuro) is a Berlin-based travel booking platform that lets travelers search, compare, and book trains, buses, ferries, and flights across thousands of transport providers throughout Europe and beyond from a single website and mobile app. Founded in 2013 as GoEuro and rebranded to Omio in 2019, the company aggregates schedules, fares, and seat availability from hundreds of carriers into one checkout. Omio does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; its carrier and distribution integrations are handled through private B2B partnerships. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from VC-portfolio discovery and enriched by probing Omio's public domain, DNS, and security surface.

providers.name: onsemi
providers.description: ON Semiconductor (now branded as onsemi) is a global supplier of semiconductor-based solutions for power efficiency, image sensing, and signal processing in automotive, industrial, and other applications. No public APIs are documented at this time.

providers.name: Oraliva
providers.description: OraLiva, Inc. is a dental diagnostics company developing an AI-powered oral cancer and dysplasia detection system for use during routine dental visits. Its ONC In-Cyt platform pairs a minimally-invasive brush biopsy with deep-learning cytology trained on more than 13 million cell images to score early malignancy risk. The company emerged from NIH-funded research at NYU by Dr. John T. McDevitt and is a portfolio company of DCVC. It is a medical-diagnostics (medtech/healthtech) company with no public developer, API, or technical surface at this time.

providers.name: OrsoBio
providers.description: OrsoBio is a privately held, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2021 and headquartered in Palo Alto, California, developing first-in-class oral therapies that restore energy homeostasis in patients living with severe metabolic disorders — obesity, type 2 diabetes, severe dyslipidemias, lipodystrophies and MASH. The name is drawn from the metabolic adaptability of bears ("orso" in Italian). Its pipeline is led by three mitochondrial protonophores — TLC-6740, TLC-1180 and TLC-1235 — intended to increase energy expenditure and improve metabolic and cardiovascular health, alongside an LXR inverse agonist (TLC-2716) for severe hypertriglyceridemia and MASH, an ACC2 inhibitor (TLC-3595) for insulin sensitivity in type 2 diabetes, and an ACMSD inhibitor to augment NAD+ biosynthesis in metabolic and inflammatory liver and kidney disorders. The company closed an oversubscribed $67 million Series B in September 2024, co-led by Ascenta Capital and Woodline Partners with participation from Samsara BioCapital, Enavate Sciences and Longitude Capital. OrsoBio publishes a corporate site covering its science, pipeline, team, board, publications, events and press releases, but runs no developer program: no API documentation, no SDKs, no developer portal, no GitHub organisation and no machine-readable API contract of any kind. The only machine-readable surface on orsobio.com is the site's own WordPress CMS route index, which the site's robots.txt explicitly disallows at /wp-json/ and which is therefore not harvested or catalogued here.

providers.name: PCV
providers.description: Precision Cardiovascular (PCV) is a UK-based digital-health company advancing cardiovascular care through continuous, AI-powered heart-failure monitoring. Its flagship PULSENSE system pairs an implantable pulmonary-artery-pressure (PAP) sensor insert and a wearable smart chest patch with an AI-powered clinical app that surfaces real-time pressure trends and analytics for clinicians and patients. The platform is designed to catch PAP fluctuations that traditional spot-check measurements miss, including overnight and during activity. PCV PULSENSE is an investigational device under regulatory review (FDA, MHRA, EMA) and is not yet approved for commercial sale. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and profiled in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK at this time.

providers.name: Percolata
providers.description: Percolata is a Palo Alto, California predictive-analytics company that applies machine learning to help retailers optimize labor scheduling and marketing spend. Its platform forecasts hourly sales, in-store traffic, and takeout demand to drive staffing optimization and marketing budget allocation, with published claims of 4x higher forecast accuracy, 10-20% same-store sales lift, and a forecast-accuracy guarantee. Named customers include 7-Eleven, Uniqlo, and Telefonica. The company is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Google Ventures (GV). Percolata does not publish a public developer portal or REST API reference; its retail platform is delivered as a managed product with custom application integration. The percolata.com marketing site is now served by Wix, which provisions a live, first-party Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint and an llms.txt for agentic access to public site content.

providers.name: Physera
providers.description: Physera was a virtual physical therapy (musculoskeletal) startup that provided members video access to a nationwide network of licensed physical therapists for diagnosis and treatment, along with in-application 3D exercise animations, voice prompts, computer-vision range-of-motion measurement, and asynchronous messaging. Backed by Lux Capital, Physera was acquired by Omada Health in May 2020 (reported ~$30M) and now operates as the "Omada MSK by Physera" digital care program; the physera.com domain redirects to omadahealth.com/musculoskeletal. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; enrichment found no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI surface, or documented event/webhook surface — it is a member-facing clinical product with no first-party developer program.

providers.name: Pixcel
providers.description: PIXCEL Inc. is an early-stage deep-tech startup developing cutting-edge silicon photonics solutions and photonic integrated circuits (PICs) for optical communications and related systems. Based in Matawan, NJ, and co-founded by silicon photonics veteran Long Chen (previously at Cisco Systems and Acacia Communications), the company designs passive and active photonic components and collaborates with foundry partners to optimize process design kits (PDKs). PIXCEL is a hardware and semiconductor company with no public API, developer portal, or software product surface at this time; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of Matrix Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. This profile reflects an enrichment pass that confirmed there is no API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Pliops
providers.description: Pliops is an Israeli data-acceleration semiconductor company, founded in 2017 and headquartered in Ramat Gan, that builds the Extreme Data Processor (XDP) — a low-profile PCIe accelerator card that offloads storage and key-value data-path work from server CPUs. Its software surface is delivered as host libraries rather than as a web API: XDP-AccelKV and XDP-Rocks expose a RocksDB-API-compatible key-value engine (the "storelib" shared library) used as a drop-in under MySQL/MyRocks, Redis, KVRocks, TiDB, Kafka and Spark, and XDP LightningAI extends the same acceleration to GenAI KV-cache offload for vLLM-based inference. Pliops raised roughly $205M from investors including Intel Capital, NVIDIA, AMD, SoftBank Ventures Asia and Western Digital, and was acquired by Astera Labs in February 2026, which took certain assets, IP and about half the staff into a new Israeli R&D center. Pliops has never operated a public developer program: there is no developer portal, no public API reference, no published OpenAPI or other machine-readable contract, and no published SDK in any package registry — product and library access runs through a sales/evaluation conversation.

providers.name: PopChill
providers.description: PopChill is Taiwan's largest secondhand luxury fashion trading platform, operating as a mobile marketplace app for buying and selling authenticated pre-owned designer goods including handbags, watches, jewelry, apparel, and footwear from Chanel, Hermes, Louis Vuitton, Dior, Gucci, Prada, and 40+ other brands. The company provides item authentication, secure transactions, and seller support to a consumer audience. PopChill is backed by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or technical integration surface; this profile tracks the company in the API Evangelist network pending any future API program.

providers.name: Popmeals
providers.description: Popmeals (Pop Meals, operated by Farm To Fork Sdn Bhd) is a Malaysian food-delivery and cloud-kitchen brand offering popular meals at affordable prices through a central-kitchen model and a network of outlets across Malaysia and Southeast Asia. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network. This is a consumer brand with a public ordering and support surface but no published developer/API program: domain-security posture was probed live, and no OpenAPI, SDK, MCP server, or developer portal was found.

providers.name: Presto Automation
providers.description: Presto Automation (now operating as Presto Phoenix, Inc.) is a Silicon Valley-based voice AI and automation provider for restaurant drive-thrus and quick-service restaurant (QSR) chains. Its flagship product, Presto Voice, is an AI-driven drive-thru ordering assistant that automates order taking using in-house Natural Language Understanding (NLU) and large language models combined with automated speech recognition (ASR) and text-to-speech (TTS), with optional human-in-the-loop supervision. Presto offers a full spectrum of operating modes (supervised AI, pure AI, agent-led, and unsupervised AI) and has expanded into AI-native phone ordering for QSRs. Presto Voice integrates into existing drive-thru hardware, confirmation boards, headsets, and POS platforms through partnerships with vendors such as Oracle, PAR, and Qu, and draws on AI partnerships with OpenAI and ElevenLabs. Presto does not publish a public or partner-facing developer API, SDK, or documentation portal; integrations are arranged directly with the company through vendor and POS partnerships, so no API products are listed here.

providers.name: Quantierra
providers.description: Quantierra (Quantierra Advisors LLC) is a quantitative real estate advisory firm that uses proprietary software to source, analyze, and execute real estate transactions on behalf of institutional investors, family offices, nonprofits, and everyone in between. The firm blends data-driven deal sourcing and quantitative underwriting with traditional brokerage and advisory services. Quantierra keeps a deliberately low public profile at the preference of its clients and does not publish a public developer program, API, or self-service platform; its technology is used internally to support client engagements rather than exposed as a product.

providers.name: Qumu
providers.description: Qumu is an enterprise video management platform for creating, managing, and securely distributing live and on-demand video across large organizations, with features spanning live broadcasting, video content management, analytics, enterprise content delivery/eCDN, and AI-powered enhancements such as auto-generated summaries and video chapters. Qumu was acquired by Enghouse Systems in 2023 and is now operated as part of Enghouse Video; the qumu.com domain redirects to the Enghouse Video product page. No public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI specification, or SDK surface is published.

providers.name: Rhoda Ai
providers.description: Rhoda AI develops robotic intelligence for real-world industrial and commercial environments, building general-purpose foundation models that adapt to the variability of physical work through its Direct Video Action model. Its robots handle tasks across automotive, manufacturing, logistics, and ecommerce, including returns processing, component handling, and material breakdown. The company is a venture-backed portfolio company of Mayfield and currently publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Saul Ewing
providers.description: Saul Ewing LLP is a U.S.-based law firm founded in 1921 as Saul, Ewing, Remick & Saul, with more than 450 attorneys across 17 U.S. offices spanning the Mid-Atlantic, Northeast, Midwest, Florida, and California. The firm serves clients across 40+ industries with practice strengths in litigation, corporate and M&A, bankruptcy and restructuring, real estate, public finance, life sciences, financial services, intellectual property, labor and employment, and cybersecurity and privacy. Saul Ewing does not publish a public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, or machine-readable data product; its public technology surface is limited to its corporate website, a HighQ-powered client portal, the SEquel Alumni Portal at alumni.saul.com, employee remote-access tooling, and a small set of practice-specific blogs (Construction Industry Counselor, OZ and EB-5 Investments, Legacy Matters, The Friday Five). Two empty GitHub organizations (Saul-Ewing and saulewing) exist with zero public repositories.

providers.name: Sherlock Biosciences
providers.description: Sherlock Biosciences is a molecular diagnostics company founded in 2019 out of the Broad Institute to commercialize SHERLOCK (Specific High-sensitivity Enzymatic Reporter unLOCKing), the CRISPR-based nucleic-acid detection method developed in the Zhang lab, alongside INSPECTR, an ambient-temperature synthetic-biology amplification platform. In May 2020 it received the first FDA Emergency Use Authorization ever granted to a CRISPR-based diagnostic, for SARS-CoV-2. The company developed disposable, instrument-free molecular self-tests, led by a combined Chlamydia trachomatis and Neisseria gonorrhoeae assay. OraSure Technologies acquired Sherlock Biosciences in December 2024 and absorbed it into its rapid-diagnostics portfolio; the sherlock.bio domain now permanently redirects to orasure.com. Sherlock Biosciences is a laboratory diagnostics developer and has never operated a public developer program, HTTP API, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Shpock
providers.description: Shpock is a mobile-first second-hand marketplace and classifieds platform that brings millions of private buyers and sellers together, primarily across the United Kingdom, Austria, and Germany. Users list, discover, and negotiate on pre-owned goods across categories including electronics, fashion, home and garden, vehicles, and property, alongside a Shpock+ for Professionals program for business sellers. Founded in Vienna and backed by Speedinvest, Shpock operates consumer iOS/Android apps and a web experience. As of this enrichment pass Shpock publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; the api.shpock.com host exists but is private (returns 401 to unauthenticated requests). This profile therefore captures company identity and probed domain security rather than an API contract.

providers.name: Smart Diagnostics Systems
providers.description: Smart Diagnostics Systems (SDS) is a food-safety diagnostics company based in Columbia, Missouri, founded in 2016 and backed by Techstars. SDS builds the PathoMeter, a state-of-the-art rapid diagnostic system for the detection of foodborne pathogens such as E. coli, Listeria, and Salmonella, helping food processors and companies protect consumers from foodborne illness. The company operates as a hardware and laboratory diagnostics business; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company for API-surface discovery and is re-evaluated on each enrichment run.

providers.name: Spencer Health Solutions
providers.description: Spencer Health Solutions is a Morrisville, North Carolina medical device and digital health company behind spencer®, an in-home smart medication dispenser that combines automated multi-dose dispensing from pharmacy-prepared refills with telehealth, patient surveys and connected Bluetooth biometric devices. The spencer platform pairs the countertop device with spencerAssist®, a mobile app for patients and caregivers, and spencerCare™, a web portal that lets healthcare professionals run real-time alerts, telehealth visits and longitudinal real-world data collection. The company sells into three markets — care management for home care and senior living, patient support programs for pharmaceutical manufacturers, and decentralized clinical trials, where the spencer SmartHub™ serves as the in-home trial partner — and reports a 97% medication adherence rate across more than 5,800 patients in the United States, Canada and Europe. Spencer Health Solutions publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract; the platform is delivered as a managed device and portal offering through direct commercial and partner agreements, including a 2025 partnership with PharMerica.

providers.name: Sygaldry
providers.description: Sygaldry Technologies builds quantum-accelerated AI servers — augmenting classical data-center infrastructure with quantum processors purpose-built for AI to deliver exponential speedups on specific training and inference tasks. Founded in 2024 in Ann Arbor, Michigan by Chad Rigetti (founder of Rigetti Computing), Idalia Friedson, and Michael Keiser, the company combines multiple qubit types within a single fault-tolerant architecture to accelerate model training, fine-tuning, and token generation while cutting compute cost and energy use. A Y Combinator Spring 2025 company, Sygaldry has raised $139M ($34M seed led by Initialized Capital and a $105M Series A led by Breakthrough Energy Ventures, with Bloomberg Beta among its investors). Sygaldry currently publishes no public developer API; this profile is maintained for API Evangelist network discovery.

providers.name: Taiyaki Studios
providers.description: Taiyaki Studios is a Tokyo-based startup working to redefine how anime is consumed, delivering stories that are immediate, engaging, and satisfying. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Polychain Capital in the DeFi/NFT (web3) sector, the studio pairs anime content production with web3 and AI technology and creator-community building. As of this enrichment pass Taiyaki Studios publishes only a marketing website (taiyakistudios.com) and a contact email; it exposes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Tammwel
providers.description: Tammwel (Tamawal) is a Saudi Arabian digital financing intermediary that connects consumers with licensed financial institutions to compare and obtain Sharia-compliant financing. Its consumer platform and iOS/Android apps let users apply once and receive multiple offers across four products - personal loans, credit cards, auto financing, and mortgage financing (each up to 150,000 SAR) - emphasizing transparent pricing with no hidden fees. The company is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Tammwel publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDK, or /.well-known discovery surface; this profile captures its identity and infrastructure security posture.

providers.name: Team Wildfire
providers.description: Team Wildfire develops jet engine-enabled fire suppression technology built to prevent catastrophic wildfire losses. Its mobile units, the "Hurricane" and "Storm Cell", apply fire retardant at scale to deny ground to advancing wildfires. The company offers fireground services, evacuation route hardening, asset protection, prescribed fire containment, and military base protection. Team Wildfire is a physical hardware and services company backed by Techstars; it publishes a marketing and services website but no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or developer documentation. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio lead and enriched with the identity and domain-security signals available for a non-API company.

providers.name: Twinn Health
providers.description: Twinn Health builds preventive whole-body MRI infrastructure for early disease detection, pairing AI-structured imaging reports and longitudinal health data pipelines with imaging providers and wellness clinics in the UK, Saudi Arabia, and the wider Middle East. Founded at Imperial College London, validated with UK-based NHS clinicians, and backed by 500 Global and Wa'ed Ventures, it also offers expert MRI report interpretation for individuals. Twinn Health publishes no public API or developer surface as of July 2026.

providers.name: uncommonbio
providers.description: Uncommon (uncommonbio.co, formerly Higher Steaks) is a Cambridge, UK biotechnology company backed by Balderton Capital. The company sold its cultivated meat platform to Vow and has pivoted to launch SymphoRNA, a new venture developing nucleic acid delivery technology for multi-RNA combination medicines that target complex diseases such as fibrosis, heart failure, and neurodegeneration. As a life-sciences research and platform company, Uncommon publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API specification. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of Balderton Capital and enriched via the local enrichment pipeline, which confirmed the absence of an API surface while capturing live domain-security posture.

providers.name: Unigrid
providers.description: UNIGRID Inc. is a San Diego-based sodium-ion battery company founded in 2021 out of UC San Diego Ph.D. research by Dr. Darren H. S. Tan and Dr. Erik A. Wu. Its sodium chromium oxide (NCO) chemistry and alloy anode technology deliver fire-safe, fully passive batteries rated for 30,000+ cycles and -40C to 60C operation, sold as 12V starter batteries (Na+ Fleet), BMS-less rack modules (Na+ Module), residential energy storage (Na+ Casa), and DC rack systems for commercial, industrial, and data center use (Na+ Cleo). Cells are UN38.3 and UL 9540A certified. Backed by Transition VC, Ritz Venture Capital, Union Square Ventures, and Foothill Ventures via an oversubscribed $12M Series A (2024); shipped its first sodium-ion residential batteries in July 2026. UNIGRID publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: Vistel
providers.description: Vistel (Beijing Zhiyuan Huitu Technology, 致远慧图) is a Beijing-based medical AI company founded in 2016 that applies computer vision and deep learning to ophthalmology. Its NMPA Class III and EU CE certified software analyzes fundus images to screen for diabetic retinopathy, glaucoma, and age-related macular degeneration, paired with its RC350 and RX350 fundus cameras and VS550 vision screener, plus telemedicine and image management systems. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners, Cyberport Hong Kong, and Redhill Capital. Vistel publishes no public developer portal or API surface.

providers.name: vivino
providers.description: Vivino is the world's largest online wine marketplace and wine-discovery mobile app, founded in 2010 in Copenhagen, Denmark by Heini Zachariassen and Theis Sondergaard. Users scan a wine label to get community ratings, reviews, and tasting notes drawn from a database of more than 15 million wines and tens of millions of members, and can buy wine directly through the integrated marketplace. As of an enrichment pass on 2026-07-21, Vivino does not publish an official public API or developer portal (the former developer.vivino.com subdomain 301-redirects to the main site), so this profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Volta
providers.description: Volta is an experiential technology company that turns passive audiences into active participants in live events, retail spaces, and out-of-home advertising. Its Dynamic Experience Engine, powered by the VoltaConnect backend, lets attendees control stage visuals, brand content, and public displays directly from their smartphones, creating audio-reactive, audience-driven activations for concerts, brand experiences, museum exhibitions, and retail environments. Volta is a Techstars-backed company; as of this profile it publishes a marketing site (hosted on Squarespace) with no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or other machine-readable API surface, so this entry is limited to verified identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: VR Medical
providers.description: VR Medical (Kunshan Weirui Medical Technology Co., Ltd.) is a medical device company founded in 2009 that designs, develops, and manufactures devices for respiratory care, critical care, and wound care, operating an FDA-registered, ISO 13485 certified plant in Kunshan, China. Qiming Venture Partners led its Series A in February 2016. The company publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: Wolverine World Wide
providers.description: Wolverine World Wide is a leading designer, manufacturer, and marketer of branded footwear, apparel, and accessories. Brands include Merrell, Saucony, Wolverine, Sperry, Sweaty Betty, and Hush Puppies. The company operates global wholesale, direct-to-consumer, and digital commerce channels. Wolverine World Wide does not currently expose a public developer API.

providers.name: Wuxi Vision Pro
providers.description: Wuxi Vision Pro Co., Ltd. (无锡蕾明视康科技有限公司, "蕾明视康"), founded in 2010, is a Chinese ophthalmic medical device company that develops, manufactures, and sells intraocular lenses (IOLs) and other high-end ophthalmic consumables, focused on foldable IOL R&D and domestic substitution of imported lenses. Headquartered in Wuxi with a Shanghai branch, and backed by Qiming Venture Partners. No public API or developer surface was found.

providers.name: Zions Bancorporation
providers.description: Zions Bancorporation, National Association is a nationally chartered bank and bank holding company headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, with roughly $87 billion in total assets. It is a super-regional operating a single national bank charter across seven regional divisional brands - Zions Bank, Amegy Bank, California Bank & Trust, National Bank of Arizona, Nevada State Bank, Vectra Bank Colorado, and The Commerce Bank of Washington - serving consumers, small business, and commercial/treasury clients across the Western United States. On the open-finance front Zions runs NO public first-party developer API portal: developer.zionsbank.com and api.zionsbank.com do not resolve, and its business digital-banking surface (Treasury Internet Banking at treasurygateway.zionsbank.com) is credential-gated with no published API reference or downloadable OpenAPI. As a large depository institution it is subject to the CFPB Section 1033 Personal Financial Data Rights rule, but Zions has not published a first-party data-access API or a documented FDX-conformant endpoint; consumer-permissioned data sharing in practice reaches Zions through third-party aggregators (Plaid/MX/Finicity/Akoya) rather than a first-party API surface.

providers.name: 3S robotics
providers.description: 3S robotics (Shanghai Shengshi Weisheng Technology Co., Ltd. / 上海昇视唯盛科技有限公司) is a Chinese intelligent-robotics manufacturer founded in 2020 and headquartered in the Songjiang district of Shanghai, with a smart factory in the Haining Economic Development Zone, Zhejiang. It is a member company of the listed Harbin Institute of Technology intelligent-robotics group (哈工智能), and its majority-held subsidiary Hagong Hyundai (哈工现代, HGXD) builds general-purpose industrial robots. The company develops an in-house "AI + 3D + ROBOT" stack — machine-vision cameras, motion control, and offline path-planning software — packaged as task-specific intelligent robots for welding, grinding and assembly, marketed as needing no teach-pendant programming. Its flagship line is a 3D-vision intelligent welding robot aimed at steel-structure, tunnel arch, rail-transit and heavy-equipment fabrication. The software it ships is embedded machine-side control and vision tooling sold with the hardware; the company publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable interface contract.

providers.name: 42 Floors
providers.description: 42Floors was a Y Combinator- and 500 Global-backed commercial real estate search platform founded in 2011 by Jason Freedman to make it easy to discover and lease office, coworking, retail, industrial, and warehouse space across top U.S. markets. It aggregated a large listings database (the "42Floors MLS") that brokers and tenants searched online. The company was acquired by Knotel in 2018, and the 42floors.com domain and listings service were later taken over by Yardi, which folded them into CommercialCafe — 42floors.com now redirects there. The only surviving developer surface is the first-party `mls` RubyGem, a client for the (now-decommissioned) 42Floors MLS API at mls.42floors.com.

providers.name: Adaps Photonics
providers.description: Adaps Photonics (Shenzhen Adaps Photonics Technology Co., Ltd. / 灵明光子) is a fabless semiconductor company founded in May 2018 in the Nanshan district of Shenzhen, China, with R&D centers in Shanghai and Zhejiang. It designs single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) based direct time-of-flight (dToF) 3D depth-sensing chips and modules — silicon photomultipliers (SiPM), 3D-stacked SPAD arrays hybrid-bonded to custom DSP dies, and all-in-one integrated dToF depth sensors — for smartphones, automotive LiDAR, AR/VR headsets, robotics, smart home and industrial IoT. The company sells silicon and sensor modules to device makers through a direct sales motion; it publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable interface contract.

providers.name: AICE
providers.description: AICE is a defense-technology company building the next generation of underwater defense systems: autonomous swarms of modular marine drones that secure naval assets and coastal infrastructure against evolving underwater threats. Founded in 2026 by former NASA engineer Gregoire Chomette and European Robotics Champion Remi Bouteiller, the company is part of the Y Combinator Spring 2026 batch, is based in the San Francisco Bay Area with hardware manufactured in France, and applies swarm robotics and AI to surveillance, detection, and protection of critical subsea infrastructure. AICE currently ships hardware and does not publish a public API, SDK, or developer platform; this profile tracks the company for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Algorized
providers.description: Algorized develops edge-native nervous system technologies for physical AI, creating sensing and perception solutions that protect life by detecting human presence, tracking, positioning, and vital signs even through obstacles. Their sustainable, unobtrusive edge‑AI models integrate seamlessly with people, places, and sensors across robotics, industrial, and safety applications, aiming to reduce risk and enhance wellbeing.

providers.name: AmiiboAPI
providers.description: Nintendo Amiibo Information

providers.name: Andrenam
providers.description: Andrenam is a defense technology company building an AI-powered maritime sensing network for undersea surveillance. It develops mass-manufacturable, low-cost buoy-based autonomous sonar systems that deploy from manned and unmanned vessels to detect, track, and identify real-time maritime traffic using cloud and edge AI, then dispatch resources to priority areas. Its product line spans deployment, AI-enhanced detection, and integration with naval command-and-control systems, targeting government and military maritime-domain-awareness customers. No public API, developer portal, or documentation surface is currently published.

providers.name: AnimeFacts
providers.description: Anime Facts (over 100+)

providers.name: Apoteket
providers.description: Apoteket is Sweden’s leading pharmacy retailer, operating a nationwide chain of pharmacies and an extensive online store. Founded in 1971, it is a state‑owned enterprise that provides prescription medicines, over‑the‑counter products, health advice, and digital services such as e‑prescriptions and home delivery. The company reinvests profits into public health, education, and social care, reflecting its public‑service mission. Apoteket’s digital platforms offer APIs for product catalogs, order management, and customer accounts, supporting integration with healthcare providers and third‑party services.

providers.name: Aqrose Technology
providers.description: Aqrose Technology (阿丘科技) is an industrial AI machine-vision platform provider founded in Beijing in 2017 out of the Tsinghua University AI Lab, now dual-headquartered in Beijing and Singapore with offices in Suzhou, Shenzhen, Hsinchu, Berlin, Tokyo, and Seoul. The company builds AI tools, models, and turnkey systems for manufacturing quality control, safety inspection, and process optimization, with 20,000+ AI deployments across 1,200+ clients in 50+ industrial sectors. Its product line spans the AIDI defect-inspection platform, the AQVision low-code AI vision development toolkit, the AIDG toolkit, the SV2000 smart vision hardware, an AI Review System (ARS), a robot inspection system, and the AQ-VLM industrial vision-language model, serving EV batteries, automotive, semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, electronics, photovoltaics, food and beverage, and packaging. Surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Arcticherocore
providers.description: Arcticherocore is a stub company identified in the API Evangelist secondary-market harvest. It currently lacks a publicly accessible website or detailed public information. The company appears in equity and investment listings but its own domain does not resolve, and no official API documentation or developer portal is discoverable. This entry serves as a placeholder for future enrichment as more data becomes available.

providers.name: Audio Up Media
providers.description: Audio Up Media is a Los Angeles based podcast studio, music company and audio entertainment network founded in 2020 by Jared Gutstadt, the founder of Jingle Punks. The company develops and produces scripted and unscripted audio series, original music IP and branded audio campaigns, and adapts that intellectual property into television, film and live formats. Its catalog includes scripted titles such as Strawberry Spring, Make It Up As We Go, Where the Bodies Are Buried and Maejor Frequency, alongside branded case-study work for consumer brands. Audio Up is a content studio rather than a software platform: it publishes a marketing site and distributes its shows through third-party podcast platforms, and does not operate a developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable specification of its own.

providers.name: Avago Technologies
providers.description: Avago Technologies Limited was the Singapore-headquartered semiconductor company spun out of Agilent Technologies' semiconductor products group in 2005 that acquired Broadcom Corporation for $37 billion on February 1, 2016 and renamed itself Broadcom Limited, today Broadcom Inc. (NASDAQ: AVGO). Avago is therefore not a subsidiary of Broadcom but its legal predecessor and former corporate name. The brand is retired: every path on avagotech.com returns an HTTP 301 to broadcom.com, avago.com is a third-party domain-brokerage landing page rather than a company site, and no Avago-branded developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, SDK, package or GitHub organization exists. API surfaces once associated with Avago product lines (LSI and Emulex storage controllers, fiber optics, RF) are published today by Broadcom and are profiled under the broadcom record.

providers.name: Biodesignlab
providers.description: Bio Design Lab is a biotechnology and bioengineering company based in Seoul, South Korea. It creates and develops highly potent biopharmaceuticals using synthetic biology and systems-level genetic and genomic designs. The firm focuses on advancing retroviral and lentiviral vector platforms for cell and gene therapies, offering vector packaging services and innovative platform solutions. Its mission is to design and construct gene and cell therapy drugs and immunotherapies, delivering novel therapeutic technologies.

providers.name: Bioengine
providers.description: Bioengine (Shanghai BioEngine Sci-Tech Co., Ltd.) is a China‑based provider of serum‑free cell culture media and bioprocess services. With over 30 years of experience, it offers custom media solutions for antibodies, vaccines, and cell‑ and gene‑therapy production, serving global biopharma partners from its GMP‑certified manufacturing facility.

providers.name: Biofire
providers.description: Biofire manufactures handcrafted ceramic storage stoves and fireplaces in Germany, offering custom designs and high-quality heating solutions. With over 40 years of experience, the company provides personalized service, from planning to on‑site installation, emphasizing durability, efficiency, and timeless design. Their product range includes various stove models, accessories, and consulting services for optimal home heating.

providers.name: Bioheng
providers.description: Bioheng, operating under the brand Imviva, is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing allogeneic CAR‑T cell therapies for oncology and autoimmune diseases. The company aims to create scalable, off‑the‑shelf cell therapies to broaden patient access and advance regenerative medicine.

providers.name: Bionoxx
providers.description: Bionoxx is a biotechnology company focused on developing innovative solutions in the field of molecular diagnostics and bioinformatics. The company aims to provide advanced data-driven tools for researchers and clinicians, leveraging cutting‑edge technologies to improve health outcomes. This stub was initially added to the API Evangelist network from secondary‑market sources and is being enriched through the full profiling pipeline.

providers.name: Blossomenergy
providers.description: Blossomenergy is a private renewable energy startup listed on secondary‑market platforms such as EquityZen. Public information about the company is limited; attempts to locate an official website or detailed corporate branding have been unsuccessful. The company appears in investment listings but its own domain, documentation, or API endpoints are not publicly discoverable. This entry serves as a placeholder for future enrichment when more concrete data becomes available.

providers.name: Blue Ocean Barns
providers.description: Blue Ocean Barns develops Brominata®, a patented seaweed-based feed supplement that dramatically reduces methane emissions from cattle, improving energy conversion and profitability for farmers. By leveraging Asparagopsis taxiformis, the product can cut enteric methane by up to 80%, contributing to climate-smart agriculture and offering a sustainable solution for the livestock industry.

providers.name: Blueshockrace
providers.description: Blueshockrace is a stub entry in the API Evangelist catalog, originating from a secondary-market harvest. The company appears to be a placeholder with no publicly available website or detailed information. This entry awaits further discovery of its official domain, documentation, and API specifications as the profiling process continues.

providers.name: Borqs
providers.description: Borqs Technologies Inc. is a global Internet of Things (IoT) platform solution provider delivering customizable, differentiated and scalable smart-connected IoT software, hardware and cloud-service platforms. Founded in 2007, Borqs is a Google-licensed Android and Android Wear partner with R&D centers in the U.S., India and China, and debuted publicly on Nasdaq (BRQS) in August 2017. Its BorqsWare platform powers smartphones, tablets, wearables, in-vehicle infotainment (IVI), M2M and smart-appliance solutions, and in 2021 it expanded into solar and energy storage systems (ESS) via its Holu Hou Energy acquisition. Borqs is now a Sasken Group company. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal is published; this profile carries company identity and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Boson Motors
providers.description: Boson Motors is an electric vehicle and robotics company founded in 2017, building a modular electric off-road utility vehicle (UTV) platform for agriculture, farm automation, and work applications. Its flagship LX40 is a user-serviceable, low-maintenance electric 4WD UTV that charges from a standard 110v outlet and accepts interchangeable work modules for spraying, hauling, and crew transport. The company operates engineering and production out of Tada, Andhra Pradesh, India, with a strategic base in Fremont, California, and maintains a robotics arm (Boson Robotics) focused on autonomous and agricultural automation. Boson Motors is a Techstars-backed portfolio company. As of this profile it publishes a consumer marketing and reservation site with no public developer program, API, SDK, or developer documentation; its public engineering footprint is a GitHub organization of ROS/robotics libraries. This profile is maintained as an API Evangelist network lead and enrichment target.

providers.name: Boyd Gaming
providers.description: Boyd Gaming is a multi-jurisdictional casino entertainment company that owns and operates 28+ gaming properties across 10 U.S. states. The company offers casino gaming, hotel accommodations, dining, entertainment, and sports betting through its Boyd Sports platform. Boyd Rewards is the company's loyalty program spanning all properties, accessible via web portal and mobile app.

providers.name: BrainsGate
providers.description: BrainsGate is a medical device company focused on developing innovative therapies for central nervous system (CNS) diseases. Their platform technology uses electrical stimulation of the Spheno‑Palatine Ganglion (SPG) to increase cerebral blood flow, targeting applications such as acute ischemic stroke and chronic vascular dementia. The company is based in Israel and aims to bring novel neuro‑stimulation treatments to patients worldwide.

providers.name: Brazilian Vehicles and Prices
providers.description: Vehicles information from Fundação Instituto de Pesquisas Econômicas - Fipe

providers.name: Breathe Technologies
providers.description: Breathe Technologies, Inc. is a California-based medical device company that develops wearable and continuous ventilation systems for patients with chronic respiratory insufficiency and neuromuscular disease. Its flagship Life2000 Ventilation System is an FDA-cleared, ultra-lightweight ventilator that adapts from a stationary compressor to a wearable device, supporting both acute and chronic respiratory failure in home and institutional settings. Breathe Technologies is a Kleiner Perkins portfolio company and is now part of the Hillrom family (acquired by Baxter), with the Life2000 system distributed under Baxter respiratory care. This is a hardware medical device manufacturer with no public developer, API, or programmatic integration surface.

providers.name: Brown-Forman
providers.description: Brown-Forman Corporation is one of the largest American-owned spirits and wine companies in the world, established in 1870 and headquartered in Louisville, Kentucky. The company produces, bottles, imports, exports, markets, and sells a wide variety of alcoholic beverages under brands including Jack Daniel's, Woodford Reserve, Old Forester, Herradura, El Jimador, Slane Irish Whiskey, Benriach, Chambord, Diplomático, and Ford's Gin. Brown-Forman is traded on the NYSE under tickers BF.A and BF.B.

providers.name: Cakap
providers.description: Cakap is an Indonesian ed‑tech platform offering online language learning courses, corporate training, and AI‑driven workflow automation. It provides a mobile app and web portal for English, Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, and other languages, serving students, professionals, and enterprises across Southeast Asia.

providers.name: Castlery
providers.description: Castlery is an online modern furniture retailer offering a curated selection of sofas, tables, chairs, beds, and home accessories. The company operates globally with localized storefronts for the United States, Singapore, Australia, Canada, and the United Kingdom, providing free shipping on qualifying orders and a range of design collaborations. Their website showcases product catalogs, design inspiration, and services such as interior styling and customization.

providers.name: Cat Facts
providers.description: Daily cat facts

providers.name: Cencora
providers.description: Cencora (formerly AmerisourceBergen, renamed August 2023) is a leading global pharmaceutical solutions organization that connects manufacturers, providers, pharmacies, and patients across the healthcare supply chain. Cencora operates an Axway-based central EDI platform exchanging over 800,000 EDI messages daily with more than 23,000 trading partners and a Cell and Gene Therapy (CGT) Integration Hub for real-time data exchange with biopharma and provider platforms. No public developer API portal has been identified.

providers.name: Cerrion
providers.description: Cerrion builds enterprise-grade video AI agents for manufacturing. Its platform connects to existing or provided factory cameras to monitor production lines in real time, using pre-trained visual triggers to automatically detect and respond to quality defects, safety hazards, process deviations, and equipment issues. The closed-loop system can slow or stop machines, raise alarms, and escalate alerts while giving operators root-cause insight, helping manufacturers resolve problems up to 50% faster and cut downtime and scrap. Cerrion is deployed in live production across glass, food & beverage, tableware, sawmilling/timber, and CPG environments (customers include Unilever, Riedel, Schott Zwiesel, Stölzle Lausitz, Sisecam, and Verallia). Zurich-based and backed by Creandum, Y Combinator, Goat Capital, 10x Founders, and Session VC. No public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Channelcorp
providers.description: Channelcorp is a global leader in channel economics, partner finance, and channel growth consulting. Founded in 1989 and based in Vancouver, Canada, it provides strategic education, in‑house executive training, and public workshops across 29 countries, helping technology vendors and partners improve performance and revenue.

providers.name: Chaodechuangtechnology
providers.description: Chaodechuangtechnology (成都超德创科技有限公司) is a Chinese high‑tech enterprise founded in 2020, specializing in the design, development, production and sales of electromagnetic and permanent‑magnet braking systems, servo motor brakes, and related motion‑control components. The company serves industrial sectors such as CNC machinery, robotics, automation equipment, wind power, aerospace and new energy, with certifications including ISO‑9001, ISO‑14001, IATF‑16949, UL, CE, RoHS and REACH. It exports products to Germany, Italy, Turkey, South Korea and other overseas markets.

providers.name: CleanCo
providers.description: CleanCo is a United Kingdom-based beverage company, founded in 2019 by Spencer Matthews, that produces premium low- and no-alcohol alternative spirits. Its product line replicates the flavour profiles of traditional spirits across key categories, including CleanGin, CleanRum, CleanVodka and CleanTequila, aimed at consumers who want to reduce alcohol consumption without sacrificing taste. The company sells direct-to-consumer through cleanliquor.com and through grocery and hospitality retail channels across the UK and international markets. CleanCo raised venture funding from Lightspeed Venture Partners in 2020. It is a consumer packaged-goods brand and does not publish a developer API, developer portal, or any machine-readable API surface; it is retained in the API Evangelist network only as an identified Lightspeed portfolio company, not as an API provider.

providers.name: Clinova
providers.description: Clinova is a healthcare technology company focused on delivering innovative digital solutions for clinical data management and patient engagement. The firm provides a platform that integrates electronic health records, telemedicine services, and analytics tools to improve care coordination and outcomes. Founded to address gaps in interoperability, Clinova aims to streamline workflows for providers and empower patients with secure access to their health information.

providers.name: Clutch Canada
providers.description: Clutch is a Toronto-headquartered, vertically integrated online used-car retailer serving Canadian drivers. Unlike marketplace models that broker to third-party dealers, Clutch owns its own inventory and runs an end-to-end e-commerce purchase flow at clutch.ca: browsing reconditioned pre-owned vehicles, auto financing and a loan calculator, trade-in and sell-my-car offers, protection plans, insurance, and home delivery, backed by a 10-day money-back guarantee. It operates across Ontario, Nova Scotia, New Brunswick and Prince Edward Island. Clutch is a consumer retail business rather than an API vendor: its software is shipped as an end-user web application, and it publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Comfort Systems USA
providers.description: Comfort Systems USA (NYSE: FIX) is a Houston-based mechanical, electrical and plumbing contractor — one of the largest in the United States — that installs, services and maintains HVAC, piping, electrical and building-automation systems for commercial, industrial and institutional buildings through more than 45 operating companies in over 170 locations. Its business lines are construction (engineering and design, prefabrication, virtual construction), modular and off-site construction, building services (maintenance, on-demand and retrofit) and building automation (controls, monitoring, security and energy management). The company publishes no public API, developer program, SDK or machine-readable contract; its web presence is a WordPress marketing site and an investor-relations site.

providers.name: Connecthomes
providers.description: Connect Homes offers modern, sustainable, prefab houses built for smarter, greener living in Connecticut and beyond. The company provides a platform for ordering, customizing, and financing eco‑friendly modular homes, with an API for accessing product catalogs, pricing, and order management.

providers.name: Coreel
providers.description: CoreEL Technologies (India) Private Limited, established in 1999, is a world‑class engineering and technology company offering high‑end electronic system‑level products and solutions for aerospace, defence, space and manufacturing sectors. The firm provides RF & microwave, hardware‑mixed‑signal, SoC/FPGA, software and mechanical engineering services, and operates globally from its Indian headquarters. It focuses on high‑end electronic system level products and solutions, serving aerospace and defence customers worldwide.

providers.name: Cortec
providers.description: Cortec Corporation provides advanced corrosion inhibition technologies, including VpCI® and MCI® solutions for packaging, metalworking, construction, electronics, oil & gas, and many other industries. Founded in 1977, Cortex has grown to a global leader with over 400 products and 60+ patents, offering environmentally responsible, cost‑effective corrosion control. The company operates worldwide, serving customers with R&D, ISO‑accredited labs, and extensive technical support.

providers.name: Cosmic Robotics
providers.description: Cosmic Robotics, Inc. designs and operates autonomous construction equipment that takes on the hardest, most dangerous jobs on a construction site, coordinated as a fleet by a single software layer. Its first market is utility-scale solar energy, with expansion planned into data center construction. The flagship Cosmic-1A is a purpose-built robotic platform for solar panel installation, and Constellation is the coordination and control layer that plans, dispatches, and monitors the robot fleet across a jobsite. Founded in 2023 and based in the Dogpatch neighborhood of San Francisco, the company is backed by Y Combinator. Cosmic Robotics is currently a hardware and fleet-software company with no public developer API; this profile tracks its identity and any agent-facing surfaces (such as its published llms.txt) as the API Evangelist network enrichment pipeline monitors it for a future API.

providers.name: Culinary Sciences
providers.description: Culinary Sciences develops patented rapid-chill and food‑treatment technology for high‑volume food production. Their PrecisionVac platform combines rapid cooling and flavor infusion, delivering up to 5× faster cooling, 25× faster treatment, and significant energy savings. Based in the USA, they serve commercial kitchens and food processors with multi‑capability systems.

providers.name: Datalogue
providers.description: Datalogue was a self-service data integration and preparation startup founded in 2015 that used machine learning to automatically classify, transform, and standardize data from disparate sources for analytics teams. Backed by Bloomberg Beta, the company was acquired by Nike in February 2019 and its standalone product was discontinued; the datalogue.io domain now serves an unrelated blog. This profile is retained for the API Evangelist network as a historical/portfolio record. The only surviving first-party developer artifacts are the company's public GitHub organization and an unmaintained Python SDK ("datalogue") still published on PyPI.

providers.name: DataSift (MediaSift Inc.)
providers.description: DataSift (MediaSift Inc.) was a pioneering social data platform that provided real-time and historical access to social media firehoses (Twitter, Facebook Topic Data, and more) through its CSDL filtering language and its Push, Historics, and Managed Sources REST APIs. Founded in 2007 and backed by Insight Partners and others, the company was acquired by Meltwater in 2019; the datasift.com domain now redirects to meltwater.com and the standalone DataSift developer platform and APIs have been discontinued. Official first-party client SDKs for Python, Ruby, PHP, Java, and Node.js remain published on public package registries under the datasift GitHub organization as historical artifacts.

providers.name: Deci AI
providers.description: Deci AI was a deep-learning development company (founded 2019, Tel Aviv) whose platform helped teams build, optimize, and deploy computer-vision and NLP models in production. Its stack combined the AutoNAC neural-architecture-search engine, the Infery inference runtime, and the open-source SuperGradients PyTorch training library — the home of the YOLO-NAS object-detection architecture. Deci was acquired by NVIDIA in 2024; deci.ai now redirects to NVIDIA and there is no live standalone hosted API or developer console. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's surviving first-party open-source software surface (SuperGradients and DataGradients on PyPI, published from the Deci-AI GitHub org).

providers.name: Destiny The Game
providers.description: Bungie Platform API

providers.name: Dida
providers.description: DidaTravel (道旅科技, Shenzhen Dida Travel Technology Co., Ltd.) is a technology-driven global travel distribution company. It operates an open platform that connects travel buyers and suppliers, providing flexible connectivity solutions across hotels, flights, airport transfers, and attraction tickets. Headquartered in Shenzhen, China, DidaTravel serves online travel agencies, tour operators, and other travel businesses worldwide with aggregated hotel content, dynamic rates, and booking delivered through its B2B distribution technology. The company positions itself as a global technology leader in travel product connectivity and is backed by investors including IDG Capital.

providers.name: Discovery Communications
providers.description: Discovery Communications was a global media company providing original and purchased programming across multiple distribution platforms before merging with WarnerMedia in 2022 to form Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD), a leading global media and entertainment company whose portfolio spans HBO Max, Discovery Channel, CNN, Warner Bros. film studios, DC, Food Network, HGTV, and other television, film, and streaming brands. No public developer APIs are documented at the corporate level; technical and partnership inquiries are handled at the individual brand or business-unit level.

providers.name: DISH Network
providers.description: DISH Network is a U.S. television provider offering satellite and streaming TV services, as well as wireless services through its Boost Mobile and DISH Wireless brands. DISH is now part of EchoStar following the 2024 merger that brought DISH and Hughes back together under one parent. No public consumer-facing developer APIs are documented; the Boost Mobile and DISH Wireless networks are operated on a 5G Open RAN architecture.
