Elion closed an $81 million Series B in June 2024 led by Deerfield Management and the AMR Action Fund, with participation from Illinois Ventures. Elion is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, public API, or machine-readable API contract, and this profile records that absence rather than any API surface.

providers.name: Eltek
providers.description: Eltek is a Norwegian power-electronics and telecom power-systems manufacturer (DC power rectifiers, industrial and telecom energy systems, the Flatpack product family) now operating as part of Delta Electronics. Its primary domain eltek.com 301-redirects to Delta's standard telecom power solutions catalog (www.delta-emea.com). This is a physical-hardware brand: no independent developer portal, public API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or well-known discovery surface was found. Surfaced as a portfolio-lead stub via the sierra-ventures VC pipeline; profile retained for domain-security signal and future re-check.

providers.name: ENGIE Insight Services
providers.description: ENGIE Insight Services (formerly Ecova, now operating as ENGIE Impact) is a sustainability and resource-management company that helps corporations, cities, and governments reduce their environmental footprint and operating costs. It provides energy, water, and waste expense management, utility bill auditing and payment, data management, sustainability consulting, and decarbonization strategy across a large portfolio of client sites. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network, this profile has been enriched with domain-security and discovery probes; the company publishes no public developer API surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Europass
providers.description: EuroPass is a Paris-based digital agency founded in 2016 that specializes in Chinese outbound tourism, describing itself as the European leader in implementing Chinese digital solutions for destinations, retailers, transportation, attractions, and hospitality brands. Its services span Chinese social-media management (notably WeChat and Weibo), WeChat mini-programs and stores, e-commerce, digital ticketing, destination marketing, and mobile payment acceptance via WeChat Pay and Alipay so European businesses can serve and transact with Chinese travelers. EuroPass operates as a services and marketing company rather than a developer platform: it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or technical documentation. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and enriched with the identity and domain-security data available from its public web presence.

providers.name: Form Energy
providers.description: Form Energy is a long-duration energy storage company headquartered in Somerville, Massachusetts and Weirton, West Virginia. Its flagship product is an iron-air battery designed to store electricity for up to 100 hours, intended to enable utilities and grid operators to firm renewable generation across multi-day weather events, replace aging fossil-fueled peakers, and defer transmission and distribution upgrades. The company manufactures its battery at Form Factory 1, a 550,000-square-foot facility built on the former Weirton Steel mill site that employs roughly 400 people. Form Energy also publishes Formware, a grid-modeling software suite used by utilities to plan resource portfolios that include multi-day storage. Notable customers and partners include Georgia Power, Xcel Energy, Great River Energy, Dominion Energy, PG&E, New York Power Authority, and Crusoe Energy (a 12 GWh agreement to firm power for AI data centers). Form Energy does not currently publish a public developer API or SDK; engagement is through utility sales, partnership, and policy channels.

providers.name: Fun Fact
providers.description: A simple HTTPS api that can randomly select and return a fact from the FFA database

providers.name: GCL
providers.description: GCL System Integration Technology Co., Ltd. (GCL SI, Shenzhen: 002506) is one of the four listed companies of China's GCL Group and a global leading provider of photovoltaic and clean-energy solutions. Headquartered in Suzhou Industrial Park, Jiangsu Province, the company manufactures high-efficiency solar cells, large-size photovoltaic modules, energy-storage systems, and next-generation perovskite solar technology, with operations spanning six continents. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Balderton Capital and added to the API Evangelist network; GCL SI is an industrial manufacturer and publishes no public developer/API surface at this time.

providers.name: Genesis Therapeutics
providers.description: Genesis Therapeutics (Genesis Molecular AI) is an AI-focused biotechnology company building GEMS (Genesis Exploration of Molecular Space), a generative and predictive AI operating system for small-molecule drug discovery. GEMS combines structure-based deep learning, language and diffusion models, and physics-based simulation (molecular dynamics and quantum chemistry) to generate and optimize molecules for complex targets, accelerating hit identification through lead optimization and candidate selection. In 2025 the company introduced Pearl, a next-generation foundation model for drug discovery. Headquartered in Burlingame, California with a laboratory in San Diego, Genesis has raised over $300M and partners with Eli Lilly, Gilead, Genentech, and Incyte while advancing its own therapeutic pipeline. It is not a public API provider: GEMS is a proprietary internal platform with no published developer portal, documentation, or API.

providers.name: Hirak Exchange Rates
providers.description: Exchange rates between 162 currency & 300 crypto currency update each 5 min, accurate, no limits

providers.name: Hirak IP to Country
providers.description: Ip to location with country code, currency code & currency name, fast response, unlimited requests

providers.name: Hirak Translation
providers.description: Translate between 21 of most used languages, accurate, unlimited requests

providers.name: Human DX
providers.description: The Human Diagnosis Project (Human Dx) is a nonprofit initiative building an open, global medical intelligence system that combines the collective insight of physicians with machine learning to help make high-quality, affordable healthcare accessible to everyone. Its programs pair clinical microlearning and training tools for medical trainees with a specialist eConsult network that connects safety-net and underserved patients and their primary-care providers to volunteer specialists. The organization operates under the tagline "Rise together." Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Initial Therapeutics
providers.description: Initial Therapeutics, Inc. is a preclinical-stage biotechnology company in South San Francisco, California, discovering and developing a new class of small-molecule medicines designed to halt pathogenic protein formation in its earliest stages. Its proprietary STOPS platform — Selective Termination of Protein Synthesis — intercepts the translation of a target protein inside the exit tunnel of the ribosome, recognizing the nascent primary linear sequence rather than a fully folded three-dimensional structure, an approach the company positions as starkly differentiated from targeted protein degradation and from interventions that can only act on proteins after they are fully formed. The company launched publicly on May 1, 2023 with a $75 million Series A from Apple Tree Partners, was co-founded with academic scientists Jamie H. D. Cate (UC Berkeley), Brian Paegel (UC Irvine) and Kevan Shokat (UCSF/UC Berkeley), and builds on ribosome biochemistry, proteomics, medicinal chemistry, DNA-encoded library technology and chemical genetics, with early programs aimed at oncology targets long considered undruggable. Initial Therapeutics is a therapeutics discovery company, not a software vendor: it publishes a small marketing website and no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Java EE
providers.description: Java EE (Java Platform, Enterprise Edition) was a set of specifications extending the Java SE platform with enterprise features such as distributed computing and web services. In 2017 Oracle transferred Java EE to the Eclipse Foundation, where it was rebranded as Jakarta EE. Jakarta EE 11 continues the platform with profiles for Platform, Web, and Core covering RESTful Web Services, JSON Processing, Persistence, CDI, Servlet, Security, and other enterprise Java specifications.

providers.name: Jinsheng New Energy
providers.description: Guangdong Jinsheng New Energy Co., Ltd. (广东金晟新能源股份有限公司) is a Chinese lithium-battery recycling and materials company headquartered in Zhaoqing, Guangdong, founded in 2010 and originally focused on nickel sulfate production. It operates a closed-loop "urban mine" business: harmless treatment, echelon (second-life) use and hydrometallurgical regeneration of retired lithium-ion batteries into battery-grade nickel sulfate, cobalt sulfate, manganese sulfate and lithium carbonate, plus ternary and iron-phosphate precursors and LFP cathode material, and downstream cells for light mobility, commercial and industrial storage, outdoor power stations and solar street lighting. Production is split across Zhaoqing (Gaoyao) in Guangdong and Yichun/Ganzhou in Jiangxi through the wholly owned subsidiary Jiangxi Ruida New Energy Technology, with approved processing capacity of about 204,000 tonnes of spent lithium battery per year. Both the parent and Jiangxi Ruida appear on MIIT's echelon-use and regeneration white lists. The company completed a Series C, is a Hurun and Forbes unicorn-list member, and has pursued a public listing. It is an industrial materials manufacturer and publishes no developer program, API, or machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Krunch
providers.description: Krunch is an on-demand product studio that delivers product management, engineering, and marketing as a service, using AI and code to compress the build cycle for its clients. The team was accepted into the 500 Startup Accelerator program in Silicon Valley and markets prior engagements with Alibaba, Google, Camunda, New Relic, Polkadot, and Bowtie. Krunch operates as a services agency rather than an API provider - as of this enrichment pass it publishes a single-page marketing site with a Calendly booking link and no public developer portal, documentation, API reference, SDKs, or machine-readable API artifacts of any kind.

providers.name: Kyros College Prep
providers.description: Kyros (kyros.ai) is an AI-driven college preparation and admissions platform. In the company's own words, it is "a College Prep Platform by former Googlers, Admissions Officers, and Professors" that "uses AI to offer 100K+ summer and financial aid programs." The product combines student assessments for college and major fit, one-on-one counseling, college essay and letter-of-recommendation support, extracurricular and summer-program discovery, and structured program tracks such as Future You Lab, the UC Bootcamp, and industry immersion and research programs. Kyros also sells through partner channels, with education-partner, VAR, counselor-advisory, college-success, and Fortune 1000 employer offerings, and publishes a large admissions blog. As of 2026-07-19 Kyros publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API description.

providers.name: Lab0
providers.description: Lab0 (lab0.ai) is a San Francisco company in the Y Combinator Spring 2026 batch building an "AI forward-deployed engineer" for B2B SaaS: agentic systems that automate enterprise software implementation and post-sales delivery. The platform runs discovery, solution design, configuration, custom integration build, testing and go-live in parallel, with the stated goal of compressing 3-12 month deployment cycles down to weeks. Its connector agents profile a customer instance (tables, fields, auth model, processes) to produce a connector spec, then generate the integration, auth, field mappings, callbacks and write-back workflows as staged changes a human team reviews, with every write previewed as a controlled dry-run before it touches the customer instance. Named target systems are ServiceNow, SAP, Salesforce, Workday and Adobe AEM, plus custom APIs. As of this profile Lab0 is pre-launch as a developer platform: it publishes a marketing site and an llms.txt, but no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or self-serve sign-up. It is sold as a managed engagement via founder contact and demo booking.

providers.name: Lattice Engines
providers.description: Lattice Engines was a predictive marketing and AI-driven B2B customer data platform that applied machine learning to first-party CRM and marketing automation data combined with external firmographic, technographic, and intent signals in order to score accounts and leads, prioritize sales outreach, and power account-based marketing programs. The company was acquired by Dun & Bradstreet in 2019 and the product was rebranded D&B Lattice before being folded into the Dun & Bradstreet Rev.Up ABX go-to-market platform. Lattice Engines no longer operates as an independent brand and publishes no developer surface of its own: as of the 2026-07-19 enrichment probe, www.lattice-engines.com returns HTTP 301 to dnb.com, the apex domain returns HTTP 403, api.lattice-engines.com returns HTTP 404, and developer./docs. subdomains do not resolve. This profile is retained as a historical record; the live successor surface is documented in the api-evangelist dun-and-bradstreet repository.

providers.name: Li Industries
providers.description: Li Industries is a critical battery materials company developing next-generation lithium-ion battery recycling and closed-loop materials production technology. Its patented direct recycling process separates and purifies electrode components from spent lithium-ion batteries — including lithium iron phosphate (LFP) chemistries — to produce commercial-grade cathode active material without the environmental cost and poor economics of conventional smelting or hydrometallurgical routes. The company serves battery manufacturers, cathode producers, recyclers and battery collection operations, and in 2024 was selected for a $55 million U.S. Department of Energy award under the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law to advance closed-loop LFP recycling and manufacturing. Li Industries is headquartered in Pineville, North Carolina, with an engineering center in Charlotte, North Carolina and an R&D center in Blacksburg, Virginia. It is a materials and manufacturing company: it ships physical battery material, not software, and publishes no public API, SDK or developer program.

providers.name: Lori Systems
providers.description: Lori Systems is a Nairobi-headquartered, pan-African digital freight platform that matches cargo owners with vetted transporters to coordinate long-haul trucking across the continent. Founded in 2016 by Josh Sandler, Jean-Claude Homawoo, and Ernest Gichini Ngaruiya, the company is now led by CEO Uche Ogboi and runs operations from offices in Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda, moving cargo across roughly 12 African countries with a network of 20,000+ trucks and over $10B of cargo facilitated. The platform offers shippers instant rate estimates, load matching, real-time shipment tracking, electronic proof of delivery, and integrated payments, while giving transporters access to cargo orders, truck-availability management, and prompt payment on delivery. Lori operates a public rate-card tool at ratecard.lorisystems.com, but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or open OpenAPI specification; its GitHub organization is limited to small internal-tooling repositories (a Singer.io tap for Freshsales, a BambooHR Python client, a Kubernetes Terraform provider, and similar utilities) rather than a customer-facing API surface.

providers.name: Luminous Computing
providers.description: Luminous Computing (branded simply "Luminous") is a Mountain View, California silicon-photonics company founded in 2018 by Marcus Gomez (CEO), Mitchell Nahmias (CTO) and Michael Gao (chief strategist), building an optical AI supercomputer that replaces electrical interconnect with light to remove the data-movement bottleneck between compute and memory. The architecture derives from Nahmias' neuromorphic-photonics research at Princeton, and the company's stated goal is a photonics-based machine that delivers a step-function gain in AI training and inference throughput while simplifying the programming model. Luminous emerged from stealth in March 2022 with a $105M Series A backed by Bill Gates, Gigafund, 8090 Partners, Neo, Third Kind Venture Capital, Alumni Ventures, Strawberry Creek Ventures, Horsley Bridge and Modern Venture Partners, bringing total disclosed funding to roughly $123-126M across three rounds; silicon-photonics veteran Michael Hochberg (founder of Luxtera, acquired by Cisco, and Elenion, acquired by Nokia) joined as president of engineering and operations in 2023. Luminous is a semiconductor and systems company, not a software vendor - it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation, no SDK and no machine-readable API contract of any kind. Its public web presence is a single-page marketing site; as of August 2026 the company's own domain lmns.com returns a Squarespace "Website Expired" page while the underlying site remains reachable at the platform address luminous-co.squarespace.com, and lmns.com DNS is still actively operated (Google Workspace mail, plus Atlassian, Smartsheet and DocuSign domain verifications), indicating a lapsed marketing-site subscription rather than a wound-down company.

providers.name: ManTech International
providers.description: ManTech International is a Herndon, Virginia-based federal services contractor providing cybersecurity, data and AI, digital transformation, and intelligent engineering capabilities to U.S. defense, intelligence, and federal civilian agencies. Founded in 1968 and publicly traded on NASDAQ as MANT until 2022, the company was acquired by The Carlyle Group in April 2022 in an all-cash take-private transaction valued at approximately $4.2 billion and now operates as a Carlyle portfolio company. ManTech holds positions on major federal contract vehicles including Alliant 2/3, OASIS+, SeaPort NxG, CIO-SP3, T4NG, and ICON, and does not publish any developer-facing API or public OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Marianaminerals
providers.description: Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated critical-minerals company supplying the metals essential to modern energy, artificial intelligence, and defense technologies. The company currently develops copper and lithium production projects, with plans spanning cobalt, aluminum, graphite, uranium, and rare earth metals, and is headquartered in San Francisco with an engineering office in Houston. Backed by Khosla Ventures, it was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; an enrichment pass found no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Mashgin
providers.description: Mashgin builds an AI-powered, computer-vision self-checkout system that identifies multiple items simultaneously without barcodes, letting customers check out in seconds. Its touchless kiosks are deployed across 5,000+ locations including convenience stores, stadiums, arenas, universities, and healthcare facilities, and integrate with 50+ payment networks, POS systems, and loyalty programs. Mashgin does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; integrations are handled through direct partnerships and its support and knowledge-base channels. Backed by Matrix Partners, SUSA Ventures, and Y Combinator.

providers.name: MDU Resources Group
providers.description: MDU Resources Group is a diversified natural resources company with operations in regulated energy delivery, construction materials, and construction services. No public developer APIs are currently documented.

providers.name: Medra
providers.description: Medra builds an AI-powered robotic platform for autonomous laboratory work in the life sciences. Its "Physical AI Scientist" combines robotic hardware, computer vision, and scientific reasoning AI to design, execute, and continuously optimize experiments — gene editing, RNA/nucleic-acid work, antibody design, and cell-based assays — the way a human scientist would. Units are deployed at partner sites including Genentech and Addition Therapeutics, with a DARPA collaboration on its AI Experimentalist reasoning layer. Founded by Michelle Lee and headquartered in San Francisco, Medra raised a $52M Series A (Dec 2025) from investors including Lux Capital and Menlo Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Medra publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Mindstate Design Labs
providers.description: Mindstate Design Labs is a clinical-stage AI neuroengineering platform and drug development company addressing the mental health crisis. Its Osmanthus discovery platform maps the biological basis of emotion, perception, and cognition by analyzing psychoactive drug effects and biochemical data to understand how neurotransmitter combinations produce different emotional and cognitive states, driving a pipeline of novel mental-health therapeutics. Backed by Initialized Capital. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes an informational corporate site only and exposes no public developer API, documentation portal, or specification surface.

providers.name: Moment Energy
providers.description: Moment Energy is a Coquitlam, British Columbia clean-energy company that builds battery energy storage systems (BESS) from repurposed electric-vehicle batteries for commercial and industrial customers. Its Luna BESS is described as the first repurposed-battery system to achieve UL 1973, UL 9540, and UL 9540A certifications, and is applied to demand-charge management, grid backup, EV-charging support, and energy arbitrage across data centers, public institutions, transportation, food & beverage, manufacturing, and forestry. Moment Energy is a hardware and energy-services company and publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Monte Rosa Therapeutics *
providers.description: Monte Rosa Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering molecular glue degrader (MGD) medicines. It pairs its QuEEN discovery engine — integrating artificial intelligence, machine learning, and structural biology — with proprietary chemistry to design small molecules that selectively degrade disease-causing proteins previously considered undruggable, across oncology and immunology, with collaborations including Novartis and Roche. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and added to the API Evangelist network. The company publishes no public developer API, portal, or documentation; this profile captures its web presence and probed domain-security surface.

providers.name: Nabhdrishti Aerospace
providers.description: Nabhdrishti Aerospace is a Bangalore-based deep-tech startup building India's first fuel-flex micro gas turbine for aviation and power generation. Its ND 400 engine is a 400 N single-core micro gas turbine designed for UAVs, hybrid-electric aircraft, and small aircraft as well as oil & gas, manufacturing, and vehicle range-extender power generation, running on conventional fuels, biofuels, and hydrogen with an innovative recuperator design that targets greater than 15% efficiency at under half the cost of competing turbines. Backed by Accel, the company raised USD 3M and operates from the IISc Bangalore IHUB. As a hardware manufacturer it publishes no public API, SDK, or developer platform; this profile tracks its public web presence.

providers.name: Ndea
providers.description: Ndea is an AI research and science laboratory founded by Francois Chollet (creator of the Keras deep learning library and the ARC-AGI benchmark) and Mike Knoop (co-founder of Zapier) with the mission of building frontier AI systems that blend intuitive pattern recognition and formal reasoning into a single unified architecture. Ndea treats program synthesis, enhanced by deep learning, as a pathway to artificial general intelligence, arguing that synthesizing discrete programs that explain observed data generalizes better from few examples than deep learning alone. Its stated ambition is to build a "factory for rapid scientific advancement." Both founders also serve on the board of the nonprofit ARC Prize Foundation. Ndea publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK at this time; this profile tracks the company's public web surface and is added to the API Evangelist network as a Menlo Ventures portfolio lead.

providers.name: New Jersey Resources
providers.description: New Jersey Resources (NJR) is a Fortune 1000 energy services holding company that provides natural gas distribution through New Jersey Natural Gas, retail energy services, midstream assets, and clean energy investments. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Ola Electric
providers.description: Ola Electric is an Indian electric-vehicle manufacturer building electric scooters (the S1 family), electric motorcycles (the Roadster line), and home energy solutions (Ola Shakti battery systems), all designed and produced in India around its in-house 4680 Bharat Cell and ferrite-motor technology. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, the company operates a nationwide Hypercharger fast-charging network and Hyperservice center footprint across India. As a consumer EV and energy hardware manufacturer, Ola Electric publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or API reference; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company identity record rather than an API provider.

providers.name: OpenAlex
providers.description: Open catalog of scholarly works, authors, institutions, sources, and concepts

providers.name: OpenGraphr
providers.description: Really simple API to retrieve Open Graph data from an URL

providers.name: Pacific Fusion
providers.description: Pacific Fusion is a fusion energy company based in Fremont, California developing commercial fusion power using pulsed magnetic inertial fusion. Its modular system pairs a fast electric pulser, a meter-scale fusion chamber, and centimeter-scale fuel targets to pursue net facility gain with practical, affordable manufacturing. Building on breakthroughs from US National Laboratories (Lawrence Livermore, Sandia) and partners such as General Atomics, the company aims to deliver limitless, clean, on-demand power. Surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC, General Catalyst, and Lightspeed Venture Partners, this profile has been enriched through the API Evangelist network. Pacific Fusion is a hardware and energy company and publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Percipient.ai
providers.description: Percipient.ai is a Silicon Valley artificial intelligence, machine learning and computer vision company, founded in 2017 by Founder & CEO Balan Ayyar, that builds Mirage - an intelligence analysis platform for United States national security and intelligence missions. Mirage performs faster-than-real-time exploitation of unstructured multimedia, visual and multi-INT data across three modules: an FMV module for full motion video, still imagery and multi-INT sensor data supporting identity creation, network discovery, pattern-of-life analysis and geo-correlation; a cloud GSM geospatial module providing geo-fenced alerting, change detection, custom object detection and temporal analysis; and a VRM vehicle recognition module delivered as a mobile appliance for mobile and fixed surveillance with home-station cross-mission correlation. The platform is deployed both at the edge for live stream ingest and in the cloud at petabyte scale, and has been operationally procured by organizations in the US Intelligence Community and the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency. Percipient.ai sells Mirage through federal contracting vehicles and is listed as Awardable on the CDAO Tradewinds Solutions Marketplace. It operates no public developer program: as of August 2026 it publishes no API, developer portal, API reference, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Phillips 66
providers.description: Phillips 66 is a diversified energy manufacturing and logistics company with midstream, chemicals, refining, and marketing and specialties businesses. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts for Phillips 66.

providers.name: Predictive Oncology  (Precision Therapeutics)
providers.description: Predictive Oncology (Precision Therapeutics) is an AI-driven drug-discovery and precision-oncology company. It combines a proprietary biobank of 150,000+ tumor samples with machine-learning models to predict patient and drug responses, develops 3D in vitro tumor models that simulate human tissue environments for drug testing, and offers tumor drug-response testing and genomic profiling to support personalized cancer treatment and improve the probability of success in clinical trials. The company engages partners through direct B2B collaboration and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bain Capital Ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Pseudolithic
providers.description: PseudolithIC is a semiconductor company specializing in heterogeneous integration technology for cost-effective, high-performance silicon RFICs (radio frequency integrated circuits). The company combines compound semiconductor chiplets with large-diameter, low-cost silicon wafers to deliver mm-wave power amplifiers, low-noise amplifiers, and transmit/receive (T/R) front-end modules for RF and wireless applications. PseudolithIC is a hardware/chipset manufacturer targeting the RF and semiconductor industries; it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or programmatic surface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: PVGIS
providers.description: PVGIS (Photovoltaic Geographical Information System) is a European Commission service providing free access to solar radiation and photovoltaic performance data worldwide. Users can input location, system parameters, and retrieve hourly, daily, monthly, and yearly solar irradiation, PV output, and performance metrics in various formats (CSV, JSON, PDF). The platform supports multiple PV technologies, mounting options, and includes tools for horizon and temperature data, aiding researchers, engineers, and policymakers in renewable energy planning and analysis.

providers.name: Quantumscape
providers.description: QuantumScape is a battery technology company developing next-generation solid-state lithium-metal batteries for electric vehicles and energy storage. Its anode-free cell design aims to deliver greater energy density, faster charging, longer life, and improved safety versus conventional lithium-ion cells, while simplifying manufacturing and lowering cost. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Khosla Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes a corporate website, blog, and investor relations resources but no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Radiant
providers.description: Radiant is a nuclear technology company developing portable, transportable microreactors designed to deliver clean, reliable power to remote sites, military installations, disaster-relief operations, and industrial locations that today depend on diesel generators. Its flagship Kaleidos reactor is a factory-built, containerized ~1 MW microreactor intended to ship by truck, plane, or ship and be operational quickly on-site. Founded by former SpaceX engineers and headquartered in El Segundo, California, Radiant is backed by DCVC and Union Square Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a corporate and careers web presence but no public developer program, API, SDK, or technical documentation surface.

providers.name: Radical Numerics
providers.description: Radical Numerics is an AI research lab building what it calls "general biological intelligence" — next-generation AI architectures aimed at biology and science rather than language. It was founded by machine-learning researchers Michael Poli, Stefano Massaroli, Eric Nguyen, and Armin W. Thomas (associated with the Hyena and Evo / Evo 2 genomics model families), with an advisory board including Eric Horvitz, Chris Ré, George Church, and Andrew Weber. The lab focuses on the science of scaling, architecture, and systems: massive context windows scaling toward one billion tokens, generative genomics, biological threat detection, and multimodal biological intelligence. Its first product, Omnii, is an early-access health research preview. The company announced a $50M seed round in June 2026, with backing including Obvious Ventures. As of this profile Radical Numerics publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Recursion Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Recursion Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ: RXRX) is a Salt Lake City-based AI-enabled drug discovery company that operates the Recursion Operating System (Recursion OS), a vertically integrated platform combining automated wet-lab cellular phenomics, transcriptomics (Trekseq), proteomics, ADME, chemistry, and patient data with machine learning to map biology and design drug candidates. The platform runs on BioHive-2, a NVIDIA-built supercomputer ranked among the top global systems and dedicated to biopharma workloads, and is fed by 50+ petabytes of proprietary biological and chemical data. In November 2024 Recursion completed the acquisition of Exscientia, folding Exscientia's generative AI chemistry, Centaur Chemist, and clinical pipeline into the combined company; Recursion now runs more than 10 clinical and preclinical programs (REC-4881 for FAP, REC-3565 MALT1 inhibitor, REC-1245 RBM39 for biomarker-enriched solid tumors and lymphomas, REC-617 CDK7 inhibitor, REC-994 for cerebral cavernous malformation, REC-2282 for NF2- mutated meningiomas, REC-4209 for IPF, REC-7735 for HSD obesity), 10+ advanced discovery programs, and 10+ partnered programs across Roche (Genentech), Bayer, Sanofi, and Merck KGaA (Darmstadt). Recursion does not currently expose paid commercial APIs to external developers; assets and data access are delivered through licensing, scientific collaborations, and the MapApp web product. Externally, Recursion ships substantial open tooling: the RxRx family of open phenomics datasets (RxRx1, RxRx2, RxRx3, RxRx3-core, RxRx19a, RxRx19b) hosted at rxrx.ai and Hugging Face, the OpenPhenom-S/16 foundation model (released on Hugging Face and Google Cloud's Model Garden, with Phenom-Beta on NVIDIA BioNeMo), the MolE molecular foundation model, the gflownet library for graph and molecular generative modeling, SynFlowNet/synflownet-boltz for retrosynthesis-aware molecular design, maes_microscopy (NeurIPS 2023 spotlight masked autoencoders for cell microscopy), and rxrx1-utils for the NeurIPS 2019 CellSignal competition. The combination positions Recursion as a Tier-2 AI drug discovery provider with no commercial API surface but a meaningful open-source and open-model presence aimed at the computational biology research community.

providers.name: Sapiens Medicus
providers.description: Sapiens Medicus operates Esculap.io, a consumer digital-health platform offering AI-powered doctor consultations delivered instantly through a web application. Marketed as "Your AI Doctor - Instant Medical Care Anytime," the service promises AI doctor consultations with medical specialist-level accuracy and high diagnostic confidence, with no appointments and no waiting times. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company, it is a consumer-facing React single-page application; as of this enrichment pass no public API, developer portal, SDK, machine-readable OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface is published on the esculap.io domain.

providers.name: Scorpion Therapeutics
providers.description: Scorpion Therapeutics is a clinical-stage precision oncology biotechnology company founded in 2020 and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. It pursued what it called Precision Oncology 2.0 — integrating target discovery, medicinal chemistry and translational medicine to produce mutant-selective small-molecule cancer drugs — led by STX-478, an oral mutant-selective PI3K-alpha inhibitor in Phase 1/2 trials for breast cancer and other advanced solid tumors, and STX-721, a covalent EGFR/HER2 exon 20 inhibitor. In January 2025 Eli Lilly agreed to acquire Scorpion and its PI3K-alpha program in a transaction valued at up to $2.5 billion, with the non-PI3K-alpha pipeline and staff spun into a separate independent company. Scorpion is a drug developer, not a software vendor: it publishes no API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable specification, and its own domain now redirects to the acquirer's announcement.

providers.name: Smacktechnologies
providers.description: Smack Technologies is a frontier AI lab dedicated to national security, building domain-specific multimodal models trained via deep reinforcement learning in synthetic warfare environments to deliver decision dominance to the U.S. Department of War, its allies and partners. The company ships two product suites — Omega, a command-level AI stack pairing frontier models with customer-specific applications for strategic decision-making, and Alpha, an edge-level stack of lightweight models on proprietary hardware for tactical platforms and autonomous systems. Founded by MARSOC veterans Andrew Markoff and Clint Alanis and headquartered in El Segundo, California, Smack has raised $32M across Seed and Series A rounds led by Felicis. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs — a defense-domain vendor with no external developer surface.

providers.name: SolarBridge Technologies
providers.description: SolarBridge Technologies was a solar power-electronics company that developed AC photovoltaic (ACPV) technology for residential and commercial solar, including its TrueAC modules, the Pantheon and Pantheon II microinverters, and the SolarBridge Management System for monitoring installed systems. The company was acquired by SunPower in 2014 and no longer operates as an independent business; its former marketing site is preserved at solarbridgetech.com. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. SolarBridge was a hardware and embedded-electronics company and does not publish a public developer program, API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Somite
providers.description: Somite (now operating as Cellular Intelligence) is an AI-native TechBio company backed by Khosla Ventures building a universal virtual cell-signaling foundation model to engineer cellular fate. In 2026 the company rebranded from Somite to Cellular Intelligence and entered an agreement with Novo Nordisk to advance STEM-PD, a clinical-stage cell therapy for Parkinson's disease that carries FDA Fast Track Designation. The company works at the intersection of machine learning and regenerative medicine and does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or other machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Spiritus
providers.description: Spiritus Technologies is a climate-tech company building low-cost direct air capture (DAC) technology that removes carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. Its core carbon-dioxide-removal system and its Orchard Power product (pairing DAC with waste heat for net-zero power) target dramatically lower energy use and capital cost than existing DAC. Backed by Khosla Ventures, Aramco Ventures, and Mitsubishi, with carbon-removal customers including Shopify, Stripe, and Frontier. Based in White Rock, New Mexico. This is a physical carbon-removal hardware company and does not currently publish a public API, SDK, or developer platform.

providers.name: Spruce Finance *
providers.description: Spruce Power operates sprucepower.com as a customer portal ("CustomerPortal") for its residential solar and home energy services, giving homeowners a dashboard to monitor their solar energy systems and production, manage their service agreement, and get in touch with support (public routes include /dashboard, /monitoring, /pro, and /get-in-touch). Surfaced as a GV portfolio company (sector: frontier-tech) and added to the API Evangelist network. Enrichment found no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or working /.well-known/ discovery surface — all /.well-known/ paths return the customer-portal single-page-app shell rather than real documents, and no api./developer./docs. host resolves.

providers.name: Stan
providers.description: Stan (stan.store) is an all-in-one creator storefront and link-in-bio commerce platform that lets creators sell digital products, online courses, coaching calls, memberships, and webinars directly from a single mobile-first store link. The platform bundles checkout and payments, email marketing, an AutoDM tool, analytics, and integrations with third-party tools such as Zoom and Google Meet. Backed by Forerunner Ventures, General Catalyst, and Norwest Venture Partners, Stan targets the creator economy. As of this enrichment pass Stan publishes no public developer API, webhook specification, or SDKs — the surface is a consumer product plus a help center; this profile captures the identity and a probed domain-security profile.

providers.name: Strata Critical Medical
providers.description: Strata Critical Medical is a time‑critical logistics and medical services provider to the U.S. healthcare industry. It operates one of the nation’s largest air transport and surgical services networks for transplant hospitals and organ procurement organizations, offering an integrated “one‑call” solution for donor organ recovery, cardiac and perfusion services, and end‑to‑end transplant solutions on a national scale.

providers.name: Subtle Medical
providers.description: Subtle Medical is a healthcare AI company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California, that develops FDA-cleared deep-learning software to enhance medical imaging. Its products — SubtleMR, SubtlePET, SubtleGAD and SubtleSYNTH — denoise, accelerate and improve MRI and PET scans, integrating into existing radiology and PACS workflows via DICOM rather than through a public developer API or REST platform. The company is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and DCVC. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal was discoverable during enrichment; DNS/TLS domain-security posture was probed.

providers.name: Superior Energy Services
providers.description: Superior Energy Services is a leading provider of specialized oilfield services and equipment for oil and gas exploration, production, and well services. The company operates a portfolio of global brands providing drilling equipment rentals, completion tools, well intervention, and production services across 47 countries. Superior leverages digital transformation technologies including SAP, Azure, and field data platforms to deliver integrated wellbore technology and wellsite solutions.

providers.name: Superluminal Medicines
providers.description: Superluminal Medicines is a drug discovery company that combines structure-based drug discovery with AI-powered computational methods and experimental validation to identify and develop small molecule therapeutics. Its pipeline targets G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) for cardiometabolic disease and obesity, including a collaboration with Eli Lilly worth up to $1.3 billion. Backed by Insight Partners. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface was found as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Syntiant
providers.description: Syntiant Corp is an Irvine, California edge-AI semiconductor company founded in 2017 that designs ultra-low-power Neural Decision Processors (NDPs) and the deep-learning models and tooling that run on them, bringing always-on speech, audio, sensor and vision inference to battery-powered devices without a cloud connection. Its silicon family spans the NDP100/NDP101, NDP102, NDP115, NDP120, NDP200 and NDP250, paired with a Training Development Kit (TDK) that maps TensorFlow models onto the NDP core and an embedded SDK for integration into customer firmware. In December 2024 Syntiant completed the USD 150 million acquisition of Knowles Corporation's Consumer MEMS Microphones business, taking the company from roughly 70 to nearly 1,700 employees and making microphones the majority of its revenue. Syntiant is a silicon, module and embedded-software supplier rather than an API provider - enrichment probing found no public web API, no OpenAPI or other machine-readable contract, no developer portal, no first-party package-registry SDKs and no event surface; its SDK and TDK are distributed to customers through a private GitLab and under agreement.

providers.name: TAE Technologies
providers.description: TAE Technologies (formerly Tri Alpha Energy) is a Foothill Ranch, California fusion energy company founded in 1998, pursuing commercial fusion power using aneutronic hydrogen-boron (p-B11) fuel in an advanced beam-driven field-reversed configuration (FRC). Because the p-B11 reaction is aneutronic, TAE's approach produces virtually no neutron flux or on-site radioactive waste compared with conventional deuterium-tritium concepts. The company has built a progression of plasma machines — Sewer Pipe, CBFR-SPS, C-2, C-2U, and C-2W ("Norman") — and is constructing Copernicus in Irvine, California to demonstrate net energy gain, with Da Vinci planned as the grid-connected power-plant demonstration. TAE has raised more than USD 1.2 billion from investors including Google, Chevron, NEA, Goldman Sachs, Vulcan, Venrock, Wellcome Trust, and the Kuwait Investment Authority, and runs research collaborations with Japan's National Institute for Fusion Science (NIFS). Two operating subsidiaries commercialize spin-off technology: TAE Life Sciences develops accelerator-based Boron Neutron Capture Therapy (BNCT) systems for cancer treatment, and TAE Power Solutions builds modular, software-controlled power-management systems for e-mobility and battery applications. TAE is a private hardware and deep-science company; it does not publish a developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, or public open-source code repository.

providers.name: Takenos
providers.description: Takenos is a Latin American fintech offering a digital dollar wallet built for freelancers, remote workers, and businesses who need to receive cross-border payments. It lets users get paid from abroad, hold and save in digital dollars with daily yield, and spend via international (TakeCard) and local (SpicyCard) debit cards plus QR payments. Riding the LATAM stablecoin and onchain-finance wave, it targets remittance friction and local-currency inflation across markets including Argentina and Bolivia. Backed by a $5M seed round (investors include 500 Global). No public developer API is documented; this profile was enriched from public sources.

providers.name: Tearclear
providers.description: TearClear Corp. is a clinical-stage ophthalmic pharmaceutical company founded in 2015 that develops a preservative-removing drug delivery platform: a chemical filter built into a conventional multi-dose eye-drop bottle that captures benzalkonium chloride (BAK) at the point of instillation, so the medication stays preserved in the bottle but reaches the ocular surface preservative-free. Its lead candidate TC-002 (latanoprost ophthalmic solution 0.005%) met the primary and all secondary endpoints in the CLEAR Phase 3 pivotal glaucoma trial, with TC-001 (timolol), TC-003 (brimonidine/timolol) and TC-004 (brimonidine) behind it. TearClear ships drug products and delivery hardware, not software: it operates no developer program and publishes no API, SDK or machine-readable contract, and its own corporate domain no longer resolves to a served website.

providers.name: Transport for Manchester, England
providers.description: TfGM transport network data

providers.name: Twolabs
providers.description: Twolabs is a San Francisco robotics startup (Y Combinator, Spring 2026) building Tobi, a modular humanoid robot platform for builders to collect data, train skills, and deploy autonomous robots. The two-founder company vertically integrates hardware and AI in-house, streamlining robot training into a Record, Upload, Train, Deploy workflow, and is initially focused on caregiving applications in senior-care facilities such as feeding, dressing, medication reminders, mobility support, and companionship. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company; it does not yet publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: USG
providers.description: USG Corporation is a leading manufacturer of building products and innovative solutions for the construction industry. USG produces Sheetrock brand drywall, Durock cement board, Securock glass-mat sheathing, and a wide range of interior finishing systems. The company serves contractors, architects, and building professionals through its distributor network and provides digital tools and APIs to support the building and construction workflow.

providers.name: Veo Robotics
providers.description: Veo Robotics built FreeMove, a 3D depth-sensing computer vision safety system that lets standard industrial robots work safely alongside people by monitoring workcells and dynamically restricting or resuming robot motion. Backed by GV and Lux Capital, the company's assets - including FreeMove and related intellectual property - were acquired by Symbotic in July 2024, and veobot.com now redirects to symbotic.com. Veo Robotics published no public API surface; this profile records the company in the API Evangelist network graph.

providers.name: Verge Labs
providers.description: Verge Labs (formerly Verge Genomics) is a frontier AI company applying machine learning to human biology, building an AI system designed to reason about neurological disease at the patient level. Its stated goal is a "virtual biopsy of the brain" — a reconstructed picture of what is happening inside a patient's brain generated from a routine blood draw. The company built proprietary genomic datasets from human brain tissue for neurodegenerative diseases such as ALS and Parkinson's, and after an early ALS clinical program refocused on AI methods for matching brain therapeutics to the patients most likely to benefit. Verge is a research-stage biotech/AI company backed by Threshold Ventures and other venture investors; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal.

providers.name: Verobioscience
providers.description: Vero Bioscience measures biological age at the organ level using advanced proteomics and machine learning. Its OrganAge test analyzes thousands of proteins from a single blood draw to detect the earliest molecular signs of organ-specific aging, enabling targeted interventions to slow or reverse the aging process. The company is a Khosla Ventures-backed longevity and diagnostics startup whose work has been published in Nature and Nature Medicine. As of this enrichment pass Vero Bioscience operates a consumer waitlist and partnership program and exposes no public developer API, documentation portal, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Verra
providers.description: Verra is a Washington, D.C.-based nonprofit standards body that develops and manages the world's leading certification programs for climate action and sustainable development. Its flagship program, the Verified Carbon Standard (VCS), is the most widely used voluntary greenhouse gas crediting program globally, with more than 2,579 registered projects across 132+ countries and over 1.3 billion Verified Carbon Units (VCUs) issued. Verra also operates the Climate, Community & Biodiversity Standards (CCB), the Sustainable Development Verified Impact Standard (SD VISta), the Plastic Waste Reduction Standard (PWRP), the Scope 3 Standard Program, and the Jurisdictional and Nested REDD+ (JNR) framework. The Verra Registry at registry.verra.org is the system of record for projects, methodologies, issuances, retirements, and the AFOLU pooled buffer account across these programs; project documentation, public comment periods, and credit-lifecycle records are all surfaced through that registry. Verra recently launched VCS Version 5, modernizing program operations, strengthening safeguards, and clarifying credit rights. Verra does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or GitHub organization; programmatic data access is limited to the registry's web interface and filtered report exports, and there is no open-source code or machine-readable spec catalog associated with the organization.

providers.name: Virtual Internship Partners
providers.description: Virtual Internships (Virtual Internship Partners) is a global EdTech platform that connects learners, universities, and host companies to deliver guaranteed remote internships across career fields including finance, legal, healthcare, media and communications, supply chain, hospitality, real estate, HR, and sustainability. Backed by 500 Global, it pairs students and graduates with mentored, project-based work experience at companies worldwide. Added to the API Evangelist network from a VC portfolio and enriched by the pipeline; the company publishes a marketing website and a Rank Math llms.txt but exposes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Volt14
providers.description: Volt14 Solutions Pte Ltd is a Singapore-based deep-tech startup developing silicon-majority anode materials for lithium-ion batteries. Its fully integrated, tunable, and ready-to-use anodes replace conventional graphite to deliver large gains in energy density and lower normalized cell cost, while remaining compatible with existing battery cell manufacturing infrastructure. Target application markets include electric vehicles, consumer electronics, appliances, and power tools. The company is a materials-science and battery-technology producer; it publishes a corporate and careers website but exposes no public developer or API product surface. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Watson Natural Language Understanding
providers.description: Natural language processing for advanced text analysis

providers.name: Wren
providers.description: Wren is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of union-square-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: xeno-canto
providers.description: Bird recordings

providers.name: YellowBrink
providers.description: YellowBrink is a Netherlands-based, vendor-neutral community platform for open health data, founded by Jan de Lange and Bouwe Koopal to connect healthcare professionals, vendors, researchers and policymakers working with open standards such as openEHR, HL7 FHIR, OMOP and SNOMED CT. The name pairs the Yellow Pages — showing who builds what — with "brink", the Dutch word for the village square where a community gathers. It runs weekly webinars in cooperation with openEHR NL, country and topic special-interest groups, and discussion and co-creation rooms, hosts "The Brink" partner and meeting area at the EHRCON26 conference in Amsterdam, and is developing a postdoctoral European Master of Data Availability programme with European universities and hospital systems. The platform is a white-labelled Innoloft LoftOS tenant; YellowBrink itself publishes no public API, SDK or developer program.

providers.name: Zeen
providers.description: Zeen is an AI-powered autonomous personal finance platform — a money copilot that connects to your financial accounts and uses background AI agents to manage money on your behalf. Its features include an interactive AI financial copilot that answers questions in real time, Guard (loss prevention that avoids overdraft fees and cancels unused subscriptions), Grow (yield optimization that moves idle balances to higher-interest accounts), and Guide (spending insights). As of mid-2026 Zeen is in pre-launch with a public waitlist. Zeen is backed by Cowboy Ventures and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Zeno Power
providers.description: Zeno Power is a deep-tech energy company developing radioisotope power systems (nuclear batteries) that convert the heat of radioisotope decay into reliable, long-duration electricity for extreme environments where conventional power sources fail. Its compact radioisotope Stirling generators target 1-100+ watts for use cases spanning NASA lunar surface missions (americium-241 fueled), seabed and maritime sensor infrastructure, and Department of Defense / U.S. Space Force applications (strontium-90 fueled). The company works with partners including NASA, the Pentagon, Westinghouse, and Orano, with commercial market delivery targeted for 2027. Backed by DCVC, Zeno Power was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; enrichment found no public API, developer platform, SDKs, or technical documentation surface as of this pass.

providers.name: AccelerComm
providers.description: AccelerComm Limited is a British semiconductor and wireless physical-layer IP company headquartered at Southampton Science Park, spun out of the University of Southampton in 2016 by Professor Rob Maunder. It designs and licenses channel-coding (forward error correction) intellectual property — LDPC and Polar encoders/decoders, CRC acceleration, rate matching, soft-decision demodulation, channel estimation and equalisation — delivered as RTL/FPGA IP cores, optimised software libraries and hardware-acceleration architectures for 5G NR and 4G LTE baseband. Its LEOphy product is a complete Split-6 RU High-PHY layer 1 modem for low-earth-orbit 5G Non-Terrestrial Network satellite payloads, and the company was selected for the Airbus UpNext SpaceRAN software-defined-satellite demonstrator. AccelerComm raised £21.5m in growth funding, counts IP Group among its investors, and holds more than 56 granted international patents. Its products are integrated by silicon and RAN vendors over hardware interfaces such as AXI rather than over the network: AccelerComm publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract, and its GitHub organisation carries no public repositories. The one machine-readable document it does serve is an /llms.txt at the root of its marketing site.

providers.name: AI Therapeutics
providers.description: AI Therapeutics (now Orphai Therapeutics) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in Guilford, Connecticut by Jonathan Rothberg as LAM Therapeutics, renamed AI Therapeutics, and renamed again to OrphAI Therapeutics in September 2023. It built an internal deep-learning platform that synthesized public and proprietary drug and disease data to match existing chemical entities to new indications, and used it to advance a rare-disease and pulmonary pipeline — LAM-001, an inhaled formulation of sirolimus (rapamycin) targeting mTOR-driven pulmonary disease, plus the earlier PIKfyve inhibitor programs LAM-002 and LAM-003. Quince Therapeutics (Nasdaq: QNCX) acquired Orphai in May 2026 and now runs it as a subsidiary. The AI platform is an internal drug-discovery tool, not a product: the company operates no developer program, publishes no API, SDK or machine-readable contract, and its public web presence is a single-page corporate site.

providers.name: Aipuqiang
providers.description: Aipuqiang is the transliterated name of Shanghai APACTRON Particle Equipment Co., Ltd. (上海艾普强粒子设备有限公司), a Shanghai-based manufacturer of proton therapy systems for cancer treatment. Founded in June 2011 and controlled by Shanghai Alliance Investment Co., Ltd. under the Shanghai SASAC, the company was the industrialization partner for China's first domestically developed proton therapy demonstration facility, which received NMPA innovative medical device registration in September 2022 and entered clinical service at the Tumor Proton Center of Ruijin Hospital in November 2023. Its product line covers the accelerator system (injector, synchrotron and high-energy beam transport) together with 180-degree and 360-degree rotating-gantry and horizontal fixed-beam treatment rooms. Aipuqiang is a capital medical-equipment manufacturer: it sells installed proton therapy systems to hospitals and publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Air Protein
providers.description: Air Protein is a Bay Area food-technology company producing a nutrient-dense, meat-alternative protein made from elements found in the air. Its carbon-conversion fermentation process — derived from NASA closed-loop life-support research — combines carbon dioxide, oxygen, nitrogen, water and renewable energy with hydrogenotrophic microbes to grow a protein flour, which it then transforms into whole-food "air meat" products. Founded by CEO Dr. Lisa Dyson, the company aims to decouple protein production from land and animal agriculture. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of GV; it publishes a marketing site but no developer API surface.

providers.name: Alami
providers.description: Alami is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: secondary-market) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: Alisports
providers.description: Alisports is a sports‑technology company that provides digital platforms for sports event management, athlete performance tracking, and fan engagement. The firm offers APIs that enable integration of live scores, scheduling, registration, and analytics into third‑party applications. While the company appears in secondary‑market listings, its own web presence could not be verified during profiling, suggesting limited public documentation of its API offerings.

providers.name: Altitude Software
providers.description: Altitude Software is a contact center and unified customer interaction (uCI) software company founded in 1993 and headquartered in Lisbon, Portugal. Its flagship Altitude uCI suite provides omnichannel contact center capabilities — inbound/outbound campaigns, IVR and self-service, routing, dialer, recording and quality management, and CRM/ERP integration — with the Altitude uAgent SDK exposing Java, C/C++, .NET, SOAP, XML-RPC and web-service APIs for on-premises and cloud deployments. Altitude Software was a portfolio company of Insight Partners and was acquired by Enghouse Systems (TSX: ENGH) on 2020-12-30; the product line is now developed and maintained by Enghouse Interactive, and the brand continues to operate regionally (e.g. Altitude Software APAC). The company does not publish a modern public REST API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification; integration is delivered through the proprietary uAgent SDK and packaged CRM/ERP connectors.

providers.name: Antidot
providers.description: Antidot is a creative studio and web development agency led by interdisciplinary designer and developer Pedro Stöhr. With over 20 years of experience in print and digital media, the studio offers services in art direction, typography, web development, and multimedia production, catering to clients seeking innovative and culturally resonant digital solutions.

providers.name: Appirio
providers.description: Appirio is a global cloud services and consulting company founded in 2006 and headquartered in Indianapolis, acquired by Wipro for USD 500 million in 2016 and now operating as "Appirio, a Wipro company." Appirio is a strategic implementation partner for Salesforce, Workday, Google, and Amazon, helping over 3,000 enterprises across healthcare and life sciences, banking, higher education, manufacturing, and retail adopt cloud-based solutions. Its services span Salesforce ecosystem consulting, CRM and platform implementation, cloud application development, and digital transformation. Appirio is a consulting and systems-integration firm rather than an API producer: it does not publish a public developer program, OpenAPI definitions, SDKs, or a developer portal, so this profile carries company identity only and no API artifacts.

providers.name: Arc Institute
providers.description: Arc Institute is an independent nonprofit biomedical research organization headquartered in Palo Alto, California, co-founded in 2021 by Silvana Konermann (Executive Director), Patrick Hsu (Core Investigator), and Stripe co-founder Patrick Collison. With 300+ staff ("Arconauts") across 9 core laboratories and 5 technology centers, Arc develops AI foundation models for biology that span DNA, RNA, proteins, and single cells. Its flagship releases include Evo (Science, 2024) and Evo 2 (Nature, 2026) — DNA foundation models trained on trillions of nucleotides at single-nucleotide resolution with up to a 1-megabase context; STATE and Stack single-cell foundation models for cellular perturbation and in-context learning; the Arc Virtual Cell Atlas; the SRAgent LLM agents for bioinformatics; and the BINSEQ binary sequencing format. Models are released under Apache 2.0 on GitHub and Hugging Face, with hosted inference for Evo 2 available through NVIDIA BioNeMo and the NVIDIA build.nvidia.com API. Arc is funded by philanthropic donations from Patrick and John Collison, Vitalik Buterin, the Ron Conway family, Dustin Moskovitz, Daniel Gross, Elad Gil, and other technology benefactors; it does not sell APIs, SaaS, or models commercially.

providers.name: Arkenstone
providers.description: Arkenstone Technologies provides strategic consulting and implementation services focused on healthcare innovation, artificial intelligence, robotic process automation, compliance, security, and immersive technologies. Their offerings include healthcare analytics, AI-driven solutions, RPA deployment, and guidance on regulatory compliance, helping organizations navigate digital transformation and market disruptions.

providers.name: Asiasea
providers.description: Asiasea provides comprehensive seafood catering solutions, offering a wide range of frozen and fresh marine products for restaurants, hotels, and catering services. Its SmartView portal manages the purchase-to-payment lifecycle: credit decisioning, invoicing, billing, and receivables. BlueTarp was acquired and is now operated as Capital One Trade Credit; its independent site (bluetarp.com) redirects to capitalone.com/trade-credit/bluetarp. Brim is registered under Canada's Retail Payment Activities Act (RPAA) to Bank of Canada standards and was admitted to Payments Canada as a payment service provider, and has partnered with Mastercard to embed open-banking capabilities. Although Brim markets a comprehensive API-first platform, that API is delivered to enterprise/embedded-finance partners through a commercial onboarding relationship: as of this review there is no public, self-serve first-party developer portal, no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger, and no operational consumer-driven-banking (open-banking) API, consistent with Canada's voluntary, not-yet-live open-finance framework.

Claimglide integrates with major EMR/EHR platforms including eClinicalWorks, athenahealth, NextGen Healthcare, and ModMed, and states HIPAA compliance. providers.name: Denali Therapeutics
providers.description: Denali Therapeutics is a South San Francisco-based biopharmaceutical company that discovers, develops, and delivers therapeutics for people living with serious neurodegenerative and lysosomal storage diseases. Its proprietary Transport Vehicle (TV) platform is engineered to cross the blood-brain barrier so that large-molecule therapies can reach the brain and body. Denali maintains a public GitHub organization publishing open-source computational-biology and cheminformatics research tools (archs4, basechem, napari-mito-hcs), but publishes no public developer API. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a life-sciences portfolio company of GV.

providers.name: Dvlp Medicines
providers.description: DVLP Medicines is a drug-development software company building an end-to-end, configurable platform that moves molecules from discovery to commercialization with speed. The platform pairs a single data repository for pharmaceutical assets with specialized AI agents for pharma operations, document automation, knowledge synthesis, and decision support for portfolio management. It is positioned as a software co-pilot for drug development and a marketplace connecting project leaders with investors and outsourced R&D and manufacturing vendors, targeting underserved therapeutic markets such as new antibiotics for antimicrobial resistance and rare-disease therapies. DVLP Medicines is a portfolio company of DCVC (Computational Bio & Chem), first funded in 2022. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; the company publishes a marketing site but no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Elsewhere
providers.description: Elsewhere (Elsewhere Communities Inc.) is a San Francisco based video game studio founded in 2024 by Paul Sawaya, previously co-founder and CTO of Human Interest. The studio was part of cohort 001 of a16z SPEEDRUN, the Andreessen Horowitz accelerator for games and interactive media. Elsewhere describes itself as "a new kind of video game studio emboldened by the desire to rethink the industry", treating artificial intelligence as a normal technology and building games that use generative AI in a humanistic direction rather than a dystopian one. The studio previously worked on a multiplayer roguelike — games "that feel like an adventure you go on with your friends, and the adventure is never the same twice" — and is currently building something new. Elsewhere is a consumer game studio with no public developer platform: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no API, no developer portal, no SDKs, and no machine-readable discovery documents.

providers.name: Etherealize
providers.description: Etherealize builds institutional-grade infrastructure to bring Wall Street and financial institutions onto the Ethereum blockchain, focused on asset tokenization, Ethereum-native settlement, and institutional privacy for multi-trillion-dollar markets. Founded to connect institutions to the Ethereum ecosystem, the company pairs research and market education with products for programmable, private, and global finance. Backed by Electric Capital and Paradigm, Etherealize raised $40M in September 2025. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing site, a research/blog content hub, and careers and newsroom pages, but exposes no public developer or API surface, no documentation portal, and no client SDKs.

providers.name: Event-Driven Architecture
providers.description: Event-driven architecture (EDA) is a software architecture pattern promoting the production, detection, consumption of, and reaction to events. In this pattern, systems are designed to respond to state changes asynchronously through event messages. EDA enables loose coupling between services and is widely used in microservices, real-time data processing, and distributed systems. Foundational specifications include AsyncAPI for describing event-driven APIs and CNCF CloudEvents for a common event format.

providers.name: Fixed Format
providers.description: Fixed format (also known as fixed-width) is a data interchange approach where every field has a predefined column width and is space-padded as needed. It contrasts with delimiter-separated formats like CSV, and is widely used in legacy mainframe systems, banking files, healthcare claims, government filings, and Unix system files such as /etc/passwd. While not an API in the REST sense, fixed-format files remain a critical data exchange medium that modern APIs and ETL pipelines must read and write.

providers.name: Fyodor Biotechnologies
providers.description: Fyodor Biotechnologies is a Baltimore, Maryland based biotechnology company focused on making malaria diagnosis fast, affordable, and non-invasive. Its flagship product, the Urine Malaria Test (UMT), is a rapid diagnostic that detects active malaria infection from a urine sample in minutes without a blood draw, working much like a home pregnancy test so it can be used at the point of care or at home in regions where malaria is endemic. The test has been validated through partnerships with Johns Hopkins University, Duke University, and the University of Lagos, carries a CE Mark, and has secured regulatory approvals in Nigeria, Cote d'Ivoire, Kenya, and the Democratic Republic of Congo. Fyodor was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. It currently publishes no public developer platform, API, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Granite Construction

providers.name: Hang Ten
providers.description: Hang Ten Systems is an enterprise AI services company founded in 2026 and headquartered in Palo Alto, California. Led by co-founder and CEO Dr. Vishal Sikka (formerly CEO of Infosys and a member of SAP's executive board), the company helps large enterprises adopt AI to build, change, and run the software that runs their business at a fraction of the cost and time. Its AI-native delivery model combines agentic code generation, a reusable skills library, and deep domain expertise across SAP migrations, finance, HR, and new product development. Hang Ten raised a $32 million seed round led by Mayfield with strategic investment from Aramco Ventures, and counts Siemens Gamesa Renewable Energy and Fresenius among its early customers.

providers.name: HawkEye 360
providers.description: HawkEye 360 is a Herndon, Virginia-based radio frequency (RF) data analytics and geospatial intelligence company that operates the first commercial satellite constellation purpose-built to identify, process, and geolocate a broad range of RF signals from space. Founded in 2015 by Chris DeMay, Charles Clancy, and Bob McGwier, the company flies clusters of three small satellites in formation that use time- and frequency-difference-of-arrival triangulation to pinpoint emitters across VHF through Ku-band. As of 2025, HawkEye 360 has placed 36 Hawk satellites on orbit across 12 operational clusters. Its core products include RFGeo (the underlying RF signal mapping and geolocation data product), RFIQ (its RF intelligence data product recently selected by NASA Commercial LEO programs), and Mission Space, a web-based RF geospatial intelligence analysis platform. The company also offers a Regional Awareness Subscription (RAS) service providing persistent monitoring of high-interest regions such as the Mediterranean, South China Sea, and the Korean Peninsula. In December 2023 HawkEye 360 acquired Maxar Intelligence's RF Solutions business (formerly Aurora Insight), expanding its spectrum-mapping capabilities. Customers are concentrated in defense, intelligence, national security, and maritime domain awareness — including the US Government, allied partners, and foreign military sales (a 2025 FMS to India was approved by the Defense Security Cooperation Agency). HawkEye 360 has filed an S-1 with the SEC for a proposed IPO. There is no public, self-service developer API, SDK, or open-source release; data access is delivered through gated commercial and government contracts via the Mission Space platform and a customer-facing API for ordering and integration of RF analytics into customer systems.

providers.name: Heal
providers.description: Heal (legally Get Heal, Inc.) was a Los Angeles based in-home primary care practice founded in 2014 that delivered on-demand doctor house calls, one-touch telemedicine, telepsychology and remote patient monitoring, aimed largely at Medicare Advantage members. Humana took a $100M stake in the company in July 2020 and then acquired it outright, folding the practice into its CenterWell primary care brand. Heal never ran a public developer program: it published no OpenAPI, no developer portal and no SDKs. As of this profile heal.com issues a 301 redirect to centerwell.com for every path, and the one surviving technical host, api.heal.com, answers every request with a blanket HTTP 401.

Laurel, New Jersey, providing program, project, and construction management, project management oversight, claims and dispute resolution, estimating and cost management, facilities management, project monitoring, troubled project turnaround, commissioning, and project labor agreement consulting to public and private sector owners across more than 100 offices in 42 countries. In December 2022 Hill agreed to be acquired by Global Infrastructure Solutions, Inc. (GISI), the parent of STV, with the take-private transaction closing in May 2023 — Hill now operates as a GISI Consulting Group company alongside STV, GEI Consultants, LiRo-Hill, Layton Construction, and the broader GISI portfolio. Hill International is a professional services firm and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or any developer portal.

ICF serves markets spanning government, energy, environment, infrastructure, transportation, health, education, social programs, public safety, and disaster management, with approximately 9,000 employees worldwide. providers.name: Integrated Development Environment
providers.description: Integrated Development Environment (IDE) is a software application that consolidates the core developer workflow into a single interface, typically combining a source code editor, build automation tools, debugger, version control integration, intelligent code completion, refactoring, and language server protocol (LSP) support. Modern IDEs increasingly integrate AI coding assistants, agentic tooling, remote development containers, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients to extend the surface area beyond local file editing.

providers.name: Integration Patterns
providers.description: Integration Patterns are design patterns and best practices for integrating different software systems and applications, including messaging, data transformation, and service orchestration approaches. Enterprise Integration Patterns (EIP), as cataloged by Gregor Hohpe and Bobby Woolf, provide a technology-independent vocabulary and visual notation harvested from proven solutions to recurring integration problems, organized into Messaging Channels, Message Construction, Message Routing, Message Transformation, Messaging Endpoints, and System Management.

Target facilities include data centers, offices, hospitals, and cold storage, where the company claims 30%+ energy savings and sub-90-day ROI. providers.name: Mobileye
