providers.description: Mobileye is an Israel-headquartered ADAS and autonomous-driving technology company, majority-owned by Intel and publicly traded on NASDAQ as MBLY. Its flagship platform is the EyeQ family of purpose-built automotive systems-on-chip (EyeQ4, EyeQ5, EyeQ6L, EyeQ6H, EyeQ Ultra), shipped in over 175 million vehicles worldwide through partnerships with most major OEMs. Mobileye's solution portfolio spans entry-level ADAS, Mobileye SuperVision (eyes-on, hands-off highway and urban driving), Mobileye Chauffeur (eyes-off conditional autonomy), and Mobileye Drive (Level 4 full autonomy in robotaxi and goods-delivery applications). The company pioneered Responsibility- Sensitive Safety (RSS), a mathematical framework for AV decision safety contributed to IEEE standards work, and operates Road Experience Management (REM), a crowdsourced HD-mapping system that harvests anonymized road data from millions of consumer vehicles to build and update the Mobileye Roadbook. Mobileye does not publish a traditional public developer API; OEM and integration relationships are private B2B engagements.

providers.name: Mockups
providers.description: Mockups are visual representations or prototypes of user interfaces and designs used to demonstrate the look and feel of a product before development. They are used across software, mobile, web, and product design to align stakeholders, validate ideas, and improve outcomes by surfacing feedback before code is written. This index tracks tools, services, and resources in the mockup and prototyping space.

providers.name: Modeling Language
providers.description: A modeling language is a formal language used for specifying, visualizing, constructing, and documenting the artifacts of a system. Modeling languages are used in software engineering, systems design, enterprise architecture, and data modeling to capture structure and behavior in a way that can be shared, reasoned about, and turned into running systems. This index tracks modeling languages and notations relevant to the API and software design space.

providers.name: Nook
providers.description: Nook is an accounts payable (AP) automation platform for businesses, combining invoice management with automated payment workflows to reduce manual data entry, cut errors, and give finance teams clearer visibility over outgoings. Founded in the UK and backed by Speedinvest as an early investor, Nook was acquired by payments infrastructure provider Modulr; its product now operates as "Modulr AP" and its former standalone site at nook.io presents the combined Modulr AP offering. Nook does not publish an independent public developer platform, API reference, or SDKs — the payment rails are provided through Modulr's platform — so this profile is maintained as a company record rather than an API-bearing provider.

providers.name: Novig
providers.description: Novig is a peer-to-peer sports prediction and trading platform marketed as "America's #1 Sports Trading App," operating as a betting exchange rather than a traditional sportsbook. Users can set their own odds or accept existing lines across two modes: free-to-play with Novig Coins and real-money trading with Novig Cash. The consumer product is delivered as iOS and Android apps and is available in 35+ U.S. states. Backed by Forerunner Ventures, Multicoin Capital, and Pantera Capital. As of this enrichment pass Novig exposes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable discovery surface.

providers.name: Novo Nordisk
providers.description: Novo Nordisk A/S is a Danish multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Bagsværd, Denmark, and the world leader in diabetes care. The company also develops treatments for obesity, rare blood disorders, and growth-hormone therapy, including its widely known GLP-1 medicines Ozempic, Wegovy, and Rybelsus. Novo Nordisk does not publish a public commercial developer API. The company maintains a research GitHub organization (novonordisk-research) that releases open-source scientific computing libraries and an SDK for the Waters Empower Web API (OptiHPLCHandler) used in pharmaceutical analytical chemistry workflows.

providers.name: Nucor
providers.description: Nucor Corporation is a Fortune 500 American steel and steel products manufacturer headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. It is the largest steel producer in the United States and the largest recycler of any material in North America. Nucor does not publish a public developer API or OpenAPI specification; this index captures the corporate, sustainability, and certification resources that are publicly available.

providers.name: NXTP
providers.description: NXTP is an early-stage B2B technology venture capital firm investing across Latin America and globally, with more than 15 years of investing experience. Originally added to the API Evangelist network as "NXTPLabs" — a portfolio lead of 500 Global — enrichment revealed nxtplabs.com now redirects to nxtp.vc, the firm's current home. NXTP runs Fund III ($100M), has made 122 investments with 32 exits, and its portfolio companies have raised more than $2.3B in capital. The firm backs category-defining B2B founders from offices in Buenos Aires, São Paulo, and Mexico City. As an investment firm it publishes no public API, developer platform, SDK, or technical documentation, so this profile carries identity and firm facts rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Open Government, Estonia
providers.description: Estonia Government Open Data

providers.name: Open Government, Poland
providers.description: Poland Government Open Data

providers.name: Paisley Consulting
providers.description: Paisley Consulting was a governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) software company best known for its AutoAudit internal audit management product. The Paisley Consulting brand and its paisleyconsulting.com domain now redirect to Empowered Systems, a GRC software vendor whose Connected Risk platform delivers internal audit, internal controls, enterprise risk, operational risk, third-party risk, model risk, and policy & compliance management, along with the AutoAudit audit solution. The company supports frameworks including SOX/ICFR, COSO, Basel III, NIST, ISO 27001, and DORA. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; no public API, SDK, or developer surface is currently published.

providers.name: Peloton Interactive
providers.description: Peloton Interactive is a connected fitness company that produces interactive exercise equipment and a streaming subscription service. The company sells connected stationary bikes, treadmills, rowers, and a digital app offering live and on-demand fitness classes. Peloton has built a large community of members who participate in instructor-led workouts and track performance metrics through its platform.

providers.name: PerkinElmer
providers.description: PerkinElmer is a global leader in scientific instrumentation, lab services, and informatics for life sciences, diagnostics, food, environmental, and industrial markets. The company provides analytical instruments, reagents, software, and software downloads to support laboratory operations and scientific research.

providers.name: Plantd
providers.description: Plantd is an American advanced-materials manufacturer based in Oxford, North Carolina, founded in 2021 by former SpaceX engineers Nathan Silvernail (CEO) and Huade Tan (CTO) with Josh Dorfman (CMO). The company grows and harvests fast-growing perennial grass on farms across North Carolina and Virginia and presses it into carbon-negative structural building panels intended to replace oriented strand board (OSB), plywood and other timber-based sheathing. Production runs on a modular, all-electric, closed-loop manufacturing platform in a 150,000+ sq ft facility, with a research farm in Stovall, NC. Customers and partners include homebuilder D.R. Horton and furniture brand Studio TK. Plantd has raised roughly $47.5M across seed, Series A and a $22M Series B (October 2025). Plantd is a physical-goods manufacturer: it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind — this profile records that absence rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Quantum Systems
providers.description: Quantum-Systems GmbH is a Gilching/Munich, Germany-based dual-use drone manufacturer founded in 2015 by former Bundeswehr helicopter pilot Florian Seibel. The company designs, builds, and operates small electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) fixed-wing unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) for reconnaissance, intelligence, surveillance, target acquisition (RSTA), surveying, and mapping. Its flagship platforms include the Trinity Pro (mapping/surveying VTOL with up to 90-minute endurance), the Vector tactical reconnaissance drone (the de facto main small UAS supplier to the German Bundeswehr and, with 619+ systems delivered as of April 2025, one of the most-used Western reconnaissance drones in Ukraine), the Reliant long-range Group 2 ISR/RSTA platform built for the U.S. market with 10+ hours endurance and hot-swappable MOD-compliant payload bays (EO/IR, SIGINT, EW, CRPA), and the Ukraine-manufactured Sparta drone carrier that delivers two FPV drones to a 200 km combat radius. All platforms are operated through QBase 3D, Quantum-Systems' proprietary Windows-based mission planning, control, and post-processing software with integrated ESRI terrain data and direct export to Pix4D, Agisoft, Propeller, and Trimble Business Center. The Vector tactical line is built on Auterion's flight stack. Backed by HV Capital, DTCP, Thiel Capital, Project A, Airbus Ventures, and Omnes Capital, the company reached unicorn status in May 2025 as "Europe's first dual-use unicorn." Quantum-Systems supplies the militaries of Germany, the United States, Ukraine, Australia, the Netherlands, New Zealand, Romania, and Spain. There is no public developer API, REST endpoint, SDK, or open-source release for QBase 3D or any Quantum-Systems platform; integration with Pix4D/Agisoft/Propeller/Trimble is via standard photogrammetry file exchange (GeoTIFF, RAW imagery, flight logs), not a programmable API.

providers.name: RecommerceX
providers.description: RecommerceX is an engineering-driven manufacturing company applying circular-economy practices to transform industrial waste into advanced engineering materials. It operates three flagship brands: RexSteel (seamless and ERW stainless steel pipes, tubes, forgings, flanges and heat-exchanger tubes), RexPol (HDPE and DWC polymer pipes, polymer compounds and engineering plastics), and RexTherm (critical infrastructure including liquid cooling, heat exchangers, power components and acoustics). It serves oil & gas, chemical, pharmaceutical, infrastructure, automotive, water, power and industrial manufacturing sectors. Surfaced as a portfolio company of accel and added to the API Evangelist network; the public site publishes no API, SDK, developer portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Related Companies
providers.description: Related Companies is a privately held, fully integrated real estate firm founded by Stephen Ross in 1972 as an affordable-housing developer and now active across luxury residential, affordable housing, retail, office, hospitality, data centers, and city-scale mixed-use development. Related is the developer of Hudson Yards in New York City, The Grand LA, Time Warner Center (now Deutsche Bank Center), The 78 in Chicago, and operates regional platforms including Related Beal, Related Midwest, Related California, Related Ross, and Related Argent in the UK. The firm owns and manages roughly 55,000 affordable and workforce housing units and has stated it has never converted a single affordable unit to market rate. Stephen Ross also owns a majority stake in Equinox Holdings (Equinox fitness clubs, Equinox Hotels, SoulCycle, Blink Fitness) and the Miami Dolphins / Hard Rock Stadium.

providers.name: Rome Therapeutics
providers.description: Rome Therapeutics is a Cambridge, Massachusetts biotechnology company developing therapies that target the "repeatome" — the vast repetitive, non-coding regions of the human genome (the "dark genome," including LINE-1 and other transposable elements) implicated in cancer and autoimmune disease. Its discovery engine pairs ROMEMap, a proprietary high-resolution database of annotated functional repeats, with ROMEQuant, a machine-learning method for quantifying repeat expression and prioritizing targets and biomarkers. Backed by a16z and GV, the company raised a $77M Series B (2021) plus a $72M Series B extension to advance its lead program into clinical development. These are internal research/data-science tools; the company publishes no public developer or web API. This profile was surfaced as a VC portfolio lead and enriched by the pipeline.

providers.name: Shopkeep
providers.description: ShopKeep was a cloud-based iPad point-of-sale (POS) platform for independent retailers, restaurants, and quick-serve businesses, offering register, inventory, employee management, payments, and analytics. Founded in 2008 and backed by Canaan Partners, ShopKeep was acquired by Lightspeed Commerce in 2020 and its product and brand have since been folded into the Lightspeed Retail (S-Series) line. The marketing domain shopkeep.com now redirects to lightspeedhq.com/shopkeep, and support has migrated to shopkeep-support.lightspeedhq.com. ShopKeep never shipped a publicly documented developer API — a private "API beta" existed circa 2015 and the app backend at api.shopkeep.com remains live as a session-authenticated, undocumented internal service. No public OpenAPI, SDKs, developer portal, or API reference are published, so this profile is identity-only.

providers.name: Signify Group
providers.description: Signify Group is a London, United Kingdom-based ethical data science firm founded in 2017 by co-founder and CEO Jonathan Hirshler, applying machine learning, natural language understanding, and open-source intelligence (OSINT) to social and digital media data. Its flagship service, Threat Matrix, is widely regarded as the leading platform for detecting, analysing, evidencing, and actioning online abuse and fixated threats directed at athletes, clubs, leagues, player unions, federations, brands, and other public figures. Threat Matrix scans incoming public messages across X (Twitter), Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok in 39+ languages, uses "augmented intelligence" (AI speed combined with trained human analyst nuance) to triage racist, sexist, homophobic, anti-semitic, islamophobic, gambling-driven, and personally targeted abuse, and produces evidence-grade reports with network mapping that can be used by platforms, police, sponsors, and protection teams. Customers and partners include the Professional Footballers' Association (PFA), Kick It Out, the International Tennis Federation (ITF) and WTA Tour covering c.8,300 players, the International Ski and Snowboard Federation (FIS) protecting 1,000+ athletes and officials, the Badminton World Federation (BWF), the NCAA, and Japan's 2026 World Baseball Classic squad. Signify also operates ShareScore (media coverage and social buzz analytics), Sports Insights (fan engagement and athlete insight analytics), and Online Forensics (brand reputation, OSINT investigations, and risk assurance). Signify is a private services firm with no public developer API, no public SDKs, and no public GitHub organization; engagement is via direct sales and managed service contracts with rights-holders, leagues, federations, and enterprise clients.

providers.name: SiLC
providers.description: SiLC Technologies is a silicon photonics company headquartered in Monrovia, California that builds integrated single-chip FMCW (frequency-modulated continuous-wave) LiDAR — coherent 4D vision systems that capture depth, instantaneous velocity via micro-Doppler, and dual-polarization intensity from one photonic chip. Its Eyeonic product family spans Eyeonic Trace Ultra (a Class 1 laser line scanner for industrial automation and inspection), Eyeonic Vista (an ultra-long-range perimeter security and counter-UAS vision system with detection beyond 2 km), and Eyeonic Edge (high-precision 4D inspection of large objects). The company sells sensors, modules and vision chips to industrial and AI robotics, perimeter security, and mobility customers. It was founded by Dr. Mehdi Asghari and is backed in part by Honda. SiLC ships hardware, not software services: as of this profile it publishes no public developer program, API, SDK, documentation portal, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Spirit AeroSystems Holdings
providers.description: Spirit AeroSystems Holdings is one of the world's largest manufacturers of aerostructures for commercial airplanes, defense platforms, and business and regional jets. Spirit designs and builds fuselages, pylons, nacelles, and wing components for major aircraft programs including Boeing 737 MAX, 787, and Airbus A350. The company does not publicly expose developer APIs; its digital operations are focused on internal supply chain, manufacturing execution, and enterprise systems.

providers.name: Syapse
providers.description: Syapse was a San Francisco precision-medicine software company, founded in 2008, that built a real-world evidence platform for community oncology. Its product integrated structured clinical data from health-system EHRs with genomic/NGS results to support molecular tumor boards, care coordination, quality improvement and life-sciences research, and it ran the Syapse Learning Health Network of community health systems alongside collaborations with Roche, Amgen and the US Department of Veterans Affairs. Syapse Holdings was acquired by N-Power Medicine in a stock-for-stock exchange that closed 2024-12-30 and was announced 2025-01-12; its network of 1,000+ community oncologists, its data and technology stack, and its team were folded into N-Power Medicine's always-on community clinical-research model. The Syapse brand has since been fully retired: syapse.com now serves nothing but a 292-byte meta-refresh stub redirecting to npowermedicine.com, dated 2025-01-12. Syapse never published a public developer program, and no public API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL contract, SDK or developer portal survives.

providers.name: Synonym
providers.description: Synonym (rebranding to Roebling) is a biomanufacturing infrastructure and finance company founded in 2022 by Edward Shenderovich and Joshua Lachter and backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). It develops, finances, and builds commercial-scale bio-manufacturing facilities to give synthetic biology producers flexible fermentation capacity, and it operates bioproduction tools including a techno-economic modeling suite (TEA/FEL-1/FEL-2 engines) and the Capacitor-powered Match platform that connects clients with production capacity. As of this profile Synonym publishes only a marketing website and private product surfaces; it exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, documentation portal, or /.well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Tekever
providers.description: Tekever is a multinational defence technology company headquartered in Lisbon, Portugal, with operations in the United Kingdom (Bath and a planned large-scale drone production facility in Swindon), France (Toulouse and Cahors), and the United States (Fayetteville, North Carolina). Founded in 2001, the company specialises in AI-driven autonomy for civil and defence missions, with its core business centred on long-endurance Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) used for Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR), maritime surveillance, and electronic warfare. Its flagship platforms include the AR3, a configurable medium-range tactical UAS (designated StormShroud in service with the UK Royal Air Force), the AR5, a SATCOM-enabled long-endurance maritime and land ISR aircraft, and the ARX, a next-generation system positioned as the company's game changer. These platforms are paired with ATLAS, Tekever's real-time intelligence-as-a-service platform that fuses sensor and satellite data into actionable mission intelligence. Tekever drones are operated by the UK Ministry of Defence, the British Army, the Armed Forces of Ukraine (with the UK having committed approximately £270 million in Tekever UAVs for Ukraine since the start of the Russian invasion), the European Maritime Safety Agency under a €30 million contract, the French Ministry of Armed Forces (CNES/DGA), Portugal, and NATO. The company also develops satellite technology and Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) capabilities to extend its intelligence services beyond the airborne domain. Tekever's revenue model is built on government and defence contracts, platform sales, and managed ISR-as-a-service offerings; it does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or open-source release, and engagement with the company is conducted through direct sales, government procurement, and partnership channels.

providers.name: Terranox AI
providers.description: Terranox AI is the first vertically integrated, AI-powered uranium discovery company, founded in 2026 and part of Y Combinator's Winter 2026 batch. The company finds high-grade uranium deposits in North America by training machine learning models on more than seventy years of exploration outcomes locked in thousands of legacy PDFs, drill logs, and hand-drawn geological maps. Traditional uranium exploration has a hit rate below one percent and timelines measured in decades; Terranox aims to raise that hit rate and compress discovery time to help supply the fuel a global nuclear-energy resurgence needs — the world must roughly quadruple uranium production by 2050. Terranox is a private operating company focused on geoscience and mineral exploration and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. It is backed by General Catalyst, 776 Ventures, and Y Combinator.

providers.name: TradeKing
providers.description: TradeKing was a US online brokerage offering commission-based self-directed trading of stocks and options, backed by Battery Ventures. It pioneered one of the first public brokerage APIs, letting developers manage accounts, place equity and options orders, stream real-time market quotes, and manage watchlists over OAuth 1.0. TradeKing was acquired by Ally Financial in 2016 and rebranded as Ally Invest; its API surface lives on as the Ally Invest API (profiled separately as ally-invest in this network). tradeking.com now redirects to ally.com/invest and the historical API hosts no longer resolve. This profile is maintained as a historical record.

providers.name: VXB Aerospace
providers.description: VXB Aerospace is an Australian space technology company founded in 2022 by Alexander Ryan, developing generative design software and Hall-effect plasma propulsion for the satellite market. Its platform automates the design, manufacturability analysis, multi-physics modeling and validation of complex aerospace hardware such as propulsion systems, antennas and satellite layouts, while its ZEPHYR-35 Hall-effect thruster (Argon/Krypton/Xenon) provides in-orbit mobility, refueling, servicing and de-orbiting. The company was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio lead and enriched in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Whole Surplus
providers.description: Whole Surplus (now operating as Fazla) is a Turkish technology-based waste management and circular-economy company backed by Techstars. It prevents waste at its source and recovers surplus products back into the circular economy with maximum environmental, social, and economic benefit across the entire supply chain from producers to consumers. Its platform combines an AI-powered analysis tool that identifies the optimal recovery path for each product with services including Fazla Market (discounted resale), donations to food banks, animal-feed conversion, recycling, a smart-scale detection system, and sustainability consultancy. Fazla is the first B Corp certified waste-management company in Turkey and is supported by the UN Development Programme (UNDP). The company operates a customer web application (app.fazla.com) but publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable specification at this time.

providers.name: ZenGo
providers.description: ZenGo (also styled Zengo) is a consumer, non-custodial keyless cryptocurrency wallet that replaces the traditional seed phrase with MPC (multi-party computation) threshold signatures, splitting the signing key into two independent secret shares so there is no single point of failure or seed phrase to lose. Through its iOS and Android mobile apps and browser extension, users can buy, sell, trade and store Bitcoin, Ethereum and other crypto assets, connect to Web3 dApps and NFTs, and access features such as prediction markets. Founded circa 2018 (formerly KZen Networks) and backed by Insight Partners, the company also publishes open-source MPC and threshold-signature cryptography research through its ZenGo-X GitHub organization. As a consumer wallet product, ZenGo does not currently expose a public developer or product API.

providers.name: ZeroMark
providers.description: ZeroMark is a defense-technology company building an AI-powered targeting system for counter-drone (counter-UAS) defense. Its bolt-on hardware and software components attach to existing weapons, platforms, and sensing systems to detect, track, and neutralize small drone threats in milliseconds while minimizing collateral damage. The product line spans Apex (AI aim-assist for shoulder-mounted rifles), Vanguard (a precision system for turret-mounted and vehicle platforms effective against Group 1-3 drones), and Nexus (a command-and-control software layer that integrates deployments into shared targeting and battlespace-awareness environments). ZeroMark was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, SDK, developer documentation, or open-source presence; its Nexus C2 integration is delivered through defense procurement rather than a public developer program.

providers.name: /dev/agents
providers.description: /dev/agents (homepage sdsa.ai) is building a next-generation operating system for AI agents - a cloud platform, developer tools, and new UI primitives meant to let autonomous agents coordinate work across a user's apps and devices instead of people navigating individual applications. It was founded in 2024 by David Singleton (former Stripe CTO and Google Android VP of Engineering), Hugo Barra, Ficus Kirkpatrick, and Nicholas Jitkoff, and raised a $56M seed round at a $500M valuation led by Index Ventures with CapitalG and Conviction. As of this profile the company is pre-launch: it publishes no public API, SDK, or developer documentation yet, so this API Evangelist entry captures verified company identity and domain posture only.

providers.name: /dev/fast
providers.description: /dev/fast is an AI-native code forge — code review, deployment infrastructure, and hosting rebuilt for the AI era. The product reframes code hosting, review, and CI/CD around software written and shipped by agents: an RFC-style review surface optimized for human taste and judgement, a multi-agent software factory that dispatches, supervises, and merges work from many cloud agents, agent-native CI/CD where the agent writes declarative pipeline code testable locally, and a fine-grained permission system, with every agent run captured and replayable. Founded in 2025, /dev/fast is a Y Combinator Winter 2026 company based in San Francisco, currently invite-only. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a Y Combinator portfolio lead and enriched from its public surface; no public API, developer documentation, or machine-readable specification is published yet.

providers.name: 6thSense
providers.description: 6thSense is a physical-AI hardware company building the touch layer for dexterous robots. It designs and manufactures wearable tactile-sensing data gloves that capture how human hands interact with the world — pressure, contact, grip, and 3D hand pose — alongside custom tactile skin molded to robot hands. Its capture stack synchronizes eight aligned modalities (tactile and pressure proxies, egocentric video, depth/RGB-D, hand pose, motion and IMU dynamics, wrist and scene cameras, dense labels and commentary, and success/failure outcomes) into model-ready demonstration datasets used to train the next generation of dexterous, manipulation-capable robots. Founded in 2026 in San Francisco and backed by Y Combinator (S26).

providers.name: 7k7k
providers.description: 7k7k (7k7k.com) is a Chinese online casual gaming portal operating a consumer-facing website that aggregates hundreds of free browser-based mini games across action, role-playing, strategy, puzzle, and two-player categories. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. The 7k7k property is a consumer web destination and publishes no public developer platform, API, SDK, or developer documentation; enrichment probes confirmed no OpenAPI, no .well-known discovery documents, and no security-disclosure or trust-center program at this time.

providers.name: 88rising
providers.description: 88rising (stylized 88 with a rising arrow) is an American mass media company and record label founded in 2015 by Sean Miyashiro, headquartered in Los Angeles and New York with a division in Shanghai. It describes itself as a hybrid management, record label, video production and marketing company, and is known for building a global platform for Asian and Asian American artists including Rich Brian, NIKI, Joji and Keith Ape. Beyond recorded music it operates the Head in the Clouds festival franchise and the 88 Night Market live and commerce brand. It is a media and entertainment company rather than a software company: it publishes no developer program, no public API documentation and no machine-readable specifications.

providers.name: Aaltosemi
providers.description: AaltoSemi (Chinese name 芯爱科技（南京）有限公司) is an integrated-circuit packaging substrate manufacturer founded on 8 May 2021 and headquartered in the Pukou Economic Development Zone in Nanjing, Jiangsu, China. The company designs and fabricates the organic substrates that carry the electrical connection between a semiconductor die and the printed circuit board, covering both BT and ABF material systems across Coreless, ETS, FCCSP, FCBGA (BT) and FCBGA (ABF) product families for consumer electronics, high-performance computing, communications, automotive and medical applications, and it offers those as an end-to-end service spanning R&D, design, production and test. Its Nanjing fab is a high-automation plant with a stated annual capacity of roughly 1.45 million substrate panels, and the company holds IATF 16949 and VDA 6.3 quality certifications and has filed more than twenty patents since founding. The name is taken from the Finnish designer Alvar Aalto. AaltoSemi is a hardware manufacturer: it sells physical substrates to chip makers and OSATs, and it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: AbCellera
providers.description: AbCellera (NASDAQ: ABCL) is a Vancouver-based antibody discovery and development company that integrates biology, computation, and engineering to develop antibody-based medicines. Its technology platform combines high-throughput single-cell antibody screening, GPCR and ion-channel capabilities, bispecifics, antibody-drug conjugates, structure-based design, and AI for sequence and structure analysis. The company operates a hybrid business model with a co-development partner network (40+ partners and 100+ antibody drug programs since 2015) alongside a growing wholly-owned pipeline that includes ABCL635 (non-hormonal vasomotor symptoms), ABCL575 (atopic dermatitis), ABCL688 (autoimmunity), and ABCL386 (oncology), plus 20+ discovery programs. AbCellera does not publish a public API or developer portal; capabilities are delivered through partner collaborations and contract terms.

providers.name: Aggra
providers.description: Aggra Technologies Private Limited operates Moneytor, an autonomous, self-learning platform for stressed loan recovery. Founded in 2017 in Mumbai, India by Ayush Srivastava and Anubhav Singh, Moneytor delivers debt management, collections, enterprise collections software, and distressed-debt / portfolio purchase solutions to lenders. The SaaS platform applies machine learning and automation to digitize the collections process — automating settlements, offering borrowers customized repayment plans, orchestrating multi-channel borrower communications, tracking overdue accounts, sending automated reminders, and surfacing real-time reporting and analytics — helping lenders collect and liquidate their consumer loan portfolios. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: AI-Prime (Paidao Intelligence)
providers.description: AI-Prime (Paidao Intelligence / 湃道智能) is a Shanghai-based industrial-safety AI company founded in 2017 that builds computer-vision, deep-learning, and knowledge-graph platforms for high-hazard industries. Its full-stack products span an AI industrial-safety monitoring cloud platform, 40+ safety-scenario models (PPE detection, unsafe behavior, equipment leaks, fire/smoke, work-process compliance), a self-learning AI model-development platform, and Prime-Edge smart hardware (edge-computing boxes, inspection robots, AR work mirrors, and edge cameras) serving the chemical, steel, coal, oil & gas, energy, and mining sectors. AI-Prime is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. It is an enterprise B2B provider with no public developer API program; this profile captures its identity and web presence.

providers.name: AirEye
providers.description: AirEye is a wireless airspace security company delivering Wireless Detection and Response (WDR) for enterprise IT and OT environments. Its AI-driven, agentless SaaS platform individually protects every Wi-Fi-enabled asset without isolating it from the network, identifying and classifying devices and wireless interactions, visualizing wireless communications in real time, automatically preventing threats through policy enforcement, and providing forensic analysis of incidents. AirEye addresses unauthorized wireless access, data leakage, network-segmentation circumvention, and device hijacking, with a focus on healthcare providers, defense manufacturers, and general enterprises. The company has been recognized in multiple Gartner market guides for medical device security and operational technology protection. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead; AirEye publishes no public API or developer program at this time.

providers.name: Airside
providers.description: Airside (formerly Airside Mobile) is a digital identity and mobile credential product whose website airsidemobile.com now permanently redirects (HTTP 301) to Entrust's Airside app page, indicating the product and its assets were acquired by Entrust. As of this enrichment pass no public API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, developer portal, or developer documentation surface could be discovered: developer/api/docs subdomains do not resolve and the root domain and /.well-known/security.txt both redirect off-site to Entrust. The company was originally surfaced as a bain-capital-ventures portfolio lead (sector ai-apps) and remains a stub pending any first-party developer program.

providers.name: Allergan
providers.description: Allergan was a global pharmaceutical company that developed, manufactured, and commercialized branded therapeutics, devices, and biologic products across medical aesthetics, eye care, central nervous system, and gastroenterology. The company was the maker of Botox (botulinum toxin), Juvederm (injectable filler), CoolSculpting, Alphagan, Vraylar, Linzess, and Ubrelvy. AbbVie completed its $63 billion acquisition of Allergan in May 2020. The company now operates as Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company. Allergan Data Labs, the digital innovation arm, built the Alle loyalty platform serving over 3 million users across nearly 20,000 medical offices and spas in the US, using machine learning for personalized consumer engagement in medical aesthetics. Allergan Aesthetics does not maintain a public developer API program.

providers.name: Allset
providers.description: Allset is a food pickup and rewards platform (now part of SoundHound AI) that lets consumers order ahead from local restaurants and coffee shops for grab-and-go, curbside, or dine-in service while earning up to 15% cash back. Positioned as an alternative to third-party delivery marketplaces, Allset connects diners directly with participating restaurants across 100+ U.S. cities, and also runs Allset for Teams for corporate meal ordering. It is a consumer mobile application (iOS and Android) with a restaurant partner program; it does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal.

providers.name: Alltricks
providers.description: Alltricks is a French online retailer specializing in cycling, running, and outdoor / mountain-sports equipment. Founded in 2008 and headquartered near Paris in Saint-Cyr-l'Ecole (Yvelines), France, the company sells bikes and frames, components and parts, apparel, footwear, nutrition, and accessories across France and multiple European markets. Alltricks operates as a direct-to-consumer e-commerce storefront at alltricks.fr and was an early Partech portfolio company. As of this pipeline run the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or /.well-known/ discovery surface; this profile captures its identity and the domain-security posture of its production host.

providers.name: Alphora Holdings
providers.description: Alphora (Alphora GmbH / Alphora Holdings) is a Berlin-based, AI-native managed IT services company founded in 2025 and backed by Northzone at the seed stage. Its agentic platform runs IT operations end-to-end for businesses and managed service providers (MSPs) — an integrated IT service desk, managed compliance and documentation, managed AI delivered by forward-deployed engineers, endpoint cybersecurity, user and hardware provisioning, and 24/7 network and cloud monitoring — pairing centralized intelligence with local execution across a shared data lake. The company operates alphora-it.com with a marketing site and active careers portal but does not yet expose a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications.

providers.name: Altair Semiconductor
providers.description: Altair Semiconductor is a fabless semiconductor company that designs low-power, highly integrated cellular IoT chipsets. Its core products are the ALT1250 (a dual-mode LTE-M / NB-IoT modem and SoC with integrated iSIM, MCU and GNSS) and the ALT1350 (a next-generation 5G LPWA SoC that combines LTE-M/NB-IoT, unlicensed-spectrum and satellite NTN connectivity), used in smart meters, asset trackers, wearables, sensors and vehicle telematics. Altair was acquired by Sony in 2016, operated as Sony's cellular IoT unit, and in 2026 was spun back out as an independent company with $50M in funding led by Pitango. This is a hardware/semiconductor provider: it ships chipsets, evaluation kits and datasheets rather than a public developer API, so it carries no OpenAPI, SDK, MCP or developer-portal surface to enrich.

providers.name: Ambros Therapeutics
providers.description: Ambros Therapeutics is a biotechnology company focused on developing innovative therapeutic solutions for serious diseases. Leveraging cutting‑edge research in molecular biology and immunology, Ambros aims to bring novel treatments from discovery through clinical development to patients in need. The company emphasizes robust scientific collaboration, advanced platform technologies, and a commitment to addressing unmet medical needs across oncology, rare diseases, and other critical therapeutic areas.

providers.name: Anchor Finance
providers.description: Anchored Finance is a premier auto finance lender offering quick approvals and funding for used auto loans. With over 50 years of combined experience, the company provides tailored financing solutions to customers, emphasizing speed, reliability, and personalized service across its nationwide network.

providers.name: Angelic
providers.description: Angelic (Angelic: Dark Symphony) is a dark, story-rich cinematic turn-based Strategy-RPG from Angelicore Game Studios, where players lead neo-human angels through tactical missions, impossible choices, and cosmic horror. Originally launched as a Web3 / metaverse gaming project backed by Pantera Capital, the title is now distributed as a premium PC game on Steam and the Epic Games Store. Angelic publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or documentation surface as of this profile; it is a consumer game studio rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Apex Space
providers.description: Apex Space (Apex) is a Los Angeles based satellite manufacturing company that builds productized, configurable spacecraft bus platforms for proliferated constellations across LEO, MEO, and GEO orbital regimes. Apex offers three product lines: Aries (small satellites up to 150 kg payload), Nova (medium satellites up to 300 kg payload), and Comet (large satellites up to 3,000 kg payload), and operates Factory One, a high-rate manufacturing facility in Los Angeles with the capacity to produce more than 200 satellites annually. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network. Apex does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or developer documentation; customers configure satellite platforms through the on-site Configurator and direct sales inquiries.

providers.name: Apla
providers.description: Apla, Inc. (aplahub.com) was an AI-based accounting and bookkeeping platform based in Santa Clara, California, founded in 2023. Aplá targeted early-stage startups and accountants working in QuickBooks Online, offering automated expense categorization, transaction and expense management, bookkeeping, and financial reporting, and shipped a "Vendor Search" Chrome extension that retrieved vendor details inside QuickBooks Online. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. As of this enrichment pass the company appears inactive: the aplahub.com origin is unreachable (HTTP 522/525 behind Cloudflare) and third-party trackers list it as deadpooled. No public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDK surface could be found; the only developer-facing artifact located was the QuickBooks Online Chrome extension.

providers.name: Arcstone
providers.description: Arcstone is a Singapore-based digital manufacturing technology company (founded 2013) that helps enterprises digitalize and gain real-time transparency across their shop floors and supply chains. Its product family spans arc.essentials (a lightweight Manufacturing Execution System for SMEs), arc.ops (a modular, next-generation MES for large enterprises), arc.net (multi-tier supply chain visibility), arc.studio (a low-code enterprise app and integration platform), arc.green (sustainability tracking), and arc.ai (an AI control tower for managed AI workforce deployment). Arcstone serves precision engineering, FMCG, mining, semiconductor, plastics, and biomedical manufacturers, and was named a Gartner Cool Vendor in Manufacturing Operations in 2022. The company is backed by 500 Global. No public API, developer portal, or SDKs are published at this time; this profile carries the identity and infrastructure signals harvested by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Aro Homes
providers.description: Aro Homes is a Mexican construction and remodeling company specializing in new builds, renovations, and detailed architectural projects. Their portfolio showcases residential and commercial works, emphasizing quality craftsmanship and client-focused design. The company provides services from project conception through completion, aiming to transform client visions into reality with integrated design and construction solutions.

providers.name: Aspinity
providers.description: Aspinity is a Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania semiconductor company that develops analog machine learning (AnalogML) technology combining ultra-low-power analog signal processing with machine learning for always-on, battery-operated edge AI event detection and classification. Its analogML processors the AML100 and next-generation AML200 deliver TOPS-level inference in a microwatt power footprint, targeting automotive vehicle-security monitoring, smart-home sensing such as glass-break and water-leak detection, and IoT applications including voice and keyword detection and vibration monitoring. Aspinity is a hardware and semiconductor provider and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile tracks its public web and security posture in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Atomionics
providers.description: Atomionics is a Singapore-based deep-technology company, founded in 2018, that builds quantum sensors for mineral resource exploration and GPS-free navigation. Its Gravio quantum-grade gravity-sensing platform uses cold-atom interferometry to measure tiny gravitational changes and map the Earth's subsurface at high resolution, and its ORE-O AI geologist visualizes complex geologies and mineral deposits in 3D to accelerate exploration for energy-transition resources such as copper, lithium, nickel, graphite and rare earth elements. The company does not currently publish a public API or developer platform; this profile tracks its identity and public web surface within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Attotude
providers.description: AttoTude is a semiconductor and data-center infrastructure company building the first wired terahertz (THz) interconnect for AI and hyperscale networking. Its platform pairs the AttoEngine, an ASIC-based THz radio built on standard CMOS manufacturing, with AttoWire, a low-loss dielectric waveguide that carries 200/400/800 Gbit/s per lane over reaches up to roughly 40 meters, delivering the bandwidth density of optics without the cost, power, and complexity of photonics. Founded to relieve the interconnect bottleneck in everything-to-everything AI clusters, the company has raised roughly $143M across seed, Series A, Series B, and Series C rounds. This is a hardware company with no public API, developer portal, or SDK; the profile below is enriched only with the identity and domain-security facts the pipeline could verify.

providers.name: Audos
providers.description: Audos is a New York-based AI-native startup studio and "publishing house for everyday entrepreneurs," founded in 2024 by Henrik Werdelin and Nicholas Thorne (the team behind Prehype, BarkBox, Ro, and Managed by Q). It helps non-technical solo founders turn expertise into million-dollar AI businesses, giving them AI-powered business-building tools, up to $25,000 in funding, and paid-social distribution in exchange for a ~15% revenue share, aiming to launch startups at massive scale. Audos raised an $11.5M seed round led by True Ventures (with backing from Niklas Zennstrom) and acquired No Cap. Its product surface is a consumer/entrepreneur web platform; the api.audos.com backend is private and auth-gated, with no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Autobutler
providers.description: Autobutler is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of creandum and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: consumer. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Autoscience
providers.description: Autoscience (Autoscience Institute) builds AI systems that train state-of-the-art models for frontier and applied AI labs. The company automates AI research itself, developing agents and infrastructure that design, run, and evaluate machine-learning experiments to accelerate model development and automated scientific discovery. Autoscience is an early-stage AI research company backed by General Catalyst and is hiring engineers, researchers, and designers. It currently publishes a marketing site, a research blog, and a careers page; no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API specifications have been located at this time.

providers.name: AutoTrader.com
providers.description: AutoTrader.com is an American online automotive marketplace headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and owned by Cox Automotive. Launched in 1997, it connects car buyers and sellers by aggregating listings for new, used, and certified pre-owned vehicles from franchise dealers, independent dealers, and private sellers. The site provides vehicle search and comparison, pricing and valuation tools, financing and trade-in estimates, dealer reviews, and lead-generation connections between shoppers and dealerships. It is a consumer-facing marketplace and does not publish a public developer API program; this profile tracks its public web and security posture in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Avanza
providers.description: Avanza is a Swedish online stock broker and financial services platform offering trading, savings, and investment products to private investors. The company provides a modern web and mobile experience, extensive market data, and a range of APIs for account information, trading, and portfolio management. Avanza aims to democratize investing with low fees and user-friendly tools, serving millions of customers across Sweden.

providers.name: Avegant
providers.description: Avegant is an augmented reality display technology company that develops light engine technology bringing high-performance visuals to lightweight AR glasses designed for everyday wear. Its flagship product, the AG-30L2 LED light engine, is described as the world's smallest LED light engine for augmented reality. Avegant is a venture-backed hardware company (a portfolio company of 500 Global) focused on the optical and display components that power the next generation of AR eyewear rather than on a public developer platform. No public API, SDK, or developer documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Avon Products
providers.description: Avon Products is a global manufacturer and marketer of beauty and related products, primarily distributed through a network of independent sales representatives. Founded in 1886 and headquartered in Northampton, UK as Avon International, it was owned by Natura &Co from 2020 until Regent acquired it in January 2026; its corporate site is avonworldwide.com. The North American business (avon.com) was separated in 2016 and has been run as a distinct company.

providers.name: Awavesemi
providers.description: Awavesemi (Awave Semiconductor) is a semiconductor company originally surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. As of the July 2026 enrichment pass, its domain awavesemi.com issues a 301 redirect to https://www.qualcomm.com/data-center, indicating the company and its data-center silicon effort have been absorbed into Qualcomm. Awavesemi publishes no independent developer portal, public API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or MCP surface — it is a hardware/silicon company, not an API provider, so the enrichment pipeline finds no API artifacts to harvest beyond domain-level security posture.

providers.name: Axalta Coating Systems
providers.description: Axalta Coating Systems is a global supplier of liquid and powder coatings for transportation and industrial end-markets, operating through Performance Coatings (refinish and industrial) and Mobility Coatings (light vehicle and commercial vehicle) segments. Brands include Cromax, Spies Hecker, Standox, Imron, and Voltatex. In July 2024 Axalta acquired The CoverFlexx Group from Transtar Holding for $285 million to expand its economy-tier aftermarket coverage in North America. In November 2025 Axalta announced a $17 billion all-stock merger of equals with AkzoNobel that is expected to close in late 2026 or early 2027, forming a coatings company with dual headquarters in Amsterdam and Philadelphia.

providers.name: BANIQL
providers.description: BANIQL CORP. (BANiQL) is developing a sustainable process for selectively extracting nickel and cobalt for use in lithium-ion battery production. Its core technology uses a chemical process to selectively extract nickel and cobalt from raw materials at lower temperatures and atmospheric pressure, producing high-quality nickel at roughly 30% lower cost than High Pressure Acid Leaching (HPAL) with net-zero waste, cutting energy consumption and carbon dioxide emissions by around 80% while repurposing leftover materials into products like fertilizers and construction materials. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; this materials/cleantech company publishes no developer or API surface, so this profile carries company identity and domain-security data only.

providers.name: Bankiom
providers.description: Bankiom is a Dubai-based consumer fintech founded in 2018 by Danny Abla. It began as a UAE/GCC lifestyle neobank offering free virtual prepaid Mastercard cards, multi-bank account aggregation, spending insights, and instant peer transfers through a mobile app across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Kuwait, and Oman. Bankiom has since repositioned as an autonomous AI money agent that securely connects to a user's bank, audits roughly 90 days of transactions, and surfaces the fees, interest, unused rewards, forgotten subscriptions, and expiring loyalty points a customer should not be paying, charging only a capped share of verified savings. It is a consumer-facing application and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: beijingyuanxin
providers.description: beijingyuanxin (Beijing Yuanxin) is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of qiming and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. Its primary domain beijingyuanxin.com is served over HTTPS (TLS 1.3) and 301-redirects to www.yuanxinjituan.com (Yuanxin Group). During this enrichment pass no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface (OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL) was discoverable; the domain answered TLS/DNS security probes, but its content host was not reachable from the probe location. This remains a portfolio lead pending a discoverable API surface.

providers.name: Bellatrixaerospace
providers.description: Bellatrixaerospace is a nascent aerospace technology firm focusing on advanced propulsion systems and satellite deployment services. The company aims to innovate in low Earth orbit access, offering modular launch solutions and in‑space manufacturing capabilities. While currently in early development stages, Bellatrixaerospace seeks partnerships with satellite operators and research institutions to accelerate its technology roadmap and expand its market presence across commercial and governmental sectors.

providers.name: Big Fish Games
providers.description: Big Fish Games is a casual-games publisher and digital storefront offering downloadable and online casual, hidden-object, match-3, puzzle, card, and social-casino titles for Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android. Founded in Seattle in 2002 and now part of Aristocrat's Pixel United, the company distributes thousands of games through its bigfishgames.com storefront and mobile apps. It operates as a consumer-facing games company and does not currently publish a public developer API program, OpenAPI definition, or partner API surface; this profile tracks its public web presence for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Bigger Games
providers.description: Bigger Games is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of index-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: entertainment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: BigScreen
providers.description: Bigscreen is a social virtual-reality company founded in 2014 by Darshan Shankar. Its flagship Bigscreen app lets people watch movies, mirror their Windows PC desktop, play games, and hang out with friends inside shared virtual rooms across major VR platforms. In 2023 the company shipped the Bigscreen Beyond, an ultra-compact, custom-fit OLED PC-VR headset, followed by the Beyond 2 line. Bigscreen is a consumer VR hardware and software company backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and other investors; it does not currently operate a public developer program or REST API. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Bigwaverobotics
providers.description: Bigwaverobotics is a robotics and AI company focused on building physical artificial intelligence solutions for industrial automation. Their platform integrates hardware and software to deliver real-time AI-driven robotics, targeting sectors such as manufacturing, logistics, and smart infrastructure. The company emphasizes a global standard for industrial physical AI, offering products like Marosol and SOLlink to enhance automation efficiency and safety.

providers.name: Billhero
providers.description: Billhero is an Australian energy‑bill management platform that helps households and small businesses understand, track, and reduce their utility costs. Through a suite of tools—including bill upload, usage analytics, and personalized energy‑coach advice—Billhero empowers users to avoid overpaying for electricity and gas, compare tariffs, and stay informed about industry changes. The service also offers a marketplace for energy‑saving products and a community forum for sharing tips.

providers.name: Biplus
providers.description: Biplus is a Vietnam‑based software solutions and IT outsourcing company offering custom software development, Atlassian partnership, AI‑tailored solutions, and consulting services across telecommunications, finance, e‑commerce, and fintech sectors. It provides enterprise‑grade development, personnel outsourcing, and SaaS integration, positioning itself as a trusted partner for digital transformation.

providers.name: Boosters
providers.description: Boosters is a Seoul-based global commerce company and brand aggregator, founded in 2019, that acquires and accelerates the growth of emerging Korean direct-to-consumer (D2C) brands, with a particular focus on K-Beauty. Boosters takes over small and medium-sized Korean brands that have strong product potential but struggle with marketing, distribution, and inventory management, then scales them across domestic and international commerce channels. Portfolio brands include Eqqualberry and Branden. The company raised a USD 10 million Series A round in 2022 with participation from Partech and other investors. Boosters is a consumer commerce operator rather than a developer platform, and does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Boston Metal
providers.description: Boston Metal is an industrial metals and materials company founded in 2013 and headquartered in Woburn, Massachusetts, with a wholly owned subsidiary and commercial plant in Brazil. The company commercializes Molten Oxide Electrolysis (MOE), a one-step electrochemical process that uses clean electricity rather than fossil fuels to reduce iron ore into liquid metal, producing steel with no direct CO2 emissions, and to recover high-value critical metals such as niobium and tantalum from low-grade ore and mining waste. Boston Metal commissioned a multi-inert-anode industrial MOE cell at its Woburn facility and has raised over $500 million from investors including Tata Steel. Boston Metal is a physical process-technology and manufacturing company; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI definition, developer portal, or machine-readable contract of any kind. This profile captures its public web, corporate, and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Botanical Solution
providers.description: Botanical Solution provides advanced botanical data integration services, offering APIs that deliver plant taxonomy, phytochemical composition, and cultivation insights for agritech, research, and wellness applications. Their platform aggregates curated botanical datasets, enabling developers to build applications that require accurate plant identification, health benefits analysis, and supply chain traceability. By focusing on data quality and comprehensive coverage, Botanical Solution aims to support innovative solutions in agriculture, pharmaceuticals, and consumer products.

providers.name: Brickbolt
providers.description: Brickbolt Engineering provides structural and civil engineering services worldwide, offering design, BIM modeling, and consulting for industries such as oil & gas, steel plants, and construction. Their expertise spans structural design, pipe rack engineering, conveyor systems, and façade engineering, delivering high‑precision solutions to contractors and fabricators.

providers.name: Bright Horizons Family Solutions
providers.description: Bright Horizons Family Solutions Inc. (NYSE: BFAM) is the largest provider of employer-sponsored child care in the United States, headquartered in Newton, Massachusetts and founded in 1986 by Linda Mason and Roger Brown. The company operates more than 1,000 early-education and child-care centers across the US, UK, Netherlands, and India, serving roughly 1,450 employer clients through three core lines: Full Service Center-Based Child Care (on-site and near-site centers for employer-sponsored families), Back-Up Care (last-minute child, adult/elder, and pet care via in-home and in-center networks), and Educational Advisory Services. The Educational Advisory segment is anchored by EdAssist by Bright Horizons (tuition assistance, student loan repayment, and workforce education administration covering 257 employer clients, 4.7 million eligible learners, and more than $1 billion in education and loan payments administered annually), College Coach (college admissions coaching delivered as an employee benefit), and Sittercity (consumer caregiver marketplace acquired in 2020 and offered through corporate benefits). Bright Horizons sells exclusively to enterprise HR and benefits buyers — 72 of the Fortune 1000's top 100 companies use EdAssist — and does not publish public APIs, SDKs, a developer portal, status page, or a public GitHub organization. The brighthorizons GitHub org exists but contains zero public repositories. This profile documents the corporate structure, segment portfolio, and employer-benefit positioning of a child-care and family-benefits operator that runs a closed B2B technology stack with no third-party developer surface.

providers.name: BRKZ
providers.description: BRKZ is a Saudi Arabian construction-technology company operating a B2B online marketplace for building materials and construction equipment. Positioned as a top online building materials store in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), the platform connects contractors and construction businesses with material suppliers, streamlining procurement and offering nationwide delivery across Saudi Arabia. The bilingual (Arabic and English) storefront lets buyers source construction supplies online, and the company is backed by 500 Global among its investors. This profile was enriched from BRKZ's public web presence; the company runs a private, authenticated API host (api.brkz.com) but does not publish a public developer program, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Caesars Entertainment
providers.description: Caesars Entertainment is the largest U.S. casino-entertainment company, operating over 50 gaming facilities, hotels, restaurants, and entertainment venues across the country and internationally. The company operates the Caesars Rewards loyalty program and offers gaming, hospitality, dining, entertainment, meetings and conventions, and retail experiences.

providers.name: Cambrio
providers.description: Cambrio is a manufacturing software company, now a Sandvik-owned brand, that develops CAD/CAM software for CNC programming and digital manufacturing. Its portfolio spans GibbsCAM for CNC milling and turning, SigmaNEST for nesting and material optimization, and Cimatron for integrated tooling and mold design. Cambrio serves the automotive, aerospace, medical, electronics, and general manufacturing industries. It was a Battery Ventures portfolio company before being acquired by Sandvik AB in 2021. Cambrio is desktop/on-premises manufacturing software and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: CardMonster
providers.description: CardMonster turns ideas and brands into games. The company designs and publishes premium IP-based tabletop titles with global partners such as Disney and Krafton, and builds CardMonster Forge, an AI-powered tool that helps creators turn their own ideas into playable digital prototypes. From physical board games to an online playtesting platform, CardMonster connects creativity and technology to make game creation faster, smarter, and more accessible. Backed by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass CardMonster publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification; this profile captures company identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Cargon Tech
providers.description: Cargon Tech B.V. is a supply-chain and logistics technology company backed by 500 Global. Its public presence at cargon.com positions Cargon as a fast, innovative supply-chain platform with powerful analytical tools for shippers and carriers, while the related Cargon TMS product (cargon.tech) offers a cloud transport-management system for small carriers and freight forwarders covering dispatch, fleet management, invoicing and Timocom integration. No public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, or /.well-known discovery surface was found during enrichment (the cargon.com site is a client-rendered single-page app that returns its index shell for unknown paths), so this profile currently carries identity and domain-security signal only.

providers.name: Carr, Riggs & Ingram (CRI)
providers.description: Carr, Riggs & Ingram (CRI) is a top-25 nationally ranked accounting and advisory firm headquartered in Alabama, operating 70+ locations across 13 states plus Mexico. The firm delivers audit and attest, tax, and advisory services (cybersecurity, fraud and forensics, valuations, and transaction advisory) to more than 18 industries, alongside value add-on subsidiaries including CRI Advanced Analytics, CRI CFO Hub, and CRI M&A Advisors, and is a member of PrimeGlobal. It was surfaced via the VC-portfolio pipeline and enriched here; note that criadv.com is a professional-services accounting firm, not a Bessemer-backed fintech startup, so the portfolio-lead tagging is a domain false-positive. No public API, developer portal, or documentation surface exists.

providers.name: Carsome
providers.description: Carsome is Southeast Asia's largest integrated used-car e-commerce platform, founded in 2015 and headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, with operations across Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, and Singapore. The company runs an online marketplace where consumers can sell, buy, and finance pre-owned vehicles, combining a consumer-facing storefront with B2B dealer auctions, vehicle inspection and certification, logistics, insurance, and financing services. Carsome is a venture-backed technology company (a regional unicorn) counted among the portfolio of 500 Global. No public developer program, API documentation, or API surface has been found; this profile remains a company/lead record awaiting any published API.

providers.name: CatalYm
providers.description: CatalYm GmbH is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in Planegg-Martinsried near Munich, Germany, developing next-generation cancer immunotherapies. Its lead approach neutralizes GDF-15 (Growth Differentiation Factor 15) to reverse a key immune-resistance mechanism in solid tumors, aiming to reinstate anti-tumor immune activity and overcome resistance to checkpoint-inhibitor and other cancer therapies. The company is a portfolio company of Canaan Partners. This is a biotech/pharmaceutical organization with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile rather than an API provider.

providers.name: cehome
providers.description: cehome (铁甲工程机械网, "Tiejia") is a Chinese digital platform for the construction and engineering machinery industry, operated at cehome.com and m.cehome.com. It is a professional information hub and community serving equipment owners, operators, dealers, and manufacturers: industry news and price data, product reviews, buying guides and detailed product listings across brands (Sany, Caterpillar, Komatsu, Doosan, and others) and equipment types (excavators, loaders, bulldozers, cranes), a used-machinery marketplace, operator job listings, and the active 铁甲论坛 community forum. cehome is a consumer/community web platform rather than an API provider; it publishes no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or programmatic API surface. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Chickin
providers.description: Chickin is an Indonesian poultry-technology company operating a full-stack, integrated ecosystem for chicken farmers across Indonesia. It combines closed-house smart-farming hardware (IoT climate and environmental controllers), day-old-chick and feed supply, farmer financing, and guaranteed offtake and distribution of live birds, aiming to modernize and de-risk small and mid-scale poultry farming. Backed by 500 Global, Chickin runs its operations through a mobile and web application at chickin.id. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts; this profile records its public web presence and domain-security posture and remains a lead for further enrichment should a developer surface be published.

providers.name: Ciridae
providers.description: Ciridae is building an AI-native operating system for services businesses — the industrial, construction, and field-service companies that make up the real economy. Its platform replaces fragmented ERPs and spreadsheets with a unified system that automates core business operations across project management, financials, CRM, accounts payable and receivable, and reporting, while keeping humans in the loop to oversee AI decisions. Modules span AI-generated field workforce scheduling, vendor onboarding and compliance, automated payment workflows, and customer order expediting, typically deployed in a two-to-four-week implementation with embedded engineers. Founded in 2025 and based in San Francisco, Ciridae is backed by Accel. The company does not currently publish a public API, developer documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: CIX Technology
providers.description: CIX Technology (此芯科技) is a Chinese fabless semiconductor company founded in 2021 that designs high-performance, general-purpose heterogeneous intelligent CPU chips for AI computing. The company builds low-power, high-efficiency compute platforms spanning personal computing (PC), vehicle/automotive computing, and edge computing, and partners across the Arm ecosystem (Arm, Arm China, Lenovo and others). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm qiming and added to the API Evangelist network. CIX is a silicon/hardware company and publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal at this time; this profile captures its verifiable public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Clairity
providers.description: Clairity Technology Inc. is a Los Angeles based climate-tech company building gigaton-scale carbon dioxide removal using Direct Air Capture (DAC) paired with ex-situ mineralization. Their approach removes CO2 from the atmosphere with readily available, inexpensive chemicals and standard construction materials to produce concentrated CO2 streams for permanent removal and storage. Clairity operates Project Juniper, a live carbon-removal facility in Southern Nevada, and raised a $6.75M seed round in 2024. As a hardware and carbon-removal operator the company publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Clarity
providers.description: Clarity (clarity.fm) is an on-demand business advice marketplace that connects entrepreneurs and startup founders with a curated network of vetted experts, advisors, and industry leaders for paid, one-on-one phone consultations booked by the minute. Founded by Dan Martell and now part of the Startups.co family, Clarity lets members search experts by topic, schedule calls, and pay per-minute for coaching on fundraising, marketing, sales, product, and growth. As of this enrichment pass Clarity publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures the company's identity and a live domain-security probe of clarity.fm.

providers.name: Colony Capital (DigitalBridge Group)
providers.description: Colony Capital was a diversified real estate and hospitality investment firm founded by Tom Barrack in 1991. In June 2021 the company rebranded as DigitalBridge Group, Inc. (NYSE: DBRG) — completing a multi-year pivot from traditional real estate to pure-play digital infrastructure investing. The Boca Raton, FL-based alternative asset manager now operates exclusively across five digital infrastructure categories: data centers, macro cell towers, fiber networks, small cells, and edge infrastructure. DigitalBridge manages approximately $119B in assets across 45+ portfolio companies including Vantage Data Centers, DataBank, Switch, Vertical Bridge, Zayo Group, GD Towers, Boingo Wireless, AtlasEdge, Scala Data Centers, Yondr Group, and ExteNet Systems. In December 2025 SoftBank Group announced a definitive agreement to acquire DigitalBridge for approximately $4 billion, with the deal expected to close in the second half of 2026. DigitalBridge itself publishes no developer API, SDK, or public OpenAPI surface — it is a holding company whose programmable surface lives inside its individual portfolio companies (e.g., Zayo, DataBank, Switch), each of which is profiled separately in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Commoncomputer
providers.description: Common Computer provides reliable IT support services for homes and businesses, offering solutions ranging from network setup and cybersecurity to cloud migration and on‑site troubleshooting. Founded to deliver trustworthy technology assistance, the company emphasizes rapid response, skilled technicians, and personalized service, ensuring clients can focus on their core activities without IT disruptions.

providers.name: ComparaOnline
providers.description: ComparaOnline is a Latin American digital marketplace and licensed insurance broker that lets consumers compare and buy insurance and financial products in one place. Operating in Chile (comparaonline.cl), Brazil (comparaonline.com.br) and Colombia (comparaonline.com.co), it aggregates offers for auto insurance, mandatory SOAP accident insurance, travel, life, health and pet insurance alongside financial products such as mortgage, auto and consumer loans, credit cards and checking accounts. Its Chilean brokerage, Compara Online Corredora de Seguros SpA, is supervised by the Comision para el Mercado Financiero (CMF), and the company earns revenue as a broker collecting premiums and by referring users to partner banks and insurers. ComparaOnline is a fintech/insurtech portfolio company of Ribbit Capital. No public developer API or specification is currently published; this profile captures the company's public identity and web surface.

providers.name: Consolidated Edison
providers.description: Consolidated Edison, Inc. (NYSE: ED) is a Fortune 500 utility holding company headquartered in New York City. It publishes no APIs of its own; it operates through its regulated subsidiaries, principally Consolidated Edison Company of New York (CECONY), which serves electric, gas and steam customers in New York City and Westchester County, and Orange and Rockland Utilities (O&R), along with Con Edison Transmission. The developer surface - Green Button Connect My Data (Share My Data) and Green Button Download My Data, both served from coned.com - belongs to CECONY and is profiled under the con-edison provider. This profile covers the holding company only.

providers.name: Coolant
providers.description: Coolant (Coolant Climate, Inc.) is a climate-technology startup building AI-powered forest monitoring and carbon measurement from consumer-grade drone imagery. Its "3D spatial intelligence" platform reconstructs high-resolution 3D forest models from ordinary drone footage (DJI Mini, Mavic) and applies computer vision to measure biomass, tree height, diameter at breast height (DBH), tree counts, species, and growth rates — delivering LiDAR-grade accuracy at a fraction of the cost. The company positions this as the measurement, reporting, and verification (MRV) layer for scalable, verifiable carbon removal, reforestation success tracking, and conservation planning. Coolant raised a $4.3M seed round from General Catalyst and Floodgate in October 2025. As of this profile the company operates a marketing site, a demo web application, and a technical blog, but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Copilot
providers.description: GitHub Copilot is an AI‑powered coding assistant that suggests whole lines or functions in real time, integrates with popular IDEs, and offers a CLI for automation. It helps developers write code faster, learn new APIs, and adopt best practices, with support for multiple programming languages and enterprise governance features.

providers.name: Corteva
providers.description: Corteva Agriscience is a publicly traded, Fortune 500 global pure-play agriculture company that provides farmers around the world with one of the most complete portfolios in the industry, including a balanced and diverse mix of seed, crop protection, and digital products. Corteva was formed as the spinoff of the agriculture division of DowDuPont in June 2019. The company markets seeds under the Pioneer, Brevant, and other brands and crop protection products including herbicides, fungicides, insecticides, and biologicals. Corteva also operates Granular, a farm management software platform with insights and analytics products. A public developer API is not currently published; growers access tools through the Granular Insights and Granular Link platforms.

providers.name: Cosmart
