providers.description: Cosmart is an Indonesian membership-only B2B e-commerce and procurement platform, founded in 2021 by Alvin Kumarga and Robert Tan, where members (individuals and SMEs) purchase their recurring daily and business needs in larger quantities at competitive prices. The platform lists over 100,000 products across categories including office supplies, electronics, household items, automotive parts, industrial equipment, furniture, and services, with nationwide delivery, flexible payment terms, and dedicated relationship managers for corporate clients. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Lightspeed India Partners. Cosmart does not publish a public developer program, API, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Cove
providers.description: Cove is a visual workspace for thinking with AI — an AI collaborator that works alongside you on projects big and small in a spatial, canvas-style interface rather than a linear chat. The product pairs an on-screen agent that can search the web, write and run code, and cite sources with a flexible visual surface for organizing ideas, and it ships an accompanying Chrome browser extension. Cove is a consumer/prosumer application backed by the venture firm Homebrew; as of this profile it does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer documentation. This entry tracks Cove in the API Evangelist network, with domain-security posture captured by the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Cover
providers.description: Cover (Cover Technologies Inc.) is a Los Angeles-based construction technology company that designs and builds custom, architect-grade backyard homes, accessory dwelling units (ADUs), and residential spaces using a prefabricated, factory-manufactured building system. Cover handles the full development process end to end, from initial consultation and design through permitting, manufacturing, and on-site installation, delivering custom spaces in weeks rather than years. The company is a venture-backed portfolio company of General Catalyst. Cover is a physical-product homebuilder and does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures verifiable company identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Crmbônus
providers.description: Crmbônus is a Brazilian SaaS company offering a suite of tools for retail businesses to attract, convert, and retain customers through loyalty programs, cashback, conversational commerce, and retail media solutions. Their platform integrates with WhatsApp, e‑commerce, and ERP systems, providing analytics, campaigns, and member management to boost sales and customer engagement across multiple channels.

providers.name: Crossbar
providers.description: Crossbar, Inc. is a Santa Clara semiconductor company founded in 2010 that develops resistive random-access memory (ReRAM), a non-volatile memory built on RRAM patents licensed from the University of Michigan. Its CMOS-compatible ReRAM targets faster write performance, lower power consumption, and higher endurance than NAND flash at roughly half the die size, and is offered as embedded and standalone memory IP to OEMs and system-on-chip developers across consumer, mobile, enterprise, industrial, and IoT markets. Crossbar is a hardtech portfolio company backed by Kleiner Perkins. As a silicon-IP provider it exposes no public developer API surface; this profile carries company identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Crossfit
providers.description: CrossFit is a fitness brand and training methodology built around constantly varied, high-intensity functional movements that combine strength, conditioning, gymnastics, and weightlifting. The organization operates a global network of independently owned affiliate gyms, delivers a coaching certification and education program (the Level 1 through Level 4 courses and specialty seminars), and produces the annual CrossFit Games competition season. CrossFit was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes a consumer and affiliate web presence (gym finder, courses, store, Games results) but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API definition.

providers.name: CrowdAnalytix
providers.description: CrowdAnalytix (CAX) is a crowdsourced data science and predictive analytics platform that connects enterprises with a global community of data scientists to build, test, and compare machine learning models through hosted modeling competitions. The company runs prediction and classification contests across industries such as consumer packaged goods, retail, banking, insurance, and healthcare, and has extended into AI/ML model development, data annotation and labeling, and packaged AI solutions. Headquartered in Frisco, Texas with operations in Bangalore, India, CrowdAnalytix is backed by Accel.

providers.name: Cvachip
providers.description: Cvachip (曦华科技) is a Chinese semiconductor company specializing in AI scaler chips, microcontrollers, and smart sensor solutions for automotive and IoT applications. Their products include AI Scaler ASICs, TMCU-CVM series MCUs, and smart display and touch chips, targeting high‑performance, low‑power edge AI deployments. The company emphasizes safety‑critical standards such as ISO26262 and offers comprehensive hardware and software integration services.

providers.name: Daivin
providers.description: DAIVIN! is a deep-tech hardware company (Y Combinator Winter 2026, based in San Francisco and Finland) building tankless diving technology. Its core product, SPRING, is marketed as the "world's first tankless diving technology": instead of carrying heavy pressurized oxygen tanks, a diver wears a lightweight vest of electrolyzers and a battery belt that use electricity to split water on demand into breathable oxygen (O2) and hydrogen (H2), targeting depths up to 200 meters / 650 ft. Founder Leo Kankkunen frames breathing as "fundamentally an energy problem," and the company envisions applications beyond recreational and professional diving across space exploration, high-altitude rescue, hospitals, and aircraft. Added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-capital portfolio lead surfaced via y-combinator. Daivin runs a conceptual marketing website (Wix) and a news blog; it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or other machine-readable developer surface, so no API artifacts apply to this provider.

providers.name: DCS-Touristik (DCS Travel)
providers.description: DCS-Touristik GmbH, trading as DCS Travel (dcs.travel), is a German river- and sea-cruise operator based in Nagel, Germany. The company organizes river cruises on major European waterways — primarily the Danube and the Rhine — as well as sea cruises along the Croatian coast, operating its own vessels including the DCS Amethyst 1 and DCS Amethyst 2. Its business is direct consumer travel booking: multi-day cruise packages (roughly 3 to 12 days), organized transfers and shore excursions, themed sailings, travel-insurance partnerships, and early-booking discounts. This is a consumer-facing tourism brand with no public developer program, API, SDK, or developer documentation. It was originally added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio stub; that classification appears to be a false match (the "early-bird" cruise discount wording rather than the Earlybird venture firm), and no API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Dingdong Maicai
providers.description: Dingdong Maicai (叮咚买菜), operated by Shanghai Yibai Mi Network Technology Co., Ltd., is a Chinese on-demand fresh grocery e-commerce and delivery platform. It runs a mobile-app marketplace for fresh produce, meat, seafood, prepared foods, and daily groceries, backed by a network of front-line neighborhood micro-fulfillment stations that enable fast, same-hour delivery in major Chinese cities. The company is publicly listed on the NYSE (ticker DDL) and was backed by SoftBank Vision Fund. It is a consumer-facing operation with no public developer program or open API surface; this profile is a network lead maintained by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Discovered Materials
providers.description: Discovered Materials (legally matforge inc) is a Y Combinator-backed (Spring 2026) startup based in San Francisco building AI scientists for the semiconductor industry. The company uses swarms of AI agents to run the full materials-discovery pipeline - generating candidate materials, synthesizing them, and testing them in physical laboratories - to find novel materials for datacenters and fabrication facilities. Their stated goal is to compress a process that traditionally takes 10+ years of lab work into months, targeting 10x-better alternatives for applications such as nanoscale interconnects. Founded by Akash Ramdas (Stanford materials-science PhD/postdoc) and Advaith Sridhar (Carnegie Mellon AI, formerly Luma Labs and Persona AI). At the time of profiling the company exposes no public API, developer portal, or documentation; this entry is an enrichment lead maintained in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Distributedspectrum
providers.description: Distributed Spectrum, self-described as "The World's First AI Signals Expert," builds edge-AI radio-frequency sensing technology that detects and identifies RF signals to autonomously map threats without expensive hardware or trained operators. Its sensors process data locally to deliver real-time alerts on threat types such as tactical radios, GPS jammers, and drones, and can be deployed anywhere using commercial components to form distributed detection networks. The company is headquartered at 99 Madison Ave, New York, NY, raised a $25M Series A, and is a Felicis portfolio company. No public API or developer program is published at this time; this profile carries the identity and domain-security posture surfaced by the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Djoin
providers.description: Samastha Synergy Pte. Ltd. operates Djoin (djoin.id), positioning itself as a "digital partner for sustainable scale" that helps financial institutions and organizations in Indonesia grow through an adaptive product ecosystem. Djoin's named products are Coopmax (a platform aimed at cooperatives / koperasi), Kocek, and ProofyLink. The company runs a private backend API at api.djoin.id, which sits behind Cloudflare and returns 403 to unauthenticated requests; as of this profile there is no public developer portal, OpenAPI/Swagger definition, documentation, or SDK surface published. Samastha Synergy was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; this profile captures what is publicly verifiable from the djoin.id site and DNS/TLS probes.

providers.name: Dverse
providers.description: Dverse is the API Evangelist network profile for Symmetry Dimensions Inc. (株式会社SYMMETRY), a Tokyo-based technology company whose "DVERSE" digital-twin lineage evolved into a portfolio of DX solution services, infrastructure operations and maintenance support (インフラ維持管理支援), and SDTC data services. The company was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the network as an enrichment lead. The branded domain symmetry-dimensions.com now redirects to the company's live site at symmetry-inc.co.jp. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a corporate/marketing site (a Nuxt single-page app on Google Cloud) but no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, CLI, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface — so no machine-readable API artifacts could be harvested. This record therefore carries company identity plus a probed domain-security profile only, and remains a lead awaiting a public API surface.

providers.name: Eaze
providers.description: Eaze is a California-based cannabis marketplace and delivery platform that connects licensed dispensaries and cannabis brands with adult consumers, offering online ordering and same-day delivery of flower, edibles, vapes, and related products across the state. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in San Francisco, Eaze operates a consumer marketplace plus a technology and logistics stack for compliant retail. Backed by 500 Global and DCM Ventures, it was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead. Eaze does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal; its api.eaze.com host is an internal, bot-protected surface.

providers.name: Ebates
providers.description: Ebates is a consumer cash-back and rebate shopping platform founded in 2000 in San Francisco that pays members a percentage of their purchases back as cash when they shop through its links at thousands of partner retailers. Rakuten acquired Ebates in 2014 and rebranded the U.S. service as Rakuten Rewards in 2019; the ebates.com domain now redirects to rakuten.com. The business is a consumer-facing rewards and affiliate-commerce brand and does not operate an independent public developer API program. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: eBureau
providers.description: eBureau was a predictive analytics and big-data scoring company founded in 2004 and headquartered in St. Cloud, Minnesota, providing real-time predictive scores, identity verification, and fraud-prevention products (eScore, eIDverifier, eIDcompare) to lenders, insurers, and marketers. eBureau was acquired by TransUnion in December 2015 and its capabilities were absorbed into TransUnion's fraud and identity solutions; the ebureau.com domain remains live (behind Cloudflare) but exposes no independent public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API specification. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Redpoint Ventures and enriched with a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: EDGE Sound Research
providers.description: EDGE Sound Research is an audio technology company building intelligent audio infrastructure, as stated by its own tagline. Backed by Techstars, the company operates from edgesoundresearch.com. As of this enrichment pass no public developer portal, API, SDK, CLI, MCP server, or machine-readable specification (OpenAPI/AsyncAPI) was found on its web presence, and the site is a fully client-rendered Next.js application. This profile captures the company's identity and web/domain security posture within the API Evangelist network pending any future developer surface.

providers.name: EdgeQ
providers.description: EdgeQ is a fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Santa Clara, California, building a converged "Base Station-on-a-Chip" that integrates 5G, 6G, non-terrestrial network (NTN), custom waveform, CPU, and antenna-controller functions into a single software-defined silicon platform. Its programmable baseband targets small cells, private enterprise 5G, open RAN, satellite (LEO/MEO) communications, and AI-enabled physical devices. EdgeQ is a hardware and silicon provider surfaced as a portfolio company of Threshold Ventures; it publishes a corporate site, a 5G engineering blog, newsroom, and careers, but exposes no public developer portal, API, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Ellis Coffee Company
providers.description: Ellis Coffee Company is a Philadelphia-based wholesale coffee roaster founded in 1854 and now in its fourth generation of family ownership. Ellis supplies coffee, tea, hot chocolate, brewing equipment, and POS materials to restaurants, hotels, resorts, office coffee service (OCS) programs, convenience stores, universities, distributors, and vending operators. Customers place and manage orders through deliver.elliscoffee.com and request brewing equipment service through the OnUpkeep portal. Ellis Coffee Company does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, webhook program, SDK, or status page.

providers.name: Enfabrica
providers.description: Enfabrica is a semiconductor company building networking silicon and systems for large-scale AI and accelerated-computing infrastructure. Its ACF-S ("Accelerated Compute Fabric") SuperNIC targets maximum throughput with fault-tolerant, multipath connectivity across AI clusters, and its EMFASYS elastic memory fabric system provides memory offload for AI inference workloads. Enfabrica is backed by Spark Capital. The company publishes a technical blog and company news, but does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal, so this profile carries company identity and domain-security signals rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Enviri (formerly Harsco)
providers.description: Enviri Corporation, formerly known as Harsco Corporation, is a trusted global leader in environmental solutions, developing and refining methods of recycling and beneficial reuse for industrial customers. Enviri operates through three divisions: Clean Earth (hazardous waste management and recycling), Harsco Environmental (services to the global steel industry), and Harsco Rail (rail-track maintenance equipment and services). Enviri does not currently publish a public developer portal or open APIs.

providers.name: EraDrive
providers.description: EraDrive is a space technology company building compact, AI-powered self-driving modules that give spacecraft onboard autonomy — vision-based navigation, control, collision avoidance, and situational awareness computed at the edge. A Stanford Space Rendezvous Laboratory (SLAB) spinoff founded by Sumant Sharma (CEO), Justin Kruger (CTO), and Prof. Simone D'Amico (CSO), EraDrive integrates flight-proven autonomy software with existing satellite infrastructure for space traffic management, on-orbit servicing and logistics, and advanced remote sensing across commercial and defense missions. The company closed an oversubscribed $5.3M seed round in December 2025, co-led by Haystack Ventures with participation from Point Nine, Harpoon Ventures, Brave Capital, 2100 VC, and Entropy Industrial Capital. As an early-stage hardware/software company, EraDrive currently publishes no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Everest
providers.description: Everest is an early-stage Y Combinator (Fall 2025 / F25) startup based in San Francisco building agent-ready technical support for developer tools. Its premise is that a growing share of a devtool's users will be coding agents rather than humans, and Everest helps devtool companies sell to and support those coding agents with instant technical support. The company was founded in 2026 by co-founders Yolanda Cao and Spencer McKee. As of this profile Everest operates a single marketing landing page (everestagi.com) with no public API, developer documentation, SDKs, or other developer surface yet published; this record is maintained as a lead for the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Fabric Cryptography
providers.description: Fabric Cryptography (legal entity Fabric of Truth, Inc.) is a Santa Clara, California semiconductor company founded in 2022 that builds the Verifiable Processing Unit (VPU) — a custom silicon chip whose instruction set is designed exclusively for the mathematical building blocks of modern cryptography. The VPU combines the programmability of a GPU with the performance of an ASIC: hundreds of number-theory units for 32-bit to 384-bit modular arithmetic, custom hash instructions, software-controlled scratchpad memory, a non-blocking network-on-chip, and an on-chip multi-core RISC-V processor for native witness generation. Products announced are the FC 1000 chip, the VPU 8060 card (three FC 1000 chips, ~1 TB/s memory bandwidth to 30 GB) and the "Byte Smasher" server (up to eight VPU 8060 cards). Software is an LLVM-based compiler plus a reconfigurable library of primitives targeting plonky2, plonky3, GKR, halo2, Jolt/Lasso, Nova and TFHE, with a stated future cloud offering. The company raised $33M in 2024 from Blockchain Capital, 1kx, Inflection and Protocol Labs, and has announced collaborations with Polygon Labs (AggLayer) and RISC Zero (Boundless). As of this pass Fabric publishes no developer program, API, SDK registry package or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Fern Bot
providers.description: Fern (operating as Ishiki Labs) is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) physical-AI startup building high-fidelity, custom robot world models that let robotics companies evaluate and train their robot policies at scale in software. Fern provides plug-and-play reinforcement-learning environments generated from a foundational world model: robotics teams seed varied starting scenes from their production environments, test and improve policies entirely in simulation, and Fern generates RL heads on top of existing policies to raise speed and success rates — a continual-learning flywheel where production robots improve every week. Founded in 2025 by CEO Amit Yadav (ex-Meta LLaMA / Reality Labs research scientist) and CTO Robert Xu (ex-Meta Reality Labs and Citadel Securities). As of this profile Fern publishes a marketing site, a whitepaper, and case studies but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Firnas Aero
providers.description: Firnas Aero is a Saudi Arabian deep-tech startup building autonomous Drone-in-a-Box (DiaB) systems for aerial surveillance, industrial inspection, and environmental assessment. Its turnkey platform pairs self-charging, robotic battery-swapping drone stations with cloud-based remote management over 5G, Ethernet, or Wi-Fi, and applies machine-learning and deep-learning models for anomaly detection, Foreign Object Debris (FOD) detection, hazard identification, and geo-location. Based at KRTP HQ in Thuwal, Saudi Arabia, the company serves infrastructure, energy, and security clients including Red Sea Global, NEOM, and the Saudi Electricity Company, and is backed by 500 Global. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Flock
providers.description: Flock is a London-based commercial motor and fleet insurtech that provides usage-based, data-driven insurance for businesses operating vehicle fleets. Using real-time telematics and data science, Flock prices risk dynamically and rewards safer driving with lower premiums, delivering connected fleet insurance through a digital platform and partner integrations. The company is backed by Anthemis and other investors and operates primarily in the United Kingdom. This API Evangelist profile tracks Flock's public developer and company surface; as of this enrichment pass Flock publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: FM (FM Global)
providers.description: FM (formerly FM Global) is a mutual insurance company specializing in commercial and industrial property insurance, loss prevention engineering, and risk management research. FM operates through six business units including FM, FM Affiliated, FM Approvals, FM Boiler Re, FM Cargo, and FM Renewable Energy, and is one of the largest commercial property insurers in the world. This repository tracks the FM (fm.com) entity and any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts. The abbreviation "FM" is also used in unrelated contexts (Facilities Management, FM radio broadcasting, financial management); this repository is scoped to the FM Global commercial property insurer that owns the fm.com domain. No public APIs or developer programs are currently published.

providers.name: FMC Technologies (now TechnipFMC)
providers.description: FMC Technologies was a Houston-based energy services and equipment company serving the upstream oil and gas industry, particularly subsea, surface, and measurement solutions for hydrocarbon production. In January 2017 FMC Technologies completed its merger with Technip to form TechnipFMC, a global energy services company serving the subsea, surface, and offshore project markets. This repository tracks the legacy FMC Technologies brand and any successor APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts associated with the merged TechnipFMC entity. No public APIs or developer programs are currently published.

providers.name: Foaster
providers.description: Foaster is an AI transformation consultancy that bills itself as "the AI-native McKinsey." Founded in 2026 by Raphael Dabadie and Alexandre Combes and backed by Y Combinator, it deploys AI agents that interview a company's employees at scale, map how work actually gets done, identify bottlenecks and AI opportunities, and draft a transformation roadmap in about two weeks, with expert consultants reviewing the outputs and feeding their corrections back into the system. Its offerings span an AI Transformation Assessment, Continuous AI Transformation with monthly adoption tracking, and Enterprise Deployment backed by forward-deployed engineers. Foaster is a managed professional-services company and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or other developer-facing technical surface.

providers.name: Foreword Fund
providers.description: Foreword Fund is an early-stage venture capital firm led by solo general partner Declan Kelly, backing daring founders in their first chapters. Foreword writes first checks of up to $250,000 at the pre-seed and seed stage, partnering with roughly ten exceptionally focused teams each year across B2B software, fintech, crypto, enterprise software, AI, marketplaces, and consumer sectors in the US and Europe. A partner fund of Seedcamp, its portfolio spans 40-plus companies including unicorns Sorare, Jeeves, and Localyze.

providers.name: Formally
providers.description: Formally is an AI-native platform for legal collaboration that begins with US immigration. It combines intelligent technology, behavioral science, and secure, portable client data to connect immigration attorneys and law firms, individual visa applicants, and employers sponsoring global hires in a single connected product. Attorneys manage cases at scale, individuals track applications and reduce anxiety while retaining ownership of their own data, and employers coordinate visa sponsorship. As of this enrichment pass Formally does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, developer portal, or documentation surface, so this profile captures company identity and published web properties only.

providers.name: Fortastra
providers.description: Fortastra is a spacecraft manufacturer building low-cost, maneuverable orbital defense systems designed for scalability and autonomous operation. Its spacecraft protect space-based infrastructure with autonomous navigation that detects, analyzes, and responds to orbital anomalies without relying on distant ground-based sensors. The company's open software architecture spans sensing, maneuvering, coordination, and response functions, and its hardware is validated through component testing, simulation, and orbital deployment. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bloomberg-beta.

providers.name: Founder Collective
providers.description: Founder Collective is a seed and pre-seed stage venture capital firm that describes itself as stage-focused, sector agnostic, and proudly anti-thematic. Founded more than fifteen years ago and operating from Cambridge, MA (Harvard Square) and New York, NY (SoHo), the firm positions itself as founder-aligned, backing capital-efficient companies from idea through IPO. General partners include Micah Rosenbloom, David Frankel, and Amanda Herson, with Eric Paley as partner emeritus. Notable portfolio companies include Uber, SeatGeek, WHOOP, The Trade Desk, Airtable, Cruise, Coupang, Verkada, Shield AI, and Suno. Added to the API Evangelist network via the venture-capital portfolio graph.

providers.name: Fox-Tech
providers.description: FOX-TECH CO. is a New Taipei City, Taiwan IoT company (founded 2016, backed by 500 Global and SparkLabs Taipei) that digitally transforms farming, logistics, cold-chain, and manufacturing operations. Its TempHawk platform pairs wireless temperature, humidity, CO2, light-intensity and soil-EC sensors over Sigfox LPWAN with web and mobile apps and cloud data analytics, helping the perishable-goods value chain monitor conditions, manage risk, and meet policy compliance. Recognized on the Forward Fooding FoodTech 500. No public API, developer portal, or SDK is currently published.

providers.name: Freestyle
providers.description: Freestyle is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of foundry-group and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: venture-capital. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Full Truck Alliance
providers.description: Full Truck Alliance Co. Ltd. (Manbang Group / 满帮集团, NYSE: YMM) operates a leading digital freight platform in China that connects truckers and shippers to make road transportation more efficient. It runs the Yunmanman (运满满) and Huochebang (货车帮) mobile apps, applying mobile internet, big data, and artificial intelligence to freight matching, brokerage, transaction services, and value-added offerings across hundreds of cities and tens of thousands of routes. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures, hongshan, and softbank-vision-fund and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or open platform on its corporate site; this profile carries verified company identity plus a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Fyto
providers.description: Fyto is a Bay Area agricultural cleantech and robotics company, founded in 2019 by Jason Prapas with MIT origins, that builds automated cultivation systems for lemna — fast-growing aquatic "superplants" in the duckweed family. Its ReCover process, GrowGrid raised growbeds, and autonomous Harvester machine capture excess nutrients from dairy and livestock operations and convert them into high-protein animal feed, cutting nitrate pollution and greenhouse-gas emissions without arable land, synthetic fertilizer, or manual labor. Backed by GV, Fyto is scaling regenerative farming from California's San Joaquin Valley. No public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation is currently published.

providers.name: Galactic Energy
providers.description: Galactic Energy (星河动力航天 — Galactic Energy (Beijing) Space Technology Co., Ltd.) is a private Chinese commercial launch company founded on 6 February 2018 and headquartered in Beijing E-Town. It builds and flies the Ceres family of solid-propellant small-lift rockets (Ceres-1, the sea-launched Ceres-1S, and the larger 3.35 m Ceres-2) and is developing the partly reusable liquid oxygen/kerosene Pallas-1 and Pallas-2 medium-lift vehicles, the Eros vehicle, the Welkin (苍穹) CQ-series liquid propellant engines, and the Edge attitude and orbital control system. Its public web surface is a corporate marketing site at galactic-energy.cn carrying product pages, a launch plan, completed-mission history, a news feed, careers listings, a Chinese-language document centre of launch-vehicle user manuals (PDF), and an HTML launch-reservation form. Contract discovery on 2026-08-04 found no developer portal, no API documentation and no machine-readable API surface of any kind: every probe for OpenAPI/Swagger, GraphQL, MCP, an A2A agent card, /llms.txt, robots.txt and the full /.well-known/ discovery set returned HTTP 404 on every galactic-energy.cn host, and no api./developer./docs. subdomain resolves. This profile is therefore identity and domain-security only.

providers.name: galbot
providers.description: Galbot (银河通用机器人, "Galaxy Universal Robotics") is the official site of a general-purpose, embodied-AI robotics company. It was surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and profiled here for API and developer-surface enrichment. As of this enrichment pass Galbot publishes only a marketing website rendered as a client-side single-page app; no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, or MCP surface could be discovered. The only machine-readable signals captured are the DNS, TLS, and email-authentication (SPF/DMARC) posture of the galbot.com domain.

providers.name: General Instinct
providers.description: General Instinct is a San Francisco company (Y Combinator Spring 2026) building the deployment layer for physical AI. Founded in 2026 by Bill Jiao and Guanming Wang, it distills, quantizes, and deploys large frontier AI models onto constrained edge hardware so robotics, drone, and physical-AI teams can run low-latency models fully offline on devices like NVIDIA Jetson, mobile NPUs, ARM CPUs, the Apple Neural Engine, and Snapdragon. Its first product, Instinct Edge, takes a model, a target device, and a latency budget and returns an offline runtime that hits the budget on-device with no cloud calls, handling model compression, custom kernel optimization (CUDA, Metal, ARM NEON), and the data-to-serving pipeline. It was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub; enrichment searched the public web and found a marketing landing page but no developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, SDKs, or public API surface, so no API artifacts could be harvested. This profile captures the company identity plus the security posture of its public web surface, and remains an identity-only lead pending a discoverable API.

providers.name: Gentle Monster
providers.description: Gentle Monster is a South Korean luxury eyewear brand founded in 2011 and operated by parent company IICOMBINED, headquartered in Seoul. The brand designs and sells avant-garde sunglasses and optical frames, and is widely recognized for its immersive, art-installation flagship stores and experiential retail spaces. Its sister brands include Tamburins (fragrance and body care) and Nudake (conceptual dessert and patisserie). Gentle Monster sells globally through flagship stores, department-store concessions, and its direct-to-consumer site at gentlemonster.com. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; it is a consumer retail brand and publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Georgiamune
providers.description: Georgiamune Inc. is a Gaithersburg, Maryland based biopharmaceutical company developing first-in-class immunotherapies that reprogram immune signaling pathways to rebalance the immune system and restore health across cancer and autoimmune diseases. Built on a target-discovery platform, its pipeline of immunomodulators spans clinical, preclinical, and discovery stages, including the clinical-stage dual-functioning antibody GIM-122, the regulatory T-cell (Treg) inhibitor GIM-531, and the Treg activator GIM-407, alongside additional antibody and small-molecule programs. The company was surfaced as a venture-backed portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network; it does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or programmatic interface.

providers.name: GigaCrop
providers.description: GigaCrop is an agricultural biotechnology company engineering the photosynthesis pathway to dramatically increase crop productivity. Founded by Chris Eiben, PhD, the company combines enzyme engineering and machine learning to optimize the RuBisCo enzyme, aiming to roughly double yields in staple crops such as corn and soy and to break past the limits that have held annual yield gains near one percent for a century. Backed by Playground Global, GigaCrop is working to make agriculture both more sustainable and more abundant.

providers.name: GITAI
providers.description: GITAI is a space robotics company building safe and affordable robotic labor for space. It develops robotic arms, spacecraft platforms, autonomous "Inchworm" robots, and lunar rovers for on-orbit servicing, satellite assembly and maintenance, and lunar and orbital infrastructure construction, working with customers and agencies such as NASA and JAXA. GITAI operates as a B2B and government contractor and does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, SDK, or developer documentation; this profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched with the publicly observable web, blog, and domain-security surface only.

providers.name: Golden Ventures
providers.description: Golden Ventures is a seed-stage venture capital firm based in Toronto, Canada, founded in 2011 by former founders and operators who back bold, early-stage entrepreneurial teams across North America. The firm is sector agnostic and invests at the pre-seed, seed, and seed+ stages with typical initial checks of roughly $500K to $3M, having made over 100 investments including Wattpad, BenchSci, Float, ResQ, and Neo Financial. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Foundry Group. As a venture-capital firm rather than an API provider, it publishes no developer or API surface; this profile captures firm identity and domain security posture.

providers.name: GoWabi
providers.description: GoWabi is a Bangkok-based beauty and wellness booking marketplace serving Thailand and selected markets across Southeast Asia. Consumers use its web and mobile apps to discover and book more than 5,000 spas, massage studios, beauty clinics, nail, hair, dental, fitness, and wellness providers, with discounted deals, cashback rewards, and multiple payment options (credit card, Alipay, BNPL). GoWabi also offers a B2B SaaS/CRM tool integrated with partner point-of-sale systems to help salons, spas, clinics, and studios manage bookings and operations. It is backed by 500 Global. GoWabi operates a private mobile app backend (mobile-api.gowabi.com) but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or portal at this time.

providers.name: Greypoint Industries
providers.description: Greypoint Industries is a Canadian defense-technology company (Y Combinator S26) building passive RF mapping software that charts the electromagnetic spectrum so operators can see every signal, track every threat, and act first — "built in Canada for those who protect." Founded in 2026 by Nic Chu, Jordan Khoo, Steven Xu, and Darcy Zhang, the company also develops mass-produced autonomous counter-drone interceptors designed to defeat drone-swarm saturation at a fraction of the cost of the targets. As an early-stage hardware and software startup, Greypoint currently publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification; this profile captures the company's identity for the API Evangelist network and awaits a developer surface to enrich.

providers.name: H World Group
providers.description: H World Group Limited (formerly Huazhu Group / China Lodging Group) is one of the world's largest multi-brand hotel operators, headquartered in Shanghai, China and founded in 2005 by Ji Qi. It franchises, manages, and leases-and-operates thousands of hotels across economy-to-luxury tiers under brands including HanTing, Ji Hotel, Orange, Hi Inn, Elan, Starway, Crystal Orange, Manxin, Madison, Blossom House, CitiGO and Ni Hao, plus the upscale European Deutsche Hospitality portfolio (Steigenberger, IntercityHotel, MAXX, Jaz in the City, Zleep) and the H Rewards loyalty program. The company is dual-listed on NASDAQ (HTHT) and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (1179). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; H World is a consumer hospitality operator and does not publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: H&M
providers.description: A Swedish multinational fast-fashion retailer offering affordable clothing, accessories, and home goods. Operates thousands of stores globally and is one of the world's largest fashion companies. No public developer portal or open API catalogue was located on hm.com or hmgroup.com.

providers.name: Happy Elements
providers.description: Happy Elements is a mobile game developer and publisher, backed by DCM Ventures, best known for free-to-play titles such as the Ensemble Stars! rhythm/idol franchise and Merc Storia. Operating across China and Japan, the company builds consumer entertainment games distributed through the Apple App Store and Google Play rather than a public developer API. Added to the API Evangelist network as a consumer-sector portfolio profile; enrichment found no public API, developer portal, or SDK surface, so the only machine-verifiable artifact is a probed domain-security posture for happyelements.com.

providers.name: Hasbro
providers.description: Hasbro is a global play and entertainment company committed to making the world a better place for children and their families through brands and franchises including NERF, MAGIC: THE GATHERING, MY LITTLE PONY, and TRANSFORMERS. This repository tracks public APIs, developer resources, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Hasbro. No public developer APIs have been published at this time.

providers.name: Hedgeye
providers.description: Hedgeye Risk Management is an independent investment-research and financial-media firm founded in 2008 by Keith McCullough and headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut. Hedgeye sells subscription research and market analysis to investors across macroeconomics, sector/vertical coverage, and individual securities, delivered through daily notes, models, and its Hedgeye TV video platform, newsletters, and live events. The company is best known for its data-driven, process-oriented "GIP" (growth, inflation, policy) macro framework and its independent, no-conflicts positioning relative to traditional Wall Street sell-side research. As surfaced in the API Evangelist network, Hedgeye operates a consumer/subscriber web application at app.hedgeye.com but does not publish a public developer program, API, SDK, or machine-readable discovery surface; this profile captures the identity and domain-security posture that could be verified without authenticated access.

providers.name: Hermeus
providers.description: Hermeus is an American aerospace and defense company building rapidly reusable high-Mach and hypersonic aircraft for national-security missions in partnership with the U.S. Department of Defense. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, the company applies a hardware-rich, rapid design-build-test approach to move quickly from concept to flight. Its programs include Quarterhorse, a reusable high-speed flight-test aircraft; Darkhorse, a multi-mission reusable hypersonic uncrewed aerial system (UAS); and Chimera, a hybrid turbine-based combined-cycle engine that transitions from turbojet takeoff through supersonic flight into hypersonic acceleration. Hermeus is a hardware manufacturer with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile tracks the company's public web, security, and corporate properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Hexion
providers.description: Hexion is a global leader in thermosetting resins, providing a broad range of adhesive, structural, and specialty resins to a wide variety of industries including coatings, construction, electronics, and automotive. Their purpose is to activate science to change our world.

providers.name: Heytea
providers.description: Heytea is a Chinese premium modern tea-beverage chain founded in 2012 in Jiangmen, Guangdong. It pioneered cheese-topped tea and fresh-fruit "new-style tea" and has grown to thousands of stores across mainland China and international markets including Singapore, the United Kingdom, Australia, Canada and the United States. Backed by investors including Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China) and IDG Capital, Heytea runs its own mobile ordering app and retail loyalty program. As a consumer food-and-beverage retailer it publishes no public developer API, documentation portal, or SDKs; this profile is retained in the network as a company identity lead.

providers.name: Highfive
providers.description: Highfive was a video collaboration and conferencing company (highfive.com) surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of gv and lightspeed-venture-partners. The brand was acquired by and folded into Dialpad: highfive.com now issues a 301 redirect to dialpad.com/highfive, and developer.highfive.com no longer resolves (NXDOMAIN). Highfive exposes no independent developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI, SDKs, MCP server, or /.well-known/ discovery surface of its own; any current programmatic capability lives under the Dialpad platform. This profile is retained as an enrichment lead; only a domain-security probe of the surviving highfive.com domain yielded real data.

providers.name: Hlabs
providers.description: Hlabs (Harrison Laboratories, Inc., operating as hlaboratories.com) is a US-based, Y Combinator-backed (Winter 2026) manufacturer of plug-and-play robotics components. The company produces a domestically-manufactured, integrated hardware ecosystem for robot builders — including the RB1 main board (powered by Nvidia Jetson), wireless communication modules, field-oriented control (FOC) boards, pancake motors, and actuators. Its stated goal is to eliminate the complexity of sourcing mismatched components from overseas and integrating them, so roboticists can focus on design rather than electronics debugging. Hlabs targets teams building medium-to-large robots such as quadrupeds, humanoids, and robot arms, and serves customers across household robotics, defense, and other robotic platforms. This is a hardware manufacturer with no public developer/API surface at the time of profiling.

providers.name: Homary
providers.description: Homary is a direct-to-consumer home furnishings retailer that sells furniture, faucets, lighting, outdoor, kitchen, bath, storage and organization, decor and rugs sourced straight from manufacturers to shoppers' homes. The brand positions itself around "affordable luxury" home decor, operating an online storefront (homary.com) with category catalogs, deals, best sellers, a design service, and a business-to-business program. Homary was surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners. As a consumer e-commerce brand it exposes only internal storefront endpoints (/hm-api/, /chart-api/, disallowed in robots.txt) and publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation at this time.

providers.name: Hormel Foods
providers.description: Hormel Foods Corporation is a global branded food company with over $12 billion in annual revenue. Known for brands like SPAM, Skippy, Jennie-O, Hormel, and Planters. The company produces and markets a wide range of meat, nut, and food products. No public APIs were identified.

providers.name: Humane Genomics
providers.description: Humane Genomics Inc is a New York City biotechnology company engineering oncolytic RNA viruses to selectively target and destroy cancer cells. Using a first-principle, computer-aided design approach built on Vesicular Stomatitis Virus (VSV) with aptazyme-controlled selective replication, the company develops precision viral therapies; its lead candidate targets pediatric liver cancer (hepatoblastoma). Backed by Union Square Ventures, Humane Genomics operates from Alexandria LaunchLabs and partners with Genezen for cGMP manufacturing. The company publishes no public API or developer surface; this API Evangelist profile tracks it as a portfolio-company lead.

providers.name: HungryHub
providers.description: HungryHub is a restaurant reservation and dining-deals platform operating primarily in Bangkok, Thailand. It connects diners with fixed-price dining packages — all-you-can-eat buffets, omakase, fine dining, rooftop venues, hotel staycations and cruise dining — from luxury hotels and restaurants, often at significant savings. The consumer marketplace runs on the web and in mobile apps, while a separate business portal gives 2,000+ partner restaurants and hotel chains a booking and package-management dashboard. The company reports serving more than four million customers monthly and is a portfolio company of 500 Global. HungryHub publishes no public developer or partner API; this profile captures its public web, discovery and security surface.

providers.name: Huntsman
providers.description: Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global chemical manufacturer of differentiated and specialty chemicals serving a diverse range of consumer and industrial end markets, with operating segments in polyurethanes, performance products, and advanced materials. Huntsman maintains a Technology Portal for partner collaborations, but no public developer APIs have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Hypersonica
providers.description: Hypersonica is a European defence and aerospace company developing sovereign hypersonic strike systems for both military and civilian applications. Founded to give Europe an independent technological edge to deter aggression, the company tested what it describes as Europe's first sovereign hypersonic missile prototype in February 2026, focusing on fast, modular, maneuverable deep-strike capabilities delivered in months rather than years at a claimed 80% cost reduction. Headquartered in Munich with UK offices, Hypersonica raised a EUR 23.3M Series A backed by Plural, SPRIND, and General Catalyst. As a business-to-government defence contractor it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or technical documentation, so no API artifacts could be enriched.

providers.name: Iberdrola
providers.description: Iberdrola, S.A., is a multinational electric utility company headquartered in Bilbao, Spain. It is one of the world’s leading electricity producers and distributors, operating in multiple countries across Europe, the United States, and Latin America. The company focuses on renewable energy generation, smart grid technologies, and sustainable energy solutions, serving millions of customers worldwide. Iberdrola’s digital transformation includes a range of APIs for energy data, billing, smart devices, and sustainability reporting, enabling developers and partners to integrate with its services and promote greener energy consumption.

providers.name: iceonline
providers.description: iceonline (冰场联盟) operates an enterprise-grade backend management platform for ice rinks in China, published at www.iceonline.cn as a login-gated single-page administrative console branded "冰场联盟 企业级后台管理系统" (Ice Rink Alliance Enterprise Management System). The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass the public surface is a private SPA with no discoverable API: no OpenAPI/Swagger, SDK, developer portal, changelog, or security.txt was found — every probed path (including /.well-known/*, /swagger.json, /openapi.json) returns the SPA shell rather than a real document. Only live domain-security posture (TLS/DNS) could be captured this round.

providers.name: Iconicgames
providers.description: Iconic Interactive (iconicgames.io) is a game development studio building real-time AI systems for gameplay and interactive storytelling. The team combines game developers and AI scientists with credits on major franchises including GTA, Forza, and Just Cause, and is developing a game demo, "The Oversight Bureau," available on Steam. The company is backed by Kindred Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the studio publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or developer documentation; this profile captures its public identity and the security posture of its web domain. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Internal Control Standards
providers.description: Internal Control Standards are frameworks of policies and procedures designed to provide reasonable assurance regarding the achievement of objectives in operational effectiveness, reliable financial reporting, and compliance with laws and regulations. The COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework (originally released in 1992 and refreshed as ICIF-2013) is the most widely adopted standard for internal controls and underpins SOX 404 compliance, with supplemental 2023 guidance for internal control over sustainability reporting (ICSR) addressing modern risks including generative AI and robotic process automation.

providers.name: International Flavors & Fragrances
providers.description: International Flavors & Fragrances (IFF) is a global creator of flavors, fragrances, and ingredients for consumer products including perfumes, cosmetics, food, beverages, and household goods. IFF is a Fortune 500 company with no documented public developer API program at this time.

providers.name: Inversion
providers.description: Inversion is a Los Angeles-based aerospace and defense company founded in 2021 by Austin Briggs and Justin Fiaschetti, building a new class of highly maneuverable reentry vehicles. Its flagship Arc is an autonomous, reusable, low-cost space-based delivery vehicle designed to store cargo in orbit and deliver it with precision to anywhere on Earth in under an hour, descending under parachutes using non-toxic propellants so crews can approach it immediately on landing. The company also develops hypersonics and space-based interceptor technology and flew its first reentry capsule, Ray, as an early technical demonstrator. Inversion has raised roughly $54M to date, including a $44M Series A led by Spark Capital and Adjacent with participation from Lockheed Martin Ventures, Kindred Ventures, and Y Combinator. It does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile tracks the company for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Iron Mountain
providers.description: Iron Mountain is a global leader in storage and information management services, providing records management, data centers, secure shredding, digital transformation, and asset lifecycle management for organizations worldwide. Iron Mountain helps customers protect and unlock value from their physical and digital information assets.

providers.name: Itch
providers.description: Itch is a UK direct-to-consumer pet wellness brand, backed by Seedcamp, offering a subscription service that delivers vet-approved flea, tick and worm treatments to pet owners on a recurring schedule, alongside pet health guidance and related care products. It was surfaced as a Seedcamp portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification could be found; the consumer website sits behind bot protection, so this profile carries provider identity plus a probed domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Iyuno
providers.description: Iyuno is one of the world's leading media localization companies, providing dubbing, subtitling, and access services for film, television, and streaming platforms across dozens of languages and markets worldwide. It was formed from the combination of Iyuno Media Group and SDI Media and is backed by the SoftBank Vision Fund. Iyuno operates as an enterprise content and media-services provider; as of this profiling it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts, so this profile carries company identity only.

providers.name: J&T Express
providers.description: J&T Express (J&T Global Express Ltd, HKEX: 1519) is a global logistics service operator whose core business is express parcel delivery and international logistics. Founded in Indonesia in 2015, it operates express delivery networks across 13 countries including Indonesia, Vietnam, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand, Cambodia, Singapore, China, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Mexico, Brazil, and Egypt, with international freight services reaching Asia, Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Oceania. The company serves e-commerce sellers and consumers with parcel pickup, sorting, line-haul, last-mile delivery, and track-and-trace. As of this profile J&T Express publishes a public track-and-trace web experience and regional merchant onboarding, but no public developer portal, API documentation, or OpenAPI definition was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and probed domain security.

providers.name: Johnson Controls
providers.description: Johnson Controls is a global diversified technology and multi-industrial leader serving customers in over 150 countries, providing products, services, and solutions for buildings (HVAC, fire, security, building automation), energy storage, and connected building platforms (Metasys, OpenBlue). No public, self-service developer portal or OpenAPI is currently published; partner and customer integrations are typically delivered through the OpenBlue and Metasys product lines.

providers.name: KAR Auction Services (Historical)
providers.description: KAR Auction Services was a leading provider of vehicle auction, vehicle remarketing, and salvage auction services in North America. The company divested its salvage business IAA in 2023 (now part of RB Global) and rebranded its remaining wholesale business as OPENLANE. This repository is retained for historical reference. For current activity see the OPENLANE repository.

providers.name: Kavak
providers.description: Kavak is a Mexico-founded digital marketplace for buying, selling, and financing pre-owned cars across Latin America, the Middle East, and Turkey. Founded in 2016 in Mexico City by Carlos Garcia Ottati, Loreanne Garcia Ottati, and Roger Laughlin, Kavak became Mexico's first unicorn in 2020 and reached an $8.7B valuation in 2021 with backing from SoftBank, Sea Ltd, and Founders Fund. The company operates an end-to-end consumer platform that combines an e-commerce site and mobile app, physical hubs, in-house vehicle reconditioning, and a financial-services arm (Kavak Capital, Kuna, and Kavak Credito). Internally, Kavak uses machine learning and proprietary pricing models to value, inspect, and route inventory across markets including Mexico, Argentina, Brazil, Chile, the United Arab Emirates, and Turkey, while sponsoring high-profile partners such as the NFL. Kavak's revenue comes from vehicle sales, financing margins, and after-sales services, and the company does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, or open-source GitHub organization. Customer-facing integrations are limited to the consumer web and mobile apps and partner financing channels.

providers.name: Kennametal
providers.description: Kennametal is a leading provider of productivity solutions for metalworking, earth cutting, and wear components, coatings, and powders. Kennametal offers online integration services including Punch-Out / OCI (Open Catalog Interface), EDI, and a Product Data Portal for catalog and product information.

providers.name: Kets
providers.description: KETS Quantum Security is a Bristol, UK deep-tech company (incorporated 2016) building chip-based quantum-safe encryption and networking hardware. Its product line spans Quantum Key Distribution (QKD), Quantum Random Number Generators (QRNG), and the KETS KORE sub-system, delivering security grounded in the laws of physics rather than computational complexity. KETS technology hardens telecommunications networks, satellite and aerospace communications (including Airbus collaborations), data-center backups, and critical infrastructure control systems against the emerging threat of quantum computing. Backed by European quantum-specialist venture investors including Speedinvest and supported by multiple UK government funding awards, KETS is a hardware and photonics company; it does not currently publish a public API, SDK, or developer portal. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Speedinvest portfolio lead and enriched with identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Lear
providers.description: Lear Corporation is a Fortune 500 global automotive technology leader in Seating and E-Systems, delivering complete seat systems, electrical distribution and connection systems, and intelligent in-vehicle technology to vehicles from major automakers worldwide. No public REST APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Legg Mason
providers.description: Legg Mason was a global asset management firm offering investment products and services through a network of investment affiliates before being acquired by Franklin Resources (Franklin Templeton) in 2020. Investor resources and product information are now consolidated under Franklin Templeton, and no public REST APIs or developer portal have been identified.

providers.name: Life House
providers.description: Life House was a vertically integrated hotel software, brand and management company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Miami Beach, Florida. It built its own back-of-house operating system — property management, revenue management, digital marketing and financial operations — for independent hotels, ran more than 50 properties across the United States, Mexico and Canada, and from 2021 sold the platform to third-party hoteliers. It raised over $100M from Inovia Capital, KAYAK, Tiger Global, Trinity Ventures, Sound Ventures and JLL. In December 2024 Life House combined its management portfolio with Lark Hotels to form Lark Hospitality — in which Lark holds the controlling interest — and spun its AI revenue-management platform out as Diamo. Life House never operated a public developer program: it was a consumer of hotel APIs (notably the Mews Open API) rather than a publisher of one, lifehousehotels.com now 301-redirects to larkhotels.com, no api/developer/docs subdomain resolves in DNS, and its GitHub organization holds a single fork of a third-party JavaScript library.

providers.name: Lightmatter
providers.description: Lightmatter is a Mountain View, California photonic supercomputer company building optical interconnect and compute products for AI infrastructure. Its flagship Passage line of 3D-stacked photonic interposers and co-packaged optics, including the Passage M1000 superchip and the Passage L20 and L200 pluggables, deliver up to 114 Tbps of optical bandwidth and target frontier-scale AI training and inference fabrics. Lightmatter also ships the Envise general-purpose photonic AI accelerator and the Guide VLSP Light Engine universal light source, and provides reference systems and evaluation kits. The company holds a 4.4 billion dollar valuation on roughly 850 million dollars raised as of late 2024 and partners with TSMC, GlobalFoundries, OIF, IEEE, and OCP. Lightmatter does not expose a public developer API, so this profile is hardware-, research-, and press-focused with an intentionally empty apis list.

providers.name: Lithos Carbon
providers.description: Lithos Carbon delivers permanent carbon dioxide removal through enhanced rock weathering on agricultural land. The company applies crushed basalt to farm fields, where it captures atmospheric CO2 while raising soil pH, replenishing nutrients (iron, magnesium, phosphorus, calcium), improving crop yields, and building resilience to drought and pests. Lithos uses machine-learning soil models to optimize basalt application rates and provides measurement, reporting, and verification of the resulting carbon removal, managing delivery, sampling, and installation end to end for farmers and carbon-credit buyers. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures and Union Square Ventures.

providers.name: Lo Que Necesito
providers.description: Lo Que Necesito (loquenecesito.co) is a Colombian real estate technology platform that lets people request and purchase housing online, accompanying customers through the buying process. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global, it was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. A July 2026 enrichment pass found a live consumer website but no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Long Lake
providers.description: Long Lake is an AI-enabled roll-up holding company founded in 2023 that acquires and modernizes established American services businesses — spanning homeowners association (HOA) management, construction and infrastructure services, and corporate travel — by deploying its proprietary horizontal AI platform, Nexus. Backed by General Catalyst, Alpha Wave, D1 Capital, Thrive, and Elad Gil, the company has raised over $670 million and acquired more than 30 businesses, including a $6.3 billion agreement to take American Express Global Business Travel private. Long Lake operates as a private holding company (llmh.com) with no public API or developer surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company lead.

providers.name: Luna Park
providers.description: Luna Park is a consumer-sector company surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) and added to the API Evangelist network. Its registered domain lunapark.com now redirects (HTTP 301) to meetquinn.ai — Quinn, described on-site as an AI training platform focused on "operational readiness for the trades." As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a minimal marketing landing page with no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, or other machine-readable API surface. Domain-security posture was probed live: TLS 1.3 with SPF and DMARC (quarantine) present; no HSTS, DNSSEC, or CAA records.

providers.name: Lunasonde
providers.description: Lunasonde is a Techstars-backed deep-tech space company building a satellite constellation for subsurface Earth imaging. Its sensing technology aims to scan beneath the surface from orbit to detect groundwater, minerals, and other underground features, delivering the resulting geophysical data to mining, agriculture, water, and natural-resource customers. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, documentation portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface; this record captures its verifiable web and domain-security footprint for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Lunchclub
providers.description: Lunchclub is an AI-powered professional networking platform that matches members for one-to-one meetings and warm introductions based on their goals, background, and interests. Members set what they are looking for — hiring, fundraising, sales, mentorship, or making new connections — and Lunchclub's matching system proposes relevant people to meet over video. The company is consumer/prosumer facing and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and enriched in the API Evangelist network; probing confirmed no public API surface, no OpenAPI, and no /.well-known discovery documents.

providers.name: LuxCreo
providers.description: LuxCreo is a hardtech company delivering same-day dental 3D printing through an integrated ecosystem of hardware, materials, and cloud software. Its dental line pairs the FDA Class II 510(k)-cleared iLux Pro Dental printer, iLuxWash cleaning, and iLuxCure curing hardware with proprietary resins and ActiveMemory polymer technology (4D Aligner, 4D Bright). The software stack — LuxFlow Pro print prep, LuxDesign AI design automation, LuxLink fleet management, and the LuxCloud Dental platform — runs the in-house aligner and appliance workflow. Backed by Kleiner Perkins. Surfaced as a portfolio-lead stub and processed by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline; no public developer API surface was found.

providers.name: Lydia
providers.description: Lydia is a French fintech, founded in 2013, that built one of Europe's most popular mobile peer-to-peer payments apps, letting users send money, split bills, and pay merchants from their phone. Backed by Accel, Tencent and others, the company evolved into a full mobile banking and financial services provider. In 2024 it split its consumer banking product into a new brand, Sumeria (sumeria.eu), while the Lydia name continues for the P2P payments experience. Lydia publishes a security.txt bug-bounty contact but no longer exposes a public developer API or portal.

providers.name: Madison-reed
providers.description: Madison Reed is a female-founded and female-led direct-to-consumer hair color company offering 8-Free permanent, demi-permanent, and root touch-up hair color crafted in Italy, sold as at-home kits and delivered as professional services at 95+ Hair Color Bar locations across the United States. The company blends e-commerce retail, subscription replenishment, and in-person salon booking. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and True Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures identity and probed domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Magic Circle Studio
providers.description: Magic Circle Studio is a venture-backed consumer mobile game developer building social games designed to nourish relationships through cooperation, creativity, and playful shared experiences. Its flagship title, Magic Garden, launched on iOS in July 2025 and reached one million players in its first year, following the studio's earlier titles Truffle Hogs and a Magic Circle Discord activity that won Discord's Best Chill/Party Game award. The studio received pre-seed funding from General Catalyst in 2022 and joined the a16z Games SPEEDRUN accelerator in 2023. It is a direct-to-consumer game company with no public developer platform, API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile is maintained as a network identity record.

providers.name: Magnetis
providers.description: Magnetis is a Brazilian digital wealth management and automated investment (robo-advisor) platform, backed by 500 Global, that offered goal-based portfolio recommendations and managed investment accounts to retail investors in Brazil. The company was acquired by BTG Pactual, and the magnetis.com.br domain now redirects to BTG Pactual's investimentos platform; no independent public developer program or API surface is currently published.

providers.name: MAGNiTT
providers.description: MAGNiTT is a venture data platform covering startups, investors, and funding activity across emerging venture markets, with a focus on the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) and adjacent emerging ecosystems. It aggregates data on startup companies, venture capital and corporate investors, funding rounds, and exits, and publishes market research and analytics reports used by founders, investors, and enterprises to track venture activity. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass MAGNiTT publishes no discoverable public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable discovery surface; the platform is a subscription-based data product served behind login and bot protection.

providers.name: Maimai
providers.description: Maimai (脉脉) is a Chinese professional networking and workplace social platform operated by Beijing Taoyou Tianxia Technology Development Co., Ltd. It combines professional networking, recruitment and talent matching, job referrals, company reviews and workplace community, and career-development learning (脉课堂) for the Chinese-language market. Surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Maimai publishes no public developer program, open platform, or API documentation, so this profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Malaeb
providers.description: Malaeb (ملاعب) is the #1 sports pitch and facility booking application in the MENA region, letting players discover and reserve stadiums, courts, and pitches around them across Bahrain, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, the United Arab Emirates, and Oman. Backed by 500 Global, Malaeb connects players and venue operators through a consumer mobile marketplace. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, documentation, or well-known discovery surface; its web presence is a WordPress marketing site fronting a React single-page application.

providers.name: Mammoth Biosciences
providers.description: Mammoth Biosciences is a genetic medicines company co-founded by CRISPR co-inventor Jennifer Doudna, developing in vivo gene-editing therapeutics and CRISPR-based diagnostics. The company discovers and engineers novel CRISPR systems and proteins to overcome delivery challenges in genetic medicine, with the goal of creating permanent cures. It is a therapeutics- and diagnostics-focused biotechnology company rather than an API/platform provider; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDK, documentation portal, or programmatic access. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc, Mayfield and SV Angel and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Manifold Bio
providers.description: Manifold Bio is a biotechnology company developing tissue-targeted biologic medicines. It runs a high-throughput in vivo discovery engine that pairs massively multiplexed in vivo screening — using mCode protein barcodes read out by DNA sequencing — with AI-powered protein and antibody design (mBER) and engineered mShuttle delivery vehicles. Its pipeline targets CNS diseases such as Alzheimer's and Parkinson's (amyloid-beta, tau, alpha-synuclein) and peripheral cardiometabolic disease. Backed by Playground Global. The company publishes no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or event surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Manitowoc
providers.description: Manitowoc Cranes is one of the world's largest providers of lifting equipment for the global construction industry, including lattice-boom crawler cranes, tower cranes, mobile hydraulic cranes, and boom trucks. No public developer APIs have been documented.

providers.name: Maple VC
providers.description: Maple VC is an early-stage ("believing first") venture capital firm that writes first checks into founders at the seed stage, before their companies achieve mainstream recognition. The firm invests globally across four operator communities — San Francisco, Canada, Cambridge, and Korea — and is run by operators drawn from early teams at Uber, DigitalOcean, and Shopify. Notable portfolio companies include Clay, Neo Financial, AutoLeap, Playbook, BenchIQ, Finny, and Blacklake. Maple VC is a venture capital firm and does not operate a developer platform, public API, or API documentation.

providers.name: Marathon Oil
providers.description: Marathon Oil was an independent international energy company that engaged in the exploration, production, and marketing of liquid hydrocarbons and natural gas. The company was acquired by ConocoPhillips in 2024, and its public web presence now redirects to ConocoPhillips. No public developer APIs have been identified.

providers.name: Massive Science
providers.description: Massive Science is a science communication platform and media company that publishes stories, explainers, lab notes, and reports about current research, written and edited by working scientists. It runs the Massive Science Consortium, a training network of scientist-writers, alongside editorial content, newsletters, a community discussion forum, and a shop. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment finds no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable interface beyond a public RSS feed.

providers.name: Matchstick Ventures
providers.description: Matchstick Ventures is an early-stage venture capital fund investing across the North and Rockies (the Upper Midwest and Mountain West). The firm backs seed and pre-seed founders where innovative ideas, large markets, and diverse "underdog" founders intersect, describing itself as a catalyst for its founders, partners, and regional startup communities. Its portfolio spans consumer, commerce, developer, and B2B software companies including Soona, StackHawk, Spekit, Branch, Inspectorio, Airspace Link, Fiveable, Parallax, River, Tilt, Base, Ordermark, and Upsie.

providers.name: Methodical Games
providers.description: Methodical Games is an independent AAA game development studio building award-winning multiplayer games, describing itself as "built by developers, for developers." Founded by veterans of Infinity Ward, Respawn Entertainment, Epic Games and Santa Monica Studio, its lean team has shipped and shaped franchises including Call of Duty, Titanfall, Apex Legends, Fortnite, Gears of War and God of War Ragnarok. The studio emphasizes a developer-driven process of fundamentals, quick iteration and collaboration to craft immersive, long-lived multiplayer experiences. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a game studio it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and public web presence.

providers.name: Microagi
providers.description: Microagi (stylized microagi) is a data research lab building end-to-end physical, embodied AGI, with a stated focus on reliable real-world deployments; its public positioning is "Accelerating embodied AGI." Backed by Northzone, the company is early-stage: as of this profile its public presence is a single marketing site at microagi.ai with no published developer API, documentation, SDKs, CLI, or agent surface. This API Evangelist profile tracks Microagi as a portfolio lead; artifacts here are limited to a live domain-security probe of the marketing host until a developer surface is published. (Note: the unrelated github.com/microagi org, "µAGI / microagi.dev" by Vitakka Consulting, is a separate entity and is deliberately not attributed here.)

providers.name: MightyFly
providers.description: MightyFly is an autonomous air-logistics company building hybrid-electric eVTOL cargo aircraft for expedited, long-range, same-day deliveries. Its autonomous aircraft carry up to 500 pounds, travel up to 1,000 miles at roughly 150 MPH, and cut delivery emissions by around 64% versus traditional ground and air freight. MightyFly targets B2B logistics and defense delivery partnerships rather than offering a public developer platform. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no developer API, SDK, developer portal, or public specifications; this profile captures its public web presence and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Mirendil
providers.description: Mirendil is a frontier AI research lab founded by veterans of Anthropic, xAI, Google DeepMind, and OpenAI and led by CEO Behnam Neyshabur and CTO Harsh Mehta. The company is building self-accelerating AI R&D: training frontier models that are exceptional at AI research and then redesigning the entire research loop around them to make it faster, more capable, and more autonomous.
