Its stated goal is to put frontier AI R&D in everyone's hands so people closest to a problem can stay on it, with applications spanning drug discovery, chemistry, biology, materials science, and robotics. Mirendil raised a $200M seed round at roughly a $1B valuation co-led by Andreessen Horowitz and Kleiner Perkins with participation from Nvidia. As of mid-2026 the company has no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Module
providers.description: Module is a vertically integrated sustainable housing company that designs, manufactures, and builds modular homes. Operating across design (architecture and engineering with BIM), manufacturing (its Last Mile Facility in Pittsburgh), and construction (licensed general contracting), Module focuses on infill and "missing middle" housing, small-footprint and energy-efficient affordable homes, and mixed-income developments through its Last Mile Network of design, construction, and mission-driven developer partner programs. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched in the API Evangelist network; Module publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation surface.

providers.name: Moglix
providers.description: Moglix is an Indian B2B commerce platform for industrial and MRO (maintenance, repair, and operations) procurement, founded in 2015 and headquartered in Noida, India, with a Singapore base. Through MoglixBusiness it supplies enterprises with industrial products — safety equipment, electricals, power tools, fasteners, packaging, and office supplies — alongside supply-chain, procurement-software, and financing services. A unicorn backed by Accel and other investors, Moglix operates across manufacturing supply chains in India and international markets. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; enrichment probing found an internal API host (api.moglix.com) but no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or documented API surface.

providers.name: MojiLala
providers.description: MojiLala was a marketplace for stickers, GIFs, and emoji that offered a content API and mobile SDKs so developers could embed searchable sticker and animated-sticker packs into messaging and social apps. Backed by 500 Global, the team subsequently pivoted to LEO AR (leoapp.com), a consumer augmented reality application for creating, transforming, and sharing AR experiences. As of this profiling the original MojiLala developer surface at mojilala.com is offline (returns HTTP 403/530) and the active property, leoapp.com, is a single-page marketing/app site that publishes no public developer API, documentation, or well-known discovery endpoints. This profile is retained as a network lead; no live API artifacts were discoverable.

providers.name: Monolith AI
providers.description: Monolith AI develops artificial-intelligence software for engineering product development, helping R&D and test-lab teams validate physical products faster. Its cloud SaaS platform pairs a notebook-style workspace with proprietary self-learning models built for engineers: a Test Data Validation module whose anomaly detector flags errors across hundreds of data channels, a Test Plan Optimisation module whose next-test recommender can cut test plans by up to 70%, and a System Calibration module that tunes performance across operating conditions. It serves battery, automotive, aerospace and defense, and industrial and medical engineering teams. Monolith AI is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. No public developer API, portal, or SDKs are published at this time.

providers.name: MoreTickets
providers.description: MoreTickets (摩天轮票务), operated by Shanghai Juqitech, is a next-generation internet performance ticketing marketplace founded in 2015. The platform lets consumers buy and sell tickets to concerts, stage plays, musicals, and sports events through a transparent, competitive pricing marketplace with standardized ticketing services. It operates primarily as a consumer-facing web and mobile marketplace and does not publish a public developer API or open platform. The company is backed by Qiming Venture Partners and has raised a reported $108M in funding.

providers.name: Morph Systems
providers.description: Morph Systems is a Palo Alto, California based artificial intelligence consultancy that accelerates enterprise adoption of Palantir Foundry and AIP by building LLM-powered operating systems on top of an organization's data and ontology. Founded by forward-deployed engineers who began by supporting military aviation with an LLM-based kneeboard system that generates mission briefs from integrated airport and flight data, the company now delivers AI-driven operating systems for trading firms, LLM-powered supply-chain visibility for large-scale factory construction, and patient-experience and operations solutions built on the Palantir platform. Morph Systems is an early-stage, venture-backed team (backed by 500 Global, Seoul National University, Mashup Ventures, Orange Planet Foundation, and the Tech Incubator Program for Startup / TIPS) that operates as a services and solutions provider rather than a public API platform; it does not currently publish a developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or a public API surface.

providers.name: Movel AI
providers.description: Movel AI is a Singapore-based robotics deployment software company, founded in 2016, that makes it faster and cheaper to get autonomous mobile robots up and running in real-world environments. Its platform pairs deep learning, sensor fusion, and probabilistic planning so robots can perceive their surroundings and plan tasks on their own. Core products are the Movel Fleet Management System (FMS) for real-time monitoring and control of multi-robot fleets and Movel RNS (Robotic Navigation System) for precise single-robot navigation of complex spaces, applied across logistics, manufacturing, construction, and healthcare. The company is backed by Silicon Solution Ventures, 500 Global, AviTech, SGInnovate, Seeds Capital, and Enterprise Singapore. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Movel AI publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Mushroom Material
providers.description: Mushroom Material is a New Zealand and Singapore based sustainable-packaging startup founded in 2020 by Shaun Seaman and Jotinder Singh that grows a biodegradable, home-compostable alternative to expanded polystyrene (Styrofoam) from fungal mycelium. The company combines agricultural byproducts such as wood chips, sawdust, hemp straw and cardboard with mycelium to grow millions of pellets, coats them in a biopolymer binder, and uses compression molding to shape protective packaging that drops into existing Styrofoam production lines. The material offers shock absorption, low density and natural water resistance while composting in months. A Techstars-backed company, Mushroom Material raised a US$5M+ (NZ$8.5M) seed round led by Wavemaker Partners and Singapore's SEEDS Capital (with Icehouse Ventures, K1W1 and Black Kite Capital) to build a pilot plant in Auckland. This profile is a materials/manufacturing company in the API Evangelist network; it has no public API surface.

providers.name: My China Roots
providers.description: My China Roots is a Chinese heritage genealogy platform that helps people of Chinese descent trace their ancestry, find records of their ancestors, connect with long-lost relatives, and organize roots trips to China. The platform offers a searchable database of roughly 200 million ancestors drawn from digitized clan books (zupu), overseas immigration records, tombstones, obituaries, and clan association member lists, alongside family-tree building and a Library Edition for institutions. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the company exposes a consumer web application only, with no discoverable public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: Myxt
providers.description: Myxt is a consumer music streaming platform operated by Paper Phones Inc., built around the tagline "Musicians. Fans. Nothing in between." Instead of forced monthly subscriptions, Myxt uses an "unlock" model that lets artists monetize audio, session files, project files, images, and videos directly, while fans support creators without a recurring commitment and can chat with the artist after each unlock. Native iOS and Android apps extend access beyond the web. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network; during enrichment no public API, developer portal, or SDK surface was found.

providers.name: National Security Agency
providers.description: The National Security Agency (NSA) is a U.S. intelligence agency responsible for global monitoring, collection, and processing of information and data for foreign intelligence and counterintelligence purposes.

providers.name: navabi
providers.description: navabi is an online retailer specializing in plus-size designer fashion for women, founded and headquartered in Aachen, Germany. As of July 2026 only the Canadian storefront (navabi.ca) is live: navabi.com now redirects to an unrelated parked domain (gitinama.site) and navabi.de returns a maintenance page, indicating the brand has largely wound down its international operations. The shop curates dresses, tops, jackets, jeans, coats, swimwear and accessories from luxury and contemporary labels such as Anna Scholz, Basler, Bogner, Lacoste, Roberto Cavalli and Zizzi, alongside styling advice, a fashion magazine and an affiliate program. navabi was surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. It is a consumer e-commerce brand with no public developer portal, API, well-known discovery surface, or published security program; enrichment probes captured only its web/domain security posture (navabi.ca).

providers.name: Neoplants
providers.description: Neoplants is a French climate-biotechnology company building genetically and microbially engineered houseplants that capture and metabolize indoor air pollutants. Its consumer product line pairs bioengineered pothos plants with an enhanced root microbiome ("Power Drops") to remove volatile organic compounds such as formaldehyde, benzene, toluene and xylene from indoor air. Backed by Partech and other climate investors, Neoplants operates as a direct-to-consumer brand rather than an API provider. This API Evangelist profile was created from a venture-portfolio lead; an enrichment pass confirmed the company publishes no developer API, OpenAPI, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface as of July 2026.

providers.name: nested
providers.description: Nested is a modern, technology-enabled UK estate agency that helps people sell, buy, and let residential property. It pairs hyper-local human agents with a digital platform and mobile app that give sellers transparency across the transaction, listing homes on major portals such as Rightmove, Zoopla, and OnTheMarket. Nested was surfaced as a portfolio company of balderton-capital and northzone and added to the API Evangelist network. The company operates a consumer-facing service and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or technical documentation at this time.

providers.name: Network Engines
providers.description: Network Engines, Inc. was an early venture-backed (Canaan Partners) server and storage appliance maker that built application platforms and OEM appliance integration hardware for software vendors. The company was later acquired by UNICOM Global and rebranded UNICOM Engineering — its original networkengines.com domain now redirects to www.unicomengineering.com, where the business is positioned around Dell-based appliances and OEM engineering / build-to-order application platform integration. It is a hardware and manufacturing-services business, not an API producer: an enrichment probe on 2026-07-20 found no public developer program, no OpenAPI, no /api or /developers surface, and no /.well-known discovery documents on either host. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a Canaan Partners portfolio lead; there is no API surface to enrich.

providers.name: Neversitup
providers.description: Neversitup is a Bangkok, Thailand based software development and IT outsourcing company delivering end-to-end digital software along with web, mobile, and backend engineering and dedicated developer placement for clients. It also builds and operates its own consumer fintech products, including the Piggipo and Piggipo Go credit-card management apps and the Fast Loan lending platform, on a stack spanning Python, Node.js, React, Kotlin, and Swift running on AWS and Firebase. As of this enrichment pass Neversitup publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or SDKs; it operates as a services and product company rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Newcleo
providers.description: Newcleo is a nuclear energy company founded in September 2021 by Stefano Buono, Luciano Cinotti and Elisabeth Rizzotti, headquartered in Paris with operations across France, Italy, the United Kingdom, Switzerland, Belgium and Slovakia. It designs small modular lead-cooled fast reactors (LFR) fuelled with mixed oxide (MOX) fuel made from reprocessed spent nuclear fuel, with the aim of closing the nuclear fuel cycle and reducing long-lived waste. The group employs roughly 1,000 people, has raised over EUR 780 million, and has grown by acquisition (Hydromine Nuclear Energy, SRS-Fucina, Rutschi Group). Newcleo publishes no public developer API or developer program; its only public machine-consumable software is a small set of open-source scientific Python libraries released through its newcleo-dev-team GitHub organisation.

providers.name: Nimsoft
providers.description: Nimsoft was a SaaS-based IT infrastructure and application monitoring and service-desk company, founded in 1998 as Nimbus Software in Oslo, Norway and later headquartered in Redwood City, California. Backed by Northzone and JMI Equity, it was acquired by CA Technologies in March 2010 for roughly $350 million, after which its products were folded into CA Unified Infrastructure Management (UIM). CA was in turn acquired by Broadcom in 2018, and the former Nimsoft monitoring capability now lives on as Broadcom DX Unified Infrastructure Management. The www.nimsoft.com domain today resolves to Broadcom infrastructure, and Nimsoft has no independent developer portal, public API, or OpenAPI surface of its own.

providers.name: Ninjacart
providers.description: Ninjacart is India's largest agritech B2B fresh-produce supply-chain company, founded in 2015 and headquartered in Bengaluru. It connects farmers and producers directly with retailers, kirana stores, and businesses, removing layers of middlemen from the fruit-and-vegetable supply chain. Its product portfolio spans Ninja Mandi (wholesale produce marketplace), Ninja Kisan (farmer sourcing), Ninja Kirana (retailer supply), and Ninja Global, alongside a technology-licensing model, Ninja Tech Ventures, and a Startup Program that gives FoodTech/AgTech startups access to its supply-chain tooling (demand forecasting, pricing intelligence, procurement, inventory, logistics, and catalog management). Ninjacart is backed by investors including Accel, Tiger Global, and Walmart/Flipkart. As of this profile it exposes no public self-serve developer API or documentation; technology access is handled through partnerships (partnerships@ninjacart.com).

providers.name: Nova
providers.description: Nova (Nova Intelligence) is an agentic AI platform for SAP teams, used in production across documentation, functional design, development, and production issue resolution. Its capabilities include code intelligence and system visibility, fit-to-standard analysis mapping custom code to SAP standard, development acceleration for ABAP Cloud and BTP CAP, S/4HANA and Clean Core transformation support, and security vulnerability identification, with claims of a 3x productivity boost at 50% lower cost. Nova is an enterprise, demo-led product with no public API, developer portal, or SDKs at this time; it is backed by Accel and Battery Ventures. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline, which probed the company's public surface and found a domain-security posture and a Vanta trust center but no developer or API artifacts to harvest.

providers.name: nvxclouds
providers.description: nvxclouds is the web home of 锘崴科技 / NVX, whose legal entity is Hangzhou Nuowei Information Technology Co., Ltd. (杭州锘崴信息科技有限公司), an information technology company based in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China. It was surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming. The public website at nvxclouds.com is a single-page web application served over TLS from Alibaba Cloud infrastructure. An enrichment pass on 2026-07-20 probed the domain and common developer paths and found no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI or documentation surface to catalog; this profile records the verified corporate identity and domain-security posture and remains a lead pending any future developer-facing API surface.

providers.name: NYDIG
providers.description: NYDIG is a vertically-integrated bitcoin and power company founded in 2017, operating at the intersection of power, compute, and sound money. It develops power infrastructure supporting bitcoin's proof-of-work security and low-cost energy, and provides institutional-grade financial infrastructure including regulated bitcoin custody, spot and derivatives trading, structuring, and financing. NYDIG was surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network. It exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; access is through the authenticated institutional platform at app.nydig.com.

providers.name: Omniscient
providers.description: Omniscient is an AI intelligence platform for organizational decision-making, describing itself as a new class of AI that masters an organization's data and context to deliver decision-moving insights. Its focus areas include corporate reputation and narrative monitoring, geopolitical and regulatory risk tracking, marketing and narrative measurement, and supply chain and ESG risk, with an emphasis on early detection of weak signals and coordinated response. A Seedcamp portfolio company, it is added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as of this pass it publishes a marketing site (Azure Static Web Apps) with no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: On
providers.description: On (On Holding AG) is a Swiss performance sportswear company founded in 2010, known for its CloudTec running shoes and athletic apparel. It designs and sells premium running footwear, clothing, and accessories worldwide through on.com and retail partners, and is publicly traded on the NYSE (ONON). On was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bond Capital. On does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures the company identity and its domain-security posture within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Once
providers.description: Once (getonce.com) is a consumer chat and connection platform positioned as an alternative to traditional dating apps, offering a pressure-free space for people seeking meaningful connections, improved social skills, and guidance in their personal lives. The mobile app surfaces a small number of daily matches based on shared interests and vibes, lets users join communities of like-minded people, and runs a rewards system called Sparks that members earn and spend on gifts and chat features. Once is a Consumer-sector portfolio company of the venture firm Partech. It ships as a consumer mobile application and does not currently expose a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: One Raven
providers.description: One Raven is a Phoenix, Arizona smart-home technology company building a local-first home automation platform designed for homeowners who want simplicity, privacy, and control. Its core product is the One Raven Home Server, which processes and stores home data locally rather than in the cloud, and ships pre-paired with a curated set of devices such as thermostats, smart locks, leak-detection and security sensors. The platform emphasizes local data storage, encrypted remote access, and a subscription-free model. Backed by a $5M seed round led by proptech investor Fifth Wall. One Raven does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Orbital Operations
providers.description: Orbital Operations is a space-defense technology company founded in 2024 and based in Huntington Beach, California, developing high-thrust, cryogenic-powered orbital vehicles for rapid-response satellite defense, interception, and in-orbit repositioning. Its flagship Astraeus vehicle uses liquid-hydrogen propulsion with a proprietary zero-boil-off (ZBO) cryogenic storage system enabling in-space refueling and efficient payload transport between LEO, MEO, GEO, and lunar orbits. Backed by Initialized Capital, the company builds spaceflight hardware and does not currently expose a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Origami Robotics
providers.description: Origami Robotics is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) hardware startup based in Millbrae, California building advanced robotic hands designed specifically for machine learning and general-purpose robotic manipulation. The company designs a high-degrees-of-freedom hand with in-joint motors, co-designed with a matching data-collection glove that eliminates the embodiment gap between human and robot manipulation so that real-world training data transfers directly to deployed robots. Its focus areas include force transparency, avoiding the sim-to-real problems of high-ratio gearboxes, and scaling real-world manipulation data by deploying devices "in the wild." Origami Robotics targets industrial automation in manufacturing and logistics and has sold hands to Physical AI research labs including Amazon. Origami Robotics is a hardware and robotics company; as of this profile it publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Ornadyne
providers.description: Ornadyne is a Los Angeles hard-tech startup building autonomous flapping-wing UAVs (ornithopters) that look and fly like real birds for covert reconnaissance and surveillance. Its near-silent, AI-powered, man-portable drones are engineered for low acoustic and visual signatures, hour-class flight times, and natural bird-like flight, contrasting with easily detected quadcopters and fixed-wing aircraft. Founded by Geourg Kivijian (CEO, ex-NASA JPL and Astrolab) and Armen Arakelyan (CTO, ex-SpaceX Starship), the company is a Y Combinator Spring 2026 company operating in the hardware, robotics, drones, aerospace, and defense space. It is a hardware/defense company with a marketing website and no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Outfittery
providers.description: Outfittery is a European personal-shopping and personalized-fashion e-commerce service that curates and ships tailored outfits to customers based on a style questionnaire and human stylist recommendations. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany, it operates across the UK, Spain, France, Germany, Switzerland, Austria, Belgium, the Netherlands and Sweden. Surfaced as a portfolio company of HV Capital and Northzone and added to the API Evangelist network. An enrichment probe found a consumer web/e-commerce presence with no public developer portal, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: OYO
providers.description: OYO (Oravel Stays Limited) is an India-headquartered hospitality company that operates a franchise and aggregator platform for budget and mid-market hotels, homes, and vacation rentals across India, Southeast Asia, Europe, and other markets. Founded in 2013 by Ritesh Agarwal and backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, OYO standardizes independent properties under its brands and distributes them through its consumer apps and website. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a consumer-sector company; as of this enrichment pass OYO publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation, so this profile carries company identity only.

providers.name: Oyster.com (TripAdvisor)
providers.description: Oyster.com is a hotel review and travel-photography website owned by TripAdvisor, known for its in-person "Photo Fakeout" investigations and professionally shot, unedited hotel photos across destinations worldwide. It operates as a consumer-facing WordPress-based review and booking-referral site rather than a developer platform: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or well-known discovery documents. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: PaceMaker
providers.description: PaceMaker is the consumer DJ application from Pacemaker Music AB, a Swedish startup and 500 Global portfolio company, that lets anyone mix and mash millions of tracks on iPhone and iPad. It connects to streaming catalogs such as Spotify, includes an AI DJ that suggests matching tracks and beat-matched transitions, and lets users crop and blend songs at phrase, bar, and beat precision to record and share their own mixtapes. Pacemaker is a mobile end-user product; as of this pass it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDK, MCP server, or developer portal, and its domain (pacemaker.net) currently serves a WordPress marketing blog.

providers.name: Packaging Corporation of America
providers.description: Packaging Corporation of America (PCA) is the third largest producer of containerboard and corrugated packaging products in the United States, supplying packaging to food, beverage, and industrial customers. No public APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: Padminivna
providers.description: Padminivna (padminivna.com resolves to Padmini VNA Mechatronics Ltd.) is an automotive component manufacturer established in 1991, specializing in innovation and manufacturing of technologies for the auto components industry across passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles (M&HCV, LCV), two- and three-wheelers, tractors, and off-road vehicles. Its offerings span ICE, hybrid, and EV powertrains plus sensors and agnostic technologies, with a focus on fuel efficiency, quality, and environmental sustainability. Surfaced as a portfolio lead of norwest-venture-partners; the public site exposes only a vendor portal and employee login and publishes no public developer API or documentation surface.

providers.name: PaintZen
providers.description: PaintZen is a residential painting services platform that connects homeowners with vetted professional painters, offering instant online quotes and booking for interior and exterior painting, deck staining, epoxy flooring, and drywall repair. Backed by Bullpen Capital, the company operates its proprietary Zenify platform and now runs under Arch Painting out of Woburn, Massachusetts. As of this enrichment pass PaintZen publishes a consumer-facing website with online quoting and financing but no public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Paramount
providers.description: Paramount is a global media and entertainment company producing premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide, encompassing film, television, and streaming through brands such as Paramount Pictures, CBS, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV.

providers.name: Parasma
providers.description: Parasma is a San Francisco based biological compute startup building algorithms and hardware that train living human brain cells (cortical neurons on a chip) to perform computation for AI workloads. Founded in 2026 by Sean Cole and backed by Y Combinator (Summer 2026 batch), the company grew out of research that taught a clump of lab-grown human neurons to play Doom, coverage of which appeared in Nature, The Economist, Scientific American, The Guardian and elsewhere. Parasma currently operates as an early-stage research company with a marketing and news website; it does not yet publish a public API, SDK, developer portal, or other machine-readable developer surface. This profile is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company lead so any future developer platform can be captured when it ships.

providers.name: parenthoods
providers.description: Parenthoods was a Y Combinator-backed mobile social network for parents, founded in 2014 by Siobhan Quinn and Jeni Axline in San Francisco, that helped local moms and dads discover nearby parents and share parenting experiences to counter the social isolation of early parenthood. The company raised a $1.32M seed round in November 2014 with participation from Slow Ventures, Lowercase Capital, 500 Global, and Y Combinator. The product shipped as an iOS mobile application and never published a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or documentation portal. The parenthoods.com domain now redirects to Wonderschool, and this profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a Slow Ventures portfolio lead with no discoverable API surface.

providers.name: PathSpot
providers.description: PathSpot Technologies provides a health-and-safety operating system for restaurants, commercial kitchens, food manufacturers, cafeterias, and hospitality venues. Its flagship HandScanner uses light-based spectroscopy to detect harmful contaminants on employees' hands in about two seconds after washing and drying. Alongside the scanner, PathSpot's SafetySuite bundles real-time temperature monitoring (PowerTemp), digital task management (PowerTasks), and food labeling (PowerLabels), rolling the data up into the SafetySuite Hub dashboard with analytics, automated compliance reporting, email reports, text alerts, and optional API-based data integration. PathSpot markets API integration as a data-delivery feature of SafetySuite but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, or SDKs as of this profile.

providers.name: Pawdly
providers.description: Pawdly (포들리) is a South Korean pet e-commerce marketplace and mobile app operated by KCC I&C, offering pet product shopping across categories, saved/wishlist items, and pet-care service reservations, alongside pet-care tips and member benefits delivered through its app. KCC I&C operates as a payment intermediary and mail-order sales broker rather than the direct seller, with individual merchants fulfilling orders, shipping, and refunds. Pawdly was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. An enrichment pass found a consumer web/mobile marketplace with no public developer portal, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Pawsh
providers.description: Pawsh is a consumer marketplace that connects pet owners with top-rated local dog and cat groomers. Pet owners browse groomer profiles, read real reviews, compare transparent pricing, and book grooming appointments online in minutes. Backed by 500 Global, Pawsh runs as a Firebase-backed web application at pawsh.app and serves 2,000+ pet owners. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or documentation surface — it is a consumer-facing booking platform with no programmable interface to catalog.

providers.name: Persistent
providers.description: Persistent Systems Limited is a global digital engineering and enterprise modernization company with 35+ years of experience, ~27,500 employees across 21 countries, and roughly $1.65B in annual revenue. It provides consulting, software product engineering, cloud and infrastructure, data and analytics, and applied-AI services to enterprises across banking and financial services, insurance, healthcare and life sciences, industrial, software and hi-tech, and telecom and media. Publicly listed in India, Persistent operates an AI Hub (GenAI Hub, iAURA, SASVA) and a products marketplace, but does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, SDKs, or API reference documentation as of this enrichment pass; this profile therefore captures company identity and probed domain-security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Petrarch
providers.description: Petrarch is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) data-marketplace company based in San Francisco that unlocks enterprise data for the AI economy. Petrarch sources proprietary, enterprise-facing datasets from distressed businesses and legacy industries such as construction, manufacturing, and logistics, clears and anonymizes them, and brokers them to AI companies and research labs building for the physical world. Notable data types transacted include construction plans, autonomous-driving recordings, and codebases. The company was founded by Harvard graduates Ian Lee, Samuel Hahn, and Sudhish Swain, with prior experience at organizations including Scale AI. As of this profile Petrarch operates a public marketing website but does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: PG Studios
providers.description: PG Studios is a full-service creative media company offering animation, film production, and creative media services. The studio operates specialized divisions spanning animation production, filmmaking, audio and music composition, and game development. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global, PG Studios is a creative-services business rather than an API provider: its public website markets studio capabilities and a client portfolio, and it publishes no developer API, SDK, documentation, or developer portal. This profile has been through the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline; the honest result is that there is no public API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Phantom Space
providers.description: Phantom Space Corporation is an American space transportation and satellite manufacturing company founded in 2019 and headquartered at 1816 S Research Loop in Tucson, Arizona. Co-founded by Jim Cantrell, Michael D'Angelo and Michal Prywata, it is developing the Daytona family of small-lift orbital launch vehicles — Daytona I, II and III — alongside modular satellite buses, spacecraft manufacturing and constellation deployment services, pursuing a mass-manufacturing, fully US-based supply chain approach to launch and spacecraft production. The company acquired StratSpace and Micro Aerospace Solutions in 2021 to build out its satellite supply chain. Phantom Space sells launch capacity and satellite build programs through direct commercial contracts; it publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Phia
providers.description: Phia is a personal shopping assistant that helps consumers build their closet and find the best prices instantly across the web. Co-founded by Phoebe Gates and Sophia Kianni, the product spans a mobile app and a browser extension that compares prices for a given item across new and resale marketplaces, tracking more than 700 fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands. The public phia.com site is a consumer storefront (a brand directory plus editorial style edits) and exposes no developer API, documentation, or programmatic surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of GGV Capital and enriched from live probes of the public site.

providers.name: Philz Coffee
providers.description: Philz Coffee is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of cowboy-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: consumer. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: PhishMe
providers.description: PhishMe is a phishing defense and security awareness company founded in 2011 by Rohyt Belani and Aaron Higbee, and rebranded as Cofense in 2018 following its acquisition by a private-equity consortium. The company pioneered simulated-phishing training and crowd-sourced phishing detection, and today operates the Cofense phishing-defense platform spanning Phishing Detection and Response (PDR), security awareness training, managed phishing defense, and threat intelligence. Originally backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, it was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead. The company markets a connected, AI-assisted platform for post-perimeter phishing remediation rather than a public developer API; product, integration, and threat-intelligence capabilities are surfaced through customer and partner channels.

providers.name: Phoenix Tailings
providers.description: Phoenix Tailings is a clean rare earth and critical minerals refining company working to restore U.S. industrial independence by building domestic refining capacity for the metals behind every major technology. It recovers rare earth elements and other critical minerals from mining waste (tailings) and low-grade feedstocks using a low-emission, zero-landfill process, supplying materials for medical devices, electric vehicles and automotive systems, electronics, and defense applications. The company operates as a materials producer and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile tracks its identity and web/domain security posture.

providers.name: Phood Solutions
providers.description: Phood Solutions is a New York City-based food-waste technology company founded in 2015 by Luc Dang and Nick Kruczek. Its computer-vision platform, PhoodX, pairs a countertop scale and camera system with a waste-analytics dashboard to automatically identify, weigh, and categorize discarded food in commercial kitchens, grocery prepared-foods operations, and food-service venues. The platform reports product-level margins, recommends demand-based production volumes, and helps operators cut food waste by up to 50 percent, reduce kitchen labor, and lower food-inventory costs. Phood also offers Phood Lab, custom digital solutions built by its food technologists. The company is backed by Techstars. Phood publishes no public API or developer program at this time.

providers.name: Pinhome
providers.description: Pinhome is an Indonesian proptech real estate marketplace for smart buying, selling, and renting of houses, apartments, offices, and shop-houses (Pintar Jual Beli Sewa Rumah). The platform spans property listings and search, mortgage (KPR) and loan-takeover facilitation with partner banks, an automated property valuation tool (Pinvalue), and a marketplace of household and property services. Backed by Ribbit Capital, Pinhome operates a consumer-facing web and mobile product and does not publish a public developer API surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Pioneer Square Labs
providers.description: Pioneer Square Labs (PSL) is a Seattle-based startup studio and venture capital firm that partners with founders to build and fund early-stage technology companies. It operates two programs: PSL Studio, which co-creates companies from scratch alongside founders, and PSL Ventures, which invests seed capital in early-stage startups. PSL has spun out and backed companies including Arrived, Boundless, Recurrent, Dropzone, and SingleFile, and is currently focused on AI and agent-driven ventures (including its own "Lev" AI co-founder). This is a company/investor profile in the API Evangelist network; PSL publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Planby Technologies
providers.description: Planby Technologies, Inc. (PLANBY) is a Seoul-based AI transformation partner for architecture and construction organizations, helping construction firms, architectural offices, and interior studios adopt AI-powered workflows. Its products include PLANA (interior and concept CG rendering automation) and PLAD (apartment exterior design visualization), which cut visualization timeframes from days to hours, alongside its AX Program for organizational AI transformation (diagnosis, training, and workflow integration) and Knowledge System Building that structures construction data such as blueprints, specifications, and defect records into domain-specific data frameworks. Clients include Samsung E&A, POSCO E&C, Hyundai, Daewoo E&C, and Samsung C&T. Backed by 500 Global. PLANBY publishes no public API or developer surface at this time.

providers.name: Platogo
providers.description: Platogo Interactive Entertainment GmbH is a Vienna, Austria based social casino gaming studio that builds and operates free-to-play slot and casino apps for mobile and web. Its flagship titles are Slotpark, a premium Vegas-style social slots app used by millions daily, and Gaminator, one of the largest social casino gaming communities on the web. The company localizes its games into more than 13 languages and works alongside industry partners including Greentube and Novomatic. Platogo is backed by Seedcamp. No public developer API, SDK, or technical documentation is currently published; this profile captures the company identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: PleasrDAO
providers.description: PleasrDAO is a decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) formed in 2021 by a collective of digital artists, NFT collectors, and DeFi investors. It is known for acquiring and stewarding culturally significant digital and physical assets, including the sole copy of Wu-Tang Clan's album "Once Upon a Time in Shaolin," the original "Doge" meme image, and Edward Snowden's "Stay Free" NFT. The organization pioneers fractionalized, on-chain ownership of art and cultural artifacts. PleasrDAO operates as a community-governed collective rather than a conventional software or API company; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: Podfund
providers.description: Podfund provides startup and growth capital to podcast creators and audio-driven media companies, typically investing $25,000 to $150,000 based on stage, track record, traction, and revenue. Operated by TechNexus Venture Collaborative, which has backed 600+ startups since 2007, Podfund pairs funding with business planning, a peer community, mentor matching, a growth toolkit, and partner offers. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and added to the API Evangelist network. Podfund publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity and web presence for network discovery.

providers.name: Pony.ai
providers.description: Pony.ai is a global autonomous-mobility company founded in Silicon Valley in 2016 and dual-headquartered in Guangzhou and Fremont. Its core technology is the Pony "virtual driver", a Level 4 autonomous driving stack deployed across three business lines: Robotaxi (PonyPilot+ ride-hailing service operating in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Shenzhen, plus pilots in California and Arizona), Robotruck (autonomous heavy-duty trucking in China), and Personally Owned Vehicle (POV) intelligent driving software for production passenger cars. The company is publicly listed on NASDAQ under PONY and reports more than 32 million kilometres of autonomous road testing. Pony.ai does not publish a traditional public developer API; its public GitHub presence includes infrastructure tooling such as pony_aim (experiment tracker) and bazel-buildfarm rather than the AV stack itself. This profile captures the company surface and any developer-relevant artifacts.

providers.name: Pop Mart
providers.description: Pop Mart International Group is a Chinese pop-culture and designer-toy company best known for its blind-box collectibles and character IP such as Labubu (The Monsters), Molly, Skullpanda and Dimoo. Headquartered in Beijing and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, it operates retail stores, robot-shop vending machines, and a consumer e-commerce presence across China and international markets. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan (HongShan/Sequoia China). Consumer sector; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment (no developer portal, /.well-known documents, or llms.txt).

providers.name: Pose
providers.description: Pose (pose.vn) is a Vietnamese entertainment and lifestyle media publication based in Ho Chi Minh City, covering celebrity news, beauty pageants (including Miss Universe Vietnam), fashion, beauty, health, and film and television. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio lead and added to the API Evangelist network as a company stub. As of this enrichment pass the site is a consumer-facing content publication monetized through advertising and sponsored content, with no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Potion Labs
providers.description: Potion Labs (which rebranded its engineering org to Ntropika Labs) is a decentralized finance team behind Potion Finance / Potion Protocol, an on-chain risk-management and options platform on Ethereum. Potion is a "perfectly priced put AMM" — a decentralized put-option / DeFi insurance marketplace where liquidity providers earn yield by selling downside protection through a proprietary bonding curve based on the Kelly Criterion, while buyers get automated routing to the best price across independent liquidity providers. The protocol is delivered as Solidity smart contracts with TypeScript/Vue frontends rather than a hosted REST API. Backed by Polychain Capital. This profile was surfaced from Polychain's portfolio and enriched from the team's public GitHub org and website; the project appears largely dormant (contracts deployed to the deprecated Ropsten testnet, and potion.fi now serves a DeFi blog).

providers.name: Proxima
providers.description: Proxima (Proxima Bio) is a preclinical biotechnology company making protein interactions programmable through an integrated discovery platform that combines artificial intelligence, machine learning, and structural proteomics. Building on a proprietary atlas of protein cross-linking data, Proxima trains models that design proximity modulators - Inducers, Modulators, and Blockers - small-molecule therapeutics that induce or block protein-protein complexes to address cancer, autoimmune disorders, and other hard-to-treat diseases. The company is backed by DCVC and collaborates with major pharmaceutical firms. It is listed in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; as of this pass Proxima publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Public Storage
providers.description: Public Storage is an American real estate investment trust (REIT) that acquires, develops, owns, and operates self-storage facilities throughout the United States and Europe. Headquartered in Glendale, California, it is one of the largest self-storage operators in the world, serving customers via its online reservation system (eRental), mobile apps, and physical facilities. No public developer APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: PVH
providers.description: PVH Corp, formerly known as the Phillips-Van Heusen Corporation, is an American clothing company headquartered in Manhattan, New York City and listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker PVH. Founded in 1881, PVH today operates two iconic owned global brands — Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger — along with licensed brands including Kenneth Cole New York and Michael Kors. PVH divested its Heritage Brands wholesale business (Van Heusen, Arrow, Izod, Geoffrey Beene) to Authentic Brands Group in August 2021, refocusing the company on its two flagship designer lifestyle brands. PVH does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal at the corporate level; technology and commerce integrations are handled brand-by-brand and through closed wholesale, licensing, and retail technology partnerships.

providers.name: QikPod
providers.description: QikPod was an Accel-backed Indian startup that built an automated parcel locker network for last-mile e-commerce delivery, letting shoppers collect and return packages from unattended smart lockers placed in apartments, offices, and retail locations. The company has since rebranded and pivoted to Leapmile Robotics, a nano-warehouse automation and intelligent fulfillment platform that uses robotics to handle storage, retrieval, picking, auditing, and dispatch inside compact autonomous warehouse facilities. The legacy qikpod.com domain now redirects to leapmile.com/qikpod. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company lead; no public developer API surface has been found for either the QikPod or Leapmile properties.

providers.name: QOSMIC
providers.description: QOSMIC builds optical ground station infrastructure, a frontier-tech play backed by prosus-ventures and tracked in the API Evangelist network. Its public presence (qosmic.space) is a single-page marketing site with no documented API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable surface at the time of enrichment. This profile captures the company identity and probed domain security posture; it remains a lead awaiting a public API before deeper artifact enrichment.

providers.name: Quickshipper
providers.description: QuickShipper is a last-mile delivery and fleet management SaaS platform that helps businesses manage order fulfillment and deliveries. It provides route optimization, order batching, automated or manual dispatching, a courier mobile app, real-time tracking, branded customer notifications, and business analytics. Companies can operate their own fleet or connect with third-party courier providers, and can sync orders automatically through API integration and WooCommerce/WordPress plugins. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Rasyonet
providers.description: Rasyonet is a Turkish fintech company providing integrated financial software solutions and capital markets data platforms for institutional clients, asset managers, and financial analysts. Founded in 2000 and headquartered at ITU ARI Teknopark in Istanbul, Rasyonet offers tools for analyzing global equity markets, economic indicators, mutual and pension funds, fixed-income securities, portfolio analytics, and automated financial reporting. Their flagship EquityRT platform delivers equity research, company valuation, and peer benchmarking capabilities via desktop and Excel integration. No public developer API or machine-readable specification has been documented at this time.

providers.name: Rcom
providers.description: Rcom (Reliance Communications, RCOM) is an Indian telecommunications and digital infrastructure company providing enterprise connectivity, voice, and data-center services. Its portfolio spans dedicated internet access and DDoS protection, IP transit, MPLS VPN, Ethernet and leased lines, cloud networking (Cloud X Fusion / Cloud X WAN), enterprise voice (E1 PRI, SIP trunk, IP Centrex), cloud telephony and hosted contact centers, toll-free and global access numbers, audio/web conferencing, colocation and managed data-center services, and global subsea cable networks via its Global Cloud Xchange subsidiary. The company surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; enrichment confirms an enterprise service business with customer and billing portals but no public developer program, API surface, or well-known discovery documents.

providers.name: Rebookify
providers.description: Rebookify is a travel-technology company that helps travel agencies and travel management companies save money on hotel bookings by continuously monitoring the price of existing hotel reservations and automatically rebooking them at lower rates whenever prices drop, capturing the savings without changing the guest's stay. Backed by 500 Global, Rebookify operates a business-facing web product at rebookify.com. As of this enrichment pass no public developer API, documentation, developer portal, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface has been identified.

providers.name: Rec Rec
providers.description: Ecobites Pte. Ltd. operates Rec Rec, a Vietnamese consumer packaged-goods brand producing cricket-based snack foods marketed as high-protein, nutrient-dense alternatives to conventional snacks. Its product line spans cricket noodles (Mi Dam De), cricket puffs (Banh Phong De) in flavors such as Gochujang and Mala, and seasoned dried crickets (De Say). Products emphasize complete protein with a full amino-acid profile plus iron, zinc, magnesium, and potassium while keeping sodium low. Rec Rec is distributed through 7-Eleven, Farmers Market, Galaxy Cinema, BHD Cineplex, Naman Market, LS Place, Shopee, and TikTok Shop. The company is a 500 Global portfolio company and was added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. It publishes a consumer e-commerce website but no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: RedNote (Xiaohongshu)
providers.description: RedNote, known in China as Xiaohongshu (小红书, "Little Red Book"), is a Shanghai-based social and e-commerce platform operated by Xingyin Information Technology (行吟信息科技). It blends user-generated lifestyle content, community discovery, and in-app shopping, and is one of China's largest content-commerce platforms. Beyond the consumer app, RedNote runs an open platform (open.xiaohongshu.com) plus the Qianfan (千帆) merchant commerce workbench (ark.xiaohongshu.com) and a mini-program surface (miniapp.xiaohongshu.com) that let brands, merchants, and marketing partners integrate storefronts, content, and campaigns. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of HongShan (Sequoia China) and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Refundid
providers.description: Refundid is an instant-refund platform for e-commerce returns in Australia/NZ. Provides instant cash refund at the point of return initiation.

providers.name: Renren
providers.description: Renren (人人网), originally launched as Xiaonei in 2005 and renamed in 2009, was one of China's largest social networking platforms and was widely described as the "Facebook of China," especially popular among university students. Renren Inc. listed on the NYSE in 2011; the social-networking business later declined and the assets were sold in 2018. The site is now operated by Chengdu Renren Interactive Entertainment Technology Co., Ltd. and is undergoing a service upgrade. Historically Renren ran an Open Platform with an OAuth2 REST API (wiki.dev.renren.com) for third-party login and social integration; that developer surface is now defunct and no live API endpoints respond.

providers.name: RetailMeNot *
providers.description: RetailMeNot is a consumer savings destination that aggregates coupons, promo codes, cash-back offers, and deals from thousands of retailers and brands, helping shoppers in the United States save money when they buy online and in-store. It operates a website, mobile apps, and browser extensions that surface verified discount codes and cash-back at checkout, and it monetizes through retailer affiliate relationships rather than a self-serve developer platform. As of this profile RetailMeNot publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface; probing found no reachable developer portal or well-known discovery documents, and partner activity is handled through whitelabel affiliate infrastructure.

providers.name: Reverie
providers.description: Reverie is an early-stage venture capital firm based in New York that invests at the pre-seed and seed stages in crypto and web3 companies and protocols, describing its work as crafting generational companies and protocols. Its portfolio spans blockchain infrastructure, wallets and key management, DeFi, on-chain security, and trading, and includes companies such as Blockaid, Keplr, Squads, Stride, Tensor, Geodnet, and Agora. Reverie was surfaced through the Multicoin Capital portfolio and also produces The Archive podcast. It is an investment firm rather than an API producer, so it publishes no public API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Rise Robotics
providers.description: RISE Robotics develops industrial linear-actuation technology designed to replace traditional hydraulic systems. Its flagship Beltdraulic Cylinder is a fluid-free hydraulic alternative delivering faster actuation, higher reliability, no fire hazard, and fuel-source flexibility for large-scale industrial applications. The company builds actuation products (Beltdraulic Cylinder, Railgate, SuperJammer, CLD) for Tier 1 suppliers, OEMs, and the US Department of Defense. RISE Robotics is a hardware and heavy-equipment company backed by Techstars; it publishes no developer API, SDK, or developer portal, so this API Evangelist profile captures identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Roadrunner
providers.description: RoadRunner is a tech-enabled managed waste and recycling services company operating across all 50 US states, serving 14,000+ commercial customers in hospitality, healthcare, retail, logistics and manufacturing. It consolidates multi-location waste programs and layers proprietary optimization tooling (Oversite, Waste Metering, BillCheck, Priceshield) plus the RecycleMORE and CleanStream recycling programs on top of hauler networks. Backed by Fifth Wall and Kleiner Perkins in the climate sector. As of this enrichment pass RoadRunner publishes a marketing site and a customer + payment portal but no public developer/API surface, so no OpenAPI, SDK, MCP or event artifacts were found.

providers.name: roadster
providers.description: Roadster was a Palo Alto digital automotive retail commerce platform (its Express Storefront let dealers sell and finance vehicles fully online) that was acquired by CDK Global in 2021 and folded into CDK's automotive digital-retailing suite. The roadster.com domain now serves CDK Global's Automotive Digital Retailing product and no longer exposes a standalone Roadster developer portal, API reference, or public API surface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of slow-ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network; no public API artifacts are discoverable.

providers.name: Rocket Lab
providers.description: Rocket Lab (Rocket Lab Corporation, formerly Rocket Lab USA; Nasdaq RKLB) is an American aerospace manufacturer and end-to-end space company founded in 2006 by Peter Beck. It designs and launches the Electron small-lift orbital rocket, is developing the reusable Neutron medium-lift vehicle, and builds the Photon spacecraft platform along with satellites, spacecraft components, solar cells, reaction wheels, star trackers, separation systems and other space systems. Rocket Lab operates launch complexes in Mahia, New Zealand and at Wallops Island, Virginia, providing dedicated and rideshare launch services plus on-orbit management for commercial, civil and national-security customers. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Khosla Ventures; this profile is enriched from public identity and live domain probes only, as Rocket Lab publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Rocketable
providers.description: Rocketable acquires profitable SaaS products and infuses them with AI, operating a portfolio of software businesses that are run, improved, and grown by AI agents. Backed by Y Combinator, True Ventures, Bloomberg Beta, and INDIE.vc, the San Francisco company buys established SaaS products generating at least $500K in annual revenue and works toward support that resolves problems in seconds and features and fixes that ship in minutes or hours instead of quarters. The public site runs two intake flows — apply to join the team, and submit a SaaS product to be acquired — plus a newsletter on automating software businesses with AI agents. No public API or developer surface is published.

providers.name: Rowspace
providers.description: Rowspace builds AI infrastructure for major asset managers, converting fragmented institutional knowledge into clean, structured data that AI can reliably operate on. Founded in 2024 by Michael Manapat (former CTO of Notion and Head of Applied ML at Stripe) and Yibo Ling (former Chief Business Officer of Binance), the company operates under Emergence Capital's "Agentic Software" thesis with the positioning "You built your firm's edge. Compound it with AI." As of this enrichment pass Rowspace publishes only a marketing website (www.rowspace.ai) and has no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures verified company identity and a domain-security probe.

providers.name: roxmotor
providers.description: ROX Motor (roxmotor.com) is a Chinese electric-vehicle manufacturer, a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners, best known for the ROX 01 electric off-road SUV. It is a consumer automotive brand with no public developer API surface; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched with a domain-security probe. The site is hosted on Tencent Cloud and was not reachable from the enrichment environment for content search.

providers.name: Rtv
providers.description: Rtv (Return to Vendor) is a materials-innovation company building a circular recycling system for nylon-6. Its patented molecular design regenerates nylon that can be recycled infinitely without quality loss, yielding production-ready recyclable yarn, monomaterial stretch fabric, and regenerated pellets for injection molding and extrusion. The company also offers end-of-life textile collection, waste reprocessing, and regulatory-compliance support (EPR, California SB 707, EU textile regulations) for apparel, automotive, and technical industrial applications. Backed by Khosla Ventures, Third Sphere, Teknor Apex, and NSF SBIR grants.

providers.name: Rubicon
providers.description: Rubicon (formerly NYSE: RBT) is a waste, recycling, and sustainability technology company founded in 2008. It went public in 2022 via a SPAC merger with Founder SPAC at a pro forma valuation of roughly $1.7 billion, branding itself a "digital challenger" to the traditional waste-hauling industry with a marketplace connecting waste generators to independent haulers plus the RUBICONSmartCity fleet-and-routing platform used by more than 70 municipalities. Operating Status: the company subsequently faced severe financial distress - layoffs and debt restructuring in 2023, a June 2024 NYSE delisting, and a May 2024 divestiture of its entire fleet technology and smart-city business unit (RUBICONSmartCity, RUBICONPro, RUBICONPremier) to Rodina Capital for roughly $68 million plus a possible $12 million earnout; those assets were subsequently absorbed by Routeware. In early 2025 Rubicon deregistered its securities and became a privately held company, majority-owned by Jose Miguel Enrich through MBI Holdings, and remains the subject of shareholder litigation over the change-of-control terms. The surviving company operates as a smaller enterprise waste brokerage and sustainability-data business built around the RUBICONConnect platform (service, equipment, pickup, and cost visibility for enterprise customers such as Chipotle and FedEx), alongside RUBICONRegWatch compliance tooling, sustainability reporting, technical advisory services, and the Rubicon Now on-demand dumpster-rental service in a handful of cities. rubicon.com publishes no developer portal, no public API reference, and no OpenAPI specification. The only discoverable API artifact tied to the rubicon.com domain is a "Routeware Smartcity Public Api" Swagger UI hosted at a dev subdomain (haulerpublic-api.dev.aws.rubicon.com) - leftover infrastructure from the divested fleet/smart-city business - which returned a 503 Service Unavailable on every check during this review and is not publicly documented or reachable. Any hauler or municipal system integration Rubicon references (for example, connecting to city 311 systems) is negotiated per partner and gated behind sales and onboarding rather than exposed through self-serve developer documentation. Pricing across RUBICONConnect and Rubicon's enterprise services is entirely quote-based and negotiated per contract; no public pricing, tiers, or rate limits are published. This entry is maintained as an honest stub pending any future public API surface.

providers.name: Samara
providers.description: Samara is a residential design and construction company that builds prefabricated, factory-made homes. Founded as an independent venture by Airbnb co-founder Joe Gebbia, Samara designs and delivers backyard accessory dwelling units (ADUs) in configurable Studio, One Bedroom, Two Bedroom, XL 8 and XL 10 models, alongside "Locale by Samara" single-family homes and a modular "kit of parts" for higher-yield multifamily infill. The company pairs a consumer-facing online configurator, property-eligibility checks, financing options and regional showrooms with factory production and installation. Backed by General Catalyst, Samara operates in the housing, construction technology and real-estate space. It is a physical-product company with no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Samunnati
providers.description: Samunnati is an integrated agri-enterprise platform working to de-fragment India's agricultural value chain by connecting farmers, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), and agri enterprises. It combines financial solutions (lending to farmers, FPOs, and agri businesses), trade facilitation and market linkages, and digital marketplaces (FPO Next, Trade Next, and input, output, credit, and consumer marketplaces), alongside innovation, research, and foundation-led community work. Operating across Chennai, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Jaipur, Odisha, Uttar Pradesh, and Bihar, it positions itself as one of India's largest agri enterprises. Samunnati runs several customer-facing digital platforms but does not publish a public developer portal or API at this time.

providers.name: Saudara Ai
providers.description: Saudara AI is an AI-native sourcing brokerage, founded in 2024 and based in Spokane, Washington, that connects American brands with vetted Indonesian manufacturers. Buyers submit requests for quotes (RFQs) and the company pairs human brokers with AI agents that scan factories, verify certifications, benchmark pricing against market data, and prepare quotes, returning vetted supplier options within 48 hours. Saudara AI also handles quality control, logistics, improved payment terms (30/70 and net-60), and vendor financing. As of its launch the company reports having sourced over $1M for 40+ brands. It operates as a brokerage service and does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Savioke
providers.description: Savioke is a robotics company, backed by GV, that built the Relay autonomous delivery robot used by hotels and hospitals to move items such as amenities, medications, lab samples, and supplies through facilities without human assistance. The company now operates as Relay Robotics (savioke.com redirects to relayrobotics.com). It publishes no public API, SDK, or developer surface; enrichment found only a marketing/contact site.

providers.name: Scodix
providers.description: Scodix is a digital print enhancement (embellishment) technology company founded in 2007 and headquartered in Rosh HaAyin, Israel. It manufactures the Scodix Ultra series of digital embellishment presses and the Scodix Studio web-to-print software, enabling decorative effects across 17 applications including Spot UV, foil, glitter, metallic, cast-and-cure, braille and variable data. Scodix serves commercial print, folding-carton packaging, publishing and web-to-print markets with over 400 installations worldwide, and went public on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (TASE) in 2021. Scodix Studio exposes integration APIs for connecting embellishment workflows to MIS and web-to-print storefronts, but Scodix does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or self-serve API documentation.

providers.name: SDSA
providers.description: SDSA (stylized as /dev/agents) is a stealth-stage startup building what it describes as a next-generation operating system for AI agents, aiming to make agentic applications a robust part of everyday consumer software through new UI patterns, a reimagined privacy model, and a developer platform for shipping more capable apps. The company was founded by David Singleton (former Stripe CTO), Ficus Kirkpatrick, Hugo Barra, and Nicholas Jitkoff, and is backed by SV Angel. As of this profile the company is pre-product: sdsa.ai is a single marketing/recruiting page with no public API, developer documentation, SDKs, or developer portal yet available. This entry was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched with what is publicly verifiable.

providers.name: Seed&Spark
providers.description: Seed&Spark is a crowdfunding and streaming platform for independent film and episodic content, combining a project crowdfunding marketplace for filmmakers with a subscription streaming service for independent films and series. Founded in 2012 and backed by Techstars, the company helps independent creators raise funds, build audiences, and distribute their work. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment (homepage and app paths sit behind Cloudflare bot protection; no api.* or developers.* subdomain resolves and no well-known API documents are published).

providers.name: SeeMexico
providers.description: SeeMexico is a B2B corporate travel management platform and business travel agency in Mexico that lets companies book flights, hotels, and car rentals from a single platform. It offers corporate rates, business credit, cashback, direct invoicing (facturacion), and a dedicated account executive to streamline managed business travel. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; the public site is a Duda-built marketing site and no public developer portal, API documentation, or programmatic surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Sequence Holdings
providers.description: Sequence Holdings is a technology holding company that acquires established businesses and transforms them with artificial intelligence. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc, it operates as an investment and operating group that buys mature companies and applies AI to modernize their products and operations. The company publishes a single marketing site and no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: ServiceMaster Global Holdings
providers.description: ServiceMaster Global Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: SERV) was the Memphis-based parent company behind Terminix, ServiceMaster Restore, ServiceMaster Clean, Merry Maids, AmeriSpec and Furniture Medic — termite and pest control, disaster restoration, commercial and residential cleaning, home inspection and furniture repair, delivered largely through a franchise network. The company no longer exists under this name. On 1 October 2020 it sold the ServiceMaster Brands franchise business to Roark Capital for $1.553 billion, and later that month renamed itself Terminix Global Holdings, Inc., changing its NYSE ticker to TMX. Rentokil Initial plc completed its acquisition of Terminix Global Holdings in October 2022, absorbing the remaining pest-control business. The ServiceMaster brand itself continues under the independent, Roark-owned ServiceMaster Brands at servicemaster.com. Neither the historic holding company nor its successors publish a public developer program, API documentation, or a machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Sheroes
providers.description: Sheroes is a women-only social network and community platform based in India, founded in 2014 by Sairee Chahal. It gives women a safe, moderated space to connect, ask questions anonymously, seek support, learn, and grow across communities spanning careers, health, relationships, parenting, entrepreneurship, and personal finance. The platform operates a mobile app and website, offers helpline and expert support, and has expanded into women-focused financial services (MahilaMoney). Sheroes was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Sheroes exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, developer portal, or documented event/webhook surface; the site is a fully client-side single-page application. This profile therefore captures the company identity plus a live domain-security probe of its public host.

providers.name: Shift5
providers.description: Shift5 is an operational technology (OT) cyber and observability company that instruments the onboard serial data buses of planes, trains, and military weapons systems to deliver real-time intrusion detection, predictive maintenance, and compliance intelligence for defense and transportation fleets. Founded by former US Army Cyber Command engineers, it collects and analyzes data directly from vehicle bus networks (MIL-STD-1553, ARINC 429, CAN) to give operators actionable insight into the health and security of their platforms. Backed by Insight Partners. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; enrichment confirms Shift5 publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: ShoeDazzle
providers.description: ShoeDazzle is a California-based online fashion subscription retailer offering curated shoes, handbags, and accessories through a VIP membership model. Founded in March 2009 (early backers included Andreessen Horowitz and Lightspeed Venture Partners), it was acquired by JustFab in August 2013 and is now operated as a brand of TechStyle Fashion Group alongside Fabletics, JustFab, FabKids, and Savage X Fenty. ShoeDazzle is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API documentation.

providers.name: Shots Mobile
providers.description: Shots Mobile, Inc. is the company founded by John and Sam Shahidi that built the Shots selfie photo-sharing app (2013) and grew from mobile-game studio RockLive into a podcast and media business. Today shots.com presents SHOTS as a media company that helps creators turn shows into businesses through partnerships, distribution, and growth resources. It publishes a marketing/content website on WordPress.com and exposes no first-party developer or API product surface; there is no public documentation, SDK, or hosted API. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Shotwellai
providers.description: Shotwell AI is a Y Combinator-backed startup building an observability and annotation layer for robotics training data. Its pipeline ingests raw teleoperation video, robot logs, and multimodal sensor streams, then uses models to watch every frame, segment continuous motion into discrete actions, and label each action against a customer's task definition and SOP rubric. Every label is quality-scored and returned in hours rather than weeks, producing dense, frame-accurate, training-ready datasets for robot manipulation, deformable/folding tasks, teleoperation episode QA, and vision-language-action (VLA) foundation-model post-training. As of enrichment the company exposes only a marketing website and a sales contact (hello@shotwell.ai); no public API, developer portal, documentation, or SDKs were found.

providers.name: Shriram City
providers.description: Shriram City (Shriram City Union Finance Ltd) was a leading Indian non-banking financial company (NBFC) in the Shriram Group, offering personal, business, two-wheeler, gold and small-enterprise loans plus fixed deposits. Founded 1986 in Chennai, it was surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners. In November 2022 the company was amalgamated into Shriram Finance Ltd; its www.shriramcity.in host no longer resolves and the shriramcity.in apex now redirects to shriramfinance.in. No public developer or API program was found. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline: web search + live domain/security/well-known probes.

providers.name: Sidekick Data
providers.description: Sidekick is a professional AI assistant for real estate agents and brokerages, built on the same large language model technology that powers ChatGPT with custom integrations into real estate-specific data sources. From a chat-style interface it combines an agent's inputs with MLS data feeds, local market insights, and a brokerage's brand preferences to produce detailed, on-voice outputs - covering client relationship tracking, email and call interaction analysis, market trend monitoring, property comparisons, transaction document management, and compliance risk detection. Sidekick is directly integrated with MLS and association data feeds across the United States and is backed by investors including Socium Ventures, Swift Ventures, and Garuda Ventures. It is a consumer/professional SaaS product and publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Silagroup
providers.description: SILA is a next-generation business services and real estate platform based in India, backed by Norwest Venture Partners. It delivers strategic solutions across Facility Management, Material Handling Services, Food & Catering, Real Estate Advisory, and Real Estate Development, supporting corporate entities, real estate funds, landowners, and developers throughout the entire real estate lifecycle. SILA runs a WordPress-based corporate website (silagroup.co.in) and publishes no public developer API surface; the only exposed HTTP API is the internal WordPress REST (wp-json) endpoint used to render the CMS. Enrichment confirmed no OpenAPI/AsyncAPI, no /.well-known discovery documents, and no developer portal, SDKs, or docs as of this pass.

providers.name: SJSemi
providers.description: SJSemi (SJSemiconductor (Jiangyin) Corp.) is a Chinese semiconductor Middle-End-Of-Line (MEOL) pure-play foundry and outsourced assembly and test (OSAT) provider, founded in 2014 as a joint venture between JCET and SMIC and headquartered in the Jiangyin High-Tech Industrial Development Zone, Jiangsu, with offices in Shanghai and Santa Clara, California. The company operates a 12-inch wafer bumping, wafer-level chip-scale packaging, chip probing and final-test line, and supplies advanced packaging and 3D multi-die integration services — Cu pillar, RDL, fan-out, TSV and silicon interposer 2.5D — into smartphone, 5G communications, high-performance computing, data-center and automotive electronics supply chains. It is a contract manufacturer of physical semiconductor packaging services and publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable interface contract.

providers.name: SK Finance
providers.description: SK Finance Ltd (skfin.in) is a Jaipur, India-based non-banking financial company (NBFC) providing asset-backed retail lending.
