Its products span commercial vehicle, car, tractor, construction-equipment and two-wheeler loans alongside secured business loans and home-renovation / mortgage finance, delivered through a physical branch network with EMI calculators, online EMI payment, a branch locator, a loan-application portal and a customer "Refer and Earn" referral program. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a corporate/marketing website (Next.js) with no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs or other machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Smule
providers.description: Smule is an American consumer music technology company whose flagship social singing and karaoke app lets people perform solos, duets, and group songs and collaborate with other singers around the world in real time. Launched on iOS in 2012 and on Android in 2013 under the name "Sing! Karaoke," the app grew to tens of millions of monthly active users. Smule Inc. is headquartered in San Francisco and is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Shasta Ventures. Smule publishes no official public developer API; this profile tracks the company for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Snowcap Compute
providers.description: Snowcap Compute is building the world's first commercial superconducting computing platform, operating at 4.5 Kelvin to deliver breakthrough energy efficiency and performance for AI and data-center workloads. Launched in June 2025 with $23 million in seed funding led by Playground Global, the company is developing superconducting chips and systems aimed at the next era of AI and quantum-adjacent compute. As a hardware and deep-tech company it publishes a marketing and careers presence but no public API, developer portal, or SDK at this time.

providers.name: Soufflé Therapeutics
providers.description: Soufflé Therapeutics is a genetic medicine company developing nucleic acid (siRNA) therapeutics that use proprietary cell-specific ligand-conjugation technology to target and deliver treatments to specific cell types. Its initial programs address muscle and heart disorders, with first therapies targeting Facioscapulohumeral Muscular Dystrophy (FSHD) and genetically-driven cardiomyopathies, with clinical trials expected to begin in 2026. The company is headquartered in Watertown, Massachusetts and was surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners. It is a therapeutics/pharmaceutical company and publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK surface.

providers.name: SOURCE Global
providers.description: SOURCE Global, PBC (founded as Zero Mass Water) is a Scottsdale, Arizona public benefit corporation started in 2014 by Arizona State University materials scientist Cody Friesen to make drinking water out of sunlight and air. Its SOURCE Hydropanel is an off-grid solar-thermal device that pulls water vapor from the atmosphere, condenses and mineralizes it, and delivers roughly five liters of drinking water a day; the panels were deployed in residential, commercial, community and humanitarian projects across more than 50 countries, and the company later moved into bottled water, acquiring Proud Source Water in 2023. It raised approximately USD 270 million in total, including a USD 50 million Series C led by BlackRock in 2020 and a USD 130 million Series D in 2022 co-led by Breakthrough Energy Ventures and the Drawdown Fund with Microsoft Climate Innovation Fund and Fifth Wall participating. SOURCE was a hardware and consumer-products business rather than a software vendor: it never published a developer portal, API reference, SDK or any machine-readable API contract, and the only machine-readable surface its site ever exposed was the Shopify platform behind its direct-to-consumer storefront. The company went quiet during 2025 — an April 2025 SEC filing showed a USD 75 million raise that closed at USD 19.3 million, and founder Cody Friesen announced his departure in June 2025 — and as of August 2026 source.co answers HTTP 402 "Store unavailable" on every path while the legacy zeromasswater.com domain resolves to a parked GoDaddy builder page.

providers.name: Space Ape
providers.description: Space Ape Games is a London-based mobile game studio founded in 2012 and now part of Supercell, known for live-service mobile titles including Beatstar, Fastlane: Road to Revenge, Transformers: Earth Wars, Samurai Siege, and Rival Kingdoms. The studio operates in the consumer gaming sector and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDK; its primary web presence redirects to Supercell. This profile was surfaced as an Accel portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline, which found no public API surface and captured domain-security posture for the studio domain.

providers.name: SpeedHome
providers.description: SpeedHome is a Malaysian online property rental marketplace that connects landlords and tenants directly, best known for its zero-deposit rental model backed by tenancy protection. The platform covers listing, tenant screening, digital tenancy agreements, rent collection, and landlord protection through its consumer-facing web and mobile applications. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as of this pass it publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Spenny
providers.description: Spenny is an Indian personal-finance and micro-investing app that works like a digital piggy bank, rounding up everyday spending on cards, UPI, and netbanking and automatically investing the spare change. Users can put round-ups and lump sums (from as little as Rs. 10) into digital gold and curated mutual fund baskets, with no lock-ins and anytime withdrawals. Spenny is a consumer mobile application and does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, or developer portal. Backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: StableBrowse
providers.description: StableBrowse is a San Francisco startup (Y Combinator, Spring 2026) building browser infrastructure and real-world data pipelines for AI agents and AI labs. Its platform transforms dynamic websites into structured knowledge and execution graphs so agents can reliably complete web-based tasks — form filling, data extraction, authentication flows, and website change detection — without relearning workflows on every run, and it sources, labels, and enriches hard-to-find long-tail, gated, and ephemeral web data until it is worth training on. StableBrowse markets performance gains including large reductions in token usage, faster workflow execution, and high task success rates across use cases such as price monitoring, loan applications, CRM updates, travel booking, and navigation of legacy enterprise systems. The company was founded by Jay Mehta, Deepit Shah, and Somansh Shah (all formerly of Amazon). As of this profile the public site is a marketing landing page with no published API, developer documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Stailer
providers.description: Stailer (ステイラー) is a retail-commerce platform built by 10X, Inc. (株式会社10X) that lets Japanese supermarket, drugstore, and other retail chains vertically launch and operate their own branded e-commerce and online-grocery services. It provides the consumer storefront apps, order management, in-store picking and fulfillment, and delivery operations that let established brick-and-mortar retailers stand up online shopping quickly. Stailer is a B2B SaaS offering sold through direct enterprise engagement; as of this enrichment pass it exposes no public developer API, documentation portal, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Starcloud
providers.description: Starcloud is developing orbital data centers that run AI and high-performance compute in space. The company aims to deploy hyperscale, gigawatt-scale infrastructure in orbit, using continuous solar energy without batteries and radiative cooling into the vacuum to lower cost, scale beyond terrestrial siting and permitting limits, and deploy rapidly. Backed by Nvidia, Sequoia, Andreessen Horowitz, NFX and others, Starcloud is building a roadmap of Starcloud-1 through Starcloud-4 satellite compute platforms. As of this profile the company exposes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or technical documentation surface; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a space-compute infrastructure company and lead for future enrichment.

providers.name: StyleSage
providers.description: StyleSage was a fashion and retail market-intelligence startup (Techstars-backed) that applied computer vision and data science to track apparel pricing, assortment, discounting, and trend signals across e-commerce retailers. The stylesage.co domain now redirects to Centric Software, which acquired the product and folded it into its Centric Market Intelligence platform for fashion, footwear, home, and beauty brands. As of this enrichment pass no standalone public developer API, documentation, SDK, or well-known surface is published for StyleSage.

providers.name: SubVysion
providers.description: SubVysion is a subsurface mapping intelligence company that delivers 3D maps of hidden underground infrastructure for construction crews, utility locators, and contractors. It combines multi-sensor ground-penetrating radar (GPR) with 3D mapping to visualize buried utilities, pipes, and conduits so teams can see what is below before they dig or break ground — reducing strikes, rework, and safety incidents. Backed by Y Combinator, SubVysion is an early-stage company that currently publishes a marketing website only; as of this enrichment pass it exposes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Super
providers.description: Super (super.gs) is an early-stage consumer entertainment application built by Outpace Studios and backed by Bullpen Capital, positioned around the tagline "Entertainment you can cash out." As of mid-2026 the product is pre-launch: the public site is a single-page marketing and waitlist experience with no published developer platform, API, SDKs, or documentation. This API Evangelist profile tracks Super as a portfolio lead and currently carries only a live domain-security probe of super.gs; it will be enriched further if and when the company ships a public API surface.

providers.name: SuperCircle
providers.description: SuperCircle (operated by MASC Inc.) is a technology and reverse-logistics platform that helps retail and fashion brands run circular-economy programs for textiles. It provides turnkey trade-in and resale programs that let consumers send worn clothing back to brands for store credit, manages excess and overstock inventory through a warehouse pickup and logistics network, and delivers real-time performance tracking and customizable impact reporting on recycling and diversion outcomes. Brand partners include Reformation, tentree, Parachute, A.L.C., and Subset. No public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface was found at the time of enrichment; this profile is a company lead in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Swag.com
providers.description: Swag.com is a custom branded-merchandise and promotional-products platform that lets businesses design, order, warehouse, and distribute company swag such as apparel, drinkware, tech accessories, and curated "Swag in a Box" kits. A Techstars-backed company (acquired by Custom Ink in 2021), it operates a self-serve online storefront and fulfillment service. No public developer API or developer portal is currently published; this profile was surfaced from a VC portfolio and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Sweetgreen
providers.description: Sweetgreen is a fast-casual restaurant company (NYSE: SG) building healthy, plant-forward food through a network of company-owned locations and its digital ordering platform. It reaches customers primarily via its consumer website and mobile app for pickup, delivery, and its Sweetgreen Rewards loyalty program, and operates automated "Infinite Kitchen" locations. As of this enrichment pass, Sweetgreen publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specifications; this profile captures its public web presence and probed domain-security posture only. Backed by D1 Capital and True Ventures.

providers.name: Swiftmile
providers.description: Swiftmile is a California-based hardware and IoT company building universal charging and parking infrastructure for micromobility — docking stations that power, secure and organize shared and privately owned e-bikes and e-scooters, including solar-powered units and integrated digital advertising panels. Founded around 2014 and headquartered on the San Francisco Peninsula, it supplied secure charging docks to the New York City DOT public e-bike charging pilot alongside PopWheels and Swobbee. Company interviews describe a fleet- and battery-management backend with integrations offered to micromobility operators, but Swiftmile has never published a public developer program, API reference, SDK, or machine-readable contract of any kind, and as of 2026-08-29 swiftmile.com no longer serves the company website at all — the domain answers with a Nexcess hosting placeholder and a TLS certificate that does not match the hostname.

providers.name: Swimply
providers.description: Swimply is a peer-to-peer marketplace that lets people book private swimming pools and other recreational spaces (family, party, and luxury pools plus tennis, pickleball, and basketball courts) by the hour, and lets owners list and monetize their spaces as hosts. Operating across the US, Canada, and Australia, the platform reports over 4 million five-star experiences, 15,000+ active hosts, and 15,000+ available spaces, and offers a 2026 Summer Pass membership. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners. No public API or developer program was found at the time of enrichment; this profile documents the company's public web surface only.

providers.name: Synquote
providers.description: Synquote is a decentralized crypto options trading platform that lets traders obtain options quotes directly from market makers using a request-for-quote (RFQ) model. Founded in 2021 by former Google engineer Ahmed Attia and based in San Francisco, the platform offers European-style options across ETH, BTC, AVAX, LINK and MATIC with liquidity spanning 500+ instruments. It pairs a centralized-exchange-like experience (social/Google logins, two-click trading, zero-gas trading, maker rebates and low taker fees) with DeFi self-custody, and supports undercollateralized margin trading for liquidity providers to improve capital efficiency. Backed by Initialized Capital and Polygon, Synquote raised $2.8M and launched publicly in June 2023 after a beta exceeding $25M in notional volume. Added to the API Evangelist network as a crypto/DeFi portfolio profile.

providers.name: T. Rowe Price
providers.description: T. Rowe Price is a global asset management firm (NYSE: TROW) offering a broad range of investment management strategies and retirement solutions to individuals, advisors, institutions, and retirement plan sponsors. Founded in 1937, the firm manages mutual funds, ETFs, separate accounts, and retirement plans including 401(k) services. T. Rowe Price does not offer a public REST API but provides institutional client portals, data feeds, and integrations with retirement recordkeeping platforms and open banking aggregators such as Plaid and Finicity.

providers.name: TenOneTen
providers.description: TenOneTen Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm based in Los Angeles, founded in 2011 by repeat software founders David Waxman and Gil Elbaz (later joined by managing partner Minnie Ingersoll). The firm backs engineers-turned- entrepreneurs building B2B software, data infrastructure, artificial intelligence, and technical products that reimagine essential industries such as healthcare, logistics, real estate, and manufacturing. TenOneTen typically leads pre-seed, seed, and Series A rounds with checks from roughly $500K to $5M, invests about ten times a year with a ~90% B2B focus, and has backed companies including Procore, Pluto TV, Scopely, and Crexi. The firm also produces the LA Venture podcast covering the Los Angeles startup and investor community. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a venture-capital company record.

providers.name: Terra Industries
providers.description: Terra Industries is a Nigeria-based defense-technology company, positioning itself as Africa's first defense prime, that designs, manufactures, and deploys autonomous multi-domain security systems across air, land, and eventually sea. Founded in 2024 by Nathan Nwachuku and Maxwell Maduka, the company builds ArtemisOS (an AI-powered operating system for infrastructure security), the Archer long-range VTOL surveillance drone, the Iroko modular UAV, the Duma autonomous unmanned ground vehicle, and the Kallon solar-powered AI sentry tower to monitor, detect, and respond to threats such as terrorism, sabotage, and armed attacks on critical infrastructure including hydropower plants, mines, and power assets. Terra raised $11.75M led by 8VC in January 2026. As a hardware and defense-systems manufacturer it publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation surface; this profile is maintained as a company/provider record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: The League
providers.description: The League is an American social and dating mobile application founded in 2014 by Amanda Bradford and launched in 2015. It positions itself as a selective, career-oriented dating community ("Date. Intelligently."), using an application/waitlist model and LinkedIn/Facebook-based verification to curate its membership. The League was acquired by Match Group in 2022 and operates as a consumer iOS/Android app. It is a portfolio company of Cowboy Ventures. As a consumer mobile app it publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or partner API surface.

providers.name: ThirdLove
providers.description: ThirdLove is a San Francisco-based direct-to-consumer women's intimate apparel brand best known for its online Fit Finder quiz and half-cup bra sizing, selling bras, underwear, and loungewear direct to consumers through its e-commerce site. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of a16z and Felicis. An enrichment pass on 2026-07-21 found no public developer or API surface — no developer subdomain, no documented API, no /.well-known/ discovery documents, and no security.txt or trust-center program. Only a domain-security probe of thirdlove.com yielded real data (TLS 1.3, HSTS, SPF, DMARC).

providers.name: Thomas
providers.description: Thomas is a Y Combinator-backed startup (Spring 2026 batch) based in San Francisco, building what it describes as the world's first AI founder: an autonomous AI agent that starts, runs, and grows its own companies on the internet end to end. Founded by Thomas Cloarec (the company was formerly named HireThomas, Inc. / MadeByThomas), it operates a public marketing site at madebythomas.ai. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, CLI, or developer documentation; the site is a single-page marketing application and its internal /api/ and /events/ routes are explicitly disallowed to crawlers via robots.txt.

providers.name: TimeBlocks
providers.description: TimeBlocks is a consumer calendar and personal scheduling mobile app developed by Day2Life Inc., a South Korean company backed by 500 Global. Marketed as Korea's #1 decoration calendar, it brings calendar, to-do, memo, and habit tracking together in a single view, with patented drag-and-drop time-block scheduling (US Patent 10,409,474 B2), roughly 1,000 customization items (themes, stickers, fonts), shared and group calendars with real-time notifications, seven home-screen widgets, and cloud sync across devices. It is a native iOS and Android app; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface.

providers.name: Toasty
providers.description: Toasty (toasty.family, published by Wenose) is a French consumer mobile application for responsible, sustainable, and ethical shopping. The app curates committed brands and makes conscious consumption engaging through a gamified experience of daily private sales, quizzes, challenges, gifts, and rewards. It reports a 4.9-star rating across the app stores and more than 400,000 downloads. Toasty is a business-to-consumer mobile product with no public developer program, API, or documentation surface at this time; it was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. This profile captures its public identity and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Toll Brothers
providers.description: Toll Brothers is the nation's leading builder of luxury homes, designing, building, marketing, and arranging financing for luxury residential communities across the United States. As a Fortune 500 company and #1 Most Admired Home Builder in Fortune magazine's 2026 list, Toll Brothers operates across 60+ markets. The company does not publicly expose developer APIs. Website integrations and home search functionality are provided through the tollbrothers.com consumer platform.

providers.name: Tops Friendly Markets
providers.description: Tops Friendly Markets is a regional supermarket chain headquartered in Amherst, New York operating 152 grocery stores and 58 gas station and convenience stores across upstate New York, northern Pennsylvania, and Vermont. In November 2021 Tops Holding II merged with Price Chopper / Market 32 to form Northeast Grocery Inc, a roughly 300-store regional alliance under common ownership. The Tops consumer brand continues to operate an e-commerce platform with online grocery pickup and DoorDash delivery, the BonusPlus loyalty card program with digital coupons and gas rewards, the MoolahVille cash back rewards program, in-store pharmacies, gift cards, and iOS and Android mobile apps. Vendor and supplier engagement is handled through Northeast Shared Services. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, webhook, EDI portal, status page, RSS feed, or changelog is published for the Tops brand.

providers.name: Toyota Connected
providers.description: Toyota Connected is Toyota Motor Corporation's global connected mobility technology arm, building the data, telematics, and software platforms that power Toyota and Lexus connected vehicle services worldwide. The group operates as a federation of regional subsidiaries — TOYOTA Connected Corporation (Japan), Toyota Connected North America (TCNA, Plano, Texas), TOYOTA Connected Europe (TCEU, United Kingdom), TOYOTA Connected India (TCIN), TOYOTA Connected Asia Pacific, and Toyota Tsusho Connected Middle East — and runs Toyota's Mobility Service Platform (MSPF) and the Drivelink telematics backbone behind Safety Connect, Service Connect, Remote Connect, Destination Assist, Wi-Fi Connect, and the "Hey Toyota" in-vehicle voice assistant. TCNA reports surpassing five million connected customer calls across Toyota and Lexus and runs Toyota's Big Data Center for connected-vehicle data. KINTO — Toyota's mobility services brand for car subscription, car-sharing, ride-hailing, and carpooling (KINTO One, KINTO Flex, KINTO Share, KINTO Ride, KINTO Join) — sits adjacent in Toyota's mobility portfolio and is powered by KINTO Technologies on AWS. Toyota exposes developer portals at developer.eig.toyota.com (Toyota API Portal covering TMC, TMNA, TEMA, TFS, NAMC, and other entities) and developer.toyotaconnected.eu (Toyota Connected EU API services, including Telematics and Vehicle APIs documented with Swagger/OpenAPI), but access is gated to partners and internal Toyota teams — no public, unauthenticated OpenAPI specifications are published. Third-party access to Toyota vehicle data for individual developers is typically brokered through partners such as Smartcar and High Mobility rather than directly via Toyota's own portals.

providers.name: Tradewind Markets
providers.description: Tradewind Markets is a fintech company that operates a digital platform for precious metals, using blockchain and distributed-ledger technology to enable the trading, settlement, supply-chain management, and custody of physical commodities. Its VaultChain Gold and VaultChain Silver products represent investment-grade bullion held physically at the Royal Canadian Mint, with ownership tracked on a secure distributed ledger for real-time tracking and transparent auditability. Founded in 2016 and adopted by institutions including the Royal Canadian Mint and Kitco, Tradewind was acquired by Wellfield Technologies in 2023. No public developer/API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: tripaneer
providers.description: tripaneer is an Amsterdam-based online travel company that operates a family of themed wellness and activity travel marketplaces, connecting travelers with the organizers of retreats, courses, and holidays around the world. Its brands include BookYogaRetreats.com, BookSurfCamps.com, BookMeditationRetreats.com, BookAdventureRetreats.com, BookFitnessHolidays.com, BookMartialArtsHolidays.com, and BookSailingHolidays.com, among others. Each site lets travelers discover, compare, and book multi-day experiences by theme, destination, price, and date, while giving retreat and course organizers a channel to list and sell their offerings. tripaneer was surfaced as a portfolio company of Point Nine and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a consumer travel marketplace (sitemaps for listings, organizers, and a blog) but exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, OAuth/OIDC discovery, or developer-portal surface that could be found or probed.

providers.name: TrustAI
providers.description: TrustAI (trytrust.ai) is a San Francisco-based Y Combinator Summer 2026 company founded in 2026 by Hannah Chung and Medha Venkatapathy that provides continuous compliance, governance, and risk assessment for AI agents operating on sensitive enterprise systems, with an initial focus on ERP agents such as SAP Joule. It maps what every agent can reach, then runs evaluations across six domains - data privacy, hallucinations and grounding, permission compliance, robustness at scale, accountability, and security - including adversarial pentests and prompt-injection red-teaming, and maps every risk to controls like SOX, ITGC, ISO 27001, GxP, and the EU AI Act for audit-ready reporting. The company does not currently publish a public developer API, docs, or SDKs. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub.

providers.name: Tumblbug
providers.description: Tumblbug (텀블벅) is a South Korean reward-based crowdfunding platform for creators, where makers launch projects and backers pledge funds to bring creative works — comics, games, publishing, design, music, film and more — to life. Surfaced as a portfolio company of DCM Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass Tumblbug publishes a consumer-facing web platform (help center, creator guides, pricing/advertising, terms and privacy pages) but exposes no public developer API, documentation, or open API surface; this profile therefore carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: UrbanHire
providers.description: UrbanHire was an Indonesian all-in-one hiring and assessment platform (applicant tracking system) backed by 500 Global, designed to streamline recruitment and help employers hire the right talent. The company appears defunct - urbanhire.com has been offline behind Cloudflare (HTTP 530) with the last archived homepage from January 2021 - and it never published a public API or developer documentation. Its GitHub organization and first-party npm engineering packages remain the surviving technical footprint.

providers.name: Velocity
providers.description: Velocity was an Israeli DevOps / site-reliability-engineering startup that helped engineering teams move faster — originally by letting developers spin up on-demand, fully isolated, production-like development environments, and later by applying AI to automate SRE and major-incident-response workflows so engineers could focus on solving problems instead of chasing alerts. On November 10, 2025 Velocity was acquired by BigPanda (the Insight Partners-backed agentic AIOps / IT operations company) to accelerate its AI Detection and Response product; founder and CEO Tal Kain joined BigPanda as VP of AI Detection and Response. The velocity.tech domain now redirects to bigpanda.io and Velocity no longer operates an independent public developer surface, API, or documentation portal.

providers.name: VICI Sports
providers.description: VICI Sports operates FanFest, a white-labeled fan engagement platform for the sports industry that "turns fan engagement into revenue" by recognizing every fan action across stadiums, homes, and bars and rewarding it automatically. The company reports 150+ activations with sports brands and 30M+ fans commercialized, with partners including AC Milan, the Premier League, Paris Saint-Germain, and Manchester City. Backed by Techstars. No public developer/API surface is currently published; the fanfest.vip site is a single-page marketing app with a contact form only.

providers.name: Vinterior
providers.description: Vinterior is a UK-based curated online marketplace for vintage, antique, and pre-owned furniture and homeware. It connects independent sellers, dealers, and restorers with buyers looking for one-of-a-kind pieces, positioning itself as a more sustainable alternative to mass-produced furniture. The platform handles product discovery, listings, seller storefronts, checkout, and delivery for design-led vintage goods. Vinterior is backed by Seedcamp. As of this profile Vinterior does not publish a public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API surface; this record is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company profile and enrichment lead.

providers.name: Virgin Galactic
providers.description: Virgin Galactic is a publicly traded (NYSE: SPCE) commercial spaceflight company founded by Richard Branson that develops and operates suborbital, crewed spaceplanes for space tourism and research payloads. It flies its air-launched SpaceShipTwo-class and next generation Delta-class vehicles from Spaceport America in New Mexico, carrying private astronauts and scientific experiments to the edge of space. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Social Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Enrichment found no public developer API, portal, or documentation surface: it is a consumer-facing space-tourism business, not an API provider.

providers.name: Virtualtech Frontier
providers.description: Virtualtech Frontier (VTF) is a creative technology company that designs immersive experiences by combining human creativity with technology across immersive centres and installations, experiential events and exhibitions, AI-powered audience engagement, metaverse and virtual worlds, and extended reality (XR/AR/VR). It operates the no-code metaverse-building platform Mitoworld and the Lumiworks service, with offices in Kuala Lumpur, Beijing, Dubai, Tokyo, and Singapore, and clients including HP, AIA, Nestle, Laneige, Dynatrace, and Omega. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. No public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: VisasQ
providers.description: VisasQ Inc. is a Tokyo-headquartered knowledge-sharing and spot-consulting platform that connects companies seeking specialized insight with a global network of roughly 800,000 experts across 190 countries and diverse industries and job functions. Its flagship "ビザスクdirect" service arranges one-on-one expert consultations, and it has launched "AI Scout" to deliver precision expert matches in under five minutes, 24/7. The company operates six global offices with multilingual support and over 600 employees, serving Japan and the United States as primary markets. VisasQ was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCM Ventures. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or MCP surface; only domain-security posture could be probed.

providers.name: VisualLogix
providers.description: VisualLogix develops mission-critical CAD, simulation, and analytical software used by engineers who design and validate real-world physical systems. Its tools span computer-aided design, physics and systems simulation, and analytical modeling for engineering teams building and testing products across industrial, mechanical, and infrastructure domains. VisualLogix is backed by Insight Partners. As of this profile the company publishes a marketing website (built with Figma Make) but exposes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable discovery surface.

providers.name: VivaReal
providers.description: VivaReal operates vivareal.com.br, a Brazilian online real estate marketplace and classifieds portal where consumers search, buy, sell, and rent residential and commercial properties across Brazil, connecting property seekers with real estate agents, agencies, and developers. It was originally backed by 500 Global and later became part of Grupo ZAP / OLX Brasil. It was surfaced as a portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; an enrichment pass found no public developer API surface, portal, or specification.

providers.name: Vulcan Elements
providers.description: Vulcan Elements is a United States manufacturer of sintered permanent neodymium-iron-boron (NdFeB) rare earth magnets, founded in 2023 and headquartered in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina. The company produces high-performance rare earth magnets domestically for defense and commercial applications — the components that convert electricity into motion in motors, drones, robotics, vehicles and consumer electronics — as an alternative to a supply chain concentrated in China. In 2025 it announced a $65 million Series A, a $620 million loan from the Pentagon's Office of Strategic Capital, and a $1.4 billion partnership with the U.S. government and ReElement Technologies to build a vertically integrated domestic magnet supply chain, including a nearly $1 billion, 1,000-job magnet factory in Benson, Johnston County, North Carolina. Vulcan Elements is a physical-goods manufacturer: it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Wealor
providers.description: Wealor is an AI-native platform for wealth managers, building a centralized, queryable source of truth across wealth management, tax, legal, estate, and insurance. The platform captures data from conversations, financial documents, tax returns, legal documents, and custodial systems into a single knowledge layer, then uses specialized AI agents to automate operational work — account opening, client subscriptions, tax optimization, trade rebalancing, and billable client-plan generation — directly across legacy partner portals and internal systems via APIs and browser automation. Founded in 2026 by Karim Bouri and Pierre Depuydt and backed by Y Combinator (P26 batch), Wealor is based in San Francisco. As of this profile it is an API consumer with no public developer API, documentation, or specification surface.

providers.name: Wineaccess
providers.description: Wine Access is an online wine retailer that curates limited-production and hard-to-find wines from around the world, sourced and vetted by its team of sommeliers and wine experts. Beyond direct e-commerce, the company operates a portfolio of subscription wine clubs (Discovery, Connoisseurs, Champagne, Collector's, Decanter, and Sunset clubs), a wine podcast and editorial content platform at discover.wineaccess.com, corporate and personal gifting, gift cards, and climate-controlled shipping. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners. As of this profile, Wine Access publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; it is a consumer e-commerce brand rather than an API provider.

providers.name: WISECRICKET HOLDING KY
providers.description: WiseCricket (WISECRICKET HOLDING KY) offers AI-powered fiscal and accounting audit software for businesses ("Software de Auditoria Fiscal y Contable con IA para Empresas"). The Spanish-language platform applies artificial intelligence to tax and accounting compliance, helping companies automate financial and tax audits and surface issues. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub; enrichment found a marketing landing page but no public developer API, documentation, developer portal, or well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Xingsheng Selected
providers.description: Xingsheng Selected (兴盛优选, Hunan Xingsheng Youxuan E-Commerce Co., Ltd.) is a Changsha, Hunan-based Chinese community group-buying platform, grown out of the Furong Xingsheng convenience-store chain and built on a "pre-sale plus self-pickup" model: consumers order groceries and daily necessities online by 23:00 and collect them the next morning from a neighborhood convenience store acting as a pickup point, supplied through the company's own central-warehouse, grid-station and store logistics network. It has raised roughly USD 5.4B from investors including Tencent, KKR, Primavera Capital, Temasek and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, and has contracted out of loss-making provinces since 2022. Xingsheng Selected operates no developer program: probing found no portal, documentation, OpenAPI, webhook or .well-known document on any host it controls, and its supplier system is login-walled.

providers.name: Yetcargo
providers.description: Yetcargo is a Mexican freight and cargo transportation company that connects businesses needing to move goods with a network of reliable carriers, handling both local and long-distance (foráneo) shipments. Operating a Spanish-language web platform, it positions itself as a trusted cargo-transport provider ("Tu proveedor confiable de transporte de carga") for shippers who need to resolve local and out-of-town delivery problems. Yetcargo was surfaced through the 500 Global portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Zepto
providers.description: Zepto (Zepto Marketplace Private Limited) is an Indian quick-commerce grocery delivery company founded in 2021 that delivers groceries, fresh fruits and vegetables, meat, pet care, beauty and household products "in minutes" from a network of dark stores across major Indian cities. It operates a consumer-facing mobile app and website (zepto.com, formerly zeptonow.com) and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; its partner-facing surfaces are limited to merchant onboarding (Sell on Zepto / brands.zepto.co.in), delivery-partner and franchise programs. Backed by General Catalyst, Lightspeed Venture Partners and Y Combinator.

providers.name: Zetwerk
providers.description: Zetwerk is a global contract-manufacturing and B2B supply-chain company that connects original equipment manufacturers with a vetted network of manufacturing partners across processes including CNC machining, die casting, forging, injection molding, and sheet-metal stamping. It serves industries such as aerospace and defense, automotive, consumer electronics, renewable energy, and industrial equipment, offering production sourcing, quoting, and program management. Backed by Accel, D1 Capital, Khosla Ventures, and Lightspeed Venture Partners, Zetwerk operates as a manufacturing services marketplace rather than a developer platform: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or programmatic integration surface.

providers.name: 011h
providers.description: 011h (011h Sustainable Construction S.L.) is a Barcelona-based construction technology company founded in 2020 that designs and builds low-carbon residential, affordable-housing, flex-living and hospitality buildings using an industrialized building system and a digital platform connecting factory, design and site. The company combines standardized hybrid concrete/wood/steel prefabricated components, an integrated network of qualified manufacturers, and an in-house software platform covering design, contracting and construction execution with end-to-end traceability. It is a certified B Corporation and raised EUR 20M in October 2025 co-led by Ship2B Ventures and CDTI. As of this profile 011h publishes no public developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract; its software is an internal/customer-facing product rather than a platform API.

providers.name: 6river
providers.description: 6 River Systems (6RS) is a warehouse fulfillment automation company founded in 2015 in Waltham, Massachusetts. Its flagship product is "Chuck," a collaborative autonomous mobile robot (AMR) that works alongside human associates to guide and optimize picking, sorting, and replenishment in distribution centers. The platform is WMS-agnostic and integrates with existing warehouse-management systems as an intelligent execution layer via a private/partner REST API for host data exchange; it does not publish a public developer portal, API documentation, or consumer SDKs. Norwest Venture Partners was an early investor; the company was acquired by Shopify in 2019 and by Ocado Group in 2023. The public marketing site at 6river.com currently serves a parked lander stub.

providers.name: Accro Bioscience
providers.description: Accro Bioscience (Suzhou) Limited, trading as Accropeutics, is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2017 with operations in Suzhou, China and New York. It develops small-molecule therapeutics against regulated cell death — necroptosis, pyroptosis and ferroptosis — targeting the cell-death-to-inflammation loop behind inflammatory, fibrotic, autoimmune and oncology disease. Its pipeline is led by AC-101, an oral selective RIPK2 inhibitor in Phase Ib for ulcerative colitis with FDA clearance for a Phase II multi-regional IBD study; AC-201, a TYK2/JAK1 pseudokinase inhibitor licensed to Fosun Pharma for Greater China as FXS5626; and AC-003, a RIPK1 inhibitor in Phase Ib for acute graft-versus-host disease with FDA Orphan Drug Designation. It closed a $50M Series C led by OrbiMed in May 2026. Accro Bioscience sells drug candidates, not software: it runs no developer program and publishes no API, SDK or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: AccuPulse Medical
providers.description: AccuPulse Medical Technology Co., Ltd. (Suzhou AccuPulse, 艾科脉) is a cardiac electrophysiology medical device company in Suzhou Industrial Park, Jiangsu, China, founded in November 2020 to treat atrial fibrillation with non-thermal ablation. It is developing a pulsed electric field ablation (PFA) system — the AccuBlator generator and AccuPulse catheter — using high-voltage fields to induce irreversible electroporation in endocardial cells instead of the thermal injury caused by radiofrequency and cryoablation, plus Accu-System, a 3D cardiac electroanatomic mapping and navigation platform with magnetic/electrical localization and high-channel intracardiac EGM acquisition. The founding team came out of Johnson & Johnson, GE, Abbott, Acutus Medical and MicroPort, with R&D in China and the United States. AccuPulse sells regulated devices to hospitals; it runs no developer program and publishes no public API, SDK or machine-readable API contract on any host it controls.

providers.name: Aiolos Bio
providers.description: Aiolos Bio was a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2023 with offices in San Francisco, California and London, United Kingdom, developing treatments for respiratory and inflammatory disease. Its sole disclosed asset was AIO-001, a half-life-extended monoclonal antibody against thymic stromal lymphopoietin (TSLP), positioned as a Phase 2-ready candidate for moderate-to-severe asthma with potential six-month dosing intervals. The company launched in October 2023 with an oversubscribed $245 million Series A co-led by Atlas Venture, Bain Capital Life Sciences, Forbion and Sofinnova Investments, with RA Capital Management. GSK plc agreed to acquire it on 9 January 2024 for $1 billion upfront plus up to $400 million in milestones, completing on 14 February 2024. Aiolos Bio is a drug developer, not a software vendor: it never ran a developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable contract, and aiolosbio.com now serves a blanket HTTP 301 to www.gsk.com on every path.

providers.name: Alleghany
providers.description: Alleghany Corporation is a holding company engaged in property and casualty reinsurance and insurance through its subsidiaries, with additional investments in non-financial businesses held via Alleghany Capital. Founded in 1929 by railroad entrepreneurs Oris and Mantis Van Sweringen, the company transitioned over decades from rail holdings into specialty insurance and reinsurance, and is headquartered at One Rockefeller Plaza in New York City. Its principal insurance subsidiaries are Transatlantic Reinsurance Company (TransRe), a global reinsurer founded in 1977 with roughly 600 employees across 23 offices and more than $40 billion in claims paid to date; RSUI Group, a wholesale excess and surplus (E&S) underwriter spanning Property, Casualty, Professional Liability, Management Liability, and Binding Authority lines; and CapSpecialty, a specialty casualty and surety underwriter. Alleghany Capital holds non-insurance operating companies including toy and collectibles maker Jazwares (Squishmallows, Pokémon, Roblox, Fortnite licensed lines). On March 21, 2022, Berkshire Hathaway announced an $11.6 billion all-cash acquisition of Alleghany at $848.02 per share, which closed in October 2022. Alleghany now operates as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway, contributing approximately $8.8 billion in 2025 gross premiums written and roughly $14 billion in insurance float to the parent. As a holding company whose operating units distribute exclusively through reinsurance intermediaries, wholesale brokers, and independent agents, Alleghany and its subsidiaries do not publish a developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, or any other machine-readable API artifacts; the only digital surfaces exposed publicly are gated broker and agent login portals.

providers.name: AllStripes
providers.description: AllStripes was a San Francisco healthcare technology company, founded in 2017 as RDMD by Nancy Yu and Onno Faber, that built a research platform dedicated to rare disease. It retrieved, digitized and de-identified patients' medical records into regulatory-ready real-world evidence for biopharma drug development, and paired that with a patient application through which families affected by conditions such as Batten disease, Hunter syndrome and sickle cell anemia could participate in treatment research from home. The company raised roughly $74M in venture funding, including a $50M Series B in August 2021 led by Lux Capital with JAZZ Venture Partners, Spark Capital, Medidata, McKesson Ventures and Maveron. PicnicHealth acquired AllStripes on October 23, 2023 and folded the platform into its own; the AllStripes brand has since been retired, and allstripes.com and app.allstripes.com now issue blanket 301 redirects to picnichealth.com. AllStripes never published a public developer portal, REST/OpenAPI contract, SDK, or webhook surface, and no such surface survives the acquisition.

providers.name: Améthyste
providers.description: Generate images for Discord users

providers.name: AND Global
providers.description: AND Global is a fintech-as-a-service company operating across the Asia-Pacific region, with offices in Mongolia, Singapore, Japan, the Philippines, and Thailand. It builds software that lets banks and lenders launch digital lending and financial products, integrating with banking and payment systems through APIs and other means. Its solutions span automated lending lifecycle management (Looms), custom and AI/ML credit scoring (Scorecard Builder, Custom AI Scoring, Niko AutoML), intelligent document processing (Mindox), omnichannel customer data, document management (DMS), and a collaborative investment platform (Oasis). Consumer-facing brands include the LendMN and Lend Pinoy digital lending platforms. AND Global was added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company; no public developer portal or API documentation was found at profiling time.

providers.name: Aossci
providers.description: Aossci (傲势科技) designs and manufactures long-endurance electric and hybrid unmanned aerial vehicles for public safety, forest fire fighting, emergency rescue, energy inspection and other industrial applications. Based in Chengdu, China, the company offers a portfolio of fixed‑wing and VTOL drones such as the XC‑150, XC‑25 and XB‑12, integrated with cloud platforms for mission planning, data analytics and satellite communications.

providers.name: Aprogenpharmaceuticals
providers.description: Aprogenpharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing innovative bispecific antibody therapeutics and recombinant protein products. The firm operates in research, development, and manufacturing of novel drug candidates, leveraging advanced platforms for antibody engineering and protein fusion technologies. It maintains a pipeline of novel drugs and biosimilars, with a commitment to advancing healthcare solutions.

providers.name: Arda Therapeutics
providers.description: Arda Therapeutics is a San Carlos, California biotech company founded in 2021 that develops targeted cell depletion therapies for chronic disease. Rather than modulating the proteins that pathogenic cells produce, Arda uses a single-cell sequencing and computational discovery engine to map disease-specific cell states, identify surface markers on harmful cells, and design targeted biologics that selectively deplete them across fibrotic, autoimmune, and metabolic conditions. Backed by a $43M Series A led by a16z Bio + Health with GV, Two Sigma Ventures, Eli Lilly and others. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public developer and web surface; Arda currently publishes a corporate marketing site with no public developer API.

providers.name: Arsenalmedicalinc
providers.description: Arsenal Medical is a clinical‑stage biotech company developing innovative biomaterials such as NeoCast™ and ResQFoam® to address unmet medical needs in neurovascular and trauma care. Founded by serial entrepreneur‑investor Carmichael Roberts and scientists Robert Langer and George Whitesides, the firm transforms medical devices with advanced materials, securing funding from DARPA, NIH and the Department of Defense.

providers.name: Atomwise
providers.description: Atomwise pioneered the use of deep convolutional neural networks for structure-based drug discovery, with its AtomNet platform applying AI to virtual screening of small molecules against protein targets. The company ran the Artificial Intelligence Molecular Screen (AIMS) academic collaboration program, partnered with biotech and pharma companies on discovery contracts, and built an internal pipeline of small-molecule programs. As of 2026, atomwise.com redirects to Numerion Labs (numerionlabs.ai), reflecting an apparent rebrand or successor entity that positions itself as an AI superplatform exploring drug-like chemical space with programs in immune and inflammatory diseases. Atomwise never exposed a public commercial API; AtomNet screening was delivered to partners as a service. The legacy GitHub organization (github.com/atomwise) hosts no public repositories.

providers.name: Aulos Bioscience
providers.description: Aulos Bioscience is a biotechnology company focused on developing innovative solutions for early disease detection and personalized medicine. Leveraging advanced genomics and proteomics platforms, the company aims to provide clinicians with actionable insights to improve patient outcomes. Founded with a mission to bridge the gap between cutting‑edge research and practical healthcare applications, Aulos Bioscience offers a suite of APIs for data access, sample management, and analytical results, supporting integration into electronic health record systems and research pipelines.

providers.name: Avenzo Therapeutics
providers.description: Avenzo Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing next‑generation oncology therapies. The company aims to advance innovative treatments for cancer patients, leveraging cutting‑edge science and strategic partnerships to bring novel therapeutics to market.

providers.name: Aviceda Therapeutics
providers.description: Aviceda Therapeutics is a private, late-stage clinical biotechnology company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts that describes itself as the world leader in glyco-immune checkpoint therapeutics. It develops immune-mediated therapies built on a glyco-mimetic nanoparticle platform that targets the interaction between sialic acids on cell surfaces and Siglec immune receptors in order to modulate aberrant inflammation. Its lead asset, AVD-104, is an intravitreally administered sialic-acid-coated nanoparticle being evaluated in the Phase 2/3 SIGLEC trial for geographic atrophy secondary to age-related macular degeneration. Aviceda is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: BeConfident
providers.description: BeConfident (Beconfident Inteligencia Artificial em Idiomas Ltda.) is an AI-powered English language-learning platform that lets learners practice through real-time conversations with AI tutors via text, voice, and video, plus guided 24/7 lessons, grammar and pronunciation feedback, and study plans tailored to proficiency level, with access across web, WhatsApp, and smartwatch. It is a consumer EdTech application backed by Prosus Ventures and operating primarily in the Brazilian (Portuguese) market. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface, so this profile is identity-only.

providers.name: Bestmile
providers.description: Bestmile was a Swiss fleet-orchestration SaaS company, spun out of EPFL in Lausanne in 2014, whose cloud platform planned, dispatched and optimized mixed fleets of autonomous and human-driven vehicles for on-demand mobility and transit operators. The platform was described by the company as API-first, with documented Fleet, Booking and Transportation APIs for integrating operator booking apps, fleet-management systems and traveler-information systems. The company no longer operates: ZF Friedrichshafen acquired Bestmile's technology in November 2021 and folded it into its own SCALAR fleet-orchestration platform, so any successor API belongs to ZF rather than to Bestmile. As of 2026-08-17 bestmile.com is a parked Gandi.net registrar domain that refuses HTTPS, and no developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, package or /.well-known surface survives. Surfaced originally as a Partech portfolio company.

providers.name: Bidops
providers.description: Bidops provides a procurement and spend management platform that helps organizations automate purchasing, manage supplier relationships, and gain visibility into their spend. The solution integrates with ERP systems, offers analytics, and supports compliance with procurement policies, aiming to streamline the sourcing process for enterprises and public sector agencies.

providers.name: bigbasket
providers.description: bigbasket is India's largest online grocery and daily-essentials retailer, now part of the Tata Group, delivering fresh produce, packaged foods, household, and personal-care products across Indian cities via web and mobile apps (bigbasket, bbnow, and bbdaily subscription delivery). Surfaced as a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. bigbasket operates as a consumer app rather than an API platform: it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or client SDKs. Its only first-party public developer surface is the github.com/BigBasket organization and the open-source @bb-tech react-admin UI component libraries on npm.

providers.name: Bitstar
providers.description: BitStar is a Tokyo‑based influencer marketing platform that connects brands with video creators. The company offers a suite of tools including BitStar Agent, Studio, and a marketplace to manage campaigns, analytics, and payments. Founded in 2014, BitStar has raised multiple funding rounds and serves hundreds of creators across Asia, providing data‑driven solutions to accelerate growth in the creator economy.

providers.name: Bouffalo Lab
providers.description: Bouffalo Lab (博流智能) is a fabless chip design company founded in 2016 and headquartered in Nanjing, China, focused on ultra-low-power AIoT (AI + IoT) and edge-computing system chips. Its product line centers on RISC-V based microcontrollers with integrated wireless connectivity — the BL602/BL604 (Wi-Fi 2.4G + BLE 5.0), BL702/BL704/BL706 (Zigbee 3.0 + BLE 5.0), BL606P (quad-mode dual-core Wi-Fi/BT/BLE/Zigbee), and the BL616/BL618 and BL808 families — combining wireless radios, audio/video processing, and on-device AI algorithms. The company ships the open-source BouffaloSDK (a merge of bl_mcu_sdk and bl_iot_sdk) under Apache 2.0 through its public GitHub organization, along with hardware abstraction drivers, Matter/Thread support, and NuttX RTOS ports. Bouffalo Lab is a hardware/firmware provider rather than a web-API provider; it exposes no public HTTP/REST developer API, so the enrichment pipeline captures its developer surface (GitHub SDK org) and domain security posture. It is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: BrainTripping
providers.description: BrainTripping is a whimsical Markov-chain language game founded by Matthew Huebert in the Y Combinator Summer 2012 batch. It lets players step inside the vocabularies of famous historical and modern figures and compose their own sentences, constrained to that person's word patterns. The company is no longer active as a startup; today the BrainTripping GitHub organization publishes open-source ClojureScript tooling such as cljs-live, magic-tree, and the Lark editor. The public surface is a single-page ClojureScript web app at braintripping.com and it exposes no public REST API, SDK, or developer platform.

providers.name: Broadbitbatteries
providers.description: Broadbit Batteries is a Finnish technology company developing revolutionary sodium‑based batteries using abundant, low‑cost materials such as table salt. Their batteries aim to power electric vehicles, portable electronics, starters and grid storage with higher energy, lower cost, improved safety and scalability. The company commercialises lab samples and pursues mass production, positioning itself as an eco‑friendly alternative to traditional lithium‑ion technology.

providers.name: Brooklyn Dumpling Shop
providers.description: Brooklyn Dumpling Shop is a modern Asian‑inspired fast‑casual restaurant brand that serves dumplings, bowls, and other Asian‑fusion dishes across the United States and Canada. Founded in 2021 in New York City, it has grown to multiple locations, retail partners, sports venues, and entertainment sites. The company offers online ordering, catering, a loyalty program, and franchise opportunities, aiming to make bite‑size foods a staple for a broad audience.

providers.name: Bubblesandbeyond
providers.description: Bubblesandbeyond is a boutique pet care brand offering premium grooming, spa, and wellness services for dogs and cats. Founded to combine playful creativity with professional expertise, the company emphasizes personalized care, high-quality products, and a community-focused approach. While currently listed as a stub in the API Evangelist network, Bubblesandbeyond aims to develop a robust API ecosystem for appointment scheduling, client management, and service integration, reflecting its commitment to modern, tech-enabled pet care.

providers.name: CABRA Sports
providers.description: CABRA Sports is a Latino-focused sports fandom platform based in Los Angeles. It aims to capture the true nature of Latino sports fandom by putting fans at the center, offering a vibrant community where culture and sports intersect. The company provides a digital space for fans to engage, share content, and experience sports with a unique cultural flavor.

providers.name: Caribou Financial
providers.description: Caribou Financial is a fintech platform that helps consumers refinance auto loans by matching them with multiple lenders to find the best rates and terms. The service aggregates loan offers, provides personalized recommendations, and streamlines the application process through an online portal. Founded to simplify vehicle financing, Caribou Financial leverages data-driven insights to improve loan approval odds and reduce borrowing costs for borrowers across the United States.

providers.name: Catalyte
providers.description: Catalyte is an AI‑enabled workforce platform that uses proprietary technology and over 500 data points to discover, develop, and place high‑potential talent. Founded in 2000 and based in Baltimore, the company offers employers a talent‑as‑a‑service model, providing trained software developers and other skilled workers on demand. Catalyte’s services include talent sourcing, training, and placement, helping organizations accelerate hiring, reduce turnover, and build high‑performing teams. The platform also partners with educational institutions to create pipelines of skilled workers, delivering a blend of technology and human expertise to meet modern workforce needs.

providers.name: Catawiki
providers.description: Catawiki is an online auction marketplace headquartered in Amsterdam, Netherlands, specializing in special and collectible objects. Founded in 2008, it runs curated weekly auctions across categories such as art, jewelry, watches, classic cars, coins, stamps, comics, wine, and other collectibles, where every lot is reviewed and vetted by in-house experts before it goes live. Catawiki operates as a consumer marketplace connecting buyers and sellers internationally; it does not publish a public developer API or partner integration program, and runs its engineering on a Ruby/Go/Kafka stack visible across its public GitHub organization. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead (Accel, Northzone) and enriched with verifiable identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: CellResearch Corporation
providers.description: CellResearch Corporation is a Singapore‑based biotechnology company focused on stem cell research and regenerative medicine. It offers a range of services including umbilical cord lining stem cell banking, contract research, and development of therapeutic products such as CALECIM® and SOLLAGEN™. The company publishes scientific publications, patents, and collaborates with clinical partners to advance treatments for burns, wounds, eye diseases, musculoskeletal disorders, and neuro‑degenerative conditions.

providers.name: Chefs' Warehouse
providers.description: The Chefs' Warehouse, Inc. (NASDAQ: CHEF) is a premier distributor of specialty food products to high-end independent restaurants, fine dining establishments, country clubs, hotels, caterers, culinary schools, bakeries, and specialty food stores across North America and the Middle East. The company offers a broad portfolio of artisan, exotic, and signature ingredients spanning center-of-the-plate proteins, specialty dry goods, produce, pastry, cheese and charcuterie, dairy and eggs, oils and vinegars, and kitchen supplies. Customers order through a B2B e-commerce platform (re-platformed to Optimizely B2B in 2021, previously Magento) and companion iOS and Android wholesale-ordering apps built in partnership with Unbound Commerce. As of this profiling, Chefs' Warehouse does not publish a public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or open-source repositories; its digital surface is a buyer-facing ordering experience rather than a programmatic API. This profile documents the company's public footprint for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Church and Dwight
providers.description: Church & Dwight Co., Inc. is a Fortune 500 American consumer packaged goods (CPG) company headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, that manufactures and markets a portfolio of household, personal care, health and wellness, beauty, and specialty products. Best known as the parent company of the Arm & Hammer baking soda brand (the company's flagship since 1846), Church & Dwight operates through three reporting segments: Consumer Domestic, Consumer International, and Specialty Products Division. The company's brand portfolio includes Arm & Hammer, Trojan, OxiClean, Vitafusion, L'il Critters, Therabreath, Hero (Mighty Patch), Batiste, Waterpik, OraJel, Nair, Spinbrush, First Response, RepHresh, Zicam, Flawless, Toppik, Viviscal, Kaboom, Orange Glo, XTRA laundry detergent, and Arrid antiperspirant. Church & Dwight does not currently publish a public consumer-facing developer API; partner integrations are managed through internal portals, and consumer experiences focus on brand websites, e-commerce direct-to-consumer storefronts, and the Innovation Portal for external R&D partnerships.

providers.name: CinCor Pharma
providers.description: CinCor Pharma is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing therapies for cardiovascular, metabolic and kidney diseases. Founded in 2018, it advances its lead candidate CIN-107 (baxdrostat) for hypertension and chronic kidney disease, and was acquired by AstraZeneca in 2023.

providers.name: Circuity
providers.description: Circuity is a private‑market technology platform that enables the buying, selling, and management of pre‑IPO company shares. It offers liquidity solutions, settlement services, and equity administration tools for investors, employees, and private companies. The platform integrates with secondary‑market venues and provides a mobile app for real‑time trading and portfolio management, aiming to democratize access to private‑company equity.

providers.name: Cisinfo
providers.description: Cisinfo is a supplier and service provider of Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), and an industrial cloud platform. The company focuses on delivering integrated solutions for material management, energy management, and production monitoring, targeting manufacturers and laboratories seeking digital transformation. Based in Beijing, Cisinfo develops software that enables real‑time data collection, analytics, and workflow automation across the enterprise, helping clients improve efficiency, compliance, and product quality.

providers.name: CivaTech Oncology
providers.description: CivaTech Oncology is a Durham, North Carolina medical device manufacturer that develops polymer-encapsulated low dose rate (LDR) brachytherapy radiation sources for the treatment of solid tumors. Its FDA-cleared product line includes CivaSheet, a flexible, bioabsorbable, unidirectional planar source that can be custom-sized in the operating room and shields healthy tissue; CivaString, a polymer-encapsulated brachytherapy seed used for prostate and other localized cancers; and CivaDerm for dermatological applications. The company markets to radiation oncologists and surgical teams across pancreatic, sarcoma, colorectal, gynecologic, head and neck, lung and prostate indications, and its research has been supported by NIH/NCI and SBIR programs. It publishes no public developer program, API, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Cloud Elements
providers.description: Cloud Elements was a Denver-based API integration platform that offered pre-built connectors ("Elements") and category-level Unified APIs (CRM, Documents, Finance, Helpdesk, Messaging, etc.) so SaaS vendors could embed third-party integrations without building each connector from scratch. UiPath acquired Cloud Elements in March 2021 and has since folded the technology into UiPath Integration Service. The original cloud-elements.com developer portal and the my.cloud-elements.com console are no longer marketed as a standalone product, so the canonical developer surface today is UiPath Integration Service. This profile is retained as a historical record and a pointer to the successor platform.

providers.name: ComfyUI
providers.description: ComfyUI is an open-source, node-based stable diffusion UI that enables users to create complex image generation workflows through a visual programming interface. It provides a modular architecture, extensive community-contributed nodes, and integration with various AI models, making it a powerful tool for artists, developers, and researchers to prototype and produce high-quality AI-generated visuals. The platform supports custom extensions, real-time preview, and collaborative sharing of workflows, fostering an active ecosystem of contributors and users.

providers.name: ContinuumRx
providers.description: ContinuumRx provides home and site-based infusion therapies and services, partnering with healthcare systems to improve post-acute care coordination, patient outcomes, and financial performance. With over twenty years of experience, they offer antibiotic, enteral, parenteral, IVIG, heart‑failure, and biologic therapies, along with patient education and referral resources.

providers.name: Covid-19
providers.description: Covid 19 spread, infection and recovery

providers.name: Creativegalileo
providers.description: Creativegalileo (also known as Creative Galileo) is an Indian ed‑tech startup founded in 2020, focused on early childhood learning. It delivers the Little Singham learning app for children aged 3‑10, offering interactive videos, games and e‑books across numeracy, language, science and more. The platform includes a parent‑zone for progress tracking and integrates Indian favourite characters to create personalised educational experiences.

providers.name: CTRL Therapeutics
providers.description: CTRL Therapeutics (cTRL Tx) is a Chicago-based preclinical biotechnology company developing next-generation cell therapies for solid tumors. The company harnesses circulating tumor-reactive lymphocytes (cTRLs) - a rare, potent T cell population found in the blood and naturally equipped to fight cancer - to engineer polyclonal cell therapies that avoid invasive tumor-tissue surgery. From a single blood draw, CTRL's proprietary IsoQore cell-sorting platform isolates millions of migratory, tumor-reactive cTRLs via novel markers, aiming to simplify the discovery, manufacturing and administration of solid-tumor cell therapy. CTRL launched in 2023 with a $10M seed financing led by General Catalyst, with participation from Intermountain Health and FACIT. This profile was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; the company operates a corporate website and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Danaher
providers.description: Danaher Corporation is a global life sciences and diagnostics conglomerate whose operating companies include Beckman Coulter, Leica Microsystems, Cepheid, SCIEX, IDT, Cytiva, Abcam, Aldevron, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, Radiometer, and others. Danaher itself does not publish a corporate-level developer API; product and service APIs are provided by individual operating companies under the Danaher portfolio.

providers.name: Datanyze *
providers.description: Datanyze is a sales intelligence and technographic data provider owned by ZoomInfo. It offers a free browser (Chrome) extension that surfaces business contact information — work email addresses, direct-dial and mobile phone numbers, and company firmographics — for prospects on LinkedIn profiles and company websites. Datanyze pioneered "technographics," the practice of tracking the web technologies and software a company uses to power targeted B2B sales and marketing outreach. ZoomInfo acquired Datanyze in 2018 to deliver real-time technographic data to its customers. No public developer API is currently documented; this profile captures the company's discoverable web and security surface.

providers.name: Downstream
providers.description: Downstream Impact Inc. was a Seattle-based SaaS platform that helped brands optimize and automate their Amazon advertising, founded in late 2017 by ex-Amazon marketer Connor Folley and ex-AWS engineer Salim Hamed. A Techstars Seattle graduate, Downstream was acquired by Amazon-analytics company Jungle Scout in March 2021 and its capabilities were folded into Jungle Scout's advertising products. The standalone downstreamimpact.com web application is no longer served (returns 404), though the domain and Google Workspace email infrastructure remain active. Downstream published no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or first-party SDK; its GitHub organization contains only archived internal tooling and forks. This profile is retained as a network company record.

providers.name: Edgar Online (OTC Markets Group)
providers.description: Edgar Online (OTC Markets Group) is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: fintech. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: eFishery
providers.description: eFishery is an Indonesian aquaculture technology ("fishtech") company founded in 2013 in Bandung by Gibran Huzaifah and Chrisna Aditya. Its platform combined an IoT smart auto-feeder (eFeeder) that dispenses feed to fish and shrimp ponds and streams pond telemetry to a smartphone app, with an integrated services layer: eFisheryKu / eFarm farm-management software, eFund (including the Kabayan "pay later" financing product) linking smallholder farmers to lenders, and eFresh / eMart marketplaces connecting farmers to feed suppliers and downstream buyers. The company raised a $90M Series C (2022) and a $200M Series D (2023) at a unicorn valuation, backed by investors including 500 Global, Aqua-Spark, SoftBank Vision Fund 2, Temasek, and Northstar. In late 2024 an audit alleged large-scale financial-statement fraud dating to 2018; both founders resigned and the company underwent multiple rounds of layoffs and restructuring through 2025. This record was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; eFishery exposes no public developer API or developer portal, and its primary efishery.com domain currently resolves to a parked/forwarding host.

providers.name: Elixiron Immunotherapeutics
providers.description: Elixiron Immunotherapeutics (Cayman) Limited is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2017, with offices in Taipei, Taiwan and Cambridge, Massachusetts, developing precision immunotherapies for neuroinflammation, autoimmune disease and cancer. Its clinical pipeline is led by enrupatinib (EI-1071), a small-molecule CSF-1R inhibitor in development for Alzheimer's disease and other neurodegenerative indications, and EI-001, a fully human anti-interferon-gamma monoclonal antibody in Phase 2 for vitiligo, alongside preclinical EI-012 (anti-CD36) and EI-220 (mRNA) oncology programs. The company publishes a corporate and investor-relations website only: there is no developer portal, public API, SDK, webhook surface or machine-readable specification of any kind on its own hosts.

providers.name: Epiroc
providers.description: Epiroc AB is a leading global provider of equipment and services for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. The company designs, manufactures and supports a broad range of products including drilling rigs, rock excavation tools, and automation solutions that improve productivity and safety in challenging environments. Epiroc focuses on sustainable development and innovation, delivering advanced technology to customers worldwide.

providers.name: Ericsson
providers.description: Ericsson (Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson) is a Swedish multinational networking and telecommunications equipment vendor headquartered in Kista, Stockholm. Founded in 1876, the company supplies mobile and fixed network infrastructure to communication service providers worldwide and operates across three product areas: Networks (5G RAN, 5G Core, Cloud RAN, transport), Cloud Software & Services (OSS/BSS, orchestration, billing, charging, analytics), and Enterprise Wireless Solutions (private 5G via Cradlepoint). Ericsson holds more than 60,000 granted patents and operates 21 R&D centers, with networks that carry roughly 40 percent of the world's mobile data traffic. In 2024 Ericsson and twelve major operators — AT&T, Bharti Airtel, Deutsche Telekom, KDDI, Orange, Reliance Jio, Singtel, Telefonica, Telstra, T-Mobile, Verizon, and Vodafone — closed Aduna, a 50:50 joint venture that aggregates CAMARA-aligned network APIs (SIM Swap, Number Verification, Quality on Demand, Device Location, Device Reachability, Scam Signal, Call Forwarding Signal, Connectivity Insights, OTP SMS) and exposes them through hyperscaler and CPaaS channel partners (Microsoft Azure Marketplace, Google Cloud, Vonage, Sinch, Infobip). Ericsson also owns Vonage (acquired 2022), which operates the public-facing developer portal for many of these network capabilities, and runs the Ericsson Intelligent Automation Platform (EIAP) for ORAN-aligned rApp development. Ericsson does not publish a single consolidated developer portal or canonical OpenAPI catalog at ericsson.com — its programmable surface is delivered indirectly through Aduna, Vonage, and channel partners, and most of its public GitHub presence is research tooling and infrastructure software (CodeChecker, CodeCompass, ecchronos) rather than developer-facing APIs.

providers.name: Factory OS
providers.description: Factory OS (styled Factory_OS) is an off-site construction company founded in 2017 by Rick Holliday and Larry Pace that industrialized multifamily and affordable housing production on an assembly line inside a 275,000-square-foot facility in Building 680 on Mare Island in Vallejo, California. Union carpenters build wood-frame housing modules across roughly two dozen stations in a 33-step process, and the finished modules are trucked to the project site and assembled — an approach the company says cuts production time by about half and production cost by a quarter against conventional site-built construction. It raised roughly $132 million across three rounds, including $60 million from JPMorgan Chase and Saint-Gobain in 2021, and delivered more than 4,000 homes across California and Hawaii, about 90 percent of them affordable housing. In May 2024 the company was recapitalized and renamed Harbinger Homes (legal entity Harbinger Production Inc.), with Tom Smith as CEO and Kevin Brown as president; factoryos.com now 301-redirects every path to harbinger.homes.
