Harbinger filed a WARN notice on 12 February 2026 covering all 280 employees, citing a lack of new business and loss of capital funding, with layoffs beginning 13 April 2026. Factory OS is a manufacturer of physical housing modules, not a software company: it operates no developer program, API, SDK, webhook surface or machine-readable specification of any kind, and its GitHub organization has no public repositories.

providers.name: Folksam
providers.description: Folksam Försäkringsbolag is a Swedish insurance company offering a wide range of insurance products for homes, cars, and individuals, as well as savings and pension solutions. It serves over 900,000 vehicles and countless households across Sweden, emphasizing customer service and digital accessibility through its website.

providers.name: General Mills
providers.description: General Mills is a leading global food company that manufactures and markets branded consumer foods including Cheerios, Betty Crocker, Pillsbury, Haagen- Dazs, Nature Valley, Old El Paso, and Progresso. General Mills operates in over 100 countries. The company does not currently publish a public developer API portal and primarily relies on EDI and direct supply chain integrations with retail partners.

providers.name: Getground
providers.description: GetGround is a London-based property investment platform that lets UK and international buy-to-let investors set up and run their rental businesses through a limited company. The all-in-one platform handles limited company formation, business bank accounts, accounting and tax filing (including Making Tax Digital), bookkeeping, buy-to-let mortgages, landlord insurance, tenant finding, and sourcing of investment properties. GetGround is backed by QED Investors and offers subscription tiers and launch packs for landlords managing single or multiple rental properties.

providers.name: Harman International
providers.description: Harman International, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Samsung Electronics, is a global leader in connected technologies for automotive, consumer, and enterprise markets, including connected car systems, audio products, professional solutions, and connected services. Harman does not currently publish a public developer portal or open APIs; integrations with Harman platforms (such as Ignite, Ready Connect, and audio brands like JBL, Harman Kardon, and AKG) are typically delivered through commercial partnerships and OEM agreements.

providers.name: Hearst
providers.description: Hearst is a privately held, diversified American media, information, and services conglomerate headquartered in the Hearst Tower in New York City. Founded in 1887 by William Randolph Hearst, the company spans more than 360 businesses across magazines, newspapers, broadcast television, cable networks, business and financial information, healthcare information, automotive data, and venture investments. Hearst reported approximately US$13B in revenue (2024) with ~22,000 employees worldwide.

providers.name: Hyster-Yale Materials Handling
providers.description: Hyster-Yale Materials Handling is a global designer, engineer, manufacturer, seller, and servicer of a comprehensive line of forklifts and aftermarket parts marketed under the Hyster and Yale brands. This repository tracks public APIs, developer resources, and integration touchpoints associated with Hyster-Yale.

providers.name: Imbue
providers.description: Imbue is a San Francisco AI research lab building agentic foundation models for reasoning and the human tooling around them, with a stated mission of AI that is loyal to its user. The team trains large reasoning models in-house (including a 70B model trained from scratch with open-sourced tooling and evaluation datasets) and publishes research on agent and reasoning architectures, reinforcement learning, data generation, and the scientific theory of deep learning. Imbue ships practical tools that emerge from the research, including Sculptor and mngr for orchestrating parallel coding agents, Bouncer for filtering social feeds, and Blueprint and Vet. There is no public commercial inference API; integration happens through open-sourced repositories, model artifacts on Hugging Face, and research releases.

providers.name: Immunis
providers.description: Immunis, Inc. is a private, clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Irvine, California, developing immunomodulatory secretome biologics — the mixture of proteins and factors secreted by stem cells, rather than the cells themselves — as a treatment for age- and disease-related immune decline. Its lead candidate, IMM01-STEM, is under study in the STEM-MYO Phase 1/2a trial for muscle atrophy and sarcopenia, alongside a STEM-META Phase 2 program and a STEM-K9 veterinary program. Immunis is a therapeutics developer, not a software company: it publishes no developer portal, API, SDK, webhook surface, or machine-readable API contract of any kind. Its entire public surface is a WordPress marketing and clinical-trial-recruitment site whose only machine-readable endpoint is the default WordPress REST API at /wp-json/, which serves the CMS of that site and is not an Immunis API product.

providers.name: INDEX Robotics
providers.description: INDEX Robotics is a South Korean humanoid robotics startup based in Seongnam (Bundang) building high-precision actuators and upper-body humanoid robots for high-mix, low-volume industrial work. Its core products are the IA Series, a family of high-precision actuators purpose-built for humanoid joints, and INDEX01, a compact upper-body humanoid prototype that deliberately foregoes a mobile base so it can slot into constrained factory workspaces for logistics handling, machining support, and precision assembly. The company treats joint precision, responsiveness under sustained repetitive motion, and long-run performance consistency as the core unsolved problems in humanoid commercialization. In February 2026 INDEX Robotics closed a $1M (KRW 1.5B) seed round led by Futureplay with Bass Ventures and 500 Global co-investing. This is a hardware company with no public API, SDK, or developer program at this time.

providers.name: INSEE
providers.description: INSEE (Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques) is France's national institute for statistics and economic studies. It provides official statistical data, analyses, and publications covering demographics, economy, society, and geography. The institute offers open data portals, APIs, and documentation for developers to access datasets on population, employment, inflation, and more, supporting research, policy making, and public information.

providers.name: Kairos Aerospace
providers.description: Kairos Aerospace is a methane-detection company founded in 2014 in Sunnyvale, California that provides cost-effective, high-frequency aerial methane detection for the oil and gas industry. Its patented LeakSurveyor spectrometer is flown over upstream and midstream infrastructure to image methane plumes, and proprietary software turns those flights into actionable emissions data so operators can find, prioritize, and fix leaks. The company rebranded as Insight M in March 2024 and was subsequently acquired by Zeitview. Kairos Aerospace was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface, so this profile is an identity record rather than an API catalog entry.

providers.name: KBR
providers.description: KBR is a Fortune 500 company that delivers science, technology, and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world, spanning defense, intelligence, space, energy transition, and sustainable infrastructure markets.

providers.name: Kinaset Therapeutics
providers.description: Kinaset Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in Medfield, Massachusetts, founded in 2020 by Robert Clarke (CEO), Roger Heerman (COO) and Frazer Morgan (CDO) to develop novel inhaled therapeutics for severe respiratory disease. Its lead candidate, frevecitinib (KN-002), is a dry-powder inhaled pan-JAK inhibitor — potent and balanced across JAK1, JAK2, JAK3 and TYK2 — designed as a non-invasive anti-inflammatory add-on to standard of care for all severe asthma patients regardless of the underlying cause of inflammation, and explored in COPD. The company completed a Phase 1/1b program (NCT05006521), received FDA IND clearance, and in July 2026 dosed the first patient in the Phase 2b PANAIRAMA trial (NCT07532265) after closing a $103M oversubscribed Series B in January 2026 led by RA Capital Management and Forge Life Science Partners, with EQT Life Sciences, Vivo Capital, Schroders Capital, Willett Advisors, Pictet Alternative Advisors, Sixty Degree Capital, Atlas Venture, 5AM Ventures and Gimv participating on roughly $143M raised to date. Kinaset is a drug developer, not a software company: its product is a clinical pipeline, and it publishes no developer program, no public API, no SDKs, no webhooks and no machine-readable API contract. Its entire public surface is a 34-page Squarespace marketing and investor-news site whose robots.txt disallows every platform JSON view and blocks the major AI crawlers by user agent.

providers.name: Latigo Bio
providers.description: Latigo Biotherapeutics, Inc. ("Latigo Bio") is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Thousand Oaks, California, developing novel non-opioid medicines for acute and chronic pain. Its lead candidates LTG-001 and LTG-321 are oral NaV1.8 sodium-channel inhibitors targeting pain at its peripheral source without the addiction risk of opioids; LTG-001 holds FDA Fast Track designation and reported positive Phase 2b results in post-abdominoplasty acute pain, published in the New England Journal of Medicine in July 2026. The company was founded on human-genetics-validated targets and uses in-house AI/ML and structure-based drug design to optimize potency and selectivity. It debuted in 2024 with a $135M Series A and closed a $150M Series B in March 2025, backed by Westlake Village BioPartners, 5AM Ventures, Foresite Capital and Corner Ventures. Latigo is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor: it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Lawdingo
providers.description: Lawdingo is a New York City legal-technology company founded in 2012 by Nikhil Nirmel and Dan Langevin, and a Y Combinator Winter 2013 alum backed by Andreessen Horowitz, General Catalyst and AltaIR Capital. It launched as a consumer marketplace for talking to a lawyer on demand, then pivoted to serving law firms and corporate legal departments with remote paralegals and contract attorneys — legal research, litigation drafting, court filing and discovery support — delivered through an online platform where clients assign work, share documents, deposit funds and track hours. Lawdingo publishes no public API, developer portal or SDKs, and as of this enrichment pass its lawdingo.com and www.lawdingo.com domains both return HTTP 404 "Site Not Found" from an unpublished Framer site, leaving no live web surface to harvest.

providers.name: LIH Healthcare (长和医疗)
providers.description: Beijing Changhe International Medical Investment Management Co., Ltd. — operating as LIH Healthcare (长和医疗) — is a Chinese rehabilitation-medicine group that invests in, manages, and operates rehabilitation hospitals and outpatient clinics. The company imports international rehabilitation techniques, service models, and management practices and adapts them to the Chinese market across pediatric developmental and behavioral rehabilitation, cardiopulmonary and critical-care rehabilitation, pain rehabilitation, neurological rehabilitation, and bone and joint rehabilitation. Its three business models are building and investing in high-standard rehabilitation hospitals and clinics, co-operating rehabilitation-medicine departments inside existing general hospitals, and selling systematized rehabilitation service solutions (planning, clinical pathways, operations, equipment, IT consulting, and staff training) to hospitals. Facilities include Beijing Changhe Dayun Pediatric Clinic, Shanghai and Shenzhen pediatric rehabilitation outpatient centers, and Kunming Changhe Tiancheng Rehabilitation Hospital. It is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. LIH Healthcare publishes no public developer program, API, or SDK — this profile carries identity and domain-security data only.

providers.name: Lowy Asia Power Index
providers.description: Get measure resources and influence to rank the relative power of states in Asia

providers.name: Lululemon Athletica
providers.description: Lululemon Athletica is a designer, distributor, and retailer of technical athletic apparel, footwear, and accessories for women, men, and girls. Lululemon does not currently publish a public developer portal or open APIs; digital integrations are handled through partner relationships and internal ecommerce, retail, and supply-chain platforms.

providers.name: LyondellBasell
providers.description: LyondellBasell Industries N.V. (NYSE: LYB) is one of the world's largest producers of polymers and plastic resins, including polyethylene, polypropylene, and specialty polyolefins such as Catalloy and Polybutene-1. The company also produces chemicals, fuels, polyolefin process technology, and advanced polymer solutions, and operates a Circular & Low Carbon Solutions (CLCS) business marketing CirculenRecover and CirculenRenew recycled and renewable polymers. LyondellBasell has no public developer program, no API documentation, and no source code published in its (empty) GitHub organization. In January 2025 the company began the permanent closure of its Houston Refining facility — the 263,776 bpd, full-conversion plant that was the first refinery on the Houston Ship Channel when it opened in 1918 — eliminating more than 400 jobs and exiting the refining business entirely. Profiled as a Tier 3 industrial / no-APIs provider for portfolio completeness.

providers.name: MakersPlace
providers.description: MakersPlace is a curated marketplace for authentic digital creations, letting artists mint, sell, and collect verified digital artworks (NFTs) recorded on the blockchain. Founded in 2018 and based in San Francisco, it is known for high-profile digital art drops and for guaranteeing the authenticity and provenance of every creation. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Pantera Capital in the crypto sector. As of this enrichment pass MakersPlace publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Material Exchange
providers.description: Material Exchange is a sourcing platform that structures early-stage sourcing workflows for product development teams, backed by Partech. It provides a structured, agentic environment - with an AI assistant named Frank - to define sourcing direction, align stakeholders, and coordinate sourcing earlier in product development. The platform helps teams structure briefs, identify relevant suppliers and materials, surface missing cost or compliance data, compare options, and flag gaps before decisions move downstream. No public API, developer portal, SDKs, or documentation surface has been found; this profile was enriched via domain-security probes and public identity discovery only.

providers.name: McGraw Hill Financial
providers.description: McGraw Hill Financial was a financial information and analytics company providing credit ratings, benchmarks, and analytics to global capital and commodity markets. The company was renamed S&P Global in 2016. No public developer APIs are currently documented under the McGraw Hill Financial brand.

providers.name: MGM Resorts International
providers.description: MGM Resorts International is a global entertainment company with national and international locations featuring best-in-class hotels and casinos, state-of-the-art meetings and conference spaces, and dining and entertainment venues. This repository captures the APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts for MGM Resorts International.

providers.name: Micro
providers.description: Micro is an open source project building a Go framework and runtime for cloud-native services and AI agents. Its flagship library, go-micro (go-micro.dev/v6), provides pluggable abstractions for service discovery, RPC transport, message brokering, and configuration, and is described by the project as a Go agent harness and service framework. Micro is developed in the open on GitHub under the micro organization. The micro.dev site is a minimal landing page rather than a hosted developer portal, and the project ships no public REST API, OpenAPI specification, developer console, or SaaS control plane at this time.

providers.name: Minted
providers.description: Minted is a San Francisco-based online design marketplace that crowdsources graphic and fine-art designs from a global community of independent artists and sells the winning work as stationery, wedding invitations, holiday cards, art prints, home decor, and personalized gifts. Its e-commerce storefront at minted.com pairs artist-submitted designs with in-house printing and fulfillment. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and Slow Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; the enrichment pass probed for any public developer surface and found no documented public API — Minted operates as a direct-to-consumer commerce brand, not an API provider.

providers.name: MisterBnB
providers.description: misterb&b (operated by SFO84 inc.) is the world's largest LGBTQ-focused travel and accommodation booking platform, connecting gay and queer travelers with LGBTQ-friendly rentable lodging including private rooms, apartments, hotels, and homestays across more than 200,000 cities worldwide. Founded in Paris in 2014 by Matthieu Jost, François de Landes, Marc Dedonder, and Julien Delon and now headquartered in San Francisco, the company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. Enrichment found no public developer/API surface: the consumer site is Cloudflare-protected (403 to non-browser clients), the github.com/misterbnb organization holds only open-source Ruby/JS forks, and no well-known, OpenAPI, SDK, or MCP artifacts are published. Host-partner connectivity is offered indirectly via channel managers such as Guesty rather than a documented public API.

providers.name: Monsanto
providers.description: Monsanto was a global agricultural products company that produced seeds, biotechnology trait products, and herbicides before being acquired by Bayer AG in 2018. Operations and brands have since been integrated into the Bayer Crop Science division.

providers.name: Mozart Therapeutics
providers.description: Mozart Therapeutics, Inc. is a privately held, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company in Seattle, Washington, founded in 2020 to develop disease-modifying therapies for autoimmune and inflammatory disease. Its platform is built on the regulatory CD8 T cell (CD8 Treg) network — an upstream immune checkpoint that normally recognizes and eliminates the pathogenic immune cells that attack healthy tissue, and that becomes dysfunctional in autoimmune disease when inhibitory killer immunoglobulin-like receptors (KIR) block CD8 Treg activation. Rather than suppressing downstream inflammation, Mozart engineers bispecific CD8 Treg modulators intended to restore that checkpoint and re-establish long-term immune balance. Its pipeline comprises MTX-101, a KIR x CD8 bispecific antibody in Phase 1b study for type 1 diabetes, and MTX-201, a KIR x ICOS bispecific in preclinical development for inflammatory bowel disease. The company launched with a $55M Series A led by ARCH Venture Partners and Sofinnova Partners with participation from Eli Lilly, MRL Ventures Fund, Leaps by Bayer, Altitude Life Science Ventures and Alexandria Venture Investments, and later added a $25M extension including Pfizer Ventures, AbbVie Ventures, Ono Venture Investment and UPMC Enterprises. Mozart Therapeutics sells therapeutics, not software: it runs no developer program, publishes no API, SDK or machine-readable specification, and maintains no public source-code organization.

providers.name: National Grid
providers.description: National Grid is a multinational electricity and gas utility company that delivers energy to millions of customers across the United Kingdom and the United States. It operates transmission and distribution networks, provides energy services, and invests in sustainable infrastructure and innovation. The company focuses on reliable power delivery, renewable energy integration, and customer support, while maintaining regulatory compliance and environmental stewardship.

providers.name: NewLimit
providers.description: NewLimit is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of kleiner-perkins and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: healthcare. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: NextPoint Therapeutics
providers.description: NextPoint Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based at 238 Main Street in Cambridge, Massachusetts, developing precision immuno-oncology therapeutics built on its scientific work on the novel B7-H7/HHLA2 checkpoint axis. Its pipeline includes a T-cell engager engineered for an improved therapeutic index, an antibody-drug conjugate using proprietary linker technology, and a multi-functional checkpoint inhibitor, each aimed at tumors that upregulate B7-H7. The company publishes a seven-page corporate marketing site covering its science, pipeline, leadership, and news; it operates no developer program, publishes no API, SDK, or machine-readable specification, and is profiled here for network completeness rather than for an API surface.

providers.name: Nortek
providers.description: Nortek is a global manufacturer of HVAC, data center cooling, and cleanroom systems, organized into three divisions: Nortek Air Solutions, Nortek Data Center Cooling, and Nortek Cleanroom Solutions. No public developer portal or OpenAPI specifications have been identified at this time; this repository tracks Nortek for future API discovery and integration intelligence.

providers.name: NortonLifeLock
providers.description: NortonLifeLock was a consumer cyber-safety company built from the Norton antivirus / consumer security business and the LifeLock identity-theft-protection brand, offering device security, VPN, password management, dark-web monitoring, and identity restoration to individuals and families. It was formed in 2019 when Symantec sold its enterprise-security business to Broadcom and renamed the remaining consumer unit NortonLifeLock, and in September 2022 it merged with Avast to form Gen Digital (NASDAQ: GEN), the current parent of Norton, LifeLock, Avast, AVG, Avira, and CCleaner. The company sells consumer subscription products rather than a public developer platform: nortonlifelock.com now redirects to gendigital.com, and there is no first-party public REST/OAuth developer API, SDK, or developer portal. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio lead and enriched to record that no public API surface exists.

providers.name: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings
providers.description: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. (NYSE: NCLH) is a global cruise company operating three premium brands: Norwegian Cruise Line (pioneer of Freestyle Cruising), Oceania Cruises, and Regent Seven Seas Cruises. The company operates a combined fleet of more than 30 ships sailing to over 700 destinations worldwide. No public developer portal or external API offering has been identified for Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings; travel agent and global distribution system (GDS) integrations are handled through contracted partner programs rather than a self-serve developer API.

providers.name: Nuance Labs
providers.description: Nuance Labs is an early-stage AI research company based in Seattle, Washington, building a human foundation model with emotional intelligence. It is developing a real-time, full-duplex audiovisual system that sees, hears, reasons, speaks, and expresses simultaneously, reading tone, facial expression, and hesitation to enable face-to-face AI interaction that feels human. Backed by Accel and Lightspeed Venture Partners, the company is pre-product: as of this enrichment pass it publishes only a marketing site (About, Press, Contact, Careers) with a "Get Demo" / early-access call to action, and exposes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or other developer surface.

providers.name: Onda
providers.description: Onda is a ready-to-drink spirits brand that makes canned sparkling tequila — blanco tequila from a woman-owned distillery in Jalisco, Mexico, blended with sparkling water and real fruit juice and sold in 12 oz cans at 5% ABV, 100 calories, zero sugar and naturally gluten free, in lime, blood orange, watermelon and grapefruit. The company was founded in 2019 and launched publicly in July 2020 by Noah Gray (CEO), Max Dworin (COO), Kelli Adams (CCO) and actor-producer Shay Mitchell (Chief Brand Officer). It raised a $5M Series A in 2021 and a $12.5M growth round in 2022 from existing investors including Aria Growth Partners and 25madison, and sells through national grocery, liquor retail and third-party beverage e-commerce alongside its own direct-to-consumer store. NO PUBLIC API SURFACE: Onda is a consumer packaged goods company, not a software vendor — there is no developer program, no API documentation, no SDK and no machine-readable contract of any kind. Its only owned web property, drinkonda.com, is a Shopify storefront that on 2026-08-26 returned HTTP 404 "This store is unavailable" on every path probed, with a robots.txt that disallows all crawling and a Shopify-generated /llms.txt that states agent interaction is not possible; the last archived working capture of the storefront is 2026-02-18. Onda appears in the API Evangelist network because it trades on the private secondary market (EquityZen, Nasdaq Private Market), not because it publishes an API.

providers.name: OpenBazaar
providers.description: OpenBazaar is an open-source, decentralized peer-to-peer marketplace protocol that let buyers and sellers trade goods and services directly with one another using cryptocurrency, with no central company, listing fees, or intermediaries taking a cut. Trades were coordinated over a distributed network built on IPFS and libp2p, settled with Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies, and secured with multisignature escrow and third-party moderation. The project originated from the DarkMarket proof-of-concept and was developed and funded by the company OB1 (backed by a16z, Union Square Ventures, and others). The OpenBazaar server daemon exposed a local JSON REST API on the node that desktop, mobile, and web clients used to manage listings, orders, wallets, and profiles. OB1 wound down commercial operations and the hosted services in early 2021, and the code was open-sourced to the community. The openbazaar.org site now advertises an in-development "OpenBazaar 3.0" successor, and the GitHub organization hosts the legacy Python (1.0) and Go (2.0) daemons alongside newer Rust and browser-based clients.

providers.name: OpenCola
providers.description: OpenCola is a non-profit organization building free, open-source, local-first software as an alternative to corporate social media and cloud platforms. Its application keeps a user's data on their own device by default, offering personal search, offline content archives, multiple personas, trust-based connections via tokens, information-centric collaboration, and community moderation. The project is grounded in four principles: transparency, accountability, personal control, and security (cryptographic verification). It is a revival of the original OpenCola (1999), and the current release is a local desktop application rather than a hosted service. OpenCola publishes no public web API, developer portal, SDK, or OpenAPI at this time; this profile captures its identity and open-source posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Opencurriculum
providers.description: OpenCurriculum is a nonprofit education-technology organization (a Y Combinator alum) that builds curriculum-planning software for K-12 schools. Its web application helps teachers and administrators create and organize lesson plans, unit plans, and courses; draw on a curated library of high-quality, ready-to-go teaching ideas, resources, and strategies; align instruction to standards and learning goals; collaborate with colleagues on instructional design; and track progress through planner, calendar, and semester views with alignment analytics. The organization is based in Sacramento, California. As of this enrichment pass OpenCurriculum publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, OpenAPI specification, webhooks, or /.well-known discovery surface; it maintains a small public GitHub organization (one public repository, "flow", an open-source learning-app maker). This profile therefore carries company identity only, with no API artifacts to enrich.

providers.name: Pahdo Labs
providers.description: Pahdo Labs is a venture-backed consumer game studio (an a16z portfolio company) building anime-inspired action-RPG and world-creation experiences. Its public engineering footprint is a game-technology stack rather than a public API product: the pahdolabs GitHub organization publishes forks and modules for the Godot game engine (including a React loader for Godot, a prediction-and-rewind network synchronizer, a Tracy profiler integration, FMOD audio, GodotSteam, and FishNet networking). As surfaced from an a16z portfolio harvest, Pahdo Labs does not publish a developer portal, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, hosted MCP server, SDK for third-party integration, or a documented public API surface at this time. This profile captures the company's real identity and open-source game-engine tooling for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Palerra
providers.description: Palerra, Inc. was a Santa Clara, California cloud security company whose LORIC platform delivered Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) capabilities: automated security monitoring, threat detection, configuration management, and compliance across SaaS and IaaS environments such as Salesforce, AWS, Microsoft Office 365, ServiceNow, and Box. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners and Wing Venture Capital, Palerra was acquired by Oracle in September 2016 and folded into the Oracle CASB Cloud Service. The palerra.com domain now redirects to Oracle's cloud security portal, and no independent public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification remains.

providers.name: Parrot
providers.description: Parrot (useparrot.com) is a Y Combinator-backed startup (Spring 2026 batch) building an agentic, all-in-one management platform for collision and auto repair shops. Its AI agents automate estimate auditing, parts procurement (voice agents that compare supplier quotes), insurance claim follow-ups, invoice reconciliation, tax filing, payments and invoicing, inventory management, team coordination, and inbound call handling, and it integrates with CCC ONE, Audatex, and Mitchell 1. Parrot does not currently publish a public API or developer program.

providers.name: PEI-Genesis
providers.description: PEI-Genesis is a privately held, Philadelphia-headquartered global authorized distributor and value-added assembler of interconnect components (cable and circular connectors), founded in 1946. The company self-describes on LinkedIn as providing "Engineered Solutions for Connectors and Cables" in the Appliances, Electrical, and Electronics Manufacturing industry, with 501-1,000 employees. The public-facing peigenesis.com web property is a product catalog and quote-request portal protected by an interstitial JavaScript challenge; no public REST API, OpenAPI specification, developer portal, EDI integration documentation, PunchOut catalog, or GitHub organization could be located. Public API documentation has not yet been catalogued in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Physical Intelligence
providers.description: Physical Intelligence (often styled "Pi" or "π") is a San Francisco-based research company building general-purpose foundation models for robotics with the stated goal of producing learning algorithms that can control any robot to do any task. The company has published a continuing line of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models: π0 (October 2024, first generalist multi-task multi-robot policy), π0-FAST (autoregressive variant via Real-time Action Chunking / FAST tokenization), π0.5 (April 2025, open-world generalization), π*0.6 (November 2025, reinforcement-learning from experience), and π0.7 (April 2026, steerable model with emergent capabilities). Physical Intelligence releases significant work as open source: the openpi repository (~12K stars) is the canonical home for π0 weights and code, with companion repos including real-time-chunking-kinetix, pi-data-sharing, aloha, augmax, and rlds_dataset_builder. The company does not yet offer a hosted commercial API; access to the platform is via open-weight models and research collaborations.

providers.name: PineTree Therapeutics
providers.description: Pinetree Therapeutics, Inc. is a preclinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered at West Cambridge Scientific Park, 767C Concord Ave, Cambridge, Massachusetts, developing next-generation targeted protein degraders (TPDs) built on its proprietary AbReptor platform. AbReptor degrades membrane-bound and extracellular proteins through target co-engagement, induced endocytosis, endolysosome formation and lysosomal degradation, aiming to overcome drug resistance and tumor recurrence in oncology, with additional application in inflammation and immunology. The company is advancing trispecific degraders and ADC-integrated programs, closed a $17M Series A in July 2024, and has entered a licensing partnership with AstraZeneca. It is a therapeutics developer rather than a software vendor: it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Publix Super Markets
providers.description: Publix Super Markets is one of the largest employee-owned supermarket chains in the United States, headquartered in Lakeland, Florida. It operates grocery stores, pharmacies, delivery, catering, and online ordering services across the southeastern United States. Publix is a Fortune 500 company. No public developer APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Qphox
providers.description: QphoX is a Delft, Netherlands-based quantum technology company founded in 2021 and spun out of Delft University of Technology (TU Delft). It develops quantum networking hardware to tackle the scaling challenges of quantum computing, centered on its Quantum Transducer, described as the first quantum interface between single optical and single microwave photons, enabling optical interconnects between superconducting quantum processors. Alongside the transducer, QphoX offers an Optical Control System for delivering RF signals into extreme cryogenic environments and a CryoSwitch Control Module for use with Radiall's cryogenic latching actuator. The company publishes open-source Python instrument-control libraries (QCoDeS drivers) on GitHub for operating its hardware. QphoX is backed by Speedinvest. QphoX exposes no public web API or developer portal.

providers.name: Quanta Therapeutics
providers.description: Quanta Therapeutics is a privately held, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2018 and headquartered at 2 Tower Place in South San Francisco, California, with a second site in Radnor, Pennsylvania. It develops oral allosteric small-molecule medicines for RAS-driven cancers by targeting the protein-protein interactions that drive oncogenic RAS signaling, an approach the company describes as conformational blockade of RAS. Its discovery engine is a proprietary high-throughput Second Harmonic Generation (SHG) optical platform that detects subtle protein conformational changes and so surfaces allosteric modulators of signaling complexes that conventional binding assays miss. The clinical pipeline is a set of direct multi-KRAS inhibitors: QTX3034, a G12D-preferring oral multi-KRAS inhibitor in Phase 1 as monotherapy and in combination with cetuximab in KRAS G12D-mutant solid tumors; QTX3544, a G12V-preferring multi-KRAS inhibitor cleared for IND in January 2025; and QTX3046, which dosed its first patient in a Phase 1/1b trial in June 2024. Indications span pancreatic, colorectal, lung and endometrial cancers. The company announced a $60 million Series C in October 2021 and a Series D of over $50 million in May 2023 led by Avidity Partners alongside Sofinnova Investments, Vida Ventures, Surveyor Capital, Longitude Capital and AbbVie Ventures. Quanta Therapeutics runs no developer program and publishes no public API. Its corporate site is a single static HTML document served from Apache with anchor-based sections; probes for OpenAPI, GraphQL, MCP, llms.txt and every /.well-known/ discovery path returned HTTP 404, and no api./developer./docs. subdomain resolves.

providers.name: Realtor.com
providers.description: Realtor.com is a real estate listings website operated by Move, Inc., a subsidiary of News Corp, headquartered in Santa Clara, California. The platform is the official site of the National Association of REALTORS (NAR) under a long-term operating agreement and is one of the largest U.S. property search portals, serving home buyers, sellers, renters, and real estate professionals. Realtor.com aggregates for-sale, for-rent, and off-market listings sourced primarily from Multiple Listing Services (MLSs) via Move's listings distribution subsidiary ListHub, and surfaces them through consumer web and mobile apps alongside neighborhood, school, mortgage, and market data. The professional side of the business sells lead-generation and marketing products such as Connections Plus, ReadyConnect Concierge, and Market VIP to agents and brokers, while ListHub provides MLS-to-portal syndication, broker reporting, and listing feed management. Adjacent Move properties include Doorsteps, Moving.com, and SeniorHousingNet, and the company publishes a public economic research arm at realtor.com/research that releases monthly housing market reports and downloadable historical datasets. Realtor.com does not publish a first-party public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK; programmatic access to listing data is gated through MLS membership and ListHub's broker/vendor agreements, while the only widely available HTTP APIs branded as Realtor.com are unofficial third-party scrapers hosted on RapidAPI and Apify.

providers.name: Rent the Runway
providers.description: Rent the Runway is a New York-based fashion technology company operating a subscription and one-time rental service for designer apparel and accessories, delivered direct-to-consumer through its website and mobile apps. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass the company publishes no first-party public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal; its GitHub organization holds only internal Java/RabbitMQ tooling and forks, and third-party access is limited to an affiliate program run through external commerce networks.

providers.name: Safran
providers.description: Safran designs, manufactures and supplies aircraft equipment, interiors, propulsion systems, defense equipment and space hardware. It provides landing gear, wheels, brakes, nacelles, seats, cabins, engines and optical systems to aircraft manufacturers, armed forces and space agencies worldwide. The group’s mission is to contribute to safer and more sustainable aviation.

providers.name: Schuettflix
providers.description: Schuettflix is a German digital logistics platform for the construction industry, founded in 2018 in Guetersloh. It operates a neutral B2B marketplace that connects construction companies, bulk-material suppliers, freight forwarders and waste-disposal firms in a single fully digital workflow. Through its iOS and Android apps, customers order sand, gravel and crushed stone with transparent real-time pricing, coordinate dispatch and transport, capture delivery documentation, manage routes, and handle mineral-waste disposal and circular-economy recycling of construction materials. The company digitizes the traditionally analog and fragmented process of procuring and delivering bulk goods, earning a commission on the transactions facilitated through its platform. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest. No public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification was found during enrichment.

providers.name: SCIWIND
providers.description: Sciwind Biosciences (Hangzhou Sciwind Biosciences Co., Ltd.) is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Hangzhou, China, with a US office in San Ramon, California, focused on discovering, developing, and delivering innovative therapeutics for weight management and metabolic disease. Its pipeline spans obesity, type 2 diabetes, and non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH), led by the GLP-1 receptor agonist Ecnoglutide (advancing through Phase III trials). The company operates proprietary drug-discovery platforms including BiasVantage (biased agonist discovery), OralVantage (oral peptide delivery), and HaleVantage (half-life extension), with 14+ pipeline programs, 120+ researchers, and 110+ patents. Surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found no public API or developer platform surface.

providers.name: Seekster
providers.description: Seekster is a Bangkok, Thailand based technology company operating an on-demand home and business services marketplace alongside a field service management (FSM) platform used by enterprises to dispatch, schedule, and manage service technicians. The consumer marketplace connects customers with vetted providers for cleaning, maintenance, repair, and facility services, while the SaaS product gives businesses workforce management, job tracking, and customer booking tools. Seekster is a 500 Global portfolio company. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; at the time of enrichment the public website deployment was offline (HTTP 402 / DEPLOYMENT_DISABLED) and no public API specification, SDK, or developer portal could be located.

providers.name: ShareRoot
providers.description: ShareRoot was a user-generated content (UGC) marketing platform and, as ShareRoot Ltd (ASX: SRO), an Australian listed group headquartered in St Kilda, Victoria. Its brands were the ShareRoot platform for legally acquiring, organising and displaying UGC and brand-ambassador content (social walls, Facebook tabs, contests, experiential galleries and UGC on product pages), The Social Science, a marketing agency for Australia's life sciences and health technology sectors, and Ludomade, a digital-experience studio doing web design, mobile games, VR/AR and experiential activations. Shareholders approved a rename to Opyl Limited (ASX: OPL) at the December 2019 annual general meeting, and the group repositioned into artificial intelligence for clinical trials and digital health; ludomade.com now redirects to opyl.ai. ShareRoot never published a developer program, API documentation, machine-readable specification or client SDK, and shareroot.co is now a stale legacy site sitting behind a bot challenge. This profile captures the company identity, a live domain-security probe, a recorded-absence well-known probe, and the two first-party open-source npm utilities the ShareRoot engineering team published in 2016.

providers.name: Smava
providers.description: Smava (smava GmbH) is a Berlin-based German consumer-finance marketplace, founded in 2007, that lets borrowers compare personal, auto, and mortgage loan offers from more than 20 partner banks for amounts ranging from EUR 1,000 to EUR 120,000, without impacting their SCHUFA credit score. The company operates a digital, data-driven loan-brokerage platform serving consumers across Germany and employs roughly 600 people. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Earlybird. As of this enrichment pass Smava is a consumer (B2C) web and mobile-app business and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or well-known API discovery endpoints.

providers.name: Sofar Sounds
providers.description: Sofar Sounds curates secret, intimate live-music gigs in living rooms, small venues, and unexpected spaces in hundreds of cities around the world. The company connects independent and emerging artists with attentive local audiences through a mobile-first ticketing and events platform, and works with hosts who lend their spaces for the shows. Sofar operates a consumer-facing website and apps rather than a public developer program; probing its surface confirmed no documented public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI. It runs a real GitHub organization (github.com/sofarsounds) of internal engineering repositories, and its production backend is served from api.sofarsounds.com (Heroku), but neither exposes a published, documented API for third-party developers.

providers.name: SURGE Therapeutics
providers.description: SURGE Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, developing intraoperative cancer immunotherapy. Founded on research from Dr. Michael Goldberg's laboratory at Harvard Medical School, the company's SURGERx platform is an injectable, biodegradable hydrogel placed directly at the site of surgical tumor resection to provide extended, localized release of immunotherapy — addressing the surgery-induced inflammation that suppresses the immune system and allows residual disease to reawaken. Its lead program, SRG-514, completed Phase 1 dose escalation in breast cancer patients undergoing surgery and is being prepared for a registrational trial, with an additional IND cleared for a Phase 1/2a study in bladder cancer. SURGE has raised a $26M Series A and a $32M Series B. It is a therapeutics developer, not a software company, and publishes no developer program, API, or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Theranica
providers.description: Theranica Bio-Electronics is a digital therapeutics company developing prescription-grade wearable neuromodulation devices for prevalent neurological pain conditions. Its flagship product, Nerivio, is an FDA-authorized wireless Remote Electrical Neuromodulation (REM) device worn on the upper arm for the acute and preventive treatment of migraine, with or without aura, in patients ages 12 and up. Nerivio is controlled by a companion iOS and Android smartphone app that lets patients start treatments, adjust stimulation intensity, monitor session duration, and keep a shareable migraine diary. Theranica is a venture-backed medical device company; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Tidal Vision
providers.description: Tidal Vision Products, Inc. is a Bellingham, Washington biotechnology and specialty-chemicals manufacturer, and the only commercial-scale US producer of chitosan — a non-toxic, non-hazmat, biodegradable industrial biopolymer upcycled from crab and shrimp shell waste. Its zero-waste Chitofining process extracts, modifies and formulates chitosan chemistries that displace PFAS, halogenated chemicals, toxic antimicrobials and persistent plastics across three business lines: Tidal Clear water and wastewater treatment, Tidal Grow AgriScience crop and soil inputs, and Tidal-Tec Biomaterial Science performance materials. The company closed an oversubscribed $140M+ Series B in 2025 and acquired Clear Water Services. It is a materials-science manufacturer and publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Tripwire
providers.description: Tripwire Inc. (part of Fortra), headquartered in Portland, Oregon, is an enterprise cybersecurity company known for file integrity monitoring (FIM), security configuration management (SCM), and vulnerability management. Its product line includes Tripwire Enterprise, the Tripwire Axon Agent, Tripwire IP360, Tripwire ExpertOps, and the original Open Source Tripwire. Tripwire's capabilities are delivered as on-premises and managed products with product-embedded REST APIs and configuration-management integrations (Puppet, Chef, Ansible) rather than a public developer portal; there is no public developer portal, public OpenAPI, or first-party client SDK on the public package registries as of this enrichment pass. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and is being enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: TubeMogul
providers.description: TubeMogul was an independent video advertising software platform — a demand-side platform for planning, buying, measuring and optimizing programmatic brand video campaigns across desktop, mobile, connected TV and out-of-home. Founded 2006 in Emeryville, California, it IPO'd on NASDAQ in 2014 and was acquired by Adobe in 2016, then folded into Adobe Advertising Cloud. It ran an Ad Platform API at api.tubemogul.com for partner reporting and campaign management; that host is now dark and no independent developer surface remains.

providers.name: Tydo
providers.description: Tydo delivers autonomous audits for Shopify stores inside Claude. A single integration runs hundreds of audits - retention, shipping, email and SMS, and more - scoring a store against similar brands in its network, re-running on a cadence in the background, and routing every finding to a next step: fix it yourself, turn on an agent, or get matched to a vetted partner via dtcmvp. A Greylock portfolio company, currently waitlist-only with no public developer portal, API documentation, or published MCP endpoint.

providers.name: Upverter
providers.description: Upverter is a browser-based, collaborative electronic design automation (EDA) platform for schematic capture and PCB layout, founded in Toronto in 2010 (Y Combinator W11) and acquired by Altium in 2017. Surfaced as a Version One Ventures portfolio company. As of the July 2026 enrichment probe the upverter.com platform returns HTTP 502 on every path, its docs/blog/status subdomains no longer resolve, and no public API surface remains; the GitHub organization is dormant since 2019.

providers.name: ValCtrl
providers.description: ValCtrl is a Y Combinator-backed (Spring 2026 batch) startup building an intelligent prediction market platform, where users can input any public, resolvable belief about the future and the platform structures, prices, and enables trading on that claim. Its world model maps typed beliefs to relevant market signals, evaluates basis risk, and provides model-priced liquidity. Founded by Gaurav Paliwal and Sarth Garg in New York City, the company is pre-launch with a stealth landing page and no public API, documentation, or developer surface as of July 2026.

providers.name: View
providers.description: View, Inc. is a smart-glass and smart-building technology company founded in 2007 and headquartered in Milpitas, California, with manufacturing in Olive Branch, Mississippi. View makes View Dynamic Glass, electrochromic architectural windows whose tint adjusts automatically to sunlight, glare, and heat, alongside a connected Smart Building Platform in which each pane is individually IP-addressable and app-controllable and layered with sensors and services such as SmartProtect (an Azure IoT integration that alerts building managers when glass breaks). Backed by the SoftBank Vision Fund, View went public via SPAC in 2021 and filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2024, transitioning back to private ownership under its lenders. View exposes no public developer API surface; its GitHub organization (viewinc) mirrors third-party C/C++ and IoT firmware libraries used internally rather than first-party SDKs.

providers.name: Voltron Data
providers.description: Voltron Data is a Mountain View-based data infrastructure company (founded 2021) behind Theseus, a GPU-accelerated, composable distributed SQL query engine for petabyte-scale analytics and AI pipelines, distributed embedded through partners rather than as a self-serve public API. The company is a major steward of the open-source composable data stack — Apache Arrow, Ibis, Substrait, Arrow Flight SQL, and ADBC — acquired Claypot AI in January 2024, and is backed by Battery Ventures, GV, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Walden Catalyst, with an Accenture investment in 2025. As of 2026-07-21 the company website (voltrondata.com) is unreachable — the domain is registered but its DNS zone is lame-delegated — leaving the GitHub organization as the live public surface; no public API, SDK packages, or developer portal are published.

providers.name: Wawa
providers.description: Wawa is a privately held, family-owned convenience store and fuel retail chain headquartered in Pennsylvania. Founded in 1803 as a dairy farm and operating convenience stores since 1964, Wawa runs approximately 1,100 stores across Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, Maryland, Virginia, Florida, North Carolina, Indiana, and Alabama. The company is a regional fresh-food, beverage, and fuel brand with a strong loyalty program (Wawa Rewards) and a mobile ordering app. Wawa operates an internal API management platform (built with MuleSoft) used to connect to third-party services such as Uber Eats, Grubhub, and DoorDash for delivery, but does not publish a public developer portal or expose public APIs.

providers.name: Williams-Sonoma
providers.description: Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500 American publicly traded retail company specializing in kitchenware and home furnishings. It is one of the largest e-commerce retailers in the United States. The company operates multiple brands including Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, PBteen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark and Graham, and Green Row. Williams-Sonoma does not offer a public developer API. The company uses internal APIs and third-party platforms for e-commerce, registry services, and supply chain management.

providers.name: Wiz Freight
providers.description: Wiz Freight (Wiz Logtec Solutions Private Limited) was a Chennai, India based digital freight forwarder founded in 2020 by Ramkumar Ramachandran and Ramkumar Govindarajan, offering ocean, air and surface freight booking, instant rate discovery, live shipment tracking, digital documentation and multi-currency freight payments through its own technology platform. The company raised roughly $58.6M from Tiger Global Management, Nippon Express Holdings, SBI Investment, Stride Ventures, Foundamental and Axilor Ventures. Trade press reported in September 2025 that the company had suspended export bookings amid an executive exodus, and as of September 2026 its public surface is gone: wizfreight.com serves a GoDaddy Website Builder placeholder, the former booking portal path 404s, and the sit.wizfreight.net platform host no longer resolves. No developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract was ever published on a reachable host, and none survives today.

providers.name: 51Talk Koala (koalareading.com)
providers.description: koalareading.com serves 51Talk考拉外教官网, the marketing landing page for 51Talk's "Koala" online English foreign-teacher tutoring product aimed at Chinese K-12 learners. The site is a single-page property (hero banner plus footer) operated by 大生在线（深圳）文化传媒科技有限公司 of Shenzhen under ICP filing 粤ICP备2023085692号, with lizhen01@51talk.com published as the technical support contact. The profile entered the API Evangelist network as a Qiming Venture Partners portfolio lead under the name "koalareading" (考拉阅读 / Koala Reading, a Chinese K-12 reading-comprehension edtech); the domain as observed on 2026-07-19 serves the 51Talk Koala product instead, and the relationship between the two is not asserted here. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDK, CLI, or machine-readable discovery surface, so this profile carries only probed evidence.

providers.name: abbisko
providers.description: Abbisko Therapeutics (上海和誉生物医药科技有限公司) is a Shanghai-based clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery and development of innovative small-molecule therapeutics, primarily in oncology. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. Enrichment found no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or agent surface — this is a biopharmaceutical R&D company, not an API provider — so no API artifacts apply; only a live domain-security probe was captured.

providers.name: AbleTo
providers.description: AbleTo is a virtual behavioral health company delivering structured, evidence-based cognitive behavioral therapy and coaching programs for anxiety, depression, and stress, typically delivered through health insurance benefits. Founded in 2008 and acquired by Optum (UnitedHealth Group) in 2020, AbleTo now operates as part of Optum Behavioral Care; its www.ableto.com domain 301-redirects to optumbhcare.com. Originally backed by Bain Capital Ventures, the company is patient-facing and publishes no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or OpenAPI. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for portfolio and market tracking.

providers.name: Ace Vision Group
providers.description: Ace Vision Group, Inc. (AVG) is a Boston, Massachusetts based emerging medical laser device company founded in 2006 by vision scientist AnnMarie Hipsley, DPT, PhD. The company develops the VisioLite Er:YAG ophthalmic laser system and Laser Scleral Microporation (LSM), a non-contact therapeutic procedure intended to treat age-related eye dysfunction such as presbyopia by micro-porating the sclera to restore the eye's natural dynamic range of focus. The VisioLite system remains under development and has not been approved or cleared for commercial sale in the United States, European Union, United Kingdom or other jurisdictions. Ace Vision Group publishes a four-page corporate website and operates no developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable interface of any kind.

providers.name: aceabio
providers.description: ACEA Biosciences (aceabio) is a life-sciences company known for cell-analysis instrumentation that was acquired by Agilent Technologies; its aceabio.com.cn domain now redirects to an Agilent landing page (explore.agilent.com/ACEA-joins-Agilent). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of the Qiming venture firm and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. Enrichment found no independent developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, or public API surface for the standalone entity — the operating web presence has been folded into Agilent.

providers.name: aceatherapeutics
providers.description: ACEA Therapeutics (aceatherapeutics.com) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing innovative small-molecule and antibody-drug-conjugate treatments across oncology, autoimmune, and antiviral therapeutic areas, with product candidates including Olgotrelvir, Abivertinib, AC0058, STI-6129, and AC0939. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a pharmaceutical company oriented toward patients, physicians, and investors, ACEA Therapeutics publishes no public developer API, documentation, SDK, or technical integration surface at this time; this profile captures its verifiable web/domain footprint only.

providers.name: Achira
providers.description: Achira is a digital-biology company building molecular world models to transform drug discovery and the physical sciences. Founded by John Chodera, Theofanis Karaletsos, and Zavain Dar, it blends geometric deep learning, generative AI, physics, quantum chemistry, and statistical mechanics into foundation simulation models that enable out-of-distribution prediction at the atomistic scale — a "third path" between pure machine-learning approaches and traditional molecular dynamics simulation. Achira raised a $33M Series A from Dimension, Amplify Partners, NVIDIA NVentures, and Compound. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: acxel
providers.description: ACXEL is a digital cell biology company building advanced microfluidics platforms and productivity tools for life sciences research and drug development. Its self-developed AP-LOC (Active Pixel Lab-on-Chip) technology enables high-throughput, parallel, and precise microdroplet manipulation, alongside AM-EWOD and AM-DMF digital microfluidic platforms supporting cell sorting, cell therapy, antibody therapy, synthetic biology, and chemical synthesis with full-process chip integration and real-time feedback monitoring. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. ACXEL is a hardware and platform provider and publishes no public developer/API surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: AdaptHealth
providers.description: AdaptHealth is a national provider of home medical equipment, supplies, and related services in the United States. The company supports patients with sleep therapy, respiratory care, diabetes care, mobility, and other home medical needs through a network of locations and partnerships with healthcare providers and insurers. No public developer API or technical documentation portal is currently available.

providers.name: Adaptilens
providers.description: Adaptilens is a privately held, pre-clinical ophthalmic medical device company based in Chestnut Hill, Massachusetts, developing the Adaptilens A-IOL, described by the company as the first biomimetic accommodating intraocular lens. The soft, flexible lens is built around a patent-protected bottlebrush polymer intended to mimic the young natural crystalline lens, responding to the eye's own ciliary muscles and natural signal to focus so that cataract patients regain near, intermediate and distance vision without glasses. The company raised $1.6M in seed funding led by Pillar VC and a $17.5M Series A led by Perceptive Xontogeny Venture Funds with Pillar VC, 380 Cap and Accanto Partners. Its own site states the Adaptilens is in the development phase and is not yet approved for investigational or commercial use. Adaptilens is a device developer, not a software company, and publishes no developer program, no API documentation and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Adcentrx Therapeutics
providers.description: Adcentrx Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in San Diego, California, developing next-generation antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) and protein conjugate therapeutics for cancer and other life-threatening diseases. Its proprietary i-Conjugation technology platform pairs stable conjugation chemistry and protease-cleavable linkers with novel small-molecule payloads; the clinical pipeline includes ADRX-0706 (Nectin-4) and ADRX-0405 (STEAP1). The company was surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: secondary-market). It publishes a corporate and investor-relations website only — no developer program, API, SDK, or machine-readable specification of any kind was found.

providers.name: Advolve.AI
providers.description: Advolve.AI is an AI-driven performance-marketing and customer-acquisition platform for e-commerce brands and marketplaces, offering an end-to-end solution to automate, scale, and optimize paid media and digital advertising, including a patent-pending creative-optimization capability that tunes interactive ad elements (messaging, graphics, colors, fonts). Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Sao Paulo, Brazil, Advolve was backed by Prosus Ventures and Valor Capital and was acquired by iFood (Prosus group) in November 2025 to power iFood Ads across Latin America. Advolve publishes a marketing website only; as of enrichment it exposes no public developer program, API, SDKs, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Aillis
providers.description: Aillis, Inc. (アイリス株式会社) is a Tokyo-based medical technology company founded in 2017 that applies machine learning to the diagnosis of infectious disease. Its flagship product, nodoca, is an AI-equipped pharyngeal camera cleared in Japan as an AI-based new medical device for influenza screening: it photographs the posterior pharyngeal wall, detects influenza follicles in the image, and combines those findings with body temperature and reported symptoms to support a physician's diagnosis. nodoca is sold to clinics and hospitals as a finished end-user medical device; Aillis publishes no public developer portal, API reference, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind, and its corporate site is a marketing site built on the STUDIO no-code platform.

providers.name: aistarfish
providers.description: aistarfish (aistarfish.com) is the web home of Haixin Health (海心健康), a Chinese digital-health company operated by Zhejiang Haixin Zhihui Technology Co., Ltd. that provides full-course disease management and support services for cancer patients across their entire treatment journey. Its consumer-facing products are iOS and Android mobile apps built around a patient community, peer-support networks, patient and official medical diaries, and patient-to-doctor connections, under the mission of "helping cancer patients live longer and live better." The company holds an Internet Pharmaceutical Information Service qualification. It is surfaced here as a portfolio company of the Qiming venture network. As of this pass it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Aivick
providers.description: Aivick株式会社は、食とICTを融合し、個人の健康と豊かな暮らしを支える企業です。パーソナル栄養、ウェルネス支援、無添加食品の開発などを通じて、ITと食のテクノロジーで最適な食事提供を実現します。京都発の宅配食サービスやシステムインテグレーション事業を展開し、健康管理ソリューションを提供しています。

providers.name: Alassio
providers.description: Alassio is a French financial-technology company building a next-generation payroll software platform (logiciel de paie nouvelle generation) for businesses. Alassio positions itself as offering the functional depth expected of a specialist payroll and HR tool, with added transparency and control for finance and people teams. The company is backed by venture-capital firm Partech and operates from France, serving the French and European payroll, compensation, and human-resources market. As of this profile the company publishes only a marketing landing page and a legal notice; no public API, developer documentation, SDK, or integration surface has been located. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub awaiting a public developer surface to enrich.
