providers.name: Apixio (Centene)
providers.description: Apixio is a healthcare artificial intelligence company that applies machine learning and natural language processing to unstructured clinical and claims data for value-based care, risk adjustment, HCC coding, payment integrity, and healthcare analytics. Founded in 2009 and an early Bain Capital Ventures portfolio company, Apixio was acquired by Centene Corporation in 2020; its connected-care and coding products are delivered as enterprise B2B SaaS to health plans and providers. Apixio does not currently publish a public developer portal or open API; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Apollomics
providers.description: Apollomics, Inc. (Nasdaq: APLM) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Foster City, California, focused on the discovery and development of oncology therapies designed to be combined with other treatments to harness the immune system and target specific molecular pathways that inhibit cancer. Operating since 2016, Apollomics has a pipeline of nine drug candidates spanning small-molecule targeted drugs and biologics, including late-stage programs such as vebreltinib (Phase 2, NSCLC and solid tumors with cMet dysregulation) and uproleselan (Phase 3 in China for relapsed/refractory AML). The company became publicly traded via a business combination with Maxpro Capital Acquisition Corp. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network; as a biopharmaceutical company it publishes no public developer API surface — this profile carries its corporate identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: APP Group  Ness Czechia
providers.description: APP Group (renamed Ness Czechia after its acquisition by Ness Digital Engineering) is an enterprise IT services and systems-integration company headquartered in Prague, Czech Republic, with offices in Brno and Ostrava. Operating today as Ness Czech s.r.o., it is one of the most significant SAP providers (SAP Gold Partner) in the Czech Republic and the wider CEE region, delivering system integration, ERP and SAP S/4HANA implementation, business intelligence, data analytics, eGovernment / eHealth registers, core banking, pricing and billing, CRM and portals, IoT, and digital-platform engineering to large enterprises and the public sector. It is not a public API provider: it does not publish a developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, or a self-serve API program. This profile was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio company and is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company identity record.

providers.name: Aravax
providers.description: Aravax is a biotechnology company focused on developing next‑generation immunotherapies for food allergies. It aims to revolutionise treatment by using proprietary peptide platforms to retrain the immune system, offering safer and more convenient solutions. The company runs international clinical trials for its lead product PVX108 targeting peanut allergy, with sites in the United States and Australia. Aravax is headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, and also operates in the UK.

providers.name: Aria Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Aria Pharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company that applies artificial intelligence and machine learning to drug discovery, using a computational platform to identify and advance small-molecule therapeutic candidates for complex, inflammatory, and immunological diseases. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Aria operates as a therapeutics developer rather than a software or API provider. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company profile; an enrichment pass found no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or other programmatic developer surface for the company at this time.

providers.name: Arrail Group
providers.description: Arrail Group (瑞尔集团) is one of the largest privately owned dental service providers in China, operating premium Arrail Dental clinics and the Rytime Dental (瑞泰口腔) network across major Chinese cities. The company delivers general dentistry, orthodontics, implants, and pediatric dental care through directly operated clinics and hospitals. It is listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and counts Qiming Venture Partners among its investors. Arrail Group was added to the API Evangelist network as a Qiming portfolio company; it is a consumer healthcare provider and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Ascend3dbe
providers.description: Ascend3d Software specializes in development and licensing of software technology to improve plant floor operations and communications. This includes factory automation based on Windows PC development solutions offering a unique approach to integration and bridging the capabilities of today’s cutting edge robotics with tomorrow’s lean manufacturing practices. The company provides robotic machine vision, metrology, and integration services for manufacturers worldwide.

providers.name: Aspire Health *
providers.description: Aspire Health was a community-based palliative care provider surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) and added to the API Evangelist network as a life-sciences stub. The company delivered home- and clinic-based palliative and serious-illness care and was acquired by Anthem (now Elevance Health) in 2018; its aspirehealthcare.com domain today redirects into the Carelon Health / CareMore Health palliative-care service line. Aspire Health is a healthcare services organization, not a technology or API provider: enrichment found no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or /.well-known/ discovery surface. This profile is retained as a network lead with only the identity and domain-security posture that could be verified from public probes.

providers.name: Astonsci
providers.description: Aston Sci. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing innovative medicines to meet unmet medical needs. The company presents its pipeline, science focus areas, and corporate information through its website.

providers.name: atantares
providers.description: Atantares (芯宿科技) is a Chinese synthetic-biology company based in Suzhou Industrial Park that builds "silicon-based biology" — semiconductor-driven biotechnology. Its chip-based, high-throughput platform (the EcoSyn synthesizer and ECHOS MicroArray, using electrochemical oligonucleotide synthesis on CMOS/MEMS microelectrode arrays) drives low-cost, high-fidelity DNA synthesis and is expanding into RNA and protein synthesis and detection. Research-service offerings include primer/oligo synthesis, gene synthesis, gene sequencing, cloning and mutagenesis, strain-library preparation, and gene editing, built on an in-house full-workflow automation, sequence-analysis, and order-management platform. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners. The company operates a marketing website only and publishes no public developer program, API, or documentation at the time of this profile.

providers.name: Athletigen
providers.description: Athletigen is a health‑focused biotechnology company that provides personalized genetic and biomarker insights to help individuals optimize nutrition, fitness, and wellness. Their platform leverages DNA testing and advanced analytics to deliver actionable recommendations for diet, exercise, and lifestyle. The company aims to empower users with data‑driven guidance for better health outcomes.

providers.name: Augtera Networks
providers.description: Augtera Networks is an AI-native networking (Network AIOps) company founded in 2016 and based in Palo Alto, California. Its Network AI platform ingests telemetry from network devices, applies machine-learning anomaly detection (including gray failures), eliminates noise, performs incident root-cause identification, noiseless ticket creation, and auto-mitigation/remediation for data-center and enterprise networks. The platform exposed a Topology REST API for device discovery/lifecycle and DevOps/ITSM integration. Augtera was acquired by NVIDIA in December 2024 and folded into the NVIDIA Spectrum-X networking portfolio; its standalone augtera.com site now 301-redirects to nvidia.com, so no independent public developer/API surface remains. Added to the API Evangelist network as a bain-capital-ventures portfolio lead.

providers.name: Autolus
providers.description: Autolus is a life-sciences (biopharmaceutical) company operating in the cell-therapy space, developing programmed / engineered T cell (CAR-T) therapies for cancer and other serious diseases. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As a clinical/commercial-stage biopharma, its public web presence (autolus.com) is a corporate marketing and investor-relations site rather than a developer platform: no public API, developer portal, API documentation, or OpenAPI surface was found during enrichment. The only machine-discoverable artifact is a minimal RFC 9116 security.txt.

providers.name: avimedical
providers.description: Avi Medical is a technology-enabled primary care provider headquartered in Munich, Germany, operating a network of modern general-practice (Hausarzt) medical practices paired with a patient-facing mobile app for booking appointments, video consultations, prescriptions, and digital access to medical records. The company combines physical clinics with digital health tooling to modernize German primary care, and is backed by Balderton Capital among other investors. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company; no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal has been found on its public surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Axcelius I/II
providers.description: Axcelius I/II is a biopharmaceutical company-creation vehicle backed by Canaan Partners, formed to found and incubate drug-development companies pursuing treatments for cancer, rare diseases, and neurodegenerative disorders. It is led by managing partner Dennis Podlesak and sponsored at Canaan by general partner Brent Ahrens, and operates from San Francisco, California, with an associated holding entity registered in Connecticut at Canaan's Westport office. Rather than operating as a product company, Axcelius assembles management teams and capital around licensed therapeutic assets and spins them out as standalone biopharma companies; Transposon Therapeutics, developing therapies for ALS and Alzheimer's disease, is its best-documented creation. As of this enrichment pass the vehicle remains in stealth mode with no public developer surface -- no product website beyond a holding page, no documentation, developer portal, SDKs, GitHub organization, or API of any kind.

providers.name: Axionorbital Space
providers.description: AxionOrbital Space is a San Francisco Bay Area startup (Y Combinator Winter 2026) building foundation models for continuous Earth observation through clouds and darkness. Its flagship model, ORION, converts Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data into high-resolution, photorealistic optical imagery in real time using deterministic one-step diffusion, overcoming the limitation that traditional optical satellites are unusable roughly 70% of the time due to weather and night cycles. The technology targets 24/7 situational awareness for defense and intelligence, commodities and financial analytics, disaster response, agriculture, and climate monitoring. Founded in 2025 by Dhenenjay Yadav (CEO, former ISRO ML engineer) and Atharva Peshkar (CTO, PhD, CU Boulder / Harvard VCG). At the time of profiling the company is pre-product with no public API, developer portal, or specifications published; this record captures its identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Azureflying
providers.description: Azureflying (蔚复来) is a Zhejiang‑based technology company that leverages AI and digital solutions for green waste recycling, smart city infrastructure, and sustainable resource management. It offers AI‑enabled waste classification hardware, end‑to‑end waste processing services, and digital platforms that enable traceability, data analytics, and carbon‑neutral operations for municipalities and enterprises. The firm reports over 200 patents, operates across 200 cities, and focuses on turning waste into valuable resources through AI‑driven processes.

providers.name: Bangyaobiological
providers.description: Bangyaobiological, also known as Zhejiang Bangyao Biomaterials Co., Ltd, is a high‑tech enterprise integrating R&D, production, and sales of biomedical polymer materials and medical devices. The company focuses on absorbable medical polymers, offering intelligent excipient solutions for new drugs worldwide. It emphasizes innovation, safety, and green manufacturing, aiming to become a global supplier of smart excipients.

providers.name: bayomics
providers.description: Bayomics (贝普奥生物) is a Shenzhen-based biotechnology company specializing in spatial proteomics and trace (micro) proteomics solutions for pharmaceutical research and drug development. Its product lines include the SISPROT protein sample-preparation kits built on proprietary Spintip centrifuge-pipette technology that process nanogram-level samples in roughly two hours, VistaProX spatial visualization proteomics combining immunofluorescence staining with high-depth mass-spectrometry detection on a single slice, and high-throughput automation systems capable of processing up to 400 proteomics samples per day. Bayomics operates as a B2B reagent supplier and research-services provider and does not currently publish any public developer API, SDKs, or programmatic developer resources. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: BehavioSec
providers.description: BehavioSec is a behavioral biometrics and behavioral intelligence platform that continuously authenticates users and detects fraud by analyzing how people interact with digital environments — mouse movements, typing rhythm and cadence, touch gestures, and device handling — producing real-time, explainable risk scores. Originally a Swedish company spun out of research at Luleå University of Technology, BehavioSec was acquired by LexisNexis Risk Solutions in 2022 and is now delivered as part of the LexisNexis Dynamic Decision Platform, integrating with ThreatMetrix for combined device and behavioral intelligence. It detects account takeover, bots, remote access tool (RAT) fraud, and social-engineering scams across financial services, ecommerce, gaming, telecommunications, and travel. Access is via an enterprise API; there is no public developer portal.

providers.name: Bellabeat
providers.description: Bellabeat is a femtech and women's wellness technology company founded in 2014 by Urska Srsen and Sandro Mur, headquartered in San Francisco, California. It designs health-tracking wearables and connected devices aimed at women, including the Leaf and Ivy wellness jewelry trackers, the Time hybrid smartwatch, and the Spring smart water bottle, paired with the Bellabeat mobile app that tracks activity, sleep, stress, meditation, menstrual cycle, and overall wellness. Bellabeat operates as a direct-to-consumer wellness brand; it does not currently publish a public developer API, so this profile captures company identity and network provenance rather than API artifacts. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Y Combinator portfolio lead and enriched here.

providers.name: besunyen
providers.description: Besunyen is a Chinese consumer-health company known for herbal weight-management, functional and detox teas plus related wellness and nutrition products, surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. Enrichment on 2026-07-18 found no public developer, API, or documentation surface — besunyen.com serves only an nginx 404 and its TLS certificate is issued for besunyen.co (hostname mismatch); the only real artifact captured is a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Bionaut Labs
providers.description: Bionaut Labs is a clinical-stage medical robotics company headquartered in Los Angeles, California, developing "Bionauts" — remote-controlled, magnetically steered microscale robots roughly the size of a grain of rice that travel through tissue to deliver drugs, biologics and nucleic acids directly to targets deep in the brain and central nervous system. Founded in 2016 by CEO Michael Shpigelmacher, the company is pursuing treatments for malignant glioma, Dandy-Walker syndrome, Parkinson's disease and Huntington's disease, and has raised more than $80 million from investors including Khosla Ventures. Its product is a therapeutic device and navigation platform regulated as a medical device, not software sold to developers: Bionaut Labs operates no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: BioOrbit
providers.description: BioOrbit is a London-based in-space manufacturing company, founded in 2023, that uses microgravity to crystallise protein-based biologic drugs at scale. Its autonomous BOX hardware — a compact, microwave-sized manufacturing unit designed to operate in low-Earth orbit — grows highly ordered crystalline forms of therapeutic proteins that reduce viscosity, enabling treatments normally given intravenously (including cancer therapies) to be reformulated as subcutaneous, self-injectable products. Co-founded by Dr Katie King and Dr Leonor Teles, BioOrbit raised the world's largest seed round for in-space manufacturing (~£9.8M / $13.2M) co-led by LocalGlobe and Breega with Seedcamp, Auxxo, Type One, 7percent and angels, and is supported by the UK Space Agency, ESA BIC and ESA BSGN. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a Seedcamp portfolio company; it publishes no public API or developer surface.

providers.name: Bioyond Robotics
providers.description: Bioyond Robotics (奔曜科技) is a life-sciences intelligent-automation company founded in 2021 and headquartered in Shanghai's Zhangjiang Science City. It combines robotics, machine vision, and artificial intelligence to build autonomous laboratory solutions for scientific research, drug discovery, applied chemistry, synthetic biology, multiomics, and clinical diagnostics. Its product line spans the LabGenius robot platform (liquid-handling and transport robots), the LabMate automation platform (material/liquid handling, stackers, and intelligent scheduling), the LabMind laboratory software platform for integrating external instruments and modules, and the BIOYOND AutoSeq genetic-analysis system. Bioyond is backed by Qiming Venture Partners. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal — this record captures its identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Blacklaketechnologies
providers.description: Black Lake Technologies provides an Industrial AI platform delivering AI agents that automate and optimize manufacturing operations. Their solutions cover order processing, scheduling, and fulfillment, leveraging data-driven decision-making across factories. Serving over 40,000 factories and 2 million users, the platform claims 95% decision accuracy and supports 30+ industries, aiming to transform traditional production into agile, AI‑enabled processes.

providers.name: BlackThorn Therapeutics *
providers.description: BlackThorn Therapeutics was a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2015 and headquartered in South San Francisco, focused on discovering and developing targeted therapeutics for brain diseases and central nervous system (CNS) disorders such as major depressive disorder and schizophrenia, using a precision-medicine platform. It was backed by gv (Google Ventures) and later combined into Neumora Therapeutics, whose corporate site now resolves at neumoratx.com. This is a life-sciences company profile: it operates no public developer API, SDK, or agent surface, so API-oriented artifacts are not applicable beyond a domain-security probe of the corporate host.

providers.name: Blue Cloud Pediatric Surgery Centers
providers.description: Blue Cloud Pediatric Surgery Centers operates accredited ambulatory surgery centers specializing in pediatric and special-needs dental and oral surgery care delivered under general anesthesia. Positioning itself as the largest pediatric surgery center company in the United States, Blue Cloud partners with dentists and payors across multiple U.S. locations with a mission to expand access to care, exemplify safety and quality, and reduce costs to patients and payors. Headquartered in The Woodlands, Texas, the company is a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. Blue Cloud is a healthcare services provider and does not publish any public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile is maintained for network identity and demand-side coverage.

providers.description: Brawl Stars Game Information

providers.name: Breathe Well-being
providers.description: Breathe Well-being is an India-based digital therapeutics and chronic-care company focused on Type 2 diabetes reversal and management. Through a mobile app (Android/iOS) it pairs continuous health coaching, personalized nutrition and lifestyle plans, medical supervision, and progress tracking to help members reduce blood sugar, lose weight, and lower medication dependence. Founded by Aditya Kaicker and Rohan Verma, the company is backed by Accel and Y Combinator (Series A, 2021). It operates as a direct-to-consumer health program rather than an API provider: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface (paths return the SPA lander fallback). This profile captures the company identity and its probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Brosmed
providers.description: BrosMed Medical (Guangdong Brosmed Medical Technology Co., Ltd.) is a medical device manufacturer founded in 2012 and headquartered in Dongguan, Guangdong, China, specializing in the research, manufacturing, and global sale of high-performance vascular intervention medical devices. Its product families span cardiovascular intervention, peripheral vascular intervention, hemodialysis access, neurointervention, and intervention accessories. The company employs over 1,000 staff, holds 650+ product registrations, and sells across 100+ countries. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and added to the API Evangelist network; as a physical medical-device manufacturer it publishes no public developer/API surface.

providers.name: Cabinet Health
providers.description: Cabinet Health is an end-to-end supply chain platform for private-label over-the-counter (OTC) medicines. The company develops, sources, manufactures, and delivers OTC products across 70+ active ingredients in tablet, softgel, capsule, liquid, powder, gummy, and chewable formats to retailers, wholesalers, and online marketplaces, emphasizing sustainable, refillable packaging and quality assurance at scale. Cabinet also produces its own certified B Corp consumer brand sold on Amazon and Target. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; no public developer or API surface has been found for this provider.

providers.name: Cabot Oil & Gas
providers.description: Cabot Oil & Gas was an independent oil and gas company engaged in the development, exploitation, exploration, production, and marketing of natural gas and oil properties in the United States. In 2021 it merged with Cimarex Energy to form Coterra Energy, which operates across the Permian Basin, Marcellus Shale, and Anadarko Basin.

providers.name: Cage Bio
providers.description: Cage Bio Inc. is a clinical‑stage biotechnology company developing localized therapies for dermatology, inflammation, and immunology using its proprietary deep eutectic ionic liquid platform. The company aims to provide high‑efficacy, skin‑targeted treatments that reduce systemic exposure while maintaining therapeutic potency.

providers.name: Cano Health
providers.description: Cano Health is a primary care provider focused on delivering value-based care to seniors and underserved communities, primarily through Medicare Advantage. The company operates medical centers offering primary care, wellness, pediatrics, and other services with an emphasis on preventive care and chronic disease management. No public developer API or technical documentation portal is currently available.

providers.name: Canto Reality
providers.description: Canto Reality, Inc. is an early-stage exploratory deployment lab building social experiences, categorized under AI infrastructure. Founded in 2023 in Palo Alto, California by Shuby Deshpande (engineer and researcher) and Aryan Deshpande (engineer), the roughly seven-person company was part of the inaugural Cohort 001 of Andreessen Horowitz's (a16z) Speedrun accelerator program. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes only a marketing landing page (cantoreality.com) with a contact address; it exposes no public developer platform, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, or code repositories, and its GitHub organization has no public repos. This profile is maintained as an a16z portfolio lead in the API Evangelist network and will be upgraded when a public developer or API surface appears.

providers.name: Caraway Health *
providers.description: Caraway Health is a digital health company that provides virtual mental and physical healthcare designed for college and university students, delivered through a mobile app with support offered around the clock. The company partners with higher-education institutions and is backed by GV (Google Ventures). It operates as a direct-to-consumer / campus telehealth provider rather than an API platform; at the time of this enrichment pass no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable specification was found on its public web surface. Sector: life-sciences / digital health.

providers.name: Cardiogram
providers.description: Cardiogram is a digital-health company whose consumer app analyzes heart-rate and activity data from wearables such as the Apple Watch, Wear OS, Garmin, and Fitbit to help people understand their cardiovascular health. Its DeepHeart deep-neural-network technology was developed to screen heart-rate patterns for signs of conditions including atrial fibrillation, sleep apnea, diabetes, and hypertension, work studied in collaboration with academic health researchers. The company is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead; as of this pass Cardiogram exposes no public developer or API surface and its primary website (cardiogram.com) does not complete an HTTPS/TLS handshake.

providers.name: Cardiologs
providers.description: Cardiologs is a cloud-based ECG analysis platform that uses clinically validated artificial intelligence to streamline cardiac diagnostics, helping clinicians and healthcare providers reduce the burden of manual ECG interpretation while improving diagnostic scalability and accessibility. Founded in Paris in 2014, Cardiologs was acquired by Philips in 2021 and is now offered as part of Philips ambulatory monitoring and diagnostics (ECG monitoring) portfolio. The company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its primary domain redirects to the Philips healthcare product page.

providers.name: Carevision
providers.description: Carevision Inc. is an AI-powered digital health company whose platform turns any camera into a 60-second contactless cardiometabolic wellness scanner. Using remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) and deep learning models trained on 12M+ patient records, it extracts 30+ physiological parameters — including heart rate, blood pressure indicators, stress index, respiratory rate, and oxygen saturation — and produces a comprehensive digital health persona covering 15+ cardiometabolic conditions. Carevision operates under the FDA General Wellness Policy (it is not a medical device or diagnostic tool) and is delivered as a kiosk, an embedded/white-label SDK for iOS and Android, or a web integration to hospitals and clinics, health insurers, pharmacy chains, diagnostic laboratories, wellness apps, and teleconsultation platforms, integrating with EMR/HIS systems.

providers.name: Cassidy
providers.description: Cassidy AI provides a platform for building AI‑powered agents, workflows, and knowledge bases that automate complex business tasks. The service offers a suite of tools including Copilot, document handling, skill extensions, and industry‑specific solutions for insurance, manufacturing, employee benefits, and professional services. Users can create custom agents, integrate with existing systems, and leverage a flexible pricing model for enterprises and developers.

providers.name: Celltype
providers.description: CellType is an AI-driven drug discovery company building what it calls "The Biological World Model" — foundation models and autonomous agents that simulate human biology to predict drug responses in human systems before clinical trials, reducing reliance on traditional preclinical models such as mice and cell lines. Its core technology, Cell2Sentence (C2S), teaches large language models to understand cellular biology by converting single-cell gene expression data into a text-like format that models can interpret, and the company reports using it to discover and validate a novel cancer treatment signal targeting tumor immunogenicity. A Y Combinator (Winter 2026) company based in New York City, CellType works with large pharmaceutical partners and currently operates as a B2B research and drug-discovery platform rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Centreherbs (Beijing Shengtaier Biotechnology)
providers.description: Centreherbs is the brand of Beijing Shengtaier Biotechnology Co., Ltd., a veterinary pharmaceutical company founded in 1999 and headquartered in the Daxing Biopharmaceutical Industrial Park, Beijing, China. An integrated research, development, production, and distribution organization for animal health, it specializes in veterinary traditional Chinese medicine preparations, animal vaccines for poultry and livestock, plant-based premixed feed additives, and pet health products, backed by four wholly-owned subsidiaries and an internal biotech research institute. It is a healthcare portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. The company operates a corporate marketing website and publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Chevron
providers.description: Chevron Corporation is one of the world's largest integrated energy companies, with operations across upstream exploration and production, downstream refining and marketing, and the production and transportation of crude oil, natural gas, refined fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and renewable fuels. Chevron is headquartered in Houston, Texas, and operates globally under brands including Chevron, Texaco, and Caltex. Chevron does not currently publish a public consumer-facing developer API; supplier and partner integrations are handled through the Chevron Invoice and Payment Status (CIPS) system and the Supplier Relations channels, and investors and stakeholders are served through corporate, sustainability, and IR websites.

providers.name: Chimerix
providers.description: Chimerix, Inc. was a biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Durham, North Carolina, focused on developing medicines for serious and life-threatening diseases. It is best known for brincidofovir (TEMBEXA), an antiviral approved by the U.S. FDA in 2021 as a smallpox medical countermeasure, and for dordaviprone (ONC201), an investigational small-molecule therapy for H3 K27M-mutant diffuse glioma, a form of brain cancer. Chimerix was a publicly traded company (NASDAQ: CMRX) and was acquired by Jazz Pharmaceuticals in 2025, primarily for dordaviprone; the chimerix.com domain now redirects to jazzpharma.com. As a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company, Chimerix does not operate a public developer program or API surface — this profile tracks it as a company entity within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Circle Health Group
providers.description: Circle Health Group is the largest independent operator of private hospitals in the United Kingdom, running a nationwide network of hospitals and clinics that provide diagnostics, surgery, physiotherapy, and consultant-led private medical care to self-pay patients, insured patients, and the NHS. Originally backed by Balderton Capital as Circle Holdings, the group offers services spanning orthopaedics, cardiology, gynaecology, general surgery, and imaging. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; the organization operates a consumer-facing patient website and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal surface.

providers.name: Clausematch
providers.description: Clausematch is a London-founded regulatory technology (RegTech) company providing a cloud platform for policy and procedure management, regulatory change management, and structured document authoring and collaboration for banks, insurers, and other regulated financial institutions. Its tooling helps compliance teams draft, review, version, and attest to policies while mapping regulatory obligations to internal controls. Clausematch was acquired by Corlytics in 2024; the clausematch.com domain now 301-redirects to corlytics.com. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. No public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API specification was found during enrichment (the web surface is WAF-protected and returns HTTP 403 to automated probes).

providers.name: ClearCare
providers.description: ClearCare (originally ClearCare Online) is a web-based home care agency management platform founded in 2011 and headquartered in San Francisco. It provides non-medical home care agencies with back-office and point-of-care tooling: caregiver scheduling, telephony-based clock-in/clock-out and electronic visit verification (EVV), billing and payroll, client and caregiver management, care planning, a family room portal, and business analytics. ClearCare was backed by Battery Ventures and Cendana Capital and was acquired by WellSky (formerly Mediware) in 2019; the product is now marketed as WellSky Personal Care, and the clearcareonline.com domain redirects to WellSky. This profile was surfaced as a Battery Ventures portfolio company and enriched as a historical company record — ClearCare no longer operates a standalone public developer or API program.

providers.name: Clerio Vision
providers.description: Clerio Vision is a development-stage ophthalmic medical device company based in Rochester, New York, commercializing LIRIC (Laser Induced Refractive Index Change) — a non-invasive femtosecond-laser platform, licensed from the University of Rochester's Center for Visual Science, that alters the refractive index of corneal tissue and of polymer optics without cutting or removing material. The company applies LIRIC across four ophthalmic segments: multifocal soft contact lenses for presbyopia, myopia control in children, post-implant intraocular lens (IOL) optimization after cataract surgery, and incisionless corneal refractive correction. Clerio has raised roughly $40 million from Safar Partners, Armory Square Ventures, Topmark Partners, Proxima Ventures, Atma Capital, Hegemon Capital and the National Science Foundation, and holds more than 90 patents across over 30 families. Its products are lasers, optics and lenses rather than software; the company publishes a single-page marketing and investor website and operates no public developer program, API, SDK or developer portal.

providers.name: cmlabs
providers.description: CMLabs (千麦医疗 / Qianmai Medical) is an independent third-party clinical laboratory group headquartered in China. It operates a network of medical testing laboratories that provide clinical laboratory diagnostics, pathology diagnosis, routine and specialty blood testing, clinical trial and research testing, and laboratory information system (LIS) services to hospitals, clinics, and other medical institutions. The company is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. It does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Collegevine
providers.description: CollegeVine is a Cambridge, Massachusetts company, backed by Menlo Ventures, that has repositioned itself as "the AI operating system for universities." Its platform pairs automated ingestion of data from campus systems (a Data layer) with a unified Ontology of institutional operations and an AI Operations layer of agents, applications, and ML models that connect directly to a university's CRM and admissions workflows. CollegeVine also operates a large consumer-facing college-admissions guidance property (chancing engine, essay guidance, and an AI counselor) at collegevine.com and blog.collegevine.com. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, developer portal, or published SDK for its product; engagement is enterprise sales and demo driven. It does maintain an active public GitHub organization of open-source PureScript, Haskell, and TypeScript libraries.

providers.name: Comanche Biopharma
providers.description: Comanche Biopharma is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in Concord, Massachusetts, developing investigational siRNA (small interfering RNA) medicines for maternal health. Its lead candidate, CBP-4888, is a subcutaneously administered siRNA therapy targeting sFlt1-mediated preterm preeclampsia, a leading and potentially life-threatening complication of pregnancy. The company's mission is to develop and make globally available the first therapy targeting a root cause of preeclampsia. In April 2025, CBP-4888 received Orphan Drug Designation from the European Medicines Agency. Comanche Biopharma is a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures). As a therapeutics company it publishes a corporate and scientific web presence rather than a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Connexus
providers.description: Connexus, Inc. is a non‑profit licensed supported living agency based in Tennessee. It provides community‑based and family‑based services for children and adults with physical, mental, and developmental disabilities, including residential care, personal assistance, supported employment, and vocational rehabilitation. The organization focuses on nurturing, teaching, and strengthening individuals and families with respect and professionalism, aiming to help them reach their full potential.

providers.name: CopilotIQ
providers.description: CopilotIQ is a Nashville, Tennessee remote patient monitoring and telehealth company, founded in 2021, that delivers AI-driven chronic-condition management to seniors and Medicare members living with type 2 diabetes and hypertension. Through connected in-home devices, predictive analytics, and clinical automation it captures daily biometric readings and pairs them with weekly nurse coaching to catch anomalies early, reduce hospitalizations, and lower costs for health plans and providers. In October 2024 CopilotIQ merged with in-home care company Biofourmis. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and the SoftBank Vision Fund. CopilotIQ operates as a clinical care service and does not publish a public developer API or documentation surface.

providers.name: Cordis
providers.description: Cordis is a global medical device company specializing in interventional cardiology solutions. It offers a wide range of products such as drug‑eluting balloons, guidewires, sheaths, and stents for vascular procedures. The company’s website provides detailed product information, regulatory approvals, and corporate news, confirming its identity as a leading provider in the cardiovascular market.

providers.name: Corsair Pharma
providers.description: Corsair Pharma, Inc. is a privately held clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing proprietary prodrugs of treprostinil for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). Its lead program, the TRX-248 transdermal system, is an investigational once-daily patch that delivers an inactive treprostinil prodrug across the skin for conversion to active drug in the liver, aiming to combine the efficacy and titration profile of parenteral prostacyclin therapy with non-invasive once-daily dosing. The company completed its preclinical program, announced positive Phase 1 results for TRX-248 in June 2026, closed a $23M Series B led by New Rhein Healthcare Investors, and has entered a strategic collaboration with United Therapeutics to advance novel treprostinil prodrugs. Corsair Pharma is a drug developer, not a software vendor: its public web presence is a five-page marketing and investor-news site with no developer program, API, SDK, or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: CSR Biotech
providers.description: CSR Biotech (超视计 / Chaoshiji) is a Chinese life-sciences instrumentation company that develops super-resolution optical microscopy systems for advanced biological research. Its product line includes the HIS-SIM and MI-SIM structured-illumination microscopes and the SIM-Ultimate platform, delivering live-cell imaging down to roughly 60nm resolution across many imaging modes. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. As a scientific-instruments maker, CSR Biotech publishes no public developer portal, documentation, or API surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: CUNA Mutual Group (TruStage)
providers.description: CUNA Mutual Group, now operating as TruStage, is an insurance and financial services company that provides insurance, retirement, and investment products to credit unions and their members. Founded in 1935 to serve the credit union movement, the company rebranded to TruStage in 2023, unifying its consumer-facing brands under a single identity. TruStage offers life insurance, auto and home insurance, AD&D, retirement planning, annuities, lending solutions, compliance services, and analytics tools to credit unions and their members.

providers.name: Curtiss-Wright
providers.description: Curtiss-Wright is a global integrated business that provides highly engineered products, solutions, and services mainly to the aerospace, defense, commercial power, process, and general industrial markets. Its product portfolio spans rugged embedded computing, mission-critical avionics, electronic packaging, naval propulsion, reactor coolant pumps for nuclear power, surface treatment services, industrial valves, sensors, data acquisition systems, telemetry ground stations, emergency arresting systems for military aircraft, and electronic systems for naval shipbuilding programs. The company traces its lineage to the aviation pioneers Glenn Curtiss and the Wright brothers and today operates across the Defense Electronics, Naval & Power, and Aerospace & Industrial segments.

providers.name: Cuspai
providers.description: CuspAI is a Cambridge, UK artificial intelligence company, founded in 2024, building generative AI for materials discovery. Its platform lets users specify desired physical and chemical properties — such as selective CO2 binding — and then generates, evaluates, and optimizes candidate molecular and material structures for applications spanning carbon capture, energy storage, catalysis, water purification, electric vehicles, and healthcare. CuspAI has raised roughly $130M (a $30M seed and a $100M Series A in September 2025) from investors including Northzone and Prosus Ventures, and maintains open-source scientific computing tooling on GitHub. As of mid-2026 the company operates a placeholder marketing site with no public API, developer portal, or SDK surface.

providers.name: D2G Oncology
providers.description: D2G Oncology is a precision-oncology company based in Mountain View, California, reported to have been founded in 2018 by Ian Winters. Public company descriptions characterize its work as applying quantitative and multiplexed functional cancer genomics to relate drugs to genotypes in order to advance precision cancer therapeutics. The company operates INSITE, a login-gated internal research portal at www.d2g-insite.com supporting preclinical study management and result exploration. D2G Oncology publishes no public developer API program, no developer portal, no API documentation, and no client SDKs, and third-party company trackers list the company as inactive as of 2026. It was surfaced through the Lightspeed Venture Partners portfolio and is retained here as an identity-only profile.

providers.name: Data Driven Bioscience
providers.description: Data Driven Bioscience (now operating as Duoseq, a ddb.bio service) is a cancer genomics testing company that performs comprehensive molecular profiling of both DNA and RNA from a single sample in an on-site workflow, delivering results from sample to report in roughly two days. Its platform detects mutations, expression levels, gene fusions, and clonotype information, and integrates directly with Epic and other leading EHR systems so results flow into the patient chart. The company is a portfolio company of initialized-capital and was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment; as of this pass it publishes a marketing/clinical website but no public developer or API surface.

This profile is retained as a network lead and carries only infrastructure-level (domain security) probe data.

providers.name: Deep 6 AI
providers.description: Deep 6 AI was a clinical-trial acceleration company that used artificial intelligence and natural language processing to mine structured and unstructured clinical data in electronic health records, matching eligible patients to clinical trials in minutes rather than months. The Techstars-backed precision-research platform was acquired by Tempus AI in early 2024, after which its standalone deep6.ai web presence was retired (the domain no longer serves a site, though its email/DNS records remain active). No public developer program, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or package registry entries could be found for Deep 6 AI during enrichment.

providers.name: Defense Finance and Accounting Service
providers.description: The Defense Finance and Accounting Service (DFAS) is the agency within the Department of Defense responsible for paying members of the U.S. military, DoD civilian employees, contractors, and annuitants, as well as providing finance and accounting services to DoD components and other federal agencies. DFAS exposes member-facing self-service portals such as myPay but does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: dezhentech
providers.description: Dezhen Technology (德臻) is a Shanghai-based healthcare information technology company providing informatization solutions for public hospitals and medical institutions across China. Its portfolio spans hospital operations management centers, integrated electronic medical record (EMR) systems, information integration platforms, hospital data centers and big-data analytics, refined operations management dashboards, EMR interoperability testing, and domestic (localized) technology transformation of core hospital systems. Dezhen is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. As of this profile the company publishes a corporate marketing site but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specifications.

providers.name: digitalsurgery
providers.description: Digital Surgery (originally Touch Surgery / Kinosis) is a London-based surgical artificial intelligence company backed by Balderton Capital and acquired by Medtronic in 2020, where it now operates as part of Medtronic's Covidien surgical business. It builds the Touch Surgery ecosystem of surgical simulation and training tools and Touch Surgery Enterprise, an AI-powered platform for recording, analyzing, and reviewing surgical video in the operating room. The company does not publish a public developer program or API; digitalsurgery.com now redirects to Medtronic's Digital Surgery product page. This profile remains a network stub awaiting a real developer surface.

providers.name: Diplomat Pharmacy
providers.description: Diplomat Pharmacy was an independent provider of specialty pharmacy services that helped patients with chronic and complex conditions access and manage specialty medications. The company was acquired by UnitedHealth Group's OptumRx, and operations have been integrated under that brand. No publicly documented developer APIs are offered under the Diplomat Pharmacy name.

providers.name: dkmedtech
providers.description: dkmedtech (Suzhou Dingke Medical Technology Co., Ltd.) is a medical device manufacturer founded in 2010 in Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, China, developing interventional vascular devices across three areas: peripheral vascular intervention, cardiovascular intervention, and neurovascular intervention. With a team of 100+ and a global manufacturing center launched in December 2025, its products carry NMPA (China), CE (Europe), and FDA (United States) regulatory clearances. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners, the company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; it publishes a corporate website but no developer API, documentation, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

It operates location-based VR venues in the United States, licenses its platform to international operators, and is a partner in the Dreamscape Learn education joint venture. Its public surface is a consumer ticketing and booking website; as of August 2026 the company publishes no developer portal, API documentation, SDK, or machine-readable specification, and the single backend its website calls is a private, key-gated AWS API Gateway host that returns 403 to anonymous requests.

providers.name: Dyna Robotics
providers.description: Dyna Robotics is a Redwood City, California robotics AI company founded in 2024 by Lindon Gao, York Yang and Jason Ma to build robot foundation models for real-world commercial automation. Its DYNA-1 vision-language-action (VLA) model drives pairs of stationary robotic arms through high-dexterity tasks such as napkin folding and garment handling, and the company reports a 99%+ autonomous success rate over 24-hour continuous runs. Dyna targets commercial laundry, food service and factory environments, and closed a $120M Series A in September 2025 led by Robostrategy, CRV and First Round Capital with participation from NVentures, the Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund, Salesforce Ventures, Samsung Next and LG Technology Ventures, following a $23.5M seed. Dyna sells robotics-as-a-service rather than software: enrichment probing of dyna.co found no public developer API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL contract, SDK, developer portal, MCP server, agent card, or event surface.

providers.name: e-CROSS
providers.description: e-CROSS is a cross-border e-commerce platform that lets international brands sell into Latin America. Acting as a Merchant of Record, it handles payment processing, currency exchange, logistics and fulfillment intelligence, customs and legal compliance, and storefront localization so merchants can expand into the region with a simple integration into their existing e-commerce stack. e-CROSS is a 500 Global portfolio company. Its public site runs on Wix and exposes a hosted, unauthenticated Model Context Protocol (MCP) server plus an llms.txt for agentic AI access to public site content; e-CROSS does not currently publish a first-party developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK.

providers.name: Elemy
providers.description: Elemy (formerly Sprout Therapy) was a US pediatric behavioral-health startup providing in-home Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy for children with autism, reaching unicorn valuation on backing from SoftBank Vision Fund, General Catalyst, and 8VC. In late 2022 it wound down its direct-care therapy division and pivoted to software; in 2023 it rebranded to Tilly (tillytherapy.com), a HIPAA-compliant ABA practice-management and AI platform covering intake, scheduling, authorizations, billing, payroll, and family engagement for autism-care providers. The original elemy.com domain no longer resolves. Tilly is a closed SaaS product with no public developer API, developer portal, or published API documentation as of this profile.

providers.name: Elevation Spine
providers.description: Elevation Spine is a privately held medical device company headquartered in Monterey, California, founded in 2015, that designs and manufactures integrated-fixation spinal implants. Its Saber platform combines interbody support with in-line spike or screw fixation in a single construct; the flagship Saber-C anterior cervical fusion system is a zero-profile ACDF device cleared as an anterior cervical plate, and the company received FDA 510(k) clearance for Saber-C AVIA, a porous 3D-printed titanium interbody, in July 2026. Elevation Spine sells physical surgical implants and instrumentation to hospitals and surgeons through distributors; it operates a Webflow marketing site and a customer login portal, and publishes no developer program, public API, SDK, or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Endo International
providers.description: Endo International was a specialty pharmaceutical company best known for Xiaflex (collagenase clostridium histolyticum), branded urology and orthopedic products, and a large sterile-injectables and generics business (Par Pharmaceutical). Endo filed Chapter 11 in August 2022 amid mass opioid litigation tied to its legacy Opana ER franchise, and emerged in April 2024 as the private company Endo, Inc., owned by its former creditors. On July 31, 2025, Endo combined with Mallinckrodt; the merged group then separated in November 2025 into two independent companies — Keenova Therapeutics (specialty branded therapeutics, including the former Endo Xiaflex/urology/orthopedics portfolio and Mallinckrodt specialty brands) and Par Health (generics, sterile injectables, and pharmaceutical Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients manufacturing). Endo no longer operates as a standalone public-facing pharmaceutical company. There is no public developer program, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or technology API surface associated with Endo, the post-emergence Endo Inc, Keenova Therapeutics, or Par Health. Any references to "API" on the successor companies' sites refer to pharmaceutical Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients, not software application programming interfaces.

providers.name: Epiodyne
providers.description: Epiodyne is a San Francisco-based pharmaceutical company using structure-based drug discovery to develop small-molecule opioid medicines precisely calibrated for minimal side effects and minimal addiction potential. Its pipeline targets pain management and opioid use disorder (OUD), engineering compounds with specifically tuned receptor functions to address the opioid crisis. The company is a venture-backed biotech portfolio company of Menlo Ventures and does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, or technology platform.

providers.name: Epizyme
providers.description: Epizyme, Inc. was a Cambridge, Massachusetts biopharmaceutical company developing epigenetic therapies for cancer and other diseases. Its lead product, TAZVERIK (tazemetostat), is an oral EZH2 inhibitor approved by the FDA for epithelioid sarcoma and relapsed/refractory follicular lymphoma. Epizyme was acquired by Ipsen in 2022. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub via the kleiner-perkins venture portfolio; the company operates no public developer program, API, or documentation surface, and its former corporate website (epizyme.com) is no longer serving a web presence though the domain remains registered and mail-active.

providers.name: Eureka Therapeutics
providers.description: Eureka Therapeutics, Inc. is a privately held, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Emeryville, California, developing T-cell therapies for solid tumors and hematologic malignancies. The company was founded by Dr. Cheng Liu and is built on two proprietary platforms: E-ALPHA, a high-throughput human antibody discovery engine used to find binders against cancer-specific targets, and ARTEMIS, an engineered T-cell receptor platform (AbTCR) designed to deliver CAR-T-level potency with a reduced cytokine-release profile. Its clinical programs include ET140203 (ARYA-1 in adults, ARYA-2 in pediatrics) and ECT204 (ARYA-3) in advanced liver cancer, alongside a GPC2 ARTEMIS T-cell program for neuroblastoma licensed from the National Cancer Institute. Eureka publishes a corporate website, pipeline and technology overviews, a press-release archive with an RSS feed, and patient-facing trial information; as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Everyone Medicines
providers.description: Everyone Medicines is a therapeutics company listed in the Khosla Ventures portfolio under the Therapeutics category, where it is described as "individualized precision therapeutics." The company has no public developer or API surface as of July 2026. Its original web address, everyonemedicines.com, now issues a 301 redirect to www.eomeds.com, a domain registered through GoDaddy on 2024-05-11 that currently resolves to no DNS A record, so the site is dark and no page, documentation, or .well-known document can be retrieved. Probes of the package registries (npm, PyPI), GitHub organizations (everyonemedicines, eomeds), and the .well-known discovery surface all returned nothing. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a venture-backed life-sciences lead; it carries probed domain-security data only and should be re-run once the company publishes a live site.

providers.name: Evonetix
providers.description: Evonetix is a Cambridge, UK deep-technology company developing a benchtop DNA synthesis platform built on semiconductor technology. Its core innovation is a silicon chip carrying thousands of independently thermally-controlled reaction sites, allowing many DNA strands to be synthesised in parallel with per-site temperature control, in-process error detection and correction, and assembly of high-fidelity genes at the desktop. The company's goal is to give synthetic biology, life-science, and drug-discovery researchers accurate, on-demand access to synthetic DNA without relying on centralised outsourced gene foundries. Evonetix was surfaced as a portfolio company of the deep-tech venture firm DCVC and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK, and its primary web domain (evonetix.com) resolves to a suspended-account placeholder page.

providers.name: Excision BioTherapeutics
providers.description: Excision BioTherapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing CRISPR-based gene-editing therapies intended to functionally cure serious viral infectious diseases. Its programs use multiplexed CRISPR/Cas approaches delivered via adeno-associated virus (AAV) to excise latent viral DNA from infected cells, with a lead candidate (EBT-101) targeting HIV and additional research directed at herpesviruses and hepatitis B. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As a therapeutics company it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile therefore carries company identity and domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Floracene
providers.description: Floracene is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) health-tech startup that optimizes medical-device purchasing for independent surgery centers. Its platform surfaces clinically equivalent implant options based on a physician's manufacturer contracts, helping independent orthopedic and spine surgery centers choose lower-cost, clinically interchangeable devices and recoup an estimated 20-30% of implant spend while protecting case margins and patient care. US surgery centers spend roughly $7 billion annually on implants, which represent 40-60% of procedure costs. The company is at an early, pre-product stage with a placeholder marketing site and no public API, developer portal, or documentation at this time.

providers.name: Fujian Deer Technology
providers.description: Fujian Deer Technology (福建德尔科技股份有限公司) is a Chinese specialty-chemicals manufacturer founded in June 2014 and headquartered in the Jiaoyang Industrial Concentration Zone, Shanghang County, Longyan City, Fujian Province. The company pursues a full fluorine-chemistry industry-chain strategy, researching, producing and selling basic chemical materials, fluorine-containing electronic gases, high-purity semiconductor wet electronic chemicals, new-energy (lithium battery) materials and other fluorinated advanced materials. Its electronic-grade gases include trifluoromethane, carbon tetrafluoride, sulfur hexafluoride, hexafluoroethane, chlorine trifluoride and octafluorocyclobutane, supplied into semiconductor chips, LED chips, flat-panel displays, communications optical fibre, power and energy-storage batteries, ultra-high-voltage transmission and transformation, and photovoltaic power generation. It is a designated national high-tech enterprise and is privately held; its shares appear on secondary-market venues. It manufactures physical materials and publishes no public API, developer program or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Genomics Medicine Ireland
providers.description: Genomics Medicine Ireland (GMI) is a Dublin-based life-sciences company founded in 2015 to build a large-scale Irish genomic and clinical research programme, sequencing volunteer participant DNA and pairing it with longitudinal phenotypic data to study the genetic basis of common and rare diseases such as Alzheimer's, heart failure, inflammatory bowel disease and multiple sclerosis. GMI was absorbed into WuXi NextCODE and subsequently rebranded as Genuity Science (genuitysci.com), a precision-medicine business offering disease-enriched genomic cohorts, whole-genome and next-generation sequencing through a clinically accredited lab, and population-scale data-analysis services to pharmaceutical and biotech partners for target discovery and biomarker identification. As a genomics research and data-services organization it exposes no public developer API, portal, SDKs or OpenAPI; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company/portfolio lead and carries only the artifacts that can be honestly derived or probed for it.

providers.name: Gentem
providers.description: Gentem is a healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) technology company that helps medical practices automate insurance billing and get paid faster. Its platform streamlines eligibility verification, claims submission, denial and payment management, and patient billing for independent and specialty providers, with the goal of reducing administrative burden and accelerating provider cash flow. Gentem was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global; its public developer surface is not currently reachable for artifact harvesting (the primary domain is protected behind a bot challenge and no developer, docs, or API subdomains resolve), so this profile carries verified domain-security probe data plus company identity.

providers.name: GlassPoint
providers.description: GlassPoint is an industrial solar process heat company founded in 2009 that designs, builds, owns and operates enclosed-trough solar thermal systems delivering steam to industrial customers under a Steam-as-a-Service model. Its enclosed trough places mirrors inside a glasshouse to cut capital cost and wind loading, and it has delivered commercial solar process steam since the Amal project in Oman went online in 2012, followed by Miraah and the Ma'aden Solar I project in Saudi Arabia. The company sells decarbonized industrial heat and energy plants, not software: it operates a marketing and press site at glasspoint.com and publishes no developer program, API, SDK, or machine-readable specification of any kind.

Principal subsidiaries include Kaplan (educational services), Graham Media Group and Social News Desk (broadcasting and social media tools), The Slate Group and Foreign Policy (digital publishing), Code3 and City Cast (digital marketing and local news), Hoover Treated Wood Products, Joyce/Dayton, Group Dekko, and Forney (manufacturing), Graham Healthcare Group (home health and hospice), Graham Automotive (dealerships), Clyde's Restaurant Group (including Old Ebbitt Grill), and Framebridge (online custom framing). Founded in Hangzhou around 2010 and among the early investments of Qiming Venture Partners, the company operates a large internet-hospital and clinic network across China. It positions itself as one of China's leading health-management companies, integrating more than 1,000 domestic and international medical resources — private physicians, specialist experts, tertiary hospitals, and health-examination centers — to deliver private doctor services, family medical-care programs, and corporate health services such as medical screening, employee assistance programs (EAP), group insurance, and on-site corporate health centers. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the Qiming venture network; no public developer portal or API surface was found during enrichment (the site is served behind a Huawei Cloud WAF).

providers.name: GYENNO
providers.description: GYENNO is a medical technology company that designs assistive devices and digital-health tools for people living with Parkinson's disease and other movement disorders. Its consumer product line includes the GYENNO Bravo anti-tremor eating utensil (a stabilizing, weighted spoon/fork that counteracts hand tremor) and the GYENNO Skywalk portable freezing-of-gait mobility aid that projects a visual laser cue to help users resume walking, alongside a range of adaptive and weighted utensils and daily-living aids. GYENNO was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a consumer marketing site only and exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Happiest Baby
providers.description: Happiest Baby is a consumer sleep-technology company founded by pediatrician Dr. Harvey Karp, best known for the SNOO Smart Sleeper - an FDA-authorized responsive bassinet that uses sensor-driven motion and white noise to soothe infants and improve sleep. The company also sells the Sleepea swaddle and sleep sacks, runs a companion mobile app with parenting guidance, and operates a healthcare/hospital program. Its connected SNOO hardware communicates in real time over PubNub; Happiest Baby publishes no official public developer API, and the only programmatic access is via community-built wrappers around the undocumented mobile-app API. Backed by GV and Obvious Ventures.

Its offerings center on consumer lead generation, compliance and operational analytics, and member acquisition and retention optimization for the health-insurance market. The company has since rebranded as MPA (mpa.com), positioning itself as an AI-powered platform for licensed insurance professionals and agencies. Its core operations centered on onshore unconventional production in the Bakken Shale of North Dakota and a major offshore position in the Stabroek Block in Guyana, with additional interests in the Gulf of Mexico, Canada, and Southeast Asia. Chevron Corporation completed its $53 billion all-stock acquisition of Hess on July 18, 2025, after a regulatory and arbitration delay that included a Federal Trade Commission consent order barring former CEO John B. Hess from serving on Chevron's board and a parallel ExxonMobil/CNOOC arbitration over Guyana right-of-first-refusal claims. Hess is now a wholly-owned subsidiary of Chevron, and the ONE GUYANA FPSO at Stabroek has come online to produce approximately 250,000 barrels of oil per day. providers.name: Hyundai Bluelink
providers.description: Hyundai Bluelink is Hyundai Motor America's connected vehicle service for Hyundai owners, providing remote vehicle control, vehicle status and diagnostics, navigation and route services, safety and security features, and EV-specific charging and climate management. Bluelink is delivered to owners through the MyHyundai with Bluelink mobile app (iOS and Android), the in-vehicle infotainment head unit, the owner web portal at owners.hyundaiusa.com, and connected smart-home and voice integrations (Amazon Alexa, Google Assistant, smartwatch apps). Feature sets vary by model year and subscription tier — typically Bluelink, Bluelink+, and Bluelink Connected Care / Remote / Guidance bundles — and include remote start with climate, remote door lock/unlock, remote horn and lights, vehicle finder, stolen vehicle recovery and SVI, automatic collision notification, SOS emergency assistance, monthly vehicle health reports, destination search (powered by Google), in-vehicle Wi-Fi hotspot (via AT&T on supported models), and EV-specific remote charge start/stop, charge schedule, charge-level monitoring, and pre-conditioning. Bluelink is a consumer-facing, owner-authenticated service. Hyundai does not publish a public developer portal, public OpenAPI specification, or self-serve API keys for third-party integration with Bluelink vehicle endpoints; access is limited to authenticated owners through Hyundai's first-party apps and to enterprise partners under contract (fleet, insurance telematics, charging networks, smart-home platforms). A community ecosystem of reverse-engineered, unofficial Python and Node.js clients (Hyundai-Kia-Connect/hyundai_kia_connect_api, Home Assistant integrations, Bluelinky) is used by enthusiasts and home automation users, but these are not endorsed, supported, or governed by Hyundai and may break at any time.

providers.name: IconOVir Bio
providers.description: IconOVir Bio is a New York City-based, clinical-stage life sciences company whose stated mission is to cure cancer and restore life to patients. Backed by GV (Google Ventures) as a portfolio company, IconOVir Bio operates in the oncology and cancer immunotherapy space, developing therapeutics aimed at treating patients across a range of cancers. The company maintains a corporate presence at 689 Fifth Avenue in Manhattan and presents a single-page corporate website with no public developer program, API, SDKs, or technical documentation. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a life-sciences portfolio lead; the enrichment pass confirmed there is no public API or developer surface to catalog beyond basic web-domain security posture.

providers.name: Illume Labs
providers.description: Illume Labs is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) startup building a 24/7 AI personal health and longevity companion. Its platform is designed to connect a user's wearables, blood panels, and genomic data, then text them personalized, actionable insights — detecting patterns across data sources, answering health questions conversationally, and offering an interactive surface for deeper exploration of longevity signals. As of mid-2026 the company is pre-launch and operates a single marketing landing page ("A new lens on longevity") on Vercel with no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface yet published. This profile remains a network lead pending a public developer surface to enrich.

providers.name: Immunos Therapeutics
providers.description: Immunos Therapeutics is a privately held biotechnology company focused on harnessing the immune system to treat cancer and inflammatory diseases. The company develops immuno-oncology and immunomodulatory therapeutic candidates, advancing a preclinical and clinical pipeline supported by scientific and clinical advisory boards. Immunos Therapeutics is a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners. As a therapeutics/drug-development company it operates in the life sciences rather than as a software API provider, and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer documentation at this time. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company and portfolio discovery.

providers.name: IncreBio
providers.description: IncreBio (formerly JuiceInnov8) is a Thai food-biotech company founded in 2017 that uses biology to create the next generation of healthier food and drinks. Its flagship product, INCREDIBLE Juice, is a 100% juice with roughly 70% less sugar than standard juice, about 30 calories and 5g of fiber per serving, under the tagline "Make Juice and War on Sugar." IncreBio is backed by 500 Global. It is a consumer food-and-beverage brand with no public API, developer platform, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: innostic
providers.description: Innostic is a China-based medical-device distribution and healthcare supply-chain company, established in 2015 and originally profiled as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. Its public web presence at www.innostic.com now resolves to the Shanghai Jianfa Zhixin Medical Technology group, which operates across medical-device distribution, in-vitro diagnostics (IVD), hospital supply-chain management (SPD and centralized distribution), and consumer healthcare supply-chain services for manufacturers, distributors, and hospitals. The company is a B2B healthcare logistics and distribution firm; its only online systems are internal, login-gated operational platforms (Zhixin, U9, OA). As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface. This profile records verified company identity and a domain-security probe; there is no public API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Instabeat
providers.description: Instabeat is a San Francisco based swimming technology company that builds a heart-rate monitoring device integrated directly into swim goggles, giving swimmers real-time, color-coded effort feedback (heart-rate zones), automatic stroke detection, lap counting, pace, distance and rest-interval tracking without a chest strap or wrist watch. Paired with the Instabeat mobile app and myinstabeat.com, it delivers data-driven training insights so swimmers can adjust workouts in the water rather than after the session. The company sells the device through a Shopify storefront and has tested the product with 250+ swimmers across 56 countries. Added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company; no public developer or API surface has been identified.

providers.name: Instylla
providers.description: Instylla, Inc. is a privately held medical device company headquartered in Bedford, Massachusetts, founded in 2017 by Incept LLC to develop next-generation resorbable liquid embolic agents for interventional radiology, with initial clinical applications in interventional oncology and peripheral hemostasis. Its flagship product, the Embrace Hydrogel Embolic System, received U.S. FDA premarket approval (PMA) in August 2025 for the embolization of hypervascular tumors in peripheral arteries of 5 mm or less, and began commercial use in January 2026; the company also markets the FDA-cleared Tembo Embolic System. Embrace is delivered as two injectable polyethylene-glycol precursors that crosslink in the vessel lumen into a soft hydrogel and then resorb by hydrolysis over roughly eleven months. Instylla is a device manufacturer rather than a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable interface contract.

providers.name: InterVenn
providers.description: InterVenn Biosciences is a digital-biology company applying artificial intelligence and mass spectrometry to glycoproteomics, the large-scale study of glycosylated proteins, to discover novel biomarkers for precision medicine. Its proprietary platform integrates liquid chromatography and tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS) with AI-driven analysis (including the OpenPIP software) to identify and quantify glycopeptides and glycan structures across complex diseases such as cancer. Surfaced as a portfolio company of amplify-partners and softbank-vision-fund and added to the API Evangelist network. InterVenn publishes no public developer API, portal, or specifications as of this enrichment pass; this profile carries company identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Intuitive Surgical
providers.description: Intuitive Surgical is the global leader in robotic-assisted minimally invasive surgery, developing and marketing the da Vinci surgical system, Ion endoluminal system, and the Intuitive Hub for case management, streaming, and integration in operating rooms worldwide.
