It focuses on innovative small-molecule drug research and development in oncology and free-radical-related diseases, pursuing Best-in-Class therapeutics based on independent intellectual property. Its lead approved product is Kelopin (tolametinib), a MEK inhibitor for advanced NRAS-mutant melanoma. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners; no public developer or API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Kenvue
providers.description: Kenvue is the world's largest pure-play consumer health company by revenue, formed from the consumer health spin-off of Johnson & Johnson. Everyday care is a powerful catalyst in making you feel better, inside and out. Kenvue's iconic brands include Tylenol, Neutrogena, Listerine, Aveeno, Band-Aid, and Johnson's.

providers.name: Kinnser Software
providers.description: Kinnser Software was an Austin, Texas-based provider of cloud, web-based software for the post-acute care industry, serving home health, hospice, private duty / personal care, and outpatient therapy agencies. Its flagship product, Kinnser Agency Manager, handled clinical documentation, scheduling, billing, OASIS assessments, and regulatory compliance for home-based care providers. Founded in 2003 by Chris Hester, the company took growth investment from Insight Partners (Insight Venture Partners) in 2012, was acquired by Mediware Information Systems in December 2016, and its products were folded into WellSky after Mediware rebranded as WellSky in 2017. The kinnser.com domain now redirects to wellsky.com; there is no independent Kinnser public developer portal or API surface. This record is a portfolio-lead stub retained in the API Evangelist network for lineage and enrichment.

providers.name: Kiwilogic
providers.description: Kiwilogic.com AG was a German conversational-AI pioneer founded in 1999 in Hamburg, with a secondary office in London. It built the Lingubot platform, one of the earliest commercial natural-language dialogue engines for the web, which let online businesses deploy interactive virtual characters that acted as store greeter, customer-support agent, product specialist and entertainer across web sites and mobile messaging channels. The company was backed by Earlybird Venture Capital (approximately $5.2M reported) and won a best-German-startup award in 2000. The Lingubot business was acquired in the mid-2000s and folded into Artificial Solutions, whose Teneo conversational-AI and voice-AI platform is the commercial successor; the kiwilogic.com domain now issues a blanket redirect to teneo.ai. Kiwilogic operates no independent developer portal, documentation, or API surface today, and this profile is maintained as a historical company record within the API Evangelist network rather than as an active API provider.

providers.name: Lansing Trade Group
providers.description: Lansing Trade Group was an international merchandiser, marketer, and logistics company specializing in bulk commodities including grains, biofuels, and energy products. In 2022, The Andersons completed the acquisition of Lansing Trade Group; its commodities business now operates as part of The Andersons' Trade Group.

providers.name: Leaders In Tech
providers.description: Leaders In Tech (LIT) is a leadership accelerator for startup founders and technology executives, founded in 2015 and part of the Y Combinator Summer 2015 batch. Based in San Francisco, it runs cohort-based fellowship programs grounded in experiential, feedback-rich learning: the Founder Fellows Program (10 months, Series A to pre-IPO), the Grove Fellows Program (6 months, pre-seed and seed founders), the Executive Fellows Program (6 months, senior leaders), plus corporate workshops and retreats. Its primary teaching methodology is T-groups — small-group experiential learning built on shared observation, collective accountability and repeated practice — a model brought from the Stanford Graduate School of Business by co-founder Dr. Carole Robin. Leaders In Tech reports more than 350 alumni founders running companies valued at over $75B. It is a leadership-development organization, not a software or API provider: it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Livongo
providers.description: Livongo Health is a digital chronic-condition management platform for diabetes, hypertension, weight, and prehypertension prevention, pairing connected devices (blood-glucose meters, blood-pressure cuffs, connected scales) with a mobile app, real-time monitoring, and certified health coaching delivered at no cost through employers and health plans. Founded in 2008 and taken public in 2019, Livongo was acquired by Teladoc Health in 2020; the standalone www.livongo.com site now 301-redirects to teladochealth.com/livongo, where Livongo operates as a consumer-facing product line. It is a patient/member health product, not a developer platform: no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or API documentation surface exists. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Sapphire Ventures, and Threshold Ventures.

providers.name: longwill
providers.description: Longwill (Zhejiang Kangjiu Health Technology Group, 浙江康久康养科技集团有限公司) is a Chinese digital elderly-care and community-health group building what it calls a "China digital elder-care ecosystem" (数字康养). Operating from Xiaoshan District, Hangzhou, it runs 40-plus medical and senior-care institutions across Zhejiang (Hangzhou, Jiaxing, Ningbo, Quzhou, Jinhua, Zhoushan), Chengdu (Sichuan) and Shizuishan (Ningxia), organized around a "five-in-one" care model spanning a digital care cloud, CCRC senior-living complexes, institutional medical-and-elder care, community care and home care. It is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. As of this enrichment pass Longwill publishes a corporate marketing website (www.longwill.com.cn) but exposes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Lonza
providers.description: Lonza Group is a Swiss multinational contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) serving the pharmaceutical, biotech, and nutrition industries. Headquartered in Basel, Switzerland, Lonza develops and manufactures active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), biologics, cell and gene therapies, and drug products for customers worldwide. Note: within Lonza's domain, "API" refers to Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (a chemical/biologic substance), not a software/web API. Lonza publishes no public developer portal, REST/GraphQL API, OpenAPI specification, or machine-readable API surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-adjacent lead and enriched; the honest result of the enrichment pass is that Lonza has no software API surface to catalog. The only machine-derived artifact is a domain-security probe of lonza.com.

providers.name: LucidAct
providers.description: LucidAct (Lucidact Health) is an AI-powered care management platform operating in the healthcare technology and digital health vertical. The company builds software that streamlines patient care coordination and clinical workflows, using artificial intelligence to automate administrative tasks, support clinical decision-making, and improve patient engagement and population-health outcomes for healthcare organizations. LucidAct was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface could be found — the marketing site (www.lucidact.com) returns 403 on developer and well-known paths — so this profile currently carries only the provider's probed domain security posture alongside its identity.

providers.name: Lucira Health
providers.description: Lucira Health (formerly Diassess Inc.) was a molecular diagnostics company based in Emeryville, California that developed single-use, disposable RT-LAMP test kits designed for at-home use. Its Lucira COVID-19 All-In-One Test Kit received the first FDA Emergency Use Authorization for an over-the-counter at-home molecular COVID-19 test, and the company later introduced the first at-home combination COVID-19 and influenza (flu) test. Lucira Health filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in February 2023 and its assets were subsequently acquired by Pfizer. The company is a consumer medical-device and diagnostics business; it published no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record; the legacy lucirahealth.com domain is now managed under Pfizer's email/DNS infrastructure and no longer serves a working web presence.

providers.name: Lumere
providers.description: Lumere was a Chicago-based healthcare technology company providing evidence-based analytics on medical devices, drugs, and clinical supplies to help hospitals and health systems reduce cost and variation in supply and utilization decisions. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Lumere was acquired by GHX (Global Healthcare Exchange) in 2019 and its capabilities now ship as part of the GHX Clinical Integration / Value Analysis product line; lumere.com redirects to ghx.com. No independent Lumere developer portal, API documentation, or public API surface exists — this profile is retained as a network lead.

providers.name: Magna
providers.description: Magna is a direct-to-consumer beverage brand (drinkmagna.com) making a magnesium-based electrolyte hydration drink mix. The product pairs a triple-magnesium formulation (malate, gluconate, glycinate) with electrolytes and is marketed to athletes and fitness enthusiasts for hydration, energy, and recovery. Backed by Forerunner Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a consumer-sector company profile. The brand operates as a retail/e-commerce storefront and publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Mantis
providers.description: Mantis (Mantis Biotech) builds predictive digital twins of individual people, aggregating personal data streams — wearables, digital activity, and clinical records — into high-fidelity models by combining large language models with physics-based simulation. The company positions itself as a neutral intermediary for personal predictive models — an "OAuth for identity" or "Plaid for banking" layer — letting individuals grant scoped, revocable access to their twin to healthcare providers and third-party builders. Applications include pre-symptomatic infection detection, cognitive baseline monitoring, heart-failure decompensation forecasting, medication-adherence prediction, post-operative recovery trajectories, psychiatric relapse early warning, and running trials on twins. Mantis is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) company; as of this profile it publishes a marketing site and manifesto but no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Maribel Health
providers.description: Maribel Health provides AI-native operational intelligence for healthcare organizations delivering out-of-facility care, including home health, hospice, hospital-at-home, and community paramedicine programs. Its platform acts as a real-time operational layer that connects clinical workflows, patient records, and financial systems to help provider organizations monitor, coordinate, and control care delivery across settings. Maribel Health is backed by General Catalyst. As of this enrichment pass, no public developer program, API, SDK, or documentation surface was found on the company's website.

providers.name: Marinus Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Marinus Pharmaceuticals is a pharmaceutical company known for developing ganaxolone (brand name ZTALMY), a neuroactive steroid and GABA-A receptor modulator approved for the treatment of seizures associated with CDKL5 deficiency disorder (CDD). The company operated in the rare-disease and epilepsy space of the life-sciences industry. As of 2026 its corporate domain (marinuspharma.com) redirects to Immedica Pharma (immedicaus.com), reflecting the acquisition of Marinus and its ganaxolone franchise. Marinus was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners. As a clinical- and commercial-stage pharmaceutical company it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface; this profile therefore captures corporate identity and domain security signals only.

providers.name: Mavely
providers.description: Mavely, now operating under the Later brand, is a creator‑focused influencer platform that enables everyday creators to monetize their content through affiliate partnerships, brand collaborations, and a suite of creator tools. The platform aggregates shared links, provides earnings dashboards, and offers a marketplace for creators to connect with top brands, aiming to simplify and expand earning opportunities for social media influencers.

providers.name: Maze Therapeutics
providers.description: Maze Therapeutics is a clinical-stage precision medicine company developing small-molecule and other treatments for common diseases with significant unmet medical need, with a focus on kidney disease. Its Compass platform pairs human genetics with variant functionalization to connect specific genetic drivers to disease biology and design targeted medicines, including programs for APOL1-mediated kidney disease and SLC6A19-related conditions. Surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and gv, it was added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; enrichment confirmed it publishes no public developer API, documentation, or discovery surface.

providers.name: MBX Biosciences
providers.description: MBX Biosciences is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel precision peptide therapies for people living with endocrine and metabolic disorders. Its proprietary Precision Endocrine Peptide (PEP) platform engineers long-acting peptide prodrugs, and its pipeline includes canvuparatide (MBX 2109) for chronic hypoparathyroidism, MBX 4291 for obesity, and MBX 5765 for post-bariatric hypoglycemia. The company is publicly traded on Nasdaq under the ticker MBX. As a clinical-stage biotech it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or technical documentation surface; this profile is maintained for network completeness.

providers.name: Medico.com
providers.description: Medico.com was a Spanish-language online health portal and question-and-answer community, offering health reference articles, health news, and topic-focused Q&A around conditions such as diabetes, heart disease, and depression, initially targeting Hispanic markets. Backed by 500 Global, FJ Labs, First Round Capital, and FirstMark Capital, it was acquired by Everyday Health. The medico.com domain now 301-redirects to everydayhealth.com and exposes no independent developer portal, API, or documentation. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio lead; enrichment found no live API surface.

providers.name: medmotion
providers.description: MedMotion (复动肌骨 / 复动医疗, Shanghai Fudong Medical Management Co.) is a China-based musculoskeletal medical company founded in 2018 in Shanghai, building an integrated orthopedic, rehabilitation, orthotics, and physical-conditioning care model for conservative treatment and pre-/post-surgical recovery of sports and skeletal injuries. It operates three product lines: offline musculoskeletal rehabilitation medical centers, the PhysioCloud cloud service platform, and the NMPA-approved TELEREHAB (悦行) musculoskeletal digital-therapeutics device. It is backed by Qiming Venture Partners (Pre-A lead), TF Capital, and SunMed Capital. As of this enrichment pass MedMotion publishes a patient/clinic-facing marketing site and app backend but no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal, so no API artifacts were harvested.

providers.name: MedSci
providers.description: MedSci (梅斯医学 / MedSci Healthcare Holdings Limited, HKEX 2415) is a leading online professional physician platform in China, founded in 2012 and headquartered in Shanghai. It connects roughly 2.9 million registered physician users with pharmaceutical and medical device companies through big data and AI, offering physician platform solutions (medical knowledge, clinical study assistance), precision omni-channel marketing, real-world study (RWS) solutions, and the MedSci xAI medical AI agent. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. No public third-party developer API program, OpenAPI/SDK, or developer portal was found; the primary web host is geo-restricted and unreachable for HTTP probing.

providers.name: medxtmc

It is a leading provider of companion diagnostics (CDx) and total precision-medicine solutions, offering pharma services (biomarker discovery, target validation, patient stratification, IVD/CDx R&D and commercialization), clinical testing panels for solid tumors, blood cancers and infectious diseases, and diagnostic products built on IHC, PCR and NGS platforms. MEDx has collaborated with 400+ pharmaceutical and technology partners and holds ISO 13485, ISO 17025, CAP and CNAS accreditations. It is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. MEDx TMC publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile captures company identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.description: Mindstrong (Mindstrong Health) was a digital mental health company backed by General Catalyst that combined a virtual behavioral-health care team with a research program in "digital biomarkers" — passively measuring cognition and mood from smartphone interaction patterns. The one first-party software artifact located is a Python research library (digital biomarker model fitting) published to PyPI by the company's data science team. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as an enriched company record with no public API surface.

providers.name: Mipsology
providers.description: Mipsology was a France-based (Palaiseau) AI/ML company founded in 2015 that developed Zebra, a deep-learning inference acceleration software stack for FPGA and adaptive-compute hardware. Zebra let CPU/GPU-trained neural networks run on FPGAs without changing the model, framework, or quantization, targeting high-throughput, low-latency computer-vision inference in the data center and at the edge. Mipsology was backed by Partech and other investors and was acquired by AMD in 2023, where its team and technology were folded into AMD's adaptive-computing (Xilinx) AI inference software. As an independent company Mipsology exposed no public developer API, SDK client library, or developer portal; mipsology.com now 301-redirects to amd.com. This profile is retained as a historical network entry with no active API surface.

providers.name: Modulo
providers.description: Modulo Bio is a San Diego, California biotechnology company reprogramming the neuroimmune system to overcome the world's toughest neurological diseases. The company develops therapeutics that target microglia, the brain's resident immune cells, by combining stem cell engineering, neurobiology, multiomics (CRISPR and single-cell techniques), and machine learning to understand and manipulate microglial behavior, identify biomarkers, and discover new drug candidates. Modulo Bio is a therapeutics research company and does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, or technical documentation; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Mogassam
providers.description: Mogassam is a digital dentistry company building all-in-one dental 3D printing hardware and software for chairside, single-visit treatment. Its products include the DentCase automated all-in-one 3D printer with integrated CAM, automatic washing, and post-curing, the Microdent 1 Pro printer, and the DentPrint dental 3D printing software, used to produce dentures, dental models, surgical guides, and provisional and permanent restorations. The company was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public API, SDK, or developer documentation was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Monogramhealth
providers.description: Monogram Health is a value-based, in-home specialty care provider for people living with chronic kidney disease, end-stage renal disease, and other complex chronic conditions. Multidisciplinary teams of physicians, nurse practitioners, nurses, dietitians, pharmacists, and social workers deliver coordinated care in patients' homes with 24/7 access, addressing both medical needs and social determinants of health to reduce hospitalizations and emergency visits. Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, the company partners with health plans (payer partners) and provider groups and serves over 200,000 patients annually. This is a healthcare services company with no public developer, API, or platform surface; the enrichment pass probed domain security and found no API.

providers.name: MyHealthTeam
providers.description: MyHealthTeam operates condition-specific patient social networks that connect roughly 4 million members across 80+ chronic-condition communities (from multiple sclerosis and rheumatoid arthritis to autism and cancer) with peer support, practical advice, and trusted health information to help them better manage life with a chronic condition. It is a consumer-facing web and mobile platform rather than a developer-oriented API provider; as of January 2025 MyHealthTeam is a Swoop company. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. Enrichment found no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface on myhealthteam.com — only the consumer marketing site (which now redirects its blog to swoop.com), so this entry carries identity and domain-security signal only.

providers.name: MyLife
providers.description: MyLife (formerly Stop, Breathe & Think) was a meditation and mindfulness mobile app backed by 500 Global that guided users through short check-ins and recommended meditations based on how they were feeling. As of this enrichment pass the company's primary web presence at stopbreathethink.com no longer resolves to a live site (DNS and CAA records remain but there is no reachable HTTPS host), and no public developer, API, documentation, or SDK surface could be located. The company appears defunct.

providers.name: NanoMosaic
providers.description: NanoMosaic is a biotechnology company delivering ultra-sensitive multiomics powered by its NanoNeedle single-molecule detection technology, purpose-built for gene therapy analytics, neurology biomarkers, and brain health research. Its FDA/CBER AMT-designated AAV analytics platform supports high-sensitivity protein and biomarker quantification for therapeutics developers. Backed by Insight Partners, the company is profiled in the API Evangelist network; it operates a corporate web presence and publishes no public API, developer platform, or SDK.

providers.name: Natalist
providers.description: Natalist is a direct-to-consumer fertility and pregnancy products brand founded in 2019 by Halle Tecco, selling prenatal vitamins, ovulation and pregnancy tests, fertility supplements, and pregnancy and postpartum products online. The company was acquired by Everly Health in 2021 and its storefront now redirects to Everlywell; it is a consumer e-commerce brand with no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or webhook surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-lead stub and enriched with live domain-security probing of natalist.com.

providers.name: National Indian Gaming Commission
providers.description: The National Indian Gaming Commission (NIGC) is an independent federal regulatory agency that regulates gaming on Indian lands to protect tribal gaming as a means of generating revenue for tribal governments. The agency publishes online resources, public records, and gaming-related data through its website but does not currently expose a public web API.

providers.name: NeoTract
providers.description: NeoTract was a privately-held medical device company founded in 2004 that developed and commercialized the FDA-cleared UroLift System, a minimally invasive transurethral treatment for lower urinary tract symptoms caused by benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH). Teleflex Incorporated acquired NeoTract for up to $1.1 billion in October 2017; the UroLift product line now lives under Teleflex at urolift.com. Surfaced as a portfolio company of NEA. This is a physical medical-device business with no public developer, API, or SDK surface; the neotract.com domain no longer resolves.

providers.name: Nested Therapeutics
providers.description: Nested Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company founded in 2021 and headquartered at 1030 Massachusetts Avenue in Cambridge, Massachusetts. It discovers and develops novel, targeted, small-molecule precision medicines for patients with cancers driven by the RAS-MAPK pathway, using mutation clusters to identify druggable pockets that conventional target discovery misses. Its lead program, NST-628, is a pan-RAF/MEK non-degrading molecular glue cleared by the FDA for investigation in advanced solid tumors carrying RAS-MAPK genetic alterations. The company was launched with $125 million in financing from Versant Ventures and the life sciences investment division of Goldman Sachs Asset Management. Nested Therapeutics is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor: it publishes a two-page marketing website and press-release PDFs, and operates no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: NextEra Energy
providers.description: NextEra Energy, Inc. is a Fortune 500 American energy company and one of the largest electric utility holding companies in the United States. It is the world's largest generator of renewable energy from the wind and sun, and a world leader in battery storage. NextEra Energy operates principally through its two subsidiaries, Florida Power & Light (FPL) and NextEra Energy Resources. This repository captures the public-facing digital surface, corporate touchpoints, and any developer or data resources for NextEra Energy. No public REST APIs, developer portal, or machine-readable data feeds have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Nia Health
providers.description: Nia Health GmbH is a Berlin-based digital health company and spin-off of Charité Universitätsmedizin Berlin that develops Nia, a mobile medical application supporting people living with atopic dermatitis (neurodermatitis) and other chronic skin conditions. Nia was the first atopic dermatitis app approved as a medical device, helping patients document flare-ups, identify triggers such as stress or fragrances, and manage their therapy day to day. The company builds a patient-engagement platform that turns real-world behavioral and symptom data into insights for patients, physicians, and research partners including pharmaceutical companies such as Sanofi. Nia Health is a consumer- and clinician-facing mobile product; it exposes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Version One Ventures and enriched from public sources.

providers.name: Nilo Therapeutics
providers.description: Nilo Therapeutics is a New York-based, preclinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering a differentiated approach to immunomodulation by targeting the neural circuits that regulate systemic inflammation. Building on seminal discoveries from the laboratories of Charles Zuker (Columbia University / HHMI), Ruslan Medzhitov (Yale), and Stephen Liberles (Harvard) that identified vagal neurons regulating systemic immune activation, and led by CEO Kim Seth, the company harnesses the body-brain axis to restore immune homeostasis centrally, moving beyond conventional immunosuppression to treat autoimmune and inflammatory disease. Nilo launched in 2025 with a $101M Series A co-led by DCVC Bio, Lux Capital, and The Column Group, with participation from Alexandria Venture Investments and the Gates Foundation. As a therapeutics company it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal surface.

providers.name: Nimbus Therapeutics
providers.description: Nimbus Therapeutics is a Boston-based biotechnology company, founded in 2009, that designs and develops small molecule medicines with exquisite selectivity across oncology, immunology, and metabolic indications. Its approach integrates structure-based and computational drug design (including cloud-based molecular simulation) with target selection, translational medicine, and clinical development. Nimbus is a private, VC-backed drug-discovery company and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Nocion Therapeutics
providers.description: Nocion Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company discovering and developing a novel class of biologically selective charged sodium channel (NaV) blockers designed to selectively silence overactive sensory neurons to relieve chronic cough, pain, itch, and inflammation. Its lead candidate, inhaled taplucainium, is a first-in-class therapy in a Phase 2b (ASPIRE) trial for refractory and unexplained chronic cough, with topline results expected in 2026. Founded on foundational intellectual property licensed from Harvard University and Boston Children's Hospital and backed by Canaan Partners, F-Prime Capital, and other life-sciences investors, Nocion is a therapeutics R&D company with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: NODA AI
providers.description: NODA AI is a defense-technology company building autonomous force orchestration for the frontlines. Founded in 2024 in Austin, Texas by Global War on Terrorism veterans, it develops URZA, an AI-native strategic orchestration platform that acts as a tactics repository and reasoning engine for real-time task brokering across vendor-agnostic, mixed-fleet autonomous assets, integrated with 30+ OEM vehicles and control systems from subsurface to space; and LARIA, a synthetic weapons-and-tactics training environment that uses digital-twin modeling to develop and test autonomous plays. In February 2026 the company raised a $25M Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners to serve the U.S. Department of War, the Intelligence Community, and the UK Ministry of Defense. NODA AI is a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Bloomberg Beta. It publishes no public API, developer documentation, or SDKs; its GitHub organization holds no public repositories.

providers.name: novoprotein
providers.description: Novoprotein (Suzhou Novoprotein Scientific / 苏州近岸蛋白质科技股份有限公司) is a Chinese biotechnology company specializing in recombinant protein preparation and related life-science reagents and contract research services. Its catalog spans mRNA vaccine raw materials, cytokines and growth factors, Matrigel and culture media, reference and bispecific antibodies, cell lines, target proteins, and viral research products serving drug discovery, cell therapy, and diagnostics customers. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a B2B reagent supplier it publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Oblenio Bio
providers.description: Oblenio Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing tri-specific antibody immunotherapies for refractory autoimmune diseases. Its lead candidate, LBL-051, is a tri-specific T-cell engager targeting BCMA, CD19, and CD3 to deplete B-cells and pursue long-term, drug-free remission and immune reset for patients. Founded with support from Aditum Bio and surfaced through the GV portfolio, Oblenio Bio operates in the life-sciences sector and does not currently publish a public developer or API program.

providers.name: Oklo
providers.description: Oklo Inc. is a Santa Clara, California advanced fission company designing and deploying small modular reactors under the Aurora powerhouse brand. The Aurora is a liquid-metal (sodium) cooled, metal-fueled fast reactor derived from the Experimental Breeder Reactor-II (EBR-II) lineage, engineered as a "walk-away safe" passively cooled system that is self-stabilizing and self-controlling under loss-of-coolant and loss-of-shutdown conditions. Oklo's reactors are intended to run on recycled high-assay low-enriched uranium (HALEU) fuel, including legacy EBR-II material, with the company building out three vertically integrated fast-reactor businesses: clean power generation, advanced nuclear fuel fabrication and recycling, and medical radioisotope production. The first commercial Aurora is targeted for operation at Idaho National Laboratory (INL) in late 2027 to early 2028, supported by selection into the DOE Reactor Pilot Program and Fuel Line Pilot Projects, and the company has completed an NRC Phase 1 pre-application assessment. Oklo went public in May 2024 via merger with AltC Acquisition Corp (a SPAC co-founded by Sam Altman, who serves as chairman) and trades on the NYSE under ticker OKLO. Oklo's commercial posture is utility-scale and industrial — selling power, fuel cycle services, and isotopes to data center operators, defense customers, and industrial offtakers — and the company exposes no public developer API, SDK, or open source software.

providers.name: Olema
providers.description: Olema Oncology is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in San Francisco with operations in Cambridge, Massachusetts, focused on developing targeted therapies for cancer. Founded in 2006, the company works in endocrine-driven cancers, nuclear receptors, and mechanisms of tumor drug resistance, with a stated goal of transforming the metastatic breast cancer treatment paradigm. Its investigational pipeline includes palazestrant (OP-1250), an oral complete estrogen receptor antagonist and selective estrogen receptor degrader advancing through the Phase 3 OPERA program, and OP-3136, a KAT6 inhibitor in Phase 1 clinical trials. Olema trades publicly on the Nasdaq exchange under the ticker OLMA. As a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company, Olema does not currently publish a developer-facing API, developer portal, SDKs, or public API documentation; this profile captures its corporate identity in the API Evangelist network.

The platform curates a network of dental providers, surfaces verified patient reviews, handles online booking and appointment reminders, and gives participating practices a patient-acquisition and practice-management channel. Opencare operates as a consumer-facing web platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or documentation surface. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 8vc.

providers.name: Operand
providers.description: Operand is an AI-enabled pricing and commercial strategy platform for consumer retail, founded in 2024 and backed by Felicis, Y Combinator, SV Angel, and Soma Capital. It applies proprietary AI systems — an autonomous "agent swarm" — to set pricing and promotion strategy for mid-market and enterprise brands and retailers managing thousands of SKUs, volatile demand, and thin margins, running simulations to benchmark margin, revenue, and inventory-turn objectives before automating price changes. Operand is delivered as a managed platform with expert support and request-a-quote pricing rather than a public developer API; it currently publishes no OpenAPI, developer portal, or self-serve SDKs. An earlier Operand product at operand.ai offered an embeddings / semantic-search API with Python, Go, and TypeScript SDKs, now discontinued.

providers.name: Orapharma
providers.description: Orapharma is a specialty pharmaceutical company and a division of Bausch Health focused on oral healthcare, developing and commercializing products that help dental professionals improve and maintain periodontal and oral health. Its portfolio includes Arestin (minocycline HCl microspheres for the treatment of periodontitis) and the OSSIX bone-grafting and regeneration products. Headquartered in Bridgewater, New Jersey, Orapharma partners with dental professionals across the continuum of care. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer API or portal at this time.

providers.name: Origin Bio
providers.description: Origin Bio is a cancer-biology research company that generates spatial, molecular, and functional maps from patient tumor samples to study cancer in its native tissue context. Its platform combines a spatial genomics pipeline that maps gene expression while preserving tissue architecture, tissue phenotyping that grounds molecular findings in histology and protein measurements, and functional response testing that runs ex vivo drug and perturbation experiments on precision-cut tumor slices. On top of this proprietary sequencing and spatial-transcriptomics data the company trains multimodal AI models for therapeutic target discovery, treatment-response prediction, and patient stratification. Origin Bio is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) company. As of this profile the company publishes no public-facing API, developer documentation, or SDKs; this record is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Orthocon
providers.description: Orthocon, now operating as Abyrx, is a surgical-therapeutics medical device company that has built a materials-science platform focused on therapeutic devices used during surgical procedures. Its portfolio centers on resorbable and hemostatic bone putties for orthopedic, trauma, spine, sports medicine, cranial, maxillofacial, and cardiothoracic applications, including AHBP (water-soluble hemostatic bone putty), the HemaSorb family (HemaSorb, HemaSorb Apply, HemaSorb Plus with HA/beta-TCP), and MONTAGE settable resorbable bone putty. The company sells directly to surgeons, hospitals, and distributors and does not operate a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or programmatic developer surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and enriched via the API Evangelist pipeline; the honest result is that there is no API surface to catalog.

It develops advanced tumor and immune profiling tests built on next-generation sequencing, including its NeXT Personal ultra-sensitive tumor-informed molecular residual disease (MRD) and recurrence-monitoring assay and the ImmunoID NeXT whole-exome and transcriptome platform used for translational cancer research, biopharma partnerships, and population sequencing programs. It provides partner practices with operational support (billing, payer contracting, HR, payroll, technology, compliance, and marketing), talent recruiting/development/retention, and infrastructure for long-term stability and value-based care participation, while letting each practice keep its local identity. Partner practices include Cobb Pediatrics, Cornerstone Medical Associates, and Rainbow Pediatrics. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners. No public API, developer portal, documentation, or event surface was found as of this enrichment pass.

The company operates a portfolio of social and casual mobile gaming titles distributed through major app stores and uses data-driven engagement and live operations to monetize its global player base. Playtika does not publish a public developer portal or external API.

providers.name: Pliant Therapeutics

Leveraging a proprietary integrin drug discovery and delivery platform, its lead program PLN-101095 is a dual-selective avb8/avb1 integrin inhibitor being evaluated in the FORTIFY clinical trial for patients with advanced or metastatic solid tumors, alongside additional pipeline programs in fibrosis and oncology. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Menlo Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. providers.name: Power Lattice
providers.description: Power Lattice (Powerlattice) is a semiconductor and power-management startup building power delivery solutions for AI accelerators and GPUs. Its core product is an industry-first power delivery chiplet that integrates voltage regulation directly into the processor package, addressing the data-center "power wall" as AI chips push past 2,000 watts. The Rainier micro-IVR architecture combines miniaturized on-die magnetic inductors, advanced control-circuit innovations, a vertical design, and a programmable software layer to deliver 50%+ power reduction, 2-3X performance-per-watt gains, and extended system lifetime. Backed by Playground Global, the company raised $25M to break the AI power wall. This is a hardware company with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Prana Health

The platform centers on proprietary body-modeling technology, including its MUSCLE-1 hypertrophy prediction model, and is currently offered to users through a beta program. As of this profile Prana publishes a consumer marketing and research site only and exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

Its systems serve biopharmaceuticals, clinical diagnostics, public health, food safety, and agricultural breeding. providers.name: Prime Life Science
providers.description: Prime Life Science (璞睿生命科技) is a Chinese life-science technology company focused on digital and intelligent (数智化) clinical research. Its business spans the full lifecycle from clinical research to commercial decision-making, offering digital innovation solutions built on big data and artificial intelligence. The company positions itself as a "digital intelligent clinical research accelerator" aimed at driving innovative drug and device development, health management, and improved clinical-research decision-making and operational efficiency in China. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the Qiming venture fund and added to the API Evangelist network; the public presence is a WordPress marketing site with no developer or API surface discovered during enrichment.

The company develops high-precision additive manufacturing systems built on its proprietary SMS (Scan-Mode Slicing / sub-pixel micro-scanning) photocuring technology, including the Rapid 600 and Rapid 400 industrial printer series, the SP high-accuracy series, and MP micro-nano printers for research. Its systems serve dental and orthodontics (clear aligners, dentures), precision medical devices, jewelry, education and research, electronics, and mold/prototype manufacturing. As a B2B hardware manufacturer, Prismlab publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures identity and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Project Prometheus
providers.description: Prometheus (announced in November 2025 as Project Prometheus) is a San Francisco based artificial intelligence company co-founded by Jeff Bezos and Vik Bajaj, who serve as co-CEOs. The company builds what it calls an "artificial general engineer" — physical-AI models intended to automate the design, simulation and manufacture of complex physical systems across computing, aerospace, automotive production and drug development, learning from real-world trial and error rather than from text corpora alone. It launched with roughly $6.2B in funding and raised a ~$12B Series B in June 2026 at a reported $41B valuation, backed by Bezos, ARCH Venture Partners, JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs and BlackRock, with offices in San Francisco, London and Zurich. As of August 2026 the company remains in stealth: prometheus.ai is served entirely behind a Vercel bot challenge, and no public developer portal, documentation, API, first-party GitHub organization, package or machine-readable contract could be located.

Service lines include hydraulic fracturing, the FORCE electric fleet (eFleet), Silvertip Wireline, cementing, PROPWR power solutions, and Aqua Prop water management. ProPetro does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or technology developer portal.

providers.name: Quanterix
providers.description: Quanterix is a life-sciences company that develops ultra-sensitive protein detection technology for the research and clinical diagnostics markets. Its Simoa (Single Molecule Array) digital biomarker platform, delivered through instruments such as the HD-X and Simoa ONE analyzers and consumable assay kits, measures proteins at concentrations far below conventional immunoassays, enabling early-detection research in neurology (including Alzheimer's blood-based biomarkers), oncology, cardiology, inflammation, and infectious disease. Quanterix was surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. The service is delivered through consumer iOS and Android apps. Quipper is a 500 Global portfolio company. The platform generates comprehensive first drafts in Microsoft Word format that follow FDA and ICH requirements, with word-level traceability of every statement back to source documents, integrations with SharePoint, Veeva, and Outlook for document retrieval and follow-ups, a regulatory search over FDA and ICH guidelines, and a privacy posture built around local deployment with no cloud storage. providers.name: Sai De Yang Guang Oral Care
providers.description: Sai De Yang Guang Oral Care (赛德阳光口腔) is a dental healthcare chain operating across China, founded in 2007 by orthodontist Zhou Yanheng, formerly a director at Peking University School of Stomatology. It runs roughly 30 clinics across major cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Chengdu, Xiamen, Xi'an, Tianjin, Shenyang and Changsha, with nearly 340 treatment chairs, and provides orthodontics (including Invisalign), dental implants, pediatric dentistry, cosmetic dentistry and periodontal treatment. It is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. The company operates a patient-facing website (appointment booking, clinic locations, expert profiles) and publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: Seneca Systems
providers.description: Seneca Systems is a govtech company whose stated mission is "building better government" through software that helps public-sector organizations serve constituents and modernize internal operations. Its flagship product is Romulus, a constituent-relationship and case-management platform aimed at local and state government. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Cowboy Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as of this pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable discovery surface.

providers.name: Senti Biosciences
providers.description: Senti Biosciences (Nasdaq: SNTI) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in South San Francisco, California that engineers programmable "Gene Circuits" into cell and gene therapies to treat cancer with greater precision and control. Its lead candidate, SENTI-202, is an off-the-shelf logic-gated CAR NK cell therapy in clinical trials for acute myeloid leukemia and other hematologic malignancies. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of lux-capital and menlo-ventures. As a therapeutics company it exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: sh-eco
providers.description: SH-ECO (翊科聚合物 / Yike Polymer) is a Chinese medical-device materials manufacturer specializing in the research, production, and customized fabrication of medical catheters and membrane materials. Its product range spans single-lumen tubing, multi-lumen tubing, composite/multi-layer tubing, and injection-molded components serving healthcare and multiple industrial applications. The company is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile. It publishes a corporate marketing website but exposes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Shape Shapescale
providers.description: Shapescale is a consumer body-scanning company that builds ShapeScale, a home 3D body scanner and companion mobile app. The device slowly rotates around a standing user, captures a photorealistic 3D model of the body, and measures body composition, weight, and circumference metrics so users can track fitness and body changes over time. Shapescale is a Y Combinator portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a consumer product website but no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: Shezlong
providers.description: Shezlong is an online mental health and therapy platform serving Egypt and the wider MENA region, connecting users with licensed psychologists and therapists through confidential video, voice, and text sessions delivered from any device. Founded in 2015 and Arabic-first, the consumer service offers subscription-based access to counseling, self-assessment tools, and educational content. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Shezlong operates a client-side (Angular) web application behind Cloudflare and publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDK, or /.well-known discovery surface; the profile is maintained as a lead for discovery and future enrichment.

providers.name: ShipEngine
providers.description: ShipEngine (an Auctane / ShipStation company) is a shipping API for rate shopping, label generation, tracking, and address validation across major carriers.

providers.name: shsongli
providers.description: shsongli (Shanghai Pine & Power / Songli Biotech Co., Ltd.) is a Shanghai-based biotechnology and medical-device maker specializing in the R&D, manufacture and sale of biological hemostatic products, most notably animal-derived quick-dissolving fibrin glue with independent IP, used in surgery and expanding into tissue engineering. The company operates a Class III medical-device line and is ISO 13485 and GMP certified. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm qiming and added to the API Evangelist network. The enrichment pass found no public developer or API surface: the shsongli.com domain returns 404 on every path (EIMS web server) with an expired TLS certificate, and no docs, portal, packages, MCP, llms.txt, /.well-known/ endpoints, or security program were published.

providers.name: shukun
providers.description: Shukun Technology (数坤科技) is a Beijing-based, globally operating AI medical-imaging company founded in 2017. It builds an AI-powered "Digital Doctor" portfolio (CoronaryDoc, NeuroDoc and related Digital Heart / Digital Brain products) that analyzes CT and other medical images to assist clinicians in screening, diagnosing, and planning treatment for cardiovascular, cerebrovascular, chest, abdominal and musculoskeletal disease. Shukun holds NMPA Class III certificates, EU MDR CE markings, and US FDA clearance across several therapeutic areas, and its products are deployed in nearly 3,000 healthcare institutions. The company is a clinical/enterprise AI vendor with no public developer or API surface at the time of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: silversheet
providers.description: silversheet was a healthcare credentialing and provider-workforce technology company added to the API Evangelist network as a stub from venture-portfolio sourcing. As of this enrichment pass its domain silversheet.com no longer serves an independent product or developer surface — it redirects to AMN Healthcare's workforce technology platform (amnhealthcare.com/technology/workforce/), indicating the Silversheet brand has been absorbed into AMN Healthcare. No api/developer/docs subdomains resolve, no OpenAPI or developer portal was found, and no first-party API surface exists to enrich. The domain is still administratively live (SPF and DMARC configured, Proofpoint MX), so a domain-security probe was recorded, but there is no independent API to profile.

providers.name: SimplifiMed
providers.description: SimplifiMed is a healthcare technology company that provides an AI-powered virtual assistant for medical and physician practices, automating patient communication and front-office administrative workflows such as messaging, appointment scheduling, and intake in order to reduce staff workload and streamline clinic operations. It is an early-stage company backed by 500 Global. During enrichment no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or GitHub organization were discoverable; the marketing site is served behind a bot-challenge wall, so only infrastructure-level security signals could be probed.

providers.name: Singulate
providers.description: Singulate is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of seedcamp and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: SinoMDT
providers.description: Sino Medical-Device Technology Co., Ltd. (SinoMDT), founded in 2007 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China, is a high-tech medical equipment manufacturer that researches, designs, and produces accurate injection and infusion devices along with radiographic imaging diagnosis systems. Its product line spans the SN-50 series syringe pumps, SN-1500 series infusion pumps, SinoPower high-pressure contrast injectors used for CT/MRI/DSA enhanced scans, and molybdenum-anode film and full-digital mammography systems for breast radiographic diagnosis. SinoMDT is a portfolio company backed by Qiming Venture Partners. It manufactures physical medical hardware and publishes no public API, SDK, or developer platform.

providers.name: Sinotau
providers.description: Sinotau (先通医药) is a Chinese pharmaceutical innovator specializing in the research, development, production, clinical application, and academic promotion of radiopharmaceuticals (nuclear medicine). Formally established in 2014, the company focuses on three therapeutic areas — oncology, neurology, and cardiology — and has brought its first innovative product, 欧韦宁 (Florbetaben Fluorine-18 injection for PET brain imaging), to market alongside a pipeline of 10+ products in development. Sinotau operates multiple R&D and production facilities, employs 400+ staff, and holds 80+ authorized patents. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. As a corporate radiopharmaceutical manufacturer, Sinotau publishes a corporate marketing website but no public developer platform, API, or technical documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: SinoUnited Health
providers.description: SinoUnited Health (曜影医疗) is a premium private healthcare provider headquartered in Shanghai, China, operating a group of international-standard medical and dental clinics offering family medicine, specialty care, and dental services. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a private, in-person healthcare services provider, it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal surface at this time.

providers.name: sinovision-tech
providers.description: Sinovision (Sinovision Weisheng, 赛诺威盛) is a Beijing-based medical imaging technology company that designs and manufactures computed tomography (CT) systems and related clinical solutions. Its portfolio spans the Insitum 16-128-slice scanners, the Alpha series up to 512 slices, veterinary Petcare CT, mobile and vehicle-mounted units, image-guided navigation robotics, AI-assisted diagnostics, and the Sinoplatform cloud imaging platform, with 700+ installations across 150+ international partners. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners; as of this enrichment pass the public website publishes no developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Sisu Clinic
providers.description: Sisu Clinic is a doctor-led medical aesthetics and cosmetic medicine provider that operates a network of clinics offering treatments such as anti-wrinkle injections, dermal fillers, and skin and skincare services delivered by qualified medical practitioners. It is a consumer healthcare brand rather than an API provider - no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface was found on its website or in developer registries during this enrichment pass. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bullpen Capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: SK Ventures
providers.description: SK Ventures is a seed-stage venture capital firm run by general partners Paul Kedrosky and Eric Norlin that backs science-driven founders who are deep domain experts in their startup's field. The firm invests around themes surfaced through the founders' technology conferences (Defrag, Glue) — identity, software infrastructure, security, and emerging technologies — providing early capital, practical guidance, connections, and pathways to later funding rounds. Its portfolio spans 50+ companies including Blockstream, Wealthfront, Rachio, Sphero, Premise, FullContact, and Klue, with notable exits including FanDuel, Remitly, Cloudability, and Kinvey. Surfaced as a portfolio company of foundry-group and profiled in the API Evangelist network; SK Ventures publishes a marketing website but no public API surface.

providers.name: SMTP Technology
providers.description: SMTP Technology Co., Ltd. (Beijing Shuimu Tianpeng Medical Technology, tpmedical.com) is a Beijing Zhongguancun-based medical device company founded in 2010 that develops, manufactures, and sells ultrasonic surgical equipment - including the ultrasonic osteotome (bone scalpel), Ultrasonic Osteotomy Surgical System, ultrasonic aspirator, and ultrasonic hemostatic surgical systems - with market authorization in China, the EU, and the USA, and is a drafter of the YY/T 1601-2018 industry standard for ultrasonic bone-tissue surgical devices. A Qiming Venture Partners healthcare portfolio company. Enrichment probing found a brochure-only website (HTTP-only, unreachable outside China; profiled via its September 2025 Wayback snapshot) with no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or event surface.

providers.name: Snips
providers.description: Snips was a Paris-based artificial intelligence company that built a private-by-design, on-device voice assistant platform and natural language understanding (NLU) technology, letting developers add offline voice interfaces to connected devices without sending audio to the cloud. Snips was acquired by Sonos in November 2019 and its team became the Sonos Voice Experience group; the developer platform, hosted APIs, and console were subsequently discontinued. snips.ai now serves only a static acquisition-announcement page, and the company's open-source libraries (notably the Snips NLU engine) remain archived under the github.com/snipsco organization.

providers.name: snssurgical
providers.description: snssurgical is a surgical / medical-device company (domain snssurgical.com.cn, based in China) surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass the company website presents no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface (its host serves a self-signed localhost certificate and redirects to a non-responsive HTTP endpoint), so there is no API to profile yet. This profile is a lead retained for future re-enrichment should an API surface appear.

providers.name: Springbank Collective
providers.description: Springbank Collective (Springbank) is an early-stage venture capital firm investing in mission-critical infrastructure technology across three core sectors — work, live, and care. The firm backs pre-seed through Series A companies building AI-driven productivity tools for frontline workers and small businesses, innovation responding to demographic change and the multi-trillion-dollar generational wealth transfer, and healthcare and caregiving delivery infrastructure. Springbank emphasizes backing world-class founding teams of all genders and backgrounds. It was surfaced as a portfolio-adjacent company of foundry-group and tracked within the API Evangelist network; the firm itself publishes no public API or developer surface.

providers.name: Sprout Wellness Solutions
providers.description: Sprout Wellness Solutions is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of techstars and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: SpyBiotech
providers.description: SpyBiotech is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing next-generation vaccines against infectious diseases and cancer using its proprietary SpyTag/SpyCatcher "protein superglue" platform. The technology snaps target antigens onto virus-like particles (VLPs) to produce highly immunogenic vaccines with greater ease and speed. An Oxford University spinout backed by GV, its pipeline includes candidates such as SpyVLP01 targeting human cytomegalovirus (hCMV). This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; SpyBiotech publishes a corporate marketing website but no public developer or product API surface.

providers.name: Sticky
providers.description: Sticky was a San Francisco-based biometric SaaS company (founded 2009, offices in New York and Stockholm) whose cloud platform ran large-scale market research studies using webcam eye tracking and emotion analytics — measuring what real people saw, missed, and felt when engaging with websites, ads, email, and video. A Northzone portfolio company, Sticky was acquired by Tobii on 2017-05-17 and integrated into Tobii Pro, continuing as "Sticky by Tobii". The sticky.ai website is no longer online and Sticky publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: Stilla Technologies
providers.description: Stilla Technologies is a life-sciences instrumentation company that develops digital PCR (dPCR) systems, consumables, and assays, best known for its Naica system for Crystal Digital PCR and the Nio product line. With operations in France and the United States, its technology serves oncology diagnostics, cell and gene therapy, and infectious-disease testing. Stilla was acquired by Bio-Rad Laboratories (announced February 2025, ~$225M plus up to $50M in milestones, closed 2025); its web properties now redirect to Bio-Rad. The company operates laboratory hardware and consumables rather than a public developer platform — no OpenAPI, developer portal, SDKs, CLI, or MCP surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Stipple Bio
providers.description: Stipple Bio is a preclinical precision-oncology biotechnology company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, founded in 2022 by cancer-biology researchers Aaron Ring (Fred Hutch) and Aashish Manglik (UCSF). Its Pointillist Platform performs cellular profiling and tumor-specific epitope discovery to design antibody binders and antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) that target tumor-specific cell-surface epitopes while avoiding on-target, off-tumor toxicity. Its lead asset, STP-100, is an ADC advancing toward early clinical studies. The company emerged from stealth in April 2026 with an oversubscribed $100M Series A co-led by RA Capital, a16z Bio+Health and Nextech Invest, with participation from Google Ventures (gv). As a therapeutics company, Stipple Bio publishes no public API, developer portal, or software developer surface.

providers.name: Stockholm stad
providers.description: Stockholm stad is the municipal government of Sweden’s capital city, providing a wide range of public services, open data portals, and digital tools for residents and businesses. The city’s website offers information on education, transportation, urban planning, social services, cultural events, and e‑services such as permits, registrations, and contact centers. This profile aims to capture the APIs that power these digital services and support developers in building applications that interact with Stockholm’s public sector data.

providers.name: Stylus Medicine
providers.description: Stylus Medicine is a Cambridge, Massachusetts biotechnology company developing in vivo genetic medicines built on engineered recombinases. Its platform aims to generate precise, durable CAR-T cells directly inside the body using cell-targeted lipid nanoparticle delivery to immune cells, with therapeutic programs spanning oncology, autoimmune disease, and genetic disorders. The company is a portfolio company of Khosla Ventures. It operates as a research-stage therapeutics company and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Syremis Therapeutics
providers.description: Syremis Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in Tel Aviv, Israel and Boston, Massachusetts, developing best-in-class oral small-molecule medicines for serious mental health conditions. Its neuropsychiatric pipeline is rooted in clinically validated mechanisms including muscarinic M1/M4 agonism and next-generation NMDA antagonism; lead program ST-905 is a dual M1/M4 agonist in Phase 1 for schizophrenia, with ST-901 also spun out from Clexio Biosciences. The company launched publicly in December 2025 with a $165M Series A co-led by Dexcel Pharma and Third Rock Ventures, with participation from Bain Capital Life Sciences, GV (Google Ventures), QVT, and Pictet. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of GV. This company publishes no public API, developer, or event surface at this time.

providers.name: Tally Labs
providers.description: Tally Labs is a Web3 media and entertainment company founded in 2021 and headquartered in the United States. It is best known for creating and operating Jenkins the Valet, a fictional character and NFT project built around Bored Ape Yacht Club #1798, and for the community-generative NFT novel "Bored & Dangerous," set in the fictional world of Azurbala and written with New York Times bestselling author Neil Strauss. The company builds characters, narratives, and interactive storytelling tools intended to let creators turn their imaginations into content. Tally Labs raised a $12M seed round in May 2022 led by a16z crypto. As a Web3 media/IP company it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or machine-readable specifications; this profile captures its identity and public web surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Taysha Gene Therapies *
providers.description: Taysha Gene Therapies is a clinical-stage biotechnology company (Dallas, TX with a laboratory in Morrisville, NC) developing AAV-based gene therapies for rare monogenic diseases of the central nervous system. Its lead program, TSHA-102, targets Rett syndrome and has completed dosing in the REVEAL pivotal trial. The company operates as a therapeutics developer and publishes no public developer API, documentation portal, or technical integration surface; it was surfaced as a GV portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead.

providers.name: TenSixteen Bio
providers.description: TenSixteen Bio is a San Francisco-based clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering the study of somatic mosaicism and clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential (CHIP) to discover and develop novel therapeutics for age-related diseases including cancer and cardiovascular disease. Founded by CEO Mark Chao and launched in 2022 with a $40M Series A from Foresite Capital and GV (formerly Google Ventures), the company combines human genetics, functional genomics and next-generation-sequencing (NGS) based assays to identify CHIP-linked mutations and translate them into companion diagnostics and precision-medicine treatments. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; as a therapeutics and diagnostics company it publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: TenSixty Bio
providers.description: TenSixty Bio is an oncology-focused biotechnology company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, working to revolutionize the treatment of cancer. The company combines biology, machine learning, and high-throughput technologies to build an atlas of antibody targets on the surface of cancer cells, discover novel cancer targets, and develop improved therapeutics from bench to bedside. TenSixty Bio is a privately held research-stage company backed by General Catalyst and Wing Venture Capital, and it does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced through the API Evangelist venture-capital portfolio pipeline and enriched with verified public company identity.

providers.name: Thalamed
providers.description: Thalamed is a Berlin-based medical device procurement marketplace, founded in 2014, that connects healthcare providers such as clinics, private practices, and outpatient care facilities with suppliers of medical equipment including ultrasound and x-ray devices, sterilization and disinfection systems, and medical lasers. Customers describe the device they need and Thalamed's team evaluates the request and contacts the most suitable providers to deliver matching quotes, simplifying comparison and purchasing. The company is a Point Nine and RTAventures portfolio company. No public developer API, documentation, or integration surface is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: The Data Guild
providers.description: The Data Guild is a San Francisco-based venture studio, founded in 2013, that builds data-driven companies addressing challenges in healthcare, life sciences, renewable energy, and climate change. Steeped in machine learning, data science, and artificial intelligence, the Guild pioneers a co-creation model that converts LP capital into equity across a portfolio of new ventures while applying its own team's efforts directly rather than simply allocating capital. It brings products to market through spinouts, alongside portfolio-company teams, and with strategic partners. Investors include Bloomberg Beta, David Gutelius, and Silicon Valley Data Capital. The Data Guild operates a marketing/company website and publishes no public API, developer documentation, SDKs, or MCP surface; this profile captures its identity and a domain-security probe.

providers.name: tisenc
providers.description: tisenc (天深医疗 / Tianshen Medical) is a Chinese in-vitro diagnostics (IVD) medical-device manufacturer based in Guangdong, backed by Qiming Venture Partners. The company develops chemiluminescence immunoassay analyzers and point-of-care testing (POCT) systems — its ACCRE 8, ACCRE 90, and ACCRE 120 single-sample chemiluminescence platforms and an accompanying reagent menu — together with a digital POCT management platform. It is a nationally recognized high-tech enterprise. tisenc operates a corporate marketing website only (WordPress/Qifeiye, hosted in China); as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Tokaido Health
providers.description: Tokaido Health is an AI-native medication steerage platform anchored in behavioral economics that helps employers and health plans cut pharmacy costs. It identifies same-or-better medications that cost less - via site-of-care steerage, biosimilar substitution, formulary optimization, and polypharmacy reconciliation - and pairs recommendations with incentives that get members to switch, layering on top of the existing PBM and benefits stack. Founded in 2025 in San Mateo, CA; raised $25M in May 2026 led by Norwest Venture Partners. No public API surface is published.

providers.name: Transport for Los Angeles, US
providers.description: Data about positions of Metro vehicles in real time and travel their routes

providers.name: Trella
providers.description: Trella is a Cairo-headquartered B2B trucking marketplace and digital freight platform that connects shippers with carriers across the Middle East, North Africa, and Pakistan (MENA-P). Founded in 2019 by Omar Hagrass, Ali El Atrash, and Pierre Saad and backed by Y Combinator, Trella runs a digital load marketplace, a carrier mobile app, and a shipper web dashboard that together replace the traditional broker-driven, paper-based long-haul trucking workflow. Core platform services include load posting and carrier matching, instant quoting, GPS tracking and live shipment visibility, electronic proof of delivery (ePODs), load insurance, a control-tower operations layer for carrier quality and performance, and integrated payments and invoicing between shippers and carriers. The network spans 30,000+ carriers and operates from major freight hubs including Cairo, Alexandria, Port Said, Damietta, Sokhna, Jeddah, Dammam, Riyadh, and Dubai, serving industries such as FMCG, construction, manufacturing, agriculture, mining, e-commerce, retail, electronics, ceramics, and freight forwarding. Trella's revenue model is marketplace take-rate and value-added logistics services; there is no public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, webhooks catalog, or open-source platform release for the Trella marketplace.

providers.name: tripod-glp
providers.description: tripod-glp resolves to TriApex Laboratories, a next-generation pharmaceutical and biomedical contract research organization (CRO) headquartered in Nanjing, China with facilities in Shanghai, Kunming, Wenchang and Pennsylvania. TriApex provides integrated nonclinical services (safety assessment, efficacy, DMPK and research models) and clinical trial services across phases I-III, with disease expertise spanning cardiometabolic, CNS, ophthalmology, autoimmune and oncology. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network, it publishes a corporate website (www.tri-apex.com) but no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Trisk Bio
providers.description: Trisk Bio is a preclinical AAV (adeno-associated virus) manufacturing partner / CDMO that develops bespoke, scalable processes for AAV gene therapies to enable affordable preclinical manufacturing. It supplies research-grade and non-human primate (NHP) study-grade vectors across capsid serotypes and transgenes, offering custom process development, high-throughput optimisation of a single transgene against multiple capsids, and purification and supply of partials as reference material. Backed by Matrix Partners, Trisk Bio is a healthtech / biomanufacturing company; at the time of this enrichment pass it publishes a marketing website but no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Truvian
providers.description: Truvian Sciences is a San Diego-based diagnostics company founded in 2015 that develops an automated, benchtop blood-testing system combining clinical chemistries, immunoassays, and hematology assays within a single instrument to deliver lab-accurate results in under 30 minutes at the point of care. The company has raised roughly $208M across multiple rounds (including a Series C) and counts General Catalyst among its backers. Truvian is a diagnostics hardware and instrument business rather than a software/API provider: its public surface centers on the analyzer device, clinical assays, and FDA clearance for its testing platform. As of this profiling it publishes no public developer API, API documentation, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable specifications. This record is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; there is no API surface to enrich until Truvian ships a developer program.

providers.name: TScan Therapeutics
providers.description: TScan Therapeutics (Nasdaq: TCRX) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in Waltham, Massachusetts developing T-cell receptor engineered T-cell (TCR-T) therapies for the treatment of patients with cancer. The company uses a high-throughput, genome-wide target-discovery platform to identify the TCRs and antigen targets that drive T-cell recognition of tumors, building a multiplexed library of TCR-T candidates (ImmunoBank) for both hematologic malignancies and solid tumors. Lead programs TSC-100 and TSC-101 target minor histocompatibility antigens to prevent disease relapse after allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplant. As a therapeutics company it exposes no public developer API surface; this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and GV.
