The company operates assets in the Delaware Basin in West Texas and southeastern New Mexico and is publicly traded. No public developer API or technical documentation portal is currently available.

providers.name: Philly Shipyard
providers.description: Philly Shipyard (now Hanwha Philly Shipyard, Inc.) is a commercial shipbuilder based at the former Philadelphia Naval Shipyard, constructing Jones Act-compliant container ships, product and Aframax tankers, and National Security Multi-Mission Vessels (NSMVs) for the U.S. Maritime Administration and state maritime academies. In December 2024, Hanwha Systems and Hanwha Ocean (subsidiaries of South Korea's Hanwha Group) completed the acquisition of Philly Shipyard for approximately $100M, rebranding the operation as Hanwha Philly Shipyard Inc. (HPSI). No public developer APIs have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Piñata Farms
providers.description: Piñata Farms is a Los Angeles-based consumer entertainment company behind an AI video and meme-making mobile app that turns chats, photos, and trending templates into personalized memes and short AI-generated video messages. Backed by Index Ventures and Founders Fund, the product is delivered as an iOS/mobile consumer app served by a private backend at api.pinatafarm.com; the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or API documentation. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company lead with a monitored (currently unavailable) marketing site and a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: PolicyPal
providers.description: PolicyPal is a Singapore-based InsurTech and digital insurance broker founded in 2016 by Val Yap that lets consumers buy, understand, and organize their insurance policies from a mobile app using OCR and rule-based policy digitization. Backed by 500 Global (500 Startups), PayPal Incubation, and Startupbootcamp FinTech, it was the first startup to graduate from the MAS FinTech Regulatory Sandbox and was acquired by Hong Kong's AMTD Digital in 2020. As of 2025 PolicyPal Pte. Ltd. and its entities (including PolicyPal Tech Pte. Ltd., Baoxianbaobao Pte. Ltd. and the ValueChampion brand) are no longer regulated by MAS, and the consumer website is undergoing a revamp. PolicyPal does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: PulteGroup
providers.description: PulteGroup is one of America's largest homebuilding companies, building homes under the Centex, Pulte Homes, Del Webb, DiVosta Homes, John Wieland Homes, and American West brands. No public developer APIs have been identified at this time; this index tracks the company's public web properties.

providers.name: Raven Risk AI
providers.description: Raven Risk AI is an AI platform for credit managers and investment professionals that automates credit analysis workflows — financial data analysis, due diligence, risk assessment, and report generation — to help teams assess and monitor investments with greater speed and precision. Founded in 2023 by Blair Fleming and based in Manhattan, New York, the company is backed by 500 Global. The platform integrates internal and external data sources, applies fine-tuned AI models for credit assessment, and supports deal tracking and firm knowledge management. No public API, developer portal, or documentation is currently published; this profile tracks the company as an API Evangelist network lead pending an eventual developer surface.

providers.name: Revvity
providers.description: Revvity is a life sciences and diagnostics company providing instruments, software, reagents, and services to support drug discovery, development, diagnostics, and applied research. Formed from the former life sciences and diagnostics businesses of PerkinElmer, Revvity serves pharmaceutical, biotech, clinical, academic, and applied markets with offerings spanning reproductive health screening, omics, imaging, and laboratory automation.

providers.name: Rote
providers.description: Rote is an AI-native insurance department for auto body shops, backed by Y Combinator (Winter 2027 batch). The platform uses AI agents to handle the entire negotiation lifecycle between collision-repair shops and insurance carriers, autonomously filing and defending claims using technical repair data so that shops recover revenue lost to denied or undervalued estimates. Founded in San Francisco by Aditya Mittal and Gabriel Castillo, Rote is an early-stage company presenting a marketing website only; no public API, developer portal, SDK, or OpenAPI surface has been published to date. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio lead and enriched from the company's public website.

providers.name: Singularity
providers.description: Singularity (Singularity Defense Corp) is a defense-technology company building low-cost, mass-producible air-defense and counter-weapon systems to protect warfighters and civilians from drones and cheap aerial munitions. Founded by engineers from SpaceX, Tesla, and Anduril alongside operators who have deployed air defenses in combat, the company emerged from stealth in July 2026 with an $80M Series A at a $400M valuation led by Khosla Ventures and Felicis, with Menlo Ventures, NEA, Y Combinator, Harpoon Ventures, and others participating. It emphasizes in-house manufacturing of major subsystems combined with commercial-volume components for rapid production and field deployment, including active conflict zones. Singularity is a hardware defense company and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a Menlo Ventures portfolio lead and enriched with verified company identity by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Skild AI
providers.description: Skild AI is a Pittsburgh-founded robotics AI company developing the Skild Brain, a general-purpose, omni-bodied physical AI system intended to control many different robot embodiments across many tasks without being tied to a specific hardware design. The company is initially targeting three application platforms: security and inspection robots that can navigate dangerous environments, mobile manipulation systems combining grasping and navigation, and autonomous packing with dexterous skills. Skild publishes a research blog discussing topics such as learning from humans and video data. The company is backed by Sequoia, General Catalyst, Felicis, SoftBank, Bezos Expeditions, and other investors. Skild AI does not currently publish a public API, SDK, model weights, or developer documentation; commercial engagement appears to run through direct partnerships and pilots.

providers.name: Streamloots
providers.description: Streamloots is a monetization platform for live-streaming creators and their communities, originally surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners. It lets streamers turn viewers into paying supporters through interactive collectible Cards that trigger on-stream moments, plus Subscriptions, Auctions, a Marathon goal timer, and Tips. The platform works across Twitch, YouTube, Kick, Facebook, and Trovo, offers creator-favorable revenue splits and bi-monthly payouts, and provides fraud protection, a points store, and browser/OBS alert overlays. Streamloots runs a backend API at api.streamloots.com that powers its apps and Twitch Extension, but does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal.

providers.name: Syenta
providers.description: Syenta is an Australian deep-tech semiconductor company (founded 2022, spun out of the Australian National University, with teams across Australia, Europe and the United States) building manufacturing equipment for advanced chip packaging. Its proprietary Localized Electrochemical Manufacturing (LEM) technology combines material deposition and 3D patterning in a single step to produce sub-micron High-Resolution Interconnects on large (>1000 mm2) packages, targeting the chip-to-chip bandwidth bottleneck in AI computing; its Achyon production tool delivers wafer-level system integration at high density. Backed by Playground Global and Australia's National Reconstruction Fund (Series A), Syenta is a hardware / fabrication-equipment maker and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Temple
providers.description: Temple Capital is a cryptocurrency trading firm founded in 2018 that specializes in the algorithmic trading of liquid digital assets using machine learning technology. The firm has a seven-year live fund track record and manages over $75 million in assets on behalf of a diversified investor base, supported by a team of roughly 25 investment professionals across quantitative research, engineering, and operations. Backed by investors including Pantera Capital and Bain Capital, Temple Capital operates as a quantitative crypto hedge fund and does not currently publish a first-party developer API; its temple.capital marketing site is Wix-hosted and exposes a generic Wix Site MCP endpoint for AI agents.

providers.name: The Nudge
providers.description: The Nudge is a free consumer lifestyle app that texts its members short videos from locals recommending their favorite real-world things to do — secret hikes, date ideas, restaurants, and activities — a few "Nudges" each week to help people (primarily millennials) have more fun in real life and be more adventurous, romantic, and social. Founded in 2018 by siblings Sarah and John Peterson and based in San Francisco, The Nudge is available on iOS and Android and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners among other investors. It is a business-to-consumer product delivered over SMS and mobile apps, with no public API or developer program.

providers.name: Theorycraft Games
providers.description: Theorycraft Games is an independent video game studio backed by a16z, best known for developing SUPERVIVE, a free-to-play hero shooter / MOBA-battle-royale hybrid. Surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a consumer game and community presence but no public developer API, developer portal, API documentation, SDK, or OpenAPI surface; the corporate site is in maintenance mode.

providers.name: Tizona Therapeutics
providers.description: Tizona Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing first-in-class cancer immunotherapies by translating novel scientific insights into new medicines. Its lead program, TTX-080, is a first-in-class HLA-G antagonist in clinical trials for advanced solid tumors. Tizona is a portfolio company of Canaan Partners. As a pharmaceutical drug-development company it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or other machine-readable API surface; this profile is retained as a network company record rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Truelli
providers.description: Truelli is a health-technology company (a 500 Global portfolio company) behind a non-invasive menstrual health-screening product: a menstrual pad that also functions as a diagnostic device. A user wears the pad, scans a barcode with the Truelli mobile app, and receives instant screening results across general, hormonal, sexual, and metabolic health — spanning indicators such as anemia and fatigue, fertility and perimenopause, STIs and cancer risk, and diabetes and cardiovascular markers. The company emphasizes UKAS lab accreditation, HIPAA compliance, and clinical-trial validation. Truelli is a consumer product with no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Unnatural Products
providers.description: Unnatural Products (UNP) is a Santa Cruz, California biotechnology company founded in 2017 by UC Santa Cruz alumni Cameron Pye and Joshua Schwochert. The company operates a drug-discovery platform for synthetic macrocyclic peptides, combining data science, machine learning, and parallel chemical synthesis to rapidly optimize potency, selectivity, and passive membrane permeability against traditionally "undruggable" targets that sit between small molecules and biologics. UNP works primarily through pharmaceutical research collaborations, including partnerships with Novartis, Merck, Argenx, and BridgeBio, and has raised approximately $38.4M. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Wing Venture Capital, it exposes no public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Unreal Estate
providers.description: Unreal Estate (formerly USRealty.com) is a tech-enabled flat-fee real estate marketplace and brokerage that lets home sellers list on their local MLS without paying a traditional listing commission, with flat-fee plans ranging from $0 to $449 upfront plus 0.5% at closing, available nationwide except South Dakota. The company also offers buyer services, rental listings with cash rebates, and AI-powered market intelligence, and was acquired by Abode in November 2024. Unreal Estate publishes no public developer program or API.

providers.name: Urban Observatory
providers.description: The largest set of publicly available real time urban data in the UK

providers.name: US Presidential Election Data by TogaTech
providers.description: Basic candidate data and live electoral vote counts for top two parties in US presidential election

providers.name: USA.gov
providers.description: Authoritative information on U.S. programs, events, services and more

providers.name: VectorY
providers.description: VectorY Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing novel genetic medicines for neurodegenerative diseases using its proprietary Vectorized Antibody Platform, which combines AAV-based gene delivery with antibody engineering to express therapeutic antibodies directly in the central nervous system. Its pipeline targets amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) with VTx-002 and VTx-001 and Huntington's disease with VTx-003. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a therapeutics research organization, VectorY publishes a corporate website, pipeline, scientific publications, news, and careers, but operates no public developer API, documentation portal, or programmatic interface surface.

providers.name: Venus Aerospace
providers.description: Venus Aerospace is a propulsion company building the Venus Rotating Detonation Rocket Engine (RDRE) and the Venus Detonation Ramjet (VDR), a hybrid that pairs the RDRE with air-breathing ramjet technology to carry a vehicle from takeoff through hypersonic cruise on a single engine. The company positions detonation-based propulsion — supersonic detonation waves propagating around an annular combustor rather than conventional subsonic combustion — for defense munitions and uncrewed systems, space upper stages, orbital transfer vehicles and landers, and commercial high-speed flight. Venus Aerospace is a hardware and flight-test organization: it publishes a public marketing site covering the RDRE, the VDR, its team, investors and newsroom, but no developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Vertos Medical
providers.description: Vertos Medical, Inc. is a medical device company founded in 2005 and headquartered in Aliso Viejo, California, that developed the mild (minimally invasive lumbar decompression) procedure for treating lumbar spinal stenosis caused by hypertrophic ligamentum flavum. The mild device kit removes excess ligament tissue through a 5.1 mm treatment portal with no implants, no general anesthesia and no stitches; it received FDA clearance in 2006 and CE mark approval in 2019. Stryker announced a definitive agreement to acquire Vertos Medical in August 2024 and completed the acquisition on October 1, 2024, folding the mild procedure into its Interventional Spine business. The vertosmed.com domain now answers every path with a site-wide HTTP 301 redirect to Stryker, and Vertos Medical publishes no developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable specification of its own.

providers.name: Vima Therapeutics
providers.description: Vima Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing novel oral therapies for movement disorders, with a focus on the underlying biology of dystonia and Parkinson's disease. Its lead program is an experimental oral therapy being evaluated in the Stride dystonia clinical study, aimed at helping patients regain control of movement rather than only managing symptoms. The company targets dystonia, dystonic cerebral palsy, and Parkinson's disease — conditions that collectively affect more than one million people in the United States. Vima was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners. As a patient- and clinician-facing therapeutics company, it publishes no public developer program, API, SDK, or technical documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Vitalgen
providers.description: Shanghai Vitalgen BioPharma Co., Ltd. (Vitalgen), founded in March 2020 and headquartered in Shanghai, China, translates cutting-edge gene delivery and gene editing techniques into clinically effective treatments for patients with unmet medical needs. Vitalgen operates a GMP-compliant commercial production platform built on its proprietary ViCas CRISPR/Cas editing tools, ViLNP lipid nanoparticles, and ViVec AAV capsids, developing gene therapies for hereditary diseases and neurodegenerative disorders across a pipeline that includes Bietti Crystalline Dystrophy (VGR-R01), AADC Deficiency, Parkinson's Disease, Gaucher Disease, and Glutaric Acidemia Type I. Several candidates have entered clinical trials and secured U.S. FDA Orphan Drug Designations and an EMA PRIME designation. Surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. The company publishes a corporate marketing website only and exposes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable surface.

providers.name: Western Midstream Partners
providers.description: Western Midstream Partners (WES) is a midstream energy company that owns and operates oil, natural gas, and water gathering systems, natural gas processing plants, oil treating facilities, and crude oil, natural gas, and NGLs pipelines. The company operates primarily in the Delaware Basin and DJ Basin, handling the transportation and processing of hydrocarbons and produced water.

providers.name: Yuanbao (元保)
providers.description: Yuanbao Inc. (元保) is a technology-driven online insurance distribution platform in China, founded in 2019 and listed on NASDAQ under the ticker YB. It distributes medical, critical illness, accident, property, and pet insurance products directly to consumers and provides system services to partnered insurance carriers, embedding proprietary large language models into core functions including risk identification, customer acquisition, product design, personalized recommendation, policy management, and claims processing. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners, Yuanbao operates a consumer-facing web and mobile experience (yuanbaobaoxian.com, redirecting to yuanbaobaoxian.cn) and does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or open API platform at this time.

providers.name: &Volume
providers.description: &Volume is an AI-powered risk management platform for digital assets, built for institutional investors such as family offices, asset managers, and corporate treasuries. The platform normalizes data across exchanges, custodians, protocols, and strategies, then monitors risk in real time, compares uncorrelated yield and arbitrage opportunities, and rebalances capital among them with varying levels of AI-assisted automation. It connects to major exchanges (Binance, Coinbase), custody providers (Fireblocks, BitGo, Copper), protocols (Aave, Lido, Uniswap), and wallets (MetaMask, Ledger, Safe). Founded by a team drawn from Deutsche Bank, BNP Paribas, Jane Street, and EPAM, &Volume partners with the University of Edinburgh AI Laboratory and the LUMI supercomputer to build explainable, testable AI for capital orchestration as global assets move on-chain. Backed by 500 Global. No public API or developer program is published at this time.

providers.name: 01 Advisors
providers.description: 01 Advisors (01A) is an early-growth venture capital and advisory firm founded in 2018 by former Twitter CEO Dick Costolo and former Twitter COO Adam Bain, with former Facebook Chief Revenue Officer David Fischer as a third general partner. Headquartered in San Francisco with a New York office, the firm positions itself as "venture coaches" that deliberately avoid taking board seats, focusing on Series B companies with product-market fit that need help building professional sales organizations and revenue operations. It manages roughly $920M across multiple funds. Added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-capital portfolio lead surfaced via foundry-group; the firm runs a corporate marketing website (Squarespace) and publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable surface.

providers.name: 12 Gigs
providers.description: 12 Gigs, Inc. — later operating as Super Lucky Casino Inc. and renamed Super Free Games, Inc. — was a San Francisco-based mobile game developer founded in 2011. The studio began in social casino games (Super Lucky Casino) before pivoting to casual and word titles such as Word Collect, Word Nut and Trivia Star. It was acquired by Stillfront Group in December 2020 for approximately USD 150 million upfront and now operates as a Stillfront studio; its former superluckycasino.com domain now redirects to stillfront.com. The company exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK.

providers.name: 1200 Pharma
providers.description: 1200 Pharma LLC is a privately held pre-clinical drug discovery company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Culver City, California, with roots in Pasadena. It was launched by Caltech chemist Brian Stoltz, UCLA translational oncologist Dennis Slamon and chief executive David Licata, and it pairs Caltech medicinal-chemistry methodology with UCLA biomarker-driven screening assays to identify novel small-molecule oncology candidates — including KRAS and CDK inhibitors — at a fraction of the industry-average cost and timeline. The company employs roughly 20-50 people, has filed patents covering indole-based anti-cancer compounds, and has raised approximately $14.1 million from Kairos Ventures, Vest Coast Capital, OCV Partners, Alexandria Venture Investments, Pasadena Bio and the National Institutes of Health. Its product is drug intellectual property and discovery partnerships, not software: no developer program, public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract of any kind could be found, and no api/docs/developer hostname exists under its domain. At the time of profiling its only web property, 1200pharma.com, was not being served — the Cloudflare edge in front of it terminated every TLS handshake and answered plain HTTP with error 1001 — so the corporate site itself could not be read.

providers.name: 1GENE
providers.description: 1GENE (壹基因) is the brand of Hangzhou He-Yi Gene Technology Co., Ltd., a Chinese molecular-diagnostics company founded in Hangzhou's Binjiang district in May 2014 by chairman and chief executive Junyi Wang. It develops non-invasive early cancer screening tests built on proprietary tumour DNA methylation markers and liquid- and stool-based biopsy chemistry, sold under the mission of "letting everyone stay away from cancer earlier". Its product pipeline covers colorectal cancer screening (常壹宁), gastric pathogen screening and medication guidance (优壹宁), gastric cancer screening (卫壹宁), and liver and oesophageal cancer screening in development; company scientists co-authored a validated stool-DNA biomarker panel for colorectal neoplasms in the Journal of Cancer Research and Clinical Oncology. The company raised an angel round in 2014, a RMB 49.5M Series A in 2015 and a Series B of several tens of millions of RMB from listed pharmaceutical maker Chengda Pharmaceuticals in December 2022, and its shares are listed for secondary-market trading on EquityZen. 1GENE sells a clinical test, not software: it publishes no developer program, no public API, no SDK and no machine-readable specification, and as of this profile its own web origin at www.1gene.com.cn is unconfigured and serves a placeholder page.

providers.name: 555 Comic
providers.description: 555 Comic is an interactive storytelling and virtual-influencer studio founded by Ben Watanabe. It runs casts of anime-styled virtual characters — such as @CRC_Luna — who publish real-time alternate-reality-game (ARG) stories across TikTok, Twitter/X and Instagram, letting fans create original characters (OCs) and interact with official storylines across four interconnected fictional worlds: Conspiracy Research Club, All Night Arcade, The Convenience Store, and a Paranormal Research Club. Stories unfold in real time on "Poppy-valley Standard Time," with fans participating through social comments. 555 Comic is a Techstars Music portfolio company. It publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface; this profile captures its identity and a domain-security probe of its web host.

providers.name: 5Nine Software
providers.description: 5nine Software, Inc. was a US-based cybersecurity and cloud-management company that built the leading management and security platform for Microsoft Hyper-V and Microsoft Azure environments, letting managed service providers monitor and manage on-premises Hyper-V clusters and Azure instances from a single console. The company was backed by Insight Partners and was acquired by Acronis in December 2019, after which its technology was folded into the Acronis Cyber Platform and is now offered as Acronis Cloud Manager. 5nine no longer operates as an independent vendor: its domain (5nine.com) permanently redirects to the Acronis Cloud Manager product page and it publishes no standalone developer portal, API, or SDKs.

providers.name: 9 Mothers
providers.description: 9 Mothers Corporation is a defense technology company founded in 2024 and based in Austin, Texas, building AI-powered counter-drone (C-sUAS) point defense systems for the FPV drone era. Its flagship product, EDDA, is a small, low-power, autonomous-capable point-defense turret that engages Group 1 suicide drones at 10-100+ meter range to protect soldiers, vehicles, and critical assets. A Y Combinator Spring 2026 company with reported sales to the U.S. Department of War, its roadmap includes Vor (passive acoustic sensor), Atla (belt-fed shotgun system), and Gleipnir (counter-drone for larger platforms). This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. The company publishes no public API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: 9Slides
providers.description: 9Slides was a cloud-based presentation platform, founded by Ruchit Garg in 2011, that let users combine slide decks (PowerPoint, PDF, Keynote, Prezi, Excel) with synchronized video and deliver them through an HTML5 player viewable on desktop, tablet, and mobile. It operated on a freemium model, charging for premium features such as an ad-free player, password-protected presentations, and viewer analytics, and later pivoted toward learning and training. Backed by 500 Global, the company was acquired by employee-engagement platform Limeade. The 9slides.com domain no longer serves the product and now resolves to a parked/redirect landing page; no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation is currently published.

providers.name: Aavenir
providers.description: Aavenir is an AI-powered contract lifecycle management (CLM) and source-to-pay software company that delivers procurement, legal, and finance workflow automation applications built natively on the ServiceNow platform. Its product suite includes Contractflow (contract lifecycle management), Obligationflow (contract obligation and compliance management), Sourcingflow (RFx and strategic sourcing), and Invoiceflow (accounts-payable invoice automation), using natural language processing and machine learning to digitize contracts, invoices, and procurement processes. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Abdera Therapeutics
providers.description: Abdera Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in South San Francisco, California, with research operations in Vancouver, British Columbia. It was launched in 2021 out of adMare BioInnovations with AbCellera as a founding partner and has raised roughly $148 million from investors including Versant Ventures, Foresite Capital, Johnson & Johnson Innovation (JJDC), Qiming Venture Partners USA, RTW Investments and venBio. The company engineers precision radiopharmaceuticals for solid tumours on its proprietary Radio Optimized Vector Engineering (ROVEr) platform, which pairs antibody-derived targeting vectors with potent alpha-emitting radioisotopes such as actinium-225. Its lead candidate, ABD-147, targets delta-like ligand 3 (DLL3) and is in a Phase 1 trial (NCT06736418) in small cell lung cancer and large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma under FDA Fast Track designation; a second program, ABD-320, targets 5T4. Abdera's product is a drug candidate, not software. It runs no developer program and publishes no API, developer portal, API reference, SDK, or machine-readable specification of any kind. As of 2026-09-06 the company's own corporate site at www.abderatx.com was additionally unreachable, returning a Flywheel "Unknown Domain" host error on every path behind a TLS certificate that expired on 2026-07-19.

providers.name: ABK Biomedical
providers.description: ABK Biomedical Inc. is a Halifax, Nova Scotia medical device company founded in 2012 as a spin-out of Dalhousie University, developing and manufacturing imageable embolic microspheres for interventional oncology. Its lead product, Eye90 microspheres, is a yttrium-90 radioembolization device built on a proprietary imageable glass composition that is directly visible under fluoroscopy, X-ray and CT during and after the procedure, and it was granted FDA Breakthrough Device Designation for unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma and studied in the ROUTE90 pivotal trial. Its Easi-Vue embolic microspheres received FDA 510(k) clearance for embolization of hypervascular tumors and arteriovenous malformations. Devices are produced in the company's own cleanroom manufacturing facility in Halifax, with a second office in Ladera Ranch, California. ABK Biomedical is a regulated medical device manufacturer rather than a software vendor, and as of this profile it publishes no developer program, API documentation, SDK, or machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Acade Powder
providers.description: Acade Powder is the English trading name of Suzhou Luxin New Material Technology Co., Ltd. (苏州鲁信新材料科技有限公司), a Chinese advanced-materials manufacturer founded in 2013 and headquartered at No. 512 Fangqiao Road, Xiangcheng District, Suzhou, Jiangsu, with metal-powder production bases in Henan, Anhui and Jiangsu. It develops, produces and sells metal powders for additive manufacturing (3D printing), powder metallurgy, metal injection moulding and laser cladding — superalloy, titanium, aluminium, copper, cobalt-chrome, mould steel, high-speed steel and soft-magnetic grades, plus custom powders — for aerospace, new energy, electronics, photovoltaic, shipbuilding and medical/dental customers. A private pre-IPO company traded on the EquityZen secondary marketplace, it is a materials manufacturer rather than a software vendor and publishes no developer program, API documentation, SDK or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Acela Micro
providers.description: Acela Micro (Suzhou Acela Microelectronics, founded 2013) is a Chinese fabless semiconductor company designing high-end signal chain integrated circuits — ultra-high-speed and high-precision analog-to-digital converters (ADC), digital-to-analog converters (DAC), high-speed clock and wideband signal conditioning chips, and RF agile transceivers — plus system-level validation platforms such as the AUV1302 wideband real-time validation board. Its parts target 5G base stations, optical communications, test and measurement instrumentation, high-speed data acquisition, broadband radar, security imaging and medical devices, and the company positions itself around the domestic localization of high-performance data converters. Headquartered in Suzhou Industrial Park with branches in Beijing, Chengdu, Wuhan and Shenzhen, it holds 90+ invention patents across 80+ product families. The company sells silicon, datasheets and reference hardware; it operates no developer program, publishes no public API, SDK or machine-readable contract, and its Service and Support area distributes product manuals as PDFs.

providers.name: ACELYRIN
providers.description: ACELYRIN, Inc. (Nasdaq: SLRN) was a late-stage clinical biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Agoura Hills, California, focused on accelerating the development and commercialization of medicines in immunology. Its lead candidates were izokibep, an anti-IL-17A small protein therapeutic, and lonigutamab, a humanized IgG1 monoclonal antibody against IGF-1R. It completed a $540M IPO in May 2023, and on May 21, 2025 it merged with a subsidiary of Alumis, Inc. and survives as a wholly owned Alumis subsidiary. Its corporate domain acelyrin.com now 301-redirects to alumis.com. The company is a drug developer, not a software vendor: it published no developer program, public API, SDK, webhook surface, or machine-readable specification, and no GitHub organization exists under the ACELYRIN name.

providers.name: Acne Studios
providers.description: Acne Studios is a Stockholm-based fashion house founded in 1996 as part of the creative collective ACNE (Ambition to Create Novel Expressions). The company designs and sells ready-to-wear womenswear and menswear, footwear, leather goods, denim, and accessories through its global network of retail stores and its official e-commerce site at acnestudios.com. Surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Acne Studios publishes no public developer API program or developer portal; this profile captures its public web identity and live domain-security posture. Sector: consumer / fashion retail.

providers.name: Actavis
providers.description: Actavis is a pharmaceutical manufacturer of generic, branded-generic and over-the-counter medicines that no longer exists as an independent company. Actavis plc renamed itself Allergan plc in June 2015, and on 2 August 2016 Teva Pharmaceutical Industries completed its acquisition of the Actavis Generics business for roughly $40.5 billion. What survives of the name is a product label and a handful of Teva regional affiliates such as PT Actavis Indonesia. The historic corporate domains (actavis.com, actavis.us, actavis.co.uk) are delegated to Teva nameservers and no longer answer HTTP at all, and actavis.bg redirects to teva.bg. Actavis published no developer program, no API, no SDKs and no machine-readable specification; in this industry "API" means Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient, not a software interface.

providers.name: Acutus Medical
providers.description: Acutus Medical, Inc. is a Carlsbad, California arrhythmia-management medical device company (SEC CIK 0001522860, SIC 3841 Surgical & Medical Instruments) that built the AcQMap non-contact ultrasound-based cardiac imaging and mapping system, the AcQBlate FORCE sensing ablation catheter, and the AcQCross and AcQGuide left-heart access family for electrophysiologists treating complex cardiac arrhythmias. The company sold its left-heart access portfolio to Medtronic beginning in 2022, restructured in November 2023 to solely manufacture and distribute that portfolio for Medtronic, and in December 2024 announced an operational downsizing that exited the electrophysiology mapping and ablation business and cut roughly 70% of its workforce. Its common stock was suspended and delisted from Nasdaq in May 2024, and it filed a Form 15-15D on 24 January 2025 to suspend its reporting obligations and go dark. Acutus was a device manufacturer rather than a software or platform business and never operated a developer program or published an API; as of September 2026 its entire public web presence — acutus.com, acutusmedical.com and the ir.acutusmedical.com investor site its own press releases link to — no longer resolves in DNS, leaving no host on which a contract could be published.

providers.name: ADEL, Inc.
providers.description: ADEL, Inc. (주식회사 아델) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, founded in 2016 as a spin-off from the Asan Medical Center / University of Ulsan College of Medicine by Professor Seung-Yong Yoon. ADEL develops antibody therapeutics, companion diagnostics and delivery platforms for Alzheimer's disease and other neurodegenerative conditions. Its lead candidate ADEL-Y01 is a humanized monoclonal antibody selectively targeting tau acetylated at Lysine-280 (acK280), in a global first-in-human Phase 1 study under a US FDA-cleared IND; in December 2025 ADEL granted Sanofi exclusive worldwide rights to ADEL-Y01 in a deal worth up to USD 1.04 billion including an USD 80 million upfront payment. The wider pipeline includes ADEL-Y03 (a beta-2 microglobulin antibody), ADEL-Y04 (an ApoE4-targeting antibody), the ADEL-D01 tau pT217 diagnostic antibody, and two proprietary platforms — BTS (Brain Targeting System) for blood-brain-barrier penetration and ADTAC (Autophagic Degradation Targeting Chimera) for targeted protein degradation. The company is research-and-development driven and sells no software product: it publishes no developer portal, public API, SDK, webhook catalog or machine-readable specification of any kind. Its only web surface is the corporate marketing site at adelpharm.com.

providers.name: Adona Medical
providers.description: Adona Medical is a clinical-stage medical device company headquartered in Los Gatos, California, and a Shifamed portfolio company, developing an adjustable interatrial shunt with integrated bi-atrial pressure monitoring for patients with advanced heart failure. The implant uses nitinol shape-memory geometry so the shunt flow channel can be enlarged or reduced after implantation, allowing hemodynamic therapy to be re-titrated as a patient's condition evolves. The company completed enrollment in its ATHENS-HF first-in-human study of the device. Adona Medical is a device and clinical company rather than a software vendor: it publishes no public developer program, API, SDK, or machine-readable specifications, and its device is investigational and not approved for sale.

providers.name: Advanced Drainage Systems
providers.description: Advanced Drainage Systems (ADS) is a leading manufacturer of stormwater and onsite septic wastewater solutions. The company produces drainage infrastructure including pipes, chambers, basins, and water quality treatment products serving residential, commercial, agricultural, airport, and transportation markets. ADS provides CAD integrations and engineering resources for civil engineering professionals.

providers.name: Advanced Metal Research
providers.description: Advanced Metal Research is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) company based in Los Angeles building machine intelligence for American welding. The company develops American-made robotic welding cells that pair computer vision with real-time seam tracking and post-weld inspection, turning welding from a scarce manual craft into a closed-loop manufacturing system that learns from every weld as it happens. Founded in 2025 by Julian Fried, Stephen Lin, and Angus Muffatti, it targets the projected shortage of skilled welding professionals across US industrial manufacturing. The company is early-stage and hardware-focused; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Advanced NanoTherapies
providers.description: Advanced NanoTherapies, Inc. (ANT) is a clinical-stage medical device company founded in 2018 and based in Santa Clara / Los Gatos, California, applying nanoparticle engineering to vascular drug delivery. Its lead program, SirPlux Duo, is a dual-drug drug-coated balloon (DCB) that delivers sirolimus and paclitaxel simultaneously from a proprietary nanoparticle coating to inhibit restenosis in coronary and peripheral arteries, and it has received FDA Breakthrough Device designations for small-vessel coronary artery disease, coronary in-stent restenosis and below-the-knee peripheral lesions. The company builds physical interventional devices rather than software; it operates no developer program and publishes no public API, SDK, webhook surface or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Aemon
providers.description: Aemon is an autonomous AI research-and-development engineer founded in 2025 by Ray Xu and Richard Zhou and backed by Y Combinator (Winter 2026 batch). Given an engineering problem and a measurable objective, Aemon reads state-of-the-art research, then generates, tests, and evolves thousands of candidate approaches at machine speed to discover optimal solutions that can exceed what human experts find. The team demonstrated the approach by setting a new world record on the NP-hard circle-packing optimization problem for under $10 of compute, beating a prior Google DeepMind result. Aemon is an early-stage, demo-first enterprise product headquartered in San Francisco; as of this profile it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Aerodome
providers.description: Aerodome was a Drone-as-First-Responder (DFR) company founded in 2023 by former California police officer Rahul Sidhu (CEO) and Kenaniah Cerny (Chief Architect). It built a fully integrated, automated, and remotely operated software platform that let public-safety agencies dispatch autonomous drones directly from 911 calls, pairing DJI drone hardware, robotic battery-swap docking nests, and radar with Aerodome DFR software featuring augmented-reality street overlays, automated flight operations, computer-aided-dispatch integration, and live airspace awareness. The company reported average 86-second response times to 911 calls. Backed by a16z, CRV, and 2048 Ventures across a seed (Oct 2023) and $21.5M Series A (May 2024), Aerodome was acquired by Flock Safety in October 2024 for over $300 million; its technology and software now ship as the Flock Safety "Flock DFR" product line, and the aerodome.com domain redirects to that product page.

providers.name: AFUN Interactive
providers.description: AFUN Interactive (에이펀인터렉티브) is a Seoul-based real-time 3D content production studio founded in 2017 that builds digital humans, virtual celebrities and high-quality real-time 3D media. Its four stated service lines are Digital Celebrity Management, Digital Human (photoreal CG characters and live avatars for hologram, VR, AR and AI concierge use), Ganimation (a real-time animation/game hybrid genre that won at the 2018 Venice International Film Festival), and High Quality Realtime 3D Contents (AR content, car configurators and high-end MR for automotive, entertainment and telecom clients). Through its subsidiary VV Entertainment it produces and manages the virtual K-pop artist APOKI. It is a work-for-hire production and artist-management business that sells finished 3D content, not developer access, and publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: AggreDyne
providers.description: AggreDyne, Inc. is a privately held Houston, Texas medical device and in vitro diagnostics manufacturer, founded in 2011 by Edward R. Teitel, MD, JD and Robert C. Hux, CPA, to commercialize the AggreGuide platelet function analyzer. Its flagship product, the AggreGuide A-100, is a benchtop laser light scattering aggregometer that measures platelet aggregation from a single-use disposable cartridge in under five minutes, assessing how well a patient is responding to antiplatelet therapy such as aspirin, clopidogrel, prasugrel and ticagrelor. The company holds three FDA 510(k) clearances under product code JOZ — K122162 (2013), K163274 for the A-100 AA Assay and Instrument (2017), and K181777 for the A-100 ADP assay cartridge (2019) — and its products are CE marked. It sells to hospital laboratories, physician office laboratories in cardiology, endocrinology, neurology and family practice, and regional reference laboratories. AggreDyne is a diagnostic instrument and consumable manufacturer rather than a software or platform business: it has never published a developer program, public API, SDK, or machine-readable API contract, and as of September 2026 its corporate website is offline behind a suspended hosting account.

providers.name: Agraga
providers.description: Agraga (operated by Virya Logistics Technologies Private Limited) is a Chennai, India based digital cross-border logistics platform founded in 2021 by Anoop Raghavan and Venkatesh Narayanaswamy. It positions itself as a single operator for every leg of a shipment, bringing ocean freight, air freight, domestic transport, customs broking, warehousing, e-commerce fulfilment and embedded trade finance onto one booking and tracking platform aimed at underserved Indian MSME exporters and importers. It reports 700+ customers and 1,000+ vendors across 40-plus markets, and raised INR 100 crore in a pre-Series B round led by Bajaj Finserv with IvyCap Ventures. As of this profile Agraga publishes no public developer program, API documentation, SDK or machine-readable API contract; its platform backends are private and answer every anonymous request with an authentication error.

providers.name: Agrani Labs
providers.description: Agrani Labs is a Bengaluru, India semiconductor and systems-software company founded in December 2024 by Dheemanth Nagaraj (CEO), Ashok Jagannathan (chief architect), Srikanth Nimmagadda (CTO) and Rajesh Vivekanandham (chief performance architect), all former AMD and Intel engineers, with Pentium architect Vinod Dham as founding advisor. The company is building indigenous AI GPUs together with the full software stack around them — compilers, kernel and math libraries, system software and AI frameworks — for enterprise and datacenter compute in North America and Asia, and emerged from stealth in January 2026 with an $8M seed round led by Peak XV Partners. Agrani Labs is a pre-product silicon company: agranilabs.com is a single static marketing page with a team section, a Notion-hosted careers site and a contact form, and it publishes no developer portal, documentation, API reference, SDK, CLI, changelog, status page or pricing. Enrichment probing on 2026-09-12 found no OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL, AsyncAPI, WSDL, gRPC, MCP or A2A agent-card surface on any host, no /.well-known/ documents, no public GitHub organization and no first-party packages in npm, PyPI, Maven Central, NuGet, RubyGems, crates.io or pkg.go.dev.

providers.name: Ahana
providers.description: Ahana was a venture-backed SaaS company founded in 2020 and headquartered in San Mateo, California, that provided a managed, cloud-native offering of PrestoDB — the open source distributed SQL query engine originally created at Facebook — positioned as the query and analytics layer of the open data lakehouse. Ahana raised roughly $32M in seed and Series A funding from investors including GV (Google Ventures), Lux Capital, Third Point Ventures, Leslie Ventures, and Liberty Global Ventures, and was a leading contributor and steward of the Presto Foundation. In April 2023 Ahana was acquired by IBM, which joined the Presto Foundation and folded Ahana's SaaS Presto capabilities into IBM watsonx.data. The independent Ahana product and developer surface no longer exist: the ahana.io domain now 301-redirects to https://www.ibm.com/products/watsonx-data. This profile is retained as a historical network record for the acquired company; there is no live first-party API to enrich.

providers.name: AheadGene
providers.description: AheadGene (Sichuan AheadGene Biotechnology Co., Ltd. / 四川艾合智兴生物科技有限公司) is a synthetic biology company founded in 2021 and headquartered in Chengdu, Sichuan, China. The company engineers non-natural protein functions — "bioworks beyond nature" — and applies them to pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturing, with the stated ambition of becoming a full industry-chain platform business spanning enzyme and protein design through to production. Its public web presence is a single static Chinese-language landing page at www.aheadgene.com linking to an internal management console at system.aheadgene.com; the company publishes no developer portal, API documentation, SDKs or machine-readable contracts of any kind.

providers.name: AInnovation
providers.description: AInnovation (创新奇智, Qingdao AInnovation Technology Group) is a Chinese enterprise artificial-intelligence company founded in 2018 and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (02121.HK). It focuses on "AI + Manufacturing", delivering industrial AI through its AInnoGC platform — an industrial large-language-model and AI-agent application-development platform — and its MMOC technology stack: ManuVision machine-vision, MatrixVision edge-video intelligence, and the Orion distributed machine-learning platform. It serves manufacturing verticals including semiconductors, steel, 3C electronics, automotive, energy, food and materials, construction, and financial services. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, the company reports 1,400+ patent applications. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is published as of this profile.

providers.name: airquality
providers.description: AirQuality (爱优特) is a Shanghai-based manufacturer of high-efficiency electrostatic air purification and disinfection products, including central air filtration systems, commercial kitchen exhaust (hood) cleaners, odor-elimination units, and smart air-quality detection systems for schools, hospitals, offices, shopping malls, and hotels. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. It is a hardware/manufacturing business that publishes a consumer website and online shop but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time, so most enrichment artifacts are not applicable.

providers.name: Aiyianimalmedicine
providers.description: Aiyianimalmedicine is a stub entry in the API Evangelist catalog, representing a company that appears in secondary-market data sources but for which no public API documentation or website has been verified. The entry serves as a placeholder for future enrichment when reliable information about the company's digital presence, API offerings, and related resources becomes available.

providers.name: Albedo
providers.description: Albedo is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of initialized-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: frontier-tech. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Aliena
providers.description: Aliena is a Singapore-based space-technology company, incorporated in 2018, that designs and manufactures compact electric propulsion systems for small satellites. Its MUSIC plasma thruster line delivers high thrust-to-power ratios at very low power budgets with high specific impulse, enabling small satellites to operate and sustain very low Earth orbit (VLEO) for high-resolution remote sensing. Aliena is a hardware manufacturer with no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a 500 Global portfolio lead.

providers.name: AllSome
providers.description: AllSome is a Malaysia-based cross-border e-commerce fulfillment, warehousing, and supply-chain company serving online marketplace sellers across Southeast Asia. It operates a fulfillment network and order-management platform that helps sellers source, store, and ship goods (notably China-to-SEA cross-border trade) across channels such as Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop. AllSome is backed by 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; no public developer API surface was discoverable during enrichment (the primary website is WAF-protected and returns 403 to automated clients, and no api/developer/docs subdomains resolve).

providers.name: Alongside
providers.description: Alongside is an a16z-backed crypto company (alongside.xyz) founded in 2022. It originally launched the Alongside Crypto Market Index (AMKT), the first on-chain broad crypto market index token with a 0% annual fee, backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Coinbase Ventures, and Franklin Templeton. The company has since pivoted to AI-native compliance automation for scaling crypto firms, unifying fragmented KYC/AML/KYT tooling into a single system and reducing manual analyst burden for autonomous financial agents. As of this enrichment pass Alongside publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, MCP server, or developer documentation; this profile captures its identity and probed domain security only.

providers.name: Amberpoint
providers.description: AmberPoint was an enterprise software company founded in 2001 that provided runtime management, monitoring, and governance solutions for Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) and distributed web-services applications. Its products let organizations discover, secure, monitor, and enforce policy across complex multi-application business processes and message flows, and competed in the SOA management space alongside vendors integrated into enterprise middleware stacks. AmberPoint was acquired by Oracle on February 8, 2010, with its technology folded into Oracle Fusion Middleware and Oracle Enterprise Manager. The company no longer operates independently; the amberpoint.com domain is held by Oracle and no longer serves a public developer surface. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a historical portfolio-lead record surfaced from a venture-capital portfolio.

providers.name: Ambri
providers.description: Ambri develops and commercializes liquid metal battery technology for grid‑scale renewable energy storage. Founded by MIT professors, the company delivers long‑duration energy storage solutions that enable higher renewable penetration and reduce reliance on fossil‑fuel power plants. Ambri’s batteries are deployed in data centers and utility projects, and the firm has secured funding from notable investors such as Bill Gates and Total.

providers.name: American Aerospace Advisors
providers.description: American Aerospace Technologies, Inc., doing business as American Aerospace Advisors, is a defense and critical-infrastructure monitoring company based in Conshohocken, Pennsylvania. It provides end-to-end airborne intelligence systems that combine unmanned aircraft systems (UAS), airborne sensors, analytics, and communications to deliver near-real-time data through a cloud-based intelligence gateway. Its flagship AiRanger medium-altitude long-endurance unmanned aircraft and InstiMaps sensor technology support pipeline and linear-asset patrol, beyond-visual-line-of-sight (BVLOS) flight services, sensor integration, and aviation policy consulting. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Amino
providers.description: Amino is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of techstars, union-square-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Amundsen
providers.description: Amundsen is a data discovery and metadata platform originally developed at Lyft, now an open-source project helping organizations improve data discoverability, governance, and collaboration. It provides a searchable UI, integration with data sources like Hive, BigQuery, Redshift, and supports lineage, usage metrics, and data ownership. The project is maintained by a community of contributors and offers extensive documentation for deployment and customization.

providers.name: Analytical Flavor Systems
providers.description: Analytical Flavor Systems is the startup behind Gastrograph AI, a sensory-science and machine-learning platform that modeled human flavor, aroma, and texture perception to help food and beverage companies predict consumer preference, benchmark products, and optimize formulations before physical prototyping. It was a Techstars-backed portfolio company. Its gastrograph.com domain now 301-redirects to NielsenIQ, which acquired the technology and folded it into its BASES AI Product Developer solution; no independent public API, developer portal, or SDK surface remains.

providers.name: Anchor *
providers.description: Anchor was a podcast creation, hosting, distribution, and monetization platform (anchor.fm), founded in 2015 and backed by GV (Google Ventures) among others. Spotify acquired Anchor in 2019 and folded it into its creator tooling, later rebranding the product to Spotify for Podcasters and then Spotify for Creators. The anchor.fm domain now 302-redirects to Spotify's creator product (podcasters.spotify.com / creators.spotify.com); Anchor never published a standalone public developer API, and it no longer operates as an independent company. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of gv and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub lead; enrichment confirms it is an acquired/absorbed brand with no independent developer surface to harvest.

providers.name: andjaro
providers.description: Andjaro is a French SaaS platform for replacement management and workforce flexibility, helping organizations handle short-notice absences, staff shortages, and operational continuity across the private and public sectors. The product gives HR and operations teams real-time visibility of available personnel across an employment ecosystem, matches available workers (CDI/CDD employees, freelancers, and temps) to urgent replacement needs, and automates the administrative workflow by integrating with payroll, ERP, planning, and HRIS systems. It serves facility management, healthcare and social services, the public sector, retail, collective catering, and transport and logistics. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of balderton-capital; no public API, developer portal, or SDK was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Angelmedicalsystems
providers.description: Angelmedicalsystems, operating as Angel Medical, provides precision ophthalmic instruments for eye surgery, including LASIK, cataract, glaucoma, and retinal procedures. Their product catalog features ReLEx SMILE lenticule extraction sets, laser-assisted vision correction tools, and comprehensive surgical instrument kits, serving hospitals, surgery centers, and physicians worldwide.

providers.name: Anhui Iprocom Biotechnology
providers.description: Anhui Iprocom Biotechnology is a biotechnology company based in Anhui, China. It focuses on research and development of biopharmaceutical products and related technologies. The company is listed in secondary-market harvests and is being profiled for API Evangelist documentation. Further public information about its services, products, and API offerings is limited at this time. No additional public website or detailed API documentation could be located through standard web searches, indicating a low public exposure of its developer resources.

providers.name: Anon
providers.description: Anon is an enterprise AI agent platform that builds production-ready AI agents for companies. Its offerings include computer-use agents that automate long-running browser workflows, hosted web agents that perform tasks across multiple systems, and an agent authentication toolkit that gives developers tools to authenticate agents across third-party services. Originally positioned as an automated authentication layer for the gen-AI age, Anon has raised $14M from Forerunner Ventures, Union Square Ventures, and Abstract Ventures. As of this profile the company does not publish a public self-serve API, SDK, developer portal, or MCP server; engagements are handled directly (hello@anon.com).

providers.name: Anycart
providers.description: Anycart is a consumer grocery delivery and store-pickup platform that lets shoppers enter a zip code, choose a favorite local grocery store, and shop for anything they need with no price markups and no service fees. The service spans multiple U.S. retailers and focuses on transparent pricing for everyday grocery ordering, delivery, and pickup. Anycart was surfaced as a portfolio company of Menlo Ventures and Techstars and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. It operates a consumer web and mobile storefront (anycart.com) and does not publish a public developer program, OpenAPI definition, or API documentation at this time.

providers.name: APACTRON Particle Equipment
providers.description: APACTRON Particle Equipment, based in Shanghai, China, manufactures proton therapy and particle accelerator equipment. Established in 2011, it is controlled by Shanghai Lianhe Investment and jointly invested by the Shanghai Institute of Applied Physics. The company provides advanced medical equipment for cancer treatment and research.

providers.name: Aplanet
providers.description: Aplanet, operating under the brand Adventure Planet Group, is a Polish company specializing in organizing corporate events, meetings, incentives, conferences and team‑building activities. They offer a wide range of services from event planning to execution, targeting businesses seeking professional MICE solutions. Their portfolio includes incentive travel, conferences, online events, and custom event experiences, positioning them as a leader in the regional events industry.

providers.name: aplum
providers.description: aplum (branded Plum, Chinese 红布林) is a Beijing-based online marketplace for second-hand and pre-owned luxury fashion, founded in 2017. It runs C2B2C and B2B2C models — authenticating, grading, photographing, and reselling used designer apparel, handbags, watches, and accessories through its mobile app and website. Plum raised a $100M Series C from Zhuanzhuan Group in 2022, and earlier venture rounds from Qiming Venture Partners and Matrix Partners China. The platform is consumer-facing (Android app com.aplum.androidapp and mobile web m.aplum.com); it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal, so it is catalogued here as a company profile rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Apollo Shield
providers.description: ApolloShield develops counter-drone (counter-UAS / cUAS) systems that detect, classify, and neutralize unauthorized aerial threats. Its product suite spans RF detection sensors (omnidirectional Omni RF Sensor up to 1.5 km and directional sensors 2-5 km with triangulation), active-defense jammers (portable RF Gun under 4 kg, stationary, mobile, and vehicle-mounted RF Jammers), the integrated RF Sense&Block system, a CUAS vehicle, and a centralized Command Center that manages sensors and issues real-time alerts via SMS, email, and API. The platform uses AI-assisted RF fingerprinting to identify drone communications and can force unauthorized drones to return home. Command Center runs on-premise or cloud-based. Note: jammers cannot be sold in the United States except to federal government entities and require regulatory compliance in other jurisdictions. ApolloShield exposes no public developer API, documentation, SDK, or portal today; the only programmatic surface referenced is outbound Command Center alert delivery. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech.

providers.name: Apollomedicaloptics
providers.description: Apollomedicaloptics is a Taiwanese company specializing in non‑invasive visualization technology for medical applications. It develops advanced optical imaging systems used in ophthalmology and other clinical fields, aiming to improve diagnostic capabilities through innovative hardware and software solutions. The firm is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, and focuses on delivering high‑resolution, real‑time imaging to healthcare providers worldwide.

providers.name: Apotea
providers.description: Apotea is a Swedish online pharmacy offering a wide range of medicines, health and beauty products. The site provides fast, free shipping and a user-friendly shopping experience, with categories covering dermatology, allergy, eye care, and more. It operates under Swedish regulations and is listed on the Swedish Medicines Agency site. The company’s digital presence includes extensive product listings, a premium service, and a dedicated customer support portal.

providers.name: AquaShield
providers.description: AquaShield is a Y Combinator-backed (Spring 2026 / P26 batch) startup building AI-driven water leak detection for buildings and large real estate portfolios. Non-invasive sensors clamp onto existing pipes in minutes with no pipe cutting, retrofits, or downtime; the platform learns each building's normal water-flow patterns and flags anomalies in real time before they escalate into costly damage. Water damage is the largest preventable loss in real estate — more than fire and theft combined. Founded by former MIT and Harvard/EPFL robotics researchers Paul Beckers (CEO) and Marguerite Benoist (CTO), the company is based in San Francisco and works with some of the largest residential portfolios in the world. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; AquaShield currently publishes a marketing site only and does not yet expose a public API or developer program.

providers.name: ArbiLex
providers.description: ArbiLex is a legal-fintech startup founded at the Harvard Innovation Labs in 2018 by Isabel Yang that brings AI and predictive analytics to high-stakes international arbitration and litigation finance. Its Bayesian machine learning and NLP models — trained on a dataset of over nine million cases — produce empirical, explainable case ratings that help counsel quantify uncertainty, reduce errors, and value claims. ArbiLex also operates the ArbiLex Funding Exchange (AFX), a data-driven marketplace pairing AI-rated cases with litigation-finance capital. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global; no public developer API surface was found at time of enrichment.

providers.name: Archsystems
providers.description: Archsystems, also known as Architectural Systems, Inc., is a leading global provider of innovative, distinctive, and sustainable interior finishes. The company collaborates with architects, designers, and decision‑makers across market segments, offering material expertise, project management, material take‑offs, on‑site support, and a commitment to service. Their product lines include wood panels, porcelains, surfacing materials, and luxury vinyls, showcased through an online catalog and extensive resources.

providers.name: Arctherapeutics
providers.description: Arctherapeutics develops and provides specialized radiosurgical solutions for the treatment of brain metastases. The company partners with hospitals to deliver turnkey systems, including the Zap X radiosurgical unit, and offers comprehensive support ranging from facility design to virtual tumor boards. Their mission focuses on innovative management of metastatic brain tumors, integrating multidisciplinary clinical, technical, and operational expertise to improve patient outcomes.

providers.name: ARG
providers.description: GoodPeople (ARG) is a boardriding community platform and e-commerce brand for skiers and snowboarders, operating under the tagline "Where the boardriding family meets." It publishes freeride competition results and rankings across events such as the Freeride World Tour (FWT), the IFSA Freeride World Qualifier (FWQ), and the World Rookie Snowboard Finals, alongside a blog covering event highlights, athlete spotlights, and freeride footage. The company also runs an online shop selling apparel, accessories, and lifestyle products, with a sustainability program that plants one tree for every purchase. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. No public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Arilinc
providers.description: Aril Inc. (Arilinc) is a fabless semiconductor company in Los Gatos, California designing efficient AI processors and memory technology for edge inference. Its two core products are the Aril Standard Cell Memory, a patented on-chip memory offering roughly 40% lower active power and 3.6x smaller area, and a scalable RISC-V-based AI Processor Engine delivering hundreds of TOPS of inference per block with integrated vector and matrix engines. The company targets robotics, industrial automation, drones, defense and aerospace, autonomous vehicles, and edge vision systems where power efficiency is critical. Founded by a team of engineers who have collectively shipped 20M+ processors and worked on silicon for Cisco, Intel, AMD, and Google. Arilinc sells custom silicon and IP to hardware makers rather than a public developer API; it publishes no API, SDK, developer portal, or programmatic surface at this time.

providers.name: ARS Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: ARS Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing innovative therapies for rare diseases. The company operates globally with a strong pipeline of products and a commitment to patient care, research, and collaboration with healthcare partners. It maintains an investor relations site and corporate information portal, providing detailed product, pipeline, and regulatory information.

providers.name: Arthrosi Therapeutics
providers.description: Arthrosi Therapeutics, Inc. is a late-stage clinical biotechnology company founded in 2018 and headquartered in San Diego, California, by a team of gout specialists who previously led first-generation urate-transporter development at Ardea Biosciences. Its lead candidate, pozdeutinurad (AR882), is a once-daily oral next-generation URAT1 inhibitor in two fully enrolled replicate global Phase 3 trials (REDUCE 1 and REDUCE 2) for progressive and tophaceous gout, backed by roughly $299M in venture financing including a $153M Series E led by Prime Eight Capital. Sobi (Swedish Orphan Biovitrum) completed its acquisition of Arthrosi on 9 February 2026. Arthrosi is a drug developer, not a software company: it operates a WordPress corporate site with company, leadership and news pages, and publishes no developer portal, public API, SDK, package or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Arthurpharmaceuticals
providers.description: Arthurpharmaceuticals is a stub entry created from the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: secondary-market). Exhaustive web searches, including attempts to resolve domains such as arthurpharma.com and related listings, did not reveal a public website, documentation, or API endpoints. Consequently, detailed information about the company’s services, products, or API offerings is currently unavailable.

providers.name: asgoodasnew

providers.name: Assetplusf339
providers.description: AssetPlus is a digital wealth‑tech platform that provides tools and software for mutual fund distributors, financial advisors, and investment professionals to manage client portfolios and financial products through a unified system. Founded in 2016, it offers paper‑less onboarding, transaction processing, compliance handling, brokerage tracking, and reporting, supporting mutual funds, fixed deposits, pension plans, and insurance solutions with analytics and portfolio insights.

providers.name: Assist
providers.description: Assist (assi.st) was a San Francisco conversational-commerce platform founded in 2015 by Shane Mac, Giovanni Vatieri, and Geek Squad founder Robert Stephens, and backed by Slow Ventures. Assist built branded chatbot and voice assistant experiences that let consumers order, book, and pay inside messaging channels, running deployments for brands including Fandango, 1-800-Flowers, and Hyatt across Facebook Messenger, Telegram, Twitter, Apple Business Chat, Amazon Alexa, and Google Assistant, where it shipped one of the first Google Actions at launch in 2016. Conversocial acquired Assist in March 2019 and Shane Mac became Conversocial's Chief Automation Officer. The assi.st domain is now parked with no web host, and Assist never published a public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification, so there is no API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Ateamventures
providers.description: Ateamventures is a venture that focuses on personalized manufacturing, offering a platform that combines on‑demand 3D modeling with a network of local 3D printers. By providing a one‑stop‑shop for designers and inventors, it aims to reshape how hardware and software products are created, enabling rapid prototyping and small‑batch production. The company leverages AI and data analytics to streamline design workflows and connect customers with manufacturing resources, positioning itself at the intersection of advanced manufacturing and digital innovation.

providers.name: Athletes First
providers.description: Athletes First is a full-service sports representation and management agency founded in 2001 and headquartered in Southern California, with additional offices in New York City, Gainesville, Austin, and Atlanta. The firm represents elite NFL players, coaches, front-office executives, collegiate athletes, and sports broadcasters, and operates specialized departments spanning football contract negotiation, career management, pre-draft preparation, talent marketing and brand building, broadcasting and new media, media development and sales, and properties and events. In February 2023, Mastry Ventures in partnership with General Catalyst acquired a majority stake in the agency. This profile was surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company (sector: consumer) and added to the API Evangelist network. Athletes First publishes no public developer, API, or technical surface.

providers.name: Atia Vision
providers.description: Atia Vision, Inc. is a clinical-stage ophthalmic medical device company headquartered in Campbell, California, and a portfolio company of the Shifamed medical innovation hub. It develops the OmniVu modular shape-changing intraocular lens (IOL) — a two-part implant pairing a fluid-filled, shape-changing base with an exchangeable fixed-power front optic — designed to work with the eye's natural accommodative mechanism to restore a full range of functional vision in cataract patients, and implanted using conventional cataract surgical technique. The company raised a $20M Series D and a $42M Series E, and in May 2025 the U.S. Food and Drug Administration granted it an Investigational Device Exemption to begin a feasibility clinical study of the OmniVu Lens System; the device is investigational and is not approved for sale or use in the United States. Atia Vision is an implantable-device manufacturer: it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable specification.
