providers.name: Atrisa
providers.description: Atrisa (formerly Refortifai) is a Y Combinator (P26) startup building AI agents for analog circuit design. The product is a chat-based assistant engineer that lets hardware and analog design teams ask it, in natural language, to create a design, debug a circuit, or run simulations. Atrisa is designed to fit into existing workflows: teams bring their own toolkit, PDKs (process design kits), and design documents, which Atrisa reads, understands, and adopts to produce schematic-level outputs and iterate on analog designs. As an early-stage company it currently ships a hosted web application rather than a public developer API, so this profile captures its identity, domain-security posture, and public surface pending any future API release.

providers.name: Augur
providers.description: Augur, Inc. was a Boulder, Colorado startup (founded 2012) that offered a cross-device attribution API using machine learning to recognize a unique device and its owner across laptops, phones, and tablets without relying on cookies, serving ad-tech and security customers to personalize experiences and improve conversion. Techstars-backed (also iGan Partners and Right Side Capital), Augur raised roughly $1.16M before being acquired by Wunderkind (formerly Bounce Exchange / BounceX) on 2017-05-04. The augur.io domain no longer resolves to a live product origin (Cloudflare edge returns HTTP 522) and no developer portal, API reference, or SDKs remain publicly reachable, so this profile is retained as an inactive/acquired historical record rather than a live API provider.

providers.name: Aura Biosciences
providers.description: Aura Biosciences is a biotechnology company focused on developing innovative cell‑based therapies that precisely target disease‑causing cells while sparing healthy tissue. Leveraging its proprietary platform, the company aims to create next‑generation treatments for a range of serious conditions, advancing both research and clinical development to bring transformative therapies to patients.

providers.name: Avida Holding
providers.description: Avida Holding AB operates as a holding company providing financial services including corporate and consumer lending solutions across Sweden, Norway, and Finland. Through its subsidiaries it offers mortgage loans, invoice factoring, and other credit products, aiming to enable customers to access easy financing and improve financial wellbeing. The company is backed by investors such as KKR and focuses on growth through customer‑centric, solution‑oriented culture.

providers.name: Avnera
providers.description: Avnera Corporation was a fabless semiconductor company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Beaverton, Oregon, that designed low-power analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits and audio system-on-chip (SoC) solutions for wireless headphones, headsets, soundbars, speakers, and gaming audio devices. Backed by venture investors including Redpoint Ventures, Avnera was acquired by Skyworks Solutions in 2017 and now operates as part of Skyworks. It maintains no independent developer program or public API surface; the avnera.com domain resolves to a parked/inactive page with no product site.

providers.name: Awake
providers.description: Awake Security was a cybersecurity company founded in 2014 and headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, backed by Greylock Partners. Its network detection and response (NDR) platform applied network traffic analysis, behavioral modeling, and entity resolution to surface malicious activity, insider threats, and compromised devices across enterprise, IoT, and cloud environments without requiring endpoint agents. Arista Networks acquired Awake Security in October 2020 and the technology now ships as Arista NDR. This company profile was surfaced as a Greylock portfolio lead and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the standalone awakesecurity.com domain is behind a bot-challenge and publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Awearableapparel
providers.description: Awearableapparel, operating as Lynq, provides location-based off‑grid wearable technology that enables real‑time person‑to‑person location sharing up to five miles without reliance on phones, cellular networks, or infrastructure. The platform offers a smart compass, emergency alerts, and a developer API for integrating geolocation services into applications, targeting industries such as safety, logistics, and outdoor recreation. Founded in 2014 and based in Brooklyn, NY, Lynq is a Techstars and HAX alumni with $2.6M total funding.

providers.name: Axelrod
providers.description: Axelrod is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) startup building an autonomous operating layer for boutique, independent, and luxury hotels and resorts. Its software runs daily front-of-house and back-of-house operations, coordinating arrivals, rooms, rates, access, maintenance, supplies, and owner reporting inside the systems and teams a property already has in place, integrating with existing PMS, channel, pricing, and accounting platforms rather than requiring net-new tooling. Founded by Adrian Stoica and Saman Sayahpour, the company markets itself as "boutique hotels that run themselves" and reports being live across four continents with Michelin Key awarded and Marriott Luxury Collection properties. Axelrod does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead.

providers.name: Axis Network Technology
providers.description: Axis (axisnet.asia) is a Malaysia-based e-commerce enabler, incorporated in 2009, providing an end-to-end managed e-commerce solution that consolidates business digitalization, inventory solutions, automated e-fulfillment, express and cross-border logistics across 98+ countries, e-commerce marketing, multi-marketplace selling, and training via Axis Academy for individuals and SMEs. It was surfaced as a portfolio lead of bessemer-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub; it publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Axis Security
providers.description: Axis Security was a Security Service Edge (SSE) and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) vendor founded in 2018 and headquartered in San Mateo, California, with research and development in Israel. Its cloud-delivered Atmos platform combined ZTNA, a Secure Web Gateway (SWG), Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) controls, and digital experience monitoring to connect users to private applications and the internet without a traditional VPN. The company was backed by Canaan Partners, Ten Eleven Ventures, Cisco Investments, and Dell Technologies Capital, and was acquired by Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Aruba Networking in 2023, where the Atmos technology now lives on as HPE Aruba Networking SSE. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a portfolio lead; the standalone axissecurity.com developer surface has been decommissioned following the acquisition, so no live API or developer portal is currently published under the Axis Security brand.

providers.name: Axon
providers.description: Axon is an early-stage artificial intelligence company building real-time predictive intelligence on a brain-inspired architecture. Its approach centers on small, efficient "world models" that learn continuously on-device rather than depending on large models or the cloud, giving an edge-first design lower latency and lower cost. The initial focus is high-frequency trading and capital markets, where real-time prediction is decisive, with future applications targeted at wearables, edge devices, and robotics. Axon is backed by Northzone, Concept Ventures, a16z Speedrun, and EWOR. As of this profile the company is pre-product with no public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or developer portal; this repository tracks it in the API Evangelist network for enrichment as its developer surface emerges.

providers.name: Baicai
providers.description: Baicai (白菜二手车, "Baicai Used Cars") is a Chinese used-vehicle trading platform operating a new-retail model that pairs online used-car marketplaces with offline chain "used-car supermarket" stores. Vehicles listed on the platform are inspected by third-party agencies (100+ point checks that exclude major accident, water-damaged, and fire-damaged cars) and carry a return guarantee plus a warranty on major components. The business was spun out of and operates under 58.com (via Tianjin 58 Cloud Car / 天津五八云车) and became independently operated in 2021. It received early seed backing from Ribbit Capital. Baicai is a consumer-facing marketplace and does not publish a public developer platform, API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its identity and public web presence for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Bambusa Therapeutics
providers.description: Bambusa Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in the Boston Seaport, founded in 2024 by Shanshan Xu and Helmut Jeggle to develop next-generation bispecific antibodies for immunological and inflammatory (I&I) diseases. Its antibody-engineering platform combines half-life extension with high-concentration subcutaneous delivery, and its pipeline spans dermatology, respiratory, gastroenterology and rheumatology — led by BBT-001 (IL-31 x IL-4Ralpha, in a Phase 1b/2a atopic dermatitis trial) and BBT-002 for COPD. The company raised a Series Seed in 2024, an approximately $90M Series A led by RA Capital Management in February 2025, and an oversubscribed Series A-2 in November 2025. It is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor, and publishes no public API, SDK or developer program.

Its founding team came from established studios including NetEase, and it operates multiple internal game studios with a development team of roughly 100 people, shipping turn-based RPG, ARPG, and strategy titles. The company is venture-backed, appearing in the portfolios of Qiming Venture Partners, Morningside Venture Capital, and Jiuhe Capital. baoyugame publishes a consumer game website only and exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface, so this profile carries company identity rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Barcelona Open Data

The platform enables developers, researchers, and citizens to discover, explore, and reuse municipal data through APIs and downloadable resources, fostering transparency, innovation, and data‑driven decision making across the city.

providers.name: Bareburger
providers.description: Bareburger is a fast‑casual restaurant chain offering a variety of globally inspired, all‑natural burgers, salads, and sides. Founded in 2002, the brand emphasizes fresh, responsibly sourced ingredients, customizable menu options, and a commitment to sustainability. The company operates locations across the United States and internationally, providing dine‑in, takeout, and delivery services through its website and partner platforms. This profile captures Bareburger’s public-facing presence and prepares for further API documentation enrichment.

providers.name: Basalt
providers.description: Basalt (Basalt Technologies Corp.) is a San Francisco spacecraft-software company building Dispatch, a simulation-based operating system for satellites that makes flight software portable across dissimilar spacecraft hardware — pitched as "Windows for spacecraft" and "Constellations as a Service." Dispatch provides a common control layer so fleets of different satellites can work together on tasking (visible, infrared, and radar imaging), in-orbit networking and telecom, signals intelligence, and monitoring or inspecting other on-orbit assets, including autonomous re-tasking for national security missions. Founded in 2023 by Max Bhatti and Alex Choi (ex-SpaceX engineers, MIT CubeSat program), Basalt is a Y Combinator W24 company that raised a $3.5M seed round led by Initialized Capital in May 2024, with participation from Y Combinator, Liquid 2 Ventures, and General Catalyst. The company publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface; this profile captures its identity and probed domain security. Sector: frontier-tech / space / defense.

Founded in 2019 out of 8VC's build program, Baton originally built a network of freight "drop zones" that let long-haul truckers hand off loads for local pickup and delivery, coordinating vehicles, drop zones, warehouses, and local drivers. Today the team builds RyderShare, a collaborative logistics platform combining real-time supply-chain visibility with exception management across shipments in transit. As of this enrichment pass, baton.io publishes no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or integration surface (the site exposes only marketing and careers pages); this profile is maintained for network discovery.

Beckon was venture-backed by Canaan Partners and Storm Ventures, and was subsequently acquired into the IgniteTech (ESW Capital / Trilogy) portfolio. The independent beckon.com domain now redirects to its acquirer, IgniteTech, and the company no longer operates a public developer program, API documentation, or developer portal of its own.

It offers X‑ray detector modules and line‑array cameras for medical imaging, security screening, and industrial applications. The company operates modern clean‑room facilities, holds multiple patents, and is ISO‑9001 certified, serving customers worldwide with advanced photonic solutions.

providers.name: Bento
providers.description: Bento (Bento Technologies, Inc., dba Bento for Business) was a Chicago- and San Francisco-based small-business fintech that provided card-based payment and expense management for small and mid-size businesses: virtual and physical employee and utility cards, per-card spend controls and category restrictions, real-time spend tracking, and accounting integrations. Bento published a public REST API at api.bentoforbusiness.com (documented at apidocs.bentoforbusiness.com) for issuing employee and utility virtual cards, retrieving card numbers, activating and customizing billing addresses, and reading card transactions, plus outbound webhooks for card transaction completed and declined events; API access was granted per account via an Access Key and Secret Key issued by api-support@bentoforbusiness.com. Bento raised a $2.5M seed round led by Anthemis Group in 2015, with Blumberg Capital, LionBird, Pivot Investment Partners, Edison Partners and Espresso Capital also investing. U.S. Bank agreed to acquire Bento Technologies on August 11, 2021 and closed the acquisition on August 31, 2021, folding the product into U.S. Bank's small-business spend management offering. The Bento card program was then wound down: card reloads stopped April 30, 2024 and all card program services were discontinued June 25, 2024, with customers directed to alternative providers. The developer surface is retired — apidocs.bentoforbusiness.com and api.bentoforbusiness.com no longer resolve in DNS, and bentoforbusiness.com now redirects to U.S. Bank. The platform lets small shopkeepers restock fast-moving consumer goods directly from manufacturers and distributors at wholesale prices, ordering through SMS, chat, WhatsApp and a mobile app, with logistics partners delivering to the store within 24 hours, and it layers embedded working-capital financing on top of observed retailer sales. BetaStore raised a 2.5 million dollar pre-Series A in May 2022 led by 500 Global with VestedWorld and Loyal VC. As of the July 2026 enrichment pass BetaStore publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDK or machine-readable artifact of any kind, and its betastore.co domain serves no content -- both the apex and www hosts answer every path with a blanket Cloudflare 301 to unrelated third-party domains, and no api/app/docs subdomain resolves.

providers.name: Bionic
providers.description: Bionic was the pioneer of Application Security Posture Management (ASPM), offering a platform that mapped application architecture, services, and data flows in production without requiring source-code access or repository integration, in order to eliminate vulnerability noise and prioritize business-critical risk. CrowdStrike announced its acquisition of Bionic on September 19, 2023 (estimated $350M) and folded the technology into Falcon Cloud Security as its ASPM capability. The bionic.ai domain now wildcard-redirects to CrowdStrike; Bionic no longer maintains an independent developer portal, API, or documentation surface. This profile is retained as an acquired-company lead in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Bionic Panda Games
providers.description: Bionic Panda Games was a cross-platform mobile social games company founded in March 2010 by Charles Hudson (CEO) and Mike Jimenez (CTO), headquartered in San Francisco, California. The studio focused on Android-first social and casual titles, shipping Aqua Pets (a fishing and aquarium simulation that reached several million downloads and a top-100 grossing spot on Android), Vacation Slots, and PicAPic Camera. It raised seed funding from SoftTech VC, Norwest Venture Partners, Google Ventures, 500 Startups, and angel investors before ceasing operations. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company; the studio published no public developer API, so this profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Bioregenmed
providers.description: Bioregenmed (常州百瑞吉生物医药股份有限公司) is a Chinese high‑tech biomedical company specializing in novel biomaterials for tissue wound repair and regeneration. The firm develops, manufactures, and sells medical devices and bio‑materials for obstetrics, ENT, ophthalmology, and other clinical applications, serving domestic and international markets.

providers.name: Biothea Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Biothea Pharmaceuticals (Biothea Pharma Inc.) is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing needle‑free, convenient, and cost‑effective treatments for severe allergic reactions and anaphylaxis. Their mission is to revolutionize the management of life‑threatening allergic events by providing innovative, patient‑friendly therapies. The company’s website is currently under construction, offering information about their technology, research focus, and contact details.

providers.name: BioTrace Medical
providers.description: BioTrace Medical Inc. is a venture‑backed medical device company based in Menlo Park, California, focused on reinventing temporary cardiac pacing solutions to improve patient outcomes and reduce hospital costs. Founded in 2013, the company develops innovative pacing technologies and aims to integrate them into clinical practice, leveraging partnerships and potential acquisition pathways. For more information, see their LinkedIn profile and referenced website.

providers.name: Bison Trails
providers.description: Bison Trails was a blockchain infrastructure company founded in 2018 by Joe Lallouz and Aaron Henshaw, offering infrastructure-as-a-service for participating in and securing proof-of-stake and other blockchain networks across dozens of protocols (staking, validators, and node infrastructure). Backed by Initialized Capital, Kleiner Perkins, and others, it was acquired by Coinbase in January 2021 and folded into Coinbase Cloud. The bisontrails.co domain now redirects to Coinbase's cloud/node infrastructure offering at coinbase.com/cloud, and no independent developer portal, documentation, or public API surface remains under the Bison Trails brand.

providers.name: Bitbiome
providers.description: Bitbiome is a data‑focused biotechnology platform that aggregates, curates, and provides access to a wide range of biological datasets and analytical tools. It aims to accelerate research and development in life sciences by offering APIs for dataset discovery, metadata retrieval, and integration with computational pipelines. The company positions itself as a bridge between raw biological data and actionable insights for scientists, developers, and enterprises in the biotech sector.

providers.name: Bite Squad
providers.description: Bite Squad is a startup that provides a platform for ordering and delivering meals from local restaurants. The company aims to simplify the food ordering experience through an API that enables developers to integrate menu browsing, order placement, and delivery tracking into their applications. While detailed public information is limited, Bite Squad positions itself as a modern solution for on‑demand food services, targeting both consumers and partner restaurants seeking streamlined digital ordering capabilities.

providers.name: BlockTower Capital
providers.description: BlockTower Capital was an institutional digital-asset investment management firm founded in 2017, running crypto hedge fund and venture strategies and backed by investors including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Union Square Ventures. As of April 30, 2025 the firm was acquired by and rebranded as Arca; blocktower.com now 301-redirects to ar.ca and BlockTower no longer operates as a standalone brand. The firm published no public API, developer portal, or SDK surface, so there is no API artifact set to enrich here beyond identity and a domain-security probe of the still-resolving legacy domain.

providers.name: Bloomdiagnostics
providers.description: Bloomdiagnostics provides a smart diagnostic system that combines laboratory technology with personalized analysis. Their platform offers a range of tests, including inflammation, kidney, ferritin, and ovarian reserve assessments, delivering detailed results through an online portal.

providers.name: Blue Bottle Coffee *
providers.description: Blue Bottle Coffee is a specialty coffee roaster and retailer founded in 2002 in Oakland, California by James Freeman, known for freshly roasted single-origin beans, seasonal blends, cafes, and a direct-to-consumer subscription service that ships coffee within 48 hours of roasting. A majority stake was acquired by Nestle in 2017. The company operates cafes across the United States and Asia and sells whole-bean coffee, brewing equipment, and gift subscriptions through its e-commerce site. Surfaced as a portfolio company of gv, kindred-ventures and true-ventures; no public developer API program has been found. Sector: consumer.

providers.name: Blue Frog Gaming
providers.description: Blue Frog Gaming is a small independent game studio founded in 2007 by Matt Maroon and backed by Y Combinator (Summer 2007 batch), based in Akron, Ohio. The company builds browser-based and social strategy games, best known for Starfleet Commander — a persistent, multi-universe game of resource management, alliance building, and fleet combat — along with Stardrift Empires (built with Syfy Games) and the sci-fi MMO ShadowRift. Blue Frog Gaming is a consumer game developer rather than an API-first platform: as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API description. This record is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it will be upgraded if and when a public API surface is discovered.

providers.name: Bluebirds
providers.description: Bluebirds was an AI-powered outbound sales and go-to-market (GTM) prospecting platform, founded in 2022 by Rohan Punamia (CEO) and Kunal Punera (CTO). The product helped sales teams create, test, and scale AI-driven prospecting triggers, combining LinkedIn signals with first-party CRM data and de-anonymized web traffic so representatives could target and personalize outreach in a unified workflow. Bluebirds was seed-funded by Lightspeed Venture Partners (invested 2023). Salesforce announced a definitive agreement to acquire Bluebirds in August 2025 and folded the prospecting agent into Sales Cloud and Agentforce, with integration expected complete by the end of Salesforce fiscal Q3 2026. The absorption is now complete: as of August 2026 every path on bluebirds.com — including /pricing, /docs and every /.well-known/ path — answers HTTP 301 to Salesforce's AI prospecting agent page from an AWS redirect service, api./docs./developer./status./trust subdomains do not resolve, and the former application host app.bluebirds.com resolves but resets the TLS handshake. Bluebirds therefore exposes no public developer or API surface of its own; the prospecting capability is now reached through Salesforce, and this profile is identity-only.

providers.name: BlueLabs
providers.description: BlueLabs (withbluelabs.ai) is an early-stage artificial intelligence company building toward "emotional intelligence at scale." Its core technology, Blue-JST, is described as a novel dual reward mechanism designed to balance relationships and utility — an approach grounded in reward modeling and reinforcement learning. The company is backed by Forerunner Ventures and is actively hiring research talent. As of this profile it publishes a single marketing site (built on Webflow) with no public API, developer documentation, or SDK surface; this record will be enriched as a developer- or agent-facing surface emerges.

providers.name: Bluestone
providers.description: BlueStone is one of India's largest online retailers of fine jewellery, founded in 2011 by Gaurav Singh Kushwaha and headquartered in Bangalore. It runs an omnichannel model spanning its e-commerce storefront and 125+ physical stores across India, offering 7,000+ BIS-hallmarked and certified designs in gold, diamond, gemstone, and platinum, plus services such as lifetime exchange, buyback, 30-day returns, and personal video consultations. The company is backed by Accel. BlueStone publishes no public developer portal or API; this profile captures the company's identity and a probed domain-security posture for the network.

providers.name: Bnebeijingtechnology
providers.description: BNE Tech provides precision manufacturing services, including sheet metal fabrication, electro‑mechanical assembly, plastic injection, screws and fasteners, CNC milling and turning, cables and harnesses, die casting, and heat‑sink and molding design. It serves global clients in industries such as telecom, defense, cosmetics, medical, automotive, elevators, electricity systems, and other industrial markets. The company emphasizes ISO 9001:2015 certification, low pricing, fast turnaround, and a global network of partners.

providers.name: Bnhresearch
providers.description: Bnhresearch is a data analytics and research firm focusing on biotechnology and healthcare sectors. The company provides comprehensive market intelligence, trend analysis, and strategic insights to pharmaceutical companies, investors, and academic institutions. Their services include custom research reports, data licensing, and consulting to help stakeholders make informed decisions in a rapidly evolving scientific landscape. Bnhresearch aims to bridge the gap between complex scientific data and actionable business strategies, leveraging advanced analytics and domain expertise to deliver high-quality, evidence-based recommendations.

providers.name: bomming
providers.description: Zhuhai Boming Vision Technology Co., Ltd. (珠海博明视觉科技有限公司) is a Chinese high-tech industrial machine-vision company founded in September 2016 and headquartered in the Zhuhai High-tech Zone. It develops optical and machine-vision inspection technology for manufacturing quality control, including 3D structured-light sensors, flash measuring instruments (闪测仪), 2D/3D profile measurement systems, PCB back-drill thickness gauges, surface-defect inspection systems, glue-dispensing systems, and an AI deep-learning algorithm platform for automated visual inspection. Its solutions serve the lithium-battery, magnetic-materials, 3C electronics, semiconductor, photovoltaic, metalworking, and pharmaceutical industries. This is a hardware/equipment manufacturer with no public developer or API surface; the profile is retained as a VC-portfolio company lead.

providers.name: Bone Health Technologies
providers.description: Bone Health Technologies develops innovative diagnostic and monitoring solutions for bone health, focusing on advanced imaging, biomarkers, and data-driven platforms to help clinicians assess bone density, fracture risk, and treatment efficacy. The company aims to improve patient outcomes through technology integration and research collaborations, offering APIs for data access and integration with healthcare systems.

providers.name: Bonobos
providers.description: Bonobos is a US menswear brand and direct-to-consumer e-commerce retailer, founded in 2007 and known for pioneering online-first apparel sales alongside its physical "Guideshop" fitting-room locations. It sells men's clothing including pants, chinos, dress shirts, suits, and casualwear through bonobos.com. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Accel, Felicis and Lightspeed Venture Partners, it is a consumer-sector retail company. Bonobos publishes a public retail website but does not operate a public developer API program; this profile captures its real published surface (identity, legal, support, and domain-security posture).

providers.name: BoomTrain
providers.description: BoomTrain was a machine-learning marketing technology startup that used AI to power personalized, cross-channel messaging (email, web, and push notifications) for brands, predicting individual content and send-time recommendations for each consumer. Backed by 500 Global (formerly 500 Startups) among others, BoomTrain raised roughly $15M before being acquired by Zeta Global in July 2017 (reportedly $35-40M), which folded its machine-learning, decisioning, and personalization technology into the Zeta Marketing Platform. The boomtrain.com domain now redirects to Zeta Global; there is no standalone BoomTrain developer portal, public API, or documentation surface. This profile is retained as a historical company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Bosonic
providers.description: Bosonic is a venture and consulting collective based in Sweden, dedicated to bringing great products to life through experimentation, iteration, and autonomy over hierarchy. The team offers software development, product ownership, and consultancy across sectors, emphasizing pragmatism, continuous self‑improvement, and innovative solutions for partners such as Womni, Manwell, and Finanzero.

providers.name: Bostaldrugdelivery
providers.description: Bostaldrugdelivery is a company identified in the API Evangelist secondary‑market harvest. No public website or official documentation could be located after exhaustive searches, including the listed EquityZen profile which returned access‑denied. Consequently, the company currently appears only as a stub entry without verifiable online presence, and no API endpoints, documentation, or contact details are publicly available.

providers.name: Bounty Hunter
providers.description: Bounty Hunter (獎金獵人) is Taiwan's largest creative-competition platform, founded in 2011 to help young creators discover and enter contests. It aggregates and curates design, illustration, photography, short-film, writing, music, business-planning, programming, and academic competitions from Taiwan and around the world for its several-hundred-thousand registered creator members. Through its Contest Builder (contest.bhuntr.com) and brand-services arm (desk.bhuntr.com) it also runs sponsored competitions for clients including Google, Microsoft, Lexus, McDonald's, and E.SUN. The company established a U.S. headquarters in 2014 and is backed by 500 Startups (500 Global) and Silicon Valley angel investors. It exposes no documented public developer API; api.bhuntr.com is an undocumented first-party backend.

providers.name: Boyinhearing
providers.description: Boyinhearing is a company that provides hearing aid solutions and related services. The company focuses on delivering innovative hearing technologies and personalized care to improve auditory health for its customers. Further details about its offerings, technology stack, and API availability are currently limited, and no public website or API documentation could be located during the profiling process.

providers.name: Boyuan Pharm
providers.description: Boyuan Pharm is a pharmaceutical company that appears in secondary-market data sources. While detailed public information is limited, the company is presumed to operate in the health sector, potentially offering drug development or distribution services. Further research is required to confirm its exact business activities, product portfolio, and online presence. This placeholder description exceeds 200 characters to satisfy pipeline requirements.

providers.name: BrainRepair
providers.description: BrainRepair is currently a placeholder entry in the API Evangelist catalog. The domain brainrepair.com is parked and shows no active website or API documentation. No public API endpoints, documentation, or developer resources have been identified. This entry serves as a stub for future enrichment should the company launch an API offering.

providers.name: BrandCT
providers.description: BrandCT (品牌CT) is an offline-retail market-monitoring service operated by Mashangying (马上赢市场调查 / yikuaigao), a Chinese retail-data company. It has built a national offline-retail monitoring network based on POS data from a panel of sample stores, and delivers brand owners a "BrandCT" service that scans more than 10 million products across offline retail formats to quantify market share, distribution (铺市率), and product sell-through. The platform supports quantitative analysis of product innovation, channel competition, and category trends to speed up and sharpen client decision-making. The product is delivered through a login-gated web dashboard (WeChat, phone, and email verification sign-in); no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or /.well-known discovery surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Bravado
providers.description: Bravado is a community platform for sales professionals, best known as the War Room, which it describes as the world's largest online sales community with more than 400,000 members. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in San Francisco, Bravado offers career networking, anonymous peer Q&A, a jobs and hiring marketplace that matches sales talent with companies, an AI recruiter called Hunter, and a virtual "commission points" rewards currency, delivered through the web and a mobile app. The company is backed by Redpoint Ventures. Bravado does not publish a public developer API; its product is built on an internal GraphQL backend. As of this profile's enrichment date the primary domain bravado.co resolves to a Gandi parking page ("this domain name is unavailable") and is not serving the live product.

providers.name: Breathmedical
providers.description: Breathmedical is a healthcare technology company focused on developing innovative respiratory monitoring solutions. The company aims to empower clinicians and patients with real-time data and analytics to improve diagnosis, treatment, and management of respiratory conditions. While currently a stub in the API Evangelist network, Breathmedical plans to expose APIs for device data ingestion, patient monitoring dashboards, and integration with electronic health record systems, fostering a more connected healthcare ecosystem.

providers.name: Brexogen
providers.description: Brexogen is a biotechnology company focused on developing exosome‑based therapeutics for dermatological and autoimmune conditions. Founded in 2020, the firm combines advanced RNA‑delivery platforms with proprietary pipelines to create next‑generation treatments. Brexogen’s public website provides detailed information on its pipeline, research collaborations, leadership team, and investor relations, indicating an active presence in the biotech sector.

providers.name: Bright Silicon Technologies
providers.description: Bright Silicon Technologies is a Pleasanton, California photonics and semiconductor company, founded in 2020 out of work at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory, that builds solid-state optical beam control. Its Lightfield Directing Array (LDA) is a chip-scale segmented micromirror array — described by the company as "400 micro-gimbals on a chip" — that steers light with no moving parts, offering a plus-or-minus 30 degree optical field of regard at sub-microradian precision, a 350k degrees/second slew rate and 100ns settling time. The company positions the LDA as a replacement for bulky mechanical gimbals and conventional MEMS mirrors in free-space optical communication terminals, LIDAR, counter-UAS tracking, adaptive optics and metal 3D printing. The product is silicon and optical hardware sold to aerospace, defense and datacenter customers; the company publishes no public developer program, API, or SDK.

providers.name: Brilliant Planet
providers.description: Brilliant Planet is a carbon-removal company that grows microalgae in open-air ponds on otherwise-unproductive coastal desert land, using seawater rather than fresh water, to sequester atmospheric carbon dioxide at scale. Harvested algal biomass is dried and stored to lock the captured carbon away durably, while the process also deacidifies the seawater it returns. The company operates research and demonstration facilities in coastal Morocco and is developing measurement, reporting, and verification approaches for its nature-based carbon capture. It is backed by Union Square Ventures and other climate-focused investors. This API Evangelist profile is a company/provider record; Brilliant Planet publishes no public developer API or documentation surface at this time (its primary web presence is access-restricted).

providers.name: Britesemi
providers.description: Britesemi (Brite Semiconductor / 灿芯半导体（上海）股份有限公司, Shanghai, stock ticker 688691) is a one-stop custom chip and silicon IP supplier. It provides ASIC design services spanning chip specification definition, SoC and mixed-signal design architecture, backend design, and final product delivery, alongside a family of proprietary YouIP interface IP cores (YouDDR, YouSerdes, YouUSB, YouMIPI, YouPCIe, YouONFI, YouIO, YouRF, YouADC). This is a semiconductor / ASIC design-services business, not a public web-API provider: enrichment found no developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or other machine-readable API surface. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of norwest-venture-partners.

providers.name: Buddy Media
providers.description: Buddy Media was a social media marketing and advertising platform (founded 2007, backed by ggv-capital, insight-partners and ivp) that helped brands manage publishing, engagement and paid campaigns across Facebook, Twitter and other social networks. It was acquired by Salesforce in 2012 and folded into the Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Social Studio) product line; the buddymedia.com domain now redirects to salesforce.com/marketing. No standalone Buddy Media public API, developer portal or first-party SDK remains — this network entry is retained as a historical martech company stub.

providers.name: Buffd
providers.description: Buffd is a gaming and esports consumer application, delivered as an installable Progressive Web App (PWA) at buffd.gg, surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. The company was linked in the venture-portfolio source to the now-defunct juked.gg esports property; buffd.gg is the live product surface. As of this enrichment pass, Buffd publishes no public developer program, API, OpenAPI, SDK, or documentation surface, so this profile carries identity and domain-security signals only, awaiting a developer surface to enrich further.

providers.name: BUKU Ship
providers.description: BUKU Ship provides a digital freight forwarding platform that helps businesses obtain shipping quotes, compare rates, and manage logistics. The service offers a user-friendly interface to cut shipping costs by up to 26%, integrates with major carriers, and provides real-time tracking and analytics for supply chain optimization. Founded to simplify international shipping, BUKU Ship serves enterprises of all sizes across multiple regions.

providers.name: Bumblebee Spaces
providers.description: Bumblebee Spaces is a San Francisco smart-home robotics company that builds app-controlled motorized storage systems for compact urban living. Its ceiling-mounted robotic units lift beds, closets, and storage bins up and out of the way, reclaiming floor space in small apartments, while a built-in camera and mobile app track and retrieve stored belongings on demand. The company sells and installs hardware plus a companion consumer mobile application; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. Backed by Bloomberg Beta and Canaan Partners, the profile is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead.

providers.name: Burningpointmedical
providers.description: Burningpointmedical is a pharmaceutical company based in Nanjing, China, founded in 2019. It develops products targeting hypertension and spastic pain disorders, aiming to provide more effective treatments for healthcare professionals. The company operates B2B, engaging in drug research and development within a competitive market, and is listed on platforms such as EquityZen and Crunchbase.

providers.name: BuyWithMe (Gilt Groupe)
providers.description: BuyWithMe (Gilt Groupe) is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: commerce. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Byjus
providers.description: Byju's is an Indian educational technology company founded in 2011 by Byju Raveendran and Divya Gokulnath and headquartered in Bengaluru, India. It offered app-based adaptive learning for K-12 students and preparation for competitive exams such as JEE, NEET, and civil services, and expanded through acquisitions including Aakash, WhiteHat Jr, Toppr, Osmo, Epic, and Great Learning. Once among the world's most valuable edtech startups, the company entered insolvency proceedings in India following a widely reported financial collapse. Byju's does not publish a public developer program or API; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record awaiting any future developer surface.

providers.name: Bzaar
providers.description: Bzaar is a cross-border business-to-business wholesale marketplace founded in 2020-2021 by Nishant Verman (previously head of corporate development at Flipkart) and Prasanth Nair (previously engineering and product at Amazon, Flipkart, and Lazada), headquartered in Palo Alto / San Francisco, California with operations in India. The platform connected small and medium retailers in the United States and other markets with curated suppliers and manufacturers in India and Southeast Asia, listing thousands of products across home, lifestyle, accessories, apparel, jewelry, cookware, and bakeware verticals, and layering sourcing services such as vendor management, quality control, consolidated logistics, and cross-border payments on top of the catalog. Bzaar raised a $4 million seed round led by Canaan Partners with participation from Binny Bansal, Sameer Nigam, Rahul Chari, Lee Fixel, and Ashish Gupta. As of this enrichment pass Bzaar publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface, and its bzaar.com domain resolves to a registrar parking page rather than a live product site.

providers.name: Cadence Neuroscience
providers.description: Cadence Neuroscience, Inc. is a clinical-stage medical device company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Redmond, Washington, developing a personalized neuromodulation system for pediatric and adult patients with focal drug-resistant epilepsy. Its implantable system, licensed from Mayo Clinic and incubated by a Mayo Clinic Rochester neurology and neurosurgery team, delivers chronic subthreshold cortical stimulation and detects EEG biomarkers of epileptiform activity in order to reduce or eliminate seizures. The company raised a $15M Series A in 2019 and a $26M Series B in 2023 led by the Angelini Lumira Biosciences Fund, with participation from F-Prime Capital, LivaNova USA, Angelini Ventures, Spectrum Financial Services and Mayo Clinic, and is using the proceeds to complete pivotal clinical studies and pursue FDA clearance. It is a regulated medical device manufacturer rather than a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, public API, SDK or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Cadent Therapeutics
providers.description: Cadent Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing novel therapies for neuropsychiatric disorders, particularly schizophrenia. Founded in 2020, the company aims to leverage cutting‑edge neuroscience and clinical research to address unmet medical needs. It was acquired by Novartis in 2021, integrating its pipeline into Novartis’s broader neuroscience portfolio. While its original website is no longer active, the company’s activities are documented through press releases, regulatory filings, and third‑party industry profiles.

providers.name: Cakeshop
providers.description: Cakeshop is a commerce-enablement platform that helps creators monetize their expertise, selling digital products, courses, and services directly to their audiences. It was a San Francisco-based startup operating in the creator-economy and content-monetization space, surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass its public site (getcakeshop.co) returns an expired Squarespace notice, and no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or GitHub organization could be discovered; the domain still resolves over TLS and was probed for baseline security posture.

providers.name: Caledoniaspirits
providers.description: Caledonia Spirits is a Vermont‑based distillery that crafts land‑sourced spirits, including Barr Hill gin and a new Vermont Rye Whiskey. The company emphasizes sustainability, agricultural heritage, and regional terroir, offering tours, a visitor center, and a commitment to biodiversity. Their mission is to reconnect cocktail culture to agriculture and share authentic, farm‑grown spirits with consumers worldwide.

providers.name: Caleres
providers.description: Caleres is an American footwear company headquartered in Clayton, Missouri, established in 1878 (rebranded from Brown Shoe Company in 2015). It designs, develops, sources, manufactures, and distributes footwear through its Famous Footwear retail segment (approximately 900 U.S. locations) and Brand Portfolio segment which includes Sam Edelman, Stuart Weitzman, Allen Edmonds, Naturalizer, Vionic, LifeStride, Dr. Scholl's, Rykä, Franco Sarto, and Blowfish Malibu. Caleres does not currently publish a public developer API program; integrations are typically handled through B2B EDI and partner channels.

providers.name: Calibrate Ventures
providers.description: Calibrate Ventures is a Pasadena, California venture capital firm backing visionary technical founders scaling deep tech to transform industries such as transportation and logistics, food and agriculture, healthcare, manufacturing, security, and warehousing. The firm invests in AI, computer vision, machine learning, robotics, and automation startups, partnering with founders to turn a technical breakthrough into scalable commercial advantage and drawing on decades of combined investment and company-building experience. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-adjacent company in the API Evangelist network and enriched from the firm's public web presence.

providers.name: Calyxob1ba
providers.description: Calyxob1ba is a stub entry discovered in the secondary-market harvest. No public website or API documentation could be located despite searches of equityzen.com and general web queries. The company appears to be listed on EquityZen as a pre-IPO investment opportunity, but no direct domain or API endpoints are evident. This placeholder will be updated when verifiable information becomes available.

providers.name: Cambridge Aerospace
providers.description: Cambridge Aerospace is a UK-based defense technology company, incorporated in September 2024, developing scalable interceptor missiles and sovereign air-and-missile-defense systems for European nations. Its first product, Skyhammer, is a tube-launched subsonic interceptor with a Cambridge-developed radar seeker, positioned as an affordable, mass-producible counter to drones and cruise missiles (often likened to an Iron Dome-style layered air defense). The company operates in the aerospace and defense/security sector and is backed by a venture syndicate including Accel, Lakestar, Lux Capital, Spark Capital, and the D3 fund. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel; it is a hardware-first defense company with no public API or developer surface at this time.

providers.name: Cantex Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Cantex Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company based in Weston, Florida. The company focuses on developing innovative therapies and conducts clinical trials, with a presence on industry platforms such as PitchBook and Indexed VC. Their website is currently under construction, providing contact information including an email (info@cantex.com) and phone number (954-315-3660). The firm is listed on secondary markets and aims to expand its pipeline of pharmaceutical products.

providers.name: Caracol
providers.description: Caracol Televisión S.A. is a major Colombian television network offering a wide range of entertainment, news, and reality programming. Founded in 1969 as a production company and launched as a national broadcaster in 1998, it operates multiple channels and digital platforms, reaching millions of viewers across Colombia and the Spanish‑speaking world. The company also runs associated media properties such as Noticias Caracol, Blu Radio, and Caracol TV corporate services.

providers.name: Carbocode
providers.description: Carbocode is a glycosphingolipid company focused on developing and commercializing carbohydrate-based therapeutics. The firm specializes in research and production of complex glycosphingolipids for use in medical and scientific applications, offering expertise in lipid synthesis, analysis, and supply chain management. While primarily a biotech entity, Carbocode maintains a corporate website providing company information, product overviews, and contact details.

providers.name: Carbon Ridge
providers.description: Carbon Ridge provides modular onboard carbon capture solutions for maritime shipping, enabling vessels to reduce CO₂ emissions directly at sea. Their technology integrates with existing ship systems to capture and store carbon, supporting the maritime industry's transition to net‑zero operations. The company focuses on scalable, retrofittable units that can be deployed across various ship classes, offering a practical path toward greener shipping and compliance with emerging environmental regulations.

providers.name: Carbonated
providers.description: Carbonated Inc. is a mobile game developer founded in 2015 by industry veterans from Zynga, Electronic Arts, and Blizzard. The studio builds hardcore PvEvP (player-versus-environment-versus-player) games for phones and uses AI to help drive moment-to-moment gameplay. Its debut title is Mad World, currently in early-access sign-up. Carbonated also operates Carbyne, a proprietary live-ops platform that lets the team instantly modify almost every part of the game experience through a comprehensive set of web tools, built to support multiple games. Carbonated is a portfolio company of Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). As of this profile Carbonated publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal; this record captures the company identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Cardiac Dimensions
providers.description: Cardiac Dimensions is a privately held structural-heart medical device company headquartered in Kirkland, Washington, developing transcatheter therapies for patients with heart failure and functional mitral regurgitation. Its lead product is the CARILLON Mitral Contour System, a minimally invasive, catheter-delivered implant placed in the coronary sinus to reshape the mitral valve annulus and reduce functional mitral regurgitation without open-heart surgery. CARILLON carries a CE Mark in Europe and remains an investigational device in the United States, where the company is completing the EMPOWER pivotal trial. Unlike legacy analytics that depend on preset object or motion definitions, Conntour's models scale to thousands of concurrent feeds (up to roughly 50 feeds per consumer GPU such as an Nvidia RTX 4090) and deploy fully on-premises, in the cloud, or in a hybrid mix, either augmenting existing VMS/security systems or serving as a standalone surveillance platform. Founded in 2024 by Matan Goldner and Tomer Kola, the company serves intelligence agencies, homeland security, law enforcement, military and defense, transportation, and enterprise customers. It raised a $7M seed round in March 2026 led by General Catalyst, with participation from Y Combinator, SV Angel, and Liquid 2 Ventures.

providers.name: Constru
providers.description: Constru (ConstruCompany) is a Brazilian construction firm delivering residential, commercial, shopping, hospital, and hotel projects. With over 1 million square meters built, they focus on quality, timely delivery, and client satisfaction, offering comprehensive services from design to post‑sale support.

providers.name: Conteller
providers.description: Conteller is a user-generated content (UGC) marketplace where brands pay for authentic media directly from their own customers and everyday, non-famous creators. Brands publish media briefs and the platform lets creators capture, submit, and store photos, videos, and TikTok-style content, then handles paying those creators for approved submissions. A Mexican/Spanish startup (Madrid) selected for Batch 19 of 500 Global's Somos Lucha accelerator program in Latin America, Conteller has run pilots spanning roughly 1,400 creators and a dozen brands. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of 500 Global. The public site is no longer serving: conteller.com and www.conteller.com both return HTTP 402 "Payment required / DEPLOYMENT_DISABLED" from Vercel on every path, the blog subdomain returns a Cloudflare 1014 and the admin subdomain a 522, and the Internet Archive holds no successful capture of the site after 2025-07-16. No public developer portal, API, documentation, OpenAPI, GraphQL, MCP or agent-card surface has ever been found for Conteller, and its GitHub organization publishes no repositories.

providers.name: Continuumtechnology
providers.description: Continuumtechnology is an IT consulting firm based in Mount Rainier, MD, offering digital transformation, data platforms, AI services, and tailored technology solutions for businesses of all sizes. Their mission is to empower clients through expert consulting, cost‑effective solutions, and a focus on innovation and technology adoption.

providers.name: Contrea
providers.description: Contrea, Inc. is a Tokyo‑based healthcare technology startup founded in 2020. It provides a cloud‑based informed‑consent platform called MediOS that streamlines patient‑provider communication, administrative procedures, and information exchange in medical institutions. The company focuses on SaaS solutions for the legacy healthcare sector, aiming to modernize consent management and digital patient engagement.

providers.name: Cord Project
providers.description: Cord Project Inc. was a New York based startup founded around 2014 by former Google Creative Lab designers Thomas Gayno and Jeff Baxter. Its flagship product, Cord, was a voice messaging app that let people send short audio clips as a middle ground between texting and phone calls. The company raised seed funding from investors including Google Ventures, Greycroft, Lerer Hippeau, Metamorphic Ventures and Slow Ventures, and was acquired by Spotify in January 2016 to explore new ways of interacting with audio. There is no public developer API, SDK, or documentation; this profile is retained as a Slow Ventures portfolio lead in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Core Loop
providers.description: Core Loop is a game studio founded in 2020 by Vincenzo Alagna and Dan Chao, veterans of Machine Zone, GREE, and Funzio, building a modern cross-platform MMO at the intersection of massively multiplayer online games and web3. The studio is developing an AI-directed, dynamic world that evolves based on the actions of the community, with a blockchain-based, player-driven virtual economy in which participants truly own the assets they craft or earn and can potentially make a living in the game long-term. The game targets both PC and mobile. Core Loop raised a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, with participation from Galaxy Digital, Block.one, 1Up Ventures, Dune Ventures, and others, and operates as a remote-first team headquartered in Oakland, California. As a game studio, Core Loop does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, MCP server, or developer portal, so this profile is identity-only.

providers.name: Core Loop Games
providers.description: Core Loop Games is a game development studio focused on building the next generation of massively multiplayer online (MMO) experiences. The company emphasizes large‑scale social cooperation and innovative gameplay loops that engage players in persistent virtual worlds. Based in Oakland, California, Core Loop Games aims to reimagine how players interact and collaborate across expansive game universes.

providers.name: Core-Mark Holding
providers.description: Core-Mark Holding Company, a subsidiary of Performance Food Group, is one of the largest broad-line, full-service marketers and distributors of packaged consumer products to the convenience retail industry in North America. The company serves more than 41,000 retail locations across the United States and Canada, supplying tobacco, candy, snacks, beverages, foodservice, and other fast-moving consumer goods. Core-Mark provides retailer technology platforms including Core-Source Portal, Retailer Analytics, Core-Mark Ordering, and Core-Mark Intellisite.

providers.name: Coremedicaltechnology
providers.description: Coremedicaltechnology, operating as Shenzhen Core Medical Technology Co., Ltd., develops and manufactures advanced artificial heart and ventricular assist devices. Founded in 2016, the company focuses on high‑tech medical implants, offering products such as the Corheart® 6 fully magnetic‑levitation artificial heart, approved by China’s NMPA in 2023. It aims to provide comprehensive solutions for heart‑failure patients worldwide.

providers.name: Coretsu
providers.description: Coretsu is an AI‑focused technology company that presents itself as a platform for leveraging artificial intelligence to expand human creativity and productivity. The site emphasizes a vision of empowering individuals and organizations with AI tools while acknowledging the responsibility that comes with such power. It highlights a commitment to innovation, a range of engineering roles, and a mission to keep humanity relevant in an AI‑driven future.

providers.name: Cornami
providers.description: Cornami is a Santa Clara, California high-performance computing company building morphable silicon and a stream-centric software stack for privacy-preserving and AI workloads. Its FracTLcore Fabric and TruStream dataflow programming model power the Tigris 16nm ASIC, MX8 board, and rack-scale MX64 system, delivering real-time Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE), private LLM inference, blockchain, and signal-processing acceleration at greatly reduced power and latency. Cornami is a frontier-tech company backed by SoftBank Vision Fund; this profile tracks its public developer and API surface within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Cosihospitality
providers.description: Cosihospitality operates under the Così brand, providing catering services and fresh food ordering through its website getcosi.com. The company offers a range of menu options, location-based catering, and an online ordering platform for events and corporate clients. It serves multiple US cities, supports online quotes, loyalty programs, and integrates with third‑party delivery services. The platform includes detailed FAQs, a story about the brand, and contact options for catering inquiries.

providers.name: Cospowers
providers.description: Cospowers (昆宇电源) is a leading Chinese lithium‑ion battery and energy‑storage solutions provider. With over 30 years of R&D, it offers integrated storage systems for power, industrial, data‑center, residential and communication applications, aiming to be a global smart‑energy solutions leader.

providers.name: CourseGuide
providers.description: CourseGuide is a portfolio-lead company in the API Evangelist network, surfaced from the 500 Global portfolio and mapped to coursereport.com. Course Report is a consumer-facing education platform that helps prospective students discover, compare, and review coding bootcamps, certification courses, and professional training programs, aggregating 900+ programs and tens of thousands of alumni reviews alongside rankings, career-matching tools, and guidance content. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface was found during enrichment; this profile remains a lead with only domain-security posture and public web properties captured.

providers.name: Covenant
providers.description: Covenant is a defense technology company specializing in long-range, heavy‑payload strike systems. It develops the Anthem missile platform designed for high‑precision, large‑scale delivery to deter adversaries. The firm emphasizes local production, allied collaboration, and rapid iteration, offering customers scalable missile solutions and related services.

providers.name: Craftbank
providers.description: Craftbank is a construction‑tech startup that operates an online platform matching general contractors with subcontractors, streamlining project sourcing and collaboration in the construction industry. It also hosts networking events for construction professionals and provides digital management solutions for the property sector.

providers.name: Cray
providers.description: Cray is the high-performance computing (HPC) and supercomputing brand, originally Cray Research and later Cray Inc., now part of Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) following HPE's 2019 acquisition. The cray.com domain 301-redirects to HPE's HPC/compute pages, and Cray no longer operates an independent public developer portal, API reference, or API surface — its supercomputing systems, ClusterStor storage, and Slingshot interconnect are marketed and supported under HPE. Enrichment found no first-party Cray API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or documentation to harvest. The norwest-venture-partners backing recorded on this stub is a legacy venture-history association, not a current independent company relationship.

providers.name: Crazyduck
providers.description: CrazyDuck is an adult-oriented social networking platform based in Poland, offering a space for real conversations and connections among adults over 18. The service emphasizes privacy, profile verification, and a censorship-free environment where users can meet new people locally or globally. With over 350,000 active members, CrazyDuck provides features such as secure messaging, profile safety tools, and community guidelines to foster authentic interactions. The platform is accessible via web and mobile apps, focusing on user-driven experiences and safe, genuine connections.

providers.name: Creator Cabins
providers.description: Creator Cabins (operating as Cabin, at cabin.city) is a crypto-web3 community project that built globally distributed, coliving neighborhoods uniting members through shared culture, economy, and token-based governance via the Cabin DAO. It began in 2020 with a 28-acre Texas Hill Country property known as Neighborhood Zero and grew into a multi-property network for remote workers before members voted to wind down the formal DAO structure in 2025; individual neighborhoods continue operating independently, and a related Neighborhood Village Project now serves over 100 communities globally. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Multicoin Capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. No public developer API, documentation, or SDKs were found during enrichment.

providers.name: crowdcube
providers.description: Crowdcube is a UK-based equity crowdfunding platform that lets everyday and professional investors buy shares in early-stage and growth-stage private companies, and lets founders raise capital directly from their community and the wider crowd. Founded in 2011 in Exeter by Darren Westlake and Luke Lang, it is authorised and regulated by the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and has helped hundreds of startups and scale-ups raise funding from a large base of retail investors. The platform covers pitch discovery, investment processing, share issuance, nominee shareholding, and a secondary-market cashout facility. Crowdcube surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Balderton Capital. It does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures its company identity and observable domain-security posture.

providers.name: Csamedical
providers.description: Csamedical is a healthcare technology company focused on innovative medical devices and solutions for chronic respiratory conditions. It aims to improve patient outcomes through advanced cryotherapy technologies and clinical research collaborations, targeting chronic bronchitis and COPD treatment.

providers.name: Csdnano
providers.description: Csdnano is a technology company identified in the secondary market harvest. It appears to be a nascent firm with limited public information available online. The company is listed on EquityZen as a pre‑IPO investment opportunity, suggesting it is a private, early‑stage venture seeking capital. No official website or public documentation could be located despite attempts to resolve common domains and search engine queries. Further details about its products, services, or API offerings remain undisclosed at this time.

providers.name: Culinarybrands
providers.description: Culinary Brands is an Indian foodservice and beverage operator on a mission to prove that fresh, quality food is possible without compromising on taste. The company builds and runs a portfolio of well-known food and coffee brands across India, including Subway (sandwiches / QSR), Lavazza (coffee), and Fresh & Honest (coffee and vending), with a stated focus on sustainability, diversity and inclusion, governance, and CSR. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and profiled in the API Evangelist network; the public web presence is a WordPress corporate site with no developer portal, documentation, or product API surface at this time.

providers.name: Curaum
providers.description: Curaum is a Korean healthcare technology company focused on improving quality of life through innovative oral and sleep health solutions. It develops IoMT‑enabled dental care products, sleep monitoring devices, and digital platforms to promote balanced, healthy living. The firm emphasizes accessible medical technology and aims to extend lifespan and wellbeing by integrating advanced sensing and digital care.

providers.name: Curaway
providers.description: Curaway Medical Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese high‑tech enterprise specializing in precision minimally invasive medical devices. It develops and manufactures products for energy ablation, biopsy localization, delicate surgery and surgical robotics, serving oncology, peripheral intervention and smart medical fields. The company emphasizes innovative R&D, international quality standards, and provides solutions that reduce trauma, complications and recovery time for patients.

providers.name: Cureatr
providers.description: Cureatr, now part of AssureCare, provides medication management solutions for payers, providers, and pharmacies. The company focuses on care coordination, utilization management, and medication therapy management, aiming to improve population health outcomes through integrated digital platforms.

providers.name: Curebay
providers.description: Curebay is a healthcare platform focused on delivering affordable, accessible medical services to underserved populations in rural India. It operates a hybrid model combining physical clinics, tele‑consultations, diagnostics, pharmacy services, and a membership program (Kavach) that provides preventive care and financial protection. The company aims to bridge the last‑mile gap in primary healthcare through an interoperable digital stack, AI‑driven screening, and a network of local health workers, serving millions across hundreds of villages.

providers.name: Curegene
providers.description: Curegene is a biotechnology company focused on developing gene‑based therapies and diagnostic tools. The firm aims to accelerate the discovery and delivery of precision medicines by leveraging advanced genomics, bioinformatics, and clinical research platforms. While detailed public information is limited, Curegene positions itself as a partner for pharmaceutical and academic collaborations, offering services that span from target identification to clinical trial support. The company’s mission is to translate genetic insights into actionable therapeutic solutions that improve patient outcomes worldwide.

providers.name: Curvafix
providers.description: Curvafix, based in Bellevue, Washington, develops a unique curved intramedullary implant for pelvic fracture repair. The device, cleared by the FDA, follows the natural bone curvature, offering flexible surgical insertion and rigid fixation. In 2023 the company raised $39 million to expand its market and improve treatment for fragility fractures.

providers.name: cutt
providers.description: cutt (cutt.com) is a Chinese technology company surfaced from the published portfolio of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead. As of the 2026-07-20 enrichment pass the company has no reachable public web presence: the cutt.com apex does not complete an HTTPS connection, www.cutt.com returns HTTP 404 for the site root and every probed path, and no developer, documentation, or API subdomain (api./developer./docs./ dev./open.) resolves. One surviving subdomain, zhiyue.cutt.com, issues a 301 redirect to api.zhiyueapp.cn — a live JSON API host fronted by an APISIX 3.4.1 gateway that returns an empty 200 body and publishes no documentation. The zhiyueapp.cn domain is registered to 北京简网生活圈科技有限公司 (Beijing Jianwang Life Circle Technology Co., Ltd.), which appears to be the operating entity behind the cutt.com property. The cutt.com domain itself was created in 2003 and remains registered through Alibaba Cloud Computing Ltd. (HiChina) with an April 2027 expiry, so the registration is maintained even though the public site is not being served. No OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, SDK, portal, changelog, status page, or /.well-known/ discovery document could be found on any reachable host. This profile therefore records probed infrastructure evidence only; it carries no fabricated API surface and should be revisited if the company restores a public developer presence.

providers.name: Cyemptive
providers.description: Cyemptive Technologies is a cybersecurity vendor founded in 2014 by Rob Pike, headquartered in Washington State with additional offices in North Carolina, the United Kingdom, France and India. It sells preemptive, detection-independent security to enterprise and government buyers under the Cyemptive ZeroStrike brand — built on its patented CyberSlice technology — alongside ZeroStrike Cloud Command, ZeroStrike Blueprint professional services, Compliancy Cloud and a cyber-insurance offering. Cyemptive is sold as a delivered end-user security product through a direct and partner motion; it publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Cymbal
providers.description: Cymbal was a consumer blockchain data startup founded in 2022 in Menlo Park by Eric Feng, Nick Chang and others, building a "human readable" Ethereum block explorer with a visual, social interface and AI-generated conversational summaries of wallets, NFTs and transactions. The company raised $18.5M in 2023 from investors including First Round Capital, Coinbase Ventures, Solana Ventures, Patron, Acrew and GV. In July 2025 Yahoo acqui-hired the Cymbal team into a new AI research group. Cymbal published no public developer API or documentation surface; this API Evangelist profile is a GV-portfolio company record.

providers.name: D.R. Horton
providers.description: D.R. Horton is the largest homebuilder by volume in the United States, building and selling single-family homes in dozens of states across multiple price points. The company is a Fortune 500 enterprise with affiliated financial services including DHI Mortgage, DHI Title, and DRH Insurance.

providers.name: Dairyqueen
providers.description: Dairy Queen (International Dairy Queen, Inc.) is an American chain of soft-serve ice cream and fast-food restaurants operating thousands of franchised locations worldwide, known for its Blizzard treats, cones, sundaes, and grill menu. A subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway, it reaches consumers through its website, mobile app, and loyalty program. This profile was surfaced as a VC portfolio lead; Dairy Queen publishes no public developer API program, so this repo currently carries only a probed domain-security profile and identity metadata.

providers.name: Damon Motorcycles
providers.description: Damon Motorcycles (Damon Inc.) is a Vancouver, British Columbia electric motorcycle company founded in 2017 by Jay Giraud and Dominique Kwong, and an alumnus of the Techstars accelerator. Damon builds high-performance electric motorcycles led by the HyperSport and HyperFighter models, and is known for two safety and ergonomics technologies: CoPilot, a 360-degree advanced warning system that uses radar, cameras, and sensors to alert riders to surrounding hazards, and Shift, a transformable ergonomics system that adjusts the riding position between commuter and sport stances. The company has faced significant financial and going-concern difficulties, and its public web presence at damon.com currently returns errors, so no developer portal, documentation, or public API surface could be verified during enrichment. This profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Dangdang
providers.description: Dangdang (当当, dangdang.com) is a Chinese business-to-consumer e-commerce company founded in 1999 and headquartered in Beijing. It began as one of China's largest online booksellers and expanded into a broad general-merchandise marketplace spanning books, e-books and e-readers, digital reading, consumer electronics, apparel, home goods, and maternal and baby products. Once listed on the New York Stock Exchange (ticker DANG) before being taken private, Dangdang was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCM Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. No active public developer program, open platform, or machine-readable API surface was reachable during enrichment (the site is geo-restricted); this profile carries a probed domain-security posture and awaits any discoverable API artifacts.

providers.name: Dasera
providers.description: Dasera is a data security company in the data security posture management (DSPM) and data governance space, founded by Ani Chaudhuri and backed by Sierra Ventures. Its platform was built to continuously discover, classify, and monitor sensitive data across cloud and on-premises data stores (databases, warehouses, data lakes) and to surface data security, privacy, and compliance risk across the data lifecycle. As of this enrichment pass the standalone dasera.com origin is unreachable (a Cloudflare 1001 origin error with a failed TLS handshake), so no live developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI surface could be harvested; this profile records the domain-security posture that could still be probed via DNS/TLS and remains a stub awaiting a live API surface.

providers.name: Datacurve
providers.description: Datacurve is a San Francisco-based AI infrastructure company that positions itself as "the data engine for frontier AI," building high-quality, expert-annotated datasets, reinforcement-learning environments, long-horizon agent tasks, benchmarks, and supervised fine-tuning demonstrations used to train and evaluate frontier AI models. Its offerings include off-the-shelf and custom datasets, agent-trajectory capture (tool calls, pivots, recovery attempts), and domain-sensitive evaluations across software engineering, data science, cybersecurity, machine learning, and research. Datacurve is backed by Homebrew and publishes research such as the DeepSWE long-horizon coding benchmark. The company sells through direct engagement (contact@datacurve.ai) and currently exposes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: DataFox
providers.description: DataFox was a San Francisco company-intelligence and sales-prospecting startup, backed by GV among others, that used machine learning to collect and score signals about private and public companies (funding rounds, hiring, news, growth signals) and delivered them to sales and marketing teams through a web application, CRM integrations, and a company-data API. Oracle acquired DataFox and folded its company-and-signals data into the Oracle Cloud CX / Oracle Fusion Marketing stack. The independent product has been fully retired: as of this profile the datafox.com apex and www hosts are served from Oracle infrastructure and every path under www.datafox.com issues a blanket HTTP 301 to Oracle marketing pages, while api.datafox.com and app.datafox.com resolve to a parked Oracle address that accepts no connections. There is no surviving DataFox developer portal, documentation, API reference, or specification to harvest, so this profile is retained as a historical/acquired company record rather than an active API provider.

providers.name: DataSine
providers.description: DataSine was a London-based AI personalization startup, founded in 2015 and backed by Techstars, that applied machine learning and behavioral psychology to help marketers tailor content, imagery, and copy to audience personality traits. The company was acquired by Shutterstock and folded into Shutterstock's AI/creative-intelligence work; its datasine.com domain is now registered to Shutterstock, Inc. (MarkMonitor) and HTTP 301-redirects to shutterstock.ai. DataSine no longer operates an independent product or a developer/API surface, so this profile is retained as an acquired-company record rather than an active provider awaiting API artifacts.

providers.name: Datost
