providers.description: Datost Inc. is a New York applied research lab building hardware and intelligent systems that operate in your environment without demanding constant attention — "computers that come after the screen." Its first public product is ED1TH, a 25-gram pair of AI augmented-reality smart glasses with a 640x480 green Micro-LED in-lens display readable in direct sunlight, hot-swap battery cells, a companion steel smart ring for gesture control, and a privacy-first design with zero cameras and a single hardware-mutable microphone. ED1TH runs ED1TH-OS and handles email, calendar, turn-by-turn navigation, live translation, and meeting transcription in the wearer's field of view. Datost is backed by Y Combinator (Spring 2026) and OpenAI. As a consumer hardware and applied-research company, Datost does not currently publish a public web API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Dazz
providers.description: Dazz is a cloud security company specializing in Application Security Posture Management (ASPM) and code-to-cloud risk remediation. Its platform correlates findings across code, cloud, and on-prem infrastructure into a single unified view, maps vulnerabilities back to their root cause in source code, and gives security and engineering teams a remediation engine to prioritize and fix issues across the application lifecycle. Co-founded and led by CEO Merav Bahat, Dazz was backed by Insight Partners, Greylock, Cyberstarts, and others. Wiz announced its acquisition of Dazz on November 21, 2024 to extend its Cloud Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP) with Dazz's remediation capabilities; the dazz.io domain now redirects into Wiz. This profile has no independent public developer/API surface.

providers.name: DealCart
providers.description: DealCart is a Pakistan-based social-commerce and group-buying startup offering discounted groceries and everyday household goods, surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company. As a consumer mobile-commerce business it publishes no public developer program. An enrichment pass on 2026-07-18 found the primary domain dealcart.io parked/expired (a Namecheap landing page) and dealcart.pk serving a password-gated Shopify storefront, with no developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, SDKs, or API surface to harvest. This profile carries a live domain-security probe and remains a lead pending any future public API program.

providers.name: Deep Interactions
providers.description: Deep Interactions is a collaborative, humans-in-the-loop AI builder for product teams, launched out of Y Combinator's Spring 2026 batch. The platform helps teams move from business goals through design and development to a deployed AI product, turning messy ideas, data, and tools into working software in a single afternoon while maintaining code organization and product coherence. It positions itself as the context layer that lets a whole team build in sync — integrating with existing tools such as Slack, Figma, GitHub, Vercel, and Supabase — rather than producing disconnected solo prototypes. The company is currently at a waitlist-only stage and does not yet publish a public API, developer documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: DeepMap
providers.description: DeepMap was a high-definition mapping and localization software company for autonomous vehicles, building HD maps, real-time localization, and map-update infrastructure that let self-driving cars know precisely where they were. Backed by a16z and Accel, DeepMap was acquired by NVIDIA in 2021 and folded into NVIDIA's autonomous-vehicle platform; the deepmap.ai domain now resolves to NVIDIA's self-driving solutions page. No independent DeepMap developer portal, documentation, or public API surface exists post-acquisition. This profile is retained as a network/portfolio record.

providers.name: Degla
providers.description: Degla is a Y Combinator (Fall 2026) startup building an autonomous aerial intelligence layer that turns natural language into multi-drone mission execution. Operators describe an objective in plain language and Degla plans the mission, assigns aircraft, defines coverage patterns, and deploys a fleet that adapts in real time — with no waypoints, flight plans, or specialized training required. The platform targets search and rescue, emergency response, infrastructure inspection, and other critical field operations. Founded in 2026 by Aziz Hanafi and based in Boston, the company is in early access and has not yet published a public API, developer portal, or documentation.

providers.name: DeporPrivé
providers.description: DeporPrivé is a Mexico-based sports e-commerce platform operating as a members-oriented "Sport Experience & Outlet" that runs flash sales and private, time-limited shopping events across more than 300 athletic brands including Adidas, Nike, and Salomon, with discounts reaching up to 70%. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Mexico, the company curates footwear, apparel, and accessories for running, cycling, swimming, football, and general fitness, and has grown into one of the largest sport-specific online retailers in the country, fulfilling around 1,000 packages per day across multiple sales channels. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global. No public developer program, API, or documentation surface has been identified for this consumer retail brand.

providers.name: Deutscher Wetterdienst
providers.description: Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD) is Germany's national meteorological service, a federal agency under the Ministry for Digital and Transport, responsible for weather and climate services, warnings, and the national climate archive. Its geospatial surface is an OGC-standard GeoServer at maps.dwd.de serving forecast, radar, warning and climate layers to any WMS or WFS client without a key.

providers.name: Diageo
providers.description: Diageo is a global leader in premium drinks, producing a diverse portfolio of spirits, beer, wine and other alcoholic beverages. The company operates in over 180 markets, with iconic brands such as Johnnie Walker, Guinness, Smirnoff and Baileys. It focuses on sustainable growth, innovation and responsible drinking, offering extensive consumer experiences worldwide.

providers.name: Diamanti
providers.description: Diamanti was a San Jose, California infrastructure company (founded 2014) that built hyperconverged, bare-metal infrastructure purpose-built for containers and Kubernetes. Its flagship Ultima platform paired plug-and-play appliances with hardware-accelerated networking and storage I/O cards, and its Spektra software added multi-cluster, hybrid-cloud Kubernetes management across on-premises and public-cloud environments. As of this enrichment pass the company appears to be defunct / to have ceased operations: www.diamanti.com resolves but returns a captcha-walled placeholder (HTTP 202, noindex) with no reachable developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or public API surface.

providers.name: Diapers.com
providers.description: Diapers.com is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of accel and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: ecommerce. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Digital Mortar
providers.description: Digital Mortar is an in-store and physical-location people-journey analytics company. Its DM1 platform measures shopper and visitor journeys - path, queue, occupancy, throughput, dwell and space utilization - using LiDAR and stereoscopic-camera sensors, delivering heat mapping, funnel analysis, real-time queue and occupancy tracking, display and merchandising measurement, and door/people counting as a SaaS analytics tool. It serves retail, airports, malls, stadiums and events. Digital Mortar is now part of PMY Group; its digitalmortar.com domain is dormant (mail-only, no live website) and it exposes no public developer or API program.

providers.name: Dimeq
providers.description: Dimeq is a Norwegian maritime safety technology company working to prevent loss of life at sea and set new health, safety and environmental (HSE) standards for the maritime sector. Its Eye-D System is an IoT-based digital ecosystem that delivers real-time positioning of crew and passengers to one-meter accuracy during emergencies, man-overboard detection using environmental sensors, automatic mustering that registers people in seconds, and statistical analysis for accident documentation and prevention, while keeping data anonymous and GDPR-compliant outside of emergencies. The D-Router gateway supports Wi-Fi, Ethernet, PLC, fiber optics, UWB, Bluetooth, LoRa, ZigBee and MATTER connectivity. This is a hardware/IoT product company with no public developer portal, API, SDK or documentation surface at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Distil Networks
providers.description: Distil Networks was a bot detection and mitigation company founded in 2011 and backed by Techstars, providing automated-threat protection, web scraping defense, account-takeover prevention, and API security that blocked malicious bots and credential stuffing across web, mobile, and API surfaces. Distil Networks was acquired by Imperva in 2019 and its technology now lives on as Imperva Advanced Bot Protection; the distilnetworks.com domain redirects to Imperva and there is no independent Distil Networks developer surface or public API. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a historical company record.

providers.name: Divide *
providers.description: Divide was a bring-your-own-device (BYOD) mobile management product, built by Enterproid, that created a secure, separate work persona (dual-persona / work profile) on an employee's personal Android and iOS phone. Backed by GV (Google Ventures), the company was acquired by Google on May 19, 2014 and folded into the Android for Work / Android Enterprise program. The standalone Divide product and any developer or API surface have been discontinued; divide.com now serves a Google-owned tombstone page that redirects visitors to android.com/work. No independent API, developer portal, SDK, or specification remains to enrich — this record is preserved as an acquired-company profile.

providers.name: DMall
providers.description: DMall (多点数智, Dmall Inc.) is an Asia-Pacific retail digitalization service provider that pairs consulting with technology to deliver an all-in-one digital retail operating system for supermarkets, grocery chains, and other retailers. Its cloud-native SaaS platform (Dmall OS) spans supply chain, point-of-sale, store operations, membership, e-commerce, and O2O fulfillment, helping traditional retailers modernize into data-driven omnichannel businesses. The company is backed by IDG Capital among other investors. DMall does not currently publish a public developer portal, open-platform documentation, or machine-readable API specifications; this profile captures its public web identity and domain security posture while awaiting a documented API surface.

providers.name: DogVacay
providers.description: DogVacay was a consumer marketplace for dog boarding, pet sitting, dog walking, and doggy daycare that connected pet owners with a network of vetted, background-checked pet sitters and hosts across the United States and Canada. Founded in 2012 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), the company was acquired by and merged into Rover in 2017; the DogVacay brand has since been retired and dogvacay.com now redirects to Rover. No public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation was ever published, so this profile carries company identity only and no API artifacts.

providers.name: Doodle Mobile
providers.description: Doodle Mobile (Asia) Limited is a developer and publisher of casual mobile games for Android, founded in 2010 and backed by KPCB and Innovation Works, with research and development centers in Beijing and Shanghai and more than 300 million downloads across its catalog. Its titles include Restaurant Live, Dino Island (Dragon), and Fast Racing 3D, and it also partners with third party developers to publish games worldwide. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment found a static brochure website with no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or portal.

providers.name: Dresser-Rand Group
providers.description: Dresser-Rand Group was a global supplier of rotating equipment solutions to the worldwide oil, gas, petrochemical, and process industries. It was acquired by Siemens in 2015 and now operates as part of Siemens Energy.

providers.name: Dropcam
providers.description: Dropcam is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of accel, bessemer-venture-partners, kleiner-perkins, menlo-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: consumer. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Dulcetta
providers.description: Dulcetta is the company behind Focus@Will (focusatwill.com), a functional-music streaming service that curates instrumental soundtracks scientifically designed to improve concentration and productivity during focused work. Backed by 500 Global, Dulcetta operates a consumer subscription product marketing measurable gains in focus for knowledge workers, students, and creative professionals who work with music. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-sourced lead; no public developer API or documentation surface has been identified to date, so this profile carries company identity and probed domain-security posture only.

providers.name: DwellSocial
providers.description: DwellSocial is a Techstars-backed, Chicago-area community food service that brings iconic city restaurants to suburban neighborhoods. Members browse curated restaurant offerings, place group orders for scheduled dates, and meet for a convenient neighborhood pickup to enjoy city-quality meals at home. The service also runs fundraisers for local causes and non-profits, and currently serves suburbs such as Naperville and Elmhurst. DwellSocial operates as a consumer web and mobile application; no public developer API, OpenAPI, documentation, or well-known discovery surface was found during enrichment (dwellsocial.com serves a JavaScript single-page app and api.dwellsocial.com returns the same marketing site rather than a machine API).

providers.name: Earendil Robotics
providers.description: Earendil Robotics is a Y Combinator-backed defense technology company registered in England and Wales that builds AI-powered situational-awareness and counter-drone systems for tactical units. Its product line includes IVAS, an edge-AI vision-augmentation system fusing night vision, thermal imaging, and laser ranging for total-darkness operation; Aeglos, an autonomous high-speed (300+ km/h) interceptor drone for counter-UAS defense with autonomous target locking and all-weather thermal tracking; and Holo, an ultra-lightweight dual-mode tactical sight combining high-resolution thermal imaging with a fiber-optic reticle. As of this profile the company exposes only a public marketing website and a contact form, with no published developer surface, API, SDKs, documentation, or GitHub organization.

providers.name: East Range Group
providers.description: East Range Group is a team of high purity water systems and service companies serving North America. The group is dedicated to building phenomenal places to work for its employees and to building the best high purity water service company on the continent, delivering proactive customer service and deep technical expertise across the most intricate complexities of high purity water technology. Its operating companies include Atlas High Purity Filter & Water Technologies, Pure Flow High Purity Water Services, and H2O Solutions. Surfaced as a portfolio company of norwest-venture-partners and profiled in the API Evangelist network. No public developer/API surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Eatsii
providers.description: Eatsii is a Jakarta, Indonesia based foodtech startup operating a cloud kitchen platform. It runs a cloud kitchen concept that offers takeaway and delivery alongside dine-in service, and markets cloud kitchen space to F&B operators under a franchise partnership model, positioning itself as helping food and beverage companies run a more efficient kitchen in the food delivery era. The company describes itself as combining a heartfelt touch with data and business strategy, and lists 11-50 employees in Food and Beverage Services. It was surfaced through the 500 Global (500 Durians) portfolio. Eatsii publishes no developer program, public API, or technical documentation, and as of July 2026 its eatsii.com domain does not serve a live website.

providers.name: Eden Robotics
providers.description: Eden Robotics is a Y Combinator-backed robotics company building autonomous robots for industrial operations, delivered on a robots-as-a-service model that starts at roughly $10 per hour with no setup fees. The offering is positioned as plug-and-play, requiring no on-site engineers or specialized robotics hires, and is powered by the company's Theta OS platform. As of this profile the company publishes a single marketing and sales-contact website and does not expose a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI definition; this record captures the verified company identity and domain-security posture and will be upgraded if and when a developer surface is published.

providers.name: Edfa3ly
providers.description: Edfa3ly is an Egyptian cross-border e-commerce and online shopping platform that lets consumers in Egypt and the wider MENA region buy products from international retailers and marketplaces, then handles the international shipping, customs clearance, and local delivery on their behalf. It bridges shoppers to overseas stores by managing purchasing, logistics, and payment in local currency. Edfa3ly is a 500 Global (500 Startups) portfolio company. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; the company does not publish a public developer program or API at this time.

providers.name: Edia
providers.description: Edia is an AI platform for K-12 school districts focused on improving student outcomes. Its products span AI math tutoring (reported 8-23% score improvements), attendance intervention to reduce chronic absenteeism (up to 30% reduction), and District Intelligence analytics that consolidate data from student information systems (SIS), learning management systems (LMS), behavior, and wellness sources into a single view for educators and administrators. Edia reports serving 200+ districts and 500K+ students. The company is backed by Felicis and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-sourced company profile. Edia does not currently publish a public developer portal, API reference, or API specification, so this profile carries only verifiable company identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Eeki Foods
providers.description: Eeki Foods is a food company listed in the General Catalyst portfolio and tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. As of the July 2026 enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer surface: eekifoods.com serves a pre-launch "Launching Soon" placeholder page, there are no api./docs./developer. subdomains in DNS, no /.well-known/ discovery documents, no llms.txt, no first-party client libraries on npm or PyPI, and no GitHub organization or repositories. The domain is held and mail-enabled (Google Workspace MX) and serves valid TLS 1.3 with HSTS, so this remains a live lead worth re-checking once the company launches a public product surface.

providers.name: eEye Digital Security
providers.description: eEye Digital Security was an American cybersecurity company and an early pioneer of commercial vulnerability management and vulnerability research. BeyondTrust acquired eEye Digital Security in May 2012, and the company no longer operates as an independent entity or brand. Its former domain, eeye.com, now resolves to BeyondTrust infrastructure — the www host no longer presents a valid TLS certificate, and the domain's DMARC reporting addresses point at beyondtrust.com. eEye publishes no developer portal, documentation, API, SDK, package, or discovery surface of its own; the successor product surface, including the BeyondTrust Password Safe API, is catalogued in the API Evangelist network under the beyondtrust profile. This record is retained as a historical company entry and an acquisition pointer rather than as an active API provider.

providers.name: Effa
providers.description: Effa is a sustainable consumer goods company that makes the world's first 100% recyclable paper toothbrush, a disposable, plastic-free alternative to conventional plastic toothbrushes aimed at hotels, airlines, and retail consumers. Founded in Ukraine by Dasha and Ilya Kichuk and headquartered in San Francisco, California, the company supplies eco-friendly personal care and amenity products to hospitality and travel clients, with reported customers including Netflix and Radisson. Effa is backed by 500 Global and Startup Wise Guys. Effa does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification; this profile tracks the company for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Eigen
providers.description: Eigen Technologies is a London-based intelligent document processing (IDP) and data-extraction company that uses natural language processing, object detection and machine learning to extract, classify and interpret structured data from unstructured documents at scale. Its no-code platform lets teams in financial services, insurance, law and professional services pull hundreds of datapoints out of contracts, loan agreements and filings to manage risk, automate processes and meet regulatory obligations, with extracted data pushed downstream via its document-processing API. Founded in 2014 and backed by Goldman Sachs, Temasek, Lakestar, Dawn Capital, ING Ventures, Anthemis and the Sony Innovation Fund, Eigen was acquired by contract-lifecycle-management platform Sirion in June 2024.

providers.name: eigencomm
providers.description: Shanghai Eigencomm Technology Co., Ltd. is a fabless semiconductor company founded in 2017 and headquartered in the Zhangjiang district of Shanghai, China, dedicated to the research, design, and sale of cellular Internet of Things (IoT) communication chipsets and their supporting software. Eigencomm has mass-produced NB-IoT and Cat.1bis chip series that power smart meters, smart security, mobile payment, shared devices, asset trackers, charging piles, wearables, smart firefighting, and smart home appliances, and is developing 5G silicon. The company is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund II, Qiming Venture Partners, and others, having raised roughly USD 171M across multiple rounds. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; it publishes no public web API, developer portal, or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Eka Robotics
providers.description: Eka Robotics is a Cambridge, Massachusetts robotics-AI company founded in 2025 that is building intelligence for the physical world in its native language: force. Its Vision-Force-Action (VFA) model combines vision, force sensing, and action to give robots generality, performance, and safety for close human-robot interaction. The team pioneers self-supervised robot learning, large-scale robot learning, world models, reinforcement learning, and sim-to-real transfer, drawing talent from MIT, Berkeley, Harvard, DeepMind, and Boston Dynamics. Co-founded by MIT professor Pulkit Agrawal (Improbable AI Lab), the company is an early-stage research-and-hardware venture and does not yet publish a public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation. This profile was surfaced as a venture-portfolio lead and enriched with the company's public identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: ElasticRun
providers.description: ElasticRun (legally NTEx Transportation Services Pvt Ltd) is a Pune, India based B2B e-commerce and rural logistics platform founded in 2016 by Sandeep Deshmukh, Saurabh Nigam and Shitiz Bansal. It operates an aggregated, variable-capacity transportation network that stitches together idle logistics capacity to connect FMCG brands and manufacturers to the mom-and-pop kirana stores of rural and semi-urban India. The platform blends mobile technology with local entrepreneurs to run an assisted-commerce model spanning 125,000+ kiranas and 80,000+ villages across 26 states, offering last-mile delivery, B2B distribution and supply-chain services. ElasticRun is backed by Prosus Ventures and SoftBank Vision Fund. This profile is a network stub: no public developer API, documentation or SDKs were found during enrichment.

providers.name: Elephint
providers.description: Elephint is an electronics-photonics integration company building integrated photonic systems-on-a-chip (SoC) technologies. Its focus areas span photonic integrated circuits, silicon photonics, free-space optical communication, fiber optics, optical amplifiers, coherent beam combining, wavefront control, photonic signal processing, photonic computing, and artificial intelligence. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network, Elephint is a deep-tech hardware company that presently publishes only a company website (https://elephint.ai) and does not expose a public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Elorian AI
providers.description: Elorian AI Inc is a Palo Alto, California frontier AI research company founded in 2025 and emerged from stealth in April 2026, building foundation models for visual reasoning — models that process visual input directly rather than first converting imagery into text, with the stated goal of advancing toward "visual AGI" for applications in architecture, automotive, manufacturing and robotics. It was co-founded by Andrew Dai (CEO, formerly Google Brain and DeepMind, first author of the 2015 work introducing LM pretraining followed by supervised fine-tuning, co-lead of GLaM and PaLM 2 pretraining), Yinfei Yang (Chief Multimodal Architect, formerly Apple Foundation Model Multimodal and co-creator of ALIGN at Google Research) and Seth Neel (formerly a Harvard professor researching data-centric generative AI), with Dustin Tran (formerly xAI post-training lead) as Chief Reasoning Architect. The company raised a $55M seed round at a reported $300M valuation with Nvidia and Menlo Ventures as strategic partners, and was named to the Forbes Next Billion-Dollar Startups 2026 list. As of this profiling pass Elorian is pre-product: its site states the first foundation visual thinking model will be released "later this year" and offers only an early-access waitlist. It publishes no developer portal, no API documentation, no machine-readable specification, and no public API host.

providers.name: Encore Music Technologies
providers.description: Encore Music Technologies, Inc. ("Encore") is a consumer live-music technology company based in Los Angeles, California, founded in 2020 by Ian Edelman, Jonathan Gray, and recording artist Kid Cudi. Its mobile app lets artists perform live inside custom augmented-reality environments directly from a phone while fans join, react, and pay artists in real time through gamified microtransactions such as a ten-cent "clap." The company raised a $9M seed round led by Battery Ventures in February 2022, with participation from 468 Capital, Kayak Ventures, Parade Ventures, and others. Encore ships consumer iOS and Android apps rather than a public developer platform; as of this pass it exposes no documented public API, and its marketing website (clapforencore.com) does not currently resolve to a live server.

providers.name: Endotronix
providers.description: Endotronix, Inc. is a Naperville, Illinois medical device and digital health company founded in 2007 and acquired by Edwards Lifesciences in July 2024, where it now operates as a wholly owned subsidiary. Endotronix builds the Cordella Heart Failure System, an integrated remote heart-failure management platform combining an implantable wireless pulmonary artery (PA) pressure sensor — granted FDA premarket approval in June 2024 — with a patient-facing myCordella tablet application, connected home vitals peripherals (blood pressure cuff, weight scale, pulse oximeter), and the myCordella Patient Management Portal, a cloud-based web application clinicians use to review transmitted PA pressure, vitals and symptom data and to titrate guideline-directed medical therapy. The company publishes clinical evidence (PROACTIVE-HF), instructions for use and device manuals, but operates no public developer program: there is no developer portal, API reference, SDK, webhook catalog or machine-readable specification on any Endotronix host.

providers.name: English Central
providers.description: English Central is an online English language learning platform that combines a large library of authentic video content with speech-recognition-driven pronunciation practice, adaptive vocabulary and quiz tools, and live one-on-one lessons with tutors. It serves individual learners as well as schools, universities, and enterprise/partner programs (including regional partners in Japan and elsewhere). Backed by GV (Google Ventures), it operates in the consumer education / EdTech sector. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal was found during enrichment; partner integrations appear to be handled privately.

providers.name: Enhanced Radar
providers.description: Enhanced Radar is a San Francisco-based applied AI company building intelligent systems for aviation, the world's most complex transportation domain. Its work centers on pilot-controller communications, where the company owns the full pipeline from data collection through in-house labeling and quality assurance to produce high-quality aviation AI training datasets. Products include Pattern, an aviation operational intelligence platform; ATC.com, a live air traffic control radio service; and Y4, an aviation understanding model announced in February 2026. Enhanced Radar has demonstrated real-time detection of runway incursion risks and raised $7 million in May 2026. It is backed by DCVC and Initialized Capital. The company does not currently publish a public API, developer documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: EnjoyHQ
providers.description: EnjoyHQ was a centralized user-research and customer-feedback repository — a single source of truth where product and UX teams stored, tagged, searched, and analyzed qualitative and quantitative research (interviews, surveys, support tickets, NPS scores, and app-store reviews). Backed by Point Nine Capital, it was acquired by UserTesting in 2021 and folded into the UserTesting Human Insight Platform. Its brand domain getenjoyhq.com now issues a permanent (HTTP 308) redirect to usertesting.com/platform/enjoyhq, and EnjoyHQ no longer operates an independent developer, documentation, or API surface.

providers.name: Entact Bio
providers.description: Entact Bio is a preclinical-stage biotechnology company based in Watertown, Massachusetts, developing a new class of small-molecule precision medicines called Enhancement-Targeting Chimeric (ENTAC) molecules. Where targeted protein degradation removes disease-causing proteins, Entact Bio works in the opposite direction: its ENTAC molecules recruit deubiquitinases (DUBs) to strip ubiquitin chains from beneficial proteins in order to extend their half-life, relocate them, or otherwise restore their function. The company's proprietary Encompass platform combines biological, chemical, and computational tools to identify disease targets amenable to protein enhancement across oncology, autoimmune disease, and rare genetic disorders. Entact Bio launched in December 2022 with an $81 million Series A co-led by Qiming Venture Partners USA and venBio Partners, with participation from Abingworth, Brandon Capital, and others. It is a therapeutics research organization and publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API artifacts.

providers.name: Envariant
providers.description: Envariant is building the control layer for foundation models — an AI interpretability SDK that lets teams inspect, steer, and control model behavior. The SDK exposes a compact set of primitives: detect and causally trace behaviors like hallucinations or invariant violations, reason inductively and steer outputs programmatically, extract human-readable domain principles, and synthesize targeted edge cases — moving verification upstream, directly into the model's latent space, with no bespoke engineering required. Envariant is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) company based in San Francisco. The SDK is in pre-release beta, so no public API, OpenAPI, or developer documentation is available yet; this profile captures the company identity ahead of a public developer surface.

providers.name: Epic Sciences
providers.description: Epic Sciences is a San Diego, California clinical diagnostics company founded in 2008 that develops blood-based "liquid biopsy" tests for oncology. Its platform, licensed from the Peter Kuhn laboratory at Scripps Research, isolates and characterizes rare circulating tumor cells (CTCs) from whole blood using specialized assays and digital pathology algorithms, and is paired with circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) sequencing to inform treatment selection and track how a tumor evolves. Its lead product, DefineMBC, is a comprehensive blood biopsy for metastatic breast cancer whose 56-gene ctDNA panel received Medicare coverage in April 2023. The company also runs its platform as a service for pharmaceutical partners measuring outcomes in clinical trials, and in 2020 partnered with Predicine to combine CTC and ctDNA analysis in a single offering. Epic Sciences is privately held and has raised roughly $204M across seven rounds through a Series G in April 2023. It is a laboratory diagnostics provider, not a software vendor, and publishes no public API, developer program, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: EQL Games
providers.description: EQL Games is a Louisville, Kentucky based lottery-industry technology company that operates as an original game studio, third-party content aggregator, and boutique licensor for the global iLottery market. Its iLottery Marketplace aggregates a catalog of 300+ games from 24 partner studios behind a single integration point for lottery operators, while its EQL Labs innovation division builds original instant-win and eInstant titles that fold in licensed intellectual property and live sports. The company also represents brands across lottery verticals (instant scratch and eInstant) and reports serving 8 lottery clients. EQL Games was surfaced through Bullpen Capital's portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes a marketing and corporate web presence but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification at this time.

providers.name: EST
providers.description: EST (EST Media) is a Los Angeles-based media holding company founded by Jaeson Ma and Eric Tu that amplifies Asian stories and talent for global audiences. It operates three divisions: EST Studios, which develops, finances, produces, and sells Asian film and television projects; Eastern Standard Times, a Gen Z digital video platform sharing untold stories from Asia and its diaspora; and Established, a content studio partnering with global brands on advertising campaigns, influencer collaborations, commercials, and experiential events. EST Media is a 500 Global portfolio company. It publishes no public API or developer platform; this profile carries company identity and a domain-security probe only.

providers.name: Ethereal Exploration Guild
providers.description: Ethereal Exploration Guild (EtherealX) is an Indian spacetech company founded in 2022 in Bengaluru by Manu J. Nair, Prashant Sharma, and Shubhayu Sardar, building fully reusable medium-lift launch vehicles. Its lead product, the Razor Crest Mk-1 (RCM1), targets roughly 25 tons to low Earth orbit with high launch cadence, up to 16 orbit insertions per flight, and 72-96 hour turnaround. The company has manufactured its 80kN reusable upper-stage engine (Pegasus) using a proprietary Full Flow Segregated Cooling Cycle (FFSCC) and operates a large private rocket testing facility in Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu. EtherealX has raised on the order of $26M across multiple rounds, including a Series A in December 2025. The company offers launch services rather than any developer-facing API or platform.

providers.name: Eurac Research
providers.description: Eurac Research is a private research centre in Bolzano, Italy, working across alpine environment, earth observation, health and autonomy studies. Its MAPS portal publishes research datasets — snow cover, land use, climate and remote-sensing products for the Alpine region — through an OGC-standard GeoServer callable anonymously by any GIS client.

providers.name: EV3
providers.description: Escape Velocity (EV3) is an early-stage crypto and web3 venture capital firm based in New York, co-founded by Mahesh Ramakrishnan and Salvador Gala, that backs founders building frontier-technology companies across programmable money, programmable molecules, and programmable intelligence. EV3 writes early-stage checks and concentrates on crypto-enabled and decentralized physical infrastructure (DePIN) businesses spanning advertising and attention, credit and liquidity, machine maps, and energy and bandwidth. Its funds have drawn backing from investors including Multicoin Capital. EV3 is an investment firm rather than a product company and publishes no public API or developer surface.

providers.name: eVestment Alliance
providers.description: eVestment Alliance is an institutional investment data, analytics, and market-intelligence platform founded in 2000 and headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. Institutional asset managers report performance, holdings, and firm data into the platform, while investment consultants, asset owners, and allocators use it to research, screen, and compare managers, funds, and strategies across traditional and alternative asset classes. eVestment was acquired by Nasdaq in 2017 and is now delivered as part of Nasdaq's investment-intelligence solutions; its primary website redirects to nasdaq.com/solutions/evestment/. Originally backed by Insight Partners, it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company. No public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface is currently published.

providers.name: Evolv Technology
providers.description: Evolv Technologies Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: EVLV), headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, builds AI-based touchless security screening systems used to detect concealed weapons at venues, schools, hospitals, workplaces, and stadiums. Its flagship Evolv Express walk-through system uses sensor fusion and machine learning to screen people at high throughput without requiring them to stop, empty pockets, or remove bags, and the companion Evolv Insights analytics product reports on screening volume, alert rates, and operational performance. Evolv Technology is a portfolio company of DCVC and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI/Swagger definition, SDK, MCP server, or open developer portal; its public web presence is served behind bot protection and its status surface is gated behind SSO.

providers.name: Exact Target
providers.description: ExactTarget was a digital marketing and email-marketing automation SaaS company founded in 2000 in Indianapolis, Indiana. It built the Fuel developer platform and Interactive Marketing Hub for email, mobile, and social campaign automation, went public on the NYSE (ticker ET) in March 2012, and was acquired by Salesforce in December 2013 for approximately 2.5 billion dollars. ExactTarget became the foundation of Salesforce Marketing Cloud; the exacttarget.com domain now redirects to the Salesforce Marketing Cloud email-marketing product and the former developer.exacttarget.com Fuel/Code@ API platform (REST and SOAP APIs) has been retired and folded into the Salesforce Marketing Cloud developer surface. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a historical/acquired-company record.

providers.name: Exide Technologies
providers.description: Exide Technologies is a global producer and recycler of lead-acid batteries used in transportation and industrial applications, serving automotive, motive power, network power, and other markets. Headquartered in Milton, Georgia, the company operates manufacturing and recycling facilities worldwide. No public developer APIs have been identified; ordering and product data are provided through B2B portals and distributor channels.

providers.name: Expanse
providers.description: Expanse (originally founded as Qadium) was a cybersecurity company specializing in internet attack surface management, continuously discovering and monitoring an organization's internet-connected assets to find exposures and unmanaged risk. The company was backed by IVP, Susa Ventures, and Y Combinator, and was acquired by Palo Alto Networks in 2020. Its technology now ships as Cortex Xpanse, part of the Palo Alto Networks Cortex platform, and the expanse.co domain 301-redirects to the Cortex Xpanse product page. This profile is retained as an acquired-company lead in the API Evangelist network; the company no longer operates an independent developer program or public API surface.

providers.name: FabHotels
providers.description: FabHotels is an Indian branded-budget hotel chain and online booking platform, founded in 2014 by Vaibhav Aggarwal and Adarsh Manpuria and headquartered in Gurugram. It operates a network of 1500+ standardized economy hotels across 80+ cities under the FabHotel, FabHotel Prime, and Via brands, with quality-controlled amenities such as free WiFi, air conditioning, and 24/7 security. Consumers book stays through the FabHotels website and its iOS and Android apps; the company also runs a franchise program for property owners and corporate-stay offerings, and is backed by Accel and Goldman Sachs. No public developer API, SDK, or partner integration surface is advertised — this remains a business-to-consumer travel brand rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Fable Therapeutics
providers.description: Fable Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company developing protein-engineered biologics for obesity and metabolic disease. Its lead candidate, FBL-140, is an infrequently dosed monoclonal antibody antagonizing the activin receptor type II (ActR2) pathway to reduce body weight and fat while preserving lean muscle mass and improving cardiometabolic health, with clinical trials expected to begin in early 2027. The company is also advancing a combination therapy pairing ActR2 antagonism with an incretin mimetic. Fable Therapeutics is a deep-tech portfolio company backed by DCVC. It operates as a traditional drug-development company and does not currently publish any public API, developer documentation, or technical platform.

providers.name: Faception
providers.description: Faception is an Israeli facial personality analytics company that applies proprietary computer vision and machine learning to analyze facial images from photos, video streams, and cameras, scoring individuals against personality and behavioral classifiers. The company markets its technology to public-safety and smart-city security, fintech, retail, insurance, recruiting, and personal-robotics use cases, and states that it analyzes faces anonymously by storing mathematical classifiers rather than personal identity data. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global; at this time it publishes a marketing site and blog but no public API, developer documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Fact Base
providers.description: Fact Base Inc. (株式会社Fact Base) is a Japanese manufacturing-technology company on a mission to make manufacturing seamless by driving the digitization of small and mid-sized factories (町工場). Its corporate site presents the company mission and vision for connecting Japan's fragmented small-factory manufacturing base through digital tooling. Surfaced through the API Evangelist network as an Insight Partners portfolio company; as of this enrichment pass no public developer program, API, OpenAPI, SDK, or documentation is published on the corporate domain.

providers.name: FAI & GLOBAL SOLUTIONS HOLDING LIMITED
providers.description: FAI & GLOBAL SOLUTIONS HOLDING LIMITED is a Saudi Arabian holding company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. Its site at fai.sa is a WordPress property served from nginx behind a WAF that returns HTTP 403 to every external request except /robots.txt, so no company description, developer portal, documentation, or API surface could be retrieved during the enrichment pass. No public API, specification, SDK, or event surface has been observed to date; the domain-security posture was probed successfully and is recorded in security/. Re-probe from an allowed network on a later round to confirm whether a developer surface exists behind the block.

providers.name: Faircraft
providers.description: Faircraft is a biotechnology company creating a new class of cultivated materials, starting with real leather grown in the lab from animal cells rather than raised on farms. Using cell biology and protein engineering, it produces genuine leather (product lines FCL_001 through FCL_006) with the look, feel, and performance of traditional hides but with a lower environmental footprint and no animal farming, and customizable properties for fashion, automotive, and luxury brands. Backed by Kindred Ventures, Faircraft is a materials-science company with no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Fanatics
providers.description: Fanatics is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of softbank-vision-fund, thrive-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: consumer. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: fanli
providers.description: fanli (返利网, fanli.com) is a Chinese cashback and shopping-rewards platform that aggregates promotions, coupons, and rebate offers across major online retailers, letting consumers earn money back on purchases they route through the site. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass, fanli.com is a live consumer-facing web property; no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable API definition, /.well-known discovery surface, llms.txt, or published security/vulnerability-disclosure program was found.

providers.name: fanZ
providers.description: TeamUp Inc. operates fanZ (fanzapp.io), a gamified football (soccer) fan-engagement mobile app for iOS and Android. fanZ combines fantasy football (fantaZ), social following of teams, leagues and players, prediction challenges and mini-games, a rewards system of points, badges and digital collectibles, an official merchandise store, and global leaderboards, plus news, match highlights and video content. The product is a consumer-facing mobile application operated by Wathbah for Information Technology and backed by 500 Global; no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Farfetch
providers.description: Farfetch is a global luxury fashion technology platform and online marketplace connecting consumers with boutiques, brands, and department stores across more than 190 countries, offering designer womenswear, menswear, kidswear, shoes, bags, and accessories. Beyond its consumer marketplace, Farfetch historically operated a B2B arm, Farfetch Platform Solutions (FPS), providing e-commerce, fulfilment, and logistics technology to luxury retailers; the group was acquired by Coupang in early 2024. No public developer portal or API documentation is currently reachable for the marketplace or the platform arm.

providers.name: FashionLab Nordic
providers.description: FashionLab Nordic Inc. is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Fastenal
providers.description: Fastenal is a leading distributor of industrial and construction supplies, offering fasteners, tools, safety equipment, and other industrial products through stores, vending, and e-commerce. While Fastenal provides EDI integrations and supply chain programs like FAST 360, FASTBin, and FASTStock to enterprise customers, no publicly documented API specifications are available.

providers.name: FavStay
providers.description: FavStay is a hotel and accommodation booking company in the travel and hospitality sector, surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the public site at favstay.com is offline (the host returns a Microsoft Azure Web App 404 error and its TLS certificate does not match the domain), indicating the product is defunct or the web presence has been retired. The domain still resolves with Google Workspace email and an SPF record delegating to the Juniper (ejuniper.com) hospitality booking engine, but no public developer surface, API documentation, or machine-readable specification could be found.

providers.name: FBG Capital
providers.description: FBG Capital is a digital asset management firm operating in blockchain-based capital markets, founded in 2015 by Vincent Zhou. One of the earliest and largest blockchain-focused investment firms in Asia, FBG runs a venture arm that backs early-stage blockchain and Web3 startups and a trading/asset-management arm active across cryptocurrency markets. Its portfolio spans DeFi, Layer-1 and Layer-2 protocols, gaming, metaverse, and infrastructure projects (Terra, NEAR, Livepeer, Filecoin, Maple, Origin Protocol, Zilliqa, and many others). FBG Capital publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile tracks the firm as a company/investor node in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Fenxiang Life
providers.description: Fenxiang Life (分享生活) is a Hangzhou-based Chinese social e-commerce and shopping-guide platform that combines cashback rebates with AI-driven price comparison. It returns platform commissions to consumers as cashback and analyzes historical price trends across major Chinese marketplaces including Taobao, JD.com, Pinduoduo, Douyin, and VipShop to help shoppers save money. Founded in 2018, the company reports 50M+ users and is backed by DCM Ventures, Xiaomi, and Toutoushidao Fund. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; the company is consumer-facing and publishes no public developer program, API, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Finmark
providers.description: Finmark was a financial planning, modeling, and forecasting SaaS platform for startups and small businesses, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, letting founders build budgets, cash-flow runway, hiring plans, and scenario models without spreadsheets. It was acquired by BILL (bill.com) and wound down as a standalone product: as of this enrichment pass finmark.com and www.finmark.com return a 301 permanent redirect to https://www.bill.com/. There is no longer an independent Finmark developer portal, API, documentation, pricing, or status page to enrich; the domain-security probe below reflects the residual finmark.com DNS/TLS surface only.

providers.name: Finnomena
providers.description: Finnomena is a Thailand-based wealth-technology and investment platform, headquartered in Bangkok, that lets retail investors research, buy, hold, and rebalance mutual funds and other investment products through a single mobile and web application. The platform combines a robo-advisory experience and model portfolios with an active investment community and a large body of Thai-language market education and analysis content. Finnomena Funds operates as a licensed investment intermediary, and the company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Finnomena publishes a consumer-facing WordPress marketing site and a mobile app but no public developer program, API, or OpenAPI surface, so this profile carries identity and domain-security data only.

providers.name: FireVisor
providers.description: FireVisor is an AI-based manufacturing analytics platform that helps manufacturers leverage their production data beyond traditional defect detection and process control methods. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Singapore (with a secondary office in Toronto, Canada), FireVisor works toward "self-aware factories powered by artificial intelligence," applying machine learning to manufacturing and industrial-automation data. It is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this profile the public firevisor.com site returns a 404 from its load balancer and exposes no public API, developer portal, or documentation.

providers.name: Flagship
providers.description: Flagship is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of index-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: retail. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Flanders Marine Institute
providers.description: The Flanders Marine Institute (Vlaams Instituut voor de Zee, VLIZ) is the Belgian coordination and information platform for marine research, and the operator of Marine Regions, the World Register of Marine Species gazetteer infrastructure and the EMODnet data portals. Its geospatial estate is one of the largest openly callable marine OGC surfaces in Europe.

providers.name: FlexEngage
providers.description: FlexEngage is a retail customer-engagement company that powered transactional and triggered customer communications for retailers and brands, including digital receipts, order and shipping notifications, and omnichannel messaging across email, SMS, and print. The company was backed by Bullpen Capital and was acquired by Narvar in 2019. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced from the Bullpen Capital portfolio; the public site (www.flexengage.com) is currently served behind CloudFront and returns HTTP 403 to automated clients, so no public developer/API surface could be captured during enrichment.

providers.name: Flixster
providers.description: Flixster is an American movie-discovery and social entertainment brand founded in 2007 that let people rate and review movies, browse local showtimes, watch trailers, and share what they were watching. It grew into one of the largest movie communities on the web and mobile, and in 2011 was acquired by Warner Bros. together with Rotten Tomatoes; Fandango Media later acquired both Flixster and Rotten Tomatoes from Warner Bros. in 2016. The Flixster Video digital-locker service (built on UltraViolet) was shut down in 2019. The flixster.com property no longer operates as an independent consumer site — it now redirects to Fandango, and Flixster does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company/brand record; there is no live API surface to enrich.

providers.name: float
providers.description: Float is a design-led product lab founded by David Okuniev and Neil Kinnish, the ex-Typeform Labs team, building new consumer and creator software products under the mantra "we make new products float." Its first product is Supercut, an AI-assisted video tool entering beta. Float raised a EUR 1.6M seed round led by Point Nine Capital with angels including Koen Bok (Framer), Christian Reber and Niklas Jansen (Interface Capital), Soleio, and Robert Munoz (Typeform). As of this enrichment pass Float publishes only a marketing site (float.build) and product landing pages and exposes no public API, developer documentation, SDKs, or developer platform.

providers.name: Flourish
providers.description: Flourish (Flourish Labs) is a New York City based artificial intelligence research company building, in its own words, "human-level intelligence with human-level efficiency." Backed by GV (Google Ventures), the lab concentrates on advanced machine learning systems and foundational AI research rather than a public developer platform. At the time of profiling it publishes a marketing website but exposes no public API, SDK, developer portal, documentation, MCP server, or other developer surface. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a GV portfolio-lead stub and enriched with a live domain-security probe of its website host.

providers.name: Folia Water
providers.description: Folia Water, Inc. is a clean-water social enterprise founded in 2016 by Jonathan Levine, Theresa Dankovich, and Cantwell Carson with the goal of bringing safe drinking water to 100 million people for pennies a day. The company manufactures Folia Filters, an affordable antimicrobial filter paper embedded with silver nanoparticles that kills 99.9999% of bacteria and 99.7% of viruses while removing protozoa and iron. Folia Water sells through distribution partners in emerging markets such as Bangladesh and is backed by 500 Global. It is a physical consumer-products manufacturer with no public developer platform, API, or SDK surface as of this profile.

providers.name: Food Advisor
providers.description: Food Advisor (FoodAdvisor.my) is a Malaysia-based food discovery application founded in 2014 by Kenny Hew and headquartered in Selangor, Malaysia. The service helps users find dishes and restaurants by searching dish names as keywords alongside locations. It is backed by 500 Global through the 500 Durians Southeast Asia fund. As of this profile the public web presence at foodadvisor.my returns HTTP 404 and no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation could be located for enrichment.

providers.name: Formo
providers.description: Formo (Formo Foods GmbH) is a Berlin-based food-technology company producing animal-free dairy through precision fermentation and microbial fermentation of koji (Aspergillus oryzae). Instead of cows, Formo engineers microorganisms to make milk proteins such as casein, which it turns into real cheese and cream cheese products now sold across Germany and Austria. Founded by Raffael Wohlgensinger and backed by EQT Ventures, the company has received a US FDA "no questions" GRAS letter for its fermentation-derived casein. Formo is a consumer food producer and does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Foundation Robotics Labs
providers.description: Foundation Robotics Labs — trading publicly as Foundation and incorporated as Foundation Future Industries, Inc. — is a San Francisco humanoid robotics company founded in April 2024 by Sankaet Pathak, Arjun Sethi and Mike LeBlanc. It builds Phantom, a general-purpose humanoid robot aimed at industrial automation, logistics, inspection, disaster response and defense, and Cortex, the company's self-described physics foundation model built on Deep Variational Bayes Filters that pairs physics-informed prediction with vision-language reasoning to drive the robot. The company's published master plan runs from building humanoids through fleet coherence and on to building cities, and it states explicitly that it designs for military environments, unlike U.S. competitors committed to non-weaponization. Foundation has raised a reported $111M and is traded on the secondary market via Forge Global. As of this profile Foundation publishes NO public developer surface — no developer portal, documentation, API reference, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI definition, SDK, package, MCP server or agent card. Its entire public web presence is a five-page Framer marketing site (home, Phantom, Cortex, master plan, culture, careers) with no /docs, /developers, /api, /pricing, /terms or /privacy paths and no llms.txt. Its GitHub organization (github.com/foundationbot, verified first-party by @foundation.bot commit-author domains) holds internal test benches and forks of open-source robotics tooling — Drake, jetson-containers, Kalibr, PlotJuggler, Fast-DDS, an EtherCAT master, actuator dyno benches and NXP S32K MCU demos — and contains no API specification of any kind.

providers.name: Foxtrot
providers.description: Foxtrot (Foxtrot Market, foxtrotco.com) is a Chicago-based retail chain of upscale convenience stores and cafes combining a neighborhood corner store with a coffee shop and a curated selection of local and specialty food, drink, and grocery goods, plus on-demand delivery and pickup. Surfaced as a portfolio company of d1-capital and added to the API Evangelist network. At the time of enrichment the public site (foxtrotco.com) is a minimal placeholder and the company exposes no public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable specifications.

providers.name: Freeport-McMoRan
providers.description: Freeport-McMoRan is a leading international mining company with headquarters in Phoenix, Arizona, operating large, long-lived geographically diverse assets with significant proven and probable reserves of copper, gold, and molybdenum.

providers.name: Freqens
providers.description: Freqens is an early-stage financial planning and analysis (FP&A) startup building software that helps finance teams leave spreadsheets behind in the agentic era, giving CFOs and finance leaders a better way to work with their numbers. Backed by Seedcamp, the company is currently in a private, invitation-only phase, inviting a small initial group of CFOs and finance leaders. There is no public API, developer portal, or documentation yet; this profile tracks the company for the API Evangelist network as it moves toward a public product.

providers.name: Freshmenu
providers.description: FreshMenu is a Bengaluru-based full-stack food-technology company that operates its own cloud kitchens and cooks, packages, and delivers a daily-changing menu of fresh gourmet meals directly to consumers. Unlike aggregator marketplaces, FreshMenu owns the end-to-end experience — from culinary R&D and kitchen operations to its consumer ordering website and mobile apps — serving Bengaluru, Mumbai, and the Delhi/NCR region (New Delhi and Gurgaon). The company is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and was surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. It publishes a consumer ordering experience but no public API or developer program; this profile captures its identity and infrastructure posture for the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Friend.tech
providers.description: Friend.tech is a decentralized social application built on Base, Coinbase's Ethereum layer-2 network, that lets users tokenize their social graph by buying and selling "keys" (originally "shares") which grant access to private chat rooms and gated content with individual creators. Launched in August 2023 and backed by Paradigm, a key's price rose as more people bought into a given creator. In 2024 the team disabled protocol fees and relinquished control of the on-chain smart contracts to the community. Friend.tech operates a live web frontend (www.friend.tech) but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, SDK, or OpenAPI definition; this profile was surfaced as a Paradigm portfolio company and enriched with the real signals available (live-site domain security posture).

providers.name: Friends with Benefits
providers.description: Friends with Benefits (FWB) is a token-gated social DAO and cultural community at the intersection of web3, art, music, and technology. Membership is gated by holding the $FWB ERC-20 token, which unlocks access to the community's Discord, local city chapters, IRL events, and editorial and creative programming. Backed by a16z crypto, FWB is one of the most cited examples of a social DAO. It is a community organization rather than an API provider: as of this profile it exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal, and its primary web presence (fwb.help) is a membership site. This entry was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead.

providers.name: Friendster
providers.description: Friendster is a mobile-first social network for real-life friends, operating at friendster.com with a native iOS app and a web experience. The service positions itself around privacy and intentional design — no ads, no algorithms, no spam, and an explicit promise never to sell user data — and centers on connecting people with the friends they actually know in real life. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. As of this enrichment pass Friendster publishes a consumer marketing site and a native iOS app, but exposes no public developer program, API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface — so there are no API artifacts to harvest, only company identity and live domain-security posture.

providers.name: Fulfil
providers.description: Fulfil (Fulfil Solutions) is an automation company that builds robotic online-grocery fulfillment systems. Its ShopBot robots perform zero-labor pick-and-pack across all grocery temperatures and categories (ambient, refrigerated, frozen, and produce), providing item-level data and control with claimed 99% order accuracy and roughly 50% lower operating costs. The company operates automated micro-fulfillment facilities and partners with grocery and delivery operators. Backed by DCVC, Fulfil was surfaced as a portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network; it publishes a marketing website but no public developer, API, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: FunFair
providers.description: FunFair began as FunFair Technologies, a blockchain gaming company that built Ethereum-based casino infrastructure (the Fate Channels state-channel technology and the FUN ERC-20 token) to let operators run provably-fair, on-chain casino games. The funfair.io domain now redirects (302) to FunFair Ventures (funfair.ventures), an early-stage Web3 venture firm run by the same team that invests across DeFi, gaming, infrastructure, NFTs, CeFi, social, travel, and DePIN, and sponsors the Blockchain Gaming Alliance. FunFair exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or documentation portal; its historical surface was on-chain smart contracts rather than a hosted REST/HTTP API. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of pantera-capital and enriched with live domain-security probe data.

providers.name: Fuze
providers.description: Fuze was a cloud unified-communications-as-a-service (UCaaS) provider offering enterprise cloud voice, video conferencing, team messaging, and contact-center capabilities for the mobile and distributed workforce. Originally surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Insight Partners, Fuze was acquired by 8x8 in 2022; its website (www.fuze.com) now permanently redirects (HTTP 301) to 8x8.com/fuze and the Fuze product line has been folded into the 8x8 platform. No independent Fuze developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, or public API surface could be found during enrichment. This profile remains in the API Evangelist network as a stub; the only artifact that could be enriched from real signal is a live domain/DNS/TLS security probe of fuze.com.

providers.name: GAGO Group
providers.description: GAGO Group (Beijing Jiage Tianyu Technology Co., Ltd.) is a China-based frontier-technology company focused on agricultural and rural big data applications. Its homepage positions the business around agricultural and rural big data, applying remote-sensing and data-analytics techniques to agriculture. GAGO Group is backed by DCM Ventures and was added to the API Evangelist network from that portfolio. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a corporate website at gagogroup.cn but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification could be verified, so no spec-derived API artifacts were produced.

providers.name: Gen Digital
providers.description: Gen Digital is a global leader in consumer cybersecurity, powering Digital Freedom through a family of trusted brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, Avira, AVG, ReputationDefender, and CCleaner. The company provides cyber safety, identity protection, and privacy solutions to over 500 million users worldwide. Gen Digital does not publish a unified corporate-level public developer portal; product integrations are managed at the individual brand level.

providers.name: GenArts
providers.description: GenArts, Inc. was a Cambridge, Massachusetts developer of visual effects software for the film, broadcast, and advertising industries, best known for its flagship Sapphire plug-in suite used in Oscar-nominated visual effects work since 1996. GenArts was acquired by Boris FX in September 2016; the genarts.com domain now redirects to borisfx.com and the Sapphire product line is developed and sold under the Boris FX brand. The company published no public developer API, SDK, or documented programmatic surface — its products are desktop editing plug-ins. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as an acquired-company lead.

providers.name: General Aviation
providers.description: General Aviation is a Y Combinator-backed startup (Spring 2026 batch) building a new air traffic control (ATC) system by connecting aircraft to the internet. Founded by Ben Frank, the company develops remote ATC tower technology aimed at the roughly 90 percent of airports in the U.S. National Airspace System that currently operate without control towers, giving smaller airfields an affordable path to the safety and efficiency benefits of tower services without the cost of traditional tower infrastructure and staffing. As of this profile the company operates a single marketing landing page and publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: General Cable
providers.description: General Cable Corporation was a global developer and manufacturer of copper, aluminum, and fiber optic wire and cable products. The company was acquired by Prysmian Group in 2018 and integrated into the Prysmian portfolio. No public developer APIs are documented for General Cable.

providers.name: Gens de confiance
providers.description: Gens de confiance is a French online classified-ads marketplace built around trust rather than anonymity. Members reach listings and other members through the communities and networks they already belong to and their mutual connections, so buyers and sellers of goods, housing, jobs, services, and holiday rentals transact with people vouched for by a shared circle instead of strangers. The company operates a consumer web and mobile marketplace and is backed by Partech. No public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Geometer
providers.description: Geometer is a San Francisco-based business incubator that builds and launches innovative, technology-driven companies. It provides founding leadership, physical facilities, guidance, camaraderie, and funding to early-stage teams building game-changing products, in San Francisco and around the world. Geometer operates as a company studio and accelerator rather than a software vendor; as of this profile it publishes no public developer platform, API, SDK, or technical documentation. It was surfaced through the Bloomberg Beta portfolio graph and added to the API Evangelist network as a company lead. Contact is via contact@geometer.io, and the studio is located at 530 Jackson St, 3F, San Francisco, CA 94133.

providers.name: GigaCloud Technology
providers.description: GigaCloud Technology (NASDAQ: GCT) operates the GigaCloud Marketplace, a global B2B e-commerce platform for large-parcel merchandise such as furniture, home furnishings, fitness equipment, and appliances. The marketplace connects manufacturers, primarily in Asia, with resellers across the United States, Europe, and Japan, integrating product discovery, transactions, and end-to-end cross-border logistics including ocean freight, warehousing, and last-mile delivery. The company was added to the API Evangelist network as a dcm-ventures portfolio lead. Enrichment probes found no public developer portal, API documentation, or well-known discovery surface; the corporate site is behind bot protection (HTTP 403), so this profile is limited to verified domain-security posture and company identity.

providers.name: Gilmour Space
providers.description: Gilmour Space Technologies is an Australian venture-backed space company headquartered on the Gold Coast in Queensland, founded in 2012 by brothers Adam and James Gilmour. The company designs and manufactures hybrid-propulsion orbital launch vehicles (the Eris rocket) and satellite platforms (the G-class / ElaraSat bus), and operates the Bowen Orbital Spaceport in North Queensland from which it is pursuing Australia's first sovereign orbital launch. Gilmour Space is backed by investors including Blackbird Ventures, Main Sequence Ventures, 500 Global, Fine Structure Ventures and HESTA. It is added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; the company operates in aerospace and space launch and does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Gilt Groupe
providers.description: Gilt Groupe is a New York-based online retailer that pioneered the "flash sale" model in the United States, offering limited-time, members-only sales of discounted designer fashion, luxury goods, home items, and travel. Founded in 2007, Gilt was acquired by Hudson's Bay Company in 2016 and subsequently sold to Rue La La in 2018, forming Rue Gilt Groupe; the gilt.com storefront remains operational. Gilt's engineering team was an influential early adopter of Scala and microservices and open-sourced roughly fifty JVM libraries (the "gfc" Gilt Foundation Classes, Handlebars-Scala, sbt plugins) to Maven Central under the com.gilt groupId. Gilt operated no public REST API at the time of this enrichment pass - its historical developer.gilt.com API and the github.com/gilt organization are both retired. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Matrix Partners and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: GlowRoad
providers.description: GlowRoad is an Indian social-commerce and reselling platform, headquartered in Bengaluru and founded in 2017, that enabled individuals — predominantly home-based women entrepreneurs — to resell fashion, home, and lifestyle products to their social networks over WhatsApp and Facebook without holding inventory. The company was acquired by Amazon India in 2021 and its reselling model was subsequently folded into Amazon's operations. GlowRoad runs a consumer mobile app and a supplier-onboarding funnel rather than a public developer program; as of this enrichment pass no developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI, or partner API surface is published, and the public web endpoints return HTTP 503.

providers.name: GLP
providers.description: GLP is a leading global logistics real estate and investment management company, developing and operating warehouses, distribution centers, and supply-chain infrastructure alongside a large fund and asset-management business. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of hillhouse and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. Sector: logistics. As of this enrichment pass GLP publishes a WAF-protected corporate website but no discoverable public developer program, API documentation, or developer portal; this profile remains a lead awaiting a public API surface.

providers.name: GMR
providers.description: GMR (General Mining Research) is a crypto and Web3 company backed by Multicoin Capital and tracked in the API Evangelist network. Its public presence is a single-page web application at gmr.xyz identifying it as "General Mining Research" with a general contact at info@gmr.xyz. As of this enrichment pass no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI definition, well-known discovery surface, or SDK/CLI could be found — the only machine-verifiable signal is the domain's TLS/DNS security posture. This profile remains a lead awaiting a published API or developer surface to enrich further.

providers.name: Good Glamm Group
providers.description: Good Glamm Group is an India-based content-to-commerce conglomerate in the personal care and cosmetics sector, founded in September 2021 by Darpan Sanghvi, Priyanka Gill, and Naiyya Saggi and briefly valued as a unicorn after 2021 Series D funding. Its house of brands includes MyGlamm, St.Botanica, The Moms Co, Sirona, Organic Harvest, POPxo, ScoopWhoop, BabyChakra, MissMalini, and Tweak, spanning India, Dubai, Singapore, and the USA. The group was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Prosus Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the goodglamm.com domain serves a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) stakeholder portal, and no public developer API or documentation surface was found.

providers.name: Good Manufacturing Practices
providers.description: A system of processes, procedures, and documentation that ensures products are consistently produced and controlled according to quality standards, commonly used in pharmaceutical, food, and medical device manufacturing. Proper implementation reduces legal and operational risk while supporting audit readiness.

providers.name: GoodsMart International
providers.description: GoodsMart is a Cairo-based premium grocery and household e-commerce delivery startup serving compounds across 6th of October, Sheikh Zayed, and New Cairo. Founded by Rami Fawzi and co-founders (soft-launched 2014, officially launched 2015), it pioneered contactless overnight grocery delivery in Egypt, dropping orders into a pre-installed GoodsMart box outside the customer's home between midnight and 6am. The company operates a consumer-facing mobile app and web storefront for groceries, personal care, and home-care products. It has raised roughly $4.37M from investors including 500 Global, Sawari Ventures, Algebra Ventures, and Savour Ventures. As of this profile, GoodsMart publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal; this remains a company/lead record in the API Evangelist network rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Gowalla
providers.description: Gowalla is a location-based social check-in application that lets people keep up with their friends in the real world by checking in at places, sharing their location, and collecting stamps and passport-style travel memories. Originally launched in 2007 as a pioneering location-based social game, Gowalla was acquired by Facebook in 2011 and wound down in 2012, then relaunched by founder Josh Williams in March 2023 as an iOS app before active development was paused in April 2023.
