The app remains available on the App Store and continues to operate on a limited basis, recruiting early testers through its Street Team program. Gowalla historically published a Check-In API with OAuth 2 support (2010), but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation is available today. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) and added to the API Evangelist network as a consumer-sector lead.

providers.name: Goyaz Silver Jewellery
providers.description: Goyaz Silver Jewellery is a Hyderabad-based Indian jewellery retail brand founded in January 2023 by Priyanka Vemuluri, specializing in 92.5 premium and gold-plated silver jewellery that blends traditional Indian craftsmanship with contemporary, occasion-led design. Operating a chain of 18 retail stores across Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka (including Kukatpally, Punjagutta, Suchitra Circle, Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam), Goyaz positions gold-plated silver as an accessible luxury alternative to gold. In October 2025 the company raised a Rs 130 crore (~$14.6M) Series A round led by Norwest Venture Partners, its first institutional funding, to expand its retail footprint, strengthen design and manufacturing, and enhance its omnichannel experience. The company operates an online storefront and social commerce presence but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. This profile entered the API Evangelist network as a Norwest Venture Partners portfolio lead.

providers.name: graphenest.com
providers.description: Graphenest is a Portuguese nano-cleantech company that develops sustainable, high-performance graphene-based materials for electromagnetic interference (EMI/EMC/RF) shielding. Its proprietary, scalable and low-energy graphene production process powers two industrial-ready product lines: HexaShield, a sprayable conductive coating for high-frequency applications, and G-Shield, a family of conductive thermoplastics for extrusion and injection moulding, plus the G-Prime graphene material. The solutions deliver higher shielding performance at lower cost and weight (up to 75% lighter than metal alternatives) for Tier 1/Tier 2 manufacturers in batteries, electronics, telecom (radar, LiDAR, 5G/6G), and cables & wires. Graphenest is a materials and manufacturing company; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars-linked portfolio lead and enriched from the company's public website.

providers.name: Gravity Sketch
providers.description: Gravity Sketch is a 3D design and modeling application built for spatial creation, letting designers sketch, model, and iterate on concepts in virtual reality (Meta Quest, PC VR) and on tablet. It is widely used across automotive, footwear, industrial, and product design for early-stage ideation and collaborative review, backed by a cloud collaboration platform (LandingPad) for sharing and version history. The company is a creative-tools maker rather than an API-first provider; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, developer portal, or documented webhook surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel, GV, and Point Nine and captures the company identity plus a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Guardicore
providers.description: Guardicore is a micro-segmentation and Zero Trust network security company, founded in 2013 and backed by Battery Ventures and Partech, best known for its Centra platform for software-defined segmentation, application dependency mapping, and lateral-movement threat containment across data center, cloud, and hybrid environments. Guardicore was acquired by Akamai in 2021 and its technology now ships as Akamai Guardicore Segmentation; the guardicore.com domain redirects to the Akamai Segmentation product. This profile tracks Guardicore as a distinct company in the API Evangelist network. Its API reference is delivered through Akamai TechDocs and is login-gated, so no public OpenAPI or standalone developer surface was discoverable during enrichment.

providers.name: Guess
providers.description: Guess? is a global lifestyle brand that designs, markets, distributes, and licenses a leading lifestyle collection of contemporary apparel and accessories for men, women, and children.

providers.name: Gurú de Viaje
providers.description: Gurú de Viaje is a Mexico-based travel-deals company and flight-deal hunter ("cazador de ofertas de viaje") that publishes daily cheap-flight promotions and airfare offers so travelers can fly cheaply and see the world. Its Spanish-language consumer website and mobile/push experience surface daily discounted airline tickets and travel promotions, with a focus on departures from Mexican cities such as Guadalajara and Mexico City. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this pass Gurú de Viaje operates a consumer Next.js web property (gurudeviaje.com) and publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API specification.

providers.name: Gymboree
providers.description: Gymboree is a children's apparel and accessories retailer selling clothing for babies, toddlers, and kids up to age 12 through its consumer e-commerce site at gymboree.com. The brand is owned and operated by The Children's Place, Inc. (headquartered at 500 Plaza Drive, Secaucus, NJ). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of norwest-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Gymboree publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine interface: its site is a purely consumer-facing retail storefront, so no API artifacts (OpenAPI, MCP, SDKs, webhooks) exist to harvest. This profile carries only the identity and infrastructure-security probe of the gymboree.com domain.

providers.name: Halp
providers.description: Halp was a conversational ticketing and help-desk tool that let teams turn Slack and Microsoft Teams messages into trackable tickets, founded in Boulder, Colorado and backed by Techstars. Atlassian acquired Halp in February 2020 and folded its capabilities into Jira Service Management; the standalone Halp product and its API were subsequently discontinued. The halp.com domain now resolves to Atlassian and is served from Atlassian's edge, so no independent Halp developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or MCP surface remains to enrich. This profile records the company's history and the (Atlassian-operated) security posture still observable on the halp.com domain.

providers.name: Hanesbrands
providers.description: Hanesbrands is a global consumer apparel company designing, manufacturing, and selling everyday basic apparel under brands including Hanes, Champion, Bali, Maidenform, and Bonds. In 2025 Hanesbrands was acquired by Gildan, with both companies continuing to operate as a combined apparel leader.

providers.name: Hanqi Group
providers.description: Beijing Hanqi Environmental Technology Co., Ltd. (Hanqi Group) is a Beijing-based environmental technology company specializing in full-process chemical and oily wastewater treatment for the petrochemical, coal-chemical, new-energy, industrial-park, and municipal sectors. With roughly 17 years of operating history, 140+ client references, and 80+ patents across physicochemical, biochemical, and oxidation process categories, Hanqi delivers engineered water-treatment technologies and services rather than software. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Public research confirms no developer, API, SDK, or agent surface exists for this provider.

providers.name: haoyiku
providers.description: Haoyiku (好衣库) is a Chinese private-domain social e-commerce and brand flash-sale platform operated by Haoyiku (Hangzhou) Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. and associated with Jingling Group, founded in December 2017. It equips millions of individual store owners with a one-click storefront, dropship supply chain, private-domain traffic tooling, operations training, and after-sales services, spanning apparel, footwear, bags, cosmetics, personal care, mother-and-baby, and daily-necessities categories across more than 15,000 brand partnerships. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners, Haoyiku is a consumer mobile-app business with no public developer platform or API program; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Hardware Intelligence
providers.description: Hardware Intelligence is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) startup based in San Francisco building an end-to-end, agent-native toolchain for chip design. Founded in 2026 by Athreya Anand, the company applies agentic AI and ultrafast feedback loops to the semiconductor design and verification workflow. Its first product, Wave, is a terminal-native waveform debugger with a verification agent built in, aimed at accelerating hardware debugging and design iteration. At the time of profiling the company is pre-launch with early-access pilots and a waitlist; it publishes no public API, developer documentation, SDKs, or OpenAPI, so this API Evangelist profile captures company identity only and awaits a developer surface to enrich.

providers.name: Harley-Davidson
providers.description: Shop the Official Harley-Davidson site for new and used motorcycles, genuine parts and apparel. Locate a dealer or take a test ride. Harley-Davidson does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Hatcheri
providers.description: Hatcheri (Hatcheri Foods) is a food-focused incubator-accelerator based in San Leandro, California that partners with emerging food and beverage brands to build and scale them. Founded in 2013, it operates through three arms: Hatcheri Brands (leading day-to-day operations alongside founders), Hatcheri Advisory Services (hands-on strategic support across supply chain, marketing, sales, financial management, food safety, and product innovation), and Hatcheri Capital (investment and funding partnerships). Portfolio and partner brands include Sonoma Gourmet, Snapdragon, Fra' Mani, Sukhi's, and Sonoma Specialty Foods. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners. Hatcheri publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or technical documentation; this profile is a company/provider identity record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: HathiTrust
providers.description: HathiTrust is a company surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (source: tag-qc) and added to the network as a stub for full-pipeline profiling.

providers.name: HeartyyFresh
providers.description: HeartyyFresh is a mobile-first Indian grocery delivery service that lets customers order fresh Indian groceries and household staples for home delivery through its iOS and Android apps. The consumer offering centers on convenience and quality, promoting a first-time incentive of 20% off the first five orders placed through the app. HeartyyFresh operates as a direct-to-consumer grocery app (published under the com.rahein.heartyyfresh Android package and the "HeartyyFresh - Indian Grocery" iOS listing) rather than a developer platform; it exposes no public API, developer portal, documentation, or SDKs at this time. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-lead stub and enriched for identity only.

providers.name: Heights Labs
providers.description: Heights Labs is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of pantera-capital, techstars and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: crypto. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Hello Alice
providers.description: Hello Alice is a free, multichannel digital platform that helps small business owners start, grow, and fund their businesses. Founded in 2017 by Carolyn Rodz and Elizabeth Gore, it connects millions of entrepreneurs to capital (grants and loans), a peer network, business-health tools, and educational resources, and partners with enterprises, financial institutions, and government programs to distribute grant funding and support to underserved small business owners. Backed by QED Investors among others. The company operates a consumer web application at helloalice.com; no public developer API or documented API program was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Hello Gold
providers.description: HelloGold is a Malaysian fintech company operating a mobile gold-savings app that lets everyday users buy, save, sell, send, and redeem 99.99% investment-grade gold starting from as little as RM1, with physical redemption from a minimum of 1 gram. Its SmartSaver feature runs an automated 12-month savings plan that buys gold at the lowest weekday price on the user's behalf. The service is Shariah-compliant (certified by Amanie Advisors), with gold stored in an insured and audited Singapore vault. HelloGold is a portfolio company of 500 Global and a recognized Islamic-fintech player. This profile is a consumer mobile-app company with no public developer/API surface identified during enrichment.

providers.name: Hershey
providers.description: The Hershey Company is a Fortune 500 confectionery and snacking manufacturer headquartered in Hershey, Pennsylvania, producing Hershey's, Reese's, Kit Kat (US), Jolly Rancher, Ice Breakers, SkinnyPop and Dot's Pretzels across North America and international markets. Hershey is a consumer packaged goods company rather than a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, no public API reference, and no machine-readable contract. Its public digital surface is the corporate site at thehersheycompany.com, the consumer brand site Hersheyland (hershey.com redirects there), and an investor relations site. This profile records that absence with the probes behind it, alongside press and blog coverage of the company's internal AI and data-platform investment.

providers.name: Hidden Leaf Games
providers.description: Hidden Leaf Games is an independent video game development studio founded in 2019 and based in the United States. The studio builds competitive multiplayer games centered on competition, progression, and social play, with a stated mission of delivering a world-class experience where games are meant to be played together regardless of skill level or platform. The company is led by CEO David Li and President Bao Lam and raised seed funding from Lightspeed Venture Partners in 2021. Hidden Leaf Games is a consumer gaming company and does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, or SDK; this profile tracks it as a portfolio-sourced lead in the API Evangelist network for ongoing enrichment.

providers.name: High Jump Software
providers.description: HighJump Software was a Minneapolis-based provider of supply chain execution software, best known for its warehouse management system (WMS) and its extensible, configurable architecture for distribution, direct-store-delivery, and manufacturing operations. The company was acquired by Battery Ventures in 2014, expanded through acquisitions (Accellos, Nexus, TrueCommerce lines), then acquired by Körber in 2017 and folded into Körber Supply Chain Software. As of 2024 the portfolio was rebranded Infios. The standalone HighJump brand is retired: highjump.com now 301-redirects to infios.com, and the company publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification. This profile is retained as a historical / acquired-company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Hillenbrand
providers.description: Hillenbrand is a global manufacturer of highly engineered, mission-critical processing equipment and systems serving the plastics, food, and recycling industries. The company operates across more than 60 global locations with a portfolio of leading industrial brands. Hillenbrand reports approximately $2.7 billion in annual revenue and employs over 8,000 associates worldwide.

providers.name: Hop Aero
providers.description: Hop Aero is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) aerospace and defense company based in Los Angeles, California, founded in 2024 by Jacob Balaj and Matija Milenovic. The company develops hypersonic rocket cargo vehicles that deliver payloads point-to-point into austere, contested environments hundreds of miles away in minutes, aiming to give the United States and its allies an asymmetric logistics advantage. Hop Aero has raised a $3M pre-seed round and won a $1.25M U.S. Air Force SBIR award; its team draws on experience from SpaceX, Virgin Orbit, Masten Space Systems, SpinLaunch, and Destinus. This is a hardware-stage company with no public API or developer surface at the time of profiling; this record was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and is maintained for network discovery and enrichment.

providers.name: HopShop
providers.description: HopShop Inc. is a consumer AI fashion-discovery and creator-monetization platform, often described as "Shazam for Fashion." Shoppers upload or screenshot an outfit and HopShop's visual-search AI finds the exact item plus similar matches across 600+ brand partners, including Bloomingdale's, Nordstrom, Levi's, and Tommy Hilfiger. Creators and influencers build personalized shops, link the outfits they feature on Instagram to shoppable products, grow their communities, and earn affiliate commissions. The company is backed by 500 Global. As surfaced to the API Evangelist network, HopShop operates as a consumer-facing mobile and web application and publishes no public developer API, SDKs, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and probed domain security.

providers.name: Hortor Games
providers.description: Hortor Games (Beijing Haoteng Chuangxiang Technology Co., Ltd. / 北京豪腾创想科技有限公司) is a Chinese mobile game developer and publisher focused on casual, word, and mini-game titles distributed as standalone apps and as WeChat / Douyin mini-games. Its catalog includes idiom and word puzzle games such as 成语小秀才, plus casual titles like 肥鹅健身房 (Goose Gym), 咸鱼之王, 海岛来了, and 稻田路. The company operates consumer game landing and distribution sites across the hortorgames.com, hortorcx.com, and 666youxiting.com domains. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer API program, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Hotmail
providers.description: Hotmail was one of the first free web-based email services, launched in 1996 by Sabeer Bhatia and Jack Smith and among the earliest venture-backed consumer web companies (funded by Draper Fisher Jurvetson and Menlo Ventures). Microsoft acquired Hotmail in December 1997 and operated it as MSN Hotmail and later Windows Live Hotmail. In 2013 Microsoft folded Hotmail into Outlook.com; hotmail.com mailboxes remain fully active but are served by Outlook.com and Microsoft 365 infrastructure. Hotmail exists today only as a legacy consumer email brand and domain, with no standalone developer program. Programmatic access to hotmail.com mailboxes is provided through Microsoft Graph (Outlook Mail) and the standard IMAP, POP, and SMTP protocols, not a dedicated Hotmail API.

providers.name: Huaun
providers.description: Huaun (华云安, Huayun'an) is a Beijing-based cybersecurity company specializing in attack surface management, vulnerability research, and adversarial (offensive/defensive) security. Its product line centers on three AI-driven systems: Ai·Vul (灵洞), an adaptive threat and vulnerability management platform that discovers and inventories host, web, IoT, and container-cluster assets along with eighteen classes of digital exposure including APIs; Ai·Radar (灵知), a threat-intelligence engine built on natural-language processing and knowledge graphs across thirty-plus data sources; and Ai·Bot (灵刃), an intelligent penetration-testing and attack-simulation system backed by a library of over 160,000 vulnerabilities and 2,000+ proof-of-concept exploits. Backed by DCM Ventures and other investors, Huaun helps enterprises continuously discover and validate their external and internal attack surface.

providers.name: Huixiaoer
providers.description: Huixiaoer (会小二) is a Chinese online platform for booking meeting venues, hotel conference rooms, and event spaces, operated by Beijing Yundong Digital Media Technology (北京云动数字媒体技术有限公司). It connects companies with a network of conference hotels and specialty venues across China and 20+ overseas cities, offering venue matching, price negotiation, and one-on-one meeting-planning advisors, plus bundled catering, accommodation, transportation, staging, team-building, incentive travel, and exhibition booth services on a free-to-client, commission-based model. Backed by DCM Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; no public developer program, API, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: HUM Industries
providers.description: HUM Industries is a consumer hardware company building a wearable AI assistant designed to enhance social presence. The device records conversations locally, maintains a rolling buffer of recent audio, and surfaces contextual information such as names, personal details, and commitments back to the wearer through subtle audio cues. The company frames the product as giving people "the freedom to forget" by offloading memory to the device so they can stay present in the moment. At the time of profiling the product is pre-launch, offered through a preorder waitlist, with no public API, developer portal, or third-party integration surface. Backed by a16z; added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead.

providers.name: Hyperspace
providers.description: Hyperspace is a crypto/blockchain venture backed by Pantera Capital, added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub. As of July 2026 its domain hyperspace.xyz 301-redirects to joinearlybird.com, where the project now operates as "Earlybird" — a pre-mainnet blockchain effort ("When Mainnet? Soon") with a private devnet at dev.joinearlybird.com (access-restricted, HTTP 403). There is no public API, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, developer portal, documentation, pricing, or terms surface published yet; no /.well-known discovery documents are served on either host. This profile remains a lead awaiting a real developer surface before the enrichment pipeline can capture substantive API artifacts.

providers.name: IA Ventures
providers.description: IA Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm based in New York City, at 920 Broadway, 15th Floor. It backs founders building data-driven businesses across financial technology, machine learning, and infrastructure, typically at the seed and early stage. IA Ventures was surfaced as a portfolio-adjacent firm within the API Evangelist network and is profiled here as a venture-capital company rather than an API producer: it publishes a minimal single-page website and does not expose a public API, developer portal, or event surface. This profile captures the firm's identity and the security posture of its public domain.

providers.name: Iconic
providers.description: Iconic (Iconic Interactive) is an AI gaming studio building real-time AI systems for video games and interactive storytelling — "Digital Actor" technology that lets game characters listen, react, and evolve alongside the player by combining speech recognition, large language models, and text-to-speech into low-latency conversational performances. Founded by veterans of GTA, Forza, Just Cause, and Sleeping Dogs with AI researchers from Cambridge and Imperial College, the company is backed by Northzone. Its flagship title, The Oversight Bureau, ships a demo on Steam. Iconic operates a marketing site, a Labs surface, and a technical blog; it does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a Northzone portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Identify3D
providers.description: Identify3D developed software to secure the digital (additive / 3D-printing) manufacturing supply chain by encrypting, distributing, and tracing digital part files, so that a part could only be produced by an authorized user, machine, and material and non-conforming or counterfeit parts could not enter the physical supply chain. The suite coupled part designs with production criteria (designated user, machine, material) and provided intellectual-property protection, digital-rights management, and traceability for distributed manufacturing. Founded in San Francisco and backed by Uncork Capital, Identify3D was acquired by Materialise NV in October 2021 and its technology was folded into the Materialise CO-AM distributed-manufacturing platform. The company no longer operates a standalone product, developer portal, or public API; this profile is retained in the API Evangelist network for historical and VC portfolio-graph purposes.

providers.name: Ideon Technologies
providers.description: Ideon Technologies (ideon.ai) develops REVEAL, a subsurface intelligence platform that uses muon tomography and geophysical inversion to image, map, and monitor mineral deposits and geological structures deep underground. It helps mining companies reduce geologic uncertainty across exploration, resource evaluation, geotechnical analysis, and cave monitoring, with customers including Rio Tinto, Vale, Glencore, and BHP. The company is backed by Playground Global. Ideon publishes a marketing and content web presence (solutions, case studies, papers, blog, careers) but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile tracks the company as a network lead.

providers.name: idsmanager
providers.description: IDSManager (Jiuzhou Yunteng, 九州云腾) is a Chinese enterprise cybersecurity vendor providing unified identity management and zero-trust security. Its IDaaS platform centralizes account lifecycle, authentication, and authorization around a 5A framework (application center, unique accounts, single sign-on, centralized authorization, transparent auditing). The product line spans the IPG identity authentication series, MFA combining biometrics and digital certificates, the SPG secure application authentication series with Web and API gateways, and an SDP identity-defined perimeter for zero-trust access. It targets cloud migration, mobile-office security, and regulatory compliance across internet, finance, government, manufacturing, and education sectors. No public developer portal, API, or SDK is currently published.

providers.name: Illinois Tool Works
providers.description: Illinois Tool Works (ITW) is a Fortune 500 global multi-industrial manufacturer of value-added consumables and specialty equipment with related service businesses across automotive OEM, food equipment, test and measurement, electronics, welding, polymers and fluids, construction products, and specialty products. ITW does not publish a public API or developer program. This repository exists to track APIs, SDKs, and developer resources should they become available.

providers.name: Inditex
providers.description: A Spanish multinational fashion group and the world's largest apparel retailer operating brands including Zara, Massimo Dutti, and Pull&Bear. Known for its fast-fashion model with rapid design-to-store turnaround times. No public developer portal or open API catalogue was located on inditex.com.

providers.name: infarm
providers.description: infarm (Indoor Urban Farming GmbH) is a Berlin-based vertical/indoor farming company, surfaced as a portfolio company of balderton-capital and added to the API Evangelist network. The company builds modular, cloud-connected growing systems for herbs, leafy greens, and produce placed in grocery stores and distribution hubs. This profile was enriched by the pipeline; infarm publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or documentation surface, and its website is bot-blocked (HTTP 403) to automated access, so only domain-level security posture could be probed. It remains a company/identity record rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Inferact
providers.description: Inferact is an AI inference infrastructure startup founded by the creators and core maintainers of vLLM, the most popular open-source LLM inference engine. Its mission is to grow vLLM as the world's AI inference engine and to make serving AI models effortless — as simple as spinning up a serverless database — by optimizing inference performance across diverse hardware, supporting emerging model architectures (mixture-of-experts, multimodal, and agentic), and expanding accelerator compatibility while keeping all optimizations flowing back to the open-source community. vLLM supports 500+ model architectures across 200+ accelerator types with 2,000+ contributors. This profile was surfaced as a venture-portfolio lead and enriched with verifiable public identity and domain-security signals; the company does not yet publish a public API, developer portal, or specification.

providers.name: Inloop Robotics
providers.description: Inloop Robotics (InLoop) is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) startup in San Francisco offering robotics-as-a-service for warehouses, fulfillment centers, and light manufacturing. Its bimanual "Loop V1" robot performs box assembly, kitting, visual inspection, content preparation, unpackaging, and order pick-and-pack. The system runs a hybrid-autonomy, human-in-the-loop model: onboard AI handles routine work while remote teleoperators take over on edge cases, and production failures feed continuous learning. InLoop sells this as a flat monthly subscription that bundles the hardware, ongoing AI updates, and 24/7 teleassistance fallback, rather than selling robots outright. As of this profile the company publishes a marketing site only, with no public developer portal, API, SDK, or documentation surface; this record tracks it as an API Evangelist network lead pending any future developer/API program.

providers.name: Inmemori
providers.description: Inmemori is a French funeral services company ("pompes funebres") that organizes and manages personalized funeral arrangements with an emphasis on transparency, fair pricing, and full handling of legal and administrative procedures. Available 24/7 across agencies in Paris, Bordeaux, Nantes, and Lyon, Inmemori supports families through burial and cremation, secular and religious ceremonies (Christian, Jewish, Muslim, Buddhist), coffins, urns and floral arrangements, funeral pre-planning, and online memorial tribute pages. Backed by Partech, the company operates in the consumer end-of-life services sector. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; Inmemori publishes a consumer website and blog but no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Insamo
providers.description: Insamo is a biotechnology company building membrane-permeable, orally available cyclic peptides that combine the binding affinity of antibodies with the pharmacology of small molecules for drug discovery. Its platform automates the design, synthesis, and testing of peptides at large scale and applies machine learning across vast chemical spaces to identify therapeutic candidates. Founded in February 2024 with $12M from Playground Global, venBio, and MRL Ventures Fund, the company operates from Berkeley, California and Chippendale, New South Wales, Australia. Insamo currently publishes no public developer or API surface; this profile tracks the company in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Insent.ai
providers.description: Insent.ai was a Boston-based, Techstars-backed B2B conversational marketing platform that let marketing and sales teams engage website visitors in real time with human-first chat, visitor identification, routing, and meeting booking. ZoomInfo acquired Insent in July 2021 and rebranded the product as ZoomInfo Chat; the insent.ai domain now serves ZoomInfo Chat. As a standalone company Insent.ai no longer operates its own developer portal, documentation, or public API surface, so the enrichment pipeline found no first-party API artifacts to harvest.

providers.name: Instaplay
providers.description: Instaplay is an AI-native social gaming platform that turns plain-text prompts into playable multiplayer games with no coding required. Users describe a game idea in natural language ("a two-player pong game where paddles shrink after every point") and the platform generates a playable prototype that can be tested, remixed, and shared via link within seconds. It supports party, co-op, competitive, local, online, and solo formats. Founded in San Francisco and part of Y Combinator's Summer 2026 batch, Instaplay frames games as a training ground for world models and embodied agents on the path to AGI.

providers.name: Institut für Produktqualität
providers.description: Institut für Produktqualität (ifp) is an independent analytical testing laboratory based in Berlin, Germany, providing laboratory analysis, testing, and consulting services for food, feed, cosmetics, and pharmaceutical products. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass the provider publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or machine-readable discovery surface; its public website is served behind bot-protection (HTTP 401) and exposes no /.well-known documents. This profile therefore carries identity and domain-security signal only.

providers.name: Intellimize
providers.description: Intellimize was an AI-powered website optimization, personalization, and conversion-rate optimization platform (an amplify-partners portfolio company in the ai-ml sector) that let marketing teams continuously test and machine-learn the best-performing landing-page and website experience for each visitor. It was acquired by Webflow in 2024 and folded into the Webflow Optimize product; the entire intellimize.com domain now 301-redirects to webflow.com/feature/optimize. As a standalone brand Intellimize no longer operates an independent developer portal, public API, documentation, or SDK surface — enrichment therefore found no OpenAPI, packages, well-known documents, MCP server, or security/trust program of its own. Only live domain-security posture for the retained intellimize.com domain could be probed.

providers.name: International Paper
providers.description: International Paper is a Fortune 500 producer of fiber-based packaging, pulp, and paper products serving customers in more than 150 countries. The company does not currently publish a public developer API program; business integrations are handled through customer and supplier portals.

providers.name: Invidica
providers.description: Invidica is an Oakland-based B2B wholesale ecommerce marketplace (founded 2019) that upgrades the wholesaler-retailer relationship for the reseller economy. It pairs a marketplace where resellers order wholesale products directly from brands with AI-driven analytics that combine Amazon sales data to predict an item's profitability, sales velocity, and competition, helping small sellers find the most profitable products to resell. Founded by CEO Sean Bovell and backed by 500 Global and 1517 Fund (pre-seed, 2021). The company appears to be pivoting under the Reroute Retail brand (rerouteretail.com, "launching soon"); its original invidica.com domain no longer resolves. No public API or developer surface is currently published.

providers.name: Iomob
providers.description: Iomob (The Internet of Mobility) was a Barcelona-based Mobility-as-a-Service (MaaS) technology company founded in 2017. Its platform let cities, transport operators, and corporations orchestrate multimodal, door-to-door journeys — combining public transit, ride-hailing, taxis, micromobility, parking, and demand-responsive transport — through unified journey-planning APIs, native iOS/Android SDKs, and customizable white-label apps. Iomob's MaaS platform and SDK were acquired by Busup in January 2025 to build a corporate mobility platform; the Iomob UK entity was dissolved in September 2025 and the public website (iomob.net) is currently offline (Cloudflare 526 origin error). No public developer portal, OpenAPI, SDK packages, or GitHub organization could be verified during enrichment — Iomob's APIs and SDKs were delivered under B2B/partner agreements.

providers.name: IQI Inc (Beijing AIQI Technology)
providers.description: IQI Inc, operating as Beijing AIQI Technology Co., Ltd. (北京爱其科技有限公司), is a mobile-internet company founded in April 2013 that develops smart hardware and robotics products under a "Create more & More fun" philosophy. It is best known for its ONEBOT building-block robots and construction sets — including the Mi Tu (米兔) block robots in the Xiaomi ecosystem and heritage-architecture sets such as the Millennium Mortise-and-Tenon (千年榫), Qinian Hall (祈年殿) and Forbidden City Corner Tower kits. The company sells through its own store, Tmall (ONEBOT flagship) and JD.com. It is a consumer smart-hardware/toy brand; as of this profile it publishes no public developer platform, API, SDK or documentation surface.

providers.name: Iris Automation
providers.description: Iris Automation was a Reno, Nevada deep-tech company that built Casia, a computer-vision detect-and-avoid (DAA) system enabling beyond-visual-line-of-sight (BVLOS) drone operations. Its onboard products (Casia, Casia X) and the ground-based Casia G used industrial cameras and machine-learning to detect non-cooperative intruder aircraft and prevent near mid-air collisions, integrating with MavLink-based autopilots and UAS ground control systems. Iris Automation was acquired by uAvionix in late 2023; the irisonboard.com domain now 301-redirects to uAvionix and the company exposes no public developer API, documentation, or well-known surface of its own.

providers.name: Isidor
providers.description: Isidor is a frontier enterprise-AI company, founded in 2025 and headquartered in San Francisco with a London presence, building secure, vertically-integrated data pipelines that transform unstructured proprietary enterprise data into training- and evaluation-ready material for foundation models. Its platform spans five capabilities it describes as evaluation (industry-specific and agentic benchmarks), verifiers for generative-AI outputs in critical workflows, reasoning-trace data capture, foundation-model post-training (fine-tuning and alignment on proprietary data), and enterprise-grade security and privacy. Isidor raised an oversubscribed $3.6M pre-seed led by Gradient Ventures, futurepresent, and Seedcamp, with angels from Google DeepMind, Perplexity, and others. The company has no public API or developer surface yet; this profile tracks it as an enrichment lead in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: ITA Software
providers.description: ITA Software is a travel technology company, now part of Google, that builds airfare pricing, shopping, and availability software for airlines, online travel agencies, and travel management companies. Founded in 1996 in Cambridge, Massachusetts by MIT computer scientists (notably Jeremy Wertheimer) and backed early by Battery Ventures, General Catalyst, and Sequoia Capital, the company was acquired by Google in 2011. Its flagship QPX engine powers pricing, revenue shopping, ticket rebooking, award-flight search, ancillary merchandising, and flight schedule/seat availability for carriers including Air Canada, American Airlines, Delta, United, and Virgin Atlantic, and its technology underpins Google Flights. ITA Software also operates the consumer ITA Matrix flight-search tool at matrix.itasoftware.com. The former public QPX Express REST API was retired by Google in April 2018; today ITA Software's QPX solutions are delivered as an enterprise engagement through Google account teams, with no public self-service developer program, portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Izif
providers.description: Izif (إعزف) is an online music education platform for the Arabic-speaking world, positioning itself as the largest platform for teaching music in Arabic. It offers a subscription library of more than 2,000 instructional videos across roughly ten popular Arabic instruments — oud, guitar, violin, piano, ney, darbuka, qanun, vocals, and music theory — taught by elite Arab musicians, alongside music sheets and iOS/Android apps. A 500 Global portfolio company, Izif is a consumer EdTech subscription service and publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK at this time.

providers.name: J.Crew Group
providers.description: J.Crew Group, Inc. is an American multi-brand specialty retailer offering women's, men's, and children's apparel, shoes, and accessories under the J.Crew, Madewell, and Crewcuts brands. The company operates retail stores, factory outlet stores, and direct-to-consumer e-commerce sites.

providers.name: JAKA
providers.description: JAKA (Shanghai JAKA Robotics Co., Ltd.) is a collaborative robot (cobot) manufacturer founded in 2014 and headquartered in Shanghai, China, with origins in robotics research at Shanghai University. The company designs and builds lightweight, human-collaborative industrial robot arms — including its JAKA Zu series and MiniCobo — used across manufacturing, 3C electronics, automotive, healthcare, education, and commercial service applications. JAKA robots are programmed through the company's on-device control software and a robot SDK (C++/Python) that communicates with the robot controller over TCP/IP on the local network, rather than a public cloud web API. As of this profile JAKA does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or hosted REST/MCP API surface; this repository is a company profile in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: JD Business
providers.description: JD Business is the enterprise-facing arm of JD.com (Jingdong), one of China's largest technology and retail companies, offering B2B procurement, supply-chain, and corporate purchasing services to businesses. JD.com operates across retail, logistics, technology, health, and industrials, and runs the JD Open Platform (JOS / "Zeus" Developer Center) at jos.jd.com, where third-party merchants and partners integrate with JD's e-commerce, order, product, and logistics systems. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-linked company and is being enriched from JD's public surface; JD's developer platform and enterprise services are primarily China-market and Chinese-language.

providers.name: Jetway
providers.description: Jetway was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio lead pointing at nextravel.com. Enrichment found that nextravel.com now 301-redirects to TravelPerk (www.travelperk.com), which itself redirects to www.perk.com, an all-in-one business travel and expense-management platform. NexTravel was a US corporate-travel startup acquired by TravelPerk; it no longer operates as an independent brand and publishes no public developer API, API documentation, developer portal, or /.well-known discovery documents at nextravel.com (every probed path soft-404s to the Perk marketing site). This profile is retained as an acquired/redirected lead with no independent developer surface to enrich.

providers.name: jiayuan
providers.description: Jiayuan (世纪佳缘, jiayuan.com) is one of China's largest online dating and serious-relationship matchmaking platforms, connecting members seeking marriage and long-term relationships through profile matching, search, messaging, and offline matchmaking services delivered on web and mobile apps. Founded in 2003 and later part of the Baihe Jiayuan group, it operates as a consumer-facing social/dating product. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it does not appear to publish a public developer API program, so this profile carries company identity and probed domain-security signals rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Jiumaojiu
providers.description: Jiumaojiu (Jiu Mao Jiu International Holdings, HKEX: 09922) is a Chinese casual-dining restaurant group headquartered in Guangzhou and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange since January 2020. Founded roughly three decades ago, it operates 600+ restaurants across mainland China, Southeast Asia and North America under five brands: Jiumaojiu (Shanxi handmade-noodle cuisine), Tai Er (sour cabbage fish, 400+ locations), Song Hot Pot (Chongqing hot pot), Shan Wai Mian (Guizhou sour-soup hot pot) and Chao Na Bian (Chaoshan grilled beef). Backed by IDG Capital. As a consumer food-and-beverage operator it publishes no public developer API, documentation portal, or SDKs; this profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a company identity lead.

providers.name: Jjgmachining
providers.description: JJG (JJG Aero Pvt Ltd, JJG Machining Pvt Ltd, and JJG Special Processing Pvt Ltd) is a precision contract-manufacturing group founded in 2004 that produces machined components for the aerospace, automotive, and industrial sectors. It offers 2-5 axis CNC machining alongside high-volume turned and turn-mill parts in ferrous, aluminum, copper alloys, and titanium, backed by 30+ NADCAP-approved special processes such as electroplating, anodizing, paint, and NDT. This is a physical manufacturing company with no public API, developer program, or machine-readable API artifacts; the profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record only.

providers.name: Jobedu
providers.description: Jobedu is a Jordanian pop-culture creative retail and merchandise brand known for Arabic-language streetwear, apparel, prints, and consumer goods, operating a direct-to-consumer e-commerce storefront hosted on Shopify. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of the July 2026 enrichment pass the jobedu.com storefront returns HTTP 404 (Shopify-hosted, DNS points to shops.myshopify.com) and no public API, developer portal, documentation, or /.well-known surface could be found, so no API artifacts were produced beyond a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: jsgaiya
providers.description: Jiangsu Gaiya Environmental Engineering Co., Ltd. (江苏盖亚环境工程有限公司) is a Suzhou-based environmental engineering and technology company, described on its site as the region's first firm specializing in contaminated-soil remediation, with offices at the Nanjing University Suzhou High-Tech Research Institute. Its business covers environmental engineering design and construction, environmental testing and risk assessment, R&D and sale of environmental-protection equipment, product distribution, and environmental technology consulting. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of the Qiming venture network. Enrichment probes found a static Chinese-language marketing website (IIS, GB2312) and no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, or other machine-readable developer surface.

providers.name: Jubilee
providers.description: Jubilee Inc (Jubilee Media) is a Los Angeles-based digital media production company that creates discussion-based and dating video shows designed to provoke thoughtful conversation and foster human connection across social and ideological divides. Its flagship YouTube programs include Middle Ground, Odd One Out, and Ranking, alongside sister dating channels such as Love Comma Nectar (Versus 1) and the reaction and behind-the-scenes brand TwoBilee. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public API or developer platform at this time, so this profile carries identity and domain-security signal only.

providers.name: Jump Ramp Games
providers.description: Jump Ramp Games was a New York City casual mobile gaming company best known for Lucktastic, a free scratch-card, rewards, and instant-win app that launched on Android in 2014 and grew to roughly 10 million US installs across Android and iOS, consistently ranking near the top of the lifestyle category. Founded by Alex Betancur and Tony Vartanian and backed by Bullpen Capital, the company paired free-to-play casual gaming with performance-marketing and rewards technology. Jump Ramp Games was acquired by MobilityWare in September 2019, which took over the Lucktastic franchise; the jumprampgames.com domain now redirects to mobilityware.com. The company exposes no public developer, API, or documentation surface, so this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Jupiter Endovascular
providers.description: Jupiter Endovascular, Inc. is a privately held medical technology company headquartered in Menlo Park, California, developing Endoportal Control, a platform technology that fixes a flexibly navigated endoportal device into a stable state inside the vasculature so a catheter-based intervention can be delivered with the precision and control of direct surgical access. Its lead product is the Vertex Pulmonary Embolectomy System for acute pulmonary embolism, evaluated in the SPIRARE I first-in-human study (NCT06571760) and the FDA-approved SPIRARE II U.S. pivotal study. The company exited stealth with $21M and later closed an oversubscribed Series B surpassing its $40M target, led by Sonder Capital. Jupiter Endovascular is a pre-commercial clinical-stage device manufacturer and publishes no developer program, no API, and no machine-readable interface of any kind.

providers.name: Já Entendi
providers.description: Já Entendi is a Brazilian corporate-education (EdTech) company based in Curitiba that converts traditional corporate training materials into short, video-based online courses designed for workforces with lower levels of formal education. Its learning platform combines andragogy, heutagogy, storytelling, neurolinguistics, instructional design, and mind mapping to deliver more effective learning, offering both custom-built training solutions for large employee bases with sensitive or confidential content and a catalog of ready-made courses, all with integrated video lessons, assessments, and exercises. The company reports 1.2M+ students, 100+ courses, and 1,600+ videos delivered. Backed by 500 Global. No public developer portal, API, or SDK is published.

providers.name: Jüsto
providers.description: Jüsto is a Mexican online-only supermarket founded in 2019 by Ricardo Weder, headquartered in Mexico City. It operates a direct-to-consumer grocery e-commerce and delivery model with no physical stores, sourcing produce and pantry goods directly from farmers, producers, and brands and fulfilling orders from micro-fulfillment dark stores. The company sells its catalog through web and mobile apps and has raised venture funding from investors including General Atlantic, SoftBank, Foundation Capital, and 500 Global. Jüsto has no public developer program or documented API surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: K2 Space
providers.description: K2 Space (K2 Space Corporation) is a Los Angeles / Torrance, California aerospace startup that designs and manufactures high-power "Mega Class" satellite buses. Its platforms deliver roughly 20kW of array power and up to one metric ton of payload capacity - about ten times the power and payload of conventional buses - to maximize the throw-weight of next-generation launch vehicles like SpaceX Starship and Blue Origin New Glenn. K2 builds radiation-tolerant, vertically integrated (80% in-house) spacecraft with redundant avionics and high-delta-v propulsion for LEO, MEO, GEO and cislunar missions, serving commercial and U.S. government / defense customers. Backed by First Round Capital, Lightspeed Venture Partners and Redpoint Ventures, the company raised a $250M Series C at a $3B valuation and is preparing its first production satellite, GRAVITAS. K2 Space is a hardware company with no public developer API; this profile tracks its identity and web presence in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: kaiheikeji
providers.description: Kaiheikeji Digital (开黑科技) is a Chinese mobile entertainment and esports social platform operating an online game "sparring"/companion marketplace, where players post demands (game, skill level, and price) and qualified players selectively take orders to play alongside clients. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners, which led a roughly $15M Series A+ round in 2018. The company operates a consumer-facing mobile app rather than a public developer API program; no public API, developer portal, or API documentation surface has been identified. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record surfaced from the Qiming portfolio.

providers.name: karmaloop
providers.description: karmaloop is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of insight-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: consumer. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Keepe
providers.description: Keepe operates a US nationwide service-provider network of vetted technicians covering HVAC, plumbing, electrical, furnace and heating, air conditioning, home appliances, and EV charger installation and repair. The platform streamlines the full home-services workflow end to end - recruiting, sourcing, dispatching, authorizing, and paying qualified technicians - so property managers, warranty companies, and insurers can get high-quality repair work completed reliably across markets. Keepe runs a consumer/technician mobile app and a private application backend at api.keepe.com; it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline with the infrastructure signals that are publicly observable.

providers.name: Kellanova
providers.description: Kellanova is a global snacks-led consumer packaged foods company, formed in 2023 from the spin-off of the Kellogg Company's snacks, international cereal and noodles, and North American frozen breakfast businesses. Kellanova owns and markets brands including Pringles, Cheez-It, Pop-Tarts, Eggo, RXBAR, MorningStar Farms, and Special K outside North America.

providers.name: Keno
providers.description: Keno is an on-demand, doorstep car-wash and vehicle-care mobile application operating in the United Arab Emirates, billing itself as the "No.1 car wash app in the UAE". Customers download the iOS or Android app, add their vehicle, select from wash, maintenance, and detailing services (priced by vehicle class from bike to luxury SUV), and a mobile team of "ninjas" arrives at the customer's location to perform the work with a choice of payment methods. Keno is a 500 Global portfolio company. It is a consumer mobile application with no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, CLI, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Keurig Green Mountain
providers.description: Keurig Green Mountain was a leader in specialty coffee and coffee makers, producing the Keurig single-serve brewing system and partnering with leading coffee brands. In 2018 Keurig Green Mountain merged with Dr Pepper Snapple Group to form Keurig Dr Pepper, a Fortune 500 beverage company. This repository preserves the historical API and developer footprint of Keurig Green Mountain prior to that merger.

providers.name: Keynexus
providers.description: KeyNexus was an enterprise encryption key management company based in Victoria, British Columbia, Canada, providing centralized key management, Bring Your Own Key (BYOK), and Key Management as a Service for cloud, on-premises, and hybrid deployments. Its platform helped enterprises generate, store, distribute, and control the lifecycle of encryption keys used to protect data across applications and infrastructure. KeyNexus was acquired by StorMagic in January 2021, and its technology was folded into the StorMagic SvKMS (Secure Virtual Key Management Service) product; the keynexus.com domain now redirects to StorMagic's encryption key management offering. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital and added to the API Evangelist network for tracking. KeyNexus no longer operates as an independent developer platform.

providers.name: Khazenly
providers.description: Khazenly is a Cairo, Egypt based cloud order-fulfillment and e-commerce enablement platform that helps online merchants and brands manage the full post-checkout journey. Its stack combines an order management system, warehousing and pick-pack-ship fulfillment, last-mile delivery, and cash-on-delivery collection so sellers can outsource operations while retaining visibility. Khazenly connects to popular e-commerce storefronts and marketplaces to sync orders, inventory, and shipping status. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network; its public developer/API surface is not openly documented, so this profile currently carries identity and domain-security signals rather than harvested API artifacts.

providers.name: Kinetic Apps
providers.description: Kinetic (kineticapps.ai) is a Brooklyn-based venture studio and consumer-software portfolio-company builder that uses AI to let small teams ship products that previously required much larger ones. Rather than long planning cycles, Kinetic launches focused consumer apps, watches real user behavior, and feeds those learnings back into a shared engine of creative, distribution channels, data, and product patterns to accelerate the next launch. Its portfolio of consumer applications includes Nested, Prove It, PayMe, Relay, and Tempo. Backed by GV (Google Ventures). Kinetic publishes no public developer platform, API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile is a company/provider lead in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Kishlay Foods
providers.description: Kishlay Foods is a snack-food manufacturing company based in Guwahati, Assam, India, operating since 2003. The company produces premium potato chips, namkeens, and traditional Indian savory snacks, with regional varieties such as Aloo Bhujia, Bengali Mix, Chakna Mix, Cocktail Peanut, and Chana Jor Garam. Kishlay Foods runs a consumer/distributor marketing website and recruits distributor partners across the region; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, webhook, or developer-portal surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Knote
providers.description: Knote is a small New York-based startup backed by 500 Global, surfaced through the 500 Global portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead. Third-party company databases describe it inconsistently: Tracxn profiles Knote as a knowledge-management platform that raised roughly $150K from 500 Global, while Dealroom describes it as an AI-powered email summarization and management tool. No first-party description could be confirmed. As of the 2026-07-19 enrichment pass the knote.com web property is offline — the domain resolves (Cloudflare nameservers, an EC2 A record, live Google Workspace MX and an SPF record including Mailgun and Mailchimp) but refuses connections on both port 80 and port 443, so no homepage, developer portal, documentation, API reference, or machine-readable specification could be retrieved. No corporate GitHub organization, package-registry client library, or public API surface was found; the GitHub repositories named "Knote" are unrelated third-party note-taking and Kubernetes-course projects. This profile therefore carries only what could be independently verified: the funding and identity facts above plus a live DNS/TLS domain-security probe. It should be treated as a dormant or defunct lead and re-checked if the domain returns to service.

providers.name: Korro Bio
providers.description: Korro Bio, Inc. (Nasdaq: KRRO) is a Cambridge, Massachusetts clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing a new class of genetic medicines based on programmable RNA editing. Its proprietary OPERA (Oligonucleotide Promoted Editing of RNA) platform pairs data-driven oligonucleotide design and machine-learning optimization with linker chemistry and tissue-directed delivery to recruit the body's own ADAR enzymes and make a precise, transient single-base edit to a native mRNA transcript — editing RNA rather than DNA so the change is tunable and reversible. The company was created and incubated by Atlas Venture with New Enterprise Associates in October 2019, raised a $91.5M Series A and a $116M Series B, and became public in 2023 through a merger with Frequency Therapeutics alongside a $117M private placement. Its pipeline targets liver and central nervous system indications and includes KRRO-110 (the REWRITE Phase 1/2a study in alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency), KRRO-111 and KRRO-121, which holds EMA orphan drug designation for urea cycle disorders. Korro Bio sells therapeutics, not software: it operates no developer program, publishes no API, SDK or machine-readable specification, and maintains no public source-code organization.

providers.name: Kuwo Music
providers.description: Kuwo Music (酷我音乐) is a Chinese online music streaming service, founded in Beijing in 2005, that grew from a desktop music player into one of China's major consumer streaming apps across desktop, web, and mobile. Kuwo merged with Kugou under China Music Corporation, which was subsequently acquired by Tencent Music Entertainment Group, and Kuwo now operates as one of TME's music apps alongside QQ Music and Kugou. Kuwo entered the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead via Qiming. It is a consumer-facing streaming property rather than an API-first provider, and no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface has been verified for it.

providers.name: Kyndoo
providers.description: Kyndoo Inc. was a San Francisco based influencer-marketing software platform that let brands find, connect to and work with social-media influencers. Its differentiator was audience authenticity: Kyndoo built a database of vetted influencers and published the "Kyndex" score, described as a credit score for influencers, which measured whether a following was made of real people with buying intent rather than purchased bot accounts. Around that database it sold campaign management, attribution and brand-safety tooling to brands, taking a service fee on the influencer deals brands negotiated through the platform. The company was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. Kyndoo was acquired by CIPIO (cipio.ai) and its web property is now offline - kyndoo.com has not served a page since early 2022. Kyndoo never published a public API, developer portal or SDK, so this profile is an identity and lifecycle record rather than an API profile.

providers.name: Lara Networks
providers.description: Lara Networks, Inc. (founded as Lara Technology) was a fabless semiconductor company headquartered at 110 Nortech Parkway, San Jose, California, that architected, designed, and marketed silicon-based packet-processing solutions for high-speed Internet and networking infrastructure. Its products were built on a patent-pending Associative Processing Technology (APT) and manufactured on 0.18-micron process technology: Network Database Search Engine (NDSE) devices, network coprocessors, and NDSE subsystems, with Content-Aware Switching (CAS) solutions in development. The devices were content-addressable memory search engines that offloaded ultra-large table lookups from network processors — holding tables of more than three million addresses and sustaining over 100 million lookups per second so switches and routers could process packets from Layer 2 to Layer 7 at full line rate at OC-48 (2.5Gbps) and above. The company raised a $40 million second round in October 2000 led by Raza Ventures with Battery Ventures, InveStar Capital, and TeleSoft Venture Partners, alongside a long-term co-development agreement and minority equity investment from STMicroelectronics. Lara Networks no longer operates independently: by January 2003 its laranetworks.com domain served Cypress Semiconductor Corporation content, and today every path on the domain 301-redirects to Infineon Technologies, which acquired Cypress in April 2020. As a fabless chip company selling silicon to network equipment manufacturers, Lara Networks never operated a web or developer API program, and no public API surface exists to enrich. This profile is retained as an acquired-company lead.

providers.name: Launchbit
providers.description: LaunchBit was an advertising startup founded in 2012 and incubated through 500 Startups, co-founded and led by CEO Elizabeth Yin. It launched as an email ad network that let B2B and software-as-a-service advertisers reach audiences through niche email newsletters, and helped publishers monetize email — a medium BuySellAds founder Todd Garland described as "pretty tricky to monetize." In March 2014 LaunchBit pivoted toward a customer-acquisition and lead-generation platform for SaaS companies. BuySellAds.com acquired LaunchBit in September 2014 for undisclosed terms, and the company no longer operates independently: as of a July 2026 probe, launchbit.com serves the BuySellAds corporate website for every path. LaunchBit published no public API, developer portal, or SDKs, so this profile is retained as a historical/acquired record rather than an active API provider.

providers.name: Levi Strauss
providers.description: Levi Strauss & Co. is one of the world's largest brand-name apparel companies and a global leader in jeanswear, designing and marketing jeans, casual wear, and related accessories under the Levi's, Dockers, Signature, and Denizen brands. The company does not publish a public developer API program.

providers.name: LexSpot
providers.description: LexSpot is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub awaiting enrichment. An enrichment pass on 2026-07-19 could not verify any public product, developer, or API surface for the company. The registrable domain lexspot.com is registered (created 2011-10-16, Cloudflare DNS) and carries live Google Workspace mail records, but the apex has no A record and www.lexspot.com fails behind Cloudflare (HTTP 530 / error 1016, origin DNS failure), so no website, documentation, or API could be read. Probes of the well-known discovery surface, llms.txt, npm, PyPI, and GitHub (org and repository search) all returned nothing. The bridge.legal URL previously recorded on this profile was found to redirect to boundless.com (Boundless Immigration), an unrelated company that makes no reference to LexSpot or Bridge Legal; that pointer has been corrected. This record is retained as an unverified lead: no API artifacts have been generated because there is no published specification or documentation to ground them in, and nothing has been fabricated.

providers.name: Livsho
providers.description: Livsho Holdings Limited operates LIVSHO, described as the GCC's first live auction marketplace for collectibles, where users buy, sell, and connect around the things they love through interactive live shopping experiences. The consumer-facing platform is delivered primarily through a mobile app, with a Wix-hosted marketing presence at livsho.tv and livsho.com and a Linktree for app downloads. Livsho is a portfolio company of 500 Global. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API documentation is currently published.

providers.name: Local Kitchens
providers.description: Local Kitchens is a restaurant company that operates multi-brand "food hall" locations where a single kitchen prepares menu items from a curated set of local and national restaurant brands for on-demand pickup and delivery, ordered through its consumer website and mobile app. Surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment, it is a consumer-facing hospitality and food-ordering business. As of this pass it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation — its web presence is a Cloudflare-fronted marketing and ordering site (Google Workspace email, Klaviyo, Twilio, Zoom in its DNS records).

providers.name: Loris
providers.description: Loris was an AI-powered customer service and conversation intelligence platform that analyzed voice, chat, and email interactions to surface contact drivers, sentiment shifts, and quality signals for support teams. Originally a Techstars-backed startup, Loris was acquired by Contentsquare and its product has been folded into the Contentsquare Conversation Intelligence offering. The standalone loris.ai property now 301-redirects to contentsquare.com and the company no longer publishes an independent public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation surface. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as an acquired-company record.

providers.name: Lost Lake Games
providers.description: Lost Lake Games is a Seattle-based independent video game studio building narrative-driven games. The studio raised a $5.1M seed round in 2022 led by BITKRAFT Ventures with participation from Lightspeed Venture Partners, 1Up Ventures, and Moon Holdings, and describes itself as being at the beginning of its next big adventure. As a consumer game developer, Lost Lake does not currently operate a public developer platform, API, SDK, or documentation surface; its web presence is a marketing site with an email signup and links to Steam, Discord, and Twitter/X. This profile captures the company's identity and public footprint within the API Evangelist network, surfaced originally as a Lightspeed Venture Partners portfolio company.

providers.name: Ludlow Ventures
providers.description: Ludlow Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm founded in 2010 and based in Detroit, Michigan. Led by partners Jonathon Triest and Brett deMarrais, the firm invests in exceptional founders across sectors with a relationship-driven, people-first philosophy, backing companies at the earliest stages rather than chasing trends. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Foundry Group. Sector: venture-capital.

providers.name: Lulus
providers.description: Lulus (Lulus Fashion Lounge Holdings) is a direct-to-consumer online fashion retailer offering women's apparel, dresses, shoes, and accessories, operating primarily through lulus.com and mobile apps. Surfaced as a portfolio company of IVP and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Lulus publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface: developer.lulus.com does not resolve and no /.well-known/ discovery documents are served. This profile therefore captures company identity plus a live domain-security posture probe rather than any API artifacts.

providers.name: LumaTax
providers.description: LumaTax is a US and Canadian sales tax automation platform that helps businesses automate sales tax filings, manage nexus exposure, and streamline remittance across multiple state and federal jurisdictions. The product imports transaction data from sources such as Amazon, Stripe, Shopify, and Excel, validates that data and assigns correct tax jurisdictions, generates categorized return summaries, files returns automatically, and stores past filings for audit preparation. Originally an independent Seattle fintech backed by Cowboy Ventures, LumaTax was acquired and is now offered as a product line under Taxually alongside CrossTax, EcoTax, and OneTax. As of enrichment it exposes no public developer portal, API reference, SDK, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Lumina
providers.description: Lumina (Lumina Innovations) is a San Francisco-based startup building all-electric, autonomous heavy construction equipment. Founded by Ahmed Shubber and Federico Di Palma, the company develops both the hardware and the self-driving software in-house, taking a Tesla/Waymo-style approach to the excavation and earth-moving industry. Its flagship Moonlander ML6 is a 32-ton fully autonomous electric bulldozer with roughly 750 horsepower of peak output and a 414 kWh battery pack. The broader product lineup spans Roadrunner, Moonlander, Bladerunner, and a Powerpack energy system. Lumina does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile tracks the company as a portfolio lead in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Luxe
providers.description: Luxe was an on-demand valet parking service that let users request a valet through a mobile app to pick up, park, and return their vehicle, operating in San Francisco, Chicago, and New York. Surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and GV and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment, Luxe is a consumer mobility service with no public API, developer portal, or programmatic surface; this profile records that honest finding.

providers.name: Luxe Nomad
providers.description: The Luxe Nomad is a luxury travel booking company offering curated villas, private residences, and boutique hotels across Asia-Pacific and beyond. It operates as a consumer-facing booking platform rather than a developer-first API provider. It remains catalogued as a company lead with a probed domain-security profile.

providers.name: Luxvisions Innovation
providers.description: Luxvisions Innovation Limited is a camera module and imaging technology manufacturer established in March 2018, headquartered in Hong Kong with operations in Guangzhou, Shenzhen and Shangrao, China. The company designs and produces optical camera modules and audio-video integration technology for mobile phones, tablets, PCs and notebooks, automotive systems, AIOT devices, and 3D/ToF VR/AR/MR applications, and states it launched the industry's first triple camera module for mobile phones. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan (HongShan Capital) and added to the API Evangelist network. As a hardware/component manufacturer, Luxvisions publishes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Maelyscosmetics
providers.description: MAELYS Cosmetics is a direct-to-consumer body care brand offering clinically proven body solutions focused on firming, toning, and addressing concerns such as cellulite, stretch marks, and loose skin. Surfaced as a portfolio company of norwest-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network. The company operates a consumer e-commerce storefront and publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Mafengwo
providers.description: Mafengwo (马蜂窝, "Honeycomb") is a Chinese travel social and user-generated-content platform offering travel guides, destination reviews, trip notes (游记), community Q&A, and online booking for flights, hotels, tours, and local activities. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. No public developer or open-platform (开放平台) API surface was discoverable during this enrichment pass; the site is protected by anti-bot measures and exposes no OpenAPI, well-known discovery documents, or security.txt.

providers.name: makespace
providers.description: makespace was a New York-founded, full-service consumer storage company (professional pickup, packing, digital photo cataloging, and on-demand redelivery) added to the API Evangelist network as a slow-ventures portfolio-lead stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass the makespace.com domain 301-redirects to clutter.com, the storage brand now operated as Clutter by Iron Mountain, and the company exposes no public developer program, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, MCP server, or documented API surface. This profile records the honest result of the pipeline: identity plus a live domain-security probe, with no API artifacts available to harvest.

providers.name: Mamut
providers.description: Mamut was a Norwegian business software company (Mamut ASA / Mamut AS) that provided accounting, ERP, CRM, e-commerce and online-presence software to small and medium-sized businesses across the Nordics and parts of Europe. It was acquired by Visma in 2011 and the Mamut product line has since been absorbed into the Visma family of business software. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Northzone and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this pass the mamut.com web server is unreachable (both HTTP and HTTPS time out) and there is no reachable public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface under the Mamut brand; enrichment therefore captured only what could be probed from DNS/TLS. Sector: enterprise.

providers.name: Manime
providers.description: ManiMe (Manime) is a direct-to-consumer beauty company offering custom-fit semi-cured gel manicure and pedicure kits. Customers scan their nails with a smartphone and ManiMe manufactures made-to-measure gel nail sets shipped to the home for at-home application. The company was backed by Canaan Partners and Techstars. As of this enrichment pass the manime.co storefront (a Shopify store) returns HTTP 402 "Store unavailable", indicating the store is currently closed or inactive. No public developer API, API documentation, developer portal, SDKs, or webhook surface could be found.

providers.name: Manpower
providers.description: Manpower is a global workforce solutions brand of ManpowerGroup that delivers innovative staffing and workforce services to organizations worldwide and helps talent find meaningful, sustainable employment. No public developer APIs have been documented.

providers.name: ManpowerGroup
providers.description: ManpowerGroup is a global workforce solutions company that connects talented people with innovative companies through its family of brands including Manpower, Experis, and Talent Solutions. No public developer APIs have been documented.

providers.name: Mantari
providers.description: Mantari is a weather-intelligence and earth-sensing company building a decision-intelligence platform that fuses a distributed network of sensors with AI to turn environmental data across oceans, skies, and space into mission-critical, actionable intelligence. It initially targets government and defense decision support, with plans to extend into broader economic and commercial applications. As of this profile Mantari publishes a marketing homepage and a careers page but no public API, developer portal, documentation, or SDKs; this record captures its identity plus a live domain-security probe, pending a future developer surface.

providers.name: Maqsad
providers.description: Maqsad is Pakistan's leading online entry-test preparation platform, helping students prepare for standardized university entrance exams including MDCAT, ECAT, BCAT and O-Level. The platform delivers daily live classes, recorded video lectures, 15,000+ practice MCQs per exam, weekly mock tests, real-time doubt-solving and academic counseling through student-facing mobile apps and web access.
