Founded in 2021 and backed by Speedinvest, Maqsad reports 4M+ downloads and tens of thousands of enrolled students placed into universities such as NUST, IBA and DUHS. It operates as a business-to-consumer education company and does not currently publish a developer API, documentation or developer portal.

providers.name: Maquoketa Research
providers.description: Maquoketa Research is a defense-technology startup (Y Combinator, Spring 2026) building autonomous terminal-guidance systems for one-way attack drones. Its platform-agnostic guidance modules add custom computer-vision object tracking to low-cost FPV drone hardware, raising strike success rates from under 25% to roughly 80% while maintaining target lock through GPS jamming and signal loss. Founded in 2025 and based in San Francisco, the five-person team ships hardware modules (product lines include GCS, Magpie, Odin, and TGS) that integrate with existing drone flight controllers rather than a public developer API. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched from the company's public website; it currently exposes no public API, SDK, or developer platform surface.

providers.name: Markato
providers.description: Markato (legally On Your Marks) is a brand builder and distributor for health, beauty, and wellness brands across Asia, positioning itself as a next-generation distribution disruptor. From bases in Hong Kong, Singapore, Taiwan, Malaysia, Thailand, and Australia, it helps high-potential brands enter, grow, and dominate the region's most competitive markets. Its capabilities span strategic channel development into top-tier offline and online retailers (Sephora, Watsons, Mannings, SaSa), e-commerce and social commerce operations across Shopee, TikTok, and Lazada, 360-degree marketing and brand building, and end-to-end local operations, logistics, product registration, and compliance. Markato is backed by a roughly US$4M seed round led by Lightspeed Venture Partners, with a team drawn from L'Oreal, P&G, McKinsey, and Lane Crawford. Markato is a services and distribution business and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Markhor
providers.description: Markhor is a direct-to-consumer commerce company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Y Combinator and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. Its site at markhor.com runs on Shopify and is currently offline, returning an HTTP 402 "Store unavailable" response. A July 2026 enrichment pass probed the domain and well-known paths and found no public API, developer platform, documentation, or SDK surface; only live DNS/TLS/HTTP domain-security signal was captured.

providers.name: MarkIt
providers.description: MarkIt is a Y Combinator (Fall 2025) startup based in Atlanta, GA building AI agents that automate international trade compliance workflows. The platform performs defensible HS and HTS tariff-code classification, OCR processing of shipping documents, tariff management, and customs issue resolution, with agents that work directly inside the tools trade professionals already use every day such as Excel, PDFs, and broker portals. MarkIt also publishes a free web-based HTS code classification tool at markittrade.com/hts. As of this enrichment pass MarkIt is an early-stage, landing-page-only product with no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or developer portal surface.

providers.name: Markov
providers.description: Markov (Markov Studios) is a San Francisco-based Y Combinator (Summer 2026) startup building data and environments for training computer-use AI. The company captures how people actually use computers - screen recordings with synchronized mouse and keyboard inputs, annotations, and open datasets across real workflows in tools like Salesforce, Blender, and Photoshop, plus gaming data from Valorant, Minecraft, and GTA. Markov sources high-quality tasks and data to train the next generation of computer-use and reinforcement-learning models, releasing much of its work in public on Hugging Face (150k+ dataset downloads). Founded in 2026 by Dev Mandal (CEO) and Harish Ashok, Markov distributes its datasets through Hugging Face rather than a first-party API; this profile currently tracks no public API surface.

providers.name: Masco
providers.description: Masco Corporation is a global leader in the design, manufacture, and distribution of branded home improvement and building products, including faucets, plumbing fixtures, cabinets, paints, and architectural coatings under brands such as Delta, Behr, Hansgrohe, KILZ, and Liberty Hardware.

providers.name: McCormick
providers.description: McCormick spices and products have been kitchen must-haves since 1889. Learn about seasoning and cuisine while discovering tons of delicious recipes today. No public developer APIs are currently documented.

providers.name: MealPal
providers.description: MealPal is a consumer meal subscription service that lets members reserve lunch or dinner from a rotating selection of local restaurants at a discounted, fixed membership price, ordering ahead through its iOS and Android apps to skip the line at pickup. The service is organized around its MealPass lunch/dinner subscription and MealFix offering, alongside a partner program that restaurants join to reach members. MealPal operates as a business-to-consumer mobile application and website and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation. This record was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Menlo Ventures and is tracked in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: meetdavis
providers.description: Davis (meetdavis.com) is an AI-native real estate technology company, backed by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, that compresses early-stage real estate development from months to days. Davis combines proprietary AI models with human architect expertise to deliver feasibility studies (site analysis, regulatory diagnostics, volumetrics, financial modeling) and architectural designs (floor plans, unit-mix optimization, space planning) directly to developers and investors. Its first proprietary model, Gaudi-1, performs automated architectural generation under regulatory and financial constraints. Davis operates as a service model rather than selling software, and publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, or SDKs at this time. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network from the Balderton Capital portfolio and has been through the enrichment pipeline; no API surface was found.

providers.name: Mekan
providers.description: Mekan (somosmekan.com) is a Latin American software platform serving the automotive sector, with solutions organized around two product lines - Autos (vehicles) and Repuestos (auto parts / spare parts) - to help dealers, parts sellers, and automotive businesses manage and grow their operations. Backed by 500 Global, the company was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and added to the API Evangelist network. At the time of enrichment the public surface is a Spanish-language marketing site centered on a "Agenda tu demo" (schedule-a-demo) flow, with WhatsApp and LinkedIn contact channels and no publicly documented API, developer portal, SDKs, or technical integration surface.

providers.name: Mensa Brands
providers.description: Mensa Brands (rebranded BRND.ME) is an India-based, technology-led house of brands founded in 2021 by Ananth Narayanan (former Myntra CEO), building and scaling digital-first consumer brands across fashion, beauty, personal care, home and FMCG. Backed by Accel, Tiger Global and Prosus Ventures, it reached unicorn status and operates a portfolio of acquired D2C brands. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of prosus-ventures; a public developer API surface was searched for and none was found — the company exposes a corporate/consumer web presence rather than a developer platform.

providers.name: Mercy BioAnalytics
providers.description: Mercy BioAnalytics, Inc. is a Waltham, Massachusetts clinical-stage cancer diagnostics company, founded in 2018, developing extracellular-vesicle (EV) based liquid biopsy tests for the early detection of cancer. Its patented Mercy Halo platform uses biomarker co-localization — the simultaneous detection of multiple cancer-related biomarkers on the surface of individual tumor-derived extracellular vesicles — to read a small volume of serum or plasma with a simple PCR-based readout. The company's initial programs target ovarian cancer screening in asymptomatic post-menopausal women and lung cancer detection in average and high-risk individuals; the Mercy Halo Ovarian Cancer Screening Test received FDA Breakthrough Device Designation in May 2024. Mercy BioAnalytics raised a $41M Series A in April 2023 led by Novalis LifeSciences and a $59M Series B in September 2025. The product is a laboratory-developed blood test, not software: as of this profile the company publishes no public developer program, API, SDK, or machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Meridianfleetservices
providers.description: Meridian Fleet Services is a holding company that acquires and partners with exceptional fleet service businesses, positioning itself as a permanent home for them. It focuses on preserving each acquired company's legacy and culture while supporting long-term organic growth through stronger teams, better planning and tooling, and scalable operational systems. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Enrichment confirmed a marketing website only (About, FAQs, Contact) with no public API, developer portal, documentation, or programmatic surface as of July 2026.

providers.name: Merklebase
providers.description: Merklebase provides data-driven infrastructure for institutional digital-asset finance, spanning enterprise data management, a core portfolio management system, reporting and accounting, risk management, a trade capture system, and a digital-asset loan management system. It advertises connectivity to 220+ custodians, trading venues, and data providers, and is used by hedge funds, asset managers, and financial institutions to streamline front-to-back operations across fiat, crypto, derivatives, and stablecoins. A developer API and connectivity layer is referenced by customers, but the public developer surface (docs.merklebase.io on Theneo) is currently unpublished and the API (api.merklebase.io, AWS API Gateway) is gated, so no public OpenAPI/SDK artifacts are harvestable yet.

providers.name: Metaphor
providers.description: Metaphor was an active-metadata / data-catalog platform (metaphor.io) that combined a social, agent-assisted data governance experience with a large library of open-source Python "connectors" that extracted metadata (schemas, lineage, usage, ownership, documentation, data quality) from warehouses, BI tools, and data pipelines to populate the Metaphor app. Founded by ex-LinkedIn DataHub engineers and backed by Amplify Partners, Metaphor's technology platform was acquired by KPMG; the metaphor.io site now redirects to the KPMG acquisition announcement and the standalone developer surface (docs.metaphor.io, api.metaphor.io, the MetaphorData GitHub org) has been decommissioned. The first-party open-source metadata packages (metaphor-connectors, metaphor-models) still resolve on PyPI.

providers.name: MeUndies
providers.description: MeUndies is a direct-to-consumer apparel brand based in Los Angeles, selling underwear, loungewear, socks, and basics online through a subscription membership and one-time purchase model. It operates as an e-commerce retailer at meundies.com rather than a developer platform: an enrichment pass on 2026-07-20 probed the domain and found no public API surface (api.meundies.com and developer.meundies.com both return 404, and no /.well-known/, /llms.txt, or OpenAPI documents were discoverable). This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and carries the domain-security probe result; it will gain API artifacts only if MeUndies publishes a developer program.

providers.name: microTERRA
providers.description: microTERRA is a Mexico-based food-ingredient company that develops functional ingredients derived from Lemna (duckweed). Its MAS product line delivers natural flavor enhancers and texture modifiers for the food and beverage industry, positioned as sustainable, clean-label alternatives that support salt and sugar reduction in formulations. A Techstars-backed B2B startup, microTERRA sells to food formulators and manufacturers and does not currently expose any public developer API, SDK, CLI, or technical documentation surface.

providers.name: miim
providers.description: mi|im (pronounced "mime", for Movement Imaging | Intelligence Matters) develops proprietary machine-learning and computer-vision technology that turns movement into intelligence for retail. Its movement-imaging platform analyzes and optimizes how people flow through physical space, helping retailers improve customer experience, drive operational efficiency, and detect and respond to events. Surfaced as a portfolio company of balderton-capital; no public API, developer portal, or documentation was found during enrichment (the miim.ai domain currently returns a parked WordPress error page).

providers.name: Milano Vice
providers.description: Milano Vice is a Berlin-based virtual restaurant company founded in 2021 by Rudolf Donauer and Dennis Murselovic (both ex-Delivery Hero) that operates a digitally-powered, delivery-first pizza brand. It partners with professional kitchens across German cities including Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg and Frankfurt to prepare and deliver handmade pizzas and pinsa to homes and offices, orderable through its own website and third-party delivery platforms such as Lieferando, Wolt and Uber Eats. It is a consumer food brand backed by Speedinvest, Coefficient Capital, True and Geschwister Oetker, and does not currently publish a public developer API surface. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub.

providers.name: Mind Robotics
providers.description: Mind Robotics is an industrial robotics company building intelligent robotic systems for real-world industrial deployment. The company focuses on clearly defined, high-impact environments — narrowing scope to the settings with the greatest operational need as a path toward broadly capable robots. Mind Robotics is a Kleiner Perkins portfolio company in the hardtech sector. As of this profile the company operates a single-page marketing website and an Ashby-hosted careers page and publishes no public API, developer documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Mint
providers.description: Mint was a personal finance, budgeting, and money-management product originally built by Aaron Patzer and backed by First Round Capital and Uncork Capital (then SoftTech VC) before its 2009 acquisition by Intuit. Intuit shut the standalone Mint service down and reimagined its features (transaction review, spending tracking, net-worth monitoring, account linking across 17,000+ financial institutions) inside Credit Karma. Mint exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or API reference; this profile is retained as a network company record. Sector: fintech.

providers.name: Miracle Miles
providers.description: Miracle Miles (Miracle Miles Group) is a consumer footwear e-commerce company backed by Hongshan (Sequoia China). It designs, manufactures, and sells affordable fashion footwear and accessories direct-to-consumer through a family of online brands, including DREAM PAIRS (launched 2009), Bruno Marc (men's footwear), Nortiv 8 (outdoor), and Dream Pairs Kids, selling primarily via its own storefronts and large online marketplaces. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface; this profile is maintained as a company/lead record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Miru Labs
providers.description: Miru Labs is a San Francisco / Bay Area cybersecurity startup founded in 2024 by Eoghan McKee, Quang Pham, and David Pigott, building a graph-native investigation and insider-threat prevention platform. Miru unifies cloud and endpoint sources into a living graph so human analysts and AI agents can investigate together, using behavioral intelligence to distinguish malicious intent from accidental violations and an "Agentic Dispatch" capability that runs autonomous investigations that triage, escalate, and counter-act across alerts and domains. The platform targets cybersecurity, trust and safety, and national-security investigation use cases, detecting AI leakage, data exfiltration, privilege escalation, reconnaissance, and espionage, and generating legal-grade case reports. The company raised a $2.7M pre-seed round led by Dreamcraft and Cadenza alongside Seedcamp, with participation from Inovia, Notion, and Alphagraph. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a Seedcamp portfolio lead; as of this pass Miru publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, or GitHub organization.

providers.name: Moat
providers.description: Moat was an advertising measurement and analytics company, backed by Insight Venture Partners and Mayfield, that measured ad viewability, attention, and brand safety across digital and video advertising. Oracle acquired Moat in 2017 and folded it into Oracle Advertising (Oracle Moat / Oracle Data Cloud). The independent moat.com brand no longer operates a standalone developer program: www.moat.com now 301-redirects to oracle.com/advertising, and the bare moat.com host no longer negotiates TLS. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as an acquired/absorbed company lead with no independent public API surface.

providers.name: Modsy *
providers.description: Modsy was a consumer interior-design startup founded in 2015 offering online interior design with 3D room visualization technology. In 2022 it shifted away from consumer design services to focus on its core 3D home technology, and on August 30, 2023 its IP and team became part of Lennar to pursue the next generation of 3D innovation for the home. Surfaced as a portfolio company of gv and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer or API surface exists.

providers.name: mogujie
providers.description: Mogujie (蘑菇街), operated by Mogu Inc. (NYSE MOGU), is a Chinese online fashion and lifestyle social-commerce destination that pairs a shopping marketplace with live video streaming and influencer-led content across apparel, beauty, and accessories. The company was formed from the 2016 merger of Mogujie and Meilishuo, is headquartered in Hangzhou, China, and listed on the New York Stock Exchange in December 2018. Mogujie's historical third-party open platform (open.mogujie.com) has been retired and now redirects away, and no active public API developer surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Molagri
providers.description: Molagri is a Toronto-based biotechnology startup building next-generation biopesticides for agriculture. The company designs pest-control molecules that target specific molecular pathways unique to pest insects while preserving pollinators and other beneficial organisms, and uses predictive modeling to stay ahead of the evolution of pest resistance. Molagri emphasizes higher efficacy and biobased production to reduce emissions across both manufacturing and field application. Founded in 2026 by University of Toronto PhD biochemists Zaky Hassan and Min Jin, the company was part of the Y Combinator Summer 2026 batch. It was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for tracking; as an early-stage biotech it currently publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: MomMom
providers.description: MomMom (맘맘) is a South Korean consumer parenting and family-activity platform that helps parents discover places to go with their kids and products to buy for them. The mom-mom.net website and app curate kid-friendly destinations by region, family accommodation and resort deals, restaurant and class discounts, and community-driven product rankings (국민템랭킹) covering baby and childcare essentials, alongside parenting tips. It is a B2C curation, deals, and recommendation service, backed as a 500 Global portfolio company; no public developer API, documentation, or well-known discovery surface is currently published (probed 2026-07-20).

providers.name: Moncler
providers.description: Moncler S.p.A. is an Italian luxury fashion house best known for its high-end down jackets and technical outerwear, founded in 1952 in Monestier-de-Clermont, France and today headquartered in Milan, Italy. The Moncler Group operates the Moncler and Stone Island brands, sells globally through directly operated retail boutiques, department-store wholesale and a direct-to-consumer e-commerce storefront, and is listed on Borsa Italiana (MONC). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; probing found a consumer e-commerce storefront but no public developer API program.

providers.name: Mondelez
providers.description: Mondelez International is a Fortune 500 multinational confectionery, food, and beverage company that owns iconic snack brands including Oreo, Cadbury, Milka, Toblerone, Trident, Ritz, and Triscuit.

providers.name: Mosaic Building Group
providers.description: Mosaic (Mosaic Building Group) is a full-stack construction technology company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona. It is a national leader in build-to-rent residential construction and pre-development, pairing in-house software with local homebuilding partners to deliver personalized homes faster and at lower cost across Arizona and Texas. Its Mosaic Hub platform applies AI to construction planning and operations management. Backed by a16z (Series A lead) alongside Greylock, Innovation Endeavors, Founders Fund, Thrive Capital, SV Angel, and 8VC. Mosaic operates as a hybrid construction-plus-software business and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation at this time.

providers.name: Motif Analytics
providers.description: Motif Analytics was a startup (founded 2021 by Mikhail Panko and Theron Ji, with Sean Taylor as chief scientist) building interactive sequence analytics for growth and operations teams. Its product let analysts explore event sequences — user journeys, funnels, order-management flows — with a purpose-built Sequence Operations Language (SOL) and in-browser WebAssembly so data never had to leave the browser, backed by a $5.7M seed round led by Amplify Partners and Felicis (2024). As of this enrichment pass the product site and the docs.motifanalytics.com subdomain no longer resolve and motifanalytics.com serves a MarkMonitor brand-protection holding page, indicating the company has wound down. No public REST/GraphQL API, SDK, OpenAPI, CLI, or developer surface was ever published; the sole public GitHub repo is a 2023 bug reproduction.

providers.name: Moven
providers.description: Moven (Movencorp Newco Inc.) is a New York City fintech founded in 2011 by Brett King and Alex Sion. Originally a direct-to-consumer mobile banking and financial-wellness app, the company pivoted in 2020 to a business-to-business model, licensing its spending-analytics and financial-wellness technology to banks, credit unions, and other fintechs through open APIs and SDKs. Its data-driven engagement modules power companion and challenger-bank experiences such as TD Bank's MySpend and Westpac's CashNav. Moven's API and SDK surface is partner-gated behind a demo/sandbox request rather than a self-serve public developer portal, so no public OpenAPI, reference documentation, or GitHub organization is available for catalog harvesting.

providers.name: Moxxie Ventures
providers.description: Moxxie Ventures is an early-stage (pre-seed and seed) venture capital firm founded in 2019 by Katie Jacobs Stanton, backing exceptional, technical founders building a better future. The firm writes $500K-$2M checks (typically ~$1.5M for roughly 10% ownership) across enterprise software, climate, consumer, fintech, healthcare, infrastructure (dev platforms, robotics, autonomy) and vertical AI, and has raised three funds including a $95M third fund in 2024. Its 100+ portfolio companies include Airtable, Calm, Carta, Coinbase, Lime, Opendoor and Tipalti. Moxxie publishes no public API or developer surface.

providers.name: MSC Industrial Direct
providers.description: MSC Industrial Direct is one of the largest industrial product distributors in North America, providing metalworking, maintenance, repair, and operations products and services to manufacturers.

providers.name: Murmur Technologies INC
providers.description: Murmur Technologies INC (Murmur) is a Chicago, Illinois out-of-home advertising technology company operating a mobile digital billboard platform. It mounts smart LCD screens on car-tops and pedestrian backpacks to display geo-targeted ads on city streets, using sensors, computer vision, and location data to segment audiences by demographics, location, and behavior, measure ad performance in real time, and retarget viewers across other channels such as Facebook and Google. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead for enrichment. As of the 2026-08-12 enrichment pass the operation appears dormant: both marketing domains (murmurcars.com and murmurads.com) carry Route 53 nameservers but no A record at all, and the blog host times out. The one surviving surface is portal.murmurads.com, the advertiser portal, a static React single-page app served from Amazon S3 behind CloudFront whose last build shipped 2024-12-26. Its JavaScript bundle calls a private REST backend at backendapp.murmurcars.com/api/v1/ (campaigns, venues, zipcode demographics, GPS, air quality and user endpoints), but that host — while it still resolves — has TCP 443 and 80 dead, so the portal front-end can no longer reach its own API. Murmur publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDK, or machine-readable specification of any kind, and no package exists for it in any public registry.

providers.name: MyGlamm
providers.description: MyGlamm is an Indian direct-to-consumer beauty and cosmetics brand operated by Sanghvi Beauty and Technologies Private Limited (the Good Glamm Group), backed by Accel. It sells makeup, skincare and personal-care products online and through retail. As of mid-2026 the parent company is undergoing corporate insolvency proceedings and its primary domain serves an insolvency stakeholder notice portal. No public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Mynd
providers.description: Mynd is a tech-enabled property management and real estate investing company offering full-service management for single-family rental (SFR) homes. It manages more than 20,000 homes across 40-plus U.S. markets, handling tenant screening, leasing, rent collection, maintenance, and portfolio management for individual and institutional investors, and provides a proprietary Investor Portal for real-time portfolio visibility. Mynd is owned by Roofstock and integrates with partner platforms such as Stessa. As of this enrichment pass Mynd publishes no public developer API, API documentation, developer portal, or /.well-known discovery surface; this profile remains a company/portfolio lead with no API artifacts to harvest.

providers.name: Myntra
providers.description: Myntra is one of India's largest fashion and lifestyle e-commerce platforms, offering apparel, footwear, accessories, and beauty products across its own and third-party brands. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Bengaluru, Myntra was acquired by Flipkart (Walmart) in 2014 and operates a consumer marketplace at myntra.com. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Myntra does not publish a public developer API program; its developer/API hosts resolve behind Akamai but are not openly documented.

providers.name: Myra Vision
providers.description: Myra Vision, Inc. is a clinical-stage ophthalmic medical device company headquartered in Campbell, California, and a privately held portfolio company of the Shifamed LLC medical device incubator. It develops the Calibreye Titratable Glaucoma Therapy (TGT) Surgical System, an aqueous shunt for patients with moderate to severe glaucoma whose valve-controlled outflow channels use shape-memory nitinol and can be reversibly opened or closed in-office with a transcorneal laser, letting a clinician titrate intraocular pressure after implantation rather than committing to a fixed flow at the time of surgery. The company completed first-in-human use of the Calibreye System in 2023, received FDA conditional approval of its Investigational Device Exemption in August 2025, and enrolled the first patient in its US ADAPT clinical study in January 2026. As a medical device manufacturer its product is a physical implant and a surgical procedure, not software: Myra Vision publishes no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification, and this profile captures its corporate identity and public web properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Myrtelle
providers.description: Myrtelle, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Wakefield, Massachusetts, developing gene therapies for myelin-based disorders of the central nervous system. Its lead program, MYR-101 (rAAV-Olig001-ASPA), is a first-in-class oligotrophic recombinant adeno-associated virus gene therapy for Canavan disease, a rare and fatal childhood genetic brain disease caused by mutations in the ASPA gene. The program is licensed exclusively worldwide from Pfizer Inc., holds Orphan Drug, Fast Track and Rare Pediatric Disease designations in the US with similar designations in Europe, and has reported Phase 1/2 interim results in Nature Medicine. Myrtelle is a therapeutics developer, not a software company: it publishes no developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable API contract, and is profiled here for network completeness only.

providers.name: MySpace
providers.description: Myspace (Myspace LLC, part of the People / Entertainment Weekly Network) is a music and culture social platform focused on artist networking, music streaming, and editorial entertainment coverage. Originally one of the largest social networks of the 2000s, it was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Redpoint Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Myspace operates a consumer music/entertainment website only — its former developer platform (developer.myspace.com, OpenSocial-based) has been retired and no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or API documentation surface could be found. This profile therefore carries identity and domain-security signal only, with no API artifacts.

providers.name: Mythic
providers.description: Mythic is a high-performance analog computing company building Analog Processing Units (APUs) for energy-efficient AI inference. Its compute-in-memory architecture stores AI model parameters directly in the processor to eliminate the memory bottleneck of traditional digital designs, targeting data center, automotive, robotics, edge, and defense workloads with claims of dramatically lower energy use and cost versus GPUs. Surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and Threshold Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Mythic publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: N3twork
providers.description: N3TWORK Studios Inc is a mobile and blockchain gaming studio behind role-playing titles including Legendary: Game of Heroes, Legendary: Heroes Unchained, and Triumph. N3TWORK was previously known for its mobile game network and free-to-play publishing/user-acquisition platform, and was backed by GV (Google Ventures) among other investors. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or technical documentation surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record. Sector: consumer / gaming.

providers.name: Na Kd
providers.description: Na Kd (NA-KD) is a Swedish online fashion retailer for women, selling clothing, shoes, and accessories direct-to-consumer through na-kd.com. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead, backed by Northzone and Partech. As of this enrichment pass NA-KD publishes no public developer API, SDK, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface; this profile captures the company identity and its live domain-security posture.

providers.name: Naranga
providers.description: Naranga is a cloud-based franchise management platform for franchisors and multi-location brands, covering franchise sales CRM and lead management (emaximation), operations and multi-location support (nCompass), employee and franchisee training (nSpire), field audits and inspections, task and job scheduling, and local/multi-channel marketing. API access model: Naranga does NOT publish a documented public or self-serve developer API. There is no developer portal, no published API reference, no OpenAPI/Swagger definition, no SDKs, and no self-serve API keys as of this entry. Integrations with third-party systems (for example Twilio, RingCentral, Microsoft 365, AssureSign, and lead-capture/Zapier-style connectors) exist but are delivered through Naranga's partner and professional-services onboarding (typically a multi-week implementation scoped per brand), not through open, documented, developer-facing endpoints. Pricing is quote-based / contact-sales.

providers.name: nasn-auto
providers.description: NASN Automotive Electronics Co., Ltd. is a Shanghai-based automotive chassis electronic-control manufacturer founded in 2016, developing brake-by-wire and steer-by-wire systems for smart and assisted driving. Its products include the NBooster intelligent braking system, brushless electric power steering (EPS) controllers, and motion-control solutions for autonomous vehicles. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners, Matrix Partners China, Hillhouse and CATL, NASN has raised roughly $231M and is a Tier-1 supplier pursuing a Hong Kong listing. Surfaced as a Qiming portfolio company; NASN is an automotive hardware manufacturer with no public developer API surface at nasn-auto.com.

providers.name: National Basketball Association
providers.description: The National Basketball Association (NBA) is the premier men's professional basketball league in North America, comprised of 30 franchises (29 in the United States and 1 in Canada). The NBA does not operate a public developer portal; statistical, scoring, and play-by-play data feeds are licensed through official partners (notably Sportradar and Genius Sports). The stats.nba.com endpoints are not officially documented as a public API.

providers.name: National Football League
providers.description: The National Football League (NFL) is the premier professional American football league, comprised of 32 franchises divided between the AFC and NFC conferences. The NFL produces the Super Bowl and is the most-watched sports league in the United States. The league does not operate a public developer portal; statistical and play-by-play data feeds are licensed to partners (notably AWS, Amazon Web Services Next Gen Stats, Sportradar, and Genius Sports) and are not offered as a self-serve developer API.

providers.name: Natural Intelligence Systems
providers.description: Natural Intelligence Semiconductor (Natural Intelligence Systems) is a fabless semiconductor startup founded in 2016 and headquartered in Boise, Idaho, led by founder and CEO Paul Dlugosch. The company is developing the Natural Neural Processor (NNP), a novel processor architecture inspired by the human neocortex to deliver disruptive performance for artificial intelligence and big-data analytics workloads. Its roadmap spans the chips, system boards, and a software tool chain of compilers, drivers, and low-level APIs needed to bring the NNP into customer systems. It exposes no public web API today; the developer surface is chip- and driver-level tooling. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio lead.

providers.name: naturalmotion
providers.description: NaturalMotion is a mobile game developer founded in 2001 and now operating as part of Zynga under Take-Two Interactive, with games downloaded over six billion times across more than 175 countries. Known for titles such as CSR Racing, Star Wars Hunters, and the Euphoria and Morpheme animation technologies, the company builds and publishes consumer mobile games. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of balderton-capital and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass NaturalMotion publishes no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Neverware
providers.description: Neverware was a New York-based software company, backed by Thrive Capital, best known for CloudReady — a ChromiumOS-based operating system that converted aging PCs and Macs into fast, secure, cloud-first Chromebook-like endpoints for schools and enterprises. Google acquired Neverware and folded CloudReady into ChromeOS Flex: the neverware.com domain now 301-redirects to Google's ChromeOS Flex product pages (chromeos.google/products/chromeos-flex) and its certificate issuance is controlled by Google (CAA pki.goog). The company operates no standalone public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface today.

providers.name: Nexite
providers.description: Nexite is a retail technology company (website nexite.io) surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures. It operates in the connected-retail / IoT-for-physical-retail space. This profile was added as a stub lead and has been through one local enrichment pass: the public web presence is live but fully gated behind a bot / CAPTCHA challenge, and no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or discovery (/.well-known/) surface could be reached. No public API surface is catalogued at this time; the entry is retained as a company record pending a discoverable API.

providers.name: NexLP
providers.description: NexLP was a Chicago-based legal artificial intelligence company known for its Story Engine platform, which applied data science, machine learning, and natural language processing to legal, investigations, compliance, and eDiscovery workflows. NexLP was acquired by Reveal Data in 2020 and folded into Reveal's AI-powered eDiscovery and legal intelligence platform. The nexlp.com domain no longer hosts a public website and exposes no developer API surface; live DNS probes show its security/abuse contact (CAA iodef) now points to revealdata.com, corroborating the acquisition. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio lead and enriched via the pipeline; no live API, documentation, or SDK surface was found.

providers.name: Nexus Lab Technologies
providers.description: Nexus Lab (Nexus Lab Technologies, Inc.) is a contrail-reduction software company founded in 2022 and backed by 500 Global. Operating from nexuslab.fr, it applies machine learning to satellite imagery, flight traffic data, and meteorological parameters to help airlines optimize flight paths and reduce contrail formation, mitigating aviation's non-CO2 climate impact. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes only a marketing website with no public API, developer portal, documentation, or SDKs; no developer surface was found to catalog.

providers.name: NodeFlair
providers.description: NodeFlair is a Singapore-based technology career-transparency platform, founded in 2018 by Ethan Ang, that gives Asia's tech talent access to verified salary data, company reviews, tech-stack insights, benefits, and job listings across the APAC region. Salaries are verified against actual employee payslips, differentiating NodeFlair from other job boards, and the platform serves over 500,000 monthly visitors across eight Asian countries while helping companies hire tech talent. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API surface was found during enrichment; the profile currently carries live domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Noondual-canvas for design and code
providers.description: Noondual-canvas for design and code is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of homebrew and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: developer-tools. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Normalyze
providers.description: Normalyze was a data security posture management (DSPM) company that helped organizations discover, classify, and protect sensitive data across SaaS, PaaS, multi-cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments, mapping data access paths and prioritizing risk. Backed by Battery Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, Normalyze was acquired by Proofpoint in 2024 and its capabilities are now delivered as part of the Proofpoint Data Security Posture Management product line; the normalyze.ai domain redirects to Proofpoint. Normalyze never published a standalone public developer portal, API reference, or SDK, so this profile has no independent API surface to enrich.

providers.name: NotePass
providers.description: NotePass (notepass.ai) is an early-stage, stealth-mode startup that is pre-launch: its only public web presence is a "Coming Soon" landing page inviting visitors to follow its journey and sign up for launch updates. The product has not been publicly announced and no developer platform, API, documentation, or SDK is published yet. NotePass was surfaced as a portfolio company of Electric Capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead to monitor for a future API surface. Public contact is james@notepass.ai.

providers.name: Nubity
providers.description: Nubity is an AWS Premier Tier cloud consulting and managed services provider serving enterprises across Latin America, with operations in Mexico and Argentina. It helps organizations modernize legacy systems, migrate to and build cloud-native applications on AWS, deploy cloud contact centers and GenAI and business-intelligence solutions, run managed services and DevOps practices, apply Well-Architected cost optimization, and strengthen cloud security and business continuity. Nubity is a professional-services firm and does not publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Observo
providers.description: Observo AI built an AI-native data pipeline (telemetry pipeline) platform that optimizes security and observability data in flight, filtering, enriching, and normalizing logs, metrics, and traces into standard schemas like OCSF to cut SIEM and observability data volume and cost before ingestion into the SOC. Founded in 2022 and backed by Felicis, Observo AI was acquired by SentinelOne; the observo.ai domain now 301-redirects to SentinelOne's Singularity AI Data Pipelines product, its documentation host (docs.observo.ai) is authentication-gated, and there is no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or programmatic surface to enrich.

providers.name: Octapulse
providers.description: Octapulse (OctaPulse) is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) startup applying computer vision and robotics to automate quality inspection in finfish farms. Its AI vision platform integrates into existing aquaculture workflows starting at the hatchery stage, using off-the-shelf cameras to perform broodstock phenotyping and juvenile deformity detection. The system reduces per-fish inspection time from roughly five minutes to under thirty seconds while achieving over 90% accuracy, standardizing QA processes and building proprietary multi-species datasets for the aquaculture industry. At this stage Octapulse is an early hardware-and-vision product company with no public API, developer portal, or programmatic surface; this profile tracks it as a lead in the API Evangelist network for future enrichment should a developer platform emerge.

providers.name: Odyssey Ai
providers.description: Odyssey is an AI research lab building general-purpose world models — causal, multimodal systems that understand and simulate physical environments, generating long-form interactive video simulations from text or image prompts rather than text. Its research includes Odyssey-2 (a flagship world model producing multi-minute interactive simulations), Starchild-1 (a real-time multimodal world model), Agora-1 (a multi-agent world simulator), and PROWL-1 (a reinforcement-learning framework for adversarial environment exploration). Odyssey positions world models as foundational AI for robotics, gaming, healthcare, education, and 3D visual asset generation, and raised a $310M Series B. The company is a portfolio company of DCVC. At the time of this profile Odyssey publishes research, writing, and interactive demos but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Odyssey Therapeutics
providers.description: Odyssey Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing small-molecule and biologic therapeutics for autoimmune, inflammatory, and oncology indications. The company targets upstream immune signaling mechanisms to prevent pathological inflammation rather than only suppressing downstream responses, advancing a pipeline of precision medicines. It operates as a private, venture-backed drug-discovery company with no public developer or API surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Offerfit
providers.description: OfferFit is an AI decisioning company whose reinforcement-learning platform automated marketing experimentation and 1:1 personalization (replacing manual A/B testing with self-learning agents). OfferFit was acquired by Braze in 2025 and its product now ships as the BrazeAI Decisioning Studio. The offerfit.ai domain 301-redirects entirely to braze.com, and OfferFit publishes no independent developer API, documentation, SDK, or developer portal of its own. This profile was surfaced as a Menlo Ventures portfolio company and enriched via live DNS/TLS/HTTP domain probes.

providers.name: Okera
providers.description: Okera was a data access governance and data security platform providing fine-grained, attribute-based access control, data discovery and classification, dynamic masking, and audit for analytics and machine-learning workloads across data lakes and warehouses. Founded around 2016, Okera was acquired by Databricks in May 2023 and folded into the Databricks governance stack (Unity Catalog). Okera no longer operates as an independent product: the okera.com domain now 301-redirects to databricks.com, and there is no standalone Okera developer portal, documentation, or public API surface remaining. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as an acquired-company record.

providers.name: Okol
providers.description: Okol operates propiedades.com, an online real estate marketplace serving Mexico where buyers and renters search residential and commercial property listings and connect with agents, developers, and brokers. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment, the company runs its consumer-facing listings platform on AWS but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or specifications at this time.

providers.name: Omeat
providers.description: Omeat (rebranded as Evergreen Select) is a cultivated-beef company that partners with global meat producers to create price-predictable, industrial-scale beef supply. It produces 100% real beef without antibiotics, hormones, or plant-based fillers, positioning cultivated meat as a practical supplement to conventional supply chains while holding pricing at parity with commodity ground beef. Founded by tissue-engineering researcher Ali Khademhosseini and backed by GV, the company targets restaurants and meat processors seeking supply-chain stability and consistent quality. As of this enrichment pass Omeat operates as a food/biotech producer with a marketing website only: no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or GitHub organization were found, so there is no machine-readable API surface to catalog. This profile is retained as a company/lead record surfaced from the GV venture portfolio.

providers.name: OneCommand
providers.description: OneCommand was a cloud-based customer marketing and loyalty-automation platform built for automotive dealerships, headquartered in Mason, Ohio. It helped dealers drive service and sales traffic, increase owner retention, and lower marketing costs through data-driven, multichannel outreach across voice, text, email, and direct mail. Its product family included the OneCommand loyalty-automation platform, the Higher Gear CRM, and the TrafficAccelerator service. OneCommand was absorbed into Affinitiv in September 2016, one of four automotive-marketing firms (with TimeHighway.com, Peak Performance and DPS) merged to form that company. The brand is now defunct as an operating surface — onecommand.com and portal.onecommand.com are still fronted by Cloudflare but the origin no longer answers (HTTP 522 on every path probed 2026-08-13), highergear.com no longer connects, and onecommand.net and trafficaccelerator.com resolve to parked landing pages. OneCommand never published a public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or API documentation, and the acquirer's site (affinitiv.com) publishes none either.

providers.name: OneMain Holdings
providers.description: OneMain Holdings is a leading provider of personal installment loans to nonprime consumers in the United States, with branches across multiple states. No public APIs are documented at this time.

providers.name: OneSpot
providers.description: OneSpot was an Austin, Texas adtech and content-marketing startup that built a machine-learning platform to personalize and sequence branded content across websites, email, and paid media. Founded around 2010 and backed by early investors including 500 Startups, RSL Venture Partners, and Austin angels, it raised multiple venture rounds before being acquired. The onespot.com domain (and its developer, api, and app subdomains) now redirects to IgniteTech, and the company no longer operates an independent public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: OneSwoop
providers.description: OneSwoop is a UK car-buying and new-car price-comparison website, founded in 1999 and based in Liverpool, England, that lets consumers compare prices on brand-new cars and buy them online at a discount. It operates as a consumer-facing e-commerce and comparison property and publishes no public developer platform, API, documentation, or SDK surface. Backed historically by Insight Partners and other venture investors, it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Orbicle Bio
providers.description: Orbicle Bio is an agricultural biotechnology startup developing carbon-negative, microbial-based organic fertilizers derived from soil microbes to replace synthetic fertilizers. Backed by 500 Global, the company targets rice-farming productivity and soil sustainability across Southeast Asian markets such as Vietnam and Thailand, with a commercial product launch planned for 2026. Orbicle Bio publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API artifacts; this profile is maintained for API Evangelist network completeness and enrichment.

providers.name: OSlash
providers.description: OSlash is a productivity tool that lets teams create short, memorable shortcuts — typed as "o/" followed by a keyword — to instantly find and open their documents, dashboards, and internal tools across 100+ connected apps such as Salesforce, Notion, Jira, GitHub, Figma, Asana, HubSpot, and Linear. Delivered as a Chrome extension with enterprise features like SSO and bank-level encryption, OSlash was backed by Accel. As of this profile the public product is marked "Coming Soon" and the company publishes no developer API, SDK, OpenAPI spec, or documentation surface — this remains an enrichment lead with no scored API artifacts beyond a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Osmos
providers.description: Osmos is an AI-powered data ingestion and data onboarding platform that helps companies import, clean, transform, and validate data arriving from customers, partners, and third-party sources. Its core products include the Osmos Uploader, an embeddable data-import experience that lets end users upload spreadsheets and CSV files that are automatically mapped, validated, and cleaned; AI Data Wrangler capabilities that use AI agents to reshape messy inbound data into a target schema; and data pipelines for recurring ingestion from files, APIs, and other systems. Osmos is aimed at product and data teams that need to reliably onboard external data without building and maintaining bespoke import tooling. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and enriched through the enrichment pipeline; public API surface details are gated behind the Osmos application and documentation.

providers.name: Osyva
providers.description: Osyva is a B2B commerce and procurement platform for the veterinary supply sector in Colombia and Latin America ("Gestiona tus compras veterinarias"), connecting veterinary clinics, distributors, and buyers to manage the ordering and purchasing of veterinary products and pharmaceuticals. Backed by 500 Global, Osyva runs a web and mobile application (osyva.com, osyva2go.com) and the related Hubu brand (hubu.com.co). Its platform is powered by internal API hosts (api.osyva.com, api.osyva2go.com), but as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, documentation, or API specification, so its API surface is private.

providers.name: Otis
providers.description: Otis was an alternative-asset investing platform that let retail investors buy fractional shares in collectibles such as contemporary art, sneakers, trading cards, comics, and cultural memorabilia, backed by Kindred Ventures and Union Square Ventures. Otis was acquired by Public Holdings (Public.com) in 2022 and folded into Public's alternative-assets investing product; its former domain withotis.com now 301-redirects to public.com. The standalone Otis brand is defunct and exposes no independent developer or API surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Outrider
providers.description: Outrider is an autonomous yard technology company that automates distribution yard operations with self-driving, all-electric yard trucks (hostlers). The Outrider System combines autonomous driving software, robotics for connecting and disconnecting trailers, and site operations software to move trailers between docks, parking spots, and staging lanes in large logistics yards. Headquartered in Golden, Colorado, Outrider targets shippers and logistics operators seeking to improve safety, sustainability, and throughput in the supply chain. The company is backed by investors including 8VC. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal has been identified for Outrider.

providers.name: Pace Revenue
providers.description: Pace Revenue was a London-based revenue management and dynamic pricing platform for hotels and hospitality operators that used machine learning to recommend optimal room rates from real-time demand, market, and booking-pace signals. Founded in 2016 and backed by Speedinvest, Pace was acquired by FLYR in 2023, and its revenue-optimization technology has since been folded into FLYR's hospitality commercial platform. Pace Revenue does not currently publish a public developer portal or an openly documented API specification; developer resources for the combined offering now live behind FLYR's gated developer knowledge base. This profile was surfaced as a Speedinvest portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public machine-readable API surface was found at enrichment time.

providers.name: Panera Bread
providers.description: Panera Bread is a chain of bakery-cafe fast casual restaurants offering sandwiches, soups, salads, pasta, and bakery items with a focus on clean food and convenience, anchored by the MyPanera loyalty program. Panera operates a private developer portal at developer.cloud.panerabread.com (built on Google Apigee X) that lists an APIs catalog and an OAuth-based authentication guide, but the API reference and OpenAPI specifications are gated behind authentication and are not publicly accessible. No openly documented, self-service public developer API is available at this time; access appears to be limited to partners and authenticated developers.

providers.name: Parkway Corp
providers.description: A Philadelphia-based real estate and parking infrastructure company that develops, owns, and manages parking facilities and mixed-use properties across the greater Philadelphia region. Parkway operates one of the largest privately held portfolios of urban parking and structured real estate assets in the Mid-Atlantic, providing on-street and off-street parking, monthly parking programs, validation services, and selective property development. The company does not publish a public developer API or partner integration portal.

providers.name: Passports
providers.description: Index for tracking APIs, SDKs, and developer resources related to passports (travel documents, identity verification, and government issuance). No authoritative public passport API has been identified at this time.

providers.name: PatPat
providers.description: PatPat is a direct-to-consumer children's and family apparel retailer founded in 2014 by Albert Wang and Ken Gao, selling baby, toddler, and kids' clothing along with matching family outfits, shoes, women's clothing, bags, and accessories to consumers in more than 100 countries and regions. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund 2, PatPat operates as an online marketplace and mobile-first shopping app, and is one of the largest direct-to-consumer players in the children's apparel segment. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; PatPat does not currently publish a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Patterson-UTI Energy
providers.description: Patterson-UTI Energy is a leading provider of onshore contract drilling services to exploration and production companies in North America, with land-based drilling rigs and pressure pumping services. No public developer API has been identified at this time.

providers.name: PCH International
providers.description: PCH International (pchintl.com) is a global supply chain solutions provider that helps brands bring innovative physical products to market across the entire product lifecycle. Its services span new product introduction (NPI) planning, design and development, validation and manufacturing (EVT/DVT/PVT), and post-production revenue optimization, plus global logistics, direct-to-consumer (D2C) transformation, supply-chain financing, and sustainability programs. PCH serves personal care and beauty, health and fitness, home and lifestyle, accessories, audio and entertainment, and smart retail sectors. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners, PCH is a B2B services provider with no public developer API or platform at this time.

providers.name: Pearlbio
providers.description: Pearl Bio is a synthetic biology company developing next-generation biomaterials for smart biologics. Its proprietary platform unites genome and ribosome engineering to produce novel biologics with diverse chemistries previously inaccessible, creating template-directed biomaterials with tunable properties by combining biological precision with chemical diversity. The company partnered with Merck on cancer-related biologics (announced March 2024) and is backed by Khosla Ventures. Pearl Bio operates as a research-and-partnership organization and publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Peel
providers.description: Peel Technologies Inc (peel.com) is a Redpoint Ventures-backed consumer technology company known for the Peel Smart Remote mobile app, which turned smartphones into universal remote controls for TVs, set-top boxes, and home-entertainment devices with a TV guide and content discovery layer. As of this enrichment pass the peel.com website resolves over HTTPS but serves only a single-logo placeholder page (frameset redirecting to an S3-hosted logo), indicating the company is dormant. No public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface was found; developer/api/docs subdomains do not resolve.

providers.name: Peerless Systems
providers.description: Peerless Systems Corporation is a technology company that describes itself as a leader in embedded imaging solutions. Historically focused on embedded imaging and printing controller technology and intellectual-property licensing for digital document, printer, and multifunction-device OEMs, the company operates as a corporate and licensing entity rather than a developer-facing API platform. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub associated with Battery Ventures; an enrichment pass found a corporate marketing website (peerless.com) but no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Penn National Gaming
providers.description: Penn National Gaming (now operating as Penn Entertainment) is one of the largest and most diversified regional gaming and racing companies in the United States, operating casinos and racetracks across multiple states. No public APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: Penske
providers.description: A diversified transportation services conglomerate operating truck leasing, logistics, automotive retail, and professional motorsports across North America. Penske Corporation spans Penske Truck Leasing (full-service leasing, rental, and contract maintenance), Penske Logistics (supply chain management, warehousing, distribution, dedicated contract carriage), Penske Automotive Group (retail automotive dealerships in the US, UK, Germany, Italy, Japan, Australia, and New Zealand), and Team Penske (motorsports). The corporate parent has 73,000+ employees and approximately $43B+ in consolidated revenue. Customer self-service is delivered through web and mobile portals (Penske Fleet Insight, Penske Truck Leasing app, Penske Truck Rental); Penske does not publish a public developer API or partner integration portal. Penske Automotive Group is the publicly traded subsidiary (NYSE - PAG).

providers.name: Pep Boys-Manny, Moe & Jack
providers.description: Pep Boys is a leading automotive aftermarket service and retail chain operating service centers and tire and parts stores throughout the United States.

providers.name: Pepperfry
providers.description: Pepperfry is an Indian online marketplace for furniture and home products, founded in 2011 and headquartered in Mumbai. It sells furniture, decor, lamps, kitchen and dining goods, furnishings, and modular home solutions to consumers across India through its website, mobile apps, and a network of physical studio showrooms. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. An enrichment pass on 2026-07-20 found no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/GraphQL specification, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface: the consumer site is fully bot-protected (HTTP 403) and there is no evidence of an externally documented API program. The one artifact captured is a live domain-security probe of pepperfry.com.

providers.name: Performance Food Group
providers.description: Performance Food Group is one of the largest foodservice distributors in North America, marketing and distributing food and food-related products to independent and chain restaurants and other institutional customers.

providers.name: Periscope Data
providers.description: Periscope Data was a cloud business-intelligence and analytics platform (SQL-based dashboards, data exploration, and reporting for data teams), backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, GV, SuSa Ventures and Threshold Ventures. It was acquired by Sisense in 2019; the product is now Sisense for Data Teams and the periscopedata.com domain 301-redirects to sisense.com. No standalone Periscope Data developer portal, documentation, or public API surface remains as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: PerTrac
providers.description: PerTrac was a hedge-fund and alternative-investment analytics software provider (portfolio analytics, asset allocation, and manager/database research for institutional investors), surfaced as an insight-partners portfolio company. As of this enrichment the PerTrac brand has been folded into Nasdaq eVestment — www.pertrac.com redirects to nasdaq.com/solutions/evestment/ — and there is no standalone PerTrac developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI definition, or public API surface. This profile is retained as a network record; any live API surface now lives under the Nasdaq eVestment product.

providers.name: PetSmart
providers.description: PetSmart is a North American chain of retail stores selling specialty pet supplies, services, and small companion animals. This repository tracks any publicly available APIs, SDKs, and developer resources for PetSmart.

providers.name: Pinduoduo
providers.description: Pinduoduo is a China-focused social commerce and agriculture-first e-commerce marketplace operated by PDD Holdings (Nasdaq: PDD), the multinational commerce group that also runs the cross-border marketplace Temu. Pinduoduo pioneered the "team purchase" (group-buy) model, connecting hundreds of millions of consumers directly with farmers, manufacturers, and merchants at scale. For developers, Pinduoduo runs a merchant-facing Open Platform (open.pinduoduo.com) that exposes gateway-style APIs for goods, orders, logistics, promotions, and store management to ISVs and merchant tools; that platform is geo-restricted to mainland China and was not directly reachable for artifact capture in this pass. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China) and enriched with verifiable corporate identity and domain security posture.

providers.name: Pine Street Labs
providers.description: Pine Street Labs is a crypto / blockchain infrastructure company surfaced as a portfolio company of Polychain and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: infrastructure. Enrichment probes of pinestreetlabs.com found no live developer or API surface: the domain currently serves unrelated content and publishes no OpenAPI, SDKs, docs, or security programs. This profile is retained as a lead pending a verified developer surface.

providers.name: Pinshape
providers.description: Pinshape is an online marketplace and community for 3D-printable designs, where makers, designers, and hobbyists browse, download, and sell STL and other printable model files for use on desktop 3D printers. The platform hosts both free and premium designs across categories such as toys, gadgets, art, jewelry, and functional parts, and was acquired by desktop 3D-printing manufacturer Formlabs. This profile was surfaced as a venture portfolio lead and enriched through the API Evangelist network; Pinshape publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Piris Labs
providers.description: Piris Labs is a Y Combinator (W2026) deep-tech startup building the networking layer for AI. The company develops proprietary photonic interconnect technology paired with a vertically optimized software stack that moves data between AI accelerators at ultra-low latency, targeting the bottleneck where up to 80% of advanced AI compute sits idle waiting on slow networking. Piris Labs couples this optical fabric with a full-stack, low-latency inference offering and has reported some of the fastest inference speeds for large frontier models. Founded in San Francisco by Ali Khalatpour (CEO) and Keyvan Moghadam (President), the company currently exposes no public, documented developer API or SDK — its product is delivered as hardware plus a hosted inference stack behind an early-access waitlist. This profile tracks Piris Labs' identity in the API Evangelist network and any future API surface it publishes.

providers.name: Pixelworks
providers.description: Pixelworks, Inc. (NASDAQ: PXLW) is a San Jose, California based semiconductor company founded in 1997 that designs video and pixel processing integrated circuits and software for digital video applications. Its technology spans digital displays, mobile devices, projection systems, digital signage, and video conferencing and surveillance, including the Iris visual processing line and TrueCut Motion cinematic-quality video platform. Pixelworks sells chips and IP to device makers rather than operating a public developer API platform; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company discovery and coverage tracking.

providers.name: PixOwl
providers.description: PixOwl is a mobile game studio, originally known for the early mobile version of The Sandbox and titles such as Doodle Grub, later acquired by Animoca Brands. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass the pixowl.com domain is a defunct redirect loop behind Cloudflare with no public developer portal, documentation, or API surface; only live domain-security posture (TLS/DNS) could be probed.

providers.name: Placeholder
providers.description: Placeholder is a venture capital partnership based in New York City that invests in decentralized information networks — crypto protocols and Web3 infrastructure. It was added to the API Evangelist network via the VC-portfolio pipeline. The firm publishes a marketing website (Squarespace-hosted) but no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface; this profile therefore carries firm identity and live domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Plantner
providers.description: Plantner Inc. (PLANTNER) is a South Korean biotechnology company specializing in the extraction and manufacturing of alginic acid, a biodegradable marine-derived biomaterial. Operating as a bio-industry platform provider, Plantner supplies alginic acid-based solutions across medical devices (wound dressings, nutraceuticals), pharmaceuticals (gastroprotective agents, drug-delivery systems), cosmetics (modeling masks, hydrogels), advanced biotech (bio-ink, organoids, delivery carriers), and agriculture (controlled-release fertilizers, mulching films, eco-friendly herbicides). Headquartered in Seoul with an R&D center in Suwon, the company is a 500 Global portfolio company. It is a materials/biotech manufacturer and does not currently publish a developer API, documentation, or developer portal; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: playhouse
providers.description: Playhouse is a consumer real estate application that combines homes-for-sale listings with community polls and reactions. Home searchers, neighbors, homebuyers, investors, and real estate professionals browse luxury and residential listings and react to them, turning property discovery into a social, opinion-driven experience. The product ships as native iOS and Android apps backed by a private api.playhouse.so service; there is no publicly documented developer API, SDK, OpenAPI, or API reference surface. Playhouse is a 500 Global portfolio company. This profile was enriched from live probes of its Webflow marketing site, app-store listings, and DNS/TLS records.

providers.name: Plenty
providers.description: Plenty is an American indoor vertical farming company that grows produce such as leafy greens and strawberries in controlled, climate-independent indoor facilities using proprietary vertical growing systems, automation, and robotics. Headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area and founded in 2014, Plenty is backed by investors including SoftBank Vision Fund and DCM Ventures. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a frontier-tech portfolio-company profile; the public enrichment pass found no public developer platform, API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Plexistor
providers.description: Plexistor was an enterprise storage startup that built Software-Defined Memory (SDM) - a converged memory-and-storage architecture delivering ultra-low latency and millions of IOPS on commodity servers by tiering across DRAM, NVDIMM-N, Intel/Micron 3D XPoint, flash, and spinning disk. It positioned SDM as a persistent-memory storage layer for big-data workloads such as Cassandra, Couchbase, and Spark, adding enterprise features like snapshots, clones, high availability, and clustering. The company was acquired by NetApp in 2017 and its technology was folded into NetApp's memory/storage roadmap. The plexistor.com site survives as a static legacy marketing page with no active product download, API, SDK, or developer portal. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the honest result is that Plexistor exposes no public API surface.

providers.name: Pluribus Networks
providers.description: Pluribus Networks was a software-defined networking (SDN) and open-networking vendor known for its NetVisor ONE network operating system (NVOS), the Adaptive Cloud Fabric controllerless SDN fabric, the UNUM management/analytics platform, and the Freedom 9000 series switches. The company was acquired by Arista Networks in 2022; the pluribusnetworks.com domain now redirects to Arista's Pluribus support resources, and the core Pluribus product line (NVOS, UNUM, Freedom 9000) has since been moved to End-of-Sale / End-of-Life. No independent Pluribus developer portal, public REST API, OpenAPI definition, or SDK is published; support and technical documentation are provided through the Arista customer portal. Originally surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and Menlo Ventures.

providers.name: Pocket Fm
providers.description: Pocket FM is an audio entertainment platform offering long-form audio series, audiobooks, and serialized stories across genres such as romance, fantasy, thriller, and horror. Listeners stream free episodes and unlock premium content through an in-app coins/store model, while writers and voice creators publish original work through the Pocket FM Studio. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners. As of this enrichment pass, Pocket FM operates as a consumer-facing mobile and web product and does not publish a public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Pomelo fashion
providers.description: Pomelo Fashion is an omnichannel fashion retailer headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand, selling women's apparel and accessories across Southeast Asia through its website and mobile app. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a consumer e-commerce storefront (pomelofashion.com, served via CloudFront) but exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, or /.well-known discovery surface (all probed paths returned HTTP 405). This profile therefore carries only probed domain-security signal; it remains a lead for revisiting should a developer program launch.

providers.name: Pond5
providers.description: Pond5 is a royalty-free stock media marketplace where creators buy and sell video footage, music tracks, sound effects, motion graphics, images, and other digital assets. Originally surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub, this profile has been through a local enrichment pass: the public web presence sits behind DataDome bot protection with no discoverable public API, developer portal, SDKs, OpenAPI, or security.txt at the time of the pass. Only live DNS/TLS/HTTP domain-security posture could be probed. Sector: media.

providers.name: Pop-Up Magazine
providers.description: Pop-Up Magazine is a live magazine created for a stage, a screen, and a live audience, produced by the team behind The California Sunday Magazine. Each production combines original nonfiction storytelling, live music, illustration, animation, and photography performed on tour in theaters across the United States. The company also operates Pop-Up Magazine Brand Studio, producing custom live and multimedia storytelling for brand partners. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Slow Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. Pop-Up Magazine is a consumer media and live-events brand; it publishes a public promotional website but exposes no developer program, public API, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface, so this profile is identity- and security-posture-only.

providers.name: Portal Terreno
providers.description: Portal Terreno is an online marketplace for land and parcels ("terrenos" and "parcelas") in Latin America, operating localized classifieds portals for Chile (portalterreno.cl) and Mexico (portalterreno.com.mx) with tens of thousands of land listings. The Next.js web platform lets buyers search, filter, and contact sellers to find land for sale, while sellers and real-estate agents publish listings. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. No public developer, API, documentation, or well-known discovery surface was found during the enrichment pass; the domain-security posture was probed live.

providers.name: Portals
providers.description: Portals (theportal.to) is a consumer platform organized around three activities — play, collect, and create — surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a Greylock portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the public site is a single-page consumer application: no published developer API, OpenAPI definition, developer portal, documentation, or /.well-known discovery documents were found. The only machine-verifiable surface is the web domain itself (HTTPS with TLS 1.3, HSTS, SPF, and DMARC present). This profile will be upgraded if and when a public API surface appears.

providers.name: PPG Industries
providers.description: PPG Industries is a Fortune 500 global supplier of paints, coatings, and specialty materials serving customers in construction, consumer products, industrial, transportation markets, and aftermarkets. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with PPG Industries. As of the last review, no public APIs or developer portal have been identified.

providers.name: PPS (pps.tv)
providers.description: PPS (pps.tv), originally the PPStream peer-to-peer online-video client, is a Chinese internet-video brand backed by Qiming Venture Partners.
