The pps.tv domain now issues a permanent HTTP 301 redirect to suike.cn, the home of iQIYI Suike (爱奇艺随刻) — a video-sharing and short-video community operated by iQIYI. It is a consumer video product; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface, so there is no API artifact set to harvest for this profile.

providers.name: Pratt & Whitney
providers.description: A major American aerospace manufacturer designing, manufacturing, and servicing aircraft engines for commercial, military, and business aviation applications. A division of RTX Corporation (formerly Raytheon Technologies), Pratt & Whitney is known for its geared turbofan (GTF) engine technology (PW1000G family) powering the Airbus A220 and A320neo, the F135 powering the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter, and the PT6 turboprop family. Customer-facing digital services - EngineWise health monitoring, FAST (Full-flight data Acquisition Storage and Transmission), and the Customer Portal - are operated privately for airline, MRO, and military customers behind credentialed access and are not exposed as a public developer API or open partner integration portal.

providers.name: Presidio Medical
providers.description: Presidio Medical is a privately held, clinical-stage medical device company headquartered in South San Francisco, California, founded in 2017 by Kenneth Wu and led by CEO and Chairman Michael Onuscheck. It is developing an implantable Ultra Low Frequency (ULF) neuromodulation platform intended to treat diseases of undesired neural activity, with a first indication in chronic nociceptive low back pain. The therapy delivers ultra low frequency current through an epidural spinal cord stimulation (SCS) lead to reversibly inhibit pain-signaling neurons via sodium channel inactivation, positioned as a non-opioid alternative to conventional SCS. The company raised a $72M Series C in 2023 led by Deerfield Management with Invus Opportunities, Action Potential Venture Capital and ShangBay Capital, and received FDA IDE approval for the global pivotal FULFILL randomized controlled trial in the United States and Australia. Presidio Medical sells an implantable medical device, not software; it has never operated a developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable API contract. As of 2026-08-05 its corporate WordPress site at presidiomedical.com is offline, returning a WP Engine "Site Not Configured" HTTP 404 on every path including the root.

providers.name: Prevalent
providers.description: Prevalent is a third-party risk management (TPRM) software vendor whose platform automates vendor risk assessment, continuous monitoring, and compliance workflows across the third-party lifecycle. Surfaced as a portfolio company of insight-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment (sector: cybersecurity). Prevalent has since been acquired by Mitratech; www.prevalent.net now redirects to mitratech.com/products/prevalent/. Enrichment found no public developer portal, REST API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or webhook surface — the only documented integration is a DocuSign connector inside the Contract Essentials module.

providers.name: PriceBaba
providers.description: PriceBaba is an India-based consumer price-comparison and gadget research platform, founded in 2012 and headquartered in Mumbai. It helps shoppers compare mobile phones, consumer electronics and other gadgets by aggregating specifications, expert and user reviews, and prices across online and offline local retail stores, so buyers can find the best available deal near them. PriceBaba is backed by 500 Global (formerly 500 Startups). No public developer program or API surface was discoverable during this enrichment pass. The website is served behind Cloudflare and blocks automated access, and no api.pricebaba.com host resolves.

providers.name: PrimaryBid
providers.description: PrimaryBid was a UK-based fintech that gave retail investors access to public capital markets — IPOs, follow-on equity raises, and public offerings that were historically restricted to institutional investors. It partnered with exchanges, banks, and issuers to broadcast live capital-raising events to individual investors, powering retail participation in listings such as Deliveroo, PensionBee, and Soho House. PrimaryBid's technology was acquired by SoFi Technologies, Inc. in May 2026; the standalone consumer platform has been wound down and its public website now redirects former shareholders to third-party share registrars. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a historical company record. No public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Privalia
providers.description: Privalia is a members-only online outlet and flash-sales retailer offering time-limited private sales on fashion, footwear, accessories, sportswear, and home goods from major brands at discounts of up to 70 percent. Operating consumer storefronts across Spain, Italy, Mexico, and Brazil (es/it/mex/br.privalia.com), Privalia is part of the Veepee (vente-privee) group and was an early Insight Partners portfolio company. It runs as a business-to-consumer e-commerce brand and publishes no public developer or API program.

providers.name: Privitar
providers.description: Privitar was a UK-founded data privacy and data provisioning company known for its Data Privacy Platform, which applied de-identification, anonymization, tokenization and policy-based data access controls to sensitive data at scale for enterprises in financial services, healthcare and government. Privitar was acquired by Informatica in 2023 and folded into Informatica's data governance and privacy portfolio. As of this enrichment pass the privitar.com domain (and docs.privitar.com) permanently redirects (HTTP 301) to informatica.com, and no independent Privitar developer portal, API documentation, or API surface remains online. This profile is retained as a network lead record for the former company; live API artifacts now belong to Informatica.

providers.name: prmeasure
providers.description: prmeasure (Precision Measurement & Control, 精实测控) is a Zhuhai, China based high-tech enterprise specializing in measurement, control, and artificial intelligence technologies for flexible manufacturing. The company builds industrial-grade testing and control equipment for the consumer electronics, automotive, and home-appliance industries, and offers consumer-level customized production through a C2M (customer-to-manufacturer) model. Its WowNow platform (iwownow.com) provides creative prototyping tools and flexible manufacturing equipment for individuals. prmeasure was surfaced as a portfolio company of the Qiming Venture Partners investment graph and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a corporate marketing website only, with no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Project Europe
providers.description: Project Europe (styled "Project Europe - LFG") is an initiative supporting the next generation of European founders. It runs an open application process for early-stage founders, backs and showcases a portfolio of companies started by that community, publishes an investor prospectus, and convenes a network of experienced European operators and investors. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of point-nine, Project Europe operates as a founder-community and early backing program rather than a public API or developer platform - its public web presence is a marketing site (apply, portfolio, legal pages) with no documented public API surface.

providers.name: Propagate
providers.description: Propagate (Propagate Brands) is an e-commerce accelerator and equity syndication platform founded by JD Jernigan and backed by 500 Global. It partners with early-stage direct-to-consumer brands selling on Shopify and Amazon — typically those under $1M in annual revenue and overlooked by larger aggregators — providing working capital plus growth marketing, branding, data collection, customer service, and supply-chain support to help them scale and reach acquisition-ready exits. It simultaneously lets individual investors take equity stakes in these growing private commerce brands to earn passive income. Propagate operates as a services-and-investment business rather than a software company and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or technical platform surface. As of August 2026 its website is also no longer reachable — propagatebrands.com and its www host resolve to Webflow's shared proxy but abort the TLS handshake, and archived captures show the site returning 403/404 since mid-2024 and a parked lander page by August 2025.

providers.name: Prospera
providers.description: Prospera Technologies was an Israeli agricultural-technology company, founded in 2014 and headquartered in Tel Aviv with US offices in Austin, TX, that applied machine learning and computer vision to continuously monitor plant development, health and stress from crop-field imagery and deliver irrigation and crop-growth recommendations to growers through mobile and web dashboards. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Cisco and Qualcomm, Prospera was acquired by Valmont Industries for roughly $300M in 2021 and its technology was folded into Valmont's Valley Insights and the Valley 365 connected crop-management platform. Prospera no longer operates an independent public developer surface: the prospera.ag domain still resolves in DNS but its HTTPS endpoint is unreachable, and no public API, developer portal, or API documentation was found during enrichment.

providers.name: QLC
providers.description: QLC is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Its listed website resolves to NewCampus (newcampus.com), an education and financial operator that supports organizations across the innovation lifecycle — from early-stage incubation and acceleration through grants and treasury operations to leadership training, governance design, and operating-model consulting. Notable programs include the Open Campus Accelerator (OC-X) and the seachange HR and Web3 tracks. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, MCP server, or machine-readable specification — there is no developer surface to catalog beyond the corporate marketing site.

providers.name: Quago Technologies
providers.description: Quago Technologies is a gaming analytics and fraud-detection company that uses machine learning and mobile device sensor data to protect and optimize mobile games. Its platform analyzes in-game behavioral and device-sensor patterns - without collecting personally identifiable information - to detect and manage cheating, identify user-acquisition (CPA) fraud, predict player churn, and optimize monetization and lifetime value. Quago is delivered to mobile game studios as an embedded SDK plus a backend analytics service rather than a public developer API; it was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Quantum Motion
providers.description: Quantum Motion is a UK-based full-stack quantum computing company building scalable, fault-tolerant quantum computers using silicon (CMOS) technology, the same manufacturing process used for conventional microchips. Spun out of University College London and the University of Oxford, the company develops qubit control hardware, cryogenic electronics, and quantum architecture aimed at manufacturing quantum processors at scale. It is a research- and hardware-focused company rather than an API or developer-platform provider; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass no public developer API, documentation portal, or SDK surface could be verified (the corporate site sits behind bot-challenge protection and web search was unavailable), so the profile remains identity-only.

providers.name: Quest Software
providers.description: Quest Software Inc. is a privately held IT management and cybersecurity software company headquartered in Aliso Viejo, California. Its portfolio spans database management and development (Toad), database and infrastructure performance monitoring (Foglight, Spotlight), unified endpoint management (KACE), Microsoft platform management and security (On Demand, Change Auditor, Recovery Manager, Migration Manager), data protection and backup (NetVault, QoreStor, Rapid Recovery), data replication (SharePlex), and data governance and modeling (erwin). Its products are distributed and supported through the Quest Support portal. Surfaced as a portfolio-lead stub and processed by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline; no public, first-party developer API portal or OpenAPI surface was discoverable at enrichment time.

providers.name: Quince
providers.description: Quince is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce retailer selling high-quality essentials at radical prices across apparel, home goods, bedding, furniture, accessories, jewelry, beauty, and travel. It uses a factory-direct model that bypasses traditional retail markups to offer affordable luxury. Quince was surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc, GGV Capital, ICONIQ Capital, and Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer retail brand it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or .well-known discovery surface; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Qunar Com
providers.description: Qunar (去哪儿网, "where to go") is a Chinese online travel platform founded in 2005 and headquartered in Beijing. It operates a travel search and booking service covering domestic and international flight tickets, hotel reservations, train and bus tickets, vacation packages, and travel deals. Qunar was NASDAQ-listed (QUNR) and is majority owned by Trip.com Group (formerly Ctrip). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Mayfield and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment; no public developer portal or API program was discoverable at open.qunar.com, developer.qunar.com, or api.qunar.com during this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Radionomy (Azerion)
providers.description: Radionomy (Azerion) is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: ai-apps. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Raphe Mphibr
providers.description: Raphe mPhibr is an Indian deep-tech aerospace company revolutionizing unmanned aviation through in-house carbon fiber composites, UAV airframes, propulsion, and end-to-end manufacturing. The company designs and builds heavy-lift and tactical unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs/drones) for defense and industrial applications, emphasizing research-driven innovation and vertically integrated production. Raphe mPhibr is a B2B / defense-oriented manufacturer surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or documentation surface — its digital presence is a corporate marketing site only.

providers.name: RareLee
providers.description: RareLee (Rarelee) is a Seoul-based premium personal style consulting company founded in 2017, offering data-driven hair, makeup, and fashion analysis. Its consultants classify a client's face shape, features, and skeletal structure across millions of type combinations to recommend personalized hairstyles, makeup designs, and coordinated outfits, both online and in person. Rarelee serves celebrity clientele and has collaborated with brands such as Shinsegae and Marriott. It is a direct-to-consumer service with no public API, developer portal, or technical integration surface; it was added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio lead for enrichment.

providers.name: Raw Apothecary
providers.description: Raw Apothecary is a Mexico-based consumer brand that operated a Shopify storefront at rawapothecary.mx (Spanish-language, powered-by Shopify), surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the storefront returns "Tienda no disponible" (HTTP 402, "Store Unavailable"), and the company publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, or machine-readable specification surface. This profile is retained as a company record; there is no API to enrich beyond a live domain-security probe of the storefront host.

providers.name: Rec Room
providers.description: Rec Room is a cross-platform social gaming and user-generated-content platform where players hang out, play, and build their own rooms and games using in-app creation tools (Rec Room Studio and the visual Circuits scripting system). It runs on PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Meta Quest VR, iOS, and Android with a shared avatar and economy. Founded in 2016 (originally as Against Gravity) and headquartered in Seattle, the company is backed by Index Ventures among other investors. Rec Room publishes a consumer platform at rec.net; no official public developer API or documented developer program was found during enrichment (the site is served behind Cloudflare and an internal api.rec.net host exists but is undocumented/unofficial).

providers.name: Recommind
providers.description: Recommind was an enterprise information analytics and eDiscovery software company founded in 2000, best known for its CORE predictive-analytics platform and its Axcelerate eDiscovery and information-governance products used by legal and enterprise customers. OpenText acquired Recommind in 2016, and the Recommind brand and its technology are now folded into OpenText's Discovery and information-management portfolio. The standalone recommind.com domain now redirects to the OpenText brand page, and no independent Recommind developer portal, API reference, or API surface remains.

providers.name: Recordgram
providers.description: Recordgram is a mobile music-creation platform, now operating as Cre8tor (cre8tor.app), that lets aspiring artists record songs, write lyrics, access a library of beats, and collaborate with professional producers directly from a smartphone. The company won the TechCrunch Disrupt SF 2017 Startup Battlefield and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. It is a consumer iOS/Android application with no public developer API, documentation, SDK, or developer portal surfaced at this time. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; enrichment confirmed the consumer-app nature and the rebrand to Cre8tor.

providers.name: Recount Media
providers.description: Recount Media operates The Recount, a political news and media outlet that distributes government and political coverage across social platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Snapchat, and X) plus the "Who Broke It" newsletter on Substack, under the tagline "More signal, less noise, and zero spin." It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Union Square Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer media brand it publishes no public developer platform, API, or specification surface; this profile captures its identity and the domain-security posture probed from its live website.

providers.name: Recursive
providers.description: Recursive (Recursive Superintelligence) is an AI research company founded in 2025 and backed by Earlybird, building recursive self-improving systems designed to automate knowledge discovery and accelerate scientific progress, beginning with AI research itself. Its team of researchers and entrepreneurs previously worked at OpenAI, DeepMind, Google Brain, Meta, Salesforce and Uber, and works on open-ended algorithms, AI-generating algorithms and self-improving systems. The company is based in San Francisco with an additional presence in London. Recursive currently publishes no public API, developer documentation, SDK, or other machine-readable developer surface; this profile captures its identity as a lead in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Red Tricycle
providers.description: Red Tricycle (redtri.com) was a digital parenting media company publishing local family activity guides, things-to-do listings, product roundups, and lifestyle content for parents across major US cities. It was acquired by Tinybeans, and the redtri.com domain now permanently redirects (HTTP 301) to tinybeans.com, a family photo-sharing app. Red Tricycle was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. Enrichment found no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface for either the Red Tricycle or Tinybeans consumer property.

providers.name: RedCap
providers.description: RedCap is an automotive dealer service software company that built an on-demand vehicle pickup-and-delivery, loaner, and shuttle platform for dealership fixed-operations (service) departments — offering live vehicle tracking, automated dispatching, at-home loaner contracting, on-demand parts fulfillment, and Uber-integrated shuttle coordination that plug into a dealership's existing DMS and service tools. Backed by Uncork Capital, RedCap was acquired by Solera and is now operated as Solera Service Suite; its former site (getredcap.com) redirects to the Solera Service Suite product. RedCap does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

providers.name: RedDoorz
providers.description: RedDoorz is a Southeast Asian budget-hospitality technology company that operates a franchise and management network of economy hotels and rooms across Indonesia, Singapore, the Philippines, Vietnam, and Thailand. Through its consumer website and mobile apps travelers can search, book, and pay for value-priced stays, while its "List your property" program onboards independent hotel owners onto the RedDoorz brand, distribution, loyalty, and property-management platform. Backed by 500 Global and Qiming Venture Partners, the company operates a consumer booking product rather than a public developer platform; as of this pass it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or /.well-known discovery surface. This profile tracks the company's digital and security surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: reetian
providers.description: reetian (Chinese brand 瑞天数智, Reetian Digital Intelligence) is a China-based digital-intelligence company surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm qiming and added to the API Evangelist network. Its public presence is a JavaScript single-page marketing site at reetian.com fronted by Cloudflare; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or source repositories that could be discovered and harvested. This profile remains a company-level lead pending a public API surface.

providers.name: refresh
providers.description: Refresh (refresh.si) is a Slovenian digital marketing agency focused on building and growing digital brands. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Slow Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. Contract discovery re-run on 2026-08-13 found the entire public footprint is a single WordPress splash page carrying a 2019 copyright, with two URLs in its sitemap and no blog posts — no API, developer portal, documentation, SDK, package, changelog or pricing surface, and HTTP 404 on /openapi.json, /llms.txt and every /.well-known/ discovery path. The profile is retained as a company lead with domain security captured from live TLS/DNS probes.

providers.name: Rei do Pitaco
providers.description: Rei do Pitaco is a Brazilian online sports betting, daily fantasy sports, and casino platform founded in 2019 and headquartered in Brazil. The service offers competitive sports odds, live in-play betting, daily fantasy sports contests, and casino games aimed at the Brazilian market. As a regulated iGaming operator its consumer web and mobile properties are geo-restricted outside Brazil (the primary domains return HTTP 451 to non-Brazilian visitors), and the company exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface. Rei do Pitaco is backed by Bullpen Capital and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-sourced company profile.

providers.name: Remora
providers.description: Remora is a carbon-capture startup (legally Echeneidae Inc.) founded in 2020 and based in Wixom, Michigan, that retrofits semi-trucks and locomotives with zero-backpressure devices which extract and purify up to 90 percent of the CO2 from vehicle exhaust while cutting other pollutants. The company then sells the captured, purified carbon dioxide and shares the resulting revenue with the transportation operators it partners with. Remora is a hardware and climate-technology business with no public API or developer platform; this profile tracks it as an API Evangelist network company for portfolio and discovery purposes.

providers.name: Renoster Systems
providers.description: Renoster Systems is a carbon-credit ratings agency bringing deep transparency to the nature-based voluntary carbon markets. Using remote sensing, LiDAR, satellite data, and machine learning, Renoster independently rates forestry and other nature-based carbon offset projects, quantifying how much CO2 per credit a project has actually sequestered, and publishes public tools such as its Mercury project database and Renoster/Mercury rubric for researchers, reserve managers, policymakers, and corporate buyers. Renoster is a Techstars-backed startup. As of this profile the company does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface; this record captures its company identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Renotag, Inc.
providers.description: Renotag, Inc. is a Calgary, Canada based construction-technology startup (founded 2020, backed by 500 Global) that builds home-renovation and construction cost-estimation software. Its product produces localized renovation estimates and material takeoffs in minutes by combining user inputs with regional labor and material pricing data, helping contractors quote and close more business. As of this enrichment pass Renotag publishes no public developer program, API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or documentation surface; the primary web properties (renotag.com and api.renotag.com) currently return HTTP 301 redirect loops, and the app is a private login at app.renotag.com. This profile is retained as a portfolio lead surfaced from the 500 Global portfolio.

providers.name: Reserve *
providers.description: Reserve was a restaurant-reservation startup backed by GV and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a consumer-sector portfolio lead. Its domain reserve.com now issues an HTTP 301 redirect to resy.com, the Resy restaurant-reservation platform, indicating the product has been folded into Resy. During enrichment no independent developer portal, public API, OpenAPI, or developer documentation was found for Reserve, and no security.txt, bug bounty, or trust center is published on the domain. The profile is retained as an acquired/redirected consumer-sector lead.

providers.name: Resonado Labs
providers.description: Resonado Labs is a high-velocity innovation and hardware development lab focused on improving the acoustic performance of the next generation of audio products through speaker hardware design and engineering. Backed by 500 Global, the company designs novel loudspeaker and transducer technology for consumer electronics and audio OEMs. Resonado Labs is a hardware and acoustics company; it publishes a marketing website but does not currently expose a public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Retailigence
providers.description: Retailigence is a retail technology company that applies artificial intelligence and machine learning to category management and store operations. Its ML Engine powers an AI suite for assortment optimisation, space modelling, store clustering, customer segmentation, and an X-Ray control-tower hub (web and mobile) that tracks and helps remove in-store operational issues. The platform is delivered as a proof-of-concept engagement rather than a public self-serve developer API. Retailigence was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Rev1
providers.description: Rev1 (REV1, Inc.) is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) startup building an AI-powered platform that automatically converts 3D CAD models into fully annotated, production-ready 2D manufacturing drawings in minutes instead of hours. The software applies ASME Y14.5-2018 geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T) standards, captures design intent, and lets mechanical engineers review the design rationale before sharing with manufacturers, reportedly recovering roughly 25% of engineering time at hardware companies across robotics, aerospace, automotive, medical devices, and consumer electronics. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes only a marketing site and a demo-request flow — there is no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface to catalog.

providers.name: Revolution Precrafted
providers.description: Revolution Precrafted is a Manila, Philippines-based prefabricated design and proptech company founded in 2015 by Robbie Antonio. It designs and sells limited-edition prefab homes, pavilions, modular hotels, pop-up retail spaces, glamping structures, and furniture created by more than 80 leading global architects, designers, and artists under exclusive partnership. Backed by 500 Startups (500 Durians) and K2 Global, it reached a reported unicorn valuation. The company runs a consumer real-estate and construction business and publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or technical documentation. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio lead and mislabeled "Strategic Grow" in the source stub; the website revolutionprecrafted.com is authoritative.

providers.name: Revolving Games
providers.description: Revolving Games is a mobile-first game studio and publishing company operating two independent gaming studios with a team of 150+ gaming-industry veterans. Its flagship title is War of Nova, a sci-fi 4X space-strategy mobile game for iOS and Android spanning base-building, empire-building, and competitive multiplayer live-ops gameplay. Backed by Pantera Capital, the company was surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; as of this enrichment pass it publishes a consumer marketing website only and exposes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Ricursive
providers.description: Ricursive (Ricursive Intelligence) is a frontier AI lab building self-improving systems, starting with chip design. The company combines modern AI methods with semiconductor and electronic design automation (EDA) workflows to create a feedback loop between AI systems and the hardware that runs them. It was founded by veterans from Google DeepMind, Anthropic, and NVIDIA (including researchers behind AlphaChip) and is backed by leading investors. As of this profile Ricursive publishes a public marketing and careers site but no public API, SDK, developer documentation, or developer product surface — so there is no API artifact to harvest. This company profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for discovery and monitoring.

providers.name: Right Hear
providers.description: Right Hear (RightHear) is an accessibility technology company, backed by Techstars, that helps people who are blind, have low vision, or face orientation and wayfinding challenges navigate indoor and complex public spaces more independently. Its solution pairs location sensors installed at points of interest with a companion smartphone app that delivers spoken, audible orientation cues and accessibility information to visitors, and is marketed primarily to businesses, venues, and public institutions seeking to make their physical environments more inclusive. At the time of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public developer API, SDK, or machine-readable API documentation surface, and its website sits behind a bot-protection challenge; this profile tracks the company's identity and public web presence for API and agentic-access discoverability.

providers.name: Rightpoint
providers.description: Rightpoint is a global experience consultancy, now fully integrated into the Genpact brand, that designs and builds customer and employee experiences for enterprise organizations. Its practice spans agentic experience, digital workspace, experience advisory, intelligent content, omnichannel experience, and personalization and experimentation, delivered through deep platform partnerships with Adobe, Microsoft, Optimizely, and Sitecore. As a services and consulting firm rather than an API product company, Rightpoint publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures its identity and web presence within the API Evangelist network. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners.

providers.name: Riide
providers.description: Riide manufactures connected electric bicycles combining a street-legal 500W ebike (the Riide 2) with built-in GPS tracking, 4G cellular connectivity, remote lock/disable theft prevention, and a removable battery with state-of-charge monitoring. The company pairs hardware with a mobile app and connected-vehicle services. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; as of this pass the public site is a consumer product/pre-order page ("coming soon") with no documented developer, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Rimac
providers.description: Rimac Group is a Croatia-based holding company bringing together exclusive hypercars and advanced electrification technology. Its portfolio spans Bugatti Rimac (the hypercar joint venture behind the all-electric Rimac Nevera), Rimac Technology (design, engineering and production of EV components — battery systems, powertrains, battery management systems and electronic control units supplied to OEMs including Porsche, Hyundai, BMW and others), and Verne (autonomous urban mobility / robotaxi). Rimac is a B2B automotive and electrification supplier and vehicle manufacturer; it does not currently operate a public developer program, API, or developer portal. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company/portfolio tracking.

providers.name: riskmethods
providers.description: riskmethods was a supply-chain risk management SaaS company (Munich, Germany) that helped enterprises monitor, assess, and mitigate risk across their supplier networks using AI-driven risk intelligence, supplier monitoring, and disruption alerting. Backed by Point Nine Capital, riskmethods was acquired by Sphera in 2022 and its product now lives inside Sphera's Supply Chain Risk Management suite; the former riskmethods.net domain 301-redirects to sphera.com. riskmethods did not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or discovery endpoints, so this profile carries the identity and a probed domain-security posture rather than an API surface.

providers.name: Riverpool
providers.description: Riverpool (riverpool.ai) is an early-stage, pre-launch startup building what it describes as the "post-modern analytics data stack" — a continuously circulating, self-refreshing approach to analytics data rather than a stagnant warehouse. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass the public site is a "coming soon" landing page hosted on GitHub Pages with no launched product, developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI, SDKs, or other API surface to catalog yet. This profile captures verified company identity and domain-security posture; API artifacts will be added when the product and its developer surface go live.

providers.name: Rivet Design
providers.description: Rivet is a design agent that works alongside your coding agent: given a prompt or an existing application, it explores dozens of distinct visual and UI design directions in parallel so you can compare them side by side and pick the one that fits, instead of iterating on a single design by hand. As of this profile it is an early-stage product presented through a marketing landing page at tryrivet.design; no public API, SDKs, CLI, MCP server, or developer documentation are published yet, so the API Evangelist network tracks it as an identity-only company profile.

providers.name: Rocketrip
providers.description: Rocketrip was a New York City corporate travel cost-savings platform that gave business travelers a personalized budget (a "Price to Beat") and rewarded employees who booked flights, hotels, and rail below it, sharing the savings between the traveler and the company. It was backed by Canaan Partners, GV, Bessemer, and Y Combinator. As of this enrichment pass the rocketrip.com and www.rocketrip.com domains 301-redirect to Tabhi (tabhi.ai / tabhi.com), the developer, docs, and api subdomains no longer resolve, and no public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI could be found — the standalone Rocketrip product and its API surface appear to have been retired or folded into Tabhi.

providers.name: Rockport Trade Systems
providers.description: Rockport Trade Systems is a global trade management (GTM) software company providing customs compliance, import and export management, and trade-content solutions to enterprises. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners, it was added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass the company operates a corporate marketing website but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or specification surface, and the site actively blocks automated access (HTTP 403), so no API artifacts could be harvested.

providers.name: Rothys
providers.description: Rothy's is a San Francisco-based direct-to-consumer footwear and accessories brand founded in 2012, known for washable shoes and bags 3D-knitted from recycled materials such as post-consumer plastic water bottles and marine plastics. Its catalog spans flats, loafers, sneakers, Mary Janes, clogs, sandals, heels, and boots for women, men, and kids, alongside totes, crossbody bags, wallets, and backpacks. The company ships to 40+ countries and emphasizes sustainable, seamless-knit manufacturing that reduces waste. Rothy's was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer retail brand it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures its identity and web presence for the catalog.

providers.name: RPX
providers.description: RPX Corporation is a San Francisco-based patent risk management company that provides defensive patent aggregation, patent market intelligence, and litigation-risk services to member companies. Its member platform is served from gated hosts (api.rpxcorp.com and docs.rpxcorp.com) that require subscription authentication, so no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or documentation surface is accessible for enrichment. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of crv. Sector: enterprise / intellectual property.

providers.name: Rudus
providers.description: Rudus is a Y Combinator (Spring 2026) startup building an AI-powered takeoff and estimation platform for concrete contractors and subcontractors. The software automatically detects and classifies concrete structures (footings, walls, columns, and slabs) from architectural plan sets, expands them into detailed assembly line items, and integrates into existing estimator workflows rather than replacing them. Rudus reports a 70-80% reduction in takeoff and estimation time, letting estimators submit more bids. Founded by Rishi Pankhaniya (ex-Airbnb) and Sahil Goel (ex-Amazon). As of this enrichment pass Rudus operates a lead-generation marketing site at rudus.ai with no public developer program, API, documentation, or self-service sign-up; this profile records that verified state.

providers.name: Ruedata
providers.description: Ruedata (RueData AI) is an AI predictive tire-management software platform for commercial fleet operators. It combines a smart digital inspection app, the TLGX precision tire-measurement device (tread depth to +/-1/32nd and pressure to +/-0.25 percent), and a centralized web platform to help fleets prevent tire blowouts, cut maintenance costs, extend tire lifecycle, and improve road safety. Its business-intelligence layer applies predictive analytics for tire wear and route optimization, and it integrates with major telematics providers such as Samsara, Geotab, Netfleet, and Traffilog plus ERP systems via direct API connections. Ruedata is a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass it publishes a marketing and product site but no public developer API, API reference, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: ruhnn
providers.description: Ruhnn Holding Limited (如涵控股) is a Hangzhou-based Chinese influencer (KOL) incubation, marketing, and e-commerce company. It pioneered the "internet celebrity" (wanghong) commercialization model, signing and developing influencers and monetizing their audiences through self-operated online stores on marketplaces such as Taobao and Tmall, as well as through a platform/advertising business that connects its network of KOLs with third-party brands for social-marketing campaigns. The company listed on NASDAQ under the ticker RUHN in 2019 and was subsequently taken private. It is surfaced here as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. Ruhnn is a consumer-facing influencer marketing and commerce operator and does not publish a public developer platform, API, or SDK surface.

providers.name: RUUT
providers.description: RUUT (ruut.mx) is a Mexican fintech and mobile-first investment platform that lets everyday people invest in the US stock markets. Marketed as "la plataforma de inversion para no inversionistas" (the investment platform for non-investors), it gives users access to 8,000+ US stocks and ETFs, personalized risk-based portfolios (safe, moderate, aggressive), goal-based investing, and AI-tailored market news. Accounts are protected up to $500,000 USD via SIPC insurance through its US brokerage partner Alpaca Securities LLC (FINRA/SIPC). RUUT is registered with Mexico's CNBV as an independent investment advisor (Folio #30174) and is a portfolio company of 500 Global. RUUT is a consumer product with no public developer API; this profile was enriched from its public website and live domain probes.

providers.name: RVDS
providers.description: RVDS Inc. is a South Korean food and beverage company that describes itself as growing into Korea's representative Multi-K-Food Brand Operator, building and operating a portfolio of consumer dining brands including Dodo Korea, Butai, and Salad Monster. Based in Cheongju-si, Chungcheongbuk-do, the company is backed by 500 Global. As a consumer food-brand operator it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or technical documentation, so this profile carries only identity and probed domain-security signals rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: S3 Graphics
providers.description: S3 Graphics, Inc. is a legacy graphics, video, and multimedia accelerator company known for its GPU architectures (Savage, Chrome and DeltaChrome, plus the earlier ViRGE and Trio chipsets) and its display drivers. Originally founded as S3 Incorporated in 1989, the graphics business later operated as S3 Graphics under VIA and HTC ownership. Its public web presence is a legacy marketing and driver-download site (still Flash/Ruffle based); it exposes no modern web API, SDK, or developer platform. The historical "Developers" area was a hardware developer-relations channel offering GPU sample cards during the DeltaChrome era, not a programmatic API.

providers.name: S4S Technologies
providers.description: S4S Technologies operates what it describes as India's only full-stack food processing platform, running tech-driven farm-gate procurement and processing for the food and beverage industry. The company sources fresh produce from farmers through Village Level Collection Centres, processes it through climate-clean micro food-processing units, and supplies convenience-driven ingredients (fruits, vegetables, pulses, grains, and spices) to more than 1,100 food and beverage customers. It is a B2B agritech and food-supply-chain business rather than a software or API provider; no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Sabi
providers.description: Sabi ("Just Think") presents itself at sabi.com as a consumer neural-interface company building a wearable (a beanie) that transforms a wearer's thoughts directly into text — "no typing, no voice, just think." As of this enrichment pass the company operates a single marketing landing page with no public developer portal, API, documentation, SDK, changelog, or status surface; the only outbound links are its social accounts on X and Instagram. Added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio stub lead; there is currently no API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Sailplane
providers.description: Sailplane is an early-stage, true-ventures-backed AI startup building agentic automation. As of July 2026 the company is in stealth / pre-launch: sailplane.ai serves only a teaser page rendering an agent execution trace ("A signal has been sent. An agent is listening. The trace begins here.") describing plan initiation, support agents, branch generation, trajectory proposal/approval, and execution. No public API, developer docs, SDKs, or well-known endpoints are published yet. This profile remains a lead pending a public developer surface.

providers.name: Saks Global (fka Saks Fifth Avenue)
providers.description: Saks Global (fka Saks Fifth Avenue) is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of insight-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Saks OFF 5TH
providers.description: Saks OFF 5TH is an American off-price retailer of designer and luxury fashion, footwear, accessories, and home goods, historically operated as the discount banner of Saks Fifth Avenue and later folded into Saks Global (Hudson's Bay Company / HBC). It sold marked-down designer merchandise through outlet stores and an e-commerce site at saksoff5th.com. As of this enrichment pass the public website resolves to a shutdown notice with only a store-locations link, and the company publishes no developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface. It was surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub of Insight Partners in the consumer sector.

providers.name: Salad Ventures
providers.description: Salad Ventures is a crypto and web3 investment firm operating in the digital-asset, blockchain, and web3 gaming ecosystem. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Multicoin Capital. As an investment and ecosystem firm rather than an API producer, Salad Ventures exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal; its primary web presence (salad.ventures) sits behind a Cloudflare challenge and publishes no machine-readable API surface. This profile captures the firm's identity and domain-security posture for the network.

providers.name: Samsara Eco
providers.description: Samsara Eco is an Australian climate-technology company pioneering enzymatic recycling, a process that uses engineered enzymes to break plastics and synthetic textiles down into their molecular building blocks so they can be infinitely remade into new materials with no loss of quality. Spun out of the Australian National University, the company recovers nylon and polyester from mixed and coloured textile and plastic waste and partners with global brands to build a circular materials supply chain. It is a materials-science and biotech company rather than an API provider, and has no public developer, API, or technical integration surface at this time.

providers.name: Saturnbird Coffee
providers.description: Saturnbird Coffee (三顿半) is a Chinese specialty coffee company known for premium instant coffee made with its proprietary REPUS extraction technology (cold extraction plus intelligent drying) using 100% Arabica beans. Its numbered Number Series and Express Series products, a Red Dot Design Award winner and Specialty Coffee Association member, are sold direct-to-consumer online and through collaborations with roasters including April Coffee, Kurasu, Monogram Coffee, and Fritz Coffee Company. Backed by Hongshan (HSG), it was surfaced as a portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a consumer packaged-goods e-commerce brand with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Scaleio
providers.description: ScaleIO was a software-defined block storage startup (an early Norwest Venture Partners investment) that was acquired by EMC in 2013 and folded into Dell EMC as ScaleIO, later renamed VxFlex OS and then PowerFlex. It is no longer an independent company: the scaleio.com domain is Dell-managed and 301-redirects to the Dell EMC software-defined storage product page, and there is no independent developer portal, API, or SDK surface under this brand. Any current API surface lives under Dell PowerFlex, not scaleio.com.

providers.name: SCG Cell Therapy
providers.description: SCG Cell Therapy Pte. Ltd. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Singapore, with operations across Singapore, China and Germany, developing novel immunotherapies for infectious diseases and the cancers they cause. The company targets the most common cancer-causing infections — Helicobacter pylori, human papillomavirus (HPV), hepatitis B virus (HBV) and Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) — and is advancing a pipeline of TCR-engineered T cell therapies, antibodies and therapeutic vaccines built on its proprietary GianTCR platform. Lead programs include SCG101, a first-in-class autologous HBV-specific TCR-T therapy targeting hepatitis B surface antigen in HBV-related hepatocellular carcinoma, and SCG142, a next-generation HPV E7-specific TCR-T therapy for HPV-associated solid tumors that received FDA IND clearance. SCG covers the full value chain from drug discovery and manufacturing through clinical development and commercialization. It is a therapeutics developer, not a software vendor, and publishes no public API, developer portal or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: SE3 Labs
providers.description: SE3 Labs is a European artificial intelligence company building spatial AI for autonomous systems, with a mission to enable machines to perceive, reason, and act autonomously in the physical world. Its technology performs real-time 3D reconstruction of operational environments, spatial understanding to orchestrate fleets of autonomous machines, and natural-language interfaces for commanding multiple machines at once. Early applications target the defence sector, including vision-based autonomy and multi-drone reconnaissance. SE3 Labs is backed by Seedcamp and works directly with government and military partners; it does not currently publish a public API, SDK, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Seasats
providers.description: Seasats designs and manufactures autonomous uncrewed surface vehicles (USVs) for ocean intelligence, maritime domain awareness, and defense missions. Its platform lines include the hand-deployable Lightfish (6-month endurance), the fast-response Quickfish (35+ knots with an integrated drone bay), and the heavy-payload Heavyfish. Vessels carry modular payloads, run persistent autonomous surveys, and integrate with existing command-and-control (C2) architectures. Seasats is a Techstars-backed company. As of this enrichment pass Seasats publishes no public developer API, SDK, documentation portal, or machine-readable discovery surface; its integration story is C2 interoperability, not a web API.

providers.name: SecureInfo
providers.description: SecureInfo Corporation was a cybersecurity and information-assurance company focused on FISMA and federal compliance, surfaced as a portfolio company of insight-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass the domain www.secureinfo.com no longer serves an independent site — its TLS certificate resolves to kratosdefense.com (Kratos Defense), indicating the business was acquired/absorbed. No independent public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface was found; this profile records that honest finding.

providers.name: Selkirk Pharma
providers.description: Selkirk Pharma, Inc. is a privately held U.S. contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) in Spokane, Washington, specializing in the aseptic fill/finish of sterile injectable drug products — vaccines, biologics and small molecules — for clinical and commercial supply. Founded in 2018, it operates a purpose-built aseptic campus at 9110 W Granite Avenue in the Pacific Northwest Technology Park, roughly half a mile from Spokane International Airport, running unidirectional personnel and material flow, single-use systems, SKAN isolator technology and Bausch+Strobel VarioSys dose-filling lines rated to about 3,600 vials per hour under EU GMP Annex 1. Services span aseptic filling, in-house analytical chemistry and microbiology, sterility testing, finished-product inspection, regulatory support and supply-chain services, plus a ClinFAST program that compresses fill/finish timelines for clinical-trial material. The build-out drew roughly $150M led by Spokane's Cowles Company with other Washington State investors, and Colleen Dixon was named chief executive in July 2024. Selkirk Pharma sells contract manufacturing capacity, not software: it operates no developer program, publishes no web API, SDK or machine-readable specification, and maintains no public source-code organization. (In this sector "API" ordinarily means active pharmaceutical ingredient; Selkirk fills and finishes drug product and publishes no web API.)

providers.name: Semmle
providers.description: Semmle was a semantic code-analysis company whose engine let developers write queries (in its QL query language) to find security vulnerabilities and their variants across large codebases, and which powered the free open-source code review platform LGTM.com. Its technology was adopted by Uber, NASA, Microsoft, and Google. GitHub acquired Semmle in September 2019 and folded the QL engine into what is now CodeQL and GitHub code scanning; the standalone Semmle and LGTM.com products were retired and www.semmle.com now redirects to the GitHub acquisition announcement. This profile is retained as a historical (acquired) company lead in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Seriously
providers.description: Seriously Digital Entertainment is a mobile game studio best known for the Best Fiends match-3 puzzle franchise, a bug-versus-slug adventure set in the world of Minutia and available on iOS and Android. Founded in Helsinki with a Los Angeles presence and backed by Northzone, the studio was acquired by Playtika. It is a consumer entertainment company: its public web presence (seriously.com, which now redirects to bestfiends.com) is a game marketing and community site with app-store download links and social channels. Seriously publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface, so this API Evangelist profile carries company identity and a domain-security probe only.

providers.name: Shara
providers.description: Shara (Shara Technology Management Nigeria Ltd) is a Lagos-based fintech that provides collateral-free working-capital loans of up to NGN 10 million to Nigerian small and medium-sized businesses. Sole traders, partnerships, and limited companies apply through Shara's website or Android app with basic business details and a bank statement, and receive a free loan estimate in seconds with approval typically in 48 hours to two weeks. The company reports over NGN 50 billion disbursed across 100,000+ loans to 7,000+ business customers. Shara publishes no public API, developer portal, or documentation.

providers.name: ShearShare
providers.description: ShearShare is a B2B2C marketplace that lets salon and barbershop owners rent out unused chairs, booths, and suites to licensed beauty and barbering professionals on a flexible, on-demand basis — space-as-a-service for the hair, beauty, and grooming industry. Through its mobile app and web platform, independent stylists, barbers, and cosmetologists discover and book professional space by the day, while shop owners monetize idle capacity. Founded in 2015 by Dr. Tye Caldwell and Courtney Caldwell and headquartered in McKinney, Texas, the company has been featured on ABC's Shark Tank and is backed by 500 Global among other investors.

providers.name: Shelf Engine
providers.description: Shelf Engine was a Seattle-based technology company that used machine learning and AI-driven demand forecasting to help grocery retailers reduce food waste and optimize ordering of perishable and fresh food items. It offered a guaranteed-order model where its forecasting engine predicted demand and absorbed the risk of unsold inventory. Shelf Engine was acquired by / merged into Crisp (gocrisp.com), the retail data platform, and its independent brand is now defunct: shelfengine.com 301-redirects to gocrisp.com. No independent public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface is published under the Shelf Engine brand.

providers.name: SHRAPNEL
providers.description: SHRAPNEL is a AAA free-to-play extraction first-person shooter developed by Neon Machine and built on a dedicated Avalanche blockchain subnet. Early access launched on PC in February 2024, with a Steam listing and a player-driven economy: modding and creator tools for building skins and maps, a marketplace for tradable in-game items, and the SHRAP token. Neon Machine has publicly announced a Web3 developer API platform named GameBridge, but as of this profile it is not yet publicly documented — SHRAPNEL exposes no public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI, or docs portal, and shrapnel.com sits behind Cloudflare bot protection. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Polychain and tracked in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Silk
providers.description: Silk (Silk Security) was a cybersecurity company backed by Insight Partners that built an exposure, vulnerability and security-finding correlation / risk-prioritization platform. As of this enrichment pass its primary domain silk.security issues a verified 301 redirect to armis.com, indicating the company and product have been absorbed into Armis; no standalone Silk developer or API surface (developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, docs, or status page) is currently published, so there is no independent API to enrich beyond a domain-security probe of the still-live silk.security host.

providers.name: SimplyCook
providers.description: SimplyCook is a UK-based recipe-box and meal-flavoring subscription service (tagline "For simple pleasures, SimplyCook.") that ships monthly boxes of flavor pots, stocks, and spice blends alongside curated recipes so subscribers can cook varied meals at home in around twenty minutes. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. SimplyCook operates as a direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand; it runs an internal application backend at api.simplycook.com but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface. This profile therefore carries only what could be genuinely probed: DNS/TLS/HTTP domain-security posture for the company domain.

providers.name: Simpo
providers.description: Simpo is a no-code digital adoption platform (DAP) that lets enterprise product and customer-success teams build in-app onboarding flows, guided walkthroughs, announcements, surveys, and contextual help without writing code. End users are guided at the point of need inside the software they already use, driving feature adoption, engagement, and retention. Founded in 2016 by Yohanan Hruschev and Yuval Karmi and headquartered in San Francisco, Simpo raised a $4.5M seed round led by Redpoint Ventures in 2019 and was acquired by WalkMe in October 2021. The product is a snippet/embed-installed browser layer rather than a public developer REST API; it exposes no OpenAPI, SDK, or public developer documentation surface, and the primary web host is no longer reachable following the acquisition.

providers.name: simsim
providers.description: simsim was an Accel-backed India-based social / video commerce startup (sector: consumer) that let creators sell products through short shoppable videos; it was acquired by Google in 2021 and wound down. Enrichment probes on 2026-07-21 confirm the simsim.in zone is live for email only (Google Workspace MX + SPF), with no resolving web host (apex or www), no api/app/developer/docs subdomains, and no reachable HTTPS, developer portal, documentation, or API surface to catalog.

providers.name: sinocelltech
providers.description: Sinocelltech (Beijing Sino Cell Biotechnology Group Co., Ltd.; Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market code 688520) is a biopharmaceutical research and development company founded in 2002 by Dr. Xie Liangzhi. It develops and commercializes recombinant protein and monoclonal antibody therapeutics across oncology, autoimmune disease, and infectious disease, together with preventive vaccines including a recombinant 14-valent HPV vaccine and COVID-19 vaccines. The company has multiple marketed products in China and a pipeline of clinical-stage candidates. It publishes no public developer platform, API, or technical documentation surface.

providers.name: SIQ Basketball
providers.description: SIQ Basketball is a Techstars-backed sports-technology company that builds a FIBA-approved, sensor-embedded smart basketball and companion mobile app that automatically tracks shooting mechanics, makes and misses, shot arc and other performance data to coach players. Its technology is now marketed under the Spalding brand as the Spalding TF DNA Smart Basketball, sold with an app subscription. The company operates as a direct-to-consumer product and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its network identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Skims
providers.description: SKIMS is an American shapewear, loungewear, and apparel brand co-founded in 2019 by Kim Kardashian with Jens and Emma Grede, headquartered in Los Angeles. It sells solutionwear, underwear, loungewear, swim, and ready-to-wear direct-to-consumer through skims.com and via wholesale partners, and is the official underwear partner of the NBA, WNBA, and USA Basketball. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Thrive Capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile. This consumer retail brand publishes no public developer API surface; the profile carries a live domain-security probe of its web infrastructure.

providers.name: Slauson & Co.
providers.description: Slauson & Co. is an early-stage venture capital firm based in Los Angeles, founded in 2020 by Austin Clements and Ajay Relan and named for the South LA avenue where the two first met. Rooted in economic inclusion, the firm invests at the pre-seed and seed stage in SMB software tools for the next generation of small-business owners and in culturally relevant consumer products and services, backing founders who have historically been overlooked by traditional venture capital. Slauson & Co. has raised a $100M Fund II — backed by tech companies including Google, Meta and PayPal — and runs the Friends & Family accelerator that pairs non-dilutive grants with hands-on programming. Portfolio companies include Sienna Naturals, Pressed Roots, A-Frame Brands, Charger Help, Bags and Prado.

providers.name: Slintel
providers.description: Slintel is a B2B sales and market intelligence platform that mines buyer and technographic signals — company firmographics, technology installs, psychographics, and buying-intent scores — to help revenue teams prioritize accounts and time outreach. Founded in 2016 and backed by Accel and Sequoia, Slintel was acquired by 6sense in 2021 and its data and API services are now consolidated into the 6sense Revenue AI platform. Slintel's programmatic surface (company identification, firmographics, lead scoring, and enrichment) is delivered through the 6sense API Portal rather than a standalone Slintel developer portal. As of a 2026-08-14 probe pass, Slintel operates no developer surface of its own: slintel.com redirects every path into 6sense.com, the historical api.slintel.com and app.slintel.com hosts are decommissioned, no /.well-known/ document or machine-readable spec is served, and no first-party SDK exists in any public package registry. The successor APIs are catalogued under the 6sense provider.

providers.name: Small Giant Games
providers.description: Small Giant Games is a Helsinki, Finland based mobile game studio best known for the hit puzzle-RPG Empires & Puzzles. Founded in 2013, the studio was acquired by Zynga in 2018 (now part of Take-Two Interactive) and continues to operate its live free-to-play mobile titles. As a consumer mobile gaming company it publishes player-facing games and support resources rather than a public developer API. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Creandum and EQT Ventures and processed by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline, which found no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, package/SDK, or /.well-known discovery surface — only a live consumer marketing website.

providers.name: Smilobaby
providers.description: Smilo (Smilobaby) is a direct-to-consumer baby and toddler products brand founded in 2016 and based in Boston, backed by Norwest Venture Partners. Products are developed by doctors, scientists and engineers and sold direct via smilobaby.com, spanning bottle feeding, pacifiers and teethers, pregnancy and nursing, nursery, mealtime and bath. Its hero products are a pediatric-dentist-designed pacifier that supports a baby's developing palate and a patented-nipple bottle with an extra-sensitive vent that simulates breastfeeding. This is a consumer e-commerce retail brand: it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI, so the enrichment pass records identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Smith
providers.description: Smith (GoSmith, Inc.) was an app- and web-based marketplace for home-improvement and remodeling services, founded in 2012 in Sunnyvale, California and part of the 500 Startups (500 Global) accelerator's 8th batch in 2014. Homeowners listed a project to receive quotes from up to five researched and vetted local contractors, with scheduling and payment tooling for the professionals. As of this enrichment pass the gosmith.com domain still resolves (AWS/Google Workspace DNS) but serves no website (HTTP/HTTPS connections time out), and the company exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: SnapDeal
providers.description: Snapdeal is an Indian e-commerce marketplace founded in February 2010 by Kunal Bahl and Rohit Bansal and headquartered in Gurugram/New Delhi. It began as a daily-deals platform and grew into a value-focused online marketplace that connects third-party sellers with buyers across categories such as fashion, home and kitchen, electronics accessories, and general merchandise, primarily serving price-sensitive shoppers in India's smaller cities and towns. Sellers onboard and manage catalog, orders, and payouts through the Snapdeal seller portal (seller.snapdeal.com). Snapdeal has been backed by investors including SoftBank, Bessemer Venture Partners, Nexus Venture Partners, and Kalaari Capital. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners; enrichment found no public developer portal, no api.snapdeal.com or developer.snapdeal.com host, and no published API specification or well-known discovery surface — the seller portal is login-gated behind SSO.

providers.name: SnapShyft
providers.description: SnapShyft is an on-demand staffing marketplace that connects hospitality, food-and-beverage, and events venues with vetted gig workers for short-notice shifts. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass its primary domain (snapshyft.com) serves a coming-soon placeholder page and exposes no public API, developer portal, documentation, changelog, or /.well-known discovery surface. The only machine-verifiable signal harvested was domain/transport security (TLS 1.3, HSTS, DMARC quarantine); the profile remains a lead awaiting a live developer surface.

providers.name: Sole Society
providers.description: Sole Society is a women's footwear, handbags, jewelry, and accessories e-commerce brand, surfaced as a portfolio company of insight-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass the standalone brand no longer operates its own storefront. The domain solesociety.com resolves to MarkMonitor-managed nameservers, its HTTPS endpoints do not respond, and http://solesociety.com redirects (HTTP 200) to https://www.dsw.com/, so the domain appears to have been folded into DSW / Designer Brands. No public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI, MCP server, or other machine-readable API surface was found for this brand. This profile remains a lead-stage company record with no API artifacts.

providers.name: Solugen
providers.description: Solugen is a chemical manufacturing company that produces sustainable industrial chemicals through its proprietary Bioforge platform, which combines engineered enzymes, metal catalysis, and modular process design to convert renewable feedstocks into products with minimal waste. Solugen serves markets including oil and gas, renewable fuels, aerospace and defense, water treatment, cleaning, agriculture, concrete, and personal care. Backed by Founders Fund, the company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; as of this enrichment pass Solugen publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable developer surface.

providers.name: Soluto
providers.description: Soluto is a consumer technology-support and device-protection brand operated under Asurion; its former standalone product site (asurion.com/soluto-service) now redirects into Asurion's Tech Help experience. Soluto began as an independent software company and its engineering organization still maintains a public open-source presence of 52 repositories on GitHub (github.com/Soluto). The enrichment pass found no standalone public Soluto product API, developer portal, OpenAPI, MCP, or webhook surface of its own — only the GitHub organization and the Asurion-hosted brand page.

providers.name: Sonoma Biotherapeutics
providers.description: Sonoma Biotherapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing engineered regulatory T cell (Treg) therapies to restore immune balance in autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. Building on Nobel Prize-winning Treg biology, its lead program SBT-77-7101 is in Phase 1 clinical trials for conditions including refractory rheumatoid arthritis and hidradenitis suppurativa. Backed by 8VC and GV, the company operates in cell therapy and does not publish a public developer API surface. Sector: biotech.

providers.name: Sooth
providers.description: Sooth (Sooth Labs, Inc.) is an AI research company building a "World Model for Global Foresight" — a continuously trained forecasting engine that integrates economic, geopolitical, and operational signals into calibrated probability forecasts for high-stakes decisions. Its platform is described in three parts: the Sooth Engine (a world model that reasons across domains), Sooth Chronology (autonomous agents that collect and prioritize signals), and Sooth Proof (cryptographically committed, calibrated forecasts with an auditable track record). Founded by veterans of frontier AI at Meta and Carnegie Mellon and backed by Felicis, the company is pre-product as of mid-2026 and does not yet publish a public API, developer portal, or documentation.

providers.name: Sora
providers.description: Sora Schools is a fully online, project-based independent middle and high school (soraschools.com), backed by Union Square Ventures. Students learn through interdisciplinary, interest-driven projects and live small-group expeditions rather than traditional grade-level classes, with an accredited diploma path. It is surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Union Square Ventures portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the public site is served behind a Cloudflare bot challenge and Sora publishes no public developer, API, or integrations program, so this profile carries only probed infrastructure signals (DNS/TLS/security) rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Space Runners
providers.description: Space Runners is a digital fashion company that designs and launches digital wearable NFTs for metaverses in collaboration with celebrities and brands. Positioned at the intersection of Web3, gaming, and consumer fashion, the company produces branded digital sneakers, apparel, and wearable collectibles for use across metaverse platforms. Backed by Accel and Pantera Capital, Space Runners operates a consumer-facing brand and marketplace rather than a developer platform; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Spacebel
providers.description: Spacebel s.a. is a Belgian software company building flight and ground software for space missions, including on-board software for ESA missions and Earth-observation ground segments, catalogues and data-access services. Its GIS estate serves Sentinel-derived Earth-observation products through OGC-standard web services.

providers.name: Spacejoy
providers.description: Spacejoy is an online interior design platform that pairs customers with professional designers to reimagine their spaces. Users share a room photo and requirements, then receive photo-realistic 3D renderings, curated furniture and decor recommendations, and shoppable design boards that link directly to retailers such as Wayfair, Article, Crate & Barrel, and CB2. The service covers living rooms, bedrooms, dining rooms, home offices, nurseries, entryways, and outdoor spaces, and operates an integrated storefront at shop.spacejoy.com plus an iOS mobile app. Spacejoy is a direct-to-consumer design service with no public developer program, API, or documentation surface as of this profile. Originally added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Accel.

providers.name: Spacemaker
providers.description: Spacemaker was a Norwegian proptech startup (founded 2016 in Oslo) that built cloud-based, AI-assisted generative design software for early-stage real estate and urban site planning, letting architects, developers, and urban planners rapidly explore massing, sunlight, wind, noise, and view analyses to optimize buildable sites. Backed by investors including Northzone, Spacemaker was acquired by Autodesk in November 2020 (reported ~$240M) and its technology was continued and rebranded as Autodesk Forma. The standalone spacemaker.ai domain now permanently (301) redirects to the Autodesk Forma product page, so there is no longer an independent Spacemaker developer portal, API, or documentation surface; developer/API access is provided through Autodesk Forma and the broader Autodesk Platform Services ecosystem.

providers.name: SPES (speschina)
providers.description: SPES (诗裴丝) is a China-based consumer personal-care and beauty brand operating a direct-to-consumer business across Chinese e-commerce and social-commerce channels, including its Tmall flagship store, a JD.com storefront, and Douyin, Xiaohongshu (RED), and Weibo social accounts, with a WeChat official account. The brand runs a marketing website (a Vue.js / Element UI single-page app served from Alibaba Cloud) and was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. It does not currently publish any public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, developer portal, or API documentation; the only HTTP API referenced by its site is a private content backend for the marketing pages. This profile records the enrichment pass that confirmed there is no public API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Spider Fleet
providers.description: Spiderfleet (Spider Fleet) is a Mexico-based intelligent fleet-management platform that helps businesses run and maintain their vehicle fleets. Its public site (spider.com.mx, in Spanish) markets fleet onboarding ("Flotillas"), preventive maintenance scheduling ("mantenimientos"), and quote requests ("cotizacion") for fleet operators, and is backed by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes only a static marketing website with no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable specification; two navigation links (contact and login) return 404 and the site's TLS certificate is expired.

providers.name: Spiff
providers.description: Spiff was a sales commission and incentive compensation management (ICM) platform that automated commission calculations, gave sales reps real-time earnings visibility, and streamlined finance-side reconciliation for revenue teams. Founded in Utah and backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Norwest Venture Partners, Spiff was acquired by Salesforce in 2024 and folded into Sales Cloud as "Salesforce Spiff" / Incentive Compensation Management. As of this profile the standalone spiff.com and app.spiff.com properties redirect to salesforce.com, and no independent Spiff public API, developer portal, documentation, or OpenAPI surface remains discoverable — its capabilities are now delivered through the Salesforce platform.

providers.name: Spindle Technologies
providers.description: Spindle Technologies (spindle.ai) was an Accel-backed AI startup that was acquired by Salesforce; as of this enrichment pass its entire domain — including the docs, developer, api, and app subdomains — issues a 301 redirect to salesforce.com/agentforce, so it no longer operates an independent developer portal, API, documentation, or SDK surface. This profile is retained as a network record of the company and its acquisition. No standalone API artifacts could be harvested. Domain-level security posture (TLS/DNSSEC/SPF/DMARC on spindle.ai) was probed and captured.

providers.name: SpinLaunch
