providers.description: SpinLaunch is a space technology company developing a kinetic launch system that uses a rotating carbon-fiber arm inside a large vacuum chamber to accelerate launch vehicles to thousands of kilometers per hour before ignition, aiming to eliminate up to 70 percent of the fuel and structure of a conventional rocket. It operates a Suborbital Accelerator test facility at Spaceport America in New Mexico that doubles as a customer payload-testing platform, and is developing an Orbital Launch System alongside its Meridian satellite broadband constellation for enterprise connectivity. Backed by GV, the company currently publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Spoke
providers.description: SPOKE (spoke-london.com) is a London-based direct-to-consumer men's fashion retailer specializing in tailored menswear engineered for precise fit, with the tagline "A flawless fit, delivered." Its range spans trousers, denim, shirts, knitwear, shorts, tailoring (suits and jackets) and accessories, sold through an e-commerce storefront with a "Fit Finder" sizing tool. Backed by Seedcamp and tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company. An enrichment pass found no public developer program, API, or developer documentation; the company operates a standard retail e-commerce storefront only.

providers.name: Spoon University
providers.description: Spoon University is a food and lifestyle content platform for the next generation of college students, publishing recipes, food news, restaurant reviews, cooking how-tos, and campus dining coverage across hundreds of university chapters. It is owned and operated by Her Campus Media, LLC (Boston, MA), the media company behind Her Campus, College Fashionista, InfluenceHer Collective, and Generation Hired. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Techstars and Uncork Capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass Spoon University publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation — it is a consumer content brand, not an API provider — so this profile carries identity and domain-security signal only.

providers.name: StackSocial
providers.description: StackSocial is a consumer e-commerce and daily-deals marketplace operated by StackCommerce, selling software, online courses, gadgets, and digital goods at discounted prices. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. The public surface is a bot-protected single-page storefront; enrichment probes found no publicly documented API, OpenAPI specification, SDK packages, MCP server, well-known metadata, or llms.txt on the stacksocial.com host as of this pass.

providers.name: Staked
providers.description: Staked was an institutional cryptocurrency staking and delegation provider that ran validator infrastructure and non-custodial staking services across proof-of-stake networks including Ethereum, Solana, Polkadot, and Cosmos. Founded in 2018 and backed by Pantera Capital, Staked was acquired by Kraken in December 2021 and its products have since been folded into Kraken Staking. The former staked.us domain now serves a static notice redirecting users to staking.kraken.com and kraken.com/institutions/staking; no independent developer portal, public API, or documentation surface remains under the Staked brand.

providers.name: StalkBuyLove
providers.description: StalkBuyLove was an India-based online women's fashion e-commerce retailer, surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass the brand appears defunct as an independent property, since the stalkbuylove.com domain now returns a 301 permanent redirect to styched.in (Styched, an unrelated Shopify-powered Indian youth-fashion retailer). No public developer portal, API, SDK, MCP server, changelog, or other machine-readable API surface could be found for StalkBuyLove on any registry or well-known path. The only honest signal available is the domain, DNS, and TLS security posture of the redirecting host, captured in the domain-security artifact.

providers.name: Standard Economics
providers.description: Standard Economics is building an "economic computer" aimed at financial inclusion and intelligent capital allocation at global scale, describing a system with memory, judgment, and the ability to improve its own decisions to deliver economic security. Its product surface is Uno (uno.global). The company is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Paradigm, and was added to the API Evangelist network from VC-portfolio discovery. As of the latest enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or /.well-known/ discovery surface; this profile currently carries only a domain-security posture probe.

providers.name: StarOfService
providers.description: StarOfService is an online local-services marketplace that connects consumers with vetted service professionals across home improvement, events, wellness, lessons, and business services. Headquartered in France and operating across multiple European markets, the platform matches customer project requests to nearby providers and facilitates quotes and messaging between them. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Point Nine and profiled in the API Evangelist network; the company exposes a consumer web marketplace and has no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Steelbrick
providers.description: SteelBrick was a Configure-Price-Quote (CPQ) SaaS vendor backed by IVP and Shasta Ventures before it was acquired by Salesforce (announced December 2015, closed 2016) and folded into the product now shipped as Salesforce CPQ (formerly Salesforce Revenue Cloud). The steelbrick.com domain is no longer an independent surface: its apex 301-redirects to salesforce.com/sales/cpq/ and the www host serves a broken default CloudFront certificate. There is no standalone SteelBrick developer portal, documentation, or public API — any live API surface belongs to Salesforce CPQ. This profile is retained as a portfolio lead / acquisition record; enrichment found no independent API artifacts to harvest.

providers.name: Stonks
providers.description: Stonks (now operating as Sandhill Markets) is a San Francisco investment platform, founded circa 2019-2020 by serial entrepreneur Ali Moiz, that lets accredited investors buy and sell shares of top pre-IPO companies on the private secondary market - often described as "Robinhood for private markets." The business is run through the SEC-registered adviser Sandhill Markets Advisors LLC and also publishes Sandhill Report, a venture-focused newsletter covering startups, funding, and the broader VC market. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Sandhill Markets publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures the company's public identity and a live domain-security probe of its primary domain.

providers.name: Strella Biotechnology
providers.description: Strella Biotechnology is a Seattle-based produce-quality intelligence company that uses ethylene gas sensors and predictive analytics to reduce food waste across the fresh-produce supply chain. Its product line spans Storage (predicting produce maturity in cold storage), Ripen (automating the ripening process), Sequence (optimizing shipment order to cut shrink), and Monitor (real-time environmental monitoring in logistics). The company reports tracking over two billion pounds of produce across 26 countries and is backed by GV (Google Ventures). As of this enrichment pass, Strella exposes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or webhook surface.

providers.name: Studio
providers.description: Studio (formally Studio of America, Inc.) is a creative collective that develops art through software, describing its mission as creating together, from and for the heart. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV in the consumer sector and added to the API Evangelist network, the public site at s-tud.io is a static Gatsby marketing presence (Home, Beliefs, and Team pages plus an audio player) and exposes no public API, SDK, developer portal, documentation, or well-known discovery surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Studio Moderna
providers.description: Studio Moderna is one of the largest multichannel direct-to-consumer retailers across Central and Eastern Europe, the Middle East, and beyond, founded in 1992 and headquartered in Emmen, Switzerland, with major operations based in Ljubljana, Slovenia. The company reaches consumers through TV direct-response (Top Shop), e-commerce, print catalogs, call centers, and physical retail stores in roughly twenty countries. Its portfolio of house brands spans sleep and home (Dormeo), kitchenware (Delimano), footwear and wellness (Walkmaxx), and health and lifestyle products (Kosmodisk, Rovus, WellNeo). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the company exposes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: StyleSaint
providers.description: StyleSaint is a Los Angeles-based direct-to-consumer luxury women's fashion brand, originally an a16z-backed social-commerce startup and now an independent e-commerce label selling silk, lace, and other luxury-fabric apparel that is handmade in LA, ethically made, and sustainably sourced. The storefront runs on Shopify. As of this enrichment pass StyleSaint publishes no public developer program, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, or agent-facing surface of its own; it is catalogued here as an a16z portfolio company. Any programmable commerce capability would be provided by the underlying Shopify platform rather than by a first-party StyleSaint API.

providers.name: Sumutasu
providers.description: Sumutasu Inc. (株式会社すむたす) is a Japanese property-technology (proptech) company operating under the mission "a society where people can make ideal housing choices" (住まいの理想的な選択ができる社会に). It runs an instant real-estate buying and selling service for used condominiums in Japan, using data and technology to give homeowners a fast, transparent alternative to the traditional brokerage process, alongside an agent-assisted sales offering. The company is backed by 500 Global. Its public presence is a corporate marketing website (About, Services, Members, News, and Careers) built on the Studio.Design no-code platform; no public developer platform, API, SDK, or documentation surface has been found.

providers.name: Superjampad
providers.description: Superjampad is a consumer product company surfaced as a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures and tracked in the API Evangelist network. Its site at superjampad.com serves a Next.js single-page application branded "Breaking - News from friends," a social news product, and the site robots.txt references sitemaps for breaking.im and whatsgood.im, indicating a family of consumer news and social applications. As of this enrichment pass Superjampad publishes no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI/Swagger definition, llms.txt, or .well-known discovery documents; the domain's request paths all resolve to the SPA catch-all rather than to any machine-readable API surface. This profile therefore captures verifiable identity and domain-security posture only, and remains a lead awaiting a real developer surface to enrich further.

providers.name: supermag
providers.description: Suzhou Supermag Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese deep-tech manufacturer specializing in magnetic levitation (maglev) motion and fluid-handling systems. Its product lines include SCM maglev wafer turntables for ultra-clean semiconductor rotation, SCP maglev pumps for contamination-free fluid transport, MSS maglev stirring systems for low-shear mixing, and SCT maglev turbomolecular pumps for high-vacuum applications, serving the semiconductor, biopharmaceutical, chemical, and energy industries. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners, the company markets physical industrial hardware and publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface at this time.

providers.name: Superplastic
providers.description: Superplastic is a designer-toy and entertainment brand that creates animated synthetic celebrities and collectible vinyl art toys, including the characters Janky, Guggimon, and Staffie, sold through its Shopify-powered online store. Based in Burlington, Vermont, the company blends animation, streetwear-style limited-edition drops, and collectible figures. It is a direct-to-consumer commerce and social-media brand and does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures its web and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: SuperValu
providers.description: SuperValu was one of the largest grocery retail and wholesale distribution companies in the United States before being acquired by United Natural Foods (UNFI) in 2018 for $2.9 billion. SuperValu operated retail grocery stores under multiple banners and provided wholesale distribution services. The supervalu.com domain now redirects to UNFI's wholesale food distribution platform. Suppliers interact with UNFI/SuperValu distribution through EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) and the myUNFI supplier portal.

providers.name: Supira Medical
providers.description: Supira Medical, Inc. is a clinical-stage medical device company in Los Gatos, California, and a portfolio company of the Shifamed medtech innovation hub. It is developing a next-generation percutaneous ventricular assist device (pVAD) — a catheter-based blood pump delivered through a 10 French (approximately 3.3 mm) sheath — intended to provide temporary cardiovascular hemodynamic support for patients undergoing high-risk percutaneous coronary intervention (HRPCI) and for patients in cardiogenic shock. The system has received FDA Breakthrough Device Designation and is in U.S. clinical study. The company is privately held and has raised capital through Series A–E financings led by investors including Cormorant Asset Management and The Capital Partnership. Supira Medical builds implantable and catheter-based hardware; it does not operate a public developer program, publish machine-readable API descriptions, or ship client libraries, and no public API surface was found for it.

providers.name: Surfboard
providers.description: Surfboard (teamsurfboard.com) was a workforce management (WFM) SaaS for customer support teams — scheduling, forecasting, and real-time staffing for contact centers — backed by Seedcamp and Speedinvest. As of this enrichment pass the standalone product no longer operates independently; teamsurfboard.com returns an HTTP 301 permanent redirect to Dialpad's workforce management software page (dialpad.com/features/workforce-management-software), indicating Surfboard was acquired by / folded into Dialpad. No standalone Surfboard developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI surface is publicly reachable; all probed /.well-known/ discovery endpoints return 404.

providers.name: Survata
providers.description: Survata was a San Francisco market-research and brand-measurement company, backed by Bloomberg Beta, that ran online surveys and brand-lift studies to measure advertising effectiveness across digital channels. Survata was acquired by Upwave in 2019 and the brand has since been fully absorbed — survata.com now 301-redirects to upwave.com, the enterprise brand-measurement platform. No public developer API, documentation, developer portal, or well-known discovery surface is published for Survata or its Upwave successor; this profile is retained as a network lead with no live API surface.

providers.name: Survios
providers.description: Survios is a virtual reality game studio that develops and publishes immersive VR titles across major platforms including PlayStation VR, Steam, Meta Quest, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch. Known for award-winning games such as Raw Data, Creed: Rise to Glory, The Walking Dead: Onslaught, Sprint Vector, Electronauts, and Alien: Rogue Incursion, the studio describes itself as one of the world's leading VR games studios. Backed by Lux Capital, Survios operates as a consumer games company; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal surface.

providers.name: Swiftkey
providers.description: SwiftKey is a predictive on-screen keyboard for Android and iOS that uses machine learning to improve autocorrect, next-word prediction, and swipe-to-type (SwiftKey Flow). Founded in London as TouchType, it was acquired by Microsoft in 2016 and is now shipped as Microsoft SwiftKey. The former SwiftKey SDK for embedding its prediction engine has been discontinued, and www.swiftkey.com now permanently redirects to microsoft.com/swiftkey. As of this enrichment pass the product exposes no public developer API, SDK registry package, or developer portal.

providers.name: SwitchMe
providers.description: SwitchMe was a Mumbai, India based fintech startup founded in 2012 and backed by 500 Global that helped consumers evaluate and switch their home loans and mobile service providers, handling document collection and submission on their behalf. The company appears to be defunct: no public developer program, API, or documentation could be found, and its switchme.in domain currently resolves to unrelated content. This profile records what could be verified during the enrichment pass; there is no API surface to catalog at this time.

providers.name: Syft
providers.description: Syft (originally Syft Online Ltd, later branded "Syft by Indeed") is a UK-founded flexible-staffing marketplace launched in London in 2015 by Jack Beaman and Novo Abakare. Its platform connects employers across hospitality, retail, industrial, care and facilities-management directly with vetted, rated temporary and part-time workers, removing the traditional recruitment agency and charging a flat fee on top of worker wages. Creandum led Syft's Series A in 2017; the company was acquired by Indeed in 2019 and now operates as part of Indeed Flex. Syft is a consumer/employer staffing marketplace and exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Sylvamo
providers.description: Sylvamo is a global producer of uncoated freesheet paper, pulp, and other forest products, with mills and operations across North America, Latin America, and Europe. The company is recognized for brands such as HP Papers, Hammermill, and Chamex. No public developer API or developer portal has been identified; Sylvamo operates primarily through B2B sales channels and investor and corporate communications channels.

providers.name: Systemax
providers.description: Systemax Inc. (now operating as Global Industrial Company, NYSE: SYX) is a B2B direct marketer of industrial, maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) products in North America. The company sells storage and shelving, material handling equipment, safety products, tools, HVAC, office supplies, and thousands of other industrial products to businesses, educational organizations, and government entities through its Global Industrial brand. Systemax was founded in 1949 and rebranded its primary segment to Global Industrial in 2021.

providers.name: Talk Labs
providers.description: Talk Labs (TalkLabs) builds AI-powered voice simulations for corporate learning, turning training theory into practical, hands-on skills. Its platform provides AI trainers that role-play realistic customer scenarios so frontline sales and customer-service staff can practice conversations on demand. Capabilities include 24/7 AI coaching with no capacity limits, voice-based simulations in 50+ languages, progress-tracking and analytics dashboards, LMS integration, and a no-code AI lesson builder, with deployment within a week of contract. It serves banks, retail, hospitality, financial services, and restaurants. Backed by 500 Global and founded by Serge Sarkisian (CEO) and Ilia Krotov (CTO). No public API, developer portal, documentation, or well-known discovery surface was found at the time of this profile.

providers.name: Tantan
providers.description: Tantan (探探) is a Chinese location-based social discovery and online dating application, launched in 2014 and widely described as "China's Tinder" for its swipe-based matching mechanic. The app pairs nearby users who mutually express interest and layers on messaging, moments, live streaming, and interest-based social features. An early DCM Ventures portfolio company, Tantan was acquired by Momo Inc. (now Hello Group) in 2018 and operates as a consumer mobile product across China and several international markets. Tantan is a mobile-first consumer app and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web identity and probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Tapchief
providers.description: Tapchief was an India-based online marketplace that connected businesses and professionals with a vetted network of freelance experts, consultants, and advisors for project-based work, on-demand consultations, and expert advice. Founded in Bengaluru and backed by 500 Startups (500 Global), the platform let companies discover, book, and collaborate with independent talent across functions such as marketing, finance, product, and technology. Tapchief was acquired by Chargebee in 2021, and the tapchief.com domain is now dormant. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; probing found no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Target Arm
providers.description: Target Arm is a robotics company building systems to autonomously launch and recover drones from moving vehicles without stopping. Its Ralar robotic arm captures drones mid-air, recharges them, and relaunches them, while TRACKR sensor-fusion, TurboFly autopilot, and Maestro mission-control software coordinate drone fleets across commercial delivery, first-responder, agriculture, energy-inspection, and defense/ISR use cases. A Techstars-backed hardware startup with no public API or developer program at this time; this network profile captures identity and infrastructure signals only.

providers.name: Taskty
providers.description: Taskty (تاسكتى) is an Egypt-based online marketplace for on-demand home services, connecting customers with vetted service providers for residential cleaning, furniture and upholstery care, eco-friendly pest control, and home maintenance including plumbing, electrical, painting, carpentry, marble, aluminum, and air-conditioning work. The platform is delivered primarily through consumer iOS and Android mobile apps plus a web presence, with booking, dispatch, and WhatsApp/phone support. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Taskty publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Tastemade
providers.description: Tastemade is a modern media company producing food, travel, and home & design video programming for a global millennial and Gen-Z audience. Founded in 2012, it distributes short- and long-form video across social platforms, connected-TV apps, and its ad-supported and subscription Tastemade+ streaming service, and runs a branded-content studio for advertisers. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of redpoint-ventures; enrichment found no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Tastykake
providers.description: Tastykake is a Philadelphia-area baked snacks brand founded in 1914, known for Kandy Kakes, Krimpets, Juniors, and snack pies. It has been owned by Flowers Foods (NYSE: FLO) since 2011 and operates as a consumer packaged goods brand within the Flowers Foods portfolio alongside Nature's Own, Wonder, and Dave's Killer Bread. No public, developer-facing APIs have been identified for the Tastykake brand; partner, retailer, and distribution integrations are handled through Flowers Foods' internal EDI and account-managed channels rather than a public developer portal.

providers.name: Tattvam
providers.description: Tattvam AI (Tattvam Labs) is an early-stage, Seedcamp-backed deep-tech startup building the intelligence layer of chip design, applying artificial intelligence to semiconductor and electronic design automation (EDA) workflows. As of this profile the company operates a single marketing landing page at tattvamlabs.ai (a Vercel-hosted React single-page app) with no public API, developer documentation, or SDKs; it is in a pre-product, team-building stage. Contact hello@tattvamlabs.ai.

providers.name: Teamnote
providers.description: TeamNote is an enterprise mobile productivity and secure communication platform founded in Hong Kong in 2014 and part of Y Combinator's Winter 2015 batch. Positioned as "Slack for mobile workforces," it gives corporations a mobile-first workspace for team messaging, collaboration, workflow forms, announcements, and content distribution to frontline and deskless staff, with enterprise security and administration controls. The product originally shipped at teamnoteapp.com (its first customer was Cheung Kong Holdings) and the company now presents at teamnote.ai. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or documentation surface was discoverable during enrichment; both web properties are bot-protected.

providers.name: TechieMatter
providers.description: TechieMatter is a tech recruitment platform that provides an all-in-one solution to source, filter, assess, interview, and onboard technical talent from around the globe. The platform spans candidate sourcing and resume screening, technical skills assessment and coding evaluations, expert-led technical interviews, and remote-worker onboarding (payroll, compliance, and legal). It serves 900+ companies across 13+ countries, sourcing candidates from 9+ countries across 60+ technical roles including software engineers, data scientists, DevOps, security, product, and hardware roles. No public API or developer platform is documented at this time; this profile is maintained as an API Evangelist network company record.

providers.name: Telaria
providers.description: Telaria was an independent supply-side platform (SSP) for premium video and connected TV (CTV) advertising, formerly known as Tremor Video's sell-side business. Its Video Management Platform (VMP) combined an ad server built for advanced/OTT TV with real-time analytics, automated decisioning, yield optimization, and integrated programmatic plus direct-sold monetization for publishers of digital video inventory. On April 1, 2020 Telaria completed an all-stock merger of equals with Rubicon Project to form Magnite, now the largest independent sell-side advertising platform spanning CTV, desktop, and mobile. Telaria no longer operates as a standalone company: the telaria.com domain redirects to magnite.com, and the "Telaria" name survives publicly only as a Prebid.js header-bidding bidder adapter routed through Magnite. This profile documents the historical company; there is no independent public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDK, or documentation portal to harvest.

providers.name: Tempo Automation
providers.description: Tempo Automation is a San Francisco-based software-automated printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) manufacturer, founded in 2013 and formerly publicly traded on Nasdaq as TMPO. Its software-driven manufacturing platform was built to take complex electronics from design to physical prototype and new product introduction in as little as a few days, serving customers in aerospace, medical technology, semiconductor, industrial, and automotive. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Lux Capital and Uncork Capital. The company does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its current website is a single-page placeholder offering on-demand circuit board manufacturing through a contact form.

providers.name: Tennis Channel
providers.description: Tennis Channel is a United States-based cable television network and direct-to-consumer streaming service dedicated to tennis and racquet sports, including live coverage and highlights from the ATP Tour, WTA Tour, Grand Slam events, and related pickleball and padel programming. Alongside its linear TV channel it operates a subscription streaming product (Tennis Channel / formerly Tennis Channel Plus) delivering live matches, on-demand video, news, rankings, and instructional content across web, mobile, and connected-TV apps. It was surfaced as a portfolio-linked company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as of this pass Tennis Channel publishes a consumer streaming platform but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: The Boring Company
providers.description: The Boring Company is an American infrastructure and tunnel-construction company founded by Elon Musk in 2016 that designs and builds underground transportation, utility, and freight tunnels to reduce urban traffic congestion. Its Prufrock tunnel-boring machines dig low-cost tunnels roughly a mile a week, and its all-electric, zero-emissions Loop system carries passengers in Tesla vehicles through those tunnels — the Las Vegas Convention Center Loop is its first commercial deployment. The company publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs; its web presence is marketing, careers, Vegas Loop ticketing, and a merchandise store.

providers.name: The Icon League
providers.description: The Icon League is a five-a-side (small-sided) football entertainment league co-founded by former Real Madrid and Germany midfielder Toni Kroos and German streamer Elias Nerlich (Eliasn97), operated by The Icon League GmbH of Cologne, Germany (Amtsgericht Köln, HRB 117138). Played indoors in a US-style 14-team franchise format with two 12-minute halves and "Rulebreaker" mechanics designed to maximize attacking play, the league blends professional and amateur players and is distributed primarily through livestreams and social platforms to a young German-speaking audience. Season one generated more than 1.3 billion social-media impressions, and the league raised a €15M Series A (backed by HV Capital) to professionalize operations and expand across Europe. This is a consumer sports-and-media property; it publishes a public content website (teams, players, standings, matchdays, news, tickets, shop) but exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: The Michaels Companies
providers.description: The Michaels Companies is the largest arts and crafts specialty retailer in North America, providing materials, project ideas, and education for creative inspiration. This repository captures the APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts for The Michaels Companies.

providers.name: The Players' Tribune
providers.description: The Players' Tribune is a sports-media company that gives athletes a platform to connect directly with fans in their own words, publishing first-person stories, essays, letters, and video from professional players across football, basketball, soccer, baseball, and other sports. Founded in 2014 and backed by GV and IVP, it operates as a digital publisher rather than an API provider: an enrichment probe of theplayerstribune.com found a public sports-content website with no developer portal, documentation, or public API surface (no docs/api/developer subdomains, no /.well-known/ metadata, no llms.txt). This profile captures the company identity and the results of a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: The RealReal
providers.description: The RealReal is the world's largest online marketplace for authenticated, resale luxury goods, operating a managed consignment marketplace across women's and men's fashion, fine jewelry and watches, handbags, fine art, and home. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in San Francisco, the company employs in-house gemologists, horologists, art curators, and brand authenticators to verify every item, pairing that expertise with data-driven pricing and demand insights. The RealReal is a publicly traded company (NASDAQ: REAL) and has processed tens of millions of consigned items. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; as of this enrichment pass The RealReal publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Theres Camping
providers.description: Theres (데얼스, Theres Co., Ltd.) is a South Korean e-commerce marketplace for outdoor and camping gear, where customers buy both new and second-hand equipment in one place. The platform aggregates brands and vendors (Grape Box, Camping Khan, Ridge Mountain Gear, Matador, and others), offering product search, a shopping cart, deal notifications, a community section, and vendor/product listing tools. Based in Seoul (Seocho-gu), Theres is a portfolio company of 500 Global. The company publishes a consumer web/app storefront and does not currently expose a public developer API, documentation, or integration surface.

providers.name: Threadless ( Skinny CM Holdings)
providers.description: Threadless (operated by Skinny CM Holdings) is an online design community and print-on-demand apparel marketplace founded in 2000 in Chicago. Artists and designers submit artwork, the community scores and votes on submissions, and winning designs are printed on t-shirts, apparel, wall art, home goods, and accessories sold through the site. Threadless also runs Artist Shops, free hosted storefronts that let independent creators sell their designs on a print-on-demand basis without holding inventory. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; no public developer API surface was reachable during this pass (the storefront aggressively blocks automated access).

providers.name: Ticketmonster
providers.description: Ticketmonster (TMON) is a South Korean e-commerce and social-commerce platform founded in 2010 as "Ticket Monster." Operating primarily at tmon.co.kr (the legacy ticketmonster.co.kr brand), TMON sells deals, daily bargains, fashion, travel, and a broad retail catalog to Korean consumers via web and mobile apps. It grew into one of Korea's leading online marketplaces and was later brought under the Qoo10 group. TMON is a consumer-facing retail/marketplace business; it does not publish a public developer program, API portal, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or documented API surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-linked company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline, which confirmed the absence of any public API surface.

providers.name: Tidal Metals
providers.description: Tidal Metals is a deep-tech materials company that extracts decarbonized magnesium directly from seawater and desalination brine using only electricity from renewable sources, without mining, chemical additives, or brine waste. The company's patented process concentrates and extracts magnesium salt to address a critical supply-chain vulnerability: the United States currently produces no primary magnesium while China controls roughly 91% of global supply. Founded by Ph.D. physicists and engineers with backgrounds in nuclear engineering and plasma physics from MIT, Princeton, and Wisconsin-Madison, and backed by DCVC, Tidal Metals aims for carbon-neutral, domestically scalable magnesium production. Surfaced as a portfolio company of DCVC and added to the API Evangelist network; the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable surface at this time.

providers.name: TidalScale
providers.description: TidalScale built software-defined server technology that aggregated the CPU, memory, and I/O of multiple commodity servers into a single large virtual machine (an inverse hypervisor / software-defined memory approach), enabling in-memory computing for very large workloads without specialized hardware. The company was acquired by Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) in early 2022, and the tidalscale.com domain now redirects into HPE infrastructure (its TLS endpoint serves an HPE certificate). This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bain Capital Ventures and enriched via the API Evangelist pipeline; TidalScale exposes no independent public developer API surface today.

providers.name: Tidemark
providers.description: Tidemark is enterprise financial and operational planning software for continuous, extended, and driver-based planning. It provides scenario ("what-if") modeling, workflow and approvals, and real-time data integration across 140+ ERP and EPM systems for budgeting, forecasting, and strategic planning. Founded as a venture-backed cloud analytics and enterprise performance management (EPM) company and counted among the Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) portfolio, Tidemark was later acquired and is now offered as a product within the insightsoftware family. It has no publicly documented API, SDK, or developer portal; integration is delivered through pre-built ERP/EPM connectors rather than a public developer program.

providers.name: Tiebaobei
providers.description: Tiebaobei (铁甲二手机) is a used construction-machinery C2C trading platform operated by Beijing Tiejialong Technology Co., Ltd. (北京铁甲龙科技有限公司). Founded in 2009 out of the Tiebaobei (Cehome) construction-equipment forum, it lets individuals buy and sell used excavators, loaders, bulldozers, cranes, rotary drills and other heavy equipment, backed by a network of ~400 regional "city manager" brokers across 30 Chinese provinces who verify and co-inspect machines. The platform layers industry news, equipment inspection/detection, price rankings and financing services on top of the marketplace. It raised A financing from Qiming Venture Partners, a DCM-led Series B (¥100M, 2015) and a Yuansheng-led Series C (¥200M, 2016). This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public developer API or open platform was found.

providers.name: Tipp24
providers.description: Tipp24 is a German consumer online-lottery brand — a business-to-consumer service where players place bets on the outcomes of state and international lottery draws (secondary lottery / lottery brokerage) over the web and mobile apps. The brand is operated by ZEAL Network SE, a publicly listed company headquartered in Hamburg, Germany, whose email infrastructure (SPF/DMARC) still resolves to zealnetwork.de. Tipp24 is a regulated consumer gambling product; it exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs, and its web properties (tipp24.de, tipp24.com) sit behind Cloudflare bot protection. This profile originated as an Earlybird VC portfolio lead and was processed by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline, which confirmed the absence of an API surface and captured the domain security posture of the brand.

providers.name: To Summer
providers.description: To Summer (观夏 / Guanxia) is a Chinese premium home-fragrance and lifestyle brand founded in Beijing, known for its Eastern-inspired scented candles, incense, diffusers, perfumes, and bath and body products. Positioned as a direct-to-consumer scent brand, it sells primarily through its own website, WeChat mini-program, Tmall flagship store, and a growing footprint of physical concept stores across China. To Summer is backed by IDG Capital and was surfaced through the API Evangelist venture-portfolio pipeline. As a consumer retail brand it exposes a customer-facing e-commerce experience rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and the outcome of an enrichment probe that found no public API surface.

providers.name: Toolsvilla
providers.description: Toolsvilla is an India-based e-commerce marketplace for machinery, tools, and equipment, positioning itself as one of India's largest online stores for industrial, agricultural, and power tools serving small businesses, farmers, and trade buyers. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. No public developer API, documentation, or SDKs were found during this enrichment pass; the site's internal backend at api.toolsvilla.com is undocumented and returns a bare JSON response.

providers.name: TopXGun
providers.description: TopXGun (Nanjing TopXGun Robotics / 拓攻机器人) is a Chinese unmanned aerial vehicle manufacturer specializing in the research, development, and production of agricultural spray drones, heavy-lift delivery drones, industrial and cleaning drones, firefighting and emergency UAVs, tethered drones, eVTOL and large unmanned aircraft, and the professional flight-control and avionics hardware, payload equipment, and software systems that power them. Its whole-aircraft capability spans all airspace below 5,000 meters and payloads up to 1.5 tons across core industries, and it offers ODM/OEM customization and education support. Its overseas agricultural line is marketed as TopXGun Agriculture (topxgunag.com) with CE, FCC, RoHS, and KC certifications. Surfaced as a portfolio company of DCM Ventures. No public web API, SDK, or developer portal was found during enrichment; this is a hardware manufacturer.

providers.name: Tractor Supply
providers.description: Tractor Supply Company is the largest rural lifestyle retailer in the United States, providing products to support recreational farming, ranching, and country lifestyles. Tractor Supply integrates with suppliers and vendors via EDI and vendor portal systems, enabling order management, invoice processing, and shipment notifications. The company operates through its vendor transaction portal for supplier collaboration and EDI-based supply chain integrations.

providers.name: Treat.co
providers.description: Treat.co was a consumer gifting e-commerce startup surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead. As of this enrichment pass the treat.co domain is controlled by Mars, Incorporated: it resolves to an AWS Application Load Balancer presenting a certificate for alb-redirect.mars.com and returns HTTP 403 on every probed path (homepage, /.well-known/security.txt, /api, /developers), with no MX record for email. The company therefore exposes no public website, developer portal, documentation, or API surface today; it appears dormant or absorbed following acquisition. This profile records the domain-security probe and is retained as a network lead pending any revived or successor developer surface.

providers.name: Trendy Entertainment
providers.description: Trendy Entertainment was a Gainesville, Florida video game studio best known for the Dungeon Defenders tower-defense action-RPG franchise. Insight Venture Partners acquired the studio in 2012 for ~$18.2M and exited in 2019 when founder Augi Lye led an employee buyback and rebranded the company as Chromatic Games (chromatic.games). The only developer-facing surface the studio ever shipped is the Dungeon Defenders Development Kit — an Unreal Engine 3 game-mod SDK distributed as free Steam DLC — not a public web/HTTP API. Enrichment pass found no OpenAPI, REST API, developer portal, or client SDK registries: this is a games company with no programmable API surface, so most scored artifact types are N/A rather than missing.

providers.name: Tri Pointe Homes
providers.description: Tri Pointe Homes is one of the largest homebuilders in the United States, designing and constructing premium single-family detached and attached homes across multiple regional markets. The company also offers in-house mortgage, title, and insurance services through its Tri Pointe Connect affiliates. No public developer API or developer portal has been identified; the company engages homebuyers and broker partners through its consumer website and broker program.

providers.name: Trinity Industries
providers.description: Trinity Industries, Inc. is a leading manufacturer and lessor of railcars in North America, providing products and services to the industrial, energy, transportation, and construction sectors. The company designs, manufactures, leases, and manages railcars used to transport commodities such as energy products, agricultural goods, construction materials, and consumer staples. Trinity operates a lease fleet of over 140,000 owned and managed railcars through its TrinityRail division.

providers.name: Trion Worlds
providers.description: Trion Worlds was an American video game developer and MMO publisher founded in 2006 in Redwood City, California by Lars Buttler and Jon Van Caneghem, and backed early by Trinity Ventures among others. It developed and operated massively multiplayer titles including Rift, Defiance, Trove and Atlas Reactor, published ArcheAge in Western markets, and ran the Glyph game-distribution client. The company was acquired by German publisher Gamigo in October 2018 and disbanded shortly after; its games, the Glyph platform and the trionworlds.com domain are now operated by Gamigo. Trion Worlds never published a public developer API or developer program, so this network profile carries company identity and domain-security signals only. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Trinity Ventures.

providers.name: Trocafone
providers.description: Trocafone is a Brazilian e-commerce company specializing in refurbished and pre-owned smartphones and consumer electronics sold with warranty. Operating primarily in Brazil on the VTEX commerce platform, it runs a consumer marketplace for certified semi-new iPhones, Samsung, Motorola and other devices, a trade-in program ("Venda seu aparelho") that buys used devices from consumers, and a Reparofone device-repair service. Backed by 500 Global, the company is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: TruckLabs
providers.description: TruckLabs built TruckWings, an automated tractor-mounted aerodynamic device that closes the gap between the tractor and trailer to reduce aerodynamic drag, cutting fuel consumption by a proven 3-6% and eliminating roughly 7-10 metric tons of CO2 per truck each year with an 18-24 month payback. The device deploys automatically at highway speed and retracts below it, reduces buffeting and trailer sway in crosswinds, and installs on both new builds and retrofits in about two hours. TruckLabs was acquired by ConMet, and trucklabs.com now redirects to the ConMet TruckWings product line. As a hardware fuel-efficiency company, TruckLabs exposes no public developer API, SDK, or well-known discovery surface; this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture. Backed by Uncork Capital.

providers.name: Truffle
providers.description: Truffle is an AI-native restaurant operating system building "the autonomous back of house for restaurants" — one platform to manage an entire restaurant operation more profitably. The company, a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) portfolio company operating at usetruffle.ai, positions its product as an autonomous back-of-house layer that unifies the operational and administrative work that normally sprawls across separate tools. As of this profile Truffle is a very early-stage company presenting a single marketing landing page; it publishes no public API, developer documentation, SDKs, CLI, or other machine-readable developer surface, so this API Evangelist profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture and will be re-enriched as a developer surface emerges.

providers.name: Trussle
providers.description: Trussle was a UK online mortgage broker founded in 2015 and backed by Seedcamp, offering a consumer-facing mortgage comparison, application and monitoring service. It was acquired and rebranded as Better.co.uk (trading as Trussle Lab Ltd, authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority); the trussle.com domain now 301-redirects entirely to better.co.uk. As of this enrichment pass Trussle publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or API documentation.

providers.name: TSM
providers.description: TSM (Team SoloMid) is a North American esports and gaming lifestyle organization, surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners in the consumer sector. Its public web presence at tsm.gg redirects to the official TSM Store (tsmshop.com), a Shopify-hosted storefront selling TSM apparel and accessories. An enrichment pass on 2026-07-21 found no first-party developer API surface: no developer portal, no API documentation, no OpenAPI, no resolving developer/api/docs subdomains, and no real /.well-known/ discovery documents (every probed path returned the storefront catch-all page). This profile is retained as a consumer-brand lead with only domain-security signals captured.

providers.name: Tujia
providers.description: Tujia (途家) is a Chinese online marketplace for short-term rentals, vacation homes, and homestays, frequently described as "China's Airbnb." Founded in 2011 and headquartered in Beijing, the company connects travelers with apartments, villas, and serviced homes across China and select international destinations through its website, mobile apps, and WeChat mini-program. Tujia runs a consumer-facing booking marketplace and property-management services rather than a public developer platform. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; the enrichment pipeline probed the domain and found no public API, developer portal, or open platform for the company.

providers.name: Tule Technologies
providers.description: Tule Technologies was an agricultural technology company that measured crop water stress and actual evapotranspiration (ET) directly in the field, giving growers irrigation guidance through its FieldStat monitoring tool for orchards, vineyards, and row crops. Backed by Bloomberg Beta, Tule has been acquired by and integrated into CropX; the tuletechnologies.com domain now 301-redirects to cropx.com, where Tule's ET monitoring is combined with soil sensing, weather data, and irrigation management in one platform. Enrichment found no independent public API, developer portal, SDK, or documented developer program for Tule Technologies.

providers.name: Tundra
providers.description: Tundra is a business-to-business wholesale marketplace that connects independent retailers with brands and suppliers, letting shop owners discover, source, and order wholesale products across categories online. Backed by Redpoint Ventures, the company operates in the ecommerce sector. As of this enrichment pass Tundra exposes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface: live probes of tundra.com found no developer/api/docs subdomains and no /.well-known discovery documents, and the public www.tundra.com storefront was reachable but served an expired TLS certificate.

providers.name: Tutor Perini
providers.description: Tutor Perini Corporation is a leading civil, building, and specialty construction company offering diversified general contracting, construction management, and design-build services to private and public customers worldwide. The company operates three segments: Civil, Building, and Specialty Contractors, serving transportation, water, power, and government markets. Tutor Perini does not publicly expose developer APIs.

providers.name: TVTY
providers.description: TVTY is an advertising technology company that bridges television and digital advertising through its Moment Marketing platform. Its TV Ad Alert technology detects when a brand or competitor TV spot airs and synchronizes digital media campaigns — search, social, display and marketplace advertising — to those moments so advertisers reach audiences at the point of highest attention. TVTY was a Partech portfolio company serving global brands and media agencies. The company, headquartered in Paris, was acquired by Nielsen in July 2021 and folded into Nielsen's TV attribution and ad intelligence business; the tvty.tv site stopped serving after mid-2023 and the host no longer responds, so TVTY has no independent developer surface today.

providers.name: TXN
providers.description: TXN (TXN Solutions, Inc.) was a San Francisco consumer spending analytics company that captured transactions directly from the credit and debit cards of an opt-in research panel, layering demographics and targeted surveys on top to give merchants competitive intelligence and share-of-wallet insight. Founded by Alex Rampell, Pasha Bitz, and Jonathan Wolf and backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Bloomberg Beta, General Catalyst, Homebrew, SV Angel, and Slow Ventures, it is listed as exited in the Bloomberg Beta portfolio. As of July 2026 txn.com serves only a parked "Launching Soon" page on an Alibaba Cloud host with a self-signed TLS certificate — no product, developer, or API surface remains.

providers.name: TxVia (Google)
providers.description: TxVia was a New York-based payments technology company that provided an issuer-processing platform for prepaid and other emerging payment card programs, reported at the time of its exit to power programs covering roughly 100 million accounts. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures, TxVia was acquired by Google on April 2, 2012 and its technology and team were folded into Google Wallet (now Google Pay). The company no longer operates independently: txvia.com today serves a Google-hosted acquisition notice, and there is no public developer program, API surface, GitHub organization, or published packages. This profile is retained as an acquired-company lead in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Ursa Space Systems
providers.description: Ursa Space Systems is an Ithaca, New York-based geospatial intelligence company that turns commercial satellite data — primarily Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery, combined with electro-optical, RF, AIS, and other ground-truth feeds — into decision-ready insight reports. The company operates a GeoAI platform branded "From pixels to insights" that fuses 90+ geospatial data sources and ingests imagery from a global network of commercial SAR and EO satellite operators, then applies in-house remote-sensing, data science, and GIS expertise to deliver answers about what is happening on the ground at specific places and times. Ursa Space serves U.S. Government customers — including U.S. Space Force Space Systems Command (SSC) under INDOPACOM, AFRICOM, and SOUTHCOM, the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA) under the Luno A and Luno B delivery orders, the Defense Innovation Unit (DIU), and humanitarian-aid agencies — as well as commercial enterprise customers in energy, commodities, supply chain, maritime, and insurance. Reporting domains span security and defense (border monitoring, military activity, maritime, dark-vessel and ship-to-ship transfer detection, airstrip monitoring), environmental and disaster response (deforestation, earthquakes, flooding, wildfires), and infrastructure and industry monitoring (construction, mining, oil and gas supply chain, power generation, space situational awareness). The platform is currently in beta and Ursa Space does not operate a public developer portal, OpenAPI reference, SDK, or self-service signup; engagement is sales-led through contact@ursaspace.com and tailored to government and enterprise contracts.

providers.name: VacayHero
providers.description: VacayHero (branded VaycayHero) was a vacation rental marketplace backed by a16z that offered professionally managed vacation rental homes with hotel-style guest service. The brand was absorbed by RedAwning: vacayhero.com now permanently redirects (301) to RedAwning's VaycayHero brand page, which folds the VaycayHero properties into RedAwning's collection of 100,000+ instantly bookable vacation rentals in over 10,000 destinations. VacayHero no longer operates an independent website, developer program, or public API surface.

providers.name: Vancity
providers.description: Vancity (Vancouver City Savings Credit Union) is a member-owned financial co-operative headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia, and the largest community credit union in Canada, with over 543,000 members, roughly CA$35 billion in assets, and about 60 branches across the Lower Mainland and Vancouver Island. Founded in 1946 as an open-bond credit union, it is provincially chartered and cooperatively governed, offering retail and business banking, mortgages, foreign exchange, Visa cards, insurance, and investment advice, with values-based and impact-lending positioning. Vancity exposes no first-party public developer API portal: developer.vancity.com and developers.vancity.com do not resolve. It participates in Canada's shared payment rails through Central 1 (its banking-technology and payments provider, including enhanced Interac e-Transfer real-time payments) and Payments Canada, while third-party consumer data access is provided through aggregators such as Plaid and Flinks. Canada's federal Consumer-Driven Banking (open banking) framework is legislated but not yet operational, so any programmatic account access today is voluntary and aggregator-mediated rather than served by a documented Vancity API.

providers.name: Vantis Vascular
providers.description: Vantis Vascular, Inc. is a San Jose, California medical device company founded by interventional cardiologists to build performance-driven tools for complex vascular interventions. Its flagship CrossFAST Integrated Microcatheter Guide Extension System — a dual-monorail advanced delivery system cleared by the FDA under 510(k) and in commercial use since 2025 — is designed to improve deliverability and control in complex, calcified coronary and peripheral anatomy, and a CrossSHOCK intravascular lithotripsy (IVL) system is in development. The company has raised roughly $30M across seed and Series B rounds. It builds and sells physical single-use interventional devices to hospitals and interventionalists; it is not a software vendor and publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Veniam
providers.description: Veniam builds intelligent networking software for the Internet of Moving Things, moving data automatically, securely, and cost-effectively between connected vehicles, mobile IoT devices, and the cloud across all available networks (cellular, Wi-Fi, and DSRC). Its platform serves video telematics, connected fleets, industrial IoT, and auto OEM/Tier 1 use cases, and reports processing 110M+ kilometers of mobile IoT data with 130+ granted patents. Founded by Joao Barros, Susana Sargento, Robin Chase, and Roy Russell, the company was acquired by Nexar in 2022. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Union Square Ventures. No public developer portal, API documentation, or OpenAPI surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: VerAI
providers.description: VerAI Discoveries is an AI-driven mineral discovery company founded in 2020 and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. Its proprietary AI/ML Discovery Platform searches magnetic, gravimetric, electromagnetic, and seismic geophysical datasets to detect concealed mineral deposits in underexplored covered terrain, generating drill-ready targets across a portfolio of more than sixty mineral projects and royalties in North and South America. VerAI partners with explorers and investors to develop critical-mineral assets essential to the green-energy transition. The company is backed by Insight Partners, Blumberg Capital, Chrysalix Venture Capital, and Orion Industrial Ventures, and to date exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Veriti.ai
providers.description: Veriti Cybersecurity is a Preemptive Exposure Management (PEM) platform founded in 2021 that continuously discovers, prioritizes, and remediates vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and exploitability risk across an organization's multi-vendor security stack, on-premises and in the cloud. Its AI-driven engine analyzes each environment's exposures, configurations, and existing protections to apply safe controls and automated (including virtual) patching without disrupting business, with integrations spanning 70+ security vendors. Originally an Insight Partners portfolio company, Veriti was acquired by Check Point (agreement announced May 2025); its capabilities are being folded into the Check Point Infinity Platform's Threat Exposure and Risk Management offering, and veriti.ai now redirects to checkpoint.com/exposure-management. Veriti is delivered as an enterprise security platform and does not publish a public self-serve developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; this profile therefore carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: VeriTX
providers.description: VeriTX Corp. is a veteran-owned blockchain and cybersecurity firm based in East Aurora, New York that builds trusted, tamper-evident data and supply-chain infrastructure originally developed for the U.S. Air Force under SBIR, STTR, and Defense Production Act programs. Its flagship product, QuDEFENSE, is a data-security platform that combines post-quantum cryptography with blockchain to protect sensitive files in transit and at rest, providing real-time manipulation detection, automatic quarantine of tampered data, immutable audit trails, and end-to-end data provenance. VeriTX began as a blockchain-powered digital marketplace for aerospace additive manufacturing (3D-printed aircraft parts) built on Algorand, and has since focused on secure data transfer and provenance for defense, aerospace, medical, and industrial customers. QuDEFENSE is offered as an API, an Outlook plugin, and a standalone web interface, though VeriTX does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or API reference documentation.

providers.name: Vero Software
providers.description: Vero Software is a developer of CAD/CAM software for manufacturing, headquartered in the United Kingdom and part of Hexagon's Manufacturing Intelligence division (Production Software). Its portfolio spans computer-aided manufacturing across metalworking, sheet metal, stone, and woodworking, with long-established desktop applications such as Alphacam, Cabinet Vision, Edgecam, Radan, SURFCAM, VISI, WorkNC, WorkXplore, Machining STRATEGIST, and PEPS. These are primarily installed engineering and CNC programming products rather than web services; as of this enrichment pass the company does not publish a public web API, developer portal, or SDK, and the verosoftware.com domain now redirects to Hexagon Manufacturing Intelligence marketing. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Verodin
providers.description: Verodin was a cybersecurity company that pioneered security instrumentation and validation — its Security Instrumentation Platform (SIP) continuously measured, tested, and improved the effectiveness of an organization's security controls against real attacker behavior (a category later known as breach and attack simulation). Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and TenEleven Ventures, Verodin was acquired by FireEye in May 2019 for approximately $250 million and rebranded as Mandiant Security Validation. The verodin.com domain still resolves (serving a legacy marketing placeholder) but Verodin no longer operates as an independent company and exposes no public developer or API surface. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a historical portfolio-lead record.

providers.name: Vibely
providers.description: Vibely was a creator-community platform (surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company) that let creators host paid communities, challenges, and group chat. As of this enrichment pass the domain vibely.io no longer serves an independent product; every path — including all /.well-known/ discovery endpoints — 301-redirects to kajabi.com/features/communities, indicating Vibely was folded into Kajabi's Communities product. No standalone Vibely developer portal, API, OpenAPI, SDK, MCP server, or llms.txt could be found; the only artifact captured is a probed TLS/DNS domain-security profile of the surviving redirect domain. This profile is retained as a defunct/acquired portfolio lead.

providers.name: VICI Properties
providers.description: VICI Properties is an experiential real estate investment trust (REIT) that owns one of the largest portfolios of gaming, hospitality, and entertainment destinations in the United States, including Caesars Palace and the Venetian Resort Las Vegas. The company holds long-term triple-net leases with leading gaming operators. No public developer API or developer portal has been identified; VICI engages investors and partners through corporate and investor relations channels.

providers.name: Vimaan
providers.description: Vimaan is an autonomous inventory intelligence company that combines computer vision, machine learning, and autonomous drones and robotics to verify, count, and audit inventory across warehouses, distribution centers, and supply-chain operations. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of wing-venture-capital and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Vimaan publishes no public developer, API, SDK, or documentation surface: the corporate website (vimaan.ai) sits entirely behind an sgcaptcha challenge wall and no developer, docs, or api subdomains resolve. This profile therefore captures verified company identity and domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Virgio
providers.description: Virgio is an India-based direct-to-consumer sustainable fashion brand delivering trend-driven, eco-conscious womens apparel built around circular fashion, recycled and natural fabrics (recycled polyester, organic cotton, viscose, modal, lyocell), ethical production, and zero-waste packaging. It operates as an online-first retail marketplace with a consumer web storefront and mobile app. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and Prosus Ventures; an enrichment probe found a consumer e-commerce presence but no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: ViridiCO2
providers.description: ViridiCO2 is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of eqt-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: sustainability. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Vision Space
providers.description: Vision Space Inc. (VisionSpace) is a South Korean company building Physical AI robot simulation software for automation in the logistics and manufacturing sectors. Its TESSERACT product implements logistics and manufacturing sites as digital twins, visualizing process data and predicting operational efficiency through AI-based simulation, while its TARS product delivers real-time 3D monitoring that integrates and manages data from equipment and robots in a unified 3D control dashboard. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass VisionSpace publishes a marketing website only and exposes no public developer API, documentation, developer portal, or GitHub organization.

providers.name: Vita Therapeutics
providers.description: Vita Therapeutics is a Baltimore, Maryland cell engineering company, spun out of Johns Hopkins University in 2019 and formally founded in 2020, that develops induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) derived cellular therapies for neuromuscular disease and solid tumors. Its programs pair an autologous approach with an allogeneic, universal hypoimmunogenic approach, and include VTA-100 and VTA-110 for limb-girdle muscular dystrophy and related muscular dystrophies such as FSHD. The company raised a $31M Series B led by Cambrian BioPharma and Solve FSHD and operates from the University of Maryland BioPark. It is a clinical-stage biotechnology company: it sells no software, runs no developer program, and publishes no public API, SDK, webhook or machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Vontier
providers.description: Vontier is a global mobility technology company serving convenience stores, fleet operators, and auto repair shops. Its portfolio spans traditional fueling, alternative energy (EV, CNG, RNG), repair tools, and car-wash technology through brands including Gilbarco, DRB, Driivz, Matco Tools, Teletrac Navman, ANGI Energy, and Invenco.

providers.name: Walzay
providers.description: Walzay Inc. is a global tech-talent recruitment marketplace, founded in 2019 by Humaira Khan and headquartered in New York City. The platform connects companies with vetted remote and in-office software, engineering, and sales professionals — largely sourced from the Middle East and other emerging markets — and offers white-glove recruiting alongside a self-serve candidate marketplace. Walzay is backed by 500 Global and the Sanabil 500 MENA Seed Accelerator. No public API or developer surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Wave
providers.description: Wave is a virtual entertainment company that produces interactive, avatar-driven virtual concerts and immersive live music experiences known as "Waves." The platform streams stylized, real-time performances from major recording artists — including The Weeknd, Justin Bieber, John Legend, J Balvin, and Alison Wonderland — as animated avatars across VR headsets, desktop, mobile, and social video platforms, letting fans attend and interact with shows from anywhere. Wave is a consumer-facing entertainment and media product (accessed at wavexr.com) rather than a developer platform; as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or technical documentation. It was surfaced as a venture-portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network, where this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Wave Capital
providers.description: Wave Capital is an early-stage venture capital seed fund based in San Francisco, founded in 2017 and run as a lean two-partner firm with no additional staff. The fund specializes in marketplace startups and was conceived as the "Airbnb mafia" fund, backing pre-Series-A founders drawn from the Airbnb, Dropbox, and Facebook alumni networks. Wave leads a highly selective portfolio, making no more than four investments per year (typically around $1M) and supporting founders with operating experience beyond capital. It publishes no developer API, documentation, or developer portal — it is a private investment firm, catalogued in the API Evangelist network as a company/VC profile surfaced via foundry-group's portfolio.

providers.name: WaystoCap
providers.description: WaystoCap launched in 2015 in Casablanca, Morocco as a Y Combinator-backed B2B digital marketplace to facilitate cross-border trade across Africa, helping traders source commodities, arrange financing, and secure shipment and payments. The waystocap.com domain now hosts WaysToCap Ventures, a fintech advisory and consulting firm offering strategic and investment advisory, fund raising, innovation consulting, and AI integration. No public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface is published; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and Battery Ventures.

providers.name: WeDidIt
providers.description: WeDidIt was a Brooklyn, New York fundraising platform founded in 2012 by Su Sanni and Benjamin Lamson that gave small nonprofits online donation pages, crowdfunding, peer-to-peer, ticketing, and fiscal-sponsorship tools, plus a mobile app for in-person card donations. A 500 Global portfolio company and 43North winner, it was acquired by Allegiance Fundraising Group in June 2019 and its product folded into the Allegiance suite. No public developer API was ever documented, and the wedid.it domain has since lapsed to an unrelated site, so no API surface remains to profile.

providers.name: Weeby
providers.description: Weeby is a mobile/social game company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead for enrichment. Its listed website, gameclosure.com, now redirects to Playco ("the Game Closure team is now a part of Playco"), and no public API, developer documentation, SDK, or MCP surface could be found for Weeby as of July 2026. The profile is retained as a portfolio-graph node with a probed domain-security artifact rather than an active API producer.

providers.name: WeGrow asia
providers.description: WeGrow asia CO., LTD. (威果) is a Taiwan-based agricultural technology company operating a franchise model for modern, technology-driven farming. It pairs 24-hour AI-assisted remote crop management with a transparent farmer profit-sharing model, specializing in high-value strawberries and cantaloupes while handling production, labor management, marketing, and logistics end to end ("you provide the land, we provide the labor and expertise"). WeGrow surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass it publishes a bilingual (TW/EN) marketing website only and exposes no public API, developer portal, documentation, or /.well-known discovery surface — every probed developer and well-known path returned HTTP 404.

providers.name: Wetpaint
providers.description: Wetpaint is a media brand operating wetpaint.com, an entertainment and lifestyle publication covering Hollywood gossip, celebrity news, TV series recaps and buzz, and pop-culture storytelling. Originally a Trinity Ventures-backed wiki/collaborative-media startup, the property today runs as an ad- and affiliate-supported editorial content site with no public developer program: as of this enrichment pass it exposes no documented API, developer portal, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a media-sector company record.

providers.name: Wevorce
providers.description: Wevorce is an online divorce and family-law technology company that offered self-guided and professionally supported divorce services, using guided workflows and document preparation to help couples navigate separation more amicably and affordably. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global, a16z, and Y Combinator and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. No public API, developer documentation, SDK, or machine-readable interface could be located during enrichment; the primary web property is served behind Cloudflare and blocks automated access.

providers.name: whatiseven
providers.description: whatiseven (Even, formerly Even Responsible Finance) was an earned-wage-access and personal-finance fintech that let workers access a portion of their pay before payday, budget with "okay to spend" guidance, and automatically save. Backed by Slow Ventures, Even was acquired by One (Walmart's fintech venture, now OnePay) and folded into the OnePay @Work earned-wage-access product ("Instapay"). The whatiseven.com domain now redirects through even.com to onepay.com/atwork. Even operates no independent public developer platform, API, or documentation, and the acquirer OnePay publishes no public API surface either. This profile is retained as a network record of the company and its acquisition.

providers.name: Wikidocs
providers.description: Wikidocs was a real-time collaboration startup (wikidocs.io) that built a framework for turning any web page into a live, editable, multi-user "docs" service — enabling real-time content creation, editing, and sharing directly in the browser without waiting for updated versions. Backed by Speedinvest, the company was acquired by Atlassian in September 2014 and its collaboration technology was folded into Atlassian's products. Wikidocs no longer operates as an independent product: its former domain, wikidocs.io, is now a parked and email-forwarded registrar domain with no live developer portal, API, documentation, or machine-readable surface to enrich.

providers.name: Win-Win
providers.description: Win-Win (trywinwin.com) is a charitable-fundraising platform that gamifies giving. Participants compete in tournaments hosted by celebrities and influencers, predicting head-to-head matchup outcomes and making tax-deductible donations to charitable causes while climbing leaderboards to win prizes and experiences. Win-Win also offers B2B tooling for nonprofits and corporations to launch their own gamified fundraising campaigns, alongside a consumer mobile app. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. No public API or developer surface is currently published.

providers.name: WizzPass
providers.description: WizzPass is a visitor and workplace access management platform, surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead for enrichment. At the time of this enrichment pass the company's public web presence at wizzpass.com is dormant behind Cloudflare (HTTP 409 / error 1001) and refuses TLS handshakes, so no live developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, or API surface could be reached. Email infrastructure is active (AWS SES inbound in eu-west-1, SPF authorizing Amazon SES and TeamSupport), indicating an operating SaaS organization even though the site itself is not currently serving. This profile records the honest probed state and awaits a future pass once the web/API surface is reachable.

providers.name: Wonder
providers.description: Wonder is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of accel, bain-capital-ventures, bloomberg-beta, bullpen-capital, forerunner-ventures, general-catalyst, gv and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: consumer. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Wonder Brands
providers.description: Wonder Brands is a Latin American digital-first e-commerce company that builds and operates a portfolio of 15+ consumer product brands (including AlebriPets, Tropical Heal, Somos Reyes, Kingsman, KingsHouse, and KingsPort) spanning mattresses and bedroom furniture, sports equipment, home appliances, travel gear, tools, home and garden furniture, pet and baby products, and personal care. Operating an online-first omnichannel model across Uruguay, Mexico, Colombia, and Chile, it fulfills over 2 million annual orders from 25,000+ square meters of warehouse space, backed by proprietary technology for product optimization, marketing, pricing, and demand forecasting. Backed by QED Investors. The company exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Wonderbly *
providers.description: Wonderbly is an online publisher that makes personalized books and gifts for kids and adults. Founded in 2013 (originally as Lost My Name), it lets customers design and buy books customized with a recipient's name, themes, and occasion, and has delighted over 10 million readers worldwide. The consumer e-commerce site operates across 40+ language and regional storefronts (US, UK, AU, CA, DE, FR, NL, IT, ES). Backed by GV. No public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation was found during enrichment; this remains a company profile lead in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: X1
providers.description: X1 was a San Francisco fintech behind the X1 Card, a smart Visa credit card that set limits based on income rather than credit score, backed by Craft Ventures.
