Spun out of the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), the company applies protein-stabilization and structure-based antigen design to create thermotolerant COVID-19 and influenza vaccine candidates aimed at affordable distribution in low- and lower-middle-income countries without deep cold-chain requirements. Mynvax is a life-sciences research company and does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation portal, or technical integration surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and is maintained in the API Evangelist network for discovery.

providers.name: National General Holdings
providers.description: National General Holdings was a specialty personal lines insurer offering auto, RV, motorcycle, homeowners, and accident & health coverage. Acquired by Allstate in January 2021 for approximately $4 billion and folded into Allstate as the "National General, an Allstate company" brand. No standalone developer program, public APIs, or technical portal exists; the corporate domain redirects to nationalgeneral.com which is now an Allstate-operated consumer site.

providers.name: National Telecommunications and Information Administration
providers.description: The National Telecommunications and Information Administration (NTIA) is an agency of the U.S. Department of Commerce that serves as the executive branch principal advisor on telecommunications and information policy issues.

providers.name: Netwerken
providers.description: Netwerken (Dutch for "networks") is an index entry covering the broad domain of computer networks, network management, and network connectivity services. This serves as a placeholder index for grouping APIs related to network management, monitoring, and infrastructure connectivity.

providers.name: Nimble AppGenie
providers.description: Nimble AppGenie is a fintech- and AI-focused custom software development agency based in London, UK, offering mobile app, web, and software development services worldwide. It exposes no conventional API; the only publicly reachable agent-native artifact is a marketing/SEO llms.txt file.

providers.name: OCRA
providers.description: OCRA (OATH Challenge-Response Algorithm) is a standard for generating one-time passwords based on challenge-response authentication as defined in RFC 6287. It extends HOTP and TOTP with challenge-response capabilities for stronger authentication scenarios.

providers.name: Ohio National
providers.description: Ohio National Financial Services was a Cincinnati-based mutual life insurance and annuities provider, historically operating through Ohio National Mutual Holdings, Inc. (ONMH). In March 2021 Constellation Insurance Holdings announced a sponsored demutualization of ONMH and Ohio National Financial Services for total consideration of approximately US$1 billion, including member consideration and new capital. The transaction closed on March 31, 2022, after a member vote on March 11, 2022, converting ONMH to a stock company renamed Ohio National Holdings, Inc. On July 17, 2023 Constellation repositioned and rebranded Ohio National's life insurance business as AuguStar Life, with the Ohio National Life Insurance Company and Ohio National Life Assurance Corporation expected to change their names to AuguStar Life Insurance Company and AuguStar Life Assurance Corporation in Q4 2023. Constellation Insurance is owned by long-term institutional investors CDPQ (Caisse de dépôt et placement du Québec) and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, and Constellation's family of insurance companies collectively held over US$34 billion in assets under management as of December 31, 2022. The product surface remains traditional life insurance, indexed life, and annuities distributed through agents and independent marketing organizations; no public developer APIs or OpenAPI specs are published.

providers.name: Outfit Labs
providers.description: Outfit Labs provides a platform for personalized product recommendations, leveraging data-driven algorithms to tailor suggestions to individual users. Their services aim to enhance e-commerce experiences by delivering the world’s most personal recommendations, as highlighted on their homepage. Outfit Labs is based in Chicago, Illinois, and focuses on integrating recommendation technology into various retail solutions.

providers.name: Pacific Life
providers.description: Pacific Life is a U.S.-based insurance company providing life insurance, annuities, mutual funds, and investment products and services to individuals, businesses, and pension plans. No public APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: Poppins Health
providers.description: Poppins Health is a health insurance provider offering a modern health plan built for small businesses. Headquartered in Ohio, the company focuses on affordability, transparent coverage, and a better member experience for small business owners and their employees. Poppins Health is a portfolio company of the venture firm Anthemis. As of this profile, Poppins Health publishes a public marketing website but does not expose a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation surface for third-party integration.

providers.name: Post Holdings
providers.description: Post Holdings is a consumer packaged goods holding company with businesses in center-of-the-store, refrigerated, foodservice, food ingredient, and convenient nutrition product categories, with a brand portfolio that includes Post Consumer Brands, Bob Evans, Weetabix, and Michael Foods.

providers.name: Precidian Investments
providers.description: Precidian Investments is an industry leader in the creation of innovative financial products, specializing in exchange-traded fund (ETF) and mutual fund development. The firm is best known for ActiveShares, its patented non-transparent actively managed ETF structure, and licenses its proprietary processes, technologies, and structures to financial institutions or acts as sponsor for products. Its expertise spans product development, trading, clearance, sales, technology, and securities law. Precidian operates as a business-to-business partner to asset managers and ETF providers and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Protective Life
providers.description: Protective Life Corporation is a U.S.-based financial services holding company offering life insurance, annuities, and asset protection products through its subsidiaries. This repository tracks any APIs, SDKs, and developer-facing resources associated with Protective Life and its product lines.

providers.name: Pulte
providers.description: Pulte Homes is a national homebuilder brand operated by PulteGroup, one of America's largest homebuilding companies. No public developer APIs have been identified for the consumer-facing Pulte brand at this time; this index tracks the brand's web properties and developer-relevant resources.

providers.name: Raincoat
providers.description: Raincoat builds embedded, highly scalable parametric climate insurance products and the automated infrastructure that powers them. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Juan, Puerto Rico, the company combines real-time environmental and geospatial data with parametric risk models to automatically trigger coverage and deliver instant, direct payouts to beneficiaries after natural disasters such as hurricanes, earthquakes, floods and excess rainfall. Raincoat operates as B2B2C infrastructure, connecting insurers, reinsurers and distribution partners so they can offer embedded disaster protection across Latin America, the Caribbean, the United States and other climate-exposed markets. The company is backed by Anthemis and Two Sigma Ventures. Raincoat publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation at this time; integration is handled directly through partnership.

providers.name: Renegade Insurance
providers.description: Renegade Insurance is a property and casualty (P&C) insurance company built around independent agents. It runs an agency franchise network, acquires agencies and books of business, and manages books for agents who retain ownership, pairing a consumer shop-and-compare experience for home, auto, flood, cyber, commercial property and liability coverage with an internal agent platform for quoting, client tracking and reporting. Franchise agents work on Salesforce alongside Renegade's own in-house tooling. The company was founded in 2018, is privately held, and its shares trade on secondary marketplaces. No public developer program, developer portal, or machine-readable API contract was found on any Renegade Insurance host.

providers.name: RSI Video Technologies
providers.description: RSI Video Technologies was a St. Paul, Minnesota maker of wireless, battery-powered intrusion detection devices with built-in cameras, sold worldwide under the Videofied brand, together with the Frontel receiver software that delivered alarm events and short video clips to professional central monitoring stations. Honeywell acquired the company for approximately USD 123 million in March 2016, and the Videofied product line moved to Resideo Technologies when Honeywell spun out its Homes business in 2018. RSI Video Technologies no longer operates as an independent company: its own domains either do not resolve or redirect into Resideo and Honeywell Home marketing pages, and it publishes no developer program, documentation or machine-readable API contract of its own. Any current developer surface for Videofied hardware belongs to Resideo and is profiled separately in the API Evangelist network as resideo-technologies.

providers.name: Ruby Money
providers.description: Ruby Money is a mobile accounting and tax management app designed for freelancers and independent contractors. The platform automates tax set‑asides, tracks income and expenses, and helps self‑employed workers stay organized and compliant. Backed by Leadout Capital, it has raised $2.0M and serves the United States fintech market.

providers.name: SageLink
providers.description: SageLink provides rig support and excavation services, originating from Unique Oilfield Technology Services (UNOTEC) and rebranded in 2008. It offers health and safety, equipment services, and consulting for trackhoe drilling operations, emphasizing safety, efficiency, and innovative sumpless drilling solutions.

providers.name: ScoreData
providers.description: ScoreData Corporation is a Palo Alto based predictive-analytics and AI/ML platform company founded in 2014 by Danny Yang, Vas Bhandarkar, Mudit Chandra and Prasanta Behera. Its flagship ScoreFast platform, paired with iMaaS (intelligent Models as a Service), lets cross-functional AI teams develop, deploy, monitor, manage and govern machine-learning models in production across Banking, Insurance and Healthcare. ScoreFast uses patented dynamic machine learning that learns continuously, removing the need to manually regenerate predictive models, and its applications can be deployed across in-store, mobile, web, kiosk, chatbot and cloud contact-center touchpoints. ScoreData is backed by 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead company awaiting a public developer/API surface.

providers.name: Secure-By-Design
providers.description: A software development approach that prioritizes security from the initial design phase through implementation, ensuring security considerations are built into the foundation of systems rather than added as an afterthought. It is widely adopted across industries to safeguard digital assets and reduce security risks.

providers.name: simplifile
providers.description: Simplifile is a real estate document collaboration and electronic recording (e-recording) network that connects settlement agents, lenders, and county recording offices to submit, track, and record property documents electronically. Its platform also covers post-closing collaboration, lien release, and trailing-document management for the mortgage and title industry. Simplifile is part of ICE Mortgage Technology (Intercontinental Exchange). This profile was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio lead and enriched via live domain and endpoint probing; no public developer API surface was found.

providers.name: SINAI Technologies
providers.description: SINAI Technologies is a San Francisco–headquartered enterprise SaaS company providing a Decarbonization Intelligence platform for carbon management, sustainability planning, and ESG compliance. The platform unifies organization-wide emissions accounting, climate transition planning, climate financial planning, and execution management so industrial enterprises can measure, report, and reduce Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions using science-based methodologies. Core modules include Carbon Accounting & Reporting, the Climate Transition Planner (with marginal abatement cost curves and scenario modeling), the Climate Financial Planner, and Execution & Management for tracking decarbonization projects. SINAI's Decarbonization Intelligence Portal layers Tableau-based dashboards, AI-powered bulk data ingestion, and AI Emissions Match (which maps unstructured emissions data to emission factors) on top of the underlying carbon ledger. The platform is designed around major reporting frameworks including CDP, TCFD, SEC climate disclosure, CSRD, CBAM, California SB 253 / SB 261, Brazil SBCE, and Brazil CVM resolutions 217 and 218, and is SOC 2 compliant with TÜV SÜD ISO 14064 verification. Customers include Siemens Energy, ArcelorMittal, Harley-Davidson, Emirates, Natura &Co, Minerva Foods, Wilson Sons, BRK Ambiental, and Japan's largest bank MUFG. SINAI states publicly that it can connect to enterprise customer systems through APIs to automate roughly 70% of emissions data ingestion, but it does not publish a developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, public API reference, or a GitHub organization — its API surface is delivered as a private integration capability negotiated with enterprise customers rather than a self-serve developer product.

providers.name: Sonantic
providers.description: Sonantic was a London-based AI voice company that built hyper-realistic, emotionally expressive text-to-speech models for entertainment, gaming, and film. The company is best known for recreating Val Kilmer's voice for Top Gun: Maverick after he lost his speaking voice to throat cancer. Spotify acquired Sonantic in June 2022 for a reported 93 million euros, and the underlying TTS technology has since been folded into Spotify products, most visibly the Spotify AI DJ feature launched in 2023. As of 2026, Sonantic no longer operates as a standalone product or public API. This apis.yml entry exists as a historical and archival record of the company, its technology, and its acquisition.

providers.name: Stable
providers.description: Stable is an insurtech company that provides price risk management and price insurance for agricultural and food commodities, helping farmers, food producers, buyers, and businesses hedge against the volatility of commodity prices. Backed by Anthemis and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub, Stable operates a price-stabilization platform rather than a public developer API surface.

providers.name: Techstyle Fashion Group
providers.description: TechStyle Fashion Group is the El Segundo, California holding company founded in March 2010 by Don Ressler and Adam Goldenberg as JustFab Inc. and renamed TechStyle Fashion Group in August 2016. It builds and operates direct-to-consumer membership fashion brands on a shared, proprietary commerce and personalization platform once marketed as TechStyle OS — Fabletics (with the Yitty shapewear line), Savage X Fenty, JustFab, ShoeDazzle and FabKids — selling apparel, footwear, activewear, intimates and accessories through a VIP membership subscription that gives members monthly credits, member pricing and a monthly skip window. The group reported more than five million paying VIP members and roughly $800 million in revenue as of 2019, and has since reorganized so that Fabletics, Savage X Fenty and the Global Fashion Brands unit (JustFab, ShoeDazzle, FabKids) run as standalone operating companies on the shared supply chain, fulfillment and technology stack. The TechStyle corporate identity itself has been retired: both techstyle.com and techstyleos.com now redirect to a Gandi domain-parking page at techstylefashiongroup.com that answers on plain HTTP only, so the group publishes no corporate site, no developer program, no API reference and no machine-readable contract of its own. The live API surface belongs to the operating brands, which are profiled separately in this network.

providers.name: Tela Innovations
providers.description: Tela Innovations, Inc. is a semiconductor design-technology and intellectual-property company founded in 2005 and headquartered in Los Gatos, California. It developed gridded, straight-line, one-dimensional layout structures and the pre-defined physical topologies built on them, sold as standard-cell libraries and embedded-SRAM peripheral circuits intended to let logic, memory, analog and I/O blocks scale to advanced process nodes with improvements in variability, performance, leakage and area — without forcing customers to change their existing design methodology, equipment set or process technology. Alongside the libraries it sold physical IC design services and layout- and power-optimization software; in 2009 it acquired Blaze DFM, adding patented design-for-manufacturing and power-optimization capability for digital logic in SoCs and ASICs. It was backed by Intel Capital, Cadence Design Systems, Qualcomm, KT Venture Group, Malloy & Company and Black Diamond Ventures, and a substantial share of its later activity was patent licensing, including a portfolio licence taken by Samsung in 2016. Tela never operated a developer program, public API, SDK, webhook surface or machine-readable specification — its products were delivered as licensed cell libraries, EDA software and design services under commercial agreement, not as a callable service. Its corporate host, www.tela-inc.com, still resolves in DNS but no longer runs a web service (ports 80 and 443 both refuse connections) and has no Internet Archive capture with content after January 2022, so it is deliberately not wired as a Website pointer. This profile is retained as a historical record; there is no API surface to enrich.

providers.name: The Zebra
providers.description: The Zebra is an Austin, Texas based consumer insurance comparison marketplace that lets people compare car, home, renters, and life insurance quotes from many carriers in one place. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network. Sector: consumer. Enrichment (2026-07-21) found no public developer or API surface: no api./developer./developers./partners. subdomains resolve, the public site sits behind a WAF, and docs.thezebra.com is an internal Google Workspace redirect rather than API docs.

providers.name: True Link
providers.description: True Link Financial provides financial management tools for people with complex needs and their caregivers. Its offerings include the True Link Visa prepaid card with caregiver-configurable spending controls and transaction monitoring, investment and trust administration for representative payees, fiduciaries, guardians and non-profit trustees, white-label family banking for financial institutions, and AI-powered merchant fraud prevention (Retina AI). The company reports serving more than 250,000 families. No public developer API or documentation surface was found at the time of enrichment; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: UEFA
providers.description: UEFA.com is the official site of UEFA, the Union of European Football Associations, and the governing body of football in Europe. UEFA works to promote, protect and develop European football across its 55 member associations and organises some of the world’s most famous football competitions, including the UEFA Champions League, UEFA Women’s Champions League, the UEFA Europa League, UEFA EURO and many more. The site features the latest European football news, goals, an extensive archive of video and stats, as well as insights into how the organisation works, including information on financial fair play, how UEFA supports grassroots football and the UEFA HatTrick funding scheme.

providers.name: Wayco
providers.description: Wayco (Wayco AI, Inc.) is a Y Combinator (W26) startup building an AI operator for medical-legal cases. Its platform automates personal-injury and mass-tort case workflows end to end: AI voice agents answer and triage intake calls, match patients to medical providers by case type and location, coordinate telemedicine, summarize and analyze medical records at scale, and manage lead follow-up from first intake toward settlement. Founded by Iqbol Temirkhojaev and based in New York City, the company serves law firms, medical-billing, and insurance-claims teams. As of July 2026 Wayco is early stage and publishes a marketing site (wayco.ai) only, with no public developer API, documentation, or machine-readable specifications yet.

providers.name: Wayve
providers.description: Wayve is a London-based embodied AI company pioneering AV2.0, an end-to-end, mapless, vehicle-agnostic approach to autonomous driving built on large-scale self-supervised learning rather than hand-engineered HD maps and rule stacks. Wayve's core technology stack includes the Wayve AI Driver (the production driving stack licensed to automakers), GAIA generative world models that synthesize realistic driving video from text and serve as simulators for policy training, and LINGO, a vision-language-action research line that uses natural language to train and explain driving decisions. Backed by SoftBank, Microsoft, NVIDIA, and Uber with a 1.5 billion USD funding round, Wayve is partnering with Nissan, Mercedes-Benz, and Stellantis on production programmes, and with Uber and Nissan on a Tokyo robotaxi launch. Wayve does not publish a public developer API; its public surface is research, press, and product positioning material.

providers.name: Webfinanceholding
providers.description: Web Finance Holding AD is a Bulgarian financial-services holding company established in 2002 (formerly Finance Consulting AD). It specializes in the consultation and management of debt portfolios, acquisition of receivables, collection risk management, restructuring, and the management of enterprises in liquidation, and holds stakes across insurance, banking, and leasing subsidiaries including Saglasie Insurance, Texim Bank, and BM Leasing. The public web presence is a corporate and investor-relations site; no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation is published.

providers.name: Webvan
providers.description: Webvan was a pioneering online grocery delivery service founded in 1999, aiming to revolutionize the way consumers purchased food by delivering groceries directly to their doors. Although the original company ceased operations in 2001, its brand and concept have been revived in recent years, reflecting ongoing interest in e‑commerce grocery solutions. The company is backed by Sequoia Capital and remains a notable case study in the evolution of online retail.

providers.name: Willing
providers.description: Willing was an online estate-planning and will-making platform (a 500 Global portfolio company) that let consumers create wills, living wills, and related documents. The brand has since been absorbed into MetLife Legal Plans; as of this enrichment pass willing.com live-redirects (HTTP 302) to legalplans.com. Willing publishes no independent public API, developer portal, or GitHub organization of its own, so it carries no API artifacts beyond a domain-security probe of the surviving willing.com host.

providers.name: 3VR
providers.description: 3VR, Inc. was a San Francisco-based video intelligence and video surveillance analytics company founded in 2005 and backed by Kleiner Perkins among others. Its VisionPoint VMS and Video Intelligence Platform combined video management with search-driven analytics including facial recognition, license plate recognition, object tracking, dwell/loitering detection, people counting, queue management, and forensic video search across IP, analog, and megapixel cameras, with an open architecture for third-party integration into POS, access control, and alarm systems. 3VR was acquired by Identiv in 2018 (approximately $6.9M) and folded into Identiv's Hirsch physical access control platform; Identiv's physical security business, including the 3VR line, was subsequently divested to Vitaprotech in 2024. The 3vr.com domain now redirects to Hirsch/Identiv support and no public developer API is documented.

providers.name: Abata Therapeutics
providers.description: Abata Therapeutics was a biotechnology company developing engineered regulatory T cell (Treg) therapies aimed at restoring immune tolerance in tissue-specific autoimmune and inflammatory diseases, with lead programs directed at progressive multiple sclerosis and type 1 diabetes. Founded in 2021 and based in the Boston/Cambridge area (Watertown, Massachusetts), the company was launched by Third Rock Ventures and counted Lightspeed Venture Partners among its backers. As a therapeutics developer it operated no public developer program, API, or documentation surface. As of this enrichment pass its corporate domains (abatatx.com and abatatherapeutics.com) resolve to a WP Engine host but serve an unconfigured "Site Not Configured" 404, indicating the public website has been deprovisioned and the company appears to have wound down.

providers.name: Abinitio Bio
providers.description: Abinitio Bio builds AI foundation models for biopharmaceutical manufacturing, positioning itself as the intelligence layer for drug manufacturing. Its first model, Echo, predicts manufacturing outcomes to assess manufacturability from day one through process scale-up — evaluating molecules early to reduce aggregation and regulatory liabilities, recommending optimal cell lines, media formulations, and bioprocess parameters, predicting process behavior across scales and operating conditions, and delivering lab-validated candidate molecules, processes, and characterization data ready for commercial scale-up. Founded in 2026 in Boston and backed by Y Combinator (Spring 2026), MIT's Researcher-to-Entrepreneur Accelerator, and Fifty Years' 5050 Program. The company operates a B2B model with pharmaceutical companies and CDMOs and does not currently publish a public API or developer platform.

providers.name: Absurd
providers.description: Absurd is an AI video creation platform positioning itself as "the Creative OS for AI video." It uses autonomous AI agents to handle scripting, scene planning, and video generation, letting companies produce brand and performance advertisements at scale in roughly 72 hours instead of weeks. Based in Los Angeles and part of Y Combinator's Fall 2025 batch, Absurd works with brands such as Hims, Kalshi, Replit, Brex, Whop, and Reforge, with some of its generated videos reaching over a million organic views. The company runs a managed, sales-led production motion rather than a self-serve platform: its published sitemap declares exactly four routes (home, portfolio, careers, contact), and it ships no pricing page, no blog, no developer portal, no documentation, no SDKs, and no GitHub organization. Three Absurd-controlled hosts are live but none is a developer surface — app.absurd.com is the gated customer application, api.absurd.com is its private FastAPI backend with schema and docs routes disabled, and lp.absurd.com is a key-gated Supabase project serving the landing page. This entry was enriched from public web sources and live unauthenticated probes, and will be upgraded if a developer surface appears.

providers.name: Abyrx
providers.description: Abyrx is a medical device company that develops a materials-science platform for therapeutic devices used during surgical procedures, with an initial focus on hemostatic bone putties. Its flagship product, MONTAGE, is a cohesive, settable, and resorbable hemostatic bone putty that adheres to bleeding bone surfaces, used in orthopedic, trauma, spine, sports medicine, cranial, maxillofacial, and cardiothoracic surgeries. Abyrx is a B2B medical device manufacturer serving healthcare providers and surgeons; it is not a technology platform and publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Acesion Pharma
providers.description: Acesion Pharma is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company based in Frederiksberg, Denmark, developing novel therapies for atrial fibrillation (AF), the most common cardiac arrhythmia. The company pioneers small-molecule SK ion channel inhibition as a differentiated mechanism to treat AF safely and effectively. Its lead program AP31969 entered Phase 2 clinical trials in January 2026, building on earlier work on the cardioversion candidate AP30663. Acesion Pharma is backed by venture investors including Canaan Partners. As a pharmaceutical R&D company it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or API documentation; this profile captures its corporate identity and public web properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Adialante
providers.description: Adialante is a medical imaging startup redesigning MRI from the ground up with new physics, algorithms, and hardware to make cancer screening accessible and affordable. Rather than selling multi-million-dollar equipment, Adialante deploys compact, mobile, diagnostic-grade MRI units to clinics on a flat per-scan fee, letting clinics collect insurance reimbursement and keep the margin. Its full-body scanner is roughly 80% lighter and uses about 60% less power than a traditional MRI. The company is starting with pre-biopsy prostate imaging for urology practices, with breast, orthopedic, brain, and whole-body screening on the roadmap. Founded in 2023 and part of Y Combinator's Spring 2026 batch, Adialante is backed by more than $3M in grants including NSF SBIR Phase II funding.

providers.name: Adim
providers.description: Adim is an entertainment-technology and web3 media company co-founded in 2022 by It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia creator Rob McElhenney alongside Richard Rosenblatt, Chase Rosenblatt, Melissa Kaspers, and Spencer Marell. Adim invites a community of storytellers, writers, and fans to collaboratively create, develop, and co-own a new generation of intellectual property — stories, characters, and narrative universes known as the Adimverse — rewarding contributors with ownership stakes and a say in how the community is governed. The company raised a $5M seed round led by Chris Dixon of a16z crypto. Adim is a consumer creative platform rather than an API provider; it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Advanced Biohealing
providers.description: Advanced BioHealing, Inc. was a regenerative medicine company best known for Dermagraft, a cryopreserved human fibroblast-derived dermal substitute used to treat diabetic foot ulcers. The company acquired the Dermagraft assets from Smith & Nephew in 2006, was backed by Canaan Partners and other venture investors, and was acquired by Shire plc for $750 million in cash in June 2011 to seed Shire's regenerative medicine business unit. Dermagraft was later sold to Organogenesis in 2014. Advanced BioHealing no longer operates as an independent entity and publishes no public developer portal, API, or programmatic surface; this profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio company record.

providers.name: Aeroscout
providers.description: AeroScout was an Israeli real-time location systems (RTLS) company that built Wi-Fi-based RFID tags, exciters, and location receivers together with the MobileView software platform to track the location, condition, and status of mobile assets and people, primarily for hospitals and healthcare providers. Menlo Ventures led its Series C round in 2007. AeroScout was acquired by Stanley Black & Decker in 2012 (~$240M) and folded into Stanley Healthcare; the product line and brand now live under Securitas Healthcare / Securitas Technology. AeroScout no longer operates as an independent company and publishes no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or SDKs — integration with the on-premise AeroScout Engine has historically been via a SOAP API for enterprise/HIS systems rather than a public web API.

providers.name: Ai Vivo
providers.description: AI VIVO (AIVIVO LTD) is a Cambridge, England based drug-discovery company that combines systems pharmacology with artificial intelligence to accelerate the identification and de-risking of therapeutic candidates. Its "Organome" platform simulates biological processes at the target, cell, organ, and organism levels and ranks drug candidates by their phenotypic effects at the tissue level, without relying on prior knowledge of the disease or compounds. The approach gained recognition in 2020 when the platform ranked roughly 90,000 compounds for COVID-19 and surfaced dexamethasone as a top candidate weeks before its clinical benefit was widely reported. AI VIVO is backed by DCVC and other life-science and applied-AI investors. As of this profile the company publishes a minimal public web presence (a home and contact page) and exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK.

providers.name: AIForce Technology
providers.description: AIForce Technology (Beijing Zhongke Yuandongli Technology Co., Ltd. / 北京中科原动力科技有限公司) is a Beijing agricultural-robotics manufacturer incubated out of the Chinese Academy of Sciences Institute of Microelectronics, registered in 2018 and operating since July 2019, with Chinese Academy of Engineering academician Li Deyi as chief scientist. It builds autonomous and battery-electric farm machinery across four product lines: the Wantu (万途) electric intelligent tractors, the Zhiniu (智牛) unmanned agricultural machines, the Zhinong (智农) multi-function field robots, and the Zhiyun (智耘) unmanned-operation system that adds full-day autonomous tillage, planting, crop management and harvest to existing machinery in dry fields, paddies and greenhouses, paired with a mobile app and telemetry cloud for route setting and operation monitoring. It is a hardware company that sells machines and retrofit systems to farms, cooperatives and agricultural enterprises, backed by Vertex Ventures China, Chery and CCV among others, and named champion of PepsiCo's Greenhouse Accelerator APAC edition for an AI-powered low-carbon automatic tractor. aiforcetech.com is a five-section Chinese marketing site with no developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: AirKit
providers.description: AirKit (Airkit.ai) was a low-code platform for building customer-facing digital experiences and, later, AI-powered customer service agents, backed by Accel and Emergence Capital. The company was acquired by Salesforce (announced 2023) and its technology now underpins Salesforce Agentforce. As of this enrichment pass, www.airkit.com 301-redirects to salesforce.com/agentforce and the domain's CAA records point to salesforce.com, so AirKit no longer operates an independent developer surface, API, documentation, or portal of its own — all first-party discovery URLs resolve into Salesforce properties. This profile is retained as an acquired-company record; enrichment beyond domain-level DNS/TLS evidence is not applicable.

providers.name: Airx
providers.description: Airx is a brand of Chart Industries that designs and manufactures durable air‑cooled heat exchangers for the natural gas and energy sectors. Established in 1954, the Air‑X‑Changers product line offers a range of custom‑designed cooling solutions, including engine‑driven, electric‑motor‑driven, and hydraulic‑motor‑driven models. The company focuses on delivering reliable, high‑performance equipment for industrial process technologies, serving applications such as bulk CO₂ carbonation, cryogenic transport, and fuel systems.

providers.name: AiTA
providers.description: AiTA is a recruiting agency focused on artificial intelligence talent, offering AI companies access to a curated network of over 50,000 pre‑vetted engineers and executives. It provides end‑to‑end hiring services, candidate sourcing, and consulting for AI startups and enterprises, emphasizing rapid placement, high acceptance rates, and deep industry expertise across sectors such as healthtech, autonomous vehicles, and enterprise AI.

providers.name: Akash Systems
providers.description: Akash Systems is an Oakland, California deep-tech semiconductor company that pioneers Diamond Cooling thermal-management technology, integrating synthetic diamond directly with semiconductors such as Gallium Nitride (GaN) to remove heat up to five times faster than copper. The company pairs six AI/computational discovery engines with two wet labs in a closed loop between silicon and bench to find novel antimicrobial and therapeutic candidates targeting drug-resistant pathogens and complex diseases. AMPLY is a Techstars portfolio company and has been backed by Innovate UK, Invest NI, QUBIS and other UK/NI innovation programmes. The company frames its approach around "asymmetric economics" — sensor deployment cost grows linearly while tracking accuracy grows exponentially — making the system more scalable than conventional radar installations. Arlo has demonstrated its technology with Ukrainian military operators on active frontlines and maintains partnerships across the US, Ukraine, and Northern Europe. As an early-stage hardware startup it publishes no public API, developer program, or SDKs at this time.

Its services span animal testing, human clinical trials, data management, statistical analysis, and independent core-laboratory imaging analysis, and it was among the first domestic providers in China to run trials for interventional heart valves, LAA occluders, and bioresorbable scaffolds. Headquartered in Beijing with branches in Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Chengdu, CoreMed is backed by Qiming Venture Partners. This is a services/CRO company with no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable surface; its site (coremed.com.cn) was unreachable at enrichment time (connection refused, expired TLS cert).

providers.description: Cranius is a data‑analytics and AI‑driven platform that provides businesses with advanced insights and predictive modeling tools. The company focuses on integrating disparate data sources, applying machine‑learning algorithms, and delivering actionable dashboards to improve decision‑making across finance, operations, and marketing. While detailed public information is limited, Cranius appears to target enterprise clients seeking scalable analytics solutions.

providers.name: Crescendo874d
providers.description: Crescendo874d is a software company offering a full-stack customer service platform that combines advanced AI with a global service team. Founded in 2024 and based in San Francisco, CA, it provides scalable solutions to optimize frontline and back‑office operations for fast‑moving, digitally‑native enterprises. The platform enables outcome‑driven results through augmented‑AI customer experience technology, targeting enterprises seeking personalized, data‑rich interactions.

No verifiable corporate domain, official documentation, or API endpoints could be identified. The entry therefore records the company name and minimal metadata while noting the lack of discoverable technical resources.

providers.name: Cushion.ai
providers.description: Cushion.ai was an AI‑powered consumer finance platform founded in 2016 by Paul Kesserwani. It built tools to help everyday people negotiate bank fees and navigate a confusing, costly financial system. After nine years it was acquired by LendingClub in April 2025 and subsequently shut down in early 2025 when the fee‑arbitrage model became unsustainable. The company raised $21 M and was noted for its AI‑driven fee‑negotiation service before closure.

providers.name: Dabchy
providers.description: Dabchy is a Tunisia-based online marketplace for buying and selling pre-owned and new lifestyle goods including fashion and clothing, accessories, home decor, sporting equipment, and books. Serving the Tunisian market in French (fr_TN), it lets individuals list their own items and discover deals from other sellers, positioning itself as a simple, fast, and secure platform for giving everyday objects a second life. Backed by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Dabchy publishes no public developer API, API documentation, developer portal, or machine-readable discovery surface; api.dabchy.com is a locked-down (HTTP 403) application backend and the public site is a client-rendered single-page app with no exposed spec.

providers.name: Decent
providers.description: Decent is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of menlo-ventures, qed-investors and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Dollar General
providers.description: Dollar General is a Fortune 500 discount retailer operating more than 20,000 stores across the United States. Vendor and supplier integration is handled through the DG Partners portal and RangeMe for new vendor onboarding. Dollar General does not currently publish a public REST API.

providers.name: Donaldson
providers.description: Donaldson Company, Inc. is a global leader in providing engine and industrial air, oil and liquid filtration solutions. No public developer-facing APIs have been identified at this time; this index will be updated if any are made available.

providers.name: Dot Product
providers.description: Dot Product is a San Francisco AI startup founded in 2024 by Usman Masood (former CTO of Pipe and engineering manager at Stripe) and Maksim Stepanenko (previously at Coinbase, Primer, Locu, and the MIT Media Lab). The company builds "Operator," a platform of voice-first AI coworkers (agents) for operations and customer-support teams: AI agents that follow company-specific playbooks, provide 24/7 phone/voice support, and scale to fluctuating demand as an alternative to traditional call centers. Dot Product raised a $6M seed round led by Index Ventures with participation from Lachy Groom. As of this enrichment pass the company operates in stealth: the product surface (operator.xyz) does not resolve publicly and dotproduct.xyz is parked, so no public API, developer docs, SDKs, or machine-readable specifications could be verified. Sector: ai-ml.

providers.name: Dots
providers.description: Dots is a mobile games studio founded in 2013 by Paul Murphy and Patrick Moberg, known for minimalist, calming puzzle games including Dots, Two Dots, and Dots & Co. The studio focused on well-designed, easy-to-approach games and player-friendly monetization, measuring success by how players feel rather than aggressive in-app spending. Backed by Northzone, Slow Ventures, Tencent, Greycroft, and CrunchFund, Dots was acquired by Take-Two Interactive in August 2020. This is a consumer gaming company with no public developer API surface; it was added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio stub and this enrichment pass confirmed it exposes no API, SDK, or documentation.

providers.name: Dream Finders Homes
providers.description: Dream Finders Homes is a national homebuilder that constructs new residential properties across markets in the Southeast and Southwest United States. The company emphasizes customization and affordability for homebuyers and offers mortgage, title, and insurance services through affiliated entities. Dream Finders Homes does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Edge Medical
providers.description: Edge Medical is one of the fastest growing medical device distributors, operating in the healthcare sector as a portfolio company of Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China). It was surfaced from the Hongshan portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. The Hongshan portfolio record classifies it as a medical device distribution business rather than an API provider (is_api_provider: false); no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface has been identified for it, and no company website URL is published in the source portfolio listing. This profile remains a lead pending discovery of any first-party developer or API surface.

providers.name: effx
providers.description: effx was a San Francisco developer-tools startup, founded in 2018 by Joey Parsons, that built a modern microservice catalog to help engineering teams navigate and operate microservices architectures — tracking service ownership, cataloging services, enforcing service standards, tracking migrations, and supporting incident response. The company raised a $3.9M seed round led by Kleiner Perkins alongside Cowboy Ventures. effx was acquired by Figma in 2021; the product was shut down and the team joined Figma's engineering organization. effx.com is now an acquisition/farewell notice and there is no live API, developer documentation, SDK, or public source surface to enrich.

providers.name: Elodie
providers.description: Elodie Games is an independent video game studio founded in 2019 and headquartered in Venice, California, building endlessly-playable cross-play PvE cooperative games for PC, console, and mobile. Co-founded by Christina Norman (design leadership on Mass Effect 1-3, League of Legends, and League of Legends: Wild Rift) and David Banks (former executive producer of League of Legends at Riot Games), the studio is focused on deeply social, cross-platform gameplay so friends and family can play together regardless of device or skill level. Elodie's Series A was co-led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Galaxy Interactive. Elodie publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal; its backend stack (AWS, Kotlin, gRPC/Protobuf, DynamoDB, MySQL) is internal-only, so there is no API artifact surface to enrich for this provider.

providers.name: Engram
providers.description: Engram is an early-stage AI company building models that learn from an organization's unique context and data, with the pitch that they can match or beat frontier models while using only 1%-10% of the tokens ("AI has learned the world. Now it should learn yours."). Positioned as a learned AI memory layer and backed by Kleiner Perkins, Engram is at a pre-product / research stage: as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, documentation, pricing, blog, sign-up, or GitHub organization. This profile captures the company's public identity only; there is no developer or API surface available to enrich.

providers.name: Envisia
providers.description: Envisia (Envisia Therapeutics, Inc.) was a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company based in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, spun out of Liquidia Technologies to apply PRINT (Particle Replication In Non-wetting Templates) particle-engineering to sustained-release ophthalmic therapeutics. Its lead candidate, ENV515 (travoprost) extended-release, was an intracameral implant intended to lower intraocular pressure in glaucoma patients for months from a single administration. The company was venture-backed by Canaan Partners, New Enterprise Associates, Morningside, and Batterson Venture Capital, and was acquired by Aerie Pharmaceuticals in October 2016. As a therapeutics company it exposes no public developer, API, or documentation surface, and its former web domains no longer resolve; this profile is retained as a VC-portfolio lead record with no API artifacts to enrich.

providers.name: Enya
providers.description: Enya is a Singapore-based sustainable period-care consumer brand backed by 500 Global (500 Southeast Asia) and Crusade Partners. Founded by Christian Teo, Enya sells certified organic cotton sanitary pads, liners, tampons, menstrual cups, period underwear and heating patches direct-to-consumer and via subscription (15/30/45/90-day cadence) across Singapore, Asia and the Middle East, through its enya.sg storefront, Shopee and retail partners such as DKSH. It is a consumer packaged-goods / e-commerce business with no public API, developer portal, or programmatic surface.

providers.name: Eon Laboratories
providers.description: Eon Laboratories is a pharmaceutical manufacturer that develops, manufactures, and markets a broad range of generic pharmaceutical products. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As a generic-drug maker rather than a software or API producer, Eon Laboratories publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specifications, so this profile carries company identity only and no API artifacts. The record will be revisited if the company later exposes a developer or partner API surface.

providers.name: Fabraix
providers.description: Fabraix builds red-teaming AI agents that continuously find security vulnerabilities in customer-facing AI systems. Its flagship product, Nyx, autonomously discovers exploits across chat, voice, browser, and coding agents without needing source-code access, drawing on a library of more than 10,000 jailbreaks and adaptive attack strategies that pursue promising approaches across hundreds of interactions. Fabraix also created ACE (Adversarial Cost to Exploit), a game-theoretic benchmark that measures AI security by the cost of a successful attack, enabling continuous, lower-cost vulnerability testing that re-assesses systems with each update. Fabraix is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) company. This profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network; no public API, developer documentation, or machine-readable surface has been published by Fabraix at this time.

providers.name: Flagcat
providers.description: Flagcat is a Paris-based animation and webtoon production studio building ambitious action-fantasy anime and webtoon series (including "Writers," "Deadly Hour," and "Impure Blood Regression") while redesigning the production pipeline around artist wellness. Its proprietary tool, Flagcat Colors, is an AI-powered coloring product for webtoon artists that learns from uploaded character references and batch-colorizes line art in one click, exporting layered files for final touch-ups. Flagcat Colors is in a pre-beta, waiting-list stage and the studio publishes no public API, developer platform, SDKs, or documentation as of this profile. Backed by Seedcamp.

providers.name: Flapping Airplanes
providers.description: Flapping Airplanes describes itself as a frontier data efficiency lab that is currently in stealth. It is an AI-sector company backed by GV and Index Ventures, surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes only a single stealth landing page (flappingairplanes.com) with no public API, developer portal, documentation, or SDKs; this profile will be enriched further as a developer-facing surface appears.

providers.name: Function Oncology
providers.description: Function Oncology is a precision oncology company applying single-cell CRISPR functional genomics to map cancer dependencies and identify and validate new therapeutic targets. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) Bio + Health, it was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub for enrichment. As of this pass the company publishes no live public website, developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI, or SDKs — the primary domain resolves to Google Workspace mail records only with no web A record — so no API artifacts could be searched, fetched, or derived. This profile carries identity metadata only until a public developer surface appears.

providers.name: Futurtec
providers.description: Futurtec (鑫君特) is a Chinese medical-device company founded in 2015 and recognized as a national high-tech enterprise, focused on orthopedic surgical robotics. Its flagship ORTHBOT surgical system combines navigation with automatic robotic execution — intelligent needle placement, non-invasive positioning, dual-camera navigation, and visual force-feedback pressure protection — and holds Chinese regulatory approval (Feb 2021) and EU MDR CE certification (May 2023). The company reports 251+ patents filed or granted, including 84+ invention patents and 25+ PCT applications. As of this enrichment pass, Futurtec publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or software surface: it is a clinical hardware manufacturer, so the enrichment pipeline found no API artifacts to harvest.

providers.name: G-III Apparel Group
providers.description: G-III Apparel Group is a designer, manufacturer, and marketer of branded apparel, accessories, and team sports products owning and licensing brands such as DKNY, Donna Karan, Calvin Klein, Tommy Hilfiger, and Karl Lagerfeld Paris.

providers.name: Gamefam
providers.description: Gamefam is a gaming studio that builds and operates high-quality branded games and interactive experiences for Gen Z and Gen Alpha audiences on platforms such as Roblox and Fortnite. It develops games, media campaigns, and amplification programs for 50+ brand partners (including LEGO, Adidas, Disney, and Netflix) and runs creator-facing programs such as Dev X and its Creator Fund. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. As of this enrichment pass Gamefam publishes no public developer API, portal, SDK, or OpenAPI surface — its products are consumer game experiences distributed through third-party platforms.

providers.name: gaugene
providers.description: Gaugene (Beijing Zhizhen Biotechnology Co., Ltd. / 知真生物), founded in 2017 and headquartered in Beijing, China, develops and supplies flow cytometry instruments and reagents for the in-vitro diagnostics and life-sciences research market. Its analyzers use high-power lasers and high-sensitivity multi-color fluorescence detection for clinical hematology diagnosis, single-cell analysis, protein screening, and clinical-indicator discovery. Gaugene is a venture-backed diagnostics-hardware and reagents maker rather than an API provider; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no reachable public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface (its apex domain does not resolve and www.gaugene.com returns a 502). It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub via Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: Genuine Parts Company
providers.description: Genuine Parts Company is a Fortune 500 service organization engaged in the distribution of automotive replacement parts (the parent of NAPA Auto Parts), industrial replacement parts, and electrical materials and electronic components.

providers.name: Gixo
providers.description: Gixo was a consumer live-streaming fitness startup (coached, real-time running and workout classes delivered to a mobile app), surfaced as a portfolio company of Cowboy Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead. The enrichment pipeline probed the company on 2026-07-19 and found no live provider surface: gixo.com and www.gixo.com both HTTP 301-redirect to www.bodi.com (a Beachbody / BODi property), consistent with Gixo having been acquired and wound down into the Openfit / Beachbody / BODi fitness platform. No api.gixo.com or developer.gixo.com host resolves in DNS, and no /.well-known/ discovery surface, developer portal, documentation, SDKs, or public API is published. There is no API program to enrich; this profile is retained as a historical consumer-sector lead rather than an active provider.

providers.name: GlobalCare Inc.
providers.description: GlobalCare Inc. was a healthcare technology company founded in 1994 and based in Portland, Oregon, that provided solutions enabling healthcare payers to significantly reduce the cost of out-of-network claims. Backed by an investor group led by Insight Venture Partners (Series A Preferred Stock), GlobalCare merged into Zelis Healthcare in January 2016 and no longer operates as an independent entity. Its out-of-network claims-pricing capabilities are now delivered through Zelis. GlobalCare Inc. itself publishes no independent developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface; any current API surface is Zelis's (developer.zelis.com), tracked separately in the network.

providers.name: GoatChat AI
providers.description: GoatChat AI - Adaptive Plus Inc. is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Gtctowers
providers.description: GTC Towers is a telecommunications infrastructure company based in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida, positioning itself as a customer-focused tower owner built by a team of wireless industry veterans. It develops and operates digital connectivity infrastructure including cell towers, small cells, and in-building wireless systems, alongside tower operations management, tower safety services, and Eco Power Wheels power solutions. GTC Towers leases tower space and supports carriers and enterprises through the various stages of tower siting, deployment, and growth. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a corporate marketing website only, with no developer portal, API, or programmatic surface.

providers.name: Halliburton
providers.description: Halliburton delivers advanced products and services to meet the evolving needs of the global energy industry, driving innovation, reliability, and performance. Halliburton operates enterprise software platforms such as DecisionSpace 365, Landmark, and iEnergy, but does not currently publish a public, openly accessible REST API for general developer use.

providers.name: Hassle
providers.description: Hassle.com was a London-based on-demand home-cleaning marketplace, founded in 2012 by Alex Depledge and Jules Coleman, connecting households with vetted local cleaners for one-off and recurring bookings. Backed by Accel Partners, it was acquired by Rocket Internet-backed Helpling in July 2015 for a reported EUR 32 million to form one of the world's largest home-cleaning marketplaces. The Hassle.com brand was subsequently folded into Helpling, whose UK operations have since ceased; the domain now redirects to Helpling. The company operates a consumer-facing web/mobile booking product and exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: HCC Insurance Holdings
providers.description: HCC Insurance Holdings was a leading specialty insurance group with offices in the United States, the United Kingdom, Spain, and Ireland. It was acquired by Tokio Marine in 2015 and now operates as Tokio Marine HCC, providing more than 100 classes of specialty insurance products in approximately 180 countries.

providers.name: Heartstream
providers.description: Heartstream is an emergency-care and defibrillation brand, now part of Philips, that makes automated external defibrillators (AEDs) and professional monitor/defibrillators for public-access, home, and EMS use. The company originated as a Mayfield-backed medical-device startup that pioneered automatic external defibrillators and was later acquired by Hewlett-Packard; today the Heartstream name lives on across the HeartStart AED and Tempus ALS product lines sold in more than 50 countries and regions. Its public site publishes product support, a document center (instructions for use), and a newsroom, but it exposes no public developer portal, API, or documentation surface, so there are no API artifacts to enrich.

providers.name: HilleVax
providers.description: HilleVax was a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing novel vaccines, most notably HIL-214, a virus-like-particle based vaccine candidate aimed at preventing moderate-to-severe acute gastroenteritis caused by norovirus infection. The company was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners. Enrichment probing found no developer program, no API, no developer portal, and no public API documentation of any kind, which is expected for a clinical-stage vaccine developer rather than a technology/API producer. The company's primary domain (hillevax.com) now redirects to xoma.com (XOMA Royalty), indicating HilleVax has been acquired and wound down as an independent operating company; XOMA Royalty itself was subsequently acquired by Ligand (closed July 2026). This profile is retained as a company/identity record with no API surface.

providers.name: Hinsta
providers.description: Hintsa Performance is a Finnish performance-coaching company founded by Dr. Aki Hintsa, applying methods developed over 30+ years working with Formula 1 drivers and elite athletes to help executives, leaders, and individuals achieve sustainable success. Its "Circle of Better Life" model combines Nordic wellbeing with performance principles proven in Formula 1, delivered as bespoke coaching programs across three segments (sports, businesses, and individuals). The company reports 3,500+ intensive executive coaching programmes delivered for 500+ organisations. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. No public API, developer portal, documentation, or discovery surface (.well-known, llms.txt) was found during enrichment — this is a non-API wellbeing/coaching business.

providers.name: Howmet Aerospace
providers.description: Howmet Aerospace is a global leader in advanced engineered solutions for the aerospace and transportation industries, providing engine components, fastening systems, engineered structures, and forged wheels.

providers.name: Huntington Ingalls Industries
providers.description: Huntington Ingalls Industries is the largest military shipbuilding company in the United States, designing, building, overhauling, and repairing ships primarily for the U.S. Navy and Coast Guard, while also providing professional services including unmanned systems, defense solutions, and cybersecurity. No public developer APIs have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Hyde
providers.description: Hyde is an enterprise AI platform that partners with organizations to turn their proprietary data and institutional expertise into specialized reasoning models. Its integrated workbench spans environment and data preparation, a synthetic data engine for building simulation training environments, GPU-optimized training pipelines, trajectory engineering, and a tightly coupled inference-training loop for continuous improvement. Hyde positions custom, domain-specific models that keep enterprise data private while claiming superior agent accuracy and up to 10x lower inference cost and latency versus frontier models. It is a sales-led enterprise engagement (portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and general-catalyst) that does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: i-Incubator Healthcare
providers.description: i-Incubator Healthcare is a pharmaceutical innovation incubator established by IDG Capital and officially launched in Shanghai (Xuhui District) in 2024. It operates an "incubation + empowerment" model to develop innovative drug-research programs across oncology, immunology, and metabolic disease areas, pairing global innovation perspectives with China-based execution to advance projects to international quality standards. It is backed by a dedicated, long-horizon (15-year) incubation fund. Surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital; this is a research/biotech venture with no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Iceberg Quantum
providers.description: Iceberg Quantum is a quantum architecture firm building fault-tolerant quantum computing systems around LDPC (Low-Density Parity-Check) error-correction codes. Its designs aim to cut the hardware overhead of quantum error correction by more than an order of magnitude, and its Pinnacle architecture claims roughly 10x lower overhead through modular lattice surgery and time-overhead compression. The company is hardware- and architecture-focused rather than a software/API provider; it partners with qubit hardware makers (PsiQuantum, Diraq, Oxford Ionics) and is backed by DCVC, Blackbird, and LocalGlobe. Surfaced as a DCVC portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for tracking; there is no public API, SDK, or developer surface to enrich at this stage.

providers.name: IDEC Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: IDEC Pharmaceuticals is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of kleiner-perkins and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: healthcare. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: immune-path
providers.description: Immune-Path (Yidao Biotechnology (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. / 怡道生物) is a China-based vaccine biotechnology company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Suzhou. The company develops human vaccines across recombinant protein antigen, novel viral vector, and messenger RNA (mRNA) platforms, backed by its own vaccine adjuvant technology. Its clinical and preclinical pipeline includes a recombinant zoster (shingles) vaccine produced in CHO cells, a nine-valent recombinant HPV vaccine expressed in Pichia pastoris, a respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccine, a therapeutic gastric cancer vaccine, and a COVID-19 vaccine. Immune-Path is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. It is a life-sciences drug developer with no public developer, API, or software surface; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Industrial Microbes
providers.description: Industrial Microbes (iMicrobes) is a synthetic-biology company in Alameda, California that engineers microorganisms to convert renewable, low-carbon feedstocks such as ethanol and methane into commercial-grade industrial chemicals and bio-based materials. Founded in 2014 (Y Combinator W15) by Liz Clarke, Derek Greenfield, and Noah Helman, the company has produced 100% bio-based acrylic acid and targets net-zero or negative-emission building-block chemicals for coatings, paints, carbon-fiber precursors, biopolymers, and biodegradable plastics. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Industrial Microbes publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or developer portal, so the enrichment pipeline captured only verified company identity and website link properties.

providers.name: Installed Building Products
providers.description: Installed Building Products, Inc. is one of the largest installers of insulation, garage doors, rain gutters, shower doors, mirrors, closet shelving, and other building products to the residential and commercial construction industry in the United States. The company operates a network of branch locations across the country and partners with major homebuilders and contractors. IBP combines product distribution with installation services for new construction and remodeling.

providers.name: Intersect ENT
providers.description: Intersect ENT was a medical device company based in Menlo Park, California that developed drug-eluting, bioresorbable sinus implants for patients with chronic rhinosinusitis. Its PROPEL family of steroid-eluting implants maintains sinus patency and delivers localized mometasone furoate to the sinus mucosa following endoscopic sinus surgery, while its SINUVA implant treats recurrent nasal polyps in an in-office setting. Formerly publicly traded on NASDAQ under the ticker XENT, Intersect ENT was acquired by Medtronic in May 2022 and its PROPEL and SINUVA product lines are now sold as part of Medtronic's ear, nose, and throat (ENT) portfolio. The company is a physical medical-device manufacturer and operates no public developer program, API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Jumo
providers.description: JUMO is a Cape Town-based banking-as-a-service (BaaS) platform, founded in 2015, that uses artificial intelligence to power digital credit and savings products for banks, mobile network operators, and payments providers across emerging markets in Africa. Its infrastructure has two foundational capabilities: Core, an end-to-end next-generation banking platform that replaces legacy core banking with no build cost, and Unify, an AI processor that transforms alternative data (such as GSM records and mobile wallet transactions) to reduce the cost and risk of lending. JUMO delivers financial services through partners including Airtel, MTN Group, Orange Money Group, and Mukuru, and has disbursed over USD 8 billion to more than 31 million people across Ghana, Kenya, Tanzania, Zambia, Uganda, Cote d'Ivoire, South Africa, Benin, and Cameroon. It is a certified B Corporation backed by investors including Anthemis, LeapFrog Investments, Fidelity Management, and Visa. JUMO's APIs and integrations are provided privately to regulated financial-institution partners rather than through a public developer portal.

providers.name: justmedical
providers.description: JUST Medical Devices (Tianjin) Co., Ltd. (嘉思特医疗器材（天津）股份有限公司) is a Chinese orthopedic medical device manufacturer based in Tianjin, China, and a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. The company designs and produces joint replacement implants and orthopedic prosthetics, applying 3D printing and additive manufacturing to hip, knee, and other joint reconstruction systems. Its public presence at justmedical.cn is a corporate marketing website (built on the Faisco/fkw.com site builder); the company publishes no developer program, API, SDK, or machine-readable API surface. This profile is retained as a company identity record in the API Evangelist network rather than an API provider entry.

providers.name: Kanghui Medical
providers.description: Kanghui Medical (Changzhou Kanghui Medical Innovation Co., Ltd.), founded in 1997 and headquartered in Changzhou, Jiangsu Province, China, is an orthopedic medical device manufacturer focused on the R&D and production of trauma and spine implants and instruments, plus professional surgical education and services across China and emerging markets. Formerly China Kanghui Holdings (NYSE: KH), it was acquired by Medtronic in 2012 and now operates as a Medtronic company. This is a corporate/physical-device provider with a public marketing website but no public developer portal, API documentation, or API surface; the profile is maintained as an API Evangelist network company record.

providers.name: KelAI
providers.description: KelAI (Kelai) is an AI quant research platform for hedge funds and institutional investors that positions itself as an autonomous alpha engine. Its AI agents run the full systematic-research workflow — generating trading-signal ideas, writing and testing research code, analyzing market data, running backtests and validation, and monitoring live signal performance — consolidating what normally runs across siloed systems and inefficient workflows. Founded by Jeremie Cohen, a former WorldQuant portfolio manager and head of event-driven systematic strategies who also led machine learning teams at Millennium Management, KelAI is part of Y Combinator's Spring 2026 batch and is deployed with institutional investors. As an early-stage company it does not yet publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Kelun-Biotech
providers.description: Sichuan Kelun-Biotech Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (Kelun Botai, HKEX: 6990), a Chengdu-based subsidiary of Sichuan Kelun Pharmaceutical (SZSE: 002422) established in 2016, is an innovative biopharmaceutical company focused on the research, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of novel drugs. It specializes in antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) and other conjugated therapies across both large-molecule and small-molecule modalities, targeting oncology and autoimmune diseases. The company operates several core drug-discovery platforms and maintains a pipeline of 30+ candidates with multiple approved and clinical-stage programs. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital and added to the API Evangelist network; as a pharmaceutical manufacturer it publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Keurig Dr Pepper (formerly Dr Pepper Snapple Group)
providers.description: Dr Pepper Snapple Group was an integrated brand owner, manufacturer, and distributor of nonalcoholic beverages in the United States, Canada, Mexico, and the Caribbean. In 2018 the company merged with Keurig Green Mountain to form Keurig Dr Pepper, a leading beverage company in North America with a portfolio of more than 150 brands including Dr Pepper, 7UP, Snapple, Canada Dry, Keurig, and Peet's Coffee.

providers.name: Landstar System
providers.description: Landstar System is a worldwide, asset-light provider of integrated transportation management solutions delivering safe, specialized transportation services to a broad range of customers.

providers.name: Livongo Health
providers.description: Livongo Health was a digital-health company delivering connected chronic-condition management for diabetes, hypertension, weight management, and diabetes prevention through cellular-connected glucose meters, blood-pressure monitors, and smart scales paired with human health coaching and 24/7 monitoring. Livongo merged with Teladoc Health in 2020 and now operates as "Livongo by Teladoc Health"; the standalone livongo.com domain 301-redirects to teladochealth.com/livongo. The brand exposes no independent public developer portal, API documentation, or API surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: LongBio Pharma
providers.description: LongBio Pharma (Suzhou/Shanghai, founded 2020) is a Chinese clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the in-house discovery and development of innovative antibody and fusion-protein therapeutics for allergic, autoimmune, and complement-mediated diseases. Its lead programs include the anti-IgE antibody LP-003 for chronic spontaneous urticaria and asthma. Co-founded by Dr. Bill Nai-chau Sun (co-founder of Tanox and co-inventor of Omalizumab/Xolair), LongBio raised a Series B2 round led by Qiming Venture Partners and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (01779.HK) in June 2026. It is a pharmaceutical drug developer with no public developer or API surface; this profile was surfaced as a Qiming portfolio company and completed an enrichment pass.

providers.name: Luckin Coffee
providers.description: Luckin Coffee (瑞幸咖啡) is a Chinese multinational coffee company and coffeehouse chain headquartered in Xiamen, China. Founded in 2017, it runs a technology-driven, mobile-app-first retail model in which nearly all ordering, payment, and membership happen through its native app and mini-programs rather than at a counter. As of 31 March 2026 the company operated 33,596 stores globally. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Luckin Coffee publishes no public developer program, open platform, or API — its digital surface is a consumer ordering app, not a documented API product.

providers.name: Luminus Devices
providers.description: Luminus Devices is an optoelectronics manufacturer ("Improving Life with Photons") producing solid-state lighting and photonics hardware: COB arrays, specialty and color SMD LEDs, UV/IR/horticulture LEDs, green/blue/red multi-mode lasers, and power semiconductors (SiC MOSFETs and Schottky barrier diodes) for retail, industrial, medical, life-sciences, display, and automotive applications. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. Enrichment confirmed this is a hardware/components company that publishes no public developer API, REST API, or developer portal — only a product resources/tools portal.

providers.name: Lyracollective
providers.description: Lyra Collective is a consumer-products holding company that owns and operates a portfolio of everyday care brands across skincare, feminine care, and family and pet products, including LOLA, EVER, QRX Labs, TriLASTIN, Nuvadermis, Natemia, Leash Boss, and Lusso Gear. It positions itself around "Exceptional Care, For Everyday Moments," emphasizing clean, quality essentials sold direct-to-consumer and through retail. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer-brands operator it publishes no public developer portal, API, or API documentation; there is no API surface to enrich.

providers.name: Manas AI
providers.description: Manas AI is an artificial-intelligence drug-discovery company co-founded by Reid Hoffman and physician-scientist Siddhartha Mukherjee, launched in late 2024 and backed by General Catalyst and Greylock. The company applies machine learning and computational biology to accelerate the discovery and design of new medicines, with an initial focus on hard-to-treat cancers such as breast and prostate cancer and lymphoma. Manas AI operates as a private biotech / therapeutics research organization rather than a developer-facing platform: as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or technical documentation. This entry is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company profile surfaced from the General Catalyst portfolio.

providers.name: Martin Marietta Materials
providers.description: Martin Marietta Materials is a leading supplier of building materials, including aggregates, cement, ready-mixed concrete, asphalt, and paving products, used in construction, infrastructure, and residential projects across the United States.

providers.name: Match Group
providers.description: Match Group is a leading provider of digital technologies designed to help people make meaningful connections. The company operates a portfolio of dating apps and brands including Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, OkCupid, Pairs, Plenty Of Fish, Azar, Hakuna, and others. Match Group does not publish a unified public developer portal at the corporate level; individual brands manage their own integrations.

providers.name: Matrix Pharmaceutical
providers.description: Matrix Pharmaceutical is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of canaan-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Maxion Therapeutics
providers.description: Maxion Therapeutics is a UK biotechnology company developing protein therapeutics using its proprietary KnotBody technology, which fuses venom-derived knottin miniproteins with antibodies to drug previously untreatable ion channel- and GPCR-driven diseases across autoimmune, inflammatory, and related therapeutic areas. Maxion is a preclinical-stage drug-discovery company, not an API or developer-platform provider; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for portfolio-tracking purposes and has no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Mead Johnson Nutrition
