providers.description: Mead Johnson Nutrition was a manufacturer of infant formula and other pediatric nutrition products before being acquired by Reckitt Benckiser in 2017. No public developer APIs are currently documented.

providers.name: MeadWestvaco
providers.description: MeadWestvaco was a global packaging company providing packaging solutions to many of the world's most-admired brands in the personal and beauty care, food, beverage, home and garden, and other industries. In 2015 MeadWestvaco merged with Rock-Tenn to form WestRock, and the MeadWestvaco brand has since been retired. No public APIs or developer resources are documented for the legacy MeadWestvaco entity or for its WestRock successor.

providers.name: Medir
providers.description: Medir is a South Korean digital-health company behind Medb (메듭), a non-face-to-face (telemedicine) and prescription-drug delivery platform that connects patients, doctors, hospitals and pharmacies. Through the Medb mobile app, patients receive 100% video consultations with physicians and have their prescribed medications delivered to their door — often within roughly 30 minutes to two hours — with no separate service fee beyond the standard consultation charge. Medir is a portfolio company backed by 500 Global. The business operates as a consumer mobile application (iOS and Android) and does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile tracks the company in the API Evangelist network pending any future API surface.

providers.name: Meet Cute
providers.description: Meet Cute is a New York-based media company founded in 2019 by Naomi Shah that produces and distributes original scripted romantic-comedy audio programming, releasing bite-sized 15-minute rom-com stories as podcasts across platforms such as Apple Podcasts and Spotify. Backed by Union Square Ventures, Lerer Hippeau, Advancit Capital, and LocalGlobe, the company was acquired by Fox Entertainment in November 2025 to serve as a rapid-development content incubator for scripted and unscripted series. Meet Cute is a consumer media/content brand with no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal; this profile is retained as a company record.

providers.name: Milk Moovement
providers.description: Milk Moovement is a dairy supply chain software company that provides cloud-based logistics, scheduling, routing, quality tracking, and automated payroll tools for dairy cooperatives and processors across North America. The platform digitizes the movement of milk from farm to processor, giving producers, haulers, and cooperatives real-time visibility into the dairy supply chain. The company was surfaced via the techstars portfolio and enriched into the API Evangelist network; as of this pass it publishes no public developer API, documentation, developer portal, or status page.

providers.name: Millennial Fox
providers.description: Millennial Fox, Inc. is a Los Angeles-based consumer company backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners that set out to bridge the gap between entertainment and fitness. Its flagship product, Tracks Battle Squad, was a socially gamified workout companion for iOS and watchOS that integrated with the Apple Health app to turn physical activity into points, badges, and accessories for a virtual 3D fox character. The app launched in 2017, was featured on Apple Music's Planet of the Apps, and has since been removed from the App Store; the company appears inactive and exposes no public API, developer portal, documentation, or well-known surface.

providers.name: Millennium Pharma
providers.description: Millennium Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company founded in 1993 in Cambridge, Massachusetts, that pioneered a genomics-based, platform approach to drug discovery and development. Backed early on by Mayfield, the company built its reputation on large research and development alliances with major pharmaceutical partners and on discovering and commercializing medicines for cancer and other diseases. Millennium was acquired by Takeda Pharmaceutical Company in 2008 and now operates as the Takeda Oncology unit. It is a therapeutics and drug-discovery organization, not an API or developer-platform provider, and exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Millennium Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Millennium Pharmaceuticals was a biopharmaceutical company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, focused on oncology and inflammation, best known for developing the cancer drug Velcade (bortezomib). Backed early by Kleiner Perkins, it was acquired by Takeda Pharmaceutical Company in 2008 for $8.8B and its brand was retired to "Takeda Oncology" in 2013; it no longer operates as an independent company. Surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio stub. This is a research/company profile with no independent developer API surface — the pipeline confirmed the provider publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or event/webhook surface.

providers.name: Mindsay
providers.description: Mindsay (formerly Destygo) was a Paris-based conversational AI platform that built chatbot and virtual-assistant automation for customer service and support teams, with a focus on travel and hospitality use cases. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the standalone mindsay.com brand is no longer serving a live site or developer surface (the company was acquired by Laivly), so no public API, developer portal, or documentation could be located to profile.

providers.name: Minghui Pharmaceutical
providers.description: Minghui Pharmaceutical is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: healthcare. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Miniswap
providers.description: Miniswap is a Y Combinator (Fall 2025) startup building an online marketplace for complex hobbies, starting with tabletop gaming miniatures such as Warhammer. The platform maintains a catalog of more than 20,000 unique miniatures with detailed product information, and lets sellers photograph an item and have Miniswap automatically generate an accurate, detailed listing. It targets the roughly $20 billion tabletop games industry and was founded by Zak Singh and Will Hanna, who met at Cambridge. Miniswap is a consumer-facing web marketplace at miniswap.gg; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDKs, documentation portal, or discovery artifacts.

providers.name: Minova Pharma
providers.description: Nanjing Minova Pharmaceutical Technology Co., Ltd. (南京迈诺威医药科技有限公司) is a drug-discovery and pharmaceutical R&D company founded in February 2021 and headquartered in Nanjing, China. The company focuses on the discovery, development, and industrialization of novel drugs for mental diseases and disfiguring (cosmetic/dermatological) diseases, operating in the consumer-pharmaceutical space as both a drug R&D house and supplier. Its stated capabilities span early drug discovery, compound/drug screening, and druggability (developability) research. Surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Minova Pharma publishes a corporate marketing website but exposes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: MITO Material Solutions
providers.description: MITO Material Solutions (MITO Materials) is a specialty chemical company that develops patented hybrid additive technology to strengthen composite and thermoplastic materials. Its platform functionalizes graphene and biomaterials to improve strength, durability, flexibility, and sustainability without requiring changes to a manufacturer's existing process. Core products include the MITO hybrid additive platform, MITO E-GO, MITO E-GO Res-1, and MITO ACRE, serving the sports and recreation, transportation, automotive, and infrastructure industries. The company is a Techstars portfolio company and was added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass, MITO publishes no developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: mobike
providers.description: Mobike (Chinese 摩拜单车 / 摩拜科技, "Mobike Technology") was a Beijing-based dockless bicycle-sharing company founded in 2015. Riders located, unlocked, and paid for GPS smart-lock bikes through a mobile app and QR codes. Mobike was acquired by Meituan in 2018 and its standalone brand was subsequently folded into Meituan Bike; the public site (www.mobike.com) is now a bare ICP-filing landing page with no developer API, SDK, documentation, or portal surface. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: Molecular Assemblies
providers.description: Molecular Assemblies is a synthetic biology company that developed a Fully Enzymatic Synthesis (FES) platform for de novo DNA production, using enzymatic chemistry to synthesize longer (up to ~400 base), higher-purity oligonucleotides faster than traditional phosphoramidite methods, targeting next-generation sequencing, gene synthesis, diagnostics, and therapeutics markets. Originally a DCVC-backed startup, the company's assets and intellectual property were acquired by Maravai LifeSciences, and its enzymatic DNA synthesis technology is now part of TriLink BioTechnologies. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable developer surface; its former molecularassemblies.com domain now redirects to TriLink BioTechnologies.

providers.name: Molecular Stethoscope
providers.description: Molecular Stethoscope (now operating as Superfluid Dx, Inc.) is a South San Francisco clinical-stage diagnostics company developing minimally invasive blood tests for neurodegenerative disease. Its cell-free messenger RNA (cf-mRNA) liquid-biopsy platform aims to detect Alzheimer's disease at early stages from a routine blood draw, as an alternative to spinal taps and brain imaging. Surfaced as a portfolio company of dcvc and added to the API Evangelist network. As a clinical diagnostics R&D company it publishes no public developer API, documentation, or technical platform; this profile is maintained for network completeness rather than API discovery.

providers.name: Momentus
providers.description: Momentus is a U.S.-based commercial space company providing in-space transportation and infrastructure services. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in San Jose, California, the publicly traded company (NASDAQ: MNTS) designs, manufactures, and operates Orbital Service Vehicles such as its Vigoride platform, using water plasma propulsion technology to move satellites and payloads between orbits, host payloads, and deliver last-mile satellite deployment. Momentus serves private satellite operators, government agencies, and research institutions. As of this profile it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDK, or technical integration surface; it was surfaced as a Y Combinator (S18) portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: MRC Global
providers.description: MRC Global is the largest global distributor of pipe, valve, and fitting products and services to the energy and industrial markets.

providers.name: MycoMedica
providers.description: MycoMedica Life Sciences, PBC is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded by mycologist Paul Stamets and backed by Obvious Ventures, True Ventures, and Kittyhawk Ventures. The company develops fungi-derived therapeutic drugs, including its lead psilocybin candidate MLS101 and the "Stamets Stack" (a novel blend of niacin, psilocybin, and lion's mane), for the prevention and treatment of psychiatric and neurological disorders. It raised $60 million in Series A funding in 2022 and is advancing pre-clinical and clinical research toward FDA approval. MycoMedica is a life-sciences drug-development company and publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: MycroFriends
providers.description: MycroFriends is a consumer health and wellness company that helps people become healthier through education and coaching centered on the connection between the human microbiome, nutrition, and overall health. Founded by George Cigale (previously founder of the online tutoring company Tutor.com) and headquartered in New York City, the company launched via a 2017 crowdfunding campaign and works with scientists, physicians, dietitians, and technologists to deliver microbiome education, personalized nutritional and lifestyle guidance, and access to expert health coaches. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta. As of this enrichment pass MycroFriends publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable API surface, and its former website resolves only to a default (unconfigured) Azure App Service host.

providers.name: National Cardiovascular Partners (Fresenius Medical Care)
providers.description: National Cardiovascular Partners (NCP) is a Fresenius Medical Care company that partners with physician entrepreneurs to create, sustain and grow independent, outpatient cardiac catheterization and vascular labs. Headquartered in Edina, Minnesota with operations in Houston, Texas, NCP manages the full development lifecycle of outpatient hybrid cardiovascular facilities in which physicians serve as majority stakeholders. It is a physical healthcare services operator: it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or webhooks, and its official domain (ncplp.com) is a registrar-parked defensive domain rather than an active site. Parent company Fresenius Medical Care likewise offers no public developer API. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bain Capital Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: National Laboratories
providers.description: The U.S. Department of Energy's national laboratories are a network of federally funded research and development centers conducting cutting-edge research in energy, science, and national security.

providers.name: Neumora
providers.description: Neumora Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company pioneering a new era of precision medicines to restore brain health and wellbeing. It develops therapeutics for brain diseases and neuropsychiatric conditions, applying a precision-medicine approach to neuroscience drug discovery and development. Neumora was surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead backed by SoftBank Vision Fund. As a therapeutics company it maintains a corporate and investor web presence but exposes no public developer API, SDK, CLI, or documentation surface: probing its domain for /.well-known/ discovery documents, an OpenAPI/Swagger spec, an llms.txt, and developer/docs paths returned no machine-readable API surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: NewMarket
providers.description: NewMarket Corporation (NYSE: NEU) is a publicly traded specialty chemicals holding company headquartered in Richmond, Virginia. Through subsidiaries Afton Chemical and Ethyl Corporation, NewMarket develops petroleum additives for fuels and lubricants used worldwide.

providers.name: NewsGuard
providers.description: NewsGuard provides transparent reliability ratings for news and information sources, helping users identify trustworthy content and avoid misinformation. Their platform offers AI‑driven tools, false‑claim fingerprints, and comprehensive dashboards for media outlets, advertisers, and researchers. By combining human expertise with automated analysis, NewsGuard aims to improve media literacy and combat disinformation across digital platforms.

providers.name: Nextcure
providers.description: NextCure, Inc. (NASDAQ NXTC) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on discovering and developing novel immunomedicines to treat cancer and other immune-related diseases. The company uses its FIND-IO platform to identify and characterize immunomodulatory targets and biological pathways, advancing a pipeline of immunotherapy drug candidates. NextCure surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of canaan-partners. Enrichment probe (2026-07-20) found no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal; this is a biopharmaceutical R&D organization with no programmatic API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Nok Nok Labs
providers.description: Nok Nok Labs is a passwordless and strong authentication vendor and a founding member of the FIDO Alliance, known for the Nok Nok S3 Authentication Suite that lets enterprises deploy FIDO-based (UAF/U2F/FIDO2/passkey) multi-factor and passwordless authentication across mobile and web. Its offering is an enterprise, server-side authentication platform sold to banks, telcos, and large organizations rather than a self-serve public API product. As of this enrichment pass the company has no independent public developer portal: the noknok.com domain (every path probed) 301-redirects to OneSpan's security platform at onespan.com/security, indicating its web presence has been consolidated under OneSpan. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of DCM Ventures.

providers.name: Noodle Labs
providers.description: Noodle Labs is an operational consulting firm founded by Jennifer Dennard and Jean Hsu that embeds experienced startup operators with early-stage teams to extend their leadership. Positioned as "operators, not advisors," the firm offers Strategic Operations and Engineering Leadership engagements that give founders senior leadership impact without the overhead of a full-time VP hire. It is a services business rather than a software or API provider; no developer portal, SDK, API, or technical documentation is published. Surfaced as an a16z portfolio lead and added to the API Evangelist network; the enrichment pass confirmed no API surface exists.

providers.name: Normunity
providers.description: Normunity is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing novel anti-cancer therapies that work at the interface of the immune system and the tumor. In collaboration with the Lieping Chen lab at the Yale School of Medicine, Normunity has identified a novel class of "Immuno-smart targets" — tumor-specific, cell-surface proteins co-opted by cancer cells to drive local immune suppression — and is building a pipeline of biologic medicines including therapeutic antibodies, bispecific antibodies, and payload-carrying biologics. Its lead program, NRM-823, is a T cell engager that has entered clinical trials. Normunity is backed by Canaan Partners. This is a corporate/scientific company with no public API, developer portal, or programmatic surface.

providers.name: Nosh Bio
providers.description: Nosh.bio is a Berlin-based sustainable food-technology company founded in 2022 by Tim Fronzek and Felipe Lino that produces nutritional, highly functional proteins from non-GMO fungi via proprietary precision fermentation. Its flagship Koji Protein and Koji-Beef mince hybrid are mycelium-derived, clean-label mycoprotein ingredients with binding, gelling and texturizing properties, sold B2B to manufacturers across meat alternatives, seafood, dairy, sauces, confectionery, wellness and pet food. The company is a foodtech portfolio company of Earlybird Venture Capital and closed a EUR 3.2M seed round. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Nosh.bio publishes no developer API, SDK, developer portal, or technical integration surface at this time.

providers.name: Nova Metrix
providers.description: Nova Metrix is a geotechnical, environmental, and materials-testing instrumentation company headquartered in Wakefield, Massachusetts and founded in 2009. It designs and manufactures sensors, instruments, monitoring software, and consumables for structural-health monitoring, construction, civil engineering, energy, and medical markets, operating in more than 90 countries. Nova Metrix is the parent of a family of specialist geotechnical and fiber-optic brands including Roctest, Sensornet, Sherborne Sensors, Soil Instruments, Westbay Instruments, DGSI, Waterloo Hydrogeologic, and Van Essen Instruments. It is backed by Battery Ventures, Commonwealth Capital, and Ascent Venture Partners. As of this enrichment pass Nova Metrix publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts; this profile carries verified company identity rather than an API surface.

providers.name: novamab
providers.description: Novamab (洛启生物) is a Shanghai-based clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company specializing in VHH (nanobody) antibody drug development for respiratory and inflammatory diseases such as asthma, COPD, and IBD. Its platforms span inhaled antibodies, oral antibodies, and dual/multi-specific antibodies alongside integrated drug formulation and manufacturing. Surfaced as a portfolio company of qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub; enrichment confirmed the company publishes a corporate website but no developer API, documentation portal, SDKs, or other machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Novast Laboratories
providers.description: Novast Laboratories is a pharmaceutical development and manufacturing company (CDMO) headquartered in Nantong, Jiangsu Province, China, founded in 2005 by Dr. Guohua Zhang and a multinational management team. Novast specializes in high-barrier, difficult-to-formulate generic and specialty pharmaceuticals, including ultra-low-dose hormonal and extended- / modified-release oral products built on proprietary drug-delivery technologies. It is noted as one of the first China-based pharmaceutical companies to gain U.S. FDA approval for finished drug products marketed in the United States, and provides contract development and manufacturing services to generic and innovator companies. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Novast is a physical pharmaceutical manufacturer and publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Novome
providers.description: Novome Biotechnologies is a DCVC-backed biotechnology company based in South San Francisco developing genetically engineered microbial medicines (GEMMs) - live bacterial therapeutics designed to colonize the gut and treat chronic conditions such as enteric hyperoxaluria and other GI and metabolic diseases. As a therapeutics developer, Novome is a research-and-drug-development organization rather than a software or API provider; the enrichment pass found no public developer, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Nvp
providers.description: nvp.com is not a distinct portfolio company: it redirects (HTTP 200 final) to www.norwest.com, the website of Norwest Venture Partners (NVP), the same venture capital firm listed as this stub's backer. This entry was auto-created from a VC portfolio harvest where the abbreviation "NVP" was mistaken for a separate company. Norwest is a venture and growth-equity investment firm, not an API producer. Enrichment probing on 2026-07-20 found no public developer surface on either host: /developer, /developers, /api, /docs, /.well-known/security.txt, and /.well-known/openid-configuration all return 404, and there is no OpenAPI, SDK, MCP, or documentation to enrich. No artifacts were generated (no fabrication); the honest result is that this company has no API surface and duplicates the norwest-venture-partners network entry.

providers.name: OFF
providers.description: OFF (Off-Live, off.live) is an enterprise AI software company building intelligent applications that help organizations streamline, innovate, and grow. Its products include AiVee, a smart scheduling assistant that uses computer vision to turn calendar images into digital events and manage invitations across popular calendar apps, and Pumky, a text-to-image generation platform with customizable artistic styles for both beginners and professionals. The company builds on computer vision, multilingual large language models, and domain-specialized AI models. Backed by Coinbase Ventures, Samsung Next, and Electric Capital. Surfaced as a portfolio company of electric-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Olix
providers.description: Olix (OLIX Computing) is a stealth-stage hardware company building a new computing architecture that integrates SRAM with photonics to address the computational bottlenecks of large-scale AI deployment. The company positions its SRAM-plus-photonics design to surpass HBM-based architectures on throughput-per-megawatt and total cost of ownership while outperforming silicon-only alternatives on speed and latency as frontier-model demand compounds faster than today's infrastructure can scale. Backed by Creandum, Olix is currently pre-product and hiring across the US and UK; it publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or documentation at this time. This profile was surfaced as a Creandum portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead.

providers.name: Omvana
providers.description: Omvana was a meditation and personal-growth audio app developed by Mindvalley, offering guided meditations, ambient soundscapes, and mixable audio tracks for daily mindfulness practice. The standalone Omvana product has since been folded into Mindvalley; omvana.com now permanently redirects (HTTP 308) to mindvalley.com/free-meditations. No public developer, API, or partner surface is published for Omvana or the successor free-meditations offering.

providers.name: Onkos Surgical
providers.description: Onkos Surgical is a privately held surgical oncology company founded in 2015 and headquartered in Parsippany, New Jersey, focused on innovative solutions for musculoskeletal oncology and complex orthopaedic procedures. Built on a digital platform grounded in patient imaging analysis, personalized surgical planning and advanced 3D printing, Onkos develops limb salvage systems, My3D personalized solutions, uDesign on-demand personalized surgical plans, and antibacterial-coated implants for tumor and revision orthopaedic applications. The company received the first FDA De Novo approval of an antibacterial coating for tumor and revision orthopaedic implants. Onkos does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer portal; its public surfaces are the corporate website, a product Instructions-for-Use (IFU) documentation library, and a surgeon training portal.

providers.name: Oratomic
providers.description: Oratomic is a Pasadena, California quantum computing company where leading researchers from Caltech and Harvard are building utility-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computers with neutral atoms and optical systems. Launched from stealth in March 2026, the company advances quantum error correction with the aim of making practical, cryptographically relevant quantum computation possible with far fewer qubits than previously believed (on the order of ~10,000 reconfigurable atomic qubits rather than millions). Oratomic is a deep-tech hardware and research organization; at this time it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or programmatic access surface.

providers.name: Orbital Therapeutics
providers.description: Orbital Therapeutics was a Cambridge, Massachusetts biotechnology company developing next-generation RNA medicines, combining circular and linear RNA, targeted delivery, and AI-guided design across immunomodulation, in vivo CAR-T cell therapy, next-generation vaccines, and protein therapeutics. Its lead program, OTX-201, targeted autoimmune disease through B-cell depletion. Founded out of Beam Therapeutics and backed by ARCH Venture Partners, a16z Bio + Health, and Newpath Partners, the company raised a $270M Series A in 2023. In October 2025 Bristol Myers Squibb agreed to acquire Orbital Therapeutics for $1.5 billion; orbitaltx.com now redirects to bms.com. As a therapeutics developer, Orbital publishes no public developer platform, API, or machine-readable API surface, so this record is an identity-only profile in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: PACCAR
providers.description: PACCAR is a global technology leader in the design, manufacture, and customer support of premium light, medium, and heavy-duty trucks under the Kenworth, Peterbilt, and DAF nameplates. PACCAR also designs and manufactures advanced diesel engines, provides financial services and information technology, and distributes truck parts related to its principal business.

providers.name: Packworks
providers.description: Packworks is a Philippine business-to-business technology company empowering micro-entrepreneurs through connected commerce. Its Sari IQ platform gives sari-sari store owners and other micro-retailers an integrated mobile, web, and chat-based toolkit for inventory management, bookkeeping, sales analytics, credit (utang) tracking, deliveries and collections, loyalty programs, and financial literacy. Backed by Techstars, Packworks operates as an end-user SaaS platform for neighborhood retail and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, well-known discovery surface, or integration program.

providers.name: Pallando Therapeutics
providers.description: Pallando Therapeutics is an early-stage biotechnology company developing next-generation targeted protein degraders with an emphasis on precision targeting, under the tagline "Intelligent Degradation, Innovative Therapies." It was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this profile its public website (pallandotx.com) is a coming-soon placeholder and it publishes no developer API, documentation, SDKs, or other technical surface for the enrichment pipeline to harvest.

providers.name: Parla
providers.description: Parla (originally launched as Adia) was a London-based digital reproductive-health startup that gave women access to at-home fertility blood tests, an AI-enabled fertility platform, educational content, and an expert-led peer community around conception, pregnancy, and loss. Backed by Seedcamp, Zinc VC, and other UK investors, Parla was acquired by Holland & Barrett International in April 2022; the myparla.com domain now redirects to hollandandbarrett.com and the company operates no independent public API, developer portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Party City Holdings
providers.description: Party City Holdings is a global party goods retailer offering an extensive assortment of party supplies, party goods, and Halloween costumes through retail stores and online. No public developer API has been identified at this time.

providers.name: Patient IO
providers.description: Patient IO (legal entity Filament Labs, Inc.) was an Austin, Texas care coordination and patient engagement platform founded in 2013 by Jason Bornhorst, Colin Anawaty, and Brian Gambs out of the Techstars Austin accelerator. Its API-first mobile platform connected health systems with patients between visits to support the transition to value-based care. athenahealth acquired Patient IO in August 2016 and its architecture became the foundation of athenahealth's patient-facing athenawell application. The standalone product, developer program, and public API surface have since been retired; patientio.com now serves only a placeholder page and its mail is handled by athenahealth.

providers.name: Peltarion
providers.description: Peltarion is a Swedish AI platform company that provides tools for building, deploying, and scaling deep learning models. It offers a collaborative environment for data scientists and developers to create AI applications without extensive coding. The platform includes model training, versioning, monitoring, and integration capabilities, targeting enterprises seeking to operationalize AI. Peltarion aims to democratize AI by simplifying complex workflows and providing cloud-based resources for rapid development and deployment of machine learning solutions.

providers.name: Peninsula Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Peninsula Pharmaceuticals is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of canaan-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Penn Mutual Life Insurance
providers.description: Penn Mutual Life Insurance is a mutual life insurance company providing life insurance, annuities, and investment products to individuals and businesses. No public APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: Penske Automotive
providers.description: Penske Automotive Group is a Fortune 500 diversified international transportation services company that operates automotive and commercial truck dealerships principally in the United States, Canada, and Western Europe. No public APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: Periodic Labs
providers.description: Periodic Labs builds AI scientists and autonomous laboratories to accelerate discovery in the physical sciences. Its systems formulate hypotheses, run real-world experiments in self-driving labs, and learn from the results, targeting materials design and the search for higher-temperature superconductors, and helping industrial partners such as semiconductor manufacturers analyze experimental data to iterate faster. The company is backed by Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners and SV Angel. As of this profile Periodic Labs publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface; this record captures its identity for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Ping An Good Doctor
providers.description: Ping An Good Doctor (Ping An Healthcare and Technology Company Limited, since rebranded Ping An Health, HKEX: 1833) is the online-healthcare arm of China's Ping An Insurance Group and one of the country's largest one-stop online healthcare platforms. Through its consumer app it offers online medical consultations delivered by an in-house medical team and AI triage, family-doctor memberships, a health mall for pharmaceutical and wellness e-commerce, and health-management and chronic-disease services. The platform serves individual consumers as well as enterprise and financial channels across China. As surfaced to the API Evangelist network it is a consumer/enterprise app business with no public developer API program: enrichment found no developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or open-platform documentation, and the historical corporate domain (pahtg.com) now resolves to a parked landing page.

providers.name: Playbrush
providers.description: Playbrush is a consumer oral-care technology brand that makes smart, gamified electric and sonic toothbrushes for children (ages 3+), pairing a Bluetooth-connected brush with a companion mobile app that turns brushing into interactive games and coaching to build good dental-hygiene habits. Founded as a UK/Austria startup and backed by Speedinvest, the Playbrush product line has since been acquired by SUNSTAR and is now sold under the GUM Playbrush brand; the former playbrush.com domain 302-redirects to a Sunstar GUM product page. Playbrush is a hardware/consumer-app company and exposes no public developer portal, API, specification, or /.well-known/ discovery surface. This profile was surfaced as a Speedinvest portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead; enrichment confirmed there is no API surface.

providers.name: PlusDental
providers.description: PlusDental was a Berlin-based direct-to-consumer orthodontic company offering clear dental aligners ("Zahnschiene") for teeth straightening, backed by HV Capital. The brand has since been migrated to DR SMILE (operated by Sunshine Smile GmbH); plusdental.com now serves a handover notice redirecting customers to DR SMILE customer service. This is a consumer healthcare service with no public developer program, API, SDKs, or technical integration surface. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; the enrichment pipeline confirmed no API artifacts exist.

providers.name: Pozen
providers.description: POZEN Inc. was a specialty pharmaceutical company headquartered in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, founded in 1996 and focused on developing therapeutics for pain and pain-related conditions, most notably acute migraine. It was best known for the products Treximet (sumatriptan/naproxen) and Vimovo (naproxen/esomeprazole). POZEN traded publicly on NASDAQ under the ticker POZN and in 2016 combined with Tribute Pharmaceuticals to form Aralez Pharmaceuticals. Pozen was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. As a pharmaceutical company it operated no public developer program, API, or SDK surface; an enrichment pass confirmed no API artifacts exist to harvest.

providers.name: Primus Senior Living
providers.description: Primus Senior Living is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of general-catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Process Sensing Technologies
providers.description: Process Sensing Technologies (PST) is a measurement instrumentation group that designs and manufactures precision sensors and analyzers for moisture, humidity, dew point, oxygen, and trace gas measurement across industrial, pharmaceutical, food, and life-science applications. Its brand portfolio includes Michell Instruments, Rotronic, Analytical Industries, Ntron, SensoScientific, and Isensix, spanning process gas analysis and real-time environmental monitoring. The company now operates under the DwyerOmega brand following its combination with Dwyer Instruments. It was surfaced as a Battery Ventures portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; probing of its public web surface found hardware, software downloads, calibration tooling, and monitoring platforms but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation portal.

providers.name: Protent
providers.description: Protent is a San Francisco based Y Combinator (Winter 2026) startup building a real-time video intelligence platform for law enforcement and public safety teams. Its software monitors many live surveillance, CCTV, and bodycam feeds at once, automatically prioritizing critical streams when escalation or volatility is detected, and lets teams run natural-language searches across active feeds (for example, "a person in a red hoodie with a backpack"). Founded in 2025 by Srihan Balaji (ex-Lockheed Martin Research, AWS) and Abhisheik Sharma (CTO, NLP/sentiment analysis), the company works with police departments in the Atlanta, Chicago, and St. Louis metro areas. As of this profile, Protent publishes a marketing website only and exposes no public API, developer documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Real
providers.description: Real is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of insight-partners, lightspeed-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Relish
providers.description: Relish is a consumer product operated at hellorelish.com and backed by Bullpen Capital, added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead. Live enrichment probing found the marketing site sitting behind a bot/captcha challenge and marked noindex, with no developer, API, or documentation subdomains resolving, no first-party GitHub organization, no published SDK packages, and no machine-readable well-known files. No public API surface was discovered during enrichment; the only verified technical artifact is a domain-security posture probe (TLS 1.3, SPF and DMARC present, no HSTS/DNSSEC/CAA records).

providers.name: Restless
providers.description: Restless is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of qed-investors and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: fintech. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Revivant
providers.description: Revivant is a medical device company that develops and markets proprietary technology to treat cardiac arrest, backed by Canaan Partners at the Series D stage (Canaan partner Brent Ahrens). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Enrichment research found no live company website (the revivant.com domain is parked/for-sale via Sedo and no revivant.io/.ai variants resolve), no developer portal, and no public API, SDK, or documentation surface — as a medical-device manufacturer Revivant exposes no programmable API. This profile is retained as an identity-only lead with no API surface to score.

providers.name: Rf Surgical
providers.description: Rf Surgical (RF Surgical Systems) was a medical-device company in the surgical patient-safety space, known for radio-frequency detection technology used to locate retained surgical items such as sponges and gauze during and after operations. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of menlo-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. Enrichment probing (2026-07-21) found no independent developer surface: the rfsurgical.com domain no longer resolves to a company site and is parked for sale (HugeDomains), consistent with the company having been absorbed into a larger medical-device parent. There is no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, package, MCP server, or documentation to harvest, so no supply-side API artifacts were generated. This profile carries identity metadata only.

providers.name: RhyGaze
providers.description: RhyGaze is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing gene therapy treatments to restore vision for people with retinal degenerative diseases. Its platform combines optogenetic proteins that engineer photosensitivity into mammalian cells with gene therapy delivery tools that install light-sensing machinery into human eye cells, technology originating at the Institute of Molecular and Clinical Ophthalmology Basel (IOB) in Switzerland. The team includes executives who helped develop and commercialize Luxturna, the first FDA-approved gene therapy for a genetic disease. RhyGaze operates from Basel, Switzerland and Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and is backed by GV. As a therapeutics company it publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Ricerca Biosciences
providers.description: Ricerca Biosciences is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: healthcare. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Roclub
providers.description: roclub (roclub GmbH) is a German health-tech company operating a remote-control platform for diagnostic medical imaging. Its software lets healthcare organizations perform MRI and CT examinations remotely ("Remote Scanning") and support on-site technicians from anywhere ("Remote Support"), with real-time screen sharing and device control across multi-vendor scanners (Siemens, Philips, GE, Canon). roclub also runs a marketplace of qualified medical technologists ("rocStars") who can be booked on demand, together with session documentation, scheduling, and built-in liability insurance ("roCover"). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API documentation was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Rooster
providers.description: Rooster is a subscription mobile reading app built by Plympton, Inc., a literary studio co-founded by Jennifer 8. Lee, Yael Goldstein Love, and Jacky Chang. Rooster delivers serialized fiction to readers' phones in short, commute-sized installments for a flat monthly fee, drawing on Plympton's DailyLit heritage of serialized reading. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. Rooster is a consumer-facing app; Plympton publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or webhook surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: RXO
providers.description: RXO is a freight and logistics platform that connects shippers and carriers across truckload, less-than-truckload, managed transportation, and last-mile delivery. The company operates RXO Connect, a digital freight platform that uses machine learning and AI across a network of approximately 150,000 independent carriers. RXO does not currently publish a public developer API portal on its corporate website.

providers.name: Scoop
providers.description: Scoop (Scoop Technologies, Inc.) is a San Francisco based future-of-work company backed by Index Ventures whose Scoop for Work product is a hybrid-work scheduling assistant. It plugs into employees existing calendar and Slack so teams can coordinate great in-office days, sync schedules, and see who will be in, while giving HR and workplace leaders analytics on office usage and hybrid work trends. Originally launched in 2015 as a carpool/commute service (takescoop.com), the company pivoted to hybrid workplace coordination. Note: as of this enrichment pass the product domain scoopforwork.com returns HTTP 410 Gone with a broken TLS certificate, and the legacy takescoop.com domain is parked for sale; no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface could be found.

providers.name: Seek AI
providers.description: Seek AI was a New York City generative-AI enterprise data analytics company, backed by Battery Ventures, that built a conversational analytics agent letting business users query enterprise data in natural language and receive trustworthy answers (translating plain-language questions into SQL and narrative results over a company's own databases and warehouses). In 2025 Seek AI was acquired by IBM and folded into IBM watsonx AI Labs, a developer-first agentic-AI innovation hub in New York City; the company no longer operates an independent product, developer program, or public API. Its former developer subdomain (developers.seek.ai) now redirects to IBM's watsonx AI Labs, and the standalone seek.ai marketing site is no longer served. This API Evangelist profile records Seek AI as an acquired portfolio company and carries no live API surface to enrich.

providers.name: Semnur Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Semnur Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing non-opioid pain-management therapies. Its lead program, SP-102 (SEMDEXA), is a novel, non-opioid, preservative-free and particulate-free injectable corticosteroid gel formulation intended to treat moderate-to-severe chronic radicular pain (sciatica). Semnur is a subsidiary of Scilex Holding Company and is headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, California. As a pharmaceutical R&D company it publishes a corporate website, investor presentation, and scientific publications, but exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Shanghai Desano Pharmaceutical Group
providers.description: Shanghai Desano Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese pharmaceutical company established in 1996 and headquartered in Shanghai's Zhangjiang High-Tech Park. It develops and commercializes medications addressing global public health needs, specializing in anti-AIDS (antiretroviral) and anti-malaria drugs, steroid hormone drugs, and nucleic acid drugs, with operations spanning R&D, manufacturing, regulatory registration, and international distribution across multiple production bases in Shanghai, Jiangsu, and Jiangxi. Note: in this company's domain "API" means Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (drug chemistry), not a web/developer API. Desano publishes no developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, developer portal, or other machine-readable API surface, so the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline has no technical artifacts to produce for this provider. It was surfaced as a false-positive lead from the Qiming venture portfolio.

providers.name: Shulan Health
providers.description: Shulan Health (树兰医疗 / Shulan Medical Management Group) is a Hangzhou-based private healthcare group founded in 2014 by academicians Li Lanjuan and Zheng Shusen. It integrates hospital services, life-science research, medical education, and incubation investment, owning and operating comprehensive medical institutions and providing hospital-management services to partner hospitals across China. Services include rehabilitation, nutrition, health examinations, regional medical imaging, and remote consultation. Its information systems are built internally by subsidiary Huazhuo Technology on a self-developed RubikStack hybrid-cloud platform; the group publishes no public developer portal or API. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead.

providers.name: Shurpa
providers.description: Shurpa was a healthcare logistics startup and a Techstars 2019 portfolio company, building a medical transportation management software platform focused on the population health and managed care space (AI-enabled coordination of non-emergency medical transportation and in-home healthcare services). The company raised roughly $220K across two seed rounds and has no visible operations today: the shurpa.com domain now returns HTTP 404 across all paths and is parked on CSC/UltraDNS nameservers, and no developer portal, documentation, API, OpenAPI, or .well-known surface could be found during enrichment. This profile is retained as an identity record for a dormant/defunct provider with no discoverable API surface.

providers.name: Silicon Therapeutics
providers.description: Silicon Therapeutics was a Boston-based biotechnology company that built an integrated, physics-based drug-discovery platform combining quantum mechanics, molecular simulation, and machine learning to design small-molecule medicines against historically intractable targets. Founded in 2015, it was acquired by Roivant Sciences in 2021 to form the basis of Roivant's computational discovery engine; its former site (silicontx.com) now redirects to roivant.com. The company is a computational drug-discovery firm with no public API, developer platform, SDK, or technical documentation.

providers.name: Silk Road Medical
providers.description: Silk Road Medical is a medical device company (Plymouth, Minnesota) that pioneered TransCarotid Artery Revascularization (TCAR), a minimally invasive procedure for treating carotid artery disease and reducing stroke risk. Its enRoute Transcarotid Neuroprotection System and enRoute Transcarotid Stent are physician-use devices, not a software or platform product. The company is now part of Boston Scientific. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of norwest-venture-partners; research finds no developer portal, public API, SDK, or machine-readable interface, so this remains a company profile rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Simple Love Yogurt
providers.description: Simple Love (简爱酸奶) is a Chinese natural yogurt brand operated by Pucheng Dairy (Group) Co., Ltd. (朴诚乳业), founded in 2016. Known for zero-additive, low-temperature fresh yogurts with short ingredient lists — including its no-sugar, probiotic, high-protein, and coconut lines — the brand is distributed across supermarket shelves in every Chinese province and operates its own manufacturing capacity in Hebei. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. As a consumer packaged-goods (CPG) dairy company it publishes a corporate/consumer website but no public developer, API, or programmatic surface.

providers.name: Sirtris Pharmaceuticals
providers.description: Sirtris Pharmaceuticals is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: biotech. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Skinseoul Lab
providers.description: Skinseoul Lab operates skin-seoul.com, a direct-to-consumer Korean beauty (K-beauty) e-commerce brand selling skincare and cosmetics to international customers, backed by 500 Global. Its public presence is a Next.js storefront fronted by Cloudflare with an Express commerce backend; enrichment probing (2026-07-21) found no public developer API, documentation, developer portal, or /.well-known/ discovery surface. The api.skin-seoul.com host returns only a plaintext "OK" health response, indicating an internal storefront backend rather than a documented public API.

providers.name: Socrates
providers.description: Socrates (socrates.ai) was an AI-powered virtual employee assistant that answered day-to-day employee questions across HR, IT, and workplace services. It has been acquired by Simpplr and is no longer a standalone product: the socrates.ai domain now redirects to simpplr.com/socrates-ai/ and the technology ships as the Simpplr "AI Assistant" within their employee experience platform. No independent Socrates developer portal, API reference, or public API surface exists; developer resources, if any, live under Simpplr. This profile is retained as an acquired-company record surfaced from the Norwest Venture Partners portfolio.

providers.name: Soff
providers.description: Soff is an AI-powered quoting platform for U.S. distributors that turns inbound RFQs into won deals. It automatically captures requests for quotes from email, generates instant quotes and PDFs, tracks quote performance (won vs. lost), logs activity into ERP/CRM systems, and analyzes customer behavior and lost-deal reasons. Backed by Y Combinator (S24) and General Catalyst, based in San Francisco, and SOC 2 Type II certified. As of this enrichment pass Soff publishes no public developer API, documentation portal, or well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Software Applications Incorporated
providers.description: Software Applications Incorporated is an AI‑focused software startup that builds innovative applications such as the Sky natural‑language interface for macOS. Founded by former Apple engineers, it was acquired by OpenAI in 2025, expanding OpenAI’s desktop AI capabilities. The company offers a suite of automation tools for businesses and individuals, integrating deep data and application workflows.

providers.name: Standard AI
providers.description: Standard AI, formerly Standard Cognition, is a computer-vision company that builds AI-powered autonomous (checkout-free) shopping technology for physical retail. Using ceiling-mounted cameras and machine-learning models, its platform lets shoppers pick up items and walk out without scanning or waiting in line, while giving retailers real-time inventory and shopper analytics. The company is backed by CRV, EQT Ventures, SoftBank Vision Fund and SV Angel, and maintains a public open-source organization on GitHub. Standard AI does not publish a public developer API, and its main website is served behind a bot-challenge gateway.

providers.name: StructionSite
providers.description: StructionSite was a construction-technology company providing jobsite reality-capture and progress-documentation software (360-degree walkthrough video and photo documentation of construction sites, tied to project plans). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass the standalone StructionSite brand has been absorbed by its acquirer DroneDeploy - structionsite.com, www.structionsite.com, and api.structionsite.com all HTTP 301-redirect to www.dronedeploy.com. No independent StructionSite developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, package, or /.well-known discovery surface could be found; any API surface now lives under the DroneDeploy brand.

providers.name: Sunshine Lake Pharma
providers.description: Sunshine Lake Pharma (Guangdong East Sunshine Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., also known as HEC Pharm) is a Chinese pharmaceutical company established in 2003 and part of the Dongyangguang (HEC) Group. It engages in drug research, development, production, and commercialization across innovative drugs, improved formulations, generics, and biosimilars, focused on infections, chronic diseases, and oncology. Notable products include oseltamivir phosphate (influenza), sofosbuvir-based hepatitis C therapy, and insulin glargine (diabetes). It is a manufacturer with no public developer or API surface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Super Sports Media
providers.description: Super Sports Media Group is an IDG Capital-backed Chinese sports-media company best known for holding the English Premier League broadcast rights in mainland China and operating consumer sports streaming and content services under the ssports.com brand. Its platform was subsequently absorbed into iQiyi Sports (爱奇艺体育), and ssports.com now redirects there. This is a business-to-consumer sports streaming and media-rights operation with no public developer program: no API documentation, developer portal, SDKs, OpenAPI, or open platform surface could be found during enrichment. Profile retained as a network company record.

providers.name: Surtr Defense Systems
providers.description: Surtr Defense Systems is a Y Combinator-backed defense technology company building ParallaxOS, an open operating system for counter-UAS (counter-drone) command-and-control. Surtr positions itself outside the incumbent C2 tension by not competing with hardware partners on contracts and not monetizing partner data: hardware partners decide what data the platform sees, customers decide what data is kept, and every byte is visible to partners and customers in real time. ParallaxOS ingests any sensor (radar, RF, EO/IR, acoustic) over open defense-interoperability standards such as NATO SAPIENT, Link 16, Cursor on Target, and ATAK; tasks any compatible kinetic, EW, or directed-energy effector with human-in-the-loop authorization on every engagement; and performs multi-sensor fusion, autonomous track correlation, and AI threat classification at millisecond latency on the tactical edge. Customer data, integration code, and decisions remain the customer's, deployed on-prem or in GovCloud. Founded by Anshul Ahluwalia (CEO, ex-Shield AI) and Cameron Fiore (CTO, ex-Anduril, ex-Shield AI). Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; no public developer API surface is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Syntax Bio
providers.description: Syntax Bio is a synthetic biology company programming the next generation of cell therapies. Its proprietary Cellgorithm platform uses a CRISPR-based system to program and accelerate stem cell differentiation, replacing slow, labor-intensive processes with a rapid, programmable approach that mimics human development to generate diverse functional cell types at scale. The company is advancing pancreatic beta cell therapy for type 1 diabetes and is backed by DCVC Bio, Astellas Venture Management, Illumina Ventures, and others. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of dcvc; enrichment found no public API, developer portal, SDK, or programmatic developer surface as of this pass.

providers.name: Tailored Brands
providers.description: Tailored Brands is a leading specialty retailer of menswear operating the Men's Wearhouse, Jos. A. Bank, K&G Superstores, Moores Clothing for Men, and Joseph Abboud brands. The company operates over 1,000 retail locations across North America and e-commerce platforms at menswearhouse.com, josbank.com, and kgstores.com. Tailored Brands is preparing for an IPO in 2026 following its 2020 restructuring. No public developer API is currently available.

providers.name: Talentpluto
providers.description: Talentpluto (Pluto) is an AI voice-agent platform for professional discovery and recruitment, founded in 2025 and part of Y Combinator's Summer 2026 batch out of New York City. Professionals talk to Pluto for about ten minutes about what they have done, what they are great at, and what they want next; Pluto turns that private conversation into a discoverable professional profile that the person controls and that can be shared with people and AI agents. For hiring, companies describe what they need and Pluto searches its network and the broader market, evaluates fit on both sides, privately confirms interest, and facilitates warm introductions when there is mutual alignment. The company positions Pluto as a source of truth for career context in an internet increasingly built for agents. As of profiling it is a consumer- and recruiter-facing product with no public developer API, SDK, documentation portal, or other machine-facing surface; this profile is a network stub awaiting a real API surface to enrich.

providers.name: TastyUrban
providers.description: TastyUrban is a Berlin-based virtual restaurant franchise and digital-first food-brand licensing company founded in 2022 by Felix Chrobog, Marc Hansell, and Gerry Pidgeon (alumni of Gorillas, Tier, and Deliveroo). It pursues an asset-light model in which existing restaurants and retail partners license and operate TastyUrban's digital food brands, using otherwise idle kitchen capacity to add revenue without major investment or operational complexity. The company is backed by Earlybird and raised a EUR 1.5M seed round in 2023 and a EUR 6.5M Series A in 2025 (led by IBB Ventures). TastyUrban operates a consumer/partner web presence at tastyurban.com but publishes no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Telcare
providers.description: Telcare was a digital-health company that built the first cellular-enabled blood glucose monitoring (BGM) system: a meter with an embedded cellular module that pushed readings to Telcare's Telserve/Telcloud back end, connected to EMR systems, and paired with companion smartphone apps for people managing diabetes and their caregivers. The brand was acquired into BioTelemetry and is now part of Philips (BioTel Care); the telcare.com domain redirects to Philips ambulatory monitoring, and device-data integration is offered through the third-party Validic health-data platform rather than a first-party public API. Surfaced as a Norwest Venture Partners portfolio lead; enrichment found no first-party developer portal, OpenAPI, or public API surface for the Telcare brand.

providers.name: Teligene
providers.description: Teligene (Suzhou Teligene Biotechnology Co., Ltd.) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2011 in Suzhou, China by Dr. Zhang Dawei, a former chief scientist at Amgen. The company focuses on the design, research and industrialization of innovative small-molecule targeted drugs for oncology, with a pipeline addressing lung cancer, breast cancer, and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. Teligene US LLC is a wholly owned US subsidiary advancing these candidates through clinical development. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as a drug-development biotech it publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Tellgen
providers.description: Shanghai Tellgen Life Sciences Co., Ltd. (Tellgen Corporation) is a Chinese in vitro diagnostics (IVD) company founded in 2003 and headquartered in Shanghai, focused on the research, development, manufacture, and distribution of high-end diagnostic reagents and instruments. Its portfolio spans tumor markers, HPV detection, autoimmune antibodies, infectious disease, thrombosis and reproductive-health assays across flow-fluorescence, chemiluminescence, real-time PCR / molecular, and clinical-chemistry platforms (TESMI analyzer family). The company was listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange ChiNext board in April 2017 (ticker 300642) and counts Qiming Venture Partners among its early investors. Tellgen is a medical-device and laboratory-reagent manufacturer and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Tencent Trusted Doctors
providers.description: Tencent Trusted Doctors (企鹅杏仁) was a Chinese digital-health group formed in August 2018 by merging Tencent's medical unit Tencent Doctorwork (企鹅医生) with the Shanghai doctor platform Trusted Doctors (杏仁医生). It combined an online consultation and doctor-social platform with a network of bricks-and-mortar clinics, connecting roughly 440,000 verified physicians to more than 10 million patients, and reached unicorn valuation on a USD 250M round in April 2019 backed by Tencent and Country Garden Ventures. The company was acquired by Medlinker (医联) with the deal completing 2021-01-01, and the 企鹅杏仁 brand was retired in April 2021 in favour of 未来医生 (Future Doctor). It never published a public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable contract, and its primary domain xingren.com now redirects wholesale to the acquirer.

providers.name: The Pill Club
providers.description: The Pill Club was a US direct-to-consumer telehealth and pharmacy service for birth control and reproductive health, delivering prescription contraception and sexual-health products by mail. The brand has been consolidated into Nurx (a Thirty Madison company): its domain thepillclub.com now 301-redirects to nurx.com. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of GV and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. No public developer, API, or documentation surface was found for either the legacy brand or its Nurx successor; this is a consumer healthcare service with no external API program.

providers.name: The Sentience Company
providers.description: The Sentience Company builds a consumer AI product at sentience.company under the tagline "Build the digital version of you" — a personal AI persona / digital-twin experience where an individual creates and shares a digital version of themselves. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures (sector: ai-apps) and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable API surface, or /.well-known/ discovery documents were found — the site is a client-rendered single-page app that returns identical HTML (soft-404) for every path, so this remains an identity-only lead with no API to catalog.

providers.name: thetab
providers.description: The Tab (thetab.com) is a UK-based digital media and entertainment publication operated by Digitalbox Publishing Ltd (Co Reg No. 09909897). It covers celebrity and reality-TV news, viral trends, gaming, politics, and university and campus culture across a network of youth-focused verticals, monetized primarily through advertising (advertise.thetab.com). Surfaced as a portfolio company of balderton-capital and added to the API Evangelist network. As of the 2026-07-21 enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, /.well-known/ discovery surface, or llms.txt (all probed and returned HTTP 404); this remains an editorial/advertising media property with no developer-facing product.

providers.name: ThirtyFiveBio
providers.description: ThirtyFiveBio is an Oxford, UK biotechnology company founded in 2021 to develop first-in-class small-molecule inhibitors of G protein-coupled receptor 35 (GPR35) for the treatment of gastrointestinal diseases, including ulcerative colitis, inflammatory bowel disease, and digestive-tract cancers. The company was incubated by the M:M Bio (Molecule to Medicine) drug-discovery ecosystem together with Canaan Partners, and is backed by AbbVie Ventures, Mayewell Capital, and Innovate UK. It is a preclinical drug-discovery company with plans for first-in-human trials, not a software or API provider; this profile carries no developer API surface.

providers.name: Thrive Agritech
providers.description: Thrive Agritech is a horticultural lighting company that designs and manufactures high-efficiency LED grow lights and related power systems for commercial indoor farming, greenhouses, and vertical farming operations. Its product line includes fixtures such as Strata, Boost XE, and a 1050W LED grow light, along with a Remote Power System, backed by lighting design services, rebate assistance, and multi-year warranties. The company positions itself around energy efficiency, ROI, and long-term grower partnerships rather than a developer or API offering. Surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network, this profile was enriched by probing the public web surface; no public API, developer portal, documentation, or machine-readable specification was found.

providers.name: Tilray Brands
providers.description: A global lifestyle and consumer packaged goods company operating across cannabis, beverage alcohol, and wellness segments. One of the largest cannabis companies worldwide with cultivation, processing, and distribution operations spanning North America, Europe, and beyond.

providers.name: Titan Machinery
providers.description: Titan Machinery Inc. owns and operates one of the largest networks of full-service agricultural and construction equipment dealer stores in North America and Europe. The company sells, services, and rents new and used Case IH, New Holland, Case Construction, and other branded equipment, along with parts and precision farming technology. Titan Machinery serves farmers, ranchers, and construction contractors across multiple states and countries.

providers.name: Tome Bioscience
providers.description: Tome Biosciences is a genome-editing therapeutics company founded in 2021 and based in Watertown, Massachusetts. It develops programmable genomic integration (PGI) technology that pairs the site-specificity of CRISPR/Cas with integrase enzymes to insert genetic sequences of virtually any size into the genome without relying on double-strand DNA breaks. The company was cofounded by Omar Abudayyeh and Jonathan Gootenberg, formerly of MIT's McGovern Institute, and raised roughly $213M across Series A and B financing led in part by a16z. Its stated programs target integrative gene therapies for monogenic liver diseases and cell therapies for autoimmune conditions. Tome is a biopharmaceutical R&D company with no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface; its documented website (tome.bio) does not currently resolve. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as an a16z portfolio company / enrichment lead rather than an API producer.

providers.name: Topography
providers.description: Topography (Topography Health, Inc.) was a full-stack clinical trials platform that empowered community and private-practice physicians to run clinical drug trials in their local communities across North America, reducing the administrative burden of becoming a clinical trialist. Founded in 2020 by Alexander Saint-Amand, Mac Parish, and Andrew Kirchner and based in New York and Los Angeles, the company launched in January 2022 with $27.5M in funding, including a $21.5M Series A led by Bain Capital Ventures and Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). In 2026 Topography Health's Site Business Unit was acquired by FOMAT Medical Research, and the company's public site is now a single-page acquisition announcement. Topography was a B2B clinical-research SaaS, not a developer-facing API company: no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI, SDKs, or other machine-readable API surface was ever published, and none exists today.

providers.name: Tribes
providers.description: Tribes (Tribes Protocol, Inc.) is a web3-native social wallet and messaging application that lets people co-own and manage digital assets together while communicating directly from within the wallet itself. Its "co-wallets" combine group messaging and shared custody so crypto communities, creators, and DAOs can coordinate and make decisions without relying on external tools like Discord or Twitter. Founded by former Coinbase engineer Hish Bouabdallah, Tribes raised a $3.3M pre-seed round in January 2023 led by Kindred Ventures, with South Park Commons and Script Capital. It is a consumer crypto product; its public code surface is the tribes-protocol GitHub organization (smart-contract libraries and tooling) rather than a hosted REST/GraphQL developer API.

providers.name: Trillium Therapeutics
providers.description: Trillium Therapeutics was a Toronto-based clinical-stage immuno-oncology biopharmaceutical company developing cancer therapeutics (notably CD47-targeting agents). It was acquired by Pfizer in August 2021 for approximately $2.2B and no longer operates as an independent entity. Surfaced as an nea portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a life-sciences lead. Enrichment found no public developer API, SDK, documentation, or developer-portal surface; the company website no longer serves content.

providers.name: Ursula
providers.description: Ursula is a Brazil-based AI startup building AI-native characters. Founded by an Emmy-winning team with experience at Pixar, Unity, Blizzard, and Google, it combines LLMs, symbolic AI, and long-term memory to power emotionally aware digital beings that evolve and connect with users across games, apps, and digital worlds. Ursula is a seed-stage Prosus Ventures portfolio company surfaced for the API Evangelist network. It publishes no public developer API program, and at enrichment time its Framer-hosted website at ursula.ai returned HTTP 404 (site unpublished) while the domain retained valid TLS and SPF/DMARC records.

providers.name: Velostrata
providers.description: Velostrata was an enterprise cloud-migration technology company founded in 2014 by Issy Ben-Shaul and Ady Degany, headquartered in San Mateo, California with an R&D center in Netanya, Israel. Its patented agentless technology decoupled compute from storage so that workloads could run in the cloud within minutes while the bulk storage migration streamed in the background without performance degradation. Backed by Intel Capital, Norwest Venture Partners and 83North (roughly $31.5M raised across Series A and B rounds), Velostrata was acquired by Google in May 2018 (estimated $100M-$200M). The team joined Google Cloud in Tel Aviv and the product was rebranded Migrate for Compute Engine, later Migrate for Virtual Machines. Velostrata no longer operates as an independent company and publishes no independent API: velostrata.com now redirects to Google Cloud's Migrate for Virtual Machines documentation.

providers.name: Verastem
providers.description: Verastem Oncology (Verastem, Inc.) is a development-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing novel therapies for cancers driven by the RAS/MAPK pathway, including KRAS-mutant tumors. Its work includes the first FDA-approved treatment for KRAS-mutant recurrent low-grade serous ovarian cancer, plus a pipeline targeting KRAS G12D inhibition. As a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs; this profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners and enriched with verified identity only.

providers.name: Vertex Energy
providers.description: Vertex Energy is an energy transition company specializing in producing and marketing high-purity refined products including conventional fuels, renewable diesel, and other specialty products. The company operates refining and processing facilities and is engaged in the recycling and recovery of used motor oil and other petroleum byproducts. No public developer API or technical documentation portal is currently available.

providers.name: Vincentage
providers.description: Vincentage (Vincentage Pharma Co., Ltd.) is a clinical-stage biotech founded in 2021 and headquartered in Suzhou, China, developing novel small-molecule drugs for metabolic and cardiometabolic diseases including type 2 diabetes, obesity, and MASH. Its lead candidate is VCT220 (also known as CX11), an oral small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist; worldwide rights (excluding Greater China) to CX11 were acquired by Corxel Pharmaceuticals. Investors include IDG Capital, Everest VC, Shenzhen Capital Group, Galaxy Industry Group, and Kunshan Asia Aroma. Surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as a drug-discovery pharmaceutical company it publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical artifacts.

providers.name: Vivace Therapeutics
providers.description: Vivace Therapeutics is a clinical-stage, oncology-focused biotechnology company based in the San Francisco Bay Area, developing small-molecule cancer therapeutics that target the Hippo-YAP signaling pathway. Its lead candidate, VT3989, is in clinical trials for mesothelioma and other solid tumors. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a private therapeutics developer, Vivace publishes clinical-trial, scientific-publication, and corporate content, but exposes no public developer portal, API, SDK, documentation, or code repositories.

providers.name: Walker and Company *
providers.description: Walker and Company * is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of gv and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: consumer. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Walkie-Talkie
providers.description: Walkie-Talkie is a Gen Z social audio platform built by Picslo Corp that hosts live audio rooms called "frequencies" — public or private channels where users tune in and talk with friends in high-fidelity audio anytime, anywhere. Thousands of public frequencies run at any given time, connecting people around topics they choose to discuss, alongside private frequencies between close friends. The company raised $3.25M in pre-seed funding from investors including Partech, Breega, Kima Ventures, Heroic Ventures, TI Platform Ventures, LDV Partners, and Diaspora Ventures. It is a consumer mobile application with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Wecare Probiotics
providers.description: Wecare Probiotics (微康益生菌) is a Chinese biotechnology company specializing in probiotic strain research, intelligent manufacturing, and application solutions for the food, nutrition, and agriculture industries. It operates three research institutes and five intelligent manufacturing facilities across Suzhou, Luohe, and Wuhan, producing product lines including WecLac probiotics, WecPro formula, and WecCul. Its BLa80 strain became the first probiotic strain approved for infant food in mainland China. The company presents a corporate information website only; no public developer portal, API, or technical documentation is published, so this profile carries company identity rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Wiom
providers.description: Wiom is an Indian consumer internet company offering recharge-based home broadband: shared WiFi delivered over a community mesh network so households can pay only for the internet they actually use, without a mobile-data plan or a traditional fixed-line broadband contract.
